1928fa4f7e76e8290c52df2c08857a549ac2da57.en: Bibliothèque Oscar Wilde hosts a talk with DJ Christophe Ylla-Somers exploring the deep ties between African-American music and civil rights struggles. The discussion traces the evolution of genres from blues and jazz to hip-hop as expressions of social change.

20dfc1e9ff6d7d9522bd5ef0399dc11f1e621e1d.en: Médiathèque Jean-Pierre Melville hosts a performance by the brass quintet Q5. The ensemble performs a varied repertoire blending classical chamber music with popular melodies to make classical compositions accessible to all.

960f44f4a5df920e479fd886010d10869f54c337.en: Centre culturel suisse Paris hosts an afternoon of contemporary performances and artist film screenings across its spaces. Visitors can freely circulate to experience a dynamic schedule of live acts, readings, and concerts.

79d8a6b50ccdbe310ea69f9522a5d7c0d631868a.en: Bibliothèque Aimé Césaire hosts a monthly knitting session for all skill levels. Participants bring their own yarn, needles, and ideas to receive guidance on their projects.

57f5f976f718473c37c761b580a8ea4cf9227290.en: Le Petit Ney offers a sensory storytelling workshop designed for babies and their parents. Little ones can freely explore touch-friendly books while enjoying shared reading, rhymes, and gentle group moments.

0834304a451dd2726dd8858f72ef3ed4843d315f.en: Bibliothèque Saint-Eloi hosts a traditional Japanese kumihimo braiding workshop for participants aged 8 and up. Attendees will learn how to make a simple woven cord bracelet to keep or gift.

47f34435dfd175b9fc74adc6b39ab1c2557259de.en: Théâtre Montmartre Galabru presents a theatrical show following four women in a waiting room dedicated to love. The performance blends live music, dance, French songs, and humor to explore sisterhood and personal journeys.

9f64c690090479273c0a87d0950a6013705326d0.en: Families visiting the Musée Bourdelle can explore an exhibition on artist self-representation before joining a paper costume-making workshop. Children aged 6 and up weave colorful paper strips inspired by Sonia Delaunay and the futurists.

8f3690cff4769c1b59a75d301aa0771c6ad3e31d.en: The 38Riv Jazz Club hosts a concert dedicated to Música Popular Brasileira featuring vocalist Sara Miette and pianist Edouard Ravelomantsoa. The performance highlights the political and artistic evolution of Brazilian music following the bossa nova movement.

7b955ed4e04c6da037b491f38b0e7495e2432436.en: Lafayette Anticipations offers an olfactory journey featuring custom fragrances created by the scent design studio Iris & Morphée. Visitors can enjoy a contemplative walk inspired by the Japanese coastline.

eac8a0b838651c50706b9f204cc26795a91f776b.en: Médiathèque Virginia Woolf invites role-playing game enthusiasts and beginners aged 16 and older to join an evening of games. Participants must sign up in advance through Opale Rôliste to secure a table.

a05dba49a81ec553b5268c9ba26c022b42cb5c6f.en: Enjoy an evening of charming and mysterious Breton tales told by Dominique Le Guellaff and Catherine Bonheur. The storytelling session is followed by a friendly drink to wrap up the night.

6527ae29ed2713b06e96e683abfe88af809c7d43.en: La Maison des Métallos transforms into a vibrant hip-hop stage for an electrifying evening of dance battles and a closing jam session. Come cheer on the dancers and celebrate the culture.

04bca33af3ac73851699f20a97f3b2d9a301863a.en: Discover the first issue of STAND, a multidisciplinary arts magazine, at this launch event featuring poetry readings, artwork displays, and a chance to meet the creators.

40f4f737d9c1473f39336bb44526bf94889f1521.en: Hexagone MMA brings explosive fights and top French talent to the Zénith Paris La Villette for a major night of mixed martial arts.

970edc1f2d59a6e5d2ef12a2625f5a01afa512db.en: Pianist Julien Coriatt and his quintet blend jazz, Caribbean sounds, and rich contemporary grooves for a vibrant live performance at Le Baiser Salé.

04cd3c9bfd1c09f4581e5bf1589e20d7711b1300.en: Experience an all-night cinema marathon exploring the theme of freedom through five feature films, accompanied by coffee and a food selection.

e49ce454b042990b26b92cc7c7378078e3080203.en: The Fills Monkey duo celebrate twenty years of music, comedy, and stage performance with a unique anniversary show at the Olympia.

428397687b369c2285f72ab76eb880b00f8ee114.en: El Mawsili and the Chakâm duo present an evening of classical Arab-Andandalusian melodies and Persian-baroque string compositions at the Théâtre du Châtelet.

d6ab43be45c9e62ba1801ffaa7237c83d78082c2.en: La Petite Halle hosts a warm tropical evening featuring a live afro-folk set by Abou Baga followed by a tropical DJ mix.

b291cdc581188ffd78b6ffae63408114b8faac31.en: The Cinéma Le Méliès hosts a late-night Halloween movie marathon featuring themed film selections, quizzes, and special screenings.

ec08ba6c4dcc95f49ef6a24675fc71274c6a05cd.en: Oscar les vacances brings his unique blend of French chanson, electronic music, and pop to the stage for a lively concert experience.

42f4ebe11e9e5a523074dad5c4a23392d0093a41.en: Singer Anna Torres and her quintet present a concert celebrating Brazilian rhythms, jazz, and soul while paying tribute to influential female artists.

7e1e525e1695e76fe98bac6bfe0cfc2a57d1b902.en: Orchestre Hélios performs Rossini's Petite Messe Solennelle in its original version for soloists, choir, piano, and accordion inside Église Saint-Sulpice.

e07c83e8309320695d48274bc231e202b02d155b.en: American jazz vocalist Grace Maira performs live at Le Melville alongside an all-female quintet of notable musicians.

c5e6c00fa1233ee8c58f7b6535997586f9bdeba7.en: Saxophonist and clarinetist Hillai Govreen brings her New York-based quartet to the 38Riv Jazz Club for an intimate evening of contemporary improvised jazz.

26fb3d191646109b5f3ec6cf5e501a68de377fba.en: La Bellevilloise hosts a vibrant Brazilian weekend featuring live samba, pagode, and a club night spanning baile funk, afro, and tropical beats.

d5099ae2abef96b3c5f5a071d7e01c684fb297a5.en: La Machine du Moulin Rouge hosts the official Tones of Paris afterparty across two rooms with a lineup of afro, dancehall, and trap, plus a secret live performance.

21308d8e9f863126803f1ada27fee547a2b5d5a0.en: French electronic music figure Dan Ghenacia plays an extended house set at the Rex Club alongside Melody for a late-night groove.

df1b6296201bd8d9ab472dba52ca36d1d615d982.en: Explore the Japanese Butō practice through a movement workshop at Lafayette Anticipations, where body movements are guided by inner memories and emotions.

3e86ef863c25d984eb9dd2b904bd1309e2c3fc37.en: Cinéma Max Linder Panorama hosts a morning screening of George Lautner's classic film Le Professionnel, starring Jean-Paul Belmondo, preceded by breakfast.

a74968d5b433c1e03b163b9e50e9d92a395f064b.en: At the Musée Bourdelle, families with children aged 12 and up can hand-sew their own felt or velvet artist's hat. This textile workshop lets participants step into the shoes of a creator while exploring the exhibition « L’étoffe de l’artiste ».

2dfd44d0e743acc33c910bbbdbbe2450bd6b1202.en: Discover the lives and work of Beate and Serge Klarsfeld at the Mémorial de la Shoah during this 1h30 presentation. Magnetic loops are available at reception for visitors with hearing impairments.

6c08ce228752d31587a97c04975001e0f97e6310.en: Bring your classic bicycle to SOR on October 25 for professional repairs and maintenance. Book a time slot to benefit from free diagnostics alongside paid services like chain checks, wheel truing, and brake adjustments.

27ae5df22a43efea880ff3bde604dc612df0c2c1.en: The Festival Jazz Nouvelle-Orléans à la Goutte d’Or concludes its third day at Le 360 Paris Music Factory. Enjoy a cooking workshop with Jay Kazi followed by performances and a Second Line with James Andrews & NOLA French Connection.

57bf5b9ddd9282c3f78be1f55dfd0d0c5a01782f.en: The Musée du quai Branly Jacques Chirac hosts a family Sunday celebrating the arts and cultures of the Northwest Coast of America. Explore the living heritage of the First Nations through creative workshops, storytelling, and mini guided tours.

420c75bbb0bd3bd12f6200f9b51f3038fc2eed9a.en: Join this guided walking tour through Bas Belleville to explore the contemporary history of Judaism in France. The route highlights synagogues, Holocaust memorials, and remnants of North African Jewish culture in the neighborhood.

3a242fdb051c16647c19619e453821c0b6c62096.en: Galerie Arzazou presents a photography exhibition by Claude Chose from October 25 to 28. Visitors can view the works during daily hours or attend the opening reception on Monday, October 26.

e01cb121402d43d30b56a5d4a565d1baf874bb18.en: Enjoy an immersive reading party around Margaux Motin's book L'Emerveilleuse at the Maison du jardinage et du compostage. The afternoon features silent reading with tea, meditative garden walks, and creative workshops with phones safely stored away.

95677828edddd09241a5d41bf5474b42861cc6e3.en: Celebrate World Opera Day with an outdoor guided walk through Paris tracing the history of lyric art. From the Palais-Royal to the Opera district, discover the venues, composers, and stories that shaped the capital's musical heritage.

2de9f8f70c2b2b428d469757f8211e95a3abea9c.en: Meet writer PoPésie and illustrator Lena Walrus at the Maison de Balzac for a signing of their graphic novel adaptation « La canne de Balzac ». Discover how a magical walking stick that grants invisibility changes the life of a handsome young man.

1604a9cebbfdda7ff1ad4e528a5b0122ddf63015.en: The Ferme Montsouris hosts a family morning featuring a short artist-in-residence performance followed by a parent-child circus and magic workshop. Wooden games and sweet treats complete this friendly experience for all ages.

905b477316939546cc06a1c80382cec1e940405a.en: Pianist and harpsichordist Carlos Intrieri Ricci performs a solo piano concert at the Église Saint-Merry. The award-winning musician brings decades of international experience and baroque expertise to this intimate performance.

9888a4dc65ec07428a3a58887965d74e8f258269.en: Gavarnie Ensemble performs Spanish music featuring works by de Falla, Albéniz, and Bizet arranged for flute and bassoon. Sisters Ana and Carmen Mainer Martin bring their classical expertise to the Église Notre Dame du Travail.

65b3d33a2f38047924b7e0cdf312cebe7c012a21.en: At the Mémorial de la Shoah de Drancy, discover the secret WWII adventures of three courageous children fighting the Nazis in occupied France. Follow their clandestine acts of sabotage and friendship through this engaging exhibition.

4687377dc933bc5b6ee8803d974db9f44fdd701c.en: Solène Cairoli hosts a jazz jam session at the 38Riv Jazz Club alongside saxophonist Baptiste Herbin and accordionist Laurent Derache. Together, the trio explores the legendary repertoire of Django Reinhardt in an intimate Marais venue.

70766ffe89d71d7c5e94db9a66b4a0164fefd801.en: Cure your Sunday hangover at bar Chez Hubert with a psychotherapeutic bingo hosted by Lapop Lexomil. Play for drinks, food, and mystery prizes while enjoying a lively and unconventional neighborhood atmosphere.

2a129cc3f5699a52ad31b1f37aaf2271b8e9fc29.en: Supersonic hosts its weekly tribute night, this time celebrating the golden age of Britpop with live covers of Oasis. Head down for a free evening of soaring guitar anthems and timeless nineties rock hits.

4013fbca4336b6d09023fec126caa7dcffd2d01a.en: Vocalist and composer Caloé hosts her monthly Sunday jam session at Le Baiser Salé. The evening begins with a short showcase of her jazz repertoire before opening the stage to young talents and musicians alike.

d843d2b0fcb6c8d562dd8f99257a61f61290f735.en: Le Grand Rex presents a live cine-concert screening of Michel Ocelot's animated masterpiece Azur et Asmar. Gabriel Yared's original score is performed live by the Yellow Socks Orchestra alongside traditional instruments to accompany the epic tale.

d477dfb90993b8642badec3ec0517d8ae86fc09c.en: Clarinetist Hillai Govreen and seven-string guitarist Artur Vidal perform at the 38Riv Jazz Club as part of the Jazz sur Seine 2026 festival. The duo explores the intimate musical links between jazz and Brazilian choro through rich improvisation.

0d6fe8e55ff654506e187d17659b08656b1cd914.en: Ce stage d'edge painting vous invite à créer des illustrations uniques sur les tranches de vos livres préférés. Vous apprendrez les techniques de dessin et de peinture pour personnaliser votre bibliothèque.

3106a4b1b0f657ef1ad74a09e93e7a3b04040fe4.en: Le centre Paris Anim' Jean-Michel Martial propose des stages d'automne variés pour les enfants et les adultes. Au programme : hip-hop, création de bijoux, tissage, pilates et reportage vidéo.

ce4c2a9cbd3d13fbc5902f3efba81b0bbb384fb3.en: Descendez dans les caves voûtées de l'île Saint-Louis pour vivre une partie de loup-garou grandeur nature. Des comédiens en costume encadrent cette expérience immersive d'Halloween.

8375df4ad8d55d4423355ef88de5b892dfee00a5.en: Cette formation de 50 heures propose une approche complète du Yin Yoga pour devenir professeur ou praticien certifié. Vous y étudierez la théorie, l'anatomie, la méditation et le corps énergétique.

8e8351af77197bd0c82f5801bd6c22d1c15bfece.en: Florence et Violaine vous invitent à une visite contée mêlant histoires, énigmes et souvenirs. Elle fait écho à l'exposition du MAIF Social Club dédiée aux actions citoyennes et solidaires.

1e788a9bbc8d584b11835231020da0aaf8889c7c.en: À l'occasion d'Halloween, les cinémas UGC proposent une nuit de films fantastiques et horrifiques du 26 octobre au 2 novembre. La programmation variée s'adresse à tous les publics, des enfants aux amateurs de frissons.

5db15b6ec8efaae46899e178c124b016d9dc6d25.en: Ce stage de théâtre pour enfants combine expression corporelle le matin et travail de textes l'après-midi. La semaine s'achève par une représentation publique le vendredi.

270e19dd8ee317d4279c16e4697d8194bee154b5.en: Ce stage de comédie musicale au Théâtre du Temps permet aux enfants de 5 à 11 ans de s'initier au théâtre, à la danse et au chant. Un mini-spectacle est présenté en fin de stage.

908651001acb45b7e769ab3bfcd520a79d8c128e.en: Ce stage de comédie musicale destiné aux 8-12 ans propose d'explorer la danse, le chant et la présence scénique à l'Arcal. Une présentation finale est organisée pour les parents en fin de semaine.

9741cdcabc00c1a2b32cad7c17ea31e2646aa981.en: Ce stage d'art du conte vous guide dans la création d'un récit fabuleux inspiré des grands mythes. Il permet de développer la confiance en soi, l'imaginaire et la prise de parole en public.

dd06c41f47f9954f55aefc62d012af6ec597e5b2.en: Le Centre Paris Anim' Point du Jour propose un stage multiactivités sur le thème d'Halloween. Les enfants plongeront dans un univers mystérieux rempli de défis.

e2dfb6ce9924840684b163213b0381857a13b827.en: Ce stage de théâtre de marionnettes invite votre enfant à raconter des histoires et à s'exprimer à travers le jeu de marionnettes. Une activité ludique pour développer la prise de parole.

bd0b34ec16c41e7c426e6e46f8b252f0e63ee5c3.en: Ce stage vous initie aux bases de la teinture végétale et des techniques traditionnelles de pliage et de nouage. Vous repartirez avec votre propre foulard en soie et un carnet d'échantillons.

7a00e3756f2293f5b49d88781bc0d74333b23ff4.en: Ce stage pendant les vacances scolaires initie les enfants à la réalisation d'un court métrage et aux bases du montage. Une façon ludique de donner vie à leurs projets vidéo.

1dade96c2d56e559c1ddff2601d97d8d3fc3b985.en: Ce stage croisé associe baby judo et ateliers d'architecture pour les enfants de 5 à 6 ans. Une formule originale pour bouger, créer et développer sa confiance.

0679003213b9629b31dcba53c91ed98d548c3c73.en: Ce stage s'adresse aux amateurs de 16 ans et plus souhaitant approfondir leur maîtrise des couleurs. Vous y apprendrez à créer des harmonies, des contrastes et à reproduire vos teintes.

1d81310543f0bb3e212c99bdac0981e91db71f92.en: Ce stage vous initie à l'art de la ciselure pour créer des textures et des motifs sur le métal. Accessible aux débutants, il permet de réaliser vos premières créations de bijoux.

7d3225aed6d6f5872d69231a090d5314a44e9753.en: Ce stage pour les 3-4 ans combine des ateliers de construction et du baby judo. Une activité originale pour stimuler la créativité et la motricité des tout-petits.

64dbe9a44ad7fbdce72ec35f67ac40e89f51fdc9.en: Ce stage propose aux enfants de découvrir la langue espagnole à travers des activités ludiques et variées. Une expérience enrichissante pour apprendre dans la bonne humeur.

c8e3c80529bfac7bb148662644109c2c5191d8f6.en: Ce stage de maroquinerie vous apprend les étapes traditionnelles de fabrication d'une pochette entièrement cousue à la main. Vous y découvrirez la coupe du cuir, la couture sellier et les finitions.

543da2dc97766df54ed4774bda87f67aa3684340.en: Ce stage d'acrylique à Paris - Ateliers / BOTZARIS propose de revisiter les techniques du père de l'art moderne à travers le paysage et la nature morte. Une immersion créative idéale pour approfondir sa pratique artistique.

178e55dca8cc51e3613c25f61dff71b98fc6d963.en: Le Centre Paris Anim' Eugène Oudiné propose une initiation au mix et aux techniques de base du DJing pour apprendre à créer ses premiers mix.

7a4e9ad5043f9055721b3b0510143c91b2ce5adc.en: Le cinéma Le Brady propose une projection du programme de courts métrages "La Petite Fanfare de Noël" accompagnée d'un atelier bruitage avec l'association Et si les images. Une expérience ludique pour découvrir les sons de l'hiver.

d1db4c3b40c83f3c671715f63c5daa7d7d61b31c.en: Le centre Paris Anim' Wangari Muta Maathai propose un stage de baby gym pour initier les enfants de 3 à 5 ans pendant les vacances d'automne.

e58498a5a043aff23e9c3c555c3c233e88ea8579.en: Le centre Paris Anim' Wangari Muta Maathai invite les enfants de 6 à 10 ans à découvrir la pratique de la gym lors d'un stage pendant les vacances d'automne.

ccaf97860b52a8277ed21d3f89002d8109693048.en: L'Espace 23 Rue du Sentier accueille l'exposition "Miyagi Atelier Selection" pour faire découvrir le patrimoine artisanal et les savoir-faire traditionnels de la région de Miyagi.

ed0e97cc316b1d4145fe1bd0da76265525b9dabc.en: Ce stage de théâtre mené par Margot Abascal aux Salles Saint-Roch permet d'explorer le jeu d'acteur, l'improvisation et la prise de parole à travers une approche sensorielle.

aabaa2dae02ee43b81b6574b00433a631adad99f.en: Le Centre Paris Anim' Marc Sangnier propose un stage de stop-motion pour apprendre à animer des objets image par image.

c92c51a109258602ea90cffbd51253ad1a9a406a.en: Le Centre Paris Anim' Point du Jour organise un stage de couture ludique pour les 7-10 ans afin de concevoir un costume d'Halloween unique.

d4c40c29b73b8d1d0749b24e80e1214fbcc1277a.en: Le Centre Paris Anim' Eugène Oudiné propose un atelier créatif d'activités manuelles pour plonger dans l'univers d'Halloween.

531be374dd5a1be29b739995d9f4db90cb3b631b.en: Le centre Paris Anim' Wangari Muta Maathai propose un stage d'initiation à la gravure pour les enfants de 6 à 10 ans pendant les vacances d'automne.

472303e16d8e5a489bcbf915f6b804d3f8dc564f.en: Le Centre Paris Anim' Marc Sangnier propose un stage de kitchen gravure pour enfants, permettant de créer des images sans produits chimiques grâce à des matériaux simples.

67c25e0ca36d3363d67879afefe3f49dae0322d9.en: Le Centre Paris Anim' Baudricourt propose un stage de mathématiques pour collégiens afin de se préparer aux examens et d'acquérir de nouvelles connaissances.

3ef74f3c114c0aad3c6366bec3939d11be33d6c8.en: Ce stage de dessin organisé à Paris - Ateliers / SAMPAIX permet de maîtriser la perspective et la composition pour illustrer des espaces intérieurs et extérieurs.

8e3efcc0cf1c2bd1a8845ef9075a7c2d10d9727f.en: La Maison Européenne de la Photographie propose un stage pour les 12-15 ans encadré par Élise Toïdé, combinant déambulation urbaine et création de récits visuels.

9bfb00511c8c44c59a7a85bc73a673657d0e7012.en: Le centre Paris Anim' Wangari Muta Maathai propose un stage de cirque parent-enfant pour partager une activité conviviale pendant les vacances d'automne.

56ebd30fb6daa38bf971151f748a4170f2638efe.en: Le Centre Paris Anim' Baudricourt propose un stage de mathématiques pour lycéens afin de consolider les acquis et de se préparer aux examens.

87a4cde5d82c0532375f1b2dfef777d954554d73.en: Le centre Paris Anim' Wangari Muta Maathai accueille les adultes pour un stage de crochet afin d'apprendre ou de perfectionner cette technique.

06c84599918a98d9cb6e8efd9a1bc31fbf003f62.en: Le centre Paris Anim' Wangari Muta Maathai propose un stage de fitness féminin pour découvrir la discipline ou renforcer son corps pendant les vacances.

e73b998901597dd0bb06971f3f3993eeec541cc4.en: Le Centre Paris Anim' Grange aux Belles propose un stage de pilates animé par Laury pour travailler le renforcement musculaire, la souplesse et la respiration.

95590ba723682e1ca08079059f5faf617c4d73f3.en: This writing workshop at Centre Paris Anim' Grange aux Belles invites you to explore emotions and imagination through joyful exercises involving both mind and body. It is led by writer Claire Ubac.

3fbf981478231db2673860ceb520bcd4a32750f7.en: Catch the French theatrical premiere of Yoshifumi Kondo's masterpiece Whisper of the Heart at Cinéma Max Linder Panorama. The screening on October 26 is preceded by Hayao Miyazaki's short On Your Mark and introduced by Marc Aguesse.

2df4821b2161034f24c4863fccd1d83198b00855.en: Head to Le Baiser Salé for a lively evening celebrating Hard Bop jazz. A stellar quartet led by François Constantin kicks off the night before opening the stage to an open jam session.

f88d21c7626fdb92bfb9891eefbd7282793b4c5f.en: Experience a live-action werewolf game inside vaulted underground caves near Notre-Dame at Le Secret de l'Île. Actors in costume guide you through secrets, debates, and puzzles in this immersive Halloween adventure.

99c6d413343b6c8b813dadd7d66b2eecbea78a5f.en: Discover rising jazz talent Dylan Choisi at the intimate 38Riv Jazz Club in the Marais. The trio blends traditional Guadeloupean rhythms with contemporary jazz and improvisation.

48380c904aba3d5a7d6decb6b505e7e6b4e2d475.en: Learn to make popular Korean street food classics like spicy chicken cup-bap during hands-on workshops at the Centre Culturel Coréen. It is a great way to explore comforting flavors and modern Korean culinary fusion.

65dabb9a6e3eb19923c441fd8899e3d8f96e377c.en: Spend four days at Paris - Ateliers mastering the art of wall weaving with instructor Mathilde Dupont. You will set up your own loom and learn various techniques to create a personalized textile piece.

4c8f49820c07f3077348f9610f6ae546b858c097.en: Join a nature-themed tree rally designed for young explorers at the Maison Paris Nature in the Parc Floral de Paris. Registration is free but mandatory.

97daa3fcef761b475b4ceae280cd5b30dadaf3b6.en: Explore the family history of Simone Veil through a guided tour and creative workshops at the Mémorial de la Shoah. Adults practice letter-writing while children illustrate key moments in a comic strip format.

ea1c011c92bf2892b20ff63d70aaba25d34c2eb2.en: Take a guided walking tour of Parc Monceau, a romantic park commissioned by a prince and redesigned during the Second Empire. Discover its winding paths, historic trees, and picturesque ruins starting from the boulevard de Courcelles entrance.

84e7c9976fcd1a9b29e09cef96a77ac8e8fe16fd.en: Brighten up pre-drawn travel postcards using watercolor and colored pencils during a workshop led by artist Elisabeth Ledoux at Centre Paris Anim' Bessie Smith. All materials are provided for a relaxing two-hour creative escape.

e2891854b316c08c73c4d234d85882e795aa1c64.en: Learn how to make a tawashi, a reusable Japanese sponge, out of old socks at the Bibliothèque Maurice Genevoix. This accessible workshop introduces eco-friendly habits and waste reduction in a fun, hands-on way for anyone aged 8 and up.

5ac47eda323274a052f8fdc6a3d0aa595922acbf.en: Join Joanna at Le Point Éphémère for the launch of Experimentation 001, featuring a live podcast talk, an exclusive music video screening, and a DJ set. It is a new gathering designed to share music and forge connections in fresh ways.

ddacee51a327ffd6ab856db48ea734357edda1d5.en: Attend a discussion at the Fondation Maison des Sciences de l'Homme exploring what plastic waste reveals about modern society and recycling limits. Researcher Jeanne Perez and public affairs director Henri Bourgeois Costa lead the talk, moderated by Mathieu Vidard.

8e02df0a25450331a122e1ce0787b527d7581a0b.en: Discover 21 international indie and alternative artists making their Paris debut during the third edition of the They're Gonna Be Big festival across the Supersonic venues and La Seine Café.

640035ef034ee1318657717a23c23df6d94521da.en: Kick off the They're Gonna Be Big festival on October 27 with performances by international indie and post-punk acts like Mleko, Date Camp, Alien Boy, and Tracey Nelson across local venues.

d8e07536ed67c63aef0decd63fb232abcedc3b79.en: Melanie C brings her global tour to La Machine du Moulin Rouge to celebrate the release of her ninth solo album, Sweat.

1fe5d5e47a08e5535b76ae7dd7ba84fdcaf0407b.en: Listen to pianists perform at the Médiathèque Marguerite Yourcenar during this open auditorium session. Spectators can attend freely while pianists register in advance.

7cb81a0ffa6d3d1206cdc074f6e0ef7b8536c77a.en: Celebrate independent reporting and investigative journalism at the Théâtre de la Concorde during the 2026 Albert-Londres Prize ceremony. The evening brings together reporters and thinkers to honor rigorous journalism as a democratic pillar.

e12ad664a28d59c110e8d4631fbb8fbaf291070f.en: Dance modern 4-beat rock in a friendly atmosphere near Place d'Italie at Digital Village. Enjoy beginner and intermediate classes followed by a social party with two distinct rooms.

df3eb4e0b490359a842bd7e7e3066c5e75ea7f92.en: Fédia Amice performs with Yann Phayphet and Jérôme Renaud at Le Melville, blending original music with jazz traditions through expressive guitar work.

fc995a0ee65f55d178da4b0f143bdccc339d2cb9.en: The 38Riv Jazz Club hosts the Nina Gat Trio for an intimate evening of original compositions blending jazz, pop, ambient, and folk influences.

c2adba247efae174dd1f0d700f8cf62d9f221806.en: The MPAA/Saint-Blaise hosts monthly sound creation workshops on computer-assisted music using GarageBand and Ableton Live with 129H STUDIO producers.

38cdc1ab1de15ff03566fcd509a7a8978e526e98.en: At the MAIF Social Club, artist Sasha shares his childhood collection of objects and guides children in creating their own unique creature sculptures.

ecdca0e2aeadad75e59f4bd2a0e6489abfebb810.en: The Cinéma Max Linder Panorama screens László Nemes' film Moulin in 35mm, following Jean Moulin's confrontation with the Gestapo in June 1943.

8ab226b6246c9d543942b3ef4d271523e636802b.en: An outdoor exhibition on the gates of Parc des Buttes-Chaumont explores the Mexican Día de Muertos tradition, celebrating life, memory, and heritage.

3b1e27bf3ad7b1de409697cd9df3e4e508ce8485.en: Maison Paris Nature hosts a quiz about scary animals at the Pavillon 1 of the Parc Floral de Paris.

20bae255ff8b82c2ee6c218a1eb01e7fd1a16c8b.en: CPA Curial hosts a dance and play session led by Ash from 02dansethérapie, offering a shared moment of exploration for parents and children.

605daa0ecf5750b29a5a0652446d0345c6d8e97b.en: Piscine Georges Hermant hosts a spooky Halloween event in its diving pit featuring a horror course, a clown challenge, drawing contests, and candy.

c81b5830c0d1253058614a5c319514b92c571811.en: Piscine Georges Hermant transforms its diving pit into a horror course for Halloween, featuring games, a drawing contest, and candy.

04f085f9ac0663e770f036e81dfd241a3da85c22.en: CPA Curial presents Resto Dingo, a musical clown comedy by Sébastien Petiot and Clown et Mental following the trials of a historic restaurant server.

7208389ed3b845396f6889e2f0746db5f745e24d.en: The 38Riv Jazz Club hosts a family-friendly cine-concert for ages 4 and up featuring magical films by Georges Méliès accompanied by live music.

fc166e084de6b0485f63e86ccb9931441d22176a.en: The Maison des 1000 premiers jours du 20ème arrondissement hosts a knitting and crochet social session where babies are welcome and help is available.

d9570e3ec8c24d1416c34784bd276c0c1f831e53.en: L'Atelier de la Ressourcerie Créative hosts a beginner-friendly workshop for children aged 6 to 14 to craft colorful decorations from egg cartons.

29e01e538cec3598fab6c2ac2b7616368b602055.en: Bibliothèque Benoîte Groult hosts a waste sorting and environmental awareness workshop for adults and children aged 6 and older.

7d7b02194abaede2d90e3052f75de3fe4220e29d.en: Ressourcerie Le Plant B invites parents and children aged 5 and up to create a living Halloween creature using succulent plants.

b0b34945406e7a21fe7ed6cd75370face4242b20.en: The Maison Européenne de la Photographie offers a family guided tour for children aged 6 to 12 inspired by the Penn & Fashion exhibition.

7fc19c7b150341f003bac6116b5e2c4a444951b3.en: Musée Bourdelle invites families with children aged 7 and up to create floral cyanotype prints inspired by artist costumes.

0e368d24bd87b0a189d79fdc51bf83d80fe3922d.en: CPA Curial presents Diagnostik, a play by Compagnie A Ciel Fermé exploring mental illness, youth, and caregiving through humor and emotion.

5b2070876b79e198bd600146625746fd8c70831d.en: Bibliothèque Marguerite Audoux hosts a family film screening for children during the school holidays.

9813dfe932e7e7ef5f2125d6e0d8f984d2ec0b8d.en: Meet American young adult author Veronica Roth at Fnac Forum des Halles. Registration is required.

ad54a97e062341d3ca54ed8d1370b66ba96ccbd3.en: Head to Bibliothèque des Batignolles for an origami workshop. Learn paper-folding techniques and take home your own jumping frog.

4831ba587def541c2772d2a21050090fca43e3a7.en: Join the aerial circus camp at Centre Paris Anim' Wangari Muta Maathai. Learn or improve your skills on straps and the smooth rope during the autumn holidays.

54595b4f79bfe291748835c7789f1388ef633b83.en: Day 2 of the TGBB Festival takes over SUPERSONIC on October 28, 2026. Enjoy an energetic lineup featuring international noise rock, grunge pop, and electro punk acts.

0038fc6b02959888b0a580e4c5b22c82d51d928f.en: Experience Haute Couture at Théâtre Le 13e Art, a contemporary dance show by choreographic pioneer Josépha Madoki. The performance turns the fashion runway into a striking choreographic arena.

b521c87318b894a3bdfe1f314ddb57760f60b72a.en: Attend a conference at the Maison d'Auguste Comte dedicated to Maximilien Marie. Françoise Decoursier-Sandoz explores the life, scientific work, and legacy of this remarkable mathematician and thinker.

723ff0d78baa745da89ccef2b863306a280b14dd.en: Discover Cheoyongmu at the Centre Culturel Coréen, a traditional Korean court dance inscribed on the UNESCO intangible cultural heritage list. Five dancers perform in traditional colors to celebrate this ancient art.

3fbb327343bf02e68b59bc6c61da94689f96c9b1.en: Participate in a forum theater session hosted by collectif La Formule at TLM. The event explores youth mental health through concrete situations and shared actions.

9851cc2d903477f736b1c9d1a0202770d2fbdc19.en: Catch the Fabien Mary Organ Trio at Le Melville for an evening of jazz. The group blends great American songbook standards with compositions echoing the Blue Note label.

d41c4ebbbf358a539cfa6e331dec2816608a4d10.en: Enjoy an evening of Latin American music at Sunset Sunside with Trio Escualo. Violin, bandolim, and double bass come together for a vibrant and virtuosic performance.

f4f6272280c2cad37478ce846c0d6040ce448ff8.en: Experience an intimate musical journey with the Lisa Berri Quartet at Le Baiser Salé. Enjoy subtle lyrics and velvety melodies brought to life by virtuoso musicians.

54b7ee7df472401b06ee3a0b70cd4c8678e4513f.en: Enjoy an evening of jazz standards and original compositions with Deconfin, Nyberg, and Bäckman at the 38Riv Jazz Club. The trio brings energy and subtlety to this intimate Marais venue.

1a57b4aff82483d409cc886905b041150229ebae.en: Startup For Girls returns to the Conseil Régional d'Ile-de-France for a special AI edition. Middle and high school girls can spend two days building apps, pitching ideas, and meeting tech professionals.

02efd94de9159ad17860a74bf9dc6ef440b6ada0.en: Celebrate Halloween at Piscine Thérèse et Jeanne Brulé with a festive morning for children under 12. Enjoy a pumpkin hunt, an aquatic obstacle course, and face painting.

5e18b3037c76cbab7d7d542cedf609fbee75f3a5.en: Watch Michel Ocelot's animated film Princes et Princesses at Cinéma Le Brady. Participate in a giant goose game hosted by Marine Moutot to explore fairy tales and the birth of cinema.

692b9ed8aca249dee76e738c1042ef69c068eda5.en: Join a walking tour starting from the Académie du Climat to explore the historical green transformations of central Paris. Discover local urban forests, river parks, and memorial gardens.

8388467c0ee6c7545665d460e667a4cfd0b17015.en: Browse a grand Japanese vintage market on Rue Bailly featuring imported homeware, vintage clothing, and traditional crafts. Admission is free and open daily.

449bdc920066f7ae9536bbe1b6cf45c3d058f71d.en: Join a contemplative conference at Club Montparnasse focused on the wonders of nature. Learn to find calm, observe small details, and connect with the living world.

967a1bfed6d2803c4ce23c87d612636fc5f3b414.en: Watch the animated film Linda veut du poulet at Cinéma Les 7 Parnassiens. Take part in a collaborative drawing workshop led by Marine Moutot before the screening.

7c90ec3108a191726624e526c01f565932698576.en: Bring kids to Bibliothèque Maurice Genevoix for an upcycled Halloween workshop. Transform tin cans into quirky monster bowling pins and play a game together.

f4a7e35f6162e25b22f392723c63766ec9c9a052.en: Pendant les vacances scolaires, la Bibliothèque Gutenberg propose une session cinéma adaptée aux enfants à partir de 6 ans. L'entrée est libre.

7d63f70180203d2d9d885ce2b5b42903e6ce2c32.en: Artazart accueille Tom Haugomat et Bérengère Cournut pour une dédicace de leur ouvrage « Jeanne et Nicodème ». Venez rencontrer les auteurs.

9ca0446753cd3fecac5ed1d26808487e45521cd1.en: La Bibliothèque des Batignolles présente un concert dans le cadre de la 26e édition de Musique en bibliothèque avec l'association Par ici la Scène.

b2b832007b5e632a2b8f1caf607f2226c0fecd01.en: La Mairie du 11e arrondissement accueille Rire en Scène, un tremplin de stand-up pour découvrir les humoristes de demain. Le public vote pour son artiste préféré à chaque représentation.

54c1b995952e182aedb451292eb708d45f3b766b.en: La Fondation Maison des Sciences de l'Homme accueille une soirée de présentation de l'ouvrage « Le désir d'avant-garde » avec l'auteur Sina Abédi et l'architecte Richard Scoffier.

6a6cbb90725279d779f689340cd15dc7c0791ef9.en: La Maison de la Conversation propose « Ne vous inquiétez pas », un spectacle-débat suivi d'un échange sur la prostitution des enfants en France. L'entrée est gratuite.

001ac223249b31f20df4de3414336a57160ff033.en: L'Institut Suédois invite l'artiste Andreas Eriksson pour une rencontre autour de son travail et de son rapport à l'œuvre d'Ivan Aguéli. L'entrée est libre.

37dc497568ca7672bacd007f46ed910b737885e8.en: La Bibliothèque publique d'information propose une rencontre animée par Mathieu Slisse pour explorer la réalité économique et commerciale de la mort.

22c6746b4518908d21a2e39ddf8f759c3e25c5e8.en: L'Institut des Cultures d'Islam accueille une conférence de John Tolan sur la figure du Prophète dans les écrits des auteurs des Lumières en Occident.

67f44ea48dad1fdebf7d53cb575b04110428f72a.en: Le SUPERSONIC accueille la troisième journée du TGBB Festival 2026 avec une programmation post-punk, noise et synthwave. Venez découvrir plusieurs groupes sur scène.

169914e28fef9b3d0e43c31b60400e86c440f086.en: La Maison de la Conversation accueille le Greenwashing comedy club pour une soirée de stand-up autour de l'écologie et de la justice sociale. L'entrée est gratuite.

798094fc69ecffadd930213b7aef66fc9deea797.en: Le Théâtre de la Concorde présente « Faut-il séparer l’homme de l’artiste ? », un spectacle hybride mêlant enquête journalistique et théâtre documentaire mis en scène par Étienne Gaudillère et Giulia Foïs.

b2cf79e45bf2a734cb5bcd7d9306258df0007b53.en: La Philharmonie de Paris accueille Maâlem Abdelkébir Merchane et Hind Ennaira pour un concert de musique gnaoua. Venez découvrir cet art ancestral et ses sonorités de transe.

7093fb4e84573c8772c06fb7edf128395185dc73.en: Le Melville accueille le Seb Joulie Group pour une soirée jazz post-bop menée par Sébastien Joulie à la guitare. Il est entouré de Stéphane Moutot, Slim Chikhaoui et Charles Clayette.

220ac817a71578a1eadbfc9357cc9f6be613dc1e.en: Le Studio de l'Ermitage accueille Ghost_Rhythms pour un concert de jazz surréaliste explorant les moments manquants de nos vies.

ff290f3fecb957f40c2507bfc80a3c814c08b9fc.en: Le 38Riv Jazz Club propose une lecture musicale bilingue dès 7 ans autour de Mary Lou Williams, figure majeure du jazz. La séance est suivie d'un temps d'échange.

2d1427584cd0213a09ae7c30a6cb7f04d16cec1c.en: Le Cinéma Le Brady propose une projection de 'The Queen of My Dreams' de Fawzia Mirza et du court-métrage 'Makan' de Ghanwa Rana, suivie d'une discussion.

9ab963be2aede0945860c33e7b1ccbec985932f1.en: Le 38Riv Jazz Club accueille Camille Bertault en quintet pour une soirée mêlant chanson, improvisation, slam et jazz. L'artiste revisitera ses répertoires et présentera des inédits.

8bcad34ca9e93da9191a555856d4c34075eaf679.en: Le Baiser Salé accueille Arlet Feuillard & The Syntest Quintet dans le cadre du créneau #JazzDeDemain. Venez découvrir de nouvelles compositions aux influences variées.

9a0cfdd44bf6d02e32b76d69569204f6e7a09842.en: La Seine Musicale présente La Cage aux Folles, une comédie musicale mise en scène par Olivier Py avec Laurent Lafitte. Une œuvre festive et politique célébrant la diversité.

60705de215a3d439f8015c1d177e658e7dce94ee.en: Dream Nation returns to Parc des expo Paris Nord Villepinte for a three-night indoor Halloween celebration. Electronic music fans can enjoy immersive sets across various genres alongside light shows and festive animations.

6afec2d8168cd2d34b2c5ad7d7972add561f4167.en: At Théâtre de la Ville – Sarah Bernhardt, Emily Terndrup presents Offspring (A Modern Frankenstein), a solo performance blending intimate confession and reflection on motherhood and artistic creation.

664a5b73c5f0453394b2c2ffbc8eced3ddef9ab7.en: The Grünt Festival takes over Grande Halle de la Villette to showcase the vibrant new generation of independent French rap. Visitors can discover rising talents and original performances from the contemporary scene.

73cb28d7bd4fc63039ee145b630ae7486e3f91a1.en: At Musée de l'histoire de l'immigration, this exhibition explores the unique cultural history and heritage of Maghrebi filmmakers and actors in French cinema since the 1960s through films, posters, and archives.

b77512f8101e6b5a84ae8dd5aeaa834e50596a55.en: Festival Les Femmes S’en Mêlent promotes women in music and LGBTQIA+ visibility through concerts across France. It offers an alternative programming space and discussions supporting female artists' careers.

086c59d56448b50f505e017443b3366234723eb1.en: Maison Paris Nature hosts a discovery event dedicated to myriapods at the Pavillon 1 du Parc Floral de Paris. Free registration is required to attend this guided nature animation.

4b5addecd492a6a9ea2c2f5135179658404d3159.en: La Ferme de Paris hosts a permaculture workshop focused on sustainable ecosystems, slow solutions, and renewable resources. Participants can take part in hands-on activities with mandatory registration.

176e86d9476ea67a8fd64e39a6f1566f967eaba3.en: Hosted at Palais de la Porte Dorée, this exhibition highlights the rich cinematic heritage and contributions of Maghrebi directors and actors to French culture. Visitors can discover rare archives, film excerpts, and photographs.

b70485018050c3f69bd1b7c68f1c24dacfccb8be.en: Join a guided walking tour of Parc Montsouris to discover its Second Empire green heritage, rare shrubs, and varied trees. The tour meets at the park's boulevard Jourdan entrance near the RER B station.

a1fe3fb052a08f95f0ce7423942311477b42cfb0.en: Centre Wallonie-Bruxelles presents Ré-Amarrage, a collaborative xeno-exhibition showcasing works and research from artists returning from various residencies. Visitors can explore experimental projects bridging contemporary art and science.

defb308c58dd560de03cd46ace88799a2072b541.en: At 38Riv Jazz Club, Louise and Jeremy perform a four-hand piano concert blending jazz and classical music. Suitable for audiences aged 7 and up, this intimate session is part of the Graines de jazz festival.

67e634637631bd6f2e5d8b890ec512cde0707515.en: L'Atelier de la Ressourcerie Créative offers a beginner-friendly workshop for children aged 6 to 14 to craft their own Halloween lanterns. All materials are provided, and accompanying adults must also register.

4f354077685b6bc8fe839ec8eed146c552e2edfa.en: At Maison du jardinage et du compostage, learn how to recognize indoor plants and discover the proper care they need according to their specific requirements.

222662b41057f5ad850fd41eb432a435e30a8b4e.en: Centre Paris Anim’ Mado Robin hosts a storytelling walk for children aged 3 and up. Young listeners can enjoy playful and poetic tales exploring their natural environment.

b7e7c04853f25590e5e8bed6fdc46b8f59577cc2.en: The traditional Irish choir Schola Gregoriana Maynooth performs a free concert at église St Philippe du Roule to celebrate its 25th anniversary. Enjoy traditional Irish songs, folk music, and Gregorian chant.

3a754d2ca841cb233af26921832dd8e14ccab937.en: Hôtel de la Marine hosts recurring historical costume balls ranging from the 1900s to Victorian times. Guests can enjoy courtyard dances, building visits, and festive gatherings.

e4bcfb19cf175adca608f75b4f6390022df4a9dd.en: Le Troisième Café hosts a small digital workshop for adults where participants can get step-by-step guidance on their computer devices. Registration is mandatory for this small group session.

4443bd648263662a389a003b6dd59c366337a803.en: Église Saint-Paul-Saint-Louis welcomes the renowned Bath Abbey Choir for a musical performance. Directed by Huw Williams, the ensemble showcases Britain's rich choral tradition.

7ceec61fa1c50cd149039b2eab42011a25bc7ebd.en: Association Carnet de Bals brings historical dancing back to the salons of Hôtel de la Marine. Visitors can watch demonstrations or participate in period dances in the courtyard.

5b04654b3b4b56db06567a21fafc52061af5a8fc.en: Hôtel de la Marine invites visitors to themed autumn costume balls with music and dancing from various past eras. Reservations are required to join the courtyard dances and monument tours.

ef52470568347864e50039403935866cf41364ee.en: L'Hôtel de la Marine invite le public à une enquête immersive le vendredi 30 octobre. Plongez dans une aventure nocturne pour percer un mystère ancien entre jeux de lumière et silhouettes énigmatiques.

ae873d5f70fc9fec1fb2c0fa600b106f77021c73.en: Le Centre Culturel Coréen accueille les réalisatrices Kim Mi-jo et Kim Ji-hyun pour une rencontre dédiée au cinéma coréen contemporain. Venez échanger avec elles à l'occasion du Festival du Film Coréen à Paris.

c74eb3ca0ad6a2904281a2aad15f50e848efa7d0.en: La Médiathèque Françoise Sagan organise une battle de puzzle en équipe. Des jeux de société seront également disponibles sur place pour le public et les accompagnants.

46885ebba4e81ad4788e8c55649b35d0d495b811.en: L'Espace des Sciences Pierre-Gilles de Gennes propose une chasse au trésor scientifique nocturne pour Halloween. Résolvez des énigmes en équipe pour aider Madame Lafrousse à retrouver ses pouvoirs d'épouvante.

1b4e2a5e01ebf5fcddf3f16a2f02a6b224b645ca.en: La Mécanique Ondulatoire accueille une soirée pop-rock indépendante le vendredi 30 octobre. Venez découvrir les univers complémentaires de FEATHER AID, BRINKERT et MOÏZO lors de concerts live.

cb04ff574cda1dc6b41de173eb8fd9636275edf3.en: Le Klub accueille une soirée dark folk le vendredi avec Blood And Sun, Society Of The Silver Cross et Linnea Hjertén. L'occasion de découvrir des univers musicaux sombres et intenses lors de cette date parisienne.

84c72d58c332ce7330087efcafb233ad5ab001fa.en: Le Théâtre Ouvert présente L'atelier québécois-Détours, une pièce entre huis-clos anxiogène et comédie existentialiste. Une réflexion poétique sur la nécessité de l'espoir et les chemins imprévus de la vie.

81aecb3e9ea5266b84b407513189f8e4b6f3bc32.en: Le CPA Annie Fratellini accueille le finissage de l'exposition Tránsitos de l'artiste Fernando Garcia Quintero. Venez participer à une rencontre conviviale avec l'artiste et assister à des lectures autour de son travail.

1ee1d9c4ace58ee7c5b6729a6eaa52d86c118744.en: Le Théâtre de la Concorde présente 24 Place Beaumarchais, un spectacle écrit par Adèle Gascuel et mis en scène par Catherine Hargreaves. Une création théâtrale vivante et rassembleuse portée par l'interprétation de Brahim Koutari.

14fcd7881f4513924ad54914c4f34c0546786940.en: AK4SEVEN se produira en concert à La Place pour une soirée dédiée au rap et à l'afro-urbain. Venez découvrir son univers musical hybride et son énergie live communicative le 30 octobre 2026.

9f7fa348e4dea5feea3f6f6d176799714cce695c.en: La Salle Espace Sud de la Cité Universitaire propose un stage de danse classique pour adultes débutants et moyens. Venez danser le vendredi 30 octobre de 19h à 20h30.

31c04708975098843fd9acd236041123bd03346e.en: Supersonic Records accueille le groupe indie psychédéliquant allemand Marcoca en concert le vendredi 30 octobre 2026. Venez découvrir leur musique hypnotique aux influences variées lors de cette soirée parisienne.

12e7e119dfccd2fc9474b9dabe820016310800ee.en: L'AGECA accueille le spectacle de clown Le Grand Soir le 30 octobre à 20h. Une représentation ouverte aux spectateurs à partir de 10 ans en participation libre.

02d91c078151dc5b348c5c35feb491be247d4294.en: Le Théâtre Mandapa propose une lecture musicale et poétique avec Mariann Mathéus et Patrick Karl. Un voyage littéraire autour de l'œuvre et de la vie de Simone Schwarz-Bart et Yann Plougastel.

e0baf665ceaef05014c1217d4d7bf7eb3c81c247.en: La Salle Espace Sud de la Cité Universitaire accueille un stage de danse jazz pour niveaux débutant et moyen. Rejoignez la séance le vendredi 30 octobre de 20h30 à 22h.

cba8fc7d28724b77ea451ab90164224628700bba.en: Le Théâtre Ouvert présente S'entrechoquer, une pièce qui explore comment un jeune homme surmonte le deuil et une agression. Une création théâtrale rythmée qui cherche la jubilation malgré tout.

f72427433fa3397a4d5fa3b83166bfefa6a2464f.en: L'Église de La Madeleine accueille un concert commémoratif des funérailles de Chopin de 1849. L'Orchestre et le Chœur Hélios interpréteront notamment le Requiem de Mozart sous la direction de Mathieu Cabanes.

734262dfaaee99fb99c773eeb5c94a6a3a302a72.en: Le Melville accueille le projet Cookin' With pour un hommage aux compositions de Dexter Gordon. Le pianiste Alix Logiaco et le saxophoniste Florian Marques revisitent le jazz mainstream des années 1950 et 1960.

7e4417d94190a6e3042cc3aec688f0c18c4213eb.en: Le 38Riv Jazz Club accueille Cipher, un nouveau quartet de jazz norvégien. Venez découvrir leur complicité musicale et leur univers d'improvisation dans une salle intimiste au cœur du Marais.

2bddc2abb5b51f5d66d45a608a5a9457c09d33ae.en: Le Supersonic organise sa soirée emblématique dédiée à l'indie rock des années 2000. Profitez d'un DJ set et d'un concert tribute pour faire trembler le dance floor toute la nuit.

0566b6773b69e5e46172110bb3cf8bb2431a5f18.en: La Machine du Moulin Rouge hosts an Undercover Halloween party with live music by Bedry, two rooms featuring rage room and good vibes sets, and a mandatory costume dress code.

b42231b2cb3f0de2ba7e7b80682f47b351d927cd.en: Parisian libraries invite visitors of all ages to celebrate Halloween with free animations, mysterious stories, and fantasy workshops. Drop by to discover new tales and enjoy some light chills.

ce2c9edd53034e2fc75b2b7aae4964a7815ca910.en: Cinema Ciné 104 celebrates Halloween with screenings of Shaun of the Dead and Resident Evil, plus a special children's screening featuring Shaun the Sheep, costumes, and muffins.

8724c56fa01751e517ce227a1ed96f095b0a6d2b.en: El Clúb at Le Trabendo hosts Sueños Del Infierno, a diabolical night of reggaeton, cumbia RKT, and dembow with DJs and performers for all vampires and creatures of the night.

e591300d1ad9a14c8a4da907c004b5cd16ea98db.en: Galerie Joseph hosts the interactive Hello Kitty Beyond Cute experience across three distinct chapters featuring immersive lights, creative workshops, and a matcha tea space.

f6dce4c0bdf76f47f6c32d8f3f2487a7c651f09f.en: The Médiathèque Virginia Woolf hosts a spooky writing workshop on October 31 to write about witches, curses, ghosts, and mysterious encounters with plenty of laughs and thrills.

d460549dd57e1f8a31375c402915c36a46a3492f.en: Families can enjoy a free one-hour cruise on the Bateaux Mouches for children in costume, complete with sweets distributed before boarding to discover Paris from the water.

825f027daab1e24bbf23dfd7bd57087700c4f599.en: STUDIO BLEU 20ème hosts a unique K-pop dance workshop with Jello, featuring a 90-minute choreography session, Q and A, and exclusive tour merchandise for participants.

9c7169219c2e3faba3f34d08498e55354e19bffd.en: Bibliothèque Václav Havel hosts a video game celebration featuring free arcade music games like Dance Dance Revolution and Taiko no Tatsujin provided by Make Some Noise.

d2d097db8c685264f075c159854388dd457a0f3a.en: Bibliothèque Maurice Genevoix hosts a special Halloween art workshop where children use negative printing, stencils, and paint to create spooky ghosts, bats, and pumpkins.

7bfb99b8eea729b4f0a902395b247eff34533e91.en: Bibliothèque Saint-Eloi invites children aged 8 and up to create nature-inspired artwork using drawing and collage techniques reminiscent of the painter Arcimboldo.

433ac941fa857db1f79df3cc2eacb42428cc49cf.en: Bibliothèque Maurice Genevoix hosts a special Halloween board game session for young children featuring observation games, memory challenges, and friendly monsters.

7e4c53ecae2b9639fc1d60c3c540a25189477188.en: Clément leads a guided walking tour through central Paris exploring the history of anti-Semitic spoliations, forced labor, and property looting by the Vichy regime and Nazis.

34fb7b46ba50a77cc8d067438fc0253794a1a0c2.en: Explore Rue de la Folie Méricourt on October 31 for a Halloween scavenger hunt with a costume parade at 15:00 and prizes to be won across the neighborhood.

633e4875bb1e7d04b0f97f7193e3946e57986cc5.en: Bibliothèque Maurice Genevoix hosts a gentle Halloween storytelling session for children aged 2 and up featuring friendly ghosts, witches, and monsters in a welcoming atmosphere.

b6d7da35f3d73e32075cd83ae4ce070d7e27287e.en: Bibliothèque Maurice Genevoix hosts a full day of Halloween activities including creative workshops, treasure hunts, escape games, and a musical monster goûter.

c81621275078ba6b670cee1fe5988b8b9cae28ae.en: Children and families can take part in a magic potion treasure hunt at Bibliothèque Maurice Genevoix to find hidden ingredients and win a small surprise.

ed2cdde62971b17a7845df848f5bd134e48f9e48.en: Médiathèque Hélène Berr hosts its regular literary breakfast for adults on October 31, offering a relaxed morning of discussion with free entry subject to available space.

b50e25e087722dc1bba413ced6872583b3f73b72.en: La Petite Halle hosts the Yōkai Matsuri Halloween festival inspired by Japanese folklore, featuring a costume contest, a brass band parade, and festive night performances.

69f2f8c04ec261102d3006e68d579aeac8003e1e.en: Maison Paris Nature at the Parc Floral de Paris hosts a free café gathering for nature lovers, with mandatory online registration and full accessibility for visitors.

e00ba201a573c5a72ea5f27b20bd4f1548fc6fc5.en: Celebrate Halloween with the 3 witches of Violette at Médiathèque Violette Leduc. Enjoy a magical music session with maracas, and feel free to dress up.

111abe04873800988be2f8d278721518b8b4f9dd.en: Explore extreme vocal ranges, unusual timbres, and strange vocal techniques at this musical breakfast at Médiathèque Jean-Pierre Melville.

1dc9caa563838bf70bd61233a4fa0f10c55fdbb2.en: Join the literary café at Bibliothèque des Batignolles on October 31 to discuss scary books over tea or coffee with librarians and readers.

e2ae92046faf945d082e0bf4e7cb6b9d5e80f45d.en: Le Bal Chavaux hosts a queer Halloween horror ball featuring European DJ sets, dark disco, electronic music, and gothic drag performances.

8211e9cf64900edbf779492a1208ff2596cc6e36.en: The Grand Rex hosts a Halloween movie night featuring screenings of classic horror and family films on the big screen throughout the day.

1a93544b5077132762d71be055bae3d561ed423f.en: Bibliothèque Maurice Genevoix hosts a special screening for Halloween to experience a fun scare with a famous vampire.

79c414114d8f27700e5eda0c9d2809d07ec1ea47.en: Discover the musical history of Père-Lachaise Cemetery on a guided Halloween walking tour past the graves of famous artists and composers.

1a27c0e223b8992f48e5142539d689eede111b70.en: Médiathèque James Baldwin hosts an afternoon dedicated to feminist and LGBTQIA+ fanzines, featuring a creation workshop with the Marguerite Durand library.

0f08953a7dee44cd046f5d998215881232537b10.en: The Hôtel de la Marine invites children and families to spot playful spirits hidden in the state apartments during a Halloween ghost hunt.

65e0e2d6ede8f992979175ceb443267f71fc227b.en: Musée Guimet-Iéna hosts a special Halloween tour exploring ghosts and demons of Asia exclusively for children aged 7 to 12.

6e7c994ee30a7d629107e8698e7dcd665dda1c8f.en: La Fondation Jérôme Seydoux-Pathé presents a Halloween cine-concert featuring early magic lantern shows and silent films, followed by a snack.

e2c8d6f16cc58a5974970abc8015cdf41bd7900a.en: Children aged 6 to 14 can build their own miniature haunted castle or village at L'Atelier de la Ressourcerie Créative.

41906d2c08057a94826de3a514de93b7dd420d02.en: Laura NSafou hosts a writing workshop at Bibliothèque François Villon focusing on building imaginary worlds and exploring diverse perspectives.

d21437856b7e688f9d87ebc407094b967a920f27.en: The Centre culturel suisse Paris hosts a textile print workshop using undergarments as unique matrices in connection with Klodin Erb's exhibition.

323002ecb601cefbe4357957dbd1d4edea23d755.en: Halle Saint Pierre presents a performance piece based on Antonin Artaud's pioneering 1925 surrealist text, Le Pèse-Nerfs.

6962eec29a8dff047b629c734a42b1ac0cd6dc3e.en: Maison Paris Nature at the Parc Floral de Paris hosts free nature creative workshops accessible to people with reduced mobility.

f5238f24e4a9399d859df670b491810ccd33c2d0.en: Le Saumur hosts the Paris Afro Caribbean Festival, offering two days of dance classes, fitness sessions, and lively Caribbean music balls.

542236bd8f674dc7a879360da7d8debce3ae7147.en: Bibliothèque Marguerite Audoux screens Émilie Brisavoine's documentary Maman déchire, an intimate family journey exploring a complex mother-daughter relationship.

3186d49e72cd378e12302feded95c1040720369c.en: Théâtre Ouvert presents Avalon Princesse, an emancipated retelling of the Arthurian myth set in a queer nightclub in the south of France.

bc1c781baca616bdb410c5a260cafcedd5a7f090.en: The Philharmonie de Paris hosts a concert featuring traditional Amazigh poetry from Chérifa Kersit and vocal performances by the Ensemble Lâabat.

20f7d89adf8b682467cbae163371f54fa06b3eec.en: Investigate a murder mystery at the Cité de l'Architecture et du Patrimoine by joining teams to solve the case of Grégoire Manchette.

da23a9a9921417bb230cfd5b0ca9314e80af4cae.en: The Répéthèque hosts Muddy Cotton for a free afternoon concert featuring bluegrass, American classics, and rock covers.

0007f5a5874ca76d5796057bb908a4bea7416b03.en: Maya Bergamote shares traditional tales filled with mystery and humor in a storytelling session designed for families.

e46f8a3850d91d7cbbfb0509219d623daafa8718.en: Step into a murder mystery event at the Cité de l'Architecture et du Patrimoine to investigate the death of Grégoire Manchette.

778e744000f4ddcdd079cacde5d072c306d765c5.en: Nerea Dezac presents her first text, Chienne noire, in a meeting hosted by Mariette Navarro at the Bibliothèque Oscar Wilde.

7bcbf83b1f1d779f862888daf14d0426e5289bf2.en: Join a reading club centered on nature writing to discuss selected works and share your own favorite outdoor literature.

2345bfc9a07bffec733f6f5cd7db21a9614ea764.en: Celebrate the bride with traditional songs, poetry, and dances from North Africa performed by the Zahratane ensemble.

33dfd1dd7799c694c54aedd9a85f031b01b85257.en: Celebrate Halloween with werewolf games, candy, and a horror film screening at the médiathèque.

fae83073564e094b1f057640a0ce320dcd803ce2.en: Mark Halloween at the 38Riv Jazz Club with dark jazz standards, spooky tunes, and a rare performance on the theremin.

41e892f2f5b02a587fb9769caf9d67ad6679fd4e.en: End an eventful Halloween day with stories, monster encounters, and treats at a themed afternoon snack.

57863142e093a9995aac8395bc01fd89b1a71182.en: Take part in a special library-themed werewolf game night at Bibliothèque Buffon, featuring continuous play and a shared buffet.

73bcf31645146b37fa2a182534bbdb3fa16d901a.en: Watch Brian De Palma's musical horror film Phantom of the Paradise in a screening at the Médiathèque Marguerite Duras.

7cf63cf1c41eaa5e1587b65644fa00b5d8b5f98a.en: Join a Tahitian dance endurance marathon to support cultural projects, followed by a themed evening at Jo&Joe Paris.

817b9db9c58f3829974c073dea17124027938ef9.en: Celebrate Halloween at the médiathèque with storytelling sessions, themed animation stands, and a candlelight literary aperitif.

17ab18434f133ced7cc347b605194e5ecaec897a.en: Discover a dramatic performance exploring unique perspectives and poetic imagery at Théâtre Ouvert.

de0efafa15622e6d8bbc3aeaaa55abfa995334d4.en: Explore the Parisian sewer network by night during special guided tours offering a unique perspective on the city's underground history.

2f536d3ffc9a4b95c20af6971ce46148a7fde3d6.en: Dance together at a festive Bal Pop' featuring global music styles, DJ sets, and a welcoming community atmosphere.

34eb68949f537d3c1796d2c895ea097c23d67826.en: Kick off a themed vampire ball with waltz initiations, dance demonstrations, and a buffet at Le Salon des Miroirs.

fed68f7c6d560143a4be11923a477ccce5fa6e9f.en: Solve a murder mystery inside the Musée de l'Air et de l'Espace by investigating a crime scene among the aviation collections.

1f42c04da9d1c50d604e32db0399e030a8d2bc40.en: Celebrate Halloween across multiple O'Sullivans venues in Paris with a circus-themed freak show and late-night DJ sets.

1158f3cd6eb3ae97f27ec3659c6e996755fe8605.en: Catch indie artist Only Real and nuclear post-punk group Catchy Peril at Supersonic. Expect a lively night blending raw vocals, soaring guitars, and wild dancefloor energy.

94c02647472d123e8e4811dcb7efcc83ca5e07b1.en: Join a drag murder mystery party at TLM on October 31 to investigate the untimely demise of Amy Winehouse. Enjoy performances and interrogations while trying to find the culprit among the guests.

b0f33ad778c0f76ec46765345b900d1630fa8364.en: Celebrate Halloween at the Musée Jean-Jacques Henner with a candlelit storytelling tour led by Laure Urgin. Follow the spooky tales whispered by the paintings in a magical, private setting.

216d0b52bc6ef0fba1a10549abe21d00f913aca3.en: Put on your best costume for a grand Halloween dance party with a cocktail bar and a live show featuring rock, salsa, bachata, waltz, and tango demonstrations.

47f124660618a5513c24c256a6a20ee47350e416.en: Experience the Grande Nuit de l’Horreur at the Filmothèque du Quartier Latin on October 31, 2026. Enjoy four restored horror films, quizzes, gifts, free popcorn, and a survival kit.

5746660d826fb724d070858b5b97987873959706.en: Celebrate Halloween at the Musée de Cluny with two screenings dedicated to Nicolas Flamel under the vault of the antique frigidarium. Enjoy family-friendly mystery and alchemy on screen.

4bcd3d5e920cfe5ae57b00a47f8a40f21b5ae72c.en: Explore the complex nuances of modern desire through a captivating staging by Compagnie Babel at the Théâtre de la Tempête. Six performers examine our collective representations and seek new ways of connecting.

25e6fe7ad429cfe0622a35a32f4058a2fe03e520.en: Test your observation and deduction skills in teams during a Halloween-themed treasure hunt starting from the Fontaine des Innocents. Solve clues and riddles to crack the mystery before everyone else.

2e36f06006ce1ad232a2236f10c8d16b1543ee18.en: Discover Propane, la maison aux bardeaux verts at Théâtre Ouvert, a play exploring the unique experiences of an autistic teenager living in a remote rural community.

11c7400ab55057bc65d565fa009ac5f7d9b3dbc1.en: Celebrate Halloween at the Cirque Electrique with an energetic lineup featuring hyper tekno pop, queer punk, and electrifying performances. Dress up in your boldest look for a night of techno-fascist resistance and vibrant life.

bf2298c65dcacdba4196b82b66bbf076553f7828.en: Enjoy an evening of musical storytelling with the Elisa Lecuyer Quartet at Le Melville. They present their debut EP, Ouverture, blending cross-Atlantic rhythms in a vibrant tribute to musical theatre.

2002b38a1c72a9a69c8cceda1f0fb2df2011a364.en: Catch jazz violinist Dominic Ingham and his quartet at the intimate 38Riv Jazz Club in the heart of the Marais. They present original compositions blending British folk roots with contemporary jazz.

a65e620e10af3db2190d8ba7b8615a221fddc87b.en: Dance through Halloween night across Wanderlust and FVTVR with four distinct musical spaces and a massive lineup behind the decks. A single ticket gives you access to all areas for a wild night.

c04a657728fcf773b710b187b3044d3ac8c523b1.en: Experience an explosive Halloween edition of the Gender Fvck Klub at FGO-Barbara. Kings, queens, and creatures come together for a high-energy show that will keep queer crowds dancing all night.

0b02a88b45a7afd60467262bc8e7900b1a9ff101.en: Celebrate the 10th anniversary of Le Bal des Vampires at the Salon des Miroirs for a night of macabre glamour and electronic beats. Enjoy spectacular performances, decadent cabaret, and a strict costume dress code.

512f5a0bc6f5b1fa00eaa0a9a106e038f1725500.en: Dive into the deep sea for a Halloween party at Le Hasard Ludique featuring DJ sets by DJ Beluga 92, Carrà, Divalda, and VLK. Enjoy dark beats, themed games, and costume-enhancement stations in a safe and inclusive space.

28bfce5708e65c6878f23e412b399f9f5c66cdde.en: Celebrate Halloween with an Afro-Caribbean twist at Le Chinois, featuring a sound system blending shatta, dancehall, kompa, afrobeats, and amapiano. Put on your costume and dance until the early hours.

53bfd4742a033bfc81087570e4f7d2c0890d55ee.en: Experience a harder edge of Halloween at La Machine du Moulin Rouge with the Fluid event. Five artists take over the decks to deliver a night of hardcore, schranz, and fast-paced rave sounds.

6cf0834b57b506f96306975b1c64664e91683fa5.en: Join Pentagon and Happiness Therapy at La Java for a Halloween party featuring a stacked lineup and club-themed decor. Dress up as night creatures or 90s club kids for an inclusive and energetic night.

194bf29525932f54e7414cba369304fc00f9cec7.en: Explore films that challenge social norms and dominant narratives during the Mois du doc across Paris libraries. Discover pluralistic perspectives through documentaries on local resistance and community stories.

9fdd2341c3a7aa6becdc47464f98617ef08aeda4.en: Discover the tragic history of the Camondo family at the Mémorial de la Shoah. Join director Ruth Zylberman and historian Jean-Marc Dreyfus to explore this poignant Parisian legacy.

7c74416f86c62748e1a55223ac6be9850563b06a.en: Explore the Left Bank through the lives of American LGBTQ+ writers like James Baldwin and Sylvia Beach. This guided tour uncovers a fascinating chapter of 20th-century literature in Paris.

185ac44bd1d9e49422c4484ae47fa41623e22420.en: Go behind the scenes at Lafayette Anticipations with an architectural tour. Explore the production workshop usually closed to the public and discover how artists' works take shape.

7d115c9b76c00ca628161d9fc2225aa424790488.en: Enjoy an evening of classical guitar at the Église Saint-Merry with Italian musician Enrico Damiano Vallone. A wonderful opportunity to hear a master performer in an intimate setting.

5189274737a7a93451cc7b96ba66cb1e2b80267c.en: At Théâtre Ouvert, a seemingly small incident at the Louvre sparks a larger debate about reality and narratives. A thought-provoking play that questions how we view the world.

9c655c46314d1cbed1c23e1c5f3e05dfd0e5cda2.en: Hear the testimony of Evelyn Askolovitch at the Mémorial de la Shoah de Drancy. As a survivor of Bergen-Belsen, she shares her vital history alongside her son Claude Askolovitch.

7a04894c69025f2427b746a9d19b4c9ed0bd982a.en: Esther Hoffenberg presents her documentary tracing the history of her female ancestors in Silesia. Join the screening at the Mémorial de la Shoah in the presence of the director.

b98fa15e8a979dc1a7bfd96ab44a75794ecc5136.en: Experience a Django afternoon at 38Riv Jazz Club with the Hispanic trio. Enjoy a blend of Gypsy swing, modern jazz and classic Spanish themes in an intimate Marais cellar.

d3e2d8383623d7054a355614faee1d04e61ed3ce.en: Celebrate soup season at the shared garden in the 12th arrondissement. Meet the association behind this local green space and enjoy a friendly community gathering.

b7e230ac9625209e3f5a1bce7ac3b44055fa1f2f.en: Théâtre Ouvert presents a cabaret exploring how our well-intentioned words sometimes escape us. An engaging show that reconsiders the language and political discourse we use today.

259f4e259ace885ae7a01b80c7eeb3973d9eb997.en: In Gowan Ring returns to Paris after seven years for an intimate psychedelic folk concert at the Théâtre du Temps. The evening opens with a performance by folk artist Adaya.

78c78c48cea7d2373215188c870554202fec1f9f.en: Yuri Buenaventura leads a solidarity concert at Le Palais des Congrès to support the reconstruction of Buenaventura. An exceptional lineup of artists comes together for a great cause.

2fc509326d96904008828c98aaba1d071b23e420.en: Supersonic hosts a Sunday tribute dedicated to Guns N' Roses. Catch local bands covering the legendary rock anthems for a free evening of raw energy.

541baeb16db65d596e07ff59378b66311fef1948.en: Sotiris Tsolis leads a lively evening of jazz, electronic grooves, and improvisation at Le Baiser Salé. Enjoy an opening set followed by an open jam session for musicians and fans.

3fdf05fe6f60d71b3b1365684f5a372429549cd1.en: Zamakaken performs at 38Riv Jazz Club, blending jazz and oriental music through improvisation and virtuosity. Catch Baptiste Ferrandis on guitar and Abdallah Abozerky on saz.

3b028f7ecb61e40ecd5e952eb87a5a22f5bbe9cf.en: La Machine du Moulin Rouge hosts the Ptite Soeur aftershow featuring a lineup of electronic artists. A late-night event strictly for adults over 18.

f8166ba56720b9879b88be0bb4b89e94dfaf2bd8.en: The Pitchfork Music Festival returns to Paris for its 15th edition across ten iconic venues. Discover a diverse lineup of indie, pop, and electronic artists during a week of urban concerts.

3e9d68436ea28d1b29b998e06234985016224170.en: Ralph Nataf leads a storytelling workshop focusing on ease and clowning dimensions. Learn how to bring lightness, adaptability, and expressive power to your storytelling.

9ef8c95c618b9342527cd9af807e4cdd43bcf1b0.en: The Hôtel de Ville hosts a forum dedicated to seniors and their families, featuring information stands, conferences, and exhibitions. Discover local resources for retirement, health, and leisure.

0f459dda241ce747285b4ed55a7caf3b2b5acf7d.en: The Adidas Arena hosts OUI-PLAY 2026 featuring two exciting college basketball matchups. Watch South Carolina face Maryland, followed by North Carolina against Oklahoma.

6f8c454c42452f36fcc6f146196347b958337547.en: Héroïnes, HazyMetry and Stupide Foudre perform live at Supersonic. Expect a night of alternative rock and independent music.

23c018366fb808872d7c4bb201c80d07f74c397e.en: Etats sensibles #2 at Rêva offers a live performance combining painting by Clothilde Fricot Mugnerot with improvised piano by Léo Bailac.

9292852a6c7a91f36d483f0b103d8efd44e4a2d3.en: Le Grand Parquet presents a work-in-progress showing of a play featuring texts by Marius Von Mayenburg, performed by Ellen Babic and Constance Dollé.

9d7e6d9da46faba849ba2ba1eb5321aec3029a03.en: Dutch pop singer Davina Michelle performs live at La Boule Noire for a Parisian concert featuring her powerful vocals and ambitious stage presence.

ddcc7af44a2ea708f85f94e35e8bd7950db0665c.en: Jass Club Paris hosts Hermeto Pascoal's Mothership, featuring long-time collaborators performing a 100 percent Hermeto repertoire of precise writing and collective improvisation.

af1a902393c5f3a22899880b7e0c8072dd8e5174.en: Théâtre 13 - Bibliothèque presents Marie Fortuit's staging of Thérèse et Isabelle, exploring the awakening of love and desire between two young women.

f2152c8cf25f588ae71943c92fc2d911288829f7.en: Maison Heinrich Heine hosts a film screening of Frank Beyer's Carbure et oseille, followed by a presentation by historian Caroline Moine.

7304cb4b5601b557f964dfc2fda9a82b671aa1b0.en: The Orchestre Français des Jeunes performs at Théâtre du Châtelet under the direction of Guillaume Chilemme, featuring works by Mozart and Schubert.

72bb715d07b9eebc2837b505d975202af5077002.en: Lol Tolhurst, co-founder of The Cure, performs live at Petit Bain in Paris.

c32b9d126b23b74a83a6a53bd0167aa41ead8100.en: Théâtre 13 - Glacière hosts the Grand Prix T13 showcase, featuring six new creations by young theatre companies and emerging artists.

ed78e346bca44ab45814578001dde0271f199945.en: The World of Hans Zimmer returns to Accor Arena for a symphonic concert celebrating forty years of the composer's film scores.

13b1c49ab565007a69185909ecaf14f1eca03c0d.en: Célia Jaillet presents her multimedia performance exploring a remote winter encounter and the public messages received by the protagonist.

f214d9f6e35a0d90c34539150f2e977d71369143.en: The World of Hans Zimmer brings its international arena tour to France, featuring orchestral arrangements of the composer's iconic film scores.

1d9c94a2b46820bda484e24ab2852aef289e7e24.en: 38Riv Jazz Club hosts the trio featuring drummer Véra Campos, pianist Hugo Doppler and contrabass player Léonard Pauly for an evening of modern jazz.

f4570b3954aa0803d0590190708aecad2168fa20.en: Théâtre de la Ville - Abbesses presents Samuel Beckett's Krapp's Last Tape, featuring an audio performance recorded by actor Stephen Rea.

a33e7ed0f01a078b2b3ed9c636f8edb212583c3c.en: Bibliothèque Goutte d'Or exhibits drawings and sketches by Ursula Schmidt documenting neighborhood meals, culinary traditions and local gatherings.

14687b2ca9de960848a202dd2cea62df9f98434f.en: Participate in online writing workshops exploring the theme of families through guided exercises led by experienced authors.

47af0f21e1088ca8b046e2d3aa7237c409aa898b.en: Bibliothèque Germaine Tillion hosts an exhibition celebrating the work of children's author and illustrator Philippe Corentin.

9a8eb2400a9912d14390844adaca431adc8586ec.en: Participate in the Manger, être maladroit event series across multiple libraries, featuring authors and illustrators exploring food and fairy tales.

5abbfd6cac3e1563b5df7743b7cc9e782eaf41bb.en: Bibliothèque Assia Djebar presents an illustrated mural and work by artist Agathe Chamignon, featuring floral designs and generous table settings.

0314d3580afa5a27fe3933b64407d1632455b412.en: Jazzycolors brings together international jazz scenes with artists from diverse horizons performing in cultural partner venues across Paris. Attend this new edition from November 3 to December 11, 2026, to discover the vitality of contemporary jazz.

ee4de0d4a2a01308c4fc17f828c2729c1865f37c.en: The free exhibition Portraits de Résistantes at Centre Paris Anim' Maurice Ravel highlights women from different countries and eras who resisted through social and political engagement. Visit the gallery from November 3 to 26, 2026, to explore art as a tool for reflection.

7f628d85e54e943ce2c94a8c45d70dfec452197f.en: Bring your computer to the Bibliothèque Marguerite Audoux on Tuesday, November 3, for a small-group digital workshop with step-by-step guidance. Registration is required for this morning session running from 10h00 to 12h00.

b6a6228da8263bec53994d51b8b961630114335f.en: Olalaland at Théâtre Public Montreuil blends graphic arts, silent cinema, and music into a poetic theatrical experience. Created by artist Clémence Jeanguillaume, this imaginative show invites both children and adults into an ever-changing world.

9284d173be1580a78532d527077eaad11e334625.en: The Conservatoire à rayonnement régional de Paris hosts a series of master classes, conferences, and concerts featuring jazz, classical, and early music artists throughout November and December 2026.

a4712f05731cf3094016552f0a87f1876035d34c.en: Sylvie Kleiman-Lafon leads a lecture at the Chapelle de l'Humanité on Antoine Lassalle, the adventurous first translator of Bacon. This talk is part of a conference cycle running from September 29 to December 15, 2026.

715d9b1757256ef181dc71f4357734ae9433a351.en: Ix : variations at the Théâtre de la Bastille is a 17-fragment performance by Marcos Caramés-Blanco and Sacha Starck retracing the life of a queer child. It explores social and family struggles through fiction, comedy, and drag.

15be0d4fe9b4e772f734c9b7c6a90f988e580565.en: Bibliothèque Louise Walser-Gaillard hosts a conference exploring Claude Monet's ties to the transforming 9th arrondissement of Paris in the 19th century. Discover how the neighborhood shaped the painter's life and the birth of impressionism.

4afe30e755e82941f3b6a94116019f973d0c10c9.en: Jeanne Barnicaud presents ongoing research at Médiathèque Françoise Sagan on the history of tattooed women in French prisons from 1881 to 1950. This conference complements the exhibition on female detention during a dedicated cycle.

c43ea54ca68171b7e70db3b6047ee5e066f6972b.en: Head to SUPERSONIC for a live concert featuring British singer-songwriter Scott Lavene and bedroom rock project Bleu Death. Admission is free with doors opening at 19h00 on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.

82363b848905d32fa31bfecc711c44f9b616d783.en: L'Institut du Monde Arabe hosts a conference exploring Avicenna's theory of prophecy and its reception by thinker Fazlur Rahman. Join the discussion led by Jean-Baptiste Brenet and Hazem Al Rahmany to delve into Arabic philosophy.

92d5bd6a4d695a51a0d0cad78bffc0ec7b0bd996.en: Bibliothèque Drouot hosts a relaxed writing workshop on Tuesday, November 3, from 19h00 to 21h00. Join in for fun writing games suitable for all levels in a welcoming atmosphere.

7139e719c4ad7f97d09543783367d67916ea9a0e.en: At the Théâtre de la Concorde, author Catherine Meurisse and Geoffroy Delorme discuss our connection to forests and their preservation. The event ties art and nature together by exploring Thoreau's philosophy and a life spent among wildlife.

132a63e8d8cefdc6345c468f306623b13f5c6d8b.en: The Centre Culturel Coréen presents a performance blending traditional Korean dance and music with contemporary ballet. Discover collaborations featuring choreographer Sun-A Lee, musician Kim Joo-Hong, and the Yunbyul Ballet Company.

b62e7386d71ade0da28ac614781e8ac24e0aa6d3.en: Join the community meeting at Les ateliers for an evening discussion centered on photography to mark its bicentennial. Share stories, techniques, and iconic images in an open space dedicated to cultural exchange.

9fa52154e7039b1c4179f1e3d7bca3016376bdb3.en: Facesoul brings his immersive, soul-infused R&B to Le Hasard Ludique on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. Catch the London-based artist live in concert as part of the Take Me Out series.

fd497183babb0201fc70dcaea84b142ada6454e0.en: Meat me in Paradise at the Centre culturel suisse uses myths and Christian traditions to question our relationship with animals, the planet, and the living world. This seven-chapter theatrical inquiry expands our imagination on how we inhabit the world.

5728d20f4d9690df1438aef7b34c3140da0757d9.en: Pianist Alexandre, drummer Axel, and bassist Arlo form Square Noon to deliver an energetic jazz performance at Le Melville. Experience the vibrant chemistry of these three musician friends live on stage.

35425d618b47db9fe927a0ab75ef32fb0f8ea799.en: Bachar Mar-Khalifé pays tribute to French singer Christophe at the Théâtre de la Bastille, blending piano melodies with jazz, electro, and Lebanese influences. He is joined on stage by drummer Dogan Poyraz and bassist Aleksander Angelov.

b7139bd7cbbf3a6d5edb3c64fe1180326db64171.en: Kansas City jazz vocalist Eboni Fondren performs an intimate quartet concert at the 38Riv Jazz Club in Paris. Enjoy an evening of authentic American jazz standards alongside Laurent Marode, David Sauzay, and Stéphane Chandelier.

3dabf5ba9e91a7289792703ffdc6d4e0280a321b.en: Cette exposition à la Médiathèque James Baldwin explore le parcours de femmes victimes de la prostitution grâce au travail de l'association Solenciel. Un regard photographique sur la reconstruction et la lutte contre les traumatismes.

56f87a8658490c24dbe517d44852937e33360802.en: La Bibliothèque historique de la Ville de Paris propose un cycle de conférences, lectures et tables-rondes autour de l'histoire ouvrière et des ouvrières. Un événement pour questionner les rapports entre genre, classe et domination.

93e663d9e2ad40e9db900e8cba5921e83e7a4498.en: La Galerie Arcturus célèbre l'œuvre de Marc Riboud à travers une exposition mettant en avant sa composition soignée et sa profonde curiosité pour l'humain. Une occasion de découvrir comment la géométrie devient poésie et émotion.

4f2ea8be89783e6203819d31af9f59ea33d3d62a.en: Le Musée du Louvre présente une grande exposition de plus de 300 photographies consacrée au musée lui-même comme sujet et source d'inspiration. Une exploration visuelle de l'histoire du lieu depuis l'invention de la photographie jusqu'à nos jours.

d9d57d8405d37e89ee2cc030bf37baf46437ee7f.en: La Bibliothèque André Malraux expose les aquarelles originales de Capucine Mazille pour l'album documentaire Bon appétit les animaux. Une découverte tendre et humoristique de la vie sauvage à travers le regard d'une illustratrice jeunesse.

2d6c9870c99340335c130e3b58477909af04e18a.en: Le Musée Bourdelle propose une journée d'initiation à la gravure sur bois pour les adultes et les jeunes dès 15 ans. Une matinée de croquis d'après Antoine Bourdelle suivie d'un atelier d'impression sous la presse.

00870ff8a65b8bb7edbd7a4207809db76fdacba4.en: La Bibliothèque Marguerite Durand présente l'exposition photo de Françoise Evenou consacrée à des femmes migrantes et transgenres au Bois de Boulogne. Un parcours sensible qui interroge l'identité et l'altérité.
