b436d73112c8a8ed5dece522c7b98233f4afe073.en: Le Centre de documentation sur les métiers du livre organise une matinée de rencontre et d'entraide pour préparer les concours des bibliothèques. L'événement se déroule à la bibliothèque Buffon sous forme de tête-à-tête.

77ee6709f7f914eda552c852c7c55212e44b91c0.en: L'ABI School lance une série de rencontres Coffee Talk en anglais pour les parents expatriés à Paris. La première session est dédiée à la compréhension du système scolaire français.

57ae5537db02fa4096ef8c76ed55621e9eac4c26.en: La Bibliothèque Valeyre propose un atelier de dessin pour apprendre les bases des personnages de manga avec une illustratrice. Les participants découvrent comment créer un visage et différentes coupes de cheveux.

beb05007206ca72e11d60c9b05ce1d7fd44558d9.en: La bibliothèque Buffon accueille une matinée de rencontre et d'entraide pour préparer les concours des bibliothèques. Vingt personnes se présentent à tour de rôle en face à face pour partager leur expérience.

d5c022a3247f013000984feb1d701f2e3267f70d.en: La Bibliothèque Gutenberg propose un rendez-vous de racontines pour les enfants de 0 à 3 ans. Au programme : histoires, comptines et jeux de doigts.

45ff568a765950ae51059d7da463b7a3dee7c998.en: La Bibliothèque François Villon propose un atelier pop-up pour les petits inspiré de l'album Qui mange quoi. Les enfants découvrent ce que mangent différents animaux avant de créer leur propre animal animé.

103512dd1220bc63d2bf27308836ef0146d60bff.en: La Bibliothèque Benoîte Groult invite les tout-petits de 0 à 3 ans à l'heure du conte avec Bidouille. Au programme : découverte de premiers albums, imagiers, comptines et jeux de doigts.

cc713b67724b46ba57dc5c6e493fa09768614877.en: L'Académie du climat propose un atelier sur cinq samedis pour confectionner un calendrier de l'avent éco-responsable. Les participants apprennent à coudre, découvrent les enjeux climatiques et s'initient à Illustrator et à la 3D.

10982998f407b048e1acf952bd9751b2f72ba069.en: Participez à un atelier photo bien-être et créativité avec Caroline Lepeu à la Bibliothèque Maurice Genevoix, spécialement conçu pour les mères et leurs enfants.

57e7872f0a77a98ef23f803cbdfebb8e0e0b75d1.en: Fabriquez un mobile à la manière de Calder à la Bibliothèque Drouot en collant, montant et accrochant votre propre œuvre d'art.

78cdd3b3567db6eb44cb0c1cefd9e5adcaf51dc0.en: Venez écouter et partager des lectures inclusives et féministes évoquant les minorités de genre à la Bibliothèque Aimé Césaire.

078d69a65071fd95fc0de38797898097780d6c56.en: Assistez à la séance Histoires pour grands à la Médiathèque Marguerite Yourcenar, accessible à partir de 6 ans sur inscription.

93f7d4e29717f4686adc67986c3f3ac204fef21f.en: Profitez des Contes girafons à la Bibliothèque Glacière - Marina Tsvetaïeva, un rendez-vous adapté aux enfants de 0 à 3 ans.

6dd926647f3cb1c76841fd9b40b4240dbda9d43a.en: Rencontrez la drag-queen et costumière Mademoiselle Kiss à la Médiathèque Jean-Pierre Melville pour découvrir les secrets de création de ses tenues extravagantes.

a4eb8521bfe247cab1bd295e8813a660cb88760a.en: Participez à une conférence au Conservatoire Municipal Jean-Philippe Rameau retraçant l'héritage pédagogique d'Odette Gartenlaub et l'évolution de la formation musicale.

52b3ac23865388ae87a9b52d67594de8827d10ab.en: Visitez les coulisses et l'atelier des costumes de Chaillot - Théâtre national de la Danse pour découvrir les secrets de fabrication des spectacles.

c4f031abe5a53f51eeb62e927a087f71839b7ec5.en: Partagez un moment en famille autour d'une heure du conte bilingue français-anglais animée par l'American Library in Paris à la Bibliothèque Georges Brassens.

061cda93e898f7472410b0f773fc0b14a79c7fe3.en: Échangez autour de vos livres préférés de la rentrée littéraire autour d'un café à la Bibliothèque Germaine Tillion.

34a1a538bf7b5116f6c11828d088f5f79576affe.en: Découvrez les Contes du ventre rond de Nathalie Bondoux à la Bibliothèque Toni Morrison, où histoires de gourmandise et de fuite s'entremêlent.

c062401de5adfada530b2ce36a444551a2c5c81a.en: Découvrez le spectacle jeune public Miam ! par la conteuse Anne-Gaël Gauducheau à la Bibliothèque Arthur Rimbaud, explorant le rapport des enfants à la nourriture.

c3415995457a5407d803570f106b8e62cdd08aeb.en: Les bibliothécaires de la Médiathèque Hélène Berr proposent des Histoires à Pic' Arc-en-ciel pour célébrer la diversité avec les enfants de 4 ans et plus.

d703fdef7cf508cb5e501f6334f1e18bbd6df003.en: Partagez vos courants musicaux, artistes ou vinyles préférés lors du Café vinyle de la Bibliothèque Rainer Maria Rilke.

5256b000f85029e14e34a01549b89144613d63c8.en: Partez en car pour un circuit de visites guidées artistiques en Île-de-France organisé par tram, au départ de la gare RER Denfert-Rochereau.

2a9143d90e4dec50c0277ff3e5533381e8cc4054.en: Découvrez l'exposition de photographies de Robert Burley consacrée aux Grands Lacs lors de l'ouverture exceptionnelle et des visites guidées au Centre culturel canadien.

1adb7c75f215ebfbf0eea865ad71281ef72df1be.en: Apprenez les bases de la couture en réalisant pas à pas un sac à tarte personnalisé au Centre Paris Anim' Point du Jour.

125c0ca72a9f66567d6899a9c281f7f62c19e7eb.en: Apprenez à repriser vos vêtements en créant des formes colorées lors d'un atelier créatif à L'Atelier de la Ressourcerie Créative.

2102806ab14b6e296575a0d7d5d299b7d8ed7e7f.en: Rejoignez l'Agora stoïcienne animée par Guillaume Beauquesne au Théâtre de la Concorde pour un moment de réflexion philosophique et d'échange citoyen.

91375b99c01606c4c5ef67a22d0d91731bf9def9.en: Les enfants à partir de 6 ans sont invités à créer leur autoportrait en papier inspiré par Arcimboldo lors d'un atelier proposé par la revue DADA à la Bibliothèque Buffon.

edfe03586f952114e28699b438994d8abd2ad4e6.en: Compose a unique floral decor using dried flowers, sheltered in a glass bell jar or recycled jar. This creative workshop is hosted by Rose from Green and Gold at the Ressourcerie Le Plant B.

92bf87b3ff95f6605f05b3ebce54c45e4d97b0ad.en: Experience a reimagined circus performance featuring trapeze, acrobatics, juggling, clowns, and music. This show at the Cirque Electrique offers multiple narratives and a playful atmosphere.

301a4df129489cb0d6d1496f87d0c75d42805f08.en: Children can take part in a songwriting workshop led by singer Comae at the Médiathèque Violette Leduc. The lyrics will be inspired by children's books featuring notable historical women.

5a68b06ced34adfd5a6073364491693393a83e02.en: Celebrate the new auditorium at the Conservatoire Municipal Erik Satie with a musical and theatrical cabaret. Students will perform songs, jazz, poetry, and sketches inspired by Erik Satie.

8c20b468ec530e58e924c3e8b2da5860fee529d5.en: Attend a conference on indulgence in Western painting at the Bibliothèque Louise Walser-Gaillard. The talk includes French Sign Language interpretation and is followed by a gourmet painting workshop.

7dedc8e6e42928a5e0cb31e0c94e593fd73ad821.en: Watch the documentary Habibi, Chanson pour mes ami·e·s directed by Florent Gouëlou at the Médiathèque Jean-Pierre Melville. The screening is followed by a discussion with the director.

c9dc976283165def7e009f81d02e554cbcd9c792.en: Compete in a 1000-piece puzzle tournament in teams of four at the Médiathèque Virginia Woolf. This event serves as a qualification round for the grand inter-library tournament of Paris.

47f9732ad4f382b766d9429865201dbe67512d8f.en: Listen to the vocal ensemble from the Maîtrise de Paris at the Cité de l'architecture et du patrimoine, under the direction of Pierre-Louis de Laporte.

c9f176d0e7aa06f2d4e8363f0d4f6c31264a6cc5.en: Learn the art of stamp carving with Nathalie Chapuy from Le Héron Graveur at the Bibliothèque des Batignolles. This creative workshop is part of the Mordus du Manga events.

ef9c004042f62d0c3703fa029d0d11d0ce038a5a.en: Build an articulated puppet inspired by Philippe Corentin's stories with sculptor Alex Rochereau at the Bibliothèque Germaine Tillion. Participants can then use the puppets in a traditional puppet theater.

e35794042353320ce42f53c0eddf055a12f0177c.en: Explore complex themes through a puppet and musical adaptation of Little Red Riding Hood at the Bibliothèque Goutte d'or. The performance is followed by a participatory discussion for children.

e89fe1f3b4534804d8667f34a4ca573ced50aba9.en: Enjoy a baroque concert and spectacle dedicated to Lully at the église St Séverin. Soprano Dorothée Perreau and the Les Accordenses trio will perform works by Lully, Rebel, and Couperin.

286af472e87ef288b0096f335aeb16860647c923.en: Discover a multidisciplinary theatrical performance by the Compagnie des Marlins at the Médiathèque Marguerite Yourcenar. The piece explores themes of dishonesty based on texts written by senior club members.

c0350a3795a524ce4dc6aabce8683a932d8e57a3.en: Watch Nathalie Le Boucher perform a dynamic storytelling version of the three little pigs. Combining gesture, movement, and spoken word, she brings the classic tale to life.

d0393a41dc4ddb64817d339c19a00f23c253d5ad.en: Listen to Jann Halexander pay tribute to singer Catherine Ribeiro at the Médiathèque Edmond Rostand. He will perform her repertoire accompanied by pianist Bertrand Ferrier and guitarist Sébastyen Defiolle.

808563643a24bb9b437aef42f9b5eb1b8112a4da.en: Explore the history of women in music from Hildegarde de Bingen to electronic music pioneers at the Bibliothèque François Villon. The talk is led by music librarian Tristan Vinatier.

43ae635aad8163a41fe38fafcdd6ba3c7c46ef55.en: Share a gentle storytelling session with your child using French Sign Language and songs at Atelier 77. This duo workshop is designed for parents and children aged two to five.

65656e2774f881d8ead4af76a91cc13119857c17.en: Create and personalize your own candle at Feuille blanche café noir. The workshop includes choosing your scent, pouring the wax, and a short writing session.

9003777f6ffe1375b1fd31d6f5e3fe6d0366b5eb.en: Bring young children to the Bibliothèque Benoîte Groult for stories, songs, and finger games with the mascot Bidouille. This session is part of the Pride Festival.

21fea518c9b771e6063a7d7095d80e3f07fefa3f.en: Enjoy an intimate jazz evening with vocalist Caloé and pianist Julia Perminova at the 38Riv Jazz Club. The performance features vocal improvisation, original compositions, and revisited melodies.

0930e927d50076b5dc12598f11018ff18a2d24f6.en: Explore an enchanting evening stroll through the Parc floral de Paris featuring glowing Northern Lights and shadow puppet performances by The Black Finger.

395b4b0e212404a7ae98e9a85aa9cc3bf0e1f1ed.en: Play badminton in the dark with fluorescent gear and music at the Gymnase Thomas Mann. This free event is open to adults of all levels upon registration.

46bc1501bc345c8481ed8248c311ec306aecc465.en: Listen to a musical reading of Julia Lepère's novel La Mer et son double at the Bibliothèque Marguerite Audoux as part of Paris en Toutes Lettres.

54db4802cf70f77971eb5bd58f9ed0faf1fa4795.en: Discover Camille Laïly at the Bibliothèque Valeyre for an intimate concert blending chanson, jazz, and folk with powerful vocals and poetic melodies.

6fd8c45916ab859b8a8d32b54eed59ade977c00b.en: Attend a conference at the Médiathèque Violette Leduc exploring the poetic works of Hélène and René Guy Cadou, followed by a discussion.

95380bf1d623a13b0820d5941a9e509449826971.en: Enjoy a multi-generational concert by the Fantasy Orchestra at the Bibliothèque Astrid Lindgren featuring a retro-inspired tribute to women.

a692bf06e23e3b3ea50f6d37001ddb73f1f1635b.en: Catch a night of post-punk, darkwave, and coldwave at Supersonic with live performances by Varsovie, Alien Tears, and Antifer.

4909c77a6f95dd86028c02dcde2a7aec63831689.en: Experience a contemporary tragedy inspired by Shakespeare at Théâtre les 3T exploring the passionate world of football supporters and club ownership.

e63118fcf62fd23b22f9c993ed11eb7f9d5dbbb8.en: Watch a screening of David Lynch's Elephant Man at Centre Paris Anim' Angel Parra, followed by a debate organized by Artmele.

af75cf84089b90849efc4e816dcd955b99673e54.en: Celebrate the 11th anniversary of the symphonic metal workshop at MPAA/Saint-Germain with unique rock and metal arrangements.

dfd77f0b9e682d40a81a690654ec477e4490d16b.en: Dance to live DJ sets and explore artificial intelligence exhibits during a special evening event at the Musée de l'Air et de l'Espace.

bac5a6c2f8d8f7bb1981299a77c6e18f1ba6215c.en: Experience Henri Louis at Fontaine Culture as he blends classical masterpieces by Chopin and Beethoven with French chanson and jazz influences.

8e8375dfacb2b0ff55e57813b80ff98eaf45dc14.en: Discover David Lynch's biographical drama Elephant Man at Centre Paris Anim' Angel Parra, complete with a presentation and debate by Artmele.

21ee971cebc2e9f042a5211e6af3b855a0c6c4b5.en: Step back in time at the Musée Jacquemart-André for a period costume ball celebrating the 150th anniversary of the historic mansion.

fbdda926a3138af8c09a107bbbf0892fef2db5d8.en: Dance and sing along to vibrant Brazilian samba and pagode rhythms with the Paris Samba Group at the Studio de l'Ermitage.

0cf5dfc5d113b4e8ae7dfc9aff9ff9de391a4cfb.en: Immerse yourself in the ultimate Depeche Mode experience at Salle Pleyel with tribute band Strangelove performing classic synthpop hits.

c3310b34924ff70d331a60edf902da4f4b4e848b.en: Enjoy an intimate jazz evening at 38Riv Jazz Club as Alexis Valet and Noé Huchard pay tribute to pianist Mulgrew Miller.

f8733318b00de25539ca9b12f6d69baddb2b848b.en: Run through the heart of Paris on a scenic 10km course starting at the rue de Rivoli and finishing at the Avenue de l'Opéra.

49420098cf9c8f7372b41b6d927e9b2ad727dafe.en: Join author Robert Bober at the Mémorial de la Shoah for a reading and discussion of his novel exploring family history and memory.

1589232ef9a31a7435e93e9f5a1fd650d3c5e61e.en: Join a creative writing workshop in Montparnasse inspired by the Cezanne et nous exhibition to explore your voice through literature and art.

74d509a164833ee56ac309b1f5f31da271ea6b50.en: Discover the traditional art of Chinese seal carving during this three-hour workshop at Institut Feibai. Learn engraving techniques and create your own personalized seal with calligrapher HU Jiaxing.

e2957f883b60dc16a7fc00bd8b07342742d2a2a7.en: Experience Beethoven's Pastoral Symphony at La Seine Musicale in a concert designed for children aged 4 and up. The programme also features a new creation for flute and orchestra by Darius Birotheau.

fbee5c32857d24394c69e796de5cecd80ed985e2.en: Share a playful and gentle yoga moment with your child during these parent-child workshops at L'Atelier 77. Designed for children aged 3 to 6, the session blends postures, breathing, and games.

6185865f50150b800a2930bc2fe23503fd940c03.en: Explore the playful world of clowning with your child during this energetic workshop at Studio M. Kids and parents use games and improvisation to discover their comic potential together.

0a26d3cb520456cb8258cfacba120cae2ae0c544.en: Experience a full day of krump and hip-hop at La Place with high-energy battles and underground vibes. Watch dancers give everything on stage or join to feel the unique atmosphere.

08653d7952755c98d3d4358468ddf37eb9b31866.en: Immerse yourself in North Indian classical music with a Hindustani music workshop at Théâtre Mandapa. Discover the rich tradition guided by renowned international artists.

a31295868fb5fb93bcd398765d3460dec0390665.en: Enjoy a half-day of sports activities and participatory games at Gymnase Didot during Fiertés Games 2026. Take part in badminton, dance, table tennis, yoga, and more.

e96a941415752af557338fccbc8ae474f6e41ab5.en: Explore your relationship to movement and body awareness during Géraldine Chollet's workshop at Le Carreau du Temple. Open to all levels, the session offers a deep dive into physical expression.

858287b42138454536dc3f52809c68885b14467a.en: Discover a musical spectacle based on Sophie Vissière's book at Le Pavillon de la Sirène. Linda Edsjö and Wilfried Wendling use field recordings and instruments to awaken the senses.

677c2d98d21dd7413a9cf8dbff05ed6524961f3a.en: Enjoy a family-friendly circus show at Conservatoire Darius Milhaud with artists presenting diverse circus arts. A fast-paced, one-hour performance accessible to all ages.

1251d66fd73c462d2a3864fdec030863486b080a.en: Listen to Renaissance vocal polyphony performed by Quatuor vocal Marenzio at église Notre Dame du Travail. The programme features works by Dowland, Janequin, Marenzio, Lassus, and Purcell.

31176df6e547b5bfca925c6f4610a186066894e1.en: Celebrate Beethoven's Pastoral Symphony and discover new choral works at La Seine Musicale. The evening also features a world premiere by Alexandre Manoukian and pieces by Augusta Holmès.

fbe509ad8b65028c627f9042ae178e1e62841cbe.en: Experience a classical vocal and piano recital featuring singer Lucie Deroïan and pianist Corine Durous at Église Saint-Merry. Enjoy a performance shaped by their extensive careers in opera.

dc0a771c6fd3e494e8aa267f8f064af4fc19f190.en: Attend a screening and debate about Patrice Spadoni's film at the Mémorial de la Shoah de Drancy. The discussion explores the lives of three friends navigating the 1930s and WWII.

15dcf072d7a5dc4ceef58a1b16224f67f1cf00fc.en: Join a collective reflection on immigration with a conference by Nicolas Samsoen at Notre Dame d'Espérance. The afternoon includes small-group discussions, a Q&A, and a shared drink.

eaf07d6f07e28ebe8e55313320575b854ba51d70.en: Watch Agnieszka Juszczak's film tracing the life and work of artist Alina Szapocznikow at the Mémorial de la Shoah. The screening is followed by a conversation with the director.

838a5cca24318f91d96c37f99a4c28093bd9daa6.en: Enjoy gypsy jazz at 38Riv Jazz Club with the Fanou Torracinta trio presenting their album La Belle vie. The intimate Marais venue offers a sensitive blend of swing and Corsican traditions.

7cda11e3ecff8e96df5f6de4562fe31808204b1b.en: Experience North Indian classical music at Théâtre Mandapa featuring the sitar and tabla. Virtuoso musicians showcase traditional ragas and intricate rhythms of Hindustani music.

72ec6ef7ffa0680a2e28abb45c544ef9cdf62cca.en: Celebrate Antillean culture at Digital village with dance classes, Gwoka, Konpa, and a retro Zouk evening. Join in for a festive day of music, dance, and sharing in Paris.

e5597f5f4195e3b0cf3dfa7f568737f2e464e04a.en: Head to Supersonic for a free Sunday Tribute night dedicated to pop punk. Local bands will cover hits from legendary groups like Blink-182, Green Day, and Sum 41.

b2a11ae5c7b25740e2add1fbffd20b090c674d0b.en: Pierre Manetti, Bastien Ribot and the Charlier-Sourisse tandem present a jazz journey blending Babik Reinhardt pieces, Brazilian standards and original compositions. Expect virtuosity and creative freedom from this talented quartet.

8ddeab0bfcae3e77c78ccbb9d61ca0b5539b3a5e.en: Dylan Choisi hosts a Sunday night jazz jam session at Le Baiser Salé, bringing together rising talents and established musicians to improvise. Head down to experience spontaneous, groove-heavy collective energy.

291d77e4d90b839f067b274eea9c4cc0a5dae1fc.en: Double bassist Chris Jennings performs a solo concert at the intimate 38Riv Jazz Club, drawing on influences from jazz and global music traditions. A unique chance to hear a remarkable sideman in a stripped-back setting.

858a2eafb003561b94616c5eb5c7fdbece0f26af.en: Mary Jimenez and Bénédicte Liénard present two documentary films focusing on survival, exploitation and human resilience in Peru, followed by discussions with the directors.

9015cefb8a4dff183e8ab83fccf5f8bfa8b9ddce.en: Mathieu Forget exhibits a decade of levitation photographs on the grilles of the Tour Saint-Jacques. Explore this free outdoor display celebrating movement, architecture and the freedom of the human body.

b4c14e9ff6e4eee80072c90c0b5b40e887aa285a.en: Join a free educational workshop on dendromicrohabitats at Maison Paris Nature in the Parc Floral de Paris. Advance online registration is required.

fe489cc19f9e4de2fc5d0a5495031b509afd5814.en: The professors of the Conservatoire de Paris perform Ralph Vaughan Williams's Quintet in C minor in the Salle Gabriel Fauré. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy classical chamber music played by faculty members.

8fa36eef622cccb0c6319943e3d617e1e0df1ffa.en: Author Isabelle Grégoire discusses her latest novel, Dans ta flamme, at the Bibliothèque Gaston-Miron. The talk is hosted by journalist Laurence Pivot and followed by a friendly drink.

d09a45e05bb0407a8c4074e36d5ce6758d7b197d.en: The Festival Avec la langue at Pan Piper showcases diverse francophone musical artists over three evenings. Discover emerging voices in chanson, folk, pop and rap.

8748a6426146db883fa034e8e67cb03035fe0528.en: Denis Herlin and Aline Zylberach present a concert around the historical Manuscrit Caumont, featuring harpsichord restitution from a masterclass.

082aeeaf9c80b3bc9e1cf5348f999084742f09f9.en: Pianist Caroline Sageman shares the personal stories and pressures behind her international career in a free cultural event at the Conservatoire Hector Berlioz.

e1d28982ab2bf787f47de708cf33dcbad1463a6a.en: The 27th Festival de Théâtre Amateur de Paris brings seven amateur theatre companies to Salle Jean Dame for a week of contemporary plays. Come support local troupes and celebrate the passion of live performance.

7da089816659043769d6daa7706216a86b5ed41c.en: Ensemble Sequenza 9.3 launches its new album with a choral performance celebrating oral traditions and global lullabies. Nine vocalists and a santur player blend folk heritage with contemporary composition.

682964ee6a9ab764614f5fdd9c628bc32166d7a9.en: The Orchestre de chambre de Paris performs works by Haydn, Mozart and Schoenberg at the Théâtre du Châtelet, conducted by Izabelė Jankauskaitė. Pianist Aimi Kobayashi joins for Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 27.

7a27ad3047bfe994592fd152f3a16bc3168c6959.en: Students from the Conservatoire Hector Berlioz present a tragicomic farce by Hanokh Levin about a frantic family escape. Enjoy a dark and burlesque theatrical performance.

fdac8069d2e4a65611d591a737cd68ce8aa4115f.en: Igor Kovalsky directs Les Vibrations du verre at Théâtre 13, a play exploring human addiction to screens and the metaverse. Follow Kelly's struggle to reconnect her loved ones with the real world.

fd4569daaacbaf152aa3eafa915c84eccc619780.en: The Orchestre de chambre de Paris explores Austrian musical history at the Théâtre du Châtelet, featuring symphonic and piano works by Haydn, Mozart and Schoenberg.

cb2b5c516d551f5bd0199e0796fae9c7cfc75454.en: Meow Meow brings her acclaimed cabaret performance to the Athénée Théâtre Louis-Jouvet. Enjoy an international evening of original music and theatrical flair from a renowned collaborator.

937953477c09497ef2d6f516ecab18daa0d482e7.en: Guacayo performs at PopUp! as part of their Dancing in the Moonlight tour, blending indie pop, reggae and dub. Catch their energetic show for a night of rhythm and social connection.

7823cac34f12be796a4896ee1321688622ef01da.en: Duo a piacere presents a free piano and violin concert exploring three centuries of Ukrainian music and history. Discover rarely heard compositions through an engaging musical storytelling format.

221e459fe25788fe42bd43e895da3b6271e78b61.en: Enjoy a free classical concert at Studio l'Accord Parfait where pianist DOm Paulin shares stories behind the works and composers. It is an accessible and engaging musical journey through different cultures and centuries.

624cc9b3308226c294ab4d89ef8e71a14ff69f02.en: Catch multi-instrumentalist Gustave Reichert at the intimate 38Riv Jazz Club as he presents compositions from his album MARS alongside new tracks and standards. Expect a unique blend of jazz, raw energy, and cinematic soundscapes.

f90cfe2c0257a9fc1f20e393365bed8f6431de5c.en: Experience Soie at Le Funambule Montmartre, a theatrical adaptation following a 1960s silkworm merchant whose journey to Japan sparks a life-changing romance. It is an evocative exploration of impossible love, obsession, and desire.

4b65de0bc1100633f09181cb6d03cd3248facd00.en: Explore original illustrations by Gerda Muller and classic versions of Little Red Riding Hood at Bibliothèque L'Heure joyeuse. This exhibition revisits the enduring tale to highlight its themes of innocence, danger, and vigilance.

585685b3d5443c33a8dfaf2848379824fd54e7f1.en: Discover creative works born from encounters between local libraries and shelter residents in the 18th arrondissement. The programme features screenings, creative workshops, and storytelling celebrating food and human connection.

8555372f32ffb0c47f2944a61d299072d693cde8.en: Discover the traditional art of Ikebana Sogetsu at the Maison de la culture du Japon à Paris. Master Iemoto Akane Teshigahara presents a special exhibition showcasing both traditional and contemporary floral compositions.

221083a9e1a2a5e14ba5108e9b1cc2e04cfffccb.en: Join an English-language book club session at Bibliothèque Germaine Tillion dedicated to Agatha Christie. Share your thoughts on Miss Marple and Hercule Poirot while discovering new reads with fellow fans.

cb8632791e901bfae1b8e27231cab00012f93f65.en: Browse a selection of Japanese art and objects at Galerie les Passeurs de Ruisseaux. The exhibition is accompanied by Broc'Japan, a community flea market dedicated to Japanese items.

ecda275a0dee960def025250e21143fe9c08dd56.en: Discover works in progress by young artists and companies at Théâtre municipal Berthelot - Jean Guerrin. This discovery platform offers a chance to see emerging talent and join discussions with artists and professionals.

ba9f840adf0619088bea4e46b7198207064c8ba7.en: Listen to librarians and readers share excerpts from the works of writer Georges Perec at Bibliothèque des Batignolles. It is a welcoming public reading celebrating the author's distinct literary voice.

23988ce26440e2d4529bdff47442d8dd44e93486.en: Explore the historic village of Passy on a guided walking tour with the Comité d'histoire de la Ville de Paris. Discover medieval remnants, eighteenth-century houses, and stunning Art Nouveau architecture.

ddab363ff04e96fd9b53deacf7111a6dd7789842.en: Take part in inclusive games and activities at Bibliothèque Benoîte Groult as part of the Festival des fiertés. Enjoy collaborative puzzles and creative colouring designed to celebrate diversity and raise awareness against discrimination.

e2f0e84f3d1a655f8dca006f3248dd1c704a5a11.en: Explore the often-overlooked history of female homosexuality in francophone literature at Bibliothèque Sorbonne Nouvelle. This talk highlights works from the late nineteenth century to today as part of the Festival des fiertés.

27ec68692a5b9597c91c1fccc92f5ca0be83c16d.en: Discover the history of hot chocolate through readings of Madame de Sévigné's letters at the Bibliothèque historique de la Ville de Paris. Food historian Katherine Khodorowsky hosts the evening, complete with a live tasting of a seventeenth-century court recipe.

d868fff46564a0fbbf1621b40fb33c011e14109b.en: Attend a free screening and panel discussion at Théâtre Douze focusing on international solidarity and community engagement in Argentina and Chile. The evening accompanies the Portraits de Résistantes exhibition at Centre Paris Anim' Maurice Ravel.

faf1c35ee4cb1161a7985ad736aa3acbd4a6750c.en: Celebrate the centenary of composer Jacques Castérède with concerts and student performances across venues including the CRR de Boulogne-Billancourt. The programme features orchestral works, contemporary creations, and musical tributes.

fdb49b8117c56cc6f7b4e669cd794f3e8a15d4be.en: Attend a historical conference at the Hôtel de Ville exploring the lively and inventive theatrical scene of the Foire Saint-Germain during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries. Experts discuss how forain showmen bypassed institutional monopolies through creative performances.

f61bbfb5f2e77888b13406d7580e527d8b4a7258.en: Learn about the physics, chemistry, and culture of taste in a public lecture by CNRS researcher Christophe Lavelle at Bibliothèque Robert Sabatier. Discover how science and the human sciences shape our daily relationship with food.

06c205f618f8618364970f09870ab8acca079aff.en: Visit an engaging exhibition on secondary victimisation at the Maison de la Vie Associative et Citoyenne du 13e arrondissement. Organised during the month against violence against women, it invites public awareness and discussion with association members.

5f944333415ddf35cfa5804347ebd7584bbe574f.en: Catch LA-based grungegaze project Shaki Tavi live at Supersonic alongside Paris shoegaze act Subzero Fun. Expect soaring distorted guitars and driving rhythms in an intimate gig setting.

cbbd8586ebac71dd8bd0e0d0461eb373afa5d40b.en: Le COSU vous invite à découvrir la musique du Pérou à travers un répertoire varié allant du huayno aux valses créoles. Ce concert participatif célèbre les rituels collectifs et les hommages à la terre.

e6787c8b1421b92c1e2eb1bcdbd30333cf2db094.en: Découvrez le film muet Gyurkovicsarna de 1920, présenté par des experts et accompagné au piano par un élève de Jean-François Zygel. Une séance gratuite sur réservation à la Fondation Jérôme Seydoux-Pathé.

41ff3c6a42742573b1afd3265e73aa022743aaed.en: L'atelier Masque et Musique présente Funérailles d'hiver de Hanokh Levin, une farce tragique et burlesque. Une plongée satirique dans une société prête à tout pour éviter une mauvaise nouvelle.

fe0193ec1534f7aae061083ee8ccc4c7dfb45205.en: Fatima Daas invite l'écrivain et cinéaste marocain Abdellah Taïa pour un premier rendez-vous littéraire. Ensemble, ils échangent autour de la mémoire et de l'identité en lien avec leurs origines.

cfe8457d57031847b62b401468207c0188ffddb4.en: Pauline Bureau adapte le récit d'Adélaïde Bon pour raconter la reconstruction d'Alma après une agression subie trente ans plus tôt. Un spectacle sensible qui explore les liens entre intime et politique au CENTQUATRE-PARIS.

40727291b1ee03357faf128cc8907a1ff6ff1e6a.en: Une rencontre au Théâtre de la Concorde pour analyser la manière dont les fictions politiques façonnent notre compréhension du pouvoir. L'occasion de croiser les regards sur la représentation de la démocratie à la télévision.

2ff5ea21a36b5661c82925caaed81fb85a3289b0.en: Le Collectif Bajour présente FauWst, une réinterprétation moderne et poétique du mythe de Faust. Un voyage initiatique à travers un univers marqué par les désastres écologiques et le techno-fascisme.

debce9e9d18f17ff189585944372a2fa28a28104.en: Le Mémorial de la Shoah organise son gala annuel au Théâtre des Champs-Elysées. Une soirée de soutien importante proposant différentes catégories de places avec reçu fiscal.

56dc085f17d8deb457c5b7aedc3666fccb93eba9.en: Géraldine Chollet présente La Tendresse du ventre de la baleine, une pièce dansante et musicale inspirée du mythe de Jonas. Une expérience sensorielle et immersive qui invite au partage et à la joie.

93581ae9e1fc5540db035e15aee55ea562b1ac09.en: La contrebassiste et chanteuse Louise Knobil revisite ses standards de jazz préférés accompagnée de ses musiciens. Un concert intimiste à découvrir au 38Riv Jazz Club.

d279b2cd089fbea9af21f35c20728648a9a46fc6.en: Le festival Ici Demain met en avant une nouvelle génération d'artistes émergents de la création contemporaine. Un événement chaleureux qui offre à de jeunes talents leurs premiers pas sur scène.

63c75a266d93df6531c2edad83eabf9c0025a5d6.en: La septième édition du festival Ici Demain investit FGO-Barbara pour mettre en avant la jeune création contemporaine. Venez découvrir une programmation éclectique d'artistes émergents dans le quartier de la Goutte d'Or.

3d99829a5d016a17a7a8312db003dba358f3da9d.en: Des conteurs et musiciens vous guident à travers une visite sensorielle et interactive de l'exposition Semons nos résistances. Une balade culturelle rythmée par les traditions orales et les sonorités créoles.

b4dccf24d474bf3e839f733e1d446a950be884b7.en: Le CIDJ vous donne rendez-vous pour explorer les formations et les métiers du numérique et de l'intelligence artificielle. Profitez de conseils personnalisés et de conférences avec des professionnels pour construire votre avenir.

5be67599e46a97c2225b02566e8e9e68583b6cfb.en: Les Margotines proposent un moment de lecture partagée pour initier les tout-petits au plaisir des livres. Une animation gratuite ouverte aux enfants de 0 à 3 ans à la médiathèque Marguerite Yourcenar.

d4f90bc31e6c30d2f53d06bfe915f8b57923d328.en: La bibliothèque Saint-Eloi propose une heure du conte accessible en français et en langue des signes française. Une belle occasion de partager des histoires et des comptines avec les tout-petits.

150ef14df7466618909d51ce15262d6d1c7bc705.en: Participez à une animation de jeux de société sur le thème de l'automne à la Maison Paris Nature. Une activité gratuite et accessible sur inscription au Pavillon 2 du Parc Floral de Paris.

f42661a8554ebb000bb49844c778d068267ff31a.en: La Fabrique de la Solidarité organise un atelier de confection et de décoration de boîtes de Noël solidaires. Venez partager un moment convivial et créatif pour soutenir les personnes en situation de précarité.

8ab0b5627ad54d9e9cfb32bfcc34d4f0ac9df9f0.en: Participez en famille au Prix Chronos de littérature avec la découverte de huit albums pour les enfants de 5 à 8 ans. Une lecture projetée suivie d'un vote pour cultiver le plaisir de lire entre générations.

c8b1152a4608c912d9ec0b2ecd20f1b5b7b61ec5.en: Le festival Close Up propose un atelier de création radiophonique pour explorer la ville à travers le son. Les participants s'initient à l'enregistrement et partagent leurs perceptions des paysages sonores.

8cdbf8cad82c78e2dd03e3d35f42140102acf516.en: Discover traditional and contemporary Japanese ikebana styles with master Iemoto Akane Teshigahara through continuous film screenings.

d98ff87d315630d69685adbc688a771c1bf54538.en: Noémie Sanson presents a storytelling session filled with traditional tales, songs, and gentle thrills for children and adults alike.

1ce775b846fa334f0e9aa925eab18139e02d6fe6.en: Enjoy a screening of the silent film Le Petit fugitif accompanied by a live piano and vocal score performed by Nicolas Cante.

bfd60d1d71029958057873429606e4dfe0deb4cf.en: Join journalist Julia Sirieix for a podcast workshop to discuss your favorite manga and learn how to create your own collective episode.

5be338c5d6e522ba998c9258f7517f356499f9c7.en: Children can enjoy gentle, lighthearted storytelling sessions featuring friendly scares and clever mice heroes.

98086154c5707f3cbcfa8011494f2ebd6cc0358f.en: Attend a nature reading session focused on misunderstood animals at the Maison Paris Nature.

3f9e33864e6804aa0834f7b167a30c9673d8a7b7.en: Children aged 5 to 8 can experiment with creative techniques using colors, brushes, and scissors inspired by illustrated books.

e9b7d9e0204cecce99d96586dac76e6e8092a66b.en: Children aged 5 to 8 can learn simple gardening skills like planting and watering during this hands-on workshop.

62f6c46cb4bfb408c2f4d56a1c782bc99fe4f852.en: Les Contes à Paillettes invite families and children aged 4 and up to engaging drag queen and king storytelling sessions promoting empathy and self-confidence.

b021c902310094da9d2f08707c1ea58f0e1c4106.en: Children aged 6 and up can craft their own rain stick during this creative workshop celebrating the Monte Le Son festival.

40639df852cc09c478292e48f166ff77602511ab.en: Violonist Déborah Nemtanu and clarinettist Florent Pujuila perform a musical discovery concert bringing David Litchfield's bear tale to life.

690d4572735f7b024b27e7c1f9d7128eaa7f9fa1.en: Explore makesense space, a collaborative workspace offering free public events, conferences, and discussions focused on social and environmental change.

f7bd95c89b08c47cfb527a1fa176577a3983d662.en: Learn a dance movement from Hofesh Shechter's Grand Finale with student dancers ahead of the upcoming performances.

f44303de2dbdc33c33284834dbe64357bc7498d0.en: Join researchers and the public for a roundtable discussion on the economics, culture, and power dynamics of football leadership.

5c401c45bb9ff85366e50ef2e372a675bd2c27c5.en: Catch live indie punk and dark alternative grunge performances from touring bands CARSICK and CARNE.

92eb1bb2da0ba1e14a4d57a7280515c16580d76f.en: Discover Mehis Heinsaar's new novel with translator Antoine Chalvin and publisher Emilie Maj during this literary presentation.

307f3f39c8af6c82b3d459051e51675f78abc12c.en: Historian Philippe Artières hosts a conference exploring the history of writings and archival practices among prisoners.

b3f3398c368af73afa02200f13539ea972593849.en: Franco-Peruvian singer Christine Audat presents her creation HAMACA in a concert bridging cultural traditions at the UNESCO headquarters.

4344c8a316100b29f12d0c284c28a5bc2f433a55.en: Discover emerging artists Blaise & Nico, Iri, and Louison performing a mix of French chanson, experimental pop, and global rhythms.

9c2209ca68647258b979d2b55a90e8315763b81a.en: Emmanuelle Bertrand and Pascal Amoyel perform transcendent Franz Schubert pieces in an immersive classical concert.

cc1747ded2bbf89182d6bc621961b27ec4ac81d5.en: This playful workshop explores the basics of improvisation to help participants let go and build spontaneous stories together. It is designed for anyone looking to spark their imagination and try something new.

a5a86d218fb88dac623d29eeedd744df343a7aeb.en: As part of the Festival des Fiertés, this screening of Céline Sciamma's Tomboy follows a young child exploring identity and belonging over the summer. It offers a delicate look at childhood and a space for reflection on gender identity.

1689508ae298adb9029b50dcd4d79a32a74d60f5.en: Flow Rea is an Estonian trio blending hip-hop grooves, soul depth, and jazz freedom. Catch them live for a refined, contemporary set born from collective improvisation.

33d2e0bbb28dfe6d113c7b1344140c4b43f97b40.en: Flagranti is a theatrical piece inspired by the realities faced by the LGBTQIA+ community in Tunisia. It explores a high-stakes turning point where personal lives collide with strict laws and state systems.

9ba04c3a89fcc5e1e0ca5ef2b3f6118b69a7a358.en: Two artists invite the audience to co-create a live sound fiction from scratch. Come explore storytelling and togetherness through an unexpected collective experience.

66e8339a9e905d2e18fb1d68a552b9b89ef7c8f4.en: This play follows a successful online star returning to her hometown to reunite with her mother after a ten-year absence. It offers a nuanced, heartfelt look at family bonds and social pressures.

45ba59970f1c64216fe8c50a11fed8dbbabb5b64.en: Thierry Péala and Vérioca Lherm celebrate twenty years of collaboration with a lively concert bridging jazz, samba, and Brazilian rhythms. They are joined on stage by special guest musicians for a generous anniversary performance.

e20a9d42b7601f96bfea1d194861a48ffd9b3a2c.en: The Ari Hoenig Trio brings its innovative jazz rhythms to an intimate venue for a rare live performance. It is a unique chance to see these acclaimed musicians up close during their European tour.

8d69b1e710422ccadac17eae45f6d2ed6178f667.en: This guided outdoor session helps participants learn how to recognize different bird songs. It takes place at the Maison Paris Nature and is fully accessible.

37fd3b5891e7387fe15865cc9f1e53cbf6be92d0.en: The Salon Artisans d'Excellence returns to showcase contemporary decorative arts and exceptional craftsmanship. Visitors can explore works from around a hundred specialized ateliers working with wood, metal, glass, and more.

22c75856053feb0b642cef4d8cfc3c547a52465c.en: This salon brings together numerous structures and resources to support and inform family caregivers of individuals with disabilities. It is a space to discover practical aid, connect with local actors, and access respite solutions.

47783892cd852df835850145d594d09350d8dbc7.en: Master instructor Iemoto Akane Teshigahara leads a special workshop on traditional and contemporary Ikebana styles. Participants can discover the subtle art of Japanese floral composition firsthand.

fe4b93588165663386b5981e6716a33f4e859fa0.en: This filmed radio discussion brings together researchers and activists to talk about recognizing and tackling discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity. Part of the Festival des Fiertés, it aims to share practical resources for a more inclusive society.

3cbd544cf1306507d19c1f6c79ab0ab7708d5093.en: This reading event highlights contemporary and foundational works of Quebecois lesbian literature, spanning poetry, graphic novels, and romance. Presented as part of the Festival des Fiertés, the session concludes with a friendly gathering.

fb26e62d5d10d67a886dc2fc3a25ee1981b98c7d.en: La Maison de la Vie Associative et Citoyenne du 7e arrondissement propose une formation destinée aux bénévoles engagés dans la solidarité. Elle permet de mieux s'orienter dans l'offre sociale parisienne et d'accompagner le public.

94ef08d73e92713422efcdf53075082bac2bff95.en: This conference examines how class structures and social positions shape the films we watch, from production to reception. It invites audiences to look at cinema through the lens of the bourgeois gaze.

6f487972ffea36e3d6d0acf0914567f545ac4e92.en: This translation workshop invites participants of all Spanish proficiency levels to work on a literary text alongside professional translator Marianne Millon. Together, the group explores the original text and shares translated versions during an interactive session.

69c941f278d54b26c2c2901589265dda20d12f67.en: This collage workshop focuses on visual storytelling and identity by using recycled magazines and photographs to build unique characters. Led by an inclusive image education facilitator, it invites participants to rethink media messages.

672cb9917c3eed28226cd610a8ce4851317dc12c.en: Catch 60juno and Kino Motel live for an evening of dreampop, post-punk, and beach goth sounds. Head down to the venue to discover these distinct international indie acts.

49bf5c0995bebc60cfa653e3a16ee0a03d8c01f6.en: Students and professors from the early music department present a joint performance exploring the links between literature and music.

96648e52fa5f5672a567f641df4f4bd375ffea64.en: Explore the connection between forests and climate change during a conference and participatory workshops with Maxime Blondeau at the Académie du climat.

4e57e9b1d9d30054c82e55cd7443c4fdd6757121.en: Scottish band Baby Chaos celebrates the 30th anniversary of their album Love Your Self Abuse with a rare live performance at Théâtre Traversière.

87894e14fcc30d52a955127b07015401a4220420.en: Enjoy a musical sharing session featuring classical, jazz, and traditional clarinet pieces performed by the students of Stéphanie Carne at the Conservatoire Municipal Nadia et Lili Boulanger.

dffa9519c8b16b253ce04d0801790f8e1f96498b.en: Polish reporter Wojciech Tochman discusses his literary works, ethics in journalism, and the suffering of animals in times of war at the Bibliothèque André Malraux.

115f165d14719c35552b9328c4c36ae6a1cdd7cc.en: Discover the history and challenges of filmed justice through archival exploration and a discussion with author Sylvie Lindeperg and director Guillaume Moscovitz at the Mémorial de la Shoah.

83e96127b3b99df6c24e010c3c6187de54b57d36.en: Learn about the history, architectural conversion, and environmental stakes of the Halle Pajol project through a documentary screening and discussion at the Bibliothèque Václav Havel.

8ba176616038fd1d42492db109c76b21b0695f62.en: Join anthropologists Bénédicte Bonzi and Olivia Braconnier at the Bibliothèque François Villon to discuss food democracy, access to healthy food, and agricultural challenges.

94139d2ef7e619f733dc7920ac9c37095143a9fb.en: Gaëlle Bourges presents Guillaume & Harold at La Maison des Métallos, a playful and inventive stage adaptation of the Bayeux Tapestry designed for all ages.

252fd12107345b4ef1af00ad3c064ddc6dffac41.en: Screening of Margaux Fournier's documentary Au Bain des Dames at the Bibliothèque Claire Bretécher, celebrating the lively conversations of retired women on a beach in Marseille.

438e59500c053396e308f5c7343d114a17449346.en: Jean-Luc Cesco's documentary Eredità at the Bibliothèque Georges Brassens explores the lives of two neighbors facing illness, memory, and family heritage.

9f610f5f8f6175e0f2e7462a93f740e221749c81.en: Explore a newly discovered collection of photographs documenting the first mass arrest of Jews in France at the Mémorial de la Shoah.

42e0148944d9cfed08fe96b78bad715c9c8d53b1.en: Catch live performances by 100kiki and Ave Amapola at FGO-Barbara as part of the Ici Demain festival, blending indie, electronic, and global pop sounds.

30bac0680be8f3376ef0a83c56af1f71dc62f9c3.en: Soprano Agathe Peyrat and accordionist Pierre Cussac reinvent classical, traditional, and popular songs in a singular concert at the Zèbre de Belleville.

a78237ddc305a11c2d7658da444ada48ce694e23.en: Gabi Hartmann and Louis Matute perform a blend of jazz, poetry, and Brazilian influences in an intimate concert at the Centre Culturel Arménien Alex Manoogian.

9a62c231657e36e5ebd11e826f980e90763535c5.en: Sylvain Gaudu's play at Théâtre L'étoile du nord follows a group of regulars at a public pool, focusing on an aging woman facing the early stages of dementia.

e19487a98b40423ec0e787e12546bccf219711c7.en: Léa Millet's show at Théâtre Paris-Villette follows a family gathering at a karaoke restaurant to sing and share memories after the death of their matriarch.

e0420d32e7fa5a47e006f418d5a147326ffd1151.en: Ruth Childs and Cécile Bouffard present Such a Devoted Bunch at the Atelier de Paris, a performance exploring memory, folklore, and collective body movement.

a8fb0bff83c6f07b310371d89c47d3d877d923ba.en: Théâtre Ouvert hosts a theatrical narrative following a young boy's journey through a seaside town, encounters with his brother, and a transition to city life.

1ff24e5abe9ca02d370816e7d264cd8d0be7cb1e.en: Amanda Tedesco directs Insectes at Théâtre 13, a dystopian fable using insect characters to explore political power, authoritarianism, and social struggles.

82bf549b2a6e130492186873b16e7d5be2f53801.en: Bunker Kyiv at Centre Paris Anim' Point du Jour presents a free-verse text inspired by testimonies, offering a unique perspective on life inside a war bunker in Ukraine.

3d37ad80fc63b225a436de83d467fe7f662b7142.en: Eboni Fondren and her Parisian jazz band bring the swinging, gospel-infused sounds of Kansas City to the stage. Expect a unique vocal performance from the acclaimed American jazz singer.

60051a0b7ea916942236f9d6109defee817bf56e.en: Suzanne de Baecque and Joaquim Fossi present a theatrical journey exploring modern romance through personal testimonies and live audience texts. It offers a touching and practical guide to flirting in the digital age.

d068168e04afea86ac3b910221185bd64cae81d8.en: This electronic music workshop introduces participants to the workings of vintage synthesizers and post-punk aesthetics. Learn how to tame electronic machines and channel the anti-consumerist energy of legendary 1970s and 1980s bands.

7248c30d4006d8cfa56ec47f9fec51268e9a7896.en: Join a nature event dedicated to the European robin at the Maison Paris Nature in the Parc Floral de Paris. Registration is free and mandatory to attend this session.

d4be89c5372840ba0320c740d4ca7a3db5d09012.en: This tactile workshop invites visually impaired visitors to explore an exhibition dedicated to the School of Paris using audio guides and tactile boards.

01ca73669c57d811c0ee0ef50dcf9e8886e4d52b.en: Take part in a free art workshop at the Maison Paris Nature in the Parc Floral de Paris. Advance registration is required to secure a spot for this accessible activity.

890b9f813319f4bc29d8796e2d463727809100dc.en: Le Carreau du Temple hosts a special program focusing on juvenile justice, featuring a performance by Sonia Chiambretto, a documentary by Thibaud Croisy, and a roundtable discussion. It highlights the often-invisible realities of young people in reform and the daily lives of educators.

7445a320bcda5c72d37659711cb43b8e1549ab4d.en: Screenwriter Justine Muzas leads a hands-on scriptwriting workshop using a narrative card game. Participants will learn how to build characters, define genres, and pitch engaging stories.

ac30a77c10d7af3199159e9825d596d59871c30b.en: Discover a selection of mystery and investigation board games at the library. It is a playful evening dedicated to puzzle-solving and the famous Queen of Crime.

c95dc2e93d5cfc64c0f10f499c8413475aa660ed.en: Grand master Akane Teshigahara hosts an exceptional conference on Sogetsu Ikebana, the traditional Japanese art of floral arrangement. Discover both traditional and contemporary styles in this lecture with consecutive French translation.

a5868369f7ffead0602d55558151d1ed1bd2755d.en: Join the librarians for a friendly evening of board games where you can discover new titles and share a fun time. LSF interpretation is available for this session.

ec06bf246af9a80313762b152c25d8755c051024.en: A roundtable discussion addressing the place of women and gender minorities in the French music industry today. Four industry professionals explore ongoing challenges and initiatives for equality, followed by a concert.

81dea8864b6763feb4359787d8b586d789a20597.en: American saxophonist Steve Potts leads a master class on jazz improvisation with students, followed by a public restitution concert. Come experience the collective dimension of jazz through his compositions and standards.

05d06a65767ec90bbddd2aca54e41fceaa5eb211.en: Enjoy a silent film screening of Harold Lloyd's Safety Last accompanied by a live musical cine-concert. Frédéric Pérol and Julien Coulon provide an inventive soundtrack for this classic 1924 comedy.

78b610dbb52a8473f15d874aed3c880c5c65f6a2.en: Isaias Alves brings his vibrant Brazilian rhythms and jazz improvisation to the stage for a live musical encounter. Experience a vibrant musical space where traditional sounds and modern jazz meet.

32cdc81e20439f57592dff24be6c7c899f58cb62.en: Pianist Vanessa Wagner performs a solo piano recital exploring a diverse repertoire from classical pieces to contemporary works. Experience the unique artistry of a widely acclaimed musician in an intimate setting.

4292b8fb41ecb4508f91213e63c24c73de6c46ca.en: Journalist and author Jennifer Padjemi leads a conference exploring the evolution of women's roles in the music industry. She discusses contemporary socio-cultural phenomena and industry trends through a critical lens.

39f3f11bc521115816fe6534d9846d12cb854797.en: The Nautilus Quartet performs a musical journey spanning classical string quartets by Mozart and Haydn, modern works by Ravel, and Saint-Saëns' festive Carnival of the Animals. This rich programme bridges classical elegance with timeless storytelling.

0a1e12f6174f14ee109ae6c61df31ee8d9dffe2a.en: Author, chess player, and storyteller Alain Tardits presents a multidisciplinary and lively stage performance. Expect an engaging encounter filled with stories and book signings.

debddad9b17c239db45a7e347e0311fc596f11a0.en: Fgo-Barbara hosts an evening featuring performances by emerging artists Fawzi, Gt1boiavantcsurr, and Iasam. Discover a diverse lineup blending melodic rap, alternative chanson, and electronic textures.

b7eb54ada727786c4c9f77c69495476de3d33aff.en: Au Pairs perform live at Petit Bain, revisiting their 1981 debut album alongside new tracks. Formed in 1978, the post-punk band combines rhythmic, funk-influenced sounds with politically engaged themes.

777d039348a0c4708162a0c12fcd39aa1a07cc07.en: Bertrand Ferrier presents a musical tribute to Guy Béart at Le Kibélé. He performs and brings the author's memorable songs back to life on stage.

662641ed23fb75acafc7e7064b2aa99de823fd59.en: The Francis Poulenc Municipal Conservatory hosts a chamber music programme exploring sound colors from the early 20th century. Musicians perform works by Ravel, Debussy, and Britten.

57f403cd8bc5171ba48a6c09653fa5be31bbab3d.en: La Barbichette Cabaret takes over La Machine du Moulin Rouge with an artistic evening blending poetry, satire, and music. Monsieur K. leads this participatory event where the audience engages directly with the performance.

0f3b6460df4e647425f297a66c34a8f2366470f7.en: Manda Sira Sissoko performs at La Scène du Canal in an immersive trio format. Drawing on her Malian griot roots, she blends traditional percussions with soul, blues, and pop influences.

50fd029159576dceef112ed824153299af5e4fdb.en: Maud Blandel presents Same Old Songs at the Théâtre Public de Montreuil, drawing inspiration from Virginia Woolf's Three Guineas. Three dancers explore sound dramaturgy and the relationship between body and rhythm.

0f4abf18fece2fe57ded072054247b7d44138fd0.en: The Francis Poulenc Municipal Conservatory presents a chamber music concert featuring Ernest Chausson's rare Concert alongside César Franck's Sonata. Listeners can discover the lyrical connection between the two composers.

cd026369c1038e52e5e527a0df473e42af1a8227.en: Paris Banlieue performs at Médiathèque Françoise Sagan as part of Festival Monte le Son. The trio plays acoustic pop-rock-punk songs combining poetic lyrics and diverse musical styles.

72aec64ec726a5f309279537fc247025fb55ca72.en: New York jazz vocalist and composer Anaïs Reno performs her first concerts in France at the 38Riv Jazz Club. Accompanied by Jamie Safir and Sameer Shankar, she presents music from her latest releases.

6a1fd2d79fb959d8ac725cdb590052fbe44f02db.en: The Port des Champs-Élysées hosts the annual night run supporting the Institut Curie. Participants can choose from various running and walking formats while enjoying festive entertainment.

e041c43d67a1586016ae517549a7753516b8254a.en: Aline César and Damien Dutrait lead a creative writing workshop at MPAA/Saint-Blaise exploring family narratives. Participants use personal archives to rewrite a part of their family history, culminating in a public performance.

f642dcc0e6cdf4f4a75771c5684e6eeddcdbb510.en: Children and their companions can build a cardboard megaphone with Les Inventeurs at the MAIF Social Club. This hands-on workshop explores sound propagation and how shape amplifies the voice.

1c5dc52fc9ecb5fa8cbb3e9f6779bca39cd76668.en: The MAIF Social Club offers an electronic music initiation workshop for young people aged 8 to 13. Participants learn how synthesizers work inspired by the punk and post-punk movements.

2f1c11b24a1cb0436bb9020010e13e50ee64fbfa.en: Families can learn about urban biodiversity and soil germination at the MAIF Social Club by crafting seed bombs. Participants make small spheres of soil, clay, and wildflower seeds to green the city.

6f6cefcb462a60cd50732ad325d355b84b4c46fe.en: The 32nd Autumn University of the LDH gathers citizens and activists at the Campus Condorcet to discuss the rule of law versus the state of war. Panels examine militarisation, international law, and human rights.

026af5e0d140b8cf8dac7c822ba9fc5a1fed48d8.en: Join the planting marathon at the Jardins Mécaniques urban farms in Bobigny and Sevran. Participants help put trees and bushes in the ground to support local biodiversity and food transition.

d002aef91bd5795efa9a2fdc0bdc3215a8be9e9f.en: The Conservatoire à rayonnement régional de Paris hosts a meeting and conference on baroque and modern violin alongside baroque dance. Stéphanie Moraly, Benjamin Chénier, and Hubert Hazebrouck lead the presentation.

c058db13fcecdb05fe193c4bd7c10bbfdf0bb73a.en: QJ - Quartier Jeunes hosts an information forum for those planning to study in Canada. Visitors can meet school representatives and attend thematic conferences on study programmes and admission requirements.

36482c234d0a6aa578eb6c96835a8cf1880a14ba.en: Artist Christopher Blake Bargell leads a photographic walking tour around Montmartre starting near Abbesses metro station. Participants hunt for assigned colors while learning framing and composition tips.

28ec93ae53819e687aa285333c15ed2b78e92be0.en: Bibliothèque Jacqueline de Romilly hosts a puppet show where Lilou and her scarecrow friend Ficelle discover nature. Children follow the story through colorful plush puppets and nursery rhymes.

80156effdfdd13f16878901f4f65891ba3dfbd01.en: Enjoy an immersive listening session of La Nuit transfigurée by Schoenberg in the dark auditorium. Relax in a deckchair and let the music carry you away.

ef9a76c57e3bba40a64df4000fd9d36c4e1c6783.en: Children aged 6 to 10 can explore architecture and creativity through a cartoon screening and a hands-on model building challenge.

82ab3ec67565bb54f931a9040390ab4b580d198f.en: Celebrate Japanese culture by making an omamori, a traditional embroidered fabric pouch, during this manga-themed workshop.

aaf99960c279f82541ca20b4568e03cc148f2b6b.en: Join the monthly morning storytelling session themed around Halloween, specially designed for young children.

d4db84ac36c14d35006002e2dade9eb927771017.en: Discover new books and films shared by librarians and fellow participants in a friendly readers' café. The session is open to all and includes LSF/FR interpretation.

ece180d56869c55a5db8b6ae7b06d67d30578feb.en: Experience the Penn & Fashion exhibition through guided improvisations and dance games designed for adults and children to share.

11402902e0d42a6e1f3945d313f3a73a1afb8520.en: Learn basic French Sign Language gestures through playful rhymes and games to better understand your baby's daily needs and emotions.

ba7a56e799718ea1bd463af4ede456b7b0908191.en: Chat about science fiction, fantasy, and imaginative worlds in a friendly book club setting. No prior experience is needed, just curiosity.

549621cbb3483c29aab79f6791639fba6740f14b.en: Discover a poetic show exploring the origins of paper, followed by a parent-child workshop with the artists.

c127e9e28acfbebeae3e6704b04c0c0af4df3ba3.en: Explore the fascinating life and cinematic legacy of puppeteer Jim Henson, from Sesame Street to The Muppet Show, during an interactive talk.

f3c75f64ee6730c7fa2b5d1d5f6ee9ec7f6fcba9.en: Listen to the Musiquam chamber ensemble perform a diverse programme of works by various composers, featuring an original mix of instruments.

36c9ed27d6849824798c1dd2c5388c67c9b43c19.en: Listen to a selection of stories and songs chosen by librarians around the youth theme of eating and being eaten.

c4a5e15714deeaa0bb46fde7c2517fdf723e803e.en: Attend a lecture by Danièle Prévost about François Racine de Monville, the creator of the Désert de Retz.

2f70cbae124df65fe99301eb9d901c502fb84d06.en: Share your latest reading and film discoveries or simply listen to others over a hot drink at this monthly literary café.

e62cab9c2edecfdd9126eef219860a11d85c28de.en: Economists, researchers, and activists from around the world gather to debate international taxation, wealth concentration, and concrete action.

b86fa020d22644fd98b442405c6a82f046f1f5eb.en: Enjoy a full day of drag animations, a make-up masterclass, a bingo game, podcast recordings, and DJ sets at Ground Control.

1402f416a98b59653066fa2f182958632d9b5d99.en: Visit the studios at the Fondation des États-Unis to discover the work of artists and fellows in residence before their upcoming exhibitions.

3f2c2e42d460d18f726340df68f6ecb3ff751722.en: Explore renaissance music and improvisation in these master classes led by Miguel Henry, culminating in a public restitution concert.

5a4cad820e8696ced26bdaa622be417964a44f0f.en: Learn the traditional intaglio printmaking technique using tetra pak cartons with author and printmaker Mathilde Payen.

aa987ee50c1aa7d34eeaf780cf230772114e58a2.en: Meet author Agnieszka Anna Rodzik as she presents her book inspired by the true story of her disabled dog, Brutus.

5953980ff5924b00b9bc3bc29ba00a9838b33bcf.en: Amateur dancers can join a collaborative choreography project guided by a professional dancer at the MPAA/Broussais. The sessions culminate in an open stage performance on the final Saturday.

ea9b84f333447346eebf53eb59971e4287e44180.en: Visit La Ferme de Paris on Saturday, November 21, to discover seasonal fruits, vegetables, or edible plants. You can taste them freshly picked, plain, or prepared in jams, pestos, and beignets.

591bd58256f0bfb3381652c6cec9b4abdb59d30a.en: Take part in an inter-library 1,000-piece puzzle tournament at the Bibliothèque Georges Brassens on November 21, 2026. Teams of four compete to finish first and qualify for the final at the médiathèque Virginia Woolf.

7d4d208296ed64fc07e3158ed3c219e4bd64aa43.en: Young people aged 15 and over can discover rap writing, computer-assisted music production, and vocal recording with the association Le Canap' at the Bibliothèque Václav Havel. The session ends with a mini-concert.

00fa7d99fe6b3258af8c215121d6af1a51fbee47.en: The Chai de Bercy hosts a friendly gathering for LGBTQIA+ families, prospective parents, and allies. The day features roundtable discussions, a giant party, snacks, and children's workshops.

48fb76b01596c2fe1ec096ea04a7a8cb04eee72a.en: Learn basic crochet techniques to make your own handmade stuffed bear at the Atelier de la Ressourcerie Créative. This advanced workshop takes place on Saturday, November 21, and includes all materials.

a602f27b449b7ef35f5eaa015673d2c1de5229d0.en: Parents and children explore clothing as a form of expression through exhibitions and a philosophical workshop at the Maison Européenne de la Photographie. The session is led by animator Marine Lemaire.

f4db68f1a19cbcf3401333201c7408c57cdf54b3.en: The Centre Paris Anim' Annie Fratellini hosts the Contact association for discussions around LGBTQIA+ issues during the Festival des Fiertés to help deconstruct prejudices and fight discrimination.

dc77c89c7407579ce718071f0e7ddde4aa78af23.en: Families from an emergency shelter share cooking recipes and create a stop-motion animation film with documentary editor Delphine Piau at the Bibliothèque Robert Sabatier.

d1eaa4bd0e7b3f48da1814774638a7cca2211c4b.en: Explore the real-world animals, plants, and folklore that inspired Pokémon characters during a scientific drawing workshop at the Bibliothèque Aimé Césaire. All materials are provided on site.

415f22858c4275b4203c444201f36cc7555e33f8.en: Aurelia Ivan presents a show for ages 6 and up at the Maison de la musique de Nanterre. Using object theatre, opera, and dance, it explores our relationship with automobiles and climate change.

da2442c61dfe3124f168ebb9fa73cba1f13c9847.en: As part of the Close-Up festival, the Médiathèque Marguerite Yourcenar screens Mamadou Khouma Gueye's film about a changing Dakar neighborhood, followed by a discussion with critic Thierno Dia.

e121c87876f86e2e92abf2eb026e5c57db70f1cf.en: Mathilde Morin performs a 1-hour show blending dance, costumes, and genealogy to bring family histories and memories from the past two centuries to life at the Médiathèque Violette Leduc.

85bdad36719c88382757ffd56f3f9702c43292c3.en: Enjoy an afternoon of classical music featuring works by Mendelssohn, Ysaÿe, and Jessie Montgomery at Salle Cortot. A listening guide session is offered at the start of the concert.

3d53325825c328cca5507c4418a8b9073767e697.en: Iemoto Akane Teshigahara, grand master of the Sogetsu School, performs a traditional and contemporary ikebana demonstration at the Maison de la culture du Japon à Paris.

057c2a56999624da06289353ae840b8b8706be8a.en: Discover the newly published correspondence between Virginia Woolf and Vanessa Bell during a book presentation with Editions La Table Ronde at the Médiathèque Virginia Woolf.

663b60c1e69bc1b5e43b93303a6aa4a444260aaf.en: Children aged 6 and up can experiment with Chinese ink and everyday tools alongside Japanese author and illustrator Kotimi at the Bibliothèque Benoîte Groult.

10893f30ad61a7ba58dafec745690a879a0306e8.en: Children aged 3 and up can read a story and craft their own toy crocodile from an egg carton using paint, paper, and glue at the Médiathèque Violette Leduc.

fc14cf75ef0f5326bba1d8b98cf8e1e31a91aedc.en: Celebrate European Music Therapy Day at the Bibliothèque Germaine Tillion with the Île-de-France group of the French Music Therapists Federation. Discover how sound and music are used in healthcare and support.

e6c65d18391f473c703a58512bed7e7fd12f9125.en: Try out virtual reality experiences at the Médiathèque Marguerite Yourcenar every Saturday afternoon. Sessions last up to 20 minutes and are open to anyone aged 12 and over.

affe1e53ccf124b364c35ca681e91c5b92dbf137.en: This event at Médiathèque Edmond Rostand marks the 130th anniversary of Verlaine's death with a poetic gathering. Enjoy readings, artwork, and musical performances dedicated to Verlaine and Rimbaud.

b75ba5c1c4c81c3b3f45d73f69a994ef79be9a80.en: Part of the Monte le Son 2026 festival, this open stage at the Médiathèque musicale de Paris highlights 100 percent female acts. Each performance lasts up to fifteen minutes.

0784ff08956b516bb0c482edf5d1693f71c80efa.en: Test your mystery-solving skills at Bibliothèque Gutenberg with a creative writing workshop inspired by Agatha Christie's famous novels. Suitable for ages seven and up upon registration.

bb4906453b2716970d7220aa5302a00914f90624.en: Soprano Lucia Wilson and pianist Deniz Besim perform works by female composers spanning various eras and genres at Médiathèque Hélène Berr. Admission is free for all audiences.

f7ecccfd1c4c0f77d0d5ec2788443935f0697119.en: Bibliothèque Oscar Wilde hosts a presentation and reading of Ali Shams's play The Old Maids in partnership with L’Espace d’un instant publishers. Discover this allegorical work reflecting contemporary life in Iran.

f7999b404104490f14ba3e2d0a037aace01a21d6.en: Photographer and author Jean-Marc Fiess leads a family-friendly pop-up workshop at Bibliothèque Maurice Genevoix. Participants of all ages can fold, cut, and create their own moving paper designs.

cf67529d395912762640fd9527bf0192569b1156.en: Théâtre 14 hosts an LGBTQIA+ event featuring a short film screening, a theatre performance exploring reality in Tunisia, and a roundtable discussion with community associations.

3d8462f81dab523f3be94bfef1a6dc94877a52fb.en: Vocal group GIWYZE performs a vibrant concert at Bibliothèque Hergé celebrating gospel, soul, and jazz. Enjoy powerful harmonies and arrangements honoring influential female artists.

af3344131bb3baac7743702efcc76423a4a0fabc.en: Counter-tenor Mathieu Salama, soprano Maria Donnier, and guitarist Loïc Reboul perform baroque masterpieces by Vivaldi and Händel by candlelight inside Église Sainte-Elizabeth.

df221768b463fd40ce66dd41d9e7997978cb49d2.en: Bibliothèque André Malraux hosts a literary presentation on Saint-Soleil, a Haitian art movement born in 1975 that drew inspiration from voodoo to reject commercialized naive art.

7b57a50d67b8acd97c5e8f72cf2cddbbfa5587ba.en: Art historian Valérie Mettais leads a conference at Bibliothèque Buffon exploring how generations of painters studied, copied, and critiqued the works of their fellow masters.

cec36631184457e413e44625852c5e5fd5e4d5b9.en: Médiathèque Françoise Sagan presents a retrospective on a youth literature and exhibition project created by detainees at the Réau penitentiary center.

5c48a9e960bc97edc6f0f240dc264d67be76352c.en: Join a friendly game night at Bibliothèque Louise Walser-Gaillard with bilingual French and LSF support. Bring your own drinks and snacks to share between rounds.

3f6a78fc6f2b9e565437c90a437262ddd7de9ffa.en: Conservatoire Municipal Charles Munch hosts an inter-conservatory multidisciplinary improvisation jam for advanced students of dance, music, theater, and voice.

ccf36835a053ebcb00c40e297898e31dab16630e.en: Médiathèque Marguerite Duras screens Benoît Perraud's documentary about rural life in Poitou during the twentieth century, followed by a discussion with the director and guests.

13bc4fa0f74690a06da44fca4e27e14059d9fb32.en: Vocalist Tiffany Muzellec and pianist Gautier Montegu pay tribute to the underappreciated jazz singer Jo Stafford in an intimate concert at the 38Riv Jazz Club.

ec2c6cba883bb8d64bad5685880ccd9ff22204e9.en: Le 32 Ciné hosts a screening and discussion of Pierrick Bourgault's documentary celebrating community cafés and the colorful characters who run them.

b1d9e81635b1d6b766317dc5a5bd860b3d66331b.en: Médiathèque Violette Leduc presents a documentary portrait of radio figure Bernard Lenoir, blending archival audio and intimate monologues, followed by a discussion with the directors.

1b538da98274839c6e17177253ec840cd764eb20.en: Gather at Tiers Lieu Faire-Liens for an evening of medieval tales, fables, and legends told by traditional storytellers accompanied by a musician.

7feb7ee1542cc24048e7bbf72d0ccb9c56a76d58.en: Annexe 14 hosts an energetic improvisation match featuring the home team facing off against visiting performers from Bordeaux.

e9455848def08ba5ec674187a2e1e10c4881cc94.en: La Salle des fêtes de la Mairie du 14e arrondissement accueille une soirée débat sur les droits LGBTQIA+ et un comedy club avec Tahnee, Lou Trotignon et Natacha Prudent. Venez partager un moment d'empouvoirement et de réflexion collective à l'approche de l'élection présidentielle.

b0ea4d76d6ae1561794e4c039cb7f1c3e77580f8.en: La Médiathèque James Baldwin vous invite à découvrir le parcours d'Emmanuelle Parrenin, collectionneuse de sons et figure de la musique folk, psychédélique et électronique. Une rencontre autour de ses collaborations et de son exploration des instruments guérisseurs.

e2f76e61876274d7136f7aee27dcc2a6f7c1d35d.en: L'Espace Jemmapes accueille le concert de Cœur Majeur pour le lancement de l'album Tu M’aventures et du recueil Unis Vers. Venez découvrir l'univers de la chanson française contemporaine et de la poésie d'Ariane Angeloglou.

c13590929d5e5c4be90320cca957ddce382c5773.en: La MPAA/Broussais présente Diary of women, un spectacle du duo Aatma Souls of dancers mêlant poésie des mots et Bharata natyam, danse sacrée du sud de l'Inde. Un univers intimiste où les femmes s'expriment à travers le mouvement.

08086b9af153ac3ac2e508f2601819ec95171536.en: Le Pavillon de la Sirène accueille les ensembles musicaux de La Sirène de Paris pour célébrer la Fête de la Sainte-Cécile. Une soirée festive réunissant grands ensembles et formations de chambre.

43762b59d7588ef1c65653d079543adb2e9296a7.en: Le 360 Paris Music Factory accueille Jamel Reffes pour un concert hommage au pionnier du raï électrique Ahmed Zergui, précédé et suivi par les sélections de DJ Mehtoze.

5de6c7851094595510099963e1b4e18906b71613.en: Le Son de la Terre accueille le pianiste Franck Amsallem et son quartet international avec le saxophoniste Irving Acao pour présenter leur disque Gotham Goodbye. Un concert de jazz à ne pas manquer.

ccbe221dcf691d6ec04b571ae7a8e8c447c00777.en: L'Église Saint-Louis en L'Île accueille Le Chœur de Paris pour interpréter le Stabat Mater d'Antonín Dvořák à la lueur des bougies. Un concert intimiste pour vivre ce chef-d'œuvre sacré dans une ambiance rare.

2257d4590b3a9fdc0f827102a288b25071e0e0d6.en: L’ODÉON - Scène Musicale de Tremblay accueille 2L, rappeuse parisienne à la technique percutante, accompagnée de quatre artistes émergents pour des sessions de freestyle rap.

06916a2e5148b91ae3a4ac43560caccecb8595bf.en: Le Théâtre Mandapa accueille Herencia Flamenca pour un concert intimiste de flamenco traditionnel. Un trio d'exception vous plonge au cœur de l'Andalousie entre improvisation et rigueur.

53e8cc5bf25681a540a6c98e7b749ba392588aac.en: La Vagabonde propose une journée avec le conteur Jihad Darwiche, comprenant un atelier sur les 1001 nuits suivi d'un spectacle de contes orientaux. Venez partager un moment de sagesse et d'humour.

5406b30bed94a529c2bfba5ab1c74282d8cfd912.en: Le Studio de l'Ermitage vous invite au Bringuebal pour une soirée festive mêlant chansons, danses et styles musicaux variés. Venez danser et partager un moment de joie collective.

c6d9480ba15fb4ac02861626fb79eca241dcb014.en: Le Bois de Vincennes accueille le Cardio Challenge Heroes avec des parcours de course chronométrés de 5km et 10km ainsi qu'une marche de 5km ouverte à tous. Des entraînements collectifs sont également proposés tout au long de l'année.

769dba81259dfbb63a1cf1d4a4388af4476878dd.en: Le Théâtre du Châtelet propose les Concerts du dimanche matin, un format court d'une heure sans entracte associant musique de renom et lectures littéraires et philosophiques. Une alternative originale pour découvrir la musique classique en famille.

b665ea4fa7af8638d949b43b36016ec0c1bb22c5.en: Les Jardins de l'Avenue Foch accueillent la Novemb'Run, une course caritative et conviviale organisée dans le cadre de Novembre au Masculin. Participez à cet élan collectif pour soutenir la recherche en urologie et briser les tabous.

5997baa56cc4f8475e3671a9647b8962d3d4b855.en: L'Atelier 77 propose des ateliers de danse en duo parent-enfant pour les 18 mois à 3 ans. Venez partager un moment ludique et musical favorisant l'éveil corporel et la complicité.

63cebdf781f5a75af558924958deae342cf55775.en: Le Théâtre du Châtelet présente un concert des Concerts du dimanche matin dédié à la musique de chambre de Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. Profitez d'un format intimiste d'une heure mêlant interprétation musicale et lectures.

78abb629d386d6ab0bb27baa64998494ed8fafc4.en: Le Mémorial de la Shoah présente une exposition sur la musique dans les camps nazis, de la musique contrainte des orchestres de détenus aux pratiques clandestines de survie. Découvrez des témoignages, instruments et partitions inédits.

a3de6703d75d776774d73998bea4c9fe83e4a4d7.en: Le Mémorial de la Shoah de Drancy présente la projection du documentaire Aurigny, l’île britannique d’Hitler d'Andy Webb en deux parties. Une occasion de découvrir l'histoire de ce camp de concentration nazi sur le sol britannique.

eb55d836dd91871e3fe8f9489cab497f7c8beac6.en: Le Mémorial de la Shoah accueille la projection du film Samuel Bak, fragments/espoir de Daniela Bak. Une rencontre avec la réalisatrice et l'historienne Renée Poznanski autour du parcours et de l'œuvre du peintre Samuel Bak.

3cc26e3b42b0f91757db8133596e26046f1819c0.en: Le Concert de la Sainte-Cécile is a long-standing musical tradition in Clichy, bringing together local amateur ensembles at the Eglise Saint-Vincent de Paul. It is a warm, community-focused celebration of shared music-making and local artistic engagement.

f34bd6cfb23a057b2a96d8262d6b823f1f587c55.en: Daphné Hacquard hosts an accessible and lively operatic aperitif at Les Trois Baudets, taking you through five centuries of opera in sixty minutes. Enjoy anecdotes, famous arias, and even a chance to try out lyric singing techniques in a relaxed setting.

91782c32acca85d9b32bb1795c3b5bad7057e5ff.en: At the Philharmonie de Paris, the Lechner-Márquez duo presents a contemporary cello and guitar programme bridging cultures. The concert features works by international composers connecting the Middle East and the West.

d1ec0ddbc23584874d07639e784221c16991443a.en: The Mémorial de la Shoah hosts a screening of the documentary film L’Année dernière à Vichy, exploring memories of the occupation through local testimonies. The screening is followed by a discussion with the directors, historian Henry Rousso, and journalist Marie-Béatrice Baudet.

30ddb082c10fc9ae9fac3ffaae12079778bfe2ff.en: Sébastien Giniaux trio performs a Django-inspired afternoon of jazz at the 38Riv Jazz Club in the Marais. The intimate venue offers a chance to hear beloved melodies revisited with the lightness and swing of gypsy jazz.

3983b86cffb02b4118c7a3dc94dea7e9b52d26fc.en: Théâtre Pixel presents Un Noël pour deux, a lively boulevard comedy about an unexpected holiday visitor. Written by Didier Noël and performed by a trio of actors, it offers an evening of sharp dialogue and laughter.

7396e907f478e43ddec0d7249e3506857d56136e.en: Legendary jazz fusion drummer Billy Cobham performs at Le Trianon with a six-piece band. Expect an energetic evening revisiting his most iconic compositions and career highlights.

058b19fc984a91e0e2b6d81cadb779e96cae763e.en: Poinçon Paris hosts a pride edition comedy club featuring stand-up performances by queer artists and a drag show. Hosted by Carlota and Guimso, the evening promises an energetic mix of humor, glamour, and self-deprecation.

e60490347f7be9ca28a75d2952a02b3aede8d6b7.en: The Supersonic hosts another installment of its weekly Sunday Tribute series, this time celebrating the dark and hypnotic pop of The Cure. Local tribute bands take the stage for an evening of free live music.

a387f7759d6c7a48b54b67ce5afc000813732ebc.en: At the M128 - Missions Etrangères de Paris, Father Yann Vagneux discusses his spiritual journeys across the Indian subcontinent. The talk explores the religious diversity of the region and is followed by a book signing.

c5c4a5bbb9822c1920e1bb92ec6216eee54fe5c4.en: Tom da Bahia brings a vibrant blend of samba, bossa nova, and afro-brazilian rhythms to the Studio de l'Ermitage. Accompanied by a group of experienced musicians, the performance offers an energetic and authentic taste of Brazilian music.

4041afd69eaf84d33ed44c4425791fafcd3fe5c1.en: Sara Miette and Clément Simon perform at the 38Riv Jazz Club, blending jazz, folk, and French chanson. The intimate venue provides a welcoming setting to enjoy delicate arrangements and expressive vocals.

ac6a6c4c9055c2a64dfe2cf93343589d96247d9d.en: The Centre Culturel Coréen presents an immersive video installation exploring the Seokguram grotto. Visitors can also participate in an interactive digital wish lantern experience created to mark diplomatic relations between Korea and France.

6e92ffae01959a6d07b8c82e6ca75dd23685475f.en: Les Rencontres Internationales Paris/Berlin returns to the Maison Européenne de la Photographie with a programme dedicated to contemporary cinema and media art. The event features screenings, VR installations, and discussions exploring innovative approaches to the moving image.

1cbfa7788980f405701f3a0f66ff6e43002b0ed9.en: Maison Paris Nature hosts an educational event on the amphibians of Paris at the Parc Floral. Advance registration is required for this accessible nature walk.

c4936b11af61e480c19f67f6312ad74a1ddf1d5d.en: Manchester-based post-rock trio Shaking Hand performs live at the Supersonic. Admission is free, and the evening includes an opening happy hour.

12c8c9ce8e618e4143c969bf1d889a43aea21d57.en: The Centre Wallonie-Bruxelles screens Bandes d’hystériques, a film by Kita Bauchet exploring the history of women's emancipation movements in Belgium during the 1970s. The documentary highlights key activist actions with humor and insolence.

8a1dc1315b1963f9e6640b6500d5e2a95fe4d6e1.en: Théâtre 13 - Glacière presents a theatrical creation directed by Pauline Briand and Hugo Plassard based on texts by Ivan Viripaev. The performance stages testimonies of individuals recounting transformative encounters with what truly matters in life.

135960abcf21c2e50a4aed5be2f66e4add6e6821.en: Le Regard du Cygne hosts a shared evening of contemporary dance featuring choreographers Yasminee Lepe and Delphine Mothes. Part of the Festival Signes d'Automne 2026, the programme explores themes of resilience, metamorphosis, and the female experience.

e423de42a52cb10b15de0ce673a8e881602280d7.en: The Théâtre du Châtelet hosts a cine-concert screening of Jean Cocteau's classic film La Belle et la Bête. Experience the masterpiece accompanied by its synchronized orchestral score.

de2947fcb4ae63042f2fffa032d3255f88ea931e.en: Chacune des femmes de cette pièce est accompagnée par une figure tutélaire qui apparaît lorsque le réel la percute. Une plongée théâtrale intime à découvrir au Théâtre Ouvert.
