e2a123c6935d1dfb494f32ca5e2d69f78908eb47.en: Oumou Diarra et Yacouba Koné se produiront à la Médiathèque musicale de Paris pour un concert entre tradition mandingue et blues afro-américain.

d06346c1f351eade202bd1d89c3c80047bcdb690.en: Le Théâtre Paris-Villette présente Normalito de Pauline Sales, une pièce poignante sur la différence et l'amitié entre deux enfants. Une belle occasion de s'interroger sur la normalité.

ffefcbd42c65a70c54d2be4ac4875f648176938b.en: Le rappeur Ramos présente son nouveau projet sur la scène de La Place le 18 décembre. Venez découvrir son univers musical entre rap incisif et mélodies solaires.

1c040bfd495deb0aa798ba6a72e5170ecde44362.en: La Maison de la musique de Nanterre accueille le projet Génération A par Nina Tonji dans le cadre du festival Africolor. Un concert qui célèbre les musiques afrodescendantes et leur héritage.

92dde30fe411a41b691124d21f5272cf1eb09e56.en: Le Paname Big Band de Musique Ensemble 20e vous invite à un concert jazz gratuit à la Médiathèque Marguerite Duras. Venez swinguer en famille sur des standards de jazz et des musiques de film.

67c48a68eb0ea1eb11e045a3eae1e26ec6eebc86.en: Nâdiya fête ses 30 ans de carrière le 18 décembre 2026 au Cirque d'Hiver Bouglione. Un concert festif et énergique pour revivre ses plus grands succès pop.

dd9ce14ca18d19d8c73392897a7475c993a4ba54.en: Thomas Poitevin presents Yaourt, a new show featuring absurd and endearing characters. He observes human awkwardness with tender and precise humor.

799843188799b2d8922bb6a791b930e9916eb878.en: Gurshad Shaheman portrays legendary singers in a solo performance that weaves pop culture, history, and autobiography. It is a joyful celebration of a free and sensual Tehran.

36466c62542c713c28aa199f959657616fdf6f6e.en: On Christmas Eve, Frédérique pays a surprise visit to her daughter Mathilde. This show offers a funny and moving immersion into family dynamics.

081ce7198c0909be95d361ce2c736ee63c72d7a9.en: Make your own chalk using plaster, alum salt, and pigments in this hands-on workshop with Les Inventeurs. You can then use them to share messages in public spaces.

e3820a27ce4c57fa85eba8e7fd4715525ed88b85.en: Discover the fundamentals of belly dancing in a festive and friendly workshop. It is an open, welcoming space to build confidence through movement.

ec89b3ad49ad172b80f62f5f6f4bd2cfacfd3a2c.en: Participate in an educational workshop using cards to discuss systems of oppression, resistance movements, and militant actions. It is a collaborative space for shared experiences and reflections.

791b1f2d427e36e7f827e42ad3de2bf0e7503653.en: Join choreographer Emmanuel Eggermont for a contemporary dance workshop exploring the movement techniques behind his latest piece.

4469aa4831a616c3e16e7ee492f0fa90bbe297c3.en: Author Carole Prieur discusses her work alongside readings by amateur actors and a performance of the play Vieillir debout.

d81a1d02a02228a8754edf546183f0513252fe9c.en: Nils Strassburg stars in a grand tribute to Elvis Presley, featuring contemporary rock arrangements of his greatest hits. Celebrate the legacy of the king of rock and roll.

d5ea7cb74f63759e1e6e6b3a28cdc60c2fa02a35.en: Six stand-up comedians take the stage to share sharp observations and everyday anecdotes. Enjoy a friendly evening showcasing current Parisian comedy talent.

824ab0cc39f90fed6ae5a5051e2852a4b6596455.en: Natalie Dessay explores 20th-century American culture, moving effortlessly through opera, Broadway, and song. A rich evening of swing, poetry, and emotion.

03f89b1e01b32e3b4179c34521f2ec9ed83f7384.en: Agnès Jaoui shares her perspective on Bach's music alongside organist Vincent Warnier and talented young soloists. The evening features organ works, suites, and a new festival commission.

49b73468b1b60d158f754be0b697b4c829c64257.en: Gabrielle Rachel and JulesH blend jazz and electronic music in an intimate setting. Expect a surprising and captivating dialogue between warm vocals and organic beats.

ac2c574bb2fa9856723e11f2034bbce566011395.en: Enjoy a one-hour Sunday morning concert featuring classical chamber music paired with poetry, literature, and philosophy readings.

ad99bcda0517634e3088e15cd1129f377bc590ae.en: Edou the adventurer guides young children through Tchaikovsky's Swan Lake with gentle melodies and magic tricks. A soft and joyful musical introduction for ages zero to five.

d291d876f7fa2c251cd950253d2a47ab687733fb.en: The Orchestre Colonne performs Tchaikovsky's Swan Lake alongside dance-inspired pieces by Calmel, Holmès, and Sohy. Experience a rich symphonic program centered on movement and poetry.

94ad483307f85ad91fff459bfc4371917f273fe0.en: Children take the lead in this interactive show by choosing the topics explored on stage. It is a joyful and participatory experience for the whole family.

85f1e1ca84500d8dea6a7d82b4fad43de185ec12.en: La Relève du rire showcases emerging local comedians chosen through an open call. Discover fresh voices and support new comedic talent on stage.

ab0d50ae7806df54a0de870bf7a13c2e06a527ea.en: Learn the essential functions of your smartphone step by step in this supportive workshop. Gain confidence and independence in using your device for daily tasks.

431387ba453a8d3bb5a639fefe7f38be6658c3a4.en: Passe derrière les machines du Centre Paris Anim' Point du Jour pour créer tes propres beats sur Ableton Live. Accompagné par un ingénieur du son, découvre la MAO et compose tes morceaux pas à pas.

7a4f6482288bb6124d2253229482b4f4ea4dff57.en: Offrez-vous une parenthèse créative au Centre Paris Anim' Point du Jour en mêlant collages, écriture et dessins. Créez des pages inspirantes autour de vos bonnes résolutions pour la nouvelle année.

ca7b17c1527a976ac8a699ffe333a4ebd3450705.en: Au Carreau du Temple, Emmanuel Eggermont signe un manifeste chorégraphique inspiré par les sources culturelles de la Gen Z. Ce spectacle explore la jeunesse et l'avenir à travers les mouvements et les références d'une centaine de jeunes.

1384f1941a05dd2f7adc1c9c37d91c831472556e.en: Au Théâtre de la Bastille, Roman Empire explore les étranges rapports entre le pouvoir politique et l'architecture. Une création sobre et malicieuse qui s'amuse à répondre aux énigmes de notre temps.

d0153a989bd523a7c7c9c00ef01fbe62475b6545.en: Dirigé par Hervé Niquet au Théâtre du Châtelet, ce concert célèbre un Paris populaire et festif. Retrouvez les grands classiques de la chanson française et de l'opérette dans une ambiance chaleureuse.

afc3b8e09b104763cd2fbf2c13d7a451d26e7f31.en: À Chaillot, Léonard Matton adapte Manhattan Transfer dans un dispositif immersif et musical. Douze comédiennes et un orchestre de jazz font revivre cette vaste fresque new-yorkaise.

2a15578b6dea93874ee6c65563ad082cad60e236.en: Au Théâtre 13, Ana Maria Haddad Zavadinack et ZêThó tentent de traduire une chanson qui leur tient à cœur. Une exploration comique et touchante des difficultés à se traduire soi-même.

58b86b757a2ec7611956475856cf7c6f669ab646.en: À la Maison des Métallos, Baby Volcano présente une performance organique où le corps devient instrument. Une expérience immersive qui transforme nos chaos collectifs en un moment de partage lumineux.

647aed6d1a00cf6a3c6b402e3ecc449799b98699.en: À l'église Saint-Vincent-de-Paul, Rosemary Standley et Dom La Nena revisitent des chansons de Barbara, Brel et Bob Dylan. Laissez-vous porter par cette rencontre intime entre une voix singulière et un violoncelle.

060a801c695c9434b7a8eaf9df62cb75d9fd4547.en: Au MAIF Social Club, découvrez l'exposition Semons nos résistances lors de visites guidées en Langue des signes française. L'expérience se prolonge par une dégustation culinaire inspirée des œuvres.

5f3dd6d94006c30e42be56cd42ce17c72e0a9a96.en: Au Pavillon de la Sirène, le quatuor de saxhorns Opus 333 interprète un nouveau programme consacré à J.S. Bach. Une belle occasion de découvrir la musique de chambre sous un jour inédit.

e9a1d842f5371894dfd30969706d60b6402a8b7f.en: Au Zénith Paris La Villette, quatre jeunes voix revisitent les chansons intemporelles de Céline Dion dans un spectacle XXL. Revivez l'héritage musical de cette légende sous la direction d'Erick Benzi.

d59339b1464851ad152e1a3a767d8a586bc09396.en: À la Ferme Montsouris, participez à un stage d'initiation au diabolo guidé par Robin Spinelli. Apprenez les techniques fondamentales du jonglage et progressez à votre rythme dans une ambiance conviviale.

895502341e29d8583d9fe0f755958fc34508c78f.en: Retrouvez le club des Couronnes à la Bibliothèque Naguib Mahfouz pour partager vos dernières lectures. Romans, bandes dessinées ou documentaires sont les bienvenus pour nourrir vos envies de découverte.

002bc319e08e9a1b4fb17af03f17e5d77b1e9997.en: À La Seine Musicale, l'Orchestre Pasdeloup met Ludwig van Beethoven à l'honneur sous la direction de Marzena Diakun. Ce concert symphonique accueille également la pianiste Shani Diluka.

4c2fe07bbd530720839d3cb49fc421f7b9c1e42f.en: À l'International Visual Theatre, participez à un karaoké en langue des signes animé par Christelle Pépin. Suivez la vidéo pour chansigner avec les mains, le corps et le visage.

79f945eb2810d5bb5f120f40cea8dbbcf6bb6b64.en: À La Seine Musicale, un spectacle musical rend hommage aux carrières de Michel Berger et France Gall. Retrouvez en live les mélodies inoubliables qui ont traversé le temps.

d0a4e3a1ebca9fdeebaee9fac1aec995f75a08b5.en: Au Théâtre du Châtelet, La cuisine musicale transforme les ustensiles en instruments pour un opéra-bouffe participatif. Petits et grands sont invités à chanter et rire autour des classiques revisités.

1ec973745b8548493a1b739ac732b86ff9c5010e.en: À la Ferme Montsouris, les enfants à partir de 11 ans s'initient au diabolo avec Robin Spinelli. Une journée de pratique artistique pour développer son adresse et sa coordination.

518c72ce1abbd2aa45c5f2385786b17740842d76.en: Au Théâtre de la Ville – Sarah Bernhardt, Fabienne Pascaud anime une rencontre autour de la situation actuelle de notre modèle culturel. Venez échanger sur les défis que traversent les artistes de notre époque.

b3d07828f5a23ad53783edd4e1c758b90f43d79a.en: Influent Mum at Théâtre Public de Montreuil is a satire of a family of influencers whose perfect online life is disrupted by an unexpected creature. This physical and clownish show offers a humorous look at a society in constant representation.

259c6b3890901f5a590eb1be460962daa7626a07.en: Lento at Le Son de la Terre is an instrumental project blending jazz, improvised music, and Latin influences. Led by Gilles Barikosky and Nicolas Torracinta, the quartet delivers melodic and refined original compositions.

2757b05f1b93a585ce842e758e6cd86d18f4cf81.en: Esprit vieille at Théâtre 13 - Bibliothèque is a creation by Éléonore Barrault exploring aging beyond timelines and chronologies. It uses the stage as a space for intergenerational cohabitation and the recomposition of our relationship with time.

80404ae94908c7477eefd3ee88235137fe3c8f90.en: Nocturne (Parade) at Théâtre Silvia Monfort is a sensory experience featuring wind-driven puppets and plastic forms in a circular setting. Phia Ménard's creation offers a poetic reflection on a changing world.

d7341869880e07a7cd5dcac2df8d3ee80a516a46.en: This concert at the Théâtre des Champs-Elysées features works by Mendelssohn, Schumann, and Mozart. Cellist Anastasia Kobekina joins the programme for an evening bridging dreams, passion, and virtuosity.

dcde8eaee90c18bfdae7d0761de070fa18f208e8.en: Rodrigo Cuevas presents La Bellaza at the Maison de la musique de Nanterre, blending queer cabaret and traditional folklore. This hybrid and lively performance invites audiences to rethink cultural memory.

5e05bafe668e6493ff4f85c533b39adfa4ad1af4.en: Alex Lutz presents his award-winning solo show Sexe, grog et rocking-chair at the Cirque d'Hiver Bouglione. The humorist weaves humor and melancholy through a gallery of colorful characters.

648788bc65e924ff9f0511b0268cfd3bbb3bfa67.en: L'Odeur des tissus at Théâtre Ouvert portrays seven residents in a women's facility exploring the art of joy through manual activities and discussions. The play offers an empathetic and amusing look at community life.

f781c676ea4611631167d0370649e8926050146a.en: This exhibition at the Philharmonie de Paris celebrates the legacy of jazz icon Billie Holiday. It highlights her vocal artistry, her influence on generations of musicians, and her courage in denouncing segregation.

de5f63afd1da7acd32a399b2a77da248a67cc258.en: art3f Paris at Porte de Versailles is an accessible contemporary art fair bringing together national and international artists and galleries. Visitors can discover and purchase paintings, sculptures, and photographs in a relaxed atmosphere.

c3cb0baf36a7267b7b8e233d55ea7012f56e37d6.en: Studio l'Accord Parfait hosts a free concert exploring piano music from Bach to Beethoven with DOm Paulin. Discover works by master composers and forgotten female artists during this one-hour journey.

1ef51a91fcc28778f9ad9c04c268f2ab97de9e65.en: La Nuit Étoilée at Le Grand Parquet presents a satirical fable about a father who transforms into a manipulative smartphone at night. The performance questions our inability to disconnect from invasive technology.

d6e1ed892c2bf2f9a05aaaa87f7ce2579d06ed85.en: Thrice at Chaillot - Théâtre national de la Danse is a triptych by Damien Jalet exploring air, matter, and water through dance. The performance brings together choreography, striking scenography, and music.

b928419c71166fe3ba77c50421995c604d2716b6.en: Frantz at the conservatoire Léo Delibes is a family-friendly show where five performers use everyday objects to bring a story to life. Combining puppetry, sound effects, and movement, it offers a poetic sensory adventure.

755b12c89052034d2f0335d4f61fad7853622f8c.en: Logicaltramp - The Spirit of Supertramp at La Cigale celebrates the progressive rock repertoire of the legendary band. Supported by original members, the tribute band performs classic hits with musical fidelity.

2a3e25cc5cf9c05d0220bd38deafb0de5ce687a8.en: Mon goûter pour la planète at MAIF Social Club is a hands-on cooking workshop led by chef Lila Djeddi. Children and their companions learn how to prepare planet-friendly, healthy snacks.

3131d401a37857fdc0684db3bd63dbd9d23204c5.en: Les p’tits mangeurs éclairés at MAIF Social Club invites children and adults to learn about sustainable eating. Chef Lila Djeddi guides participants through eco-friendly recipes and discussions on seasonal food.

0157a55180d83f3de794b30a754978ee4b9fc3dd.en: This sewing workshop at Centre Paris Anim' Point du Jour teaches participants how to create an elasticated skirt. Beginners can learn garment sewing basics and leave with a custom-made piece.

1170a4d4392eff785c2165cf04cabca3a8081e96.en: This cross training session at Centre Paris Anim' Point du Jour combines cardio and strength exercises for a full-body workout. Participants can exercise at their own pace in a motivating environment.

9dd0a1e7df9678b60d80e5396cb465ad7ae0f44d.en: TaxiTram offers a bus tour across three contemporary art venues in Île-de-France, starting from Galerie Fernand Léger and ending at the Centre Wallonie-Bruxelles. The guided tour visits current public art and contemporary exhibitions.

7767ac89f49f15e008056a1334fd3f4f8aaa0376.en: Clara and Robert Schumann found their language in music, sharing a deep passion for creation alongside their friend Mendelssohn. Experience this story of love and friendship told entirely through instruments at Salle Cortot.

227d2361b106f7d8493587ddc34689ae6c747857.en: Le Brass Band de la Sirène presents a rich and evocative sound journey at Le Pavillon de la Sirène. Discover a diverse repertoire of original works exploring energy, lyricism, and expressive power.

33f8c8dce6c4a392359d6c2223acb5a09269f3c9.en: LeNoise arrives at La Cigale to perform faithful, powerful renditions of Neil Young's greatest classics. Fans can experience two hours of music spanning everything from Woodstock anthems to grunge hits.

bd0e9ab752fbdc1f2e253130d22aaf3203d6063c.en: Forever célèbre ses quinze ans sur scène avec un spectacle hommage au roi de la pop approuvé par la famille Jackson. Vingt artistes investissent la scène pour faire revivre les plus grands succès de Michael Jackson.

0fa030b9c4b7b002936f8f17f90afca684f80c75.en: Ensemble Le Damier presents an interactive baroque concert at Le Pavillon de la Sirène exploring the sentimental twists of the heart. Enjoy an imaginative social evening blending humor, emotion, and baroque music.

982cbb63551b00267fd62e38fd78a5ceb0178bf1.en: Isaías Alves leads an explosive jazz jam at Le Baiser Salé blending Maranhão traditions with improvisation. Come listen, vibrate, and experience a living celebration rooted in Brazilian percussion.

ef5cdda5557a36f9c6d1c48edda89ed22f179f27.en: Mackenzy Bergile presents a solo choreographic introspection at Théâtre de la Bastille exploring diaspora heritages and hybrid identities. The piece weaves historical figures and the Haitian Yanvalou dance into a spiral of movement.

e5014f00a0d520435029b0fb27c80fe3bbab57fe.en: Pi Ja Ma performs at La Cigale to celebrate her new album, Magnetofille. Join singer and artist Pauline de Tarragon for a vibrant, joyful party blending pop, humor, and luminous poetry.

ad969d2e0ab874d5f12b737eecf5965bc1262b45.en: Gary Mullen brings the legendary 1986 Wembley concert back to life at Zénith Paris La Villette with One Night of Queen. Experience a massive rock production featuring Queen's greatest stadium anthems.

f5322ba26bb3eb194387c5c69b9a140a71aa46f5.en: MAIF Social Club hosts a playful solo performance combining dance, installation, and electronic music. AYA+TOLI explores our awkward relationship with otherness through the metaphor of a tangled thread.

41e4fdb210a88349166aaf045f18a82542a62d6d.en: Alex Dutilh leads an exploration at ECUJE into the trajectories of Israeli jazz musicians who left, returned, or settled abroad. Discover how exile transforms careers, identities, and musical styles.

98b747c242d4bdb3241bcb1f4842ccde2f2c6212.en: Jeanne Desoubeaux stages a burlesque fable about a family whose daily life is disrupted by an acacia tree growing through their dining table. Share a joyful and reflective family show about change and otherness.

df2f0a4d61414dead353386a501f302fefe7a3bf.en: Théâtre des Champs-Élysées hosts a dialogue of cultures from Mozart to Stravinsky, featuring a world premiere by Ehwa Hong. Musicians converse and compete in virtuosity across generations and influences.

31f3cc6f7341c716ee326e94a8477acdb78f5d2b.en: Omri Mor, Mehdi Nassouli, and Karim Ziad unite at ECUJE for an enchanting dialogue between contemporary jazz, Andalusian music, and Gnawa traditions. Experience a vibrant, borderless musical journey.

eb94ebb7ee43073c15da760e5c29638f3957b9a6.en: Conservatoire Léo Delibes hosts the award-winning comedy Made in France, following an ex-prisoner trying to save his factory from closure. Samuel Valensi and Paul Éloi Forget blend humor, suspense, and social satire.

7fae00ef558dbbe0aae91ca1eae08cb1d285b68f.en: Élise Allasia brings her modern soul and RnB sound to Le Baiser Salé for an intimate showcase. Discover a promising young talent exploring groove aesthetics and raw emotion.

e81a31c4d942de22c9e79e59e2495ec55d3aa8c7.en: Atelier de Paris / CDCN presents a playful dance duet by Michael Incarbone and Max Gomard exploring cultural stereotypes. The artists deconstruct French and Italian gestural habits through an engaging choreographic dialogue.

fbab1bbf8765df044751ebcd94c155474f396635.en: Centre culturel suisse Paris presents Burning Threads, a performance by Caroline Lam exploring exile, Catholic colonial heritage, and Vietnamese spirituality. The piece honors the resilience and transmission of strength among women across generations.

71b862017ac3aef5a0400faa0c16031102ad5b8a.en: Salle Colonne hosts a family-friendly educational concert introducing Offenbach's lively operetta La Belle Hélène. Children and adults alike can discover the humor and drama of classical myth through key musical excerpts.

7b9b0d4f1412613d5772a3f007bdd29f178563a6.en: Contes 1, 2, 3, 4 is a musical story by Thomas Nguyen based on texts by Eugène Ionesco. Performed by a wind quintet and narrator, it offers a poetic and tender journey into the heart of childhood.

57667c13adddd2d3b4dc5e7932d3485a751f6441.en: L'orchestre cherche et trouve autour du monde is a musical show based on Chloé Perarnau's book. Join a detective's musical investigation around the globe to discover composers and instruments.

adf64b389a55091e7c285667972dd8e3036f7dc4.en: Adrien Perruchon conducts the Orchestre symphonique in a programme featuring Beethoven's Emperor Concerto and Eighth Symphony. Pianist Arielle Beck joins as soloist at Salle Gaveau.

1b21c38683e2afb1baf03848f199d378034658b5.en: Shabaab, directed by Samar Haddad King, is a contemporary piece praising male friendship and tenderness. Two performers are doubled by a puppet to express emotions beyond words.

7ac6ae12906b3ac6a32d6ab4dc812d45b3d304c0.en: Chaillot hosts the Maison des Pratiques Artistiques Amateurs to support young creation and encourage dialogue between emerging and established artists.

d304ea42675878d3d90e30b44e5a38f258dc8e82.en: Puccini's Tosca brings passion, jealousy, and tragedy to the stage in a fast-paced two-hour performance. Experience a dramatic opera that remains surprisingly modern.

ebe4c29db47be29328f7f53a7482e8a79c643fc7.en: The Everybody festival at Le Carreau du Temple explores the contemporary body and social norms through performances, dance classes, and contemporary art installations.

11adc03e51d7b550671469b6fae4f91d4e3f897c.en: Discover a unique cine-opera adaptation of La Belle et la Bête featuring Philip Glass's music synchronized with Jean Cocteau's film.

9e533e3aa078b240eb5599696959cafff95b3940.en: Être Surya follows young Madie as she finds inspiration in skating champion Surya Bonaly to overcome social norms. Lucie Hanoy's show explores identity and the transition from childhood to adolescence.

0419908204801c6ae3f1834a44aa2b80f5da3f73.en: Pasión de Buena Vista invites audiences to experience the festive energy of Cuba through vibrant music and dance at Salle Pleyel.

c53ab76da72e810e57968e5beb1b291ebb48152d.en: Improve your music theory skills with progressive and playful exercises at Centre Paris Anim' Point du Jour. Gain confidence in reading notes, rhythms, and partitions.

0380b9a2c0681aa86af681713d9ac029e3985ca7.en: Un Héros Bordel follows a group of friends confronting their past as they return to places from their youth. Le Grand Parquet presents this work-in-progress showing by Collectif La Capsule.

931230bca507f42a917559669c06b262564bbda7.en: Ground Extended features energetic hip-hop freestyle with Sons of Wind and hypnotic whacking by Mounia Nassangar and her dancers. Experience an immersive celebration of dance heritage at Chaillot.

5b590008aedf21e9d596e710ed560f3f6d8954fc.en: NERÓ is a poetic performance where eight artists use a vertical climbing wall to explore the choreography of love. Watch bodies defy gravity at Théâtre Silvia Monfort.

402b8f5f8addf0b3e8b80a021a675ad99f720bf8.en: PUNK.E.S at Conservatoire Léo Delibes is a musical comedy inspired by the first female punk group, The Slits, celebrating youth, freedom, and the rebellious spirit of rock.

f7ee389168e41573d75efbe60e74d34beb655fb6.en: Chaillot Expérience Core offers a two-day multidisciplinary weekend featuring performances, discussions, and exhibitions. Discover an open space where art forms and audiences meet without hierarchy.

9eaebb98124a10d0fa6ecd6341b32a3ee6395180.en: Le Pavillon de la Sirène and MPAA host an open stage event for amateur musicians across a variety of styles.

25b5511707d04128caaf51992fc86ef970fe6440.en: Tempo! is an open stage event where amateur musicians can perform live, sometimes for the very first time. The MPAA and Le Pavillon de la Sirène join forces to support local talent.

eb3b38b1f0feca3afddae7f956682240749a6dc3.en: Tout comme moi is a playful and poetic show for young audiences featuring a clown, an acrobat, and a cellist. Children from 18 months can enjoy a gentle story about listening and sharing.

83e7557819a243c43525ea42ecc24f5c6d0ca6c9.en: The Orchestre Pasdeloup performs a rich symphonie programme featuring works by Augusta Read Thomas, Rachmaninoff, and Brahms at the Philharmonie de Paris.

6893b5d0314610aed1d2db7b60d4acad08f8aa7b.en: Le Disorder Festival s'installe dans quatre salles de Montreuil pour deux jours dédiés aux cultures goth, post-punk et darkwave. Vingt-quatre groupes internationaux se réunissent pour célébrer les musiques alternatives et indépendantes.

5ce6161b21e8cb4651caaa0fa7a43721e292333b.en: Ce stage de yoga propose cinq séances à la carte pendant les vacances de février pour apaiser le mental et libérer les tensions. C'est l'occasion idéale pour prendre soin de son corps et apprendre à mieux gérer le stress au quotidien.

1ef556d117c504a39cb4f30abcb7d6512a8a879d.en: Un stage d'une semaine pour initier les enfants de 6 à 10 ans aux arts du cirque aux côtés d'un artiste professionnel. La semaine s'achève par un court spectacle présenté aux proches.

5bf4e3090b7ac4ee19ac76c4baffa6e0f4e827ed.en: Un atelier de modelage de deux matinées pour apprendre à sculpter un buste en terre en explorant les volumes et les proportions du visage. Une activité manuelle pour découvrir le plaisir de la sculpture en trois dimensions.

3c64ab0f6cc693a42db43c872e6109387eb4dd93.en: Le trio danois Farveblind débarque au Supersonic pour présenter son mélange explosif de techno, breakbeat et post-punk. Un concert gratuit en soirée pour profiter d'une ambiance survoltée.

b5fc833d7dcff715392dde0d8aeb106699e3d5b7.en: La Maison des Métallos accueille le seule-en-scène intime de Bili Bellegarde, qui explore la vulnérabilité et les amitiés queers à travers chansons et récits d'émancipation. Une représentation suivie d'un temps d'échange avec l'équipe artistique.

139d9302ac1572822e147f00260d1c8fcf9dd9c7.en: Une rencontre publique menée par Victoire Tuaillon et le chercheur Pierre Douillard-Lefèvre pour questionner la montée du militarisme et de l'économie de guerre. Un débat engagé autour des luttes sociales et des traditions antimilitaristes.

a95cf428372d82c1da2e90f0e76519efba3f0325.en: Le Baiser Salé accueille le flûtiste Malik Mezzadri et son quartet pour une soirée placée sous le signe du jazz et de l'improvisation. Une occasion rare de voir des musiciens virtuoses dans un cadre intimiste.

298b84a81c8da1b944555a5702d2efbf8edd95f4.en: Le Ballet de l'Opéra de Tunis présente une relecture chorégraphique contemporaine de Carmen par Abou Lagraa. Une pièce intense qui explore les tensions du désir et de la liberté à travers la danse.

c8396b1944331762150fa9a53c75e9de70cd5058.en: Thomas Enhco s'empare de la Philharmonie de Paris pour une carte blanche mêlant musique classique, jazz et improvisation. Entouré de ses invités, le pianiste brouille les frontières entre les genres le temps d'un concert.

d1120e0ed88ba01a72b08ad131174b78e91d0cfa.en: Un stage de deux jours pour s'initier aux techniques traditionnelles de la calligraphie ou de la peinture chinoises. Une pratique guidée par des artistes chercheurs pour créer en pleine conscience.

abd0d6bc72e89a5c02bd5c0d4b610ef6ce7ce8b1.en: Le MAIF Social Club présente une lecture collective et ludique des Tréteaux de France autour de l'histoire de Pierre et Nina. Un spectacle participatif où le public suit les personnages dans une forêt mystérieuse.

de777b873f268ba809c9e5f71a42d1f3cc96ae8c.en: Un stage pour les enfants afin d'explorer le lien entre images et mots à travers la photographie urbaine. Une manière ludique de développer son regard et son imaginaire en arpentant la ville.

6e1dcf1cfdc12a80f73f175cf786c9a3ff32f67a.en: L'Orchestre Pasdeloup interprète un programme de musique américaine à la Philharmonie de Paris, mêlant Gershwin, Florence Price et la célèbre symphonie de Dvořák. Un voyage symphonique riche en couleurs et en rythmes.

8eec45b0ccf18ddf31f644abc2f5c06427a13786.en: Le Théâtre Ouvert présente une création de Yacine Sif El Islam qui interroge les violences sociales et intimes à partir d'un fait divers réel. Une pièce mêlant archives et fiction.

40237edde790fa3507e74b77e4873c36f572fc0f.en: Un atelier pratique au MAIF Social Club pour apprendre à cuisiner les restes, épluchures et fanes de manière créative. Une initiation gourmande pour cuisiner presque zéro déchet.

e1bf0be529e8d710abdd9f0e2f92db6e84fad41e.en: Projection du film Ida de Paweł Pawlikowski au Carreau du Temple, suivie d'une rencontre-débat avec des professionnels du cinéma. Une plongée en noir et blanc dans la Pologne des années 1960.

51691c75f176631ab75aeaeef856b69df8b2fff6.en: Tamara Al Saadi signe et met en scène Place, un récit intime sur la quête d'identité et le déracinement entre l'Irak et la France. Une pièce épurée qui explore la double appartenance avec tendresse et force.

7855135bf3c1ef1f9da54ca8f841fd508d3b9707.en: Un spectacle de danse et de mouvement destiné aux tout-petits pour explorer le corps et l'intimité à travers le vêtement. Une création poétique à partager en famille dès un an.

9f0b4e5e24e3d4af3ea678f7f21f38c68f34557f.en: Une échappée by Julie Nioche is a burlesque fairy tale combining dance and objects for children aged two and a half and older. It offers a gentle and poetic sensory experience designed to show audiences a different reality.

7f8b89074229f2ce8190111271f6f995de8cd674.en: Nocturne (Parade) at the Théâtre Public de Montreuil presents an immersive puppet ballet driven by wind and music. It creates an unstable landscape that serves as a sensitive reflection on contemporary political upheavals.

eb58ca720c309db5f165ae298079494900f533d9.en: At the Théâtre de la Bastille, Julien Vella and Groupe Caute adapt Robert Musil's unfinished novel into a vibrant stage laboratory. The performance mixes fragments of song, dance, and stand-up to explore how to live and resist in times of profit and nationalism.

dcca45f1d1be3f0245a0c95129ceb06ce9bcb6b3.en: FUGACES by Aina Alegre at Chaillot features a high-energy dance performance inspired by the legacy of Carmen Amaya. The choreography deconstructs traditional flamenco and the Boléro de Ravel to offer a modern reflection on strength and rhythm.

6f146df5d05fba1c97228fe38267e72c60b4e5ee.en: Le Monde brûle et moi, je m’achète des Nike at Théâtre 13 uses childhood memories and 90s culture to question personal determination and survival in a chaotic world. Anturia Soilihi's intimate piece transforms the rage of oppression into theatrical jubilation.

f9ed79928730867cdc38ad4b1236a897846bb803.en: Imitation Game at MAIF Social Club is a participatory performance where humans and AI converse live on stage. It offers a playful and philosophical investigation into the boundaries between real and artificial speech.

2c4b4b9238b892840b73fc0908fac3577bac9c39.en: Lionel Eskenazi presents a conference at ECUJE exploring the career of Norman Granz, founder of major jazz labels and a dedicated fighter for racial equality in music.

1b5302b59399fe6ed954b9e561285591850ded89.en: On finira bien par comprendre by Les Naufragés Collectif at Le Grand Parquet presents a work-in-progress fable blending theater, dance, and visual poetry. It explores the persistence of dreams even when faced with the inevitable end of hope.

274f13dbddaa0732a7b5eea13197c60c74f99352.en: Celtic Legends at Salle Pleyel brings a two-hour musical journey featuring traditional Irish tap dance and live musicians. It celebrates twenty-five years of sharing Celtic heritage through vibrant rhythms and colorful costumes.

8be4bbe5ab02766b8efbfd97a33be606267bdc41.en: Comme des chiens at MPAA/Saint-Germain is a dark comedy adapted from Stéphane Jaubertie's work that explores power dynamics and survival. It uses humor and animalistic fury to examine how much pressure individuals can endure before biting back.

d31c23b72d1ac4b5f1997e781fe967e72162d832.en: Il Virtuoso Italiano at the Théâtre du Châtelet offers a musical journey through Italy featuring cellist Christian-Pierre La Marca. The program pairs classical masterpieces by Vivaldi with traditional tunes and film scores by Ennio Morricone.

a9cf041fa63300941204a6a89231871e9a1509e0.en: The Rise at Le Dôme de Paris is an epic English-language musical by the RB Dance Company set in an authoritarian regime. It tells the story of political opposition and a system's collapse through high-energy choreography.

1aa3af5cbd81b77dded41e7079da30ee602b555c.en: At the Centre Paris Anim' Point du Jour, this sewing workshop invites participants to craft a personalized bicycle saddle cover. It is a practical and creative hands-on project for cyclists.

4f24b866d0164ab2b6d88fd2a04baa4ac6c8c551.en: Salle Cortot hosts a concert pairing Lili Boulanger's contrasting Impressionist works with César Franck's passionate Quintet. The afternoon features youth-friendly pricing and an introductory mediation session.

3a01f9dfb6e99b9eea3dec5b7f3bb4fb545e79fb.en: Singer-songwriter MICHA performs live at Le Nouveau Casino following a successful European tour. Known for his raw, powerful voice, he brings his solo project to Paris with his full band.

dd5a6903bc7a3dbdec89ddbd0e77c64f3a937773.en: The Théâtre des Champs-Elysées presents Handel's Israel in Egypt, conducted by Hervé Niquet. The performance recounts the liberation of the Jewish people through dramatic choral movements and includes the organ concerto The Cuckoo and the Nightingale.

d6e12b14c06af06d3755830de8606c42e90be580.en: Le Pavillon de la Sirène hosts an interactive baroque concert inspired by the seventeenth-century Carte de Tendre. Ensemble Le Damier guides the audience through the emotional stages of love using period music and humor.

48ab02108d8a05e4a8e9e461ede1f5e0cc8a8d12.en: Nitcho Reinhardt trio performs at Le Son de la Terre, bringing together gypsy jazz guitarists and an accordionist. The concert showcases virtuosic technique and lively traditional melodies.

61921bc2c6d265614568469b51665dc676874bbf.en: Bonnie & Clyde at Théâtre Le 13e Art is a ballet by François Mauduit set during the American Great Depression. Dancers bring the story of the famous criminal couple to life amidst Art Deco aesthetics and jazz-era atmospheres.

bf2ff99e91ae41b583a186a4554b35634763284a.en: Imminentes by Jann Gallois at Chaillot features six female dancers exploring collective strength and ritual. Drawing from hip-hop and contemporary dance, the piece creates a poetic reflection on unity and the feminine.

9f2aff9c6e13278b062acb68e8b614d09d7d3113.en: La Chute des Anges at Théâtre Silvia Monfort is a striking circus performance blending dance and theatre. Suspended bodies and poignant poetry portray a fragile humanity caught between gravity and aspiration.

2d0312651d83e2dae9805e0604a9904f97d47998.en: Un Hamlet de moins at Théâtre Public Montreuil reimagines Shakespeare's classic characters as contemporary youths. Four actors tackle power, violence and desire with humour and sharp lucidity.

edd9181615b1d412b61090976220610ee43cc12d.en: Soirée illusions at Théâtre Silvia Monfort presents two magic shows that defy reality. Tom Cassani and illusionists Luis Sartori do Vale and Kalle Nio use tricks and optical techniques to create a dizzying experience.

3b37782476648b95d11f26e7f47e3aa69137b85b.en: Maledizione at MAIF Social Club is an oral and poetic performance by Pamina de Coulon. It explores gender dominance, historical narratives and radical empathy through a surprising journey across the centuries.

cc356137adee70371beb81dbe9991de9eb392f7f.en: The Hedy Trio performs a romantic concert of 19th-century German music at Studio L'Accord Parfait. The one-hour performance features works by Haydn, Brahms and overlooked female composers.

51c259fa7c9faf910bd5b7e413e84326b888bafb.en: Keshavara brings its psych pop sound to Supersonic with a free concert. The German-Indian band blends krautpop and multilingual lyrics to invite listeners into an imaginative sonic space.

a6aac46faf1b805f3f7352b1a6e16ebd0b392b24.en: Génération Mitterrand is a comedy following three friends from their youth in 1968 to 1981 and beyond. It explores social shifts, dashed hopes, and contemporary French history.

11b3bb742918e915502d7b69f221d92618ec508b.en: Hammer by Alexander Ekman comes to Théâtre du Châtelet, performed by the GöteborgsOperans Danskompani. Thirty-one dancers present a monumental contemporary piece exploring the chaos of modern societies.

429325122f28c793210d7ad3399e0f4df2694a66.en: Centre Paris Anim' Point du Jour hosts a porcelain painting workshop dedicated to marble effects. Spend an afternoon learning how to mimic delicate marble veins and personalize your own creations.

9d57a90ca9f81c51765f0c350a6240aa9f415e7e.en: Loa Mercury performs a headline concert at La Cigale, blending rock, pop and French chanson. The singer-songwriter showcases poetic lyrics and an androgynous stage presence.

274134b2a963400410d3a5071be9d9e467291252.en: Crescendo at Théâtre du Châtelet features the Quatuor Beat in a humorous percussion show. Musicians revisit classical music from the baroque era to today using movement, light and body percussion.

47eb57e8dfe9151f86f22f029ded83ec3f5fb7de.en: Centre Paris Anim' Point du Jour offers a three-session introductory computer course on artificial intelligence. Learn how to use tools like ChatGPT and explore practical everyday applications.

548b5390364460bfa7441afbaf95ab3404739b6f.en: Celui qui voit at International Visual Theatre is a poetic duet inspired by Jeanne Benameur. Performers blend French Sign Language, dance and multilingual singing to trace a journey toward the sea.

54446179548d15c92562ee521567f837f51b1bb2.en: Oskar Haag performs an indie folk concert at Supersonic. The young Austrian artist brings his captivating voice, poetic lyrics and emotional stage presence to the Parisian venue.

458952b96d61486b59e6fbfdaf93c6fe46b15a66.en: Muette by Boris Charmatz at Chaillot - Théâtre national de la Danse is a silent solo performance. The choreographer explores the breath, the skin and unspoken emotions in a minimalist dance piece.

dc80512f225f9ce6a4ea4abc95db843e405d0e5b.en: Inside at Théâtre Silvia Monfort features Tom Cassani swallowing sabres in a raw performance. The artist transforms a traditional circus act into an intimate exploration of danger and vulnerability.

5fbdd65473383fd88ae7bda2346d784496baa561.en: Olalaland at Théâtre de la Bastille by Clémence Jeanguillaume and Lionel Dray is a playful poetic show for families. Inspired by silent cinema, it follows a whimsical character through an absurd, dreamlike adventure.

254f12f22c40945529b7fb3c5c850fcf60ba2ea7.en: Le cafard des Renard at Le Grand Parquet is a theatrical piece by Marie Dompnier and Jan Peters. Set in a deep forest, a diverse cast of characters explores the utopia of romantic couples and living together.

d53a206925da15f52f6d3b6620b956a26aece15c.en: Dafné Kritharas performs a concert at the Maison de la musique de Nanterre, singing in Greek and French. Accompanied by acoustic instruments, she breathes new life into traditional tales of powerful women.

744857d3b868d3cdabe7565548075115a60bd514.en: This concert at the Théâtre des Champs-Elysées celebrates spring through works by Mozart, Beethoven, and Schubert. Pianist Javier Perianes performs alongside the Orchestre de chambre de Paris under Aurel Dawidiuk.

78738955b758e4fd5ed2c3566bf2914ea356ed59.en: Catch the energetic indie funk band A.R.T from London live at Supersonic. Known for their spontaneous pop-up street gigs, the group brings a lively and groove-heavy performance.

a35c2866a94c285e5de18316ed4d62d05bce621a.en: Ladaniva brings their vibrant, genre-blending music to the conservatoire Léo Delibes. Known for their energy, they fuse Armenian, Balkan, and tropical traditions into a festive experience.

4c5352799e0aaabca906bb48094f967db1c2998e.en: La Fabrique du Comédien hosts an improvisation theatre workshop in Paris for beginners and experienced performers alike. It is designed to build confidence, stage presence, and spontaneity.

35d04020494497a3f8c6ef16bde007b57d7066bd.en: Designed for young children, this short concert at Salle Colonne introduces Vivaldi's Four Seasons through storytelling, rhymes, and magic tricks. It offers a gentle first step into classical music.

b83e4a4695ab700bbbe71d873cc65df2e59a8e0d.en: Experience Vivaldi's Four Seasons through an immersive concert at Salle Colonne featuring panoramic projections of Venice. The multimedia performance is brought to life by soloists of the Orchestre Colonne.

2a0c25da10a328edfab42a44cfbe004c337e2704.en: Pianist Javier Perianes joins musicians from the Orchestre de chambre de Paris at Salle Cortot for an intimate chamber music program. The evening features works by Mozart and Schumann.

bcc575e386a913388f41ab3d92ca5635023c2a7b.en: The Orchestre Pasdeloup presents a diverse orchestral program at Salle Gaveau conducted by Mojca Lavrenčič. The evening highlights works from Eastern and Southern Europe alongside soloist Élise Bertrand.

91553175ae893323903d773ffcdbb252cd4a34a3.en: This interactive family concert introduces children aged five and up to the music of Mozart. Featuring an orchestra, singers, dancers, and actors, the audience is invited to join in.

f8fbd1750fc9d92ca42f76ce9ea9393f564f2026.en: Canadian indie pop band Bombargo brings their high-energy blend of funk, soul, and rock and roll to Supersonic. Expect an engaging show driven by rich harmonies and strong grooves.

d38e0f3b0a21e4992e406015a7fc43cc5c591794.en: This musical awakening concert at Salle Colonne introduces children to Vivaldi's Four Seasons. Young listeners discover how instruments evoke nature through an interactive presentation.

465d1e3fec39ca20ee1542aa5f43c9dd6424365c.en: Chaillot - Théâtre national de la Danse hosts a discussion exploring the relationship between contemporary dance and photography. Artists and researchers examine current societal and artistic shifts.

508bd32364c7d5209f09e89bee5cf2a6d35ede3c.en: David Bobée presents a powerful adaptation of Alfred de Musset and George Sand's classic play at the Théâtre Public de Montreuil. The staging offers a political reading featuring an inclusive cast.

f0469d01e556123519177be7d18b69cb99e095e3.en: Joëlle Sambi presents a live performance of her poetry collection at La Maison des Métallos. Her work serves as a poetic and political manifesto addressing systemic violence and resilience.

fe844a313051c57e33ca82b2c6bc952c24a9a3b0.en: This program at the Amphithéâtre Richelieu de la Sorbonne explores the deep connections between music and dance. Featuring global folk traditions, it highlights how movement and sound intersect.

45d63c0ab63ae6cccdcad948a93324a1a32dd517.en: Mathilde Monnier and La Ribot perform Gustavia at Chaillot - Théâtre national de la Danse, blending physical comedy and contemporary art. The piece offers a sharp, humorous take on female artistry.

c55a644f5015c57f57bacc7b3849b5fd333a29e4.en: Adrien Béal and Arthur Igual revisit a past theatrical project at the Théâtre Silvia Monfort. The performance functions as a shared laboratory where theatre is created live in the moment.

5f8618f440c2419162aa2bd6015009c4213f85c0.en: La Maison des Métallos hosts an evolving multidisciplinary evening curated by the collective À définir dans un futur proche. Artists from various backgrounds collaborate on spontaneous performances.

188821436d27614b826d608cfbcd0256b78ff714.en: The MAIF Social Club hosts a theatrical adaptation of Animal Farm. The performance explores power dynamics and political corruption through a narrative driven by characters and objects.

b54de607255fb9ed055004f0bc769160dff5358b.en: Drawing Now Paris celebrates its 20th edition at Le Carreau du Temple, bringing together over seventy international galleries. It offers a comprehensive overview of contemporary drawing over the past fifty years.

3df84e0c7506b0f9cafa9fb603bf25cfd59a53c0.en: Part of the Centre Pompidou's 50th anniversary celebrations, this hybrid weekend at Chaillot blends dance and contemporary visual arts through performances, workshops, and music.

be4c587bf2420de3a978be5faf0984f8f1e21418.en: Baro d’evel and Babx invite audiences into a living workshop exploring identity through clay, piano, and movement as part of the development for the upcoming solo Qui soc?

3b1588f7e4c45003b41f746c528d0b41106ce659.en: After a ten-year absence, the iconic pop-rock group Pony Pony Run Run returns to the stage for a long-awaited tour featuring new tracks and explosive classic hits.

882ce90c14b6856ed94f81fac83876c57c576832.en: Who's Playing brings together passionate musicians for an energetic live show blending funk, soul, and modern pop.

6abd93ebc0be3b6a17b081ebcb4a1b0305a15af7.en: EKLA! combines electro music, giant pop-up books, and animated film for an immersive visual and auditory experience. The duo Turnsteak creates moving landscapes on stage that delight both children and adults.

17c9f145a293a91b57449e6a5a4dac40ba4a7ec3.en: The Lions Paris 9 Run returns for its 22nd edition, offering solidarity-driven running routes through the 9th arrondissement to support inclusive education for children with disabilities.

850f28c2da031f4c1ce1b4935eeacae7726239e5.en: A vocal jazz trio and musical ensemble revisit classic Walt Disney soundtracks with swing, close harmony, and dynamic choreography.

2227c077b2520eeb199e61533c4a15695d469a65.en: Created by Engruna Teatre, Univers is an immersive performance combining objects, movement, and live music designed to introduce babies and toddlers to the performing arts.

15450f5f79e62c3d61ad0dd7d3e85e745ea3caa4.en: This theatrical piece blends archive, literature, and intimate memory across six chapters to explore transmission and rewrite a personal story of trauma.

f39001d4109b35dfa821312a088b203fc10678ab.en: Agathe Charnet presents an autofictional theatrical piece exploring Alzheimer's disease, the role of young caregivers, and the enduring power of memories linked to art.

a3d554fe4b8cf8de63d92f7f1a835583697c6eea.en: Laurène Marx delivers a powerful, poignant solo performance tackling transidentity, systemic violence, and the subversion of social norms.

b4624e4acb77166a152e9492475d85112858f8dc.en: This cultural gathering features talks by prominent figures from the arts world to discuss perspectives and dynamics within the contemporary cultural landscape.

79a61984af0878b213d969eed9d1e1fd41141c7d.en: Students present a shared choreographic piece developed alongside diverse artists in an event celebrating dance and inclusivity.

0d3cc25d21bada4abe8d668fcb6a4336c11f3ade.en: Solid'Art is a solidarity-focused contemporary art fair by Secours populaire where art purchases directly fund summer holidays for children in need.

e6fe39432da89d09eb5f13fca7c4b1d50c6bccbb.en: Olivier Hutman leads an evening retracing the remarkable life and jazz legacy of pianist René Urtreger, featuring personal memories and musical history.

8d17ecdbea207fc10c64af698e8e288ec658eaab.en: The Orchestre de chambre de Paris performs a new work by Simon Wills inspired by Antigone alongside Beethoven's Symphony No. 4 in a concert exploring resistance and hope.

dac9a5a8c634c3f4a8cc46ffb23cc56db7e33025.en: Safia Nolin presents a raw, poetic musical performance exploring identity, nostalgia, and personal growth through an unfiltered artistic lens.

71e81e50de0f036d5bd045c80801ded484b3d45a.en: Hofesh Shechter presents an intense contemporary dance performance driven by collective energy, rhythmic power, and emotional trance.

57cd6c461a008aa49ed8dfa10c8db928dee2b32a.en: The Tamir Hendelman Duo performs jazz standards and new material alongside opening act KROME, winner of the 2026 Prix René Urtreger.

ab9c73f99dd700df71e7429db70b574d817f95a2.en: The Pépite musical contest celebrates its fifth edition by showcasing emerging local music talent across various genres before a professional jury and public audience.

9db10b65a4670842e52781bf4390c141002c6f4e.en: Grrrrr est un solo rituel dansé pour les tout-petits au MAIF Social Club, où des figures animales faites de peaux et de plumes prennent vie. Cette expérience joyeuse et sauvage invite les enfants et adultes à se mettre en mouvement lors d'un grand bal final.

fe88a293ec62526103448f2cb1b99b4fc62d3931.en: Le Centre Paris Anim' Point du Jour propose un stage de couture le samedi 27 mars pour apprendre à réaliser son propre sac banane. C'est un projet fun et pratique pour repartir avec une création unique.

0f0153281f3b871dfd0ae896f3f22a0af3a1062a.en: Le Nouveau Casino accueille L'Expédition pour un hommage ultra festif aux Cowboys Fringants le 27 mars 2027. Venez chanter et danser sur les plus grands succès du groupe québécois lors d'une soirée survoltée.

270e714c6ccce41a51a00297448a97f9cf59e9b8.en: Au Théâtre du Châtelet, découvrez Company, la comédie musicale américaine créée par Stephen Sondheim en 1970. L'œuvre explore avec beauté et acuité les imperfections de la vie quotidienne et des relations humaines.

28d439f8807bd633507c672efeacf003d5c11092.en: Le spectacle Depuis que je suis né, mis en scène par David Lescot au Conservatoire Léo Delibes, raconte avec humour le quotidien d'un petit garçon de six ans. Une comédienne seule en scène donne vie à cette autobiographie tendre et musicale à partager en famille.

a6e262d023528d572fe47eb93d8f495a5494cbab.en: Chaillot - Théâtre national de la Danse présente Sibylline, une création chorégraphique de Léo Lérus mêlant rythmes créoles et danse contemporaine. Neuf interprètes y explorent la mémoire vive de la Caraïbe.

0cb4a545f13a77a195054b091a05b3e5c789043e.en: La Maison des Métallos présente Les Subversives par Les Filles de Simone, un spectacle explorant des communautés de femmes à travers l'histoire. Les comédiennes proposent une plongée vivante et décalée dans ces quotidiens singuliers.

e1b29bad861ba73490228c3782e8a5c79b97b838.en: La Villette accueille The Belt de la Ambiguous Dance Company, une pièce chorégraphique mêlant hip-hop, ballet et danse contemporaine. Cette œuvre futuriste interroge notre rapport à la transmission et au progrès.

c3dff12c57162d501f107a1c714cfc922eaf2f2b.en: Le MAIF Social Club présente L'abolition des privilèges, une adaptation théâtrale du roman de Bertrand Guillot par Hugues Duchêne. Un acteur incarne une dizaine de personnages dans ce sprint haletant sur la Nuit du 4 août 1789.

ea2a7c63f800820e41afae31ad8a1c65635fae14.en: Le Carreau du Temple accueille la 11e édition de l'Urban Art Fair, la vitrine internationale de l'art urbain contemporain. Cet événement rassemble une trentaine de galeries pour découvrir le travail de plus de 200 artistes.

8d6214052a4be38d16b7d26f43bc3d8c4f92bb47.en: Le Grand Parquet présente Mille fois bonne nuit d'Hortense Girard, mêlant théâtre et cinéma à travers des tableaux sur l'amour et la mémoire. Cette présentation en sortie de résidence offre un aperçu d'une étape de travail.

267ddd755c5edfa55f35d52c5812145baa8a9e1b.en: La Maison des Métallos présente Le Birgit Kabarett #7, un spectacle documenté mêlant saynètes, chansons et satire politique. Le Birgit Ensemble y dresse un portrait burlesque et lucide de notre époque.

c1822bdc19dfd136c52a408154fc08f15c7f07e6.en: L'église Saint-Vincent de Paul accueille le clarinettiste Yom aux côtés des frères Ceccaldi pour un concert immersif. Ce trio virtuose propose un voyage musical entre jazz, musiques du monde et musique de chambre.

a7866f938dc91136e40111932b7fc3414c99ea43.en: La Philharmonie de Paris accueille Le Musée prend l'eau avec Lena Brisson, Alexis Collin, Constance Félix, Estelle Wolf et Natalia Valentin.

0967c03b259fcf146bdee39385cb48f74d384c91.en: La Philharmonie de Paris présente La Renverse par la compagnie Les Ombres Portées. Ce spectacle sans paroles associe théâtre d'ombres, marionnettes et musiciens polyvalents dans un univers enchanteur.

9938394cec6a984ef106b34bb4e2ebc0bc1387d4.en: La Salle Cortot propose un concert de musique classique avec flûte, violon, alto et violoncelle. Des œuvres de Mozart, Reicha et Dotzauer y sont interprétées comme une conversation musicale pleine de douceur.

0534d90e0984e9daab64feeaecfc59c03128d1eb.en: La Philharmonie de Paris présente Les Eaux du Monde, interprété par l'Orchestre du CRR de Paris sous la direction de Pierre-Michel Durand. Le concert associe des œuvres de Debussy, Britten et Respighi à un dessin en direct par Benjamin Flao.

7a42cbb0af9fc5f4895a14af5ab6585e8e7019b1.en: La Philharmonie de Paris propose Escape Cage, un escape game sonore à travers les espaces du lieu. Conçu avec les solistes de l'Ensemble intercontemporain, ce parcours invite à découvrir l'univers de John Cage.

1b06390974f58781e5592f1ff29cdcd83eb168aa.en: La Seine Musicale présente La Musique des héros, un concert-éveil destiné aux enfants pour découvrir les thèmes de films fantastiques. L'Orchestre Colonne interprète les musiques du Seigneur des Anneaux, Harry Potter et Pirates des Caraïbes.

f3c2d3403b48c6794abec0436d7b02d481ed5c32.en: La Seine Musicale propose Le Pouvoir de l'Anneau, un concert symphonique reliant l'univers de Wagner à celui de Howard Shore. L'Orchestre Colonne explore les correspondances musicales entre Le Seigneur des Anneaux et Le Ring sans paroles.

381b8f5bb9aed4eae358c5da523dc04c33960e19.en: Plastic Boum Boum is an award-winning musical spectacle by Compagnie du Trufu featuring recycled instruments and eccentric clowns. It invites audiences of all ages to dance and laugh together.

6234060c15e0376c292945441993a129089dcbea.en: This circus workshop for children aged 6 to 10 allows participants to explore circus techniques and history with a professional artist. The week ends with a short show for family and friends.

96533a2638df04fa378977dc8e8a6f2d80a8a4aa.en: The Grand Chœur Rythmique d'EVE performs on the stage of the Grande Salle Pierre Boulez. Middle school students, teachers, and professional adult singers unite to showcase their hard work.

53b00f18b9aa54ab7d0ff61d4b72547d9a9f9e1e.en: Dancing with Bob pairs Trisha Brown Dance Company works with the art of Robert Rauschenberg. It celebrates his centenary through postmodern dance pieces that explore movement and imagination.

0650eabbbc4c36527a8885cb251fa187f9cdddeb.en: Boris Charmatz presents 10000 gestes, a dynamic contemporary dance piece performed by a group of twenty dancers. Each performer executes a unique sequence of movements in a tribute to the ephemerality of art.

08e6ca8d58817454f5089434915bc83c754546e1.en: The Orchestre Pasdeloup presents a program dedicated to nineteenth-century romanticism at the Philharmonie de Paris. Pianist Szymon Nehring joins the orchestra to perform Brahms's Piano Concerto No. 2.

7c9af7810132bcdec65470ab25eab51cf514ae27.en: Pianist Alexandre Tharaud presents a literary concert blending readings from his book Touché with pieces by Chopin, Debussy, and Satie. Performers include Gilles Privat, Yoann Gasiorowski, and Frédéric Vaysse-Knitter.

73730383c0707143e97568505ce58164e4eb3a1e.en: The indie rock band The Lilacs from Wigan performs live at Supersonic. Known for their high-energy sound and prominent streaming presence, they bring their British scene anthems to Paris.

3fc762938e31a920172ef78a08c570fc5d20bdc5.en: Quatuor Arod performs works by Beethoven, Debussy, Ravel, and Franck at the Philharmonie de Paris. This concert highlights French music and chamber masterpieces centered around friendship and expression.

d6fb9a96c49ff0c5559a0cefc3cf2eb6e255a9c3.en: Roland Romanelli celebrates his artistic and personal collaboration with the singer Barbara. Through his accordion performance, he honors one of the finest chapters of French chanson.

164565e558542352772502edea8126b0f9980270.en: Alexandre Tharaud and Vanessa Wagner are joined by young artists from the Alexandre Tharaud Foundation for a piano celebration. The concert features works by Debussy, Rachmaninoff, Rossini, and Saint-Saëns.

9bbf2367a90223c9459b27c9b1b38a856afc2903.en: Experience Murnau's 1927 silent film masterpiece L'Aurore accompanied by live music performed by Alexandre Tharaud. It is a cinematic journey exploring themes of love through groundbreaking camera work and a synchronized score.

2d4213d31481c03c923796294a688dd5763bec4e.en: The Orchestre de chambre de Paris invites audiences to dance with a program featuring Brahms and Dvořák. Under the direction of Thomas Hengelbrock, the concert bridges classical and popular central European dance rhythms.

36577af65f9fa0435816deb320e3efcbe040c27d.en: London-based indie folk group Alberta Cross performs live at Supersonic. Led by Petter Ericson Stakee, the Anglo-Swedish band brings their acclaimed guitar-driven sound to the venue.

323b26ae7d923e21f1ed1ffb4adfee29bd4de942.en: This dance workshop offers participants a chance to discover the practice and choreography of Taoufiq Izeddiou in connection with his piece Border Dance. Registration includes a ticket to see the performance.

90d161f81d1cdc7359ad1148771d4d40aa372987.en: Il est encore temps d’abandonner is a work-in-progress presentation exploring a struggle against land capitalization and environmental loss. It offers a glimpse into a residency project dealing with property and local decisions.

ecea8fc619aeb396ad21879c1329d95dc627add3.en: Olivier Hutman leads a lecture-listening session exploring how jazz musicians have adapted sacred and secular Jewish melodies. Discover the deep connections between memory, spirituality, and improvisation.

30d8234fa3cde30cf8a329cfcb96a022fe9d0a7a.en: L’Effondrement des glaciers uses archival elements and reimagined scenes to navigate the story of Yann Lemée. The play questions human relationships, intimacy, and the nature of love and authority.

e0d165c69f4093013efdfe7f2c28eb9e39874f43.en: Anatole Édouard Nicolo presents the stage adaptation of his award-winning novel À l'ombre des choses. This sensitive solo performance explores childhood fragilities, family bonds, and personal growth through sound and light.

510dc937f75d45451d5db3bbbfdde40405fa14ca.en: Le Groupe O takes audiences back to fifth-century BC Athens to question modern democratic practices and voting. Tragédie Démocratie blends fiction and history to draw parallels between ancient politics and today's society.

50ecbf7f32eb46dcdf65ac480023e2727c3d9241.en: Le Carreau du Temple screens Laura Poitras's Oscar-winning documentary Citizenfour, detailing Edward Snowden's NSA leaks. The screening is followed by a debate with members of the film crew.

ac0a47cf03c2d8b2693fbac58a35e301993612f4.en: Théâtre 13 - Bibliothèque presents Des yeux sur moi, directed by Lucile Rose after Howard Barker. The performance explores female desire and the destruction it brings through a striking plastic universe.

aa8edc94c3ed6faca4d00ba981a79ed88897249a.en: Théâtre Silvia Monfort presents On m'a trouvée grandie, a sensory theatrical experience created by Valentine Losseau and Raphaël Navarro. The show explores the history of women diagnosed with hysteria through dance and optical illusions.

5fc9f7207eca255e0e637902724c25d95cde34a5.en: Young Mediterranean artists present contemporary plastic arts exhibitions at the Cité internationale universitaire de Paris. The works offer fresh perspectives on the regions of the Mediterranean.

eb411331a7ede1ff183915e48c86ff6f019d78da.en: Le Théâtre du Figuier Blanc presents Personne n'est ensemble sauf moi by Clea Petrolesi. This play explores invisible disabilities through the stories of young adults navigating solitude and normalcy.

96042288523677d30d81d0ec95a01b858e4285c8.en: Qui Veut Pister Paris offers outdoor investigative games across various historical districts of the capital. Equipped with an investigator's case, teams solve puzzles while discovering secret corners of Paris.

c86112971b185bfd6673169a410a90c4e32cab3b.en: Anis Gras le lieu de l'autre presents Le Roi est Mort - Variations autour du Sentiment de l'échec. This performance explores the fear of failure and how setbacks can serve as spaces for personal transformation.

069bf535de2b3e6e1af7fa92bbd52b397f93b780.en: Apollo Théâtre hosts With Love, Baubo, a musical show featuring the cabaret energy of La Bouche. Join the performances on November 3 and 4, 2026.

e9c527fee7d0b99e54db2624e65effb4f9976771.en: Âge d'Or de France offers a two-day workshop on integrating music into storytelling. Participants learn to use simple instruments to enhance oral narratives.

35ad481f4b2e291644a0bcc933ec5f22a523f9b0.en: The Czech Centre in Paris hosts a special evening dedicated to composer Vítězslava Kaprálová. The event features a screening of Petr Záruba's documentary and a live musical performance by students.

f89a1aadcf789712dff68d023bdd25fa9012adcf.en: Joachim Pastor, Joris Delacroix, and Teho bring their melodic techno live project PACT to L'Élysée Montmartre. The immersive performance features custom machines that allow the audience to interact with the music.

103418c355dbe25a6588a5df470f1afcb4fe7634.en: L'Olympia hosts an exceptional concert by electronic music producer and DJ Chloé on March 18, 2027. Experience her versatile and immersive approach to djing.

482d7bb0a081f8969469f1426000c7d1497c51f5.en: Phantom Paris hosts a late-night clubbing event featuring DJ HEARTSTRING. Doors open from 23:00 to 06:00 at Bercy.

2cae3f184099587a8e7c46b0b0a205ab9da1ef9d.en: Théâtre La Piscine - L'Azimut hosts a concert featuring three distinctive voices in urban music: Danitsa, Juste Shani, and 2L. Discover their unique fusions of reggae, hip hop, and rap.

8ce9783104e8629c7ee8c8fd41404a496a917e2e.en: La Boule Noire welcomes Grandmas House, a Bristol-based quartet known for their raw grunge and post-punk sound. Catch their energetic and uncompromising live performance.

e6ba86aa490185520769e18044e5b983596791be.en: WorkshoW Paris hosts the Deviance Horror Party and after-party on October 31. The LGBTQ+ and friends event features DJ Yuri Bonotto and a festive, kinky atmosphere.

83d736c98fb24a40a5e1d91d91a049887d0b8ac4.en: La Cigale hosts a live concert by La Kadrilla on November 4.

083a504519bbf80c16a706c374538fd907fdbb00.en: California Avenue hosts a vibrant Hip-Hop and Afrobeat party across two levels with multiple bars. Enjoy live DJ sets and tropical decor all night long.

c76a001949e0af8a42337d280457d5d957f8d010.en: California Avenue hosts a Sunday night party dedicated to old school hip-hop, R&B, and reggaeton. Enjoy music across two distinct rooms and ambient bars.

d2bb72b4635d63de9b8b5befbc668664f3ca7877.en: Sphères Festival returns to La Communale de Saint-Ouen for a three-day celebration of the new artistic generation. The lineup features drag shows, stand-up comedy, voguing, pole dance, and vintage markets.

9a44a6392b50e636dba928dac46769c1de6f67c9.en: Silva Bumpa, Scolcab, Lespol b2b Unsho, and Noon perform at Badaboum for a club night. The safe and inclusive event runs from late night until morning.

98eeeb0ff91c7026740254ae83c1eb1edf289bd8.en: La Dancing at Les Étoiles is a weekly club night playing 90s and 2000s hits, pop, hip-hop, and electro. Resident DJs keep the dancefloor moving until morning in a historic former theatre.

f8024da19f67170fac9f0e9faf8dc06444d1f7db.en: La Dancing at Les Étoiles is a weekly club night playing pop, hip-hop, electro, and 90s and 2000s hits. Resident DJs provide familiar tracks in a century-old theatre turned club.

76d2a8a6fb8051af93bbec7382b66a0a38f71b04.en: La Java hosts a special tribute night dedicated to Céline Dion featuring a dedicated DJ set, themed cocktails, and fan merch. Fans can gather to celebrate her music in a festive atmosphere.

186df76229bcdcddbf92e3d52f483a7f2642e365.en: La Java hosts a melodic death metal evening featuring Fractal Gates, The Dawn Razor, and Chabtan. The bands showcase new tracks and heavy atmospheric sounds.

4c92c9de67c12d890ba55487e9f2ee4e3e6945b7.en: Laces celebrates the release of their debut EP Mozaic with a live show at La Pointe Lafayette, blending indie rock, new wave, and alternative sounds. Blinded opens the evening.

7544c5f01c290fc8686259ca795ac4f778c01621.en: Gera D'Abundo and Marcello Cassanelli present a three-act show in Montmartre combining jazz, funk, and disco. The performance moves from listening to dance-oriented energy.

6fdaeb17eb59d479933eff74ea72d254a57e00f1.en: Camoufly performs a live set at Badaboum, bringing innovative electronic productions and sample-heavy dance music to Paris.

23fb27ba653495482a5c1b817b12403c39df6423.en: La Bellevilloise hosts the third edition of Sortir de l'ombre by Collectif Handy, a day dedicated to inclusive art, creator markets, concerts, and DJ sets.

821972c44ba0375fa95e35a327b84b26e592c165.en: Genesis Owusu performs a live concert at Le Trabendo.

c465b45b2f5f68fc922a810e5b3d07b2b8fb080c.en: Petit Bain hosts the NYOKOBOP Festival featuring international artists Saliah and Malaise Vagal. The night explores global club sounds and contemporary electronic music.

a375d804ccd8b260b1bb68fb6637601bb4ff8c42.en: Fitzroy hosts a weekly Thursday night event featuring a DJ set alongside food, drinks, darts, and a photobooth.

125b6cca295087590e9e878b038e3debe1b13e9f.en: Myd hosts Salute, Tsha, and Akalex for a special electronic music night at Mia Mao. The venue maintains a strict no-photo policy and a safe, inclusive environment.

9ea07e21dff067be90abb4734d94384bebd3617b.en: Bizz'art hosts a Latino night along the Canal Saint-Martin featuring tropical rhythms, salsa, reggaeton, and dancefloor classics with the Tropiteca team.

11515efd3631fd3f8788fa515798049180662df0.en: Le Centquatre hosts an African-themed edition of Bal Pop' featuring Ameth Sissokho and Sora Yaa Band alongside DJ Cucurucho. The evening offers live afro groove music and a worldly DJ set in an inclusive atmosphere.

84cfda3f9b1d11b54f0da89599ffbde57a70ec3e.en: La Casbah hosts a weekly vintage clubbing night on Thursdays with free entry, featuring pop, rock, disco, and electro playlists.

3b0c05e4fc4ecafacad86ce4a26b10b164cd70cd.en: The Théâtre des Champs-Elysées hosts a classical concert featuring works by Mozart and Stravinsky, alongside a world premiere by young composer Ehwa Hong performed by the Orchestre de chambre de Paris.

ee77b4834f6e0c6ddb94bd8e953de2caf665f1d3.en: Le Bateau Phare hosts a winter psy techno night presented by Providence, featuring sets from resident artists and guest Ewake in a safe and inclusive environment.

7632d1174d05c874edcba17f5ad023dc26d1c7ec.en: Noct Club hosts Therapy Halloween, a rap and afro music event featuring a costume dress code and sets from HSBO, MKneal, and MC Moya.

1414ab8e02f0b98ef620c3196e0cf41f99af08ba.en: Mirabilis Jalapa returns for its second chapter in Paris, featuring a strict dress code of Venetian masks, kimonos, and corsets. The event is strictly for guests over 21 with a no-phone policy.

1fdbfd48083ead9c84ed5dc45209d45bbf6585ec.en: Annette K. hosts a free weekly karaoke night where you can sing your favorite songs with friends or on your own. Enjoy drinks, cocktails, and pizzas in a fun, relaxed atmosphere.

f8cecce4b3d0beec67fa31d5f88e3518c86f9f2a.en: Author Lolita Pille presents her new essay Antigone Reine at the Silencio Book Club. Discover an ardent, punk-infused exploration of literature's power against modern tyrannies.

f2d87f5e8d680a6396d255084938e903a28fb2ad.en: Korean performer and dancer JellO stops in Paris for an exclusive K-pop workshop, Q&A, and merch session. A rare chance to learn choreography and meet a top industry insider.

2cdf70f2bcef5f2ce255c8f11349fc840a447efe.en: Thalie Bernard hosts a weekly pop and soul vocal jam at Le Baiser Salé. Join the stage with talented musicians for an evening of groove, improvisation, and good vibes.

2caff72c3e7fec504ce02631ef4aab7f97c7c8d6.en: Mia Mao hosts a special afterparty featuring Azzecca, Leflblom, and Nightchou for the final edition of Camille Doe's residency. Expect high-energy house, techno, and cosmic club sounds.

830bce5241c60350927ba7ebcade4fe9dbde3dcc.en: Zouzou Pigalle hosts Anarchy in the Cabaret, blending Parisian glamour with punk insolence. Enjoy drag shows, lip-syncs, and international electro-pop in an eccentric, vibrant atmosphere.

9430406f401a219e902f21c088487b5e85d1d58b.en: Zouzou Pigalle presents Le Bal des Ombres, a vampiric Halloween cabaret blending dark electro, house, and techno. Step into the night with immersive performances and a chic gothic dress code.

309a88fec8bbac2787184702bf8f8eb8bdf4d77c.en: Soleil Plein takes over Djoon for a twelve-hour groove marathon from late afternoon to dawn. Enjoy food, drinks, and a continuous flow of disco and house music on the club sound system.

c19422afe0433db4fbbc4c6868755b22c12a768b.en: La Bellevilloise transforms into a haunted mansion for a special Classics Only Halloween party. Relive 2000s rap and R&B classics across two rooms with a live karaoke session and DJ sets.

b2e88d33125084d867a39a81fb0addf3cedb1875.en: Explore the SLB technology campus in Clamart during Industry Week. Discover AI labs, 3D printing Fablabs, and energy technologies while meeting experts shaping a sustainable future.

fd9d6f1a414fbf6b562895e4ec4e46a28e5233fa.en: Take part in a collaborative workshop at the Cité des sciences et de l'industrie to better understand industrial ecosystems. Use visual cards to explore the links between economic, social, and environmental challenges.

62d571ea0718b5e2fa91a693005a4b2baf4cee98.en: Discover the winning entries of the industrial photography student prize at the Cité des sciences et de l'industrie. This exhibition highlights the richness and tools of French industry through young perspectives.

6baf28a5da43f6a548a4e8e64e5f9cf4c149a675.en: Visit the Chantier Naval du Nord Van Praet in Villeneuve-la-Garenne during Industry Week. Discover boat restoration work, dry docks, and metalworking trades alongside industry professionals.

f0a991ae74f40d237f18b3112dfa959607c478bf.en: A group of middle school students will visit Subsea 7 to discover company operations and meet professionals from the sector.

e33593ea7338d0906388d760e23b7836ea6bc487.en: School students are invited to discover the activities of the Groupe BALAS during an educational company visit in Gennevilliers.

d4bc9a34ef40c777d8a6734ff9127efb2ac2035c.en: Test your talents and identify your strengths through practical exercises imitating real industry jobs. This dynamic information session helps you explore promising career paths.

debeefc64b0caaec53b68a05e89c016c3d2a2a83.en: Spend your Sunday evening playing chess and enjoying live jazz at the Jass Club. Take part in tournaments via ChessBar or just listen to the jam session with free-price entry.

df573f65468ef867f4ec2f2f56c5fa7591a5e5c9.en: Ellen Birath performs songs from her new EP Mother of Pearl at the Jass Club as part of Jazz Sur Seine. Her soulful quartet explores themes of motherhood through jazz, folk, and raw emotion.

3194f3a0ab0e12afc8c35640baccce2fb5394dbd.en: Angelo Maria and his band bring an energetic blend of Afrobeat and jazz to the Jass Club. Inspired by Fela Kuti and Herbie Hancock, their music bridges continents and honors the fight for freedom.

8431640873160087f13b7ad8870505dd4e081c91.en: Gabriel Pierre teams up with Brazilian musicians Henrique Mota and Isaias Alves at the Jass Club. The trio explores a Franco-Brazilian repertoire blending modern jazz and traditional rhythms.

017abe67a5726c730e4b71d8f60282175253c967.en: Anna Stevens and her quintet bring the energy of 1930s and 40s American standards and original compositions to JASS CLUB. Join for an evening of swing, emotion, and dancing.

03ddf9c15b726f92c508523e8af7d10da5970ae4.en: Flutist and composer Naïssam Jalal presents "Landscapes of Eternity" at the Centre Culturel Arménien, sharing an intimate repertoire inspired by her travels in India.

758408530c0526e04d3a64239b32325fda2d622a.en: The Café IA returns to the Salle François Molé in Antony to help businesses discover practical AI tools, live demonstrations, and regulatory guidelines.

9ae2e6e3e8ffa52a2b8b01ae2f01b5c7f3a384b9.en: Join an outdoor team challenge at L'Avant Seine to observe, explore, and spot the colors all around us.

ee90cdca99f909222fb5c2eab626dd6c768ddd3a.en: Take part in a creative workshop at L'Avant Seine to make your own unique, personalized lucky charm and take it home.

216e6d288971adbe860b3b37f40391bde5714dcc.en: Explore occupied Paris through an interactive photography game of piste starting from Printemps Haussmann, organized by the Musée de la Résistance nationale.

4e721f80a43d8e4b5800df6080f4398994816ee0.en: Galerie Putman hosts an exhibition by Dana Cojbuc, showcasing works that blend photography with charcoal drawings of imaginary and real landscapes.

aff991aa720cec41bdd2d7862053ed0bc860782c.en: The Archives départementales de la Seine-Saint-Denis host a roundtable exploring photojournalism creation, featuring the specific case of workers' correspondents from l'Humanité.

fa31bc735687db7753283493ad169fe3162fd5b4.en: La Galerie Rouge highlights the humanist photography of Édouard Boubat with an exhibition featuring vintage prints from his travels across the United States between 1953 and 1986.

d77812b2cff98278d5ff4775c2c6124be048079d.en: Les Trois Bains offers image education workshops for children in the 20th arrondissement to discover the fundamentals of photography from shooting to printing.

36b1a67a53d7bc151301b7fc0fe7f7d4e47a2572.en: The auditorium at galerie Colbert hosts a two-day colloquium dedicated to the history and conservation-restoration of 200 years of photographic materials.

556c1f2c3f6c9674ea70f49d3159f8de3110014e.en: Create a personal mini diorama at Hôpital Raymond Poincaré using photographs, colored paper, and drawings.

f7cb72a233ec982cf2ae4e8f7e516df0105912c7.en: The Musée d'Histoire et de la Médecine presents an exhibition exploring writer Michel Butor's passion for photography and science.

16b23e0e20445db9f435265c8d2aa977b027ddc0.en: Delpire & Co hosts Polish photographer Rafał Milach as part of PhotoSaintGermain to present his work on protest and civil resistance through publishing.

5530829b02db8e848f6a6cc1250b89736c479094.en: The Institut national d'histoire de l'art hosts a colloquium examining how groups, networks, and collectives shape the history of photography.

5bb33502e4f4a046dbb5e403cfdc5fff831868a6.en: The Lavoir Numérique presents a screening of Hiroshi Sunairi's 2023 documentary on Japanese photographer Mao Ishikawa, introduced by Marine Lefort and Élodie Royer.

e9eeabf98ed93e740c3f1f95802b25934f4a1926.en: Galerie Arcturus presents an exhibition of Marc Riboud's photographs, highlighting his unique eye for geometry, curves, and composition.

e1b247a81479c7f55f28f2789c9e065489eeb03e.en: Galerie Art Absolument hosts an exhibition dedicated to French photographer Françoise Huguier as part of the PhotoSaintGermain festival.

21fb5ba074757206efe8769180a8c406d8b6ed27.en: Galerie Anne-Laure Buffard presents a tribute exhibition to photo-reporter Gilles Caron, pairing his iconic prints with works by inspiring artists and contemporaries.

9b0090f4ce12e8a3d48ab84a386fa90829332bcf.en: Mille secrets de poussins at Médiathèque Jean D'Ormesson is a show for children aged three and up based on Claude Ponti's books. A playful actor uses video and sound to guide young audiences into the magical world of chicks.

88464a3ca70c9f99b15954546851906dccf2902a.en: Suzanne : une histoire du cirque est un ciné-spectacle présenté à la Maison des Arts de Créteil autour de la mémoire d'une ancienne voltigeuse. Une enquête sensible entre cirque, images et récits de vie.

33bc359c281a0df114d7c0a302045663ea5d8c39.en: Le Campus educatif et écologique saint philippe organise une journée portes ouvertes pour découvrir son site de 13 hectares. Venez rencontrer les professeurs et visiter les plateaux techniques ainsi que l'internat.

11c68fdb2e46cf15011383db80f68b6622817b6a.en: Le groupe de soft rock new-yorkais Infinity Song se produit à La Gaîté Lyrique dans le cadre de sa tournée mondiale. Venez écouter leurs harmonies vocales et leurs riffs de guitare élégants.

7352ea2d43703c1d0e8d351ffca6c4da9cd1daf5.en: Maddy Street présente sa release party à La Maroquinerie pour célébrer la sortie de sa mixtape No Limits. Venez découvrir l'univers alternatif, rock et electro de cet artiste franco-britannique.

9b04e06909a611f5cde0b064fa00b9eae9d542cd.en: Le Studio des Ursulines propose la projection du film Scream. Venez suivre l'histoire de Casey Becker et de Sidney Prescott face à un mystérieux serial killer.

8bfd4d793a856fc74b67ac97d18430dff51d6fd3.en: Les Lumières présente Colargol et le Cirque Pimoulu pour une séance de cinéma jeunesse. Venez partager un moment d'émotion en famille.

9b9b8ff7e2babe88a45f3a6b76e517616082191c.en: Ciné d'Issy présente Garance, l'histoire d'une jeune actrice traversant une révolution intime et personnelle. Venez suivre son parcours jalonné de rencontres, de fêtes et de défis.

6c103751445efdc23d190efae74837ba2f7b6ed6.en: Le Carrefour numérique à la Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie vous invite à découvrir ses espaces de fabrication et de médiation. Venez réaliser vos projets créatifs en autonomie grâce à des outils adaptés comme l'imprimante 3D.

79b98e99e839780a97eb77a3cd43b9398786f313.en: Le Temps des Cerises propose un atelier d'initiation à l'archéo-anthropologie funéraire pour les enfants dès 9 ans. Venez vous initier à la fouille de tombes et découvrir ce que les squelettes racontent sur notre passé.

10f11766dec7f3a85f33f70b6a547cfa19b8df1d.en: Le Temps des Cerises propose un atelier théâtral pour les enfants à partir de 7 ans autour de L'île aux esclaves de Marivaux. Venez explorer le spectacle vivant et découvrir les grands thèmes du théâtre.

7e561f5350f598a34f2d1e8187f1c3b2630c4ecd.en: La Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie vous invite à explorer l'histoire et l'évolution de la Lune. Venez observer son mouvement autour de la Terre et découvrir les futurs projets d'exploration.

735ce1532ead95a5c63a764c9f93e0cdc6b1e645.en: L'Argonaute vous invite à visiter un véritable bâtiment musée stationné dans le Parc de la Villette. Venez découvrir la vie quotidienne des sous-mariniers à travers une visite audioguidée.

7e00d55777e454efa7580bc5e7d36e440dd3b0be.en: Le Temps des Cerises propose un stage Open-Lab pour les 11-15 ans pendant les vacances scolaires. Venez apprendre à utiliser les machines numériques du Minilab et travailler en équipe.

7136fd3f84677a435f9c7775379b49742a4d5212.en: Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte présentent un atelier sur les fluides à travers de nombreuses expériences. Venez vous familiariser avec l'hydrodynamique et l'hydrostatique.

73f10520f3a1eda0024cc8a82c89823f670c7292.en: La Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie propose un voyage autour d'un trou noir sous la voûte du planétarium. Venez explorer l'espace en compagnie de l'astrophysicien Alain Riazuelo.

586283af68574ec286a75eb4d8eccdb1fca93930.en: La Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie vous invite à une session de jeu sur le titre Pico Park sur grand écran. Venez jouer ensemble et profiter des commentaires d'un médiateur.

6ac0f4e91498ba223d04ffe46226801207f8d381.en: La Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie propose un atelier manuel de fabrication de mangeoires pour oiseaux en surcyclage. Venez créer un objet personnalisé dans un cadre créatif et inclusif.

3045c8d4245373ed98f2419ef107498a918c1faa.en: La Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie organise une conférence sur les discriminations liées aux usages du numérique. Venez échanger autour des défis posés par la surutilisation des outils informatiques.
