b149b0f66c0ec18fd916c6ecba2ec87b7cff178d.en: Korean producer and DJ Night Tempo brings his Future Funk and Showa Groove sounds, revisiting Japanese pop from the 1980s.

ac8ee8092795f0a5d372807795bf5e881f5aae5b.en: L'Alimentation Générale hosts a double bill featuring the blues-rock sounds of Valentin Gevraise and bass clarinetist Nils Kassap with friends.

85232796d25ce3b5faecdbcb4ecd99036a4b0829.en: Cabaret Sauvage presents Barbès Café, a musical and theatrical show exploring the history of Algerian immigration in France.

f8c5cfb0fb75142494dc99503cebd3f1ed438c4d.en: Barbès Café continues its exploration of Algerian immigration to France with music, humor, and personal stories. A seven-member orchestra performs classic exile songs for a generous and political cabaret experience.

93d3504faa8c219f1d378aba0170e14f599f1d0d.en: La Ch!ck returns to Badaboum for a 100% pop party in a free, inclusive, and safe space. Enjoy an evening of dancing with free entry starting at 4:30 AM.

dfaf710bf5197552d418ae2f7b317f2e21838259.en: Celebrate Halloween with a 100% Michael Jackson party featuring a kids' club time in the afternoon and an adult party with gaming, karaoke, and a dance spectacle into the night.

4868e7de465830e1682cad42e2855c8b96dbf0d0.en: Frankie Stew & Harvey Gunn stop at La Bellevilloise for their final tour and latest album, Goodbye For Now. Join the British duo for a final celebration of their music.

1b45e63e2a460f4e64e0e0dcfa6168327eaee6d4.en: La Bellevilloise hosts a vibrant night celebrating Brazilian culture with live samba, pagode, and funk carioca. Two rooms offer everything from traditional rhythms to tropical club mixes until dawn.

9d9eba56a6d6ba890c97a5aa531ddb4309a1acec.en: Si Lakhal performs for the first time in Paris at Cabaret Sauvage alongside Karim Bouazza and Lamia Aït Ami. A unique evening celebrating the richness of Kabyle music and culture.

83092720d5943f29b4a03f8f7750500e2bebabae.en: Annette K. hosts a festive Halloween night with mandatory costume dress codes, music, dancing, and plenty of candy. Gather your friends for a spooky and lively evening by the river.

17aa13c319eac681faabb37bd3ea04d8f3e9761a.en: Virage presents a night of bass, hard dance, and club music featuring sets by Lobsta B, Sita, and Canelle Doublekick. The venue promotes a safe, inclusive environment free of discrimination.

df751b98509cba5f567328b0bf4dbc55d31ef4b2.en: Love In The Endz celebrates five years as a record label with a special anniversary party in Paris. The event brings together a series of B2B sets honoring the local music scene.

9d867ffaee8309ab5b1a6aa6247009e100d570fc.en: Zouzou Pigalle presents four nights of garage rock energy and cabaret sensuality. Expect rock striptease, electric choreography, and electro-rock DJ sets inspired by the 1970s and 1980s.

f5026479c664a8b9d0f1bb5e6e7729775cc2f1b6.en: Bonsoir Mon Amour takes over Chez Moune every Thursday for a lively night of dancing and nightlife freedom. Join the crowd at this legendary neighborhood spot for a festive evening.

9e102447415d9809ef519ac1f7ff63ef77ca12e3.en: Afpa Meudon hosts a job dating event to fill thirty positions as industrial fire safety verification technicians. Candidates must hold a valid driver's license for over two years and complete a three-month training program.

c21b3499e90ca4e92e3195bb950c3d31724d9910.en: Discover Apave's training offers covering industrial safety, regulatory compliance, and risk prevention. This presentation outlines solutions designed to support team skills and installation safety.

a2f4d048a6ecba5d17523f68b5f01df5ffe7038c.en: L'entreprise Air Liquide intervient au Lycée Louis Girard pour présenter les métiers techniques et les gaz industriels à travers un jeu interactif. Une occasion de découvrir l'industrie de demain et ses domaines d'innovation.

755d74d9573eb7a650daaeb67757ba018ba89422.en: Saul Rubin and Ramona Horvath lead a jazz quartet featuring Nicolas Rageau and Philippe Maniez. The group blends New York jazz heritage with European elegance through original compositions and American songbook classics.

06522276cc25dcb5a7e5d8c9e98fc02fe5e68637.en: The Philharmonie de Paris hosts an evening of traditional Mediterranean vocal music led by master Mohamed Briouel and the Moroccan Orchestra of Andalusian Music. Five singers perform sacred and profane repertoires from the Levant to the Maghreb.

e4b3485bd3fd54fe8fabadbe127c3bbeaf833e51.en: The 3rd International Arabic Book Forum in France features a book exhibition, conferences, and round tables on cultural exchange. Enjoy poetry evenings and musical moments celebrating Arab traditions at the Cité internationale universitaire de Paris.

48f30769dab5ca5864e1a064f1dc99a90d49333a.en: "Ça tient plus la route" at Théâtre Halle Roublot is a documentary film-spectacle blending object theatre and puppetry. It explores how speed has shaped modern society through personal writings and research with the Groupe Renault.

abb01f3ce5c4d5a835e62bbf865ea6c211f27ab5.en: At Paul B, Stéphane Hoareau presents Ritual Riots, a collective musical project blending maloya with Haitian voodoo, rock and jazz. It offers an organic and trance-like energy as an act of political and spiritual resistance.

54ae4b18cd6f24be517bf7a1a78aff2d3f84f505.en: Une création théâtrale pour le jeune public et les familles qui revisite l'œuvre de Claude Ponti à travers la marionnette et le théâtre d'objets. Un spectacle poétique pour aborder avec humour la question de la différence et de l'exclusion.

3f7ed1d8436e442b33f5311dcd5b0869d0ec7a4c.en: Tech Show Paris at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles is a key event for tech and digital innovation professionals. A single badge provides access to five major exhibitions on November 18 and 19, 2026.

416c695b414dd7ec385a0d746cfa4cc926b0739f.en: Le Sélect hosts a special Halloween screening of Shaun the Sheep featuring costumes and candy distribution.

ca72e543881f4b4b566c384609732cbf436e1e77.en: Théâtre et Cinéma Georges Simenon hosts a screening and discussion around the film following nineteen-year-old Ada.

73d5c8a70af2e0daefd56bf317a86a2db36e83ba.en: Life is a Cabaret at Multisites is a theatrical tour by students exploring the Roaring Twenties and Berlin in the 1920s and 1930s. It examines how freedom and joy were met with political repression and social change.

f8b3adbf086a72a8e679e9126afbd24595a632ff.en: Espace Jean Vilar presents a special Halloween screening following the adventures of the Gruffalo.

18a5b66931427189d1f9f7650620a3df15e4faf5.en: Cinémas du palais, Armand-Badéyan hosts a screening and discussion following Erika and her children in 1995 Sarcelles.

a85c77a4472d3adafbba3188d7102c2757dbc8b9.en: Théâtre Mandapa hosts a storytelling workshop with Isabelle Genlis focusing on voice, breath and stage presence. Participants learn to free their imagination and share narratives through theatrical expression.

a90e79397b66e1af0ce26d0bedf9dc75a1797d75.en: Join ornithologist Sébastien at Parc de Montsouris for a two-hour guided tour to observe the park's diverse bird species, including herons and green woodpeckers near the lake and trees.

e6c47b5e4b275d2c498bc5f79a33d514923c085a.en: Head to the Forêt domaniale de Meudon for a family nature outing tailored for children aged 3 to 10. Led by Anne-Jeanne, the session features sensory games, nature tales and creative workshops.

d941757cd3673416ee221d1f9787fd98328a5da7.en: Join nature guide Nathalie for a two-hour botanical walk in the Bois de Vincennes to discover autumn flora and understand why leaves change color.

bf80aba4e062cf7058a686d69c98e535398e1069.en: Le Temps des Cerises hosts "Odorama, l'aventure olfactive" as part of the Fête de la science. Visitors of all ages can test their sense of smell and explore how breathing connects odor, taste and the brain.

7aa22edc815ecd85e59ca610a9a8335e5e69d86c.en: The Cité des sciences et de l'industrie hosts "Mathémagie", an exhibition using riddles and magic tricks to show how mathematics explains magic.

0a542d933580e1f0b9b26b951be92f9b644a6d05.en: Mains d'Œuvres hosts a weekly board game evening animated by the Ludi 93 association. Beginners and experts alike can discover new games and play in a relaxed atmosphere.

18eeefea50fe14ebe075bedd78d2ccf89fe56650.en: Mains d'Œuvres presents "Toujours et partout", an art and science exhibition featuring works by Marjorie Catez, Clara-Louise Hoffsaes and Lilou Granville. The pieces explore cosmic perception through traces of particles and space.

ec4372f341d15946305da8438a31e62113d4b3ef.en: Mains d'Œuvres hosts Ciclade featuring live performances by HLM38, Malesa and NZE NZE, alongside a DJ set by dominica dies.

d837feacf9cb4ab94d2017ad7ee7f8712e2e926c.en: The Arc de triomphe offers architectural guided tours during the European Days of Heritage to discover the monument's history.

0ff792379be3d5e4600a9e4e00e46f3df7f1fe12.en: The Cité des sciences et de l'industrie presents "La teuf à Galilée", a show where a mediator acts as a DJ to recount the life and discoveries of Galileo through a playlist featuring Dua Lipa and Daft Punk.

90e2fa4cce7be6ca3339d0613df7ff269154003e.en: Explore the history and science of the clitoris at Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte. Discover how social norms have influenced medical research around this often misunderstood organ.

5e833c0ae0595859f8311d38b0d3b263ac4a2fa4.en: Head to the Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie for the Semaine de l'industrie. Consult digital resources, test virtual reality headsets to explore industrial careers, and chat with professionals.

d2b6d8365f857e54016d7e3628a4084bace9136e.en: Take part in a hands-on workshop at the Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie to build a custom mechanical bird. This creative lab offers a relaxing, screen-free space for teens and adults.

f76b939b290d77d538867e979d0114f84bc68c1e.en: Join a collaborative debate on Artificial Intelligence at the Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie. Share your questions and knowledge to discuss the topic together.

d7cb98a94539b215170acfc4f1970ae1023c8467.en: Learn how to create and animate your own character using a webcam and your imagination during this digital vacation workshop at the Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie.

403619d56729f2568c630d59049443da6beddfd6.en: Discover XHTML coding and digital publishing software during an introductory e-book creation workshop at the Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie.

6e59ad5a92a8562067e05dd006f97fe1f89065bc.en: Explore paint pigments and master canvas analysis techniques like spectroscopy and ultraviolet light at Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte.

50c442807cb935c1df880e6b5282d513c30868e9.en: Discover game design at Le Temps des Cerises by imagining universes, characters, and rules. This workshop is open to anyone eight and older.

6814497887217439af181f5cba26faeb4e6e8ac7.en: View outdoor photographs by François Kollar at Jardin Monica Vitti, showcasing French craftsmanship and trades from the 1930s.

fb90b85fa42fcc426218a591501239430eef0974.en: Attend a talk at the Muséum national d'Histoire naturelle exploring how photography mirrors societal shifts and our evolving view of the living world.

a0f5b599c7e3aac7b743cbc370bac5e1a951b6fa.en: Discover how photographic film blends cinema and still images to create narrative rhythm. This event is part of Les Nuits Photo festival.

5a56cf9e387619f5b576c0205e410b72d968bd69.en: Explore photo archives that capture history and inspire new stories during the PhotoSaintGermain festival.

66d33faaee49353f5f213b9a12bb4ca0679640c6.en: View works by Laurence Aëgerter at Galerie Binome, where photography, archives, and diverse materials like tapestry and porcelain converse.

360eda2bd920f34dc8e247121bf2a3b6e9596c75.en: Explore Carl Corey's photographs of the American Midwest at Galerie Catherine & André Hug as part of the PhotoSaintGermain festival.

731f127744d41665b4799822e0978ff25fe5158b.en: See Guillaume Herbaut's documentary exhibition on Ukraine at the Académie des Beaux Arts, featured during the PhotoSaintGermain festival.

65aa3c39d9d715578087903a978c6393f9d1a6e9.en: View a photo exhibition at Petits Frères des Pauvres featuring daily life and stories captured by residents through artistic residencies.

b5dd65e64e00b97ed8d123c4e91c53b45cb0befd.en: Explore A Song for Europe by Annika Elisabeth von Hausswolff at Andréhn-Schiptjenko, featuring works built from archive and press photographs.

1d710d8c6a8a654c7cba07c95b8fd15fb699e80d.en: Cet atelier propose de transformer une photographie personnelle en une œuvre plastique unique grâce à l'association ARTEMMIS.

c93fe00604a56278ef9d2f47556d3e4fe1e84e18.en: Transform a personal smartphone photo into a unique piece of art using drawings and patterns during this creative workshop at Hôpital Necker.

f2e03f8bac735055cd86613b0f86b86c73935f23.en: Explore portraiture and self-representation at Hôpital Bichat by combining photography with embroidery or drawing alongside photographer Mélanie Legendre.

5739be8e69d4494f7b1ee587fe78c5d68fe0a58b.en: Pierre-Jérôme Jehel presents Une doublure d'invisible at Maison d'Auguste Comte, featuring photographic works created during a residency in the philosopher's preserved apartment. Visitors can explore a dialogue between history, memory, and photographic techniques inspired by Auguste Comte's positivist approach.

748663f09db29f1a3e073086308ac0ff177a654f.en: The Maison Européenne de la Photographie hosts the first French solo exhibition of American artist David Gilbert. Featuring work from the last fifteen years, the showcase blends sculpture, installation, and photography using ephemeral materials and natural light.

8f6306c7c7c9296eca85f94672877f7896c9f91a.en: Directors Ido Shaked and Hannan Ishay present Mode d'emploi pour metteur en scène en temps de guerre at the Théâtre du Rond-Point. The performance reflects on Israeli identity, politics, and the surreal challenge of creating art following the outbreak of conflict in the Middle East.

ce440facadac0b9568dbf693d7eddeb7add79776.en: Fred Pallem and Le Sacre du Tympan Sextet perform at Cafe de la Danse, offering a condensed, cinematic take on the ensemble's repertoire. The intimate six-piece lineup rearranges grand orchestral frescoes into sharp, energetic arrangements.

8270178c05c47118cb70633f44a23525ba7e9732.en: Phantom Paris hosts Miss Monique presents Biorhythm from late night until morning. Clubbers can experience an immersive electronic music event located at Place Léonard Bernstein.

ea2a3c87f6759494bef14d2f6294bebbf9d2230f.en: French melodic techno pioneer NTO performs live at L'Olympia. Known for collaborations with major international artists, he brings his latest music to the iconic venue.

d7862ad5bde662590b4edcf715688e65ffe1f9dc.en: La Barbichette Cabaret at La Machine du Moulin Rouge offers an unpredictable night of poetry, satire, and music curated by Monsieur K. Guests can enjoy an interactive artistic celebration that playfully reflects on contemporary society.

cebc067993b390ae7cab11caebcaa465c240bb4f.en: Monsieur K. presents another edition of La Barbichette Cabaret at La Machine du Moulin Rouge. The multidisciplinary performance blends humor, music, and social satire in an immersive, festive atmosphere.

1ec529547cce0b12e58bd695c61ca2c20c7e8903.en: Post-punk band Au Pairs performs at Petit Bain during their UK tour. Featuring original singer Lesley Woods alongside new members, the group revisits material from their 1981 album alongside fresh tracks.

5d24bd21f1ce9395fdf3148698cf76e2c5d64376.en: The Icon Tantine Royalty presents the All Black Kiki Ball at La Gaîté Lyrique. Attendees are invited to showcase their best all-black outfits and voguing skills while discovering a new generation of dancers.

5c158b2449a7618e3e12641d00a77b96063e44c3.en: Phantom Paris hosts a collaborative night with Galop Galop featuring Bassjackers and Part Time Killer. The event runs through the night at Place Léonard Bernstein.

b5762b7ae930f39b1e19bf017e74a2bf4745faee.en: As part of the Festival Lassiry Hip Hop, La Place hosts a collaborative evening uniting French-Gabonese artist Vicky R and Guinean rapper OPINEL XII. The concert highlights diverse voices and contemporary sounds from the French and Guinean rap scenes.

f356522acc752a615e3cc7d9a5a3709251d874a9.en: Tiki Playa hosts the Terror Halloween Party across four themed spaces and two levels. Costumed guests can enjoy multiple dance floors playing a mix of 80s and 90s hits, house, R&B, and current chart-toppers.

f5ecfb158d0cb05227e9e99fb2da5e8171b86511.en: Singer-songwriter Célestin performs at La Dame de Canton, blending acoustic and electronic elements with humanist and ecological themes. Pierre Donoré opens the evening with a set of French pop songs.

fef4bb9c00b2d2fbb28b1c92d95766fbc0df1c81.en: Folies Pigalle hosts a Halloween party featuring a soundtrack of hip-hop, dancehall, afrobeat, and party hits. Costumes are encouraged for guests celebrating into the early hours.

2200859091f3c550a97f12f37ccdaf8c435ff1db.en: Club Haussmann transforms into a haunted hotel for a large Halloween party spanning two levels. The venue offers a spooky atmosphere, horror shows, and themed cocktails for hundreds of guests.

1ed1d6887931b52bd21fc5351213a7d43149a06d.en: Griffon hosts Spin My Cabaret for an intimate evening of drag performances, chaotic blind tests, and interactive games. The audience can influence the show using tokens on the wheel of fortune.

09f249a4ed91d565a95f23ab598a938ce917453b.en: Ripe performs live at La Boule Noire following the release of their latest album, Play The Game. The band draws on years of close collaboration and community to deliver an energetic indie show.

fcebc932a6b3529778fd49301646c91988a82446.en: Jump in Bastille hosts a dedicated night of Afrobeat, Shatta, Dancehall, and Amapiano rhythms. Dancers can enjoy a vibrant party atmosphere throughout the evening.

f70b1898bb45c0350deebf83a996de80918ac88e.en: Every Wednesday, Le Rouge Pigalle hosts a festive night featuring Hip-Hop, R&B, and open format music in an elegant setting. Join the crowd for good drinks, a lively dancefloor, and a vibrant atmosphere.

0e8e222090ad67c0c41e04658c4906fb94db2265.en: 42 Marches celebrates its second anniversary with a free night curated by @sid.sco, featuring sets from @rougail.sp, @whosallegory, and @bouh_music. Head down to the dancefloor to celebrate the new season.

46306609f8f2abc7321798b11cc31cb38748ce95.en: Africolor opens its new edition at Salle Jacques Brel with Baraka and Kader Tarhanine, two acts reinventing Saharan music. Experience a blend of folk, electric guitars, and Tuareg traditions.

fe804b261211704579bfcf03220d6ca9541dc828.en: On October 31, 2026, Chalet du lac transforms into a massive monster lair for a giant Halloween party across 2,500 square meters. Expect two rooms, two musical vibes, a huge terrace, and thousands of attendees.

a98691f8ad011a3b3b292545319f20dd229287d7.en: Punk Paradise hosts the first edition of Perspective on October 29, featuring a sonic journey through deep house, techno, and hardgroove. Entry is free for the first 250 arrivals.

77f284698dc0606692382ba815553c53d522bd59.en: Café Oz Châtelet hosts Wednesday Bass every week, offering a five-hour non-stop DJ set of classic hits remixed into house and electro. Entry is free for this lively dancefloor experience.

aa66c4e903c2a2fdc0158ac1f9fc3ad344ad8465.en: Envole Moi hosts a 100% Dadju party on November 8 featuring an open mic competition, live performances, and a dedicated DJ set. It is a night celebrating the artist's biggest tracks.

9ab9aad1a275ae92f1082580785e89d66e58d402.en: La Dame de Canton hosts a double-header funk night with two brass-heavy bands on October 23. Head to this historic boat on the Seine for a unique party on the dancefloor.

eccc3342bcc60338043e0bf233e0830059d49535.en: Absolem performs a unique live concert at the Alhambra Théâtre Music-Hall on December 5.

d76e0c8843f938d60db32213e65cb1b4b3ada40b.en: The Togoleese Vibes collective presents La Nuit des Masques, an all-white dress code party taking place on the Friday of the Toussaint weekend in Gennevilliers.

6ca12b8407f46eebd49f302ee0191cf25284aeee.en: Soichi Terada brings his Sumo x Apes live audiovisual show to La Gaîté Lyrique, blending jungle beats from his 1996 album with Ape Escape soundtracks and real-time visuals. It is a rare performance uniting Japanese electronic music history with gaming culture.

b44546cf9bb4bc0da9286618c81a7d470cd3b4ab.en: La GliTS is a festive Trans Queer party in Paris featuring live shows, glittering dancefloors, and performances by Amourose, Miralo, Lil Spiya, and Maeva. It serves as the official afterparty for the Miss & Mister Trans France ceremony and Transcenders Awards.

dc12eac18b79309051d3a5839a3d602efff04642.en: The Caractères Bar in Paris hosts a Thriller Night Halloween party on October 31 with immersive horror decor, DJ sets, and cash prize contests. Enjoy afrobeats, amapiano, and dancehall until morning.

b0bc5c409aea36f49c1466c9d58caaeb1c1b1582.en: Le Poetry Club and Silencio team up for a monthly showcase combining live poetry and music on stage. Enjoy a 1.5-hour performance with time to chat and have a drink with the artists.

defcd9d0be0a541eec1abecc3a845f648f2522b4.en: Le 10e Ciel rooftop at the Pullman Tour Eiffel offers a chic evening with panoramic views, cocktails, tapas, and electro-chill DJ sets until 1 AM.

ae210f5669b35228001b8f44b03c113ba5dca485.en: Slone celebrates the release of his debut EP with his first-ever Parisian concert at Loup Diprey Theater Club. Discover the stories and musical influences behind his recent singles.

46cc399d70eb02b91dfe83e4fe3b2bd13826f4d0.en: Panic Room hosts One Night in Chicago on October 29 to launch South Loop Recordings, featuring legendary Midwest DJ J-Dub. Entry is free all night with a ticket on Shotgun or at the door.

2d7cb9f4be0c007b48684e54d04bfd6d4cd4045f.en: Corcoran's hosts an Old School Party on October 24 featuring a 100% vintage hip-hop and 90s/2000s R&B DJ set. Entry is free with registration on Shotgun.

c021c19d1bbc45e4ecbaf2d1ade9bfbaca11f4e7.en: FS Green brings his European club tour to Le Bateau Phare on November 21 for a night of shatta, bouyon, dancehall, and R&B on the Seine. Tickets are available on Shotgun.

630f87ad5696f9d2da464ab3afc53f8fc3fe5831.en: Stylo G performs a live showcase in Paris at La CASA Club, delivering Jamaican dancehall hits like Touch Down and Dumpling.

50b3c848dcc06b5a01a6445eb0e37815824b7ca1.en: TeddyBear takes the stage at L'Olympia to perform personal songs from his debut album, Le plus beau. Discover his raw and melancholic voice, capturing the thoughts of a 24-year-old navigating today's world.

83680aac6534e164446e897491a3345d9f95d6ab.en: Head to Bridge Club for a massive Halloween party inside a haunted castle under the Pont Alexandre III. Expect over 2,000 vampires, DJ sets ranging from house to reggaeton, and immersive visual shows.

7f6a09232fae56486044694c921adb11361fb5bb.en: Bar Le Bonjour Madame hosts an evening exploring queer life in the northern suburbs of Paris, featuring sociological insights from Stécy Philippe and Emma Rosier-Kraeuter. Join the collective discussions followed by informal chats over tapas and drinks.

7cb0f6cb1dbe724f462ae6fb5bda41a45cf6068b.en: La Beach Parisienne at the Chalet du Lac hosts a massive Halloween Reggaeton party spanning 2,500 square metres. Dance all night across two rooms with three DJs spinning reggaeton, latino, and hip-hop hits.

ce1e72df8060766558fd2459d0b0b82a0988c9e0.en: Monkey Pigalle hosts a unique singles event that moves beyond traditional speed dating through guided participatory debates and discussions. Join a warm, welcoming space to explore your relational patterns and meet people authentically.

691b180d6c85a4755491cf23b44c7f6ee9cea5cf.en: Explore current recruitment opportunities, digital modernization, and career evolution within the diverse manufacturing industry during this informative webinar.

8bf1932f789e8c20cc272de1d934d62c57d99e8a.en: Duo acoustic project Les Marioles performs at Débonnaire, blending guitars and percussions across rock, latino, and French and Italian ballads.

b198496c48fb3dd90dc883c1ee91ed4a642791e5.en: The Comédie-Française presents Goldoni's play directed by Clément Hervieu-Léger, depicting the struggles and youthful rebellion of aspiring dancers in the nineteenth century. Discover a poignant social comedy where art and love serve as levers for emancipation.

b66bb24eb0d0bfe2476668988ebfb54412f4527a.en: Denis Podalydès stages Molière's classic comedy at the Comédie-Française, following the witty valet Scapin as he helps young lovers outwit their strict fathers. Enjoy a lively piece of pure theater celebrating youth and clever mischief.

9308ee6ee3e48038e502c0c29e752357328eaf9a.en: Clarinettist Yom teams up with the Ceccaldi brothers for an immersive musical journey at the église Saint-Vincent-de-Paul. Experience a unique blend of jazz, chamber music, and world music in a sublime acoustic setting.

91b3f5768bb7fa1408708d2ebd649c4be873f3b5.en: Hetty Kate brings her trio featuring Amaury Faye and William Brunard to JASS CLUB for an intimate evening of swing and cool jazz. Enjoy a refined sound inspired by the legendary Nat King Cole trio format.

ca47a172c2d36908c8469dec37ccc2d35099db0b.en: Marguerite Floc’h takes the stage at JASS CLUB with her quartet to perform timeless jazz standards and surprising picks from the Great American Songbook. Experience the fresh voice of a young artist deeply inspired by Ella Fitzgerald.

135fc162a783e5b974af7934050493d5f8ba51fb.en: Kicca brings her vibrant energy to JASS CLUB alongside a talented quartet for a dynamic mix of jazz, soul, and funk. Enjoy inventive arrangements and interplay between vocals, trumpet, organ, and drums.

05c0601a3b58188725219c9141cb409f00fe5aef.en: Monsieur Samedi performs engaged French chanson and slam in an intimate vaulted cellar in the 12th arrondissement. Expect witty and striking lyrics delivered in a cozy, relaxed atmosphere.

49ff40bf4451740a0685d2f059290ca678237ea4.en: Discover how to build a global data governance and exploitation strategy tailored for SMEs in this short webinar. Access practical insights from IT expert Catherine Torsy freely in replay.

066af4da5872dab526e3fc42193b6fbf518f140b.en: Embark on an astronomical journey at Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte to explore starry skies, planets in our solar system, and distant exoplanets. Let an expert guide lead your expedition across the galaxy.

63d64e12a5e3c4423fd602315a06d9086095c6ed.en: Explore the mystery of pure water through chemical tests and experiments at Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte. Uncover what is really hidden inside a substance we use every day.

7040c7feaebac87d445cf0190ee6566605b3c8a2.en: Take part in a mind-mapping workshop at the Cité des sciences et de l'industrie to structure your ideas and assess your digital knowledge. Build your own knowledge map to navigate new technological tools.

d5028e6469e42e18596c77f36e5f30c6cdbd0f2a.en: Learn how to use a microscope and explore microscopic worlds in pairs at Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte. Observe everyday samples like saliva, river water, and plant leaves up close.

992b619c35da43592ba283ac0f356c1902109344.en: Observe living and naturalized insects at Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte to discover their crucial roles in ecosystems. Learn all about the incredible diversity and adaptations of these fascinating creatures.

0b1ae19d4c0cf202ce8b4d25cae3686b30298dd9.en: Découvrez comment les éruptions volcaniques apportent en surface des matériaux de l'intérieur de la Terre. Une présentation pour explorer la dynamique des magmas et les phénomènes spectaculaires qu'ils provoquent.

f022d1bf6ee271812047df0b01f53deab864c640.en: Cet exposé explore les dernières données sur la pré-humanité et l'hominisation. Venez décrypter l'histoire de notre évolution dans le cadre global du vivant.

0a44c78419035f92ddb42f248f0303e6f3bbeb9a.en: Le groupe de punk rock The Ain't Rights accepte de donner un dernier concert au fin fond de l'Orégon après une tournée désastreuse. Une soirée sous tension à découvrir à L'Ecran.

6df7e6c261359a758f55fab1b1d73b631c49e629.en: Assistez à la projection de Petite Casbah suivie d'une rencontre avec les co-scénaristes Jean Regnaud et Marie de Banville dans le cadre de la Fête du cinéma d'animation.

0581e75684fbb2109d073df820078e1228e286b3.en: Un moment d'échange privilégié autour de cinématographies du Maghreb au Cinéma Chaplin Saint Lambert.

1bc6280a458545966aa23f108e4c1701714499b4.en: Plongez dans un univers où chansons, danses et émotions se rencontrent pour offrir des moments inoubliables.

7ff46cbec498292d8ccba65db0b98e544c60fabd.en: Un programme de courts-métrages présenté dans le cadre du festival Ciné-banlieue, en présence des équipes de tournage.

9af1a13f4b72c73e8152d559e968002ee7e6c7e7.en: Un chef d'orchestre de renom est confronté à un admirateur insistant lors de son ultime concert à Paris. Une nuit de tension où la musique révèle un passé commun enfoui.

5f6eb43e55b3de18044e90fe4aae679be7ad63f3.en: Lip Critic présente en concert son album Theft World, né de la rencontre insolite entre le groupe et un fan aux théories délirantes. Une performance à découvrir à Mains d'Œuvres.

3683b5a83088470687f477b79c51d22b3613a49b.en: Le festival Villes des Musiques du Monde invite El León Pardo et Indus pour une soirée entre électro cumbia colombienne et rythmes afro-colombiens métissés à Mains d'Œuvres.

eedd2dc2b7810422c465582a97b662d4f3f55f33.en: Danakil achève sa tournée anniversaire par la mythique salle de l'Olympia. Retrouvez l'énergie scénique et les textes engagés du groupe de reggae français.

b44aebc14a68866d8b6e940bba73080b36cfe81c.en: Changeline investit La Maroquinerie pour un concert entre pop-rap intimiste et productions électroniques avant-gardistes. Une artiste autodidacte à l'univers aussi introspectif que percutant.

7958ece6d28bebf6ee1dace9c665feb73268a7e9.en: La Rvfleuze fait ses débuts sur scène en ouvrant directement les portes du Zénith Paris - La Villette. Un concert intense pour découvrir le premier album de l'artiste.

2f3348d8a65afa7872ec38501ed6548bfac44440.en: Liv del Estal s'installe à l'Élysée Montmartre pour un live de musique électronique hybride. Entre trance nostalgique et acid techno, un voyage sonore sans frontière.

4dc236301b627a37a3ed38d66a75738ad7407402.en: Remontez le temps le temps d'une nuit sur le Bateau Concorde Atlantique avec une soirée 100% années 90 et 2000. Venez danser sur les plus grands hits de votre jeunesse.

6e358aebe1ee2e5f901abf57cea08012b1a51f29.en: Naïssam Jalal et son ensemble présentent Shining Legacy pour célébrer l'héritage afrodescendant. Un concert au Conservatoire de musique et de danse Joséphine-Baker du Pré.

306db529dc1b96df401347a6b379e6a4df885810.en: La Philharmonie de Paris invite l'ensemble Lâabat de Ben Slimane et la diva amazighe Chérifa Kersit. Une soirée panoramique reliant musiques du monde rural marocain, flamenco et blues.

fdfba3278bba978611890c0a0019458f21281b8e.en: Assistez au work in progress de Fondations au Centre Des Arts, une création chorégraphique signée Bastien Dausse. Quatre corps explorant l'équilibre et la gravité dans un univers suspendu.

7abc7a4e512fe56d6bd9cec40a93bdf5151e51c5.en: Partez pour une balade immersive de deux heures dans le Bois de Vincennes pour identifier les plantes sauvages. La sortie se prolonge par un pique-nique et un apéro végétal, biologique et de saison.

34c7babbc89e3825c3ac7277206185306032eb44.en: La Galerie Cipango présente un ensemble inédit d'œuvres de Christophe Tissot. Une exposition mêlant photographies et travail graphique pour questionner notre perception du réel.

5409a6c4e9466bff8bf3bb90cc77491e072b594a.en: At Hôpital Pitié-Salpêtrière, learn traditional animation techniques to create short video sequences using everyday objects and drawings. Participants can work individually or collectively to invent and sound their own animations over three hours.

2f3c307f3311f96017b45d2dc5407dfa446a4f18.en: Hervé and Vincent present a contemporary take on realist cabaret at BARLONE, blending piano, vocals, direct audience interaction, and humorous anecdotes about modern life and excess.

e4e2f4cce6a68b36585d011f98a3c9bdd796c403.en: Rising French rap voice Juste Shani takes the stage at La Gaîté Lyrique for her first solo concert in Paris following the success of her EP Diamant Noir.

81284b87985e9726f4c0f18c7f6289f7f7ed7fa0.en: American singer-songwriter Kelley Stoltz performs at Le Chinois, bringing his signature psych-pop sound and touring in support of his latest studio albums.

a9a749dedfa7803a5da9fa95fdaa40d4dc5724c8.en: Théâtre 13 / Bibliothèque presents a theatrical journey following Yasmine as she retraces her history, from her childhood in Baghdad to her adult life in France, while navigating a dual existence.

19f59520a0ad74e859289b3797f0b0ce688d0a6d.en: The Centre national de la danse hosts information and networking sessions for multidisciplinary cabaret artists and professionals, featuring guided tours, discussions, and themed workshops.

143062e33c4e0f5f8db75c668c71865390856e2a.en: At the Théâtre du Fil de l'eau, Speaker Corner presents an interactive digital installation that transforms public urban spaces and engages passersby through projection and sound.

bc928b4b395b6688d755d67f27cef5a1ddccb187.en: Théâtre de Vanves hosts Compagnie Haoma for a performance by quintet Franges, blending acoustic breath, electronic soundscapes, and synthesizers into an intimate, meditative musical experience.

d710aae659239154807206c9798aa3432741dd1c.en: L'Archipel hosts a screening of Lana Daher's documentary Do You Love Me, exploring seventy years of Beirut's audiovisual history, followed by a discussion with Yolande Zauberman and Qutaiba Barhamji.

408e70adc28e3573bcd424f96124f55fcc365bcb.en: London indie-rockers The Howlers perform at Le Chinois, bringing the raw energy and driving rhythms of their upcoming second album, Heavy.

16e7c5e7bfb8561d2ca6dcea0ef8c412b1851dfe.en: Dov'è Liana brings its vibrant mix of house pop, French touch, and italo-disco to La Maroquinerie, offering a night inspired by the energetic nightlife of Palermo.

0a65721115af13d42f19c7971be597fcb55c3b77.en: Ritual X brings a dense and poetic blend of rap, jazz textures, and melodic vocals to La Maroquinerie for an intense live performance.

fd77491d8aebde4c9afa2684aa7cc894345e468c.en: Badaboum hosts a late-night Halloween party featuring Curses, Joe Lewandowski, Le Saint, and RAG. Dance in an inclusive, safe clubbing space until the early morning hours.

9ba1d595efade0c41d2b9f6d871329a401be11bc.en: Medellin Paris hosts Miss You Mon Amour, a weekly Sunday ritual blending elegant rose lighting and deep house beats. Drop by to experience the venue's chic late-night atmosphere.

914b0e9d6993ef192d3095c47ccc5d3677aa664c.en: Bizz'Art hosts a lively Latin night along the Canal Saint-Martin with the Tropiteca team behind the decks. Dance the night away to salsa, reggaeton, and cumbia classics until dawn.

5be69bd7d8deb554176dc976561d3b7396be160c.en: Panic Room hosts Parities, a collective celebrating musical diversity with sets ranging from Arabic pop to house and disco. Enjoy free entry all night long in a vibrant, eclectic atmosphere.

25fa100daf2098052d9768f6ac4cd3a5b1cf1b56.en: Café Oz Châtelet hosts its Thursday Live & Dance night featuring salsa classes, a live cover band, and an open-format DJ set. Grab a drink and choose your vibe across three different spaces.

7b670efcfc876ede610379d65eaebe024eb2d214.en: Join fellow costumed travelers for an epic Halloween bar crawl across four handpicked nightlife hotspots in central Paris. Your ticket includes VIP entry, welcome shots, and professional guides to keep the party going.

152d1254c64c4085fdbb792879d0c1a37bea065a.en: Madame Arthur hosts a French music club night featuring a big blind test, a show by the venue's creatures, and a karakorale. Come in your best cabaret accessories and glitter to sing along to French hits until morning.

b12eff35f2ac98673a6f37ba3ad67d68ebce2bda.en: Sacré welcomes acclaimed UK Garage producer MPH alongside friends for a club night. Expect powerful basslines, punchy rhythms, and a seamless blend of club tracks and melodic sounds.

61caa2a56dd505f7eb147fcabc746bb5486b66a2.en: Mama Kossa launches the new season of La Doudou Live with an exclusive showcase by rising Pop and R&B artist Mac Hartley. Enjoy a vibrant mix of pop, R&B, and Caribbean sounds with music by DJ Playtone.

ab20febaa169dd0ca82f79df9b2d6c927e798462.en: Noct Club hosts a special Halloween party where costumes are mandatory for entry. Get your ticket and connect via Instagram for VIP and table bookings.

339c174b3f4d9d8e329b7ef67ff14d33610d1ed0.en: Le Café du Village hosts a festive evening dedicated to Celine Dion, featuring a musical quiz, karaoke, and a drag show hosted by Quetzal. The first fifty tickets include a complimentary drink and a quiz grid.

6dbc333feb2b4cfd54278335ac00c22cbebe097b.en: La Boule Noire presents Logic1000, showcasing Samantha Poulter's versatile electronic sound spanning UK funky, garage, house, and techno. Experience her intuitive and energetic production style live.

6d3b5fbc8e599750ff4d67ab772ec3524503a349.en: Get In Step teams up with Critical Music for a drum and bass night at Mia Mao, marking the label's first Paris showcase. Headliners include Mefjus, Simula, and an exclusive b2b set with Enei and Kasra.

77487e68267be539e935337e4f4cb376519fed08.en: Le Baiser Salé presents an original creation by guitarist Kevin Reveyrand and saxophonist Eric Séva in an intimate duo setting. They combine personal compositions with spacious improvisation, blending jazz and world music influences.

1ba2727ee0cd5b1510a281e83b7918db29cfe925.en: Students from the Lycée Général et Technologique d’Arsonval visit Septodont, a company manufacturing high-quality dental products used across five continents.

b18168f8e2ed3d324868a5294e92d5243c2c834d.en: Valeo Service opens its Saint-Denis site to showcase its automotive aftermarket expertise. Discover a complete range of parts and accessories for passenger cars, utilities, and heavy trucks.

c15dd78380661b7d409d708718dea53c111db31e.en: The Pavillon Comtesse de Caen presents an exhibition by photographer Guillaume Herbaut documenting the human and physical impact of the war in Ukraine. The works explore survival, displacement, and the lasting scars left on the population and landscape.

5c15dba4a73d614a0355f15e6720f5539c65b559.en: Galerie Berthet-Aittouarès celebrates its fortieth anniversary with an exhibition uniting twenty photographers from its history. The display features around forty original prints spanning from the 1950s to the present day.

e418ca7e78a205ad294ebc7e37681252dfdaae93.en: Artist Sammy Baloji leads a conference at the Maison de la Recherche of Université Paris 8 as part of a series on (post)colonial photographic collections in African worlds.

75f5ab7219a37bd19a18b75471d4d45de93a5274.en: Galerie Papillon presents Détour photographique, an exhibition exploring perceptions of reality beyond the visible through works by nine artists. The showcase is part of the city-wide photography trail in art galleries.

f508a0ccb3111b1eb8b214c20044d9e1da9f36e3.en: Hôpital Necker hosts an artistic workshop exploring portraiture and identity through photography and mixed media. Participants can experiment with embroidery and drawing on their portraits as part of the Bicentenary of Photography.

8c06c2ac5db33f07d44b1000e1ea5afe2edff5af.en: Galerie Les filles du calvaire presents Silhouettes, an exhibition featuring Charles Fréger's silhouette photography series created between 2011 and 2025. The showcase is part of the official photography trail in art galleries.

e4ba7b4216a52a6bcedf4a8cd72192ae41cc11d6.en: Galerie Arnaud Lefebvre presents Tower, an exhibition of photographs by Natalie Curtis capturing her final series of images in Manchester. The showcase is part of the city-wide photography trail in art galleries.

15c092d367ea1eaf2c5f7cd4758d919ed0b35cc8.en: The Musée de l'Air et de l'Espace hosts a three-day symposium exploring the scientific, artistic, and heritage uses of aerial and space photography. The event includes guided tours and exceptional exhibitions from the museum's photographic collections.

d48cf1db9faaec952514499e278973bfc3cd7ea9.en: LE BAL presents an exhibition exploring the relationship between photographer and subject through 120 prints from the Wilson Centre for Photography. It highlights iconic and lesser-known works from the 1920s to today.

38a76b22883c9fff2f1836e262fc3a1c56303416.en: The Paris Event Center hosts an orientation fair featuring 800 health, paramedical, and social formations from Bac to Bac+5. Visitors can attend conferences, meet student associations, and explore free guidance.

0aa86593397b75a2917d849805083648d2aa6e6e.en: Espace Paris Plaine presents a puppet theater show for children aged four and up. It follows the initiatory journey of Taqqi, a young blind Inuit boy, as he discovers the world.

6d2512e90e4031973fb6d3f7b6deb09f35e35f0d.en: Europa Expérience hosts monthly lunchtime debates to discuss European current affairs with experts. It is a chance to ask questions and understand a changing world.

480480db85fbb33ca356d5f7c773928571ad490d.en: L'Ecran presents Flush as part of its Friday series. The story follows Luc, a struggling junkie trying to get his life back on track despite constant setbacks.

8be01324b158e3795c3838e7ea463b6bfdd5f97e.en: Le Luxy hosts a screening of 2 Soeurs as part of its Halloween Night. Enjoy horror-themed entertainment and snacks throughout the night.

6aaa92bc819379c7a229f40dae923c1cb61cdd8f.en: Les Cinq Caumartin hosts a preview screening of Gabin, a documentary directed by Maxence Voiseux.

309974ad9e8b8ba375ae7a2aacd733d2ace8520d.en: Le Sélect invites children to a special Halloween screening of Ducobu et le fantôme de Saint Potache. Come in costume and enjoy a distribution of candies.

4a00db6eb8350d1ae8b98062998f12e1dd6eb41d.en: Experience an enchanting live performance by the quartet Ão, blending Mozambican and Portuguese roots with delicate melodies and danceable rhythms.

3aee2a52b1ce51675c509cfde7d336ea688425f5.en: Experience a powerful evening of atmospheric post-black and post-metal with Heretoir, Unreqvited, and Nidare.

2d54f8a35122aae625ed60488004f4ab3df4795d.en: Catch acclaimed saxophonist and composer Zoh Amba as they transition into folk music, acoustic guitar, and original songwriting.

49d76a066cdd14702dff4c3806b61a3a5e6207ae.en: Enjoy a live techno night featuring Marta's unique blend of acoustic violin and electronic drums alongside Isabelle Labaston's electronic trio.

b51343d4e1c8bb6d8b553c4ec68318c03d3afd79.en: Dance through the night at Phantom Paris for an Organïk clubbing event running from late evening until early morning.

1f792584dcdaa8ecacfd1fd6589b11fc98845f3e.en: Aloïse Sauvage returns to La Cigale for a live concert defined by physical intensity and raw energy.

ed0579cded2a2eb7d679e0b721f9a7579c5c924f.en: Experience a guided ambient and techno meditation session at Listener, combining simple movements, breathing, and pristine sound.

3bc64c457e75467e8ca935b33c6aa1ba2762cc0a.en: Join an ambient and techno listening session at Listener, featuring guided breathing, gentle movement, and top-tier sound.

5ba1439a847980dd1814bb0cf64d9b4dde5e478d.en: Dolphin Love plays Le POPUP du Label, showcasing an immersive, guitar-driven indie sound blending warmth, optimism, and hip-hop influences.

5e8a3a266b5bec078f3fb59b442780ea9ccdec3e.en: The Cabaret Bad Biches present a brand new immersive show at Les Trois Baudets, investigating the mysterious fate of Constance Palmer.

4b3453ecb8d88fc4f015b53387be9159186bba79.en: Petit Bain hosts a release party for psychedelic rock band Brama alongside electronic duo Turfu as part of the Villes des Musiques du Monde festival.

0c68d3ed9740d5893da2fb0572679523e1ebfd36.en: A rotating lineup of 6 to 9 comedians takes the stage for a lively stand-up night in Paris.

d00ef007555866ccff2b1f6685dd88a4f4ce1b79.en: Enjoy a lively comedy night featuring a rotating lineup of 6 to 9 stand-up performers in Paris.

64361a25210178072c07846fc5c07bc482a863d8.en: Les Étoiles hosts Mini Club, a friendly weekly Friday night party in a former 19th-century theatre playing pop, hip-hop, and electro hits.

dc220e266a8de4f35c38f5b3d6766403ebd795b6.en: Miami Boulevard transforms into a haunted castle for a 90s and 2000s Halloween party filled with throwback hits and drink specials.

2306434905d9e96a865f3167456109e02a05ee90.en: Rêva Brasserie hosts the closing event for the Strates exhibition, featuring a live painting performance by Clothilde Fricot Mugnerot accompanied by improvised piano from Léo Bailac.

5922eb70ce32d99bea7bd5d17db3f09a00026b85.en: Pianist and composer Yakir Arbib performs solo at Salle Colonne to celebrate the release of his new album, Whisper.

1269fc3d26b90363ad421961d7c5b8a93333df2e.en: La Bringue hosts a girls-only techno night at 42 Marches, featuring an all-female lineup and a safe, welcoming space for everyone.

65fbbe45a98a6bdf3ea3221b1e024948bba883dd.en: Ezek celebrates the release of EZEK'S PARTY with his very first live show at La Boule Noire on November 14, 2026. Expect an energetic night designed to get the whole room moving.

1119c30ac9d3375b2059aef7c3e9e81431fea89d.en: Nico Moreno brings his signature industrial rave sound to Paris at La Cité du Cinéma on November 20, 2026. Catch a major figure of modern techno live in a brand new venue.

f866ed44bdc5dd72f353ac653e3f7a70555c7bc3.en: Le Mazette kicks off winter with live piano, DJ sets from Un*Deux, a brand new game room, and seasonal cocktails. Drop by for food, drinks, and cozy chalet vibes.

cf9f3658333907c6d3890ab4b12a6116dc5d0ab0.en: Ring in 2027 at the Jungle Zone with a multi-room New Year party featuring classic hits from the 80s onwards. Enjoy an open bar, bubbles, and tropical jungle decor.

7b0a974d5883dfdd26f9054c2640f863658e92c6.en: Le Flow hosts the official Studio 2054 aftershow celebrating Charli XCX right after her arena concert. Expect a dancefloor mix of hyperpop, trance, and club anthems.

81609e6acc184a21e36554dec517428a9b4f1baa.en: French Kiss takes over Oz Club for a late-night party celebrating afro, hip-hop, afrohouse, and latino rhythms. Dress sharp for a night of hot tracks in central Paris.

f54c74d229b0bf947eb4026a0a2f86bb5c43d9e4.en: French sibling duo Jersey bring their unique blend of UK rock, French Touch, and EDM to La Cigale on January 13, 2027. Catch them live to celebrate their debut album.

92412c43f7dae118879630b8cbb22eaa85d0f961.en: La Petite Halle hosts the final day of the Yōkai Matsuri festival with free Japanese craft stalls, workshops, and live music. Come enjoy a gentle, festive farewell with the yōkai.

88c15fd14f5111cc0c230d30a00a1fe5d418a45e.en: Mains d'Œuvres celebrates Colombian music as part of the Villes des Musiques du Monde festival. Catch El León Pardo and duo Indus blending traditional rhythms with electronic beats.

f0c9d50eb666fa673711afe73678d61fb2419684.en: Sacré hosts electronic music heavyweight Butch alongside Barcelona duo Family Matters for a late-night club session. Expect fine selections and underground house all night.

15f4c362f4ba63d10d5b524546a06bcaf66c1b0e.en: Panic Room hosts Mirabelle Club for a free night of house, groove, and disco tracks. Join DJs gu3yte, Ziczny, and DSTRCKT to heat up the dancefloor.

c438d5c4b09fd7ac92d4c6641e4f212f45bf4ee1.en: Step aboard the Le Loceynus boat on October 31, 2026, for a massive Halloween party on the Seine. Enjoy a night of clubbing on the water with views of Paris by night.

432e7ae43e45b8c131fb392475b417729487ab3c.en: French rock band WEB bring their modern sound and energetic live show to the Bataclan on March 20, 2027. Catch the rising boys band following their recent sold-out tour.

bf3f26396dd030add648b22800aa8fb808045e32.en: Tiwony presents Dancehall Frequency at Canal 93, celebrating sound system culture with an authentic and contemporary reggae set. Expect a powerful journey across generations of Caribbean vibrations.

2a93e6c3af2b9195697ebcfd27498bdd47aed0da.en: Smile World Gaité Montparnasse hosts a dedicated Rihanna party featuring arcade games, karaoke, and a 100% pop and R&B club night. Dress in your best icon-inspired outfit to join the fun.

049283736e49fb4dfbcbc831c8ce1fb13bd82537.en: O'Flynn stops by Sacré for his album release party alongside former resident Loulou Ferrari. Expect an energetic blend of percussive house, afrobeats, and disco-house.

e8045bd5afcb2edad4bbb0fab1af556e05a44aaa.en: La Marbrerie hosts Melo Xxx for a girly punk release party featuring a full band live show, drag acts, and independent creators. Expect a colorful and unfiltered blend of electro-pop and rock.

40b244f73796edf1af71d83a7c5c33ae58f38d43.en: Badaboum hosts La Ch!ck for a weekly Thursday party dedicated to the golden era of EDM. Enjoy a safe, inclusive club night with free entry available late into the morning.

780aa59a295eefc090315d1d09ee28dc97f3a266.en: Portuguese revelation Ana Lua Caiano brings her unique one-woman-band setup to Le Hasard Ludique on February 27, 2027. Discover a live performance blending traditional melodies with electronic beats.

90d772167fe815df590ec9b04d267aa45fe6cc8a.en: Le Baiser Salé hosts a Sunday jam session led by drummer Sotiris Tsolis. Kick off the evening with a live set blending jazz, electro, and improvisation before the floor opens up to musicians.

a764684a86a43468fddc53105f56e04483b67c18.en: La Qonasse returns to freedj for a new season of music, drag shows, high heels, and cocktails. Come enjoy DJ sets by Andy & Blouson, regular drinks prizes, and plenty of drama.

f7016a446d299e2c2b993ac4ea63eb710051f74e.en: Le Klub hosts the Korean Night After Party on October 21, 2026, featuring a mix of K-hiphop, K-pop, and special sets by Jay Park and Le Sserafim. Dance the night away with DJ Seiji and a guest DJ in your own style.

e852e05536da4bbac861a00f477ebc2025377f88.en: Théâtre du Temps presents Trans_Human_Art 2:22, a multi-disciplinary performance exploring memory, a violent attack, and an investigation into love and survival. Created by Mickael Sabbah, it blends theater, electronic music, dance, and spatialized sound.

30c2f9e176e4807e8e8b8d4ad7eb1d881d563bd3.en: Annette K. Seine hosts a disco-themed night celebrating hits from ABBA to Juliette Armanet. Put on your best outfit to enjoy a 100% disco DJ set, games, and a dance battle.

023879e7ccd18541e75ea38c6fc682a85656669b.en: Babour Sauvage hosts Club Eterno on October 31 for a Halloween night of house, tech house, and progressive music. Anton S. and Termo from collectif C7 play a 100% vinyl set alongside residents Austher, Sphinx, and Van Cau.

7d4c59334eda3f5fbe244e652f7493954e178337.en: Central Chapelle welcomes Irish club sensation Jazzy on December 5 for her Peace & Patience Tour. Catch one of the leading names in international dance music following her major chart hits and collaborations.

86c980c1068f13c3815b2203348c8a1af2fcb7d2.en: Infinity Club brings back La Fibre for a special Westaf edition celebrating the culture, vibe, and artists of Mali, Senegal, Guinea, and beyond.

a5e330d41fde9c2065d60d42aaa452517a5b5640.en: La Morézienne Comedy Club features stand-up performances by Hugo DBK, Robin Gomez, and Caroline Seba. Online booking is required and a drink purchase is mandatory at the entrance for this intimate 50-seat show.

b2cf8f63b6ffbd3e5c71aebed74cf891f88bfc6d.en: The Pandora Club hosts a monthly women-only night, welcoming all cis and trans women for a safe space with a welcome drink, a DJ dancefloor, and a Confession Box. Enjoy themed cocktails and prize giveaways in a phone-free environment.

a748578600d5fdf97e913b301a1b6226b019ccc3.en: Punk Paradise hosts a salsa evening featuring a dance initiation with Marie-B and a live concert by Madinina pa'Cuba accompanied by DJ Pascualito. Enjoy happy hours, pizza, and a lively night of social dancing.

e1940ec9f9683505aa0c73641500bcc44f79c422.en: Chez Moune hosts its weekly Thursday night party, offering a historic neighborhood venue for dancing and nightlife in Paris.

1b91d70d0f5dd65bd5d4058eaceb29c6d7194019.en: Le Triangle hosts the exclusive screening of Electric Angels on October 23, blending electronic music, dance, and live performance. The evening features companion DJ sets and a look at this unique audio-visual format.

42521c13b8c99956ebe44e4763f18ae702c561eb.en: Maison de la Mécanique hosts a conference on strategic autonomy and standardization for businesses, featuring keynote speaker Natacha Polony. Join industry leaders in Courbevoie on November 17 to discuss resilience, cooperation, and supply chains.

ea8c094e0fc1676047b3a135f0dd3798297383ac.en: Agence La Courneuve hosts an immersive information session to help you discover industrial careers through interactive games and skills tests. Explore new sectors, collect points, and find out about future job opportunities.

62a3d46f93861dc4d8089fb803389ed4a9d62b70.en: Agence Paris 10eme Vicq d'Azir hosts a discovery workshop on industrial careers featuring a testimony from a production colorist at SOCOMORE via My Job Glasses. Explore dynamic modernization trends in technical aviation painting and meet the recruitment teams.

66306294b4b20328814c6c5ea7a4b997cd896fcf.en: Hôpital Albert Chenevier hosts a photography workshop focused on a collection of vintage black-and-white portraits from 1900 to 1950. Explore early photographic styles, studio staging, and historical visual codes.

e84c40f8ab5749dbf24c60ede20a165f7d9adf2d.en: Le Molière hosts the 10th edition of a ppr oc he, an independent art fair dedicated to experimental photography. From November 12 to 15, 2026, explore fifteen solo exhibitions highlighting contemporary creators as part of the national Bicentenary of Photography celebration.

b008df8e0625defe67c0f786ce813f0ee967f860.en: Festival Photo Days highlights the letter R for Reél in the latest edition of the Dictionnaire presque complet de la photographie by Réseau LUX. Explore how photography interprets reality through this contemporary visual arts festival across Paris and its region.

687fc864f5f1f1996bc464eb3e2906beb37b8152.en: Musée du Quai Branly - Jacques Chirac presents an exhibition tracing its collection of Nepalese photography from 19th-century royal portraits to the contemporary work of Prasiit Sthapit. Part of the Bicentenary of Photography, the display explores how images have shaped the visibility and history of the country.

b421c0695700143d67db7c2af922c828fb724707.en: Le Musée Postal lance une collecte de photographies argentiques sur La Poste et ses métiers. Particuliers et professionnels sont invités à partager leurs archives pour enrichir ce patrimoine visuel.

ba56d1b3664998280323c993ab147ef9c5a4f36f.en: Assistez à la projection du film Scream dans le cadre de la Nuit Halloween du Luxy. Profitez de grignotages et d'animations horrifiques tout au long de la nuit.

518daa01f9cf449dbfba0f53bde748c9a2e0a9d1.en: Participez en famille à un atelier culinaire inspiré par des œuvres d'art présentées par un médiateur. Un moment ludique et créatif accessible à partir de 6 ans sur réservation.

2e87de2d5af772c580b0622619dac0dfc8d36ba1.en: Découvrez de nombreux arts martiaux lors de démonstrations gratuites présentées par l'Académie de Recherche Martiale dans le cadre de l'événement Couleurs Japon.

e9e95dd779c80617b5e9ccad22ec1b26ac265d9b.en: Profitez de cours de français langue étrangère gratuits et ouverts à tous les samedis. L'apprentissage se fait sur trois niveaux, de l'alphabétisation au niveau intermédiaire.

d0a8423881a05c70938a22279c2791b3a636ffdd.en: Découvrez la géologie de la planète Mars grâce aux observations des rovers et des satellites. Cette séance explore l'histoire martienne et la recherche d'indices sur le développement de la vie.

a73c27be5ee4c923683960b04bdabfdce872cd8a.en: Comprenez les enjeux et les modèles économiques des entreprises à impact et de l'économie sociale et solidaire. Cette rencontre offre des repères pour structurer et faire accompagner votre projet.

ed48ce9cdb8675fa6d87f2ff8def01fd9dfe7e1b.en: Venez jouer au titre World Championship NES Edition sur grand écran lors d'une session animée par un médiateur de l'équipe Jeux Vidéo.

7f59e633764722ad0e57c901997ce014b8ce866a.en: Explorez le fonctionnement, les capacités et les limites des intelligences artificielles génératives de texte et d'image comme ChatGPT et Midjourney.

46fe07255e539ae3d298dda89d5a2b5ab798df73.en: Apprenez à manier les outils de base du dessin vectoriel et préparez vos créations pour les machines du Fablab.

7c854ddca27b4bc4b2f3edfe470c1346c2e7f7d3.en: Découvrez un courant artistique ou un artiste à travers les œuvres du Musée Numérique avant de participer à un atelier créatif en famille.

c1b7a218e0647dbd5a7285584b0e7a551ef4c995.en: Offrez à vos enfants un stage nature et Montessori alternant des journées dans le parc de l'île Saint-Germain et des activités sensorielles et créatives.

17af775be66f03ab0b661cf35e737a094d1ac505.en: Partez pour un voyage dans le système solaire guidé par un astronome. Observez les mouvements des planètes et approchez-vous de ces astres fascinants.

12aa95d76b97a81a4ef8d372b03357cf7febc2e2.en: Partez à la découverte des satellites naturels de notre système solaire. Cette séance détaille les caractéristiques incroyables de ces lunes et de leurs éclipses.

012942fcf5792ea620f46554558654ce77df3985.en: Testez en direct les frontières entre l'humain et la machine lors d'une conférence-performance théâtrale et philosophique. Un échange pour interroger notre esprit critique face aux technologies.

2fe8a32da27195ec75a8db81f722882c7a80e064.en: Découvrez l'histoire librement inspirée des Slits, le premier groupe de punk féminin londonien formé en 1976 par quatre jeunes femmes.

485d4e1d5b389fb338ec48aa1c1884f4cea0179e.en: Explorez des expositions immersives mêlant science et art pour éveiller la curiosité et l'imaginaire des plus jeunes. Des médiations sont proposées pour stimuler le regard des enfants sur le monde.

a635e0df195d41c8e52a9ee0e19355f15e96c637.en: Le Salon International de l'Agriculture revient avec une configuration repensée pour moderniser le parcours visiteur. Retrouvez également le concours de startups Agreen Startup.

9ff6d477d5e040ba6006a5bea173ce5b3c82288b.en: SHAMANE plays an instrumental trance music built on relentless rhythms from a double bass, drums, and two electric guitars. Catch them live at Larocafé for a hypnotic musical experience.

1af0ae36a3f5a7293d5694ff824f1641654f592d.en: Sami Galbi brings his unique electro blend of North African raï, chaâbi, and electronic textures to Canal 93. Aziz Konkrite opens the night, fusing traditional rhythms with futuristic beats.

3c3481ae9fe9e9f63ec2cf46b836a325bc40eed3.en: Stéphane Varupenne directs a burlesque comedy by Nicolaï Erdman at the Comédie-Française. It follows a man whose chance remark sparks a wild rumor that he wants to commit suicide.

dfbfd65005334f43e8b7bf123286b3aec4ddcc32.en: A Moi! at Salle Pablo Neruda follows a young girl named Céleste and her doudou as they explore a world centered around objects. Go to see how she navigates endless desires and material possessions.

30c92a3c3ca123dbff3493b0e9da98ed15d2e7d1.en: School holiday revision stages at the Maison de la Ferme help collège students strengthen their skills in a chosen subject. The interactive workshops combine group and individual learning.

77effe2dd3ec5abb19c56b0a80b679b361469d3f.en: Zangbeto performs organic, danceable music at JASS CLUB that bridges jazz and traditional Togolese rhythms. The quintet celebrates their acclaimed debut album and previews upcoming new material.

7203c351a7ee1d5a92a1b8599889315a599fca2b.en: An instrumental concert at the Auditorium Angèle et Roger Tribouilloy traces the history of the tuning fork from the Renaissance to today. Discover how changing frequencies shape musical eras.

d79d4fc9e304d2a734120a9460ad5fc171744df9.en: Nantes rapper Cielbleu brings his new EP, Gosse Coureur, to La Cigale. Expect a raw, poetic blend of rap, soul, and jazz.

a7f6cbded8aa3e3db4408dd1fd4e6618dbab19b6.en: The MuAM hosts an immersive weekend exploring the history of photography in period costume. Visitors can try out historic techniques like stenope and cyanotypes while examining the medium's modern role.

4560f156a8ed845c0961719bc74b9d4a87eab9cc.en: The Château des Tourelles presents an exhibition celebrating the bicentenary of photography. It pairs works by 19th-century pioneers with contemporary artists using artisan techniques.

40009b0141fb20080d2dc18c01f53af31367d9f8.en: The Atelier de Sèvres presents photographic works by second-year Bachelor students. The exhibition explores documentary photography by combining personal images with varied archival sources.

533ac921dabea08ca1e27351324ad969f000fa94.en: Alzueta Gallery hosts an exhibition by Xènia Fuentes as part of the official gallery photography trail.

31cb53f1a13b7baa97315f8729ef41269ce89164.en: Galerie Monbrison presents photojournalist Olympia de Maismont's portraits of Egúngún figures from Yoruba tradition. The exhibition explores the spiritual presence of ancestors through striking ritual costumes.

8b3732bcecd204aa64ac996ad2fe740386aaed09.en: The Musée Postal presents an exhibition featuring documentary work by six renowned photographers commissioned by La Poste in 1991. Explore unique visual accounts of postal workers and daily life across France.

61f8bfc5c6c7ecff27119a21c47199c0fbe0a202.en: Franco-Sri Lankan artist Nilusi performs at La Gaîté Lyrique, blending soul, R&B, jazz, and traditional South Asian music. She brings her powerful storytelling and identity-driven art to the stage.

10143c1b1ea951a900258c1a17501c8818bea9d2.en: Wallace Cleaver performs at the Zénith Paris - La Villette, presenting introspective rap tracks from his album Marcel. Lekchan and Henri Bleu join as opening acts.

2d498d197e6bb487e5233ec7fd2fccf0920eab1a.en: Legendary French rock band Roadrunners reunite for a special tour stop at La Marbrerie. Expect high-energy melodies and classic franglish stage presence.

805fcf3772fab7bedb383349356ad94ac6e6d908.en: Jake Xerxes Fussell performs at Le Hasard Ludique, reinterpreting forgotten American folk traditions with modern sensibility. Fingerstyle guitarist Nathan Salsburg opens the evening.

c7b7130417304716f59b3c5f7dc6b70c5a6fcd0f.en: Electro duo Yuraa performs at Le Hasard Ludique to celebrate their second EP, Goodbye My Love. Catch their atmospheric vocals and melodic house live on tour.

7882dedf13802f205ba6c3afb5c9aac95dc3b2f6.en: Kakamü est un petit lapin sensible qui quitte sa maison pour explorer des planètes inconnues et prouver son courage. Ce spectacle jeune public à Les Trois Baudets suit ses rencontres avec des êtres singuliers qui l'aident à grandir.

2c594d451d75591e15390febec6539bb317a71e4.en: NAEKO se produit à FGO-Barbara pour présenter son univers de nouvelle pop, marqué par une écriture brute et frontale. Un concert intimiste pour découvrir une œuvre explorant la vulnérabilité, la dualité et la reconstruction.

dc65f795b40396a07fcff38a101206e7a6bc4823.en: Le jeune auteur-compositeur-interprète Stanislas se produit à l'Al Alhambra. Entre rap indie et pop alternative, il présente son premier EP Topless après avoir marqué les esprits sur les plateformes de streaming.

0bc3b021468d116c431c4c1c7e1b0276a0f9a0d5.en: La Cave Argenteuil accueille un concert pour livre pop-up animé dès 4 ans. Le duo de musique électronique Turnsteak plonge les spectateurs à l'intérieur d'un livre magique mêlant sculptures de papier et paysages sonores.

30f8de1ab104e31e1808634c3d2c99194e053428.en: Aupinard revient sur scène au Zénith Paris-La Villette pour présenter son tout premier album, spleen. social club. Un concert chaleureux mêlant bossa nova, soul et électro aux côtés d'invités.

c149d73aebf515edf37460ce3e0a0bd033ca9ce1.en: Le duo franco-américain Faux Real investit le Club Bus Palladium pour un concert exceptionnel. Attendez-vous à un univers théâtral et saisissant, entre chorégraphies et énergie brute, pour découvrir leur deuxième album Poison Time.

c02f8a20ff82f270fe74244dbec9102438e911d5.en: Karpatt revient à La Bellevilloise pour présenter son nouvel album Au Compte Goutte, mêlant chanson du voyage, rock et rythmiques sud-américaines. La première partie sera assurée par le duo folk De Grands Enfants.

659b11d3c2e8c126b6381a300494d51ca6c8540a.en: Nuit noire fête la sortie de son premier EP aux Trois Baudets avec un show électronique et modulaire unique. Roukie assurera la première partie avec ses harmonies vocales atmosphériques et ses synthés pop.

8adde6b48ee8216f8f3b68d2e03192c3da41ad7d.en: Le trio Dov'è Liana pose ses valises à La Maroquinerie pour une date supplémentaire afin de prolonger la fête après un premier concert complet.

7b2fadfd53ee9687e2c4b4121f380d225478a9cf.en: Le Poetry Club s'installe au Griffon pour une soirée de poésie vivante et rythmée. Six poètes se succèdent pour des passages de quelques minutes dans une ambiance chaleureuse et propice aux rencontres.

572f4bcdd448d321d8435cb6792e962c35997fac.en: PIO présente son nouvel EP aux Trois Baudets avec une pop solaire et mélancolique aux mélodies entêtantes. MargauxRZ assurera la première partie avec un univers pop électro introspectif aux textes percutants.

6979e9e8b73ee112157e837e2b896ac3f278b3c9.en: Le groupe Vowski célèbre la sortie de son premier album au New Morning avec un spectacle mêlant post-jazz, lumières et vidéos. Marylou Sharrock assurera la première partie de cette soirée unique.

881267950bd0cca53f78c3933d892283d26756a3.en: Keeno et Vibre Strings débarquent au Nouveau Casino pour leur toute première date en France. Un événement live inédit combinant drum and bass, piano à queue et quatuor à cordes pour une soirée orchestrale.

52a064c3d17fa7807ae2e5ad0188c3f0c9498cf0.en: ElectroRoller investit le Loft de La Bellevilloise pour une soirée roller disco, funk et house. Enfilez vos patins ou louez-les sur place pour danser et rouler au rythme des DJ sets.

e4c97158ec715d7801347b6447d80aab662b4c22.en: Le collectif afro-futuriste Ibibio Sound Machine se produit au Hasard Ludique. Attendez-vous à un concert explosif mêlant rythmes d'Afrique de l'Ouest, textures électroniques, disco et post-punk.

35402736a0a0ae0de3b1e74585d06e83d5ceaa48.en: Le Pavillon Gravelle vous invite à une édition spéciale d'Halloween pour une nuit mystérieuse et sensuelle. Venez vivre une expérience hors du commun entre surprises, frissons et rencontres.

428142e068bb5ec7c088c89fbe4269e67159d73a.en: L'artiste émergent 55ASKY se produit au Trabendo pour présenter sa musique hybride et émotionnelle. Entre hyperpop et musiques électroniques alternatives, il repousse les frontières des genres musicaux.

82a82464f131709a6f7b67f215545590137b4c17.en: Le groupe lyonnais Hôtel Particulier se produit à La Boule Noire pour partager son indie rock de chambre. Leurs morceaux se déploient lentement entre narration française et textures de rock contemporain.

403af80c490464546a723693b85a2c882d0c6861.en: Le Fitzroy vous invite à danser chaque week-end dès le début de soirée avec ses DJ sets généralistes. Profitez d'une ambiance festive avec des espaces de jeux, des options food et drinks jusqu'au bout de la nuit.

fdbc92290f2c7627a34de74553a30fe062649131.en: Ali A.k.a Mind débarque à L'Alimentation Générale pour une soirée et une fête colombienne vibrante. Venez célébrer la culture latine et découvrir en live son album Honesty.

4531d52a470f23778a16ad363eada1a44b01a456.en: Cult Collective and Le Diable au Corps take over Terminus for a night of oldschool tekno, hard techno, and frenchcore. Seven artists deliver seven hours of immersive sound.

a68aaaae3723257524dfd3b38a92b182dcc805b3.en: La Fondation Cartier pour l'art contemporain accueille une rencontre sur les collections photographiques françaises. Des figures majeures y discutent des défis actuels et futurs de la conservation et de la diffusion des images.

816729887e537ea4bade58112c6a1fcf408b4ae1.en: Le square du temple accueille une exposition photographique de la Saison Cabaret mêlant archives et créations contemporaines. Un parcours pour découvrir l'histoire et l'évolution de cet art vivant.

9cd34c708a60c529cee504f2c0321e2605408b5d.en: La Cité des sciences et de l'industrie présente une exposition sur l'histoire de la photographie couleur à travers les plaques autochromes. Le parcours inclut une immersion sonore et visuelle retraçant le travail de Marc Ferrez.

8e2ab725e25a932718015889c4ee405b07900217.en: La Bibliothèque hosts an exhibition celebrating a century of photography in the Haut-Pays region from 1860 to 1960. Visitors can explore the region's photographic history through portraits and historical prints.

1ff77ad9d65b2b75373322dc38c00e39f3533289.en: The MAC VAL presents "Ici grand ouvert", an expansive exhibition by artist SMITH. The showcase features works spanning photography, installation, and performance that explore metamorphosis and the boundaries of perception.

a98bb91135e45149ce7597181fb372ef6dc0a756.en: La Contemporaine hosts an international symposium on the intersection of photography and comic books. The event coincides with an exhibition dedicated to the work of photographer Didier Lefèvre.

8fd8832640d63a738ff590ba0c53022092055c37.en: Join a guided tour exploring how the Louvre has inspired photographers over time. Discover the museum and the Tuileries garden through a unique visual lens.

518860e2440dd34e5479bcc100bc754f97497d26.en: The Salon international de l'agriculture brings together producers, winemakers, and artisans at the Parc des expositions Porte de Versailles. It is a chance to meet farmers and taste local products from across France.

2b4e57344637db63276857b6649bb213950be53c.en: The Salon de l'Etudiant at the NEWCAP Event Center helps students navigate their educational futures in journalism, marketing, and communication. Attendees can meet professionals, attend workshops, and receive personalized orientation advice.

e7ed76bbc655fd7e4c620ecea4400a6235dc4c59.en: Espace Jeunes Anne Frank offers school holiday workshops designed to help high school students strengthen their skills and overcome academic difficulties. Sessions combine group learning with individual support.

0ce8a65c686d4e7ab0c522d4c858ec304078eeed.en: Que Choisir Ensemble Meudon Val Fleury holds regular sessions at the Espace Val-Fleury to help consumers defend their rights. Volunteers offer advice, information, and support for resolving everyday consumer disputes.

23213e07c4d241af185295b9a18666b594311af8.en: The Grand Palais presents unusual scientific conferences that answer unexpected and quirky questions. It offers a playful way to satisfy curiosity and understand fundamental research concepts.

67d12d6e6e00e00503a072b8907ce4578e1e1994.en: The Instituto Cultural de México presents an exhibition of contemporary Mexican jewelry during Parcours Bijoux 2026. Inspired by Zapotec tradition, the works explore memory, identity, and artistic connection.

9328ca3e27cfc7af651eafdf77a9d649ce510ea5.en: L'Ecran presents Paper Tiger, a drama following two estranged brothers in 1986 Queens who get entangled with the Russian mafia.

d152a4e8782d6c3ab1ec23283ee05aae15ccef2d.en: Le Luxy hosts a Halloween night screening of Heretic, complete with midnight snacks and horror-themed animations.

52921148fe5a88af3dcc8e1d8266bc2dcff3e990.en: Le Luxy offers a child-friendly Pingu screening tailored for toddlers starting at 18 months, preceded by a morning breakfast.

fc6d3e2d009570ae2a7dd81dd3608c74d06e4aa6.en: Le Luxy presents a screening of L'Arabe followed by a Q&A with director Malek Bensmail and a friendly gathering featuring Algerian flavors.

9cca8508e4010fc8362a8b2ba2f001f65a957248.en: Le Luxy hosts a screening of JE VEUX BIEN, followed by a discussion with co-director Vincent Glenn and trade union delegates on unemployment and precariousness.

8324e7c2610579633afbdad181727604970e8067.en: Les Toiles screens Le Chantier, a documentary portrait of a workplace community, followed by a quiz and a discussion with the director.

17bf6065932ab14976f659d86f8cc55ad3d54b4b.en: Le Temps des Cerises invites children aged 7 and up to learn how to give paper and packaging a second life through a hands-on recycling workshop.

7a0f5db005fa879bb609649a6dd354e3f27994e8.en: Cet atelier invite les 8-11 ans à découvrir l'art de la linogravure à travers une approche traditionnelle et une découpeuse laser.

abb2ab8323f031dbc8c37fb90f608cf8260ce9db.en: Cet atelier permet aux personnes à partir de 15 ans de découvrir le fonctionnement des imprimantes 3D en vue d'une utilisation en autonomie.

c837e5bc4649221cd5f0470383453117107a8c32.en: Le Carrefour numérique² accueille des associations du Libre comme Parinux, le Blender User Group et Wikimedia tous les premiers samedis du mois.

0f6e697658e433e3c93468c7b539e89d0804c2e7.en: Le Planétarium propose une immersion sonore et visuelle chaque dimanche avec une playlist exclusive imaginée par Radio Nova.

19e1c5b669988ca4d3719040c988b783ae631767.en: Cet atelier d'analyse d'images aide à comprendre les clés de la perspective et des illusions visuelles.

ae9ecd2a0747a5a1d24c5885114223e19bbe4da2.en: Cette animation explore les secrets de la navigation à voile et de la poussée d'Archimède à travers des expériences physiques.

eae88266480c0952f291f4cecfb63885beef987a.en: Une activité surprise est proposée aux enfants et à leurs familles le samedi après-midi.

bb4024288a56cf615293add6a4756f5bda1ae00f.en: Cette conférence explore l'histoire de l'informatique, de ses pionniers à ses concepts fondateurs comme les algorithmes et la logique binaire.

e8ee09717592dac82a0e26ed698ad62e5c74b896.en: Le planétarium propose d'assister en avant-première à l'étude de la galaxie d'Andromède et à sa future collision avec la nôtre.

f4cd3d582b1ccf8103ab1f3275fa66d3c869d8e2.en: Les enfants découvrent les plantes et composent leur propre tisane magique d'Halloween au cours de cet atelier déguisé mené par l'herbaliste Francesca.

7a1ee0a3078817dfa1d53d4eecb078a9882b45d2.en: Cet atelier invite à façonner sa propre sphère végétale naturelle selon l'art japonais du kokedama, dans l'ambiance chaleureuse de l'association WoMa.

1a757ed442af461fb019fa35b251bc13402819b7.en: La dessinatrice Léna Walrus et l'auteur Popésie présentent leur album « La Canne de Balzac » publié aux Éditions Dargaud lors d'une rencontre en entrée libre.

755e51c4726023d422ac78f673b11cfe29d3edcb.en: Des contes joyeux sur les quatre saisons et la force de l'hiver sont racontés pour se réchauffer pendant la saison froide.

6ecc9efdcbaa4103acd8dfe6245ca44cf4fa8c11.en: Ce dispositif immersif plonge les visiteurs au cœur des ateliers de fabrication et des procédés historiques de la Monnaie de Paris du XIXe au XXe siècle.
