9cacd39d47f462247cd0fc0ef3ac908201a03cbf.en: Cette exposition revient sur les dernières années de la prison Saint-Lazare à travers des photographies et des documents d'archives inédits.

d87bcd8086f6c07a4d0aaec6823bd9d7b3c1448c.en: Les artistes photographes Lucy Winkelmann et Mélanie Legendre proposent d'initier de jeunes patients à la technique de la broderie sur photographie.

7fd53136b8b4f773073a7ec5720be9e15b9beff4.en: Lucy Winkelman présente une conférence sur l'image comme trace et patrimoine au chevet des patients.

f5f003d7934997a5f25acb1a18fba0561955bfc0.en: Le Lavoir Numérique présente l'œuvre lauréate du Prix Swiss Life à 4 mains, mêlant la photographie d'Oleñka Carrasco et la musique de La Chica autour du thème de l'exil.

119d090c48bf09839565d859354196fb419ff14a.en: Cet atelier inclusif au Carreau du Temple associe danse contact improvisation et pratiques somatiques. C'est l'occasion d'explorer ses limites, ses forces et la rencontre avec autrui.

36aeb7ee6713fdf64fbf8953c2c49f07adc9ab29.en: Sokra se produit en concert au Nouveau Casino le 31 octobre 2026 pour présenter son univers en live, avec ADS & Kalys en première partie. C'est une occasion unique de le découvrir entouré de ses invités.

711eab91bf7d3091a1e0aaec146fc9c7a71b31ab.en: Keros-N est en concert au Zénith Paris - La Villette le 23 octobre 2026. Venez vivre une soirée reggae et dancehall dans l'un des lieux les plus emblématiques de Paris.

8218bdd461d9e24d591b1fbaf8e0800fdd5d0a51.en: Golden Bug investit le Silencio Club pour une live experience mêlant machines, rock et textures électroniques. L'artiste y présente son nouveau single 'Sans Soleil' et son nouvel EP.

97a19193d5ca8c1d5f92e3ac45ef28534f1396a3.en: L'artiste pluridisciplinaire keiyaA se produit au Hasard Ludique le 28 octobre 2026. Son univers musical et théâtral explore l'identité, le mouvement et l'émotion à travers un continuum sonore.

a60ce3dab9359b5a68fe267f32da7f58f7663a63.en: Le Centre des Arts d'Enghien-les-Bains accueille Tetha pour un live musical d'une heure. C'est un rendez-vous convivial pour découvrir cette autrice, compositrice et interprète pop.

6346e7d22a7536d9bbd1fbcbff9aa41e3dfa7841.en: WEB se produit en concert à La Maroquinerie pour une date à ne pas manquer. Venez découvrir leur live dans cette salle parisienne iconique.

38339959344c28c682f143703b2aea7c2ec4587e.en: Les Trois Baudets accueillent erodie, Caïman et Lazur pour une soirée de pop alternative et expérimentale. Une expérience immersive et sensible pour découvrir ces artistes singuliers.

0a097eea422efc5379393ac90792ec9a3d29697a.en: Panzerfaust et Nexion se produisent au Chinois pour une soirée de black et death metal. Une date immersive entre riffs massifs, ambiances apocalyptiques et univers occulte.

7e3fcc5291fa465497bd7ed9654d6cb6b2899f33.en: Dent May est en concert au Hasard Ludique pour présenter ses chansons pop à la fois mélancoliques et euphoriques. Venez découvrir son album chaleureux aux influences solaires.

1307630b76441f55ae5192e1117ff699c591ce0b.en: Nonsense présente Donky Tonk à Paris pour une soirée mêlant folk, rock et blues. Profitez d'un concert live organique suivi d'un DJ set jusqu'au bout de la nuit.

1a78bb1a74e082383eb15c9f68203183e4632027.en: Gigi Von Dredee et Morphine Blaze vous donnent rendez-vous à La Folie pour un Bingo Drag festif. Au programme : performances musicales, DJ set et lots à gagner.

ac8b902567d2d918b7bea55fe457a035fe97d464.en: La Dancing vous invite tous les samedis aux Étoiles dans un ancien théâtre transformé en club. Venez danser sur des tubes pop, hip-hop et electro des années 90 et 2000.

8c86f4b0c83d3f5e46e6a121d3c66af5c94654a5.en: La Dancing s'installe tous les samedis au club Les Étoiles pour une nuit festive. Retrouvez des tubes pop, hip-hop, electro et dance pour faire la fête jusqu'au matin.

66b4467b55c8ed5ec63d12d4fb9a2475c4108578.en: Le Mini Club vous donne rendez-vous tous les vendredis aux Étoiles pour une soirée sans prétention. Venez danser sur un mélange de pop, hip-hop, electro et variété.

8a5e76aaafcfba49d3422a90b8c739b4c1a5be84.en: Amaluna accueille le dernier chapitre de la résidence Sideratio² avec P.O. en live. Un format intimiste et un sound system HiFi pour une exploration musicale éclectique.

7633dd5a0a0215091b4585e31e4681663dd2e690.en: Le rappeur britannique Saam Sultan se produit à La Boule Noire. Venez découvrir son univers musical éthéré et cinématographique aux influences cloud rap et indie.

d35e281b8b10d1592ca83210d72815e5c96cb71f.en: Eva présente son nouveau projet Summergirl en concert à L'Olympia dès février prochain. L'artiste y défend ses nouvelles compositions entre pop, reggaeton et sonorités urbaines.

0b237537206218a3fec4b37c1449461c28847436.en: Tout Le Monde En Parle accueille une soirée spéciale Halloween sur son rooftop. Profitez d'une ambiance clubbing, d'un afterwork et d'une vue exceptionnelle sur Paris.

c8984137e3e415df010d453774cb89d39491a21d.en: Natascha Rogers présente sa carte blanche au Baiser Salé autour de son disque Onaida. Un concert intime mêlant piano et percussions, accompagné d'invités spéciaux.

06fed57b14368cc146f3b3853cf88bb45fd419c0.en: Enjoy a Sunday ritual of house beats, rose glow, and elegance at Medellín Paris. It runs every Sunday starting at 23:30.

0924524b8f71a296691e2d37c5158abe9d3810bb.en: Join Callea and Julie Clouds at The Highlander Pub for their release party featuring live performances and free entry.

af6764437fb8c903a306df40a3408c6ef3161302.en: Celebrate 20 years of Sourdoreille at Mains d'Œuvres in Saint-Ouen with performances by GAM1, Johnny Montreuil, Noreah, and Xea.

1093732cae9790bd2e0efce463f54721bd2235a7.en: Dance to 100% pop music at Badaboum every Thursday during La Ch!ck: Remembering Brat Summer. Enjoy a safe, inclusive party with free entrance from 4:30.

a23c9e00efa007fbafb7639065053cd2398a6c80.en: Experience a unique collaboration between Nassim Dendane and Amazigh Kateb at Pôle Musical d'Orgemont, part of the Villes des Musiques du Monde festival.

585e695fa7403945e796e152cab761405838109e.en: Madame Arthur presents French Collection with three club rooms, a blind test, a cabaret show, and the karakorale by Minima Gesté.

1a9d7f1c7c51bceb16a45e1d64873030dcaec0eb.en: Experience a tropical Sunday night at Café Oz Grands Boulevards with salsa, bachata, reggaeton, and latino vibes led by DJ Dreams. Entry is free all night.

ca7fada45900d410b826d9b71f6c47a407c90b28.en: Celebrate The Weeknd with bowling, arcade games, karaoke, and a dedicated club night at Smile World Gaité Montparnasse.

fed8b61cc19b40fe883c209a3846f0f97ea6606b.en: Enjoy stunning views, cocktails, tapas, and chill electro DJ sets at Le 10e Ciel, the temporary rooftop at the Pullman Tour Eiffel.

3fcc1c68fc19439e558d80083b5323aa46527d49.en: Le Hasard Ludique hosts La Virée for a final celebratory evening featuring live performances and DJ sets by Estelle, Charlie Motto, Silvestri, Mamaz, and La Virée Soundsystem.

1c7ece2bb462953b51c51d34d0bd9adb23808d05.en: Discover the high-energy, feminist pop-rock of NAVA live in concert at Badaboum.

a4f93a0a08f283d974f65eeb4dfb1630abc97d01.en: Loh presents their new EP Hearing the Call at Les Disquaires, followed by a Latin-American influenced DJ set by RdeRika.

4677f45eb134554533b6139b3f80f1a203cfb573.en: Join the open jam session aboard the La Dame de Canton barge. Bring your instrument, voice, or enthusiasm to play music and meet the expat community.

c508db943d68ffeef1efeeceb0e0c985eddc45a8.en: La Petite Halle hosts Armel Bizzman for a phone-free R&B, Soul, and Funk night under the glass roof of the Parc de la Villette.

d7279ae85ef60603cc018f684ec5a3a8c1c3e1ea.en: Espace Chaptal hosts Yana Opportunities, a forum connecting the public with job opportunities and relocation resources in French Guiana.

1bac5cbff1e078b55fdc6ba7e54e61ad0e14649f.en: Visit SAFRAN to discover inspiring career paths with employees from the Elles bougent association and tour the showroom of establishment products.

e5ef0cc4ca25af23150a58fa8c227609bc09bf23.en: Les Dramaticules present a conference-performance at Centre d'Art et de Culture detailing the sound, light, and staging techniques behind theatrical creation.

f593f2b719225cf2e2e83ca6099b178283da314a.en: Le Cube Garges presents Vertige, Manhattan Transfert, an immersive theatrical creation based on John Dos Passos' novel that explores modern city life and technology.

b3d65ad4b9b0254b18bae559c7f4ac5e885de39b.en: At Théâtre El Duende, Rose faces a prison sentence in a baby-manufacturing factory for doubting her desire for children. This dark comedy questions bodily autonomy and societal pressure through a satirical lens.

24dd8e2d7bf6164b0abbbcf38d5a0741aa30e5c6.en: At Médiathèque Aragon, book delivery women serve up pizzas accompanied by mini puppet shows and tongue twisters. It is a whimsical blend of storytelling and theatre for the Salon du livre d'Amour 2026.

627dfa14457cd680e48a8fe7d053935c551320c6.en: At Théâtre de Cachan, a travelling circus resists the authorities in a poetic tale about freedom and prison. Four puppeteers and two noise musicians bring this live-action cinematic adventure to life.

af38cb399c33cee25dc66879d1198dfdf65c14cf.en: At Théâtre Berthelot, Fahartadji Ahmed-Ibrahim blends dance, personal narrative, and the spirit of Medea to explore identity and emancipation. This energetic performance initiates a triptych on the theme of change.

5c16f1176dfc8cb4736bc217ba5e8f0cf292e694.en: At L'Etoile du Nord, a family of social media influencers sees their perfect online facade collapse when a strange creature enters their home. This grotesque performance critiques the monetization of family intimacy.

4ed67e5ffd48a3bbc87fd68bf58cb4d521f1adb8.en: At Maison de l'ile-de-France, SPA[S]M explores our relationship with technology through a collaboration between dancers, musicians, and artificial intelligence. This art-science project examines how technology shapes our bodies.

12146a2745765a7b4776af052b33a68cdb69cfc1.en: Adapted from a short story by Roberto Bolaño, Le Retour portrays a man recounting what happens to him after his death. This intimate, stripped-down staging explores memory, mortality, and human connection.

29d43515d19edc17dbda83f10b08b57815864760.en: At JASS CLUB, the Hammond-and-drums duo The Honnet Brothers team up with jazz saxophonist Julien Lourau. Expect a cinematic, highly danceable evening rooted in jazz and groove.

4c274e2ae4bf82e79e73c47aef21ae18ab9fe2d4.en: At JASS CLUB, Arthur Suprin-Demaegdt and Gaspard Berton revisit the iconic and intimate songs of Jacques Brel. This dynamic duo offers a fresh, emotional tribute filled with anecdotes about the artist's life.

d64c849932c95271038d23f83451a78d6f3a3897.en: At Paris La Défense Arena, DJ and multidisciplinary artist Anyma stops in Paris for his 2026 world tour, ÆDEN. Experience his brand-new live show following his standout performance at Coachella.

b56004b2189f21eccd822727300d6264efefe156.en: At La Cigale, singer and rapper Zinée presents her new EP, BIL, celebrating a personal and artistic renaissance. Catch her live for a memorable concert following the success of her album OSMIN.

8b2b6d9dccc8d0570b8e2f6a19a2adb8130114a4.en: At Espace Jean Vilar, enjoy a Halloween-themed workshop following a young couple's visit to an isolated island restaurant. The resident chef prepares a lavish menu with a few surprises.

4b54f18207dca5f3f000239fa58b0e7e1feeec94.en: At Cinéma Chaplin Saint Lambert, join a post-screening debate hosted in partnership with Amnesty International.

607ba8a87e7973a0c2037d8e9c9974f59e5ba953.en: At Ciné Gérard-Philipe, Shaun the Sheep's Halloween plans go awry when the Farmer accidentally destroys the pumpkin patch. A mad scientist transformation leads to a hilarious search for a missing farmer and a wild beast.

a144e1a5bbcce363e42f7c5970e9fa7e2e139119.en: At Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie, a quirky galactic controller explores the wonders of water through magic and science. Anne Revel presents an ecological theatrical magic show celebrating our planet.

7e0dda30f8a0422e69583cb69c9bad7cd632702c.en: At Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie, this workshop helps entrepreneurs master public speaking, stress management, and non-verbal communication. Learn how to pitch your project and present your company effectively.

5200c89a6f2f0e5dce36e414886f37efd1da7f88.en: At Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie, meet with an advisor from the OPCO Uniformation to find solutions for your recruitment, management, and professional training challenges.

0fbac267c015ea2e4980e44907d868be0564be00.en: At Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie, get guidance on validating your professional experience through a formal diploma. This session covers continuous training regulations, funding, and career matching.

941c3e78cc44db3deffdc5fa91ed3bd98e40efd9.en: At Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie, this workshop covers practical steps and common pitfalls for anyone looking to create and develop a business. All aspiring entrepreneurs are welcome.

27d2588d54585e131088dbe2a4568885c076f3be.en: At Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte, explore the concept of infinity in mathematics. Discover how this abstract idea helps describe probabilities, fractals, and numbers.

72dfbbd3f2c1b4fe8adfd15ab977319d1398117f.en: Explorez la complexité et la portée des algorithmes à travers une série de problèmes simples et ludiques. Une découverte accessible à tous pour comprendre ces outils mathématiques qui nous entourent.

99605e4db9b2b8bd9fd13913f698d203abbd0469.en: Apprenez les bases de l’OSINT à travers des exemples concrets et des outils accessibles. Une initiation pour retrouver des informations publiques et mieux protéger vos traces numériques.

56d1683e455b364f2a85a0d06a633c465c3da27d.en: Venez jouer en famille au Pôle Numérique lors de créneaux d'une heure dédiés. Un animateur vous accueille pour vous initier aux jeux vidéo à partir de 8 ans.

94a3b9147352b9de7ca47fe80e5cc2b1bc448318.en: Participez à cette conférence interactive pour explorer le potentiel éducatif des jeux vidéo. Un moment d'échange pour les familles, dès 8 ans, afin de mieux comprendre Minecraft Education et les usages numériques.

4ffe0993abfd62b5ecc74ad4e5d5d1584b6e3afa.en: Découvrez les conséquences des chutes de météorites et leur lien avec le système solaire. Une exploration fascinante pour comprendre l'histoire de ces roches extraterrestres.

4d09132d895c9909e39d61b711118507deb6ebfb.en: Suivez l'histoire d'amour entre Pierre, employé d'hôtel à l'île Maurice, et Louise, une touriste française. Une séance de ciné banlieue pour découvrir une autre facette de l'île.

998cf9b66b071a809b07a2b45b01a0b161b53dfa.en: Traversez la France et l'Espagne à travers cette projection pour rejoindre Alger. Un voyage sur les traces des parents de Zano et Naïma.

c984ecfa6b7b5a2c75c8368151e7d7c5cd034f06.en: Découvrez les sculptures et dessins de Tanguy Bidou, où les objets se transforment en instruments. Une exposition à voir dès le vernissage au Conservatoire de Pantin.

2b7498e1560be1f22630367cc9f42f9b5eaaec72.en: Explorez les liens entre nos mondes intérieurs et les espaces que nous habitons grâce à ce réseau de performances. Chaque pièce met à l'épreuve les liens entre récit et perception du réel.

d5cff64fd6a35908b8aba1958674426f8252eeb9.en: Découvrez cette exposition collective et évolutive qui explore l'archive comme une matière vivante. Un dialogue entre les collections du Frac et des artistes de la scène tunisienne.

b2e8d155073a439830b16a9c4a3f6ff1575d0c49.en: Dancehall Big Party takes over California Avenue for a festive night featuring dancehall, afrobeat, and reggaeton hits across two rooms. Wear a floral item to receive a complimentary drink.

58ac2921d35bb351ef8c47222f409a678a859808.en: The Lassiry Hip Hop Festival features performances by Tizzy Miller and Thiird at La Place. Discover two distinct voices pushing the boundaries of rap through melodic and introspective artistry.

1351c9a4a87fa8447c35b80bb8fb3448914e868a.en: Sama' Abdulhadi takes over the Rex Club booth for an exclusive all-night-long electronic music journey. Experience an immersive extended set from the acclaimed artist.

70790788765526a9aa59d2b80453b382fd2068ba.en: Gigi Von Dredee hosts a lively drag bingo night at À la folie alongside Daisy Lusion. Enjoy musical performances, a DJ set, and fun prizes in a friendly atmosphere.

a3c3ddd0c6de2b614142c4e2daf76c542e6b0697.en: Tous les vendredis aux Étoiles, le Mini Club propose une fête sans prétention dans un ancien théâtre centenaire. Au programme : des sons pop, hip-hop et électro pour faire bouger le 10ème.

06f0f40ac5e3c801ea89b515d91bcb6d08ba1df0.en: Le 31 octobre 2026, la Péniche Henjo se transforme en bateau club hanté face à Notre-Dame. Venez profiter d'une vue panoramique, de DJs et de boissons offertes pour les personnes déguisées.

a1afaafa62e22e8bc14a67fdce8620d96e550ddf.en: Le California Avenue accueille l'édition spéciale Halloween de la soirée Projet X. Profitez de deux salles aux ambiances musicales différentes, de décors de films d'horreur et de tarifs réduits au bar.

c4986046653118cea6085ba5b4bb7ddc2d9da5cb.en: Le WorkshoW Paris vous invite à treize heures non-stop de fête LGBTQ+ inclusive pour le Nouvel An. Retrouvez des DJ sets de tribal house et une ambiance nocturne et diurne.

b73ad2b934741188d9bd2307c069af4fe68b71f3.en: Le Yoyo au Palais de Tokyo se transforme en manoir hanté pour le Bal des Monstres de l'Horreur 2026. Plus de 1300 invités sont attendus dans ce grand club pour une nuit d'Halloween mémorable.

708c4861661ba0afac879bd99d48bb51c5b25431.en: Le Fav Bar Restaurant Club présente Madame Shatta XL : Striptherapy & 911Gogo pour Halloween. Au programme : une ambiance infirmerie, cinq DJs et des styles allant du shatta à l'afrobeat.

02a4a3f27503ecbf7d4d5dbc68d37b98b33f641e.en: Laces, le projet solo de Dhali Sebie, présente son premier EP Mozaic aux Disquaires. Venez découvrir un univers mêlant post-punk, new wave et rythmes afrobeat dans un format live.

6bd10e9a778d3e931189bc820a17acc4946428c3.en: Le Klub accueille une soirée post-métal avec Baïkal, Le Grand Déclin et Hølls. Venez découvrir ces groupes aux influences trip-hop, doom et shoegaze le temps d'un concert.

4b98a010812c583e4c9feda2b239595fd1061912.en: La Péniche Babour Sauvage accueille la release party du groupe Take Time. Venez assister à un concert rock suivi d'un grand dancefloor pour fêter la sortie de leur premier EP.

b0504774c63faca2278833d37e742e49554922a8.en: Le chanteur belge GS se produit sur la scène de La Boule Noire. Venez découvrir son univers musical mêlant pop, rap, R&B et textures électroniques.

eb1a4667c38a9f17063439298509ab6d189652bc.en: Le groupe K-Pop NEWBEAT fait halte au Café de la Danse pour sa première tournée européenne, Break the Sound. Venez voir le septuor sur scène pour des performances énergiques.

40b77d2d2076ea1540f3e012f3bc921b79861e44.en: Le rappeur Mischa se produit au Canal 93 aux côtés de Saint Novah en première partie. Venez découvrir les couplets acérés de ces nouveaux talents de la scène rap.

78fbcd7d713edec655307dcc771cd570dbcc3622.en: Le Petit Bain fête ses deux ans avec une édition XXL de Hyperbrat. Retrouvez une programmation hyperpop et techno incluant un live de Ruby Nikara dans un espace queer et bienveillant.

0f306fbe5d4efb800aad9c981f2fbfef15f77e18.en: Le Trabendo accueille les Pitchfork Club Nights avec des b2b exclusifs entre Cinthie, Fafi Abdel Nour, Dylan Dylan et Mad Rey. Une nuit placée sous le signe de la house et de l'électro.

39809b19db4b12b82e0937ea771de3e229be88f3.en: Le Hasard Ludique célèbre les dix ans de l'association Les Aliennes avec Démuselé·es. Au programme : book club, tables rondes, stand-up, pole dance et DJ set féministes.

9a732c55672b39c7f22c35e3ead4fd90eeacecc7.en: Whitemary se produit au Badaboum pour présenter son univers électronique inspiré par la pop italienne. Membre du collectif Poche, elle manipule samplers et synthétiseurs analogiques sur scène.

31ca3fa732223db6e832e290504de5f5dc3fca77.en: Les Planches fêtent Halloween avec la deuxième édition de la résidence Balagan. Retrouvez un mélange de house et d'énergie club aux côtés des DJs Richard VDV, TDF et Gio Lucci.

fe14aa3219dace3ac11982129a43c60450e80620.en: The Ex s'associe à Brass Unbound à La Marbrerie pour une série de concerts improvisés. Le groupe poursuit son exploration musicale mêlant rock, jazz et cuivres.

cbde41fc9addd9f167eea283653d11c7ae4be3d0.en: Utopia Paris organise une nouvelle étape de son DJ Battle Tour. Venez assister aux performances des candidats et voter pour désigner le meilleur DJ de la soirée.

6c009ceebf7ee3d3f0450d894a316b91d2522f50.en: Le Generator Hostel accueille la soirée Halloween The Baddest Bitches are in Paris. Venez danser sur des DJ sets 100% pop aux côtés de vos artistes favorites dans une ambiance costumée.

4f674ed40ddc4641f7c3213373f371947d7fe977.en: Pygments returns to the 211 for an intimate all-night vinyl session exploring deeper, progressive sounds. Join Gabbor, Terminal Trax b2b In-Tan, and a secret guest for a sensory experience stretching from midnight to late morning.

8b40cf3f5e0e986b57f4853ce48272b49ba0d15f.en: Serane and Kasper939 take over La Machine du Moulin Rouge for a live show.

3964be2029bbcfd1292af27c446f20a174b098ee.en: Le 10e Ciel is a pop-up rooftop at the Pullman Tour Eiffel offering panoramic views of Paris, elegant cocktails, tapas, and electro chill DJ sets.

65369ead30451e26ef7a0e784e657f7c0a37b8bf.en: Soirée Nouvoné returns to Chez Prince for a night dedicated entirely to R&B and Hip Hop. Come dance to hits inspired by artists like Tyler The Creator, SZA, Beyonce, and Luidji.

5fa7381e710cf6cc58c40d3aa71be72daefdcac4.en: French pop band Apollone brings its blend of pop melodies, disco funk rhythms, and electronic programming to the Club Bus Palladium. Discover their new tracks ahead of their upcoming EP release.

7bfc31f5237c4c2d6e31a6ac46c5d8f7e78b6b5f.en: Club Vendome hosts a 100% Chris Brown and Usher party featuring a karaoke session, live performances, a dance battle, and a massive DJ set by Delrio.

6ae9e30141ef1f4382644dc912631a09c9fce655.en: Le Baiser Salé hosts its weekly Saturday night jam session featuring Valentin Caillon on vocals and piano. It is a late-night gathering open to vocalists, musicians, and live music lovers.

039e27274a4f3f0099d5506a4c270fbfc746cd2b.en: Step aboard Fluctuart every Saturday night for an eclectic music lineup, custom cocktails, and views of the Seine. It is an ideal way to leave the week behind and start your weekend.

6a5d486ac49830fc56da23483ae1c5da0e571be3.en: ØUT returns to the Rex Club for a queer-friendly night featuring techno, tribe, and acidcore sets by Avenir, Kou2tatane, and Saphire LeFleur. Expect a strict no-photo policy and a safe, inclusive atmosphere.

384d3351a7f9f79129e0f278383ffeb01721e4fc.en: High school students can tour Imprimerie Baron et Fils to discover the company's premises, daily operations, and professional environment. It is a chance to explore various printing careers and talk with industry professionals.

24df785924b1ec70ad4aec152ce227cb4d141ba4.en: Ambiance Lumière is an industrial SME specializing in custom lighting and luminous signage solutions for buildings, commerce, industry, and urban planning.

164dbd38cf48a0cf71e85d2bb2f3b29b09b1721b.en: Hexagone Manufacture invites you to discover the world leader in pool cleaning robotics. Meet industry professionals and learn about career opportunities within the company.

203b102efdc34899b049fda178592a0b12212cc1.en: The GRETA 93 agency hosts an information session at the Saint-Denis branch for its certified boilermaking training program. Learn about course content, admission requirements, and career opportunities.

991db29149c9520a28f2f4321d89a4c9668c9700.en: The second edition of ESUS 93 at the CCI Seine-Saint-Denis brings together solidarity-based enterprises and social economy actors. Join the morning sessions to discuss funding, public procurement, employment, and new partnerships.

44816e40c9b865d7fc7bbbc90a4417cc974e63a6.en: The Archives départementales de la Seine-Saint-Denis host a series of round tables exploring the history of documentary photography and photojournalism from 1951 to today. Professionals and historians discuss how photography shapes our understanding of reality and collective memory.

75d04241cbc7931451b967c64c81b4fbb789f702.en: Campus Condorcet hosts a public camera obscura workshop with Oscura during the Printemps des Humanités. Visitors can observe, create, and develop large-format images while exploring social sciences and photographic practices.

77e878a6b6a6500d9edef7b85d10fac5017e20c7.en: The Studio Frank Horvat presents an exclusive audio-guided visit of the photographer's personal collection. Listen to recorded conversations between Frank Horvat and fellow photographers like Robert Doisneau, Josef Koudelka, and Helmut Newton discussing their work.

e3ee8eab19b2fae4076bbf5dade216b4d352b9e5.en: Studio Harcourt shares the secrets behind its iconic lighting and portraiture expertise during a specialized photography production workshop.

8d369a169993d3584cf0b0509f82634b5c90a030.en: Galerie christian berst art brut presents À l'intérieur, an exhibition pairing 19th- and early 20th-century police and judicial photographs with drawings by incarcerated outsider artists. The collection examines themes of surveillance, confinement, and power dynamics.

a28a46a74f4f001432baba15d8e57f608de3aae0.en: Librairie 7L hosts an exhibition by Noémie Ninot as part of PhotoSaintGermain, featuring her photographic project exploring cellular chimerism and female identity across three generations of women.

3d337d6fd5931158ebec384385d891f2b0826a88.en: The Archives de Paris present an exhibition exploring the diverse uses of photographs from the nineteenth to twenty-first centuries. Visitors can discover thirty original documents that highlight how photographs serve as proof, testimony, and artistic expression.

7b96b9777d9610e5a82f2fd9c048347c7641964e.en: La Fondation Francès offers its first retrospective photographic collection focusing on humanity and its excesses. The exhibition examines how photography captures social, cultural, and political transformations over the past twenty years.

a40c66878c7ab2e5c0aa050beecea26d41b5ffa8.en: Galerie Frank Elbaz hosts an exhibition featuring major works by Kunié Sugiura spanning over six decades of her artistic practice. The selection highlights her experimental approach combining photography, painting, and sculpture.

86987147bb6febb84cfee882c2f3a6a5154b7faf.en: Polka Galerie presents Irina Werning's award-winning series capturing animal fairs in Buenos Aires. The visual narrative explores the quiet connection between humans and horses as rural traditions change.

a1f67bcf2db9df2717694987b1f89476d492b572.en: La Contemporaine showcases the photographic archives of photoreporter Didier Lefèvre, featuring his notable journey to Afghanistan in 1986. The exhibition highlights his long-term dedication to documentary storytelling.

f8e6547a35c3f9d20a55081eaaaa41bfada2e968.en: Dominique de Font-Réaulx and Quentin Bajac lead a guided tour of the Louvre Photo exhibition. Visitors can discover over three hundred photographs exploring the Louvre as a subject, source of inspiration, and museum space.

2885d8325fd91110cf2a24772c791784890fe277.en: Parc Montsouris hosts family nature sessions for parents and children aged three to ten. Participants can enjoy nature adventures, yoga breaks, and hands-on creative workshops together.

50aadea23e52f186c6ad33f3955baa9713410c1f.en: Le Temps des Cerises invites participants aged seven and up to explore and discuss everyday objects from the past that have disappeared. This intergenerational session encourages sharing memories about how new items change our daily routines.

6424d7cc5a62fc86807fd2cb4195d371411b36a9.en: Le Temps des Cerises hosts a family creative workshop for children aged three to six inspired by Ilya Green's book Mon arbre. Families can tear, rub, and assemble papers and origami to craft their own paper trees together.

e3052bc37444af533e2d7c103750cb5ed884e09b.en: Le Temps des Cerises opens its Digital Museum for a free exploration of curated collections and cultural themes. Visitors of all ages can discover digital artworks and chat with a mediator.

21acd07879899bbf6f8e78c40fbf43bd7c63d10d.en: The Cité des sciences et de l'industrie hosts soap bubble demonstrations and hands-on activities. Visitors can learn how soap bubbles are made and experiment with creating larger shapes.

f5b1b6b546f99fd9233228d6da8929055d2b3271.en: The Cité des sciences et de l'industrie invites space enthusiasts to join the astronaut school for a mission to Mars. Participants can tackle obstacles in this space-themed adventure linked to the space exhibition.

647fc08a8035c32dc99ad61b9b1ba2cfb559f6d3.en: The Cité des sciences et de l'industrie offers continuous astronomy activities including star chart construction and meteorite recognition. Visitors can explore the solar system and learn about key figures in space science.

641a8d9218edc15c47631637eda817281deb068a.en: The Cité des sciences et de l'industrie offers thirty-minute professional coaching sessions with certified coaches from the EMCC. Visitors can receive support on confidence building, stress management, and career transitions.

5aeb8c38fdd8c806dd1bb01cfb45e4e248708e3e.en: Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte offers an introductory astronomy session to help observers identify visible stars. An astronomer guides visitors on a journey from the Earth's surface to the edge of the universe.

481fc433f876137ffe0ea4cb29d247e90e7ede36.en: Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte presents an interactive mathematics session adapted to visitor questions. The mediation reveals mathematics as a living and evolving discipline.

1d5c6d62fc9f8c6b00c10d8491851aaa4d3a169f.en: The Cité des sciences et de l'industrie presents a permanent exhibition exploring the genealogy of matter over 13.7 billion years. Visitors can discover the origins of atoms and the physical laws shaping our universe across two levels.

eb65d5e080360c63bef01f3cf56a66d4f287e816.en: The Cité des sciences et de l'industrie features an aquarium showcasing various fish, crustaceans, and molluscs from Mediterranean shores such as Corsica, Sardinia, and Greece.

cc3fdb55dcf13a1a0c37a155ee8e2431ed237d26.en: Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte hosts a quiz on blood and its components for individuals and groups. Participants can learn about blood types, medical history, and transfusion facts.

1726cc500ba59d18a9df9479f343b880e33f6d7d.en: Explore hot spot volcanoes with an eminent volcanologist during an open house at the PSHIT laboratory. Discover the secrets of effusive volcanoes on the slopes of the Piton de la Fournaise.

3c43e1b671360f66e56fe8320037258f6dcd436c.en: Find reliable medical information and answers to your health questions at the Cité de la santé. This documentation resource center is designed for visitors of all ages.

79168fccd3351f8a79855601cc271ee76fae8c10.en: Share knowledge and explore visual creation across generations during this collaborative workshop. It offers a dedicated space for artistic exchange and creation.

00bc23351b7f6ac745cacfcf2cdc7b2408b22fbf.en: Nine refugees who escaped the conflict in Gaza share their stories through this moving screening and discussion event. A stark map of the region guides their testimonies on stage.

88b3f81eb62c13e60bebe66c650456f55b937ac1.en: Follow the journey of a dedicated truck driver struggling to balance his passion for the road with his personal life. This screening is followed by a discussion with the director and screenwriter.

08c7495ee88628d3700421958068d5f082e19d61.en: Enjoy a screening of Le Sixième sens as part of the Nuit Halloween du Luxy. The evening features themed snacks and horror animations throughout the night.

727b2b7d8a6e9bc16bec0053633da44f9b3d2d9b.en: Follow Gabin, a young man from northern France torn between loyalty to his family's butcher shop and his own dreams. A touching film exploring personal freedom and family expectations.

225aa0b7581198c31fe56605875bdae766432159.en: Discover the history of the Unknown Soldier and the Flame of Remembrance during a special guided tour this November. Conclude the visit by attending the flame rekindling ceremony on the parvis.

db51d8edb7c70c9bdbc8af65065c9d91189259ad.en: Journey back in time to explore how medieval scholars understood comets, seasons, and supernovas. This exhibition highlights the evolution of astronomical knowledge through history.

820f2a018ce5caeb0210f4eea3608ee269a52271.en: Discover a century of photography through vintage cameras and historical prints housed in a unique mobile museum. The exhibition features interactive modules including 3D photography and motion workshops.

6c48900ea29068d4dd0f71a0913534925f0b95ad.en: Explore the earliest photographs of Vanuatu taken between 1885 and 1895 within the collections of the musée du quai Branly - Jacques Chirac. The exhibition highlights the territory and its communities amidst colonial tensions.

c7b2463095a2209640e5b15b10119d73fa255f39.en: Explore the fascinating boundary between contemporary drawing and photography through an innovative collective exhibition. Discover how modern artists draw inspiration from photographic images.

58856e12e07c58044eb1267f27f3c2cd0c36bc3d.en: Young participants can invent hospital-themed scenes, dress up, and transform their own photos into personalized stories. Create funny or touching comic strips using custom text and speech bubbles.

da764fdd50c12ccce51438da60e5b4baf8617655.en: Join a discussion and showcase exploring the place of women and gender minorities in the music industry. Artist Lisa Li-Lund will share her experiences regarding professional inequalities and creative challenges.

00a850fe0629b12c2e847446d99cfe89ae2a785d.en: Discover the historical events behind the notorious mass possession case in 17th-century Loudun. This screening retraces Cardinal Richelieu's political maneuvers against autonomous governance.

618e6e5a28d2ccce927ad4ec5f1da2c83f9cb55d.en: Immerse yourself in a surreal VR experience inspired by Laurentis's album Musicalism. Slip on a headset to explore glowing landscapes where sounds transform into visual art.

1e7698c59972b254ecb509aee9a15449abe8f1f6.en: Children can craft their own objects using instructions found in books selected by the library staff. A fun hands-on activity blending reading and creation.

b7d58a7634d4d35ecdc807be520aaf28d5dfc999.en: Entrepreneurs can learn how to optimize their professional image, master colorimetry, and improve non-verbal communication. This workshop helps strengthen credibility and business impact.

0e1e2b327462007adb19b7fa4a254166fe2814da.en: Discover how the human heart functions as a powerful electric pump that circulates blood throughout the body. Volunteers can participate in live recordings of heart sounds and electrical signals.

b16d0f866a2aba3c1ba0ba8d3127737d63ba305c.en: Explore the mysteries of the Earth's magnetic field at Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte. Discover what current research teaches us about its long-standing characteristics.

f7868bd46323c21fa862b497bdc42d96a7b6c12b.en: Test your brain power and learn about the nervous system through fun experiments at the Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie. A surrealist-inspired exhibition that highlights how we learn.

8f02dc1414841a9afdfd981bdeeda7844f4e2f74.en: Visit Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte to build a detailed model of the heart with a mediator. Understand how the cardiac cycle works and the role of this central organ.

73ba9825949c35795007cc556c8676cea17f6ce7.en: Customise your windows at the Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie by creating anti-collision stickers for birds. Design your own patterns and cut them out to take home.

986a35c43a171c9d0684a4e6cb2c1e83fc9e5aa5.en: Learn how forensic scientists analyze clues from crime scenes at Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte. Simple experiments explain the principles behind sophisticated investigative methods.

91280ba19668ad4cdd2d4de3c33f1aafc7f9efc6.en: Discover the link between color and wavelength through simple experiments at Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte. See how colors appear and change before your eyes.

11bdb92934d3cc25a19a71c571b40859460dc55d.en: Singer Yar presents an intimate tribute to Brazilian icon Elis Regina at JASS CLUB. Enjoy classic bossa nova and samba in a powerful performance.

8a540e2c436e678ef78ba3fe581b5f236fb61fd6.en: Emma Caly Quartet celebrates a century of jazz and songwriting at JASS CLUB. Enjoy a blend of American standards, bossa nova, and modern jazz.

4b81548d9206bff7ba8c94f8b7e92e118d49a5d9.en: Blue Mood invites you to a sensory musical experience for the Nuit des Conservatoires 2027 at the Salle des fêtes of Bondy. Lie down, close your eyes, and let yourself drift.

7eae52d7e4156b33cf459d7e9b32d43e73884beb.en: Des luttes et des rêves is a popular cabaret celebrating the local territory through song and musical theater at Salle André Malraux. Created by local conservatories and vocal ensembles.

caea0b89550ffe295031c71ac5704a3d2a42ae46.en: Watch a unique performance at Studio Le Regard du Cygne that explores the creation of paper from plant fibers and water. Dance meets living materials and the flight of kites.

3af1fdbc593c1feedaf94613deb972b382aa141f.en: Meet poet Tahar Bekri at Université Paris Nanterre for a reading and discussion. Students will share translations of his poems in Arabic and French.

2e8139407ddf2fdc44400495c91ab76df650ccf5.en: Experience Monteverdi's music as a living dance at La Philharmonie de Paris with Les Cris de Paris. Seven singers and seven instrumentalists perform in a stripped-down staging.

43f032b03e346d929552a5195e7664c2ad075540.en: Juste Irena at Theatre Le Colombier tells the story of a 94-year-old former resistance fighter who saved thousands of children during World War II. Go to experience a polymorphous show blending actors and object puppets to explore courage and humanity.

f36f5aa6c9771e00c495f508e06b2883483f98b4.en: Join the ADOPT'TON IA event at CCI Paris Île-de-France to explore artificial intelligence for your business. Participate in practical workshops and meet AI solution providers.

8376c958290f0107fc24e67d196abfbaa3de8c29.en: Explore the Hauts-de-Seine department through a 92-kilometer cycling loop inspired by the Tour de France. Discover cultural sites and natural spaces at your own pace.

c241a7935d6cbdda486e745882e2f6dcbd820b46.en: See Victor Hugo's masterpiece Ruy Blas at the Comédie-Française, directed by Julie Duclos. A romantic drama about a valet who loves a queen.

36f4ea4aebd40ca3688baccff60a05516d71220c.en: Attend the Forum Emploi Handicap at the Conseil régional d'Île-de-France to meet employers and training organizations. Get personalized advice to help build your professional project.

84dd9117782b358d71b841ada95c8ac81d1bc9ed.en: At L'Avant Seine, children take part in two workshops to create and personalise their own articulated puppet, then bring it to life through games and sketches.

bd414540335e2cd1f5f8a42f11f6a53e25d43ad1.en: The Cité des Sports hosts a week-long camp for 11 to 14-year-olds combining morning rock climbing sessions with afternoon academic support in French or mathematics.

88a863059213b66a9dd96d973a0c9036d4f308f0.en: At BARLONE, Hélène Barrier presents an exhibition featuring minotaur drawings upstairs and whimsical Eden-inspired frescoes in the basement.

a630d618d146252f9c85457a320b1958c2b10cff.en: Follow the adventures of Gramblanc, a white clown driven by instinctive vitality and a love of life, in this performance at BARLONE.

cf33e97e802614cc7ea898b3535c689a358f6f9d.en: 8ruki performs live in concert at L'Élysée Montmartre.

a9be0f542d394b15b18853861c728cf0a30d63a0.en: Le Kilowatt hosts a 100% Chinese Man Records party featuring BOLD, Rumble, ASM, and Tha Trickaz for a night spanning hip-hop, dub, trap, and electronic music.

82aff1807561f78fd0ee7447bc8e0d89009125f2.en: The Bateau Concorde Atlantique hosts a monthly 90s and 2000s retro party across two dance floors and a terrace, featuring the biggest hits of the era.

1490bf65fb736733f5fe40ef2e063d6fe5b3a5d0.en: French rap figure Dosseh performs at La Cigale for a concert celebrating his latest projects and milestone career.

3923100a1fb6fa447bc147501bac1502a7f3734b.en: ESTL performs at Les Étoiles, bringing her delicate piano-driven songwriting and intimate, melodic storytelling to the stage.

fc3ca9859a1be9aec53b4e2dc8bf5db278f346b4.en: Goldie Boutilier performs at L'Élysée Montmartre, supported by Ugly Ozo, with a show exploring themes of nostalgia, femininity, and self-expression.

411524f6e3521efe1f9a34bc3fe92b89a82ef220.en: Oscar les Vacances celebrates the release of his album at the Maison des Métallos with an intimate and energetic live show blending French chanson and electronic pop.

2cc5c4ac403fedab5c0a41b205ab080efc0ba7c8.en: The Bateau Concorde Atlantique hosts an inclusive Halloween party featuring three dark musical and visual universes for a night of thrills.

a885dc2c902677e99eef50a58b59275765ff168b.en: Jasmine Not Jafar hosts a live techno release party at FGO-Barbara, blending brat girl power attitude with heavy bass and hypnotic synthesizer melodies.

fd1a30b550b2f3eb2b2b2c82eb544763087ce68f.en: Ben Klock presents Photon at Phantom Paris for a night of electronic music.

db45064368fd4ee5635feb10af639b0d4bde12a2.en: Daysy and Cobalt stop at Studio Raspail for an intimate acoustic tour featuring guitar melodies and shared emotions.

Through photography, film, and installation, the exhibition highlights diverse individual trajectories and shared social realities.

7a2eb6825346ab5e826101c9d1738c9ad4a792d7.en: Galerie Dix9 presents an eclectic collective exhibition exploring masks through sculpture, painting, photography, and video. The artworks examine both the physical materials and the symbolic, social dimensions of masking.

701cd07ebbc9b56a27df6150ade45a3e43fe0dc0.en: The Galerie Zander exhibits rare, early black-and-white photographs by Tina Barney capturing American social life in the late 1970s.

a66c9d4ec796a862a81ebd297a5e853829fc5649.en: Zen Lefort's exhibition at Spirale Galerie explores the communities and physical divisions along Belfast's Peace Line.

8762990de2c98f760efaee1c6a59cc8384421800.en: The Galerie du Crous presents photographic projects exploring geopolitics, water resources, and the landscapes of Ukraine, Asia, and the Dead Sea.

42561891a5f36bb975b2665bcbf92c9af1eaebf2.en: View the photography exhibition by Lukas Hoffmann at Galerie C as part of the local gallery photography trail.

3a60fafcc80cb11e83bc81ffe6118a6ac55ec908.en: Deyrolle displays a historical collection of glass lantern slides exploring geography, science, and education from the early 20th century.

974fb3caa14ebeae4824da93b2e1daa00a710bb2.en: Enjoy a brief 20-minute introductory tour of the Louvre Photo exhibition, exploring the museum through more than 300 photographs.

141131b28b49912d61244164fb14d288c8439d5d.en: Diskoteekki is a musical comedy by Nicole Genovese performed with Les Percussions de Strasbourg, transforming a bleak bingo hall into a vibrant disco.

f515bebc7bcd33bae3b0cfe6d1e5ea5cad67921a.en: [poíēsis] is a poetic immersion at Théâtre des 2 Rives featuring two actors who connect us to ourselves and each other. Go to experience a live poetic montage that explores rich, multiple identities and a shared world.

4e769fc95287903f3a8d507418992b12d513d61e.en: Le Voyage de Kristoffer at Les Gémeaux is a diptych for youth featuring the play Kant and an immersive journey exploring the universe. It blends art, science, and philosophy to make doubt a tool for curiosity and dialogue.

192068759865c5790afd043127957afbaaba5ae9.en: Menart Fair 2026 at Galerie Joseph is Europe's only art fair dedicated to the Middle East, North Africa, and their diasporas. Attend to explore diverse contemporary artworks, attend conferences, and meet international artists.

148837b9d695ce45d278955210cc369f3a5ea313.en: Frantz at Conservatoire Léo Delibes brings to life the story of a young man dealing with his father's disappearance using everyday objects and live soundscapes. It offers a sensory, inventive theatrical experience for the whole family.

ef38d2875229dc52fb5a45687f56994174314ad9.en: Les chats sont-ils liquides ? at the Palais de la découverte is a scientific conference answering an unexpected question with rheologist Marc-Antoine Fardin. Attend to satisfy your curiosity and learn about current research in a fun format.

5fffbe0f234fb7c75147a66f2996b2d221933293.en: Une foule peut-elle se synchroniser sans se concerter? at the Palais de la découverte is a scientific conference hosted by physicist Denis Bartolo. Go to explore unexpected research questions guided by science communicator Alice Thomas.

d61ce137168b9bbf82b9dd1edaeba589367ea557.en: Transparence at the Palais de la découverte inaugurates the Palais des enfants with a poetic exploration of transparency. Young visitors can enjoy interactive displays and optical effects that play with perception.

71084fed60796ebda3d901d2ab963ec150a0f2c7.en: A Drop of Poison at Auditorium Angèle et Roger Tribouilloy is an emotional musical journey through Tom Waits's America of the forgotten. Go to hear original compositions and soulful performances by Claude Whipple, Leïla Soldevila, and Jean-Pascal Molina.

4ffd577043edccb74237bba9c915d983d6d257a3.en: Experience an evening of jazz and maloya during the jam session at JASS CLUB with Abraham Réunion. It is an essential meeting point for emerging and established artists to share music on stage.

8c460bd144e8e32c27631e1decc781885720ba87.en: The Sandro Zerafa Limestone Quartet performs at JASS CLUB, blending jazz tradition with bold influences from Malta to Brazil. Go to hear guitarist Sandro Zerafa alongside Noé Huchard, Yoni Zelnik, and Francesco Ciniglio.

35c5d20538a74538259020afce230db094bdb5d2.en: The Forum Emploi Est Ensemble 2026 at the Hôtel de Ville de Bondy brings together around sixty recruiters and job seekers for non-discriminatory hiring. Attendee benefits include thematic workshops, job dating, and direct exchanges with public employment actors.

299623b1f869c76a70b019e34d2e2643d89eaac1.en: Les 3 Fromages celebrate their 20th anniversary with Magoyond at L'Olympia. Go to experience a high-energy evening of rock, theatrical metal, and festive performances.

7ba53ce92bb2819132ba7c10f4a19af4b81006b6.en: 63OG brings his unique DMV flow and bilingual rap to L'Olympia. Go to see the rising artist take the stage for a major headline show in Paris.

6ebf75905446dc6a89509ff5f6417d9c712cbb30.en: GLK performs live at La Cigale for his first major concert event. Go to experience the French rap heavyweight performing hits from his career.

ea48fb681f698e597f63c458958f915874b8d6d9.en: Lucas Seb brings his vibrant kompa and Caribbean rhythms to La Cigale with a full band. Go to dance to a modern mix of afro, Latin, and R&B influences.

417f4c7590c1bb53a4533a69d2cf97d96652c96b.en: Frankie and the Witch Fingers bring their high-energy psych-punk sound to Le Trabendo. Go to hear tracks from their album Data Doom exploring technological dystopia.

cb2891b582e8c49b9d186aac184f66f5972e314b.en: KERMESSE at Théâtre Romain Rolland uses the traditional group dance of the chenille to question shame, ridicule, and social connection. Go to experience a thought-provoking theatrical project that turns a simple dance into a social experiment.

7e4838ec8a29975ff63626dd2eb2b11348bb9cbf.en: Visites Spectacles offers immersive walking tours of Paris featuring professional actors in costume. Explore neighborhoods through theatrical outdoor plays, puzzle games, and storytelling.

9be929a9627cdd4c17ef0b41316bc46cd5d5c830.en: Join an 8-hour sourdough bread-making workshop at Éco-atelier Pierre Rabhi with culinary animator Vanessa. Learn the complete baking process, share a communal lunch, and take home your own bread and recipes.

aebf1872b1aac25b95d18fa41097ef848e8c1774.en: The Cité des sciences et de l'industrie offers interactive permanent and temporary exhibitions on technology, space, and the earth. Children aged 5 to 10 can also explore a dedicated discovery trail at the Cité des enfants.

20e18c9e7d5701cfee170997388d3d2462f2708b.en: Explore interactive and playful permanent and temporary exhibitions at the Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie. Discover topics ranging from health and life sciences to the environment, mathematics, and video games.

94792924da5b8be6b57f82aed3c85300fa92c41d.en: Nursing students starting their end-of-studies dissertation can attend a coaching workshop at the Cité de la santé. Learn to identify key concepts and use specialized documentary resources in partnership with the SETES editions.

d830eb7e4fff2078e33189e66ce6a06dd74b22a0.en: Le Temps des Cerises hosts a family origami and art workshop suitable for children aged 5 and up in partnership with the Musée Marmottan Monet. Explore Claude Monet's inspirations and create a delicate water-lily basin.

057cd3b24b68fa44a7b418f83ee436d0fd189e24.en: Discover the machines and equipment of the Minilab during open house sessions at Le Temps des Cerises. Book a one-hour time slot to learn how to use the workshop tools.

61c186417c4a4fba28972d04eb91e7f6c4dd3e56.en: Discover how photographic innovations shaped movements like Pop Art through a themed workshop at the Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie. Use photo retouching tools to transform your portrait into a vibrant artwork.

d08ee76c039a93d4c1756dd406c045f880662bdc.en: The Club égalité professionnelle at the Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie brings together employment and guidance professionals. Participants network and build tools to promote professional equality and mixed employment.

7ecee90576158f1446f8f5ac27f4011fb0685fdd.en: Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte hosts mathematical recreation workshops for visitors aged 9 and up. Experiment, reason, and solve puzzles together using objects like the Conway cube and the Towers of Hanoi.

63b6ea148f68202acdb9f03ca073a8cc3e23cad8.en: Step into the shoes of an astronaut and explore current and future space missions at the Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie. The exhibition covers research, space technologies, and the realities of space travel across five themed sections.

8fab6ab83ef1c5eda5c12f657ec94b85a2ee7afd.en: The Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie hosts a photo display by ADEME highlighting French industrial projects from France 2030. Young visitors can also meet an AI researcher to discuss modern industrial careers.

5579997e2a2b4da7171497e7ca83f2254a69ea3c.en: Debunk common myths and misconceptions about the human brain during an interactive quiz at Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte. Share your views and separate scientific facts from widespread beliefs.

97bbca547999322153c00014e65dcd1b25fde635.en: At Le Grand Action, the residents of Hope face an isolated and growing threat when communications are cut and emergency services are deployed elsewhere. Some villagers try to protect their home while others venture into the dangerous mountains.

b931fd807f1e2085776912328c4d64631fa8281e.en: Bibliothèque Jules Verne and partner libraries in Pantin host reading sessions for young children aged 0 to 3. Enjoy shared stories within capacity limits and register on-site.

9241cf301f47722fbb29e7d9093f504a853f7b9d.en: Practice your French and prepare for language tests with free resources and online exercises available in Pantin. Librarians also host free conversation workshops for anyone over 12 looking to improve their language skills.

8b62e3ddf3edff02e988c8a7228fb624117b92f9.en: The Conservatoire Jacques Higelin de Pantin presents the Ballet's Days de Pantin to celebrate classical ballet. Professionals and amateurs alike can attend open classes, round tables, and demonstrations exploring the evolution of dance.

e2ff9e8d1955eaa53822aea43c45e66707668e36.en: The Théâtre et Cinéma Georges Simenon presents a costume screening featuring Petit Vampire, a three-hundred-year-old vampire who wants to go to school to make a friend.

c17b198f3be8787e539782bc01b47a4909676737.en: Espace Jean Vilar hosts a film club screening of Suspiria, following a young American woman who arrives in Fribourg to attend a prestigious dance academy with a strange atmosphere.

62bc66f63ac189b0e363bf743fcc79101129d2fe.en: La Manufacture Chanson welcomes Albane Aubry for a poetic pop-rock concert featuring electro-pop-rock arrangements by Samuel Cajal. Discover her new EP Dans la forêt during this musical journey through nature.

16daac58fa58cbd85cbe2b6835eec164e2e25a2c.en: An exhibition featuring photos of hospitalized children and young participants from the Papillons blancs de Paris photo workshops. It offers a touching look at their creative journeys.

a5c6c7df20246c9596c3c662cfb559af2366af60.en: Follow a young girl on a poetic forest journey in this sensory theatrical adventure for young children. It explores identity, friendship, and simple pleasures through music and gentle dialogue.

bdbd73c73434424112f0148ec7abda1c9720eac1.en: An immersive burlesque cabaret celebrating feminist erotism and the power of the female body in a historic monument. Three artists use song and dance to break the oppressive codes of the early 20th-century brothel.

6c2aadd36a3024db15f1e57aad0d0e6aa2dc9657.en: A staged reading of Iman Kerroua's award-winning play about family silences, exile, and healing. Presented by Compagnie Mama Luna as part of the Théâtre du Rond-Point's emerging artist support.

6178e4a4fce60b052657aed04825f3db28576cef.en: Robert Wilson and Isabelle Huppert return for a special run of their acclaimed performance. It captures the final, intense moments of Mary Stuart, Queen of Scotland, as she faces her execution and reflects on a life of passion.

696e94cc1b6eb7d229f447e81eb10b4f6cd69e48.en: Cette fiction théâtrale explore la reconstruction des familles d'accueil et des enfants placés. Un spectacle sensible qui place la joie au centre de ses récits.

2eaa9e00bf74ff9b3fcd99aa8982794e45299d4d.en: The New Zealand psych-rock band No Cigar brings their groovy guitar riffs and catchy rhythms to the stage. Known for dynamic live performances, they celebrate their latest albums shaped in part by their time in France.

eb9fde5185d9a4aa86d3621a7e4ec40cb28b89b1.en: Catch 34murphy live for an exclusive show at La Gaîté Lyrique.

ea3e4718357471566d9cd99532cac5c8db24fa7c.en: The French duo Bonne Nuit brings their indie pop melodies to Le Trabendo for a festive live concert.

4f98b1169655b637b250a5ff90e67847ab5d1af5.en: Rising rap and pop artist a6el takes the stage at La Cigale following a string of sold-out shows and a successful debut EP. At just 20 years old, this promises to be a milestone performance for the young artist.

9846b09a7f37765a60b8076c94195d6f8dc3aa65.en: An open and lively jazz night featuring the TANA quartet alongside guest saxophonist Béryl Benveniste. The evening pairs original compositions with jazz standards before opening up into a festive jam session.

cbc335946eadfcc27cb48f5dca30aa03db6118ee.en: A gentle storytelling show for young children about a curious boy who gets lost and discovers the wider world. It features rhythmic words, unfolding landscapes, and live songs.

e81f6284b39f705f1933d7637ea8877e8c0807ab.en: A contemporary dance performance by Compagnie DK-BEL featuring seven dancers with and without disabilities. The piece explores human relationships, power dynamics, and resilience through energetic and poetic choreography.

c9bdf6837ca8991baa368ecc3eacd430cefa3092.en: An exhibition showcasing municipal archives that trace the collective history of Fontenay-sous-Bois from the late 19th to the early 21st century. It highlights local community life through sports, celebrations, and shared gatherings.

79e95e7cfe9a45f5df8dd72447750a39f0311d29.en: An exhibition pairing Robert Frank’s intimate Mabou series from Nova Scotia with John Cohen’s photographs of the Beat Generation during the filming of Pull My Daisy. It explores two distinct chapters in Frank’s artistic journey.

98627451227ff0e3dc4a386d963c4fb9ad3e05a0.en: A cultural cycle dedicated to traditional black-and-white silver printing featuring master printer Fred Goyeau. The program includes an exhibition of his series Saving Daylight, workshops, and artist talks.

6ca964f67dd622c41116f167f94401a7642e29c5.en: An exhibition showcasing the daily life and historical events captured by photojournalist Jean Marquis between 1951 and 1983. Featuring work from his time with Magnum Photos, it highlights Parisian streets and international reportage.

df1e2dbe8d695b2c459427710982731f801c3427.en: A public lecture by Bronwyn Lace and Neo Muyanga exploring (post)colonial photographic collections in African worlds. Part of a seminar series at Université Paris 8, it brings artists and researchers together to interrogate archival practices.

9a2bb4554fe8680cf00ab4488a4ffdb8354417e8.en: This conference series at the Maison de la Recherche explores (post)colonial photographic collections in African worlds. It offers students and the public a collaborative space for methodological sharing and dialogue with researchers and artists.

0b850b13962e99d3c42e85038b80101a29c4d5f9.en: This exhibition by Jacqueline Salmon at the Musée d'art et d'histoire Paul Eluard explores the variations of the perizonium in depictions of the Crucifixion. Through a vast collection of images, the artist invites visitors on a visual and spiritual journey.

b61b8ee6e11dfbcdc8b50f548f14e6c930303f98.en: This exhibition by Mélissa Boucher Morales at Galerie Jocelyn Wolff is part of the photography parcours organized by the Comité Professionnel des Galeries d'Art.

4a748f498818c4ee54bd31c252e7debe23e0c8b0.en: La Bibliothèque presents a special documentary screening about Félix Tournachon, known as Nadar, the first great portraitist in photography history. The event celebrates photography month using National Library archives and graphic animation.

50c7ca14bf3eb656fecefb699dbed3dddb7b6347.en: This exhibition at the Musée d'Orsay highlights the multidisciplinary talent of Gustave Le Gray, one of the 19th century's most celebrated photographers. Visitors can discover major yet overlooked works displayed in their creative context for the first time.

2e438353d0ae129d0bed55aa6730b5a6b5369cc2.en: At Polka Galerie, photographer Claude Nori presents a major retrospective and book titled La Dolce Vista. The exhibition explores memory, cinema, and a luminous nostalgia through a collection of natural backdrops and personal souvenirs.

a950362d3782c3c5431586f942b7c5dccee652ff.en: Japanese instrumental rock band MONO performs live at Cabaret Sauvage, bringing their deeply emotive blend of rock and classical music. Known for their powerful and euphoric live shows, they are recognized as one of the world's best live acts.

a1b3d6bfc402af0ec16fccfc6d63f4aba8f21618.en: Chassol and Ala.ni perform live at Paul B, featuring a bar and light refreshments on site starting with doors opening in the evening.

86220fb6b2c6cfd3636d3195dfdbdc72ec055316.en: Duo Charlotte Fever brings their signature synth-pop and magnetic stage presence to La Maroquinerie to celebrate the release of their second album. Expect an intense and sensory evening exploring contradictory emotions.

8fe016b725de76f707b29fb9c308239c31532a59.en: Theo Juice performs a one-night-only concert at the Alhambra Théâtre Music-Hall Show.

682c97a6de4d6c0381f107afb7003bd546f5c1e8.en: Spanish indie-pop and rock trio Siloé performs live at the Café de la Danse. Known for blending emotional lyricism with electronic elements and stage energy, the band brings their unique musical universe to Paris.

f59fd3ad3d8be8788af98ddd6da183ad509617e1.en: Guinean artist AK performs live at La Place, blending rap, afro-urban rhythms, and modern sounds. Known for his charismatic stage presence, he delivers introspective and poetic lyrics rooted in his heritage.

46f9d8ca7171ee6e531940e5c015f0a5a665a6cb.en: American band feeble little horse performs at La Bellevilloise to present their third album, bitknot. The show features their signature blend of fuzzy harmonies, synthesizers, and intricate indie-pop arrangements.

ae3b618e888582d69b0473f60709c75e8c92cb62.en: Nonsense Montmartre presents Donky Tonk featuring Massi and Band, blending folk, rock, and blues with an organic live energy. The evening includes a chic dress code, food by Julien Sebbag, and an afterparty DJ set.

3f971efffe28df204dbca279a2e67531bb91e1a4.en: Australian artist Ella Thompson performs at Les Trois Baudets, bringing her powerful voice and contemporary soul sound. It is an ideal concert for fans of authentic soul music and emotional performances.

0faec3f90c1b56a6542a34891e3682f9ff772b43.en: Tiki Playa hosts a Full Moon Fluo Party across multiple rooms and levels with immersive decor and tropical vibes. Guests can enjoy extended happy hours on drinks, homemade pizzas, tapas, and a club atmosphere.

3d6187b20649e2d150b1d9a841b772587b43069a.en: Casa Loca hosts a 2000s-themed party featuring international hits, disco, pop, and hip-hop across a festive bar and restaurant space. Attendees can enjoy discounted drinks, tapas, wood-fired pizzas, and a lively dance floor.

54abda62ddf602d99b69539d17d561f9065d14e1.en: SHĀHERI and Band perform at Nonsense in Montmartre, blending Persian musical heritage with psychedelic rock and cinematic grooves. Led by Jonathan Shaheri, the project offers an immersive live experience with a chic dress code and food by Julien Sebbag.

9c072257e11e3cc596628e36d31966e235163482.en: La Bellevilloise hosts VENDREDIXXL, a vibrant queer event featuring a glamorous cabaret, live electro-pop and alternative music, and multiple dance floors. Attendees can also enjoy outdoor spaces and a dedicated social zone.

ef92018847534f9836c29113adcbe168a87f0319.en: British producer and singer Nia Archives performs at CENTQUATRE-PARIS as part of her Emotional World Tour. Known for her vibrant fusion of jungle, drum 'n' bass, and neo-soul, she brings her fresh electronic sound to the stage.

d2e59604c6b1c895d63de9fd6721e1be916396a1.en: Le Point Fort d'Aubervilliers hosts the closing night of the Villes des Musiques du Monde festival, paying tribute to Colombian music legend Totó La Momposina with family, friends, and special guests.

40cf19e2f4feb1378a91414d2d0101e08747f377.en: ROAR takes over the Institut du Judo for nine hours of hard rave and techno, featuring a custom LED stage design and an explosive line-up in a legendary dojo.

d2f08b4d6810447825f1d2069deb4837986311e2.en: At Les Trois Baudets, 22-year-old neoclassical pianist and TikTok phenomenon Juan Arenosa presents his deeply personal and cinematic debut album, Three States at 3 A.M.

1928209c4b72f5dd94e100c6d30d25a07b021b12.en: The Disorder Festival takes over four venues in Montreuil for a two-day celebration of goth, post-punk, cold wave, and alternative cultures featuring 24 international acts.

b83e239480c21b5f37da32156344d6ee02e43096.en: Electronic producer Vitess returns to the Cabaret Sauvage for an uninterrupted five-to-six-hour live set, navigating between house and techno-trance under his Vitess and Grand V aliases.

5f7fd6454e9664611fd4275ad749bfbb01b60089.en: Indie pop-rock band Polyphone performs at the Club Bus Palladium, sharing new songs from their upcoming EP about youth, nostalgia, and the journey of growing up.

7a85888458c52f580c8fe82aa8f3d6b9f283953b.en: Sean takes the stage at La Cigale for a unique live concert, bringing together his distinct musical universe built over years of releasing music.

c226878feadfbd4e4876a697eaaa64c7468bd5d0.en: La Java hosts Sept Mesures, a showcase bringing together seven independent rap artists and diverse musical styles for a vibrant live showcase in Paris.

f3a4c713a0fe5a4df8ef86565a6a190d2706bcb0.en: Le Baiser Salé hosts a Sunday jam session led by drummer Sotiris Tsolis, blending jazz, electronic grooves, and improvised music in a collaborative space.

f13532dce4009f68713beb88879d337c10c46058.en: Vice Versa hosts the Talk to me nice club night for an evening of music and drinks.

dff02badaa62b0b1a8d67a5c5841b1380ec7b099.en: New Jazz Underground performs at La Petite Halle, blending hard bop tradition with hip-hop and modern soul in an energetic performance by the rising American jazz trio.

1cb6615b5a68e764a7037ad1a2a0b2abc67498c0.en: Medellin Paris hosts Miss You Mon Amour every Sunday, offering a weekly ritual of house beats and elegant vibes.

8325cff3ed56711b0ff67aa5502bb67ec4411972.en: Mia Mao hosts a night of acid, tekno, and hard rave music featuring Protokseed, Ling Ling, Enko, Acidpach, and more.

64d9ae91fe6b1e7f6cc139a82497fb96d76026f5.en: Café Oz Châtelet hosts Midnight Whine, a weekly Tuesday night party featuring Afrobeats, Amapiano, dancehall, and hip-hop to dance until the early hours.

170c9022b7198f217748bcd0d8d7bb54dfe34476.en: The Rex Club hosts Resurrection Rebirth, bringing together electronic artists including Vinka Wydro and Highvoltage for a special reopening night.

cfdacffc13cb7e5b404721a74cf7899d0e8c0eb7.en: Cabaret Sauvage presents Barbès Cafe, a popular and political musical spectacle directed by Méziane Azaïche that explores the history of Algerian immigration in France.

357359e6f78e7ed9d8b11f4d4c02d146d8862224.en: Le Baiser Salé hosts Quint'Up for an evening of hard bop and Caribbean rhythms, led by Mario Canonge, Michel Zenino, Arnaud Dolmen, Josiah Woodson, and Ricardo Izquierdo.

f64387c385f6018502ca019e3342313d1cfb0b02.en: La Bellevilloise hosts Samba da Democracia as part of its Weekend do Brasil, featuring a live roda de samba, Brazilian DJs, and a live screening of the election results.

5ced6646744700e36350655d8757a2d031b18812.en: La Dame de Canton hosts a rock double bill featuring the Parisian veteran punk and garage group The Unbelieverz alongside the No Jazz Quartet.

db06662c32a5ec017f2ac71f024d2adca71201f4.en: Club Haussmann hosts a massive afterwork party starting at 7 PM with a buffet and drinks, followed by a DJ set turning the venue into a club dancefloor from 9 PM.

ca4436d2f3380ebb0cdf31c89875e094438036de.en: Youthdreams takes over the Nouveau Casino for the second edition of the Dreamer Experience and the launch of Solene124. Enjoy a night of diverse DJ sets and immersive sounds.

18a9553f78babcad1eddc7ea97649c8576cb8e5d.en: Corcoran’s Sacré-Cœur transforms into a haunted house for a special Halloween party with dark decor, a costume dress code, and a live DJ set.

832eee62db2ed8e953fd2f15b5404d6db02a0623.en: The Truskel hosts a tribute night dedicated to Radiohead, inviting fans to sing along to hypnotic guitars and melancholic melodies spanning the band's catalog.

2c9386ba84eb4889ba904a7b6a16ea4644215e8f.en: The Mineral Expo Paris returns to Espace Charenton for its 53rd edition, gathering nearly 200 exhibitors showcasing minerals, crystals, fossils, and jewelry.

215551564765d80221d2822c3db38db0f6fff3d4.en: The Écomusée de Fresnes presents an exhibition exploring the social role, history, and decline of neighborhood cafés and bistros in the suburbs.

3b5c3edae0a1b1014f15891df608b4b935c6638d.en: Le Sélect opens the new season of the Paris Opera Ballet with a cinematic screening of Romeo and Juliet.

477ce6a0427530b5fde958115ac801bb42c628e3.en: Le Luxy hosts a film screening followed by a candy distribution for young audiences.

6824f2596d6b4ea64da7b09bf59e8dcc869261be.en: Espace Jean Vilar hosts a special Halloween screening of Resident Evil, following a medical courier fighting for survival during a sudden outbreak.

df580e390ed284b0b06aa92d5ec4566d2f8f3457.en: Espace Jean Vilar presents a cine-snack screening of Le Corset, following an eleven-year-old boy in the Beauce region navigating life and family.

961edf7f4ecdae07fef6083cbaf112926dab61c8.en: Pianist Soma Balázs-Piri performs a recital at the Mairie du 6ème arrondissement honoring Ferenc Liszt and the 70th anniversary of the 1956 Hungarian Revolution.

31cf7be7ed144ed4e605224a20cf283e8a76c842.en: INALCO hosts a meeting with translators Isabelle Rabut and Makiko Andro-Ueda to discuss a trilingual collection of Taiwanese and Japanese poetry.

fd66549dcc137bab8626ec55ffbf37311a7164df.en: Step into the shoes of a space traveler at the Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie with an immersive show dedicated to locating and recharging the Voyager 1 probe.

8cd300f91ed54ca47b13bb0d50b773b7d75cc707.en: Le Temps des Cerises presents a poetic puppet show for young children, featuring an illustrated story by Ilya Green and free exploration on soft play mats.

94589ac3afc3b8db4a73ed626e3c7d0460c35d25.en: Le Temps des Cerises hosts an open house at its Digital Museum focusing on the rediscovery of lost castles through interactive collections.

e6da158ff716f579cdbcaf665ef88c6e57289583.en: The Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie hosts a workshop on pitching techniques to help entrepreneurs master the codes of presenting their business projects.

9797236c9bb3cec7675d7258c51c41053ef90c27.en: The Cité des sciences et de l'Industrie hosts its 11th mental health recovery forum featuring round tables and personal testimonies on experiential knowledge and art.
