344b218a5e400f9490a9265b1c37956d989a8a1e.en: Billie performs her intimate, generation-spanning pop-rock in the main hall of La Gaîté Lyrique, showcasing her journey from London and France.

93e7f89ccc9ae6378accb3bcccc2001007a642d0.en: La Marbrerie hosts Le Bal & La Bête II, featuring five dark music acts spanning deathrock, blackened hardcore, sludge, and doom psych.

1b5e587f3d06015fde278cef4379dec1b898ec9d.en: California Avenue hosts a Coupé Décalé Session Party across two levels, featuring a 100% sunshine playlist of Afro, latino, and dancehall hits.

bf4fc475f4172f940690f95cf0d6831fd3f92481.en: Hide Châtelet hosts an old school party dedicated to the biggest 90s and 2000s hits across multiple rooms and a speakeasy shot bar.

c4e410fb74718fb35912cc83b4f65916a9a405cd.en: Les Étoiles hosts Mini Club every Friday in a centennial theater, offering a lively night of pop, hip-hop, and electro in the 10th arrondissement.

bfe35dad726b90c3a20747042da0119c86771c75.en: La Java hosts a special Pop Princess Party dedicated to Taylor Swift, celebrating two decades of music with a 100% Swiftie DJ set and themed cocktails.

22548c45a968b29de16f6fb00bdadfa89696adad.en: The BenArt Ensemble celebrates its debut album at the New Morning, joined by guest saxophonist Baptiste Herbin for a mix of jazz, world music, and groove.

2476b372a1fd7b657b81f08f63bab4d96cd8470b.en: Félicien Adam brings his retro-pop project to the Péniche Antipode for his first solo concert in Paris, blending intimate bedroom arrangements with live musicians.

2534cb445f750bc74cff5494cb5f5b5246681bc1.en: Forensics hosts Original Sins at La Rotonde Stalingrad, featuring a fetish dress code, two playrooms, and a lineup of electronic artists.

930e6e33a233718de94fd47c15375a726fc5ccd5.en: La Machine du Moulin Rouge hosts a takeover by the Divin0 collective as part of the 8th edition of the NYOKOBOP festival, celebrating global club culture.

db8078e2441a34ad4d6e57b2d814837c82244b7f.en: La Bringue hosts a Halloween party at 211 exclusively for women and those identifying with the feminine spectrum. Enjoy a DJ set, Halloween shows, and a costume contest in a safe and inclusive environment.

384cb9f1382ea7cdadc8fbba5b995729248517a0.en: Moroccan rapper, songwriter, and producer Shobee performs at La Maroquinerie. Experience his unique blend of rap, trap, and electronic textures as he enters a fresh musical cycle.

862088b6c8aba26ba86e7da1688cbfdf399ccf0b.en: French pop artist Satine performs live at La Gaîté Lyrique on March 13, 2027. Catch her dynamic electronic pop and hyperpop tunes for an unforgettable night in Paris.

2b74e70a4778e2ead6c0db08ae94c9495a26503d.en: Beau Wanzer brings his raw underground electronic music to Le Klub in Paris on November 26, 2026. Expect a bizarre mix of distorted vocals, electro, and minimal synth straight from Chicago.

c6ffc991ed27f4c6d1475662a98fe1a618ca7e7f.en: British producer Bonobo brings his acclaimed live show to Salle Pleyel on March 27. Experience his genre-defining electronic music featuring international collaborations and striking visual production.

32747c933836424f2f3c07734431fc838df87e86.en: Club Sauvage presents a 30-hour non-stop party across Cabaret Sauvage, Babour Sauvage, and Le Bien Public on November 27 and 28. Join the marathon event featuring 15 artists and a massive lineup.

6d32af5f446f6111c180dc0f494fa29dc016e5f2.en: La Casbah hosts its weekly Vintage Clubbing night every Thursday with free entry. Enjoy a mix of pop, rock, disco, and electro selected by rotating DJs and collectives.

84d4523f348329130c2d9e9c8bb60ca34a6ec7cb.en: Café Oz Châtelet hosts Thursday Live & Dance featuring salsa classes, a live cover band, and an open format DJ set. Enjoy free entry, happy hours, and great food all evening.

494f6737c4164a1631dd8169ca6b2dc091d3783a.en: Joseph Martone plays La Dame de Canton with an opening set by Impostor Costume. Discover his unique blend of Italian and American folk-noir influences and cinematic soundscapes.

e6803d5edef6c089b3e084e117c49ae59b4b4634.en: Cabaret Sauvage presents Barbès Café on December 13, 2026, a popular musical show telling the story of Algerian immigration in France. Enjoy a live seven-piece orchestra performing classic exile songs.

1a539d55d5193a49ea5c5aec9c73f2a2b41f816d.en: Duc des Lombards hosts its late-night Jam Session after the second set every Friday and Saturday. Tonight features live jazz by the Maïcé Trio in the heart of Paris.

025e55ff1575480a0a3c62b4b1d532941d832586.en: Celebrate the 5th anniversary of AÏE at Cabaret Sauvage on Saturday, October 24. Expect a joyful, inclusive, and free-spirited party atmosphere.

eac77e0ba11b81762296645594cee4827587533a.en: Virage hosts its first kids' Halloween party on October 31 from 2pm to 8pm. Bring the little ones for costumes, a haunted bouncy castle, candy, and a DJ set by Lucie Kosmala.

7c39b17729541a1f682e2202cba49b989bf46a20.en: Le 10e Ciel rooftop at the Pullman Tour Eiffel hosts an evening on October 24 with stunning views, cocktails, tapas, and electro chill DJ sets until 1am.

09c5222ed8a8e7c60daea5e03eb4a82971462baa.en: Fehd Benchemsi & The Lalla perform at Cabaret Sauvage on November 6, 2026. Experience a unique blend of Gnawa music, North African sounds, and Western influences.

6b14e346cc67fc85716a631054d5e01c7838ecb9.en: Author Diaty Diallo hosts a book club event at Silencio Club discussing her new novel Darya & Dounya. Experience her unique blend of literature and performance live.

5dcc1dda46dc82a80c6272d443ce28923c526ee7.en: Unisson hosts an extraterrestrial-themed party at Under in Le Kremlin-Bicêtre with a stellar lineup, light show, and affordable drinks. Enjoy a safe space with harm reduction teams on site.

db3d1981a6ad33c732a1a03649501a8f5d620b8d.en: Yann Kesz takes over the decks at Les Disquaires for a night of house, hits, and rare grooves. Enjoy free entry and a friendly dancefloor vibe.

4feba05eaf78a503b064e3deb8b7477a8017db05.en: Rex Club presents a massive night of electronic music featuring Arthur Pringle b2b Axel Blanc and Mira Ló.

1b919cfecfa9be56bf99fd055881879ee85be886.en: À la folie celebrates three years of Queer du Bled with a special anniversary edition. Join the lineup featuring Babouchka Babouche, Doracell, Eli El Sultan, and more for a night of great energy.

18dc58d3a3325d576f2898970a51a96c0316f335.en: La Bellevilloise hosts a 100% Latino Halloween celebration across four spaces with concerts, DJ sets, salsa classes, and Mexican food. Dance to non-stop salsa, cumbia, reggaeton, and more for nine hours.

87b4459106447634cf12d3dcc4372a35dd26ad1a.en: La Nuit hosts a special night featuring Tjondoo and Neyl & Nadrums, bringing the BACCVS and SAHARA communities together on the eve of a public holiday.

093dd8fe7659f225654710ef04bf12bc5240dc24.en: The Cité des sciences et de l'industrie hosts a networking and discovery event focused on green transition careers, featuring renewable energy, waste management, and circular economy professionals.

3f729ff1cab3d07977e4cade474a7812a23cf822.en: Young people from the Mission Locale visit Air Liquide to discover the company's business sector, professions, and career opportunities.

d68378e7f7273c2628f1b748dd5de48776aa3695.en: EGC Intérim hosts a temp work event dedicated to the industrial sector.

e9666826bd0b1797d730bc86c740aecabc7be1f9.en: Agence Villejuif hosts an orientation event exploring careers and recruitment opportunities across diverse industrial sectors like automotive, aerospace, and robotics.

a0fd30f7cc9ed8a2e36c1c10d70b5c84d7ea992b.en: DJ Bens performs a live concert at Zénith Paris - La Villette, bringing high energy to the stage for a memorable night out.

32cf6201616f14edfbf902abf31203af7b105a26.en: THÉA brings her emo-core and pop-punk project to Zénith Paris - La Villette for a high-energy concert exploring youth, mental health, and queer experiences.

c99f0666f7474ced987ec3e6369dbdc112836834.en: Dabeull performs a live analog concert at Zénith Paris - La Villette, bringing 70s and 80s funk, vintage synthesizers, and energetic grooves to the stage.

24fd5ad1190294b3db0949125510bb6b0a6ab1d7.en: Alternative electro-pop duo Zimmer90 performs live at L'Élysée Montmartre during their Arthouse Tour, bringing their immersive sound and indie hits to the stage.

cb57c5f7b18184e039355eeb49cb839af2d5011a.en: The Meltdown performs at Le Trabendo, offering a soulful blend of southern soul, Stax and Motown influences, rich horns, and hypnotic grooves.

6684415467b3e90cd657c0ce04608e10247f9b46.en: Bateau Concorde Atlantique hosts a 90s and 2000s themed party across two floors and a terrace, featuring the biggest hits and pop culture throwbacks from the era.

fcd5f5f995be62f4dc72b7a8e78033f9b7063bd0.en: Espace Charles Aznavour hosts the Forum du Vivant, welcoming students to discover agricultural and agri-food careers through interactive stands and professional demonstrations.

4a844d7aaa1424fe929a06b2b6ce4d98652cdaf7.en: The Bibliothèque nationale de France presents an exhibition marking the bicentenary of photography, featuring two hundred nude photographs spanning two centuries of artistic creation.

3f97225865ad8540412e0c92be95badfaaa2f013.en: Musée de l'Homme presents a photography exhibition by Nikos Aliagas and Samuel Pavard exploring the biological, demographic, and social realities of aging and generational bonds.

c7b8e6ece55c9cf492a109a8dfb19fa5ef9b81f4.en: Sorbonne Université presents an exhibition on Gabriel Lippmann and interference color photography, featuring historical plates and backlit digital visualisations.

41187790fcc39ee69c9ffa2ab1d20ded13706214.en: Hôpital Tenon hosts a meeting with nurse and photographer Hélène Mauri to discuss her palliative care photography project and book.

a2d06d1809b94cf7d973fcf818a27ee13164cd52.en: The Maison Européenne de la Photographie presents a major retrospective of Japanese photographer Ishiuchi Miyako, featuring nearly two hundred works spanning five decades of memory and material traces.

32b732c00f4708711bb885d90e4ca4fd7333449b.en: Musée du Quai Branly - Jacques Chirac presents an exhibition by artist Roméo Mivekannin, featuring new paintings and sculptures that critically examine colonial history and ethnographic exhibitions.

ba610054e2f43ecf6657557e2982280b3012aac4.en: Plunge into the photographic history of the Louvre from early prints to contemporary techniques at the Musée du Louvre et jardin des Tuileries. Featuring over 300 photographs, the exhibition explores the museum as a model, subject, and source of inspiration.

e73a9d30680e14726a47bff63885ef705e35c280.en: Enjoy a children's show for ages 3 and up at the Médiathèque Boris Vian de Chevilly-Larue featuring various animals. Traditional tales from around the world are accompanied by voice and transverse flute to highlight the value of cleverness and teamwork.

214114b4dd0e85a2b3e9eb49fadaca2c19f1aefd.en: Le Musée d'Orsay présente Nanoulak, l'ours qui danse, une fable écologique mêlant danse, mime et théâtre d'objets. Ce spectacle questionne notre capacité d'adaptation face aux transformations de notre environnement.

b7f885a574708543189f17f72b7dec6763a36a37.en: Supraconducteur at the Campus Pierre et Marie Currie explores quantum matter and electricity without resistance through a playful scientific impromptu. Researcher Hugues Pothier and the Groupe n+1 combine serious physics with a poetic, artistic approach.

c10bf5abc6dcacd5053fbd2ed45bc8a2a1830506.en: CRUCHES at L'Echangeur - Théâtre de Bagnolet features three female researchers transforming a pottery workshop into a laboratory. They investigate the history of women and pitchers through myths, intimate stories, and an immersive sensory experience.

b22c6ac55f01a76645e214ee786ccf12958f62ba.en: Cabaret "Chez Zézette" at Le Barlone begins with a karaoke session hosted by drag queens Black Velvet and Debby d'Al Khôl. The second part features an acoustic concert with four cabaret artists performing in an intimate setting.

fa515ab2ce560fbf0cd63d3fad3238906505c9a2.en: Kabine at Paul B is a musical and gestural performance featuring a female performer interacting with a bendable, resistant structure. Together, they create moving shapes through unified singing and movement.

e811bcdfce0de89156272cbc6d2cf8e62481ecf8.en: Le Voyage de Kristoffer at the Théâtre de Rungis is a youth project combining theatre, immersive experiences, and new technologies. It follows an eight-year-old boy exploring big questions about the universe and learning to embrace doubt.

c270249f9e9c60220473c0b7d282dbf89e64cf35.en: Le Grand Action hosts a screening of A fidai film by Kamal Aljafari in the presence of the director. The documentary explores the 1982 Israeli invasion of Beirut and the confiscation of Palestinian archives through a unique experimental approach.

cc7fc3d8e978a76382d26ffb505cc3835ac3168f.en: Learn about the impact of artificial intelligence in private equity deals at Tour EURONEXT. Experts Fabien Thieblemont and Maxime Wuthrich discuss AI applications in sourcing, screening, and financial due diligence.

fb9fa7e748ff07bb7c62f413ffa1065a3b215703.en: Experience a classical guitar recital by Claire Sananikone inside a vaulted stone cellar at a dance studio in Paris. Enjoy a programme spanning from the Renaissance to the present day in an intimate, unamplified setting.

48b4be1967a1f4a4ca3a7eeb60e4194745cf65e9.en: Made in France at the Conservatoire Léo Delibes is an award-winning comedy about a recently released prisoner trying to save his closing factory. The play combines humor, social satire, and suspense to question our relationship with work.

f89323e27fa14821a00c349eff6095fa73a19fbe.en: The Cultural Centre of Korea presents a screening of the 1958 drama The Money as part of its special Ciné-Club Corée. Directed by Kim Sodong, the film explores rural poverty and social inequality in 1950s Korea.

041e5ab54c1daed7fb74daa2147e521cc2aa3a10.en: The Tournée de l'Excellence at the Université Paris Nanterre allows young people and families to meet professionals across various sectors. The event features alumni testimonials and thematic workshops ranging from finance to law and digital tech.

de2a9b8ff08289af36ab693c40b9e3c1cbcb6036.en: Théâtre de l'Atelier presents 4.48 Psychose, Sarah Kane's powerful final work directed by Jacques Osinski and starring Sandrine Bonnaire. The text explores the boundaries of contemporary theatre through a profound and intense vocal performance.

a6e9f0446b50bde661eadd5858eeb9470e559013.en: Head to JASS CLUB for a late-night Brasil e Jazz jam session hosted by Jean-Baptiste Loutte. Musicians and music lovers can gather to share music, with a grand piano, double bass, and drums provided on site.

85e3fb1b44788b60c73e840f2df5b7fc73ba2dae.en: Everybody Loves Roy Ayers at JASS CLUB pays tribute to the jazz-funk and soul icon with an energetic and groovy live performance. A five-piece band revisits his classic repertoire for jazz and groove enthusiasts alike.

46b3334be7d17d33126aadc124df75f48c9a6fdf.en: Solar So Loud at JASS CLUB performs electronic music exclusively using live instruments and effects without synthesizers. The quartet blends jazz improvisation, rock energy, and electronic soundscapes.

71e990ebd9530873387a59d9f22d1134cdae72c6.en: Children aged 8 to 11 can learn the basics of 3D modeling at Le Temps des Cerises. Participants will discover the world of 3D design and use the minilab's 3D printers during this hands-on workshop.

4baa49062821d7af00f7ec3a59e6bc00bc52089d.en: Les Étincelles du Palais de la découverte propose des exposés scientifiques interactifs dans sept disciplines pour petits et grands. C'est l'occasion idéale d'explorer l'astronomie, la chimie ou la physique en famille ou entre amis.

2a7bc2da5be7f83f0958caf921610c5544bd6d79.en: Cet exposé aux Étincelles du Palais de la découverte retrace l'histoire du logiciel libre et du mouvement open source. Venez découvrir les enjeux de la liberté informatique, des premiers hackers aux technologies d'aujourd'hui.

3035bb63af782279c82239530e7cfea57fc257cd.en: La contemporaine accueille un colloque sur les liens entre photographie et bande dessinée à l'occasion de l'exposition consacrée à Didier Lefèvre. Un rendez-vous pour interroger ces formes artistiques et le succès de la non-fiction.

31609706f789b177ce482f2ecb58b1f83d489906.en: La Cité des sciences et de l'industrie propose des lectures d'albums pour les jeunes enfants en accès libre. C'est une belle occasion de découvrir de jolies surprises en famille.

046611a4b6fbdf3091cc42452ca9610e9cd1dd3a.en: Découvrez les origines et les concepts clés de la physique quantique à travers des expériences présentées aux Étincelles du Palais de la découverte. L'événement idéal pour comprendre les technologies quantiques qui façonnent notre quotidien.

5de01206a2a59fe927df89667e736982a5dcb3fb.en: Cet exposé aux Étincelles du Palais de la découverte explore les secrets du laser et ses applications variées. Venez comprendre les mécanismes physiques de cette lumière unique et tenter de fabriquer votre propre laser.

2c1b1202e99731149ea14ecb8a7495979ab3242a.en: La bibliothèque de la Cité des sciences et de l'industrie offre un vaste espace de coworking et un accès gratuit à plus de 120 000 ressources. Profitez d'un lieu de travail idéal pour vous passionner pour la science, la culture et l'environnement.

a61db05f633ce95dc850ffec49b40eb30e024967.en: Le Cinéma Chaplin Saint Lambert accueille une soirée spéciale présentée et animée par la LDH Paris 15, la LDH Paris 14, ATTAC Paris 15 et l'AFPS.

717cff230cabd8852b9ac785c4231d68618acdf1.en: Participez à un atelier d'1h30 pour fabriquer votre propre savon artisanal par saponification à froid sur la Place Marthe Simard. Vous y apprendrez un savoir-faire respectueux de la peau en utilisant des ingrédients biologiques.

e330d212775442e383712e1d7450c6b646158591.en: La Galerie Françoise Livinec présente une exposition de Matthieu Ricard dans le cadre du parcours Photographie dans les galeries d'art.

189f87f4ac37cf1234a7f2d62fcefe18e3586a16.en: L'Agence Paris 20eme Vitruve organise un atelier pour découvrir les métiers de l'industrie et ses opportunités professionnelles. Venez explorer les formations et les parcours adaptés à votre projet de carrière.

c437684cfaa334862b75ebff516d691986239d15.en: Polka Galerie présente une exposition de Bruce Gilden dans le cadre du parcours Photographie dans les galeries d'art.

5251fbb08b28669f85172c694f90eebc4cd43648.en: L'Ecole des mines de Paris accueille un retour d'expérience pragmatique sur la souveraineté numérique en Europe. Venez explorer les solutions pratiques pour maîtriser nos données face à la domination des géants technologiques.

a7870c88b5cf159e51b19513fb735111c24def91.en: Le Luxy propose une séance de cinéma suivie d'un goûter et d'une animation autour du film Le Royaume des chats.

1d8f971803bfd9585acfd4c863ac14479d4a3ba0.en: Le Théâtre de la Ville accueille une version 100% féminine de L'endormi, un récit rap pour la jeunesse. Porté par un texte lumineux et des raps percutants, le spectacle aborde les thèmes de la fratrie et de la quête de vérité.

50773e7bbcd4ad04bdaf4788f1e238f3bc7c3fc0.en: Arthur Fu Bandini se produit en concert à La Maroquinerie pour présenter ses textes engagés en français. Venez découvrir un artiste complet qui fusionne rock, électro et pop.

2a99d61c8d3440aa89b133256e4ecdb3fad735cf.en: Peter Sandberg se produit aux Trois Baudets pour un concert mêlant minimalisme néoclassique et piano moderne. Venez découvrir l'univers cinématographique et émotionnel du compositeur suédois.

dc79ceeed688cf66e8ec3f87f2eaf5646b8b9936.en: Le Bateau Concorde Atlantique vous invite à danser sur les plus grands tubes des années 90 et 2000 lors d'une soirée festive. Profitez d'un grand dancefloor et d'une terrasse couverte pour replonger dans l'ambiance de cette décennie.

7c1c92fca8cc241a2ea57cba5fe4b615bc86cfdd.en: Break the Stage returns to Red Factory for a night dedicated to the discography of Wallace Cleaver. Enjoy DJ sets in a raw and energetic atmosphere.

ab9e4654d15b752c318391070e6a0e351ce1ab1c.en: Frizzy P and Mr Cole perform live at La Boule Noire, blending old school hip-hop, trip-hop, and jazz. Experience their intimate, timeless, and emotionally charged sound.

26be4f9641dbc003b02219d9a7b0c3ee57e27da4.en: Andéol brings his unique pop blending French chanson and electronic music to Le Trabendo. Discover his latest EP live on stage.

0fdfbe3102d3a4b95be0600e0ee4286e641ef122.en: Mohand Baha performs at Petit Bain as part of his tour, offering a French rap concert that blends introspection with live energy.

633d91f95690ad84255c03bc116a7abecc54b48c.en: FGO-Barbara hosts GU1T4R, a young hyperpop-influenced artist from Bordeaux. Catch his personal and creative musical universe live.

768c977cb69e729a4e74b182b64846d736b9c10a.en: Ginton performs at the New Morning, bringing his unique blend of electronic and acoustic music. Experience one of the rising names in international afro-house.

26f2d74cdf9a2d56fbf2341406d4f81cce4c0147.en: La Boule Noire hosts Dernier Motel, an alternative concert where fiction and reality blend. Experience a night of music where the rooms become dreams.

cc71b907e2f2f54583bfd586fe6d0e8821a88370.en: Il Est Vilaine presents Best Service at La Machine du Moulin Rouge. Discover their new album mixing analog electronics, techno, rock, and synth-pop.

97e59c1a9758619bf733d44c29be21c2680e64a4.en: Chevreuil performs at Le Chinois, bringing their unique math rock and spatialized sound setup. Experience this minimalist and physical musical performance.

24470b6ef57275c004ba78d066994dd8e3e9fd8f.en: The Centre des Arts d'Enghien-les-Bains hosts a non-verbal show about Hokusai, featuring traditional Japanese music, martial arts, and digital projections, with an opening set by Maelstrom.

c31860e2cfb880d7d21ba8df6681cc5e8329d87c.en: Listener hosts a unique session of slow movements, breathing, and visualization guided by Alexandrine Comte. Experience this combination of ambient and techno music in an insonorised listening room.

df0fe8784099f71758f98dc21fde632fb20acf87.en: KILIMANJARO brings his powerful electronic sounds and rhythm to La Boule Noire for his first live show. Expect an intimate yet energetic performance rooted in his musical background.

ea9fd8b8d60a882dfe7b1c12ab8f45be662493e5.en: Nicolas Fraissinet presents Piano 24i at L'Auguste Théâtre, combining piano, voice, and cinema. Experience an immersive show where each song acts as a live film projection.

0a0438f22beb0ff37310459928c7539972596ee6.en: Rapper, poet, and activist Mykki Blanco performs live at Badaboum, blending pop, hip-hop, and queer culture. Experience an unforgettable and uncompromising performance.

1a63d7c469b95df4a1fa57b5137f9d315f8188b8.en: Jake Silverman, known as Button Masher, performs at La Petite Halle. Enjoy his unique blend of jazz fusion and chiptune music in a lively venue.

fd8905853797fa0b17b1a415aa918b04087b1fb9.en: Paul B hosts the second night of Les Primeurs de Massy, featuring performances by Pamela and Wamen. Discover new musical talents in an intimate setting.

3a0d06295ad60739af1989826b5acda78742f1a5.en: La Machine du Moulin Rouge hosts La Barbichette Cabaret, an artistic night blending poetry, satire, and music. Enter through the Bar à Bulles for a unique and festive experience.

ed58b947288ea838ed2dc924c59469d58d2b13dd.en: Modestep performs at La Maroquinerie, bringing their signature mix of dubstep, drum and bass, and rock. Experience a high-energy crossover bass music show.

1b3be0a37c24b851429569b3a356c67c699a0d17.en: Emma Hoet performs at La Boule Noire, sharing her intimate pop and folk music. Discover songs inspired by her travel collaborations and acoustic melodies.

1e835965984aa49bae27f82eed949645705d34f6.en: Paul B hosts the Henri Texier Essential Quartet for a live jazz concert in Massy. Enjoy an evening of improvised music with seating on a first-come, first-served basis.

350e7a4262d60c74cc38d79731488fb9f098e50b.en: La Bellevilloise hosts an evening featuring live performances by Dutch group Another Taste, alongside DJ Spinna, Coco Maria, and Emile Omar. It is a chance to experience a vibrant mix of live funk, soul, and global Latin and Brazilian rhythms.

1a327be4a135203a83c111554b682a1b58bdfa56.en: French rap artist Yvnnis returns to the Paris stage following his recent mixtape DND and a sold-out French tour. Audiences can expect an energetic performance showcasing his versatility and growing status in the genre.

df94499e70f1b36f34bc4de13c2772f96cb8df04.en: House O'Drome celebrates its fourth anniversary at the 211 in the Parc de la Villette with sets from Art Of Tones, Jade Edwards, Nightchou, and Diblob. The event features a high-end sound system, roller dance friendly spaces, and massage stands.

becca8195cc4fec6e7c5817e922f0a5ba7494f33.en: Pop singer-songwriter Morgan St. Jean brings her explosive production and raw storytelling to La Java for a live show. Fans can expect to hear her viral feminist anthems and catchy pop tracks in an intimate venue setting.

08b0504dc637e1dae8f9640ee170bf3f16869370.en: La Dancing at Les Étoiles offers a weekly Saturday club night in a former centennial theater, spinning 90s and 2000s pop, hip-hop, and electro hits. Resident DJs keep the energy high until morning for anyone looking to dance to familiar tracks.

2dd5ebc0b83bdacc89418fb98b3717854ca32f5f.en: Cem Erdost İleri presents Portakal Altı at La Palmeraie, an intimate musical gathering featuring guest artists sharing folk songs and stories through improvisation. It brings a popular digital project onto the live stage.

dd820b66d30f72a77cc831338617d936df43da08.en: British electronic music producer Bonobo visits Salle Pleyel to present his new album Distance In Static alongside a brand new live show. The performance highlights his signature blend of meticulous instrumentation and global collaborations.

681e3296b0598712d62f9e1eadef554ae922bbdc.en: Angus Andrew brings his experimental music project Liars to La Boule Noire for an immersive live performance. The show offers a unique opportunity to experience the artist's constantly evolving sonic landscape and physical stage presence.

d1b2e5a55405891d793ce7e26cfdddae81ea63ed.en: La Java hosts a special Halloween edition of the Queer Up party featuring a vampire ball theme, a 100% pop DJ set, and custom cocktails. Costumes and makeup are encouraged in this safe and inclusive space for the lesbian and queer community.

948a3062d18602a7064ae6f3b10ea651504c7941.en: The Nyokobop Festival at La Bellevilloise welcomes Brazilian urban music duo Tasha & Tracie and carioca funk pioneer Deize Tigrona. It highlights contemporary sounds from underrepresented global music scenes.

367b4ba3171e9a7d7d04e9b27216f2b51455e45e.en: La Gaîté Lyrique hosts the 11th edition of its Marathon! event, focusing on repetitive and electronic music with live sets from Actress, Cabaret Contemporain, Ensemble Links, and Deena Abdelwahed. It offers a night of immersive electronic and acoustic minimalism.

74328a5e41810f2838ccb8f8575ea5db18c01191.en: Sorg & Napoleon Maddox celebrate the release of their third album 1968 at L'Alimentation Générale with guest artist Mike Ladd. The Franco-American duo brings their collaborative hip-hop and jazz-infused project to the Paris stage.

3fb07f7d956b2e5e5dbce78438794296499924c5.en: La Java hosts a Halloween Villains Night featuring generalist and Halloween music by DJ Luca Belluco, a photobooth, and a professional makeup artist. Guests are encouraged to dress as iconic villains for an evening of dancing and spooky vibes.

2a8afb4ca6131c9b2f1767713b97265ce87e7219.en: Salle Cortot hosts a classical chamber music concert featuring works by Ysaÿe, Jessie Montgomery, and Mendelssohn performed by four string instrumentalists. An introductory listening guide opens the afternoon to help audiences explore the music freely.

65124aa9baaeed645de15647f274037ca71bf691.en: Ora Farmhouse transforms its space into a living room for a house party featuring 90s and 2000s classics mixed by DJs right in the crowd. Attendees can enjoy finger food, drinks, and a casual atmosphere designed for dancing with friends.

4153d57d47bcccf5d609ba9ae90f650d1162f0cb.en: Le Quartier général Oberkampf hosts the first edition of Out Of Line, a new concert series dedicated to independent rock. The evening features live performances from Flowery Beard, Slice and the Cruisers, and Tati and the Chronicle.

fe76a85fda3e7118346082ecd24a0c113931a22c.en: Medellin Paris hosts its weekly Sunday ritual featuring house beats, red lighting, and an elegant atmosphere. It offers late-night dancing every week starting late Sunday evening.

3ef470565049b2d6134f29f667f5e4575ae7e5ee.en: DJ and beatmaker Walkman The Soul brings his hip-hop, RnB, and house expertise to Mama Shelter Paris West. Known for his work with international dance battles and underground freestyle sessions, he delivers a dynamic DJ set.

5d6fadb5418e598aab721d8f2459b8f028d86a47.en: French artist Aloïse Sauvage returns to La Cigale for two special live dates following her last major Paris concert at the Olympia. Audiences can expect an intense and physical performance highlighting her unique artistic energy.

4595a0c351c41bdec173e670a0fce18887e5cce6.en: Central Chapelle hosts the Afro Live Boubou Party, blending live musicians and powerful DJ sets playing Afrobeats, Amapiano, and Dancehall. Attendees are invited to wear a traditional boubou or a colorful accessory to celebrate African culture.

fc0ed406e1f2ba67ef88b640911a57edf7655261.en: Chase & Status bring their influential electronic and drum & bass sound to Zenith, celebrating their new album Generic Everything.

1413b056a4394c4861c43ec428d093d3fd86c5c2.en: BUSLOAD performs live on Péniche Marcounet, bringing their rich blend of alternative soul rock.

169a384a1ea25b13d6426a97daf6bc799a8ca4ba.en: Arthur Lipsky performs at La Boule Noire, showcasing his unique pop-électro sound with French-Japanese lyrics.

a2b0b81b88651f5ba55f2e7ade8fa1cb780d36f7.en: Enjoy stunning views, elegant cocktails, and chill electro DJ sets high above Paris at the 10e Ciel rooftop.

4c824b34f6ce34b0bb8c7a105295cb24e4c00683.en: Base performs at La Bellevilloise, bringing his unique "Soulwave" blend of soul, R&B, and rap.

784f7e0538c784e2c922b7edcb19f24c4525406e.en: Leba brings his dynamic blend of Senegalese rap, modern beats, and cultural identity to Le Point Fort d'Aubervilliers.

5c316721f15f57a132da29f62b821b8614f84876.en: La Java hosts an energetic night of deep, groovy, and hypnotic techno with ESSENCE and Optimal Request.

c4ab69fab57d5e96fb838c74270dc96dae3efd79.en: Bar Gallia hosts the Collectif Popcord for a lively roda de choro, featuring drinks, food, and games.

ca9997699076ed1f8d2ba2324d9fe5fffa330aa5.en: Monsieur Culbuto hosts a 90s dance party dedicated to eurodance, 90s techno, and French Touch classics.

9d293cb52a04c647ebe930595f9857cbacfdf641.en: Le Gambetta Club hosts Quartier Son for a night of non-stop techno featuring four live acts.

38d456c2fb69933ccc48784313f8426510798fdc.en: Sanofi Vitry-sur-Seine hosts a site and Biolauch corridor tour for third-year middle school interns.

70cf51fe1a1e34c031b212d51e3d0254ba0132ea.en: Violaine Robert presents Contes de souris at La Vagabonde, a storytelling session centered on clever mice.

3830458eeeb225801ff1a38561379c8fa6f8ba54.en: École Jean Jaurès presents Rouge écharpe, a performance tailored for young audiences aged 3 and up.

874f2c9e5a49aed7b3e68ba37a52e53c413e85e6.en: Galerie Sit Down presents an exhibition by Jean-Gabriel Lopez in dialogue with the pioneering work of Arthur Batut.

79bb5b8d2f19697cd8ccea5ea3582782ab9fc776.en: Mondes en commun hosts the launch of the Fléchette collection, pairing historic images with contemporary texts.

60a4cd6e10ab6b1cf8ae72c7d5ae413b617a60af.en: The Centre tchèque de Paris presents photography exhibitions featuring the work of Jindřich Štreit and the FAMU academy.

085a7b4c4990dd53fbfb76386886e56092ff82e7.en: Mairie du 7e arrondissement hosts an exhibition by Chloe Sharrock exploring the lasting physical and historical traces of past conflicts.

d37ce47ac455c5b67b92f74120c6f1aebf78b445.en: Amandine Nana leads a conference at Université Paris 8 exploring post-independence African photography and its preservation.

e1db9453e468c0a56c46d5eee53f1060f06d29e5.en: Jean-Kenta Gauthier presents Rocket Science, a group exhibition featuring photographic and sculptural works exploring ingenious techniques.

d96f8fbb36a63247b4b5d397b8f3bc306a11224e.en: Lavoir Numérique hosts a screening of Ryōta Nakano's film The Asada Family, exploring memory and photography.

9b68a751b30173947ecd56d8f8abf8b245797caa.en: Explore the landmark photography of Kwame Brathwaite, who popularized the "Black is Beautiful" slogan in the 1960s. The exhibition celebrates Black identity, fashion, and jazz culture.

df8d0b53f18afc59048468c0bca081cde5c818bb.en: Discover Philippe Chancel's photographic exploration of cacti at the intersection of art and botany. The exhibition showcases exotic plants through striking daytime and nocturnal images.

abd5529077a5dd762731d723607aba3dbee36ee5.en: Join a lecture series addressing positionality and ethics when photographing people in South Africa, led by Jo Ractliffe. It offers a space for students and researchers to dialogue on postcolonial collections.

9fa5f37c2592aca3943318ea0e7e7689ae8b3fd1.en: Enjoy an evening of jazz, folk, and pop standards performed by the Alix Logiaco trio featuring vocalist Ophélie Cazes. It is a great chance to hear a fresh live repertoire in an intimate club setting.

1afcb927029e7acf8a4731ccc8bf730c97b6c460.en: Take a guided, educational nature walk through the Parc Floral to learn how to identify common trees and explore their history. The leisurely stroll offers a fun way to connect with local plant life.

d87947f4377da76357af0d6e4d37aa6ef88388bd.en: Bring young children to a weekend nature workshop featuring seasonal sensory games, yoga, and hands-on crafts. Families can explore the outdoors together and learn about local flora and fauna.

68d6ac797afe9c28178c5d7ba477b5ff018c87bb.en: Participate in family-friendly Japanese arts and craft workshops as part of the local cultural festival. Enjoy kamishibaï readings, martial arts demonstrations, and culinary specialties.

85dbc372173dcc4c9216e0e7c7011daa97f5f20a.en: Take a guided family tour of the Musée Marmottan Monet to explore world-famous impressionist masterpieces. The visit offers a child-friendly introduction to the permanent collection and Claude Monet.

d7d8207d3794941010e9b8f1b85c836ae2148bd9.en: Explore the famous Fibonacci sequence through numerical and geometric puzzles at this interactive science presentation. Learn how mathematical patterns appear naturally in many plants.

5e1db3b195074d511d1e3958326ebdd0224034f8.en: Learn how the human immune system works and how vaccines are developed through an interactive quiz and presentation. The session covers vaccine types, efficacy, and herd immunity.

4f099a2889a1aa5337835f8dd8809034faf61527.en: Explore the realities of living in space through surprising physics experiments that debunk science fiction myths. Discover the unique challenges of this unusual environment.

92515ea866bbb969ddab816d375ec0cd66de7885.en: Learn how to tame difficult emotions, set healthy boundaries, and build a personal protection system. This session focuses on emotional well-being and self-care.

ed945629e707fbcdac8f975229715d438bf65d5e.en: Discover the life of Alan Turing and his work on the Enigma code alongside modern cryptography. Learn how current algorithms protect our digital data.

31f17727b9165948d234e0fcb3400c5afe057b98.en: Explore current science, technology, and environmental news through investigative reports, interviews, and special dossiers. The space is updated regularly with fresh journalistic content.

874d5d985ea749416a8ebb177c92af0e41f93446.en: Relax with children at the library by listening to a curated selection of audio resources in a peaceful setting. This free, open-access space is ideal for a quiet family break.

9827823ae96a3060edbd51c3651e4b956910f675.en: Test your critical thinking skills and learn to spot fake news in an immersive town setting. Use an interactive bracelet to navigate everyday cognitive biases and media manipulations.

57f4f8c53facaa7b5f423ee3827d62d90b1ea893.en: Learn how to use creative and technological tools to craft your own custom cosplay prop. Design a magical wand inspired by popular fantasy universes.

8e5410a2752dedd46908ea47fe43148432c49afd.en: Investigate incomplete laboratory notes to uncover the secret formula of a magical potion. This interactive activity invites participants to solve puzzles in a mock lab setting.

8bee8ad93f825043cd1fde24396398d219098f16.en: Help choose the physics experiments performed live by science mediators in this interactive demonstration. Expect surprising demonstrations ranging from extreme temperatures to electromagnetic fields.

25bce9a0054d1f3043ce82eca28e0364d0a46937.en: Un stage pour les jeunes pour apprendre à créer une histoire en imaginant des personnages et une intrigue avec des rebondissements. Une activité idéale pour développer son imagination et s'initier à l'écriture.

7045ef122ceced561c263a49bc71a5d22affabcf.en: Un spectacle de conte participatif proposé par La Cour des Contes autour d'un grand banquet. Une invitation chaleureuse à partager des histoires pour réfléchir ensemble et imaginer l'avenir.

447ad37481b54bbe2ee86d9019f88cdf801e1f05.en: Un spectacle solo d'Anturia Soilihi qui interroge la construction personnelle et la lutte dans un monde en crise. Une performance mêlant souvenirs d'enfance et culture pop pour transformer le chaos en énergie positive.

3e712b8be9c3daf240117ff2859b76fcce780222.en: Un cabaret vivant et indiscipliné qui fait revivre les illustres personnalités du Père-Lachaise. Chanson, danse, théâtre et drag se mêlent dans un spectacle changeant et festif.

24792c2f1763e1ed35be750d171955ffeaf5bfcf.en: Une sortie de résidence qui explore l'intimité d'une femme confrontée à la solitude et à sa propre cruauté face aux nuisibles. Un seul-en-scène physique et sonore à la frontière du réel et de l'hallucination.

912be0ae3971add9a2ca08c288db0dbd2f48d321.en: Un film dramatique qui suit Léo, sur le point de se séparer de sa compagne, alors qu'il apprend la mort de son père biologique qu'il n'a jamais connu.

02db005e069721d73998d31debc032425b12bf68.en: Un film qui suit un groupe de lycéens français en voyage à Pompéi, saisis par un brusque vertige face aux ruines et aux corps pétrifiés du Vésuve.

301a13e53f42f011f423289d47a442940c5e4057.en: Une rencontre littéraire avec la rabbin Delphine Horvilleur pour découvrir son ouvrage Sermons sous les décombres. Une discussion pour éclairer notre époque à travers la tradition juive.

4e72dc79140b021b3faf3f957769a6fa1cfc5240.en: Marcelle raconte l'histoire vraie d'une femme dévouée aux autres et amoureuse de la vie. Entre humour et émotion, ce spectacle invite à voir le monde avec légèreté.

1df86fb422bf4fa18047585f335f9baefe86c2bc.en: L'exposition En miroir présente le concours international du livre d'artiste au Musée-Atelier de l'Imprimerie de Nantes. Venez explorer des créations originales mêlant texte, image et typographie.

cef77e07590fefecccd1feecaa9894e8172b1381.en: Papanosh fête ses 20 ans avec le spectacle Yes I Are?!, un répertoire collectif inspiré de l'esthétique afro-américaine. C'est un cri du cœur pour le collectif et le partage artistique.

9e1b15489cdfe1fae1e380c2fa1581064a039968.en: Le Château des ducs de Bretagne propose aux 9-12 ans une animation autour de l'exposition Expressions décoloniales. La visite se poursuit par un atelier créatif inspiré des artistes présentés.

f08095a7616bafbc781d4321db85d54864ae4177.en: Les enfants de 4 à 6 ans partent à la recherche d'indices sur les dragons au Château des ducs de Bretagne. L'aventure se termine par un atelier créatif pour repartir avec un souvenir.

b6407112e8ad9d598e6ec079237d151dd48b57f8.en: Apprenez la technique ancienne du cyanotype avec l'artiste Fañch Lepage au Musée d'arts de Nantes. Créez votre propre composition végétale en plongeant dans le bleu unique de ce tirage.

3e545bfd71429fccb5e076c94ab2200f597ab100.en: L'école des Beaux-Arts de Nantes fête les 40 ans de son artothèque avec une exposition collective d'œuvres de jeunesse d'ancien·nes étudiant·es. Venez découvrir des pièces qui soutiennent la jeune création.

257d16219762cc4846de44ca52b2105a2bf04aae.en: L'hôpital privé du Confluent participe à Octobre Rose avec la projection du documentaire La Cordée de l'après. La séance est suivie d'un échange sur le dépistage et la reconstruction après la maladie.

a7f9fbb256b4cb49d227f10a7b57aa5d03287ad4.en: L'artiste Cordiforme vous invite à découvrir son Cabinet de Cœuriosités à la Galerie Morphose. Plongez dans un univers poétique composé d'objets enchantés et de contes tissés.

64ead154277ccca3a6e90b71fdd814397a6d0c3a.en: Le Cinéma Le Beaulieu propose une soirée autour du film Les éléphants dans la brume d'Abinash Bikram Shah. Profitez d'une dégustation de spécialités népalaises avant la projection et le débat.

983fce9946dc02d7e51d8fbe1cad73c9b4bab9fc.en: La Galerie Mélanie Rio Fluency présente LIMINAL, une exposition personnelle d'Angélique Lecaille. L'artiste y explore des paysages en transition entre formes architecturales et éléments naturels.

f62dbce58da390c50d93adbb7b25dfbf8566b661.en: Santiago Tamayo Soler présente le fruit de sa résidence croisée au Grand Huit - Collectif Bonus. Découvrez des univers virtuels et narratifs inspirés des archives et des jeux vidéo.

b2552dc73da92913555ba4e94886ed744a9fa2da.en: La Libre Usine invite Joris Mathieu et Lin Weidmann à présenter des étapes de travail de leurs prochaines créations. Une rencontre pour découvrir les coulisses du théâtre, de la danse et de la performance.

b7881b1b72e65e308816ca03bc6c48780fd701ea.en: L'Espace seniors Barberie propose un parcours d'ateliers numériques animés par l'association ANADOM. Venez apprendre ensemble à utiliser vos outils au quotidien.

cf4b269f0e0b7a17862a5ac88e427f3eb65dfcb1.en: La Médiathèque Jacques Demy vous invite à observer le soleil avec les instruments du Planétarium de Nantes. Une activité accessible dès 8 ans.

6baac34a9227e45d45b3e6449e8bef6997432a0f.en: Venez échanger sur vos coups de cœur horrifiques ou de suspense à la Médiathèque Charles-Gautier-Hermeland. Partagez vos lectures et profitez d'un goûter convivial.

06f0a35533b27e0d9ee33bb4cbbb1a79060b6532.en: Trois clowns d'expérience revisitent l'histoire de l'art clownesque au Théâtre de la rue de belleville. Un hommage vibrant et plein d'humour aux grands noms du cirque d'antan.

c350e5c39000cd8d4d10b1e897d064c2d0c49a8e.en: Catch Attack rassemble les meilleures troupes d'improvisation amateures nantaises au Mystère Comedy Club. Venez soutenir vos favoris à travers un tournoi menant à la grande finale.

a710127c70491023dc85ac8b06c9f5eded67e5c0.en: Stéréolux propose une soirée Doc'N'Co consacrée à Kraftwerk avec la projection d'un documentaire. La séance est complétée par un concert de Rodolphe Burger et Julien Perraudeau.

ceda7e490c90685b4782daddbf83ebb5354607cc.en: Le Chronographe propose un atelier pour découvrir l'histoire ancienne des ex-voto. Chaque participant pourra réaliser sa propre offrande inspirée de ces pratiques.

0e3d0e14fa7f5df6f0a26956e4f5f44c0a309845.en: La Maison du don de Nantes is a permanent collection site for blood, plasma, and platelets run by the EFS. Open daily with various hours, it welcomes donors aged 18 to 70 with an ID and about an hour to spare.

e12132791e474028a5b50ada09842eb092861c02.en: The fourth edition of Expression(s) Décoloniale(s) opens the museum to new historical perspectives and artistic sensitivities regarding French colonial history. It features works by guest artists Rosana Paulino and Omar Victor Diop, alongside historian Lylly Houngnihin.

1b06fddc18b941ae39dc7f5a3d80d2952685e47c.en: Children can learn cooking techniques and explore sweet recipes in a workshop led by L'école comestible. Another session introduces participants to lactofermentation with the Ateliers Hara, allowing everyone to take home their own jar.

db3e8d92b28e8c1dc2dcf5ea490c2dea41b1bea7.en: Théâtre 100 Noms presents an interactive improvised adventure inspired by Jules Verne. When a manuscript is urgently requested by the publisher, the household staff must invent a brand-new story overnight.

9fca48a52bfb56e226c73f67ad70539651f2f165.en: This community garden project on Cours de la Prairie d'Amont offers open gardening sessions animated by Bio-T-Full. Visitors can drop by whenever they like to participate in cultivating a shared nourishing landscape.

814629f5545eadcf8d594163bbb4bfcd78e3b3fb.en: Fusées is a burlesque and poetic musical theatre piece directed by Jeanne Candel that explores human obsession with space travel. Using acoustic instruments, simple props, and actor performances, it creates a whimsical cosmos on stage.

4333b4ed5e2ea6513db47ff8f633c25b3a1b0b2b.en: Galerie RDV hosts an exhibition by Pierre Kurczewski featuring photographic works that explore landscape, memory, and intimacy. Part of the Quinzaine Photographique Nantaise, the display examines tensions between nature and culture.

2d77a55d7d4266049959f460ceadd89662993386.en: The EFS organizes a blood donation drive at the Maison des Associations in St Joseph de Porterie. Donors aged 18 to 70 can book an appointment in advance to reduce wait times.

cb95d83ee18dc42d7a31cc39e8d33527b73f67cd.en: An open-air exhibition along the railings of the Muséum garden traces over two centuries of the institution's history. Accessible freely 24 hours a day, it offers passersby a preview of the museum's future transformation.

cf57ff8974797278bbb614e047c29727990ea6d8.en: Marking the 40th anniversary of the artothèque, the École des Beaux-Arts Nantes St-Nazaire hosts a collaborative photography exhibition. The collection offers a nocturnal and haunting vision of bodies, cities, and landscapes.

205ab93b4c191f24e3718b5b4d50d5beaf6b5db3.en: The Archives Départementales de Loire-Atlantique present an immersive exhibition featuring 200 photographs from their collections to mark the bicentenary of photography. Visitors can explore regional history through these diverse archives.

cb2e303b0fbb482510d0ece5274b261ad859f33d.en: L'Ensa Nantes presents an architectural photography exhibition focusing on large housing complexes built between 1960 and 2010. Curated by Paul Landauer and Ken Rabin, it forms part of a broader research and transmission project.

c261836633db1c262cd2ad73e9c5c255c18205b4.en: Nicolas Clauss exhibits a video installation at Le Lieu Unique featuring hundreds of anonymous pedestrians filmed crossing public spaces. The multi-screen display transforms everyday encounters into a silent dialogue with spectators.

8d26d1db6e77308674c80cfa5bcb7b795830c833.en: Garage IA at ISG Nantes is a free practical workshop where participants build their own AI assistant with the guidance of coaches from Le Wagon. No prior technical skills are required for the session.

ef4c0d2ccc981b51bf8030e7358145a19ac30499.en: Le Porteur d'histoire is an award-winning theatrical treasure hunt created by Alexis Michalik. A discovered manuscript leads characters on a captivating journey across continents and centuries.

637049bc277ae993cc86165005119d19907e9d59.en: The Centre socioculturel des Bourderies hosts a sewing and textile arts workshop linked to its local solidarity thrift store. Participants can use provided machines and materials to repair or customize garments.

74f4d1f4f9d151ceb54e6d64d4275bbc711012a3.en: The Théâtre de la Gobinière screens Mamoru Hosoda's animated film about a lonely boy who enters a parallel world of beasts. The screening is followed by a concert and tasting evening organized by Info Jeunes.

85e09b683aad43ee6af0f430d200b34d7e976f77.en: Of Course Montessori offers autumn-themed English workshops for children during the late October holidays. Kids can enjoy storytelling, crafts, and cooking activities entirely in English.

e684b3d26059939b02804d2ff553f9806c2ff125.en: Artist Joel Janse van Vuuren leads a collage workshop at Collectif Bonus where children use colored paper shapes to invent imaginary cities. Participants experiment with composition, colors, and architecture.

824ea52c7f3fc7e0ea21eebbb869ad4669d3d84c.en: Local residents prepare a solidarity meal using organic, local, and seasonal ingredients at the Maison de quartier Bottière. The menu includes a starter, main course, and dessert.

e46ed8b4c9a7104cf52fbaa4f3703b165ee54907.en: A meeting at Cosmopolis exploring Spain's journey to the EU and its current role in European affairs and international relations.

4c84d044b787232df1a83d7f8251c361c6d902c4.en: Registration sessions with the CCAS of Nantes for festive senior meals featuring lunch, music, and dancing from December 3 to 15.

d51a8f79566b9e2179c6ed1f4575d56a21080588.en: A wooden puzzle hunt across Nantes neighborhoods from October 15 to 29. Gather local pieces to win puzzles and shopping vouchers.

0f06945fcf0796fe17c5b66c93f3914f6b76a9ee.en: Discover insights from a public survey on physical appearance and discrimination at work, followed by a roundtable discussion.

3d909fb697a12a2a2c2c334a485817e8d73cf613.en: A cozy 20-minute storytelling session for children aged 3 to 6 and their families in the Salon of the Musée d'arts de Nantes.

ce84334bc3f547299ed4fe21f4b58d37f6ac2815.en: Pink Martini performs live at Le LAPS, bringing their signature mix of upbeat retro pop, world sounds, and big band glamour.

17610c0d45cba7ecf86f6fc9ad668f4c2f189a6a.en: Josman takes the stage at Zénith Nantes Métropole for the DPC Tour, offering an immersive and intense live rap experience.

51409a90d612349f4acc386b7c5fcc9657ae1cb5.en: A free road safety workshop at the Barberie district town hall to help seniors review pedestrian rules and reflexes.

5bbc34f91632953844e893ab117756f2880eac0b.en: A workshop for 12-15 year olds to discuss mental health and wellbeing while creating an original comic book with author Benoît Broyart.

311b863947379aaf76a2b3ae74251b715cf87eec.en: An outdoor presentation by Violette Figueras at Musée Dobrée revisiting a 1560 painting to explore themes of justice, peace, and solidarity.

f2b43bd5946f9a9caa5b9966801c2ba7d36541be.en: A workshop dedicated to seniors at Espace seniors Barberie to help secure daily pedestrian travel with the local authorities.

453d7aea1e115753408d30f83b6092364afbf4a2.en: A participatory and humorous family show at Théâtre Rue de Belleville where professor Peter Drake shares his research on dragons.

1a18620c40a2cb273d9a81b54833df45d90cfc16.en: Venez réparer votre ordinateur ou explorer de nouveaux systèmes d'exploitation lors de cet atelier participatif à prix libre. Une belle occasion de prendre soin de son matériel ensemble.

c43d1cbf20e54e164634ad4a768eed636fae259f.en: Explore events across Nantes during Pink October to raise awareness for breast cancer screening and support the Ligue contre le cancer.

9a2d9235bcec54196d97ac262acb9dbf486cd432.en: Law students and Campus present Fuego'ween at Warehouse, featuring a Halloween party with Afro, shatta, rap, and a spooky atmosphere.

22f722b40072aa7042a6d79f101bd6ae68338d52.en: Théâtre 100 Noms hosts the hit satirical comedy Chers Parents, where a surprising family announcement shatters household unity.

b9b2a38e311ea493ec63e1dcc6356fd45ff7ac05.en: An introductory geology workshop in partnership with the Planétarium de Nantes to help visitors learn how to identify meteorites from rocks.

bcf1f18edde815a426cd3cfb7073aa377bca7b9e.en: Amaurose is an interactive and burlesque show at La Cour des miracles where the audience makes choices that directly shape the characters' fate.

e51d8b0c67088b9c4432fb2b6256ce81d93ed4f6.en: Prodigue at Nouveau Studio Theatre is an absurd and philosophical tragicomedy following a corporate employee during a sudden fall.

aca0a3b54179f9623f10dc2cf123d959e5fc6a27.en: An evening at Taproom Aerofab featuring folk dance introductions, an open jam session, and a live electronic concert by Mercure.

04779a4e93df738790f281c9b6dc3a724c738731.en: Découvrez des aventures tendres et poétiques aux côtés d’un oisillon, d’un petit lapin et d’un oiseau sentimental dans ce film d’animation.

8078fc7f03983f2a249a2ac2552d1b4076fd1cee.en: Venez imaginer une histoire originale, enregistrer son univers sonore et créer votre propre fiction.

f4ec43acbefc9060a8c8023ab5861a2aa11e7b1e.en: Partez à la découverte du Château des ducs de Bretagne et des espaces incontournables du musée d’histoire de Nantes lors d'une visite guidée.

da3b84d2df18668a9622b19aa89a5ed7a1e58ffa.en: Participez à un atelier créatif pensé pour les parents et les enfants un mercredi par mois à la maison de quartier du Breil.

9ebb9ef231e19f2de7e66cc260d058622a1261a1.en: Les enfants imaginent leur propre personnage de sorcier·ère à l’aide de drapés et de peinture corporelle avant de participer à un shooting photo.

f5dea5d57d7868794f33759d59abdeec029e5f2d.en: Le crew Get Up! All Stars investit le Point Bar pour une sélection musicale variée et festive.

638260a24e9da10014ec4ecd9c162714db569f3f.en: Célébrez l'ouverture du nouveau pont Anne-de-Bretagne avec un spectacle sur échasses, une exposition et des rencontres avec les architectes.

a9b41d8a0ab7ca8881d7ad865f34af10e9d524ef.en: Explorez une exposition éphémère réunissant plus de 150 œuvres emblématiques de l’artiste de rue Banksy.

761ef0568d3595640e6bce22049a97381f3aa4c0.en: Les enfants de 9 à 12 ans découvrent l'archéo-anthropologie et apprennent ce que l'étude des sépultures nous apprend sur les humains du passé.

327f682a2ae7a10b5ccafe3b881afe7c35f2c2a5.en: Venez échanger avec un professionnel du Centre communal d’action sociale à la médiathèque Lisa Bresner pour vous informer des aides et dispositifs existants.

ea871ae541103fcb1eebb2a1cc9a7c32b88cdbbd.en: Retrouvez Colonel Reyel et Jessy Matador sur scène pour une édition XXL riche en hits.

8e2b5c9ce9d294cd5cb223b6bc97d588f076e8e2.en: Participez au Grand Loto d'Automne 2026 à la Maison des Habitants et du Citoyen de Bellevue.

98c9e3d889a2de0e7e310823168e584b436b7ee8.en: Profitez d'un après-midi festif et gratuit au Ranzay mêlant atelier cuisine, voyage dans le temps et chansons d'antan.

664f5d7251610eda6e69399346d467458e82b59f.en: Découvrez la peinture à l’huile lors de cet atelier sur deux jours conçu pour les débutants.

4cf972acfd2aecd5673fda1f2d5ee6fe191ed336.en: Les enfants de 8 à 12 ans fabriquent un dispositif lumineux pour donner naissance à un hologramme inspiré des machines de Jules Verne.

dd699238266d1d58b46d16c62074ab09dfca2dbd.en: Découvrez Endless Landscapes, une série de tableaux vidéographiques miniatures signés Nicolas Clauss qui captent des fragments du quotidien.

a27ab22788fba0da5a7289cc3c48ffe0985770f2.en: Admirez 90 sculptures spectaculaires créées à partir d'un million de briques LEGO par l'artiste Nathan Sawaya.

e3b8fee9b7b9dd8bb6f44ed08800cf6a65df2d62.en: Découvrez le mythe d'Orphée revisité dans un opéra miniature féerique mêlant piano, chant et marionnettes.

c779167f44b7d636962904d21acb75651447929b.en: Plongez au cœur du bocage et des haies à travers deux expositions dédiées à la biodiversité et aux paysages de l'Ouest.

695c644eb562fd8b070f049c94a697aa5458bf72.en: Retrouvez Jonathan Lambert sur scène avec son spectacle Vu d'en haut.

47eb22557769f9ba9c18fc23c01274246eae3e11.en: Une parenthèse enchantée autour des mots et des mélodies pour les enfants de 0 à 3 ans. Un moment d'éveil et de partage à vivre en famille.

130443b0a24bc5c6960ba27431f489c4d230967f.en: Une balade contée et sensorielle pour les 2-4 ans à la découverte des œuvres du musée. Une première rencontre douce avec l'art abstrait.

84036c9c62f80d7a19ac9d735498a47ee8a5a955.en: Un rendez-vous conté autour du thème Ami ou ennemi pour les enfants dès 3 ans. Une proposition de l'association AILE dans le cadre de Bib en fête.

47d1adb436aa2c044cf7f330721ddbcd9c2f0652.en: Une soirée spéciale Halloween à la piscine réservée aux ados de 10 à 16 ans. Au programme : jeux aquatiques, musique, friandises et ambiance terrifiante.

bd0ff2ff204faf52add507733dee722640b6e7ad.en: Un atelier parent-enfant bienveillant pour aborder la surexposition aux écrans. L'association Lève les Yeux propose d'ouvrir le dialogue et de trouver des solutions.

14b5ad137d9b28d12b7b4d18bf6a4aa6739aafb4.en: Votez pour votre film préféré parmi une sélection et profitez de la projection. Une animation accessible dès 6 ans.

f4e42541a19e344a7b63c43950bef5e1e123566c.en: Nilson présente un one-man-show tendre et piquant sur les petits tracas du quotidien. Une comédie idéale pour décompresser en couple ou entre amis.

680e3863306dfa03a6f561df02867871e244171c.en: L'association Bio-T-Full vous invite à une journée portes ouvertes festive et familiale au Solilab. Au programme : visites guidées, ateliers et animations.

b685f236d39743d5056e768ffb92e433435b7132.en: Un spectacle participatif et musical pour les enfants de 3 à 8 ans. Aidez Little à traverser le royaume des émotions à travers énigmes et danse.

f8b9e5c3d933d3a3582be1760de75e31c77810ce.en: Une soirée dédiée à la culture waacking avec une initiation et un DJ set disco house. Un événement proposé par Ladies'Co à la Taproom Aerofab.

4d598b1918e3d1eb41fa3d21faf12f2f7037d6f4.en: Venez découvrir l'Avifit gratuitement tout au long du mois d'octobre. Une occasion parfaite pour tester cette activité au Cercle d'Aviron de Nantes.

016912de4dbca67f947170d247a3ec90808fe761.en: Le naufrage du Titanic raconté de l'intérieur par Giovanni Pastore. Un seul-en-scène poignant présenté au Théâtre Krapo Roy.

acac1f21a624578e17d37a0430f699803af26349.en: Un rendez-vous matinal pour écouter de belles histoires à la bibliothèque Le Petit Chantilire. Une courte animation idéale pour les jeunes enfants.

41352702950bedc8bf1c7b237505c84355a7dfd1.en: Un spectacle jeune public interactif et musical avec le capitaine Black Sparow. Les enfants dès 3 ans participent activement à cette aventure menée par Nilson.

6711e9ddaf7a211096ab784d979cacfcc208bcae.en: Une comédie romantique qui explore avec humour les petits travers de la vie à deux. Jouée par Pauline Le Coq et Nilson, elle se savoure en couple ou en solo.

5526a658f69091d486665e52efc501c1b178222b.en: Trois amis d'enfance rallient Paris au Havre en canoë dans cette adaptation théâtrale. Embarquez pour un voyage fluvial aussi drôle qu'absurde.

529ba0f121b4c63b301e7eb9349611a1680170ce.en: Une enquête policière improvisée dans le Londres des années 1950. Un spectacle participatif mené par la compagnie Les Complices Impro à la Fabrique à Impros.

6de5f58453ea3ab9500c50cc270a540ab87e46da.en: Une future mariée passe ses derniers préparatifs avec ses deux cousines. Une comédie hilarante sur les souvenirs d'enfance et les choix de vie.

eec882010c871845525695b9936f14ffcfc92fa5.en: Nilson transforme les galères du quotidien en éclats de rire dans ce one-man-show. Une sortie idéale pour rire des attentes face à la réalité.

039047d637cd9485c342556d1ca523d3c1ffbdf2.en: Une table ronde sur le futur de la musique électronique en Amérique latine suivie de concerts. Une soirée proposée à Trempo.

8f2f42c6dce76dd478c3b2d5c8dc7a992dd658d8.en: Explore the heritage reserves at Médiathèque Jacques Demy and discover over 300,000 exceptional documents, from medieval manuscripts to contemporary artist books. Learn more about the library's history and conservation secrets.

7e798d6774b705d3b2b8924ca6a148e715dabd34.en: Enjoy a screening of the animated film Gruffalo de Père en Fils, directed by Jakob Schuh, Max Lang and Johannes Weiland. Find out what happens when a Gruffalo ventures into the deep dark woods.

5e9d2f0a501344ff29e805196afec1e7ea00705c.en: Follow young Lucie in Le Secret des Mésanges as she embarks on a family adventure guided by a pair of tits. The screening is followed by a stop-motion meeting and live animation demonstration with director Diane Dedecker.

a1ae00e28b156d432d3b37825492a1c6fa5a1cad.en: Pannonica celebrates the 20th anniversary of Pull Rouge Matic with a landmark indie-rock concert featuring original members of Swell and special guest Troy von Balthazar. Come experience a unique evening dedicated to the legacy of David Freel.

cd3144e542e2e40059ea018380561c4ad94886bd.en: Stereolux hosts the final Amarres Production showcase celebrating the French independent rock scene. Catch live performances from chest., Vera Daisies, and Trainfantome for a night of noise rock, grunge, and shoegaze.

723b0d0d87b914116dc66dc9739fa65f940a033e.en: Join Les Complices Impro at the Fabrique à Impros for an improvised Sherlock Holmes adventure set in 1950s London. Help the detectives of Clues Consulting solve a brand new theatrical mystery.

ba02e47dfd7ac49227292d59355b5021348e69eb.en: Ciné-Théâtre Bonne Garde presents Festi’Mômes, featuring a fun children's show about magical words and fairy tales. Enjoy a playful theatrical journey filled with laughter and literature for families.

14a94cec256c53964e881467c7134a2c1df83f46.en: Join this writing workshop at the Nouveau Studio Théâtre to explore tools for creating youth theatre. The session is open to adults, professionals, and amateurs with prior theatrical experience.

88a40704f93c3c2b1de1f4c4d24b2173658a546b.en: Le 20 mille hosts a creator's studio clearance event supported by the Ô P'tits Coins association. Browse handmade collections, find unique items, and discover local talents at small prices.

86f790a08bc7b82b1a112133256edf1912f1ae8b.en: The Or'Vocal choir celebrates its 20th anniversary with a special concert at Église Sainte Bernadette. Enjoy a diverse repertoire featuring French variety, film music, gospel, and contemporary sacred chants.

a08f2fa6353cc418429a201a6a1f65b1e699a51f.en: Médiathèque Charles-Gautier Hermeland hosts a discussion around the climate plan comic book Ça va être super. Authors Adèle Verlinden and Benjamin Adam, and director Thomas Rault discuss the role of art during times of crisis.

8b971913249076b7ab14f56865951dca1e01d34a.en: Discover the evolving landscape of the neighborhood gardens during a guided walk starting from Café des marchandises. Learn more about the industrial railway heritage transformed into a scenic promenade.

57905dc08883996a744180c109d01b0feac0541c.en: Le Wattignies hosts the Fête de la camaraderie to celebrate local cooperation and citizen initiatives. Enjoy collaborative games, a participatory cooking workshop, a film screening, and a polka concert.

a9284d8a08067325d531006ff8d1d715fa0826ec.en: The Corsaires de Nantes face Morzine at the Petit Port ice rink for a French Division 1 hockey match dedicated to Pink October. Come dressed in pink to support breast cancer awareness while enjoying fast-paced family entertainment.

1067fe4c13990b5f9ca197a8ddfeb576ae7f8782.en: Fabrique à Impros presents an improvised theatrical show highlighting forgotten or overlooked women in history. The audience helps select famous female figures whose lives are reimagined on stage by Cie Maestria Impro.

c1c547f41fe307ba6d335721e72dbdd48ff15139.en: The Tour de Chantenay celebrates its 100th anniversary with a festive morning featuring music, theatre, and concerts across various iconic locations in the neighborhood.

b20488769c12be7b5721bb71f929753e8f862ccc.en: CallMeLudo brings his stand-up show On fait comme on a dit to the Théâtre de Poche Graslin. Enjoy a sensitive and humorous performance exploring everyday relationships and human contradictions.

cf965e51df10f2e5696cdf93fe0635dc7d77e716.en: Ahmed Sylla presents his one-man show Origami at Zénith Nantes Métropole. Explore a humorous and reflective journey through life choices and personal destinations.

685361f105ea5ec5be367f2cfb82c7747def8b8d.en: Le Théâtre de Jeanne presents an adaptation of Alphonse Daudet's classic tale La chèvre de Monsieur Seguin. Children aged 4 to 10 can enjoy a musical and theatrical journey celebrating freedom.

d93a6feb1a9bbe9f21dc4851d05c7e5172443f07.en: Discover the Plants and people exhibition at the Musée d'arts de Nantes during a guided tour with a museum mediator.

c132ed8330b82e247c0789232d57649e950bfd10.en: Atelier Le Coquillage et l’Oreille hosts a drawing workshop focused on proportions, ink techniques, and hatching methods. Participants will learn volume rendering and apply these skills to create a final portrait from a catalogue.

2f123a4d1f62770e3014ae0493cffb3428c3ca9f.en: Manou Partages hosts an autumn gathering featuring shared cooking, travel stories from Constant Pelhate, and guitar songs by Lionel. It is a free, all-ages event to cook, listen, and share time together.

d09cb4d29ca6cbca2f45ab06367fa0e0f22f076d.en: The Métallo Sport Chantenay Nantes Athlétisme hosts the 100th edition of the Chantenay running races on October 25, 2026. Runners can choose between the 9.6km Tour de Chantenay and the 18.9km Trail Urbain Nantais, featuring surprise animations and a route through the Jardin Extraordinaire.

91968f119c59c312e0cec7891895d09d907378d2.en: Taproom Aerofab hosts a kids' party on October 25 featuring DJ VirilE, makeup, animations, and a snack. It offers a lively space for young children to play and experience music together.

d95c916202ba9d56c4f1731f277fd3aac73a7689.en: Cosmopolis hosts an afternoon dedicated to the twinning between Nantes and Niigata. The programme features a tourism presentation, a dance film screening, traditional percussions, yosakoi performances, and dance initiations.

cac1a098d6b8a8afa19eb2806f40bca64a771511.en: Le Chronographe offers a one-hour guided tour of the exhibition Maternités, archéologie de la figure maternelle. Reservations are available by mail, phone, or on-site.

a133fbdd03c3b8508a2a17326a68d046ccb1295b.en: Théâtre de la Gobinière screens Dounia le Grand Pays Blanc, a film by André Kadi and Marya Zarif following Dounia as she faces the biting winter cold and a new culture with her grandparents and friend Rosalie.

b21d300de50c208bb42449177a60ca8496825853.en: Victoire Bélézy leads a theater workshop for children aged 7 to 11 at Pôle associatif Mangin Beaulieu. Through simple and joyful listening games, participants explore guided improvisations and present a public showcase at the end of the stage.

3cf0b595032a7e2125ace4b8fef06301bf40ab07.en: Victoire Bélézy leads a theater workshop for teenagers aged 12 to 18 at Pôle associatif Mangin Beaulieu. The sessions use joyful listening games and guided improvisations to build acting skills, ending with a public presentation.

80739361466f6c09b6041744e83c2b02db8c58ec.en: Manou Partages presents a storytelling moment for children hosted by Lucette.

1ae24199d3d8df92b4263d6b60a70eac3ebddfd1.en: Little Atlantique Brewery hosts a surprise solidarity banquet featuring dishes crafted by five local restaurateurs using regional products. One-third of the tickets are reserved for food aid beneficiaries in partnership with the Banque Alimentaire de Loire-Atlantique.

1c7bcf6fb8c1ae1a39d7bf1a61392127becee6b2.en: Théâtre Rue de Belleville presents Portnawak, a family show by Productions Hirsutes for children aged 3 to 10 and their parents. Follow the Barbu siblings as they empty their toy box for a home-made American-style show before bedtime.

58ee244122f992e3967237b619216430e11821e3.en: Maison de quartier Bottière offers an artistic workshop for youth aged 11 to 15 around the theme of parallel worlds. Guided by two professional actresses, participants create a performance using movement, voice, and materials, culminating in a Friday evening show for parents.

7d4de4792bbc388a0924834c2ac75e07eaa475b7.en: Collectif Bonus hosts an art workshop for children led by Marie Aerts, where participants observe the codes of power in famous statues and design their own monument using drawing, clay, carton, or wood.

848a2efd1d8337045056996f86df5bb795acd767.en: Conservatoire Bellevue hosts an oral music learning stage exploring contemporary traditional Irish and Scottish repertoires. Led by accordion professor Samuel Le Henanff, the workshop is open to students of the Conservatoire de Nantes upon pre-registration.

9e6dfdce79b6fca78797f98d9ab03d059618ce32.en: Le 20 mille hosts a cross-stitch embroidery initiation workshop for ages 6 and up. Participants learn the technique to create a simple pixel art illustration, with materials provided and a drink included.

f3be2d1fba7aa19e7a4ca05457146cb2ca11463c.en: Plan B hosts community storytelling workshops led by artist Nathalie Papeil and illustrator Timothée Moreau. Participants aged 8 and up share stories about the Bellevue neighborhood to contribute to a stop-motion film for the Ciné Motion contest.

3cb99838e5374b3c27552fa3b15b8cb9f1731358.en: Atelier Le Coquillage et l’Oreille hosts an oil painting class where participants paint step-by-step alongside the instructor. The session covers drawing construction, color layers, and personal artistic interpretation in a convivial setting.

14d3fb9aa206d1bf6569421ce8160aae6ea0cdad.en: Maison des Associations du Port Boyer hosts a drawing, comic book, manga, and illustration stage for teenagers. Participants explore graphic techniques, develop their imagination, and create their own stories at their own pace.

40590b91e06eb93c2904abeab1f12d1a5ba366ce.en: Les petits débrouillards hosts a free digital fabrication stage from October 26 to 30 for youth aged 11 to 14. Participants learn to use laser cutters, 3D printers, and vinyl cutters for neighborhood projects.

65d09f7d57260fee6bf46082d35cb1f549e61c4a.en: Ce stage de théâtre et de boxe s'adresse aux jeunes de 15 à 19 ans résidant à Nantes et dans sa Métropole. Une semaine pour mobiliser le corps et l'esprit à travers deux disciplines qui partagent le goût du risque et du collectif.

e7ae243e9fae85613473c0150f17b6a5ef12198f.en: La compagnie s'installe au Ciné-Théâtre Bonne Garde pour faire découvrir le théâtre aux enfants à partir de 5 ans. Une semaine de création autour de livres jeunesse adaptés pour la scène.

ce79c293318d466abf345d772b5d8d697d5aa39c.en: Ce conte humoristique, interactif et musical emmène les enfants de 2 à 7 ans au Pays des Légendes. Une aventure menée par Claire Toucour et Samantha Sitbon pour rêver et découvrir des personnages mythiques.

cee48a1e1bf0f5714a1bc0d246b24fbb8ad85ba3.en: La salle festive du 38 rue du Breil accueille Pixel Breil 2026, un événement gratuit ouvert à toutes et tous. Venez participer à des ateliers autour des jeux vidéo, de l'impression 3D et du numérique.

89ac596d235bbf063df83c4642f8c20684fad8c4.en: La conteuse Rose propose un moment d'écoute autour du thème des différences à la bibliothèque Tulitujou. Une séance de 45 minutes accessible à partir de 4 ans.

6bcf488fe28fb6ab0e920ca22f322aa9ae3c6e76.en: Pendant les vacances d'octobre, le Collectif Bonus propose un atelier artistique animé par Marie Aerts. Les enfants y modèlent et construisent une cité imaginaire inspirée par les ruines et la mémoire.

7717876595bae04456525699b174f7046f129820.en: Le Château des ducs de Bretagne propose aux enfants de 11 à 13 ans une visite spéciale pour découvrir le monument à travers ses légendes. Une animation encadrée par l'équipe de médiation du musée.

4cfc551a107d41b83f22a3e9fd371ae96cbb0930.en: Le Château des ducs de Bretagne invite le public à découvrir l'exposition Expression(s) décoloniale(s) #4 lors d'une visite guidée. L'occasion d'explorer la mémoire et l'identité à travers les œuvres de Rosana Paulino et Omar Victor Diop.

b3fbde7a5f36e9205153f5fbae88077aee1cc425.en: L'épicerie solidaire Le Comptoir d'Halvêque propose la vente de paniers de fruits, de légumes et de produits secs labellisés AB. Un accès solidaire basé sur les ressources, accessible sur inscription.

f85881e450652f335d2003b490c02cfd8daf44ba.en: Ce Point Information Nantes Solidaire Seniors se tient au Pôle associatif Désiré Colombe. Une rencontre pour faire le point sur vos droits et découvrir le nouveau Guide pratique Seniors Nantais avec les services du CCAS.

bc4431300673405a6d952d3d242506447c2183c0.en: Découvrez une exposition colorée inspirée de l'album de Richard Marnier et Aude Maurel. Un rendez-vous adapté aux enfants dès l'âge de 6 ans.

75bf8390530c86c67499bbfc5ee6e2738000e1bb.en: La Médiathèque Floresca Guépin vous invite à venir découvrir sa sélection de jeux vidéo.

b11a8b139cd79303813e340d4717580b830f2c82.en: Ben H présente son spectacle de stand-up à la Compagnie du Café-Théâtre. Une invitation à glorifier ses défauts et ses échecs pour voir la vie du bon côté.

96454f156c4684e92dcf3300a580e5c39097354e.en: Ce spectacle jeune public raconte l'histoire de Céleste, une petite sorcière qui rêve d'être gentille. Une aventure fantastique et musicale à découvrir en famille à la Compagnie du Café-Théâtre.

50a0537a604fbc1107485faf397cb90a9f63f5f1.en: Manou Partages propose des ateliers de peinture intuitive et créative pour un moment intergénérationnel pendant les vacances.

16469c3fceb0013fde357d5888fccb8e46933889.en: Ce programme de sensibilisation aux discriminations proposé par l'association Magma se déroule en plusieurs séances à Open Lande. Une aventure collective pour comprendre et agir face aux systèmes de domination.

341d335f5a59edb6d9314d273c7a39010b52fe6f.en: L'équipe de La SAUGE anime des permanences hebdomadaires au jardin partagé du Breil au Parc Georges Méliès. Venez jardiner dans un esprit convivial et repartez avec votre propre récolte.

44d7a7f1f9bee11f2f0e5cf03b03c74735f32615.en: La Médiathèque Luce Courville accueille un stage vidéo animé par l'association Vlipp. Pendant trois jours, les participants découvrent les étapes de création d'une série en réalisant le pilote d'une mini-série.

c91023f9a743876b0bf37e70fa0b7e0a68a82de3.en: La Galerie Morphose accueille un atelier créatif pour les enfants de 6 à 12 ans guidé par l'artiste Nina Missir. Une initiation artistique autour de l'observation des oiseaux en ville.

a31d4548bc20dd7a1d76e477f16059d14ede783d.en: L'Espace seniors Désiré Colombe accueille un Point Informations Nantes Solidaire Seniors. Une permanence pour connaître vos droits, découvrir le guide pratique et rencontrer les services du CCAS de Nantes.

fd81ab953ebcce0b7b3037a994bb21555ff5eb84.en: Mona explores wild dreams featuring disco divas and friendly monsters guided by the Sandman. This poetic show for young audiences offers a charming journey into dreamlands.

aca8c6e9971ce965b9c11ca686ac8b2361fa70a8.en: Jack and Brume present a funny and tender Halloween show to help children discover ancient traditions and tame their fears.

95374a8b3d5965729ba7da3474edc73d448d09de.en: Olga and Colin blend stand-up and improvisation to explore childhood emotions and deconstruct the codes of couple dynamics.

5b8892bbb1591d15633d247cec56b16934673b10.en: Fanny Pocholle presents her comedy show Comment bien réussir son burn-out at the Compagnie du Café-Théâtre. The performance takes a witty and unfiltered look at the absurdities of the modern workplace.

5b9281dfce1c9d1ba2f5f44540200cc0de1c27f8.en: The Théâtre de la rue de belleville presents Sosies, a play directed by Régis Flores. Five characters seek ways to escape their solitude and destiny through a sharp and humorous story.

0d68aa1506d159b35f23b46cb33c29e8e951e76b.en: Le Ripaillon hosts senior workshops focused on safe and independent mobility. Participants can learn about available transport options, tariffs, and digital travel applications.

59b3169ba704172021b6263f4b2c9d6edc5b6d9a.en: Venez rencontrer des professionnels à la maison de quartier de la Bottière pour être écouté, conseillé et soutenu dans vos démarches budgétaires. Ce Point Conseil Budget est un dispositif ouvert à tous les Nantais.

218c4f5c0e6676782723bac176d4ab4222d3901a.en: The Bibliothèque de la Manufacture hosts a discussion group dedicated to graphic novels and their literary adaptations. Join fellow readers to talk about novels brought to life in comic book form.

9c74f2d3d752acff2b21b57297fb237dd972a0f5.en: The Espace culturel Adine-Riom hosts a public meeting to present the latest updates on the Grandes Noëlles project. Residents can discover how the urban development plan has evolved following local consultations.

51501ee77b8f5f98b572887b15a4cd608da181ce.en: The Maison de la Mer hosts a conference dedicated to Auguste Dejoie, a 19th-century cap-hornier captain from Vertou. Lecturer Dominique Dejoie explores his family history alongside the maritime heritage of local sailors.

06b6dd4000b640ee69fca87a8573547cca275f7c.en: Helena performs at Zénith Nantes Métropole for her first solo tour. Enjoy her emotional pop melodies and hit singles live.

1fd4f02d1ff57ab096e8ea2ead878b14e1e6f807.en: Learn basic genealogy, research sources, and trace your family history at Médiathèque Le jardin de Lecture in Saint-Aignan de Grand Lieu. This free workshop is hosted in small groups.

c88a8f71b754885cbbf16953a230dd16c2dca336.en: Pannonica hosts a roundtable on artificial intelligence, stage performance, and the future of live music alongside a concert by Edouard Ferlet.

5374dc00f4cfd32bc25b9e360f57950935c13139.en: Pianist Édouard Ferlet revisits Keith Jarrett's famous Köln Concert at Salle Paul Fort using AI technology. This performance includes audio-description.

787ab7453f29cbf76093b67f0427c96a12beb672.en: Children aged 2 to 8 can help the clown Gabilolo find Santa's missing magic sack in this interactive comedy at Théâtre de Jeanne.

7f15e154b301e7f23a1e36c517d415f3af461e6f.en: Enjoy story readings for children aged 4 and older at Ludothèque Accord du Breil, in partnership with the local library.

940200ff6e6a559f4f1b4a784af3f8629d329554.en: Teenagers aged 15 to 18 lead film analysis workshops and co-animate screenings at cinema Le Concorde in partnership with Creative Maker.

467564bb5fb9a3536007b1bde394a0d6b07bc866.en: Eugénie Druart discusses gender equality in the workplace and the Women Equity Label during a conference hosted by Iségoria at Audencia Business School.

4f8092b01a87b5f935b6ec553b3d9eac8610a8d1.en: Galerie Angelo presents an exhibition by artist Izabeau Jousse at the Galerie des Oubliés, blending abstraction and figuration to celebrate humanity.

973bf9298a37edef80dce83bbf8839d9f89b1e34.en: Join a collective story and sound building adventure for young readers at Médiathèque Lisa Bresner.

ddbbca63e26e9a692303d546736fdce29859ff98.en: Children aged 5 to 11 can explore arts, performance, and culture through weekly discovery workshops at Maison de quartier des Haubans.

f4e691b225d414ca10cf61bc55e88a777fb915c6.en: Share musical moments and nursery rhymes with your young children aged 0 to 3 at the Maison de la parentalité.

a31ecee0ae39215dc5c520b23b394945e0a75987.en: The City of Nantes offers affordable mutual health insurance options through partner organizations during dedicated support sessions at the CCAS.

e3c66104117bc4553c3b0449034caa23260bec9d.en: Robin Renucci directs Molière's classic comedy exploring female emancipation and control at Théâtre de la Fleuriaye.

79cae890ab2de7ca6f29403818203900d8991f61.en: Babies aged 0 to 3 can discover English sounds through playful songs and rhymes with Véronique at Bibliothèque Le Petit Chantilire.

a4ca26571e3acefe70baabad306fde157688ae15.en: Théâtre Rue de Belleville presents Molière's comedy L'Avare, followed by a discussion with the artistic team.

bf27c2b3ed1a12974125644cad0dbe70cbf25a68.en: Children and teenagers can play Super Smash Bros. Ultimate in a relaxed setting. Participants choose from around sixty video game fighters to enter the arena.
