5b19481862c026e0ced03d7b26cbe2eb205b720d.en: DJ Alu headlines the final festival event at Délirium Café with an electro set accompanied by guests. Close out the festival with a veteran of the acoustic scene.

ae7d39944c6e36933f2c3295dd0facf5c0f3f490.en: Venëhing plays hypnotic techno, industrial pressure, and schranz at Grabuge. Experience a dark and uncompromising set built on obsessive loops and distorted pulses.

a01a95b1d060d5687574fdc751f0e55a8bddf7e8.en: Monkey French is a Foo Fighters tribute band performing classic rock hits like Everlong and Learn to Fly. Catch this powerful live set at De Dannan for a tribute to one of rock's biggest bands.

12f866989895ec7f7f2f9677ca8525ea1225244a.en: Théâtre Boris-Vian hosts Un démocrate, a play by Julie Timmerman exploring the life of Edward Bernays, the pioneer of modern propaganda. Directed by Loïc Auffret and performed by Arlequin Concorde Théâtre.

6500a6043c43376599b906afc7817e7e57ccaec3.en: Enjoy an afternoon of intergenerational gaming at Centre Socioculturel La Manu with La Sauce Ludique. Discover various games, enjoy crêpes, and meet new people in a friendly setting.

1fb49fd01d379afc5af2dad42d47efe74594f596.en: CSC Accoord Bellevue hosts an entertaining evening of comedy focused on daily life and current events as part of Les Hivernales. Food options will be available during the intermission.

4544012db054baa31d7cac2f85117ea47c35e301.en: Théâtre du Sphinx presents Les Reines déconnent, a comedy featuring a colorful gallery of quirky and endearing female characters. Written and performed by Servane Lotte and Agnès Guillon Robin.

b36a3faccb1227d38a787da7e9db9ca2f86650e0.en: Maison de quartier Bottière hosts a qi gong workshop covering the five animals and seasons, led by Stéphane Wellcam. Suitable for all levels, including beginners.

4a194acc993754ae6507da9e176be6b5034471f6.en: Toxic Shore brings its cold wave and post-punk sounds to Bubar. Experience the raw and uncompromising energy of this Nantes-based band.

9d1e7081a2336c3d06d74182e77c5f07a6beca09.en: Vigilante performs at Sauvage Bar a Copain.es, bringing a mix of 80s hardcore punk and 90s rock with a DIY spirit and plenty of fun.

2f5b98b2b3610c243911767c59fb50c1631d39c1.en: The Parachute brings its garage and indie rock sound to Brocéliande, channeling fresh energy reminiscent of the early Arctic Monkeys and Strokes.

4f882b2204a4b776fa65bf75f890c65e967d70c8.en: Chute Libre performs at Taquin, delivering a hard-hitting punk hardcore sound influenced by the 90s New York scene.

76733461d98172f6cc17a5492558e5abf972155f.en: Faux Contact performs at Belle de Jour, blending rock, pop, and funk through original creations and covers.

0738bdd2a967287aea1fe42532350ce13f73f0a0.en: Hors Bord takes over Le Chat Noir for a house and techno night. Expect a rhythmic and eclectic mix to keep you moving.

7beb1e394f55c91276ab95d2cf9fd5ede30ec609.en: K-Smile performs live at Princesse Abibiche, blending reggae, hip-hop, and dancehall with positive energy.

23d171015b29257aa8c55b14d06c1e10a5905aee.en: Argalouve performs at Soeurs Carnage, offering an intimate and politically festive rap style with a touch of humor.

935fe5969a82a6ceb3fdb25e2dd655ffd12d81fb.en: MQ Madeleine Champ de Mars hosts a morning workshop on sleep and relaxation techniques with the association L'Affaire d'une Vie. Learn tools to improve your sleep quality through respiration and positive visualization.

915f3e58d747ebff229c54e30201386eb918f7df.en: Children aged 5 to 7 can discover and test instruments available for loan during a workshop led by Conservatoire musician Armelle Alexandre at Médiathèque Floresca Guépin.

66cd3130ed5ac2bde403095fb0c273933d239fe1.en: Ohm Town hosts an after-party with its resident DJs, keeping the celebration going from early morning.

9d5acccc5661f1764dd2f252a0cfe9ebbf2fd4a0.en: L'Agronaute hosts a Christmas market featuring local creators, unique second-hand finds, and responsible gifts. Enjoy warm drinks, food, and music in a festive atmosphere.

aaa9f9e085732836f690f85a9540c84093a0a659.en: Taquin offers a wide selection of music genres, including rock, punk, hip hop, and soundtracks, available on original and reissued vinyl and CDs.

cf7b9b0f973283ce0a42469c3a42cf0870c6221b.en: Olivier Rémy exhibits colorful, nature-inspired paintings at Taquin. Explore works influenced by art brut and comic books that blend terrestrial and underwater landscapes.

02c976dbb72c059c964941ba3629a72ebb1f6821.en: Terminus Brass Band performs at Oldegar with a dynamic musical set designed to get people dancing.

0d60f38c216696f26382bf0d8283eb31efc98f98.en: Boy Harsher and Choir Boy perform live at Warehouse Nantes, bringing their signature darkwave, synth, and underground electronic sounds to the stage.

98381e1f2bec6aa8d92ca0d0d2932a5922b34d1d.en: The Dirty Dandies play at Track'N'Art, covering garage punk tracks alongside an eclectic mix of rock.

9bcf642fb19cefe6e13a2b22eec1404fb325fba4.en: TDL hosts a 2000s and 2010s party in partnership with Chérie FM, featuring an energetic set by resident DJ Kataa.

fd31adc2e09e91ce15e008ed07bbea12a257b2da.en: Collectif Confluence takes over 13&3 to mark the closing of the Bar-Bars festival.

f1b7b4693c89bd7234cc831524975d50db40d5a9.en: Dont'F is a pop-rock duo performing at Café de l'Ile with raw energy, inviting listeners to enjoy the present moment.

02d9809f6750a8073a44bbce40a68486d31b4890.en: Macadam hosts a breaks and bass night featuring local artist Slodki and guests.

65a03e52483bcaa31d77ff2c500efddb9cf076e8.en: The musicians of The Del Bars switch to DJ duties at Barons Perchés, spinning a rock and mods soundtrack.

ca5bcf809e796fbd9f3f3bde5cb97736a79291fd.en: Doucesoeur plays a vibrant mix ranging from shatta, bouyon, and afro-caribbean to neoperreo and bailerave, often ending with nostalgic classics.

b6174c718f3cc7f40ef509f234b809849696afab.en: Ferrailleur hosts the first edition of Broken Window Fest, a hardcore festival featuring performances by Last Hounds, Supernova, Lerox, and more.

c12274b76aa88163fddc3484b00b3c143e2beb9b.en: Chapelle de l'Immaculée presents a baroque and Gregorian concert featuring Pergolesi's Stabat Mater performed by soloists and a string orchestra.

40a8ecfcf92b57941fbb3ef84c8bfe32f101286f.en: AK Shelter celebrates 30 years of the punk association Mass Prod with live performances by Inner Terrestrials and Suppose It's War.

665c18381caa50920038abe40b6a23cc398f7c42.en: Picon Records takes over Le Chat Noir for a multi-genre night moving from groove and UK bass to house, rap, and techno.

79bb07d13f5ac4438d6f5b5c82a3c0e93eebd9ec.en: Faustine Seilman performs a solo set at Brocéliande using keyboards, vocals, and sound textures.

84438b9c9a0008210b6a514820816a5e7300dfda.en: Stereolux presents a young audience show exploring the sounds of natural materials and questioning the boundary between nature and humans.

c921dc019c0ee18dab89916a8b373f5e424bd791.en: Espace René Cassin hosts the regional choir À Cœur Joie des Pays de la Loire for a musical show featuring 75 choristes and four musicians exploring the theme of water.

78e4f570c3b7731e092d0758b52266511854a988.en: Bar303 hosts Mane & Noty, featuring sets inspired by techno, rave, and acid music.

43d432450a440ecfc043b2e98382e89634a1edc5.en: Chez Mon Oncle presents Grève by Cie Les Hoboes, a theatrical story about six factory workers facing a difficult choice to save their workplace.

52d9da78be4140177054ec14cc9d7b8ead4bcacc.en: Sauvage Bar a Copain.es hosts Barbaquiz, a musical blind test where teams compete using handmade physical buzzers.

2375dc2b87d47f41eda4b1b3f5e2cc2133982c78.en: Enjoy a festive musical blending dance, hip-hop and winter poetry to bring light and hope to the streets. This artistic evening supports people experiencing homelessness.

65c9bf3854a2d0f97f9296cb87ea9ea94a121cfe.en: Experience a bold circus creation featuring acrobatics, contortion and a dynamic collective of artists. It explores the limits of the body through poetry and resistance under the big top.

b727e34d831092c5c4ec97a48d5587459be35a55.en: Dive into an immersive musical tale that brings a lush tropical jungle to life through sound and illustration. Recommended for ages six and up, it features a special pre-show family workshop.

0c5c6b8d405d82b7b3215415fcfd79481781383f.en: Learn to draw step-by-step using charcoal and black chalk in a supportive group setting. Suitable for beginners and experienced artists alike, the session focuses on observation and personal interpretation.

6023fd37618a06b3d04428153c5d6eed226f7138.en: Edgar-Yves Jr presents a new stand-up show that trades political correctness for unfiltered, precise humor. Catch him live in the auditorium for a dose of sharp comedy.

07c44d1bde86ca8f776fccc5a698c911fc63557d.en: Zaw hosts a special jazz brunch to close out the Festival Culture Bar-Bars.

f7e173dd11902add1a2a074c202f7eed96d6a161.en: Wind down your weekend with a special Festival Culture Bar-Bars session featuring hybrid and deep sets by Hanaka, Abia and Sojoe.

4c8b6fdb5524028c3aa9ed63534fc274c8a0db33.en: Explore the museum through an intimate, divinatory experience combining tarot and art. Actor and cartomancer Léone Métayer offers continuous personal consultations connecting cards to the artworks.

287d6c4cbd7e312a07cf4b452c6919ceb4d193f0.en: The Orchestre National des Pays de la Loire performs a symphonic concert featuring works by Cimarosa, Françaix and Beethoven. Soloist Sabrina Moulaï takes on the clarinet concerto.

74e2a2fa4d4186591e5be9df6187151da9eb588d.en: Catch the amateur medical student fanfare Les Trompettes de Fallope bringing lively brass music to the Christmas market.

1e111e72b4b50ace83b452b0aee4b6140903e19a.en: Claptrap returns to showcase their solar yet intense indie pop. The quartet blends danceable rhythms with sharp harmonies.

7bc01ccd3abdc2eeb3b98c9f80ee35637db3c5c6.en: Enjoy a family-friendly brunch featuring an all-you-can-eat menu and free entertainment for children. It is a warm and relaxed way to close out the weekend.

3ccb4a2d13b1dfd52d0fed296d4ded08cb1d1379.en: Jeanne Martinez and Katell Jaffrès present an introduction to the surrealist art exhibition. The talk highlights works from Leonor Fini to Hélène Delprat.

c20cae9a234c62214f62361dc7dbd336d96b6329.en: Three actors portray over twenty political figures in a theatrical burlesque about Jacques Chirac. The play blends sharp wit and tragedy for an entertaining look at power.

090f91201995d4fb4dd83b9870bb82e5921c99cc.en: Discover a political choral performance reclaiming female bodily representations alongside the emerging spoken word project Contre Feu. Marie Heck Mosser performs alongside musicians on stage.

497033d90c3d52372e42c96192c45ca0ba2c85c9.en: Meet local elected officials for a neighbourhood information session covering local projects and community life. The evening concludes with a friendly drink.

f48e124830ed20d49e4094dd72318e5213ab4b61.en: Violinists and pianists perform romantic sonatas by Brahms, Schumann and Beethoven. This high-profile duo brings an intense classical programme to the conservatory stage.

09e83882712d451b6db2dcf815ea69aa1ba0dba3.en: Marlène Saldana transforms Paul Verhoeven’s cult film into an extravagant electro cabaret about ambition and power. This solo performance uses kitsch and exaggeration as a critical weapon.

a55d3d3bc77727ed2f10fc786a9a65644c7ad05f.en: Experience a political choral presentation reclaiming intimate narratives alongside the raw spoken word and musical project Contre Feu. Marie Heck Mosser performs live with guest musicians.

c12d0af45cfa20e8a5703b70ad3a861768fe75f4.en: An exhibition at Médiathèque Floresca Guépin featuring artworks created by the Centre d'activités thérapeutiques collective. The pieces offer an opening and an invitation to discover an inner world through artistic mediation.

27b88bc9f5c8e63e4b206495013585fe2591ef1b.en: A free conference at La Maison de l'Habitant where the France Rénov' team shares practical keys to adapt your home and reduce energy bills. Registration is required.

76092b6de9d5ea52f6944faaf659eced929782f2.en: A double bill at Pannonica celebrating Arlt's 20th anniversary with their primitive songs and burlesque performances, followed by La Cour blending lyric singing and traditional melodies.

e27d43ba8b374e150a1102480302e39bc0e9cdd5.en: A dance, theatre and clowney show at Théâtre ONYX where a duo's attempt to present a grand dance solo immediately derails. Claire Laureau and Nicolas Chaigneau transform technical failures and absurd disputes into a sensitive playground.

69cf7b871c89f671f4f4cb69887edf55b0b1a135.en: An opera at Théâtre Graslin revisiting Bizet's Carmen through the format of a courtroom trial. The performance dissects the events leading up to the tragedy with music by Diana Soh.

fe0db1bb531a2a1bd5d8adb253ff3e93476b04ea.en: A meeting and information forum at Salle Bonnaire for parents of young children seeking guidance on childcare options, assistance, and municipal or private nurseries.

91363f4cfd30b508102523933c3f07220d5c4df4.en: A performance at Médiathèque Ormédo featuring texts by Philippe Malone read by Marie-Laure Crochant. It is a sensitive tribute to the migrants who have disappeared crossing the Mediterranean.

40f11fcf1a3fe155b5e2d4b3d97757e7906f6470.en: A concert by No Tongues at Médiathèque Jacques Demy exploring ancestral sounds and songs. The group blends the visible and invisible to create a contemporary sonic universe.

d6e7613cb4a42325b8c9e98cadf84a18fc5fa7b7.en: A historical conference at Archives Départementales de Loire-Atlantique exploring the parallel and contrasting markets of wine brandy and rum in Nantes during the 18th and 19th centuries.

10097d8096441c17c341ab29996e82f176e44aa1.en: A performance at Mixt, salle Nova where Arno Wögerbauer investigates his family's past in 1930s Austria. Using paper, matches, and storytelling, the show reflects on historical responsibility and the present.

fdb3385cea1eb95b9d203d39d91dc0a88461f61f.en: Meet the professionals behind the Nantes Museum during its renovation closure and discover the skills and stories that bring the institution to life.

326247ebc58c5775ef0217154c4d0d5526a901fc.en: A musical performance by Nosfell at Salle Paul-Fort featuring stripped-down arrangements from his upcoming album. He sings in an imaginary family language that blends music, dance, and personal memory.

f927e864f1cc90d80063e5f584930da5304d54a0.en: A concert at Piano'cktail featuring jazz vocal artist Célia Kameni. Accompanied by guitar, cello, and piano, she presents Méduse, a unique sound journey blending jazz, electro, and experimental music.

7826dd611ff742516b40a471e5953582116b7e61.en: A concert at Stereolux featuring Luiza, whose music blends cumbia, baile-funk, reggae-dub, and tropical R&B. Expect a radiant and sunny energy rooted in her international background.

34fbb89aded101993780b4d9b022c41a07f2ac8d.en: A practical workshop at Stereolux for beginners using TouchDesigner to create audio-reactive visual performances. Participants will learn how to capture sound in real time and build dynamic visual scenes.

9d959d6f6fb87c34a92c541d012ddd59f917ff79.en: A video game session at Médiathèque Floresca Guépin inviting children and teenagers aged 7 and up to play Super Mario Bros. Wonder in a relaxed atmosphere.

589ed4733fa18d3b9125a8616f43014234600845.en: An accessible board game session at Médiathèque Floresca Guépin where a librarian introduces games like Dobble, Timeline, and Cortex in adapted versions.

ef112e4a80d9e254a6727adc6b9955bc1e5e2025.en: A musical project at L'Auditorium combining contemporary, oriental, and western music performed by Interzone and Quatuor Debussy, accompanied by the voice of Khaled Aljaramani.

3d87e8e798524d4952199b0208c938f5628a7d2d.en: A free second-hand toy and game distribution event at L'Alterboutik in Rezé for the Christmas season. Families can select up to three toys and three decorations.

79b5be83b0c00cc9309fcf096dde7e2962868a67.en: Apprenez à consulter sur les postes dédiés les millions d’heures de radio, télévision, web et cinéma de l'Institut national de l’audiovisuel. L'atelier est consacré au thème des adaptations littéraires.

8a0b08ecb5e80f86938d7a14c48a137fbcbfa741.en: Quatre interprètes explorent la fracture laissée par les mutations du travail et du numérique. Un spectacle vibrant qui cherche un chemin vers une parole retrouvée et une réparation collective.

f146c65a7353179f111b7c99f8a006bee7b67b66.en: En 1943 à Limoges, un ouvrier et son jeune collègue sont contactés par la Résistance. Cette pièce est une ode émouvante aux personnes de l’ombre qui s'engagent un jour, quoi qu’il en coûte.

129761e147d9b3a1d452892a60cac4f8e9048515.en: Rémish invite Thomas Calone pour une soirée de stand-up au Mystère Comedy Club. Chaque humoriste dispose de trente minutes pour roder de nouvelles blagues dans une ambiance conviviale.

58761d5e59bb79f8147b8cf4ffa9703a9367c0fd.en: Accompagné d’une médiatrice, venez découvrir l'exposition Surréelles. De Leonor Fini à Hélène Delprat, une autre traversée du surréalisme lors d'une visite de trente minutes.

e3add41ba86a308d60cc8e32bd8427e00157b023.en: Yves-Marie Le Texier brosse un portrait humoristique et tendre du monde paysan. Seul en scène, il incarne cinq avatars pour explorer les difficultés et les limites de chaque modèle agricole.

ad8aafdbd98898b5ae64377e54c2157da6143182.en: Mélissa Laveaux présente un album intime et engagé mêlant pop indé, fingerpicking psychédélique et rock latino. Sa musique explore la vulnérabilité à travers des références littéraires.

e60e691c17bb0024d315d9ce0cd8d5647cb75842.en: L'Ensemble Scorrevole rend hommage au compositeur György Kurtág à l'occasion de son centenaire. Ce concert met en valeur l'univers intime et poétique de l'une des figures majeures de la musique contemporaine.

7f1c1d645974479c924efa5de43767b53c9f09bb.en: Marie Dupas, responsable de la collection Art contemporain au Musée d'arts de Nantes, présente un nouvel accrochage du Cube intitulé Atome et Anatomie.

fbfebcbc1a616b453e9d0fea52a1f8a8a7aa0535.en: Le Code Caché est une expérience collective pour comprendre et questionner les biais algorithmiques. Cet atelier vise à imaginer des actions concrètes pour une intelligence artificielle plus éthique et inclusive.

193f85dda5c2d3f6ef3e5fae6ace9e717837a4ac.en: Cette visite thématique explore l'histoire et l'évolution des couleurs à travers les âges. Apprenez comment la symbolique des teintes révèle beaucoup d'une époque et d'une démarche artistique.

067c175f88044e24128e466405b0645d45ed0a9c.en: Denis Plassard signe un spectacle musical et chorégraphique conçu comme une véritable émission de radio en direct. Les danseurs animent ce talk-show vivant avec énergie, humour et malice.

868e1ed346f8394f2b78ce0b581deb49a489a5d5.en: La compagnie La Chouette Boîte présente Blossom, un spectacle poétique et comique façonné à partir de douze histoires inspirées par le public.

bd698c7ed97150590a7227bb983fdc2f8e415fdb.en: Participez à un atelier intergénérationnel et zéro déchet pour fabriquer des couronnes de l'Avent et des décorations de Noël en matières naturelles. Une activité idéale pour partager un moment créatif en famille.

e4b30577fba5b24a49fccdeacb5884e51c6e45f3.en: Apportez vos branchages et tailles de jardin pour les faire broyer sur place par l'association Compostri. repartez avec du broyat gratuit pour nourrir votre compost ou pailler vos massifs.

6aff559998e5e72d33ba6cea5d4dcfc94bb81a7f.en: Esquif aborde avec sensibilité la question des exilés qui traversent la mer à bord de bateaux de fortune. À hauteur d'enfant, le spectacle questionne la peur, l'hospitalité et la force d'un geste.

91830cee1bd0cb0f0b4de36964fbbccc4e6a9c5f.en: L'humoriste Jojo Bernard revient sur scène avec un nouveau one-man-show inspiré par son voyage en Australie. Entre sketchs et stand-up, il raconte son hilarant périple avec une nouvelle maturité.

bb632c5f68320f4dfc02e165fd7cb03a468a4548.en: Aketo and Tunisiano return to the stage as Sniper for a 2026 tour. Fans can expect classic hits alongside new tracks from the founding French rap group.

e7a0158faa572e300efead4db6f81138bc003740.en: Victoria Dauberville presents a unique ballet about a ballerina who escapes her music box to find her own path. It is an invitation to experience dance beyond traditional rules.

048df953f91804ff7e200c25e13025bc26efbce5.en: Annabelle Brouard and Olivier Minot create a live radio show on stage using archives, interviews, and sound creations. It is a tender, acoustic journey celebrating stories of love on the radio.

8d18d1c24a8ae491b820a7de7608f84d13d814d2.en: Cyril Trochu and Florian Chaignev present a musical spectacle in total darkness. Experience a surprising, sensory immersion that offers a new way of listening to the world.

6b75138bf1d0ef5b85fc178bab8d465b659ec455.en: The ADIL 44 hosts an informative workshop for tenants on home energy performance and rights. Learn how to decode energy bills and understand your rights regarding housing.

ced774082ebc92c7c3d669831b5a79422604e5a3.en: The ONPL symphonic concert highlights works by notable female composers throughout history. Trumpet player Lucienne Renaudin-Vary also joins the children's choirs for festive holiday classics.

bad1608cdef6bbc86f63478f135e02c8d473586d.en: Nicolas Moro performs a solo show mixing Brassens-style lyricism with Johnny Cash blues using a guitar, banjo, and mandolin. A shared buffet follows the performance for everyone.

3eb75074f9c5e31a729cf66b146e6beabc0bfe60.en: Emma shares her personal journey and acting dreams in a lively, humorous solo performance. It is a striking show about taking the plunge at forty.

97ed547cddb5912a60d3011283d254f5f7af44a7.en: Médiathèque Luce Courville offers multilingual picture book readings for toddlers starting from 18 months.

2ae45679f66d0c6106dae061bb67102d471101ca.en: Discover and taste natural wines during this tasting and sales event open to both individuals and professionals.

dfaefa8a6bf661ae50236c2c2d306f9e3348f239.en: The CSC des Bourderies hosts its year-end loto for a fun afternoon with locals and volunteers. Join in to win prizes while enjoying refreshments and a warm atmosphere.

fa8488c6d13a53c32d10131ada8ece9ea950aaa4.en: Vote for your favorite film to watch during this special screening for ages 6 and up. A tasty snack will be served right after the movie.

359c00027a9aa2d977b6f2d162899a4d21af1113.en: The Etablissement français du sang organizes a blood donation drive at Espace sportif du Souchais. Donors aged 18 to 70 can book an appointment in advance for a smoother visit.

9c5e5e328cedb9a30dc12e3e8a0e4a26db3d58fc.en: Soprano Véronique Gens and the Aria Voce chamber choir perform a sacred music program featuring John Rutter's Magnificat. Led by Étienne Ferchaud, this is a rare choral concert.

4a620a9f2287dd0c5cb57815981dfc224411a836.en: Listen to a musical reading of Tomi Ungerer's tale Guillaume l'apprenti sorcier. Students from the Nantes Conservatory accompany the story with basson performances.

9e52fe5d52d4612c7a2b7b3f0c84b4f7165aeb71.en: Join the Troupe Permanantes for a musical comedy weekend workshop themed around the Addams Family. Participants will put on a public performance featuring acting, singing, and dancing.

df98f2f638b7cc94ef1a5b591639768011fa5a5f.en: The living library event features individuals sharing their personal experiences with mental health struggles and recovery. Visitors can walk around and listen to these human stories.

5477c2b7c0bbd70d8a6e0280d0f1ece1a3a83086.en: Format Paysage is an improvised choral narrative blending humor, poetry, and spontaneity. Four actors weave together three distinct everyday locations into a tender and comical epic.

079027e547c5a73c59e07ad97362159b7e4cc998.en: An improvised Sherlock Holmes adventure set in 1950s London. Join the detectives of Clues Consulting as they solve a new mystery.

1f4c59c3fa942c5ad61a53591e329ae056f4a2d1.en: An improvised choral narrative weaving poetry and humour across three familiar locations. Watch three distinct lives intersect in an unexpected journey.

a0e493b63615f29e44ced518d40c51a8b266349d.en: An improvised Sherlock Holmes adventure set in 1950s London. Follow the detectives of Clues Consulting as they investigate a new case.

15c1c66e012776f360cfabfdc81e73562e051d42.en: A live-streamed journey from Bamako featuring real-time video, kora music, and an investigation into daily resilience. Join the screening and discussion.

c2c6fe4fbe9c454325c44499d6304f9838601143.en: The French Blood Establishment organizes a blood donation session at Nantes Erdre. Donors aged 18 to 70 can book an appointment in advance to reduce waiting times.

07828f740aefaed7dd809385a1d01a8cbb5cbf5b.en: Comptoirs du rêve presents a sensory and musical show for young children and adults. A musician explores a white universe filled with sounds, colors, and gentle movements.

6102a70a0fc1e88e3193197f09ef79d270e956f9.en: Artist Joel Janse van Vuuren leads a collage workshop for children during the December holidays. Participants use colorful paper cutouts to explore emotions and create expressive portraits.

629fd3693bcd2d08e4c5be6a52c238c5614ecbed.en: One Charming Night at the Conservatoire de Nantes offers a musical journey through English song from the Middle Ages to today using rare instruments.

1afd600674a773496fbec1082728c3e845f261d0.en: Camille performs at Stereolux, presenting over twenty years of poetic music and vocal creation.

eff2e71cdb4fbdab5290008dc12a1e879ed85e67.en: Discover the landscapes, music, and traditions of Bolivia through a documentary screening and discussion at Espace Vie Locale.

6d7ca6c9392d3b43b1bd50c8c735b9de2142df12.en: Le Chronographe hosts a dual-perspective tour exploring motherhood through both archaeological and healthcare lenses.

f2bca66599e64a5c546e9466db18ef8317882850.en: Louis Caratini presents an interactive musical show at Salle Paul-Fort blending popular French songs, rare tracks, and a blind-test.

ec2fa1674dd295c3bab8ee057263ad1e71d3d17c.en: Maria Moreno presents her stand-up show at the Cité des Congrès, sharing chaotic and funny everyday anecdotes.

a4b51c176c9666bc4ec42878fe75e086a43e88fe.en: The Musée d'arts de Nantes offers a gentle first discovery of its spaces and collections for children aged 2 to 4.

bfa69f694b6ef27e5acc56e06df2fb5795a8d3d7.en: Salia Sanou presents a performance at Lieu Unique blending video installation, singing, and dancing with Cameroonian artists.

34c3305d278680ad0b9da28281ae2c9c7d9890b7.en: Lilie Printemps and Damien Joëts present a colorful, humorous musical concert for children aged 3 to 8 at the Théâtre de Jeanne.

c923622b7024cccd083ff0853a63496d18ccd88f.en: Kelly Rivière stars in a tragicomic solo show at Odyssée, retracing her journey as an actress and questioning what it means to succeed in life.

2e69662dea92c45f6c50042952d3e3e1b9535bbf.en: Tidiani N’Diaye and Fatou Traoré perform a dance duet at Mixt exploring themes of friendship, history, identity, and transmission.

5d0be17018c422b5f0822d45590a36f11239be7a.en: Salia Sanou presents a ballet for six diverse dancers at Mixt, blending Bach, kora music, and electronic sounds as part of the Trajectoires festival.

70788eae88e643eca43517542a3040e775b8f211.en: The Musée d'arts de Nantes and Maison de la poésie invite author Claudine Galéa for a poetry residency linked to the museum's exhibition.

46c41f881897278006a6b90c8c0dd831bfc8230c.en: André Manoukian performs at Salle Paul-Fort with an album paying tribute to his sister, blending family memories, jazz, and oriental influences.

bf2a33392becd8f693c83e42f112e77fd65b7599.en: The Orchestre National des Pays de la Loire performs a symphonic concert featuring works by Mussorgsky and Rachmaninov at the Conservatoire de Nantes.

655cac5482a81f15989569308beb6c3cf624910f.en: At the Théâtre Graslin, the Angers Nantes Opéra choir explores collective power through great opera crowd scenes in resonance with Georges Bizet.

095cacb1af51275ab7f987dbbb1939be0e95c98c.en: At Lieu Unique, Elie Blanchard and Victoria Follonier present a live ciné-spectacle exploring the mysterious and familiar world of the night.

a088af970de959cfbdb7347ecb54568229e88558.en: At Stereolux, Izïa presents her new cycle, bringing her powerful and vulnerable voice and unique blend of rock and pop to the stage.

2b4b30caa9e26987d127c13e1755bd80508180cb.en: At Mixt, Group Berthe presents Trust, a participatory electro-techno show celebrating friendship and human connection through singing and dancing.

e00f8548f0961fc7644a8db53d4ae8df411ebd19.en: At Théâtre Ligéria, nine performers blend circus arts and dance in an immersive show that turns into a participatory ball for all ages.

b8f07fbcb43eab2ec66fee0034a0c9fa6e18dd01.en: At Maison de la Carrière Bourg, join an immersive day combining a wild plant cooking workshop with a guided botanical outdoor walk.

6ef14be1842f3b6e7d67615a860e5a30decbab1b.en: At Warehouse, melodic techno pioneer Kölsch performs an early evening set from 19h to 00h, supported by Colette.

7d2bfcdb0ae3067603a86de4fa5c8ca01bf3097f.en: At the Musée d'arts de Nantes, children aged 5 to 7 observe museum artworks before creating their own scratch card drawing.

8de720619a24d127fa15884223a221376741961d.en: At the Musée d'arts de Nantes, children aged 8 to 11 use charcoal and chalk in the studio after exploring artworks in the galleries.

ab100ba7a7a4186b36a1f3162af48d06c4f75e6a.en: At the Cité des Congrès, the Grissini Project performs the iconic film scores of Joe Hisaishi from Hayao Miyazaki's animated masterpieces.

3d93d0b82a86543ee96b513eafde8f9ef871f914.en: At Maison de la Carrière Bourg, learn how to cook seasonal wild plants and create original appetizers and cocktails with an expert chef.

7ef921ce4b0fc223c654ef0510cf549e105f50ed.en: At Capellia, Hanoumat Compagnie presents Moi Peau, a contemporary choreography exploring the skin as our primary sensory connection to the world.

7afd64a55b078304f222f230882ddea229870c14.en: At the Cité des Congrès, the Grissini Project performs the powerful and epic themes from Attack on Titan in an immersive concert.

46962ad89bf29edb6dd16d1f0368752822abddac.en: At La Fleuriaye, the artists of cirque Inshi combine classical and Ukrainian folk music with high-level acrobatics and poetic resistance.

e6c54b59318f4ca1673e913e9078d680576cc0e8.en: At L'Auditorium, Claire Laureau and Nicolas Chaigneau explore the humor of the banal through a deliberately chaotic theatrical performance.

553005a3a8b097d4043c31405ab96c8c8c3bf3dd.en: At the Théâtre Graslin, students from the Conservatoire de Nantes perform a chamber music programme inspired by the passion of Louise Labé's sonnets.

95a64f9c7e754b6805aa182e673d19470305acb8.en: At the Cité des Congrès, humorist Ana Godefroy presents her one-woman show analysing generational flaws and personal mishaps.

2a2fa7a2d0e53c32c055cab4e74dc09497c6903f.en: Athletic bodies and lights combine for a circus performance exploring resistance and war. The poetic tableaux blend innocence with the tension of combat.

840a81911c38d13090480a337337b8d29ecea542.en: Singer-songwriter Nicolas Jules celebrates thirty years on stage with a unique anniversary concert. He performs with Roland Bourbon on drums and Frédéric Jouhannet on violins.

644b1d02a6f85bdd967c214fa30d830ce02016a2.en: Historian Manon Bril brings her internet vulgarisation to the stage to explain humanity's absurd history. Expect a fresh look at the past with a support act from Lou Howard.

6254b526fc95d2a9e753461f1311efc835fb6a26.en: Nicolas Jules presents an evening of singular humor and poetry celebrating thirty years of artistic freedom. Discover an unexpected world where the absurd meets profound humanity.

72a77df46659963546a2c3a84a541f9d5b7461cb.en: Explore the history of photographic collections from African worlds at this public conference. The event highlights photographic information and archives from the French Ministry.

12b6b7c5bbe515d7a1575782f459a7b2499964d2.en: Emmanuel Noblet adapts Tanguy Viel's thriller about a man facing a judge after a real estate scam. Vincent Garanger stars in this intense face-to-face story.

1722ecec4074b572c5c95968b4b34e737ce37188.en: Dancers and percussionists unite to perform Iannis Xenakis's avant-garde masterpiece Pléïades. The collective experience transforms complex music into a powerful physical landscape.

dfa4c166c590877bfc2716697200094083fb89d9.en: Julien Sigalas and Etienne Champollion pay acoustic tribute to Jacques Brel through guitars, piano, and accordion. Rediscover the Belgian singer's greatest works in a poetic concert.

f9a597d64733bedd6d63f12f83f9fa80139bd3b6.en: Nash shares funny, touching anecdotes and personal stories in an interactive stand-up show. Expect a warm atmosphere filled with laughter and positive energy.

83d4702d7004e5adef125757de30c53fd1d9f372.en: Frédéric Jouhannet leads a musical adventure filled with surprising sound objects and mechanical horses. This inventive show invites families to travel through imaginative Caucasia-inspired sounds.

45c87b1bec6afa5ec211fd1f82d818753ea4a1ba.en: Virtuoso Farnaz Modarresifar performs on the santûr alongside western instruments and a soprano. This quartet creates a musical bridge through improvisation and shared tradition.

f315eb3bfcb9b5336fd7ce4530c62adcde3957fd.en: Julien Sigalas and Etienne Champollion bring Serge Gainsbourg's poetic repertoire to the stage. Enjoy faithful renditions of his most memorable melodies without artifice.

5a1b6d80b161390c066c87dd919fee64eb8daf91.en: Follow the compelling story of Alan Turing from breaking Enigma to building the first thinking machine. Discover the man whose work shaped modern computing and artificial intelligence.

b607aabf47ac79e700f069f2bdca72a41ca91db0.en: Corinne Gazull and David Humeau share their passion for music and literature through covers and original songs. Bring a vegetable for the chef to cook while you enjoy the show.

38d6322841d934b00953cefdf0876accbac8f184.en: Multidisciplinary artist Aloïse Sauvage returns to the stage with a new album. Experience her raw energy and physical intensity live.

de254596aee7c1ecbec318a15d87f088c3da86ec.en: Georges Feydeau's classic vaudeville comedy features seven colorful characters caught in a series of hilarious misunderstandings. A family dinner goes awry when a young student is mistaken for a famous tenor.

6febf7223f835db2eacf2295d3025c2c70cd9f86.en: Dancer and choreographer Aurélien Dougé leads a lunchtime encounter bridging live performance and visual arts. Join the artist for an hour of discussion at the museum.

77d6c9d2ac5147b69384b360ac778518ddcdfc4a.en: Singer Raphaël takes on an unexpected karaoke challenge accompanied by three musicians and video design. The show blends live music, humor, and technological satire.

98da5f436b7e57c2970e006e08c505794ee231b3.en: Join a public debate on the growing trend of child-free spaces and what it reveals about society. Experts discuss the place we grant to children in our cities.

95dc6de3b587df46bf7532126d56957b3a1060ca.en: Florent Billy, François Girard, and Thibault Maignan perform piano trio works by French composers from the early twentieth century. The concert features music by Gabriel Fauré, Lili Boulanger, and Maurice Ravel.

d10a69582cd49019a94a43de12bdc74cd300b746.en: Dom La Nena revisits her repertoire in an intimate setting, specially rearranged for a string quartet. Audiences can experience a sensitive dialogue between multiple cellos and violins.

c14dea2632b54aa3f3c2202b74c83372a6e8a455.en: Luther takes the stage for the Sublime Tour, bringing his dark, sincere universe and dense rhymes to fans. This stop features his signature generational malady and atmospheric flows.

0ab5e96ac7a52b741cc87f6be791ade6e3f2ccb5.en: Bertrand Hénot stars in a theatrical lecture where Sigmund Freud humorously explores psychoanalysis. This show offers a light, caring look at the human unconscious and clinical work.

e878ed3acf83364b31ff54800d9f3c0d2004eaac.en: Christian Hecq and Valérie Lesort present a stunning stage adaptation of Jules Verne's classic. Six puppeteers bring underwater creatures to life using clever lighting and sound.

74b05bc6eac14a2203f30410551ed809a80a09ba.en: Choreographer Steven Michel explores our relationship with time and memory, inspired by spiritism. Four performers are guided by invisible forces in a sensory journey.

6b895db5352ec98226455f24e92f94fb93a7d113.en: Visitors can explore the exhibition through a descriptive guided tour featuring relief drawings. This session is specifically adapted for blind and partially sighted guests.

15712655655e30809745e7c7c57b618fd34c348a.en: An interactive adventure designed for children aged 3 to 8 and their parents. Young spectators can dance and play alongside a dragonologist meeting colorful creatures.

52ecfdc7324b002b262a86c7a59900d165c9ee6a.en: Daniel Camus shares colorful stories inspired by his years running a bar. He welcomes audiences into a diverse universe filled with eccentric characters.

f432665076da87bc4de396c057f4e18874e6cf7d.en: Discover the museum's exhibition in French Sign Language during a bilingual guided tour. The visit is designed to be accessible for both deaf signers and hearing audiences.

889609009f2e844f06c16e5783187ee1a87b4962.en: A conference exploring the history of religious devotional medals sold to pilgrims in the Nantes region. Experts discuss these small metal images and their cultural context.

240b3714c67e8f42ecdd807ae871afaf158ea91c.en: The Franco-Swiss rapper brings his creative, unformatted style to the stage for the Sublime Tour. Expect a mix of melancholy and energetic tracks delivered with precision.

3ae7d71058c5a8b8eaa1e977d1d615bc99d2bcee.en: Three dancers translate olfactory sensations and tastes into movement inside an intimate cabaret setting. This sensory experience invites audiences to reconnect with gourmet memories.

4ee4a8083cb3e60e77bf3209756d74be3dfa7966.en: Laurent Brethome stages Victor Hugo's epic play with a large choir of amateur performers. This theatrical fresco tells a passionate, fast-paced tale of freedom and betrayal.

81a116162e990a7737b667805de397f8c5b86148.en: Two actors bring thirteen different characters to life in a fast-paced vaudeville show. The performance relies on witty dialogue, sound effects, and rapid plot twists.

24503d3df430d0118b55f8fae548de9a50b0b342.en: Tristan Petitgirard directs a gripping new play about the double life of athlete Toumany Coulibaly. The story explores the tragic spiral of a promising runner caught in addiction.

49e530ecc801a7e4c29b926256551e26bc7e6d0d.en: Juliette Magnevasoa presents her organic solo project combining folk and chanson influences. Audiences can discover her singular sensitivity and daily musical rituals on stage.

d9266b8f6c5324f176a20b354a96bb0308fd8a98.en: Véronique Balme presents a musical theatre adaptation of Andersen's classic tale for young audiences. Using puppets and clever sets, the show explores the adventures of a tiny girl.

c14ebad1623e469e3c8bed5f6ea079e9a3f2d4f8.en: A playful storytelling show for children aged 4 and up featuring quirky tales and colorful characters. Comedians bring reimagined fables to life through the magic of words.

6b820e97c54b8c1ed5eb6764af8f194bda47517e.en: Thomas Fersen shares poetic stories and songs inspired by a whimsical journey to Mexico. Accompanied by three musicians, he recounts a humorous tale of youth and growing up.

950647ea7f44891c685f6e1cc088a0dcfceffc87.en: David Sun présente son premier spectacle de stand-up, oscillant entre souvenirs de médecine, CrossFit et questionnements existentiels. Un moment d'humour pour découvrir sa reconversion artistique.

37fc55bc648abb4311a35aa028bc1913407d9aeb.en: Un ciné-débat autour du documentaire de Samuel Poisson-Quinton retraçant l'œuvre de Gilbert Nexer. Une projection poétique suivie d'une rencontre avec les auteurs.

7b5370369e6df9eb7254e46529d4122b0441121a.en: Un spectacle de théâtre et marionnettes revisitant Le Petit Chaperon Rouge dans une version belge actuelle. Une comédie vive pour questionner nos peurs et aiguiser son esprit critique.

dfc33a0b1bd504de355a0e17ca8f183ed30f418f.en: Phia Ménard présente une pièce visuelle et poétique où des créatures légères tournoient au rythme de la musique de Debussy. Un spectacle pour contempler l'air et le mouvement.

80250daa0ee223c1b0ac5c5aaa59b8a21c775126.en: Nantes accueille un stage exceptionnel de Tuishou animé par le champion du monde Naxo. Une occasion unique pour les débutants comme les pratiquants de perfectionner leur maîtrise du contact.

85138832f7873a5b01699291d5b4bf057999f8f8.en: Guillaume Perret présente son nouvel album From Silence, un voyage entre jazz électronique et musique cinématographique. Un concert immersif porté par un dispositif scénique hybride et précis.

0f1b167a826ed8b76047ea42893c5dd6966ad62d.en: JF Pauzé, auteur-compositeur des Cowboys Fringants, présente son premier album solo sur scène. Un concert généreux et festif à ne pas manquer.

c52d109179a1c6d7613a5b2e4f9a2531b072a3c5.en: Trois ateliers guidés par des expertes pour aborder sereinement la fin de vie, la mort et le deuil. Une occasion d'obtenir des clés concrètes pour organiser ses volontés et échanger avec ses proches.

b5779c48b8ee4af53d87e3238feae74870ad07f2.en: Un spectacle choral de l'In Itinere Collectif qui entchoque les crises écologiques et sociales. Une mise en scène inspirée du cinéma qui donne autant de poids au geste qu'au texte.

e0bf1c3a5a9f04f4b7b2e90abeb89bd46e521c62.en: Trois artistes portent cette fresque musicale inspirée du Comte de Monte-Cristo, entre voix, guitare et piano. Un spectacle vivant qui plonge le public dans les tourbillons de la vengeance d'Edmond Dantès.

7b34009f44c406ec17cfa655271fdab228ddeaa4.en: Geoffrey Le Goaziou présente son nouvel album Où timbre le silence lors d'un concert intime. Une exploration sensible des doutes et de la nature humaine.

c1779ab486e065dc83b8bf12f17bdc188e95beea.en: Un spectacle de danse poétique et fantasque suivant le voyage d'une petite feuille emportée par le vent. Une création sensible signée Sylvain Riéjou et Hervé Walbecq pour célébrer nos rêves.

11ca254709c3c955caed1e819ff714dc6ff02cb5.en: François Salque et Vincent Peirani revisitent l'œuvre de Bach en croisant classique, musiques du monde et jazz. Un concert d'improvisations savoureuses et d'interprétations inspirées.

0944e4acfc4257f89df1ba684e58f146fa637f31.en: Un spectacle entre polar sensible et quête intime qui explore le désir de disparaître. Une création visuelle et physique mêlant réalité brute et échappées poétiques.

ee10031604f64fe8c45b85ba5155379e704d05c8.en: Eric Bouvron and Didier Gustin present a musical comedy about a post-mortem friendship with Johnny Hallyday. Enjoy a sensitive road trip blending songs, humor, and impressions.

8ebff9c8f6fd829002d6ec406af28d37f6f80102.en: Sources Fest brings together iconic French rap figures like Médine, Lino, Zaho, Neg' Marrons, and Cut Killer for an intergenerational celebration of hip hop history.

53f3b8e14f45efbd1ca6aa742e0ed68f2feb14a5.en: The Hanoumat Compagnie presents a dance piece inspired by Paul Éluard, using visual effects to tell the poetic story of a girl who dreams of wings.

4ac77e729908f36e0a684f528a9d76ad90e3cbbf.en: Edouard Deloignon presents a one-man show about feeling out of step with life. Enjoy an hour and a half of letting go and shared laughter.

6b738ec1625a991e2a4e5dbe14baac5095df120a.en: Led by Monsieur K., La Barbichette Cabaret blends music, drag, and satire to question social norms and celebrate differences.

b7984e9a8219f0b715241de05dcc05933212bb59.en: Alexis Le Rossignol presents Chamboulé, a new stand-up show born from the unexpected twists of life and impending fatherhood.

1f9967003a3e3d42930a592ba90d6758d39ec147.en: Julien Sigalas and Etienne Champollion pay acoustic tribute to Renaud with intimate performances of his poetic and rebellious songs.

c63d943bffbf41de3cf9865149aaacf900088e10.en: Juliette brings musical storytelling to life, turning everyday situations into charming musical sketches inspired by proverbs.

fbbf5290449f17f039af040130865b757bb5b305.en: Fane Desrues and Sylvain Didou present L'Envol, a gentle musical collaboration combining piano, voice, and double bass for an intimate experience.

2bcc02c31eb8d8b3b7d2a17fb8005982903fd0fb.en: Tiago Rodrigues stages a dystopian dialogue between a father on Earth and his daughter on Mars in 2077. This science-fiction piece explores the universal distance of family.

9a09f23e210db315fea1354f5728434dec5a840c.en: Three lifelong friends see their relationship tested by the purchase of a white monochrome painting in this witty theatrical comedy nominated for four Molières.

efc15fa719176a5dc3c36acb420100fe64b59f3c.en: Toutouig La La offers a gentle musical nap for babies and parents, featuring soft sounds and soothing lights in a cozy setting.

f0b1eee2a7d119ca04195b6debc77c64f21a29e4.en: Thomas Poitevin plays multiple characters in Yaourt, a solo show exploring the awkward and funny ways people try to fit in and get along.

acf853b00cea0e9f25b83a33b72f610f18ef5697.en: Julien Sigalas and Etienne Champollion perform acoustic covers of Alain Souchon's most beloved songs in an intimate concert.

2871fd19b3e414cf8f0a276a280c3890d361bd7d.en: Quartet Badeau blends traditional Vendée music from 1960s archives with modern arrangements for an immersive performance.

61fec8365e0609d84fe83577086d20fde3f4aeeb.en: Camille Tissot presents her debut one-woman show, Heureuse, where she humorously navigates anxiety, motherhood, and daily life.

b98d711fb2c5a8359d226540092ff1cf6aecbbfd.en: Camille Tissot presents her debut one-woman show, Heureuse, exploring anxiety, motherhood, and daily life with humor across a 70-minute performance.

c881aa9e32b8dc06eb17130eb94659870498ba53.en: Blending theater and movement, Annette tells the inspiring story of a woman who finds freedom and love later in life.

2679f7cdda52f4af408d243fcfddf8856bdbe0e9.en: Choreographer Christian Rizzo explores the forces of abstraction and the void in human relationships through a subtle dialogue of movement, light, and music with seven dancers.

018f3752d5435b7ca97ce0f7ce47c1819a57af69.en: A public debate addressing why contraception remains largely a female responsibility in France and exploring the existing options and barriers for men.

a952a2a7fa1bc3ae064fac29bf7259fece674eb1.en: A performance at the intersection of theatre and dance that follows a woman's journey of emancipation, celebrating the freedom to reinvent oneself at any age.

485a23a3e891f1e72808cab51a612dfc6914934e.en: Linda Hayford and the Paradox-Sal collective present a powerful hip-hop dance piece exploring identity and collective strength through a sci-fi inspired community of hybrid beings.

9b3a7d9c8550dae5894f7569dae811b8bd74cb76.en: Stradivaria invites audiences to discover the intimate musical world of Anna Magdalena Bach, the accomplished second wife and collaborator of Johann Sebastian Bach.

850853a72c0939814b7057f4c110dcde9e6123af.en: Sascha Goetzel leads the Orchestre National des Pays de la Loire in a symphonic Beethoven program featuring the Romantic wind serenade, the Grande Fugue, and Symphony No. 4.

4c12e4cbb38490031972fdfc6cbc76f62f165a50.en: Guillaume Fosko presents an introspective stand-up show exploring the humorous and sincere realities of modern family life.

89692bed6715bb9a1dbd19c5a339bb553e3c5eca.en: The Schola de la Cathédrale and Cantates Spirituelles perform works by J.S. Bach exploring the multifaceted theme of death as both a transition and a sorrow.

0e6de44633aff44b44c6d69aeb6f8ce7a40e1981.en: Orléans-born musician Johnny Jane delivers melodic, melancholic pop songs driven by raw, sincere lyrics and a distinct sense of spleen.

e312fcf3cb4690006376901466e0838dc749dac4.en: Cie Canicule presents a collective journey through the memories of an indomitable elderly woman, offering a unique perspective on aging and personal freedom.

94db35ef7728aeb8c8243f3a0e09c3984ac84adb.en: The pioneering French hip-hop group Assassin returns to the stage with their uncompromising socially conscious rap and a brand new album.

52653c673574706f752d390f7da8f34549d7bc00.en: Guillaume Meurice explores the historical causes of current political and social issues in a comedic show aimed at understanding the system and combating resignation.

b58a30395535352a59f2d806c80bd3484a6521a9.en: A concert featuring various compositions by Liszt, Schumann, Reger, Rimski-Korsakov, and J.S. Bach that incorporate the four-note musical motif spelling BACH.

25b6c964e89f8e843f47f3e4a2d6c6e55a0bb8f3.en: A musical comedy about a small lie that spirals out of control, celebrating the joys of childhood and the complexities of honesty for audiences aged six and up.

7c4246241b3046d37cfd5e07ddcf64398037f663.en: A friendly 90-minute workshop where participants can learn basic crochet techniques with guidance from Elodie of OmeBonheurs, complete with drinks and snacks.

c58a86c9cb4b1595bf0350241e4a2e3d8890751b.en: Jean Le Peltier stars in a solo show blending science, illusion, and personal narrative as a self-proclaimed mage returned from the future questions our perceptions.

962f95eac8fc295dc8c263f1fdf7b11be9148819.en: Piers Faccini presents his delicate folk and blues songwriting from his album Faultlines, questioning the place of human creativity in the age of artificial intelligence.

04aaa2e8714b020e11a89c3de52ab335d45d794c.en: Élise Lerat and her trio explore the connection between dance and ritual through powerful movement and Mathias Delplanque's electronic music.

b079df4c459f2a6e7df0404b865969edc05af710.en: Renowned pianist David Fray performs a recital celebrating French baroque composers and the art of transcription, featuring works by Royer, Couperin, Rameau, and Bach.

7e5a5a1c5ffe230a590956e631292b074974d58a.en: Christophe Alévêque delivers a humorous and satirical press review targeting politics, current events, and people in power.

6442d19a9f90179449c6452bf51b4e7c1702ccc9.en: Martin Harriague and Émilie Leriche present a dance performance exploring romantic attraction. Accompanied live by the Ensemble 0, it offers a delicate dialogue between movement and music.

dc986bb44d9276e4faaa99f51b0ec5ed41dee1bb.en: This touching human tale follows Victor, a teenager who uses slam poetry to navigate everyday struggles. It is a heartfelt story about youth, solidarity, and connecting with the environment.

fb6be74257503c781b86915f3311b33aaf9dca8c.en: Discover chansigne, an expressive art form blending sign language with the emotion and rhythm of French songs. Emmanuelle Laborit invites everyone to explore this unique contemporary Deaf art.

fceaf15babe4d8165d79a0abc23b17bd0946dea8.en: The Musée d'arts de Nantes opens its doors to student creativity for a festive evening. Enjoy unexpected tours, performances, and concerts that offer a fresh look at the museum collections.

890655fbd4b28fbb12d21457ff38bbd4786e5713.en: Andy Emler unites his trio with eight renowned clarinetists for a bold and luminous jazz creation. This unique musical adventure showcases collective cohesion and artistic freedom.

ceb09eaf7c49640b57f8296043c138acc3d58124.en: Nicolas Pelissier presents a documentary exploring contemporary Cuba beyond the postcard clichés. Join this screening for an authentic look at a people facing historic change.

bb2e68a46e6ee0f011ee3ac147dd4ad4b6843922.en: Bertrand Belin presents his eighth album, Watt, blending rock, electro, and blues. On stage, his enigmatic poetry and minimalist phrasing create a captivating musical atmosphere.

4269a887c2bcd5dc093f023862fd3ca561a6c5c2.en: A blocked novelist meets an eccentric housewife in a waiting room, leading to a surprising dinner invitation. Performed by Compagnie Slash, this comedy explores a funny and complex alliance.

ce251ed6dcaf75acf03155b59ede4d59e92a0a16.en: Celebrate the fifth orchid exhibition and sale inspired by Jules Verne. Explore diverse plant displays, attend repotting workshops, and discover rare species from around the world.

e6d7484e68ee82fd3d01c67a8bb895256706c6b0.en: Choreographer Jan Martens presents a hypnotic performance where eight dancers jump to create a raw, rhythmic soundscape. It questions the boundaries between art and endurance.

ef8b58bb9a1ede9ea313fee26bf155e4885b85b7.en: Rodrigo y Gabriela bring their signature instrumental virtuosity blending rock, folk, and Latin music. Expect an impressive percussive energy from the Mexican guitar duo.

5c58661bec49aba3a7b908f3d82e3c3a89652b82.en: Six actresses and four justice professionals bring to life the reality of a fictional staff room. This play explores the complex daily efforts to understand, judge, and prevent violence.

ef3bb4941c65ad43b2190b103bffce014ab415be.en: Saodaj blends traditional Indian Ocean maloya rhythms with western sounds and powerful vocals. Founded in 2013, the group brings a fresh, contemporary energy to ancestral musical traditions.

efa00a6edbe3db9c2903f79582df18b925e66e96.en: Join a friendly crochet workshop to learn how to make granny squares from a diagram. All necessary creative materials and guidance are provided for a cozy and creative evening.

c169e193d03cf2a4478a9ffa1d276fd752de5c0f.en: Anaïs Allais Benbouali presents a modern tale addressing the tragic reality of migrants crossing the Mediterranean. Inspired by SOS MÉDITERRANÉE testimonies, it approaches a difficult subject with gentle poetry.

f6005e8d4f342456934886307dbca3106562cdbe.en: Henri Texier and Daniel Zimmermann offer a double bill of vibrant jazz in an intimate venue. Experience authentic, locally brewed jazz crafted by experienced musicians.

1b3666dc0d0576e1a599a58f06992ac3b3f6f704.en: Olivier de Sagazan transforms his face with clay and paint on stage to sculpt hybrid creatures. This captivating performance serves as a shamanic exploration of the human condition.

99e606298d1a923d2dc5e77e9109b905619a980c.en: Explore the artistic work of Florian and Michaël Quistrebert in a quick thirty-minute tour. A concise and engaging way to discover their creations at the museum.

83b44313cab931cccd08478a680f42bf57fe5b89.en: Blending stand-up and song, this performance explores the absurd question of why we preserve life. Join a Thursday evening reflection on existence with a touch of humor.

4703c3946e1943d39248df6511e92f7d46434b61.en: Belgian artist TeddyBear delivers a striking blend of rap and song with deep lyrics and a unique voice. Catch this rising musical talent live on stage.

2654d5c79c0f6e3d6272813a3e3285f80452e39e.en: Enjoy a symphonic concert at the Conservatoire de Nantes featuring Shostakovich's Chamber Symphony and Pergolesi's Stabat Mater. Violinist Matthieu Handtschoewercker leads this poignant musical journey.

94ea6a0df2d97544b8f4e375796643d1f227a301.en: At the Piano'cktail - Théâtre municipal de Bouguenais, Yves-Marie Le Texier shares a humorous and heartfelt portrait of modern agriculture based on his childhood in a Breton farm.

0e20c98797845adb1ebaebd93efaa607ebfd4697.en: Pauline Croze performs at Salle Paul-Fort, presenting her new album Jour se lève. Discover an hypnotic blend of dream pop and cinematic poetry inspired by eclectic musical influences.

c0a924fc1c9afeac34538c79aa7e22114b031c64.en: Head to the Théâtre de Jeanne for a sharp and funny comedy about parents, school, and unexpected encounters. A divorced father's meeting with his son's teacher turns into a hilarious clash.

f252308bb714716ffaf698aa1835619eb15f6178.en: At Capellia, Méliné Ter Minassian presents a powerful solo show blending personal memories with collective history between France and Armenia. Explore themes of transmission across generations.

cfc5b3cf8442d079745dc50e4d03d17a2ddc7a17.en: Mixt, salle Super hosts a concert by the Orchestre National des Pays de la Loire celebrating orchestral music from the African diaspora. Discover bold works by historical composers guided by conductor Jeri Lynne Johnson.

d1d4b9e6ab59163866e131ef2972e8cf530962dc.en: At Le LAPS - Parc des Expositions de la Beaujoire, Ilyes Djadel presents his brand new stand-up show at just 27 years old.

a2dfe3eb59f4a49f5b693e46c4e5b2cb015d301e.en: Emma Bojan presents her new stand-up show at Théâtre 100 Noms. Expect plenty of humor, late arrivals, and relatable stories about daily life.

a8bd6d2bd9c3dc2ca743c636882f4a494e87c56b.en: At Sémaphore - Espace Beaulieu, Guillaume Guisset delivers a caustic and cynical stand-up show. Enjoy sharp satire on modern times and existential crises.

48b80af5c92895c369067b29143e7e72a8ad189a.en: Adèle Castillon performs at STEREOLUX, presenting her third solo album. Experience a fresh musical horizon combining French pop innocence with personal depth.

4c9a893ee332922b1803b8449c7bf835d712034e.en: At Le LAPS - Parc des Expositions de la Beaujoire, Laurent Gerra presents a biting satirical revue. Politicians, singers, and media personalities all pass through his comedic culinary review.

5fe859d5b17fd44b99073f977d984a632dab539f.en: At Lieu Unique (le), ensembles Spat'sonore and Musikfabrik perform Phillip Sollmann's Glitch. Experience an immersive contemporary music piece exploring nature and technology within a forest of brass instruments.

4ee3a79e600cbb1e099348e0986fb123e2b30d9c.en: Abdullah Miniawy performs Peacock Dreams at L'Auditorium, blending jazz, Sufi accents, and baroque influences. Experience a spiritually charged musical meeting featuring powerful vocals and trombones.

6db7e484d0fd4130b4e9337747bf65dfde458101.en: At Théâtre 100 Noms, Cédric Salaun presents a humorous stand-up show about passing thirty and trying to figure out life. Join him in a joyful quest for answers amidst daily confusion.

2fdf000aaa397f4e6dfda4c8e1cefa8e4511c15a.en: At Théâtre de la Fleuriaye, four performers use puppetry and shadow theatre to tell the moving story of Irena. Follow three Kansas teenagers as they uncover a forgotten wartime hero.

898fb332bdf25ad47a03fcc339a1e0bb7ddfe798.en: At the Musée d'arts de Nantes, children aged 5 to 7 can explore museum collections and create their own landscape using the monotype technique.

68517ffc9bff1fcf23199d936c86e72079c7de1f.en: At Théâtre 100 Noms, five performers explore the social constructs and vulnerabilities behind traditional masculinity. A humorous and raw look at the universal need to be accepted.

3820aa9b27e4516a18989c87493b5515771a1092.en: Bonbon Vodou performs at Salle Paul-Fort with their third album Épopée métèque. Enjoy a vibrant maloya rhythm accompanied by the Piment Piment trio in an audio-described show.

d4f9e4ac53a4ad1a38235b0085c738ec56a8215d.en: At Lieu Unique (le), Anna Gaïotti and Clément De Boeve present Rage, a dance performance inspired by Pier Paolo Pasolini. Experience a raw physical exploration of resistance and vitality.

622bb2059e9e3cc30607eeb95cc7c61b44d758e3.en: At Mixt, salle Nova, choreographer Sylvère Lamotte presents a playful dance piece about waiting and boredom. Six dancers transform stillness into a burlesque adventure for all ages.

1b615be91507de97394e76b84e7450debd755e0e.en: At the Musée d'arts de Nantes, children aged 2 to 4 can discover the museum spaces and collections gently with their families or childminders. Help Laszlo the parrot plan a trip to a warm country during this 45-minute introductory visit.

f47403c1849fde31ba9eb962626ab774771b95ed.en: L'Auditorium hosts a performance by three men and three women of different nationalities who use their bodies as their only instrument. Expect impressive acrobatics, vaults, and lifts in this bold ode to conviviality and human connection.

e14812edb020b1f43ab7d404f887a119fda1a060.en: At the Théâtre de la Fleuriaye, a high-ranking official tries to cover up his lateness after an infidelity, only to spiral into an absurd jealousy crisis. Eight actors deliver a lively performance featuring 1900s scenography and flamboyant costumes.

28d59fd0e86b4ed50dece87eec04f97108e85778.en: Centre Marcet presents a wordless puppet show for toddlers about a white world disrupted by the arrival of a colourful neighbor. Accompanied by live music, this visual and sonic journey explores friendship, difference, and encounters.

5af6ff638b32224053a7afdaccb39fe2725f56f9.en: At Odyssée, American singer-songwriter Wolfgang Valbrun performs with virtuosic musicians delivering deep vocals and an organic, incandescent groove. Enjoy a warm, generous, and deeply human concert filled with communicative energy.

911f42a08860e64b0c87eb6d4b2fee13097fc060.en: Théâtre ONYX presents a provocative play inspired by real-life court cases involving a sexist joke and a case of domestic violence. This unflinching production confronts the complexities and torments surrounding sexual violence in society.

cb2370276e72c93d52974be76afec96af1359c56.en: At Stereolux, Rover performs romantic, melodic pop infused with 1970s influences. Expect a powerful yet gentle musical experience combining a soaring vocal range with electric intensity.

add40194773649c4339f7df73915953bf006a92f.en: The Conservatoire de Nantes hosts a cine-concert featuring three 1917 slapstick short films starring Roscoe Fatty Arbuckle and Buster Keaton. Trumpet player Airelle Besson and a quartet provide a live soundtrack mixing acoustic jazz and electronic touches.

c6547f519913bceb01de29950bd0bf1eb998f8ef.en: Salle Paul-Fort hosts a joyful musical show by Virginie Capizzi and Thomas Cassis that introduces young audiences to jazz, pop, and bossa nova. Original songs explore childhood emotions, friendships, and daily comforts through acoustic and electronic arrangements.

ddeb1ea774e0ed2ed1202196927c3929d5204956.en: Piano'cktail hosts an immersive concert-bd where the jazz trio Emile Londonien and comic book author Pierre-Henry Gomont recreate the atmosphere of a Japanese jazz cafe. Enjoy a dialogue between live improvised music and real-time projected drawings.

7ad4be106e943ac109159c2f95cdc9a27be0c145.en: At Mixt, salle Super, Valérie Dréville performs a solo adaptation of Camille de Toledo's novel about a man tracing his family's history after personal losses. The staging combines multiple voices, live images, and historical archives to explore the enigma of transmission.

84973a2a84ea670ec0544ee77b70eb2ad1565212.en: Odyssée presents an intimate circus and theatre performance where two artists explore the theme of fatherhood and transmission. Through close interaction with the audience, they offer a powerful and luminous dialogue on family ties.

ad84a04f221d1810496f6f9bbc3d46a081b53de5.en: At Stereolux, French 79 brings his signature electronic sound inspired by classical and electronic pioneers to the stage. The Marseille-born producer and melodist delivers a powerful live set showcasing his international style.

bd7b4347045c84d4646c2f96150aaea6e92f8272.en: The Conservatoire de Nantes presents a symphonic concert featuring Mozart's vibrant Symphony No. 31, Alban Berg's delicate Sieben frühe Lieder with mezzo-soprano Svetlina Stoyanova, and Carl Nielsen's powerful Fourth Symphony. Sascha Goetzel conducts the Orchestre National des Pays de la Loire.

f00270c8494eb4d9dc89ccb404b23f973f08a937.en: At the Théâtre Graslin, choreographer Leïla Ka and choir director Christophe Grapperon present a choral adaptation of Maldonne with five dancers and 28 artists from the Angers Nantes Opéra choir. Set to various Stabat Mater pieces, the performance celebrates sisterhood and freedom.

2b9d121158827324ac54157eedfc4e4c0e5aee2c.en: L'Auditorium hosts a theatrical and musical show following Pani on a quest to find the guardian of the oceans in a frozen Greenlandic landscape. The performance uses music and storytelling to encourage environmental awareness and children's courage.

ac7126e1d9b41947bc8ad10a8f97743454199d53.en: At the Théâtre Ligéria, Emmanuel De Candido stars in a true story about a son traveling across three continents to retrace his late father's footsteps. This intimate epic explores notions of filiation, heritage, and identity.

3b1819e6eb0ec092a79a384416045d3a2f0af14f.en: At Le LAPS in the Parc des Expositions de la Beaujoire, four childhood friends gather for dinner and discover a revealing letter left by a deceased confidant. Maxime Gasteuil, Camille Combal, Charlotte Gabris, and Jean-François Cayrey star in this comedy about friendship and truth.

e894079f8e5768593d956e75996071e114ebc0a6.en: Salle Paul-Fort hosts a comedy by Marilyne Bal about a music producer who tries to announce his career change to his three ex-wives. Directed by Anne Bouvier, the play stars Fabienne Carat, Kamel Belghazi, and Tonya Kinzinger in a chaotic gathering of quips and clashes.

57b3bf5205aed87a363af771dc4717ad5136b895.en: The Gymnase Géraudière hosts the second edition of the Journée de Rencontre de Tuishou Libre, organized by Tao Événements. Beginners and experienced practitioners alike can practice push hands techniques in a warm, welcoming environment.

fba95c45f61342ae78d3ef269976fe7e767e5831.en: La Compagnie Zygomatic présente Climax, un spectacle total mêlant théâtre, danse et chant pour aborder le dérèglement climatique avec humour. Une catharsis artistique libératrice et inventive.

7faa8384c2958c0821c81d84b1d56c9e78aa44d7.en: La soprano Sabine Devieilhe présente Smile, une soirée cabaret inattendue entre music-hall et chanson française. Accompagnée au piano et au violoncelle, elle livre une réflexion intime sur la vie et les sentiments.

4abdd6dc76e2fa7dfa3e9bf30a699c0ba7605c17.en: Tété présente sa nouvelle tournée intimiste, un concert chaleureux entre chansons et poésie. L'artiste propose un moment de lien et de douceur dans un monde fragmenté.

6aa33445a7f07fb46218d8fce863af8c431ec4a9.en: Sarah McCoy se produit sur scène avec sa voix chaude et puissante, entre blues et émotion brute. Un concert intense pour découvrir l'une des voix les plus singulières de la scène actuelle.

51f1f427eb39d0cffed7c4a781ce15c3c2fbcf19.en: Arve Henriksen, Ambre Villermoz et Robert Lucaciu unissent trompette, accordéon et contrebasse pour un concert aux influences folk et jazz. Une conversation musicale européenne et poétique.

9c7e9226935a1a9135b26d9aa9f684353c6fba43.en: Hend Jouda présente Gaza ô ma joie, un seul en scène poétique en arabe surtitré en français. Accompagnée par Zouheir Atbane, elle célèbre la vie et la résilience malgré la guerre.

9f644691c49f814ffd9f67d78c7f1510dcbbf857.en: Marc Temmerman présente son film immersif Maroc, version vanlife lors d'une ciné-conférence Altaïr. Un voyage poétique et partagé à travers les routes et les paysages du Maroc.

63e28c9d576fb09bb9045013bdfb0de1bab30724.en: Le spectacle Pouvoir interroge notre rapport à la démocratie et à la représentation à travers un théâtre visuel et inventif. Une invitation joyeuse et stimulante à questionner le monde.

e83be9cbbbf3169fa11dea5c6c175fe829a3bb23.en: Le Conservatoire de Nantes invite ses grands élèves à se produire pour un concert de musique de chambre surprise. Une belle occasion de découvrir de futurs talents en fin d'études.

bfcbceb3d45ba42850fb5ffb264c7c4101450f7d.en: Elsa, Charlotte et Rebecca forment le trio Maaar, mêlant musiques du monde, chants galiciens et rythmes vénézuéliens. Un concert rythmé et chaleureux porté par des voix puissantes et des percussions.

366637f3227043d0f9469cd4c845059f08a2353c.en: Jain poursuit son exploration d'une pop multiculturelle et sautillante avec son nouvel album Soul System. Un concert électro aux mélodies entraînantes et lumineuses.

b0a1d85db4c4d9f7bf56e61e0edefab231a02139.en: Nina Santes présente Wet Songs, une comédie musicale expérimentale qui célèbre l'eau à travers la danse et le chant. Un spectacle onirique et politique porté par cinq performeurs.

e15342e9635cb06da3905241fb20076f693534b8.en: Leïla Ka présente Lullaby shot, une création chorégraphique puissante pour huit danseuses. Un spectacle brut et électro qui célèbre la liberté et la puissance des corps féminins.

c1d74b48e5ba9b45633d9d9fa28eb430d9a35605.en: Tayc revient en concert au Zénith pour présenter son nouvel album JOŸA. Retrouvez le pionnier de l'Afrolove pour une soirée placée sous le signe de la danse et de la joie.

7820112718adf8cd7dc11e57637a3cd502d1e00e.en: Un débat Place publique sur la transition vers une alimentation végétale et ses enjeux climatiques, agricoles et sociaux. En présence d'experts et retransmis en direct sur YouTube.

0e125c50f6bfb9c2ffba4f905e8ae30c627a3c0f.en: Bilal Hassani présente son nouvel album Bonsoir Paris en concert au Warehouse. Une soirée festive inspirée par la house des années 90 et la French Touch.

4f6fba5e39e62432664f2c5c3ad7c7ee49720bd3.en: Les Wriggles reviennent sur scène en costume rouge pour un concert de chansons françaises pleines d'humour et de poésie. Un mélange de sketches et de guitares acoustiques à ne pas manquer.

785fcf405b732760586b0a02a745a6daf4b289f2.en: La Yegros se produit en concert pour un mélange explosif de nu-cumbia, de folklore andin et d'électro. Une artiste génératrice d'une énergie communicative et festive.
