6444b82972e0b6bd501248bef2f041652544e7dc.en: Grignote at TNT - Terrain Neutre Théâtre is a musical puppet adventure about a young girl navigating school struggles and a summer camp with the help of a wise skulk. Written and performed by Léo Bossavit and Céline Lemarié.

cc173e084b14135c5367123ef40f8d94c3a26549.en: Stereolux hosts a concert featuring Rounhaa alongside solo and combo ticket options including Luther and the Sublime Club afterparty.

2125bc44a939978eed7cc6d6b255bd6630c94dc7.en: Indie rap and alternative pop artist Stanislas performs live at Le Ferrailleur following the release of his debut EP Topless and recent charting success.

1ea4d6a2f59dbe14701a35ab082563fea9dd32b8.en: French melodic techno pioneer NTO performs live at Stereolux, showcasing tracks from his acclaimed albums and recent collaborative electronic projects.

ccdf00690628b143302db57cf47331773106c3a7.en: CO2 Club Origin hosts an inclusive underground electronic night featuring live sets and performances by Aerae, Johnfaustus, Kasar, and Wony in a safe and welcoming space.

488ce106e9d6ab8328ad390d3f105326de0aeea8.en: Gaïa takes over Les Machines de l'Île for an evening performance as part of the L'Été indien aux Nefs series.

06183598fc0fd7f39a9f7a255ce1d9d0b97649e6.en: The Conservatoire de Nantes hosts an ONPL orchestral concert directed by Polina Lebedieva, featuring solo double bass performances by Andrès Fernandez Subiela.

aeda299bc5b4a2f828a2a52906195109401a6703.en: Experience high-level women's futsal as Nantes Métropole Futsal takes on Sporting Paris at the Complexe Sportif Mangin Beaulieu for an energetic match.

e30fa2d33ef87be7beb2b5336decb182780c7912.en: Join the weekly life model drawing sessions every Thursday afternoon at the Pôle associatif Séverine.

918fc1d2fea4c36f51d7075b3e3b1706c3f4a930.en: La Générale hosts the opening of Mathilde Guiho and Guillaume Noury's photography exhibition titled Passer les montagnes as part of the Quinzaine de la Photo Nantaise 2026.

d62b92a444796ddfe35226035627994eb80185fb.en: Pôle associatif Désiré Colombe hosts weekly intuitive and free-movement dance sessions for adults, combining elements of the 5 rhythms, dance medicine, and ecstatic dance without any prerequisites.

68c2fdf1498e58d3698889f47fad46e7f1dcdd48.en: The Chamber of Agriculture in Nantes hosts a discovery workshop outlining the essential steps, regulations, and market trends for starting an organic farming project.

bf518f164ff0f9ab0a65e941c97d4b9d28881c73.en: The Conservatoire de Nantes welcomes the ONPL season for a lunchtime concert celebrating the poetic and dreamy chamber music of Boccherini performed by a sextet.

8b1d129a55cc82b94649009649487c46717422ac.en: Médiathèque Floresca Guépin presents Fjord, a musical tale for children aged 6 to 9 following a curious bird through Nordic landscapes with live recorder flute accompaniments.

b8c30961fc4fef4d313f2ac55500da35155c5a4c.en: Médiathèque Luce Courville presents Guillaume, l'apprenti sorcier, a musical tale about a sorcerer's apprentice accompanied by bassoon students from the Conservatoire.

8966f020380dc53a53ccb39d38667556f062cfa3.en: Klarnaval at the Conservatoire de Nantes features a playful musical creation by cycle 1 clarinet students with special guest performers for children aged 6 to 9.

f6d48703fab498989c59f17f70a9a9f3277677e5.en: Jwles brings his distinct hip-hop and electronic sound, shaped by international travels and underground collaborations, to the stage at Le Ferrailleur.

3e3bd1e871bcbf1be3a4cbf6f6359bedb3b295a7.en: La Barakason hosts a dedicated reggae, dancehall, and dub night headlined by British pioneer Macka B alongside Ganja Tree and local sound systems.

f274df289cac1f0f9eef4c0b58ad8996f90b167c.en: Requin Chagrin performs live at Le Ferrailleur, bringing new wave synthesisers and brighter pop sounds from their fourth album Décollage.

27ab7c5889ad6fb40fb3786bbf6c2b97d2e32373.en: La Semaine thématique des métiers de la tech et de l'industrie du futur à l'Académie de Nantes propose aux élèves des ateliers immersifs, des webinaires et des rencontres avec des professionnels. Une occasion unique de découvrir des secteurs variés comme le numérique, la robotique et la cybersécurité pour préparer leur avenir.

3cab6095a197bb29f784b693518b57059c60b9b3.en: Cet atelier interactif à Rezé vous invite à détecter vos talents et valoriser vos habilités à travers des exercices ludiques sur tablette. Une excellente opportunité pour envisager un parcours vers les métiers de l'industrie tout en testant votre autonomie et votre dextérité.

19cc2ca186ddf53eb9377f53843b977af6bbacb5.en: Les Ateliers MilleFeuilles présentent une exposition consacrée à la peinture protéiforme d'Édouard Prulhière, mêlant peinture, sculpture et installation. Venez découvrir le parcours unique de cet artiste moderne à travers une œuvre libre et affranchie des codes.

5d855664dd6e1a00ce9674da109cf004bbabb534.en: Retrouvez les Mardis dans les mailles au 20 mille pour un cycle d'ateliers crochet conviviaux animés par Elodie de OmeBonheurs. Venez partager des projets accompagnés, perfectionner vos techniques et échanger autour de la création.

d41ccde35f96ccdfa4e6ed782d95f5077c78725a.en: Cette exposition au CHU de Nantes propose d'explorer le phénomène des zoonoses, ces maladies transmises par les animaux qui représentent une part majeure des maladies infectieuses. Un éclairage scientifique bienvenu pour comprendre la diversité des agents pathogènes à l'origine de ces épidémies.

1528d374153eb56d82cf61b8f25a4b972e20f82a.en: Quatre amis d'enfance découvrent une lettre pleine de secrets après la mort de leur confident, faisant dérailler leur dîner de retrouvailles. Une comédie sensible sur l'amitié portée par Maxime Gasteuil, Camille Combal, Charlotte Gabris et Jean-François Cayrey.

8c0af646330fd9ac82365b005cf66c0ec4be3252.en: L'exposition Boxing Queens de Delphine Blast met en valeur l'autonomisation de jeunes femmes tanzaniennes à travers la pratique de la boxe. Un travail photographique engagé à découvrir au Passage Sainte-Croix dans le cadre de la Quinzaine Photographique Nantaise.

e73c25fc03618c5fb6e43614f2d89b3aef9d45ce.en: La Maison de quartier Madeleine champ de mars propose un atelier découverte associant une pratique simple et douce de yoga à des processus créatifs intuitifs. Une belle façon d'exprimer librement ses émotions dans une ambiance conviviale, sans aucun prérequis.

f5a0eed3d67507c19eb2692207158cd03561e49a.en: L'Atelier Alain Le Bras accueille l'exposition Biomes bicéphales d'Elise Bergonzi et Eugénie Faurie, qui explorent les formes du vivant et les écosystèmes à travers un univers hybride. Venez découvrir cette esthétique commune née de la rencontre de leurs deux démarches artistiques.

cdbb110bf1722ea1a84876237b37ef7e91144d31.en: La Commune libre du Bouffay accueille l'exposition Le Bouffay des arts, mettant à l'honneur des animaux à travers les œuvres d'artistes et d'associations nantaises et ligériennes. Venez admirer des peintures, sculptures, gravures et photographies variées.

fa5bc718ac0f253cba729256f0f50afd29c9ac6d.en: Le rappeur Josman fait escale au Zénith Nantes Métropole dans le cadre de sa tournée DPC Tour. Venez vivre une expérience scénique immersive et intense portée par la force introspective de son dernier album.

bffa6b38572fe56e7f968f65fc4b743f5d3a1bb8.en: Le Frac Pays de la Loire présente une exposition explorant les formes actuelles de la contre-culture à travers les collections de plusieurs institutions. Une invitation à découvrir des œuvres qui revendiquent un positionnement à la fois politique et artistique.

e1647a0bbd84764f9e8fa1d95045c480deaca05a.en: Le Centre Claude Cahun expose le travail photographique de Julien Goldstein, qui révèle la dimension cachée de la création variétale dans la première région horticole de France. Une exploration artistique de ce qui constitue le vivant au cœur du Maine-et-Loire.

f9788f564e207e8e604f72f3c058c7b25311f2e7.en: Le producteur et mélodiste marseillais French 79 fait son retour à Stereolux pour présenter son univers électronique singulier, inspiré de la grande tradition de la French Touch.

89d98cacd780134367ffe421fbd3857a6fc32d03.en: Stereolux accueille le Sublime Tour avec les concerts de Luther et Rounhaa, suivis d'une soirée club interdite aux mineur des pour prolonger la nuit. Des packs et billets simples sont disponibles pour profiter de cette programmation rap.

45ae48f54887d0f98869e6df0e3ca23f0eb03a3d.en: Le rappeur NeS se produit sur la scène de Stereolux pour présenter son univers musical mêlant prods futuristes et flow old-school revisité. Une occasion de découvrir l'un des talents montants du rap français.

a498eebfd037e3cabbdac607aa7dd5ec7f085575.en: Le Conservatoire de Nantes accueille l'Orchestre National des Pays de la Loire pour un concert de Noël dirigé par Sascha Goetzel. Ce programme met à l'honneur des compositrices trop souvent oubliées qui ont pourtant marqué l'histoire de la musique.

6e9c2492d0443a2dc228776fcfb12f365568eefd.en: Le Conservatoire de Nantes accueille l'ONPL pour un concert mettant en valeur le célèbre Stabat Mater de Pergolèse sous la direction de Matthieu Handtschoewercker. Une œuvre emblématique portée par deux sublimes voix.

21b514e1f3c6526938082dda612961366df699a1.en: Le Conservatoire de Nantes invite les enfants de 7 à 9 ans à découvrir et tester une grande variété d'instruments de musique. Une belle occasion de rencontrer les enseignants et de trouver sa vocation artistique.

714875e0695bb98270de9cde2bc2bca09c8fb659.en: Le Théâtre de Poche Graslin présente un spectacle drôle, musical et émouvant où un personnage attachant transforme ses souvenirs en chansons de Queen. Un théâtre-concert exceptionnel porté par l'énergie de l'acteur et la musique du groupe.

66a89a0882674bc67350df57667b936b6b7fab32.en: L'association Métisses propose une série d'événements conviviaux à Nantes, incluant pique-niques, soirées dansantes, le Show Tropikal et des chants de Noël. C'est l'occasion idéale de se retrouver et de partager des moments festifs tout au long de l'année.

f14b5beb3b9a6127666b3032989b3b711b21f316.en: Cet atelier de couture en très petit groupe permet aux enfants de créer un projet responsable à partir de textiles de seconde main. Une belle opportunité pour les jeunes débutants comme confirmés de développer leur créativité.

473f897a427a9aecea4681bed4cf3476876b3d94.en: La Zoo Galerie présente l'exposition Moëra du duo Émilie Brout et Maxime Marion, centrée sur une installation numérique collaborative inspirée des jeux vidéo. L'occasion de découvrir un univers artistique ancré dans les technologies contemporaines.

f480996181d73b83361300413522facf8b2c91ed.en: Bring your struggling computer to the Centre socioculturel du Sillon de Bretagne to get help fixing it or to switch to an alternative operating system on a donation basis.

3fe1faf3cd0f49bb4c886cb2f85c53ba11e7757c.en: Assistez à un match de D1 Futsal au complexe Mangin Beaulieu pour soutenir le Nantes Métropole Futsal. Une soirée sportive rythmée et conviviale à partager entre proches.

22f4b6865577fa1bc7dfd50e7556c13e372a21a5.en: Venez vivre l'intensité du futsal de haut niveau lors de la rencontre entre le Nantes Métropole Futsal et le Nice Futsal Club. Une soirée sportive et conviviale idéale à partager en famille ou entre amis.

746134690b05c9299ba62595498eb445e221d60c.en: Cet atelier hebdomadaire permet aux adolescents d'approfondir leurs techniques en BD, manga, illustration ou architecture. Un espace créatif idéal pour affirmer ses choix artistiques.

1482f3ddaa95b4fb9538e179ed721f9dd3cc847a.en: Cet atelier gratuit propose aux jeunes de 11 à 12 ans d'apprendre à réaliser une planche de BD aux côtés de professionnel·les. Une belle occasion de s'initier à la bande dessinée.

1a60158f1401fde4903ad1e8724ee77d9ba24c85.en: La Rue Kétanou fait halte à La Carrière pour partager plus de vingt ans de chansons libres et fraternelles. Venez apprécier l'énergie et la poésie de ce groupe incontournable.

2e50e93fab087ed8d8bda6950d60392a0d9acd2f.en: Danyl présente son univers musical teinté de sonorités raï et de modernité à la salle de la Carrière. Une occasion unique de découvrir en live l'auteur-compositeur et beatmaker.

d14dd1f46eb493acc26472f0abeb3f0d0a174c55.en: Découvrez le temps d'une matinée les opportunités d'emploi et de formation dans le secteur industriel en Sud Loire. Un rendez-vous concret pour avancer dans votre parcours professionnel.

f6b92eeb3305fa9e39fe66fa742ee77ab2e2db11.en: Le Conservatoire de Nantes accueille la saison de l'ONPL pour un concert mêlant jazz et classique. Une soirée placée sous le signe de l'improvisation pianistique.

4d3c490402cc7ae0d5e2435693a2ada31c3c03a9.en: L'orchestre OCEAN et le Chœur Universitaire de Nantes s'associent pour interpréter des œuvres du répertoire classique et romantique. Un concert partagé à découvrir au Conservatoire de Nantes.

77183dbbdcac90b726eed68acb0239264214caf3.en: Ce concert célèbre le 400e anniversaire de la disparition de John Dowland à travers le répertoire anglais des 16e et 17e siècles. Une belle occasion de redécouvrir des œuvres intemporelles mêlant instruments anciens et modernes.

0a3a204c410079ef790b4467cbb458c77b5d80e2.en: Cette visite en famille invite petits et grands à découvrir le quotidien au château à l'époque du duc François II. Un parcours ludique ponctué de jeux pour vivre une journée à la cour.

78ba9b4ed99a839daebd6c7a7b36a4d53c8a1443.en: Quatre comédien·nes imaginent le monde des adultes à travers le regard absurde et fantastique des enfants lors d'un spectacle improvisé. Une création originale à découvrir au Terrain Neutre Théâtre.

647f656c419e01165323e7a1319fa2f80955256e.en: Cosmopolis accueille une exposition et des événements culturels dédiés à l'histoire et à la culture tibétaine. Une invitation à la découverte à travers des témoignages historiques et artistiques.

869b1789c96d05e789166287043c0f9e3bbd4927.en: Le Théâtre du Cyclope met à l'honneur des autrices dramaturges à travers une programmation de spectacles variés. Un week-end théâtral riche en émotions et en réflexions.

5ed5e55b9b0c7ebac4094ea260c3598cd9e5b0c3.en: Ce spectacle interactif invite les jeunes familles à partager des chansons et des comptines tirées au sort sur des cartes. Une parenthèse musicale pleine de douceur pour éveiller l'imaginaire des enfants.

97adc92798e3cf29a60ace88029532c349bbe25f.en: Shéhérazade at Théâtre du Cyclope is an interactive show where the audience helps the character invent stories to save her life. It is suitable for ages 6 and up.

459e2fbc48788b99d31add4493cc3f4312439e69.en: Enfantillages at Théâtre du Cyclope is a play by Léonore Confino that humorously explores the illusions of the perfect couple through Barbie and Ken. It is recommended for ages 12 and up.

21617cb7178d385ebf0ad79a5f3400c7d0adf6c6.en: La fabrique des dieux at Musée d'arts de Nantes invites children aged 8 to 11 to discover mythology in the collections and create their own deity with unique powers.

ad5a8d013d57116aac83b986642dcafc8be13f5e.en: Ado un jour, à dos toujours ! at Théâtre de Jeanne is a family comedy about the daily life of teenagers and parents. Come enjoy a humorous show that brings adults and adolescents together.

c4e717d66f30933d53bbafa99f3b9bfd74f8d9c8.en: Guy2Bezbar will perform at La carrière in Nantes on October 30, 2026. Catch the French rap artist for an energetic live show.

35e422437568709433f7e72273d77b3e286ceede.en: Le Ferrailleur hosts a hardcore lineup featuring Sunami, Desolated, Missing Link, Extinguish, Moral Law, Bind., and Chute Libre. Experience a powerful evening of punk hardcore, beatdown, and metalcore.

306d2fb8a93ad26af35c5cad407fa2405d2d26a2.en: Diane Mentecheras performs at BAR303 as part of the Festival Culture Bar-Bars.

85e88e51888f535174ef7a3e37ccdb1148c42d18.en: Weekly sophrology and meditation sessions at Maison de quartier Madeleine Champ de Mars offer gentle relaxation exercises to reduce stress and improve sleep. These group workshops are open to beginners and the curious.

55d59fb62b7758f3b4541e71a5e664b0974fd905.en: Tayc returns with the JOÿe Tour at Zénith Nantes Métropole in 2027. Discover his new album blending RnB and Afrolove.

d9a8789c18b77a2b9a239397cf7ad3d4b5f3b82c.en: Mamans & ses Copines hosts a Mamma Mia themed evening for women at La Madrague in Saint-Sébastien-sur-Loire on November 19. Enjoy a 90s and 2000s playlist with friends starting at 19:30.

203fa8491bf6ba77e3ecccc3479d7bf74d4561f4.en: Actual Talent in Nantes hosts an open house recruitment day for industry professionals on November 19, 2026. Meet the team to discuss career opportunities in CDI, interim, or service provisions.

251a2828600291f744cf5bddc6137d4df484fe23.en: Clarinet Power at the Conservatoire de Nantes showcases the clarinet through classical and contemporary works. The concert features soloist Raphaël Sévère alongside students and the Nantes Philharmonie.

f4e71cc26ed909d8a454a5ed848a84de929d8019.en: De la passion at Théâtre Graslin features students and teachers from the Conservatoire de Nantes performing a chamber music program inspired by love and emotion.

393b49c8ca20ab32045c296dfbd224011b72c790.en: Impromptus musicaux at the Conservatoire de Nantes invites children aged 5 to 9 and their families to discover musical instrument families through short performances in the hall.

509d2dbbf5b35b3b908ac00449d24de44d9db237.en: The Centre Communal d'Action Sociale in Nantes offers regular appointments to help residents access affordable mutual insurance plans regardless of income.

7d4478eabd36f1ab7824b4e0853963a8481308a1.en: Les jeudis brodés at Le 20 mille offers monthly workshops to discover Japanese embroidery techniques like Sashiko and Kogin, suitable for ages 10 and up.

9f15c2888238bd1094663d90bff8ef4e76005454.en: Les jeudis de paille at Le 20 mille invites participants aged 12 and up to discover straw marquetry through monthly workshops.

2b9607e330b8feddda75e424786696c5c528cea6.en: Celle qui attend at Théâtre du Cyclope is a play exploring political commitment and disengagement through the story of an anti-heroine on a ZAD. It is recommended for ages 10 and up.

d4c53f1208f3f9bd5b5393fce699e937ffe0fe59.en: The CAUE de Loire-Atlantique exhibition showcases inspiring local projects supported by free expert advice from the organization. It is available online and in the documentation center window in Nantes.

4dc630206e2fb91308a6c48b58e704bc2864e653.en: Enjoy a vintage, non-verbal puppet and magic show designed for children aged 2 and up. Created by Cie L’Atelier Flottant, it features Chef Cocotte in a humorous and musical culinary adventure.

a0d013bce7c3fc9332672e7eccf43ac52e997483.en: Bring your children from birth to 4 years old to a dedicated play and sensory exploration space. Admission is on a pay-what-you-want basis with no registration required.

099817d5a1af8e070335da55cb70decf27fb8613.en: Children and teenagers aged 6 to 15 can take part in artistic workshops during the October holidays. Sessions last 2 to 4 hours at the Collectif Bonus premises in Nantes.

a95b5c0867c0f0f9d4575b4f3ecf45c285d486a0.en: Experience a rap night featuring the cinematic universes of Hvrley Qveen and genre-blending sets from Oki Kuhu. The event brings together hip-hop, RnB, electronic influences, and more.

8ac356e32e715fd5f0972d63154c12d276bce529.en: Dance the night away at Hangar 24 during a special 80s and 90s themed boom party. DJ Yves will be behind the decks for a lively evening.

c8764ce73dafd3ab330b2843df2d75e20922483e.en: Join a monthly gathering featuring a vegetarian cooking workshop, health and creation activities, and a shared meal on a pay-what-you-free basis. The event takes place at the Centre Socio Culturel du Bout des Landes.

b282413cae236e37efe5a7db2e1e8bb5a5546f33.en: Krav Boca brings an explosive mix of punk, rap, and electronic music to Le Ferrailleur. Expect an inclusive live performance featuring masked rappers, pyrotechnics, and aerial acrobatics.

dfe8f388ac04258ff07a38da9e9800c797a1ae96.en: Daysy and Cobalt invite you to an intimate acoustic tour this autumn. Share a warm evening of songs and stories up close with the artists.

0f6a0df0e5540dda118c46dfc6a660c4845a1e40.en: Macadam hosts a night of rave culture, acid techno, and experimental electronic music featuring performances by Multifun, Binary Digit, Someone, and Choreophila.

31856af5ea4b985d66532ea3f00c28ec83bf1234.en: Listen to spiritual tales from around the world and life stories collected by pilgrim storyteller Arnaud Pelletier. The event offers a moment of meaning, peace, and shared humanity.

6b2949d68f76a45ba496ef257f283d1fcb307b51.en: Discover agricultural training programs, facilities, and teaching teams during the EFEA open days across multiple locations in the Pays de la Loire region. It is an opportunity to explore career paths in the living sector.

f656e05be4235e21c21bc3e5b5d63fe0085662ba.en: Children aged 7 to 9 can take part in a 45-minute orchestra immersion at the Conservatoire de Nantes. They will sit within a junior concert band to discover instrument timbres and play on stage.

6f82190027840fcfee0ecd7c865a3987ac119e35.en: Clarinetist Raphaël Sévère leads a masterclass at the Conservatoire de Nantes focusing on the interpretation of major repertoire works with student musicians.

d8e78b4c8856679ebbbe9dd8a0b5079da8b5c4e1.en: Attend the preview screening of La Conscience Politique in the presence of director Léolo Victor-Pujebet and philosopher Geoffroy de Lagasnerie. The film explores institutional violence and collective emancipation.

d438c56177448bc31df157ae6fb7fa05d0c111e9.en: Help the witch Hécate recover her magic during a self-guided family scavenger hunt in the Jardin des Plantes. Solve riddles hidden throughout the autumn gardens to guide lost souls.

ca524a218d02a39f318ea228dfa4551b7c8d1e90.en: Discover artisanal printing and micro-editing techniques during a bi-monthly workshop cycle led by Zoé Richard-Dalsace at Le 20 mille. All creative materials are provided for adults and teenagers aged 15 and over.

3e1605d1e6c57072fb3255383a87698b498e2921.en: Explore the Musée d'arts de Nantes through a giant board game designed for visitors aged 6 and up. Solve riddles hidden inside the artworks to advance through the museum rooms.

8d6899f9a1f96a41374e5009601575c21e52f07c.en: Celebrate the 35th anniversary of the album Alors regarde with Patrick Bruel live on tour. The concert brings iconic tracks back to the stage for an exceptional evening.

513c9c74ec6a9d2d81cc6697a421af6ce05edd73.en: Andrès Fernandez Subiela, solo double bassist of the Orchestre National des Pays de la Loire, leads a masterclass at the Conservatoire de Nantes. Students will work on repertoire interpretation alongside the professional musician.

b2d6f971bb02c674077abacb11519277befc1526.en: Kalika brings her trash pop style and intimate confessions to Le Ferrailleur ahead of her upcoming album release. Attendees under 16 must be accompanied by a parent.

43f317f0b2a9971a8559921c8e032ae011a64394.en: Zélie performs her energetic and raw electronic pop live at Stereolux. Expect an explosive show blending contemporary and hip-hop dance with deeply personal songs.

527191587af70ec6a7e304e998b65e32dba875b4.en: Adèle Castillon takes to the Stereolux stage to present her third solo album. Discover her new musical horizon combining the innocence of French pop with a homemade spirit.

1f92bffa44ada1459c67f9bd5c22f24ba0845bbe.en: The Warehouse hosts the Dubadub Experience featuring a live DJ set by Stand High Patrol alongside Marina P, O.B.F, and guests. Experience an explosive night of reggae, dub, and bass music.

3fd138ca479a056476988f905494232ce6cefd39.en: The Auditorium du Conservatoire de Nantes hosts a symphonic student concert featuring Prokofiev's Suites from Romeo and Juliet directed by Roberto Forés Veses. Enjoy an exceptional dramatic musical performance for a small entry fee.

ba9093862347402ccbf18e014184115ccd1ba2e8.en: Le 20 mille hosts a creative street art workshop where children design, paint, and make stickers of their own monster creations. Materials and a welcome drink are provided.

6b4af308b02bbe4067da4efd323294dca5112812.en: Ariane Bonzini se produit à Stereolux dans le cadre du Festival Nouvel Orage. Venez découvrir cet artiste aux compositions singulières qui bousculent les genres musicaux.

8fe929c5dcadf8af64252423116db44a0caf8c0e.en: JeanneTo investit Portevent avec sa pop punk aux accents de rave et de new-wave. Laissez-vous submerger par une énergie brute et dansante le temps d'une soirée.

77b004779356e5452da8191dd8ea08aba223d1a2.en: Macadam vous propose une nuit électronique rythmée par Britney Speed, DJ Physical et Kyle Starkey. Venez danser sur des sélections percussives entre techno, trance et rave.

33ed73ffa6971fe53c77dab63e716de41213e214.en: Vivez une nuit électronique intense à Macadam avec Kamen, Elli Acula et Nene H. Le line-up promet des sets hypnotiques entre techno, breakbeat et rythmiques percussives.

e5b3a70f3fc4c5ea67b07708c1d1421ab566aa90.en: Le Conservatoire de Nantes accueille l'ONPL pour un concert dirigé par Natalia Ponomarchuk. Venez écouter Vanessa Wagner interpréter le Concerto en sol de Ravel.

3fb4257e82fe655596873d380dc95cfbe8135b14.en: Partez à la découverte de Nantes autrement en menant l'enquête en équipe. Muni d'une mallette d'indices, résolvez des énigmes tout en explorant la ville de manière ludique.

3a44972b9a48837652fc664184d6a630942dfe51.en: Le Théâtre Beaulieu présente une comédie d'Isabelle Mergault où un complot tourne court. Entre quiproquos et amitié inattendue, suivez les péripéties de Gigi et Barbara.

903781345039bfd6e6eab255e0c4618f8ea12bcd.en: PaQ'la Lune invite les artistes et porteurs de projets à un temps d'échange convivial. Venez discuter et partager des conseils au Pôle Associatif Désiré Colombe ou en visio.

8a712c25c0f9ea18d14eb9af1722aeadd2ae5ddd.en: Participez à un atelier créatif pour concevoir votre propre bijou personnalisé. Choisissez vos perles, charms et couleurs pour repartir avec une pièce unique.

406bc13359dd4cea3b5e80385b6843ec4e52e951.en: Offrez-vous une pause dansante et intuitive sans pas à apprendre ni règles à suivre. Cet espace inclusif invite à se mettre en mouvement en toute liberté.

7a85043da9e0d86c27221236cbe3896d58152e82.en: Profitez d'un pack duo à Stereolux réunissant les concerts de Luther et Rounhaa. Une belle occasion de retrouver ces artistes sur scène lors de leur passage à Nantes.

694ae4e1ddf8566928a421970be63844ef792fe1.en: Le Conservatoire de Nantes accueille l'Orchestre national de pays de la Loire pour un voyage musical. Suivez les aventures de Gaspard et Gustave portées par l'orchestre.

2d6fcda8f6b6b2e334abf634f6e2be2803a00038.en: Léo and Anna embark on a road trip to Bordeaux in this comedy by Lilian Lloyd. Expect plenty of unexpected twists along the way.

f915b1c136cde032d41b0be76d424124985627f9.en: These sessions at Espace Anne Sylvestre offer assistant.e.s maternel.le.s and young children a chance to explore sounds, play with instruments, and share musical moments together.

283348ab25c37b8fe69c4a9661168f7cffa7a69d.en: Join a memory-boosting conference and a series of five workshops led by a psychologist and the Brain up association at Espace seniors Désiré Colombe.

b2464ad4bfd4450408963507436ca93419b1a915.en: This family comedy illustrates the universal dynamics between a father and his children across different ages. It offers a humorous and tender look at everyday life for all generations.

f8930273f07580dae9c42b19a8d73c71d77719a7.en: Catch a high-level D1 Futsal match featuring Nantes Métropole Futsal at Complexe Sportif Mangin Beaulieu. It is a fast-paced and technical sporting event to enjoy with family or friends.

21e84a773c02938df11ab3ba41f13b9d067b6b2f.en: Michel Batt and Hervé Guillermit present a photography exhibition capturing the quirky and absurd scenes of daily street life. Visitors can also meet the artists on September 27.

f0a5249e0486aa22270d09e644b4989e5b99a1e1.en: Discover regional films from Pays de la Loire and participate in a collaborative short film project created on the spot. No prior experience is needed to join a team.

cd4718b8ba9393780e5a22b6093e6a3f61c551b9.en: This monthly men's circle provides a confidential, supportive space to explore self-awareness and body movement through dance and Gestalt therapy.

2a69b396ef7637394035548fe6b1469d899cdf98.en: The Musée d'arts de Nantes offers free admission on the first Sunday of every month, excluding July and August.

86ff7e7887a2e3930c9bc2711ac571dc41ecb8e2.en: Le DIX hosts its youth festival featuring a variety of poetry-filled shows for children and families during the autumn holidays.

4dd5a6e498ac457a41d116e8c5db26f6362ef90a.en: Ben PLG performs live in concert at Stereolux. Attendees under 16 must be accompanied by a parent.

e6ee4ca38279baef77db6328990483daf6c8b40e.en: Experience Alfred Hitchcock's 1938 thriller The Lady Vanishes accompanied by a live score performed by the ONPL musicians.

45e599b74cf293bce96cef684e974a5d7ad68183.en: Join Manou Partages for gentle and tailored exercises focused on fall prevention in a welcoming atmosphere.

976f823620be3f013db21d496c5c70eb581d7ded.en: Les petits débrouillards offer science workshops for children aged 6 to 12 to explore daily phenomena through fun experiments and hands-on activities.

82db32896324cf7469712499944e13b9bda758ca.en: Zamdane returns on tour with "Le Spectacle RAHMA" to present his latest album and a brand new show.

4cd1efeb4271b72ea5325f1a60e30353c0bf063a.en: An outdoor exhibition on Place Royale explores the municipal social actions directed at mothers and newborns from the 18th to the early 20th century using archives from Nantes.

ab8828b56aba32f3ebe6b7c1db9c7d5f98f9e26d.en: Galerie TrES hosts a collective exhibition featuring works by Chang Rim Ji, Alain Cheguillaume, and Kim Kwan Hyun from October 15 to 31, 2026.

cb9fac1c9431474991fb4fb2455b581a7a87c08a.en: Children and teens aged 10 to 13 can discover theatrical performance through dynamic and creative games led by a professional actress.

20c3399a9d0822b12bd61d24c5d53e265fbe7637.en: When the reindeer kidnap Anselme Noël, Madame Hortense organizes a grand casting show to find a substitute Santa Claus in this dynamic children's show.

bf3ec07a79134d53bd7ba72dccd5a74ae795f961.en: Spectacle musical pour jeune public, Les chansons préférées de l'Oncle Walt propose une nouvelle version de son histoire avec des musiciens en live au Théâtre Beaulieu. C'est l'occasion idéale pour les enfants à partir de 5 ans de découvrir un show féérique et musical.

9e194c23799f0a602b38f7257f2d99fbcc70afe5.en: L’historienne Emmanuelle Berthiaud présente la conférence « Mères et enfants dans l'art » au Musée d'arts de Nantes. Venez découvrir comment ce thème majeur de l'art occidental a évolué à travers les siècles, des représentations religieuses aux visions contemporaines.

d0ab2a610119f58ae9be683f88e69ec72e18096a.en: Retrouvez la chanteuse pop française Myla en concert au Ferrailleur à Nantes. Elle y interprète ses morceaux à succès qui ravissent un public international.

3e12335b29a9d23be39a7a9905aa87725441ac39.en: Le Stereolux à Nantes accueille le Sublime Tour avec Luther et Rounhaa. Profitez de concerts et de soirées club dans ce lieu incontournable.

65dbc9f1e08170358bf7a638007c9bc7641c43b7.en: Maëlle se produit en concert au Ferrailleur à Nantes pour partager son univers pop moderne et sincère. Venez découvrir sa voix envoûtante et ses titres entraînants en live.

f1774ef24f44eb496bd1709f69bddf93f6829e37.en: Le club Macadam accueille Prosumer, Sianza et L’Étalon Disco pour une nuit dédiée à la house, à l'acid et au disco. Venez profiter de sets généreux au cœur de Nantes.

77e0ee15204a6eb747f04da975faab1677dc2743.en: Linh présente les chansons de son premier album lors d'un concert à La Carrière à Saint-Herblain. C'est l'occasion de découvrir en live la voix puissante de cette jeune révélation de la variété française.

1975175f4409a3e0d4fd80fbd86529c6cacfec3c.en: Le Palais des Arts et des Congrès accueille le Festival Vive la Magie pour deux jours de spectacles et d'animations. Venez découvrir le grand show Prodiges ainsi que des ateliers de magie adaptés à toute la famille.

4230280ad1dc5af9ec686e288c97cb62fb43ee39.en: Le Ciné théâtre Bonne Garde accueille le spectacle Les Mots Magiques dans le cadre du festival Festi’Mômes. Un rendez-vous familial idéal à partir de 4 ans pour découvrir des contes détournés pleins d'humour.

ac625613562006577ad4af63800a90471c4fe3eb.en: Le 20 mille propose un cycle mensuel d'initiation à la linogravure animé par Alix Rebora. Venez expérimenter l'impression sur papier et textile dans une ambiance conviviale à partir de 10 ans.

14a73685dd2d7e1cc26b2f178a48edb5b290bc73.en: La Médiathèque Charles-Gautier-Hermeland expose des planches de la bande dessinée Billy the Kid : l'histoire est toujours écrite par les vainqueurs de Loïc Sécheresse. Venez découvrir le travail de l'artiste qui revisite les codes du western.

654292b793aacb1dabb7ca7de24e8d869218d610.en: L'éco-appart propose un atelier pratique pour mieux comprendre ses consommations et réduire sa facture d'énergie. Venez trouver un contrat adapté à votre mode de vie grâce à l'aide d'experts.

8190b3eb0be0d690f7457ba66a802ff1ec91cf4a.en: L'Espace Beautour accueille le marché de Noël de l'Amicale laïque Beautour avec des créateurs locaux et de quoi se restaurer sur place. Venez découvrir des artisans de quartier et profiter d'un moment convivial.

639cf49c535de11b7fecc7aef008ee33aa9e0918.en: Le Théâtre Beaulieu présente le spectacle musical Oncle Walt et le Royaume magique. Petits et grands peuvent y suivre les aventures de la princesse Angélique au rythme de superbes chansons.

7c8f481022ac52d1bfbf45afed2fd6b1b4291e6d.en: L'École nationale supérieure d’architecture de Nantes présente l'exposition collective La Dolce Vista. Venez découvrir le regard d'étudiants sur l'architecture romaine à travers une série de photographies.

cf52e2bf65b3b1e40631199202edeabd99d1bd47.en: Le Conservatoire de Nantes accueille l'octuor de violoncelles de l'ONPL pour une pause concert dédiée à la musique américaine. Venez écouter des œuvres allant de Dvorák à Gershwin et Glass.

538efc06b5ec39e46518619961ca171f9681d747.en: Le Conservatoire de Nantes présente le spectacle jeune public Il reste des plumes sur le sol par la compagnie La Cabane. Une création poétique et dansée à savourer en famille, suivie d'ateliers créatifs.

702052b79bf1bbcbafed1dd948c5136013d41314.en: Le Zénith Nantes Métropole accueille La Fève pour une date de sa tournée événement. Venez retrouver l'un des artistes incontournables du rap francophone en live.

d416932f52ffd1ad56a764908bbd35b3d9e75542.en: Le DockSide Food Hall accueille le groupe Time Machine pour une soirée dédiée aux classiques du rock et du hard rock. Venez profiter d'un concert live reprenant les plus grands hits de plusieurs générations.

f80b6090bcfc717150e9a283b39094311207ff08.en: Loïc Nottet returns to the stage after three years for an unprecedented concert, blending pop, emotion, and performance. Discover a freer and more intimate musical universe during this special tour.

8cc099843e43f13e3683642f9ee582ca1610ba0f.en: Lushe brings his precise, introspective rap and growing live energy to Le Ferrailleur. Catch one of the most promising voices of the new francophone rap scene live.

946865a1ca4075272442372b991ba33df3f2e591.en: Dance until dawn at the CO2 Club Origin with an underground techno and acid lineup featuring Acidéale, Wimt, Praxiis, Melvyn, and a contest winner. The event offers an extra hour of music and a safe space for everyone.

2767dabce3d9d5341537823fe90e36325cdbdca0.en: Insolenss takes over Room 2 of the Warehouse with an immersive 360-degree booth format featuring Elyrä, Nø_s, Nøw, and Naes. One ticket grants access to both rooms of the venue.

887bed07c0dafa97de7dd84b90a1470eac54bf33.en: The departmental archives invite you to contribute photographs documenting the territory, its landscapes, and inhabitants. Share your historical and recent pictures to help build a shared iconographic heritage.

832af13020ab0c28820018f31796e1e0106a2f68.en: Explore how Nantes and its residents experienced the Second World War through historical objects and documents. This guided tour covers the occupation, resistance, and the execution of the 50 hostages.

f3380e52346fb0c38bf8729c6c09bac747c96d1b.en: Explore the art of photographic illusion with a carte blanche exhibition by Catalan photographer Israel Ariño. The works question reality and fiction at the Centre Claude Cahun.

9ad970e67bebcbb8f620945df6d41898d765c284.en: Discover the museum collections with a pencil in hand during an open sketching night. A guide will be present to help you observe and draw the artworks.

ef635a550eeb551d688229d14a94515aa3bbbfae.en: Abderrahmane Cheref presents an installation exploring the fossilisation of matter through clay, burnt wood, and cast metal. Visit Les Petites Ecuries to see these deep-sea inspired works.

ec6ebde372bb52c08602b5e7af399c2c20de2e05.en: Experience high-level futsal as Nantes Métropole Futsal takes on Toulouse at Mangin Beaulieu. Enjoy a fast-paced and technical sports evening with family or friends.

584de0f010844356aac6853aedba7a2b3531a502.en: Bring children aged 3 to 10 to a musical and environmental tale about a young girl saving a polluted island. Enjoy an imaginative adventure filled with quirky characters at the Théâtre de Jeanne.

6c81d8b0823e20c4f908c28a4fcc009078a53039.en: Emilie de la Perrière stars in a witty solo show that tackles modern taboos, education, and feminism with humor and tenderness. Enjoy a light and human performance at Les Variétés.

4ee28625d9217c2b2c78133b10dd2de941f6ff90.en: The People team takes over Hangar 24 for a Sunday celebrating African culture with animated films, dance, live painting, street food, and a DJ set.

2637514590d2088b9921bd92ee2b86c3521fc64e.en: A blood donation session run by the French Blood Establishment (EFS). Booking ahead cuts the wait; donors aged 18 to 70 should bring ID, avoid fasting and allow about an hour.

ab75394b4efee62455d7895c2c55865f8e24db97.en: A hands-on workshop on sugar and cooking for children, who learn kitchen techniques and take part in what they eat. Also a lactofermentation session on a natural way to preserve food, where you take home your own jar.

4a0791be344d089c2926de82de61f1319f6992cb.en: A free road-safety workshop for seniors, run by the Maison de la tranquillité publique with the municipal police and a road-safety association. Participants test their knowledge on 22 October, booking required.

f6ad9878909a1fa37b88a75547e8ad13967820c1.en: A workshop for seniors on staying safe as pedestrians, led by the Maison de la Tranquillité Publique and a road-safety association. It is part of a series that also covers driving and public transport.

c2d92057e540c8cd1bec1de2512288fd19019a97.en: A sun-watching session using the instruments of the Nantes Planetarium, held at the Jacques Demy media library. Suitable from age 8.

80a3dba0f7c945db32a3ddfdfb6671d5552c1235.en: A workshop for 12 to 15 year-olds on mental health: what it is, how to look after yourself and where to turn when worried. The group turns the discussion into a shared comic strip with author Benoît Broyart.

851e9d8dc1a79307d7f82587aaec925e0c2100af.en: An evening for the public, staff and doctors marking Pink October, the breast cancer awareness campaign. It screens the documentary La Cordée de l'après, about eight women in remission who climbed Mont Blanc together, then a talk. Free, by registration.

66ca63e035e5bca985e959c2069c54a55d4ae5d7.en: A talk marking 40 years since Spain joined the European Community. It looks at Spain's path to membership, its role in the EU today and its links with Latin America and the Mediterranean. Offered by the Franco-Spanish cultural centre.

3f086dd97603b8f20943681a317ce6f98d0415be.en: A hands-on evening for anyone, with no technical skills needed, where you build your first AI agent, an assistant that handles part of your work. A live demo is followed by 1h30 of coached practice.

83075feca6b05303ce72593e0d4a5b382ba5ba43.en: A screening of Mamoru Hosoda's 2016 animated film about a lonely boy who becomes the disciple of a beast named Kumatetsu in a world of animals. A concert and tasting evening follows, run by Info Jeunes.

a11e8cbc9b3ee76f2e38d0dbc383bc4fee89952a.en: A cinema evening with Nepalese food, an exhibition and a writing workshop, then a screening of Abinash Bikram Shah's drama with a discussion on Nepal. Pirati must choose between freedom and her duty to her community.

9f8662af975c53674353077ad46c0d8af78aa139.en: The DPC tour by independent French rapper Josman, following his album Dom Perignon Crying. Known for an introspective, raw yet elegant style, the show promises an immersive mix of sound, image and emotion. The Paris La Défense Arena date sold out months ahead.

0bb72103b959d7b20b3a2311b0e8b477a9a957dc.en: A concert by Papanosh, the five-piece jazz group marking 20 years in 2026 with a new show, Yes I Are! It celebrates the collective and its Afro-American-inspired sound rather than the past. Part of the Pannonica season.

d36af8901074f24a72500fcd7c756dc287d08030.en: Pink Martini, the Oregon orchestra founded by Thomas Lauderdale, plays upbeat old-school pop, world sounds and big-band rhythms. Its mission is multicultural connection and inclusion, with several guest singers including China Forbes and Storm Large.

23d55f9c6cbcd2b49a777eaa3c6c708b472f04c7.en: A workshop on spice plants, their origins and benefits, where you test your senses and knowledge. A second session looks at local, more environmentally friendly alternatives to imported breakfast drinks such as cocoa, tea and coffee.

8aa83c72c2c8f2ccaf32d3ad4da054ed4ec465e9.en: A holiday art workshop for children at Collectif Bonus, led by Joel Janse van Vuuren. Children cut coloured paper shapes to build imaginary, real or fantastical cities, learning about shape, colour, proportion and composition.

41ee13720175e393b6254ae8c1c3ae844fd785dd.en: A one-day in-person workshop on 24 October 2026 at the Cité Internationale des Arts, led by choir leader Nina Joussain. It helps amateur singers read scores, hear the notes and learn new pieces without relying on audio files.

f032dfed326ce18a06e6fa6a0d847ffb427799c1.en: Traditional Capoeira Angola classes with Mestre Faísca at the Gymnase Julie Vlasto. Beginners are welcome whatever their fitness; lessons build strength, coordination and rhythm through moves, traditional songs and instruments.

a15d6fa9941f13e1a36318b551771f95fe99d145.en: Hervé Niquet conducts the Orchestre de chambre de Paris and a chorus at the Théâtre du Châtelet in a playful programme of French music-hall songs and operetta, including Bourvil, Trenet, Chevalier and Francis Lopez.

804c668707542c36194ce7e7ace0004cac50fd73.en: STMPD 10 Years, a mobile-only show during Amsterdam Dance Event, organised by A Mojo and Insomniac. Ticket prices are listed under the Experiences section of the organiser's site.

1aa91f59af55e77e248c9201a2f62a75490cc1d5.en: Meduza performs at Melkweg during Amsterdam Dance Event. Entry works only with a smartphone ticket from the Ticketmaster app, and screenshots of the barcode are not accepted.

e362048995d4e7181fd56c843146710a09e4c12f.en: KI/KI, a five-hour mobile-only show at Ziggo Dome, presented by A Mojo and Insomniac. Ticket prices are listed under the Experiences section.

d563527d67acd105cf032a60059c60c48ace0d8a.en: Kraak & Smaak perform live at Melkweg during Amsterdam Dance Event. Entry is by smartphone ticket only through the Ticketmaster app.

5979bbca92049503e2e31b7fbe2c7c71056b8b3b.en: Nimino performs at Melkweg on the Keep Me Awake tour during Amsterdam Dance Event. Entry is by smartphone ticket only.

7cd801ef5522c4e568f8fef1b7fc43cee946eff5.en: Monstercat x Ophelia at Melkweg during Amsterdam Dance Event, a night of electronic music with a line-up that includes NGHTMRE, Seven Lions and Trivecta.

679aeb7fbb2c7f77b94ab40ee402538c178f9fc4.en: Paardenrave at Club Annie in Amsterdam, a night with Kim Swim b2b Aya, Sexstasy and Kahorsa, billed as a country-themed party.

9c0be4d7f6240915ab084437e8788c4d276f6c44.en: Face 2 Face at Melkweg during Amsterdam Dance Event. Entry is by smartphone ticket only through the Ticketmaster app.

bb28e36ede1cea9b3e0b37488bd28a7654098fae.en: Davyboi, presented by Hyper Dreams at Melkweg during Amsterdam Dance Event, with George Radsport b2b NYRA and a guest DJ list.

9654199ec5edf754c16388956fdcf83db132b92a.en: Imanu presents De_Verte at Melkweg during Amsterdam Dance Event, with Kaskade, Flava D, Raven Lux and others.

778d70de1d22526abf0223133f0602331814a5d5.en: Get Physical. at Melkweg during Amsterdam Dance Event, a night of electronic music. Entry is by smartphone ticket only.

7e450cbe182096d0a4c88abddc8c72fdd318b6cc.en: Starjunk 95 at Melkweg. Entry is by smartphone ticket only through the Ticketmaster app.

e077d2af57675b100c7c4d3f137107794d5a7e15.en: Club Kid (2026), a preview screening at Melkweg during Amsterdam Dance Event. Doors open 30 minutes before the listed start time.

8012490ef2e1faa95365017adbef537839663a47.en: Dave Clarke presents 30 Years of ADE at Melkweg during Amsterdam Dance Event. Entry is by smartphone ticket only.

7eec5f2f72f6aafc1bcecbb5e8363ae2f6e7faac.en: Rampage at Melkweg during Amsterdam Dance Event, with Zomboy and special guest Mefjus, plus Arcando, FMS and Layz.

3cec4797178cbca3cfaea6e949f01e6e464847e4.en: Paul van Dyk performs Open to Close at Melkweg during Amsterdam Dance Event. Entry is by smartphone ticket only.

e51822f35f98054e96adac5fd95306883a0d5342.en: GoldFish at Melkweg. Entry is by smartphone ticket only through the Ticketmaster app.

a35e353959eea3aeea4ddaa452ff8199694ba5a7.en: Akaash Singh, Generational Triumph tour, at the RAI Theater. The VIP upgrade includes a post-show meet and greet, tour merchandise and a signed poster, collected on the night, but not premium seating.

50123eab77870b414b4f6c4d9cf7847dbf86d983.en: 4AM Kru at Melkweg during Amsterdam Dance Event. Entry is by smartphone ticket only through the Ticketmaster app.

ea700775a40c8a692d6c84fa47d51774aeb53748.en: KitKatClub: Kinks of Berlin (2026), an Amsterdam Dance Event premiere at Melkweg. Doors open 30 minutes before the start time shown on the ticket.

a5d6357af9d6d36f064c4b34dea2898f8d62c673.en: Outworld at Ziggo Dome during ADE 2026, an all-night Klangkünstler event that is listed as sold out. It is a mobile-only show run by A Mojo and Insomniac.

9f4546fdfafb2c6e2bab41b60b2dd68e1a9aa73b.en: Boys Noize presents Ones and Zeroes at Melkweg during Amsterdam Dance Event, with Mechatok and SALOME. Entry is by smartphone ticket only.

347252b0e12c2f3e37068958a639865506a4eeed.en: Blendsworld ADE Special at Melkweg, an African electronic music night with Dlala Thukzin, Danni Gato, Henry X and others, hosted by MC Gary Blackx.

6a062c796698e2bd7dc1a0bd36fabae51cef8069.en: Aftershock book launch at Melkweg during ADE 2026, presented by Sonic Boom. Entry is by smartphone ticket only.

27aece0285d59f7fa0a25c3f2ebb54ec938b7513.en: Amsterdam Dub Event at Melkweg with Moritz von Oswald's dub set, Radikal Guru and a tribute set by Kingsway, hosted by Rub a Dub Ramses and Paulisme.

b918dc3ac9d10f1792600739fbcb230df3fae03e.en: Scooter Crushes ADE at Ziggo Dome, a mobile-only show run by A Mojo and Insomniac.

90ce3ebef05a917824bf11e3148edbdfa7fc102c.en: Annie's ADE weekender at Club Annie, a 30-hour opening weekend from Friday 23 October 23:59 to Sunday 25 October 06:00, with free re-entry and a long line-up of DJs.

0b5e48248e0a1e60a46d633f8b941b4d030d64fc.en: Placebo at Ziggo Dome, a mobile-only show. Ticket prices are listed under the Experiences section.

01927db1114e193d3a591df9c6df85e25a4b2969.en: Placebo, Venue Premium Packages at Ziggo Dome Club. The packages follow the venue's general terms and day membership conditions, and resale is not yet open.

ba917e41d04cb7ea9d6199bf717968f79d8107de.en: Charlie Jeer at Club Annie in Amsterdam. Entry is by smartphone ticket only through the Ticketmaster app.

ad3150d72a0ba836d2c275280d394925aa21860f.en: High Tea Indoor Festeaval 2027 at Melkweg in Amsterdam. Entry is by smartphone ticket only through the Ticketmaster app.

fef980fed2f51f32b01721753bc09af195d37148.en: Jordan Rakei, a mobile-only show. VIP tickets cannot be resold or transferred a few days before the event.

e125c04c238c73b540cdfd94fee526e2817fea98.en: Thomas Bergersen at AFAS Live in Amsterdam, with Comfort Seats that include VIP entrance without a queue, a comfortable chair and warm snacks.

6a866b54d2347d78f69edfc00876d8d411e5db7d.en: Jack Kays and His Band at Melkweg in Amsterdam. Entry is by smartphone ticket only through the Ticketmaster app.

f123527096dde167332813160ff4bb335f0e5027.en: Politie Warnsveld at Melkweg in Amsterdam. Entry is by smartphone ticket only through the Ticketmaster app.

59beb27aada9c6ad3d6cc65e208b9b6c39d5c2b3.en: Jake Bugg, Alamo UK and European Tour, at Melkweg in Amsterdam. Entry is by smartphone ticket only through the Ticketmaster app.

17f93773fb9c4533c2411dadaedd784f195bcaed.en: Damien Rice, 'O' 25th Anniversary Tour, a mobile-only show at Koninklijk Theater Carré. Resale and transfer are not yet open.

ae3bc395df69c83a098ca8e5758628412bdc57ce.en: Chef'Special at AFAS Live in Amsterdam, with Premium Seats that include VIP entrance without a queue, a comfortable chair and warm snacks.

c657f19cf6452f8e036c6c88aecf6e4e1e66e98c.en: Hang Massive at Melkweg in Amsterdam. Entry is by smartphone ticket only through the Ticketmaster app.

b3874e1aa7661e6bc602b08ecb0883a7008d7c9a.en: Wanda at Melkweg in Amsterdam. Entry is by smartphone ticket only through the Ticketmaster app.

0e88b2ec18c3d662f4ca3287eb7f957d30270fd9.en: Trivium and In Flames at AFAS Live in Amsterdam, with Comfort Seats that include VIP entrance without a queue, a comfortable chair and warm snacks.

2dc162c6e37a7dc940213802781e16fc0cbea915.en: New Wave All Stars at Ziggo Dome, a mobile-only show. Ticket prices are listed under the Experiences section.

e32d7b265fc6a663734b15b4c4726c1c06d82860.en: New Wave, Venue Premium Packages at Ziggo Dome Club. The packages follow the venue's terms and day membership conditions, and resale is not yet open.

71049ba7b299c4dfec8fa2fbc971b3428d765c1d.en: Launch party for the Vida Festival 2027 with La Publicidad and Bernal at Antiga Fàbrica Estrella Damm in Barcelona. Doors open at 19:00, and season-ticket holders enter free with a companion.

9e5053f864fe77e9a7b76d82f536e25ff0cda243.en: Declan Welsh & The Decadent West in Barcelona, a concert with a 2 euro handling fee per order. Children under 16 may only enter with an adult, and every attendee needs a mobile ticket.

dd802ad477bbf3491589371aea6f82cf55319cec.en: Fontaines D.C., D.C. EU Tour 2026, at Sant Jordi Club in Barcelona, with support act CHALK. Minors under 16 need an adult and must complete the minors' access form to get a QR code.

16b6deaa6983f9af0822b935b4c04ae8faf07674.en: Niall Horan, Dinner Party Live on Tour, at Palau Sant Jordi in Barcelona. Minors under 16 need an adult and must complete the minors' access form to get a QR code.

e58772d429b80924cdcc9caf394ded17d23fbf06.en: ElGrandeToto in Barcelona, a concert with a 2 euro handling fee per order. Minors under 16 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian, and tickets are digital only.

3b030bf93396f2ff0d175747b9795bb62c1e8659.en: Pitbull, I'm Back., at Palau Sant Jordi in Barcelona. Minors under 16 need an adult and must complete the minors' access form to get a QR code.

e00b7c388a8f0c1ab9c2aa21c99bb9e17268e383.en: Joe Bonamassa, 2026 Europe Tour, at Sant Jordi Club in Barcelona. Children under 16 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian, and reduced-mobility tickets can be ordered by phone.

87d6380dd9ef2b369b6194b80ecb23b3566991e0.en: Arlo Parks, Desire Tour, at Sala Apolo in Barcelona, with guest artist Baird. It is a mobile-only event, with a 2 euro handling fee per order.

292ca036bf78cdde0f5498fb99937a41baaf5465.en: Jack & Jack, SYN/ANTI Europe 2026, at Sala Razzmatazz 2 in Barcelona. Minors under 16 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian, and tickets are digital only.

53c205115cecf52672015dc114a7dffd43afc8e4.en: Artemas, Lovercore / Getting Up to No Good Tour, at Sala Apolo in Barcelona, with special guest Henry Morris. It is a mobile-only event.

f3936662621a5cd24f018bca0f5be19c0aa82f13.en: Polyphia, Be Not Afraid World Tour, at Sala Razzmatazz 1 in Barcelona. Minors under 16 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian, and tickets are digital only.

1926ede62d83a3f2ef8a04532b9fc30f4ac8c5a3.en: Kingfishr, Europe 2026, at Sala Apolo in Barcelona. Minors under 16 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian, and tickets are digital only.

4d0566a2cf4fd273ef84447173b4f5851cd0c3e7.en: Vida Festival 2027 launch party with Cervatana at Antiga Fàbrica Estrella Damm in Barcelona, where the Extremadura band presents its self-titled debut album. Doors open at 19:00, and season-ticket holders enter free with a companion.

faa73f84e7f37bb61859fb69bd737771ec85ddd8.en: Grecas at Sant Jordi Club in Barcelona, with the main artist on at 21:00. Minors under 16 need an adult and must complete the minors' authorisation form online.

be390879fe435ae8a66d45eddf893a4502229f91.en: The Sheepdogs, Out All Night Tour, at La 2 de Apolo in Barcelona. Minors under 16 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian, and tickets are mobile only.

49849446849c9e751e88ea64cad760b1887ab732.en: RIKAS at La 2 de Apolo in Barcelona. Minors under 16 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian, and tickets are digital only.

4e5a79250084cab5299a33b2b6504f62a0aae846.en: Jay Wheeler in Barcelona, a concert with a 2 euro handling fee per order. Children under 16 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian, and tickets are digital only.

40127ec21843d82eeaa3f45fffa7dfc9f996c26f.en: A photo exhibition in the Treptow town hall foyer, 26 October to 11 December 2026, presenting nine interviews on volunteering by women and queer people in Treptow-Köpenick across seven roll-up banners.

86dc9e1593cd888de72f5996e48060b19f0fa66a.en: Chemist and artist Jane Dienemann, known as lovelymicrobe, shows digital artworks based on real bacteria grown on agar plates at Lichtenberg town hall. The images invite visitors to see the microscopic world with new eyes.

e8d99443edd0d06f861acd4d25f8bfdf469126da.en: A gentle full-body gymnastics course for women and men at Pestalozzi-Treff, improving mobility, endurance and strength. Held on Fridays, with registration by phone through Frau Grimm.

e42f680b2ba84139f1b073c1e2557fd3fd9d3579.en: A free help service at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek for Lichtenberg residents who need support with benefits. Project staff help with forms, letters, understanding texts, applications and finding advice services. No registration needed.

fceaf459c78d524c53f9ea12a05b29722d58ad3b.en: An exhibition of photographs by Jesús Cabrera Hernández at Volkshochschule Tempelhof-Schöneberg draws attention to the many adults in Germany who struggle to read and write, and to the pressure that everyday phrases can put on them.

3e6011dfbffc135ac63b5b0ce1ff5f9a827e4966.en: A free autumn holiday project for ages 10 to 15 at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Bibliothek. Participants design an object on a laptop, print it on a 3D printer and finish it at the Repair Café, in one of two weeks in October 2026, with ten places each.

f8a08286df9767bce569fade395f2215be06af72.en: Julius Pristauz's installation GEGENWIND at Kunst Raum Mitte uses kinetic sculptures, light and video to explore political pressure on freedom, queer life and the cultural scene. Wind becomes a metaphor for resistance and change.

1cfff79cf30cedf99a2517ed26fcc03b31eb564f.en: The exhibition Future Archives / Archive Futures at the Ratskeller gallery asks how archiving practices shape what is remembered and which futures are imagined. Works come from artists including Nora Al-Badri and Sarah Oh-Mock. Opening 7 October 2026.

b778d183ab245917ed6c4b246e74c30ede0c16d5.en: Open studio sessions at Studio Bildende Kunst for people with creative projects who want to paint together, guided by artist Andrea Werner. Mondays 17:00-20:00 and Thursdays 10:00-13:00. Entry is free, and donations for materials are welcome.

782a6a59941cd4e0c0293c099e3c43463495c925.en: A family tour of the Gotisches Haus in Spandau, one of the oldest surviving townhouses in the Berlin area. Archaeological finds and a model with openable walls show six centuries of city life, and visitors can join in singing, guessing and role play.

be57b51470c7b70ea393a7012c4e9cacf99b6e03.en: Photographer Michael Wesely's exhibition Doubleday at Museum Pankow, 10 September 2026 to 28 March 2027, rephotographs historic Prenzlauer Berg sites from the same spots, layering past and present in long-exposure images.

d36182a982e62ffc6655c3e5fcb82fee69f93c8d.en: A special exhibition at the Tempelhof Museum on the former ivory bleaching works of merchant Theodor Francke in the 19th century. It traces overlooked traces of colonial exploitation in Tempelhof and invites critical reflection on Berlin's colonial history.

048f6b2f3679daf3bef649a8455ff1c072872b28.en: Museum Pankow's 25th anniversary exhibition presents the projects, memorial initiatives and education programmes that have shaped the district's history, with objects, archive documents, posters and photographs.

3b8f941a36a9eb3ab9db87183d6bccdba11c959b.en: Nina Paszkowski's solo show Furore at Bärenzwinger draws on the Furies of Greek myth, who become the gentler Eumenides. Over nine months, ceramic growths break out of the walls, exploring anger as a force that can open up new ways of living together.

d53597eb1edf12a8d3d53c7ca183390e7194d4b6.en: Berlin district libraries mark the Day of Libraries 2026 with a week of free events, including book blind dates, bingo, crafts and readings. Some events, such as readings, require advance registration.

2263f8c5fd5a53d2647de39d9e61bb9eff829718.en: Parent and baby crawling groups at the Kindercafé of the Kaulsdorf neighbourhood centre give children a safe place to play and make friends, while parents exchange tips and relax together.

3120f46b44206ae27a6937c6ff916b06bea01e53.en: BUILD THE CHANGE is a free four-day workshop for ages 9 to 12 at Gertrud-Junge-Bibliothek, 19-22 October 2026, 10:00-14:00. Children explore technology and Lego, make messages on fabric, learn simple repairs and bring their ideas for the neighbourhood.

33cbe42244ae082e3240c35ed5b47ec80cd907a2.en: A dance day for young and old at the Galerie im Kulturhaus Karlshorst, run with TSF Lichtenberg e.V. in the hall at Aufgang A. Entry costs 3 euros.

7dc7cc30a664eb65b74bfed4c8a1ff40fbe2078d.en: An exhibition at the Dokumentationszentrum NS-Zwangsarbeit on how memory is formed, changed and contested, shown on the site of a former forced labour camp. Interactive stations invite visitors to explore personal and public memory.

8b12f8ed3e2f00e2e046f3f526184e8f1251f2a4.en: A breakfast buffet with Heike at the Warnitzer Borgen community centre for 26 participants, costing 6 euros including a glass of sparkling wine.

361c5a10c2500b484ffbe20935ff44c13a0ae696.en: A tech help session at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek introduces the new self-checkout machines and helps with catalogue searches, reservations, Tolino e-readers and the library's digital apps.

2e8b2fe6a34552f83c658fed301f80cfd2830dd5.en: Forms of Alignment at the Centrum Judaicum explores how relationships form between people, spaces and history, through five artistic works in a listed building treated as part of the show. Curated by Daniel Laufer and Constanze Murfitt.

f6c97bffdb64947682d96e2377aadd882b4d890d.en: A drawing and painting class at Pestalozzi-Treff every Thursday from 10:00 to 12:00 under expert guidance. The course does not run during school holidays, and registration is requested by phone.

93048c062dde29d14e48e31315d6ab810fa72652.en: A school holiday workshop for ages 10 and up at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel, where children program a small mobile robot with Calliope and Scratch and learn the basics of electronics and simple circuits. Registration required.

58b84ae2598234c05f9670426251ef09940d3f84.en: A parent and child meeting at Bettina-von-Arnim-Bibliothek on Thursdays from 10:00 to 11:00, for children up to 24 months. Parents chat over coffee or tea while the children play. Bring your own play mats.

80baa88a1aaf42d828961290342f898906713b6f.en: Forced to Work – Willing to Survive is an international travelling exhibition on Nazi forced labour, told through personal biographies from Poland, Austria and Italy. It ends by linking those histories to exploitation in the present day.

cacbd483c1f61d689996474ec7b83229fac1bf0b.en: Christina Dubin's solo show Phasenverschiebung at Stadtteilzentrum Kaulsdorf, 2-28 October 2026, combines therapeutic painting with the structured patterns of Zentangle to make inner processes visible. Opening on 2 October at 16:00.

f7881b305a3db063d126b0cd15aed1a39255e363.en: Frank Jimin Hopp's exhibition at Galerie Wedding, 21 August to 1 November 2026, explores the memories of South Korean migrant workers who came to West Germany in the 1960s and 1970s. Interviews and collaborative ceramics form a living archive.

b45a64ad967c1e871537130c6c486c96adff0b79.en: A duo show at Schwartzsche Villa in which Berlin and Hong Kong artist Isaac Chong Wai responds to Käthe Kollwitz, looking at mothers' fear of war. Three Kollwitz sculptures, including Pietà, appear alongside his two-channel video The Mothers.

e5f4d852b061367a82e164100f9c67d8677d24c2.en: Qusay Awad's artistic research project at Bärenzwinger, linked to the year's theme of hauntings, looks back at the gallery's ten years of exhibitions in relation to the building's own history. Results are shown from October.

1fd60dcbb96d4fc152347d82d6b68d6ce5837980.en: Lili Yuan's ink paintings at Galerie im Kulturhaus Karlshorst turn saturated colour and ink into emotional symbols, combining Eastern philosophy with abstract forms on Xuan paper. The Shanghai-born artist has lived in Germany since 1992.

43fd9cb688d1df6657f12c618bfc68bc357e6369.en: A puzzle swap at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof, where puzzle fans can trade with each other. Visitors should bring complete puzzles only.

ecbd3ae177472001af4f63250c095eefed3e4cad.en: A hands-on exhibition at PYRAMIDE Hellersdorf, 24 August to 30 October 2026, guides visitors through major art periods from ancient Egypt to Pop Art through a quiz and interactive art machine. Free entry, Monday to Friday 10:00-18:00.

c45e58d1d66c72f24e5a6aabb75fa843da987f5f.en: Stolz und Vorurteil at the Centrum Judaicum brings together short films by Nico Beyer, portraits of Jewish life in Europe, with an audio installation on stereotypes, online hate and the difficulty of representing Jewish people.

85462ecac437ab04bf0821526daa68f29d00a189.en: A children's puppet show at Schwartzsche Villa, Sterntalerchen, based on a Grimm tale about a little star who searches for a girl who helps the needy. For ages 3 and up, tickets 6 euros.

d1e454be0b81533066ba34e228894fa136433e8d.en: An exhibition at the Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek marks 125 years of the Chorverband Berlin, the umbrella body for more than 350 choirs. Free entry, no advance registration needed.

0e308e1550ab10fc98a3b0d56ef4ec72451c16fa.en: Museum Pankow re-stages its exhibition on Max Skladanowsky, the film pioneer and photographer, showing his lesser-known photographs of everyday life in Pankow and Niederschönhausen from the early 1900s. The accompanying book costs 7.50 euros.

53c55a42d2d4a41db69cda9e8b1073ca4a4378ab.en: A show at Museum Lichtenberg by Jürgen Wittdorf and Andreas Fux on queer life in Lichtenberg, curated by Stephan Koal. It runs alongside the exhibition Klingel bei Anna, on 100 years of queer life in the district.

d6af6f3813a2e37088414f26febd9e6728ade1c9.en: A documentary exhibition at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek on Otto Nagel (1894-1967), a Weimar-era modernist and communist resistance fighter whose independent vision clashed with GDR cultural policy. Curated by his granddaughter, on view until 7 November 2026.

e0c60389a68fa3bfc2bec3fcabdeacf2ea7b62b4.en: The Mitte Museum's exhibition on writer and journalist Susanne Kerckhoff (1918-1950), whose fictional portraits from 1948-49 probed guilt, denazification and antisemitism in post-war Germany. Art contributions include Peter Wawerzinek.

75549306b6bd9657a024502b2abcbabe4dfa3beb.en: Lost & Found at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel turns forgotten items, from bookmarks and postcards to ice scrapers and beer mats, into a playful display. Visitors can also check whether something of their own was left behind.

80d2103e532d80e67898186735d0a21f92e4beea.en: The exhibition Schrott oder Schatz at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek, 10-30 October 2026, follows electronics from raw materials to repair and recycling. Clear graphics show how our consumption links to global supply chains and what we can do about it.

2249488879628654943343016ded638086eb8f10.en: A German class with Iduna at Stadtteilbibliothek Karow, every Thursday from 11:00 to 13:00 for adults. No registration needed.

faf15d6508c26167cec30c5bbae1a5b5617635f1.en: Carola Andreas's colourful paintings of nature and everyday moments in the Gropiusstadt community centre foyer, 31 August to 31 October 2026. The artist is on site on selected evenings. Free entry.

caa7262729a95758bda4900f4f06693172440850.en: Matt Browning's exhibition A Screen of Trees at the Mies van der Rohe Haus opened during Berlin Art Week. His sculptures carve Douglas fir into chains of blocks, scaling up the traditional craft of whittling to room size.

1f44977034717f9505c63b88f2530a6697c5cf5f.en: A special exhibition at the Hugenottenmuseum on the 300th birthday of Daniel Chodowiecki (1726-1801), showing how the Enlightenment artist was rooted in Berlin's Huguenot community. Drawings, prints and books run until 25 October 2026.

c9cda94d96ec04e032527547aca38f3a8a0cbd4e.en: A quiet hour every Thursday from 12:00 to 13:00 at Bettina-von-Arnim-Bibliothek. Phones are muted and conversation is kept low, so everyone can read in peace.

ad563a276077122edc38fbb964a37f81bf7cb79a.en: An exhibition by Gleis 69 on the Moabit freight station, from which Berlin's Jews were deported. Its role was long forgotten, and a memorial came only decades later, while the historic deportation ramp continues to decay.

cc9d886635d9dc5170ecebccba6fd5357c4cd01c.en: Eberhard Hollerbach's pencil and graphite drawings at Bibliothek Kaulsdorf make stillness visible through everyday landscapes, paths and Berlin scenes. The artist, born in 1949, leads a local drawing group. Free entry.

cddaa0d382d2539a6ca26dc26d5a6864a4c0c64b.en: Margarita Wenzel's sound installation You Are Here Since You Left fills the medieval vaults of the Historischer Keller, 21 August to 29 November 2026. Faint sounds of air, footsteps and masonry circulate at the frequency of human voices.

cceeb9c0765fa33d24b5e8939d230c22f9c445aa.en: The exhibition Courage at Prater Galerie, 4 September 2026 to 3 January 2027, shows only works by women from the East Berlin gallery's history. Artists include Gundula Schulze Eldowy and Christa Jeitner, many of whom were underrepresented under the GDR.

2ae1d69ddce09c9f0a14e77a5468203f576d3b35.en: 600 Akkordeons, a travelling exhibition on the accordion collection of Dieter Plinke, shown in six Berlin shopping centres during the Year of the Accordion. The East Side Mall stop focuses on historical instruments, with free workshops and concerts.

1fb9da14fd4547df7a8d5e5c701c636d5a85e840.en: Ute Mahler's exhibition Derselbe Himmel at Galerie Pankow, 2 September to 1 November 2026, shows her 1980s fashion and portrait series for the East German magazine Sibylle, plus a 2020 photo essay on women.

be8fe208c0b30b7fe677484e2447525a9d00dc34.en: Mukenge/Schellhammer's Fleshy Works at Galerie Johannisthal, 12 September to 4 November 2026, uses the leopard skin as a symbol of colonial power, resistance and fashion glamour. The multimedia installation combines painting, video and photogrammetry.

806cc19a09ba23f0d4ae928e19d13ec424ac7ed2.en: A course in biographical writing at Bruno-Lösche-Bibliothek, where small groups learn to record their own life stories and share memories. It runs with Die Wille gGmbH as part of a lifelong learning project.

98919606616ca570aa7bf1ebbd093e61b2fafc45.en: georgia Krawiec's installation DENKMAL UM at the Spandau Citadel, running until about March 2027, uses three camera obscura objects to project images of former Nazi-era research buildings. The upside-down images invite visitors to rethink monuments.

fbb9ed8d3bfd55a93fc3669a4144070007caba9b.en: A DGB travelling exhibition on working women in the GDR, after reunification and today, told through eight women from Brandenburg. Free entry and no registration, with a talk by one of the witnesses on 10 September.

4cae151805e3eb7a4c55335c9797d1fbbf2141bc.en: Forschergarten offers hands-on science experiments for children from age 5 in the Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek. Sessions on 20, 22 and 27 October 2026 cover sound, the sun, moon and stars, and materials under a magnifying glass.

0f27eee61298a158a92e95e2f4d63fc7a22fd2ee.en: Free digital advice at Bettina-von-Arnim-Bibliothek on all things digital, including booking online appointments and phone settings, as well as the library's digital services.

19e7fa1e6342781368e61f9b5fc89845419b5a23.en: Family and friends gaming afternoons at Bibliothek am Wasserturm on Mondays and Fridays, 16:00-18:30. Teenagers and families play Nintendo Switch games such as Mario Kart in 30-minute slots, booked at the library or by email.

334df4a25d4e0c017582aaf714ac0683ae154bc1.en: Antje Püpke's cheerful illustrations and caricatures at Mittelpunktbibliothek Ehm Welk, offering small islands of good mood. Free entry during library opening hours.

d4731bbe38189a639de339744aaf468de0f04fb4.en: Digital-Zebra, a free walk-in help service at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek for problems with smartphones, the internet or digital forms. Thursdays and the second and fourth Mondays, 13:00-16:00.

bcdc2b5397ddc5825fe29508ea6cc7e7447ee31c.en: Volker Kreidler's photo exhibition Half Life Chornobyl at Bastion Kronprinz in the Spandau Citadel, 3 July to 29 November 2026. Images from the exclusion zone and Kyiv show the resilience of people and nature amid war and nuclear risk.

cf4f33fc4b5d48362d169dc3cddab1267b80d59c.en: During the Easter Knights' Festival (30 March to 1 April), only three Spandau Citadel sites stay open, daily from 10:00 to 19:00. Other museums are closed and public tours are cancelled. The Kommandantenhaus covers the history of the fortress.

e2127eaaa021411dee96d7afca749a8ae943fe71.en: #BerTA workshops for people aged 60 and over at Bibliothek am Luisenbad, held on the second Thursday of the month from 13:00 to 15:00. A psychologist leads discussion over coffee and biscuits. Free, no registration.

707f34c0780cbbc0594e154d643efe0000ea6a1d.en: An opening at Kulturhaus Spandau for paintings by Helmut Frelke, who paints mythic and biblical scenes in the grain of precious woods. The exhibition runs from 17 October 2026 to 16 January 2027. Free entry.

e5391d195e80db1b04e4736a97f16471a1c94917.en: Five new exhibitions at the ZAK Centre for Current Art in the Spandau Citadel, 19 September 2026 to 3 January 2027. The EG Lounge shows Funda Özgünaydin's hybrid collages, mixing photography, paint and digital effects.

1b1fa3b7791d3c148566a29ab8971916e5532ee0.en: Digital-Zebra public help at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek during service hours, for smartphones, the internet, online appointments, e-tickets, PDFs, e-prescriptions and ringtones.

618f435d539435e574853773a716a22989a8da1d.en: Free one-to-one advice at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek on living wills, lasting powers of attorney and care directives, on 22 October from 14:00 and 11 November from 11:00. Registration is required.

50bd93a2e6534c85e97d12a5be6e9e5ca70e05ba.en: A technology consultation at Bodo-Uhse-Bibliothek, run by digitally skilled students, to answer personal questions on digital problems or to deepen workshop topics. Free, no registration needed.

1c1b3bab3b3fb5786a84d6c3f67c6e33f2ca5c2d.en: A chatty afternoon for seniors at Hans-Rosenthal-Haus, starting at 14:00, hosted by Martina Wappler and the chair of the seniors' council. Participants choose the topics. Food and drinks are paid for separately.

acf0446d231215a31d3ae59d8fd703f2ac71dc6d.en: Digital-Zebra at Schiller-Bibliothek, a walk-in help service for digital devices and online tasks such as doctor appointments, PDFs, e-prescriptions and ringtones. Bring your device or use the library computers during service hours.

64a5a32700dacf96e4794e759ae6e3c8e31ac93e.en: A Halloween crafts session at Stadtteilbibliothek Halemweg, where participants make autumn and spooky crafts together in a colourful, creative atmosphere.

27f293df7e7e820457b58e92a219600cd05f932c.en: A free two-day drawing course for ages 8 to 16 at Bettina-von-Arnim-Bibliothek, combining creative drawing with simple mindfulness exercises. Participants' own ideas drive the work, building focus and self-expression. Registration required.

fbc02166dd07e53ad64d9df6d6c8b606395dd3bf.en: A gaming corner at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof-Schöneberg, Monday to Friday 14:00-18:00. Visitors aged 12 to 18 can play EA Sports FC 26 on PS5 or Mario Kart 8 Deluxe on Switch for an hour. Free with a library card.

21aa89c0b4a028753126ec943466447eca7fa698.en: A dance café with DJ Jürgen Pölitz at the Judith-Auer-Straße community centre, including a coffee set. The fee is 8 euros, and advance registration by phone is requested.

2bf4cfd1e2a4d7e57b92369d3c7f22792f114386.en: Archipel der Stimmen is a free, intersectional and multilingual self-publishing space for women, hosted at Stadtteilbibliothek Buch.

ac3404150fad5963a1b8daaf65fcd2a31aeb27fd.en: Rita Grunow's exhibition at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek, 12-31 October 2026, shows what it means not to read and write, through expressive images of cold and beauty. The artist attends the opening on 13 October. One in eight adults in Germany is affected.

0214710ec21f2a490ecc5cd7ccb8a4c92a2d0521.en: Klingel bei Anna, the first comprehensive exhibition on queer life in Lichtenberg, from the district's founding in 1920 through Weimar, the Nazi era and the GDR to today. Curated by Neo Seefried and Karl-Heinz Steinle, it focuses on homes and friendships.

a8677fd364d38c81d2b75fc71004e62df58596ef.en: A trading card swap at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade during the autumn holiday programme, for children from age 6. Kids can swap cards and learn Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh and Magic: The Gathering. Free, no registration.

d89976861e9d25848b402df6f766ead5c6154086.en: A dance afternoon with live music by Joe Morris at a Kommunale Begegnungsstätte, costing 5 euros including a cup of coffee. Phone registration is requested, and guests should arrive by 14:30 to keep their reservation.

158e9091572fd1034e12aab7dd1166d53e204b5f.en: An information stand of the Fennpfuhl mobile neighbourhood work at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek on Thursdays from 14:00 to 16:00. It is a meeting point for information on local services and events.

d2707e5b87ffc16eb82e4ff2553fd78f6f48739c.en: A travel talk by Charly Kittel, part two of Mongolia beyond tourism, with untouched nature, at the Rusche 43 community centre. Limited seats, phone registration requested, fee 4 euros.

9922ee3f011221c55db02ddfa82180e442b9ce66.en: Free drop-in workshops on monsters, storytelling and transformation at Schiller-Bibliothek, for ages 6 to 26. Sessions on 19, 21 and 22 October cover collage, illustration, simple bookbinding and a monster film strip.

35561cd2f1a3469869dbe6d03a51211e4dea2dd2.en: The reading club at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek, supported by Stiftung Lesen, helps children discover the joy of reading through shared reading, reading games and creative workshops. Volunteer leaders run the weekly meetings. Free, no registration.

eb6a0983832d6c6c00b7f52ef7f27a2d29251009.en: A dance café with live music by Hans-Jürgen Millow at Maria-Rimkus-Haus, starting at 14:00 with doors at 13:00. The fee is 3 euros plus 3 euros for coffee and cake, and drinks cost extra.

4bd4d53c88663bb72064c7367a22df9e59ae9efb.en: A robot workshop at the Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek, where children aged 4 and up can try Bee-Bot and Ozobot robots. They steer them with buttons, pen and paper, and Ozobots can be borrowed afterwards. No registration.

3424345bdbf0f703030a46a567c09ff9ada1dbd7.en: A Yu-Gi-Oh duel arena at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade every other Thursday from 15:00 to 18:00, for ages 9 and up. Newcomers get guidance with the library's decks, while experienced duellists can compete. Free, no registration.

d2aeaf6efee0088b2b6c7a303694fb8733309a61.en: Digital-Zebra public digital advice at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek in Linden-Center Hohenschönhausen, for smartphones, the internet and digital forms, booking appointments, e-tickets, PDFs and e-prescriptions during service hours.

b2bc78196e19985048c49bd5fc8f8c92294f9a93.en: The Makerspace at Mittelpunktbibliothek Ehm Welk, open Mondays and Thursdays from 15:00 to 17:00, is a meeting point for digital and analogue gaming. For now it offers LEGO and board games, with Switch, Xbox and tournaments planned.

b825306e1cc7a021082a8f15d912ebe373a7ddce.en: A German conversation café at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek, held in the library garden in good weather. It suits learners at levels A1 to B2 who want to practise German and meet new people. Registration by email or phone.

e571ff3c3ae0166a1755a60b43308395d389fe30.en: A textile printing workshop at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek as part of the Azubi Weeks. Visitors bring old clothes or fabric scraps to print with new motifs, and this time there is fabric paint for self-painting.

bc3d0c990679d600da55d5b15fd8c435ed27af16.en: A LEGO afternoon at Stadtteilbibliothek Buch every Thursday from 15:00 to 19:00, with a new theme each month. Free building is welcome, and visitors vote for the best model of the month, which is published on Instagram.

3b57c3b5ba4f07b31874df1c95afda3aceeea92c.en: A monthly citizens' advice hour at the Margarete-Kubicka-Bibliothek, run by the Neukölln senior council, which represents older residents to the district, transport providers and care services. No registration needed.

d197e4622f4a5e839481e95df85c624e17a1f8fc.en: A vision board and collage workshop with Pia Hasenkamp at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek, where participants visualise their goals and ideas through creative collage. Free entry, registration requested.

006bb0ba863d92327e53ffadc36956f91a933143.en: An autumn health workshop at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek on quince, pumpkin, elderberries and walnuts, with a tasting of quince and elderberry syrup and roasted nuts. Led by Sabine Bock-Scholz. Free, registration required.

ee6e97705b13af1813c68715161cf9c7ad01050f.en: The Game Maker Lounge at Bibliothek am Luisenbad, a space for children aged 6 to 18 to develop their own games, with media-education support and room to build digital skills.

8aa1644279f09c4b57170f892962486cc52620c6.en: The GameMaker Lounge at Bibliothek am Luisenbad, a space for ages 6 to 18 to develop their own games, with media-education support. No registration is needed.
