3b7a3f86d4ba02d95165703e0012c512267b331f.en: Digital-Zebra at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek, a public help service for digital devices, online tasks, doctor appointments, PDFs, e-prescriptions and ringtones. Service times are held at the Stadtschloss neighbourhood café and PC room.

139efaa618172be04de59465f39590d7a079d51c.en: Chess at Gertrud-Junge-Bibliothek, a drop-in for all levels from beginners to grandmasters, to learn, play and exchange ideas. No registration, suitable for all ages.

36a2dffb9083be225f46fc183ce260b1376c98cf.en: A picture book cinema at the Kinderbibliothek Luisenbad every Wednesday at 16:00, where children, parents and families can join in colourful stories. No registration needed.

4229b7046d740258f338645678644807ccd20580.en: A fairy tale reading afternoon at the Ribnitzer Straße community centre for young and old listeners. Free of charge, with advance registration requested.

ea0ad412621dd1c90b127eaaf3f23b21169fe52b.en: Lesewelt Berlin's reading hour at Bodo-Uhse-Bibliothek, led by volunteer readers every two weeks for children aged 4 to 12. Each session lasts an hour, is free and needs no registration.

1cefbe4c414a671446991d1f9ac4346b31160e3c.en: Families with children aged 9 and up can try out new board games at a games afternoon in Adolf-Reichwein-Bibliothek, from 16:00. Free entry, all games are explained, and no registration is needed.

f11dacd2dbd62d7e3b07dbeda3ee09e156c1b55b.en: An upcycling workshop at Schiller-Bibliothek where participants make their own beeswax wraps from cotton fabric. Wednesdays are in German and Thursdays in English. Free, no registration.

0c87efae363e1509f87f50856e65cd27d196a359.en: A new self-help group for people with visual impairments at Stadtteilzentrum Kaulsdorf, bringing together people with and without sight loss to share experiences and find solutions together, 16:00-17:30.

d159e986ca72bdf084c21e065107548cbb948c4b.en: A drawing workshop at Schiller-Bibliothek for people who think they cannot draw. It focuses on experimenting and having fun rather than accuracy. Materials are provided and all ages are welcome.

c0affe098cde5d9f24bf2a4b8b9ee9b0033fbb37.en: A pottery workshop at Stadtteilbibliothek Karow where children aged 7 to 10 make their own clay plate with natural hay inlays and a relief decoration. Registration by phone or email.

1385c80e3a32bb23f7722d8c7ac4f4d185e50cd4.en: LEGO Zeit at Stadtteilbibliothek Halemweg, Thursdays and Fridays from 16:00 to 18:00, with LEGO boxes to build freely. All ages are welcome, free, and no registration is needed.

15c4a5722d385ebc1bf8622518c957633def121f.en: Coding afternoons at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek on the second and fourth Thursday of each month, 16:00-18:00, where children try small robots and coding games aimed at young tinkerers.

cf7d2f75d982f51897b64e694433957816703012.en: A picture book cinema at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek every Thursday at 16:00 in the event room, for children aged 4 and up. Free, and the stories are a surprise.

e0b80af7f822fcb953b0c56893417d792aaa4072.en: A reading club at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek led by reading mentors. Eight-to-eleven-year-olds meet on Tuesdays and five-to-seven-year-olds on Thursdays, with up to eight children per group. Free, with registration by phone or email.

a361e81553499cf9b9d433d865c26954ca5d5078.en: A family tinkering Thursday at the Bibliothek im Märkischen Viertel, with Ozobot and Dash robots and Makey Makey boards to try. Other sessions focus on creative use of technology. For ages 6 and up, no registration.

d34d11aae150e92579302f07496d7fd32d54cfc0.en: Lesemäuse storytelling for children at Bibliothek am Wasserturm every Thursday at 16:30, except during school holidays. It is a picture book cinema or kamishibai for ages 3 and up. Free, no registration.

697d0cdeb0715598fbfbd8a748a84e1f5b7eaa03.en: A digital drop-in clinic at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek, run by the youth association Sonay e.V., where young people help seniors with mobile phones and tablets every Wednesday.

f7eeeb77f868c3636025f9541ae76495341ed359.en: An open knitting and crochet meeting at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek every Thursday from 16:00 to 19:00, for beginners and experienced crafters. Bring your own wool and needles. Tea and water are provided.

eaf72b9754dc8bf1fc9605162f09303887c200f7.en: A chess lesson in the autumn holidays at Adolf-Reichwein-Bibliothek on 22 October 2026 at 16:00, with two experts teaching the rules and useful strategies. All levels welcome, free, no registration.

2a0fc06d73d97e16f28bedcb9ce30ac679ee7ffe.en: Weekly reading sessions at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Bibliothek for children aged 4 to 12, every Thursday from 16:00 to 17:00 with volunteer readers, in cooperation with Lesewelt Berlin e.V.

ee4abbd7661bc125d3ff59af7106b314c5075651.en: A multilingual story time with Stadtteilmütter at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek, every Thursday from 16:00 to 17:00, for families with children aged 3 and up. Reading aloud, picture book cinema or kamishibai. Free, no registration.

0125ad59371bf90c21fb4e820619a4c84d6e38e9.en: An open robotics afternoon at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel, where visitors can try robots from the library's lending collection and gain first experience programming them.

0623708bf96220930853ba3af7a0a2d3a8749896.en: Strick In, an open knitting and crochet meeting at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek. Bring your own projects, chat with other crafters and join in with any kind of handwork. Free, no advance registration needed.

34f52287d60461fedff136c9b746b35c932be468.en: A reading hour with Lesewelt e.V. at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek, every Thursday from 16:30 to 17:30 for children aged 4 to 12. Volunteer readers take children into different worlds of stories. Free.

20f53532dd1bf5dec19dd48ab604b2286fb43171.en: A read-aloud session at Stadtteilbibliothek Reinickendorf-West for children aged 4 to 8.

6957d7adc8a465f8d9f9813800b06017044053de.en: A kamishibai or picture book cinema for ages 3 and up at Theodor-Heuss-Bücherei, held on Thursdays at 16:30 in the square outside. Free and no registration, with an indoor alternative in wet weather.

c198a173f1558128a9cdb01ee30cacdd78ab0a65.en: A weekly creative workshop at the Kaulsdorf neighbourhood café for children aged 4 to 12, every Thursday from 16:30 to 18:00. Children paint, craft, collage and experiment with materials. Registration by phone or email.

22628cd22e9a2bed6f9b66ff323860fe91696668.en: A picture book cinema for kindergarten children every Thursday at Janusz-Korczak-Bibliothek, with big pictures, lively stories and a lot of fun.

131e60013283afa04aac3b54c41c640e7172e958.en: A picture book cinema at Stadtteilbibliothek Lankwitz, showing classic and newer picture books that delight young and old alike.

076cc5ce7d123dadaa4417e8b8ce4ced821c32f6.en: A weekly reading hour with Lesewelt e.V. at Stadtteilbibliothek Halemweg, every Thursday from 16:30 to 17:30 for children aged 4 and up. Free, no registration needed.

edec7f486e19a430dfaa7036d4244eb6e6f47f5d.en: A multilingual family story time at Eva-Maria-Buch-Haus, with reading and picture book cinema in several languages. Diakonie neighbourhood mothers lead the sessions on Thursdays, and some dates are cancelled.

6fca258854d572ef059351e6f268788b5301126d.en: The puppet play Grille und Ameise by Puppentheater Fingerleicht, after Jean de La Fontaine, for ages 4 and up. An ant and a cricket learn about being different, one playing and one planning for hard times.

d4a739e22e890d28c917f67227e3641bd7657d8c.en: A stuffed animal sleepover at Theodor-Heuss-Bibliothek. Children leave their favourite soft toys on Monday 27 October and collect them the next day to see what they got up to. For ages 3 and up, no registration.

2bf274704360ff2e50b1d68e59e0ecce060971a1.en: Weekly creative activities for children at Stadtteilbibliothek Erich Weinert, with crafts, painting, board games and picture book cinema. Drop in, no registration needed.

0725f425c58c27a6ea6a64f772d95b52c0dc6243.en: Code Club Gropiusstadt is a volunteer initiative where children and teenagers aged 7 to 17 learn programming through play in free afternoon clubs. No prior knowledge is needed, and the space is wheelchair accessible.

e1fc8988c750097592d5bb64ba158543453dde4b.en: Helenes Leseclub is a new reading club at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek that treats texts as puzzles and as a space for dialogue. The first meeting plans logistics, and the second focuses on dystopian fiction.

626eb450e5072b36500699e169ac8a21d53ccaab.en: A monthly book club at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek on the first Thursday of each month at 17:00, where passionate readers talk about favourite books in a relaxed setting. Registration by phone is required.

a35a2ec0ed485d3fe22b0daad641829892509a86.en: Raum für Fantasie: regular board game sessions organised by Nexus e.V. at Hansabibliothek, lasting about four hours and suited to newcomers and experienced players alike. Sign up on Facebook or by email.

8c3d6b052e25ce4f291d20e75129bad33b3b8ae0.en: A reading and talk at Nachbarschaftstreff Kietzer Feld on 22 October 2026 at 17:00. Authors Uta Mitsching-Viertel and Ellen Händler draw on 80 interviews with the older East German generation about family, careers and gender roles in the GDR.

2d38299241ed639af85aea1f0891ad7a4a27e7dd.en: An adult games evening at Eberhard-Alexander-Burgh-Bibliothek every Thursday from 17:00, with board and card games for all group sizes. A new game is featured each week. Free and no registration needed.

a16cba6aa87b28f5969f925f409c5d7c0e8e7a53.en: Four talks and a discussion at the Mitte Museum on Jewish queer life stories from 1933 to 1945 and beyond. Topics include the Jewish painter Gertrude Sandmann, Yiddish culture, queer Jews in Sachsenhausen and the Queere Helden memory project. Held in German.

b318954dd53a1b3c45f4dfc6891c2616347508c0.en: Queer Thursday at Stadtteilbibliothek Buch, an open and creative evening for queer people and allies to write, listen and read aloud. No experience is needed, and reading aloud is always voluntary.

4ecb077f43ffda9e807be2971726ee85e40813fa.en: A mixed-media workshop at Bibliothek Tiergarten-Süd, combining stencil art and lino printing to make large-scale prints for posters or fabric. Led by educators from Kulturlabor Trial&Error.

aaebf6c0b41f74bb20e810b9b06e00852a8652ac.en: Kiezchor 99 invites anyone who wants to sing to its weekly neighbourhood choir at Kapelle99 every Thursday from 18:00 to 19:30, except on public holidays and during school holidays. No registration and no experience needed.

1e9052c2826360733e99ca39efeeff58d72d37ec.en: A dance class at the Nachbarschafts- und Familienzentrum Kiek in every Thursday from 18:00 to 19:00, combining movement, music and wellbeing. Free in February, then 10 euros a month from March. Registration by phone.

afaa3f092a0548d11d753e495a2822c2970bf5fd.en: Oper mal anders presents Wagner's The Flying Dutchman, with Richard Vardigans telling the story alone at the piano, without singers or orchestra. Kulturhaus Spandau, with humour and piano virtuosity.

5a8530cdf313891f07f77bc365990c4d12ec99b3.en: The Silent Book Club Fennpfuhl at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek. Participants read their own chosen book in silence for an hour, then chat if they wish. Free entry, held on the fourth Thursday of each month.

4f02d770e583f598c7d1a877cb7832c8f5acb693.en: Adult recreational volleyball at the Johann-Julius-Hecker school gym. Trial sessions are possible, and during school holidays times are arranged in advance.

bb24c1d00a2ff5beef6ea4efa94e54173416b5d5.en: Queer improv theatre in cooperation with Sonntags-Club e.V., led by Serena Raucci, at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek. Interested people can get in touch by email for details.

ca1c271bdebd319f7f3a4bd4235cfcc11ca9d389.en: A reading by Monika Arnold at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek from her novel Nach draußen. A writer who has withdrawn from life watches her neighbours until a visit from one of them pulls her back outside. Free entry.

aee2d552d34ca202a12dda5d31179ecad0b6ad58.en: A musical talk at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek on Emilie Mayer, a 19th-century composer forgotten for nearly 140 years. Her symphonies were written during her Berlin years from 1847 to 1862. Part of the Marzahner Konzertgespräche series.

1bbbf37d03195f9aaba0f6bc96308945e6ca6c52.en: A staged reading at Ingeborg-Bachmann-Bibliothek on 22 October 2026 about the GDR's Schreibende Arbeiter movement, which turned workers into writers. Led by Thomas Hartung and his team, free, no registration.

406948fb744df4c7590cff81496fb40e2aeaffc7.en: A musical reading at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek for the 130th birthday of Friedrich Hollaender, composer of the song Von Kopf bis Fuß and the Groschenlied. Music by Torsten Knoll. Free entry, registration requested.

593370bc20738db2b3a33e9a7bc1f0c1cc9a8ea7.en: A series on National Socialism and family history, with workshops on researching relatives from 1933 to 1945 on 11 July and 21 November 2026, plus a film and talk. Registration by email or phone.

4501eb53ff9db3a14386d97f0f2376f34b0b5fa7.en: A show at a Berlin comedy club, billed as a love letter to the city. The organisers do not sell wheelchair tickets for this event.

4c79d063d1e0ad301e39c05ce757d64421a92502.en: The INTENSE mobile planetarium, a nine-metre dome from Stiftung Planetarium Berlin, is set up in the Puttensaal of Bibliothek am Luisenbad. It aims to spark children's interest in maths, science and technology. Registration required.

7bf742468a4d49dc76015762285514ea4d2e9d21.en: Clean Connection is a self-help group for people affected by substance misuse linked to partying and nightlife. It focuses on relapse prevention and building sober leisure activities, in a judgement-free space. Contact by message for times.

8135cb3ed567979a4c1dad925ea67936109b51e0.en: A travelling exhibition at the Jugendamt Lichtenberg shows Neu-Hohenschönhausen as a model built from building bricks at 1:1250 scale, made by volunteers and families to mark the estate's 40th anniversary. Free during office hours.

980feb5cef57aa9198239e4756990c2ba320ac19.en: Free, discreet family law advice from lawyer Marion Kehrberg on the fourth Thursday of each month, 16:00 to 18:00, at Pestalozzi-Treff in Mahlsdorf. Topics include maintenance, custody, separation and divorce. Phone booking is required.

dc0cd82025814fc87733a28281b7c925160a9200.en: A free public guided tour of the permanent exhibition zurückgeschaut | looking back at Museum Treptow, on the First German Colonial Exhibition, the 106 people from Africa and Oceania displayed in it, and their resistance. No registration.

c022484c2391b55b9491260d08a72d1c8ab7e37f.en: A performance by Julius Pristauz with Elena Francalanci, staged within the installation sketch for an assembly at Kunst Raum Mitte. Sexual gestures, dance and pop references explore intimacy, desire and discomfort.

dedce2060c364c7552286b786e3e8f48ad0b0258.en: A panel at the Dokumentationszentrum NS-Zwangsarbeit on how Austria, Italy and Poland remember Nazi forced labour. Historians Sabine Schweitzer, Carlo Gentile and Roland Borchers take part, moderated by Julana Bredtmann, as part of Forced to Work.

8724dc6c924cdbbf952c2074eab8226db3f8bd60.en: A neighbourhood photo project at Stadtteilzentrum Kaulsdorf collects old wedding photos up to 1976 for an exhibition called Hochzeiten aus den Familienalben, showing how wedding customs and family life have changed. The exhibition opens on 1 October 2026.

1c53baf618143e8beeb5723c6dc03e5c5f964c9d.en: Play to Change at Stadtwerkstatt Berlin is a day of interactive methods on diversity, anti-discrimination and democracy for trainers, educators and teachers. It ends with the documentary INTERSECTION and a film talk. Registration requested.

6b59585a34443fdba7efa621545005b7caf9ad6e.en: A free learning tandem at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek, where a retired primary school teacher helps first and second graders with reading and maths in 45-60 minute sessions on Fridays during opening hours.

42ce17f1966268a340cb89d731222748a6107949.en: An international webinar, Europe in Transition, held in English by the European Academy Berlin with partners. It covers EU enlargement, relations with China and political education. Free, registration required.

182e6cfe8a7e03cfd161a6115882fb0102de6ff4.en: The Familienbüro Lichtenberg is a free, confidential point of contact for expectant parents and families, offering information on youth welfare services and local support. The mobile service visits the Bodo-Uhse-Bibliothek.

577de5a76ae684c7e96e244946d5f423464cf1c8.en: A Super Mario Maker workshop at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek for ages 10 and up, where teams design a level on paper first and then build it on the console. No experience needed, registration required.

14397bbf1ce7ddf9950cfc20068b2fdad0a83415.en: A holiday workshop at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade for children aged 9 and up, building a talking poster with Scratch and Makey Makey. Free, registration required.

854ebefda903dca0cbb7982125575faa236f14cc.en: A beginners' photography course at Kiek in, starting in October and held every Friday at 10:00, led by Jürgen Köpnick. Free, no prior knowledge needed. Bring a camera or smartphone.

2ffc16db7e5fa832aa9f1e411f0c780e42fe3a80.en: Weekly Digital-Zebra advice at Janusz-Korczak-Bibliothek on Wednesdays and Fridays during set service times, for phone settings, online doctor appointments and creating email addresses. iPads and printers are available.

4a1d8e6f18ca0d7a491094a1d08c2825f470e34a.en: GANZ SCHNELL NIRGENDWOHIN LAUFEN is a dance-theatre performance by Stadttheater Spandau that uses the treadmill as a model for a world caught in a race for optimisation. Free entry, premiere on 16 October, for ages 10 and up.

e2058526fa5b087cd29b7809f7ca6970e78decd5.en: A smartphone course for women at Bibliothek im Märkischen Viertel, covering settings, safe use, email, messengers, online payments, PDF forms, AI tools and translation apps. Run by Frauen Computer Zentrum with Digital-Zebra. Registration required.

0efb80cf8c03be032664348ff0ad5bfffc68c37b.en: English for advanced learners at Pestalozzi-Treff STZ every Friday from 12:00 to 13:30, to refresh and extend skills in reading comprehension, grammar, listening and conversation. Teaching materials are provided.

52aee1ad91fbcc42e0779c5eb949d005da69351d.en: A Halloween session at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek where children aged 6 to 12 build witch houses from biscuits with icing and chocolate, learning a little about architecture along the way. Limited places, registration required.

13f7be8d09cb5f28a30609f49d9900206aa404a4.en: Book your librarian at Bibliothek am Wasserturm: free 30-minute one-to-one advice on VÖBB digital services such as Overdrive, FilmFriend and PressReader, plus help with e-readers and the Libby app. Several languages are available.

0548c5bab47f761f1d5ca122f6c2ad2ff9c07baf.en: Baby singing at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, where babies and their parents, grandparents or carers sing, bounce and clap to familiar and new songs, led by musicians from the tomatenklang music school. Free, no experience needed.

15857e9f8a4fb71a5b87bbc84777f3f506796d0e.en: Nachtkatze und Dachgespenst, a shadow-theatre puppet show for children aged 3 and up at Schwartzsche Villa. A cat on the roof longs to explore until a noise in the chimney calls for help. Tickets 7 euros, 6 euros reduced.

2a1d00fbe48883407415ed6fb6ab22b6b5c351dc.en: Digital-Zebra at Mittelpunktbibliothek Ehm Welk is a free, walk-in guide to the digital world, helping with email addresses, ringtones and online doctor bookings. No library card needed. Service hours vary by weekday.

145a4484e79beffbf82037df643f4082242727fd.en: Digital-Zebra at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek offers free walk-in help with internet, smartphone and digital form problems from the Neukölln libraries' digital guides. Service times are Monday 11-13, Tuesday 11-13 and 15-19, and Wednesday 15-17.

30c4bd7ea21d76025743305e260c31135190268b.en: Digital-Zebra at Gertrud-Junge-Bibliothek offers free walk-in help with internet, smartphone and digital form problems. Service times are Monday 11-15, Wednesday 13-19 and Friday 11-15.

76936ba2ac328f2bf46d83f93bad25f689f20baf.en: A community lunch at Ribnitzer Straße with volunteers cooking fresh meals. It costs 5.50 euros and places must be booked in advance.

f6ee180c15be7cec4067137741b07e5af081910e.en: An autumn holiday day at Stadtteilbibliothek Buch for children aged 8 and up with a grown-up. Experiments, a healthy cooking workshop and a neighbourhood street party with grilling. Funded by HOWOGE, registration by phone or email.

eb434f4f7c1639a06db33a4a3189e142c23c96ce.en: A second English group at Pestalozzi-Treff STZ on Fridays from 12:00 to 13:30, refreshing grammar, reading and conversation skills. Teaching materials are provided. Registration by phone.

6bc380b538c4a7e53ef90336a43d1415828f0427.en: A virtual reality workshop for teenagers aged 14 to 18 at Trude-Jugend-Bibliothek every Friday from 13:30 to 15:30. Participants try VR headsets, explore virtual spaces and create their own worlds. Free, beginners welcome.

b2e3d0c2c9bc5baa2804c73d0f22de318215da44.en: A relaxed board game afternoon at Stadtteilzentrum Kaulsdorf every Friday from 13:30 to 16:30, with classics and modern games for beginners and experts alike. Bring your favourite game if you like.

c6d5af40ecc0359746014a7701bd5f7d34e67043.en: A read-aloud session at Gertrud-Junge-Bibliothek every Friday from 14:00 to 15:00 for children and their families, who choose a story together on the day. Free, no registration.

247a4b9147a4a114fac16116bbb577b51eed8cbc.en: Creative gaming in the autumn holidays at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda on 23 and 30 October 2026, 14:00-16:30, for ages 8 and up. Participants test Bloxels, Super Mario Maker and Nintendo's game studio. Free, registration required.

04b2090f964341e26f97a5268be82a55b2eef01a.en: Free advice on vocational training, official letters, labour market integration, migration and social matters at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, run with Verein Partnerschaft Deutschland Afrika e.V.

089efde783906f32852be58d0d17df02eafad5cf.en: Leni's Kreativ-Labor is an autumn holiday family programme at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek with Duplo, Blue-Bot, Botley, Lego and Ozobo activities for different ages. Free, no registration.

7acaeb10e2f9dcdb09c2fb0ba9daf203f52e5111.en: Guided tours of the Molkenmarkt excavation in Berlin-Mitte, the city's oldest market, run by the State Monument Office. Free tours, usually on Fridays at 14:00, for up to 15 people aged 6 and up. No photos are allowed.

3a4f017566cf1662b0f0e4f32355f40ef0387c1e.en: A LEGO building day at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Bibliothek, where children can build towers, vehicles or whole fantasy worlds, with no limits to creativity.

aa26d37bc3648123de046e4036ed3903670e933e.en: A family café in the children's area of Stadtteilbibliothek Lankwitz, where parents can exchange ideas over tea and browse the library. Staff from Familienzentrum Lankwitz share information on courses and parenting support.

8f5bad3d6e1a4089da36e20e851e100aea5f8329.en: A holiday coding taster at Bettina-von-Arnim-Bibliothek with Osmo tools such as Awbie, Tangram and Words, for ages 5 to 12. Osmo combines real game pieces with an iPad. Open drop-in, no registration.

dd38915440c3fb999bac031a6deb569422928e34.en: Crafting, play and making in the foyer of Bibliothek am Luisenbad, open to all without registration.

501a8af4a53979c0c43e7cd6c0b51c00148715b9.en: A dance afternoon for over-55s at Ribnitzer Straße, with autumn-themed songs from the 1950s to today played by the Alex Band. Costs 10 euros including coffee, with advance tickets only.

04d27719207c084da2cbdd1feb07c91dc95d6c81.en: A biographical writing course for older adults at Bibliothek Tiergarten-Süd, helping people record their own life stories in a friendly group. Part of a lifelong learning project funded by the federal government and ESF Plus.

6e9da8d71b46410407b88ad90db29694a3d6eb2a.en: A free LEGO building session at Eberhard-Alexander-Burgh-Bibliothek every Friday from 15:00, for vehicles, animals, buildings or anything else imaginable. No registration needed.

f777b466f58e142ce6454becf14c210cfe3513e5.en: A LEGO Technik and WeDo session at Bettina-von-Arnim-Bibliothek on the last Friday of each month from 14:30 to 17:30, free for children aged 5 and up.

1acd962fb70057b81524cc911639ce5be1e5a696.en: A weekly board game meetup for children at Eberhard-Alexander-Burgh-Bibliothek every Friday from 15:00, with board, card, dice and memory games. Free, no registration needed.

604d272e41f2b22678fc5abf42c68eda2d89c96b.en: A one-hour guided tour of the Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek, showing visitors how to find their way around, where to ask for help and areas they may not know. Open to all; register by email, and groups need their own booking.

a87542683d053470d651668e7f81171376cba18e.en: A sewing meet-up at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof. Bring your own sewing project or browse pattern sheets, from quick book covers to bags. Fabric donations and basic supplies are available.

471d2226289531eb67715ca56352c09ed0a33611.en: A picture book cinema at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel every Friday from October to March, with read-alouds, crafts and apps to try out.

0466972423c443078a5d7afdac6548cfb7bbd8ec.en: A game space in the Makerspace at Theodor-Heuss-Bücherei in Schöneberg for ages 10 and up. Visitors can play with friends, and the equipment can be borrowed at the ground-floor info desk.

7bcbdec993986f5658a615bc1d5d3e7865071b1a.en: A puppet theatre show, Frau Holle außer Kontrolle by WagnerHowitz, at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade. It moves the fairy tale of Mother Holle into today's free market. For ages 10 and up, free, no registration.

149a5aaffdfbab2eb40983c9545d448f214c3bd1.en: A textile upcycling workshop at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel, where an artist guides children aged 8 and up to sew and redesign old clothes and fabric scraps.

03bbf944f7439328e02f3f050fd41f54eb7fcbcd.en: A musical read-aloud at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek for children aged 3 to 10, with songs and sound stories played on Orff instruments. About 30 minutes, free, with registration by phone.

144beca8d970fc71127c435b4307b251fffceb9a.en: Hakayana is a workshop series at the Wilhelm-Liebknecht library on storytelling across languages, led by storytellers from Hakaya 2.0. Sessions run from 16:00 to 19:00, with the final stories shared on stage.

5f96b9bf2777f804784f88725bfdc2b90d220763.en: A free digital advice café at Stadtbibliothek Berlin-Mitte on e-readers, smartphones and digital library services. A different branch opens every two weeks. No registration, with coffee and biscuits.

2a2775b139d3a40a3716e666d6206929c0a26755.en: A craft afternoon at Stadtteilbibliothek Reinickendorf-West, making mushrooms, owls and lanterns for ages 4 and up.

2a38f585499460ed2d4830bc1f1580bffc3ffd43.en: A chess meet-up at Theodor-Heuss-Bücherei in Schöneberg every Friday from 16:00 to 18:00, except on public holidays. Free and open to all levels, with boards and pieces provided.

54ab82883260cd55eebf6ef77da8045750732d5e.en: A popcorn cinema for children at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek, where special films are shown in a cinema atmosphere with popcorn. Free entry, no advance registration.

07d2b38d9334b6a2fca93989ce98b541ef5e330a.en: Kreativ Freitag at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof is an open get-together where people bring their own projects, share techniques and learn from each other. No registration.

f983c3cc6f852bd4a33ffec4ac29ac1c6b6f5978.en: Children's author Margit Auer reads from the new book in her series Die Schule der magischen Tiere at Bibliothek am Wasserturm on Friday 23 October 2026 at 16:30, followed by a book signing. Email registration recommended.

c4456376b42f5f650fba4e336286b4efee16fd66.en: The Sprach-Café Deutsch at Stadtteilzentrum Kaulsdorf gives beginners and advanced speakers a relaxed place to practise German over coffee or tea. The focus is on conversation and meeting new people.

fc1a080ed107536f77ebbf87465b96f615a4b4c5.en: A reading by Mariam Kurth at Stadtteilbibliothek Buch from Und alle Laternen gingen an, the story of a newly married couple after a stroke. Actors Mariam Kurth and Henning Schimke read from both partners' perspectives.

b0e6f791bef0065e53fc33d1777087a0f017742f.en: A puzzle swap at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Bibliothek, where puzzle fans of all ages bring complete puzzles to trade.

05a2027e2416dcf1ef2843529e9727b81c5e7c05.en: A reading session at Stadtteilbibliothek Lankwitz for children aged 6 and up, featuring exciting and funny books.

45c96f3ccf84db418d685eed5f0038457eddb0e4.en: A weekly story time at Eberhard-Alexander-Burgh-Bibliothek every Friday at 16:30, with picture book cinema or kamishibai. Free, no registration.

7f5954d35cf25161bac57d0aa1586cd47a050f70.en: A bling workshop at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek for the Day of Libraries, where visitors decorate their library card with coloured gems in the makerspace. Free, no registration.

182adaba24c214ba225440d3a4333f44ce605e83.en: A stuffed animal sleepover at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek. Children bring their soft toys for a night among other favourite animals, with bedtime reading and singing on 23 October 2026, and collection the next day at 12:00.

633387f0e97aa16a559c5ea4b657a82c86cfd46e.en: A reading by Patricia Vellard from Gift und Honig, the first book in her trilogy, at Stadtteilbibliothek Erich Weinert. It mixes family drama, adventure and historical fiction shaped by her time in Peru and Paraguay. Places are limited.

6b5f3e148b09faf19f7aa573696babac69ebd03d.en: An open story time at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek every Friday at 17:00, with picture book cinema, kamishibai, music, dancing and crafts. The programme suits even the youngest children.

e8175b23385f3dd388171a287866d3f992674dcb.en: A free open workshop in Polish at Stadtteilbibliothek Karow for children aged 5 and up and their parents, run by Polki w Berlinie e.V. using Montessori methods. Activities cover letters, geometric shapes, origami and colour.

424cecfbb3285e58b6860ce91107d82920becfcb.en: A Silent Book Club at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek in German and English. Participants read silently for an hour, then talk about their books over hot drinks. Free entry, with advance registration.

28ad9d0ef9d49d3a73111393d8d520f5f15662fb.en: A quiet hour at Stadtteilbibliothek Buch with phones on silent, no loud talking and a calm time to visit the library.

a85d23866bcda97bbeb45f71bfb5a94dd070f563.en: A reading by the Brause Boys at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek, a Berlin reading group that has met weekly for 23 years with humorous and satirical short stories. Registration requested, part of the Azubi Weeks.

ce7e3f0d0d170b80911ca990d5566742651840a9.en: A reading by historian Bjoern Weigel at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek on the Tempelhofer Feld, which carries more than 200 years of German history, from farming and airport to forced labour and the 2014 referendum. Free, no registration.

f40b8f70bd6c20b577d25b59b1b50f2025c15c48.en: A monthly silent reading club at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek, where people read their own books or magazines quietly together. Free, no registration. Bring something to read or borrow from the library.

d7c4d8295fdbcbad4057a5b08587bb5664e3d568.en: A listening session at Hansabibliothek, one of eight sessions from August to November 2026 organised by GROTTO. Guests share favourite songs, albums and musical stories in a relaxed setting.

310c8d8c01269ed5b436e28909eabf684040ad5f.en: Nell Zink reads from her novel Sister Europe at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek, in conversation with Elisabeth R. Hager about the role of Berlin in her work. Part of the Berlin in Books reading series.

5a1c84649a8300ddfd4d125e7d1a31e932f9ca14.en: An EU quiz night at Kulturbrauerei on 23 October 2026, with Ireland in focus during its Council presidency in the second half of 2026. Free, with registration required on the website.

4afad063ea500b2173f3a9c18e017cd2b426263a.en: The KMK Karlshorst Music Club special at Kulturhaus Karlshorst features the band SIND, who have Karlshorst roots, alongside CoppiPlay. A rock evening, with reservations required. Entry 15 euros, 3 euros reduced.

c330674635b4d2c982e336f7cccc6214784875e3.en: A staged reading of Rilke's Cornet at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel with actors Walter Prettenhofer and Noah Stehle. It follows an 18-year-old soldier in the 1663 Turkish war, through his first love to his death.

4dd15eb2e22b5765377c084605d338fca5075ce0.en: The legendary EU quiz night returns to Kulturbrauerei on 23 October 2026, with questions on the European Union and on Ireland, which holds the EU Council presidency. Registration is available on the website.

edc29b0cea402d5fb44b495468f2263ccf87d836.en: LadiesCrimeNight at Schwartzsche Villa, where ten Berlin crime writers read texts about violence, death and the dark side of human nature. Entry 10 euros, 7 euros reduced, with tickets at the evening box office.

a148e3f795c71e9b974ae03ce0e840f2d830d38a.en: The Privat-Theater-Gesellschaft Elektra stages the comedy Bei Urlaub Mord at Kulturhaus Spandau. A man will do anything to stay at home when a holiday to Greece is planned. Coffee and cake are sold on 18 and 25 October.

37e3b89970865c1d365c3b29f89f25e0e39a4d97.en: Augenhöhe, immer schon auf Augenhöhe is a humorous and musical look back at 35 years of German-Polish neighbourliness and 35 years of marriage. Performed by Celina Muza and Andreas Visser at SprachCafé Polnisch e.V. Registration by email.

0555a8bb051a0fae362d934c0184d831cabe0820.en: SKELER's Nightfall world tour, with support acts LXST CXNTURY and ÆSTRAL, presented by Goodlive Artists.

5dc4bd2bbc721a9cd9168fb8fa0c40591df6a71a.en: Guided tours for kindergartens and primary schools at Zitadelle Spandau. Each visit has a 45-minute tour and a 45-minute workshop to make a small souvenir. It costs 1 euro per child, on Tuesdays or Fridays, also during holidays.

835fd3a49a2e8c8fad878946788ad48524c8e13f.en: A swap and bulky waste market at Böhmischer Platz on 24 October, 8:00-13:00, where residents can drop off unwanted items for free and take useful things home. Car and van deliveries are not allowed.

52987be047db8ce1605a240d338dc2626f34f56a.en: A workshop at the Berlin State Centre for Political Education on responding to right-wing populism with respect and firmness, combining basic knowledge, practical strategies and discussion. Online registration required.

b2ac8d9846af38b4b1fd04c13f47b1fbc5240718.en: Dungeons & Dragons at Bibliothek am Luisenbad, a beginner-friendly tabletop campaign. Interested players register with the organiser by email.

f56e13771605cc372370e9a13047e3074ed89213.en: A photo and drawing display for the Day of Libraries at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek on 24 October. Visitors bring pictures of their favourite shelves or libraries, or draw their dream library at the table.

3fa00e564da8e94796af949f12da18175ad6db07.en: A Pokémon trade day at Stadtteilbibliothek Karow, where visitors bring their cards to swap and discover new favourites.

f29fe82cc8c66810dfe8053914e88e3b313d6f6b.en: A kamishibai theatre for children aged 3 and up at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek, every second Saturday at 11:00 from 26 September to 19 December 2026. Free, no registration, with stories such as Elefanten im Haus.

deb3d34b519745f7f2a2f08a0c13ab6758e82286.en: ReUp Studios at Schiller-Bibliothek, where visitors use the makerspace under guidance: a laser cutter, a 3D printer and a textile press for printing clothes. Free 3D printing material, and visitors bring their own textiles.

2ad8d1ef00abe9b905dfeda16c1c021d60fc812d.en: A children's workshop at Schiller-Bibliothek on turning a 3D model into a real object. Participants design on the computer, print a flat template, then cut, fold and assemble boxes, animals or fantasy creatures.

352d9184c13d06191b7ee298a9a613c688a65445.en: A sewing workshop at Schiller-Bibliothek where people learn to repair clothes, from shortening trousers to mending torn T-shirts and stuck zips. An embroidery machine can add motifs. Bring fabric scraps, buttons and zips.

8b7789591e2f6b7cfdaf28ec547cbc2b24308dcd.en: A puzzle meetup at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof, where people solve puzzles together, bring their own or take one from the swap shelf.

410b82ed9a3010233eade50594c26053325be7d9.en: Children's author Margit Auer presents scenes from the new book in her series Die Schule der magischen Tiere at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek, talks with moderator Claudia Kühn and then signs books. Recommended from age 8.

5afb29673b41de186d595241656ef444dbad7609.en: KulturLeben Berlin at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek offers people on a small budget free places for theatre, cabaret, readings, music, museums, cinema and sports through partner venues. Information on the last Saturday of each month. Free entry.

fc75ef0d5d68fb316e16cec7905e9ab8cac57dd1.en: A reading of Mark Twain's Diaries of Adam and Eva by a reading ensemble, with Katja Steuer and Thomas Hollaender. It tells of an awkward first love and the struggle to live together. About 60 minutes at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek.

5f5e40ed4cfed5f80ad640e55f1ae01a7842a47b.en: A kamishibai theatre at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek every two weeks, run by the friends' association of Lichtenberg libraries with illustrated picture cards and stories. Recommended from age 3. Free, no registration.

9d8f00438991920746bd187ac4d1a4d0166274df.en: A community clean-up in the Sprengelkiez, where volunteers remove litter from pavements, trees, shrubs and benches. Part of the Mitte clean-up campaign.

ebec183abaee5f47415a7ed88b539fcac65fb468.en: Dog-assisted reading practice at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek, where children who find reading hard read aloud to the reading dog Chess for about 15 minutes each. Supervised groups, registration by email or phone.

3f1107365fb9da48e8d7054bcb101d5ed9c06d31.en: Keloğlan und die verzauberte Schüssel, a Turkish picture book cinema for children aged 4 to 8 at the Wilhelm-Liebknecht library, told in Turkish on 24 October 2026 at 11:30. Free, no registration.

684f5f9c5f34fd28073a2dd05d1bf6cc38b5ea61.en: An exhibition of artworks by children from the Stallschreiberstraße 12 shelter and neighbouring schools, made in the holiday project Worte erzählen about basic words such as mother, house and friend. Presentation on 24 October, 12:00-15:00.

60292c80a01bee639346866949cf3a905942b286.en: A table tennis meetup on Saturdays from 12:30 to 15:00 at the table outside Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof, open to beginners and pros alike.

df3bb93f32e1619ffabf8addf757d0b8b4016ebd.en: A Pokémon swap on Saturday at Stadtteilbibliothek Buch, for trading cards or playing Pokémon Go.

e8550c5c3975adb5f65af4b924c62d284b7218b3.en: A family tinkering Saturday at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel on 3D design with TinkerCAD for families with children aged 6 to 12. The makerspace also offers electronics, robots, stop motion and laser-cut masks. Free, no registration.

5fb9cb7270d56aecffd0682e5a827b3ce7dc3ae9.en: An English-language book club at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek, starting with J. D. Salinger's The Catcher in the Rye, a novel often banned, and why it still resonates. Open to all, register by email.

91869502389f289bebcc0fd303cf1c3edf6be115.en: A digital café at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek, one Saturday each month from 14:00 to 16:00. Volunteers help with e-books, email on smartphones and online public services. Free, no registration, with a short talk from 13:00.

4b0a66d9348b3b5232213d709ee4f39a48ceb05a.en: A textile craft afternoon at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek, where children aged 4 and up design a bag or a piece of clothing with textile pens, foils and paints. Free, no registration.

0dcc77dae52a52e5d21c5a5a106a35cdb79491bf.en: A table tennis meetup at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof, held at the table in front of the library together with Stadtbewegung e.V.

023d286849b7a6bc7bc5d28bfc250464e64c8b0e.en: A walking tour of Kreuzberg on the life stories of Jewish and Kurdish women, run with the women's association Pek Koach e.V. It starts at the Admiralbrücke. Free for ages 18 and up, with limited places and phone registration.

b9464fd74c44e0903c631849da61ea8cff105822.en: Blasisafari, a discovery tour of wind instruments at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek during the KinderKulturMontag. Children try out the instruments and finish by drumming together. Free, no registration.

5cf7741b154b401d1824c1e4fed4ff406ecad484.en: A get-to-know programme for the Day of Libraries at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda, with social crafting, a plant swap, a knitting workshop, an electronic music jam and creative writing. Most sessions run through the afternoon and evening.

ede8571eee47badaff3dd31f7006397a5d6516f4.en: A reading by women from the writing groups Frau sucht Wort and Schreibfrauen Online at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek. Seven writers present biographical, everyday, poetic and musical texts.

b20e0190e808464bddcdeb2811e862017757d5ea.en: A reading by Nadja Schulz-Berlinghoff and Uta-Maria Torp at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek, telling stories of women whose achievements have often stayed in the shadows. Held on the third floor.

462b5f935b6853e704630df9a49808a9539fe2d3.en: I WRITE, a writing club at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek every second Saturday from 14:30 to 17:00. It offers time to meet, an hour of silent writing and an open end. Register via Meetup. Open to beginners and experienced writers.

b47d079e7d21271e9437931906c67959d48ec6d2.en: A two-hour manga drawing workshop for beginners at Bodo-Uhse-Bibliothek, covering the faces typical of manga and colouring with light and shadow. For ages 10 and up, free, no registration.

baf36c185b8875cd59e6dba5c93e8d0d538417ae.en: Storytelling in a Mongolian yurt at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek for children aged 5 and up and their families. Stories and fairy tales from around the world are told live, with advance booking and up to three children per adult.

8efda739e2d45d4b031064507bee9f2b06e4a715.en: A lantern workshop at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek for children aged 4 and up, decorating empty Tetra Paks so they glow in the dark season. Materials are provided by Kunststoffe e.V. Free, no registration.

cee65fd81f797ce8e3e13430ec107e3346d9f09a.en: A spooky themed guided tour of Tierpark Berlin on the strange myths and stories of animals. Tickets are online only and strictly limited, and children in Halloween costumes pay half price.

9018839462f7625510f7747200f3820006df41f0.en: A monthly family craft workshop at Bibliothek am Wasserturm on Saturday afternoons, led by Nadine, with changing themes such as paper snowflakes and autumn art. Free, no registration.

566691b5a6b37f56fa090ee5035017b4e0ab36e0.en: Nicole Gospodarek's children's theatre show Vom Bett, das nicht schlafen konnte, after Gerd Prokop, at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel for ages 3 and up. A bed that cannot sleep makes the whole house shake. No online ticket needed.

19ac13f69269803bf50d96bb6a5be4c8fe1ba620.en: Busch in Berlin: Nachwachsende Rohstoffe, an exhibition at Pforte from 10 October to 28 November 2026. It shows bio-based materials such as raw wool, mycelium and clay, from the TU Braunschweig's Institute for Architecture-Related Art.

45c25ea379accdcf3c987526a70c3f98938871b2.en: A chamber music concert at Kulturhaus Karlshorst's large hall, with Rachmaninoff's first piano trio and Fauré's Pavane alongside new works from Berlin, including songs by Barbara Ehwald. Entry 7 euros, 3 euros reduced.

4513e8d61c5144052061ee8e8c79702818e40d41.en: The STOP workshops at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda, from 17 October to 28 November, are free sessions for FLINTA* people to practise responding to racism, fatphobia, ableism and queerphobia. Allies are welcome.

da15567c4070b4e909f40a430983cf15cc11f4a7.en: A storytelling show by ErzählTheater Sabine Kolbe at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek. Cheeky fairy tales from around the world feature fruit and vegetables, told with physical play. For families with children aged 4 and up.

fdd36911e3844b21991f4d5d7377d590dc738bf7.en: A literary dinner series at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek, where guests discuss texts at a public kitchen table. This Day of Libraries edition features Sophia Hoffmann on preserving knowledge. Bring your own dishes; registration required.

34c9b2d33b6ed0e5d29f1adfc5cd3c6397118010.en: A reading from Brüchiges Plastik, a novel about a couple who try to share parenting equally until an au pair forces Eve to question old roles. Angie Volk reads on 24 October at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda, moderated by Patrick Ludwig.

6ffcc572c192089e03a2d4680ae558cfedc1bd31.en: The Jugendensemble Alte Musik Berlin performs All in a Garden Green, English Renaissance music marking the 400th anniversary of John Dowland, at the Musikinstrumenten-Museum on 24 October 2026. Tickets 18 euros, 10 euros reduced.

092d7a827613128b1db37a1d8ae459348adc12cd.en: I:RAN, a personal theatre piece by Patrick Khatami and Salome Dastmalchi at Theater unterm Dach, about being German-Iranian and never having visited the homeland of a father. Tickets 15, 10 or 5 euros.

a7ce07306f5259607586b691c918d98c17f204cd.en: CeeLo Green at Uber Eats Music Hall with Gallery Seat tickets. They include an exclusive seat in blocks 202 to 204, access to the Gallery Bar, a fast lane at the entrance and a free cloakroom. E-tickets are sent 3 to 5 days before the show.

bffe5fe78264347e29f80de874c7c5076b13e146.en: A play and movement afternoon for fathers and children up to age 6 at Familienzentrum Zukunftshaus Wedding, offered by a volunteer father. Free, no registration.

485aac45c7efe716db761517c2bbf5a57577f932.en: Laughter yoga at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek, a free session on how regular, hearty laughter relaxes and supports health. No registration needed.

e2d3906bb055c7829fa5412d746444fa6877ce9e.en: The Herbstfest of Offen für Kultur at Hansabibliothek, with stick bread, a fire show, Black Parents Reading and more.

edd768082872a0b6e830a826905dd12e363756c0.en: SonntagsMANDALAlerei at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof on two October Sundays. Adults create their own mandalas together, with no skills needed and materials on site. Registration is made via the workshop provider's website.

3d16def52add7872815edac42c9af0f3529f2779.en: A Sunday café at the Warnitzer Borgen community centre with friendly company and a fairy tale, for up to 20 participants. It costs 4 euros including a coffee set.

0ffd06d6ce7bff1ad76c1c489630be7e4470afe7.en: A guided walk through Alt-Cölln on 25 October 2026, 14:00-15:30, part of the Archaeological Path Berlin, starting at PETRI Berlin. It explores lost places between PETRI Berlin and the Humboldt Forum. 10 euros, booking required.

cbee5252a479d5ec93acf6c0b3d2c4e33806e47c.en: Theater auf dem Bügelbrett performs Beim Teufel zu Besuch at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek, a puppet play about a girl who lands in hell and tries to get out. It has light nods to Goethe and the Brothers Grimm, for ages 5 to 99.

7ba9c70e11bf4335eeb8520de970e92f4aa20b47.en: A comic marionette show, Kleines Gruselvarieté, at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Bibliothek, featuring creepy and funny puppet friends such as a monster baby, a skeleton and a giant cockroach. Magic and spooky fun for children and adults.

c7c9a717d4037a36d316a4bfc213d024efd2c827.en: A critical guided tour of the Soviet War Memorial in Treptow, run by MEMORIAL Deutschland e.V. It looks at the 7,200 graves, the Stalin quotations still on display and the site's propaganda history. Interactive, offered in several languages.

ed5a2be5c3c3dfd2f385dd3d33456098aa9e6fb0.en: A picture book cinema for ages 4 and up at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof-Schöneberg, where everyone in the group can see the pictures. Free entry.

05f342cf36a0788e5b81c6a64f4402deee29e891.en: A German course for mothers with children aged 3 months to 3 years at Familienzentrum Zukunftshaus Wedding, on Mondays 9-11 and 11-13, not in school holidays. Topics include child development, nutrition, health and everyday life.

2a03b9274178acb2b42081dabd5b3d271ea6b398.en: A photovoice exhibition by GePGeMi e.V. at VHS Marzahn-Hellersdorf asks how younger and older people feel in Berlin's migration society. Co-researchers share their daily lives, worries and hopes. Free during opening hours.

734df357f5816fa2c52e445af60b78d52a235158.en: Care advice hours at Stadtteilzentrum Kaulsdorf from the Berlin care support points, free and independent, covering care benefits, housing adaptations and support for people with dementia. Registration required.

45655bb341be05ec31fc277d1861ec43af0d36f8.en: Senior dancing at Stadtteilzentrum Kaulsdorf, a group of lively women moving gently to music, without partner dances. Men are welcome too. The focus is on social connection, and newcomers can drop in on Mondays.

b9b934f3eac5d9d664b67170f8acc8b294173fdd.en: A stop-motion workshop at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek for ages 8 to 12, where children make a small LEGO film with the Stop Motion Studio app. The 31 March and 1 April sessions are separate. Registration required.

5ac45c7c691c4a576345a4f9e36b778b9c9f0a8f.en: Beginners' English at Pestalozzi-Treff STZ, covering pronunciation, basic vocabulary, simple sentences, listening and games. Mondays 11:00-12:30 and Thursdays 10:30-12:00. Registration by phone is requested.

e5834279dc1bd828cc79602d893100cc417963d7.en: Free energy advice from a Verbraucherzentrale Berlin adviser at Rathaus Mitte on the last Monday of each month, 12:00-15:00. Half-hour consultations cover electricity saving, insulation, heating and mould. Phone booking required.

3145afcd65ac4e30502aefa1220f9c0ab18d7b14.en: A display of spooky insects during Gruselwoche at Adolf-Reichwein-Bibliothek, 26-30 October 2026, with stick insects and other creatures in terrariums, alongside the library's gecko Herbert. Free, no registration.

c3cc045963abc470fc7c745f6a597f5e2b7b5bd5.en: A clothes swap at Bibliothek Tiergarten-Süd with the AnziehBar project, under the motto swap instead of buy. Up to three items can be swapped for three new ones. Unclaimed clothes go to people in need.

f2ca33b79ac6c68138b68cbbf524a37089aecc59.en: Sewing workshops in the autumn holidays at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek for children aged 8 to 12, making small projects such as lavender bags, pouches and cushions. Children from age 6 can join with an adult. Registration required, maximum 7 participants.

01c700153a4929885ded60f1f9fb56000a1cfe3b.en: Weekly Digital-Zebra advice at Stadtteilbibliothek Buch on Mondays 13:00-16:30 and Tuesdays 10:00-12:00 and 13:00-15:30, for ringtones, online doctor bookings and email addresses. iPads and printers are available.

b3a39e4919c8a5b206634263934ce5003076462c.en: DigiQuest, a library quiz rally with the Actionbound app for ages 8 and up at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek. Players answer tricky questions on iPads, search the library for clues and photograph a drawing.

01de044eb2d98362fc78d142f96428d7c4ac704a.en: A women's language café at Stadtteilbibliothek Buch every Tuesday from 13:00 to 15:00, with biscuits and coffee. Participants practise German through games and conversation. Run with Mamis en Movimiento e.V.

9f5e5616610e859f8d30ee2bb349e3621bda87f9.en: Chess at Stadtteilzentrum Pestalozzi-Treff every Monday from 13:00 to 17:00 for chess fans. Registration by phone is requested.

18e8d3de42afd4116becda5c8758e97f8912a051.en: The TOMMI Games Award 2026 seeks children aged 8 to 16 for its youth jury, to test nominated games in the autumn holidays at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda. Free entry, applications via the form on the library's website.

af64c7af6b54e32b577ad8ec18e799c3693bfb42.en: A sewing meetup at Bibliothek Kaulsdorf every Monday from 14:00 to 17:00, with three machines and an upcycling project using foil scraps from book covers, guided by a retired seamstress and a milliner. Open to beginners and experts.

00c656abe14e1fc48e378a5b05aaaf197bbccfdc.en: Free walk-in career advice from FVAJ e.V. at Schiller-Bibliothek on apprenticeship and internship searches and application documents. No appointment needed.

2194884272848ad3f0d9059f4a6d43576f886536.en: A robotics workshop at Schiller-Bibliothek for ages 10 and up. Participants take apart and rebuild an mBot, then learn visual coding to steer it and create a robot game. Group 1 meets on 19-20 October, group 2 on 26-27 October.

5f18b75cff3b8cc549a531a279f552be27d6d380.en: A spooky guided tour of the Berlin Zoo on the strange myths and stories of animals. Tickets are online only and strictly limited, and children in Halloween costumes pay half price.

b67f8b23519316b44011426f8038bcc5136382a6.en: Free tenancy advice at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek on tenants' rights, rent rises, defects, modernisation notices, the rent brake and housing benefit. Run by asum GmbH for the Lichtenberg district office.

b7ad402306ff36154a646901eee71b0fd2dfba33.en: A LEGO afternoon at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek as part of the Azubi Weeks, with LEGO-covered tables and LEGO robots to try. Visitors build alone or together.

b5e748a1bb68ba7e34bf652d08aa74941042ef2d.en: Berlin–Paris, a musical time journey by saxophonist Detlef Bensmann and Consortium Artis, with melodies from Peter and the Wolf, The Carnival of the Animals and Hansel and Gretel, plus 1930s music. Children paint during the show. Entry 10 euros.

76edb2599e4a4f4140b6711439ddb6395260b3ce.en: Mama singt schon wieder, a musical theatre evening at Schwartzsche Villa by singer Katharina Löwe on balancing art and motherhood, mixing opera, operetta and chanson. Entry 22 euros, 18 reduced.

923d0c5583914d89c132a6ea62d50d36c73a9d02.en: A German course for parents whose first language is not German, at level A2.2, at Eberhard-Alexander-Burgh-Bibliothek. Run by VHS Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf, it meets on Mondays and Tuesdays from 9:00 to 13:00. Registration via VHS advice.

69360c21de03ac1231f2bb8c227216702b747f8e.en: A free smartphone course for women at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek on Mondays, 26 October to 14 December 2026, 11:30-14:30, run by FrauenComputerZentrum Berlin. It covers apps, email, online payments and AI tools. Registration required.

d5d2e23b9c805f4e82b69c53142e1d0a0c58ba11.en: A tablet course for seniors at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek with AWO Seniorennetz Berlin: six Monday sessions from 26 October to 30 November 2026, 13:00-14:30, covering basics, email, online shopping and data protection.

48c63b136b1ddeed19ad2cfad1364b327d3a76b0.en: A wand-making workshop at Margarete-Kubicka-Bibliothek on Monday 26 October 2026, 15:00-18:00, for children aged 5 and up. Each child makes a wand to take home. Free, no registration.

8988b22f3d8523ff7dd8a01680d5bf1f238f2faa.en: An info stand at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof on a Berlin pilot project that advises the people who support young people moving into training.

e526a315208fc8250916fdccb4737534a9632f92.en: Career guidance at Schiller-Bibliothek from Janna Behringer of FVAJ e.V., for people unsure about training, struggling to find an internship or needing help with application documents. Walk-in in the makerspace on Mondays and Wednesdays.

cc5ac810636f6fb187de68493d9cb51255b41ae4.en: A creative afternoon at Bruno-Lösche-Bibliothek on the fourth Monday of each month, 15:30-17:00, with painting, crafts and more for children and families aged 3 and up. Open, no registration.

ad48c440ec6c6cbc54dc5e3bc06f6137b6ee302d.en: A tabletop gaming session at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Bibliothek, where beginners learn the basics and paint their own figures step by step. Materials are provided. Free, no registration.

8b91e650889e9597570a9215fb13b95606761286.en: A ceramics and sculpture workshop for families with children aged 6 to 11 at Stadtteilzentrum Kaulsdorf, Mondays 16:00-18:00 from 5 October to 30 November 2026. Nine sessions, registration required, with a small material fee.

78dd8d8d617527084f7f8cdb2371ac70e092dc80.en: A digital help and games session for people aged 55 and over at Bibliothek am Luisenbad. Questions on smartphones, tablets, computers and the internet are answered, followed by group games. Free, no registration.

570a6db31345f99e8dc60f356f88733efee9eb08.en: A read-aloud session with volunteer readers at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek every Monday from 16:00 to 17:00 for young listeners. Free, and parents and grandparents are welcome.

6d99bcc23a73abc068cd2614b1af7033ef90c1c4.en: A children's games afternoon at Bibliothek am Wasserturm on Mondays from 16:00 to 17:30, for children aged 6 and up with an adult. Short board and card games, no experience needed and no registration at first.

17b137861d5331da4a7d1614992bedfed48eaa0c.en: A spooky craft session in the autumn holidays at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek for children aged 4 and up, making eerie art from paper and paint, followed by a story reading of a spooky tale.

4d054ac11a44a4d6f4ae23b5d16f039b922d1499.en: Energy advice from Verbraucherzentrale Berlin at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek for tenants, homeowners and builders. Advice is mostly by phone or online, and an adviser analyses the situation. Bring energy bills and heating reports. Free entry.

93d2d8b45e7072baeaf7b16b9e78905330207b5e.en: A weekly read-aloud session with Lesewelt e.V. at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek every Monday for children aged 4 to 12, to encourage reading and language skills. Free, no registration.

dcc13208cb584f8fbc3d4bf2712d248677f22fe4.en: Wortlaut LernBike, a German play session at Schiller-Bibliothek on Mondays from 16:00 to 18:00 for children aged 6 to 14, with crafts, language games and themed sessions through spring. Free.

a48c63c48bf851dfd6a71cc82c5a83e3a7f4a6be.en: Coding & Co. at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek, a workshop for children on the second and fourth Mondays of the month, 16:00-17:00, with robots such as Blue-Bots, Bee-Bots and Ozobots, plus Scratch and Edurino. Registration by phone or email.

6be71d24ed6c812461a2227f30d95bb2c5750acf.en: Play at Bibliothek am Luisenbad: in summer, games on the square every week, and in winter or bad weather, LEGO and robots indoors. Come and play.

dc4c4976d01466b276a613b0779e10af6a842f34.en: Mein Smartphone, Meine Regeln, a hands-on workshop with the Institut für digitale Selbstverteidigung at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek. Participants check security and privacy settings and try alternatives to data-hungry apps. Free, registration required.

ee72baa0bc69acdba609f1bd74af813e9c0f8131.en: A Lesewelt read-aloud hour at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek on Mondays for children aged 4 to 12. It supports reading and language skills. Free, no registration.

097822b86cc8c75579cf52088ba83cc3068127c9.en: A trading card game event at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, where collectors can swap cards, play against each other and meet other fans.

4159fac1de0948f9afdac7f0fd713678560ebd20.en: Thrifty household tips at Stadtteilzentrum Kaulsdorf on cooking sustainably with fresh food, using leftovers and saving money, with budget planning and recipe ideas. Free, registration required.

9f97970e7e21ddd701758dea7bd23ea10b5242cd.en: A read-aloud session at Bibliothek im Märkischen Viertel for children aged 4 to 8, with stories read aloud for young listeners.

847e1e067068eaebbd4fdae7d43627e20657f50f.en: A read-aloud session at Bibliothek am Schäfersee for children aged 4 to 12, not held during school holidays.

bc978146c07fe1536e9e4830624155682de6da67.en: A fairy tale hour with volunteer storyteller Michaela at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek on the last Monday of each month at 16:30. Costumes and lively delivery bring Grimm and Transylvanian tales to life.

b9537aea63eed861e0a6764e5104d1ca7adead28.en: A short story time of about 30 minutes for the youngest children from age 3, with an adult, at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek. Free, no registration.

03c5dd963586a7377b6aa6f82489a50aeb1b3455.en: A picture book cinema or kamishibai for children aged 4 and up at Bettina-von-Arnim-Bibliothek every Tuesday and Friday at 16:30, lasting about 20 minutes.

cb3cdc232dbb42ab6120a4d978745c013ea16370.en: Kamishibai and read-aloud sessions for the youngest at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek: kamishibai on the first and third Monday of the month, and reading on Tuesdays at 15:00, outside school holidays.

96f8d2c18141ad494c39366b7d86189f4fb07946.en: Kamishibai, a Japanese paper theatre, at Stadtteilbibliothek Lankwitz, with picture book classics and newer books that delight young and old.

d370c784b3c79722a3257ba2bdd6557a0ad8fc0b.en: Lesemontag at Erich-Weinert-Bibliothek, where the team picks one book each week and reads it aloud every Monday at 16:30. No registration needed.

d794e68e77e8d5969ba8cdee3b02ef6936d77628.en: A knitting and crochet meetup at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek, run by library staff who are beginners themselves, open to all experience levels. Bring your own materials; the library has project ideas.

4d9857c3a352d5d637bc1167ec67ebdfc3b79a34.en: LEGO Build the Change at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek: a picture book cinema on sustainability, environment and animal protection, then children build their own LEGO solutions to problems from the story.

7968659cce36d815e2d7e0b6b4e6d31e12fe2c0a.en: Volunteer readers read aloud and tell stories for children up to age 12 at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek, to spark a love of reading. Parents are warmly invited.

7f98190a6e6537464db498e4d9ce67aa485ae0a4.en: Support for teenagers in welcome classes or with a refugee background who need help learning German, at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek.

2e09d3da9fc4e2b8c2f3b56ddcf1247c2db43b1d.en: A monthly toy swap at Bettina-von-Arnim-Bibliothek for children and families. Bring good, complete toys to swap for new ones. Toys that find no new owner go home again. Free, no registration.

e5140996b598f3f3189b05d0e91d7099b0ae8a49.en: The KlimaWerkstatt Spandau Repair Café at Paul-Schneider-Haus, on the last Monday of each month from 17:30 to 20:00. Volunteers help fix toasters, vacuum cleaners and toys. Phone registration in advance is required.

4d58128ca5bbbd3cf2c7e4efb2cd50fc59dc09b9.en: Fit mit Grit, a fitness class at the STZ that mixes flowing movements, strength exercises, coordination tasks and relaxing music.

05918e4a979787097b022acc7734f56a278322f1.en: Badminton for adults who enjoy movement, at Turnhalle Annenstraße. Trial sessions are possible, and during school holidays times are arranged in advance.

9cb8544b373190bed480ebe48e4f037865094ec1.en: Recreational volleyball for adults at Grundschule an der Mühle. Trial sessions are possible, and during school holidays times are arranged in advance.

1f66427038feae6dbf829d7c3a073abad7ec977c.en: A reading by Lea Streisand from Berlinerisch – Watt denn, icke?, a cultural history of Berlin dialect that is funny and clever for locals and newcomers alike, at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek.

99b7951ab617014736e6f4571afd3cf9f9199615.en: A screening of The Librarians at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof, a documentary about librarians, parents and others resisting book censorship in the United States despite threats. Registration required.

cf7b095e8ef5eb6162fffc82e584befd78090e59.en: Hyd's Infinity Tour, presented by Live Nation. Wheelchair users and people with severe disabilities pay the regular ticket price, and their companions are admitted free without a ticket.

79af085c1fdaef8d1f8c6e11e1a1062d5c1c8ac9.en: ScienceLab's workshop The secret colours of leaves at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof on 26 October 2026, 15:00-17:00, for ages 6 to 9. Children test leaves and see how plant colours react. Registration required, 2 euros material fee.

91994c1d09566724a06755c093f629dc4bf41e07.en: Digital office hours at Kommunale Begegnungsstätte Am Tierpark, where trained young people answer questions on smartphones, tablets and internet apps. Drop in for help, run with Sonay e.V.

fb3a16dbd1b18ffe1139b9781f2f0baa9497efdd.en: Ariadnefaden, an open creative meetup for thread and yarn lovers at Bibliothek am Wasserturm every Tuesday from 20 January. Embroidery, knitting and macramé. Bring your own thread. Free, no registration.

9e1d3c396339e9492ede50ff3b80d34702cb35db.en: A Halloween keychain workshop at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel for ages 10 and up, teaching 3D modelling basics before printing your own keychain. Registration required.

80e8d8c8a40ebbe95f0769e10efe6bb0f1ad91dd.en: A holiday film workshop at Theodor-Heuss-Bibliothek for ages 8 to 12, where children make three silent animated films about fruit and vegetables in a supermarket, to be premiered with live music. Workshop 27-30 October; screening 31 October at 13:00.

321736221c0dc68c22e769fd1523b76d85961669.en: Light experiments with Thorsten Winkel at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek for children aged 6 to 12, exploring light and shadow, with colourful effects and glowing phenomena. Free, places are limited and registration is required.

b571f0b96ea2533ec2c7e2efe52273af0df53c13.en: Rent advice at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek from rental law specialists, covering modernisation notices, service charge statements, rent increases, defects and conversions to owned flats. Free entry, registration required by phone.

bc564847a179f53cde09961959d8fcd61a38eb2b.en: Programming with LEGO Spike in the autumn holidays at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek. Children build fantasy models and program them with an app, for ages 8 and up.

c78f4414a0229eb72f94e3ef804e9cf573c8c153.en: A comic puzzle reading with Steffen Gumpert, Licht ins Dunkel, at Bibliothek im Märkischen Viertel. In this mystery, a boy who can see ghosts searches for his missing father. Visitors can collect stamps for the summer challenge.

3bdb61ec71fc51e27fc0acb50b1d439f6550289d.en: The Mobile Bildungsberatung at Stadtbibliothek Spandau offers free, anonymous help with forms for nursery, pensions or Bürgergeld, job applications and learning to read and write. Last Tuesday of the month, 10:00-12:00.

d8f394b7de4a7ee6f3c9b24834f98f3454c0f51e.en: A job café at Gemeinschaftshaus Gropiusstadt on Tuesdays from 10:30 to 12:00, with career advice from Ute Großmann of Kiezakademie Neukölln on work, further training and job search. Free, registration by phone.

4fbd607f9c8316eb9e4a0bc61b2434bb4d7f8e5b.en: Table tennis at Stadtteilzentrum Pestalozzi-Treff, open to all participants and all age groups.

46126b4411fb5d47d22c4600a45b89c077f8367c.en: Healing singing at Hansabibliothek with Nicole Rubinstein-Gross, a psychotherapist. The group learns easy songs, from lively to meditative, and chants from around the world. No singing experience needed; registration required.

6f7752dae45b8883e3c9d3725ecffd271fd99090.en: An open volunteering office hour at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek on Tuesdays from 13:00 to 18:00, for questions about volunteering at the library. It is part of the FEIN pilot project, and no registration is needed for the open hour.

a71431252e3f1a829cfb046b6e8b07eec2d74235.en: An open knitting and crochet group at Bodo-Uhse-Bibliothek for people who want to learn, need advice on current projects or need help repairing knitwear. Free; bring your own yarn and needles.

af9dff4f6d6d0016408e7add17f0c31bd2f17bb2.en: A craft afternoon at the SOS-Familienzentrum Hellersdorf on 27 October 2026 from 14:00, where older women from the AWO Stadtteiltreff craft together with preschool children during the holidays.

09038b90b621751f4884ff8c2f38154ebf83821b.en: Glass graffiti in the youth area of Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof, where visitors decorate the windows with chalk pens. Free, no registration, for ages 12 and up. Friends are welcome.

46cb1a76476b4e141d34e02b45d5634cf8fec165.en: Gruselwusel-Flunkerspuk, a storytelling workshop at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek for ages 7 to 12. With author Anja Frisch, children invent and illustrate their own spooky stories, starting by making their own book. Free, registration required.

38bfa19fb2cb1385415a6e7d43a7cf74a7504706.en: The Button DIY Q*lub at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, where people aged 12 and up design buttons to wear and take home, and talk about diversity. Free entry, no advance registration.

0f844b6ecd5aa17db07b2312bdbd7eb97a9187a0.en: An information event at the Judith-Auer-Straße community centre by the DRK on the home emergency alarm service, which supports a safe and independent life at home. Free entry with coffee; phone booking requested.

3dd274514a2814e99bcf1bac6ca0bef8e5ab5925.en: A Halloween bookmark craft at Ingeborg-Bachmann-Bibliothek. Children make monster bookmarks from coloured paper, googly eyes and teeth. Free, no registration, and materials are provided.

427941bc44ea9403f56098ccd4d216e8c2113cfe.en: A Gruselwoche session at Adolf-Reichwein-Bibliothek on 27 October 2026, 14:30-15:30, where children make slime and learn about its surprising properties. Free, registration required.

d632a717bc81e36c1a40ffffa010fa92491c0459.en: A games afternoon at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek for board and card game fans, alone, with friends or with family. Sessions on 19 May and 16 June cover card games such as Rommé and Skip-Bo, and active games such as Activity and Tabu. No registration.

f38bc1d399483c42db39d91f79c0e32678cb136c.en: A German conversation café at Stadtteilbibliothek Karow every Tuesday from 15:00 to 17:00, for relaxed chats in German about different topics. Open to anyone, whatever their origin or first language.

5263ec8afb9f80f3887b11d80bfe60294ea4a4af.en: Gemeinsam Häkeln at Bibliothek Tiergarten-Süd every two weeks, for people of all ages and skill levels. Bring your own projects or start with scrunchies or wind chimes. Free, no registration, ages 8 and up.

ad16fb5aeea917e0396616c04deebe5357c6034c.en: Alf Weiss Wunschkonzert at Maria-Rimkus-Haus, where the singer presents well-loved songs with his distinctive voice. Doors at 14:00, start at 15:00, entry 4 euros plus 3 euros for coffee.

24b87944cbb4bbdf11332c3e1bba6c83553d32d2.en: A neighbourhood and nature walk from the Warnitzer Borgen community centre, followed by a coffee round. Details are available from the centre.

a006452989971082dbd2df0e73ea82254f20521b.en: The Geschichten-Kiste at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek opens every Tuesday at 15:00. Children sit down, listen to stories and look at the illustrations. No registration needed.

7532e6f4ca41bbf34f14584bf20aac43a86fd257.en: Free job advice from Kiezakademie Neukölln at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek on Tuesdays from 16:00 to 17:00, for people over 18 living in Neukölln. Help covers career orientation, applications, recognition of foreign qualifications and training. Book in advance.

dfc59a6c6f65c6fe4045c697dfdd74bf20b49931.en: A holiday upcycling workshop at Bibliothek im Märkischen Viertel, where children design funny keyrings from old bicycle inner tubes.

11bc6a97edb25cbd3cbe14b2402b44d1500b9aa6.en: Astro Bot, a virtual reality game to try at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek for ages 12 and up. Players collect the lost parts of a spaceship and repair the mother ship. Play is limited to 15 minutes per person, no registration.

297481bc96b0e3b260a4dc27650dffe108b0c671.en: A parents' surgery on phones, social media and more at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, run by the Steglitz-Zehlendorf media competence centre. Questions about media use are answered. No registration; contact by phone.

e93fbf4b2173af8ff1c552577c6533a706b37a5e.en: A German Sign Language workshop at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek on 27 October. Children and teenagers attend 10:00-16:45 and adults 17:00-17:45. Participants learn basic DGS signs and try them in everyday situations. Free, registration required.

1f8128d9684ab87756d1d6536159c4dd1be8b58f.en: Landscape pictures from wood scraps and moss at Schiller-Bibliothek, with materials supplied by FVAJ e.V. Bring your own frame up to 40 by 30 centimetres. Free for all ages.

337bcb4c64502c7e90dc0a1f8b697d844facea5e.en: Bruno, a literary club for seniors at Bruno-Lösche-Bibliothek, which discusses Martin Suter's Allmen und Herr Weynfeldt. Registration by phone or email.

7515696b76f0f272b4782be12674cd463d597367.en: The LernBike Wortlaut, a language play session at Bibliothek am Luisenbad on Mondays from 16:00 to 18:00 for children aged 6 to 14. It is outdoors in good weather and in the Puttensaal in winter. Free, no registration.

a5969a239af51e5b073db2fd995044fa03610437.en: A book repair workshop at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, where a bookbinder teaches small repairs for loose spines, torn pages and wobbly text blocks. Bring a favourite book; materials are provided. Free, no registration.

dcc6fe68ff16489b5b576398cf8f237a70d088dd.en: A weekly read-aloud session at Adolf-Reichwein-Bibliothek on Tuesdays from 16:00 to 17:00 for children aged 4 to 12, with experienced volunteer readers from Lesewelt Berlin.

3872a3fa5fd6d1300736a8039fa40a2651848123.en: A reading afternoon at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek on Tuesdays at 17:00 for children from age 3, with stories in the library. No registration needed.

fe40db873eb05f5f56fcba72d0ddc23750510143.en: A family craft workshop at Familienzentrum Zukunftshaus Wedding on Tuesdays, where families craft, paint, pot and make things together. Families may bring fruit or vegetables to share.

d3e8d7f4a6f66430d6642b069866296497b43d7f.en: An open digital clinic at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel for people aged 60 and over with questions about smartphones or tablets. Android devices only. Free, no prior registration.

3e747958fdd48f8278e922cf551e87ce36172b02.en: Switch gaming in the children's library at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel every Tuesday from 16:00 to 17:30. Games without age limits, played together.

59df3ca29108102088d661de375ee35ad98589f0.en: Tenancy advice from the Berliner MieterGemeinschaft e.V. at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek, given by lawyers who specialise in tenancy law. No registration needed.

fc8adda7d7fdb7bcc923def622750006531bf2ec.en: Lesewelt Berlin volunteers read aloud to children up to age 12 at the Hansabibliothek, helping them discover books and the joy of reading. Dates follow the school term; parents are welcome.

e0f10cba0772165401a848c446544e12d0e176a5.en: A free guitar meetup at Stadtteilzentrum Kaulsdorf every Tuesday from 16:00 to 18:00 for advanced players, led by volunteer Harald Kliem in a small group. Bring your own guitar.

403a578d1ba1266ed94df2cba29b7c13775f2128.en: A games afternoon for fathers, children and other family members at Stadtteilzentrum Kaulsdorf. Children play in a safe space and make friends, while adults share tips and relax together.

6ad2ebc1e1ae8cc6b4ffe5de635290c3eeca87e3.en: A robotics afternoon at Bibliothek am Schäfersee introduces the basics of programming with the Cubetto robot, for ages 5 and up.

dfc9c7c83aa908c7f20d200e30d2452023406e60.en: A Lesewelt Berlin read-aloud hour at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek for children aged 4 and up, with exciting and funny books. Free entry, no advance registration.

55c84355ce1cbf5ba50047c4816dc5411fb4f2ac.en: Lesewelt Berlin volunteers read aloud at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek for children up to age 12, helping them discover books and the joy of reading. Dates follow the school term; parents are welcome.

3fa70640d47dcfb5c36cc82bfd7f1b2fa2db6773.en: A storytelling time at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek, with stories that make children laugh, wonder or hold their breath, followed by painting or crafts to match. Free entry, no advance registration.

bddd96d0fa7cc19429c0b7fcf1564f042eebbcb2.en: A weekly read-aloud hour with Lesewelt Berlin at Eberhard-Alexander-Burgh-Bibliothek, every Tuesday from 16:30 to 17:30, for children aged 4 to 12.

4c73e185eb4099ab53b8c56435448d0bb704fe44.en: An online reading and talk with Kay Matter from Muskeln aus Plastik, about life with long Covid, a chronic illness and gender identity. Held on Zoom on 27 October 2026, 17:00-18:00. Registration required.

f9b44ceb25d9e70328fc550d72085764e45f54c6.en: An adult games afternoon at Janusz-Korczak-Bibliothek every Tuesday in the event room. Free, and no registration is needed.

47da8b79155581cbc6d469484a383e83f9d1b3a0.en: The Silent Book Club at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek. Participants bring or borrow a book and read quietly together, with an optional chat at the end. It takes place on the fourth Tuesday of each month, for all ages.

40d93bed173c3d141d8d313d95de1b61fcbee019.en: A crafting session at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek on making art from old books, such as origami, window pictures and table decorations. Book pages are supplied; bring scissors and glue. Free entry.

c8a8d60ff54eea3a84f861d188eccf71846ec607.en: A free concert by Andrea Môıra, an independent singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist from Italy who now lives in Berlin, at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek. His music blends jazz, blues, folk and acoustic sounds in English and Italian.

75cb15584bc5326a65f2a5a626644b4701504834.en: An open embroidery café at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek in the makerspace, where people learn hand embroidery to redesign old T-shirts and bags. Suitable for beginners and experienced stitchers. Free, no registration.

e5a92d8ce29e9bbdfb5732f83d24accb12c1e11b.en: A German conversation café at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek for learners at levels A1 to B2, practising vocabulary and pronunciation and meeting others. Free, open, with media recommendations from library staff.

cd850725b24aa5d225fc1593bdc89da8527eb34b.en: A yoga course at Stadtteilzentrum MOSAIK to help people find inner balance and regain energy. Registration by phone, by email or in person at the MOSAIK office.

fbf909312b2adcab4d07c80f397f1e6245741437.en: Country line dancing for advanced dancers at Stadtteilzentrum Pestalozzi-Treff, in small groups on Tuesdays and Wednesdays from 18:00 to 20:00. Registration with the course leader by phone is requested.

52ba9c427a2cabf3f8db5fb7b252716ad7773efd.en: Shared Reading at Hansabibliothek, where a trained reading leader reads literature aloud and invites conversation. No prior knowledge needed. Free, no registration, and it is neither therapy nor a book club.

88d177bd6282fa1408c1c38f442d85fc2ddbfba2.en: A monthly games evening at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg from 29 September 2026, on the last Tuesday of each month. Each month features one game to try, starting with Die Quacksalber von Quedlinburg. Free, no registration.

eadb0a42ada7f9dd832760a8ce66cac522f51f9e.en: An Azubi Weeks escape game at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek. Why does the special edition of a bestseller vanish the day before the exhibition? Players must find the culprit and the book before it is destroyed. Registration required.

e1d459fbb8186dcd33d8dcee84a6cba1c53b9b38.en: LeseLust, a monthly reading circle at Stadtteilbibliothek Marienfelde, reading Isabel Allende's novel Mein Name ist Emilia del Valle this time. Free, no registration.

877aa7945b3c6306ae5d9ee9463e80c79cdbe379.en: A reading and talk with philosopher Eva Weber-Guskar on Gefühle der Zukunft, which asks how emotional AI and machines that simulate feelings may change our lives. Held at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel.

1477a16740dff2b16b5cada733e32da503856409.en: Dialog in Deutsch at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek, an open conversation in German about any topic of interest. The format has run in Hamburg's libraries since 2010. Registration required by phone.

bfe1276aae2bc3fbfc9ce9d190dfd2e9d392abf6.en: A comic reading and book launch by Hamed Eshrat for Alman, an autobiographical comic about a German with migration experience. It explores home, racism and belonging with humour. 27 October 2026 at 20:00, moderated by Stephan Pless.

e42a002c6bc133dd486ca64e377550867dcca006.en: TYLA's A*POP World Tour at Uber Eats Music Hall with Gallery Seat & Drink tickets. They add drinks at the Gallery Bar and Lounge Foyer from entry until 30 minutes after the show. eTickets are sent 3 to 5 days before.

2ba63f5408cc00e5d593dbd07a31992999593721.en: Slayyyter's WOR$T GIRL IN THE WORLD tour, presented by Goodlive Artists, with support from Kalika. The venue is not listed.
