0baf58e3ec51162134708007bb96bf4b22ebb356.en: The Circular Week 2026 online conference on how cities can drive the circular economy in Europe, with sessions in German and English. Five tracks cover resilience, repair, citizen engagement and future skills. Registration via Zoom.

be9d3abf66b009e7e7a33be23fd21ea507f9a792.en: The Soziales Schreibbüro at Stadtteilbibliothek Erich Weinert offers free help with forms, applications and finding advice services, in eight languages. Wednesdays 9:00-13:00, no registration needed.

9974276ea3fbe771942036f3587afcde7a3a983b.en: A mobile citizens' office at the Gesundheits- und Beratungszentrum Koppenstraße on the fourth Wednesday of each month, 9:00-13:00. ID cards and residence permit transfers need no appointment. Card payment only; passport photos cost 6 euros.

d174b66a071b16159ba7d195726bde5f44077d53.en: A baby and toddler group run by the mobile family centre Karow at Stadtteilbibliothek Karow.

6d600443447abffb85c4c31d363d21c5ab6ac632.en: A Gruselwoche music workshop at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek. Children aged 8 to 15 compose spooky music with producer DRFTR in the m3 music makerspace on 28-30 October 2026, 10:00-13:00. Bring your own USB stick; places are limited.

2d743811bea21bd3d10aa9e5474e62d8b9c7b518.en: English conversation at Stadtteilzentrum Pestalozzi-Treff for intermediate learners every Wednesday from 10:00 to 12:00. Registration by phone is required.

2f7a97f1187547ea2560044c718e36d88d616693.en: Die Flanierfreunde, a slow walking group in Kaulsdorf every Wednesday from 10:00 to 11:00, for older people, people with disabilities and anyone who prefers a gentle stroll and conversation. Walking aids are welcome.

4132cabbb508ed71d0a0a529c4091295700bc167.en: An adult dance course at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof for building coordination, rhythm and flexibility, with or without dance experience. Places are limited, and registration is free by email, by phone or at the desk.

191106a5079b869be9f30fb4541f60c8af222577.en: Animation workshops during the holidays at Bibliothek im Märkischen Viertel with Trickmisch, for ages 6 to 12. Children make drawn, silhouette and stop-motion films, shown on 29 October at 18:00. Registration required.

d82ff7fcfb5661e91f007d0f72569d5790a71aae.en: Too Much Data Spoils the Bot, an AI workshop at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda on 28 October 2026. For ages 6 and up, it shows where AI hides in everyday life and helps participants set their own rules. Free, registration required.

c033086117beff61e8d679eed3423e4fd2db6a34.en: LevelUp, a gaming workshop at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek for ages 12 and up. Pairs play the co-operative game It Takes Two, about a couple turned into dolls. Registration required.

1b0f2055483e82a6d9402d306b8164f36a9eb3ec.en: A slow walking group in Kaulsdorf with volunteer escorts, covering 30 to 60 minutes around the neighbourhood centre. It suits people who find walking hard or use a rollator, and focuses on fresh air and conversation.

12c32a0c3122481bf8b1069cafa07b9b5e29af8f.en: A year-round ceramics course at Stadtteilzentrum Kaulsdorf on Wednesdays from 10:00 to 11:30, offered in three-month blocks at 10 euros a month. Registration required; the centre gives current dates.

532066c3698035001c53d1fdc6b96737da16fdd9.en: A silent reading party at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek to build up to the book club event on 19 November. Bring cushions, blankets, snacks and a favourite book. Author Fikri Anıl Altıntaş visits on 19 November. No registration.

20f74c27cb40b41ca62dfd7d315a5a43a1b2e3c9.en: A jewellery workshop at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek, run with NochMall, where participants turn old crystal chandeliers into necklaces, earrings or pendants. Suitable for beginners too. Places are limited; free tickets via Pretix.

1f218618788bcafcf68a75ac8c1ae49f4e992147.en: Digital-Zebra at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek offers public digital advice on smartphone and internet problems, online bookings, e-prescriptions, PDFs and ringtones during service hours.

c60e952e1e95bb2fe7555fa4159b7b060514f464.en: A Nintendo Switch games afternoon at Stadtteilbibliothek Buch every Wednesday from 13:00 to 17:00, with old and new games such as Mario Kart, for children aged 8 and up.

5e78f295df41bd59492346935bd8b7deb218f618.en: A moderated German conversation session at Schiller-Bibliothek every Wednesday from 13:00 to 15:00, run by Volkshochschule Berlin Mitte, with tea, coffee and cake. Free, no registration.

74a458ac6f4efe3a4c42254fe38396a536af22fb.en: A VR workshop at Gertrud-Junge-Bibliothek for teenagers aged 10 to 14, trying VR headsets and exploring virtual spaces every Wednesday from 13:30 to 15:30. Free.

7b5982e09220a85ee3b2610f3cee66861d33efba.en: The senior group Fröhlicher Herbst at Stadtteilzentrum Pestalozzi-Treff is looking for new members. It meets on Wednesdays from 14:00 to 18:00 with coffee, cake and varied programmes such as readings, talks, music and bingo.

ae2c3e9f83b1ec9c504c3128b22a0de1c50c8c5d.en: A dance afternoon, Wir schwofen, at the Karlshorst community centre with Olli. It costs 6.50 euros including a coffee set. The date is provisional.

633e16b486e38c8502e8a19450415d9012222175.en: A holiday LEGO Build the Change programme at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel on 21 and 28 October 2026, 14:00-16:00, for ages 8 and up. Children invent ideas for the future, such as recycling machines and climate-friendly energy. No registration.

8aa57da80f820824aaddccc04875b1c0a6f90b55.en: An open games afternoon of Werwölfe von Düsterwald at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Bibliothek on 28 October 2026, 14:00-18:00, as part of the Gruselwoche. Free, with no age limit for those brave enough to face werewolves and witches.

7dd1c11a7fdf1590490bff3e9e4eb043019e628b.en: The Lankwitzer Wollrunde at Stadtteilbibliothek Lankwitz is a monthly knitting circle whose finished pieces are donated to people and organisations in need. Materials are provided. Free, no registration.

5231d6d5e2c28b6f5d9166b262d5b23d913fe593.en: A holiday workshop at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg with Science Lab, where children aged 6 to 9 build LEGO WeDo 2.0 models, including a robot called Milo, in pairs and program them. 2 euros, registration required.

c3aa70430e066b0fa758dae307cb9fc5acce912e.en: Blue-Bot and the Magic Book at Ingeborg-Bachmann-Bibliothek, a Halloween coding game in which children guide the robot through a spooky course to help a witch find her lost spellbook. Free, no registration.

e6e4ebda4efdc0a05907ba6b92b475e5e0c692db.en: Auf einen Tee mit Till, a new adult book club at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg from October 2026. Every Wednesday at 15:00 in the makerspace, Till Waltz presents books by known and lesser-known authors over tea or coffee. Free and accessible.

b7a754f56139443cb6921db71471e467571338e3.en: A bingo afternoon at Hans-Söhnker-Haus, with doors at 14:00 and the game starting at 15:00. Entry is free; a coffee set costs 3 euros, and drinks are paid separately.

80aa522103c7e8d23bc7c91b276ce359db0fff56.en: Free tenancy advice from asum GmbH at Bodo-Uhse-Bibliothek, on behalf of the Lichtenberg district office. No appointment needed.

e6b34cea8782e2f651fea9271463e550c82b1099.en: A book breakfast at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof, where people share favourite books and reading tips over breakfast and may find their next favourite read. Registration by phone or at the desk.

765238da80c0752c77cf76852ec253227853c6d8.en: A Gruselwerkstatt creative writing session at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda on 28 October 2026, 15:00-18:00. Children aged 8 and up use story cubes to invent and write their own spooky stories. Free, registration required.

23f0ad0c3bf4f4f808b7c2bdac03981940fd23f8.en: An open drawing hour at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Bibliothek, with colouring sheets, freestyle drawing and a monthly drawing contest. Free, no registration.

0bda6ba464003cea049a72d31aae4ab922dfb75e.en: A podcasting studio at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek with professional microphones, headphones and video kits. Users need a library card and a one-time introduction, offered on Wednesdays from 17:00. Under-16s need an adult who has also attended.

912a1bab6f9734c7a6b4fde60b0b310e8e33b266.en: A Gruselwoche escape rally at Stadtteilbibliothek Halemweg, where players solve puzzles and follow clues in the dark library to find a way out.

c0edf9bbcf4e483cec4db35debbef9215f7e1fa8.en: After School Gaming at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek for teenagers aged 12 and up, on Wednesdays from 15:00 to 18:00 in the new gaming area. Each team plays for up to 30 minutes. Free, no registration, and student or library cards are needed.

21f6d8bab1cc566916e9c589c7c5b5612f00b606.en: A drop-in clinic at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek on VÖBB digital services, such as e-book loans and music streaming, held on odd-numbered weeks on Wednesdays from 15:15 to 17:15. Bring your own device. Free, no advance registration.

5126ea9b3837d329ca5832cf830c2e0e599d5e0c.en: Mal Mal Mit(twoch), a mini painting studio with illustrator Kristina Heldmann in the foyer of Bibliothek am Luisenbad every Wednesday from 15:30 to 17:30. No registration needed.

dbc0f3237901c361c603d8f4d7c0c12180778613.en: A craft and story afternoon at Bibliothek am Schäfersee with the Deutsch-Polnisches Hilfswerk for families with children aged 5 and up. Stories are read in alternating languages and craft materials are provided. Free, with a holiday special on 5 February.

b47f5e2f261e030b61f198d682e8aa2c1fa77d2f.en: A LEGO afternoon at Janusz-Korczak-Bibliothek for children aged 4 and up, with creations displayed in the library afterwards. Free, no registration.

127439de9298bd37afc7bb6e72c817d9356c6c11.en: A talk at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek by Petra Wolff of VdK Berlin-Brandenburg on disability law. It covers what counts as a disability, how to get a severely disabled person's ID and the rights that come with it, followed by questions. Free, no registration.

bb826fa7c317be41ef09e951c0555a4926b9f9a9.en: A digital drop-in hour at Bruno-Lösche-Bibliothek for questions about e-books, digital services, the library catalogue and Tolino e-readers. No registration needed.

3157bacc5f4573eea70daf49896fa54874d1c5ce.en: A Sashiko and Boro workshop at Schiller-Bibliothek on Japanese stitching for mending and reinforcing textiles, with simple stitches and new patterns. Bring your own clothes or fabric; felt is provided for children.

645e0938fb92bcd982007e1b63b8fbc7361be0b9.en: Lesewelt Berlin volunteers read aloud every Wednesday from 16:00 to 17:00 at Ingeborg-Bachmann-Bibliothek, for children aged 4 to 12, to spark a love of reading.

5c46a8cefe4cddc240621dd8f1f981ca184b8a29.en: Finanz-Fitness part 2 at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade with Matthias Derkowski, a step-by-step guide to putting the knowledge from the earlier talks into practice. Free entry, no registration.

a35b526c49b5f2b34f2a991e3922813bed81d902.en: A pumpkin carving session at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek for children, families and anyone who enjoys an autumn afternoon. Tools and pumpkins are provided, or bring your own. Registration requested.

f60ac9a6d83b4ab5f7033a77e486efe85dff4187.en: A werewolf afternoon at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek in October for ages 8 and up, in which players guess who the werewolves are among the villagers. Registration by phone or email required.

21b7e22cca28d496c99239bdb13911371f00a209.en: KulturLeben Berlin – Schlüssel zur Kultur e.V. at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg, a non-profit that helps socially disadvantaged people reach free cultural events in Berlin through partnerships with cultural venues.

6c009ff7d59cc9b559096e79491887133433fdaf.en: Animal stories with Marlis at Stadtteilzentrum Kaulsdorf on Wednesday at 16:00, with funny tales about favourite animals, including the famous raven Socke. A family outing.

6c6f98e51a21de6be38c9a0f128abe13dfdf77b3.en: A Go club at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel, where people play the Asian board game Go together.

3dce14a910e51af880daa8c26d3ff61d2c2d58de.en: A kamishibai read-aloud for children aged 3 and up at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel.

f889f5d60e3758989bd38c030fe12560d4503b7b.en: An open digital clinic at Hansabibliothek run by Sonay e.V., where young people help seniors every Wednesday with questions on mobile phones, tablets and other digital devices.

a9c3da162ce315a1d8cc8b8a5d202f924729364c.en: The third part of a Freie Universität Berlin series on sustainability as a response to planetary crises. It asks whether sustainability is a political battle term or a key to the future, with an opening talk by Klaus Dörre.

28499e497de50bfa530abf1efc9c063bf29dd9a2.en: Bastelgeschichten, free craft afternoons for ages 3 to 8 at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, with a poem or song, a kamishibai story and a simple craft at 16:30.

2218b59d458dac7e2cd3538fc934dc0bb84d8ef4.en: A Repair Café at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek, where volunteers help fix small household appliances and people share their skills. Registration by phone or email.

a1df11156c3e2faf8982c91164f6f516d08b1ecb.en: A litter-picking meetup at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof, where people clear rubbish from the park around the library. Meet in front of the Eva-Maria-Buch-Haus.

df0a16bbe240a4c71e07adaf526bf79fc421f912.en: An open digital surgery for seniors at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek on smartphones, tablets, social media and internet apps, in the third-floor conference room. No registration; each session stands alone.

f505ff05a332b9f59ca30c9e0572472f88883d3d.en: A ghost hunt at Stadtteilbibliothek Lankwitz for children aged 6 and up. Young detectives follow clues and solve riddles to find Lanki, a library ghost who vanished after decorating for Halloween. Registration required.

5950cbbcbd8557661404892bf3c83038e85cb3cd.en: A German conversation café at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek, led by a course leader from VHS Pankow, every Wednesday from 16:30 to 18:00 in the upstairs event room. It helps build confidence in speaking.

94da70c5fac5adb7f62f439f6eda41b383c37ef5.en: A family craft session at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek every Wednesday from 16:30, with scissors, coloured paper and glue in the children's area. Free, no registration.

dfa022864b0ca7ba9f0a6c6e3610d2c277782191.en: A monthly storytime at Adolf-Reichwein-Bibliothek for children aged 4 to 7, with fairy tales and picture books shown as picture book cinema or kamishibai. Wednesdays at 16:30 through the year. No registration.

20732f5b1cef7308e8baea5f4dc1545662e5d943.en: A Gruselwoche storytime at Adolf-Reichwein-Bibliothek on 28 October 2026 at 16:30, with the spooky picture book Hase Hibiskus und das grausige Gruseln shown as a picture book cinema. Free, no registration.

9a0850ecc701259b67d73679cc93fe8b7b389047.en: A city walk through the Bayerisches Viertel in Schöneberg on antisemitism, its everyday forms and its history, using documented cases from the Tempelhof-Schöneberg register and historic sites.

fe08890cad31b62ea74f7e44753c1963d09dae24.en: Storytelling for children aged 3 and up in a Mongolian yurt at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek, with stories from around the world. Advance online booking, up to three children per adult, and guests should arrive 10 minutes early.

1f7fbd4f22ef6805da6d8c0ab56aef322377b7fa.en: A workshop for parents on healthy, affordable family meals at a church in Berlin during the second autumn holiday week, run by RESTLOS GLÜCKLICH e.V. Families cook together with rescued food, and childcare is offered. Free.

8b70a999f97866b9def60464747909862574ee9e.en: Zuhör-Raum, an open talking circle with a talking stick and no set topic, at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek. The person holding the stick speaks while the others listen. Run with the SEKIS self-help office; contact in advance is requested.

ac2f46bdfe31df4147c60b97f70715ba864a41ae.en: Woll-Fühlen, a new relaxed knitting and crochet group at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek for beginners and experienced crafters alike. Bring your own projects; tea and coffee are provided. Free, no registration.

dda98fabd264b8198abc65155726d92c3e461e64.en: Berliner Kostproben, a new series at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof in which a different Berlin publisher each evening presents its authors and books, with sweets from makers. The books stay on a library shelf afterwards.

ba5b4a848399d2015349001249923dac3ac87821.en: A Linux evening at KlimaWerkstatt Spandau on 1 July, 17:30-20:00, for Windows users whose computers have become slow or no longer run Windows 11. Attendees can test Linux on their own machines, and a live demo is open to all.

821fc8f22aa89b56a4b0dc56c75815fe91b372f7.en: The tenth anniversary of the exhibition ENTHÜLLT. Berlin und seine Denkmäler at Zitadelle Spandau, with the unveiling of a Karl Marx bust from Humboldt University on 9 May at 14:00. Speakers include Dr. Carola Brückner and museum director Urte Evert.

00247ede70bcf13e0e65e8b618b38ec62d688644.en: A VHS course at Schiller-Bibliothek on digital help with official letters, job applications and online job searches. Participants practise answering authorities, completing forms and writing emails. Free, no prior knowledge or registration needed.

40aed47355ed5a4efa40992b83cf710b78986d93.en: A talk at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek by Tierheim Treff Südwest on how New Year's fireworks harm people and animals, with facts and tips for a pet-friendly celebration. Free entry, phone registration requested.

7074e2c6e8f787ccb0fe304540321b21b88ef18b.en: Vitalii Shupliak's exhibition THRESHOLDS at Gotisches Haus runs from 29 October to 23 December 2026, opening on 28 October at 19:00. The works explore thresholds between inside and outside, sacred and digital imagery, and protection and threat.

38f4c7028cfe0f94e8fc1f4a1fd31b42bdd3d4c5.en: Kerstin Hensel reads from Abendgruß, a book of two stories about family and life in East and West Germany, full of irony and poetry. Mark-Twain-Bibliothek, 19:00-20:30, registration by phone. Entry is free, with a donation at the exit.

1abb15dc8f2981590a84855297e3a464f8010334.en: The opening of Uta Jeran's exhibition Quittengelb und Lavendelgrün at Galerie 100 on 28 October 2026 at 19:00. The Berlin painter and printmaker shows landscapes, city views and still lifes until 20 December 2026. Free entry.

4a95a672084332a2c2c68419206aa3dacc4441ac.en: Recreational volleyball for adults at Turnhalle Ebereschen-Grundschule. Trial sessions are possible, and during school holidays times are arranged in advance.

c8367364b03bfe7c665aeadf93667fb9dbd2c1cf.en: Queer Needlecraft Corner at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, an open meet-up for knitting, crocheting, sewing, embroidery and weaving, for beginners and experts alike. Bring your own project and materials. Free, no registration.

96ca8f1d0147ff9e5f96bd0966ffe919d5a2f169.en: Nine German-language authors, including Daniela Dröscher and Anke Stelling, discuss literature and motherhood with editors Eva Eßlinger and Sarah Seidel at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek. The evening includes a book premiere. Registration via Pretix.

e8c64913a1ad497bc1367b396fbe4bea51ca5b5a.en: The Fray's Autumn Light Tour at Tempodrom, presented by Live Nation. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by an adult, and no one under 6 is admitted. Accessible tickets are arranged through a contact form or hotline.

bec13240cc3306f5f5d5ffe9c11a6e1ea958de14.en: The Home Team's Crucible of Life European Tour 2026, with support from Arrows in Action and True North, presented by Live Nation. The venue is not listed.

2351ff6dd4d62d8e6a2fd6a4beb1fb8dd8a64faf.en: An international conference at Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung on trade unions, the far right and the struggle for the working class in Europe and North America since 1945. Held in German and English, with interpretation.

8d9fe487fdc4949af58cc10a15baf1f063dea7c2.en: A Lyme disease support group at Stadtteilzentrum Kaulsdorf, meeting on the last Wednesday of each month from 15:30 to 17:30. A volunteer from Borreliose Bund Deutschland leads open discussion, with talks planned too.

5f7b346ea00eb4596e0389c093d0335bdbde7197.en: Unsichtbar, a live children's radio play after The Little Prince by Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, at Kulturhaus Karlshorst for children and adults. It is a multisensory experience. Reservation required; 3 euros per child, accompanying adults free.

458c059fe14f2e36463a94d53f96a09c4c2495cd.en: A Science Lab autumn holiday course at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade for ages 6 to 9 on the secret colours of leaves, testing how plant colours change. Led by Dr. Jaconette Mirck. 2 euros, registration required.

8f6f87193aee2b7f8c038c794d2acd1b2a765d8f.en: A monthly film breakfast at BALL e.V. in Biesdorf's historic stables, with DEFA films introduced by Anna-Lisa Schaier. This week's film is Nelken in Aspik, a satire about a man whose silence brings him success. Breakfast included; phone registration.

d60d7dfd1ee11c08e7fc143e78691fb9eba28b41.en: The Gespenst aus dem Koffer, a 45-minute puppet and music show by Teatro Baraonda at Schwartzsche Villa, about the world of ghosts, for ages 3 to 8. Entry 7 euros, 6 euros for groups, educators free.

26ff6161a1518d27b475dc2544b8761bbaa12d56.en: A graffiti street art workshop with Timeless Studio at Zitadelle Spandau on Thursday 29 October 2026, 11:00-16:00. Teenagers spray two large wall panels outside the citadel. No experience needed, free, registration by 27 October.

d5f13ed1522d1c32e8c04d36b561b0971a049a72.en: A song workshop on inclusion through rhythm at Musikschule Béla Bartók. Participants make sound with their own bodies, through clapping, stamping, humming and singing. It is the second workshop, and newcomers are welcome.

b22dbeab5a9a54d8007c9e2e315da71746c31486.en: A BerTA café at Bibliothek am Luisenbad, a relaxed chat over coffee and biscuits on the last Thursday of the month, 13:00-15:00. Psychologist Cornelia Benter offers prompts. No registration; for seniors and anyone who wants to talk.

174878347ebfa2d22cd856e691f007e0eedab948.en: A travel talk at the Rusche 43 community centre about autumn in north-east USA, with Quaker history, universities and white wooden churches among the autumn colours. Politics-free; phone booking requested. Fee 4 euros.

d088d4a04ebc82831e91362ca54778408111a098.en: A children's face-painting session at Stadtteilbibliothek Halemweg during Gruselwoche. Children choose from set Halloween designs and are painted to match.

3e2a2f26b59a08ad6e588a22f0500f980054f717.en: A live concert at the Judith-Auer-Straße community centre by Uta Carina and Andreas Gieseke, performing as the duo ZWEIERLIVE with modern pop-schlager. Entry 10 euros including coffee; phone booking requested.

0e4823a1f7f36c54f9b467fa09b03da51c9dd761.en: Too Much Data Spoils the Bot, an AI workshop at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda on 29 October 2026, for ages 12 and up. It explores how AI-made content can worsen AI and what this means for sustainability and society. Free, pre-registration.

7f15cf5c1eda1d8af75be9fd0bdeffc4e4e7abd5.en: A Gruselwoche robot rally at Adolf-Reichwein-Bibliothek on 29 October 2026, 14:30-16:30. Children use Blue-Bot robots to program a cockroach to escape, a playful start to coding. Free, registration required.

da9609e2772fc8dcc756fcc640721348b21d7811.en: A pop-up information stand by the Moabit Ost and Moabit West neighbourhood coordination teams at the Tiergarten town hall display case on Thursday. It is linked to the exhibition Demokratie in Mitte and presents local democracy and engagement projects.

d0062ab1918a6b0872575db1160d4eebcdb92e1a.en: A guided walk around the Naturhof Malchow with Doreen Hantuschke, on how different tree species survive winter. Free entry with a donation for the farm. Register by 27 October 2026; the walk starts and ends at the library.

705b4bcfa71c889c11dcbea68be2850fefb7343d.en: Digital life workshops at Bodo-Uhse-Bibliothek, run by student volunteers from StuCo. Each one-hour session covers topics such as file management, online banking and the Jobcenter app, on set autumn dates. Free, registration requested.

016cde8ae5cc3fce2ebf3ab0bf8aac4d9e4bb4d0.en: Melodien fürs Herz, a Vienna-themed music afternoon at Hertha-Müller-Haus with the Berlin duo WIENER BLUUT, featuring Viennese songs, evergreens and schlager hits. Start 15:00, entry 3 euros plus 3 euros for coffee. Phone registration.

debb9c39965e9205a79ec04ee83b9d1f3e0bbce7.en: A picture book cinema at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade for children aged 4 and up, with stories shown on a big screen. Free, no registration.

97b717c98d2503992e85232ee56ec68706702908.en: A Halloween party at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof for ages 6 and up, with a picture book cinema at 16:00, Halloween crafts and costume photos. A spooky cellar tour needs booking. Free; children come with an adult.

455abab557a32efaf7c1084d26e25345df48e8fb.en: An open makerspace at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, where children explore programming with LEGO Education sets, Bee-Bots and Ozobots, alone or with an adult. Free, no advance registration.

a1601e26b7af7e4504eb5b86df7a30eaab04f837.en: A digital reading time from Stadtbibliothek Steglitz-Zehlendorf, with stories shared on Instagram or Facebook every Thursday at 16:30 for children to enjoy at home.

a44be108ce6d24b0dcb3cd5baa977672b5cacf21.en: A sticker lab at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek for teenagers aged 10 and up. Artist Lisa Vasvari teaches illustration methods, and the best designs become real stickers. Free, no advance registration.

c1a7208983200d1ce3696239e1452cc6d574fd65.en: Stationary energy advice from Verbraucherzentrale at KlimaWerkstatt Spandau on the last Thursday of each month, 17:00-19:00. Each person gets about 30 minutes on power saving, heating, ventilation and heat protection. Free, booking required.

47d5a6eb230047d079bc0788e05b108840f7bf95.en: Celine Leonora reads from A Lesson in Murder at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek, a dark academia young adult romantic suspense novel set at a secretive academy. For ages 14 and up. Free, registration required.

7379a66e537cb2ac9cd0c2d9ea64bb44414c8bed.en: A new night tour at Tierpark Berlin, a walk through a Southeast Asian rainforest lit only by torches, with a personal guide. Visitors encounter animals such as the Sumatran tiger as the forest changes in the dark.

0f1f3bd75272ba2b4b157e40318c559af19ace1a.en: A reading by Lydia Betz-Michels from Freliczka – Das Aufbegehren des Fräuleins at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek. It follows a young noblewoman in the late 19th century who struggles to break free from the path set for women of her rank. Free, phone registration.

297859e3d42c2922641126a6160bd0ccb544ffb6.en: Queer Gamers, a queer community of gaming fans who meet in a relaxed and friendly setting at Stadtteilbibliothek Buch to play video, card and board games together.

0d92bacbc659cf7de4a2e9826f9c9a79037bfad4.en: A Silent Book Club at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg, where people read their own chosen book in silence, then talk or keep reading. In the colder months it meets in the makerspace. Free, no registration.

3951fda132815eefd710a7684b75fbeaacc6ee97.en: A Pimp my Kleid workshop at Bibliothek Tiergarten-Süd, where linocut and stencil techniques give clothes a new look. A limited supply of textiles is available, and participants may bring their own. Run by Kulturlabor Trial&Error.

71b338776d8b844929f37fa3309a1941296b119d.en: A reading by Burkhard Nagel from Die Wunschmörder at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek. In this political thriller a head of government is shot dead, and the cartridge cases suggest there may have been several shooters. Registration requested.

ef6186065e1d90ef5b63f48cbea8e86bdf543e1d.en: A graphic novel reading by Bianca Schaalburg from Emma und Amir, which begins on Karl-Marx-Straße by the Neukölln Arkaden and mixes crime, spy thriller, screwball comedy and political drama. Free, no registration.

db3fa87a3c06635f473e0a820fba589b7b49baac.en: A panel at Studio Chérie on whether Berlin is vulnerable to cyber attacks, and who is responsible if systems fail. Organised by Europa-Union Berlin with a podcast partner, with only 20 places and online registration required.

fa237396c2fcd781d303d82d1bac951b532f351e.en: Actor David Nathan reads aloud texts that visitors bring, such as letters, diary entries, poems, recipes or emails, at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek. Entry 4 euros, 3 euros with a library card, and free tickets for HOWOGE tenants.

03a5ccd3aad11b25d4890796de29cd7ec5b20e8d.en: A concert at REFO Moabit in which author Yevgenia Belorusets, who documents Russia's invasion of Ukraine, looks back at Soviet Kyiv through the accordion. The Motion Trio performs, as part of Global Sound Stories. Entry 16 euros, 11 reduced.

ce8339c5a69a630a244b476169c9cdcae690f4c7.en: A comic reading by Sheree Domingo and Patrick Spät of Irrläufer, based on a true story of a white beluga whale that swam into the Rhine in 1966. The book also mocks the complacent West Germany of the economic miracle.

14224f11035304040096b48488648266b590924d.en: A Silent Book Club in the Puttensaal of Bibliothek am Luisenbad. Participants read their own books quietly for an hour, then discuss them, with free mulled punch. Free entry, no registration.

45cbd26b6925191f10a99188b1749b51c03dcf6d.en: A Gruselwoche reading by the Berlin branch of Mörderische Schwestern at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Bibliothek, marking 30 years. Authors Susanne Rüster and Heidi Ramlow present their anthology Verbrechen mit Stil. Free entry, no registration.

376ce5c91ccf62c33221420f72f44d00969c9978.en: A musical and scenic evening at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel about the French chansonnier Georges Brassens, who was forced to work at a BMW aircraft engine plant in Basdorf in 1943. It falls on the 45th anniversary of his death, with songs partly written there.

e0ee68652a697c416693109cb048b906f703c5c8.en: Lichtung, a jazz quartet concert by teachers at Terzo Mondo, with guitar, bass, piano and drums.

be9e9f4021b17ee61385ab382557031a1cf2c9f3.en: Improneta 2026, an improv theatre festival at WABE, opening with a show. Tickets 17 euros or 14 euros reduced.

3220a6d5f1b3047475e61ccee058fd5905ef0cf2.en: LOUKEMAN at LARK, presented by Goodlive Artists. Wheelchair users and people with severe disabilities pay the regular ticket price, and their companions are admitted free without a ticket.

85b367995c6d433fe979912f1956b4471fd35d2a.en: A reading by Jochen Gutsch from Frankie – Unter Menschen, about a cat who ends up in a rubbish lorry and sets off on an adventure with a girl named Shattab. Entry 4 euros, 3 euros reduced; free tickets for HOWOGE tenants.

6e978cbb7334a6765b020f4987db709e9aa241db.en: Social advice for families at Familienzentrum Zukunftshaus Wedding on claiming benefits such as Bürgergeld, Elterngeld, Kindergeld and housing benefit. It also covers language offers, training, job orientation and official letters.

cdb44dff031b73d90438e2c5f86923f155159d6a.en: Uta Jeran's exhibition Quittengelb und Lavendelgrün at Galerie 100, with landscapes, city views and still lifes by the Berlin painter and printmaker. Opening on 28 October 2026 at 19:00. Free entry.

e6c2bd6e3365f9436315d3389f210c0888495740.en: A creative writing workshop at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek for people who want to rediscover or develop creative writing. No experience needed, sessions stand alone, and writing materials should be brought. Free, registration appreciated.

16e859285726c607b6d1dc78a2bba0dc42ebe226.en: Auch der Duft einer Rose, an exhibition of paintings and paper works by Brigitte and Heinz Handschick from their estate at Galerie Parterre. It runs from 30 October 2026 to 17 January 2027, Tuesday to Sunday 12:00-20:00. Opening on 29 October at 19:00.

c1d10e0a8165a35eea83530ce5509b079a0467a1.en: A Halloween party at BALL e.V. Bürgerhaus Südspitze with spooky fun in the garden: a Halloween music welcome, a monster olympics, a costume contest with prizes and a disco. Entry 3 euros per child, 5 euros per adult.

9b96e986f3fedc7c76605d8bafa5717b8ebc9573.en: Halloween crafts at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek as part of the Azubi Weeks, where participants make spooky, funny or ghostly decorations for home. Open to anyone who enjoys crafting.

6fd17f68191a6d4ab9149f45322b2cc5c5364f63.en: A Harry Potter party at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade during the autumn holiday programme for children aged 6 and up, with crafts, board games, a quiz and camera magic. Free, no registration.

b4ac5b8913c56c63a010ff607c0a0ba87cbbd096.en: Die Wilden Witwer perform Fräulein, pardon at the Kommunale Begegnungsstätte. Entry 10 euros with coffee; tickets are sold on site on Wednesdays from 9:00 to 12:00.

732aef7134e6d33ffdf34f48dcb6321074997917.en: SAN PAOLO – Das Martyrium von Pasolini, a world premiere at Heizhaus der Uferstudios by David Stöhr and Dirk Brauner. A theatre, dance and sound piece imagining a fascist turned antifascist, inspired by Pasolini's unfinished script.

718a7ca6b51bdf0831286402b975e73deb33b92c.en: A seven-hour workshop at Eine Welt Zentrum Berlin on recognising disinformation and hate speech online, including reflection on one's own social media use. No prior knowledge needed; fee 15 euros, 10 reduced. Registration by email.

c142ff3d565408d03c45ce01d52928c1299eed87.en: A senior chat with coffee and biscuits at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, a regular meeting for older people to talk about life's big and small things, run with the Steglitz-Zehlendorf senior council. Free, no advance registration.

b6829f6cde4a109f69fb24bfa3f386ddca33f3c2.en: A natural-dye printing workshop at Hansabibliothek, where participants make inks from turmeric, beetroot and cocoa, then print postcards through fine stencils by illustrator Patricia Thoma. No registration needed.

4475e787389f1e3f25292ded730893d14ec3a7c8.en: A ghost hunt at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek for children with adults: ghosts against robots, riddles, and creating and programming monsters for games. Free, no registration.

5aa1cf9e89b7f72874d6dddc0cf41f464e02546c.en: A monthly open games café at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek on the last Friday of each month from 15:00 to 18:00, where families and game fans try board, card and storytelling games. Free, open to all ages.

e51fbb8d3a8ee81bcf5f116cb52692dc6be80eeb.en: A reading of Wanda by Annika Scheffel at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek. A girl runs away from care homes and foster families and finds a hiding place in the busiest spot in town, with a group of misfits. For ages 11 and up; registration requested.

0939272766946eaef01c75f82283707bbc9086f3.en: A Halloween family afternoon at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek for children aged 4 and up, with creative crafts and a spooky picture book cinema at 17:00. Free, no registration.

799aa019485d0734400e686c6bcec5c105c7c257.en: A reading adventure with Hilal at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek, ending with a creative surprise. No registration details are listed in the programme.

5a8c63bd0fa0641673c9557196307e26662c6ca3.en: A reading with music at Janusz-Korczak-Bibliothek, with texts by Hanns Cibulka, Uwe Greßmann, Christoph Hein, Sarah Kirsch and Christa Müller, read by Helga Burchardt and Gerhard Kütbach, with piano interludes by Julius Tangerding.

ab2a2a7b56d4a0184e2d02074c13bfbcd0e77982.en: A Halloween LEGO session at Stadtteilbibliothek Reinickendorf-West for children aged 5 and up, building spooky houses and dark alleys.

b6e429c43685b63da9515e240b9699370916acdc.en: Monster Mash, a Halloween event at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek that turns the library into a spooky cabinet with stories, crafts and activity tables. Costumes welcome. Free, no advance registration.

775ea61a1783c85bc1d9f3196d0850097e776bdb.en: A picture book cinema at Hansabibliothek for children aged 3 to 10, reading an autumn story about whether there is a pumpkin thief.

2589ae57a9364a7702557e8eb2ef222d7914915e.en: Spanish storytelling at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek for children aged 4 and up, with Frau Gonzalez reading from popular Spanish children's books at 16:30. Free, no advance registration.

4e4d87377a92f191ba624c936b45e69b819b40f4.en: An open crochet café at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek in the makerspace, run by volunteers, where people crochet together, learn techniques and share ideas. Beginners and experts are welcome. Free, no registration.

94becb00deb20127f97b9b4511b956735ce446c5.en: Pink Prints, a workshop at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek on breast cancer awareness, where people print mugs, bags and T-shirts with pink motifs. Held in the makerspace from 17:00 to 19:00 on 30 October. No registration.

964e73d0eb6fb577cab8d8c97c156bad63008f6d.en: A closing Halloween party for the Gruselwoche at Stadtteilbibliothek Halemweg, with music, dancing and plenty of fun.

0ae2fa9ada128b23267b36a1e075b1035d9c95f0.en: Volunteer readers read aloud and tell stories in Portuguese at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek, for children up to age 12, to spark a love of reading. Parents are warmly invited.

7bc28f5a76d9d2d94934a9e064031d55e33637e6.en: A games afternoon at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek for young adults aged 18 and over, with board and video games such as Mario Kart and Tabu, to meet new people. Advance registration required.

80ce74bd189b711b21814b04c6efd019ca2bd519.en: A reading by Berlin thriller author Max Bentow from Puppenherz, the latest case of investigators Nils Trojan and Carlotta Weiss, at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek on 30 October 2026 at 18:00. Free, no registration.

0b87a3a9afd7fa4bbcf264241c5f8157471314f8.en: Ponto at Hansabibliothek, a gathering with screenings, audiovisual works and live-streamed digital environments. It considers how contemporary worldbuilding shapes our emotional and collective lives, moving between cinema and online space.

03dfad25e936564095bd3ab276c15964afcb9c59.en: A reading by Thomas Schleissing-Niggemann at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek on cabaret in the Nazi era and in the concentration camps, including how prisoners performed cabaret to lift the spirits of fellow inmates. Advance registration requested.

386280f6d2520c91e2f2fb874792c3ce4f155fb4.en: Stefan Zweig's 24 Stunden aus dem Leben einer Frau, a one-woman play by Anette Daugardt at Schwartzsche Villa, about a woman in her forties who discovers the depths of her feelings after meeting a man in his twenties. Entry 18 euros, 15 reduced.

f09a795b56e42dcc32152716f8e8b11352992b01.en: A performance-reading by Karolina Dreit and Kristina Dreit of Working Class Daughters, based on interviews with women about class, many from the art and culture sector. At Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek; registration via Pretix.

d6a567348580b6aee6b81548ca23ef288b88c010.en: This is Halloween, a live show at Kulturhaus Spandau with singers, dancers and acrobats. Sung hits from musicals such as Tanz der Vampire, Wicked and Das Phantom der Oper blend with rock and pop classics in a dark, sensual performance.

4ba613e187c2e5150b44cf9bbb16c27f4171d60a.en: Puscifer's The Normal Isn't Tour at Uber Eats Music Hall with Gallery Seat tickets: an exclusive seat in blocks 202 to 204, Gallery Bar access, a fast lane and a free cloakroom. E-tickets are sent 3 to 5 days before the show.

fb97eb29d4d106d6df2cddbefec5376d8d808838.en: A free Halloween flea market for all at Pablo-Neruda-Bibliothek on 31 October 2026, 10:00-14:00, with unwanted items for adults and children, plus cake and coffee. Stall registration opens on 1 October.

07470cf812f57341d0301ead0c896ae6d24fc3aa.en: Halloween at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek, with face painting as bats, ghosts or pumpkins, a craft table for spooky decorations and Sphero Indi robots to program through a ghost forest. Free, no advance registration.

b4ac90ce00eb6618d603e10dc7b49373d1d518c0.en: Chess and memory training at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek on selected Saturdays, guided by the team of business psychologist Steve J. Gildemeister. Dates include a Halloween chess session on 31 October and a tournament on 12 December.

4c66f76d0d7aa6abe441e855285c812fd0b0f75f.en: The second Highly Sensitive Persons Day at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, with an arrival session, an impulse talk by coach Antje Remke, quiet islands, a media exhibition and readings. Free entry, no registration.

67fae56ae70a382e308774eb034a2f92c1c87a45.en: Listening pop-up actions at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek, once a month, run with the Netzwerk Zuhören. They create space for people to be heard and seen, as part of a wider culture of listening that supports democracy.

86665971a8e7b7d0c43f534d4d0201699acafb27.en: Craft fun with Daniela at Stadtteilbibliothek Karow, a relaxed crafting session for all ages, held in a cosy atmosphere.

dda9667e677e4db96fe24abd300d6b496a7e1c18.en: A sewing machine workshop for children aged 10 and up at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek, taught by an experienced seamstress, with a new motif each month. No experience needed; materials are provided. Free, registration required.

d1b494f554afa63ab19551095d1780c5fd974d65.en: A family Saturday at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek for trying out new apps, learning, computer and console games. TOMMI game testing. Free entry.

9748a4a488d16faaa6b2f3077066427ffed38f1b.en: A free back exercise course at Stadtteilbibliothek Karow for preventing back pain, with targeted exercises that improve mobility and wellbeing. Registration by phone or email, or on site.

b4e26ca0ec466c8b4aab71d0acd3151242ce900a.en: MeerMärchen, a storytelling show by Kathleen Rappolt at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek, about fish, fishermen and the magic of the waves. For families with children aged 5 and up, in the KreativLounge.

aab84e61b6f2b1468e348fcac32ccc91189abcdc.en: An open zine workshop at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek on hope and inner strength, where participants make small handmade booklets. Free, no experience needed, for adults and children from about age 7. Funded by the library strengthening fund.

b0aedc0c5c591717fc47e855a2130550d619b76a.en: A family tinkering Thursday at Bibliothek im Märkischen Viertel with Makey Makey, where people build circuits with LEDs and conductive tape to light up paper cars, houses and insects. Free, no registration.

e75143c105b4751edee58652f54f4482f73c3e43.en: A screening of the stop-motion films from the Obst- und Gemüse-Oper holiday workshop at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg, shown without music. Free, registration required.

e2a25e5d7e7ee9d5ef3fb3dd71f78bf4420ce1d6.en: A wool, needle and button swap at Stadtteilbibliothek Friedrich von Raumer on 31 October 2026, 13:00-15:00. Bring unused craft supplies and trade them for something new. Free, no registration.

e31bedc44658a66c1b4618cf1b9a4cdac5e761f7.en: An upcycling workshop at Mittelpunktbibliothek Wilhelm Liebknecht / Namik Kemal, where participants make jewellery from real Berlin graffiti fragments. Run with NochMall, the BSR second-hand store, for ages 12 and up. Pre-registration needed.

155c1b5aa6836ba83d10b685c9045c5414fac69d.en: Digital legacy: the Radieschenliste at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg, a 90-minute micro-workshop by Sabine Stengel, creator of the Radieschenliste. It shows how to organise access to phones, email and online accounts. Registration required.

99b9ff19618e272d39ed4fb604314b6ea52d0915.en: Paper collage crafting with Meike Dölp at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek, layering coloured paper cutouts with pictures from magazines or paintings. Free, no registration. Comics drawing is on 31 October.

575d930603261cd55ec1087ab12feea19bca3e3c.en: A reading of Love Letters by A. R. Gurney at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek, with Isabelle Höpfner and Marc Zwinz reading the letters between two friends whose correspondence spans decades. Held on the third floor.

be848da503a74f409972bacb9728e22f7ce745fe.en: A folk dance session at Stadtteilbibliothek Karow, dancing old and new German folk dances and related European dances. Beginners and advanced dancers are welcome, and no partner is needed. Bring drinks and dance shoes.

de34d5117ead9cdd1a53df85c66db27e6c6c66a2.en: A civil courage training at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel on how to recognise danger and intervene calmly when others are insulted, discriminated against or threatened. For ages 16 and up, on 31 October or 28 November. Registration required by email.

3b2b3d08eea0389261571d51605810e8d2272017.en: Der große Popolino, a children's show at Schwartzsche Villa with jugglers, clowns and audience games for ages 2.5 to 9. Entry 6 euros.

a6aa0cd9f3446560387081b5205082e4813a2a36.en: A Halloween evening at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek, with a tour of the spookily decorated library and a Halloween story, for families with children aged 6 and up.

7ea53346d48790c1b11322fb64696c4eda5662e9.en: Unlimited Wrestling Underground #9, a Halloween-themed wrestling night at The Cube on the SRH Campus, with costumes, a party atmosphere and matches.

68ddc0d8a7635ebb221a5d1446b2a76d941698a1.en: Dittmer and Gahl perform Ick sitze hier und esse Klops at Schwartzsche Villa, a programme of old Berlin couplets and rhymes with humour and local colour, accompanied on piano. Entry 12 euros, 10 reduced.

760afdc4751541b72eed259799637ea96df6816c.en: Brasil Orchester Berlin performs Brazilian music with accordion at Gutshof Schloss Britz, conducted by Andréa Huguenin Botelho. It is the first orchestra in Germany devoted fully to this tradition. Entry 18 euros, 13 reduced.

24f3e8be8ce0b549df7e272913748ad638ee4884.en: Poetry Slam Spandau at the Kulturhaus Spandau theatre hall, where experienced poets and neighbours compete with self-written texts. No costumes, props or singing, and the audience decides the winner.

9192a34febc0eb05a721616e5bb396d2d72d5dad.en: ARLO PARKS' Desire Tour at Uber Eats Music Hall with Gallery Seat tickets, including an exclusive seat in blocks 202 to 204, Gallery Bar access, a fast lane and a free cloakroom. E-tickets are sent 3 to 5 days before the show.

5cfab0f0f9b8c2e3b4d8ef31eac6fce896d32f3f.en: MuseumsSonntag at Zitadelle Spandau, held on the first Sunday of each month. Free guided tours of the art exhibitions start at 15:00, and a family workshop for children aged 4 and up runs from 15:00 to 17:00.

9a4ce0f3dea92cc823577adc6de87627717905c3.en: Pilates with Paula Schwarzer at Hansabibliothek, a gentle yet demanding full-body workout focused on breathing and a strong core, suitable for all fitness levels. Bring your own mat; registration via the Offen für Kultur website.

8dee6b5659d28a4c9adfba387708ad2a36812d40.en: Creative Sunday at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof, with professional guidance. Drop in without registration.

c725804de77fa076a632366c48b72d6c9fec16f6.en: Hexe auf Probe, a puppet play by Theater auf dem Bügelbrett at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Bibliothek. A girl wants to train as a witch, even though the old witch at the forest edge sends everyone away. For ages 5 to 99.

208f50c17a5be333279ca8b5d9fd0a7cae0ac85a.en: Scary Tales, a puppet show at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek in which Madame Zakapüs presents strange creatures from her travels, including a genie, a giant frog and an alien who plays the accordion.

7658902833594452412b888255efb146545ba2f9.en: A walking tour from the New Synagogue Berlin through the Scheunenviertel on the 1923 pogrom, which broke out during the inflation crisis. It also covers the defence by Jewish former soldiers of the Reichsbund jüdischer Frontsoldaten. Registration required.

812afe9891a0e6add0f43d3820179fc68797674f.en: A Museumssonntag workshop at Museum Lichtenberg im Stadthaus. A guided tour of everyday life in the GDR, using Lichtenberg as an example, is followed by a printmaking workshop where participants take their own works home.

8baf9b8f0565933537190a6ce56848494bb1995d.en: An open games afternoon at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek, exploring urban space through street furniture and city games, including Venice BeReal. Part of Wissen zwischen Büchern and the Berlin Science Week.

f01cf63d83e216791b5e20a8979adcf887649b30.en: KlassiKlatsch: Händel – ein Portrait, a concert at the Kulturhaus Spandau gallery with flute and piano, exploring the life and music of Handel. Free entry, registration required by phone or email.

22080e9500799dd807843fa89d2fe6a956f5fbd6.en: Getanzte Geschichten, getanzte Emotionen at Schwartzsche Villa, a concert with dancer Carmen Rodriguez Castillo and guitarist Roger Tristao Adao. Dance and songs by Garcia Lorca and others tell stories with humour. Entry 15 euros at the door, 12 in advance.

d1437f225c387d7b6910ecc8ddfd54e967a85b45.en: The autumn concert of the Landesjugendorchester Berlin at Haus des Rundfunks, with Shostakovich's Festive Overture, the premiere of Eleftherios Veniadis's concerto for accordion, voice and orchestra, and excerpts from Prokofiev's Romeo and Juliet.

68eef7436ead60c87209903b4c53edde560f75fb.en: An open toddler meetup at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek for families with children aged 0 to 24 months. Free, no registration.

c7caacf913593e12a08a837927967b577fdcea6c.en: A reading café at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek, a new informal meeting point where readers share favourite finds over coffee or tea. Free with advance registration by phone or email.

69ebdd949497ac4c5c0edb82c0696507fc66be0d.en: Zeitreise Marzahn at BALL e.V. Bürgerhaus Südspitze, a coffee-and-cake gathering where neighbours share stories and memories of the district's past. Open to anyone who wants to share or listen.

730243f4a722bc1901b51833e37295a1c2d1d93f.en: A consultation hour at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek for people with disabilities, serious illness or chronic conditions, and their close relatives. It takes place on the first Monday of each month. Free, no registration.

044c316e8d6933d17788d3fb3263161ec63e5cf4.en: A care advice hour at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel from the Reinickendorf care support point, on care grades, prevention, home adaptations, aids, relief for carers, dementia support and housing options. Free; register at the care point.

0589270ae0fe722a0370a1139e4726c23bbcaac8.en: Wer wird Labor-Champion?, a hands-on science Olympiad at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek during Science Week. Visitors try pipetting and weighing, open tubes one-handed and solve quiz challenges. Open to all ages; free entry.

f22651fc7515aae16720e93bb09d93068415fab8.en: Plauschen und Lauschen at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek, an open conversation on the first Monday of each month from 14:00 to 16:00, with topics chosen by participants. No registration; part of the FEIN pilot project.

2dedec28c4a59d84318750eefbe7bdefc27e1c28.en: Digitale Spielwiese in Marienfelde, a digital play area on the first Monday of each month from 15:00 to 17:00, with Sphero Indi robots, Osmo and programmable LEGO sets. For ages 5 to 10 and for adults. Free, no registration.

e9673d50faeaf0e5a361e0e8719e65dd2624b671.en: Homework help at Hansabibliothek on Mondays and Fridays from 15:30 to 16:30, for children in grades 1 to 6, in a quiet room. There is no homework help during school holidays.

6aa755a441a48e9e8a85925f8ba2a83e693cd513.en: Homework help at Bruno-Lösche-Bibliothek for children in grades 3 to 6, on Mondays 16:00-18:00, Tuesdays 15:00-18:00 and Thursdays 16:00-19:00, in the children's library. Not held during school holidays.

52bac19b9b5544bf5d2bb2c946c74c87584a295a.en: A monthly creative workshop at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg on the first Monday of each month from 16:00 to 18:00, with a theme each time, such as Halloween bats or winter crafts. Materials are provided; some sessions need registration.

4577e6d27e800c34fe110b958455025f85aa7428.en: The AWO Digital Café at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek, where people over 60 learn to use tablets and the internet over coffee and biscuits, led by trained young people. Loan devices available; no registration.

6405127f34d52aa8fdfa78539bff512666a4a88c.en: An open sewing café at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek, where beginners and experienced sewers work on projects or repair and upcycle clothes with expert guidance. Machines and a small range of fabric are available. Free, no registration.

4c3aa4d40e78153600b6e531b5eba151d29056fb.en: Homework help for grades 1 to 10 at Schiller-Bibliothek, Monday to Friday from 16:00 to 18:00 in the first-floor group room, supported by Gesobau. Not held during school holidays.

ec2cc28e55c5ede16c64cadddd96047996659bc7.en: A digital afternoon at Bibliothek am Wasserturm for children and families to try robots and devices, including Dash, Ozobot, Bee-Bot, Osmo and a VR headset. Only the VR headset needs registration.

d99a930e7a3fb7036d36726685f029a6454aed4b.en: A Halloween concert by Corinna Bilke and her skeleton band at Eberhard-Alexander-Burgh-Bibliothek. In this family show with songs and comedy, a girl journeys through a cursed castle. For ages 3 and up; registration requested.

c24cf26b56a11ed9a23e5101666d0a258fc8ffca.en: A panel discussion at Centrum Judaicum on the 1923 Scheunenviertel pogrom from the Communist Party's perspective. Dr. Olaf Kistenmacher explains how the KPD fought antisemitism while warning members against defending 'Jewish capitalism'.

7fd35b1bf6f354f83b4d00ae3fa746a7f6060346.en: O je Tannenbaum, a Christmas dance piece by Theater OOPSALA at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade. It follows a tree from felling to disposal, inviting children to think about sustainability. For ages 4 to 11, free, no registration.

21be653382117d33801cade86e1bae31ac614d37.en: A Silent Book Club at Stadtteilbibliothek Lankwitz, held once a month. Readers bring or borrow any book and read together in quiet company, then relax with a good story.

7dfc421cc39c5153ce743776816cf40702737023.en: An English story time at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek on the first Monday of each month at 16:00, for children of all ages. Free of charge.

25650b704956304fba7bff5d71c24024a9d7134b.en: A new Monday games afternoon at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek on the first and third Mondays in the KreativLounge. Classic and modern strategy games suit adults, families and children, and visitors can bring a favourite game.

73cd606916482aef9732d7d50b7ce19d9bc00793.en: A storytime at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Bibliothek twice a month, with picture book stories shown with their illustrations on the cinema smartboard. Open to all picture book fans.

3d7ea32e929651e7b2f5e92b4a956847213a6689.en: Neue Literatur am Nachmittag at Bibliothek am Wasserturm on the first Monday of each month, presenting current non-fiction and novels connected to the times and to the readers' own lives. Free entry, no registration.

b4e52d9f2a1a5fcc052a602c1619790c931cc95f.en: A smartphone and computer surgery at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg with student volunteers from Studenten-Computerhilfe, helping with connection problems, setup and search engines. Free, no registration.

9f3add8c311fb69ce7a2841ff9656ade1043d5d5.en: An online crash course, ABC für Eltern und Elternvertretungen, for parents interested in participation in Berlin schools. It covers school law, class parents' meetings and the school committee structures. No experience needed; free, online registration.

5d5dd981561f298fc31e2983a3781ee9a1ecf26a.en: A Bundesbank public lecture on the climate crisis, transformation and prices. It looks at how climate shocks and the move to a climate-neutral economy affect prices and the central bank's role, followed by a reception. Free; doors open at 17:30.

8580578ad25192b24f25642e6ebe3874ac5789b5.en: A talk by Nadja Schallenberg at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek on the history of homophobia and transphobia, from their origins to today, with time for questions. Part of Queer Monday with Sonntags-Club.

75d3d7db7ad4f6746bffb6cc6a9a19f8e47236f6.en: The opening event of Wissen zwischen Büchern at Pablo-Neruda-Bibliothek on 2 November 2026, with author Bernhard Kegel reading from his novel Gras, a dance on reading by Irina Demina, and a discussion on science in fiction.

5c9fb470fd56875f91315e3ad9dfad56bc7bc300.en: An open writing workshop and reading stage at Bibliothek am Wasserturm for anyone who likes to write. Participants get feedback from the group and can present their work on the reading stage. Guests and listeners are welcome.

d9470a52414c7666bf32ae7faa15bb985b52afbc.en: Allein am Höllenlöchli, a speech opera by Glorius von Lorbeerkranz at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek. It is an opera with an orchestra but no music, set in a paper theatre universe, performed by Aldona and Holger Kosel. Registration required; free entry.

841160e4a146c0940c4539092c037fc8924e92d6.en: DON TOLIVER's Nitrous Octane World Tour, leg 2, at Uber Arena with Premium Seat and All-In Premium packages. They include premium blocks, the Premium Lounge and, in the All-In package, a buffet and drinks. eTickets are sent 3 to 5 days before.

842827b90a3d9889a2d55a994005c43a684e3b22.en: Tokyo Tea Room at Mikropol, presented by Live Nation. Wheelchair users and people with severe disabilities should book standard tickets, and carers are admitted free without a ticket.

54b1359865a5a7ed5356c71f3cd49f5bb60529aa.en: A literature circle at Stadtteilzentrum Kaulsdorf on 3 March at 16:00, discussing Mark Twain's The Innocents Abroad. Newcomers are welcome, and the group also chooses the next month's book.

da1f67193c0983a42dd74181c1011dd52c9059d5.en: A comic reading at Colosseum Berlin for kindergartens and school classes, presenting Inga Steinmetz's Felis Geheimnis for children aged 6 and up. It is about hiding behind excuses and the need to read signals. Free; registration via the Pankow library form.

a0e7f65cce7e0be67c4547a7717682e2b9a713a5.en: Computer advice for seniors at Stadtteilzentrum Pestalozzi-Treff on modern communication technology, run by the NCL project. Group I meets on the second Tuesday of the month, Group II on the first and third Tuesdays. Registration requested by phone.

f7537229875f63a59d9ef77206ee2d4c1e01824c.en: Wissen zwischen den Büchern at Mittelpunktbibliothek Ehm Welk on how social media shapes our view of history and of ourselves, using content aimed at young people with Russian backgrounds in Germany as a case study. Closed event for school classes.

ee22519dd4b8c59b4cdc5833e2f38e7386156162.en: A road safety information event for seniors at Schiller-Bibliothek, run by Berlin police on the first Tuesday of each month from 10:00 to 13:00. Free, no registration, with traffic safety advisers answering questions.

70a5b75dc2a3c9eb6fa28e0d94cedb41ac92d8ed.en: A reading of Paula, die Leseratte by Martin Ebbertz, with illustrations by Antje Püpke, at Bibliothek Heinrich-von-Kleist. A reader who manages one letter a day is the story's heart. Registration required by phone, email or in person.

391efa9df44b87f7c2ac67670f6285fa4575c3f8.en: A comic reading at Colosseum Berlin for children aged 10 and up, Herr Werner wird zum Dieb by Andrea Offermann. It tells how a caretaker saved forbidden art from the Nazis. Free; registration via the Pankow library form.

5f2380cd51baa5c986d9e3f83433195d0e453b89.en: Bunte Kiste, a cargo bike called FaBi that brings reading promotion, digital media and creative activities to Viktoria-Luise-Platz, with a selection of media and library lending and returns.

92f07ef76177a32e29cc4ec493940855d7684d8e.en: Der Himmel über dem Wilden Westen at Maria-Rimkus-Haus, where singer Claudia Himmel performs country songs from Dolly Parton to Shania Twain. Entry 5 euros plus 3 euros for coffee; doors 14:00, start 15:00.

0060b9aa77b9f0ef8a927a4f37ad07598099ce08.en: A board game afternoon at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade every two weeks from 15:00 to 17:30, for young and old. Maxi games are on hand for children, while experts play strategy games in the group room. Free, no registration.

bef7550502d3bedc375bfd915e1bd0988cf02859.en: A continuing-education course for school staff and educators on teaching primary school children about the Nazi persecution of Jewish life, using local history and biographies without overwhelming them. The venue is to be confirmed.

1eb04e1aa1b4b19c22589c3eaa84be82f8ac9fb6.en: A talk at Friedrich-von-Raumer library by the German Centre for Gerontology on the Silbernetz hotline, which listens to lonely older people. Results of an evaluation are presented on 3 November 2026 at 15:00. Free, no advance registration.

f533445c7f93558641d7872fab43176b5f40894f.en: Homework help at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek on Tuesdays and Fridays from 15:00 to 18:00 for children in grades 1 to 6, in a quiet setting. Not held during school holidays.

3d84b436e6ccacb17a5ae4a2b13e854162da9e7b.en: A kamishibai picture theatre from Japan at Margarete-Kubicka-Bibliothek every two weeks for children aged 3 and up.

c23425cdfad7a43cca988ddcf29dba39d4d262bf.en: An information afternoon at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek on reading sponsorships and volunteer reading, on 3 November 2026 from 16:00 to 17:00. No registration needed.

5c27bc42ac37e1f29980534b591b3997535d7a4e.en: Homework help for grades 1 to 6 at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 16:00 to 18:00, in a quiet setting. Not held during school holidays.

2b8205b69d526e51478c3023ef2ef72a5ccecd79.en: Homework help for grades 1 to 6 at Bibliothek am Luisenbad on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays from 16:00 to 18:00. Not held during school holidays.

a8be94133241df1e8c49a534c8e1077d0168ae55.en: Gretchen's storytime at Familienbibliothek Else Ury for children up to age 8 and their companions, on 3 November 2026 at 16:00. The spooky tales include the devil's three golden hairs and a princess in a coffin. Free, no registration.

ef2e9c9a4bf0161e8292f626e6af5326d1d0a66f.en: Podesthelden and ABC-Piraten at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek, with picture book cinema, kamishibai and drawing and crafts for children aged 2 to 7. Wednesdays at 16:30; free, no registration.

958e420c8f48fa6bd793c13f11fcb8178ce5b2e8.en: A crochet and knitting meetup at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek on the first Tuesday of each month from 16:00 to 18:00, run with volunteers as part of the FEIN pilot project, for people to learn and share together.

52a1bbabbfe3653037124b496e68c3e9038120a9.en: Nintendo Labo crafting and play at Bibliothek Tiergarten-Süd on the first and third Tuesday of each month. Participants build robots, fishing games and racing cars from cardboard and creativity.

5715b190779556b48a0c7059ec6d6eb4668c1cd5.en: A read-aloud session at Bibliothek Heinrich von Kleist on the first Tuesday of each month for children and adults. No registration needed.

1a1ef144e0596aff565acebc489c21d205e40370.en: Lesewelt Berlin read-aloud sessions at Schiller-Bibliothek for children up to age 12, with volunteer readers sparking the joy of books. Dates follow the school term; parents are welcome.

d32a537a80628d32ac3536e2424cecbd1a798054.en: The opening of the exhibition marking the library's festival month in November: 20 years in the castle, 35 years since it took the name of Ingeborg Drewitz, and 130 years of reading in Steglitz. Free, no advance registration.

8cba8f7506a8fb995964fedaffa9b29762b351eb.en: An artistic interventions talk at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek on intervening in public space through the Ernst-Thälmann monument, with the editors of Gegen/Öffentlichkeiten. Part of Wissen zwischen Büchern; free, no registration.

07ad129701aedfe6b879ab13af93b736c05ab0e0.en: So inklusiv ist Europa, an international online conference with partners from Vienna and Jurbarkas in Lithuania on the lives of disabled people, work, disaster protection and the UN disability convention. Accessible, with translation and sign language.

eef2a18e9d99f22e457ee1ae597a6c6291094288.en: GameHub at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg, an open pop-up with Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, VR adventures and classic board games. It takes place on the third Tuesday of each month, 15:00-18:00. No registration.

4a01ad44dfb5f95344c09c61cfa55e47e16cd65f.en: A talk and discussion by film scholar Matthias Grotkopp at Bibliothek Tiergarten-Süd on how people in the Global South and Indigenous communities bear the costs of western lifestyles, and how their films show it.

45451efbe766e51ec0433d1096881be1588b714f.en: A three-part online training on antisemitism for interested members of civil society, offered by the Berlin adult education centre. It builds skills for recognising antisemitism and responding to it. No experience needed; registration required.

c62987b5b3fe67625f329900cf416c83859140eb.en: Picture books read aloud at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek for children up to age 6, on the first and third Tuesday of each month from 16:30 to 17:00. No registration; dates run through the second half of 2026.

9bf460b39f2b5728e76c3e62a2180789f32a1edd.en: A guided tour of the rbb broadcaster in Berlin, going behind the scenes of news, radio music and television production, and through the history of the Haus des Rundfunks. For ages 12 and up; arrive 10 minutes early at the tower foyer.

0708424b75ad7dc7cb805db062dd22e6ab75ff30.en: A workshop at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek where people creatively imagine a library of the future. The drafts are displayed during the festival month. Free, no advance registration.

75fcef6fcdb244a2a6a5bcd01b95475beed1cbc3.en: An open plotter workshop at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek to try textile printing, card design, relief printing and sticker design. No registration needed.

170b1ae45a525e7ad8ac2a267904de2dd25c7c47.en: Finnish author Martta Kaukonen reads from her psychological thriller Manipuliert at Janusz-Korczak-Bibliothek, in Finnish and German. Free entry.

14b3063a08eb1d7abf6a4c9fa1a54374a8831166.en: A Brasil Jazz Quartet teachers' concert at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek, with original compositions built on Brazilian grooves, played on saxophones, flutes, guitar, bass and drums.

933f9438eda5140fabdc47738d03c838ca016e34.en: A support group for family carers at Hansabibliothek, run by the PflegeEngagement contact point Mitte. Members share experience and encouragement in local discussion groups. Registration by phone or email.

3b36804a0bc992bb18115c109c8a975070265581.en: Lettekiez liest, a reading and talk with Magda Wystub from Queere Tiere, about the diversity of gender and relationships in the animal world. Held at Buchhandlung am Schäfersee with Kulturraum M5 and Bibliothek am Schäfersee.

ce8cf2d443eee66fd1a5fa4ceeb94d6e721abba4.en: A milonga afterwork at Schwartzsche Villa with tango DJ Claudia Dance, turning the theatre floor into a tango salon after work. Free entry with a donation requested. From next year it runs monthly, on the first Tuesday, January to April.

47ea606b49b35cbd8796f75cba61a5d6916b1f31.en: The documentary Grenzland by Andreas Voigt, filmed in the German-Polish border region along the Oder and Neisse, follows people on both sides of the river on home, belonging and the search for happiness. Kulturhaus Karlshorst, entry 5 euros, 3 reduced.

b0a906a1ab50d93756a5a7368608d6756d6c9ce9.en: Berliner Redekünstler at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek on the first and third Tuesday of each month. Participants hear interesting speeches and receive constructive feedback. Guests are welcome; no registration needed.

5a8773724772ec66090504cdd89291fe1a3f9b8d.en: Jung, aber Denkmal, the second event of a series with the Berlin Chamber of Architects at Urania Berlin's Kleist hall on 3 November at 19:30, also livestreamed. The programme and speakers will be announced later.

6c8cd0f3c0612f3da259df1aae47db0efa66b89e.en: Veranstaltungen neu denken: Kreislaufwirtschaft in Aktion, an interactive event at Hotel Berlin bringing together hotels, caterers, equipment providers and event agencies to put circular economy principles into daily operations.

40d4ba06afc3a84cd183c58a55cfe6a033975017.en: A phone and computer course at BALL e.V. Bürgerhaus Südspitze for seniors, run with the Netcomputer Club Berlin on the first Wednesday of each month, 10:00-12:00. Bring your own device.

e098dd63602b9bac1414ee4d39372e926f9b8349.en: A comic reading by Steffen Gumpert, Licht ins Dunkel, at Colosseum Berlin for kindergartens and school classes. It is a riddle mystery with ghosts and secrets for ages 6 and up. Free; registration via the Pankow library form.

1563e20d684caf648b91b29769d58d786a3e701b.en: A phone and computer course at Bürgerhaus Südspitze on the first Wednesday each month, run for seniors with the netcomputer Club Berlin. It has a small expense allowance of 2 euros, and volunteers who share their skills are welcome.

d94c4da834505a564ac77f3e174662cb29fb7753.en: A talk on an age-friendly neighbourhood at Stadtteilbibliothek Friedrich von Raumer on 4 and 5 November 2026, on participation in the neighbourhood, accessible public space and the new Berlin care law, led by Dr. Michael Weinhardt. Free, no registration.

000c6e1c5bd76525805ad49218b6e606ae570446.en: A comic reading by Nora Borkenhagen, Bo und der erste Biss, at Colosseum Berlin for children aged 6 and up. A vampire child who does not want to bite befriends a cemetery mouse and an angel statue. Free; registration via the Pankow library form.

15045057d17b455f92f98f85302b14c4aad88809.en: A police talk on senior safety at home and on the road at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek, covering shock calls, the grandchild trick and traffic safety in the dark months. Free, pre-registration requested.

6ac8cfb9e855f5d666bb2999ae25666a083c7554.en: A family café at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek with a play corner, where parents chat over coffee and get information on courses, everyday support and parenting from the Lankwitz family centre. Free, no advance registration.

eb12f62efc9af3c21707bdfa851d5fb8c92f2d7f.en: Digital-Zebra on tour in Lichtenrade at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade, on the first Wednesday of each month from 13:00 to 15:00. It helps with doctor appointments, official matters, email addresses and digital tickets. Free, no registration.

3d1986ddff2a745ed81028e7c3cc546849beb7c1.en: A digital surgery at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek on e-books, audiobooks and streaming, which are available with a library card. It helps people who know the services but struggle to use them. Bring your device; registration by phone or email.

45650094d96598ff425798729c8913ed0dc42eab.en: Singing for all at Stadtteilzentrum Pestalozzi-Treff on the first Wednesday of each month from 14:30 to 15:30, with folk songs and schlager. Coffee and cake from 3 euros. Registration by phone.

0e4a4febab84284990a3dbf9e5fab5bf08c64940.en: A musical reading by Gudrun Bernhagen at Pestalozzi-Treff on 4 November 2026 at 14:30, from her novel about a girl's childhood between 1945 and 1952, accompanied by two musicians. Entry 6 euros including coffee; registration requested.

816cdfb3fb7b45a250be5726390cf81646ab05a8.en: A speed-dating event for schools and companies in Marzahn-Hellersdorf, Lichtenberg and Treptow-Köpenick. Teachers meet up to 12 companies and agree on career orientation offers such as internships. Online follow-up on 23 November 2026.

ffae4e876a4451225775474fcaec9f9b5a4fd554.en: The cabaret Wir sind nicht alt, aber sexxy at Kulturhaus Karlshorst, with Dagmar Gelbke and Margit Meller as two cheerful retired women with satirical music. Run with Volkssolidarität Berlin; reservation required. Entry 25 euros, 16 reduced.

3b1447d50011ea7d61b3f8189593bc75893455e6.en: Chess in the garden at Margarete-Kubicka-Bibliothek for everyone aged 6 and up. In bad weather the game moves indoors. Free, no registration.

f301ab10dcad4449e17e6f9b034240758bceec1e.en: A workshop at the Berlin State Centre for Political Education in Ostkreuz on recognising conspiracy stories, their links to antisemitism and far-right actors, and strategies for dealing with family or friends who believe them.

4b70426887d75b6792d99cb99bb324b4e264feb1.en: Literarischer Kaffeeplausch presents Des Kaisers neue Kleider, Birgit Letze-Funke's reinterpretation of Andersen's tale for adults. A vain emperor is sold a fantastic nothing by a clever thief. At Mittelpunktbibliothek Ehm Welk; free, no registration.

dedd441b3858273527735b32834fcd0c5d8feb3f.en: A reading afternoon at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek on the first Wednesday of each month at 15:30 for children from age 3. Favourite soft toys are welcome. Part of the FEIN pilot project; no registration.

f6c33bba2dc3c8d646c8eb4916b536969299ae96.en: Homework help for grades 1 to 6 at Bibliothek Tiergarten-Süd on Wednesdays from 15:30 to 18:00, in a quiet setting. Not held during school holidays.

63b2150785475d4693407bd4e05586c827956b3c.en: Schnipsel & Schnapsel, a family craft session at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek with community mother Fatma Mohammad from the Lankwitz family centre, for children aged 4 and up. Free; registration required.

f24bc359facfc03dd525571317307b37fe129bc0.en: A lantern walk through Tierpark Berlin around Martinmas, with a guide exploring animal customs, myths and legends alongside the traditional lantern procession.

6c8e91e5e98b9f5264bc4b80206b8127c19f04bb.en: A reading by Marie Hüttner from Rocky Winterfeld – Ziemlich neben der Spur at Bibliothek am Luisenbad. It is a travel adventure for readers aged 10 and up, about a boy who ends up on a van trip to Danzig with three odd classmates.

8115196683c676b48a1c01942dcfc2f7a1b4a97e.en: Gemeinsam Stricken at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek from September, knitting together in the first-floor KreativLounge for all ages, beginners and advanced. Registration required; a basic kit is available.

f3ab2d5016810d85cd6bc5645447038b1cc5c3ff.en: Wir gestalten Zukunft im Dialog, a series of eleven events in Neukölln from August to November 2026 on sustainability, participation and Europe. Run by the district's future unit with Volkshochschule Neukölln. Free, individually or as a series.

a047fdaef0a983fe42b79adecfd2bf9d5ec0fcf6.en: A training day at Johann-August-Zeune-Schule für Blinde on transitions and next steps for pupils with a visual impairment, covering obstacles, support options and further education. Teachers register via the regional training database.

02acc81f3391fde5834042ffe2b3a2290ed5d4e3.en: A family café for single parents and their children at Familienzentrum Zukunftshaus Wedding, with fresh snacks, coffee and tea prepared together. Please bring fruit or vegetable sticks rather than sugary snacks.

90368f01f5c68e3a24b1fbdcc8a2bcd0735bad7e.en: Exam help for students at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek on Wednesdays from 16:00 to 18:00 with social pedagogue Carlo Matthes. Support covers reading comprehension and structuring for school-leaving and other exams. Free, no registration.

ff2ab849b823132ca5209a9fc1a9102e2203bbd5.en: A Lesewelt read-aloud hour at Johanna-Moosdorf-Bibliothek every Wednesday from 16:00 to 17:00 for children aged 4 to 12.

1c86f3182c56a82f4f01d5e3e6fba7184b0329c5.en: Voll verspielt, an open games afternoon at Margarete-Kubicka-Bibliothek on the first Thursday of each month from 16:00 to 18:00, where families try out the library's family and board games.

7c544107087440010686b52deac5e305debb9ffe.en: makerKids – programming with LEGO at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek. Families with children aged 6 and up build fantasy models and program them with an app, with the Essential set for younger children and the Prime set for older ones. No registration.

712fe2a96f380789a61dfac27acddcefa8cf950e.en: The fourth part of a Freie Universität Berlin series on sustainability and planetary crises asks whether the concept is a political battle term or essential for the future. The opening talk is given by Ulrich Brand. Online registration required.

7c56c8141ea7945d94cb20e52d8eee8bed5b20f1.en: Meet the Scientist at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek. Visitors explore neuroscience at a digital information point with short films, then talk directly with NeuroCure researchers. Part of Wissen zwischen Büchern.

3edadc1d14d735a2e0f151b941aae16770e07c8e.en: Die drei Stadtmusikanten, a family concert at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek as part of the Berliner Märchentage. Children help the musicians look for a missing cat, performed by the Bardomaniacs. Free for ages 4 and up.

d30ccde8ee0eeb706005de1c6f2c5c3cf78804f4.en: Freddi und der Zauberkasten, a kamishibai storytelling session at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg on how smartphones can become a habit trap, and how children and parents find a way out together. Free; registration by email or at the desk.

c3673e57aae9d0137553b8cfe531333104c8ae41.en: Lesewelt Berlin volunteers read aloud at Bruno-Lösche-Bibliothek for children up to age 12, sparking the joy of reading. Dates follow the school term; parents are welcome.

78badd59162a60d42da738ec44b27676891ef862.en: A family reading meetup at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, introducing silent books, which tell their stories through illustrations. Families read one together, choose more to explore and finish with a small creative response. Free, no registration.

ea9993b5e2b45a7b7722466d1b602c242e15165b.en: ExpertenRat Wildtiere in der Stadt at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek. Silke Voigt-Heucke explains how people and urban wildlife such as foxes, wild boars and hedgehogs can live together, and where to find reliable help. Registration required from 7 October.

cb4fe717c3a34e4677c9fda54c5e3d62a5b6afaa.en: A reading from Raumrauschen by Matin Soofipour Omam at Schiller-Bibliothek. The play searches for a shared language and draws on the author's own arrival in Germany, followed by questions and conversation with the author.

2e86dee7438fe095b1b1198c9e35a67f0534f7f9.en: A games evening at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof on the first Wednesday of each month. Visitors come alone or with friends, bring their own games or learn new ones.

18e3da9bb3ddb6fe757ca0a311b6af9d2380bd00.en: Europa kontrovers at Pfefferberg Haus 13, organised by Europa-Union Berlin with partners. It asks how resilient Berlin and Europe are to disinformation, polarisation, war and climate change, and how civil peace-building and disaster prevention can help.

e83d43649fca0344c8efbabd4672af76bbd049f0.en: A documentary screening of Uferfrauen by Barbara Wallbraun at Bettina-von-Arnim-Bibliothek, on lesbian life in the GDR through the stories of six women, followed by a talk with protagonist Elke Prinz. The film has won several awards.

b4c8c03f796527406a573760afb63b5cd77021bb.en: Public guided tours of the Köpenicker Blutwoche memorial, in a former court prison, on 7 and 21 October and 4 and 18 November at 18:00. The tours recall the 1933 Nazi terror in which at least 23 people died. Free, no registration.

0bc0ce8702619bd40c26681e19fde1b2316cca71.en: Feng Shui vom Vortag, a witty show of songs and piano by Emil Bach at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek. Absurd connections, surprising wordplay and unpredictable punchlines. Free entry; registration by phone or email requested.

c6b59b861977167e1a964aa8a90bbd2e38194276.en: Özge İnan reads from Die Dichterin at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda on 4 November 2026 at 19:00. The novel is about authenticity, appropriation and the power of scandal, and Georgina Fakunmoju moderates. Free entry; pre-registration required.

1be209224428369dbdddc8fdcaf55fc278358f6e.en: Science for Fiction at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg, where Aiki Mira reads from the science fiction thriller Denial of Service. Set in Frankfurt, it imagines privatised police and transport linked to the city through implanted chips. Free, no registration.

3344d18b650346775272ab223a9ff5c5336efccd.en: Arno Zillmer's Open Mic at WABE, one of Berlin's most elaborate open mics, where young and young-at-heart artists perform each month, and the audience picks the act of the month. Entry 5 euros.

10976e7524940e6f0856f305ea5daf0d9af8d053.en: Lane 8's Europe Tour, presented by Goodlive Artists. Wheelchair users with the 'B' designation should call the hotline, which is staffed every day from 10:00 to 18:00.

4003403aa1e30a2e1e791c40cf82cd21885a2e6e.en: Trevor Wallace's The Alpha Beta Male at a Berlin comedy club, presented by Live Nation. Under-16s must be accompanied by an adult, and no one under 6 is admitted. Accessible tickets are arranged through a contact form or hotline.
