90bf6ced0f93ced0d36b88ec65966f6d593ff8fa.en: Haute & Freddy, presented by Live Nation. Wheelchair users and people with severe disabilities should book standard tickets, and carers are admitted free without a ticket.

1f0824973d247460e471c4734861c6339db58767.en: A picture book cinema for children aged 4 and up at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek every Wednesday at 10:00. Registration is required from the first working day of the previous month.

f71b4b0ceb190de49bb955037577230f6ea92957.en: Kuratieren. Sorgen für Wissen und Gesellschaft, a conference at the Humboldt Forum on how universities and museums can care for society. Four panels on nature, living together, health and the future feature curators and researchers from Berlin.

32e06b2a3ac9e82f43525d6e0ba5d0ef54c29559.en: TheaterFusion's Wind im Gummistiefel at the Kulturhaus Spandau gallery, a children's piece from the Jahreszeitenquartett about wind, rain boots, puddles and a mouse named Jakob. Reservations by phone.

a97618bd36c2e80b2a614d80a42fdf9721f97e94.en: A children's book reading with Claudia Opitz at Kulturhaus Karlshorst, Das Zebra und der Kolibri, about friendship and togetherness for children aged 5 to 7. Reservation required; entry 3 euros.

36346b242d30233883eca23b1b70a0965570942f.en: Creepy interactive Halloween stories at Schwartzsche Villa, an extra session by LiteraturInitiative Berlin exploring monster and ghost tales and story games. Entry 5 euros; it is an additional date to the 1 October event.

d2e6389d9437f2de524053be8c6da066ff9d8402.en: Little Steps Lab at Kiezanker 36, an open meetup for expectant parents, parents and babies up to 12 months, with media for babies, gentle movement and exchange. Free, registration via the pretix link.

a6af1728ebb5fa06ba991c50234b46d6feb150f2.en: The exhibition Aufbruch at Mittelpunktbibliothek Ehm Welk, with works by participants in the Dienstagsmaler course led by artist Anna Görner. They interpret departure in watercolour, acrylic, pastel, charcoal and paper.

4ef8e27ff2bc2e45089517a2f03ad4e28241abcf.en: EU-FÖRDERUNG Kompakt, an online session on Creative Europe, the EU culture funding programme with 2.55 billion euros for 2021 to 2027. It covers funding for innovative projects at the crossroads of culture, media and technology. Free, registration required.

c5546af2590384e4406ae6733b33b1a7dd043ded.en: A solar system discovery session at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda on 5 November 2026, 13:00-15:00, with a craft for children and a family quiz on planets and moons, presented with the DLR research centre. Free, no registration.

6b0660e03cbb493eba8853ad2d63bd5a53d5f117.en: A craft afternoon at Bibliothek Heinrich-von-Kleist on the first Thursday of each month from 14:00 to 17:00, for children aged 5 and up. Materials and tools are provided. Free, no registration.

c40e5e3f723a420885b0768710461c4b3136c31f.en: A Repair Café at Bibliothek Tiergarten-Süd on the first and third Thursday of each month from 14:00 to 17:00, where neighbours with craft skills fix things. Book by phone; one item per person.

fb2dde2740db8c294e142cd06bb599c19837660b.en: A 1950s memory afternoon at Hertha-Müller-Haus with quizzes, singing and surprises, starting at 14:00. Entry 5 euros; tickets go on sale on 12 October at the association office.

89d59e1be1c3298b329e687df0e26b2551c394fd.en: A political reading circle on social science books at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof-Schöneberg, run with Volkshochschule Tempelhof-Schöneberg. Participants may suggest books. Registration required.

61948571d75f7a7ab0075b39dca26aab95b46f29.en: A seven-evening European journey at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek, visiting Spain, the Netherlands, Greece and Poland, then France and Hungary in autumn, with local tastings and a November review. Registration requested.

4dd6b228a3dcec20807d86b143f74bb18a4ace0e.en: A documentary screening of Spuren – Die Opfer des NSU at Kino b-ware, about the ten people murdered by the NSU neo-Nazi cell between 2000 and 2007, and how relatives keep their memory alive. Entry 8 euros, 6 reduced, plus 1.50 euros.

f0406c5f36ca32cfd8a58bc5a806f9f05984bfc5.en: A panel on what helps against antisemitism, ahead of 9 November, at the Berlin State Centre for Political Education. Speakers include Marina Chervinsky, Sina Arnold, Anne Helm and Dekel Peretz.

132f6e7ac472484e2cdd4e71a2dffc61eaa41191.en: Parallelprotokolle, mobile writing workshops at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek. Two to four writers silently record a place and its surroundings for 20 minutes, creating anonymous, multi-voiced texts. Registration by email.

00fd44e08353f80fa36a54e747a1b5fb1a8fe6b9.en: A toy swap at Bibliothek Tiergarten-Süd, where children bring up to five good toys to trade for new ones. Toys can only be swapped, not donated. A Lesewelt reading runs at the same time, 16:00-17:00.

d225956637101b147a801f379a2722f6c1bc6a62.en: Kaffee und KI, a workshop at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek on phone security settings, strong passwords, passkeys, spam and phishing. It is aimed at women aged 60 and over, and younger women are welcome. Starts at 15:00; registration by email or phone.

052c5c177f2138e68e5e004c6507926c80d6e1bf.en: Kaffee und Bilderbuchkino, a picture book cinema at Familienzentrum Jungfernheide, on the first Thursday of each month from 15:30 to 16:30, followed by an open café. Free, no registration.

aecc375097fe50466365f74023567ac69cbebea4.en: An open drumming and rhythm group for adults at Nachbarschafts- und Familienzentrum Kiek in, on the first and third Thursday of each month from 15:30 to 16:30. No experience needed; free, registration required by phone.

e055bb76d301e3e311ef540b791bccbe50c64850.en: Leserucksack mal anders, a reading programme at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek with VHS Neukölln, for families with children aged 3 to 6 on Thursdays. It includes singing, reading and crafts for up to five adults and their children per group. No registration.

19ad091c9ee2c5f57a2bb63a855ed20c9844139f.en: Kaffee und Bilderbuchkino at Familienzentrum Jungfernheide, a picture book cinema on the first Thursday each month from 15:30 to 16:30, followed by a free café with coffee. No registration.

8b78e297fc15bd7f473283f2432fcff3f413d900.en: Tüftellab at Bibliothek im Märkischen Viertel, a Thursday programme for ages 5 to 16 and their families. Children program Dash robots and Blue-Bots and build simple circuits with LEDs and conductive tape. Free, a parent must attend; run with TüftelLab.

2dbd95d46354b47b293cb371cf50a51afb384450.en: A youth drop-in with social workers from Mobiles Wohnzimmer at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek every Thursday from 16:00 to 18:00, on school stress, bullying, conflicts with parents, love or sex. Confidential; no registration.

86fe2eea6ef30e5e93acab3f90e4a7dc42c1aa44.en: Lesewelt Berlin read-aloud sessions at Bibliothek Tiergarten-Süd for children up to age 12, sparking the joy of reading. Dates follow the school term; parents are welcome.

d3063eb1f41eccdf94117195579710fa65540bcf.en: Mobiles Atelier at Schiller-Bibliothek, a free, inclusive creative studio for adults aged 18 and over, led by art therapist Marco Fiamin. Participants paint with tempera, draw and work with clay at their own pace. Accessible, with assistance; five sessions.

8a155bff4c4094d365a4f89b46e652e9591280a3.en: Prüfungs-Coaching at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, where Mobiles Wohnzimmer youth workers help with exam components, presentations and learning for school projects. Contact by email.

87918bf191a84783e8bf0185aa47cd5956519a18.en: A board game afternoon at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek on the first Friday of each month from 16:00 to 18:00, for young and old to discover, try and take home games.

735ce8e178c6949ce56b9750a4ecc9fef0105d10.en: Herr Eichhorn und der erste Schnee, a puppet play at Bibliothek am Wasserturm based on Sebastian Meschenmoser's picture book, for ages 3 and up. Three friends search for snow, and it finds them. Free while seats last.

27734acc30117c98887f15d61534320f0424f4c3.en: A reading by Patricia Vellard from her family saga Gift und Honig, set between Paris and the Brazilian rainforest. It follows a woman starting again after 40 and a son searching for his own path. Free; registration by email.

f342b8c225691759aa56073052fe77f7583cad57.en: Read-aloud sessions at Schiller-Bibliothek by volunteer Stadtteilmütter, reading in Turkish and Arabic for children up to age 12. Dates follow the school term; parents are welcome.

3306cfab6db96e0b4295f5b740701948c253b85c.en: Do It Donnerstag at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof on the first and third Thursday of each month, where a different craft project awaits every time. Materials are provided; adults only.

60ac5b04ca1260d3aa3995afa63a08d5cb58c098.en: A Lesewelt Berlin read-aloud at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek every Thursday from 16:30 for children aged 4 and up, an hour of stories, except in school holidays. Free, no advance registration.

3adc46913b8ec65051f3044a67dc68ae8a32643d.en: A German and Chinese picture book cinema at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek on the first Thursday of each month for families with children aged 4 and up, with stories told in two languages.

4caf2b80481763840b0b7a19f109376ecb93b4e0.en: POPUP-KINO with the Wachowski siblings at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek, a film series where the audience chooses the next film from the Cinemathek. This year's theme is perception and reality. Recommended from age 16; 136 minutes, English with German subtitles.

be88f9898a0948469090caf3e9293b527d616020.en: A writing café at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek with four speakers offering writing prompts. Sessions cover clever animals, and chance and fate. A donation of 5 euros is recommended; no registration.

9675ceacd3194d928b81e6575f0f4ac8ff33ddb2.en: Fenster zur Welt: Lügen über meine Mutter, an online reading with Daniela Dröscher on 5 November 2026 from 17:00 to 18:00. She reads about a 1980s childhood in the Hunsrück and family power dynamics. Registration via the Pankow library form.

a03f90b25cee288a57e58446b0383ff4bb2076da.en: Das Diskussions-Experiment at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg, a free conversation on what we need to own in order to be happy, using experimental moderation techniques. Registration required.

9f7cd1d4a0f2d1e12a7f8cbdfa189524cca35cc5.en: Seitenweise Museum, a reading series at Zitadelle Spandau. Johann Reißer reads PULVER on 5 November at 18:00, and further readings follow in February, April and June 2027. Free, no registration.

d4581372cdfea6abd3ac38a780ca796bb6e7d0e4.en: Frauen und Revolution at the Berlin State Centre for Political Education's Besuchszentrum Ostkreuz, on women as actors in revolutions from 1848 and 1918 to today. Linked to the exhibition Stimmen at forum 1848. Free, online registration.

22abfae50f193ef404583cd054e844c1beb17087.en: Auris – Puls der Angst, a reading by Vincent Kliesch at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek on 5 November 2026 from 18:00 to 20:00. The extracts come from the sixth and final part of the thriller series co-developed with Sebastian Fitzek. Free, no registration.

1290f4dc98156e8a96ef63f1417037f881622bb3.en: Drones over Berlin and Europe: who protects the government district, critical infrastructure and European airspace? A Europa-Union Berlin discussion at Studio Chérie with a podcast partner, limited to 20 places; online registration required.

9718a40dc5e9ddae4b7e6f7ca5b611235b11da56.en: Queer Thursday at Stadtteilbibliothek Buch with Frauke Hippler, a talk on hidden contact ads from women seeking women in the East German magazine Wochenpost, and how women found each other without public meeting places.

b63e9fb2e403f7c9d37ba9beeac23572e8ad437f.en: A reading and talk at Stadtteilbibliothek Karow with Berlin comic artist Rinah Lang about her debut Peri Meno, on the menopause. Gynaecologist Dr. Wiebke Haag takes part.

aad3aeadc663e4ad2e60bcffe2f7fc54c352cb53.en: The opening of Giacometti. Figur. Raum at Gutshaus Steglitz on 5 November 2026 at 18:00. It presents four bronzes, plus paintings and paper works from the Klewan collection, with Helmut Klewan reading from his memoirs.

cd172969a47fc0c70cee01e452c5cd0435f7992b.en: Politik und Moral, a talk by Dr. Michael Fuchs at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek on the relationship between politics and morality, given during the festival month with Volkshochschule Steglitz-Zehlendorf. Free; registration by phone or email.

0ad645d03dd5cbbd953203d23c7d769ad34b0e9f.en: Wie politisch darf Zivilgesellschaft sein?, the third LondonBerlinDemocracy event at the Berlin State Centre for Political Education. It compares Berlin and London on whether civil society can be neutral and where political engagement ends.

7bb434c18b4216f807dd752b133ca97c2f689233.en: A talk with contemporary witnesses at Museum Lichtenberg, part of the programme for the exhibition Klingel bei Anna. The witnesses share queer life in Lichtenberg with co-curator Karl-Heinz Steinle, with rare interview and film clips.

17ac72401754b96db4465b5d85c692411af5d91b.en: ZuGast with Thomas Kramer at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek on the GDR comic MOSAIK and its historical, literary and artistic sources. Entry 4 euros, 3 with a library card; free tickets for HOWOGE tenants; advance sale from 8 October.

d3a940dbf40c62199918363661f6d3661b6db484.en: Gast auf Zeit – damals wie heute?, a panel at the Berlin State Centre for Political Education on 65 years since the German-Turkish recruitment agreement. It discusses work, migration and belonging, then and now, including workers arriving from India today.

6e630a5ab3db896da0720fa4f1a686e56192059e.en: Schule trifft Unternehmergeist at BLiQ, a two-day programme on entrepreneurship in schools. A community day on 10 November 2026 at IHK Berlin lets pupils build business models and pitch them to a jury. Teacher registration required.

f8a0564021277a4579904efdad19d69f933642b2.en: A 3D pen workshop at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek where children draw figures in the air, build them layer by layer and add a small LED light, which they take home as a lantern. It lasts about 60 minutes.

92ca987c43accd46d37304d4f0bd69d5afad8b89.en: A dialogue with Zakariyya Meißner and Shai Hoffmann at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek, from the Trialog project on Israel and Palestine. It asks how the conflict affects young people and how schools can make the topic discussable.

8a3362c52b4da66c6f57831b30c932e612ca0644.en: Ringelblumensalbe at Bibliothek Tiergarten-Süd, a zero-waste workshop on making marigold ointment through a warm infusion, with zero-waste body-care tips. Bring a glass jar; registration required.

4729ae3bcb076b1a1d4cbc6e5cc96afd9c2364a6.en: Maxim Leo reads Einatmen ausatmen at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek, a funny and moving novel about a stressed executive sent to a mindfulness coach who is himself in a crisis. Entry 4 euros, 3 reduced; free tickets for HOWOGE tenants.

55ef9cff2db4011b395fb3655414826ddd9c2582.en: A German-Polish literature tour with Paweł Sołtys at Club der polnischen Versager on 5 November 2026. Warsaw and Berlin writers meet to discuss literature and the relations between the two capitals.

45a04433e56e559987b1b56d3b4709ef0008aca3.en: Christiane Rösinger reads from The Joy of Ageing at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof, a sharp anti-age guide by a musician and grandmother facing ageing and money worries. Registration by online booking.

d34c6a2e040cf65ea9294a7f7c02b457c809b2b4.en: Effi Briest, a talk and reading by Claudia von Gélieu at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek on the real woman behind Fontane's novel, Elisabeth von Ardenne, who began a new life as a nurse in Zehlendorf in 1889. Free; registration by phone or email.

2a761d6e463698b2927112a085be27dd54932fc4.en: Bielfeldts Begegnungen at WABE, where chansonnier Rainer Bielfeldt meets actress and singer Antonia Bill, with duets and songs. Entry 20 euros, 15 reduced.

cb12554e2e6900a4fc3e419121e7aad1c56a6975.en: The Berlin Conference 2026 at Allianz Forum, on the theme Europe: The Art of Belonging. It asks what holds societies together beyond institutions and treaties, with workshops and participatory formats on cities, civil society and culture.

c8fe9ab22e5d7b532bc4296eb568c2a9ba578fb5.en: POLYPROBLEM-Camp 2026: Wechsel-Geld, a barcamp at Mitosis LAB asking who will finance the circular economy. Topics include new business models, banks, impact start-ups and NGOs. Participants bring their own topics.

b3268592012e86412fbf13fa99f822ef65ddbb9c.en: KLIMAANPASSUNG: Der Berlin Kongress at EUREF-Campus, a year after Berlin's climate adaptation law. It asks where the city stands, which measures work in practice and how to keep implementation moving. Registration via the Klimabildung website.

fbd876b6eeb954429d74275205ad451ab6bb971d.en: A live online seminar from the Bitkom Academy on moving from linear to circular business models, with an overview of successful circular economy models and digital levers. Registration required.

de873815c817034c138bc42528ec34cc7d79be50.en: Bücherbabys, a parent-child course at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek with eight Friday sessions from 2 October at 10:00, for up to eight children aged 1 to 2 and their parents. Stories, songs and play. Free; registration required.

a43f2d719b7071c6bc8e755d87fa64c7b0eab75c.en: A planned memory training at Stadtteilzentrum Kaulsdorf, to support thinking skills and social interaction across generations. Interested people can ask at the centre about taking part.

8f8f9a165df36d7e0d5002909acede2b95b84064.en: Free pension advice at Stadtteilzentrum MOSAIK for people insured under the statutory pension scheme. It covers questions on pension claims and applications, explained in plain language.

9a44361f36afef10e4b0cda1c28f8acb63360cfe.en: Giacometti. Figur. Raum at Gutshaus Steglitz, with bronzes, paintings and paper works from the Klewan collection. Four bronzes by Alberto Giacometti form the centre of an exhibition on figures and space.

62516f36df68c8022a33fb8b0b2606f328df005d.en: ARRIVO at Stadtteilbibliothek Karow, career and training preparation for people interested in health, nursing and social care. It offers language courses, B1 and B2 exam preparation, computer courses and internships. Free advice in several languages.

224be34b14546c53538061afc3a062c6a5d8f15b.en: A seniors' chat at Freizeitstätte Süd with the local seniors' representative Klaus Eisenreich and the head of the seniors' council, Mathilde Kannenberg. Topics are open; coffee costs 3 to 4 euros. Phone registration.

891ced028e597ee9bb3ef4ad3e1c7bf94671eb0f.en: Chess for children aged 5 to 12 at Eberhard-Alexander-Burgh-Bibliothek on the first Friday of each month, with professional coaching for beginners and advanced players. Free; registration in the library.

32e0c136c96499a573329efe57f35cd33b3f4c95.en: Waffeln und Bilderbuchkino at Familienzentrum Jungfernheide on the first Friday of each month from 14:00 to 15:00, with picture book stories and freshly baked waffles. Run with Stadtteilbibliothek Halemweg. Free, no registration.

a435d6939a160d599f34f110d5ea7c08ef93dcc9.en: A dance afternoon at Hans-Söhnker-Haus with solo entertainer George Jackson. Doors open at 13:00 and the event starts at 14:00. Entry 3 euros plus 3 euros for coffee.

cf915f1dcc20602b3e4b01e2b2c911baa52f89af.en: A lantern workshop at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek, where children make individual lanterns with a local artist. Free, no registration.

8e492597a1d962186a1c3d171cdc8d6001a5f73b.en: A research garden at Bodo-Uhse-Bibliothek with hands-on experiments for young researchers aged 5 and up. Meet in front of the library.

519f37783e5a0d3ae065301db68a5e2fd8fb2a4d.en: Lichtenrade liest, a book presentation at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade with the Lichtenrader Bücherstube. Every two months new books are shown, to buy on the spot or borrow, alternating with a local reading circle. Free, no registration.

1660fbbd1045c5aac2773c914511d5898198bac7.en: A bookbinding workshop at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek with the house bookbinder, for ages 12 and up. Participants bind a book with library motifs. Free, no advance registration.

af6ff072b7b18b29bfdc5e27a77cff10125c088b.en: KulturLeben Berlin at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek, a sign-up point where people on low incomes can register for free tickets to culture through around 600 partner venues. Proof of income is needed. Sign-ups on the first Friday of each month, 16:00-18:00.

17097b5c22a69552e3126b6258f65e4093ff57d4.en: Schlaf schön Schaf: die Show at Margarete-Kubicka-Bibliothek, a musical reading with Felix Isenbügel. Little Betty cannot sleep, and in a fantastic world the sheep turn into an orchestra. For families and children aged 3 to 7. Free, no registration.

b52e020cf935a6177bc6a6cda7419a1a106de147.en: Brittas Buch by Rotonda Teatro at Kiezanker 36 on 6 November 2026, 16:00-17:00. It is an interactive clown and puppet show for children aged 3 to 7 about a chocolate-loving rat who finds adventure in a book. Free; pre-registration required.

5baec73c08978ffc2451002fd578e54925fc1650.en: Die Woll-Lustigen, an open knitting and crochet group at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel for all ages, for company and exchange. Bring your own project. No registration.

9173c32d4dfd2ebaf44cbf304056cf8d18297f17.en: Shadow theatre by Scuraluna presents Peter und der Wolf, Prokofiev's musical tale, as a shadow puppet play with orchestral music at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek. For ages 4 and up. Free, no advance registration.

e8ba6ae01897325cd9dae6bbcde4cf4f8a07cf85.en: The Lankwitzer Lesekreis at Stadtteilbibliothek Lankwitz, a monthly reading circle that discusses a book chosen together. Registration by email.

95a5a79340dabdb51be3c4c305970ba6cedc8351.en: English reading aloud by volunteer readers at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek for children up to age 12, to spark a love of books. Parents are warmly invited.

9fd21c3cd3c876d1236c9b282ef45e36bef03def.en: A reading by Dr. Hajo Schumacher from 12 Gesetze der Macht at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek on 6 November 2026 at 17:00. It analyses the success strategies and political instincts behind Angela Merkel's chancellorship.

56a3edb034cad86cee7b0cb6a2cb1d853155737d.en: ExpertenRat: Die Erben Aitmatows at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek, with Jani Gutmann and Andrea Schroeter reading from their book on the Kyrgyz writer Chingiz Aitmatov and his family. Entry 2 euros; advance sale from 9 October.

c82e47be1c3bd17a51499d3bcba2d82baf570f8d.en: A board game evening at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek, presenting favourite classic and modern games with the rules explained. Recommended from age 10. Free entry; registration by phone or email.

a1340b38d211a103b16d6fdbf51ccd2deb25dd29.en: Systemische Aufstellung at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek, a systemic constellation workshop that makes hidden dynamics visible, to help with decisions, conflicts and old patterns. A protected space; registration by email.

b44855d50268669f035d52fae682d313bb7ebd0c.en: Wissensinseln: Raumforschung hautnah at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, where researchers from the TU Berlin's Re-Figuration of Spaces project discuss how digitalisation, crises and climate change are changing the spaces we live in. Free, no registration.

ad0b6cfcbbc4a544e3be28822901695982ee7e2c.en: Das Wir in Wirtschaft, a reading and talk with Feline Tecklenburg at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek. It shows how care work, which makes productivity possible, is underfunded, and ways to change that. Free, no registration.

14e2a4258f5f5d3909e2d50cac464c5c69f8dd80.en: Lettekiez liest, a reading and talk with Misha Schoeneberg at Bibliothek am Schäfersee about his father's silence after surviving Auschwitz, and how historical trauma passes through generations up to 7 October 2023.

3b110987dea83b076db5027e3e47410986d55fde.en: Petra Tessendorf reads Küstenstille at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade, the fourth book in her Baltic Sea crime series. It weaves art, family ties and coastal atmosphere into a cosy crime. Free; registration required.

19b6de215057988784e10ed54724eca5e7a78083.en: The international conference Im Blick der Anderen on 6 and 7 November 2026 at the Studio Akademie der Künste. It examines how East and West Berlin postwar modernism, from Karl-Marx-Allee to Interbau 1957, was reported abroad during the Cold War.

abfc07cfeb9d9f496d56c1873ad970db57cd0a8a.en: A teachers' concert, Klangwelten entdecken, with music for violin and cello by Johanna Madden and Mikel Elgezabal Garmendia, in the music school's concert hall.

556837b4935e996b43c6f36569b3751f7c207520.en: A teachers' concert with the same programme of music for violin and cello by Johanna Madden and Mikel Elgezabal Garmendia, in the music school's concert hall.

decd6f3c339525e503804c5ee5d5f57d25a7c3c5.en: Move: Wie Fortbewegung das Leben der Tiere bestimmt at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, a reading by IGB researcher Sophia Kimmig on animal movement and river connectivity, followed by discussion. Free; ages 12 and up.

5fa5381ad93d1dcd8d5fc4cab36ab244709e54f7.en: A screening of the Nazi propaganda film Ich klage an (1941) at Museum Treptow, with an introduction by film scholar Irina Vogt and a discussion afterwards. The film is restricted and may only be shown with scholarly context.

035ba1ce109642e43207665fc80e76cbdd8d8448.en: The JoDeL Matrix at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek, a 1.5-hour yodel-themed session with karaoke, a wheel of fortune and games, on tradition that can change and have fun. Registration via Pretix, on 6 November.

76fbc636d3da09e04c353b98955351980c7aa925.en: Roda de Choro at A Livraria & MondoLibro, an ensemble concert of Brazilian instrumental music from the City West music school. A roda is a circle of musicians, the same format as a jam session, where choro is learned and played.

57d8592f161c3c282a9d9bf50afa829c63613227.en: Huldrelokkk, a Pan-Scandinavian ladies' folk trio at the Gotischer Saal in Zitadelle Spandau. Kerstin Blodig and her trio sing Scandinavian folk songs in three languages, with two fiddles and a guitar.

884e6a63a40b004ad1e153825b77fdd680682e03.en: Liquid Soul at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek, a concert by Gert Anklam and Beata Gatscha on the water-pipe organ they developed, with Indian master drummer Pandit Radheshyam Sharma. Registration required; start 20:00.

3dba4a7de38332b08243424915173aa2ac8e932e.en: UCHE YARA – BODYSCANNER Tour 2026 at Sonnenraum, presented by Goodlive Artists. Wheelchair users and people with severe disabilities pay the regular ticket price, and their companions enter free.

d78f658f803963eeb34317fda7ea15e358ccf77c.en: Results of the 2026 German-Polish Barometer presented at Der Tagesspiegel. The survey has run for 26 years and looks at how Poles and Germans see each other, focusing on the border region. It marks 35 years of neighbourhood between the two countries.

daa420d8d1f86244db8d2e6303f283061aa26ec2.en: eMO project market for charging infrastructure #8 at Berlin Partner, bringing providers and businesses together to find charging solutions for workplaces, homes and commercial buildings. Speakers from Tesla and Berlinovo. Registration required.

3ee507184755ace3ae30491eee8fa4d19aadbe13.en: Mut Muskel, an action art workshop with Radikale Töchter at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek for young people aged 16 and over, to build courage and turn concerns into action. Registration required; start 10:00.

dac797a642f3095402865517e52ce92ba56c5296.en: KULer Tag der Wissenschaft at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek, with lectures on water and lies, hands-on workshops on living with climate fever, and experiments. Lectures start at 10:30 and 12:00.

2fe2252f5e2cc9d9823c509086cdcf958984624d.en: FamilienSamstag Peter und der Wolf at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek with the Scuraluna Schattenbühne, a shadow play of Prokofiev's classic that introduces the instruments of a symphony orchestra. For ages 4 and up; entry 1 euro, advance sale from 13 October.

e43a3fe7764359ba0470b510920113c470365a9c.en: Digital-Zebra at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg, walk-in help with doctor appointments, official matters, email addresses and digital tickets. Bring your own device.

440cf1866ee38eb303d45863e3ff54cd3c610775.en: A cello ensemble workshop for cellists aged 12 and over from Musikschule Béla Bartók, playing together in a large cello orchestra with a programme from the Baroque to Bartók. Register online by 18 October 2026.

221d592bf99d72c306ef39ee29a4bc62e28d08af.en: A workshop with artist Maxim Rüthers at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek, linked to the exhibition Natur in der Stadt. Participants explore nature in urban space through art and make their own work. Free, no registration.

8dd10872920c39e73f51c14fba214d077ab91921.en: A breathwork introduction at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek led by Janine Lohse, exploring the power of conscious breathing. No prior knowledge needed; free, no registration.

d859002524a0ce195a8df57de482fdb98fbaffbf.en: Bunt ist die Welt, a book presentation and mini-workshop with Jenny Boidol at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek. A bear and a cat named Lola travel through 194 countries. For ages 5 and up; registration required.

fed0a82a1b79956af2cacb19e9882794b5450f0b.en: A chess club at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof, open to all ages and levels every second Saturday from 11:00 to 13:00, with boards, pieces and expert game leadership. Free, no registration.

d37fbc87eafc3a74cb6a7599f9a1668585643bc6.en: Von Frost & Schnee & warmer Stube, a storytelling session by Sabine Kolbe at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek. Winter tales from around the world come alive with paper and simple objects. For children aged 4 and up.

37630823c795efe6ab6a618de91fdc3bf5c5df95.en: Mitmachmärchen at Stadtteilbibliothek Karow, interactive fairy tales with singing, movement and laughter, where children become part of the story. For ages 5 and up, for the whole family.

37deba497e869be9a2c9961a00e4669cd77431c8.en: A string group concert in the church hall of the Evangelischer Campus Daniel, with pupils playing solo and in ensembles. Coordinated by Nils Arne Schneider.

522a0106c1f18e9f9ead74f721435229bfaab5ba.en: A family tinkering Saturday at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel on Ozobots. Families program the robots through landscapes with a pen, paper or an app, for children aged 6 to 12. Free, no registration.

e8a2d01147abcf4010d57e55f1c36617afb33903.en: Weder Mädchen noch Junge, sondern Maler, a creative workshop with children's author Marita Kelbl at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, combining reading, live drawing and painting. For ages 6 and up, up to 15 places; registration opens 4 September.

f57cf73be9cd857b1758d53e9b11d78e6b647bc9.en: ErzählZeit: Kamishibai at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek, a Japanese paper theatre session on the first Saturday of each month, for children and families. Dates include Snow White and Rose Red on 7 November.

508fd3caa38bf0c81b6e0847f03bbd63f850b755.en: Gockel Jockel und die Weizenähre by Theater auf dem Bügelbrett at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, a puppet play based on an Eastern European tale about a rooster who finds an ear of wheat. For ages 3 and up. Free, no advance registration.

e9befc40c2547f25eaf361686277bf52ec85ab79.en: A monthly writing workshop at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek for pupils aged 12 to 18, with feedback, word games, public readings and trips. Participants read their own work while the others listen silently before commenting.

c066aaf3f002dd4eb8a03203d545145634ba967a.en: A printing workshop with Meike Dölp at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek for children. They print with bubble wrap, leaves, string or a moosgummi block to make presents.

495afc937eb97811fa695f85909fdde316d2cb87.en: A creative and biographical writing workshop with Mechtild Römer at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek for adults. It takes a playful approach to words and texts. No prior knowledge needed, and nothing has to be handed in.

50357d556927a0ff2b9889651c2e080d5f4021e3.en: Standing and seated yoga at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek, with no mat needed. It suits beginners and seniors and is led by yoga teacher Sabine Klein. Free, no registration.

5cbbae0a791f8f3c61fe0f2458c09db632fa7337.en: A yarn craft workshop at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek, making an octopus or a doll from coloured yarn without sewing. Materials are provided; for ages 4 and up. Free, no registration.

bd47965dd83958e4a4be72feca7cb45100df9618.en: A lantern workshop at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda on 7 November 2026, 15:00-17:00, run with the Wühlisch-Vierzig neighbourhood centre. Participants make lanterns for a walk through dark streets. Materials provided against a donation.

7a2de628ee4c11aaf0eac898027d56436da098f3.en: Coding Lab Luanti II at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek for ages 10 to 18. Participants look under the hood of Luanti, an open-source Minecraft alternative, and create their own textures. Registration required; laptops are provided.

a960eb7418d80f89f1789ee210c7cd7c970250bb.en: Mephisto from the Neues Globe Theater Potsdam at Gutshof Schloss Britz, a live-music stage version of Klaus Mann's novel. It follows Berlin's Weimar artistic life to the rise of the Nazis. Entry 25 euros, 16 reduced.

3c63b73d000f80e3c94b32a02eac50c23bb33069.en: Annette Kruhl's satirical show Vom Karma-Coach ins Kuschel-Camp at Kulturhaus Spandau's theatre hall. It is a comic trip through the coaching jungle, with songs, dance and self-irony.

7341faa21705c81e48ae438888b7e79f0174656c.en: A concert by Die Drumline, led by Burkhard Sander, at Haus der Musik, playing Nebojša Jovan Živković's Trio per Uno.

f8665a658c5cf8bd3a903e4b49d46f7b8df93f8e.en: SCHAU MICH AN, a dance theatre piece for young audiences at Theater unterm Dach. Three dancers wrestle with a mountain of clothes about belonging and self-expression. Entry 15 euros, 10 reduced, 5 special price.

7ec4024b446e0241a67813b8af364ae163622404.en: A children's flea market at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel with stalls, face painting, balloon modelling, a picture book cinema and cake. Table reservations only on 12 October; bring your own cups and plates.

71c8ec93ad93e3639c63c2c20ecd51ad7922433b.en: Metropolis entdecken, a walking tour by historian Friedrich Burschel on brick and clinker expressionism in Steglitz-Zehlendorf, from the Heidehof houses to Wannsee station and St Michael's church. Free, registration requested.

10fcb30cd6e3868a2337988cb55ec493e75ceace.en: A Sunday concert at Schloss Biesdorf with guitarist Roger Tristao Adao, playing Spanish music from El cafè de chinitas to flamenco and Albéniz. Entry 8 euros, 6 reduced; cash only, phone registration needed.

34dd5835da117c9a5f28bc43c073e8e3412307ca.en: Nacht der UNRUHE, a world premiere at Schwartzsche Villa. On the eve of the First World War, painter Suzanne Valadon meets poet Heinrich Heine in Montmartre cemetery, to music by Eric Satie. Tickets 20 euros in advance, 18 reduced.

8a1e430257b1c3985c6769a40d957ccc0e7482a0.en: Das alles seine Ordnung hat, a documentary theatre piece at Theater unterm Dach about Nazi perpetrators, drawn from diaries and testimony, with two former supporters and a former camp guard. Ages 13 and up; tickets 15 euros, 10 reduced.

45cbe677ccb27e6da11a8c74534311960f20c8ee.en: KI verstehen und einsetzen, a media workshop at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek on using AI to develop ideas for democratic participation. Participants check sources and create a text, infographic or audio piece. Bring a laptop; maximum 12 places.

ec7ea148cbf9e53e2a58db89c29557e4ff0b0800.en: A clothes swap party at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek with youngcaritas Berlin and Letsact e.V. Visitors bring unwanted clothes to swap, or take found favourites for a small donation. Unswapped items go to the Caritas clothing store.

aea0d11efe4fe8057f2b38bd99a7f78b9afc2940.en: An Actionbound walk through Mariendorf from Richterstraße 48 to Mariendorfer Damm 30, telling the stories behind the Stolpersteine for ten people persecuted under the Nazis. It is interactive and supported by digital content.

8480491bc99520f1d4c57bcb6ec16f88fb740d2c.en: A public guided tour of the exhibition Wie erinnern wir? Wie erinnerst du? at the Dokumentationszentrum NS-Zwangsarbeit. It covers how memory forms, why it matters and how public memory works today.

b1bb23d55a853568243ce689b93ee036fd305319.en: A stroll through time at PETRI Berlin on 8 November 2026, 14:00-15:30. A guided walk through the Alt-Cölln neighbourhood between PETRI Berlin and the Humboldt Forum, part of the Berlin Path of Archaeology. Booking required; 10 euros.

63b9c199c64152c63d81f4d66e29642ed6d24844.en: A Latin American music workshop for families with children aged 4 and up at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek, led by Mauricio Nader. It explores rhythms and melodies with dance and many instruments.

80f1116895fc6ecf89fa8b552c26c1ab54800387.en: A repair café at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek on the second Sunday of each month, 15:00-18:00, where people fix their favourite things with help from experts. Tea, water and basic tools are provided.

8d0d25f9a4a850daf1e9afcec224ff0bb31598d2.en: Komm lachen, a laughter yoga session at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Bibliothek with mini-workshops and simple exercises for more lightness and joy in everyday life. Open to all.

4d848fff8cd4ed59ee074ac38994f731ed932ffc.en: Das flotte Duo at the Kulturhaus Spandau theatre hall. Singer Simone of the Berlin rock'n'roll band Petticoat and guitarist Holger Bogen take the audience on a musical trip through the 1950s and 1960s, with hits from Caterina Valente to Bill Haley.

8653dee17c1c51d39aae9ce01e6e55904f95546f.en: Das Tarapank kommt aus dem Wald, a storytelling session by Petra Venzke at Schwartzsche Villa for children aged 6 and up. It has rhythms, sounds, audience participation and drawing afterwards. Entry 5 euros.

7f455fb33558f79d525096a172ee183fb71112d3.en: A memorial concert on the 1938 Pogrom Night at Rathaus Schöneberg, with the GofenbergChor singing Yiddish and Hebrew songs. It is held with the ZURÜCKGEBEN foundation. Places are limited; registration required.

60f97946b8045c703fda6210654dd3abc47b4a46.en: A concert by the choir Cantus Magistri at Pauluskirche Zehlendorf, performing Pergolesi's Stabat Mater with the Arco Quartet and David Menge on continuo. Conducted by Judith Kamphues.

c40347b641c45304dc28727c9c128ea044c5cd39.en: KALLESLAM Poetry Slam at Kulturhaus Karlshorst, the 93rd edition, hosted by Ortwin Bader-Iskraut. Performers with their own texts can sign up on the night until 18:45. Entry 5 euros, 3 reduced.

6c277fd6054f5238f4b14bab2616efe5bc3f0f63.en: Kaey & José's record release concert Lieb(es)lingsLieder at WABE, with covers of German-language women musicians and special guest Erik Leuthäuser. Entry 20 euros, 15 reduced.

8cf292d3b9fb67e73c29540b725c8de717343d9f.en: Raphael Gimenes performs Caçador de Horizontes at Schwartzsche Villa. The Brazilian-Danish guitarist and singer blends South American rhythms, jazz and chamber music. Entry 10 euros.

00fef12916c41fd4b08858ea0ee57d83572d4560.en: A concert by the choir BeneCantemus at Herz-Jesu church, performing Hugo Distler's Totentanz, an a cappella work on human mortality, conducted by Juliane Syrjakow.

fa25611455432c0abcf6b11b4e2e43242ffb411f.en: Ikan Hyu's Swim With Sharks Tour 2026 at Mikropol. The venue listing gives details only in its German version.

1d1decab3f98a76cb9a417de530b8adba3e8c0cc.en: A picture book reading of Ulrich Hub's Geburtstag im Staubsauger at Kino Toni for kindergartens and school classes, for ages 6 and up. It tells of a lame duck and a blind hen. Free; registration via the Pankow form.

6e5dd1170634fb9465e43a1a05899d0c1f62d866.en: Mit Mosaiken Schule gestalten, a teacher training at Hedwig-Dohm-Schule on making mosaics with pupils. It includes a practical mosaic project, creative exercises and planning for school use. Teachers register via the regional training database.

98f0d8cbefae2da40334fbc42fc9090a12d82af0.en: Digitale Fotos optimieren at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, where participants learn to edit a photo on a laptop or smartphone and copy it to a USB stick. Bring a laptop or smartphone with a favourite picture. Free; phone registration requested.

ebfac27f0c6d9e7ca897bda755da475661df0a85.en: Trinkwasser braucht keinen Müll, an interactive zero-waste travelling exhibition for children aged 4 and up at Pablo Neruda library, from 9 November to 11 December 2026. It covers tap water and packaging waste, with play and hands-on stations. Free.

b96f0307be1f72d3f386fcc46489b68ce60e7d84.en: A picture book reading of Kai Pannen's Wer spinnt gewinnt at Kino Toni for kindergartens and school classes, for ages 4 and up. Two superheroes, a fly and a spider, must free the carnival prince and princess. Free; registration via the Pankow form.

4e5ccecbd4dedf7ef631068792f91465e21aca68.en: Energy advice from the Verbraucherzentrale at 2RadLaden in Kladow, once a month on the second Monday, 14:00-16:00. Half-hour consultations cover electricity saving, heating and heat protection. Booking via the toll-free number is required.

ecbdb748bb27e554e6327ff57871c5bab66d47e1.en: Digital-Zebra on tour at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek, once a month on Mondays from 15:00 to 17:00. Free walk-in help with the internet, smartphones and digital forms. No registration needed.

dc46111baa7f57001c0c4cbaa3685a92612d9d5d.en: An open games afternoon in the children's library at Bruno-Lösche-Bibliothek on the second Monday of each month, 15:30-17:00, for children and families aged 3 and up. Board games or LEGO; no registration.

ff93e9bc84b56ba0254ef9a95826b2ee0c70bad9.en: Klar und lebendig schreiben, a creative writing course for adults at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek led by Katja Frechen. It helps turn everyday events into clear, lively texts. No prior knowledge; German at level C1 or above. Every second Monday, 16:00-19:00.

4da5a5638a504afa5d856c2e38ec422fe45ea6e0.en: A memorial event for the victims of the 1938 Reichspogromnacht at the memorial of the former synagogue in Schöneberg, with a wreath-laying and a minute of silence on 9 November each year.

161504f60df2b017a76be8b7c9c7b838e7916c26.en: Film time for children at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade with Checker Tobi und das Geheimnis unseres Planeten, an 83-minute adventure for ages 7 and up about a treasure hunt around the world. Free; registration required.

6840b493314aa1a01f2f2f5d5714911958f96d20.en: Jobs mit Sinn at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek, an afternoon talk on meaningful and sustainable careers, from childcare and forest pedagogy to ranger work and volunteering, with career adviser Susann Kühnapfel.

fd690b0455bb26b63b95cdc391f2176e90216c93.en: A Dia de los Muertos workshop at Margarete-Kubicka-Bibliothek. A bilingual German-Spanish kamishibai is followed by crafts such as papel picado for an ofrenda. For families and children aged 4 and up; free, no registration.

133933d6a5d7d9d186d03b8239767f62e187fd20.en: A St Martin's lantern picture book cinema at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek on 9 November 2026 at 16:30. Stories about sharing lead into lantern making and a lantern walk through the library. Children may bring electric lanterns.

7e8cfc2626edc76b3d47e4e96442cef509de212e.en: A bilingual Greek-German storytelling hour at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, with traditional Greek tales told in Greek and translated into German. For children aged 3 and up; part of the bilingual fairy tale days, free, no registration.

e42e167e7c043230bf5a3a331b60aac9012998d0.en: Die Lese-Lustigen, a new reading club at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel. It meets on the second Monday of each month from 17:00 to 18:30, starting 12 October, to discuss a shared book. Registration by email.

4b342ed443e95eab6168c9370149e5b24c0f129a.en: Meet your Researcher, a session at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek on what is researched about intervening arts. Early-career researchers from the SFB Intervenierende Künste discuss voice, improvisation and memes after a short pitch. Registration via Pretix.

a74cee1c4bb5efb44704a77628db1b65ef4ced47.en: An open writing workshop at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg on the second Monday of each month from 9 November, for teenagers and adults to work on their own texts. Readings and feedback are optional. Free, no registration.

315755af8ff8cc2bc740009dc75a98d7628d972b.en: Zur blauen Stunde at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel, a piano recital by pupils of the Reinickendorf music school.

321e39be683073be5cd91ffd751ed09d115d58b5.en: A literary and musical evening at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek with German poet Ulrike Almut Sandig and Ukrainian poet and musician Grigory Semenchuk. They present their joint work in German and Ukrainian, including Sandig's 2026 novel Im Orkan.

cd920c8e14d6a50a5885b3adbf8395b4b85508fd.en: A workshop with journalist and fact-checker Kathrin Wesolowski on recognising fake news, misinformation and propaganda. Participants practise checking photos and videos and spotting AI-generated content, and learn how to verify facts.

9a00a36e88893baa69dbdcec3c282693bada17a4.en: Further training for teachers on safety and accident prevention in the school kitchen during WAT lessons. Participants practise handling food safely and discuss how to apply it in school. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 26.2-134225.

1915105f51b2e03bb14275472422232607bfaf84.en: A hands-on workshop at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda on rainwater harvesting, inspired by a ceramic rainwater vessel. Participants shape a small clay object under guidance. Free entry on 9 November 2026; registration by email.

bb21322bebf1d0875c62fdd649ac5ade6f85f97c.en: A lecture by Peter Rausch, co-founder of the GDR's first gay-lesbian emancipation group, on queer life in East Germany from the 1950s to the 1980s. Questions and conversation follow, at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek.

176eed787a3366ce1f2fb226bc1a42e013ee7054.en: A memorial concert marking the Reichspogromnacht, with the Taffanel Wind Quintet Berlin. The moderated programme presents works by Jewish composers who had to leave Germany. No registration; entry is free and donations are welcome.

8346049dd9b2f75c06b9c7e6f6083ba4ec5009d0.en: A Lebensmelodien memorial concert at Apostel-Paulus-Kirche, titled "Morgen wieder Lustik". It features composers who lived and worked in Berlin, telling stories of Jewish life, persecution and remembrance. Places are limited; registration required.

6e854c4ef6ca3bf42345e57869ed1092a818461e.en: Jazz bands from the Jazz preparatory course at Musikschule City West play every two months in Platanenallee. Audiences can expect young, authentic jazz at a high level.

57e335c047e07fd233decff01f908596c25e816f.en: Isaiah Falls on the LVRS PARADISE SIDE B tour, presented by Live Nation, with special guests RAAHiiM and LUXURY LANE. Wheelchair users and people with severe disabilities marked "B" pay the regular price; their companions enter free.

fac133da99bb652587280f750ac82cb78a4b7b5b.en: Montell Fish on The Nest tour, presented by Live Nation. Wheelchair users and people with a disability ID marked "B" buy a regular ticket, and one accompanying person is admitted free. The valid ID must be shown at the entrance.

1f0867dd62f338b6e0920fbbf3826f8b7c8cd45c.en: A comic reading for kindergartens and school classes at Kino Toni. Felix Görmann presents "Das ZYX", a rhyming journey backwards through the alphabet from Z to A, for ages 4 and up. Free; registration via the online form.

74d7afce098e48575d39bacdff8a16e26b8a8ef6.en: An open consultation hour on dementia at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek, led by Frank Schumann of DemenzLicht. Visitors can talk about dementia and get information that helps reduce fears. Registration is requested.

59996259114d06f9bf3aa6efcd0d871a69dfe7b7.en: The webinar series "Circular Economy in Focus 2026", with two sessions in November, held in English. Speakers offer perspectives on the circular society and an overview of European funding for the circular economy. Registration via the NKS KEM website.

8f38b448b38213ded1b2894c83a2180d12bf1ea7.en: The Berliner Hausbesuche, a free and voluntary service for Berliners aged 70 and over, has an information stand at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek. Guides visit on request to share local offers on health, housing, leisure and digital help.

14fc45c429bea9cdd3dff4241a07cf6de746f44a.en: The AGENS social writing office at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof helps for free and in many languages. It assists with forms, applications, letters, understanding texts and accompanying visits to authorities. Just drop in.

e8267067e49b8daf5274bf308e7cc0b3f0867e77.en: A comic reading at Kino Toni for ages 12 and up, where Felix Görmann presents "Immerland", the debut novel of comic artist Flix. The book is nominated for the SERAPH 2026 in the youth book category. Free; registration via the online form.

acbe6a3505dd9b6636a08dd32768773e3585a8d7.en: An event at the Berliner Landeszentrale für politische Bildung on discrimination criticism amid a global backlash against human diversity. It asks how political education should examine its own structures, attitudes and teaching practice.

b83a070adc5b4804ff833d9ce323c47501562d2b.en: Digital-Zebra on tour: volunteer digital helpers from Neukölln's libraries offer free help with internet, smartphone or online form problems, with no appointment needed. Held once a month on Tuesdays, 14:00 to 18:00, at Margarete-Kubicka-Bibliothek.

4a9c0e5454e7f3b27405c6ba05f072515a8cf551.en: A humorous crime reading by Andrea Gerecke at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek, presenting "Dornröschens Ende", the final book of her Berlin crime trilogy featuring florist Viola. Free entry with advance registration by phone or email.

71cb517559579b7f3262c9065fbd248a2ee08cfa.en: A teacher training offer from New Israel Fund Germany on Israeli civil society, built around five short video portraits of people active in fields such as sport, inclusion and dialogue. Free after online registration, at Besuchszentrum Ostkreuz.

409f487f3e2e0539a18b039e1dd32dc57428cb8f.en: An upcycling workshop at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek where participants turn old crystal chandeliers into necklaces, earrings or pendants. Beginners are welcome. Registration is via the website, organised by VÖBB with NochMall and ZLB.

cca77943a6334fb3061dbf3d101a455956287a20.en: A dance café with the popular duo "mägic zwio", playing cheerful dance music at Maria-Rimkus-Haus. Doors open at 14:00 and the music starts at 15:00. The entry fee is 4.00 euros, plus 3.00 euros for coffee.

4e0e14115a41ee00c043abc95f76cde1cb93604f.en: Crafts for children aged 4 and up at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek, making small things from paper, CDs and other materials. It takes place every second Tuesday of the month. Free, with no registration needed.

dafc0c843e8def4fcfe96a32a998498f6350f36b.en: A bilingual reading at Bibliothek am Wasserturm of Eric Carle's "Die kleine Raupe Nimmersatt", in German and Yiddish, for children aged 3 and up. Jake Schneider and Ofri Lapid introduce Yiddish as a living language. No prior knowledge needed.

d0fcda75f9f8b7eed0d8b11a121bc5060a96170a.en: A three-hour civil courage training at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek led by trainer Chaska Stern. Participants learn to spot danger and intervene calmly, de-escalating insults and discrimination. Ages 16 and up, maximum 20 places, registration required.

1e613000056029f0daa28325d4658c1fed0e8675.en: A digital consultation hour at Margarete-Kubicka-Bibliothek. Staff show the library's e-books, audiobooks and streaming offers, available with a library card, and help with any difficulties. Bring your own device; registration by phone or email.

3aaf77f07872f5e2811325fd15b582b0b5e9d4ed.en: The same three-hour civil courage training with trainer Chaska Stern, held at Schiller-Bibliothek. Participants learn to recognise danger and de-escalate. Ages 16 and up, maximum 20 people, registration required via the booking link.

e71fb79e126a339f33874aa96ac8a531cb13b1b1.en: A shadow theatre show by Scuraluna, "Die kleine Raupe zieht hinaus", at Stadtteilbibliothek Marienfelde on 10 November 2026. It is a colourful music and light-shadow play with ukulele and singing, for ages 3 and up. Free, no registration.

9f04f9d40232da025be0b3c9771b00eea43d4e61.en: An open creative circle at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, held twice a month on Tuesdays in the colder months. Participants knit, embroider or do macramé while chatting. Bring your own yarn. Free, with no registration.

987859c10de4c1bdd9ae962603d6af57076c2228.en: An international online conference, "So inklusiv ist Europa", where people from different cities discuss life with disabilities, work, disaster protection and the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities. Held in person and online.

292599542beedc7741461491126d5d72bced0842.en: A community event at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek about waste avoidance, sorting and recycling for a clean, liveable city. Visitors can collect practical tips, addresses and dates at the info stand. Free, with no registration needed.

dc8c35d00f5e41d50845cee9250230c62559a9c3.en: A picture-book cinema reading at Schiller-Bibliothek of "Ein Pferd zu Chanukka" by Myriam Halberstam, who reads from her book in person. A horse named Golda who speaks Hebrew causes chaos and introduces Hanukkah. Registration by email.

e8f6e21628af15c30e33d5d74c2bb221a4e84a2c.en: A 3D printing workshop for children aged 10 and up at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg, in the makerspace on the ground floor. Participants create and print their first own 3D model.

e7a25fea1933645267e2195feaca369f6ef45aeb.en: A guided tour of Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek for new members or returning visitors. It covers the library's services, the voebb.de portal, automated lending and returns, and what to do when a title is missing. Free; registration by phone or email.

c3d85ed8a958fd7bb317723c7b4496b9bbce72f1.en: A ukulele taster course with Petra Malberg at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek. Participants learn basic playing and how to accompany songs with a few chords. Ukuleles are available, and a library card allows free loans. Free; advance registration requested.

4d7f76449f6f259be2f7024f094f4890bde4af03.en: An introduction to the hobby plotter at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek. Participants learn to cut vinyl and design textiles on Brother cutting machines, and can then get a device certificate. Ages 12 and up, free, limited places, booked three days ahead.

599a4bdc15a05ecb77f17c5c616cbfbad75a2122.en: A quiz game at Bettina-von-Arnim-Bibliothek, "Real or Fake", in which visitors try to tell whether scientific summaries are true or invented. It is a mini Turing test for teenagers and adults, run with NeuroCure of Charité Berlin.

97f7c86859b3f4aa2ad81d5186563d6ff2b3b187.en: A Kamishibai storytelling session at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek. The Japanese picture-card theatre brings exciting, funny and magical stories to life for children aged 4 and up. Free, with no registration required.

727d6fca05ea9665d681b9c27c0e0fadca2ca3f7.en: A book presentation and conversation with author Gwendolyn Sasse at Janusz-Korczak-Bibliothek about "Russland – Eine deutsche Erfindung". It explores why many Germans still view Russia positively despite the war in Ukraine. Free; registration requested.

e433e5990ea3ffe4c03a16677287253e185fc172.en: Franziska Gänsler presents her favourite media from the ZLB in the "Vorgemerkt." series at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek, followed by a conversation with moderator Luca Mael Milsch. Her debut novel Ewig Sommer appeared in 2022.

3f7bb382387f154bceaa1c7667874511e8a87aeb.en: Druid and Celtic-style tales of the otherworld, told by Astrid Heiland-Vondruska and accompanied by Susann Seegers on flutes, bagpipes and whistles. Held in the Schwartzsche Villa salon by Hof-Spielleut. Free entry; donations requested.

73cd4ebc9e1e2c7a8e70c0f4afea7a524d631bff.en: Alice Hasters and Mohamed Amjahid discuss Hasters's book "Anti Opfer – Warum wir Verletzlichkeit verachten" at Bibliothek am Luisenbad. The book examines a cultural shift in which vulnerability is despised. Places are limited; advance registration required.

12aba781c14cee4f676709c5e0758556dc9c7820.en: A grief group for women who lost a child during pregnancy, meeting on the second and fourth Monday of each month at Schiller-Bibliothek. Midwife and certified grief companions Aileen Deinert and Shirin Lausch lead it. Registration by email.

1bf4dde94b25113770448b4bac8239d7653c2fa5.en: Emma Braslavsky reads from "Ich bin dein Mensch" in the Science for Fiction series at Bruno-Lösche-Bibliothek. A couples therapist rejects human-like robots, then orders a custom android. A scientist joins the talk afterwards. Registration required.

81cd481fb4c3a884fe1a544909db1e89dac7317e.en: A multi-sensory discussion, a senSONICtalk, at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda on the Oder and Spree and the future of rivers. The artist collective FrauVonDa// meets researchers from the IGB. Free on 10 November 2026 at 19:00; German or English.

422adabe615fb1822a8ad0b8ae75500aba88dfde.en: Bogdan Lisevsky returns to the stage in Berlin with a new stand-up show built on absurd and unexpected twists of thought. Presented by Live Nation. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian; no admission under 6.

477a557066223bef112a435c66555e7ee26c4ace.en: A staged radio play by Christine Marx and Klaus Nothnagel at Kulturhaus Karlshorst, based on Anton Chekhov's early stories. The grotesque tales expose the small and large lies of everyday married life. Entry 7 euros, reduced 3 euros.

5b824495de1961989c34f359afc3aef3d6dc01dd.en: Sascha Grammel's charity comedy show "Lachen tut Gut(es)" at Kulturhaus Spandau. An hour of puppet comedy and playful stage spectacle that combines entertainment with unbureaucratic support. Tickets via the card phone 030 333 40 22.

47572eae49d6abff10737444c4f96ec72e056f9b.en: Danuta Schmidt talks with Andreas Lehmann, editor-in-chief of DAS MAGAZIN, at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek. The monthly magazine has been published since 1924, and Lehmann has worked on it for over a decade as a writer and as an editor.

a82eccffb485dfded814f6e316d5feecf9bebb4c.en: The Circular AI Hub FORUM 2026, an online event on how AI can support circular business models, material flows and resource efficiency. Companies and researchers present successful and scalable solutions. Registration via the Circular AI Hub community website.

d3c8c4414324bb85dbe392b5f9b866bf5b9d1190.en: A training course for teachers and multipliers at Jugendclub Skandal on teaching Nazi persecution of Jewish life to primary school pupils. It offers age-appropriate, local and biographical methods, and advice on language and on images or witness accounts.

3ccceff9a3dd695bd93d00a70ff24c2d3557d15e.en: MOPS, a wordless play by Kazbize Theater at Schwartzsche Villa about two look-alike cooks in one kitchen and a missing egg. It is full of absurdities about friendship, suspicion and loss. Performed by Clara Gracia and Felix Ahlert. Entry 6 euros.

00125ab89e87764ca0b9b934157c7cc433b54aa6.en: A consultation hour at Stadtteilbibliothek Lankwitz on the digital offers of the VÖBB library network, such as e-book loans and music streaming. Library staff answer questions; bring your smartphone, tablet or e-reader.

5bd2d4434c711a9ee629f811169da1c8aa973553.en: An exhibition, "Wir Marzahner", by photographer Asger Hunov at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek. Over 50 residents are interviewed and portrayed in photos and short texts, showing a lively picture of Marzahn. On view 11 November 2026 to 8 January 2027.

b7a951212d5b686b88f616c31ac4b3c5d14a3c50.en: Omas for Future's sustainability quiz at Hans-Söhnker-Haus, where each question teaches something new about protecting the planet, health and wallets. Doors open 14:00, start 15:00. Free entry, coffee 3 euros. Registration requested.

92b9b53575348e271b5eaeefe8b02ea26151c366.en: Digital-Zebra at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof helps people get started with digital life: medical appointments, official procedures, setting up an email address or digital tickets. Just come along; no appointment needed.

c9ebae7545c5bad84f31c0ba563e89cc54e4f00d.en: The Open Piano at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg: every second Wednesday of the month from 16:00 to 18:00, the e-piano from the library's music room is ready for anyone to play. No registration needed.

a74846fbccb88aae82d94f116ba088f9d895f0a7.en: MitMachMittwoch at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek, where children aged 8 to 12 can try a VR headset to explore games and new worlds. Younger participants need a parental consent form, which is available at the library.

f0b71160e1a981eb2579240f7345d95465760b0e.en: A Lichterfest at Bibliothek am Wasserturm on 11 November. At 16:00 children make lanterns, and at 17:00 the Rumpelmärchen tell a fire story with a live fire show in the courtyard. Free, no registration; bring warm clothes.

b7c927638bbdf9c34e96fca331c58182cf8073fb.en: The fifth event in the series "Nachhaltigkeit als Antwort auf planetare Krisen?" at Freie Universität Berlin, on new forms of participation and climate advocacy. Henrike Knappe of Universität Leipzig gives the opening input. Registration online.

9997f0fc22e47d128ce9120742095c457c68685c.en: Kieztreff International at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof, a language café where people meet neighbours, chat about the area and practise German. Beginners and advanced speakers are welcome. Free, no registration.

cc1da2804125c9c76a0c38377d209e094139acc8.en: Chess in the neighbourhood at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek. Players sit together for fun and strategy. No prior experience is needed, boards are provided, and you can bring your own. Free; no registration required.

36831bc8cbd5779d1ddbcb0b3ac2b5e0a7fbf5d5.en: A children's chess meetup at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek, offered by Schachklub Zehlendorfs e.V. Every second Wednesday of the month, young players of all levels can learn from a chess expert. Free; advance registration requested.

972619fb1c0668b6b8e6228580fa76b337492fb4.en: A three-hour civil courage training at Bruno-Lösche-Bibliothek, led by trainer Chaska Stern. Participants learn to recognise danger and intervene calmly, with de-escalation and self-protection. Ages 16 and up, maximum 20 people, booked via pretix.

a660de9f4d8ba04850037fd34345af4cd00823bf.en: A K-pop dance workshop for ages 10 and up at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek, taught in English, with choreography inspired by popular K-pop artists. It builds rhythm, coordination and confidence. Free, funded by the Bibliotheksstärkungsfonds; registration required.

ad21e14d045a0460ba3562c0a619baaf5c74170b.en: Karneval der Tiere, a picture-book cinema special for the Berliner Märchentage at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda on 11 November 2026 at 16:30. A costume contest turns into riddling rhymes, with live loop-machine sounds. For ages 4 and up with parents.

86ef38b8f5a895446231249e96ca78d3dfd36953.en: A puppet show, "Gordon und Tapir", at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek, based on Sebastian Meschenmoser's children's book. A jungle tapir and a tidy penguin share a flat, quarrel and must find their way back to friendship. Registration by email.

69eb1ae90b7cf36d6a62d5c792d54eea74a86505.en: Goldene Filmstunden at Stadtteilbibliothek Lankwitz, a relaxed cinema afternoon designed for seniors. A classic film is shown, and its title stays a surprise until the start. Humour and emotion are promised.

4b48a7a31db6c53424d0eb63b7fe919c22e09f91.en: Volunteer readers read aloud in Russian for children up to 12 at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek. Together they discover books and aim to spark the joy of reading. Parents are warmly invited to join.

ecaa9b29508c4e36896ffe8fe366891a82c421b9.en: An open drop-in at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek by Mittelhof e.V., presenting local self-help and neighbourhood support services. Visitors can make new contacts, join groups, find ways out of crises or get help with computers. Free, no registration.

948f184f116a462fff2417afde0526d5568138ec.en: A singing session, "Sing mit", with vocal coach and choir leader Roland Schulz at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek. Participants sing along to pop songs, schlager and evergreens. Free; advance registration requested by phone or email.

d4de4debb544c5684ae2c23b41f5eaccb2d9c7ec.en: A lantern parade through Marzahn-NordWest on 11 November 2026 from 17:00. Two starting points lead to a shared finish at Kiez-Treff West, where families sing together and enjoy a fire bowl, grill and punch. The Jugendfeuerwehr Falkenberg joins in.

701cbb05ca4cce50b99129215070fdee98db2288.en: An open stage at the small hall of Gemeinschaftshaus Gropiusstadt, with evenings from 18:00 on 16 September, 14 October, 11 November and 16 December. Anyone can show singing, dancing or magic. Applicants send a short video, song or text.

2abbdc0b9ba0211182a21313fcfe3ba751a75932.en: Renate Zimmermann presents "Bibliothekarin läuft" in the "Live bei Kleist" reading series at Bibliothek Heinrich-von-Kleist. Since January 2026 the former librarian has walked Berlin's streets, and visitors can join her for a day. Registration by phone.

83e33b8f37ad1bb9013cb7b2d5b16634b086dd64.en: WahlheYmat Talks, "Democracy for everyone", at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek, held in English. Guests Chantal Chisley and Esther Nass discuss how democracy can reach the one million Berliners who cannot vote. No registration; places are limited.

1815ecfb13814e9e51e72aef267d24018d68c092.en: A new evening of board and card games at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, held every second Wednesday from 18:00 to 21:00 since 10 June 2026. Players bring their favourite games and meet new people. Free, no registration needed.

dec798c23804ec65d9337d9d998bdfe3e04d6b5b.en: An online book club at Bettina-von-Arnim-Bibliothek, led by Petra Ney. The participation link is sent after registration, and books for the following month are put up for choice a week before each meeting.

876f981b5a928b135a86d281a9f9ab612391cc2d.en: The opening of the exhibition "Wir Marzahner" by photographer Asger Hunov at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek, starting at 19:00. Over 50 residents of Marzahn are portrayed in photos and short texts. Registration by email or phone; free entry.

e4703bb76c6faa2ad6a4d9a2a93b4c0113d3e452.en: An easy-language workshop, "Gott, Jesus und Allah – Religionen verstehen", by the Berlin Landeszentrale für politische Bildung and Lebenshilfe Bildung. It covers major world religions, shared ground and tolerance. Free, up to 14 people.

ac1b31e27fc65242944358ea598698f4487d980b.en: The "Fake News Detektive" workshop at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek for ages 9 to 104. Participants learn to tell real from invented news, trace images and check facts. Free, three sessions, with children and adults in teams.

a255e4dbefc95b29a46ef802aa4ad51fe4df5053.en: A seminar at Stadtbad Lichtenberg/Hubertusbad on recognising antisemitism, and on the difference between criticism of Israeli government policy and antisemitism. Participants practise interventions and counter-arguments. Free; advance registration.

1aeedebc3132a0112fdb7446aaa04a4f481e3871.en: The conference "Demokratie ist Arbeit" brings companies, public enterprises, business associations, science and civil society together on democracy at work. Topics include participation, handling conflict and corporate social responsibility.

9edd7b046786c91c89c5864bc03cdb3eb3c48b0a.en: An English-language book club at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek, meeting on the second Wednesday of each month and led by literary scholar Neil Bristow. The first title is Kazuo Ishiguro's The Remains of the Day. Free; registration by email.

f4d2b68989cad3d56473e61165735e570a8d0487.en: The steering group meeting of the Karl-Marx-Straße action project on 11 November 2026, 18:00 to 20:00, held digitally. Anyone can attend as a guest. Digital participants should email kms@bsgmbh.com by the morning of 9 November.

bbbc04685aa9b05a4f6794b2f6bfb7b14ef332c3.en: Ulf Dittmer traces the development of Karlshorst with historic aerial photos and maps, showing what has long vanished from today's streetscape. Held at Kulturhaus Karlshorst by Geschichtsfreunde Karlshorst. Entry 3 euros.

27f47ecaf6e947036cd7373be0df2611e0b73ccd.en: Bloc Party and Interpol perform at Uber Arena, presented by Live Nation. Wheelchair users and people who need a companion should call the accessibility hotline, available daily from 10 am to 6 pm.

158d54ecc257ce11ae0c08400c5e0af56f807508.en: Nick Hakim's live concert "I Can See", presented by Goodlive Artists. Wheelchair users with a "B" ID buy a regular ticket, and one companion enters free. The valid ID must be shown at entry.

e96f791b6947618bcd1bcfc7a8ed77cc82e23769.en: Peter and the Wolf, a shadow-figure play by Scuraluna with orchestra music at Schwartzsche Villa, based on Prokofiev's musical fairy tale. Suitable for children aged 4 and up, and runs 45 minutes. Entry 7 euros, 5 euros for groups with a JKS voucher.

2f8bb2a854e44ef462a4fcf5db4999de1af6cbad.en: A practical workshop at the Berliner Landeszentrale für politische Bildung on how AI can help against online hate. Participants learn how AI works, practise responding to problematic comments and discuss its limits, ethics and privacy issues.

9e6d40fd8a63ac8fb3f3fee1a8665641cfde6821.en: A citizens' consultation hour by the Seniorenvertretung Steglitz-Zehlendorf at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek, open to all seniors and their relatives. Members listen and advise in person. Free, no registration; information by phone.

15750f88fa9b4f2048c86f0a6c73fb548d93708e.en: Goldnetz advises on education and careers at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg, covering training options, entry routes and skills assessment. Bring your application documents for a quick check. Free, no registration.

4eaf9c09e383ae2c961aa3958bf19386d5728692.en: Mini Maker at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade for children aged 4 and up. Kids discover robots, try 3D printing and get creative with handicrafts. Free, no registration needed.

a7b0238f73632ad1e0aae1981318d7e621eba7c8.en: The Schreibforum Lichtenberg invites people to write stories and poems together at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek in Linden-Center Hohenschönhausen. The opening theme is "Mein Lichtenberger Kiez". Free entry.

2147dc5cdf4cdd276d6004d0ede8584306269e61.en: A talk at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek on rights and equality for women, trans and queer people in Berlin and worldwide. Activists share stories of hope and resistance, and terms such as queer and trans are explained. Held in Easy Language; free, no registration.

5df87a8ac3ded8a83e8971602ff9f1d5546501ba.en: Sir Henry de Winter, a Berlin singer devoted to the 1920s to 1940s, performs with his pianist at Maria-Rimkus-Haus. Doors open at 13:00 and the show starts at 15:00. Entry 4 euros, plus 3 euros for coffee; drinks cost extra.

5b84ba0be684c2fbf65aad1d78e242405234b5c5.en: Tüftellab at Bibliothek im Märkischen Viertel for ages 5 to 16 and their families. Children build virtual worlds with bricks, program ScratchJR and Blue Bots, and make circuits with LEDs. Free, only with a parent or guardian.

2fa9bc4fa322f09fa9e5372c339ad7d46d00782d.en: A clothes swap at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof. Bring clean, well-kept jumpers, trousers, skirts, blouses, jewellery, scarves or hats, with one bag per person. No registration; just come along.

22a80652e072ee61f09ec98084006f48e46d3e0b.en: Exam preparation for MSA, Facharbeit and 5. PK at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda, led by teacher-training students. Topics range from choosing a subject to citing and presenting. Thursdays from 5 November 2026. Free, no registration.

db06e31e6f112605b14e7297a2af966002a24e6a.en: A LEGO afternoon for children aged 4 and up at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek, where they can build whatever they imagine from coloured bricks.

a186cc81de885c404b418de0ebeaf415c9257df1.en: Theater Malinka performs "Däumelinchen" at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek, based on Hans Christian Andersen, with hand-sewn puppets built from children's drawings. Recommended for ages 3 and up. Free with advance registration.

e13bdf24de11177ed35ef395b8147eee361b3e8b.en: Hirsch Heinrich opens a new exhibition at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek on 12 November at 16:30, with the children's choir of Musikschule Béla Bartok. On 17 December the deer leads a parade to Antonplatz, where everyone sings Christmas carols.

ff0cd187c68417013315029db1aef40d260e0193.en: A picture-book cinema afternoon at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek, part of the Berliner Märchentage, about a little mermaid who trades her voice and fin for two human legs. Crafts for children included. Free, no registration, ages 3 and up.

7bcc0ac964bb4849fb519d1aec4148a9e0afa32f.en: Drawing yoga for children aged 7 to 9 at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek, with simple exercises such as Zentangle, mandalas and drawing games. No drawing skills needed. Led by Katja Spitzer for up to 15 children. Free.

badc72d93eb9514b4c42868d091ec20910e49c71.en: A three-hour civil courage training at Bibliothek am Luisenbad, led by trainer Chaska Stern. Participants learn to recognise danger and de-escalate insults and threats. Ages 16 and up, maximum 20, booked via pretix. Another date is 17 November 2026.

f4bb911e992f9c520b864426adbd8a8f6b2ab313.en: A talk for parents and families of children in grades 1 to 3 at Stadtteilbibliothek Karow on digital media. It covers social media, gaming and possible risks, with practical tips and time for questions and discussion.

ab0c7dbc07daeba166cd8527b57c0dfce22bcc7d.en: An open knitting café at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek, a relaxed meeting to knit together and chat. Beginners and experienced knitters are equally welcome. Free, no registration.

0b1c4a7adcf18636e598dfa251db025f94706d9e.en: Repair Café II of KlimaWerkstatt, held with Stadtteilladen Wilhelmstadt every second Thursday from 17:30 to 20:00 at Adamstraße 39. Volunteers help repair broken household items. Register in advance with coordinator Norbert by phone.

946f04c850c58e062934d4eb4fb586c2d55b8fce.en: A reading and conversation with Feline Tecklenburg at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek about her new book on care work. She argues that redistributing time, power and money is long overdue. Entry 4 euros, reduced 3 euros; presale from 15 October 2026.

0d9acf403fbecf3356205c5b02263c9a17aa7581.en: A talk and conversation with Nadja Schallenberg as part of Queer-Thursday at Stadtteilbibliothek Buch. The listing gives no further details.

b927a702cbe0eb96d566baa0f43483372b7f3441.en: A board game evening at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek on the second Thursday of each month, for people aged 16 and up. Each month has a theme with a guided new game, and players can also stick to their favourites.

7b9ee683d7e5a6ad924fcafd685b8f42a2607998.en: Stories read aloud in Arabic for children aged 4 to 12 and their families, at Bibliothek im Märkischen Viertel on the second Thursday of each month. Free entry.

1dbad0fb2cd9f8eef41fc85051d9efc6d23c6129.en: An artists' talk, "Archival Futures", part of the exhibition Future Archives / Archive Futures by Kunstverein Tiergarten at rk – Galerie für zeitgenössische Kunst, opening 7 October 2026 at 18:00. Children aged 8 to 12 can build a camera obscura.

d2393e832628deeb99328878048fd32ddd56df7e.en: Flair de Paris, a concert of musette and swing manouche at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek. Carmen Hey on accordion and Romani Weiss on guitar play French melodies and swinging rhythms in the style of Django Reinhardt. Free, no registration.

df0c34f0b8f1e37845a0d6381c3f051d6460ebad.en: A discussion, "Wahlnachlese 2026", at the Berliner Landeszentrale für politische Bildung on who votes and who stays out. Thorsten Faas of Freie Universität Berlin presents the analysis of the 20 September 2026 elections, followed by a conversation.

9cb10774a72978177a60d6dea294ca09e4f1f789.en: An interactive reading from "Das beste Europa aller Zeiten" by Katja Sinko and Peter Jelinek at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek. The audience develops bold ideas for a Europe that shapes everyday life. Free entry; registration requested.

16066d0ffdbd268c86e0560608a784f837b2a2d4.en: A Café Europa get-together for people interested in Europe, for exchanging ideas or spending an evening with European flair. Members and newcomers are equally welcome. The venue in Mitte will be announced.

c7d94591f495ee9be4c7b725485dbfdea8d3ef78.en: BEST OF SONGSLAM, a song parade at Kulturhaus Karlshorst, where four of Berlin's best singer-songwriters compete in a playful contest for the audience's favour. Entry 5 euros, reduced 3 euros.

0c84e6825cca25c856b83e7f7fd2ac7ab0708aa3.en: A reading and conversation with author Lena Müller about "Club der Verschwenderinnen". In a city summer, single mother and translator Eli and bartender Gunda form an emergency alliance that grows into friendship. Registration by email.

79d506241eeeb148abfc68b2305048c8097cb03f.en: A queer reading at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg from the fifth round of the poetry collection Parabolis Virtualis, with Hannah Schraven, Pia Laguna de la Vera and Mátyás Dunajcsik. Kevin Junk moderates. Free, no registration; cooperation with Querverlag.

5677e21e7f95b0ff4ad45ab4940907a00d6c750b.en: Session 99 at Kapelle99, where Musikschule Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg revives an old vaulted cellar as a neighbourhood concert venue. Each evening opens with a professional jazz or pop band, then the stage is open for jamming. Free entry.

518288f463d48694ddbf4805aa1b7b83e6c3b51f.en: A film music concert by AccordiOona-Orchestra at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek, with doors at 19:30 and the start at 20:00. Registration by email to Aylin Rehaag or by phone is required. Free entry with a donation when leaving.

2832d8856999a183658a50ae4dd2c469374756ae.en: Publisher Britta Jürgs introduces writer Annemarie Weber, and Simone Hausdorf reads from her novel about 1960s West Berlin, between marriage, student protests and bohemian receptions. Part of a series on forgotten women writers.

7a6ac7f3ed635d7331c0314f5fac16025427277a.en: A soap-making workshop, Selbstgemacht, at Bibliothek Tiergarten-Süd. Participants learn the cold process with plant oils, garden herbs, coffee grounds and essential oils, and take their soap home. Led by Kulturlabor Trial&Error.

054eb75207c452da77be182c5c6f8776328f053f.en: A reading by Rosemarie Gebauer at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek about the Lichterfelde villa colony, its streets, villas and history, including the years the Leibstandarte SS Adolf Hitler was based there. Free; advance registration requested.

57c51f84426ef32890890b94c7b1cf524069c58f.en: Overmono's Pure Devotion World Tour at Uber Eats Music Hall, with special act Blawan and Viiaan. Gallery Seat tickets include a seat in blocks 202 to 204, Gallery Bar access and a fast lane. eTickets arrive three to five days before the show.

fb91d0a9941ca288e263520ec3682eae5b9a1519.en: The European Mobility Week (EMW) network meeting 2026 at Rathaus Schöneberg on 12 and 13 November. The national EMW coordination office at the Umweltbundesamt marks ten years, with talks on experimental planning, street experiments and the AdNEB research.

9e3ced4a00ac54dddf666be0c0cedac1456c1a31.en: A swap and bulky-waste market at Kranoldplatz on 13 November from 8:00 to 13:00, held as part of the BSR Kieztag. Visitors can drop off bulky items for free and take useful things others have brought. No deliveries by car or van.

69b04afd6a02e03336aa5de49a5cfbcd5f7c0b43.en: A breakfast book club at Bibliothek am Luisenbad on every second Friday of the month, with coffee and rolls. Participants share favourite books and bring their own recommendations. Free, with changing themes.

a6e7509beeb99394951b47ae12fc0e0a320302ac.en: Fadenkunst – für Frauen, an open craft café at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek under the motto "Kreativ. International. Verbindend." Women from different backgrounds knit, crochet and embroider, and make new contacts. Free; no advance registration.
