a43e0e811ea818f4dacc7251104ab6fe5f3fd327.en: Energy advice from the Verbraucherzentrale at KlimaWerkstatt Spandau on the second Friday of the month, 13:00 to 15:00. Advisers cover electricity saving, heating, ventilation and heat protection. Free, about 30 minutes per person, by appointment.

b3c5cab2b7343aebdb718b855db48fdb4569f7f8.en: A workshop at the Berliner Landeszentrale für politische Bildung on data sovereignty and online privacy. Participants analyse their digital traces, review social media settings and learn about GDPR, password managers, VPNs and encryption.

2952788cc23241a0d5f31617e0e09f11752f9b3c.en: MuKiBa, music for children and babies at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek, led by musician Virgil Segal. Children aged 0 to 5 and their parents sing, dance and try instruments such as guitar, trumpet and xylophone. Free; registration required.

0ff5da191ab39442872a335c014c6ba79f5357d7.en: A weaving session at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel, where people of all ages can try a small loom and create their own pattern.

ec8e830c38471bb7e63c01e6f23fe791fbe150e1.en: An introduction to 3D printing at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek, covering print file preparation, printer setup and the printing process. For ages 16 and up; free, limited places, booked at least three days ahead.

d7134fcae50e9057c46d2cdff9639838ece093d6.en: Treffpunkt Synthesizer at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek for ages 13 and up, exploring synthesizers, sequencers and controllers. Led by Gisbert Schürig in cooperation with lev, from 5 October 2026 to 12 March 2027, 16:30 to 18:30.

70ebc963551706046f331e4896ed00c748057a78.en: A bilingual fairy tale in German and Vietnamese at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek, presented by the Vietnamese conversation club of Café 8TV. Part of the 11th Bilingual Fairy Tale Days in Pankow, for ages 3 and up and all fairy tale fans.

d342d51d1e4c630ed3d30a62ac8999a53ed4f4a3.en: Feel the Rhythm of English at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, a free course for learners from A2 level. It uses well-known songs from rock, pop, folk and classical music to train listening, vocabulary and pronunciation. No singing experience needed.

7c98aae18e27079b227b48f7ab014bb09d16aad3.en: Berlin schläft ein, a lullaby singing session for families in a yurt at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek. Singer and choir leader Bettina Stäbert leads familiar and new lullabies in several languages. Registration required; places are limited.

ca7ec92fcab17a37dd726ee195e29498c9adffb4.en: Volunteer readers read aloud in Spanish for children up to 12 at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek. Together they discover books and aim to spark the joy of reading. Parents are warmly invited to join.

dcaa6247285c105615d0e490b9bdede9254e2d58.en: Argos, Odysseus's faithful dog, read aloud in Greek as part of the Berlin Fairy Tale Days at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek. Argos waits for his friend for years and never gives up hope. Presented by Hellenische Gemeinde zu Berlin; free, no registration.

75912620aa7a4d6d0896ca1067b28bcdadcea3d4.en: Queerinnert, where LGBTQIA+ contemporary witnesses tell how queer community was built in East Berlin, where people had no civil rights protection and no public meeting places before 1990. At Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda.

b01af433bdd584d018f1767cd27132ed8cda9fe2.en: Rathaus Zyklus, a chamber music concert by teachers of Musikschule City West at Rathaus Schmargendorf's Ursula-Mamlok-Saal. Varied ensembles play works from Bach and Haydn to Mozart, Beethoven and modern pieces. Performers to be announced.

0ebe0ed140b54bec36f5ef87c50e827b5dbe7ec1.en: Jens Müller plays classical guitar in a programme from Bach's lute suite BWV 996 through Latin American guitar music to jazz pieces by Ralph Towner and Pat Metheny. At Schwartzsche Villa salon; entry 10 euros, children and young people free.

00ff9297ff00e020b9933b529e5f748bdf061024.en: A reading with music, "Deutschland, siehst du das nicht…?", by Roman Knižka and OPUS 45 at Kulturhaus Karlshorst. It tells of the end of the Weimar Republic from 1929 to 1933, with literature, music and a chapter on Karlshorst. Entry 10 euros, reduced 3 euros.

2c62aa402449a7d38431d395c9dda98f1fe21e59.en: A student recital by the recorder classes at Haus der Musik, led by Milena Hahne and Christa Heinrichsmeier.

a96d90a3dc03a0658672060d0b76a98766836bb1.en: LOOPTOPIA, a city-wide format by Circular.berlin from 13 to 15 November 2026, turning Berlin into an open space for circular solutions. Companies, workshops and public institutions open their doors. Applications with programme ideas are due by 1 September.

a29478f1136eee6e4742a01678e7928371be4bfc.en: The Leo-Borchard Musikschulpreis at Haus der Musik, where music school students perform before an expert jury. All instruments, genres and age groups are welcome, and the performances are open to listeners. Applications run until 31 October.

3127dad924ffe66dcf88ae6dc7dfe5df6c60e916.en: A music school competition at Leo-Borchard-Musikschule, where students perform before a jury. All instruments, genres and ages are welcome. The performances are public; applications run until 31 October on the music school website.

e23d44a449821dccb71ac94f3bb9b6a82fc8623e.en: Miteinandermöbel [bauen] at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek, an afternoon for people of all ages to explore furniture that brings people closer. Participants build models from reused materials, which will inspire a meeting bench for the library. No registration.

cd98b04e703f96f64e7a9f96ae6499947a37920e.en: Erzählzeit with the Kamishibai, every second Saturday of the month at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek, organised by the Förderkreis der Lichtenberger Bibliotheken. Traditional Japanese picture-card storytelling for children aged 3 and up with their families. Free.

bb97c5fd8203e6c4f71cb73421424dc654a8fa6b.en: An open day at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek, inviting everyone to discover the library's offers for young and old. Visitors can explore the services and be surprised by the programme.

1222c48114954bbb3d06f176bfdbd93340cd39cb.en: KinderUni Lichtenberg, the lecture "Urlaubsdetektive gesucht" by Prof. Dr. Sandra Rochnowski of HWR Berlin at HTW Berlin. It asks why people travel, and whether we can explore the world as tourists while also protecting it.

42007bac1d950c9e7fbd5d310bcce23ff233f4e6.en: A straw-craft workshop at Stadtteilbibliothek Karow, where participants make small art pieces from natural straw. Creative fun for young and old. Registration required by phone or email, or in person.

2a3ff6918d4ff452a059d610a7205513c1f92535.en: A Portuguese reading circle at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, held on the second Thursday of each month from 10:30 to 12:30. Participants share impressions of a novel read in Portuguese. No registration needed; dates to be announced.

ad11443825e561d256f1a717dad82e21ba525209.en: Yoga, a little time out at Stadtteilbibliothek Karow for adults. Gentle movement, mindful breathing and relaxation help body and mind recharge. No prior experience or registration needed.

d1940569d7d9bec1f542344c15bef55243ed709a.en: FamilienSamstag with Alexander Matakas's "Hans im Glück" at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek, a humorous fairy tale for ages 4 and up about contentment. It includes a participation part and songs. Entry 1 euro; free tickets for HOWOGE tenants.

c773da03c326e8369ef79233a3f2da6cd104d278.en: An author reading and workshop, "Ein singender Baum", by Rose Apple at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek, for ages 4 and up. The story of tree Walter, who longs for colours and songs, is followed by a stamp workshop making colourful figures.

4c15f151637d18c8ba0676c11ea0571fb4896a16.en: FamilienSamstag at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek with Parktheater Edelbruch's "Hans im Glück", about a man returning home after seven years away, guided by the motto "less is more". Free craft activity for the youngest. Entry 1 euro.

52d43025c4d04d43373fbd47511676c8871f2e9d.en: Der Grüne Georg, an environmental show for children with Georg Weisfeld at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek. A mix of songs, juggling, magic, pantomime and clowning, which needs the children's help. For families, in the children's library.

0004c11b2f76c1956f667b8ef5a2647f519664f5.en: A fairy-tale bookmark workshop at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek with comic author Susanne Buddenberg, held during the library's anniversary week. Everyone is welcome to design their own bookmarks with a range of materials.

2779cdefc9c629bbfad2185479be41ac3ce1af62.en: The exhibition "Eine andere italienische Reise" at Dokumentationszentrum NS-Zwangsarbeit shows Italy in the Second World War through historic places, photos, personal stories and documents. It covers fascism, occupation and resistance.

5b6594448e6be316e9df24eb68bfb2ecd08ea63a.en: Theater Scuraluna performs "Der kleine Angsthase" at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek, a colourful shadow play with guitar and singing. Rudi, afraid of nearly everything, grows beyond himself when a fox arrives. Ages 4 and up; free, advance registration.

ef7a1ff0312b35481a51179fc38fdf98811ce7fa.en: A Medienbasar at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek on 14 November 2026, 10:00 to 18:00, where children's and young people's books and games are sold for a small minimum donation. Proceeds support the ZLB's Freundeskreis.

64f277b58b438c15e61ed9201276e145ccf8b6bc.en: The opening of the Empathie Museum at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek, a growing collection of life stories told by neighbours. Others can later hear them in a digital format, so people meet who would never otherwise meet.

2b568cfccadfa50878fdda3b8c4ec2fda4a91745.en: A reading by Aron Boks with the Schreibwerkstatt Marzahn, presenting their book "Was uns bleibt – Mehr als nur Sachen". Young writers tell the stories behind everyday objects, keepsakes and heirlooms. Registration by email or phone; free entry.

b33bad8d85376ff3fab15632b557d9696f49c130.en: Pen & Paper adventures for players aged 12 and up at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof-Schöneberg, led by game masters from Nexus e.V. Sign up by email to stbts@nexus-berlin.de. Free.

85264bed5d9f12aa3178f1ace7363f65129b6a2e.en: A reading by Jörg Weber, "Unsere gaaanz normale Reise nach Kanada", about a family whose "normal" trip to Canada becomes one adventure after another, from airplane jogging to a near shark attack and wild rafting. At Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek.

c7a90175fca9ba0a05fe6c242584b529f6324ee1.en: Experiments with the Forschergarten team at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek for children of pre-school and primary age. Dates: 12 September soap bubbles, 10 October colours, 14 November electricity and 12 December a Christmas theme. Part of the KUBIST programme.

9bce219c267dbd10bc60f00fc13d1617ab1cc42a.en: A stamping workshop with Meike Dölp at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek. Participants carve their own stamp from rubber, mount it on a wooden block and use it on letters or gift wrap, creating a personal calling card.

870e2a14536214c19ef0ac5ab2bb23631cc9fa6f.en: A laughter yoga workshop at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek, a free offer by Stadtbibliothek Lichtenberg. Regular, hearty laughter is said to relax and benefit health. No registration needed; funded by the Bibliotheksstärkungsfonds.

9c846daa1e886ef666ad7d29018b028e97711609.en: A vision board and collage workshop with Pia Hasenkamp at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek. Participants visualise goals and ideas by cutting, gluing and arranging materials, after a short introduction to collage. Free, no registration, no pressure.

b045805ebceb5e0488b6c1cbb863711d1544b086.en: Comic artist Katharina Greve presents "Meine Geschichten von Mutter und Tochter" at Stadtteilbibliothek Friedrich von Raumer, a female answer to Erich Ohser's Vater und Sohn. The wordless short comics cover everyday challenges. 14 November 2026 at 15:00; free.

3aed59b9c41f89e43a85ad3fa69e1285a3cf4952.en: An open music session for children aged 3 to 7 at Bodo-Uhse-Bibliothek, with singing, playing and moving together. No prior knowledge needed. Led by Lars Niekisch of the KRAWUTTKES children's music project (KIMPRO).

8a721091ecaa4d2fcc603e308cec97d7095feae4.en: A drawing and painting workshop with charcoal, pencil and brush, led by Marion Stille at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek. Open to all age groups, with materials provided. Free, no registration; funded by the Bibliotheksstärkungsfonds.

9615d7eb11c38fb5693eb453d83ca1620d1c147f.en: The family theatre show "Coq Au Vin – Die große Zaubershow des Ala Labama" at Kulturhaus Spandau. A famous rabbit trick goes wrong and causes chaos in a fantasy show of theatre and circus, with acrobatics, humour and small tricks.

2ac3c65c6af3c0121b0557e00d9f73ada64141a3.en: A literary and musical reading on Robert Schumann with reader Ulrike Hübschmann and pianist Huijing Han at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek. Letters and diaries portray the composer, who first wanted to be a writer, with his music woven in.

bff8988b96975690e742e3640c23f88d24cce6ce.en: A song evening, "Von Frauenhand gewoben", at Schwartzsche Villa salon, with singers and pianist Saki Sakai. It presents songs by women composers and poets such as Pauline Viardot and Fanny Hensel. Entry 15 euros, 7 euros reduced.

d5db24570fd2990063aa895ef44ad39c378d5133.en: KoRn's EURO TOUR 2026 at Uber Arena with Premium packages. The Premium Seat includes a seat in blocks 101 to 104, the Premium Lounge and a separate entrance. All-In Premium adds a buffet and drinks. eTickets arrive three to five days before the show.

e8fa4a1a4b344af30e7e21f3bab357521f960fdd.en: The Kid LAROI's A Perfect World Tour at Uber Eats Music Hall, presented by Live Nation with support act nate sib. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by an adult, and no one under 6 is admitted. Accessibility help is via the call centre.

c8443df98fca2e3ed94a9355ce86a639a0cce84e.en: Tove Lo's ESTRUS, with the Signed First Entry Package. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian aged at least 18, and no one under 6 is admitted.

8b99c41aed1a5ffa09ae0f75b7fc47c645e6f38b.en: A violin-family workshop for the youngest students, "Fiddle-Spaß", at Droste-Hülshoff-Gymnasium. Children who play confidently in first position join a weekend of ensemble playing and present a short programme to parents, taught by music school teachers.

24f1df64212a78a7c6b0d9fad4c2d38f7bdd57fb.en: A guided excursion to the Jewish cemetery in Weißensee, opened in 1880 and covering 40 hectares. It holds nearly 116,000 graves and about 350 plant species. Men need a head covering; kippahs can be borrowed.

a9f82e5ba422f594c30d828373395bba8ddff2d5.en: A walk through Lichtenrade past 33 Stolpersteine at 13 addresses, remembering people persecuted and murdered by the Nazis, most of them Jewish. The walk lasts about two hours around Bahnhofstraße. Registration by email to vhs@ba-ts.berlin.de.

2d6d7d210e1396d2422013814209c1a823a0a6d7.en: Guided tours of "Spuren der Wehrmacht" at Zitadelle Spandau, on the Wehrmacht gas protection laboratories from 1935 to 1945, where nerve agents such as Tabun, Sarin and Soman were researched. Public tours at 12:00 on set dates; fee 4.50 euros.

02709977aaa93eff27d407839cb060250aeb277b.en: A DJ workshop with Spoon Kollektiv at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek for women, non-binary and trans people. Participants learn the equipment and try mixing with vinyl, led by Ena Lind. Registration via the website.

399ed07e0e37b7bf8a25c13666cee457c9f8d362.en: A reading and conversation with activist Arne Semsrott about his new book on turning defence into offence against a rightward shift, at Hansabibliothek. It covers legal battles, collective power, strikes and referendums. Semsrott runs the FragDenStaat portal.

7f3e63508c9914f2fdca9c7fad12cdea7f0f2ef9.en: The puppet show "Kasper Glücksmütze" at Schwartzsche Villa, in which Fräulein Ping and Fräulein Pong tell of a clumsy Kasper with a legendary lucky cap, loosely based on a Grimm tale. For ages 4 and up. Entry 6 euros; advance registration requested.

66bb61d5464fbe3a6505c515d62d87e80023a25b.en: An exhibition by Ellena Olsen at PYRAMIDE Ausstellungszentrum Hellersdorf, showing paintings, graphics and objects from 15 November 2026 to 29 January 2027. The opening is on 15 November at 18:00.

9329dcad0b8651d36c7a2280cfd37dc61df1a069.en: Roy Reinker's ventriloquist show "Irre Zeiten" at Kulturhaus Spandau. His puppets travel through time, from an old man stuck in the GDR to Cleopatra and the messenger god Hermes. A fast multimedia show of jokes and strange stories. Tickets via the card phone.

b74577aaad2a26a41dd904bc8a8a88c196c157a1.en: A factory tour for teachers at Tesla Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg as part of career orientation. It covers around ten vocational trainings, dual study options and the production of electric vehicles. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 26.2-135457.

518d6616147e307a14acc6f8596647713d718d7c.en: A training course for teachers at Hedwig-Dohm-Schule on presentation exams in WAT. Participants develop a counselling concept and task collection, based on BOA exams and eBBR/MSA requirements. Dates: 16 November 2026, 18 December 2026 and 12 April 2027.

4393d6347716288eef17901f277fc421b96e9de2.en: A toy swap at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek for children and families. Each child can bring up to five well-kept toys to exchange with others. Toys cannot be donated, and entry is free.

b3c81a7af58e95ef457b4e1db767357ab80cc933.en: Career coaching at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek for pupils and students aged 14 and up who are looking for a dream job or a way forward after dropping out of university. A career aptitude test is available on request. Free; registration by phone or email.

e3318ba2748b57c90dc2f5037bf80ba09c466e97.en: The puppet show Nur Mut, Petronella tells of a princess born where princes were expected, who sets off on adventures. For ages 3 and up. Groups pay 4.50 euros per person on Friday, 6 euros on Saturday.

aca6679bbbc9fd37a69cbeeaf76bf2f5e3aed0c8.en: A family Tüftel-Samstag at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel on PlayOsmo: children steer Awbie through the Osmo world and practise ScratchJR programming. Also electronics, stop-motion films and laser cutting. Ages 6 to 12; free, no registration.

2f297f6f898f67c42e8c90f1a375ad38d89f94d6.en: A guided tour at Dokumentationszentrum NS-Zwangsarbeit on women in forced labour, marking the International Day Against Violence against Women. It covers racism, sexual assault and forced abortions, using two exhibitions. Free; meet at Baracke 2.

3c947b9519110424e78b2f0657426646f6eb11cf.en: A workshop with Lucie Lučanská, "Das Buch von den fünf Sinnen", at Bibliothek am Wasserturm for children aged 6 to 12, maximum 12. Children map their walk on a long paper roll, noting what they see, hear and smell. Registration from 4 September 2026.

1f7e3707097669a5818269ee5d078275fb411a08.en: A Christmas workshop in Ukrainian Petrykiwka painting with Oleksandra Tkachova at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek. Petrykiwka has been UNESCO intangible heritage since 2013. Participants decorate their own baubles. Limited places; registration required.

58e0dc627da71eb4ae8b66c3b332aa5bebf12fef.en: The concert "Europa tanzt" in the "Europa klingt" series at Rathaus Schmargendorf's Ursula-Mamlok-Saal. Works on freedom and resistance by Beethoven, Chopin and others, plus songs such as "Imagine". Singing along is welcome.

458626034641923528ebdc8b7b9687e855d56412.en: A guided walk along Schloßstraße in Steglitz, part of the first Prussian Chaussee, led by Armin Woy during the anniversary month of Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek. It covers the street's history as a shopping mile. Free; advance registration requested.

9438314782ba389dcb4b8614c0ce155017246a74.en: An information event at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek on the housing market and living in old age. Single seniors in Berlin spend about 34 percent of their pension on rent, and many need age-appropriate housing. Organised by Teilhabe e.V.

8e591a325c5591281ee008de102b9df658e60b9c.en: An evening of song and piano at Schwartzsche Villa, "Shakespeare's Friends", showing how composers from different centuries and countries set the same sonnets. Singer Antonio Mario Tenor and pianist Artur Kirakosian perform. Free entry; donations requested.

0fb049adc3975b8f12a8b1bd1b323e9c94e64228.en: An Easy Language workshop, "Kleidung und Politik – Das Leben einer Jeans", by the Berliner Landeszentrale and Lebenshilfe Bildung. Participants discuss where clothes are made, how jeans are produced and their environmental impact. Free; groups of up to 14.

34f8df9dcce97506c012e659a6bd72e74cb141aa.en: Free advice on German pension insurance at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade from a volunteer adviser, covering account clarification, pension applications and forms. Second Monday of each month, 15:00 to 18:00. Advance booking with Peter Hermann required.

5f30e41d8b743291b3c88a1689f2b88688375791.en: The opening of the Wunschbaum campaign at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek with a short concert. Visitors take a star from the tree and fulfil a child's wish. The campaign runs until 10 December 2026.

ae7a5cf95dfd417aac0553cf3b9c01f80e2c3ec2.en: A bilingual fairy tale hour in German and Persian at Bibliothek am Wasserturm. Traditional Persian tales are told in Persian and translated into German, for ages 3 and up and their families. Part of the Bilingual Fairy Tale Days in Pankow. Free.

7029cfd1ae89534110e3ae1a32b7df32ae101725.en: A picture-book cinema afternoon at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek as part of the 37th Berliner Märchentage, presenting "Frau Holle". A diligent stepdaughter falls into a well and enters Mother Holle's world. Free; no advance registration.

f25f7b5e9b8741b794539112cb14c59fbd8a6601.en: An open crime-fiction book club, the Krimi-Kreis, at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel, held on the third Monday of each month for fans of all ages. No advance registration needed.

82d9de84436a137fbf9b8f497f115e9294746965.en: A presentation of beatbox workshops by children and young people from RAZZZ and the RAZZZONES at Janusz-Korczak-Bibliothek. An hour of beatboxing for parents, friends and anyone interested. Free; register by email to WORKSHOP@RAZZZ.DE.

2e86da904095d2f1429b360860e33cb6cfaf200a.en: A Pokémon card swap at Bettina-von-Arnim-Bibliothek on the third Monday of each month, 17:30 to 18:30. Bring your cards, trade them with others and discover new favourites. No registration needed.

c4db35430368d335cc4238f5f81587d888bef25e.en: Sven reads from Lewis Carroll's "Alice im Wunderland" at Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Bibliothek for adults and children aged 8 and up. Eight evenings, each with about thirty minutes of reading and then discussion. Free; no prior knowledge needed.

89549057211e6b6cc0a68616e4469961e712583b.en: The Politischer Abend 2026 of Landesjugendring Berlin at Refugio Berlin, titled "Große Pläne, enge Räume". It asks how the spaces of young people can be protected and how their views can be heard.

3c8298389c2b816f85cdea8e2aed18f7e1b970f4.en: A discussion on renewable raw materials, "Busch in Berlin", at Galerie Parterre with artists and professors Heike Klussmann, Lucy Norris and Stefanie Bürkle, in conversation with Folke Köbberling, Natalija Miodragović and Max Jeromin of IAK.

10a226023ecbdff14c391d2e591fe6334ef6c9be.en: A torchlight tour for adults through the Aquarium Berlin after the lights go out, with a guide. Visitors explore all floors with their own torch and see which animals are active at night. Tickets are sold online in advance only and are strictly limited.

72d22dacc15c363de49b8439e1c80bb35a812133.en: A panel on class barriers in grassroots sport, "Sport für alle? Klassismus als Barriere im Breitensport", at the Ostkreuz visitor centre, part of the series "Wem gehört der Sport?". It examines how social norms and brand products hold people back.

fb47119d95c8f7abe637ae2670049b3bba711a28.en: The International Guitar Night 2026 at Gotischer Saal in Zitadelle Spandau, with Dave Goodman (Canada), Jaco Liu (China) and Peter Finger (Germany). The concert series has run for over 30 years with masters of acoustic guitar.

1eaa76503ed5d949614f123cb0c25c6e47fe69ca.en: Placebo's 30th Anniversary Tour at Uber Arena. Accessibility requests from wheelchair users and people with severe disabilities who need a companion should go to barrierefrei@fkpscorpio.com.

9aae7642dd94588835c4fdae85f7a4e8b78a2f8c.en: Jessie Ware on The Superbloom Tour 2026, presented by Live Nation, with support act TSATSAMIS.

6fc5c8744b03f4644c6a0b26773a75a4717125ed.en: The Transfer Week Berlin-Brandenburg 2026 from 16 to 20 November at various Berlin venues, bringing science, companies and innovators together. A funding day on 20 November covers current support for innovation projects. Registration via b2match.

e5d7056022d41c66301645ee63148444cd9a1533.en: A monthly morning of stories and music for babies aged 0 to 3 with their carers at Bibliothek am Wasserturm. Singer Malika Alaoui sings songs, rhymes and finger plays from around the world, followed by picture-book time. Free.

06f770f80614c89aa2f21542c77713bca7a1d874.en: The puppet show "Die Schildkröte hat Geburtstag" at Schwartzsche Villa by Birgit Liebau, for children aged 2 and up. A tortoise hopes for a lettuce for her birthday, and a clever mouse brings a large parcel. Entry 6 euros; 5 euros per child in groups.

5fe2e24b18ab0993990fb675d507f2c01c6be381.en: Operetta with coffee at Kulturhaus Spandau, with Alenka Genzel (soprano) and Frank Matthias (baritone). They sing their way through operetta history in duets, with witty commentary and melodies from opera, musical and film.

0a311a85b738c6d375711ef6ceca2e4bfc9471ea.en: A career and application check at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, where advisers offer quick 15-minute application checks and advice on career changes, training and interview preparation. Free; advance booking by phone or email.

774b6b5b529cc16dc09f815213392a36304fe81b.en: An upcycling workshop at Bodo-Uhse-Bibliothek, where old crystal chandeliers become necklaces, earrings or pendants. Beginners and DIY experts are welcome. Free; children can join with a parent. Registration by email.

29fd0aef9f4c55a2c94a88185b5ceb950485d12f.en: The Seniorenorchester Steglitz-Zehlendorf, conducted by Galina Ehlert, plays marches, potpourris, operetta melodies and waltzes at Maria-Rimkus-Haus. Doors open 14:00, start 15:00. Entry 2.50 euros, plus 3 euros for coffee.

f6a2d35edb16bb80f8283486e6fa66371202a1f3.en: A clothes swap at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek to counter fast fashion. Bring clean, well-kept clothing, excluding shoes and children's clothes, sort it by category and browse. It highlights the UN goal on responsible consumption.

e7379d74cdb7e1acfd166174b4cad3cf3860615a.en: A picture-book cinema at Stadtteilbibliothek Marienfelde with funny and exciting stories for children aged 4 and up. Free, no registration needed.

f8e6142ee677c219b114b1e159ce8832ae3749a1.en: A makerspace introduction at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg. Learn what a makerspace is, ask questions and get your usage permission. For ages 16 and up, in the ground-floor makerspace.

af0a34a7ae8a6edc9dd4b55c39dddc6225614fe8.en: Mokuiku, a Japanese wood workshop at Bruno-Lösche-Bibliothek, which makes children aware of forests and wood. Working with their own hands introduces sustainability and environmental awareness in a playful way.

4cea87a7e0c8cf254765884be483376b0aabf7dc.en: The LeseZeichen literature round table at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek, held on the third Tuesday of each month at 16:00. Participants share books, often around a theme, with short contributions of up to three minutes. Excursions and literary cafés also feature.

b99c009325a0cc3807394a2524f0c328b543c37a.en: A reading afternoon at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek marking the International Day of Children's Rights on 20 November, with information on children's rights from the local youth participation office. Free entry; no registration needed.

cc8e9e3e083c134e125bf4a95a12660ba53a9e6f.en: A children's theatre show by Kindertheater Purzelbaum, "Furzipups, der Knatterdrache", at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek. The little dragon makes thunder instead of fire, which is awkward among the big dragons. From age 2; free, no registration.

4ec76a7fe3c04efe529aa381e6c4805f3f371730.en: Repair Café III of KlimaWerkstatt Spandau at Haus Kladower Forum, on the third Tuesday of each month from 17:30 to 20:00. Volunteers guide repairs of broken household items. Register in advance with coordinator Max by phone.

a8098c57f2ccdc16121c6e113f71da8117f7f9e1.en: A reading and conversation with Kerstin Ehmer about sixteen women who devoted their lives to the oceans, including Virginia Woolf and Marie Tharp, who charted the seabed. At Buchhandlung am Schäfersee, with sign-language interpreters.

f8e961b1609289e9dd22e4f2a69f8632d34fe718.en: A self-assertion and self-defence course for young and adult women at Hansabibliothek. Participants learn simple everyday techniques to stand confidently, set boundaries and defend themselves. Beginners welcome; wear loose clothing.

b64e2e2735cc6f2fc96ce9924b0dfee363a99072.en: The opening of Martin Colden's exhibition "Notate" at Galerie Pankow, the 15th Egmont-Schaefer-Preis für Zeichnung 2026. Shown from 18 November 2026 to 24 January 2027, in cooperation with Berliner Kabinett e.V.

ee0d34e6ed2e5391aaa47c467fdb74e02919b3c1.en: Karlshorster im Gespräch: moderator Manja Haueis talks with Friederike Wendt, who leads an inclusive equestrian and riding therapy centre in Karlshorst, about her work and her love of horses. Music by Lothar Bösel and Floriane Priew. Entry 3 euros.

c4b4dadc70d2f83ae16df6c1e658494098e42122.en: A concert by singing teachers of the Fachgruppe Gesang at Kirchsaal des Evangelischen Campus Daniel. Performers are yet to be named; coordinated by Elene Khonelidze.

fb921ae6c80a1da0ed0f9a3de43d7a27f3e553f0.en: A livestream reading of Stefan Zweig's "Sternstunden der Menschheit", read by voice actors Giuliana Jakobeit and Konrad Bösherz at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek. Viewers can also join the livestream on TikTok or Instagram.

982dc351787fda05344af6dc9e74fe50c1006997.en: The Merlino Quartett plays Ravel's String Quartet in F major, op. 35, paired with Mendelssohn's last quartet and a quartet by double bass virtuoso Johann Matthias Sperger, at Schwartzsche Villa salon. Free entry.

bcf1cc83b890d711ebfbb5800d3094057c54b5b2.en: Hatsune Miku's MIKU EXPO 2026 EUROPE, presented by Live Nation. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by an adult aged at least 18, and no one under 6 is admitted. Accessibility help is via the call centre.

afe91479e588d5868791e7c7bc1ac8aab3f832d9.en: A consultation hour at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek by the Pflegestützpunkte on care and ageing: care insurance benefits, adapting a home, choosing housing and relief for relatives. Every third Wednesday of the month, 10:00 to 12:00. Registration requested.

03198fe0434dc81b7c0019652b5ba073b70c95ea.en: M FOKUS, the second reading in the series "Perspektiven auf künstliche Intelligenz" at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek, with Rainer Mühlhoff, author of "Künstliche Intelligenz und der neue Faschismus". It explores how the tech industry and the new right intersect.

ffa3bae9fc5f4040d553f3b24abfabfbcad30b02.en: A reading by Valeria Gordeev from her debut novel "Die Zikade entschlüpft ihrer goldglänzenden Hülle" at Schiller-Bibliothek. Set between Kyiv, Moscow and Berlin, it follows a brother and sister in a world falling apart. The novel won the Jürgen Ponto award.

85ed2c5ba5d804762dfd8dad49b36c09e126dc38.en: A winter story at Schwartzsche Villa about friendship and tolerance: little dragon Naseweis, hedgehog girl Trudi and snow cloud Schneeweiß soften an angry big cloud. Puppet play by Birgit Liebau for ages 3 and up. Entry 6 euros, 5 euros per child in groups.

76c4b731f3a59db847dc55ac24a3520b837d2b37.en: A monthly e-media consultation hour at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg on VÖBB digital offers such as Onleihe, Libby and PressReader. One-to-one advice; bring your own device. Free, registration requested.

c47883a898a746004665464dd1b88c4017482a79.en: An exhibition of Martin Colden's "Notate" at Galerie Pankow, the 15th Egmont-Schaefer-Preis für Zeichnung 2026, from 18 November 2026 to 24 January 2027. The prize honours drawing and is awarded every two years by Berliner Kabinett e.V.

72edc2f235bee95ae826c3dcb3da476267d0a7b1.en: A music group for people with dementia and their relatives at BALL e.V. Stadtteilzentrum Biesdorf. Participants play simple melodies on table harps and recall songs from childhood. No music reading skills needed; everyone is welcome.

a9d5f438b3d5489219ea3edc51760c6f99f57d77.en: Kaffee & Kultur at STZ PestalozziTreff with the Greek guitar duo ATHENIA, on Wednesday 18 November 2026 at 14:30. Entry 5 euros; coffee and cake from 3 euros from 14:00. Registration requested by phone.

49f95a6568173ee60aefb8b5e0d7bb23bb41161b.en: A free manga workshop at Stadtteilbibliothek Buch for Manga Day 2026, led by artist and illustrator Malou Kipper.

bba14d1042641bcda93e8c40aa557186697b995d.en: The Kieztreff Kunst & Kultur at Stadtteilzentrum Kaulsdorf is an open group that meets on the third Wednesday of each month from 16:00 to 18:00. Members explore museums, studios, readings and theatre together. Newcomers are welcome.

d5a937aa4a901069f548f0d5ec4dd10d110519be.en: Chess at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek for players of all ages and levels, from beginners wanting to learn to experienced players refreshing the rules. No registration needed; information by phone or email.

c0a8496e5aba43e4a741cc003b586226b70ef635.en: A sociable dance circle at Janusz-Korczak-Bibliothek on Wednesdays from 17:00 to 18:30, with simple steps to music from around the world. Led by Ronald Kosellek. No prior experience needed; flat shoes recommended.

ddfa4f7c89fd9ee50a73a7946e71d0767efabfb2.en: An information stand at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek on the self-help and neighbourhood projects of Mittelhof e.V., including how self-help groups work and what the Nachbarschaftsladen Berlinickestraße offers. Free, no registration.

c6173041960c606cab87fce96440e9474bfd25c1.en: A pub quiz at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek, with no beer but plenty of fun. Test your useful and useless knowledge against others. Free; no registration needed.

3c2dba4fd6ae789b11449b186502106c132d8594.en: A multimedia talk, "Oberitalien", by Peter Jaeger at Kulturhaus Karlshorst, a journey through northern Italy in the footsteps of Giuseppe Verdi, with art, music and Italian flair. Run with VHS Lichtenberg. Entry 6 euros, reduced 3 euros.

69648747c720fe1125bd284ca4982fca39686933.en: The exhibition "Schrott oder Schatz" by INKOTA at Pablo-Neruda-Bibliothek on what electronic devices contain and how to keep them in use longer. Shown 2 to 29 November in four languages, with a dialogue workshop on 18 November.

7b078703574a44bf1bce57c0e054d5b720810164.en: The autumn symphony concert of the Jugendkammerorchester Zehlendorf and the Leo-Borchard-Orchester at Wohnstift Otto Dibelius, with symphonic works from classical and film music. Led by Peter Michel and Julius Schwahn.

8539594c1ae6aed7335d4058e8ceb17992b884fc.en: The premiere of "Yvonne, Prinzessin von Burgund" by Witold Gombrowicz at KungerKiezTheater on 19 September 2026 at 19:00, directed by Katrin Heinau. It shows how an outsider girl at court is destroyed by exclusion and bullying. Further dates follow.

296a6416c0b2448f81ac9fb7449036a634d8c527.en: Comic artist Simon Schwartz reads from "Vita Obscura: Out of Sight" at Bibliothek am Luisenbad, presenting bizarre biographies of forgotten lives and reading from his comics. Registration by email; entry 5 euros.

3ab89e8f5fb0161a715f3308a0ff5d81e0f37023.en: A fairy tale evening for adults, "Die Fee Ariola sucht die goldene Harfe", at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek as part of the 37th Berliner Märchentage. Three friends search for a golden harp in Ireland, with cello and Celtic harp. Starts 20:00; registration required.

2976a98e6a0a7ecfcf62a02b9c04d75e96682822.en: InfraSPREE 2026, the industry summit for water and technical infrastructure in Berlin and Brandenburg, at Schinkelhalle. Two days of knowledge and networking for municipalities, authorities, water associations, skilled workers and students.

cc0efb2ff107bf92b245acdb0270dd99b18dde88.en: Free, independent solar advice at KlimaWerkstatt Spandau from the SolarZentrum Berlin, covering photovoltaics, solar thermal and heat pumps. Every third Wednesday of the month, 10:00 to 17:00. Appointment required; about 60 minutes per person.

50045cd7c294f917ce831cb31bec323f14f75b95.en: A science show, "Energie = magic²", by Oliver Grammel at Kulturhaus Spandau for pupils in grades 3 to 6 and children aged 8 and up. Experiments mix physics and magic, from floating silver rings to a candle that powers a small boat motor. About 60 minutes.

b67e1c812b9aea9f224f6729723c451d3a8c5da2.en: A mobile citizens' office from the Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg district at East Side Mall offers public services without an appointment, from ID applications to residence permit transfers. Card payment only; passport photos can be taken on site for 6 euros.

c41da2dd6e0eae32e87c567d05e7b05b08037c34.en: A swap and bulky-waste market at Am Kiehlufer on 19 November from 13:00 to 18:00, held as part of BSR Kieztag. Drop off bulky items for free and take useful things others have brought. No deliveries by car or van.

4f52dad0eee85e554e046fe2fb18a6578ffc761d.en: A bingo afternoon at Maria-Rimkus-Haus, where a prize wheel spins for small prizes. Doors open at 13:00, start at 14:00. Entry free; coffee 3 euros, and drinks are available for a fee.

bcf67e3d0e8d36ae004a7b6b0aaed8e4d19d847b.en: A three-part teacher training at Wilma-Rudolph-Schule by DKJS on founding a pupil company, from an online input through a school concept to a visit to a school that already runs one. Dates in 2027. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 26.2-134627.

952910b73340926647995dda0bf95ec5afeb80ff.en: A poster design session for the International Day Against Violence Against Women at Stadtteilbibliothek Buch.

7808107c7ad317a69802d1d334169aa6522f3ca5.en: An open reading circle at Stadtteilbibliothek Karow on Sibylle Berg's novel "Der Mann schläft", with conversation about its themes and personal impressions. Interested people can register with the library.

d821747128212378a35adf6d1741a42f66f32bb3.en: LiteraturDialog at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek, a meeting place for readers to exchange reading experiences and get ideas. Run by the Förderkreis der Lichtenberger Bibliotheken. Free entry; registration by phone.

aa9371048265e31043a58439077c3a325f42c065.en: A monthly European afternoon at the intercultural family centre "aufatmen", with one country in focus each time. Crafts, snacks, a story and games from that country are included. No registration needed; funded by the Senatskanzlei Berlin.

eb94a22fc09b1725f09fc688b2dc21047bafafb0.en: Tüftel-Donnerstag at Bibliothek im Märkischen Viertel, where children and families build virtual game worlds with physical pieces and steer Awbie, then program in ScratchJR. Also Blue Bots and simple circuits. Ages 5 to 16; free, with a parent.

88bf00465f11c4f41eb84ebdc1f777148ca07a4f.en: A craft afternoon at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek on the third Friday of each month from 16:00 to 18:00, for children from age 5 with their families and friends. Materials are provided and each time brings a new idea.

fe9a3493c05ee1c8fd7ca30b97cbb3cc8ea78097.en: A picture-book cinema afternoon at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek, part of the Berliner Märchentage, where Rumpelstiltskin dances around the fire and sings his name. Craft activity included. Free, no registration; recommended for ages 3 and up.

89e5114d567a9bc478941af47a1b99e57375b356.en: A bilingual Chinese and German fairy tale hour at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek, with a Chinese-German story read by the association Hi Bao. Part of the bilingual fairy tale days.

62283628b332d7f476873b61aed85e461601697a.en: Chess for everyone at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek in the creative lounge on the first floor. The new chess leader welcomes beginners and advanced players of all ages from September. Free; registration required.

008af32d39a161dbcbb7481a5e23840d877c75f1.en: Leseknirpse at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda, a hands-on session with Familienzentrum DAS HAUS for families with children up to 6, with picture-book cinema, outdoor games and robots. On 18 November 2026, 16:00 to 17:30. Free.

ddfa49782b2f10d294616ab7bde6ac570615e85d.en: Muse's Wow Signal Europa Tour at Uber Arena, presented by Live Nation. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by an adult aged at least 18, and no one under 6 is admitted. Accessible tickets vary by venue.

b62470a6ee1cacac35ed58dd591e7277aea5b082.en: MeisterPOWER, a browser-based learning software for the crafts trade, at Handwerkskammer Berlin. Teachers learn to use it in WAT and vocational lessons, including a business simulation. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 26.2-135543.

a0901b3b9824847b1c94084bbd1c7ddb6e205851.en: SchlossKultur at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, a series on the last Thursday of each month from 16:00 to 19:00, offering crafts, travel and music. Past sessions included a spring booklet for ages 6 and up and an opera journey through Verdi and Puccini.

1b301f4a8a56bf58987a5648244c8f9281beeb44.en: The shadow-puppet show "Nachtkatze und Dachgespenst" at Bruno-Lösche-Bibliothek. A cat on a roof longs to join the mice in the courtyard, and at midnight something moves under a tablecloth. Ages 3 and up; registration by email.

4ccc1a7668eeb96448f91398e8ec531ecde4d72b.en: A lantern parade at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg on 19 November after the picture-book cinema, walking through Heinrich-Lassen-Park to the fairy-tale playground, followed by warm children's punch. Free, no registration; for families.

3613cfe6e69bce50ff0595a3ff05b363a77bcb81.en: An introduction to 3D printing at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg, a vhs taster course in which participants learn the printer's setup and print selected objects together. Free; registration by email or at the library counter.

dd6d6a5036db0c10b6531a4380221e29e159b6eb.en: A new true-crime talk and reading circle at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, where participants discuss true crime, crime novels and nonfiction from criminology, sociology and psychology. Anyone may present a book or article. Free, no registration.

ad2b41edb68d15a6ac615d2d4bebe8218d4d62a6.en: A KrisenFest reading with Madeleine Hofmann about "Trost" at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek, exploring what can console us amid personal losses and crises. Funded by the Berliner Landeszentrale für politische Bildung. Free; registration requested.

16f97463f33a5519aeaa0c4eb7f3fce497ae2c39.en: The autumn concert of Musikschule "Hans Werner Henze" at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek, performed by the plucked-instrument group, including the ensemble Arpeggio under Eric Schumann on guitar, mandolin, harp and balalaika. Registration requested; donation at exit.

36612cd5566d554cc009124b7720ae20e1c1b3e4.en: A Selbstgemacht workshop at Bibliothek Tiergarten-Süd on making bath bombs without allergenic ingredients, using baking soda, shea butter and citric acid. Led by Kulturlabor Trial&Error. Registration via pretix.

b2431892d4dc2d20c51794c31af922a0abb81176.en: A reading for everyone with Fikri Anıl Altıntaş at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek from his novel "Zwischen uns liegt August", about a son who loses his mother. The conversation is moderated by Mareice Kaiser. Free, no registration.

3ba5fea5d3dd524d8220593ae32f91dc679710f8.en: "All'italiana", an accordion concert at the Musikinstrumenten-Museum on Castelfidardo, the centre of Italian accordion making. Author Bruno Franceschini and accordionist Radu Ratoi create a musical and literary excursion. Entry 16 euros, reduced 11 euros.

7c081ef0caa9b5432aa726d13ed24c81496f7e13.en: The musical "The Mad Ones" by Kait Kerrigan and Bree Lowdermilk at Schwartzsche Villa, for ages 14 and up. After her best friend's sudden death, 18-year-old Sam must decide whether to follow others' expectations or take the wheel herself. First Berlin staging.

a0a1c1be967bf7f3bf31c1780e9da0b04037aafd.en: Ozan Zakariya Keskinkılıç reads from his debut novel "Hundesohn" at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda on 19 November, moderated by Georgina Fakunmoju. The love story moves between Berlin and Adana after the death of Zeko's grandfather.

a630becf612c83d3d40aac73a62744137463d644.en: A thriller reading, "Jetzt schreiben – Gegenwart lesen", at Bruno-Lösche-Bibliothek, with excerpts from published works and works in progress. Moderated by Tanja Steinlechner, founder of the writing school Schreibhain. Free; registration by pretix.

da6564838220b865168693b28cc3091e298108eb.en: The Berlin Jazz Composers Orchestra JayJayBeCe, a youth jazz band founded in 1987 at Musikschule Charlottenburg to perform works by Berlin jazz composers. At Kühlspot Social Club, in cooperation with Jazzkeller 69 e.V.

c45ad343874c67af948f752055dd44418f313772.en: Digital Stars at MIKU EXPO Europe in Berlin, presented by Live Nation, with line-up Flavor Foley and Vault Kid.

6378ca32809ed3c483273d1d35a968ea6de877a6.en: A pop and rock concert by pupils of the Fachgruppe at Artenschutz-Theater, coordinated by Piet Buslay.

eadbc093fcf0a1ada393622ce887f39e32d20172.en: A networking event on the EU funding programme LIFE at Zukunft – Umwelt – Gesellschaft (ZUG) gGmbH, titled "LIFE: Gestern – Heute – Morgen". Nature, environment and climate projects are presented, with time for exchange and networking.

556cfbc82955c089566b50dbae58b720561221ba.en: A swap and bulky-waste market at Joachim-Gottschalk-Weg on 20 November from 8:00 to 13:00, held as part of BSR Kieztag. Drop off bulky items for free and take useful things others brought. No deliveries by car or van.

157dcb39b834a0084f58860d66762b33352f3e2f.en: Storyteller Bruder Lustig tells "Toni und die Zauberflöte" at Kulturhaus Spandau in the 37th Berliner Märchentage, for ages 3 to 8, about 45 minutes. A boy herding a miser's pigs receives a magic flute. Songs and instruments included.

836887e38b7d5f667e737b1750557bc81fcfaabe.en: A reading marathon for the Bundesweiter Vorlesetag at Schiller-Bibliothek. Kindergarten groups read at 10:00 and 11:00, families are welcome at 12:00 to 15:00 and 18:00, and the "Starke Töchter" fairy-tale reading for ages 6 and up runs at 16:00 and 17:00.

06ab021ebc363b64d884bc646016eb81a66bee8e.en: The national Reading Day at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, with readings and activities for children aged 3 and up. The district councillor reads her favourite books for children aged 5 and up at 16:00. Free; phone 030 90299 2410.

4bd63ef3dedcce7143aaa8db59e07de36f47eca5.en: A clothes swap party at Schiller-Bibliothek on the third Friday of each month. Bring up to 10 clean, undamaged garments or accessories, swap them for new favourites and learn how to upcycle clothing.

f7b951d6100fb9019d155671b977c379689623f1.en: An open sewing group at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel, where people aged 15 and up sew their own projects with a sewing machine provided. Bring your own materials; prior skills are helpful. Free, no registration.

cf4c0c82f0f52ea494d708f62575dfaa6700e784.en: Music for children and babies, MuKiBa, at Gertrud-Junge-Bibliothek, led by Virgil Segal. Children and parents improvise, dance and sing, and try instruments such as drums, trumpet and violin. Free; no registration needed.

9f4c9a6ed43b42a2bd01c18118762b61c811c328.en: A children's rights day party at Bibliothek am Luisenbad with waffles, play and creative activities for children and their families.

b1facb854e917c86de63f76722eed1b9177258fc.en: A marathon reading for the Bundesweiter Vorlesetag at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek, where library staff present their work and read favourite books aloud. For everyone aged 4 and up; no registration needed.

ef20a67bbb2b71c1428b28b3112b2745c4be6b1a.en: A reading hour for the national Reading Day in the children's library at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek, with stories, fantasy and adventures for children aged 4 and up.

f2884f835955546195cafe401e814067338bae32.en: An open role-playing round by Nexus e.V. once a month at Stadtteilbibliothek Halemweg. Everyone curious can try pen-and-paper role-playing games. Contact: info@nexus-berlin.de.

43c0547a0ac38b8badf1732a534a27db99c19be1.en: A listening session with Elisa R. Linn at Hansabibliothek, where she shares her musical influences, formative albums, favourite pieces and obsessions. Together the audience listens through different soundscapes and discusses the stories behind them.

1754d2ce671f66cdfa800393a6eef5fae8ba5a20.en: A film and conversation, "Nicht ohne meine Tiere", at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek about four people living with heroin addiction and substitution treatment, supported by their pets. The film also covers German drug policy. Free, for adults.

cf4f7e93754d556585da9f0964da631c6cdcbf2a.en: A torch tour for families through Aquarium Berlin after the lights go out. With a guide, families explore all floors and look for eyes in the torchlight among reptiles, amphibians and insects. Tickets are sold online in advance only and are strictly limited.

35f167f6803dd5f57f44a1722164cf492fc0fdc8.en: A Lettekiez reading with Moritz Matthies of "Die Schweiz ist nicht genug: Ein Erdmännchen-Krimi", the eleventh volume, in which meerkat detectives Ray and Rufus from Berlin Zoo travel to St. Moritz. Reading and discussion at Bibliothek am Schäfersee.

7a348a9ecb1f9a8c41306b24b7820874609db9cf.en: A multimedia show, "Japan", by Berlin journalist and photographer Roland Marske at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade, on Japanese culture, landscapes and everyday life, drawn from several trips. Free; registration via the Cituro link.

6490e5ce6fd8df65fecbd1b91bd18aee13dd0794.en: A winter concert by Erstes Zusammenspiel and ABC-Orchester in the Festsaal of Rathaus Charlottenburg, led by Christian Rohloff, Jan Paul Kussmaul and Emmanuelle Verger. Strings from the orchestra school.

3c05d02fc9770d3d32591fef65b9ef2213d1d47e.en: A creative workshop for adults at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek on 21 August 2026, making long-lasting summer flower decorations from paper. Free; registration via pretix or by phone.

6cc294fe4198c05beb152a6ed657bfa5d980a814.en: The Lívia Bergo Quartett plays favourite songs from Brazil in a teachers' concert at Regenbogenfabrik. Lívia Bergo sings, David Philipp plays guitar, Maxi Heinicke plays violin and cavaquinho, and Katrin Hornberger plays percussion.

f78bb63246b849d87be9ee15f41e5917ec516307.en: A teacher training at Comenius Schule on preparing pupils with autism for work. It offers recommendations for school-to-work preparation, then discussion on applying them in class. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 26.2-134480.

7310abe716c296258c4c80e14e1e45911c317091.en: Coffee and AI: phone photos, for women aged 60 and over (younger women welcome) at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek. Participants learn to take, edit and sort photos with the camera app, led by Daniela Walter. Registration by email or phone.

4ade76420c5184a9112e932e5ef972d8cfdfe747.en: A screening of "Amar & Lena" with filmmaker Farouk El-Khalili at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek, a drama about a couple who choose not to have children against family traditions. A discussion with the director and cast follows. Entry 2 euros.

c77bae6ab754fbab358208e45883cac94b5f7457.en: The exhibition "Was? Haus- und Waldbesetzungen in Spandau?" at Zitadelle Spandau, 20 November 2026 to 6 February 2028, on 1970s and 1980s protests against environmental damage and planning. Video interviews, art and interactive stations.

1dac3c1493dc95bcb8c8207eb57c0931b36fcd24.en: The film "Jenseits der blauen Grenze" by Sarah Neumann (Germany 2024), about escape attempts across the Baltic Sea in summer 1989, at Kulturhaus Karlshorst. Film scholar Irina Vogt presents it, followed by a discussion. Entry 7 euros.

7ec6f272ab3724536518c337bf7bbe396d8f7a00.en: Freya Skye's Stars Align Tour at Uber Eats Music Hall with Gallery Seat & Drinks tickets. Prime seats in blocks 202 to 204, drinks from admission until 30 minutes after the show, Gallery Bar access and a fast-lane entrance.

4f0553ed1ed346949fa9c669cc2fc652e4e6b4f9.en: Duo Isenbügel and Assmann perform "Der Schneegenbogen" at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek, a poetic story about friendship and farewell, staged as an interactive reading with live music. For ages 4 and up; free with advance registration.

1257c29d6d0fdaddb93f700843330fb3e20b5961.en: The Hellenic Community reads the Greek children's book "Die drei kleinen Wölfchen" by Evgenios Trivizas at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, part of the Berliner Märchentage. A humorous tale of three wolves protecting their home from a pig. Free.

3df31484ed7d4085d19be0f41f776a139f6207c9.en: A recital by pupils of the keyboard instruments group, at the Ursula-Mamlok-Saal of Rathaus Schmargendorf.

8126a2a843261ce3ca03b05407e6be819b2e0844.en: An open games club at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek, where people of different generations test board and card games together. Players are welcome at any time.

607e485bd0aa16f505e2d35678c630792c9fb113.en: A reading of "Sîya Berêvarên Gewr" by poet Nûroj Mûnzûr at Wilhelm-Liebknecht-/Namik-Kemal-Bibliothek in Adalbertstraße. The event is in Kurmanji Kurdish, moderated by Hemza Altun, with poems and questions from the audience.

ad26f7f5e64819d7dbfb269d8aa48670d8a672c2.en: The streaming album release concert of the band Fabeck, "Wüste", at Kulturhaus Spandau. Their blend of acoustic grooves and distorted sound is celebrated after two decades of making music.

52a0d965d411a52ad2fd50ddf8acf78ca7c4147b.en: Nadel & Faden, an open craft group at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek for sewing, knitting, crochet and embroidery. New crafters are welcome. Free, no registration needed.

f3dd05206c36145f1209307e9f714c43fb314d4e.en: A workshop at Dokumentationszentrum NS-Zwangsarbeit on forced labour and labour exploitation under National Socialism and today, when exploitation still underpins some business models in Germany. Registration by email to the centre.

13fdae5113882101dee4ccca3153288c0f07fe30.en: A one-day seminar on conflict management, "Erfolgreiches Konfliktmanagement", at kantaa – gut beraten, led by mediator and supervisor Wolfgang Bißdorf. Techniques for de-escalation and solutions that include all perspectives. Fee 15 euros, including lunch.

8cc16559ccf73dbcf64b03cb1883bb8d9191fc66.en: A workshop on modern playing techniques for the flute, at the music school concert hall, coordinated by Petra Hildner and Franziska-Marie Scholz.

04c86ac9f9c47b296605c985d21b9c4e3551fa6a.en: An inclusive rhythm workshop for adults at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek, a two-hour session of movement, voice and rhythm games. Suitable for everyone, seated or standing. Led by Myriam Brigmann; bring water and comfortable clothes.

eb638d039e9929032af3a1235a93d6591a47a7d1.en: A painting session for children at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek, where artist Christine Klemke shows how to paint Little Red Riding Hood, the wolf and strong trees. No registration. Upcoming fairy tales include Rapunzel and Hansel and Gretel.

c5efde5e28501c336857a19abf869b0224963573.en: An open day at the Französisches Gymnasium on Saturday 21 November for prospective pupils and parents. Visitors see classrooms, talk with pupils and teachers, and learn about its three goals: the Abitur, the BacAbi and the French Baccalauréat.

a782ba816554a5ee6330edc14f40b4e9154eb678.en: A Japanese bookbinding workshop with Klaus Mißler at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek. Participants make brochures with coloured covers and three- or five-stitch binding, step by step. Materials provided; limited places, free. Registration by phone or email.

8a0ed7c9b9475534846b5406659eb79206cdc9b1.en: A family concert with Das Rolfsrudel in the children's library at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek, with cheerful songs and handmade music. Children can sing and dance along.

bbc34f80ab7f494ea9d76ae385c13352b0bafcff.en: Musik-Salon Luise at Bibliothek am Luisenbad with the Indie Pop Chor Berlin, singing pop songs by Radiohead, Wir sind Helden, Agnes Obel and Florence and the Machine in arrangements by conductor Lena Sundermeyer.

00181148157abfe06ebe3e7c1dab3210137dca8d.en: An introduction to pen-and-paper roleplaying with Nexus e.V. at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg. Players create characters and tell a shared adventure, guided by a game master and dice.

c1e06458a39ae9de605f0fb4f6c940eaa90c587e.en: A 3D picture-frame craft workshop for children aged 5 and up at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek, led by Asja Bonitz. Materials provided; younger children can join with an adult. Free, no registration.

1853699ea345c2041c660e71f05198ceb8f54529.en: Carla Bertone's creative crafts meeting at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek on the third Saturday of each month, with paper, paint, natural materials and upcycling. Themes include mini sculptures on 17 October and wind chimes on 21 November 2026.

21a95c8be8a05b296c13862dcdda0ea430f7b509.en: A writing workshop with author Kathrin Schrader at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek on what makes a story gripping, with a short writing exercise. For ages 12 and up; free, no registration.

bc609bba89c9f705956830c05e84db3a440ae3e4.en: Interactive laundry-basket theatre with Anna Srivastava at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek for children and families. Rumpelstiltskin is on 12 September 2026 and Cinderella on 26 September 2026, both at 14:00. No registration.

c30ae199267079d3a8df63ef4d85533ba93282fa.en: A figure play from Theater auf dem Bügelbrett, "Die guten Freunde", at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, based on a Chinese animal tale. Animals share their winter food and help one another. For ages 2.5 and up; free, no advance registration.

08ce941eb5a54d645585be8f54f65cf56d733f18.en: A mindfulness afternoon, "Mit dem Herzen sprechen", at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek, on how language shapes perception and how mindful listening creates connection. Tea, LED candlelight, short texts and a closing exercise. No prior knowledge needed.

bf8e536c757dda82867f911491b92c807cc78666.en: A recital by pupils of the wind instrument group at the music school concert hall, coordinated by Kai Heiden.

262682115aaaa59eac1f0aa85140f209da9bdc0d.en: The final concert of the workshop "Moderne Spielpraktiken auf der Querflöte" at the music school concert hall, coordinated by Petra Hildner and Franziska-Marie Scholz.

7737af9606acd218fe285db70cf0a68912111af1.en: König Workshow, an interactive drag show and workshop at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda on 21 November 2026, 17:00 to 20:00. Berlin drag performers explain what drag is and let participants try makeup and costume. Family friendly; registration by form.

8242f35038e534817c46f97214bc96dfcc05fd1c.en: A concert by the SVA ensemble of pupils from the preparatory training at Leo-Borchard-Musikschule, with works by Rameau, Handel, Schubert and others, led by Giovanni Lo Curto.

713d4d6999fd3314cb5dd272e2d46d6d4c480197.en: The documentary "Uferfrauen – Lesbisches L(i)eben in der DDR" by Barbara Wallbraun at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, based on oral history of six women. It is followed by a conversation with protagonist Elke Prinz. Free, no registration.

a220ca0b456e7ec57d1cd54ee7677c5c59a22139.en: A Euphonium Trio concert at Gutshof Schloss Britz Kulturstall, with Berlin jazz trombonist Daniel Busch, Ulli Bartel on violin and Jo Gehlmann on guitar. They play their own compositions and jazz and pop rarities. Entry 18 euros, reduced 13 euros.

e7c47d82c810bdd667a24de9fb6a51ddbd11f4d1.en: Gutalax's Shit on the Dancefloor Mini Tour 2026. The listing gives no venue, and it refers to the German version for further details.

c5e2e010763f052ed889d635479730921b08dc5a.en: A matinee by scholarship students of the Begabtenförderung at the Ursula-Mamlok-Saal of Rathaus Schmargendorf, coordinated by Angela Müller-Velte.

30372781d46ff34bc09378e9d2f7fe4de136ce6a.en: The big band Round Midlife performs at Kulturbrauerei, led by Michael Rowalska.

032e3ffcaef86c4ce677abe6f78aa54931e88883.en: A workshop at Hansabibliothek on fermenting vegetables, with its health and climate benefits. Bring a clean screw-top jar of 500 to 750 ml; you take home your own jar of fermented vegetables. Registration via offen-fuer-kultur.de.

21dce9c6ba0e55a93bbd264ea1cb15ebd86f129f.en: A painting course for children aged 8 and up at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek, in which they paint their own reindeer in acrylics on canvas, in cooperation with Pia Affeld. Registration required.

1d421a7212e9edff0a6d8b6c817f4f323275d488.en: A cinema afternoon at Hansabibliothek with the documentary "Until We Talk" by Florian Mebes, following two fathers, Rami Elhanan and Bassam Aramin, who lost daughters in the conflict. 84 minutes, original with German subtitles; a conversation follows.

024f525c8234ba7b6d9680b8fd1f88b00a8391c6.en: A singalong concert with SingSisySing at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek, a community singing event from Berlin-Neukölln. A piano plays chart hits and everyone sings together, with no need for perfect pitch. Hosted by Mika and Hanna.

9efb26fcff3f44a7ab0846a8b58406c750873e76.en: Bechstein Next Generation with pianist Yuze Zheng at Gutshof Schloss Britz Kulturstall, playing Brahms, Rachmaninoff and Schumann. Entry 15 euros, reduced 10 euros.

9bc0a180f8f65aee10b0720f7fbcfe6e9b4763fc.en: The album launch of "Wesensreise" by Tagessterne, Hanna and André's third album of songs for children and families, at Schwartzsche Villa. An interactive concert about who we are and what we need. Entry 6 euros for children, 8 euros for adults.

fb51932d798b3a4bb82ee34ab2c1f2f7177fd829.en: The Berliner Vokaphoniker present "Die goldenen 20er Jahre" at Kulturhaus Spandau, a revue of couplets and talkie hits by Friedrich Hollaender, Marlene Dietrich and the Comedian Harmonists, with tango, waltz and swing.

7eeed404035a93831411509790357d94caa745a8.en: The closing concert of an early music workshop, 20 to 22 November 2026, at Pfarrkirche Weißensee. A large wind ensemble plays early baroque pieces by Altenburg, Hassler and Pachelbel, with Jugendstreich Weißensee and soloists.

3cccafb069ff4f8f13acda023f5ae4b22db6a727.en: The library talk "Kannste dir nicht ausdenken" at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Tempelhof, on the odd relationship between fiction and reality, moderated by Jasper Nicolaisen. The first session, on 17 October 2026, covers dark romance. Registration via Cituro.

e0feeb0f6683aab25105aee97898beb23d10c929.en: A literary city walk with Jenny Schon at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, "Erleben Sie Berlin durch die Augen Franz Kafkas". It starts at Grunewaldstraße 13, where Kafka lived with Dora Diamant, and includes a reading. Free; advance booking.

e4e77523ea4b2aa316aec7fd20491cb96e0eae8e.en: Stage Steps at Kunstfabrik Schlot in Mitte, an evening of jazz by Musikschule City West. The children's band Black Cat opens at 18:00, then Jazz Newcomers at 19:00 and teachers in Jazz Professionals at 21:00. Free entry; donations welcome.

36ef1846ac789a7334fac9d127322513e29f93ff.en: A monthly games evening at Amerika-Gedenkbibliothek for people aged 16 and up, with detectives as the November theme. The group game Blood on the Clocktower is guided, and simple games are on hand. Held on the second Thursday of each month.

2834436ecb2a235a2c9b9ce10e7cfa16120997aa.en: Stage Steps – Jazz Newcomers at Kunstfabrik Schlot, with bands from the Studienvorbereitung Jazz as part of Musikschule City West's jazz evening. Free entry; donations welcome.

ea9cf53957e46e1a7a05f1b66790ffd77a71fd37.en: The Berlin piano trio Triologie marks five years at Schwartzsche Villa with Beethoven's first piano trio in E-flat major, op. 1 no. 1, and Shostakovich's second piano trio, op. 67. Free entry; donations requested. Advance booking by email.

851f55863bc423b4443bfb9a66aa199b32958d26.en: Neschastny Sluchai, presented by Live Nation. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by an adult aged 18 or older, and no one under 6 is admitted. Accessible tickets are arranged through the call centre.

be25b3fe9a44f38e186810f2feb603fcae32a06f.en: Stage Steps – Jazz Professionals at Kunstfabrik Schlot, a concert by music school teachers that closes the evening after Jazz for Kids and the Newcomers. Free entry; donations welcome.

38db229e137948bb73f79ade51a1484d5ab3cdd5.en: The Spandauer Weihnachtsmarkt in the old town, from Rathaus Spandau to St. Nikolai church, with crafts, mulled wine, roasted almonds and a medieval section on Reformationsplatz. It is close to the Altstadt Spandau and Rathaus Spandau U-Bahn stations.

2556de439803e7fe4f49a7ed7dbb865f58e36eb2.en: Pension advice at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg from volunteer adviser Peter Hermann, on the fourth Monday of each month from 15:00 to 18:00. Free; advance phone booking required.

f7b0172ca720333b3224eb5485230e290e4acfc8.en: The Krimiclub at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek, where members read one crime novel a month and retrace the investigators' reasoning together. Titles include "May Morrigans mysteriöse Morde" and "Höhenangst". Free with advance registration.

141bd0ed2eb3c5a950df41c5e98b3c4d9706f20c.en: A talk at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek between Danuta Schmidt and novelist Katharina Hagena about her fourth novel, "Flusslinien". It is a generational story about a 102-year-old woman who looks back over her life, with a view of the Elbe.

d6c0652283c8dc2872f505bd8644d87af2f4280a.en: The 28th Day of Berlin Archaeology on Tuesday 24 November 2026 from 9:15 at James Simon Galerie, with talks on current excavations and research. Afterwards visitors can see the exhibition on Genghis Khan and the Mongols; tours need registration.

b842a07bd8f9b073471968c26c32ba361f589a42.en: Cora Chilcott sings and tells anecdotes about Marlene Dietrich in "Die leidenschaftliche Diva" at Maria-Rimkus-Haus, with Schlager and chansons. Doors open 14:00 and the show starts at 15:00. Entry 3 euros, plus 3 euros for coffee.

37e72d3ba7b02ac6a55e2a281099521ad9dd1d0a.en: Instrument workshops with Klingendes Museum at Bruno-Lösche-Bibliothek, where children and families from age 3 can touch, try and play musical instruments. Registration by email.

772e32e4984f43b46263f06366751fac743017f0.en: A reading by Erol Kaya at the Bürgertreff "Gemeinsam im Kiez leben" of the Cooperative Mensch, about his book "Erinnerung". Everyday stories from his life are told with a good measure of humour.

64c9e219478d7ea43d8af250b00826f4399f637b.en: A creative writing workshop for children aged 8 and up at Familienbibliothek Else Ury, led by author Verena Teke. The two linked sessions are on 17 October and 24 November 2026, 16:30 to 17:30. Registration required.

915a4086a0c724d42d775588fb6784eae7fee371.en: An interactive panel, "Armut & Mobilität", at Stadtwerkstatt on how transport planning can be fairer, covering access, barriers and social inequality. Small group discussions lead to a final debate. Part of a series on transport and inclusion.

29c187ca55ce527f716835c4d8f245fb9a4a93bc.en: The 37th RegioTalk on e-mobility in company fleets at Club Goerzwerk on 24 November 2026, covering challenges, solutions and funding for vehicles and charging infrastructure. Registration via the regionalinkubator website.

437df7d8902c7406dfcc421dc1df551722b32892.en: Ronja von Rönne reads from and discusses her novel "Alles Liebe" with Josephine Apraku at Bibliothek am Luisenbad. The novel explores love as assertion and truth as construction. Free, with advance registration; places are limited.

95c98f321d5e9c419cef7bb4f7367a60f2fd1a88.en: Duo Safar feat. Valentina Bellanova at Schwartzsche Villa salon, blending Persian music traditions with contemporary rhythm. Jawad Salkhordeh plays tonbak and setar, Jacob Przemus drums, and Italian flautist Valentina Bellanova joins. Entry 15 euros.

0e721ba60bf1d819a94415bcd5aa8ca7d6493060.en: Julie Wolff and guests present "Lost in the Stars – Kurt Weill kurzweilig" at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek, tracing Weill from Dessau to 1920s Berlin, Paris exile and Broadway. Narrated by Judith Kessler. Entry 4 euros, reduced 3 euros.

c2d0884631b24307652f6bbc80d8b254e2af8a8e.en: IMPROTHEATER Comedy Krimi Edition at Kulturhaus Karlshorst, where audience suggestions shape improvised crime scenes, from interrogations to surprise confessions. Entry 5 euros, reduced 3 euros.

2d57ec73c657f146c20636c2da718cbd79f537d0.en: Stephan Lohse reads from "Das Knistern im All", a coming-of-age novel about mental health and friendship. Fifteen-year-old Matti has a breakdown on a school trip to Amrum and is supported by his friends. At Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek.

39b5138e1d73903ce1fb870730ee2bdd3d7723e9.en: GURRIERS' Nobody's Coming To Save You Tour 2026, presented by Live Nation. Wheelchair users with a "B" ID pay the regular price, and one companion enters free. The listing gives no venue.

f4aee8704471bf9a2e4616c222d6e2475346017d.en: A teacher training in the wood workshop at Hedwig-Dohm-Schule, where participants make a sweet dispenser with minimal machine use and then share classroom tips. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 26.2-135725.

03124f038e68a08e51d1eec09bd16311ad578fb8.en: A women's storytelling café with Johanna Wollin at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek, for women aged 16 and up. A story inspires participants to tell their own experiences, with tea, coffee and snacks. Free, no registration needed.

ede10bd765aea838f46ef802b48ff1bb13effbfa.en: A teacher training on careers guidance at Partner Schule Wirtschaft, preparing guidelines for class-based evaluation and individual advice after CheckU or the Talente Check. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 26.2-135393.

bb48bd78f8e2169e672ffbd639a4264e582737d9.en: Kofferradio hautnah with host Siggi Trzoß and artist Dagmar Frederic at Nachbarschafts- und Familienzentrum "Kiek in" on 25 November 2026 at 14:30. An evening of music and talk about her life and career. Advance ticket 14 euros, evening price 15 euros.

5573e60c21d775d8a31e49dd52ca548ebe1c6330.en: A chanson afternoon, "Eine kleine Sehnsucht", at Hans-Söhnker-Haus, with songs by Friedrich Hollaender, Hildegard Knef, Barbara and Zarah Leander, sung by Annie Kowalski with Uwe Matschke on piano. Coffee table from 14:00, start 15:00. Registration required.

a2d541c033b25553990b03055825233fa5a37200.en: A guided tour of the Stadtgeschichtliches Archiv Spandau at Zitadelle Spandau, led by archive head Sebastian Schuth. It covers the reading room, the new permanent exhibition and selected holdings. Maximum 15 people; registration two days ahead.

84ca76d4bb97a639ddb39ec16b9d32757a28d76c.en: A comic and manga workshop at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade, led by illustrator Malou Kipper for ages 9 and up. Each session covers a new theme, from faces and bodies to colouring and light and shadow. Free; registration required.

a4775489717c0985d6b47a6ddf43b220a6d7e9d9.en: The seventh event in the series "Nachhaltigkeit als Antwort auf planetare Krisen?" at Freie Universität Berlin, asking why socio-ecological transformation challenges political education. Luisa Girnus of FU Berlin gives the opening input. Registration online.

e64edc4aaa1e1b66aefc5affd4621f9803f65452.en: The shadow play "Der kleine Angsthase" by Scuraluna at Stadtteilbibliothek Lankwitz, with guitar and singing, based on Elisabeth Shaw. About 45 minutes, for ages 3 to 110. Free, with advance registration by phone or email.

a80824d69d11bd2356284e36ec3c57e886298b17.en: A workshop by Aufstehen gegen Rassismus at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, "Werde Stammtischkämpfer*in", on how to respond to sexist, anti-feminist and queer-hostile remarks, in theory and practice. Free; advance registration by phone or email.

dc41a421d051c609b01d19b2aab1b829b5e12e87.en: The Interkulturelle Woche at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek from 25 to 28 November 2026, with workshops on other cultures. On 25 November a Japanese tea ceremony with matcha; on 26 November a Sütterlin handwriting workshop. Registration requested.

29fd636f684bd713baa1f2e3f3cda505c9271e32.en: The Christmas play "Der Weihnachtsstern" at Schwartzsche Villa, by Theater im Globus, with puppets by Marita Bachmaier and performance by Hanne Braun. A gentle tale of kindness and friendship around a pretty star, with poems and winter songs. From 6 euros.

6598496cd048f269ddf443e6e2fb301503d2219b.en: A parents' workshop, "Stress? Nicht jetzt", at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek on simple everyday methods to pause and stay calm in stressful family life. Participants try exercises, then have time for questions. Bring a pen.

48983436465c0da116219d30d862d82602996ec4.en: An information event on vocational qualifications through retraining and partial qualifications, at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg. Advisers explain shorter modular routes to a qualification and offer free personal advice. Free; no registration.

554fff9db38e1b65843359655a45771c846dbafb.en: A speed-dating event where teachers meet up to 12 companies from different sectors in Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg, Tempelhof-Schöneberg and Neukölln, to plan careers activities. Online follow-up on 9 December 2026, 14:00 to 16:00.

250ec32a56070cc4264a8c2fee12e8cceb24f8c7.en: The dance piece "O je, Tannenbaum" by the OOPSALA dance collective at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, for children. It follows a Christmas tree from the forest to the living room and then to the street. Free, no registration.

4385ebfe43d39276a0bf21d30d461f55689fc197.en: Anders geFragt: Ist KI für den Menschen da? at the Humboldt Forum, the second event in a new discussion series. Petra Anders moderates with Ute Schmid and Katharina Weitz on human-centred, explainable and responsible AI. Audience members can join in.

492e35877498cddcd71966213863b496668655ee.en: A reading by Nicole Bröhan from "Falsche Originale" at Bibliothek Heinrich-von-Kleist, part of the "Live bei Kleist" series. It follows art dealer Grete Ring in late-1920s Berlin, who doubts newly offered van Gogh paintings. Registration by phone; free entry.

a1c50d56435f2ebf294026d9843a084059022cf8.en: The Berlin Monument Prize 2026, awarded for outstanding service to Berlin's monuments and named after Ferdinand von Quast, the first Prussian state conservator. Winners are announced shortly before the ceremony at Altes Stadthaus.

cb2a1edb2767bbcc861f816e9341f73081d83484.en: Merit Niemeitz reads from the first two volumes of her new-adult series "Oxford Academics" at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek, "Footnotes of Fairytales" and "Footnotes of Forever", about two rivals at the University of Oxford.

e1c3bb212f2920f23cea33287afba33524286103.en: Bryson Tiller's The Neo Trapsoul Tour, presented by Live Nation. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by an adult aged 18 or older, and no one under 6 is admitted. Accessible tickets are arranged through the call centre.

2db349055305fd524b46a23584fb6f86636e9982.en: An open day at Berufliche Schule für Sozialwesen Pankow for prospective early childhood educators. Visitors learn about full-time and part-time training, and meet employers and providers to find internships.

70177355e11db3558afc3c7e215a57523a35fb69.en: Tüftellab at Bibliothek im Märkischen Viertel with Makey Makey, a hands-on technology session in which children light up paper cars, houses and insects with circuits made from LEDs and conductive tape.

f997cca347c801bf8aded5757c994537a447682b.en: An upcycling workshop at Bruno-Lösche-Bibliothek, part of the German Sustainability Action Days, in which empty drinks cartons become plant pots, gift wrap or small storage containers. For children and families from age 2.

bc782488e9b3f67bf5604551f698ef556c4c074d.en: A puppet play, "Der gestiefelte Kater", by Puppentheater Fingerleicht at Kurt-Tucholsky-Bibliothek, based on the Brothers Grimm and Erich Kästner. A clever talking cat outwits the king and a wizard for a poor miller's son, Hans. For ages 3 and up.

90f0b2598fba7c95ba72b265709863911531cd4e.en: A review of the "Länderreise: Entdecke mit uns Europa" series at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek. Six evenings covered culture, traditions and tastings from Spain to Hungary, closing with a European review. Run by MaMis en Movimiento e.V.

f968bcf8c3a065101a28505ea8e2aa06053befc5.en: LiteraturLive with Ahne at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek, reading and singing from "Stabil im Bus", a collection of satires and dialogues written over ten years. Entry 2 euros; advance sales from 29 October 2026.

cd1dd47a983168d486734197e4fd41f9e3d5a65a.en: Artemas on the LOVERCORE / GETTING UP TO NO GOOD Tour, with support from Henry Morris and Ella Boh, presented by Live Nation. The listing gives no venue.

9682f52d45611bb6798c3a65dfa9415b44b689c8.en: The Berliner Wärmeforum at FUTURIUM, the central dialogue platform for the heat transition in Berlin. Decision-makers from politics, housing, energy and science discuss climate-neutral heating and share practical solutions. Registration online.

5e678272fddad943490fa049fbc2ccc505a6f5f3.en: A slideshow, "Unser Festmonat in Bildern", at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, with large screens showing the best pictures from the anniversary month. Visitors can send their own photos to event-bibliothek@ba-sz.berlin.de. Free, no registration.

68c0de9661a134da3b7aff323c37ecb11de5629f.en: A reading by Boris Pfeiffer, author of the "Die drei ??? Kids" series, at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade for ages 6 and up. Free, no registration; funded by the Berliner Autorenlesefonds.

f0ca5b942a1c29e404d344f5e7c723b6e8b3adb9.en: The puppet show "Die Koscher-Maschine" by Puppentheater bubales at Bibliothek am Luisenbad. Piglet Babett wants to become kosher, and mishaps on the farm are solved with help, while songs explain what kosher means. For families with children aged 5 and up.

2f88a84a6684690d2a588605f1f65174c3668e3c.en: A magic show, "Trötenzauber – magische Abenteuer im Hexendorf", at Margarete-Kubicka-Bibliothek, where a magical trumpet meets cheeky witches. Objects vanish and reappear with bangs and flashes. For ages 3 and up; free, no registration.

9f272069ca1d87993858d4fb1bd3b476728d3e6a.en: Winter and Advent crafts at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek, where each of the four Advent weeks brings something new: winter decorations or small gifts for parents and grandparents.

92add1c1c757fe27fc7db8a175f3aafecfc95573.en: A clothes swap at Stadtbibliothek Spandau, held with KlimaWerkstatt Spandau, from 16:00 on Friday 31 July. Bring up to 7 to 10 clean, well-kept items and browse for finds. No registration needed.

3b3b0d84218e851be9b8219cf0773505b024ce61.en: A staged reading by Felix Isenbügel of Charles Dickens's "Weihnachtsgeschichte" at Bibliothek Tiergarten-Süd. It follows miser Ebenezer Scrooge and the three spirits who change him. Music and sound by Arne Assmann. For ages 7 and up, about 50 minutes.

34da2097656e3a26d8254eba4c252bafa368200a.en: The BerlinJazzSingers of Schostakowitsch Musikschule Lichtenberg give a Christmas singalong concert at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek, with jazz, gospel, pop and modern vocal music. Free entry; no registration, limited seats.

4008a1b767387830b2451f740f9fafb911206365.en: Plückhahn & Vogel present their stage programme "Grob Verfeinert" at Schwartzsche Villa salon. Singer Dietrich Plückhahn and pianist Daniel Vogel make biting, playful music satire. Entry 15 euros.

b514e37d35e8f51b83152eeee39c0b5151ab0231.en: Katrin Aimee reads from and discusses her book "Unüberhörbar", about being deaf, female and outspoken, at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda on 27 November 2026 at 19:00. She describes structural discrimination and ableism. Free; registration required.

8266162ba8e67276b325a98683625755e3f31d4c.en: Patrizia Moresco's stand-up show "Außer Kontrolle" at Kulturhaus Spandau. The Italian-Swabian comic tackles social issues and her own faults with wild, provocative energy and plenty of audience interaction.
