c7e5463346bb910cfa368bf10b8add805e3607e1.en: Muna's Get So Hot Tour, presented by Live Nation. Part of the proceeds goes to TAC, which supports LGBTQ youth and queer migrants in the US. The listing gives no venue.

245cd748dc382676734d33fa7af5c59e282ac2ad.en: A workshop at Schwarzkopf-Stiftung Junges Europa for young people aged 16 to 30 on turning project ideas into reality. It covers Erasmus+ Youth and the European Solidarity Corps, with practical examples, a networking café and application tips.

0eb1b7a4a3d818be6a7522ab83f43574f502ba4f.en: A tree-decoration craft workshop at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek on Saturday 28 November 2026 from 10:00 to 14:00, for children of all ages, with some Christmas sweets to share. Free entry.

3f1fde48b1ff7ccb2b737b212bbddcd4e243ef15.en: A podcast workshop with Paul-Vincent Roll at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek for young people aged 15 and up, from first concept to recording. No own equipment needed; no registration.

7560bfd03dd68a8405dce1ad376a7c7ca85850e3.en: A professionally guided introduction to 3D modelling and printing at Stadtteilbibliothek Karow, for ages 10 and up. Bring your own laptop if you have one. Registration by phone or at the library.

41ab94d9347ebd3db80bfd1f96b4a4bc3653f482.en: The solidarity reading series "In guter Gesellschaft" at Schiller-Bibliothek, where authors talk about their work, democracy and society outdoors in front of the library. Bring your own cutlery, crockery and food to share. Free entry.

dfe10ff839faa611b0be7f9af73c3a6ea5277003.en: A fantasy reading by Oliver Plaschka, "Die Geister von La Spezia", at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek. In 1822 Italy, investigator Pat helps Mary Shelley retrace the places of her past. Registration required; free entry, 20:00 start.

50646d0f9f84cc121517c34fe53c7a30fb68eb2a.en: A specialist day on digital antisemitism at Rathaus Schöneberg for educators and civil-society workers. It explores antisemitic narratives on social networks and gaming communities, and ways to respond. Registration details to follow.

21d8f8e5a131849ba3e00d79989fd957553a2768.en: A postcard and collage workshop at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek, part of the "Reparieren statt wegwerfen" actions. Participants make personal postcards and collages from magazines and old cards, to keep or send. Kreativlounge, first floor.

1c6514615a87efaa571a76640f5fc0a72a200178.en: A reading by Jutta Rosenkranz from "Zeile für Zeile mein Paradies" on the 40th anniversary of writer Ingeborg Drewitz's death, at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek. Free; advance booking requested.

18dfd187cd6f9d939fa467a9d68d28286cfa7540.en: The first international re-VISION: Circular Cities Conference 2026, organised by the Zero Waste Agency, on urban transformation for resource resilience. A one-day meeting of politics, administration, business and civil society. Venue in Mitte to be announced.

92bd335c6c1eaaaaa4d7e1149318673606ead189.en: A literary walk through Zehlendorf with Jutta Rosenkranz, about 90 minutes, tracing Ingeborg Drewitz from her last home to her grave, with short readings. Free; advance registration requested.

e49d816d25971703bc5832a9ba6490f4a4e06ba2.en: A satirical theatre piece, "Wahrheit wird kalt serviert", by the collective ISO 3591 at Theater unterm Dach. A mock cooking show reveals how the Italian mafia affects business, society and lives in Germany. Entry 15 euros, reduced 10 euros.

39fec939e09468dee8727677b638d24604af569a.en: A seminar at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek, "Überall Bilder und Symbole", led by artist Renate von Charlottenburg and gallerist Ludwig Föllen, on reading symbols and metaphors in art and everyday life. 09:00 to 16:00; registration required.

00e307b1f92467f9371894e03180821a5dfa32e7.en: A family Saturday, "Sterntaler", at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek with Ute Kahmann's puppet theatre, adapting a Grimm tale of an orphan who gives away all she has. For ages 4 and up; 1 euro, registration from 3 November 2026.

9279774813e304b89003fa8243ae6c4590ac7319.en: A KBB seminar with social media expert Nadine Rank at kantaa – gut beraten on designing in Canva and reaching people with Instagram Reels. Fee 15 euros, including lunch; register on the KBB website.

5a88cddcb0572f313ea9f29f5f5e74847d34d1e5.en: A children's concert, "Dunkel, funkel – viele Stimmen, ein Klang", at the music school concert hall of Musikschule Steglitz-Zehlendorf, coordinated by several teachers.

afcf5b2f4b0aa2d01837a0328f0822674a8c6359.en: A monthly 3D printing workshop at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek, covering the basics and how to design and print your own objects. Afterwards you can use the Bambu Lab printer yourself. Library card needed; ages 10 and up with an adult.

44cd9d5e4409b4900ede98905f164fce756521a9.en: The family workshop "Der Märchenkoffer" at Bibliothek am Luisenbad, a journey through fairy-tale worlds of dance, music, pictures and storytelling about the moon. For ages 4 to 100, with registration by pretix.

47cc017cfb3a81076cfa1eb3d31220874bfe5c78.en: The 24th Steglitzer Literaturfest at Schwartzsche Villa, a full day of readings for the whole family by various authors, with a raffle in which every ticket wins. Organised by LiteraturInitiative Berlin. Entry 16 euros, children 10 euros.

b26714ac359db3df6d2c9b8a687e4852a1e79458.en: A Holzwerkstatt at Bezirkszentralbibliothek Pablo Neruda on 28 November 2026 from 13:30 to 16:30, for ages 7 and up with a parent. Participants saw, file and hammer, building small wooden toy cars. Free; registration requested.

841ef6b3c504b9d39effa57aad56ba16f58942d2.en: Gitarrenzauber at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek, where guitars, ukuleles and banjos can be tried and the family of stringed instruments introduced. The session ends with a joint drumming session. Free, no registration.

8ea63e484e8ed53a6f78872f49c6031ee17e796b.en: A reading called "Ach mein Sohn..." at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek by the Vorlese-Ensemble, exploring the bond between mothers and sons through texts by Simone Buchholz, Joachim Meyerhoff and Emilia Roig.

d36e9d94859b3f10c64ccd7267dabc845fb3db7d.en: A chamber music workshop for string instruments at Musikschule City West, with lessons from its teachers and an internal recital for participants on the final Sunday. Participants must prepare their voices and know the piece, and attend both days.

8d3381aec9889389ac1ea455130319a0766a2d49.en: A "Schatzdosen" craft workshop at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek, where children from age 4 make containers for small treasures, decorating boxes or building new ones. Run with Kunststoffe e.V.; materials provided, free, no registration.

115526f9d638fd3439be4871e4c1df03deaf1f0e.en: A portrait drawing workshop at Bodo-Uhse-Bibliothek for everyone aged 10 and up. Proportions, light and shadow, and details such as hair and eyelashes are explained step by step. Materials provided; free, no registration.

5957893ebe052eafd9594a8650094e596b91b9dd.en: The sixth event in the series "Nachhaltigkeit als Antwort auf planetare Krisen?" at Freie Universität Berlin, on global and sustainable perspectives in political education. Bernd Overwien of Humboldt-Universität gives the opening input. Online registration.

f3c86901500a577472ef946182498032d56206e5.en: The final concert of the Leo-Borchard music school competition at Jesus-Christus-Kirche Dahlem, where the best entrants play for jury and audience prizes. Special prizes are also awarded. Everyone can vote for the audience prize.

66048aa9b43c2af64fedad348f0a24ba94dbd4b4.en: A "Europa liebt" concert by teachers and pupils of the Studienvorbereitung at Ursula-Mamlok-Saal, part of the "Europa klingt" series. Coordinated by Luisa Sereina Splett.

96faa8308a05188976896086b6bad654b4e6ce1f.en: SACRED SUMMITS by the Wind-Or-Jester Berlin symphonic wind orchestra at Auenkirche, led by Lisa Xanthopoulou. The programme includes Cesarini's "Poema Alpestre" and Poelking's "To Sacred Summits", evoking mountains and nature.

fe196a4f028d94c66614b622247a7e80470c8fd7.en: A "Europa liebt" concert in the "Europa klingt" series at Ursula-Mamlok-Saal, with works on political freedom by Beethoven, Chopin, Lysenko and Viardot, and songs such as "Imagine". Singing along is welcome.

8613458f288644c8a6cf8501dc6867369510a600.en: A children's concert, "Mauskonzert", at Ursula-Mamlok-Saal, where children play for children. Coordinated by Kai Heiden.

aecb8b8e8c084c43b20c7ab431cb593dc4a35a7c.en: A Nikolaus concert with Natalia Natalevych at Wolfdietrich-Schnurre-Bibliothek, singing in German and Ukrainian and playing guitar and piano. A shared music session in praise of Saint Nicholas.

9ceca482758f925641738c227ff706d5936f0b19.en: The 48th Lichtenrader Lichtermarkt around the village pond, where about 100 clubs and initiatives sell crafts, ceramics, wood, honey, toys and food. Entry free; profits go to social purposes.

1aa232ed4b2935e1eab15f778ce9e41da7d71af9.en: A special opening of the exhibition "Future Archives/Archive Futures" at Ratskeller – Galerie für zeitgenössische Kunst during the Lichtermarkt, with the piece "Archiving Lights with Sound".

8e3977e21ac9e06dcdb526e742dec1a2c2802baf.en: A Christmas concert, "Klassik populär – Adventskonzert", at Kulturhaus Karlshorst with soprano Mandy Fredrich, violin, cello and piano. Works by Bach, Handel and Romantic composers, plus carols to sing along. Entry 10 euros, reduced 3 euros.

796c07e87a41e255f34bc8b963b970922b9e1ee6.en: A family workshop, "Der Märchenkoffer", at Schiller-Bibliothek on fairy tales and fables of the cold season, with dance, music, pictures and a Kamishibai reading. The characters Leppinou and Loup Magique lead the way. Registration by email.

595db17d030257d17e94a21da3c554a6bd36c35f.en: A family Advent concert, "Weihnachtswunderzeit", by the Rhythm & Melody Concertband at Heilig-Kreuz-Kirche Hohenschönhausen on 30 November at 17:00. About an hour of music from Disney to opera. Free; arrive by 16:30 for seats.

fc222c998a03da0a9bc7686cf350b2c6812b43b9.en: The Schmargendorfer Kammerkonzert in the Trausaal of Rathaus Schmargendorf, a series presenting chamber ensembles twice a year. Performers to be announced; organised by the music school management.

ab7985b3e7e10c2b04e53391fd2a2438eb9f0f1f.en: Winter Dreams by Mo'Voce and Friends at Schwartzsche Villa on the first Advent, with pop classics and winter and Christmas songs from four vocalists. Entry 15 euros, reduced 12 euros; tickets via Eventim.

62629718bae6bd3789c6b58ad2509017645f518a.en: More Town Soul, a ten-piece Berlin soul band with five-part vocals, performs "Soul for Christmas" at Gotischer Saal in Zitadelle Spandau. It mixes 1960s and 1970s soul with Christmas classics.

98d5e6a3bf8bbae4a9f2f5a291b9ac8e43c24e8e.en: Kehlani's world tour through the EU and UK, with support from Odeal and opener Waseel, presented by Live Nation. €1 per ticket goes to The Kehlani Fund. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by an adult; no one under 6 is admitted.

9c965c8ea324cdad90231764f0d5f7b25aae93cc.en: Kodaline's Farewell Tour, presented by Live Nation. Wheelchair users and people who need a companion should call the hotline. The listing gives no venue.

71ddf6979f24ddd4ab665ff414a81c9792a22704.en: NetzHelden 60+, a four-part training series for people aged 60 and over on misinformation, conspiracy myths and hate online. Attend at least three of the four dates; bring a tablet or smartphone on 9 December 2026.

164023db4931e447c768980d8577241626eb1001.en: LEGO Build the Change at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, held monthly for children aged 6 and up. After a short story, children build their own ideas for the future with LEGO bricks on themes such as nature, climate and water. Free, no registration.

da1ede6b780c0909cfcfbbe25d53d424178c781c.en: A DIY colour-edge workshop at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, where participants decorate the page edges of their own books. Materials are provided; bring your own books.

5f6f5fee1898aa4830ee4495a2c3885a136482d2.en: A concert-lecture, "Pinocchio und die Musik", for the 200th birthday of Carlo Collodi, at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek, with teachers from the wind instrument group, Gabriele Bultmann and Daniele Ruzzier.

c97e8f506c34070476ba5a09bc64bc273ad4d141.en: A crime reading, "Tatort Bibliothek", at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek, with Sandra Åslund reading from "Mord au Vin", written under the pen name Sandrine Albert and set in Bordeaux. Registration by email or phone; free entry, 19:00 start.

a8880bda1c8030031124175edc29c713ea1e5edf.en: A puppet play, "Herr Eichhorn und der erste Schnee", after Sebastian Meschenmoser's children's book, at Kulturhaus Spandau. Three friends search for snow they have never seen, and it falls right in front of them. A play about friendship and searching.

7f1e4d0063dafa93b299114b1ec57b3673120a15.en: A reading and talk by Stefanie De Velasco on "Heiss: Liebeserklärung an die Wechseljahre" at Buchhandlung am Schäfersee. It is a frank, humorous makeover of menopause. Sign-language interpreters attend; held with Kulturraum M5.

70704f9b89d905d0691be7b7772414a61ce433de.en: Chloe Slater's riot youth tour, presented by Live Nation. Wheelchair users with the "B" designation should call the local hotline. The listing gives no venue.

0270752acd3b27160ab1f86110d127b89ea591e0.en: A teacher training in the metal workshop at Hedwig-Dohm-Schule, where participants make items such as keyrings and bottle openers with minimal machine use, then discuss links to careers guidance. Veranst.-Nr. 25.1-120434.

7abc4d51a03bf0a78238120adaed073d24a407aa.en: A teacher training for the young generation hub at the Grüne Woche, planning a school visit to the fair at Messe-Süd, where pupils explore around 80 careers. Follow-up dates on 20 and 28 January 2027. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 26.2-135478.

07d57143f7da5232308ee4ba3c682a25420ebdb3.en: Adrian Kostré talks about the pitfalls of German in "Zwei Personen in einem Fahrkorb", a book of curious questions such as why gloves are called that. At Mittelpunktbibliothek Ehm Welk, 15:00. Free; no registration.

87a2f73f53038d92a5873e689bcef2b761b0fe3d.en: A family gallery talk on "Future Archives/Archive Futures" at Ratskeller, led by Kunstvermittlung Lichtenberg, with a workshop over coffee and cake. Further dates on 9 and 16 December 2026 for adults and seniors.

e4d648c983b5ca86c44b8af29a58b0ed27a62a32.en: A replacement concert, "Komponistin", with double bassist Thierry Barbé and conductor Andréa Huguenin Botelho at Kulturstiftung Schloss Britz. Works by Florentine Mulsant, Clara Schumann and Tom Jobim. Entry 18 euros, reduced 13 euros.

91ac526f57ce44c1c6cb3abfeb6de062199cec7e.en: An online course on empowering young people with special needs in the move into work, using empowerment concepts and methods. Held on BigBlueButton, with a key sent two days before. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 26.2-134489.

05ad9f816abe4d287ced6fee08409c6a2e7a471f.en: A manga workshop with Inga Steinmetz at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, for beginners and experienced artists alike. She shows how to draw a friendly manga face and handle common problems such as eye placement and profiles. Ages 10 and up; registration by email.

93734287ff96e3a5d86fe36f5df5106054f33ff3.en: A traditional Christmas craft afternoon at Stadtteilbibliothek Lankwitz on 2 December from 16:30. Participants make Christmas decorations, gift tags or small artworks while chatting. Free, no registration needed.

2fda02626ffa12e0d3fcde1304c69f1bab2fef8b.en: A Christmas cello concert at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek by pupils of the Schostakowitsch music school, led by Doris Laidler-Schüler, with warming cello music. Free entry; registration required from 4 November 2026.

224a1d48414a1549da1e9876428d27b8bd7eadc8.en: An information evening at Albrecht-von-Graefe-Schule about its profile as a State European School in Berlin.

1e1674026b140fae4130e7b077ce540725f315fc.en: The English-language Christmas book club at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek, discussing Sarah Morgan's "The Book Club Hotel". Native and non-native speakers are welcome, and participants read the book beforehand. Places are limited; register by email.

9d4262c2a1c208fdee57bed24cd91a98d20321d0.en: Andersen's Koffertheater presents "Des Kaisers neue Kleider" at Bibliothek Heinrich-von-Kleist, the tale of a vain emperor duped by tailors who promise cloth that only the clever can see. Registration by phone; free entry, 18:00 start.

41dc9b802091fc4b9554b77e7bfbb4d1beb62c9f.en: A piano evening, "Poesie & Drama: Meisterwerke der Romantik", with Maiko Mine at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek. She plays Schumann's Fantasiestücke, Liszt's second ballade and all four Chopin ballades. Free; advance booking requested.

ad3aab58de993389c3a0a6fb7b3662da0dcff1f1.en: A live concert by pop and rock bands from the Studienvorbereitung at Regenbogenfabrik, coordinated by Alex Will and Benjamin Geyer.

ebc2c61a5e24145e0978563999ff3fda1ebbc150.en: WesGhost's "If It's Not Forever", presented by Live Nation. Wheelchair users and people with severe disabilities marked "B" pay the regular ticket price, and their companions enter free. The listing gives no venue.

338a480a4995256b7ffb84a8d379d2aaf489a799.en: Clown duo Hops & Hopsi present "Im Spielzeugzimmer des Weihnachtsmannes" at Kulturhaus Spandau, a magic show in which objects vanish, thoughts are read and young helpers from the audience join in. A family show.

9bf4bb4466e97f59763a3542d6b4017286f2b1e8.en: A digital consultation hour for people aged 65 and over at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg, covering Android and iPhone, tablets and Windows PCs. Small groups of up to eight people. Register beforehand by email or at the counter.

e99878a3b6146172c3d6581decafa641673b68ec.en: A Christmas singalong at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek, where young and old sing well-loved carols, accompanied on piano by Juliane Felsch-Grunow. Free entry; no registration needed.

76e9c0ac6c39a5c2a9a6d31dae7c9424abc5d16b.en: Autumn popcorn cinema evenings for adults at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek, with a carefully chosen film selection and popcorn. Free entry; no advance registration.

94d80474bbceea761ba2a86b78134d3356756b45.en: A wind serenade by ensembles of the Fachgruppe Blasinstrumente at Kaiser-Wilhelm-Gedächtnis-Kirche, coordinated by Kai Heiden.

4265871ea2ef655932c09255577e8138747b1362.en: moé's "Geschichten die wir niemandem erzählen", live 2026, presented by Live Nation. Wheelchair users with a "B" ID pay the regular price and companions enter free. The listing gives no venue.

51ea43b84dc7a3475427c59d8287f0a000216364.en: Novulent's Live in Europe 2026 tour, with support from Softcult, presented by Live Nation. The listing gives no venue.

2190b8d678be0bb7fd712a0393045517c0759291.en: A teacher training at Wilma-Rudolph-Schule in which participants build a ruler stop for workshop machines, with safety instruction and career insights, then share classroom tips. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 26.2-135801.

10f3e5cc729176fcd48e22179f917918fb523784.en: An introduction to the laser cutter at Philipp-Schaeffer-Bibliothek, covering engraving and cutting wood, felt and plastic, from material preparation to the final cut. Completed participants get access to open makerspace sessions. Free; limited places.

6b7682224d667f3184db0aa2adabc33855d89991.en: A St Nicholas concert by children of Musikschule Béla Bartók in Pankow, at the music school.

9a811850988bed4e5d467cd9acff82dc43b2fadf.en: A talk at Schloss Glienicke by Thomas Thränert on the landscape park of Radensleben, shaped from 1833 by Peter Joseph Lenné and Ferdinand von Quast, the first Prussian monument conservator. Part of the GartenForum Glienicke series.

9449fbbb14e7216bd8459059158405777a07eb82.en: A charity art auction at the gallery of Kulturhaus Spandau during the Spandau inclusion weeks. Selected works from the "ExperimenTiergarten" retrospective are sold, and proceeds go to the Kurt-Richter-Stiftung to support children in need.

79704e51fd2300c63d95f86d88d194d3f291e8a3.en: A debut concert by pupils of the keyboard group at the concert hall of Musikschule City West, for pupils performing in public for the first time. Coordinated by Rustam Abdullaev.

17a43ca3eb3d24370a6a6ced237649fdda25b3ff.en: Dominique Lacasa and her musician present "Weihnacht" at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek, with their own songs and family and Christmas songs. In cooperation with HOWOGE. Entry 4 euros, reduced 3 euros; 30 free tickets for HOWOGE tenants.

aada537c342ca41351e92b0eabd485756cb2b0d5.en: Schalala, a singalong evening at the Kulturhaus Spandau theatre, with guitar and piano. Everyone sings familiar hits, from The Beatles and Udo Lindenberg to folk songs, with lyrics projected on the wall. Three sets, the second themed.

837ee86dff61e230d7b67887ca2f0b4b4cf93d7c.en: Julia Wolf's Deep End World Tour 2026, presented by Live Nation. Wheelchair users and people with severe disabilities marked "B" pay the regular ticket price, and companions enter free. The listing gives no venue.

f9de691c08cf37497a67bf3c10f9f2048b252cf2.en: An open day at Johanna-Eck-Schule on 5 December 2026, showing its teaching concepts, elective courses, year-group subjects, study trips and new upper school. The school is named after Johanna Eck, honoured as a Righteous Among the Nations.

7d998f63609778d4142396c129b83a28447872d3.en: Advent and Christmas tours at Zoo Berlin, a guided winter walk to find out how animals cope with the cold, from thick fur to cold paws. Suitable for families and adults; tickets are sold online in advance only.

44256f250d72c10eafc5ddad52dd8e13ff499a53.en: A family Saturday with Schattenbühne Scuraluna, "Das Bäumchen", a shadow play by Maik Zöllner. Grandfather wants to bring a little tree in on Christmas Eve, but the mouse has a better idea. Free craft activity for the youngest; entry 1 euro.

6d3e5416ad01f810c7d71887cc07b3beb67f88c1.en: Advent and Christmas tours at Tierpark Berlin, a guided winter walk on how animals handle the cold, from dense fur to cold paws. Tickets are sold online in advance only and are strictly limited.

91b9004acc7d3fef69c760683eb0704fceab1c05.en: A postcard printing workshop at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek using spices. Children and parents print postcards with natural colours alongside illustrator Patricia Thoma, learning about sustainability and waste avoidance. Free, no advance registration.

dff258ced144c5bad53454165cd375bf6839339e.en: A family Tüftel-Samstag at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel on Lego WeDo, where children build their own robot and send it along a test track. Makerspace activities include electronics, stop-motion films and laser-cut masks. Ages 6 to 12; free.

fffa2662af4d2507a67e8971bd12bab6494c6ff6.en: The 52nd Rathauskonzert of the Kammerorchester Weißensee at Rathaus Weißensee, conducted by Tilo Schmalenberg.

dac71499f31f24314641039221920897cc5fe0c4.en: An Advent concert by the orchestra school ensembles Flitzebögen and Wilmersdorfer Streichhölzer at the Kirchsaal des Evangelischen Campus Daniel, led by Till Münkler, Samuel Santana and Eva Sommer.

d436b59e980c5f80058d0ceadc0fd9665a894bd9.en: Fabrice Richter-Reichhelm and strings of the SinfonieOrchester Tempelhof in an unplugged candlelight concert, "Pop meets Classic", at the Gotischer Saal in Zitadelle Spandau. His father Mathis Richter-Reichhelm accompanies him on piano.

6f9e59d57d2824ad384aca5474fbb2c5daea45c1.en: The eighth event in the series "Nachhaltigkeit als Antwort auf planetare Krisen?" at Freie Universität Berlin, on critical political education and the imperial mode of living. Nilda Inkermann of Universität Kassel gives the input. Online registration.

65224dbb0d79b6d6f38752ca6a2f802a93239b6e.en: Touch tours at Zitadelle Spandau for blind and visually impaired people, through the exhibition "Enthüllt. Berlin und seine Denkmäler" or the Archäologisches Fenster, with tactile models and samples. Free, in German, about 90 minutes.

a07f1798111146224d66c23cfb2441b998fa6159.en: A LiteraturLive reading by Felix Haß, "Guten Morgen, Berlin", at Egon-Erwin-Kisch-Bibliothek, about a young Wessi and a young Ossi meeting in post-Wall Berlin. Part of the Lichtenberg Action Week for Human Rights. Free; registration required.

36d4ad8fe4f5be54aebf17f5903fd3f3b471a721.en: The exhibition "Co-Habitate" at Pforte by the TU Braunschweig's IAK, 5 December 2026 to 30 January 2027, asking how architecture can support the coexistence of people, animals, plants and microorganisms. Part of the "Busch in Berlin" series.

6a1fdfe410f3daffa6cdb667210d98eba3c05514.en: A walking excursion, "Haarmorde und tierische Elektrizität", commemorating famous scientists in Berlin Mitte, covering the Charité and Humboldt-Universität buildings, with graves visited in nearby cemeteries. Ends at Dorotheenstädtischer Friedhof.

0321967bccdbab5faf4cfd37befc12bbb83d8856.en: Magician Chris Hyde's Weihnachtszauber at the Kulturhaus Spandau gallery, a Christmas magic show with classic and modern tricks, in which the audience joins in. For ages 7 and up, about 70 minutes.

02af40f0d974b0c92a1d23d2098e051b9d356c59.en: beabadoobee's The Powerlines Tour at Tempodrom, presented by Live Nation. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by an adult aged 18 or over, and no one under 6 is admitted. Accessible tickets are arranged through the call centre.

3de854b347d32deead331e33427aad4ba93f4376.en: A VR taster for families at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg, showing how virtual reality works and offering interactive experiences. For ages 8 and up, in the ground-floor makerspace.

e320f6aad02d734d7078833735c4b72cef6900fb.en: A St Nicholas picture-book cinema afternoon at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, with a story on the big screen, games between the shelves, a crafts workshop for decorations and a colouring corner. Free, no registration.

36ba180e9383e860712bbbd1dca56eb52d0a7d98.en: Häkelzauber im Advent at Stadtteilbibliothek Lankwitz, a crochet session on Mondays in Advent for small Christmas ornaments made from wool. No experience needed; from age 18, no registration, materials provided free.

c5e774eec253428a9f8c5401cabd141b9f07e0c0.en: VOILÀ presents MOONBLOOM: Where Music Meets Magic, presented by Live Nation. Accessible tickets are arranged through the call centre. The listing gives no venue.

d6ec2fc9982d2eaf28a2d5ef3487f6268002d0a5.en: Spectrum Concerts Berlin, 38th season 2026, under the theme "The Vision", bringing chamber music from America and Europe together. The listing gives no venue or programme.

e90b4900c1cfa28bbde9a21ebdb0d47268e1c114.en: Europa ums Eck: Begegnung mit Finnland at Bibliothek am Wasserturm, on Finnish Music Day. Translator Elina Kritzokat reads from Timo Parvela's Ella series and explains what changes in translation, with a little Finnish. Free; registration by email.

bd41f95916810e0f7b7df8666ec2a79a2b63fe11.en: Rainer Lemke sings and plays guitar at Maria-Rimkus-Haus, performing emotional songs about longing, hope and courage. Doors open at 14:00 and the show starts at 15:00. Free entry; coffee 3 euros.

b20410bcd0cb47c3061bc6d8ec032ffb18454883.en: An introduction to 3D printing at Mittelpunktbibliothek Schöneberg's makerspace, for ages 16 and up, on how to make your own models and bring them to life.

553285c1eead6dd094b0d86f52f0c70f2513118d.en: The interactive reading "Der Schneegenbogen" with live music by Felix Isenbügel and Arne Assmann at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek, for children aged 4 to 8, who help move the story along and join in with songs. Free; registration required.

538e39e1339a2e1aa44b272de23bb04889f97d3d.en: Anne Wilkening's talk "Gebrauchsanleitung Pubertät" at Anna-Seghers-Bibliothek, explaining what happens in the teenage brain and offering tips for calmer family life. Free; registration requested.

edcb0e0c904a364ba0ae6e030f8da1f8e6f1f748.en: A box seat in the Ticketmaster Suite for BAP at Uber Arena, with leather armchairs, a premium parking pass and an open bar with wine, beer, soft drinks and coffee. Children under 6 are not admitted; under 16 must be accompanied by an adult.

33e0601a2584d3c904aba2912518ed93ec313144.en: Saam Sultan's Seraphim Tour at LARK, presented by Live Nation. Accessible tickets are arranged through the call centre, and the venue sets its own accessible ticket policy.

d241af9e93d4dddb9bf0141c4a1be62e3320d2fc.en: A teacher training in the metal workshop at Ellen-Key-Schule, where participants make rings, earrings, pendants or name tags with minimal machine use, then share classroom tips. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 26.2-135587.

eba88920b52aea8e74f382444d4014ce8e2c6892.en: A teacher training on playful methods for political education with children, covering how to discuss controversial topics with primary-school pupils. Participants try methods in practice and reflect on their own stance. Venue to be announced.

edd5d977bd55f93abffd85c6d615e2d9fec01a4b.en: Cattu's Christmas programme "Der Traumfänger – Eine rote Zipfelmütze" at Kulturhaus Spandau, a singalong concert with a snowflake dance, Rudolf the reindeer and a Father Christmas in an unusual outfit. Fun for young and old.

11db19f2446c2dec65551f314a814d3c57f9adad.en: A teacher training at Max-Beckmann-Schule on financial education for young people, with independent, practical materials about money and interactive media. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 26.2-135233.

52ac8a9ef991dab9d4f66dacc0c4e6f9a9066047.en: An adults' gallery talk on "Future Archives/Archive Futures" at Ratskeller, led by Kunstvermittlung Lichtenberg, with an exchange and a workshop over coffee and cake. Further dates on 2 December for families and 16 December for seniors.

8e90b0598792bf2dc3fded1923a3cb77d0ac36f3.en: The ninth event in the series "Nachhaltigkeit als Antwort auf planetare Krisen?" at Freie Universität Berlin, asking what answers political education can give to ecological, economic, social and political crises. Udo Dannemann of FU Berlin gives the input.

0e66f41c3b5dc67c8be0dde45f51589eb6d69545.en: A lecturers' concert, "Tangos und andere Leidenschaften", at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek, with tangos, milongas and valses by Carlos Gardel and Astor Piazzolla. Christof Griese plays alto saxophone and Hitomi Takeo piano.

fc3975305eb5e4e54e3e04b7e88ad7893e7d972e.en: A musical interactive Christmas fairy tale, "Emil rettet das Weihnachtsfest", at Kulturhaus Spandau, about a boy who believes in Father Christmas and a broken sleigh that must be repaired. For ages 4 and up.

c8730943090c6d42d2a2ef11186b5eb0ff640659.en: A Christmas party at Maria-Rimkus-Haus with live music from the Oranke-Duo. Doors open at 13:00 and the show starts at 14:00. Entry 5 euros, plus 3 euros for coffee; drinks cost extra.

14b15fb52e4ed9fbb5f2213a38e19dbda79f1811.en: The Vintage Café at Gottfried-Benn-Bibliothek, an afternoon without phones, with handwriting, puzzles, games and creative work. This Advent special invites people to write Christmas greetings together by hand. Registration by phone or email; free.

ef0e743cb57651fe496d29d85114aff24b47c09c.en: A traditional Christmas concert, "Fröhliche Weihnacht überall", by pupils of the Pankow site of the music school at Alte Pfarrkirche Pankow.

df058abce269f58301308f1877a6e5ad4119fc24.en: A three-day master workshop on traditional blues harmonica styles with Adam Sikora in Berlin, with blues expert Axel Küstner, at Kapelle99. Focus on timing, groove and intonation. Workshop dates 11 to 13 December 2026.

adbd2f80676a0f867d9e33f6916cadb9b8e913c5.en: A self-assertion workshop for girls aged 12 and up at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, run by Nachbarschaftshaus Wannseebahn e.V. It covers body language, saying no, the power of the voice and basic self-defence.

1ff35c0f6f723e88ee6a0a940126d05be899a561.en: Lichtenrade liest, a reading circle at Stadtteilbibliothek Lichtenrade, where local readers introduce favourite books and discuss them. Registration requested; free entry.

3a44e8cce67cda01483a767f91a5ada03123cc5d.en: An anime and manga meetup at Mark-Twain-Bibliothek every second Friday from 18:00. The programme includes previews of new anime, guessing anime openings and games. For people who love anime, manga and Asian pop culture.

d9f55562af7b7b49330f8444c82bd3bed585efb6.en: "Das Labyrinth der Träume" by Theater AGGREGATE at Theater unterm Dach, a poetic theatre meditation with three performers, a saxophone, a viola da gamba and three fog machines in an almost empty room. Entry 15 euros, reduced 10 euros.

9e20d34f5a0bf29c94061af41b5db25cf54a516c.en: NIMO's Home Sweet Home Arena Tour 2026, presented by Live Nation. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by an adult aged 18 or over, and no one under 6 is admitted. The listing gives no venue.

f5a836463fb3811ec6150acbbc48c70648a657b1.en: Christmas sounds in Weißensee at Immanuel-Kapelle, with soloists and ensembles from the Weißensee site of Musikschule Béla Bartók.

abda346dec28bc9fac71c7541b54eb850f9337b7.en: Christmas crafts with the library's bookbinder at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, making seasonal decorations and small gifts in a cosy atmosphere. Materials are provided.

84e57166c01887cef15b264ec99ac4d1d5a467ea.en: A pre-Christmas concert at Eliashof, Senefelderstraße site of Musikschule Béla Bartók, with pupils from the Prenzlauer Berg site playing Christmas and classical pieces for families and friends.

e138369bb18ba90f1f476befc4306d2a5ec8dfd9.en: The Blue Forty-Five and blues historian Axel Küstner perform "Blues – Teufelsmusik, die das Leben beschreibt" at Kapelle99, on country blues, its history and its close links with gospel. Entry 22 euros, reduced 18 euros.

84fe86b5ca2c52ce72d863b8acdb23acee8d585e.en: A Christmas concert of the Fachgruppe Zupfinstrumente with the children's choirs of the music school at Otto-von-Guericke-Oberschule, led by Helga Delgado. Overall coordination by Katrin Endrikat.

2d1492f015216f0d7acceb387446eaee88e6c15d.en: An Advent café at Hertha-Müller-Haus, with coffee, cake and music by the fireplace, singing and dancing with Kiry. Doors open 14:00, start 14:30, ends 17:00. Entry 10 euros, including music, coffee, Stolle and cake. Tickets from 2 November 2026.

15f3fe8925036ee1ac4446a36d03dc3cf3d4dce6.en: Theater Lingulino presents "Die Weihnachtsgans Auguste" at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, with actress Claudia Maria Franck, a hand-puppet goose and saxophonist Uwe Dohnt. Friedrich Wolf's cheerful story asks what happens when the diners fall for her. Free.

3c1f0b0271ea739a5ca27702d8b5f2b4d1d8baf7.en: JOSEFMARIA – Musikalisches Theater by Petra Pavel and Peter A. Rodekuhr at Gertrud-Haß-Bibliothek, a Christmas programme of cheerful and thoughtful songs, poems and stories, with piano. Free; registration by phone or email.

a985bb40d4c642da36e541b4b8cbc92ada3c726b.en: Alle auf einen Streich at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek, where the Klingendes Mobil brings string instruments to try and explains why a double bass sounds so deep. The session ends with drumming. Free, no registration.

0c9eae0b575b693b3bef04244dd336f9d1af9e70.en: Tilly Creutzfeldt-Jakob and Margot Schlönzke present "Oh Du Fröhliche" at Kulturhaus Spandau theatre, a witty Christmas revue with jazz, schlager, pop and swing, two strong voices and plenty of humour.

49883e427cb8314362fe12120547f7652f0a40a8.en: A Christmas concert by the Jugendblasorchester Pankow, conducted by Ronald Quandt, at Musikschule Béla Bartók. Donations are welcome for the Freundeskreis of Musikschule Pankow and the Kinderhospiz Sonnenhof.

d6f5d292fd1c3f6f6cce76c8c8a85d69c2e57fac.en: KlassiKlatsch Spezial at the Gotischer Saal in Zitadelle Spandau. Caspar and Frauke Jörns play piano while Nikolaus Radeke animates new paintings live to music by Mussorgsky, Pärt and others. Free entry; registration required.

3ff4f3efa81c9e726a3bed0e5c5f7ae9036a7300.en: Stage Steps – Jazz for Kids with Funkin' Donuts at Kunstfabrik Schlot, where the children's jazz band opens an evening of jazz in Mitte at 18:00, followed by Jazz Newcomers and Jazz Professionals. Free entry; donations welcome.

fd788cb5f9ee65913eafa5f3888257b15a0c7cc8.en: Oliver Grammel's Christmas magic show "Hokus, Pokus, Weihnachtszauberei" at Kulturhaus Spandau, about 45 minutes, for ages 3 and up. The audience helps magic a Christmas tree. Tickets via the card phone 030 333 40 22.

be0a4cf8ab9d1d02b5b6c2b441500b3fb0115736.en: A school-start picture-book cinema at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek for future school children, pre-schoolers and children from age 4, with games and a film about starting school. Free; no registration.

5729515628c03c5ddb90aff214c91956a354a3bb.en: A free AI workshop, "Die KI verstehen und nutzen", at Helene-Nathan-Bibliothek in German, Arabic and English. It covers what AI can do, its limits, better prompts, and using AI for translations, applications and online appointments. No registration needed.

59c8f9ecd5f367d45d5a881347a5ac032d12720a.en: A Christmas picture-book cinema afternoon at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, with crafts, a seasonal game, colouring sheets and carol singing around the decorated tree. Free, no advance registration.

fca18016b8cc9026aea82c94c2a2a676b05ce1ca.en: An open games afternoon for seniors at Anton-Saefkow-Bibliothek, with chess, dominoes, bingo, quizzes, memory games, strategy and puzzles. Free; no registration needed.

f57d8c1aa42fbf5521cd75178ddb809b619679e8.en: An open advice hour, "Raum für Beteiligung", at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek. Residents learn about current district projects, how to get involved and get help with participation processes. Free; no advance registration.

068eaea66fceb7778ae9a4ee6616ef3847f2749d.en: The Café Europa Christmas special, a get-together for people interested in Europe. The venue in Mitte is to be announced. Members and newcomers are equally welcome.

3b09b17c036fa1d7c8df886120adc5dd74e2e736.en: A gallery talk for seniors on "Future Archives/Archive Futures" at Ratskeller, led by Kunstvermittlung Lichtenberg, with exchange and a workshop over coffee and cake. Further dates on 2 December for families and 9 December for adults.

62645832d6c337536175337a4393d0949e69668e.en: A short-film afternoon at Stadtteilbibliothek Lankwitz for Kurzfilmtag, showing German short films nominated for or awarded the German Short Film Prize. Free, for people aged 18 and over.

f7f9d3b386d0aff8d09ea944d55f0965ffc96339.en: Schwarzblonde Weihnacht at Kulturhaus Spandau theatre, a "Fine Art of Glamourtainment" Christmas show mixing music, fashion and humour, with poetry and rock. Tickets via the card phone 030 333 40 22.

1cfd3d4c85ba5f4549d5ae08f721d98a308c8e1e.en: A traditional Christmas concert at Schlosskirche Buch with ensembles and soloists from the Buch-Karow site of the music school.

e4d0d1143edcad329d944dfa7f37cc19de4ca056.en: Shuffle Time by the JugendJazzBand Weißensee at Alter Schwede, playing jazz standards by Herbie Hancock, Miles Davis, Thelonious Monk, Amy Winehouse and others. Led by Lutz Wolf.

2b9969edf2fe74870cb33a18166d13e7467c008d.en: A shared Christmas story at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek. Over the day, visitors write three words on a Post-it to finish the last sentence or start a new chapter. A playful participation action, no registration.

1a11142032e966d3f96ee8b6d084f8aac1dfb009.en: "Geliebte, Seelenfreund – Das Bandoneon in der Weltliteratur", a talk by curator Aurélie Maurin with bandoneonist Helena Rüegg at the Musikinstrumenten-Museum's Curt-Sachs-Saal. Part of the Global Sound Stories series. Entry 16 euros, reduced 11 euros.

d1f1a238a8963ef35f9a7939042485822b93f621.en: Ibeyi live at Columbia Theater, presented by Live Nation. Wheelchair users and people with severe disabilities should book standard tickets; their carers enter free.

88dcd22cbed75337a70da96e053521c376cf7cf4.en: The "Europa klingt" concert "Winterreise durch Europa – Weihnachtskonzert" at Heinrich-Schulz-Bibliothek, with works on freedom and resistance by Beethoven, Chopin, Lysenko and Viardot, and songs such as "Imagine". Singing along is welcome.

cb3d1ce8ca07978375b02a51a43566d5d7974fc3.en: Die Märchenwelt mit Sinn at Ingeborg-Drewitz-Bibliothek, where children read Greek stories and fairy tales together and build language skills through games. Held in Greek; the group for ages 4 to 6 registers by email with the Hellenic Community of Berlin.

420316bb90a0065b7546761c2743bdf0517fb0c4.en: An open Christmas singalong, "Singt mit uns", at Horst-Dohm-Eisstadion with the choirs of Musikschule City West. Well-known carols from Germany and around the world; song texts are handed out beforehand. Free entry and free skating.

bca737f78e6a6a0a38cf7d2fe24a09a56f67761e.en: The finissage of "Future Archives / Archive Futures" by Kunstverein Tiergarten at the rk-Galerie, at Ratskeller, on collecting as an artistic, institutional and private practice, with works by many artists.

d9a1e9a8af3a0525f85439e53647b05235a1a7af.en: The Lankwitzer Bib-Quiz, Christmas edition, at Stadtteilbibliothek Lankwitz, with tricky questions and surprising facts for ages 18 and up. Free, no registration; a prize for the most correct answers.

7a9521e78aed2ed8c18020a7117eb5870550d426.en: A 3D printing question-and-answer session at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek for people who have completed an introductory course. Bring questions, failed prints or ongoing projects to solve together.

d846b0944dc5e1382ba656f12ba72e004271acf1.en: A family Tüftel-Samstag at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel on stop motion. Children bring their figures and a set to dance and make their own short film. Ages 6 to 12; free, no registration.

fbd6490c2b141313abdd28e071ce9de22cd758b1.en: A lecturers' concert, "Brasilianische Klassik", with Lívia Bergo and Gerson Sales on voice and Niek van Oosterum on piano, at the music school concert hall.

4f69f9f80933710d429d59ad72897df5af00aff7.en: An Advent concert by the E.T.A. Hoffmann Chamber Orchestra and Kammerchor Peter Schwarz at Ev. Kreuzkirche Schmargendorf, conducted by Dinah Backhaus, Matthias Wildenhof and Viola Escher.

bc51ac1f2b0ec6d276edab1475467c8441d69356.en: The eleventh event in the series "Nachhaltigkeit als Antwort auf planetare Krisen?" at Freie Universität Berlin, asking whether the climate crisis is also a crisis of adultism. Beatrice Kollinger of BTU Cottbus-Senftenberg is invited to give the input.

4bd09eb31fee88d2b9873e5215de789d18a80a85.en: A teacher training with SIEMENS-Initiative SIEYA @ School on teaching careers guidance and STEM with ready-made materials on smart cities, robotics and cybersecurity. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 26.2-135565.

4a3af09377c36545989fc45644c4ff3ad7821877.en: An open day at the new Gemeinschaftsschule Spandau (05K10), where parents and interested pupils can get a sense of the school and its profile.

dda358b2ef3785714dd60ef0e51aa18a56ab4067.en: A teacher training in the wood workshop at Heinrich-Böll-Oberschule, where participants make a marble maze with machine use, then plan how to run the project at their own school. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 26.2-135722.

72fa3d8cb1f146107085367a0d80bc401016b041.en: Operetta with coffee, the New Year's edition, by Alenka Genzel and Frank Matthias at Kulturhaus Spandau theatre, with melodies from operetta, opera, musical, Ufa films and folk songs, plus lively duets and humour.

cf4455ee7e8f7a29ff9f0dd669bad4ff3e38f61f.en: A teacher training on evaluating careers guidance, helping schools write or revise an evaluation concept, with online and self-study parts. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 26.2-135399.

f7c934920aa7353afd9d03b04367633b574f2e8d.en: A speed-dating event where teachers meet up to 12 companies from different sectors in Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf, Steglitz-Zehlendorf and Spandau to plan careers activities. Online follow-up on 17 February 2027. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin.

3921456d4096bfe6439409ce094bdefe2597c9a7.en: The twelfth event in the series "Nachhaltigkeit als Antwort auf planetare Krisen?" at Freie Universität Berlin, on political climate education. Christopher Hempel of Universität Halle and Anna Schnepper of FU Berlin give the input.

5bb5f5bb88910c2af8e0ed15db7cef22fc3d8997.en: A New Year's concert at Eliashof, Senefelderstraße, with teachers, ensembles and pupils of Musikschule Béla Bartók.

bf2ef0ce6b254b71f4eb63cd057ff4883c45c90e.en: An open day at Evangelische Schule Neukölln (08P03), an integrated secondary school, where families and pupils can explore classrooms and subjects and talk with teachers about the school's offers.

c4b72064478f14484b91c4892d911f36dc04e7b9.en: The Kissi-Chor, led by Anita Rennert, sings Advent choral music, "Cantate", at the Internationales Begegnungszentrum der Wissenschaft.

974269f3e441b8c022ff11e2cfef011362d3d28b.en: The tenth event in the series "Nachhaltigkeit als Antwort auf planetare Krisen?" at Freie Universität Berlin, on pupils' sustainability perspectives and learning at school. Katrin Hahn-Laudenberg of Universität Münster gives the input. Online registration.

30a73063e30e46e8636270af5069bf7619c61372.en: A teacher training on dual career paths for school leavers, with insights from Siemens and the Ferdinand-Braun-Institut, a company and university exchange, and a practical check at ASML Berlin. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 26.2-135620.

740c7912c4306013aab986f07d2906a464636f07.en: An open day at Luise-Henriette-Gymnasium (07Y05), where parents and interested pupils can get a good impression of the school and its profile.

9024eb3fe873c8a2c97c0f28f0a79e67298eef2b.en: An open day at Gottfried-Keller-Gymnasium (04Y04), where visitors can explore classrooms and subjects and talk with teachers. Guided tours run every 15 minutes; booking in advance is required.

9fe8a725394a4c189e7c3df606426e43ab68a961.en: A 3D printing theory course at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek, about 90 minutes, on the basics and how to print objects independently. Afterwards you may use the Bambu Lab P1S printer yourself. Library card needed; from 10 with an adult.

f41f117d9779c07d382996d27f6db39a9b383a32.en: Frank Muschalle from Berlin and Lluis Coloma from Barcelona meet on two grand pianos at the Gotischer Saal in Zitadelle Spandau, playing blues and boogie-woogie in a lively exchange of ideas, four hands and two hands.

b4ab4253cb6b73115fca6ebae39ee911e19c8083.en: Theater Fusion's "schneeschön & bitterkalt" at Kulturhaus Spandau gallery, from the seasons quartet, for children aged 2 to 5, about 40 minutes. A mouse named Jakob discovers his first winter world of snow. Tickets via the card phone.

b5958d54ae4c12d8060f12dd66dbe1f9da9a0863.en: Speed-dating "Schulen treffen Unternehmen" at Haus der Wirtschaft for teachers from Mitte, Pankow and Reinickendorf, who meet up to 12 companies and plan careers activities with them. Online follow-up on 4 March 2027. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin.

c69f384fac4b9cf4d13363ef126e02b91e06b88e.en: An open day at Albrecht-von-Graefe-Schule (02K09), presenting the profile of the State European School with the German-Spanish language combination.

92098b0a3bc2f146c24726e349b8a046fe2da94d.en: Singing with Roland at Heinrich-Böll-Bibliothek, where vocal coach and choir leader Roland Schulz leads everyone in pop songs, schlager and evergreens. No registration or prior knowledge needed.

79539fe1d9feb80c5888ca173b5625f41d99cb23.en: A taster day at the Weißensee site of Musikschule Béla Bartók, with a short pupils' concert followed by a chance to try instruments with the teachers.

06d61c0c6ea6468ba3b0b7272761a60d6a353774.en: The fifteenth event in the series "Nachhaltigkeit als Antwort auf planetare Krisen?" at Freie Universität Berlin, on concepts for a political education of care. Kleo Becker of Konzeptwerk Neue Ökonomie gives the input. Online registration.

7efa8ab86bed5a7b036e0e39b0e4208f7f2ebe6b.en: Stephen Lynch: The Me Tour, presented by Live Nation. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian aged 18 or over, and no one under 6 is admitted. Accessible tickets are arranged through the contact form or hotline.

f8563b93b679a33966c58795386b45c6c2582774.en: Clown duo Hops und Hopsi in "Hops, der Oberkellner" at Kulturhaus Spandau theatre, a restaurant visit with juggling, music and magic for the whole family. Popular since 1980. Tickets via the card phone 030 333 40 22.

a8d59767cb9b54f5cf0b05e6b29563eb160168b8.en: Nachtkinder at Kulturhaus Insel Berlin. The listing gives no details beyond a pointer to the German version.

28c09fa8308a2fa849b46c85203f193c269d01a6.en: Solidarische Perspektiven für eine Welt im Umbruch, part of the same sustainability series at Freie Universität Berlin, with input from Henna-Elise Ventoverta of Kipppunkt kollektiv. Online registration.

f1179833c87c77d51e3e60dc330b25da44955ff8.en: "Der Tod – Ihr seid Geschichte", the comedian Der Tod with his fifth evening programme at Kulturhaus Spandau theatre. He reads, sings and improvises through humanity's stories, from the Stone Age to artificial intelligence.

f8e37642e9622ee23bba9176263a1c2552893efe.en: A family Tüftel-Samstag at Humboldt-Bibliothek Tegel, with electronics, robot programming, stop-motion films and laser-cut masks in the makerspace. For ages 6 to 12; free, no registration.

3a5afd3a92264069fc1537b9bbdb9ae4b17785d5.en: Magic in Spandau with Berlin magicians Chris Hyde and André Kursch at Kulturhaus Spandau gallery, an evening of amazement, thought experiments and magical stories, close to the audience.

73f9a2f546bb36a868c33142a2889274cc9a5600.en: Two Door Cinema Club's 15th Anniversary Tour, with support from The Royston Club, presented by Live Nation. The listing gives no venue.

85891ffffb07e0fde81b97b4812d4a2c1aed4999.en: One Vision of Queen feat. Marc Martel, box seat in the Ticketmaster Suite at Uber Arena, with leather armchairs, premium parking, a separate premium entrance and an open bar. Children under 6 are not admitted.

db3bc1cca984407b8521f5b90fe7480762aa8b1a.en: The closing event of the series "Nachhaltigkeit als Antwort auf planetare Krisen?" at Freie Universität Berlin, reviewing what political education can offer in response to planetary crises. Luisa Girnus of FU Berlin gives the input.

17450c29300ade55cdb7643fc3b5b2737d1636ef.en: An open day for the Berufliches Gymnasium at Max-Taut-Aula, where pupils from integrated and community secondary schools can learn about the vocational upper-school profiles of the OSZ. The Jugendberufsagentur gives advice on site.

003eb731631830848245b166133b0b2fd7603fcf.en: Role Model presents Chuck On Tour at Tempodrom, with special guest Keni Titus, presented by Live Nation. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by an adult aged 18 or over, and no one under 6 is admitted.

fcc14d7d8d03b5842a332dbc2aa97d6d2a2d9bfd.en: An open day at Hermann-Scheer-Schule (OSZ Wirtschaft), where visitors learn from pupils and teachers about courses from the vocational upper school to the Fachoberschule and business assistant training.

2fbacfde85d3f6fe579a5fe761e00a8ae70cb065.en: An open day at Rahel-Hirsch-Schule (OSZ Gesundheit/Medizin), presenting courses from preparation for work to the vocational Abitur and further training, including the vocational upper school and Fachoberschule.

ff33e68573f37575bbc9b6f602744f37c7675cd4.en: A Graphik-Collegium Berlin e.V. exhibition at PYRAMIDE Ausstellungszentrum Hellersdorf, in memory of Knut Norbert Firchau, from 13 February to 2 April 2027. Vernissage on Saturday 13 February 2027 at 18:00.

815bbe03f249cf578a365d0cb27e0ef4e6c8e61b.en: Martin Rütter, box seat in the Ticketmaster Suite at Uber Arena, with leather armchairs, premium parking, a separate premium entrance and an open bar. Children under 6 are not admitted.

63e1cd0a65510b4a52003db3c428061fd8ecbc6a.en: A teacher training in the metal workshop at Hedwig-Dohm-Schule, where participants make pendants, name plates, keyrings or bottle openers with machine use, then share classroom tips. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 27.1-135889.

74dae5842d1db1c768b5a5a9f895dc9d65c3920a.en: DAGNY's Europe 2027 tour at Columbia Theater, presented by Live Nation. Wheelchair users and people with severe disabilities marked "B" pay the regular price, and companions enter free.

aea62960c3d4d8d65eb04d0c1b56f5413ea7d6ec.en: An online teacher training on preparing the search for internship places for pupils with support needs, covering search criteria, barriers and strategies, with shared experience among teachers. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 27.1-134498.

a8a49a9f5cdb933eba41c1e53b30eb816cd64a37.en: Masego's Fix Your Face Tour, presented by Live Nation. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by an adult aged 18 or over, and no one under 6 is admitted. The listing gives no venue.

fd7f80d5a57d4b9f57ab29f7e3b62cd4504a1636.en: An open day at Jane-Addams-Schule (OSZ Sozialwesen), where visitors learn about courses from the vocational upper school to social pedagogy and early childhood training, including training to become a childcare worker.

c1773f0e78682bc6b5f886885c6c6503bd6731fc.en: An open day at the Filiale Jane-Addams-Schule (OSZ Sozialwesen), with information on the Fachoberschule, the Berufsoberschule and social assistant training, and on the childcare training.

3b839675c82d9b83a1b190136fb2b083ad335f47.en: Figurentheater Ute Kahmann presents "Der kleine Eisbär" at Kulturhaus Spandau, after Hanns de Beer's children's classic. About 40 minutes, for ages 4 and up. Lars is caught in a trap, then escapes with a walrus and a bear girl. Entry 7 euros, 5 euros for JKS.

66e7dc49a5fe5a6c8c4a2e18eb84c9a5a375f531.en: aespa's LIVE TOUR – SYNK: COMPLæXITY in Berlin, with Premium packages at Uber Arena. Premium Seat includes blocks 101 to 104, the Premium Lounge and a separate entrance. All-In Premium adds a buffet and drinks. eTickets arrive 3 to 5 days before.

0802f1f26b53dd5e47f6e0a8559aecf65d151e6a.en: Theater Nicole Gospodarek presents "Vom Bett, das nicht schlafen konnte" at Kulturhaus Spandau gallery, a story about sleep for ages 3 and up, about 45 minutes. A bed cannot sleep and starts thundering through the house. Tickets via the card phone.

3938f0a6334c826e19c0cf80d758ba06eb2edf9e.en: André Rieu and his Johann Strauss Orchestra, box seat in the Ticketmaster Suite at Uber Arena, with leather armchairs, a premium parking pass, a separate premium entrance and an open bar. Children under 6 are not admitted.

4572085f8a9c21614585a44d65f4c13d5761ffcd.en: A discussion, "Busch in Berlin – Co-Habitate", at Galerie Parterre with bird-protection expert Claudia Wegworth, pigeon-management expert Beate Gries and architect Jonas Fangmann, with Bernd Schulz and IAK members.

ffa751ae1c0ee9f6c7e007d035da422d7a082a40.en: The thirteenth event in the series "Nachhaltigkeit als Antwort auf planetare Krisen?" at Freie Universität Berlin, on political education, global learning and education for sustainable development in practice. Birgit Brenner of EPIZ gives the input.

4a25e8a29d83a67a0e29eaf8878f26620614fc0e.en: Founding a pupil company, "Junior stellt sich vor", a three-part teacher training at Wilma-Rudolph-Schule with an online input, a school concept and a school visit. Dates in 2027. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 27.1-135742.

c6f84308c27874f4e551a50be963561b4513cf20.en: A teacher training by the Berliner Landeszentrale on handling extreme-right views in parents at daycare and primary schools. It covers responding to prejudice, keeping a working alliance and protecting children from ideology.

ae2ecc60e83d67e8138ebe7165a940c7d2c0cf86.en: A teacher training on building trades for pupils with BBR, MSA or Abitur, presenting 16 trades and the labour market, with a company visit and classroom practice. Dates in 2027. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 27.1-135606.

ce5c4e43525047560906b4cd9e6c65e0d3a4b172.en: An open day at Louise-Schroeder-Schule (OSZ Bürowirtschaft und Verwaltung), where pupils and teachers present the school's many offers, from career preparation and training to vocational Abitur.

d2ab389a44295ec9b9558b7c1d6f9b35f7de8172.en: An open day at Anna-Freud-Schule (OSZ Sozialwesen) for those interested in training as a childcare worker, with full-time or part-time training, the vocational upper school and social pedagogical assistant training.

d68d44424ee68e2882868ec91122e2b26b676e7a.en: An open day at the OSZ Banken, Immobilien und Versicherungen, with information on the vocational upper school, career preparation, the Fachoberschule and the Berufsoberschule. Pupils and teachers answer questions.

0f506caf82be6caf4d57efca68f97c1c1298ecf0.en: John Summit's EUROPE CTRL ESCAPE TOUR, presented by Live Nation. Tickets for wheelchair users are not distributed through Live Nation. The listing gives no venue.

e366b3c516957555bf40c4bc50f00306c856a560.en: An open day at Marie-Elisabeth-Lüders-Oberschule, for those interested in training as a childcare worker, offering full-time or part-time training to high standards.

8eac614716c64dcfc3903ab9cd87f6a2b4aefeb6.en: An open day at Konrad-Zuse-Schule, where pupils and teachers present the many courses on offer, from career preparation to vocational Abitur and further training.

363742bc1e5722aadfda23233ce54dddda1b3df8.en: An open day at Wilhelm-Ostwald-Schule, where visitors learn about career preparation, training, the vocational upper school, design technical assistant training and the Fachoberschule.

c37f3a4335dca4a65ef7470593ae98d664bcd153.en: "Armato il cor – Monteverdi", with the Freiburger BarockConsort and a soloist quartet, at Italienische Höfe in der Zitadelle. Works by Monteverdi, Dario Castello and Giovanni Battista Fontana, including a madrigal in which love meets battle.

e569b6c5495ceef5c21d174e77d9493426729ebc.en: An open day at Brillat-Savarin-Schule (OSZ Gastgewerbe), presenting courses including the vocational upper school and the Berufsoberschule to pupils and visitors.

4e2ee9286c60226cffb6ecc035db68ad726cc47c.en: An open day at Ruth-Cohn-Schule for those interested in training as a childcare worker, with full-time and part-time social pedagogy training, social pedagogical assistant training and a 2+2 model.

ee28bdfb78b699de90b38aab376a9cbb4d489804.en: An open day at Lise-Meitner-Schule (OSZ Chemie, Physik und Biologie), where visitors experience a full school day with live insights into lab and theory lessons.

c2d8eabc87558efd59dee5ab2d8456c54fe16199.en: A tower tour of St. Nikolai church in Spandau, climbing the steps as Theodor Fontane once did, with views over the city's roofs. Free entry; registration required through the Kulturhaus customer office.

88b815cd3813b70592d79cc5737d7c5f006b3b76.en: The Reminiscere-Vesper by cantores minores under Gerhard Oppelt at St. Nikolai church, part of the Spandauer Vesper festival format. It includes psalms, the Magnificat, works by Heinrich Schütz and Johann Crüger, and organ music.

3265236a6c54ce3d6c0f1cefc9aef17e3bb8df57.en: The 90s Super Show at Uber Arena with a box seat in the Ticketmaster Suite. It includes leather armchairs, a premium parking pass, a separate premium entrance and an open bar with a burger. Children under 6 are not admitted.

866e31fec2164e418c200c38dcd725eecd99314a.en: Schrammek trifft: Bernhard Schrammek talks with harpsichordist Christine Schornsheim and violinist Mayumi Hirasaki in the Gotischer Saal in Zitadelle Spandau before the Bach concert. A ticket for "Bach im Herzen" is required.

d91c617dc74bd5f0b5ecf890b643852890ebb580.en: Bach im Herzen at the Gotischer Saal in Zitadelle Spandau, with harpsichordist Christine Schornsheim and four strings playing three Bach harpsichord concertos and a violin sonata. Part of the SPAM festival.

a124e2d8f7b7e2da2c9a7bce06437998684ed18f.en: Fortuna Variata at Exerzierhalle in Zitadelle Spandau, with street tunes of the late 15th century on cornett, shawm, sackbut and trombone. Part of SPAM's "Museumsklänge" format, with a military history tour beforehand.

ed0d9317f07300f9ca42f4841ac0de44bfb8167d.en: "Aber mein Herz wartet …" at Italienische Höfe in the Zitadelle, with soprano Marie Luise Werneburg and friends in 17th-century love songs from the Song of Songs by Buxtehude, Bruhns and others. Includes a fortress tour at 16:30.

774306c90cf44446a8eba3a4555a2e78a8933bd1.en: Rush at Uber Arena with a box seat in the Ticketmaster Suite. It includes leather armchairs, premium parking, a separate premium entrance and an open bar with a burger. Children under 6 are not admitted.

9f26e2b603a63f1da98ae4c8a51bd1de02e84c60.en: "In Darkness" – Dowland and Purcell at night, an exclusive concert for patrons and SPAM Card 100 holders in the Fürstenzimmer of Zitadelle Spandau. Soprano Marie Luise Werneburg sings with lutenist Christoph Sommer.

ca4dff7e3a223d455c6243fa495bc7342d4ccd69.en: Alte Musik an der Musikschule in the Musikschule Spandau lecture hall, with teachers and pupils playing early music. An instrument station at 16:30 lets visitors try baroque violin, dulcian and viola da gamba. Free entry.

6ff34a9aeaea83a871be58f182e5864896627377.en: TANZOLYMP 2027 GALA, listed without venue details. The German version of the listing has further information.

3f959ebc024c807373cb02d66b84400e9e61636c.en: Berlin school gymnastics competitions at Sporthalle Schöneberg, a school contest for classes 1 to 3 and 1 to 6.

00f0d931405f413c851f92fd77a69e1bc81a9610.en: Save the date: "Freedom must win – Cafe Kyiv 2027" at Colosseum Berlin on 23 February 2027, the fifth edition. It marks five years of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine and the continued support for its reconstruction.

072561bfa240c7b80e41e52bd5eaace1d93a3889.en: A teacher training on technological change in trades, using the motor vehicle guild as the example. Covers the labour market, digitalisation and AI, with a visit to the workshops. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 27.1-135538.

a0b78007f0b42bf66baf0f96c31a0f142896d38a.en: A metal workshop teacher training at Ellen-Key-Schule, where participants make a napkin holder with guidance and minimal machine use, then share classroom tips. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 27.1-135878.

7858e7ada60eb57c86e434aeaab212daf61dc51f.en: A teacher training on school and university cooperation at Freie Universität Berlin, showing what universities offer for careers guidance and how to develop joint projects. Further dates on 14 and 21 April 2027. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin.

dc24fbdb55b58a2bf3f0b630a8f23d06ddcae3cd.en: Outlander In Concert – Echoes Through The Highlands Tour, with Gallery Seat tickets at Uber Eats Music Hall. Seats in blocks 202 to 204, Gallery Bar access, fast-lane entry and a free cloakroom. eTickets arrive 3 to 5 days before the show.

f4095847434b371417fc8fd5a24c8bd28af695e0.en: An open day at Loschmidt-Oberschule, a vocational school with special education tasks that prepares young people for work with innovative methods. Visitors can learn about career preparation and social assistant training.

e8c0fd96c07c89f5d176bb5630ac325db907afad.en: An open day on career preparation at Brillat-Savarin-Schule, for pupils finishing year 10 or in welcome classes who are interested in restaurant, hotel or health careers, or want a school leaving certificate.

1f1818911f0e35417d7b520c91eded38b01f39e7.en: An open day at OSZ Ästhetik und Technik, with information on career orientation, the cosmetics vocational school and the Fachoberschule, from pupils and teachers.

3bf8b5f3ab12821a26a75e2f6db3ce2f4ab47587.en: An open day at Oscar-Tietz-Schule (OSZ Handel II), with information on career preparation, the Berliner Ausbildungsmodell, the Fachoberschule and the Berufsoberschule.

7a241bf4c94fa7b4fb26dfdebdee0f3a0e901a4e.en: Gambenzauber at Bastion Kronprinz in Zitadelle Spandau, with Paolo Pandolfo and Amélie Chemin playing two viols in works by Tobias Hume, Marin Marais and Bach. Includes a 17:45 tour of the Renaissance vaults. An entry ticket is required.

4923289fffdf1e0926bf92e4198045454d2b0e3b.en: An open day at Georg-Schlesinger-Schule (OSZ Maschinen- und Fertigungstechnik), with information on the many offers from pupils and teachers, from career preparation to the Abitur and further training.

d15b68359a6ed605b2356b444514e6bf6c3cff4d.en: SPAM-Bach-Kanal live: Michael Maul and Bernhard Schrammek, hosts of the MDR Klassik Bach-Kanal, perform with students of the UdK's Institut für Alte Musik. Arias devoted to the heart, with audience singing and humour.

cdab98edcc80549aaed87392bc25103bfef49d4e.en: Faszination Trecento at Italienische Höfe in the Zitadelle, with the Italian ensemble La Fonte Musica under Michele Pasotti. It presents 14th-century Italian music by Jacopo da Bologna, Machaut and Zacara da Teramo, including passionate love songs.

dbff83be280f739d5c7890318a3a3d7547c8c8aa.en: Hot Chip's A Long Way From Kansas tour, presented by Live Nation. Wheelchair users with a "B" ID pay the regular price, and companions enter free. No entry for children under 6. The listing gives no venue.

35b28951f86f017261fe064777ef7bb5356ea305.en: An open day at Peter-Lenné-Schule (OSZ Natur und Umwelt), presenting courses from animal-care and environmental technical assistant training to gardening, forestry and dual study.

5482865d927fea54c878df353ab66d2fcc8280e0.en: A teacher training on anti-Muslim racism, its forms and counter-strategies, with practical examples for everyday pedagogical work and Berlin contacts. Part of the series "Politische Bildung für pädagogische Fachkräfte".

f754bafe4b4137be3febd455371e37e3ffc3cd3c.en: An open day at OSZ Lotis (Logistik, Touristik und Steuern), where visitors learn about career preparation, the Fachoberschule and the vocational upper school from pupils and teachers.

07a6fe52ca1d1f2a23a2929392788ce58a5774c2.en: A market of opportunities at Berufliche Schule für Sozialwesen Pankow, where employers and providers present themselves to prospective childcare trainees, with contacts for internship searches. Full-time or part-time training is on offer.

c8a215ee3b5815a65775eb7b94946d9e11d154a7.en: An open day at Elinor-Ostrom-Schule (OSZ Bürowirtschaft und Dienstleistungen), where pupils and teachers present the school's many offers, from career preparation to further training.

0e81ec513ed2338647c717527a1492d267128eb7.en: The Oculi-Vesper at St. Nikolai church in Spandau by the vocal ensemble Sirventes Berlin, with a large Magnificat by Orlande de Lassus, within a vesper liturgy with organ, hymns and a short address. Also works by Fehre and Ferdinand de Lassus.

4f23dd2e0753ae2c29d830a15b4f840b894758e1.en: "Mein Herze schwimmt im Blut", baroque solo cantatas at St. Nikolai church, with soprano Miriam Feuersinger and the Capricornus Consort Basel under Péter Barczi. Bach and Graupner set the same text, so the audience can compare them.

fab2ba96ef0ec681a3d3a153a6c3e8ac25ce5ed8.en: Doppelrohr-Power at ZAK – Zentrum für Aktuelle Kunst (Haus 6), with the dulcian consort and oboe band of the UdK and HMT Leipzig, playing Beethoven, Telemann and others on double-reed instruments among contemporary art.

c9e4f39d880bdf4fa1d0ee1e624a5259d5fa5e00.en: Little Matthew Passion at Alte Kaserne, first floor, by the Berlin ensemble Continuum under Elina Albach. It combines Bach's St Matthew Passion with David Lang's Little Match Girl Passion, for four singers and a hybrid instrumental ensemble.

ad45767304da07c4a0f28d1b8d2b9019a94afba7.en: BO on Tour in Marzahn-Hellersdorf, a practical day visiting training companies in the district, with talks with trainees, trainers and HR staff on helping young people into training. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 27.1-134232.

e6b08a18f9e8f4e8b8923ff803d8c899e83577e0.en: An open day at Ernst-Litfaß-Schule (OSZ Mediengestaltung und Medientechnologie), presenting career preparation, the Fachoberschule, the Berufsoberschule, media technical assistant training and the vocational upper school.

c223fd20c786db7818c7d7eeeb81c74d4f1eb1d7.en: An open day at Emil-Fischer-Schule (OSZ Ernährung und Lebensmitteltechnik), presenting offers from the vocational upper school and career preparation to food technology and chemical technical assistant training.

4a957f67d67db6a1d6f79fffc4aa448dfd266a27.en: The Markus-Passion at St. Nikolai church by Akademie für Alte Musik Berlin and Voces Suaves. In 1726 Bach performed a Passion by an author named only as "Keiser", paired here with an early Bach cantata.

f837901dc5e5f559041ead111eb0572e84e724a6.en: Hazel Brugger's Good Evening Europe at Uber Arena, with a box seat in the Ticketmaster Suite. It includes leather armchairs, premium parking, a separate premium entrance and an open bar. Children under 6 are not admitted.

fe95af44a97edbe6ec0a68a611a3440cf5d276f6.en: English consort music by the viol consort Phantasm under Laurence Dreyfus at the Gotischer Saal in Zitadelle Spandau, with works by Christopher Tye, Richard Mico, John Jenkins and William Lawes from the 16th and 17th centuries.

5edb00455fe83cc04441349b7776f7c2fd5b1968.en: "An Heart That's Broken" by Capella de la Torre under Katharina Bäuml at Italienische Höfe in der Zitadelle. Soprano Margret Hunter and historical wind instruments present songs and airs from the Elizabethan era by Dowland, Holborne and Morley.

a4464bed58b3a91c697de8f0565076a2aa4e1c39.en: ENHYPEN at Uber Arena, with a box seat in the Ticketmaster Suite. It includes leather armchairs, premium parking, a separate premium entrance, an open bar and Asian American fusion finger food. Children under 6 are not admitted.

f62f5486ab53e87b6677382ce1c313b3683cc93f.en: La Roux's OLD FLAMES TOUR 2027, presented by Live Nation. No admission for children under 6; under 16 must be accompanied by an adult. Wheelchair users should book regular tickets, and companions enter free. The listing gives no venue.

27a0f1064983af8946aa1de8f34e7c410a15b34d.en: Chansonnier Cordiforme at the Gotischer Saal in Zitadelle Spandau, sung by the vocal ensemble amarcord from Leipzig. The heart-shaped late 15th-century manuscript holds polyphonic love songs by Binchois, Dufay, Ockeghem and Josquin.

a19310e9fac59aec5344cfb9aeb1d9734cf4b23c.en: A Laetare Vesper at St. Nikolai church with the MarienVokalensemble under Marie-Louise Schneider, featuring Bach's setting of the hymn "Jesu, meine Freude", which the congregation can sing too. Also works by Johann Crüger.

d2e9007a6993412eec51a3761ae6749f83ab0bc4.en: Romeo und Julie by the Lautten Compagney Berlin under Wolfgang Katschner, a concert performance of Georg Anton Benda's 1776 singspiel. Food is available at the qnorke restaurant before and after the performance.

e3a8ee501816080a2b315572fbc5060f78c77c70.en: Wandelnde Flöten, the traverse flute consort of the UdK's Institut für Alte Musik under Georges Barthel, walking through the exhibition "Enthüllt. Berlin und seine Denkmäler" with French baroque music by Blavet, Hotteterre and Boismortier.

b37a4a9843c553d9d295e241995a3fd60bbb39e0.en: Membra Jesu nostri by Buxtehude, performed by the RIAS Kammerchor Berlin and Collegium Musicum '23 under Grete Pedersen, closing SPAM 2027. It is a meditation on the crucified Jesus, with the cantata "Ad cor" devoted to the heart.

377e14c4ff79169d9cd75ed1c7b12379ed622936.en: C2C: Country to Country, 6 and 7 March 2027 at Uber Eats Music Hall and Uber Platz, with daytime sidestages and an evening mainstage programme. Wheelchair and companion tickets are available via a link; a "B" designation is required at entry.

f13aecc66e51262cf73716a50c3815bbfd91fbb7.en: An open day at Knobelsdorff-Schule (OSZ Bautechnik I), presenting its construction training, such as building tradespeople and building technical assistants.

3c18b92837f0ffe027e8779e0e094d0a62f5f4dd.en: An online teacher training on parent work in the inclusive transition to work for pupils with support needs, with practice examples and small-group exchange on effective measures. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 27.1-134712.

c386f1721b965e436439bce6c435ae01741ea663.en: The H2 Forum Berlin at Estrel Congress Center, Convention Hall II, on innovations in the hydrogen age. Researchers, developers and newcomers present technical breakthroughs and meet investors and policymakers.

7481175af8eb96830de7befb595b050d97f483d6.en: An open day at Hans-Böckler-Schule (OSZ Konstruktionsbautechnik), presenting its offers from pupils and teachers, including metal technology specialists.

8ef7a99fb0cf8a2d0c3a666031b8bd24fc30914a.en: An open day at OSZ Informations- und Medizintechnik, presenting courses such as technical system planners, IT device advisers, IT assistants and medical device technology assistants, plus the vocational upper school for IT and medical informatics.

410f6379499fd939ccf5c86499e19b0f772719f9.en: Teddy Swims' The UGLY Tour at Uber Arena with Premium packages. Premium Seat includes blocks 101 to 104, the Premium Lounge and a separate entrance; All-In Premium adds a buffet and drinks. eTickets arrive 3 to 5 days before the show.

30179bfdefa6da0202bdbebc96330baf5fb8f667.en: Bonobo's Distance In Static live at Uber Eats Music Hall with Gallery Seat tickets. Seats in blocks 202 to 204, Gallery Bar access, fast-lane entry and a free cloakroom. eTickets arrive 3 to 5 days before the show.

c409d65c15d8b3df71862e6904375fac96a16804.en: A career advice day at Rahel-Hirsch-Schule (OSZ Gesundheit/Medizin), where pupils and teachers present offers including career preparation and the Fachoberschule.

df191c0867c343991e95f01227c165b426c0c8b7.en: Figurentheater Ute Kahmann presents "In der Hasenschule" at Kulturhaus Spandau, a playful show for school start and Easter, for ages 4 and up, about 45 minutes. Martha secretly follows her brother Max to school. Entry 7 euros, 5 euros for JKS.

bd6ac6ca605e08efc987ef4198d595b4b8a1e9bc.en: Kendall Lujan at Kulturhaus Insel Berlin. The listing gives no details beyond a pointer to the German version.

6578ed016ed1436dc3ae2ac4a9fd7267bcd20697.en: Fimiguerrero's LOST CITY, presented by Live Nation. Wheelchair users and people with severe disabilities marked "B" pay the regular price, and companions enter free. The listing gives no venue.

4b9e0d458666f1abe9989f93464e592f7c4d8bbc.en: Sienna Spiro's My House Tour at Tempodrom, with support from Eloise, presented by Live Nation. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by an adult aged 18 or over, and no one under 6 is admitted.

46f8aad9edff6fbf1c3546fb6fabaac08af6053b.en: KALEO's Way Down We Go Tour at Uber Eats Music Hall with Gallery Seat tickets. Seats in blocks 202 to 204, Gallery Bar access, fast-lane entry and a free cloakroom. eTickets arrive 3 to 5 days before the show.

d37d537ead440a7204cff1c69b7add04e84396fe.en: Ash Grunwald's European Tour 2027 at Kulturhaus Insel Berlin. The listing gives no details beyond a pointer to the German version.

6e42ee9211080204e4407e7232ecb0b4b226dc5d.en: Endgegner's live game-music concert "Before the Moon Falls" at Kulturhaus Spandau theatre, with the Majora's Mask soundtrack by Koji Kondo, played by the Cologne video-game band with jazz, classical, folk and rock, plus live visuals.

bf64c96ad403deaa01d0ab3dda0e0002d2ebb2fd.en: Gregor Meyle & Band in "Unplugged – Das Wohnzimmerkonzert" at a Berlin club, presented by Live Nation. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by an adult aged 18 or over, and no one under 6 is admitted.

2e5047d37a5eeca32e2af9a764e042554f638047.en: A teacher training on safety in WAT lessons, linking the RiSU safety guideline with the WAT curriculum, with risk assessments and classroom practice. Further dates on 20 April and 25 May 2027. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 27.1-134228.

ec6bede307b2d5105c34e60881ea7b11167db9c9.en: Theater Geist's "Das schönste Ei der Welt", a puppet play after Helme Heine's children's book, for ages 4 and up, about 40 minutes. Three hens compete to be the most beautiful, and the king sets a contest to lay the most beautiful egg.

af974c842cf67b0103866b140e8042611ea85c4f.en: Fabian & Friends – DIE Show at Kulturhaus Spandau gallery, where award-winning magician Fabian Weiss shows excerpts of his programme with showbiz friends. A mix of magic, comedy and cabaret.

b84ecc24d1913a04eb9b793dc9361990d0c7152e.en: A teacher training on safety and accident prevention in the school kitchen during WAT lessons, with practical exercises and classroom transfer. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 27.1-134227.

06c92c8aca821ddfd8d82b9d7a3318ecde26a644.en: An introductory course on repair education at schools, presented by BUND Berlin e.V. It covers repair-themed lessons, hands-on repair kits and links with local initiatives such as Repair Cafés. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 27.1-135771.

ff7ac84e2c1e05c2a4bffbdd9612b5cba6a7783d.en: A teacher training on two-year vocational training, with insights from IHK speakers, trainee ambassadors and companies, followed by planning and visiting an IHK trade fair with pupils. Further dates on 21 and 28 April 2027.

246603a6fb471ab35c821621d9618f827ce6c017.en: Nicole Gospodarek's puppet play "Hasen pfeifen nicht" at Kulturhaus Spandau gallery, after Ludvik Askenazy, for ages 4 and up, about 45 minutes. A hare wants to whistle and searches for the marmot who can teach him. Tickets via the card phone.

daf896b42707b2ba2fd5b9fe7c4fdf57a5aa87cd.en: A full-day teacher training in the wood workshop at Wilma-Rudolph-Schule, making a cutting board from a plank, with safe working and materials. Suited to schools with good technical equipment. Registration via fortbildungen.berlin, number 27.1-135736.

601f9a21bd283ff55e80c51fb344e7028d438ca6.en: ABSCHIED & BEGINN, an exhibition by the FrauenKunstKarawane at PYRAMIDE Ausstellungszentrum Hellersdorf from 19 April to 13 June 2027. Vernissage on Saturday 17 April 2027 at 18:00.

04b3c3ef655c9b4f3b42a47e9946ce2ad26d6124.en: MAFFAY + OERDING: NASHVILLE LIVE 2027 with a box seat in the Ticketmaster Suite at Uber Arena. It includes leather armchairs, premium parking, a separate premium entrance and an open bar. Children under 6 are not admitted.

364eb653ffb2920809391e36131db2be0dfb94f2.en: Thirty Seconds to Mars presents "A Beautiful Lie vs This Is War", presented by Live Nation. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by an adult aged 18 or over, and no one under 6 is admitted. The listing gives no venue.

3dd749d563df3693131837fc6a2fbbe9b4c6320e.en: Thirty Seconds to Mars presents "A Beautiful Lie vs This Is War", VIP package. Visitors under 16 must be accompanied by an adult aged 18 or over, and no one under 6 is admitted. The listing gives no venue.

c23245a653db2824adca59264bd9ca09482b93b0.en: CURRENT SWELL at Kulturhaus Insel Berlin. The listing gives no details beyond a pointer to the German version.

626f665a6686f3634f0faa3decb71ad03382abf4.en: The Europäischer Polizeikongress 2025 at Estrel Festival Center, an international platform for leaders of European police forces. Keynotes come from interior and justice ministers, with an exhibition of system-solution manufacturers.

748c6a7c2be91c5fd59cde228d6e3f531af91d3c.en: A workshop, "Kulturgintza sendotzeko tresnak", on basic cultural management at Aiaraldea Ekintzen Faktoria in Laudio on 22 October, led by Marta Castro for creators and cultural organisers. Sessions run 12:00 to 14:00 and 16:00 to 19:00.

8ca449eb96dac1b41e3ab2a5df8186ed9c01c19e.en: A literary meeting with Carmen Torres on her book "Después de todo" at the Residencia Municipal in Algorta. A pianist discovers that the author of a novel that shaped her life lives next door, and the story turns to loss, illness and forgiveness.

78344b46f1f55d42db94dba567814a210d8c3dd0.en: A talk by Daniel Belasco, director of the Al Held Foundation, on the work of American abstract painter Al Held, recently added to the Guggenheim Bilbao collection and shown in room 307. In English with simultaneous Spanish translation.
