825ac9782335b039828ee06f55b14dd43e90dd94.en: A storytelling session, "Liburu rubusa", by Lur Usabiaga at Biblioteca de Bilbao in Basurto, for children aged 5 to 9.

f71f9ebed8c4935a3a572d10376f7b2931f00471.en: A children's magic show, "Aroa eta mirariak", by Asier Kidam at Biblioteca de Bilbao in Basurto. With humour and a carefully made soundtrack, the show offers small miracles for children aged 5 to 10.

f6aa9ddbb7967137a5ca7cdc06f7fff9bab001a9.en: The presentation of "Biografía de Alberto Palacio y su puente movible" by Javier Goitia and Mª José Arnaiz at Centro Cultural Santa Clara, a biography of the engineer Alberto Palacio and his movable bridge.

8239109d30c29a7bfc8c70f8c09ca2df326098a9.en: A talk on "La cabeza de Goya: ¿Qué ocurrió?" by Miguel Barrero, with novelist Luisa Etxenike, at the Museo de Bellas Artes de Bilbao auditorium. It looks at the mystery of Goya's body, found without its head when moved to Spain.

855384b3fb07ef584ee4811e826ef243d3b38ad0.en: "Marea Baja", a comedy about two isolated people who try to live well and together in a world without a plan, between melancholy and cabaret. It asks why we should exist in spite of everything. Venue: Casino.

9b6ef75079b2dac7f5b3e41e97cb683dd9ba90cc.en: The second adult reading group of the Club de Lectura at Casa de Cultura de Trápaga – Palacio Olaso, discussing "El cuerpo en que nací" by Guadalupe Nettel, led by Idoia Carramiñana.

df63fa30e31c4192604de9dbc739f1fb9cb8d3d7.en: "Misantropía", part of Bilboko Zirkuitua 2026 at Centro Municipal de Otxarkoaga. A sister throws a surprise party where most guests are colleagues she barely knows. Directed by Javier Liñera and Aitor Pérez; 70 minutes.

0eac15befcf8794612bb7cdb2153a0b1f17b6ea7.en: The Danon plaza 2026 bertso circuit in Algorta, where young bertsolariak such as Oihana Bartra, June Diaz and Kirmen Jauregi perform in dynamic free sessions. Exercises and games suit each age and level of skill.

dbe46830fc75d18c2384a93c2c6ee47d93067e4d.en: A book presentation of "Cosamala" by Alana S. Portero at Bidebarrieta Kulturgunea on 22 October, in conversation with the writer Katixa Agirre.

83c22200fde93b77d5b052d2c89b4a85812b2516.en: The final of the 2026 Bertso Erronda at 7 Katu Gaztetxea, with improvised verse by eight bertsolariak, including Maddi Aiestaran, Maider Altuna and June Diaz. Organised by several local cultural groups.

316deb752522cee580aeeda98cd4f546bfce7c95.en: "Itzulera" by Dejabu, an irreverent theatrical road movie at Harrobia Eskena, part of BAD Bilbao 2026. Three theatre makers travel to Mexico to interview Basque emigrants, and an unexpected event changes their journey.

ca7e97a29141cdeb8d032590e8d5c0f47c50305e.en: "Las Nanas según Lorca" at Teatro Barakaldo, a staging of Federico García Lorca's 1928 lecture on Spanish lullabies. Voice, guitar and acting blend Lorca's text with traditional lullabies, with three chairs as the stage.

60d2f1b069b4702b89a994a0fac3e1812bb91e49.en: "Sidari", part of Getxo Eszena 2026 at Muxikebarri. Two young people on a trip through Europe for their eighth anniversary meet an elderly couple, in a story about love, time and the decisions that shape the future. By Kepa Errasti.

91777742fb79daa8ac95da11d9e83be60bee7752.en: Ura Bere Bidean 2026 at Bizkaia Arena – BEC on 22, 23 and 24 October, with 29 artists and bands alongside the Orquesta Sinfónica de Bilbao and the Sociedad Coral de Bilbao. The sixth edition pays tribute to Joselu Anaiak and marks 30 years of Deabru Beltzak.

213291fc55c3637e7d3edece627402b806b43365.en: Point of No Return and Molykote perform at Nave 9 on 2 October.

37b8aaf682923902279d0c1e53c16d3ee6c3be1e.en: Etxekalte and Sua perform at Bilboko Kafe Antzokia on 22 October.

0fbe8a24928ff9cfaa18099247878cf63249c4c9.en: The Film Sozialak 2026 international festival of socially engaged cinema, held at AZ Azkuna Zentroa from 15 to 22 October. Fiction, documentary and animation films aim to spark dialogue and ethical citizenship.

b776fe64fdfe59a248ef3b92cfb2ef398c19a327.en: The exhibition "Sutaren ondoren" by Garazi Markina at Kultur Leioa, from 8 to 22 October. It grows from a trip to areas hit by the 2025 wildfires in Castilla y León, showing the scarred landscape and the people who live with it.

5281417b2fb260f21c1884d6c64a4abc839a9bd6.en: The Spanish-language reading group "El mejor del mundo" at Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia, meeting fortnightly until December. Group A meets on Wednesdays, group B on Thursdays. Registration by lottery, 20 places per group, for ages 16 and up.

f7c76580747ee879f3c13035d2f11e20feb70e00.en: "Inurri Itsuak" by Igor Legarreta at Getxo Zinemak, set in Bizkaia in 1935. A storm wrecks an English coal ship, and villagers rush to salvage the coal. A family's choice could save them or doom them. Starring Urko Olazabal and Itziar Ituño.

32132bb2987a2045adef6745cf6cd62693c2728f.en: "Reencuentros", paintings by Antón Hurtado at Galería Juan Manuel Lumbreras, on encounters, friendship and painting as a collective act. The accompanying text reflects on painting as a refuge and as a crack in the everyday.

6e5ef3c9921bfcbe00622023e5290a066dd83e57.en: Guided tours of the Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia from 19 to 24 October, in Spanish. Weekday visits are at 12:30 and 18:30, and Saturday at 10:00. Registration from 1 to 16 October, in person or by phone; ID or library card needed.

f9a41394ac5060d6e583c3470b05df3f84826afc.en: Santurzine 2026, the 14th Santurtzi film festival, with screenings from 14 October and a closing gala on 24 October at Serantes Kultur Aretoa. Marta Etura will receive the Premio Serantes 2026.

3039771401619e17fe83d0529475c5f9e09e8087.en: The exhibition "malpaís" by Borja Gómez at Narata Design Studio, from 23 September to 24 October.

4adb1aa2afd76a3b6834b578dc281a4e977d25c5.en: BAD Bilbao 2026, the 28th theatre and contemporary dance festival, from 15 to 25 October at venues including La Fundición, Harrobia Eskena and Teatro Campos. The programme has four Basque premieres, a state premiere and six world premieres.

736ab89f7e2909efb5116024ebd2a52f47ae01bd.en: The seventh La Ruta del Arte BBK, "Animalario", shows reproductions of 38 works from the museum's collection in which animals take centre stage. The works look at their allegorical value, from Jupiter's animal forms to horses in Zuloaga's paintings.

16e44ba0e5f05db472d40f120111ce4291223ade.en: The painting exhibition "Trenak" by Iñaki Bilbao at Rialia Museo de la Industria, open from 25 June to 25 October.

d990a85ad406f62f8ca17d826afb9db235d934e2.en: Getxo Eszena 2026, the 44th edition of the performing arts days, from 1 to 25 October at Muxikebarri, with 17 productions of theatre, dance and circus for adults, children and families.

cd394b201686b6790e82494a762dce2a3f98123e.en: The European Heritage Days 2026 in Etxebarri, from 22 to 25 October, with a guided visit to Doneztebe church and its surroundings. A talk on the Spanish Civil War in Etxebarri takes place on 23 October.

7f41bc66c2ecebf90de86aface1fc13e28533018.en: An exhibition at Casa Torre Jauregia marking 65 years of the Mendi Alde dance group and 30 years of Santurtzi's giants and big heads procession.

660ab02c92bf379490d53969527f53e148866ad7.en: The ABAO Bilbao Opera 2026/27 season opens with Verdi's "La Traviata" at Palacio Euskalduna. Jessica Pratt and Javier Camarena lead the cast, with Francesco Ivan Ciampa conducting the Euskadiko Orkestra, in a Teatro Massimo di Palermo production.

a64a90bc38a9de60cc1b8c66dc91b1d06fb8ee28.en: The 49th Jornadas Extremeñas en Bilbao at the Centro Extremeño Bilbao from 15 to 26 October. The programme includes an opening talk, a social quiz, a tribute to founding members, a colloquium on the bullfighting season and poetry recitals.

a9a3b1eb750f4456ac3944cd34cd6771c6ef3c42.en: An introductory calligraphy course by Begoña Viñuela at Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia, from 29 September to 27 October, in Spanish. It builds attention, precision and personal expression through handwriting.

db7204428ac491d0cf8808db56dd0abd7eabd8dd.en: A preview of "De repente" by Ryûsuke Hamaguchi, a 196-minute drama in original version with Spanish subtitles, about a care-centre director and a Japanese theatre director. A discussion with Marta Piñol follows at Serantes Kultur Aretoa.

e37aa1dcada8311829874646b6ea72ebcfa16f5a.en: A book presentation of "El regreso de las Ugarte" by Arantzazu Viteri at La Sinsorga feminist space. Three sisters with an unusual gift return to a secret community that ranks people by their gifts, in a dystopian fantasy about identity and freedom.

420a92c70ccea6e9e9b3d5198dd0bf1d7349ca03.en: The Sortzaileak Basora cycle at Basoa Taberna in Galdakao, featuring local creators on five October Thursdays with free gigs at 19:30 and 20:15. The first, on 1 October, features Rollito acústico and Eriel.

cfc5f1fa629695d781113ed4f9f62cb2c97bbe16.en: Malas Yerbas and La rua azala, projects behind the EHUKultura scholarships, at Aulas de la Experiencia EHU from 23 September to 23 October. One explores queer identities through photographs and poetry; the other uses urban textures in ceramics.

89b002d5a48082c760e8961025f43275faf27f26.en: An easy-reading club on "Talismana" by Walter Scott at Biblioteca de Bilbao in Basurto, coordinated by Blanca Mata.

78a83431e2fed0338dff60512ca25621358c975a.en: An easy-reading club on "El lejano país de los estanques" by Lorenzo Silva at Biblioteca de Bilbao in Basurto.

b70cbabf8f956881b3df5b5ec5de38b13efd8d37.en: The European Heritage Days 2026 at Euskal Museoa Bilbao, with guided visits every Wednesday in October in Basque and Spanish, a family workshop, a visit to the museum's visitable store and a talk on Basque dance. All free; booking required.

479ca7285ccd0e5f03dba7616c2e1527ceef8a38.en: The exhibition "Cuadernos de viaje" by painter Pedro Cano at Bizkaia Aretoa, opened with a conversation with Miguel Zugaza, director of the Bilbao Fine Arts Museum. The Oteiza room will later host work by students of the EHU Faculty of Fine Arts.

0938a194e51fee4c8276f094eccd8d6102320858.en: The first Torneo de Dramaturgia Bizkaia 2026, run by Sala BBK, the Bizkaia provincial council and Dantzerti. Open to writers over 18, with original unpublished texts of up to 15 minutes in Basque or Spanish, for up to two performers.

b125c1d8850057cc3093a16f50c68eca1b851319.en: The Danon plaza 2026 bertso circuit, eight sessions on October Thursdays, bringing young bertsolariak and Bizkaia finalists together in free public sessions. Each session has five bertsolariak: two under 18, two aged 18 to 25, and one finalist.

80c1b083a4d282cfa1abdb119f4ad5fd6c561a15.en: "Inurri Itsuak" by Igor Legarreta at Golem Alhóndiga, set in Bizkaia in 1935, when a storm wrecks an English coal ship and villagers in Algorta rush to salvage the coal. A family must decide how far to go. Starring Urko Olazabal and Itziar Ituño.

08182d2a55378855697d97ea59a1d90bf052a498.en: An exhibition of historic posters of Basauri's festivals from the Casa de Cultura de Basauri, at Pozokoetxe Kultur Etxea from 14 to 30 October.

8a3f0b0d12850c22252492126da3f1aab96f93c1.en: BOSTEKO 2026, the 29th edition of a travelling contemporary art programme run by Amorebieta-Etxano, Basauri, Getxo and Leioa with the Bizkaia provincial council. The exhibition "No puedo ver el mar desde la plaza" is at Torre de Ariz from 1 to 30 October.

1bd6a0ededf0477e3d3759779ae05c28a56d73c5.en: "Estratos marinos", a series of macro photographs taken at the port of Getaria, showing layers of paint, rope and wood shaped by sea and time. The pieces are presented as found art, with lines, colours and textures. The listing gives no venue.

238344b93eb4b2bcdbd7bcce4ceed5978e90b8aa.en: Expodistrito 2026, Bilbao's programme of decentralised temporary exhibitions. The first show, "Cuando todo se derrumba" at Centro Municipal de Rekalde, combines photography, painting and sculpture, with a Unamuno and science display and a Picasso tribute.

96235734a49d6a87ada181ce5a87e3c3ae8f92d2.en: Expodistrito 2026's exhibition "K2. Exposiciones de fotografía, 40 aniversario" at Centro Municipal de Otxarkoaga, celebrating forty years of photography exhibitions by the K2 group in Somera during the 1980s.

8ac3abf6e40b458845d8f344ac47b0d566fd9479.en: Expodistrito 2026's exhibition "Casas de ferroviarios de Zabala. 100 aniversario" at Centro Municipal de Castaños, marking the centenary of the railway workers' houses in the Zabala district (1926–2026).

1caf38ea9e847a631ea4ddd6b666097c1ec3b18d.en: Expodistrito 2026's exhibition "Retazos de otras miradas" at Centro Municipal de Begoña, one of the quarter's decentralised shows of photography and art by local and visiting artists.

fa095a7efe0d745f4d8860245a06245c8a2de64b.en: The exhibition "La IA deshumaniza: ¿a quién beneficia?" by a collective of comic creators at Romo Kultur Etxea, from 29 September to 30 October. It reflects on generative AI and defends human creativity against the interests of large technology companies.

58c2f7a147a0547d2e3ee81dc4d02642b7243423.en: The exhibition "Medir para comprender el mundo" in the Sala Noble of Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia from 30 September to 30 October. It explores how measurement, from medicine and data to AI, serves human care and understanding.

838a85bacc2af95eae35ddb5931a4488107ca0da.en: New works in the Guggenheim Bilbao collection, including pieces by Basquiat, Klein, Koons, Tàpies, Twombly and Warhol, added through acquisitions, donations and a long-term loan. Rooms 301 and 304 are devoted to Yayoi Kusama and El Anatsui.

8c0c6cec1826dabac80c918afc8768f53be0a6b3.en: The exhibition "Quedan cinco para las doce" by Joddy Erazo Vera, born in Manta in 2000, on show from 2 to 31 October. The listing gives no venue.

08cb6bf7f6594233b22f6cb62c37160216e2cd74.en: Félix de la Concha's exhibition "Perpetuum Auto-Mobile" at Galería MÄA on Uribitarte, from 3 September to 31 October 2026. Ten works from a series of over thirty years, centred on parked vehicles, plus an installation in dialogue with Velázquez's Las Meninas.

57971ea3249c3c9ae7469fb58efb2111b8611d7a.en: An exhibition by the Asociación Filatélica de Barakaldo at Centro Cívico Clara Campoamor in Barakaldo, from 16 to 31 October.

6d5c68fc6b8e37633b6cfc84eb8b001af1a6dece.en: A family guided tour at Guggenheim Bilbao, "Aventuras artísticas: garabatos", for children aged 3 to 5. Through doodles and play, children explore art. Sessions on 4, 10, 11 and 31 October; at least two tickets per booking.

51a787162e89a13e8f7bcc859265e087eda812ff.en: The programme of Gau Beltza 2026 in Etxebarri, running from 20 to 31 October. The listing gives the full programme as a document only.

e959c7eed9e4ac574ea221b6d2aee7a1bd87090d.en: Igshaan Adams's "Levantando el polvo: El archivo del cuerpo" at Guggenheim Bilbao. Adams works with rope, beads and wire from his childhood in Bonteheuwel, and his dance-print works record collective gestures of release.

4d28f689d627e30f2c26603c0d04afbea809c174.en: A creativity workshop at Guggenheim Bilbao, "Cuando el color se mueve", inspired by Igshaan Adams's process. Children aged 6 to 10 explore how colours feel and move through the body and sound, then build a collective gallery. Lasts 90 minutes.

1a97ab8d13527bea740a734174a73cbaa96d7ebc.en: "Baby art" at Guggenheim Bilbao, a play session for families and babies aged 6 to 36 months. This quarter the sessions explore light and colour in works by Jenny Holzer, Steve McQueen and Dan Flavin. Two-hour weekend sessions in Spanish or Basque.

22663119a923d2ca1678f7444fe58b4e3585daab.en: The exhibition "Ciencia en la calle" at Casa de Cultura Torrebillela in Mungia, from 19 October to 2 November, with 11 large infographics in Basque and Spanish on everyday science, such as bread, barcodes and induction hobs. Part of Zientzia Astea 2026.

1630af9ca43fb72d989509ddcab4205250fe0dd3.en: Marta Carrillo Serrano's first solo show in Bilbao, "Donde el cuerpo insiste", at Galería 104.5º. Charcoal and pigment on canvas explore the female body as a material memory, through fragments, traces and folds.

faa442b1186cc873e8a29c5da292a90c9d623094.en: "La Naval. Cantera de titanes" at Itsasmuseum Bilbao, on the history of the Sestao shipyard, focusing on the decades from the 1960s to its closure. It shows ships from supertankers to cable layers and honours the people who worked there.

b05214c7cc67202ed9bcf33aca848630f71dbc16.en: Gazte Artea Ezkerraldean 2026, its 14th edition, showing four young local artists from 2 October to 29 January 2027 across Portugalete, Barakaldo, Sestao and Santurtzi, with painting, sculpture and work on identity and landscape.

cf9cbcd03c5798621e1449763119afc546798d87.en: Expodistrito 2026's exhibition on Miguel de Unamuno and science at Centro Municipal de Abando (Barrainkua), organised with the Unidad de Cultura Científica, the University of Salamanca and the Casa Museo Unamuno.

5170b4a00a4fd3d1c88954e14e0b5aec852b05f7.en: Ja Bilbao 2026 presents "Azcona, humorista gráfico", marking 100 years since the birth of screenwriter Rafael Azcona. About fifty cartoons he published in the newspaper Pueblo in 1954–1956 are shown at Centro Municipal de Ibaiondo.

260128938d869c590e66ba20b9478b443bbd3118.en: Free guided tours of the new Museo de Bellas Artes de Bilbao, covering the extension's architecture, the collection from Antiquity to today and the temporary shows. Tours last 40 minutes; Sunday visits run an hour. Book at the ticket office 30 minutes before.

3b239b36e89e4d8ffd15c7201b7e0e1ea375bc89.en: Zinemakumeak gara, the 31st festival of films by women, from 27 to 31 October, with 12 features, 8 shorts, workshops and an opening gala. The programme opens on 20 October at Bilborock with a talk on the making of a film.

15fc0781cca5809d5d73c09db62ed8a2825b06f0.en: The XVII Ja Festival of Literature and Art with Humour, from 14 to 31 October, with science fiction as its main theme. Events run across BBK Sala, the Fine Arts Museum, the Guggenheim, Bidebarrieta and Palacio Euskalduna.

5cf7fa104353e383c8d5f8858a41ea03dad8d8dd.en: The 26th European Heritage Days in Bizkaia, all October under the motto "Gure eskuetan", with more than 270 free cultural events in 77 municipalities, on the risks to heritage and the need to protect it together.

19cabaaf6f77407b9c7e5543b463e9247868bfa0.en: The exhibition "Las favoritas", part of Zinemakumeak 2026, presents films by women directors chosen by Basque cultural figures, shown at Metro Bilbao stations from October into November.

72e5dadf117fe8cf05d6b916a0e317d84c1aa666.en: Ja Bilbao 2026's "El asombro cósmico" by Albert Monteys at AZ Azkuna Zentroa, with pages and illustrations from Universos, Calavera Lunar and Carlitos Fax. It uses science fiction for space, time travel and humour about the human condition.

860b558c1afe3c3ebeffe8ec1c9a57014dcc2584.en: A family story session, "Books alive: Flying carpets", at Guggenheim Bilbao, starting from a witch's flying carpet and leading into Igshaan Adams's suspended tapestries. For ages 3 to 5, with sessions in October and on 1 November.

42928f4a0b95a7209223f58773559383225deb09.en: The training exhibitions "El sexismo en la publicidad" and "Mujeres en la ciencia" tour nine Bizkaia municipalities from June to December, highlighting gender stereotypes in media and women's contributions to science.

3a0f6b72f39597723dd0dcc9e32bf21ca8657d31.en: TAC 2026 Sestao, the projects submitted to the urban architecture festival, shown at the Sestao Metro exit from 13 October to 15 November and at the Escuela de Música from 21 October to 6 November.

33667e932f0fcf10bc72d881357231868fd24be4.en: BilbaoArte presents "Estrella fugaz y corazón" by M. Benito Píriz at Sala URIBITARTE40, free, from 25 September to 8 November. Protective structures such as motorbike bodywork, seats and barriers inspire work about refuge, protection and affection.

205b3d2d25155753d1c3e0c2b721711baff273b8.en: The exhibition "Ipar Baltza" by Erlea Maneros Zabala at Carreras Múgica gallery from 11 September to 8 November.

1750ea9615b9112bad62adad827b236ed0eb81c7.en: The exhibition "Nekatuta eta haserre" by Ziortza Larreategi Gómez (Histerika Irudigintza) at La Sinsorga feminist space. Early paintings, made before she painted for sale, show tired and angry women. Presentation on 8 October at 19:30.

d71bf888e07314ba6c4f6a1810f5600de8eff5c8.en: The tenth women photographers' competition of Baffest 2026, with ten finalists presenting their work on 10 October at Clara Campoamor cultural centre. The jury is Carmen Dalmau, María Azakarate and Rocío Bueno.

fbd91c0fcb77c7a0e794690d55572e1c33d4c441.en: The XIX Lauaxeta poetry competition in Mungia, with the theme "Ondartza". Original unpublished poems in Basque of 100 to 200 lines are accepted until 9 November 2026, with prizes of 800 and 500 euros.

55ebb09c5458fd7d534791050eee00b409c8b1ce.en: Baffest 2026, the women photographers' festival that turns Barakaldo into an open-air museum until 8 November. Highlights include Rocío Bueno's "Ancestras, maestras" and the Argazki Eguna on 10 October.

fd5665cbadd32c246cdfc1c39e55b416b2f8f349.en: Baffest 2026's "Ancestras, maestras" by Rocío Bueno at Casa de Cultura Clara Campoamor, a card set of twelve pioneering women photographers from the 19th and 20th centuries. Their archive portraits are overlaid with natural elements.

886312dc47f7806b50dbbfe630fa0008d2002bf9.en: Baffest 2026's "Sutura" by the Resbaladero collective, four women photographers exploring unsafe spaces for women in a fanzine. Resbaladero is a self-published photozine project founded in Vitoria-Gasteiz in 2023.

ac34030b298edaadb1b7d23591accb7bcd2ec52a.en: Baffest 2026's "Retratos de vida" by Ainhoa Pérez, portraits made at Osakidetza of people with ostomies who chose to show themselves as they are. Each portrait is an act of trust.

c598fe2568b23532b880fa4269454fe02ffb1efc.en: Baffest 2026's "Imperfeccionando" by Cristina Dobarán, a selection of analogue collage pieces with fragmented, ironic and delicate characters, where the imperfect becomes identity.

848ec5211622726598e6baf769ba7176cdd6310f.en: The exhibition "Jardín Barroco" by Aitana Rodríguez at Casa Torre de Ariz from 16 October to 13 November.

bcf6423556b95463ccac1eca68166787483a4c83.en: The poster competition for Umore Azoka 2027, open to individuals and companies, at Kultur Leioa. Entries are accepted until 13 November; the bases are available as a PDF.

6b112c01830938de90c49590614c585655fc8a17.en: The Viernes Flamencos 2026 festival in Barakaldo, from 18 September to 13 November, at Barakaldo Antzokia in its two halls. Since 1997 it has offered purist cante and dance alongside new trends and fusions.

18a089213e533c773db4259340c8f01ca0d32b4b.en: The selection process for the 42 Urduliz Bizkaia coding school: 26 days of in-person immersion in programming, with no prior knowledge needed. Learning is by practice and peer collaboration, with no teachers. The next intake starts on 19 October 2026.

1d49a1ce74b9e6c13b64c4ff35205aa0fa3a797b.en: TAC 2026 Festival of Urban Architecture in Sestao, where the FERRUM temporary pavilion by Juan Mateos Corona, a light and recyclable steel structure, stands in Labe Garaia park until 14 November. This year's theme is energy and the city.

a4ff1747e42c4f81cd4808a88ccc6045429f809f.en: Ertibil Bizkaia 2026, its 44th edition, showing work by 18 emerging artists linked to Bizkaia. The itinerant show opens at Sala Rekalde in Bilbao and moves on to Barakaldo, Basauri and Igorre, with a programme of talks.

edbbc9ece1fd1ecbd97d673558a42336136bb1e6.en: Musika Bizi 2026 at Euskal Museoa Bilbao, opening on 15 October at 19:30 with the Orquesta Sinfónica de Acordeones de Bilbao under Amagoia Loroño, playing popular classics. Tickets 3 euros; booking via the museum website.

72953c9a76ff069369370d4a9d1018ec77948ff8.en: TAC 2026 at Sestao, showing the projects submitted to the urban architecture festival at the Metro exit from 13 October to 15 November and at the Escuela de Música from 21 October to 6 November.

51c9651d89f59f1c1cf5c56e0778a26c9d10a9a8.en: Expodistrito 2026's "Nuestros cuerpos. Territorios diversos" at Centro Municipal de San Ignacio (Ibarrekolanda Merkatua), one of the city's decentralised exhibitions of photography and art.

da7df087795a9ecd5e5b29af9e96f552f347bdf5.en: Musika Bizi, a new music programme at Euskal Museoa Bilbao that aims to bring music and heritage together. It opens on 15 October with the accordion orchestra and continues on 19 November with the choir San Anton Abesbatza in the cloister.

3ebc994313f6c704d2e6cef0ef4aee5c8babc1b4.en: The 29th Txorierri short story competition, open to children and young people who write in Basque. Entries close on 20 November 2026.

c0755462c9406638c23e1f9536c575291d6e0037.en: Arte Hartze Zikloa 2026 at Aiaraldea Ekintzen Faktoria, a cycle from September to November linking artists from east and west of the Basque Country through creation in Basque. Events include an opening day on 11 September.

048d7e1ac9b3657c978d574c55e20a5003a77eb8.en: The exhibition by Maider Aldasoro at Sala Rekalde, part of the "Barriek" cycle. Her work mixes costume, character, video and sculpture to create atmospheres where body, dream and play meet, touching on sexuality and power.

1902c47352e745ebecd15c2d025647a19d6a04d2.en: A group drawing course at Guggenheim Bilbao, "Dibujando en compañía", on weekends from 17 October to 22 November at 17:30. Shared challenges such as mirror drawing and a collective tree build creativity through play and cooperation.

e23bdcaff8feef82ed92116fcdc933f12f32931e.en: The exhibition "Animarbolak", open to the imagination, at the Centro de Interpretación Histórica y Medioambiental de Barakaldo, until 22 November.

3ff349f50243a57a6ef8a705ac4a0f7ec89d68cc.en: An eight-session ceramics workshop at BilbaoArte on clay, forming, glazes and slips, from 7 October to 25 November 2026. It costs 150 euros, 75 euros for BilbaoArte users, and is free for resident artists.

02da09425487b160ff500e945c152dafa1e92bbf.en: Bazen Behin 2026, a storytelling programme in Barakaldo's municipal libraries, with free Basque-language sessions for children aged 1 to 8 between September and November, each with an adult. Places are booked online or at the library.

61ec759685037446af1228eb3971adf8adf80255.en: BBK Music Legends 2026 at Sala BBK, the 15th edition of a cycle of rock, blues, soul and folk, with four international concerts between October and November, including The Screamin' Cheetah Wheelies on 10 October.

7961243b33ec9b23a6b59f959e77c736edf232cf.en: A monologue course, "BaKAR-KARrizketa", at Aiaraldea Ekintzen Faktoria in Llodio, with five two-hour sessions from 13 October to 30 November led by different professionals. Costs 100 euros for members and 120 for non-members.

32df607cbb6d5a544c081b815ef2268b48df856d.en: JazzOn Fest 2026, the fourth edition at JAZZON Aretoa, with ten Saturday concerts from October to early December. International artists include Javier Colina, Max Ionata, Jamie Baum and Michael Olivera, with many women musicians on the bill.

65a6d42cbdb43e21511d782e448dee2dd6f94abd.en: The third FOKU edition, a finissage dedicated to Amaia Urra, exploring language-based and conceptual performance in the work of women artists in the Basque context. The listing links to further information.

7540ae370a7cadfa2a4c727003b7f1c0fa098df4.en: The exhibition "Pioneras en la ingeniería" at the Centro de Patrimonio Industrial de Euskadi in Barakaldo, from 24 September to 13 December, celebrating women in engineering.

4ddf28c50082a9107695db0caa86a19bb69f332a.en: The exhibition "Eduardo Torroja en Añorga" at the Centro de Patrimonio Industrial de Euskadi in Barakaldo, from 24 September to 13 December, on the engineer Eduardo Torroja and his work at Añorga.

fb88bf762ecfc864ffb08731d4af8be14bf7c531.en: A course by Maitane Pérez, "Emakumeak eta literatura", at Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia from 14 September to 14 December, in Basque, on how women's experiences and voices shape literary creation.

fdd255809dea16e20e8e195650c479de66c59aa1.en: A creative writing course by Tania Parra, "Escritura creativa", at Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia from 14 September to 14 December, in Spanish, to build the ability and habit of writing.

6e57a0ff3333716285429207ed86449e0a9ff04a.en: A course by Raisa Álava, "Ilustración y literatura", at Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia from 15 September to 15 December, in Spanish, on how illustration can offer new readings of a literary text.

bff0bd6669a3186d08afc6a38629c23c66fbdec2.en: Dantzaldia 2026, the 27th international contemporary dance festival in Bilbao-Bizkaia, from 24 September to 15 December, with performances at La Fundición, Barakaldo Antzokia, Azkuna Zentroa, the Guggenheim and the Fine Arts Museum, several of them premieres.

315a231d46c81aaacfbefb4599959d45d78e03f7.en: The piece "A ojo" by Compañía Carmen Fumero, created with Dácil González, at Sala Rekalde as part of Dantzaldia 2026. It explores observation and the subjective gaze, in 18 minutes. Free entry.

0aefdbbe7a0ac8b4c076225947116b4cf2df8d6d.en: The Spanish-language literary meetings at Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia, fortnightly from September to December, in two groups: Wednesdays led by Garazi Albizua and Thursdays by Izaskun Gracia. Registration by lottery, 20 places per group, for ages 16 and up.

0fc39ad63e38485ab6f6804306367e93791c76e8.en: Free 30-minute guided tours of the exhibition "Uhinak" by Ra Asensi at Euskal Museoa Bilbao, held between September and December 2026 in Basque and Spanish. Places are limited to 15; booking by email or phone.

f098df4d5bae56644c587eb2e3ade9b36eebc74e.en: Bilboko Zirkuitua 2026, the city council's season of free theatre performances by local groups across Bilbao's neighbourhoods, from 1 October to December. Shows start at 19:00; tickets are collected one hour before at each civic centre.

b77a8f44daa78ed1ad8b9e7d5f91a6a784541aa4.en: LOTURAK. Familia, a programme at Euskal Museoa Bilbao with 12 participatory Saturday activities from October to December for children aged 4 to 10 and their families. Each costs 2 euros per participant and is limited to 15 people; booking is required online.

df1d944a5ace583c95756e074e878ddd2245aac0.en: The "Cuerpo & Arte" workshop by SOMATIKA, ten sessions combining conscious movement, painting, somatic practices and mindfulness. No experience needed; led by Esti Olabarri, a dance movement therapist.

ce7a03c99f588bdd08586ee14118000b4bf11fc9.en: The exhibition "Uhinak" by Ra Asensi at Euskal Museoa Bilbao's Kukula space, from 8 July to 28 December 2026. Ceramic pieces shaped like voice waves recall the memory of Basque women linked to pottery and water transport.

b99177a813732cf54db2c0033adeaa49c7310e33.en: Support and social groups for LGBTIQ+ people run by Aldarte, offering a space to share experiences, learn coping skills and build friendships. Friends are welcome to join.

978a632a896b9e8c8f1923856ea357619ea6d002.en: Dantza Plazetan 2026, the city council's programme of free Basque folk dance events, with 58 encounters across the year, including romerías, kalejiras and giant processions. The first event is on 24 January in the Casco Viejo.

5c3d7f18daaa3353d6fa02b02a432e3200ddc6e3.en: The semi-permanent exhibition "Nor gara gu?" at the Museo del Nacionalismo Vasco in Sabin Etxea, showing fragments of the stories that shaped Basque culture, language and identity, and the role of women in society. The displays change periodically.

5d5b8d59404dcf1fe57ded7cbdfbd7b43e22a218.en: LUNA VR, a virtual reality exhibition that lets visitors experience the first moon landing from Bilbao, about an hour long and suited to ages 10 and up. Booking in advance is recommended.

723ccc09502175e06bd651afef05244e470c110d.en: Invasion Bilbao, a virtual reality action game for groups of two or more, in which players fight aliens at emblematic places such as the Nervión riverside, the metro and the stadium. About 45 minutes of play, for ages 10 and up.

8c48a8436ffe517ee6e70ac959f3a8f600adfc8c.en: The Cuadernos del Arkeologi, a popular science series from Arkeologi Museoa Bilbao with twelve numbers. They cover prehistoric art and industry in Bizkaia, remains from excavations, medieval necropolises and museum research.

c019d2eb84a225de4ace195e9527a43a83502ecf.en: The exhibition "Un día precioso para el Apocalipsis" by Ramón Churruca at Bi Hormetara, from 16 October to 31 December.

722237a9e0b5020d578326240a99b855c62b9355.en: Expodistrito 2026, from September to December, Bilbao's decentralised temporary exhibitions of photography and visual arts, including a display on Miguel de Unamuno and science and a Picasso homage. Three shows explore aspects of the city's history.

4ae26ebea9b5bd8cff43691eeb004823b38eba0d.en: The Guggenheim Bilbao exhibition "Ever is Over All. Pipilotti Rist", a 1997 double-projection video installation of a smiling woman in a blue dress breaking car windows, set to a slowed soundtrack. Curated by Mikel Onandia in room 103.

190afbf0f944cc7b4a29a222c36af0b156fd239e.en: Abigail Lazkoz's "Cordero, mitad gato, casi perro" at AZ Azkuna Zentroa, a retrospective and new work co-produced with DA2 Domus Artium 2002. It explores hybridity and expanded drawing, inspired by Kafka's short story "Una cruza".

5b8fc91bb6cb0a1e828e49006071e8d8b16dd51f.en: The exhibition "Aldeas, mil años en la tierra" at Arkeologi Museoa, produced by BIBAT, Museo de Arqueología de Álava. It shows how medieval villages between the 8th and 15th centuries shaped the land, with finds from Bizkaia. On view until mid-January.

4a48bb54c521d1b00c0e27bd30fc476f167b6dbd.en: The opening programme at BBKmuseoa, the new main gallery of the Bilbao Fine Arts Museum, with a sound installation by Itziar Okariz and three Anthony Caro steel sculptures on the terrace. From 6 October.

5bd56faccb047d3743e76df82e51856c294ef3bd.en: The exhibition "La trastienda" by actor Iñaki Miramón at Sala Ondare, a selection of more than fifty of the 160 photographs in his photobook. Family workshops run on 10 and 17 October, and a meeting with the artist on 26 October.

1424c7409246b81e34283900d35ef7cbae013e6f.en: Musikagileak 2026–2027, the 17th Contemporary Music Circuit of the Basque-Navarrese Composers' Association, from September 2026 to February 2027, showcasing Basque and Navarrese composers. The full programme is a PDF.

e573465a3fca3ae568267ff3e9d4e89ed0762e7a.en: "Balerdi. La línea infinita" at the Bilbao Fine Arts Museum's Gabinete space, a retrospective of more than fifty drawings by Rafael Ruiz Balerdi, from the 1950s to his death in 1992. From 6 October; sponsored by Fundación Gondra Barandiarán.

2ad5a0603d47c4f1a9d8e598e07c839e89d77dea.en: The Encuentros de Música Contemporánea Kuraia 2026–2027, a new contemporary music cycle organised by the Bilbao ensemble Kuraia. The full programme is a PDF.

8190d32c807b58b943deb34a52a9ac48bbaa65ad.en: Steve McQueen's "66–76–26" at Guggenheim Bilbao, in room 105, curated by Lekha Hileman. The London and Amsterdam-based artist's moving images are sculptural and invite viewers to become aware of their own breathing.

c9624bdd369de0ac5a6d03bcbed9b8d40f590700.en: The Banda Municipal de Txistularis de Bilbao's 2026–2027 season, "Soinu Zaharrak, Begirada Berria", eight concerts from 7 October to 14 April at Palacio Euskalduna and Teatro Campos Elíseos. The traditional txistu repertoire is seen from a fresh angle.

f4eea9f2c5bac3f9845c96d2ea823351db08ceff.en: The Bilbao Orkestra Sinfonikoa (BOS) 2026–2027 season, "BASOA", inspired by the forest, with 17 symphonic programmes, a world premiere of María Eugenia Luc's "Oma" and a revival of Paul Vidal's opera "Guernica", from October 2026 to June 2027.

cbe7dc4e892beb33374c3d1c676119a766973b0c.en: Richard Serra's steel sculpture "Bilbao" (1983), donated to the Bilbao Fine Arts Museum by the grandchildren of Martín García-Urtiaga and Mercedes Torrontegui. Serra made it on site for the 1983 exhibition "Correspondencias", using two stacked steel ingots.

4d9f70717161c9fe5ab0d54b3fa06999c4e95c03.en: The permanent photographic exhibition "Imagen e historia 1939–1980" at the Archivo Histórico de Euskadi, opened on 9 June. It shows nearly a thousand photographs, about seventy of them large-format, by photographers such as Germán Elorza and Manu Leguineche.

26da338152f449e6466570d36603dbd554ed0b3e.en: "Baso bidaiariak / Bosques viajeros", a public tree-lining prototype by José Ramón Ais, first shown on the Azkuna Zentroa terrace and now installed in Parque Etxebarria. It explores the stories and ideals projected onto nature and trees.

1da06f2a010565c271341ed8fc3cb972a4f68efd.en: UKEDADA ZAWP, ukulele lessons from scratch on Sundays from 17:00 to 19:00 at ZAWP in Zorrotzaurre, with instruments lent out. Ideal for families. Prices are 10 euros up to age 14 and 15 euros for adults; booking by phone.

55de68c7d39651dad3c2536f61ff74316c40f6d9.en: Information on rates, opening hours and guided visits at the Museo de la Minería del País Vasco, available through a link. The listing gives no further details.

26d62bd359fc8b36d753380c3aad39145d94de2f.en: Orconera Lutxana Bilduma, the Basque Government's store of movable industrial heritage, holding machinery and structures from the region's industrial past, from farm machinery to steel. Visits are by appointment only.

a7c3eeea2435baca37e1571a1481f9e50e2d5d5d.en: The Museo Diocesano de Arte Sacro in Bilbao, founded in 1961, with a permanent exhibition of more than 500 pieces of religious heritage from the diocese of Bilbao. Guided visits are described on the linked page.

2d495609bb024ac94a9a6af6f32cfca71e2bd25a.en: Rialia Museo de la Industria in Portugalete, whose permanent display focuses on three themes, man, iron and the estuary, through history, ethnography and art. Guided visits can be booked by phone.

546d87cb284f941b2d94adc369c1516772e307ec.en: The Museo de las Reproducciones de Bilbao, with a permanent exhibition and guided visits. All details are on the linked page.

634860bef3e7c712ead82265c48c9dd03813849f.en: The permanent exhibition at Itsasmuseum Bilbao, with objects across 3,500 square metres indoors and 20,000 outdoors, presenting Bilbao and Bizkaia's maritime culture in an interactive display in three languages.

b89c78cf91fa11cfce3661cec07b21be2795b15a.en: Arkeologi Museoa, the reference centre for Bizkaia's archaeological research, with a permanent exhibition from the first human presence more than 100,000 years ago to historical periods. Guided visits are booked by email or phone.

1598c431b8ddb4f7d60d360ccbd116f60cfd4769.en: The exhibition "Bizitza paraleloak. La memoria de las copias" at the Museo de Reproducciones de Bilbao, 1 October to 29 November. It features an electroplated copy of the Hildesheim Krater and shows how copies preserve lost works.

e663e7ae87ebd86ff1dee2585e1ae34610568860.en: Asteburuak Familiak, the family programme at the Bilbao Fine Arts Museum, with workshops that explore art through play and experimentation. Sessions have 15 places and suit inclusive and neurodivergent children.

6900e0bf3e69d2ee39f9a285ea945e71c35575b1.en: The opening show "Visiones de Ultramar. Colección Patricia Phelps de Cisneros" at the new Bilbao Fine Arts Museum, with more than 150 works from the 17th to 20th centuries, on artists' fascination with Latin American landscapes. Sponsored by BBVA Foundation.

9efae57a35fa9cde54ca114c45b89b88382b7b93.en: "On Being Human", an exhibition drawn from the collection's recurring depictions of the body and the portrait, exploring power, violence, memory, migration, identity and fragility. It proposes that being human is a process of constant change.

c33c24baa602b294e53f75ea8a69c39cc0ff629c.en: "Irakurri-Léase 'Euzkadi'", a sketch by painter Aurelio Arteta for the 1912 poster of the newspaper Euzkadi, acquired by the Bilbao Fine Arts Museum with help from the Basque Government. The poster was known only from photographs.

fc7cb9c4f7e4594101e938d8d20ba8f38b21efeb.en: "La búsqueda del comienzo", a tribute to collector Plácido Arango (1931–2020), with more than a hundred works from his collection on long-term loan, alongside loans from New York and Madrid. From 6 October, in the opening programme.

87334be82a5fd823c7be0262c9b1464cf679d89b.en: A permanent exhibition, "Recuerdos del barrio de Kareaga", from the Casa de Cultura de Basauri, at Kareaga Gizarte Etxea.

374bfad69ec9de13a29f299b5c7331cba6c687a9.en: The permanent collection display "Bildu(e)mak" at the Bilbao Fine Arts Museum, with about a thousand works from Antiquity to today, in two chronological sequences across the old and new buildings, including Japanese art.

026daa7b87580420622050bdaef1c485a3276956.en: "Raíces del Océano", a six-metre Corten steel sculpture by Jesús Lizaso from 2010, shown beside the Euskalduna docks and the Itsasmuseum collection on the Bilbao estuary. It depicts two figures holding oars.

4e1c832b25a3b189be866184e7af1f1b686f5538.en: "La posibilidad de un mundo. Visiones de la naturaleza en la Colección BBVA", at the BBVA headquarters in San Nicolás, Bilbao. Curated by Alfonso de la Torre, about fifty works from the 17th century to today on how art pictures nature.

d3f9a22f3a1c5711a472b859d158e5f8299f3fe1.en: A storytelling session, "Hodeiekin dantzan", at Biblioteca de Mungia for children aged 5 to 8, in Basque.

502d2e3b07c28a3fdbe207ffca93648530e6704f.en: Bazen Behin 2026 with Sorgina Txirulina, storytelling in "Ipuinen lorategia" at Biblioteca de Barakaldo in Arteagabeitia, for children aged 2 to 4.

1ad3a917913a99dbdace80f3bb6fa5dd285160dd.en: Porrotx, Marimotots, Pupu eta Lore present "Zerua lapurtu dute", a children's show about four friends who cannot see any stars and set off across the sky with the lighthouse keeper Birtxi to find them. The listing gives no venue.

649df77396dbdb87b63fcd0a4177cc74ae66b580.en: A guided visit to "Bizitza paraleloak. La memoria de las copias" at the Museo de Reproducciones de Bilbao, showing how the copy of the Hildesheim Krater and other reproductions keep lost works in memory. Runs until 29 November.

f79a4ae1e73015530bdcaf3f90dcdbc800f9683f.en: A storytelling session, "Hodeitxoen dantza", at Biblioteca de Mungia for children aged 5 to 8. Prior booking is required.

3901ecffbd1b3ef25277e1c53188dc1e05d29472.en: A Halloween craft session at the bookshop Sopa de Sapo, where children make a garland of monster faces and fantasy characters with foam, scissors and glue. Ages 5 and up with an adult, or 7 and up alone.

d9003991c40297bd54251b030e1972afad808ad7.en: Haizea López presents her crime novel "El club" at the Forum of Fnac Bilbao on Friday 23 October at 19:00. A running club is shaken when a member dies during a race, and the author signs copies.

80fb33be701eb3cbb7d0bf5a8d5a216d7c6d6392.en: Blanca Sarasua presents "Soledad de banquetas" at Bidebarrieta Kulturgunea on 23 October, in conversation with writer Roberto López San José and poet and editor Pablo Méndez.

46c48936ae998d20068bf53b6bd88b4c61625cc9.en: "Euskaldungak", a show by Aroa Blanco and Maite López at the Escuela de Música de Sestao. A playful look at the tensions between long-time and new Basque speakers, through talks, debates and misunderstandings about the language.

04d1eebf83a822db7bba31caeffed52d14ad54ff.en: "Bi baso bat ur" by Metrokoadrokoa, part of BAD Bilbao 2026 at Harrobia Eskena. Four people stand still in the middle of a dance floor holding glasses of water, a piece about joy after abuse, told with depth and humour.

5cb0f93321a5402819fe1478be12c75e4c58e37f.en: "Artilusio", a wordless show of about 50 minutes, in which an elderly woman named Greta, like Don Quixote, lives out her book fantasies with a machine of exotic appearance and the young Pina.

bb24eed53e3ad576b40787e538f406411005de05.en: "Oro molío", a flamenco concert by La Macanita at Teatro Barakaldo, a tour of roots cantes from her Santiago neighbourhood in Jerez, including soleás, bulerías and soníos negros.

ffe18b381bcdc40bc357c4d9dd13168ce2eb4a13.en: Adriene Bergson-Johnson, part of Getxo Eszena 2026 at Muxikebarri. A Texan magnate's irreverent collective coaching masterclass asks what it means to be Basque in the 21st century. Text and performance by Maryse Urruty.

3198490254d9e1c22f7de8341a73fa287efaee90.en: Día de las Bibliotecas 2026 in Getxo: borrowers receive a free book while stocks last at the Romo, Villamonte and San Nicolás libraries during opening hours.

5fb69e66896313c0df0b5b338be149d02f6100ec.en: "La Desconquista" by Ron Lalá at Serantes Kultur Aretoa, a burlesque comedy and musical about the Discovery and imperial ambition, with live music and five performers. Directed by Yayo Cáceres.

fee7f3df91c31e2fb56da760d28b1b695abe4509.en: Undereel plays at Cotton Club in Bilbao on 23 October.

e357884f546d8d7ec7db839047adf5fd15d33515.en: Ja Bilbao 2026 presents a conversation between novelist Ray Loriga and writer Alfonso J. Ussía at the Bilbao Fine Arts Museum, on his career, his view of literature and the role of humour. Entry by invitation; book signing.

f782d6ab274fa12d24606a8a73370ed3e9a8a35b.en: Iker Lauroba presents "Bosgarren solairutik", his seventh studio album, in an acoustic concert at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea, with vocal harmonies and adaptations of earlier songs.

78c45b9859359ae09b52214676e956283e4cb695.en: Perejilek plays on 23 October as part of the Hiru Jauzitan 2026 festival in Portugalete.

72402f16dde123f834471748ea09e37cbdd933f4.en: "DUAL", a flamenco show by Mercedes Ruiz and Santiago Lara at D8 Sorkuntza Faktoria, with more than 60 performances worldwide, in which guitar and dance meet as equals. Includes Ramón Montoya's Rondeña and Sabicas's farruca.

1eb6aa697c7163af102f972a6888850b04d1c606.en: "Escape Room", a dark comedy by Joel Joan and Hèctor Claramunt at Gurea Aretoa, about four friends who lock themselves into an escape room, where the game becomes stranger and darker. Directed by Begoña Bilbao Lejarzegi.

3b844c5fb1cea2600e29d74bbaccc22835072f37.en: Sultans of Swing, a tribute band to Dire Straits at Teatro Campos Elíseos, recreating classics such as "Sultans of Swing", "Money for Nothing" and "Brothers in Arms" with lights and projected images.

d427dd9ceddacc38cea63b019bed8fe8bb2a86ec.en: "Nor naizen baneki", a theatre piece by Harkaitz Cano and Ximun Fuchs at Kultur Leioa, asking who we really are by looking at our reflections in parents, children and our own traces. In collaboration with Teatro Arriaga.

e514798bd526a8d89c76774777ec4c2003bdb274.en: Arantza Urkiza, listed by the organisers with a video link only. The listing gives no further details.

6c1645cd48edd6660ac0e5effb73112248f2b3cf.en: FUNZO plays Sala Santana 27 in Bilbao on 23 October. The band is known for urban and emotional music about love and youth.

13d4b4197b6a547ad4636a8fb82cada526a01a9e.en: Leo Rizzi's "La Belleza de las Flores Tour", a concert at Stage Live Bilbao on 23 October, presenting his new album alongside highlights from his career.

c3a040aab1ab7d96207a078478a2ff4945575717.en: "Dos Divas Cero Vergüenzas", a drag show by El Chico Diva and Glitter Trash at La Sinsorga, with solo acts, duets and audience interaction, in support of local drag artists. Tickets are sold at the door on the day.

70c5f396cddfe349dc9492e079b95e771ca157d2.en: MESCALINA, a band founded in 2024, pays tribute to Maná, Jarabe de Palo and Los Rodríguez at Bilboko Kafe Antzokia on 23 October, under the theme "#Raíz Latina".

b3234481fcc6d94788b945aefca0437cbc8d5077.en: Will Hoge and his Rock and Roll band at Azkena Bilbo, presenting his fifteenth studio album, "Sweet Misery". The Nashville singer mixes rock, country, soul and American roots.

674c4092e1e33d84bcbf7a315729dd07a6f6e7e8.en: Tapia eta Leturia Band at the Portugalete market, part of the Hiru Jauzitan 2026 festival.

5e6943d9a01a2a2bcb7377573bb276a47d8c7b55.en: AIAMA Quartet at JAZZON Aretoa, led by pianist Amaia Izarzugaza, reinterpreting jazz standards translated into Basque alongside original songs in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

db05dc5e21ba6d4ddac882514edcd338c14b7cad.en: "Inurri Itsuak" by Igor Legarreta at Torrezabal Kultur Etxea in Galdakao, the film about a 1935 coal wreck and villagers rushing to salvage it, starring Urko Olazabal and Itziar Ituño.

495c11423de64c1ed89ebda10d8cb2ff749fbcb8.en: Ja Bilbao 2026's conversation on "Museos del futuro" between Manuel Fontán and writer Agustín Fernández Mallo, moderated by Rafael Orbegozo, at the Bilbao Fine Arts Museum, on how AI and virtual spaces may change museums. Free entry until capacity.

7dcd100b4c4c1d076a88ab31f858dce5073390f0.en: A poetry and music recital, "Extremadura y Euskadi en sus Poetas", on 23 October at 19:00 at Centro Extremeño Bilbao, part of the 49th Jornadas Extremeñas. Free entry; readers include Manoli López, with violin by Itxaso Díez.

409bf846ef66e4d99834250a4d1f9cf3ac875cca.en: The Hiriko Soinuak 2026 festival at Barakaldo's Herriko plaza on 23 and 24 October, free, with the four winners of the eighth contest: Cabaret, Últimos nómadas, Mandarinas al sol and Somak. Headliners include Toundra and The Baboon Show.

a1e91f8ce11f62eafd06d09d9ad37ba20d62b417.en: "Una historia de Bilbao", a premiere at Teatro Arriaga, a nostalgic comedy about an industrial Basque Country that will not return, with versions of Spielberg's Hook, Bowie's Labyrinth and Dickens's Christmas Carol. Two actors play a family across a century.

7e074c008c6f2a66aa19bb2db908836264b87617.en: The photo exhibition "Sahara. Territorios ocupados" by activist Luali Lebser, offered by Euskal Fondoa to councils, at Casa de Cultura de Urduliz. It gives a window onto life in occupied Western Sahara.

2adc354822bbc1fa8d0a788b2aa4cf23a90aac19.en: The exhibition "La primera mirada no era mía" by Amaya Suberviola, the opening show at SC Gallery's new space on Estraunza 7 in Bilbao, from 23 October to 23 November. Paintings on canvas and paper keep the traces of their transformations.

76d01e7fde368301c2ec740547f457c1c19cd8c2.en: A Zinemakumeak gara workshop on female anger in film and series, from La heredera to Thelma & Louise and recent streaming series, led by Itxaso del Castillo Aira at Centro Municipal de Ibaiondo.

7f42dec275d6795a950f0036b60690659b7fa483.en: A storytelling session, "Superpatata 2", at Librería Joker. The booking fee is deducted from the next purchase at the bookshop.

296ee519e7bce0353ae93750e29b95fbd9f77efa.en: A storytelling session, "Ah ze beroa duen pinguinoak", by Lur Usabiaga at Biblioteca de Bilbao in Basurto, for children aged 5 to 9.

aa0d6762d9d0c3f277a54c163736821d08f6ce4b.en: Ja Bilbao 2026's conversation between Laura Fernández and Carolina Ontivero at Librería Joker, about "Diminuta casa encantada", her first book for readers aged 10 and up. A boy and his dinosaur dog move to a new city. Free entry; book signing.

fd0d19382a4d579c39edf635cb7bb5b827ebec0a.en: Dantza Plazetan 2026 at Centro Municipal de Basurto with Beti Jai Alai Dantzari Taldea, one of 58 free Basque folk dance events across the year, including romerías and giant processions, from January to June.

e3e4297335ad4849a222f87a551eec5eae0642e8.en: A concert by Arpe Diem, with harps played by Begoña Antruejo and Leonor Hennequet, cello by Elena Kopteva and tenor Patxi García. The listing gives no venue.

e68149d067495282dffa658e680b9ed6be29a1c8.en: "Lumiero", a show by Pere Hosta, Faló Garcia i Pellejà and others at Torrezabal Kultur Etxea, exploring light and darkness through dance, poetry, magic, humour and live music. Suitable for audiences from 2 to 200 years old.

133164331da5280310c29e9913d85b31b51f38c3.en: Severine Beata at TAC 2026 Sestao, with experimental pieces that transform 15th- and 16th-century vocal polyphony from the Cancionero de Palacio using synthesisers, mixed with birdsong of endangered species.

3c7fd8b1b83cf9c73f3baf246edeed1f197e6303.en: "Oilar bat dago zure teilatuan", a family show at Centro Cívico de Cruces in Barakaldo. A rooster stuck on a roof asks a neighbour for help, and the story leads through a field of cows and a laying-hen farm, told in humour and verse.

2cda5066858f421f9ba099764b31413472098af3.en: "Ehuna" at Casa de Cultura Kotxepin, a piece for children aged 1 to 5 that explores movement through fabric and air, inspired by the creative world of Cristóbal Balenciaga.

f04c5f0ca4bbbe43abfce890b58e997d9a2678b1.en: Candlelight Bilbao: Vivaldi's "The Four Seasons" played by the Musbika string quartet, with La Folia, in a candlelit setting. 60 minutes; for ages 8 and up, and under 16s must attend with an adult.

361800bfa3eb343920ba6206d3670c076a2521bd.en: Klasikoak 2026 at the Bilbao Fine Arts Museum, the Filmoteca Vasca classic series, showing Akira Kurosawa's "Yôjinbô" (1961), in which a samurai plays rival gangs against each other. Subtitles in Basque; 110 minutes.

eee3d3da1d0aaddffd3bcc724750af09e922a2b2.en: "La Ganadora" by Collectif Troika, part of BAD Bilbao 2026 at Harrobia Eskena. Three characters play a game in which winning justifies everything, mixing dance, song and acrobatics in a dark and comic piece.

1ca34290ec890a416c270371336506efac4699e8.en: A reading club on "Banana Fish" at Librería Joker. The booking fee is deducted from the next purchase at the bookshop.

d71cc23ed9c8e4264ecea1e4f6a29f5086ecabb4.en: "Feriantes", a show by El Patio Teatro at Lonbo Aretoa, a tribute to the fairground and to the people who sold dreams and fun across Spain. It lasts 60 minutes, with three performers.

2d92769214a7aa3c08bd6534b4582b848ed0de5c.en: Ortuellan Kulturaz Blai 2026 presents "Monólogos de los 80 y 90" at Gorbea Aretoa, a comedy of monologues, songs and nostalgia for the radio, cassette tapes and early discos of the 1980s and 1990s.

8192c28c97005d5c3cf966b267341a6005e90646.en: A rock night at Sala Groove on 24 October with three bands: 4COPOLA, presenting new singles, Neriva from Euskadi, and Sevicia, mixing classic rock and new-generation metal.

704248b36477dd0365a1910302669a13469c8fd4.en: Abbey Road's "The Beatles Show & Orchestra" at Palacio Euskalduna, a tribute with eight orchestral musicians that recreates the Beatles' discography, with vintage costumes and instruments similar to the originals.

9612b75c6d3de7270b58a5f0b3d57097e2952699.en: Ana Popovic at Sala BBK as part of BBK Music Legends 2026. The Belgrade-born blues guitarist mixes blues, funk, slide guitar and jazz-inspired passages, and has been nominated seven times for the Blues Music Awards.

7a790e3fdc210c612ec585bfb0ccf3a72fe541d6.en: "El retablo de las maravillas" by Els Joglars at Social Antzokia, marking the company's 65th year with a satirical story of con men selling a huge lie that citizens accept out of fear. Directed by Albert Boadella; 90 minutes.

5afd05f22f3540bcab3b7c0d9ce8e8d23dd9c385.en: "Impostor" by Thomas Noone, part of Dantzaldia 2026 at Teatro Barakaldo, a dance piece on good, evil and inner demons, in which the dancer shares the stage with a multiform puppet creature.

11b3528d239ba6558a1a3da07885512425692f8a.en: Bon Scott Revival Show, an AC/DC tribute at D8 Sorkuntza Faktoria, covering hits from 1974 to 1980, with Javier Alcón as Bon Scott.

6db99158af029f6852daff78001b04278720942f.en: "No", a flamenco dance piece by Irene Tena and Albert Hernández at Muxikebarri as part of Getxo Eszena 2026, in which two young creators ask who they are and what has shaped their path.

42dcbe7428fb41a9a4de5febd1cddcb64881113b.en: Ja Bilbao 2026's "Azcona 100 años" at the Guggenheim Bilbao, marking the centenary of screenwriter Rafael Azcona, with memories from Fernando Trueba, Maribel Verdú, Manuel Gutiérrez Aragón and Bernardo Sánchez. Entry 3 euros; book signing.

b26eff17ba903a98979a398c3cf8e88814cb4708.en: MOVE, a jazz quartet with Alberto Arteta on tenor sax, Iñigo Ruíz de Gordejuela on piano, Borja Barrueta on drums and Javier Callén on double bass, at JAZZON Aretoa as part of JazzOn Fest 2026.

49f4bcb8582c844740db245a4cefd5a7ca5ffefa.en: "Inurri Itsuak" at Casa de Cultura de Urduliz, the Igor Legarreta film about the 1935 coal wreck and its villagers, starring Urko Olazabal and Itziar Ituño.

3ca5adb43ac51eac459190ad6a07f69aebe6edb0.en: Ms. Missery, Alerta and Kruddö play Nave 9 on 24 October.

48a2f7329659cc413275e4f0ff585a7933720ca7.en: AMOOMA and Enbata Lorade play Santana 27 in Bilbao on 24 October.

b44b288ee3456385b17ba1a05ce6ee615489922d.en: The tribute show "Zenith – The Nameless Ritual", a Ghost tribute band, at Azkena Bilbo on 24 October 2026.

0a8a79fc0baa623d8277797c83e29c50da07ec93.en: Hijos de la Ruina, a Spanish rap group formed by Natos, Waor and Recycled J, at Bilbao Arena on 24 October. Their songs cover everyday life, relationships and urban sounds.

6d4911e62c9de79242edcec7db081602738c0002.en: Candlelight Bilbao: "Queen vs. ABBA", a candlelit concert of hits such as "Bohemian Rhapsody" and "Dancing Queen" played by a string quartet. 60 minutes; for ages 8 and up.

a7f0b4ab561fd2e9f04669d9394f06a5f941252a.en: "Visite Nuestro Bar", a tribute festival at Bilboko Kafe Antzokia with Dulce Locura (La Oreja de Van Gogh), Peter Pan y los Insoportables (El Canto del Loco) and Los Chicos Cocodrilo (Hombres G).

50dc20f195c1d61a0ca3f0b80ff9cca6a63053e0.en: "Las que tienen que servir", a premiere at Teatro Campos Elíseos by Fernando López, part of BAD Bilbao 2026. Cleaners and housewives revisit their place in art and literature through workshops that become a theatre piece.

44d6fa8ddfb222b799716fbe44196a7de297f97a.en: "Hoy se lía", a show by monologist Miki Dkai at Teatro Campos Elíseos, with unfiltered monologues and wild improvisation about relationships, family, technology and everyday disasters, with audience involvement.

3a9f65bce5e7a6c36ce49726e8d4d73df9931cbe.en: PLAKA, a Portuguese instrumental trio formed in 2025, mixing afrobeat, highlife, mambo and psychedelic rock, at La Atalaia del Gardoki. The listing gives no further details.

b78e893f670d957ed8acf8e5777a77d994900337.en: A portrait photography workshop with Carmen Hache at Casa de Cultura de Etxebarri.

3129ce6554f013e2524a02ee0eaae8697eabd008.en: Jorge Blass's "Ilusionarte" at Teatro Campos Elíseos on 24 and 25 October, a 75-minute interactive magic show that invites the audience to play, fantasise and take part in the tricks.

6a375bb5e1da612e738b962afc2aabc5f30fa366.en: "Hemingway Enviado Especial", a monologue at Sede de la Compañía Joven Pabellón 6 about Ernest Hemingway's last minutes, in the early hours of 2 July 1961, when he remembers Madrid during the Spanish Civil War. Written and directed by Mario Hernández.

1688c4697fb576cde8d0d01b547d2228c08ebae2.en: "Inurri Itsuak" at Gurea Aretoa in Derio, the Igor Legarreta film about a 1935 coal wreck and the villagers who rush to salvage it, starring Urko Olazabal and Itziar Ituño.

f85921323c4239b108d266e47fc6b4c509eb1467.en: Bunker 2026, a free popular fair around music and emotions in Barakaldo's Herriko plaza from 23 to 25 October, with records, books, collectors' items, conversations and gigs. Part of Hiriko Soinuak; speakers include Miqui Puig.

8a9d3989ec9d57b5b4d13ed36ea875adeb888208.en: "Superthings: Filma" at Golem Alhóndiga, an animated adventure in which three sixth-graders find a fragment that fuses their grey city with Kaboom City, turning them into the Kazoom Kids to face the villain Mr. King.

bdb33bfa26baf35f107152ffbd50b30e83f89238.en: The Arimen Gaua 2026 programme in Sodupe, with events on 24 and 30 October. The listing gives the programme as a document only.

8ddbd86c1392919ffca6cc2ba070a7155f7ee5eb.en: Barakaldo's family performing arts programme 2026, from 24 October to 12 December, with theatre, puppetry, objects and multimedia theatre for young audiences. The full programme is a PDF.

9207f7cd7c154c3ab87aac5f2e130f306e67ef07.en: Duo Niu presents "Pandora" in Lamiako on 25 September, a 50-minute hand-to-hand acrobatic circus show with precise, high-level performance, for all audiences and without text.

74d5e3b715eba858ebfd9527fadc73ff4f8dbce4.en: Elizabeth Clapés's conference "Querida yo: tenemos que hablar" at Teatro Campos Elíseos, a guide to living more kindly with oneself: holding pain without minimising it, and relativising without invalidating. Clapés is a psychologist and bestselling author.

59f4b65ef2ab0fc9fd657d24efa6ef612d62909f.en: Lasala's show "Alai familian" at Social Antzokia, about six-year-old Alai, who lives with her grandmother and dog and feels different from her friends' families, until a dream introduces her to many kinds of family.

9df90f864c02d067479ffa89f0d3421adeeabbe5.en: "Fiestas Invisibles", a live documentary in the form of a verbena, part of BAD Bilbao 2026 at Harrobia Eskena. It celebrates what society hides or ignores, using a popular party to claim the right to appear in public space.

8c834afe399a120341d85120ba49fc5a0e8ab777.en: "MAKILhotsak (Golpes de guerra)", part of Hiru Jauzitan 2026 in Portugalete, a dance and music piece by Agurtzane Intxaurraga with OINKARI Dantza Taldea, calling for a pacifist and anti-militarist art that puts dialogue first.

60fc96756ee6ff2d2c415c5033bcd623bc491f98.en: Los Judas de la Impro present "Impro Show" at Hika Ateneo, an hour of improvised comedy stories built from audience suggestions such as a word, a phrase or a place. Bookings by email.

5e74f509d46f318f5e750c01a596047917d71887.en: "Tigre galdua" at Lonbo Aretoa in Arrigorriaga, a 90-minute adventure in Basque in which Teo, raised by a family of travelling kangaroo wrestlers, sets off to save his homeland. For all audiences; directed by Chantelle Murray.

ff58d8dc38fe143c38c08c6a22e72fafc474ac96.en: "Tretatxu", a puppet show at Muxikebarri as part of Getxo Eszena 2026, about a mischievous boy who becomes the most admired outlaw in his land after a childhood of hunger and injustice. For ages 6 and up.

00ee8fb6d1813fb479de4bbd08611dd036026094.en: "NOAREN KUTXA" at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea, a story of dance and magic in which Noa, a girl with no one to play with, enters the world of her toy chest, where the toys come alive. Contemporary dance and objects tell the tale.

b7ccae73701abb39af70047abb92d9cef700381d.en: Hiru Jauzitan 2026 at the Portugalete market, with dances by Berriztasuna Taldea.

290a306f7ba02bdb8cd21c105e5802fd9a5a0598.en: Virginia Riezu's stand-up show "Poderío" at Teatro Campos Elíseos, a sharp mix of observational comedy, personal storytelling and social commentary, drawn from real life rather than invented characters.

69e860ab4fa0fd1722c9f302a3b8265ea6448275.en: The Kiev Ballet's "Swan Lake" at Palacio Euskalduna, directed by Viktor Ishchuk, a classical production with precise choreography and costumes designed by Kiev workshop masters. The company has toured since 2022.

581782ac509bbfab11baa80542dd31e7b30cdd26.en: Salvador Sobral's tour for "A flor do recomeço" at Teatro Arriaga on 25 October. It is his first album made entirely of Brazilian songs, recorded in São Paulo with songs by Adriana Calcanhotto, Chico César and Marcelo Camelo. Sobral won Eurovision in 2017.

41e05efa192f64751ec60ba2d3310ded662464af.en: "R&J" by La Dramática Errante at Merkatu Zaharra, a reworking of Shakespeare's tragedy for today's emotional fluidity and social media, searching for a new model of love. Directed by María Goiricelaya, with a Basque version by Kepa Errasti.

cba33ab761b774f62f07cc3bab70c41e1c8a19ed.en: Ja Bilbao 2026's "Ciencia y ficción: el arte de lo posible" at the Guggenheim Bilbao, with astronaut Sara García Alonso, neuroscientist Mariano Sigman and writer Laura Fernández on how science and fiction feed each other. Entry 3 euros.

69e9298203fa80ec2f099f88d19c99bd876111fc.en: "Kandida" by Patxo Telleria at Sala BBK, opening the Homeless Film Festival 2026. A novelist finds at her door the evicted woman who inspired her book, and must take her in. Performed by Miren Gaztañaga, Nerea Mazo and Mikel Martínez.

869ee31f0bb28f8c0e2bbbd6d5f1a9d03e0c4d3e.en: Lore Jokoak 2026 in Mungia, a day of music, dance, historical scenes and folk activities under the motto "Mungia 1900, herri bakarra gara", from 11:00 on 25 October. A solidarity lunch raises money for the association Maite Ta Bizi.

29fb1100e9762887d3fe0fa21725df0150e03c02.en: A guided walk along the Galdames greenway, part of ASTEKLIMA 2026, Euskadi's climate and energy week. It shows how a former industrial landscape has been restored for nature and people. For adults.

f7a10b47768373e88147c53b2f2d8fcf1bc1b3bd.en: An art jam for children, "Arte & movimiento", at the Guggenheim Bilbao, inspired by Igshaan Adams's dance prints. Children paint with ropes and fabric while moving their whole bodies. Sessions at 10:15 for ages 3 to 5 and 12:15 for ages 6 to 10.

373bd94fe76c0a7e5bf12f061293ec000176e330.en: The 11th Homeless Film Festival, held from 25 October to 26 November in Bilbao, Santurtzi and Reinosa. It uses film and theatre to change how society sees homelessness and social exclusion.

39bd2d3f19cf9c8ef92afe621f2426450336ffc9.en: The documentary "Apaiz kartzela" by Ritxi Lizartza, David Pallarès and Oier Aranzabal at Centro Cultural Santa Clara. Four priests jailed in Zamora's concordat prison under Franco return to the prison, followed by a talk by Xabier Amuriza.

251ab9be0d8a97c5a15267e6de5df97d8aee37a1.en: A talk, "Viaje por el teatro de Unamuno", by David Barbero at Bidebarrieta Kulturgunea on 26 October at 19:00, on Miguel de Unamuno's theatre, introduced by Mikel Etxebarria Dobarán of the Asociación Unamuno.

52eac5aaf95c5d42dc196a7cf9e40208a84e0ab7.en: The eighth TOPAKETAK 2026 literary meeting in Santutxu, closing the 49th Jornadas Extremeñas en Bilbao at the Centro Extremeño Bilbao on 26 October at 19:00. Shared food and drink follow the meeting.

d32e2488419bba4a410450df44b1a7ce7e218e89.en: BeZientzia 2026, a science fair for pupils in years 5 and 6 across Bizkaia, at the Ensanche building in Bilbao on 26 and 27 October. Five science stalls by the BERC research centres, in Basque and Spanish.

9a9e8a8c7a9acba153608dc7f1213c7ce5ec0759.en: "Munduari bira (ia) 80 trukotan", a children's magic story at Biblioteca de Bilbao in Basurto, in which a magician back from around the world must find out who stole his key. For ages 5 to 12.

7c3e951802ca938e94c8716107b11fb9829b6fcc.en: The exhibition "El Día de Muertos en México" presented in Bilbao by the Asociación Cultural México Lindo with BBK Kuna, on the Mexican tradition recognised by UNESCO as intangible heritage.

ecf4c4f624deba19fdf3f9a9b1e96eae707dfe5f.en: The exhibition "Pinturas y artes decorativas" by the Agrupación de Artistas de San Miguel at Taberna Nagusia in Basauri, from 26 October to 20 November.

a005b9fad6cb0d1c5da47c40b07add1ef7ed213b.en: The exhibition "Pasión por la fotografía" by the Asociación de Fotógrafos de Basauri at Taberna Nagusia in Basauri, from 30 November to 14 January.

0bf8d187a3bc05840c302fe86f885beae3fb3b76.en: "Narratiba Berriak", a day organised by Loraldia on digital opportunities for creation in Basque, on 27 October at Euskararen Etxea in Bilbao. It explores transmedia storytelling for writers, playwrights, musicians and producers, led by Roger Casas-Alatriste.

e93923b07a56c6cb79a7d0dbec78a76b2122b790.en: A storytelling session, "Otso tonto-tontoak", by Maite Franko at Biblioteca de Bilbao in Basurto, for children aged 4 to 9.

8b6a99b69bf5fe2ed4c3af9b5fadf0bc4315ffa2.en: Storytelling by Ane Arrugaeta and other storytellers at the children's library of Torrezabal in Galdakao, on Tuesdays at 18:00 through October and November, with eight sessions.

34ecec27d240b30e8038388251dc083d1c77abe2.en: A cinema cycle at Mamariga Kulturgunea, "En peligro", for the last quarter of 2026, including the screening "Noche de angustia". The guide and poster are available as PDFs.

4a4e2265dab1ea8cdc87386a33982699de0cc27a.en: A reading club on "Libro de familia" at Biblioteca de Mungia.

3a1a870532c8c9e63874adde594455cc43225fab.en: "In Memoriam de sus Poetas", the 1,188th Tertulia Poética de los Martes at Centro Cívico La Bolsa in Bilbao on 27 October at 19:00, remembering poets of the Asociación Artística Vizcaína. Free entry.

a111eade05d291b4c2f572367d08960fb3446b61.en: A Zinemakumeak gara screening of "No estás loca. La verdad sobre la violencia vicaria" by María Bestar at Sala BBK. The documentary, with more than forty testimonies, shows how children are used to harm mothers. A round table follows.

5b82a61cf387fa132c26963c9b3556263c4ba2d2.en: "Bizipoza", a premiere at Teatro Arriaga by Patxo Telleria, a comedy in Basque about a family in therapy to recover the joy of living, when a plane crash threatens the daughter. Performed by Olatz Ganboa, Mikel Losada and others.

f5dbbdfed00ef26e82aec7a3fe03aae7beb57a59.en: Lucho Miranda's stand-up show "Abriendo las manos" at Teatro Campos Elíseos, a set of dark humour, irony and politically incorrect observations about personal experience and everyday life.

45595b11524c58b02b9a308259bf2a1709fdfd02.en: TO YO, a Japanese psychedelic rock band mixing traditional Japanese folk music with 1970s-style fuzz and wah guitar, at La Atalaia del Gardoki.

3e4a65530301047082f8b96fa6bf07ba928c6761.en: Perseo Zineforuma's "Yo no moriré de amor" at Kultur Leioa, a film forum screening in Spanish on 27 October at 20:00, part of the "¿Realidad o ficción?" cycle. Ages 12 and up; entry 2.5 euros.

94fdd4040faa7877e30ba9b2516b4f07aeaab1fe.en: BIME Live 2026 at Azkena, a free showcase evening with Pitxorines from Mallorca, Aeronave Adolescente and the Ecuadorian band Estamos Perdidos.

cbf94bfe2338b0300301c865110c76fabcbe0d38.en: The BIME Live 2026 programme from 27 to 30 October, a showcase event linking Basque and Atlantic artists and music professionals, with more than seventy showcases across the city's venues.

727551bf4f04f6de60bd2b600808f36e16e584d9.en: Barakaldo's Halloween youth programme from 27 to 31 October, with decoration, keyring and pumpkin workshops, a horror film night and a free virtual reality experience at Mega Park, run by the Giltzarri youth service.

d848f461b48cfd6cd55f77ffddca8ce1335661f5.en: The Basque Dok Festival 2026 from 27 October to 2 November in Bilbao, an international festival of the image run by EHU with Kulturbegi. Its theme, "404 IMAGES NOT FOUND", reflects on visual saturation and fragile digital archives.

66bab36188e80bc95a9f8573d878dc05c2cb520e.en: A storytelling session, "Gau Beltza: ipuin beldurgarria", by Miru at Biblioteca de Bilbao in Basurto, for children aged 5 to 10.

d8ded4d3e107d58487b1165b7b5529af6cbbca6e.en: A book presentation of "Morlans" by Xabier Mendiguren, followed by a philosophy café on 28 October at BIRA Kulturgunea, asking whether a shared historical memory is possible. Organised by Agora Filosofia.

18b9a513cf7bd256e04e508091eb72a6363a6107.en: A reading corner at La Sinsorga led by Alaine Agirre, with three sessions and three books. The first is "Esker onak" by Delphine de Vigan.

5cce2ffb18b3480d31eda30b2ec52921b891e336.en: Versadas, a poetry club linked to the work of Miguel de Unamuno. The listing gives no venue or dates.

e7e9ff1f646c9394e8781bd21c974b8423ef6aa3.en: The presentation of "Todas las noches, todas las ciudades" by Dolores Redondo at Bidebarrieta Kulturgunea on 28 October, in conversation with journalist César Coca.

4308280cabbdfd8b729ebd7c14763fb39eba5a94.en: "Herencia" by Kulunka at Teatro Arriaga, a dream-like night journey into a family's mystery, written by Iñaki Rikarte. A couple's last night together, full of fear, desire and memory, in a contemporary tragedy with the structure of a thriller.

4c0f560ee3d7faac28648bc6c788e1849175f4f1.en: Duel from Austin, Texas and Psycho Rebel Front from Logroño play Sala Groove in Portugalete on 28 October. Duel mix stoner doom with classic hard rock; Psycho Rebel Front combine psychedelic rock with post-punk.

6eba88f0be19ed83204fe7656382379f780afd28.en: BIME Live 2026 at Azkena with Gloory Hole, a Mexican act mixing electroclash, art-pop and political theatre; She is a Devil, with dark rock, metal and pop; and Mostaza Karizia, a punk band from Donostia.

e90ca93a93bd5c7a660104237ff6f86ec7dca1ed.en: The seventh BasqueDok Festival of documentary photography, from 28 October to 1 November 2026 at AZ Azkuna Zentroa in Bilbao.

ea8c4897d5e6e3c30a1ca6ae874c2008bddc02ce.en: A conference on trafficking of women for sexual exploitation recruited through social media, at Centro Municipal de Ibaiondo. Institutions, security forces and specialist organisations look at new forms of recruitment and responses.

455d45d76d23c281c91642a7366b640e644b0a21.en: A storytelling hour with Maite Franko in Basque at Biblioteca Infantil de Leioa on 29 October at 18:00, for children aged 3 to 4. Free; registration required.

722578f3dbdb8f084dc0e4a3afe3fbe124b36d06.en: "Bonnard, el pintor y su musa" at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea, a film about Pierre Bonnard and Marthe, his enigmatic muse and partner, who appears in more than a third of his work. It explores their relationship of seclusion and mutual dependence.

521fe6b346063b1df4f99a6b01d414f6325f198d.en: A storytelling session on Gau Beltza stories with Maider Alcelay at Biblioteca Infantil de Basauri (Ibaigane) on 29 October, in Basque, followed by a craft. For ages 6 to 10; pre-registration until 25 October.

3333df80acdd6eee46a648d63558ea9c07fa5cd2.en: A screening of the opera "L'Elisir d'Amore" by Donizetti at Getxo Zinemak. In this comic opera, Nemorino buys a supposed magic potion to win the love of Adina.

c4b135e26749c853b5f49b9eb75056570976ea02.en: "43º13'44''N" by Olatz Gorrotxategi at AZ Azkuna Zentroa, a one-woman performative lecture that uses documents to tell the life of her great-uncle Domingo Gangoiti, mixing memory with imagination. In Basque, with testimonies in Spanish.

291a2082881c9e1f2b0bb5208bd222bc884923fd.en: Ja Bilbao 2026's conversation with Mariana Enriquez, with Mónica Crespo and Bego R. Orbezua at Bidebarrieta Kulturgunea, about horror and literature and her book "Conversación con la oscuridad". Entry by invitation; book signing.

117071056e7593b581f0fd7b2b422883dda66f87.en: "El zoo de las plumas", part of Bilboko Zirkuitua 2026, a 60-minute comedy about Armanda and Alberta, who run a cabaret and raise an adopted son. His engagement to the daughter of a conservative senator changes everything. Directed by Ivan Iparraguirre.

07fddeeff7620d6d9c74a0a75c2acb40ab688c3d.en: A debate at BIRA Kulturgunea on 29 October, "Zirkuituak eta kontrazirkuituak: espazio herrigileak", with Fermin Muguruza, Leire Vargas, Jon Maia and Ines Osinaga, on community spaces in Basque music. Reservations by email.

134dc93017c9322e12ce4ed450b53c1a01af2d96.en: "La Dignidad. Una Historia Verdadera" by Gato Negro Teatro at Torrezabal Kultur Etxea, a tender clown piece based on Gilles Ségal's "Monsieur Schpill et Monsieur Tippeton". It moves from laughter to cruelty and reflects on the human condition.

9945f9381096c1f92b74eb978c87213489de175d.en: "El coro de Praga" at Social Antzokia, a social cinema screening. A thirteen-year-old girl joins an elite choir, where its demanding director takes advantage of her dreams. Directed by Ondrej Provazník; 106 minutes; suitable from age 12.

03ddebe461c5b50ca52f88a66b09e2d140a43fbb.en: Bilbo Beat 2026, the third edition of an urban culture day organised by SGAE's Basque council, at Sala Cúpula of Teatro Campos Elíseos on 29 October from 19:00, free. Headliners are Arianna Puello, with Novato and Nehor.

cf9ee339cbb8202a45f80ff58180b96aa7fe5e50.en: A Danon plaza 2026 bertso session in Bilbao with young bertsolariak Amaiur Betanzos, Helena Yerga, Maider Altuna and Haizea Telleria, and the finalist Aitor Etxebarriazarraga. Free entry.

712f2d6a436f8b21bdf71a458332103f3e7a73b1.en: A book presentation of "Conversación con la oscuridad" by Mariana Enriquez at Bidebarrieta Kulturgunea on 29 October, in conversation with Mónica Crespo and Bego R. Orbezua.

91650a1ffaed4001ee5e9a9326636bd626d59a3b.en: Xabier Amuriza's show "Lazkao Txiki. Bat-bateko sorgina" at Euskaltzaindiaren Aretoa on 29 October, marking 100 years since the birth of bertsolari Joxe Miguel Iztueta "Lazkao Txiki", part of the Bilbo Zaharra Forum 2026.

67da25d7f285a8bd9ba1fcb249ad11eafae3db6b.en: The Banda Municipal de Bilbao's 2026/27 concert "Caminos" at Teatro Arriaga. The programme includes Puccini arrangements from La Bohème, Gianni Schicchi and Turandot, and Robert W. Smith's Symphony No. 2 "The Odyssey".

66c8ae716cfc92a7662e0e32f75cab3abfe9287e.en: A jam session by Bilbao Musika Eskola at Hika Ateneo, once a month on a Thursday. Students and teachers play live music while visitors enjoy pintxos, with the chance to talk to the teachers and join in.

1f5a433543bc95c032cad7648258fc89ce1c45df.en: A talk at the Museo de Reproducciones, "La obra en su contexto", on the exhibition "Bizitza Paraleloak. La memoria de las copias", given by collections head Itziar Martija. It covers works known only through copies, such as the Hildesheim Krater.

6e7ff2f504de24b78e39dcbdc58acc4322471f80.en: The BOS concert "Las profundidades del alma" at Palacio Euskalduna, with Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 24 and Rachmaninoff's Symphonic Dances, played by pianist Claire Huangci under conductor Nicoló Umberto Forón.

2004cddc5a575d3ddbf07bcbd0be0b879956b912.en: Bob Pop and Daniel Bayona's theatre piece "Hablar no sirve. De nada" at Teatro Campos Elíseos, on emotional dependence, vulnerability, intimacy and the power of words, in an intimate and provocative story.

48cbd951038601f9047286e65c5a0e5f04d2ec43.en: The Vocapella Limburg ensemble, about 26 singers from Germany, performs Romantic and contemporary choral music at Muxikebarri as part of the Semana Coral de Getxo 2026, conducted by Tristan Meister.

83929c56f68a151d6d1ca4c8673c6f3cf7b28700.en: Matías Miguez's "Swango" at JAZZON Aretoa, a jazz quartet with Miguez on electric bass, Pere Miró on saxophone, Alejandro Di Costanzo on piano and Josep Cordobés on drums.

85455cf0e1d666fae96aa437e95761194f43f0cb.en: BIME Bilbao 2026, its 14th edition from 27 to 30 October, with more than seventy showcases in nine Bilbao venues from 27 to 29 October. A 1-euro donation for Colombian earthquake relief is included. Acts include Ashleys and Dianka.

b479fdfb1090fd039fb64fd349a40c1ec87fe0f3.en: The Bo Dereks play Crazy Horse in Bilbao on 29 October.

99e37b6e10280ae3176e3edf1b4725b80932928b.en: Gonzalo Hermida, a singer-songwriter from Cádiz known for emotive pop, plays Cotton Club in Bilbao on 29 and 30 October.

4814575468ab9c7c4c6890038ae26e678194b208.en: Justin Quiles, a Puerto Rican singer-songwriter known for reggaeton and Latin trap, plays Sala Santana 27 in Bilbao on 29 October.

a274d418b29cce4c78c2c329f7cdcf6e25ec49a6.en: A reading club on "Magnifica humanitas", about protecting the human person in the age of AI, led by Giovanni Pecoraro at Kultur Leioa. Sessions on 29 October at 17:00 and 19:15, in Spanish; free.

b1462a28b58d16fd2ef61dff8574db28c740e031.en: The Sortzaileak Basora cycle in Galdakao, with free gigs at Basoa Taberna each Thursday in October. Buzkentza and Azken Geltokian are on the bill for this date; two sets each evening, at 19:30 and 20:15.

c82d2832b321f032cbd9b674f4b1ccacf0057c78.en: The Arimen Gaua 2026 programme in Lemoa on 29 and 31 October. The programme is available as an image.

67b14ecd52fc19c6afe80e87de880b3f7027bb57.en: The Semana Coral de Getxo 2026, from 29 October to 1 November at Muxikebarri. Tickets are 5 euros per concert or 12 euros for a pass.

d37c77a9cdd15632b42524f190374c606e8be643.en: Bazen Behin 2026 with Ana Apika, "Besoetako ipuinak", a storytelling session with songs and books for children aged 1 to 3 and their families at Barakaldo's Arteagabeitia library. About 40 minutes.
