fb7f44c92c30b6615e8a83175849b8f5242c7d17.en: AFRIKARTE 2026, a film and discussion event at La Perrera – BilbaoArte on 30 October at 18:30, screening "Têtes Brûlées" by Maja-Ajmia Yde Zellama, followed by a participatory talk on grief, identity and community. Free; registration required.

40457ffd7bc2141795754990d934b747c7a76175.en: POLIFEME at TAC 2026 Sestao, a sound art project by María Cervelló that uses electromagnetic waves from analogue devices such as TV sets and walkie-talkies, turning the radio-frequency environment into music.

be2d86c28338aaaa5e2c838221dc31c9f4bdc918.en: Diablues ta Bluezifer play Instituto Bertendona in Bilbao on 30 October, a blues band with strong guitars, groove and voice, part of Mila Musika Haria 2026.

a2f1f83a756dc0d4157b40176057e928ae995837.en: ETEN, a poetic concert at La Sinsorga where Nekane Pérez de Nanclares's poems meet Amaia Santamaría's music and voice, in Basque and Spanish, on rupture, reconnection, motherhood and grief.

ee33656275e6c8799b6bc965457ea30e2c6a765c.en: "Una voz, mil voces", a science-music show at the Bilbao conservatory, with narration by Luca Fanelli and violinist Marianna Atria playing Ysaÿe's and Bach's solo violin sonatas, in Basque. It opens Zientzia Astea 2026.

caace80937b6396091f31634572d18c05ce087fd.en: "Madness", a musical comedy by Yllana and Primital Brothers about life on the margins of the system, from a bridge to the jet set, with a cappella singing. At the Escuela de Música de Sestao.

2046650da5d1fbd31efe8ba12370e6f5cad79c87.en: Ja Bilbao 2026's conversation with Michel Houellebecq and Rodrigo Blanco Calderón at Palacio Euskalduna, on his lifelong interest in science fiction. In French with simultaneous translation. Entry 6 euros.

0dc06fdbe9541d2efdc974b29dcbadbfdbc6bf57.en: STAFF presents its new album "Nun in a Van" at Bilborock together with Biterdi, previewing new songs live. The Bilbao band won the Koska award for best emerging band.

7efe081e236a8b4432a7f32997e246c37dc3c4c8.en: "Ya me has tocado el cuento", a comedy at Teatro Campos Elíseos in which four princes search for their princesses, who have left for the real world, and find a healthier masculinity along the way.

de5780338bc9454e5ed6636a6e369ce888fbb80e.en: "Corta el cable rojo", an improvised comedy show with music, projections and a large cast, which has run for fourteen years in Madrid's Gran Vía. Recommended for ages 16 and up.

d7edb66418b183123c71b917c610755220f02459.en: Víctor y Ruven with the Banda Municipal de Música de Barakaldo, "Inferencia sinfónico", a Basque premiere in which contemporary flamenco meets symphonic sound at Teatro Barakaldo. Bassoon by Ruvén Jiménez, dance by Víctor Mayol.

99855aad1ab9695169c86d6991f68d3c1de746a0.en: The Chamber Choir Ipavska from Slovenia at Muxikebarri as part of the Semana Coral de Getxo 2026, with 46 young voices performing sacred polyphony, Slovenian choral tradition and contemporary works. Conducted by Damjana Voncina.

f05a522ad45803c3548053a83b962c7e01df2efe.en: Petti vs Juanjo Navas, "Errotik", a blues and flamenco concert with guests at BIRA Kulturgunea, for 10 euros; booking by email.

ba9600c1edbb1f74c0cc9a01732d98bf28672d7d.en: Ariane Quartet, a jazz group of four students from Musikene, playing swing, post-bop, fusion and neo-soul, at JAZZON Aretoa.

5f7f7d38014e667658f0ef56cec2642f7d2dc0e2.en: "En tránsito, disculpen las molestias" at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea, a clown show about Bunda, who has a terminal diagnosis and talks with his conscience, Mor. It moves from denial to surrender, with humour and gratitude.

8cf3703f422886e0bcb4c718dc93994c5b064a87.en: Luis Álvaro's stand-up show "Tourette" at Teatro Campos Elíseos, with naive material and an explosive staging, from a comic known from Comedy Central and Buenafuente.

8618ea57a1606b233bbf7f4af93ab9ef0a5626c7.en: ABHIR, the rapper and singer from Las Palmas of Indian descent, plays Sala Santana 27 in Bilbao on 30 October, fusing melodic rap, R&B, alternative pop and electronica.

86102a153e25a917e4152ae45b0f9dc89f7c16ee.en: Random Key, a Bilbao rock band, presents their new album at Azkena.

19666f98756122fc9a95b24b7cd3ba03d9efbbf4.en: Musika Bizian 2026, the Galdakao festival with Faltriqueira from Galicia and Kalakan from Hendaia, whose minimal arrangements of traditional songs bring Basque-language music to life. Part of the festival programme.

7da25ff8f2b892cc0aa99e45d83adca67329af1a.en: The band Chameleons play Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 30 October.

3d4268da4033ecef5bf2843759d61be357cff6e9.en: Ángel Stanich at Sala BBK on 30 October, part of Sirimiri 2026, presenting his LP "Por la hierba", inspired by Franco Battiato, nearly five years after "Polvo de Battiato".

0be3a30dd8f41bc5b7d32fd390b85ecf301446d1.en: Xabi Solano plays Ugao-Miraballes on 30 October as part of Ganbara Sesioak.

9c1446743f743890690ea94c8cd47f129f621d6a.en: A Halloween craft session, "Manualidades para Halloween", making a garland of monster faces and fantasy characters from foam and glue. From age 5 with an adult; from 7 alone.

839c80f8bb93c088ffc909b2d74a87c6d72040b5.en: Arthur Miller's "Panorama desde el puente" at Teatro Arriaga, the tragedy of a Brooklyn longshoreman whose obsession with his niece and jealousy towards an immigrant lead to disaster. Directed by Javier Molina, with José Luis García-Pérez.

118cbd7907f3f9dbe7d7c81f56fc56827bcbb7a7.en: The programme of Musika Bizian 2026, the 12th festival in Galdakao on 30 and 31 October, with groups from several nations, including Faltriqueiras, Kalakan, Enbrum, Agraf and Xiberoots, at Iturrondo square.

6650aa8763d63af5d8f16c479966406e6a96c310.en: Leioa's photography contest exhibition at Kultur Leioa from 30 October to 22 November, showing some of the entries.

19e001df5a2f9a11d216235b8c8275fbf58cd140.en: Mila Musika Haria 2026, the 17th edition of a string-instrument concert cycle in Abando, with five concerts at Instituto Bertendona from 30 October to 27 November at 19:00, including a guitar contest.

8e06db628853f3e690c6357d3d10b73d483e077e.en: "Circus", a retrospective of Alejandra Icaza at Sala Rekalde with more than 70 paintings from the 1980s to today.

954e65b118453c67e7ba2ffb22f8eae7b5966c0f.en: A children's workshop, "Arimen gaua: ipuin itzaltsua", at Biblioteca de Bilbao in Basurto on 31 October, for ages 8 to 13.

fb121db0c8342665a23ef5c68fab0ba24ac71ada.en: A talk, "Hablando con nuestros satélites, Aventuras desde el espacio", by Aitor Conde, with a concert by pianist Ales Larrazabal and multi-instrumentalist Ivan Allue. The listing gives no venue.

a325d9abaaf8a6e0884ea6ef5a93ae13ff8e2d01.en: "Ardatzak", a circus show by Zirkozaurre about two juggler friends who, like the diabolos they grew up with, have to keep spinning to stay steady. Part of the Santurtzi Theatre Festival 2026.

b757b762906220a3e82b00d986e3deffd4cf4401.en: EZK Fest 2026 brings punk, rock and alternative bands to Santurtzi on 31 October. The line-up also includes Non Servium, Arene 6, Naxker, Añube, Hazas, Maruxak and Diskonformes.

a49e5d2bcdc564ae0d39868a813b905e3efd76f2.en: Superthings: Filma screens in Galdakao. Three sixth-graders discover a fragment of Kazoom that links their grey city to Kaboom City, and they must stop the villain Mr. King.

39456dc7565f7af4d27d0e6b0f2c12380c6fe88f.en: Visigoth Metal Fest 2026 is a new heavy metal festival at D8 Sorkuntza Faktoria. Sabotaje, Evil Seeds, Midjungards and Vhaldemar perform, with Sabotaje marking their 40th anniversary.

fd4b9c0ccc52df48f5ebb78c84a5ecae9a582d65.en: The Gau Beltza 2026 Halloween festival takes place in Alonsotegi on 31 October. The programme is published separately by the organisers.

51bd47806b1af19a310ad7b2c642fdfef11ae43d.en: Arimen Gaua 2026, Zamudio's Halloween celebration, takes place on 31 October at Plaza Lehendakari Agirre. Registration runs from 19 to 28 October, and the programme is available separately.

96db3f9bd4bf30ad2e9051a4c3eec2d783c28ad0.en: Recorta el miedo is a collage workshop at Sopa de Sapo for young people and adults. Participants combine photographs, words and found fragments to create eerie scenes and imagined creatures. No drawing skills or prior experience are needed.

7e6dc4be696c50b81313bf6d728672898f4bcea3.en: Embrujizos is a puppet show for family audiences, part of Barakaldo's 2026 performing arts programme. A witch raises an abandoned girl, and a generational clash over tradition and digital life leads to magic going wrong.

9bc637b14efbd60fb98e8ecdc5d25aa838fe22cc.en: Candlelight Bilbao presents a live tribute to Coldplay and Imagine Dragons, with a string ensemble playing hits from both bands. The concert lasts 60 minutes, and seats are assigned on arrival.

a7fa092e1f93279a133b6198aed8592f05bee2d9.en: Ander eta Yul, a 1988 Basque-Spanish film directed by Ana Díez, screens as part of the Klasikoak 2026 cycle. A man released from prison returns to a family that has changed, and meets an old seminary friend.

078ada3c9e22ef997ebf2ad505d0ea8dd0a6dc2c.en: 3 en Impro is an improvised comedy show with seven scenes performed by the actors of Impro Impar. It comes to the Teatro Campos Elíseos in Bilbao for a limited run after ten years in Madrid.

c8405a2a0e306b763bcb46bc6c62743ab03ea473.en: Nanpa Básico plays Santana 27 in Bilbao on 31 October. The Colombian artist presents his new album Que tin y que tan, alongside some of his best-known songs.

7044b5db54c123b18b26e9729ed094691d038be6.en: Concierto Soulidario Contigo at Sala BBK raises money for women's cancer research. Moses & The Tablets and MACFLY perform soul, blues and funk, and each ticket supports the Fundación Contigo.

49f38ff6349c84ed64def15600165798e105e338.en: Sigma Project, a saxophone quartet, performs a Musikagileak 2026 programme at the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao. The concert features new works by Basque and international composers.

9f512302a1e928bbbd6b4ef97e2ce8713892eb73.en: Dantza Plazetan 2026 is a free folk dance programme across Bilbao's neighbourhoods. The first event is a romería by Salbatzaile Dantza Taldea in Plaza Santiago on 24 January, and 58 events take place during the year.

3eb5c2dfcf32d27597a9fab9835dfb6210d588f5.en: El entusiasmo is a theatre piece by Pablo Remón at Teatro Barakaldo. Structured as a prologue and four parts, it follows a couple through shifting fictions about choice, fate and middle age.

2a4b098189b3e9424dacc8c29d931b6fa1e59c0d.en: Cuban Jazz Syndicate plays the JazzOn Fest 2026 at JAZZON Aretoa in Bilbao. The six-member group brings together trumpet, saxophone, piano, bass, percussion and drums with vocals.

cb428b73572bf971c8eeeba8f67d03f960492789.en: Sensación térmica is a play at Serantes Kultur Aretoa as part of the Santurtzi Theatre Festival 2026. A young woman who escaped a violent home recognises abuse in her friend's relationship with an older man.

50deee066002c00f15136453cd66dd7785473acc.en: Kirioki is a trans, queer karaoke night at Hika Ateneo in Bilbao on a Saturday. Guests sing classic pop and musical numbers with the hosts Yogurinha, Borova, Perpetua and Rebollo.

55423fd017d6d909d7857382187694fa67f27c81.en: Ángel Martín presents Somos monos at Palacio Euskalduna. The show is a comic take on how the internet has dulled our thinking, and offers a way to switch the brain back on.

45c8727ef1f06d4be3b148e4240adb6ddad3a21a.en: Tankard, Exodia and Hidden play a German thrash metal night at Santana 27 in Bilbao on 31 October.

29ca674112e94c858ac91f5590545ce5b2d5a533.en: Miguel Costas revives the hits of Siniestro Total and Aerolíneas Federales at the Crazy Horse in Bilbao. The singer and songwriter performs his best-known songs.

9ebcba58b5b327b06b246e02eceac31ccf26e8ca.en: Wet Cactus and Green Sun Cult play Sala Groove in Portugalete on 31 October.

18cc0bc9a84a5b78cabf5a85e249b80b1c9fef2c.en: Candlelight Bilbao presents a 60-minute tribute to Queen and The Beatles, performed by a string quartet. The programme includes Bohemian Rhapsody, We Will Rock You, Yesterday and Here Comes the Sun.

8db820ac15460b58aced021df6e21c483709e3bd.en: Musika Bizian 2026 brings together Enbrum, Agraf and Xiberoots. The three groups mix folk, Amazigh roots and reggae, singing in Basque, Tarifit and Souletin.

453a97e5da7a54c61168fe182fc76934ab259a95.en: Stoned Heads, a Basque hard rock band playing 1970s classics, performs at La Atalaia del Gardoki on Halloween night.

6eae930aba25874964c57f5d2ef786b532209c3b.en: Pedrá is a tribute band to Extremoduro that performs at Bilboko Kafe Antzokia on 31 October. The group reinterprets the Extremadura band's classics with energy and fidelity.

cc2881a3aad87a974e770b35327160175e3210fd.en: Deltó is an Extremoduro tribute band playing Azkena. The group aims to honour the originals with its own intense stage presence, and it toured in 2025 with sold-out shows.

f7bca24038ff32d8ec207ed7cf6582ad3c095a8e.en: Mungia's Gau Baltza 2026 runs from 16:00 to 04:00 on 31 October at Landetxo Gunea. Activities include children's and youth gymkhanas, a spooky trail, horror storytelling, a zombie party and DJ sets.

8f7fe15c4bcacea119f1fdde8a7f97a9adc53217.en: El Pabellón de los Cuerdos is an immersive psychological horror experience at Utopian. Participants help rescue a friend trapped in a psychiatric hospital, and they become part of the story.

af3743cf44ee988afd71d1f238418fbe6fa9d059.en: The Noche Negra (Gau Beltza) 2026 in Urduliz takes place on 31 October. It includes workshops and music, and the full programme is published separately.

bfbd718626206d018e81c9e9d95e9872af19e727.en: David Cepo returns to the Teatro Campos Elíseos with No cruces los brazos, a comedy show. The comedian became known online for his spontaneous videos.

cfe327bdeff242d68cf4bf7d459deb2a8b530467.en: The 47th Santurtzi Theatre Festival runs from 31 October to 3 December at Serantes Kultur Aretoa. The programme includes 19 shows, seven of them new to the Basque Country, and includes Pina Bausch's La consagración de la primavera.

2e128ded829ee31ad6086a48da7b97cd2de1ad5d.en: Piensa en Wilbur is a solo show by the acrobat Wilbur, who blends acrobatics, humour and risk. The performer has worked with Cirque du Soleil and is a former Spanish acrosport champion.

14c8f22552d519c26b88b36a2cf1033b72315bdb.en: Miguel Costas returns to the Crazy Horse for a Sunday matinee. The session includes a talk about his book Esas Palmas Coño, which the organisers describe as a war report of his life.

4927487a8d1fba8a585482bf13f0c592a26e0b1a.en: Arte Hartze Zikloa 2026 presents Ibantuta at Aiaraldea Ekintzen Faktoria. The solo show mixes oud poetry, dance and music videos, and draws on traditional string instruments from many countries.

ff46cc630e9fcb2f3275ecb82d2bdc2503106458.en: Jeff Toussaint performs El Hipnotista at the Teatro Campos Elíseos. The show is a classic hypnosis performance with volunteers from the audience, and each show is different.

5c6cd634c982c960d25782df28f139ba30b82b27.en: Techno Pop, a show at Palacio Euskalduna, revisits 1980s and 1990s synth-pop classics by Depeche Mode, Talk Talk, Yazoo and others. It features international singers and a band.

424f109f6b68894f347ee18ed7c300bef1c5f3bd.en: Pasión Vega sings songs from Pedro Almodóvar's films at Teatro Arriaga in Bilbao on 1 November. Pianist Moisés P. Sánchez and a trio of musicians accompany her, and the show is directed by Joan Anton Rechi.

4980af2182a287faa5b0c0e730f5a6d642647f81.en: Saint Angela Choir, a youth choir from Indonesia, performs at Muxikebarri in Getxo as part of the Getxo Choral Week 2026. The programme spans sacred music, contemporary pieces and folk traditions.

839d5aecf9948627fd77eae329311fdcda1fdde1.en: Ja Bilbao 2026 hosts Generación Glitch, a talk between authors Sara Barquinero and Carla Nyman on speculative fiction, online identities and a present that feels like a dystopia. Entry is free until capacity is reached.

cbf4b1eac83b8ad0427d52a620cb022d5fc1e053.en: El dragón de oro is a 75-minute grotesque contemporary tragedy by Roland Schimmelpfennig, staged at Serantes Kultur Aretoa in Santurtzi. The lives of residents in one apartment building intersect in one night.

293b44fbd4987748f66b2b45c347382dc781309f.en: The Trofeo Argizaiola 2026 photography exhibition runs from 5 to 30 October in two Bilbao venues, the Juntas Generales hall and Berastegi Metro station. The opening is on 5 October, followed by a talk with the winner, Jose Angel Amuchastegui.

2ed8739a1cf0576dc3ed3e5aca2c9610029fd0d1.en: Ensemble Kuraia performs the final concert of Elena Mendoza's composition course at the Conservatorio Juan Crisóstomo de Arriaga in Bilbao. The programme is part of Musikagileak 2026-2027 and the Kuraia series.

82e77e01ce15d96e5f4ccd574d27ae82f9475a66.en: The final-year concert of Elena Mendoza's composition course takes place at the Conservatorio Juan Crisóstomo de Arriaga in Bilbao. It is part of the Kuraia 2026-2027 contemporary music encounters.

81cf2b8de6ebdb9be31b606f330ba45b877a39ab.en: Julio Iglesias Jr. performs the classic songs of his father, Julio Iglesias, at Palacio Euskalduna in Bilbao. The show is a tribute built around glamour, elegance and romantic standards.

8f7e49d7dd03cfa1052c914f4131163f28f7ea90.en: Cría cuervos, Carlos Saura's 1976 film, screens at the Golem Alhóndiga as part of the Azkuna Zentroa film programme on Spanish transition-era directors. A girl and her aunt's relationship with their dead mother reflects Francoist family life.

73335bc9d6ab7ea5db5a9ec39d15e8022c6c71e1.en: The Azkuna Zentroa cycle Cineastas de la Transición runs six films from 1976 to 1984. It explores how transition-era cinema addressed memory, desire, violence and the end of Francoism.

a6e6bb02133f9b088bd3ac9b3883aca09d7ea187.en: The third Basauri mycology photography contest runs from 2 to 27 November at Pozokoetxe Kultur Etxea. It is organised by the Basauri Society of Mycology and Natural Sciences.

7b00b34413392bc8ae58201f162744ac6763d058.en: Gazte Artea Ezkerraldean 2026 is a touring exhibition of work by four young artists from the Ezkerraldea region. It moves through Portugalete, Barakaldo, Sestao and Santurtzi until 29 January 2027, with painting, sculpture and mixed media.

58970b2d1222ecd60424790b9ca38ba94da3aad7.en: Ventanas de color is an exhibition by the artist Nagore Zunzunegui at Basozelai Gizarte Etxea. It runs from 2 to 29 November.

d4a410f9803cf667aa35c1204b2e68bbf2a0487a.en: Odei Arregi and other storytellers hold Tuesday storytelling sessions for children at the Torrezabal children's library in Galdakao. The eight sessions run from 6 October to 27 October, at 18:00.

0a0528e626516433f59ae303f21ff7eed0eddb57.en: El vuelo del fénix is screened at Mamariga Kulturgunea as part of the Mamariga library's film cycle En peligro. The cycle runs through the last quarter of 2026.

ed44ba7b05de2fc2c637f20b9be13769def59ac6.en: Lucia di Lammermoor, Donizetti's opera, is shown in cinemas from the Vienna State Opera's 2019 production. The sung Italian has Spanish subtitles, and the cast includes Olga Peretyatko and Juan Diego Flórez.

7129c200952fa39d958bacc153e109c197c3bcc3.en: El pesimismo alegre (Mi suicidio) is a solo stage show by Mario Gas at Teatro Arriaga. It adapts the writings of Henri Roorda, a witty meditation on love, society, work and pleasure.

82d7e764a815a70c6c0924dd384be550d6f09352.en: Maddi y las fronteras, a Spanish-language book club, meets at Leioa library on 3 November with the author Edurne Portela present. Entry is free, with sessions at 17:30 and 19:00.

a16825ed24740da299b3e79877b0668c563cab63.en: Iruña. Pulsión e impermanencia is an art series by Gertrudis Gannon, inspired by medieval Carmina Burana poems and daily newspapers. The works offer no fixed answers and reflect each viewer differently.

fdc34b8e36cd6632ff0b3a1a9885ee8b86fbfbd9.en: Expodistrito 2026 at Castaños Municipal Centre presents Mengyin Wang's painting Aves en reposo. It is part of Bilbao's programme of decentralised exhibitions, which includes Unamuno and Picasso shows.

dd754c657a1903cf3cfc5705a214af6bef36ba93.en: Expodistrito 2026 at Abando Municipal Centre (Barrainkua) presents a homage to Pablo Picasso. The show draws on works by artists who contributed to his 1970s centenary, now held by the Blas de Otero Foundation.

62e26daf8fd9e360efa69f562d63833566741989.en: Euskaraz gozatu offers a children's workshop on Joan Miró at Centro Cultural Santa Clara. Children aged 4 to 7 paint his characters with acrylics and build a shared sculpture, for a maximum of 12 places.

6aee6fdc271ed056a985535cb63f7543bc55f461.en: Fandango, a documentary on the fandango tradition of Huelva, screens at Teatro Barakaldo as part of the Wednesday film series. Directed by Remedios Malvárez and Arturo Andújar, it follows flamenco singers from the province.

10db845e655e2225f08c8f51eb15283587c00086.en: Arantzarik gabeko arrosa is a book presentation at the Algorta culture hall. The Basque novel, by singer Oihane Amantegi, mixes magical realism with a rap singer's story and will be published in November 2026.

f8c6cec7c70797872bac2a30a764d87b58f90ec2.en: Biniloland Urduliz is a participatory talk on ten vinyl records, mostly singles, led by journalist Joseba Martín. Each song is played, discussed and placed in its historical context.

705bcf0d3a366266083bcdfc72bb92a5eafa3c1a.en: Hyena and Lust Ritual play Sala Groove in Portugalete on 4 November. Hyena is a Peruvian heavy metal band, and Lust Ritual is a doom metal band formed in London in 2023.

a9e88264a861a7d945aa05732a662fc20f497f96.en: Aitatxo is a documentary about grief after the loss of a child, told from the perspective of fathers. A talk on perinatal and neonatal bereavement follows the screening at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea. Recommended for ages 12 and over.

84ae187b57e309a1a2fbfdc94b3968d1ab16444f.en: The Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia runs a Spanish-language reading group on Marcelino: decires de un hombre. Two groups meet fortnightly from September to December, with 20 places per group allocated by lottery.

fe7984f2b46e0b0053ac3fb6af18e8e0316acd94.en: The Santurtzi book club meets at Casa Torre Jauregia from October to December 2026 and reads six books, including Mi marido by Maud Ventura. Places are allocated by lottery to library card holders, and the fee is 6 euros.

98c3f15785c45d4e1e422c87f6dd95136544f8bb.en: The Galdames Month of Historical Memory runs from 4 to 13 November 2026 to mark 90 years since the 1936 coup. It includes an exhibition on war posters and three evening talks on memory and wartime children.

4409bef91abd1ae8b263c49c6b9b3462a5724826.en: The Romo Kultur Etxea documentary cycle in Getxo runs from 2026 to 2027. It promotes documentaries as artistic expression and gives visibility to films made in the local area and by emerging artists.

3ca836df5b649992c48506fe34658c8b5efb5ded.en: The Portugalete library book club discusses El libro azul de Nebo by M. Steffan Ros. Further information is available at the library.

341b3052f7284b1822422bd526baf23391b656f0.en: Vivir las pérdidas is a talk at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea by members of the Sopela Zurekin association. Entry is free until the venue is full.

1d58118dde13bf1accc32759b7f3378acf380b7c.en: The Portugalete library book club discusses Salir a robar caballos by Per Petterson. Further information is available at the library.

e69e7fcfe2f1fae44e6e2ef027c9581467f575ed.en: Este himno llevará la palabra euforia is a dance piece by La Intrusa, staged at AZ Azkuna Zentroa as part of Dantzaldia 2026. The company creates a collective anthem that starts from impulse rather than hope.

60fa9c389b9aaff60a62705f3179cae8c061a37f.en: Ella es calladita is an anti-cabaret show at the Zorroza Municipal Centre, part of the Bilboko Zirkuitua 2026. Directed by Iván Bilbao, it challenges sexism in pop culture and lasts 80 minutes.

51d22e006543c00a37d520622e4caea2955ea3c6.en: Mendi Filmeko onena screens three short films at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea as part of Mendi Tour 2026. Entry is free, but attendees must request an invitation in advance, and the films are in Spanish, English and Basque.

f01526d7a097e3d3aafb0f7f1f65d275249a068b.en: Gaua, a Basque horror film set in 17th-century witch hunts, screens at Muxikebarri in Getxo as part of Zinemabarri. Directed by Paul Urkijo, the 91-minute film is recommended for ages 16 and over.

f98da77c481a3ba16c577badedb268abd8d6d338.en: Urchin, a drama set on the streets of London, screens at Golem Alhóndiga as part of the Homeless Film Festival 2026. It follows a young homeless man searching for a new start.

a6dffb90f232569d4cc89840b210034e0ded6f97.en: María José Llergo performs El Juego Tour at Teatro Arriaga in Bilbao on 5 November. The flamenco singer-songwriter is joined by a band with drums, keyboards, bass and violin.

d9293d680f3773710a60375a9b4319214c3418bf.en: Raíz compartida brings together trikitixa, zanfona, flute and saxophone players from Santander, Bilbao and Logroño. Xabi Aburruzaga, Jorge Garrido and Juan Saiz explore the links between their root music traditions at Teatro Campos Elíseos.

a6b621ade032707316fac0176e87fb4bec4d296a.en: Alchemists and Mitosia play Sala Groove in Portugalete on 5 November. Alchemists are a Swiss modern metal band, and Mitosia are a thrash metal band from Lekeitio.

9acd3b8aecd2f20877e8ace851b3078a200b5962.en: The Bilbao Orkestra Sinfonikoa season 2026-2027 includes a programme of Prokofiev with cellist Nicolas Altstaedt and conductor Markus Stenz at Palacio Euskalduna. It features the Symphony-Concerto and the Romeo and Juliet suite.

8a57ab685e210d4a0629fe1622e515289e047f08.en: Jaume Vilaseca Trio with flautist Maria Gil reworks 1970s symphonic rock by the British band Camel as jazz at JAZZON Aretoa. The flute takes centre stage in pieces such as Mirage and The Snow Goose.

f5d9ea2d6f29fd16321d1ffe82e53c0f09c6a871.en: Andrii Pokaz's Jazz Inmersivo at Teatro Campos Elíseos pairs solo grand piano with light, smoke and black-and-white visuals. The set reinterprets standards such as Summertime, Moon River and Fly Me to the Moon.

c3025edada566c2dc78453209628c0e3a258a4ab.en: El Nido is a band formed in Burgos in 2019 that reinterprets traditional Castilian and Leonese folk with modern sounds. Its 2025 album La Constancia mixes traditional rhythms with contemporary instruments.

5ec2028cbb9820faa524648a9b21fb65312ab573.en: Izaki Gardenak, a Basque indie-rock and pop band, returns to Bilboko Kafe Antzokia on 5 November after a four-year break. The group launched the album Orube in 2024 and has toured since 2025.

0bda024bdc50de376b30d2e378ea79e14c11a5e6.en: The Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia runs a Spanish-language reading group on La luz negra. Two groups meet fortnightly from September to December, with 20 places per group allocated by lottery.

19acc6036a3f22ffcc401d350891c19a8e010808.en: Cine Club Santurtzi screens Yo no moriré de amor, a 2026 Spanish film by Marta Matute. Based on her own experience, it follows a young woman caring for her mother with early-onset Alzheimer's. A talk with La Rada Elkartea follows.

8253e7ac7d56cbc1fa106377d5f6b0397135e7de.en: Bilbao Seriesland 2026, the 12th edition of the International Digital Series Festival, runs from 5 to 8 November across several city venues. The programme includes screenings, pitching sessions and an awards gala at the Guggenheim Museum on 7 November.

143fcc3d83b770df03d374b7954fe3f4ec9fb22e.en: Euskal Herria koloretan presents 225 autochromes of the Basque Country from 1907 to 1935 at Euskal Museoa Bilbao. The exhibition is a collaboration with the Musée Basque in Bayonne and runs until 23 May 2027.

121315b6073abeda1c747a34cfe21fa9159eb07c.en: AFRIKARTE 2026, the eighth African cultural fair, takes place on 6 to 8 November at Plaza Rekalde in Bilbao. It features African crafts, fashion, music, cinema and workshops, with a focus on memory and equality.

f15e359ce92487e9d11eeb313a0fec2127f10d90.en: Diario de naturaleza is a botanical illustration workshop at Librería Naubis in Bilbao. Participants learn observation and drawing techniques and design a field-journal page. It lasts two to two and a half hours and costs 15 euros, with materials included.

ee37e80190a63b491d272b755c327531ac6824dc.en: Inés Bengoa tells Japanese Kamishibai stories at Barakaldo's Arteagabeitia library as part of Bazen Behin 2026. The storytelling session is for children aged 5 to 8.

69d2cbb958be23d85adf2ba4a0f7d987354dfa6e.en: Track 1 Fest 2026 takes place at Merkatu Zaharra in Bilbao on 6 and 7 November. Bands on the bill include Vaultage, Putakaska, Turbofuckers, MCD, Deklibe, Kagando Melodias and Bandazo.

8d6dafd1b90a4dcd51894c4bdeb41a5ee238f382.en: Camerata Lírica presents El humor de la ópera at the Escuela de Música de Sestao. Four solo singers and a pianist perform comic scenes from the operatic repertoire for a family audience.

b144aa49908b0d77d1d167073639c014e12793d5.en: The Bilbao Municipal Band's 2026-27 concert Caminos, conducted by Beatriz Fernández Aucejo, is at the Conservatorio Juan Crisóstomo de Arriaga. The programme includes Bernstein's Candide Overture and Brotons's Symphony No. 7, Ausiàs March.

d302a58950b1bb9a5fbc64a40d006ce4229c6959.en: Paco Farero presents his photography career, with a focus on landscape and night photography, at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea in Sopela. The talk is part of the Sopela Photography Days from 6 to 8 November.

09ba7f370b74e66f553e5830b8933e2d3c89fb0b.en: A musical bertso session features the improvisers Miren Artetxe, Unai Mendiburu and Maddi Ane Txoperena, with Araitz Bizkai and Oihana Landa. It is organised by the Algorta Bertso School.

8c344bc6e46e62aa316b8e824cf008ef94b8ca6e.en: The Mila Musika Haria 2026 guitar competition, its 14th edition, takes place on 6 November at Instituto Bertendona in Bilbao. Guitarists Mnkyoung Jeon and Markel Intxaurre Onaindia are among the competitors.

2155cda56a412e72c8b990a97697c3c2b07d9c0a.en: El humor en la ópera is a family show by Camerata Lírica, celebrating comic opera and Mozart. It features selections from Così fan tutte, Il barbiere di Siviglia and L'elisir d'amore, sung by four soloists with piano.

e8c93cbc912d0bef80c5527e19db91fe995f18fa.en: Leonora is a poetic stage piece by Alberto Conejero about the surrealist painter Leonora Carrington. It draws on her memoirs and focuses on her youth and her time in Spain after the Civil War. Natalia Huarte performs it at Sala BBK.

4305a5bb263de8a9036ccc89e190fe44c8cf5e5a.en: Supremme de Luxe's Intimísimo at Teatro Campos Elíseos is an improvised cabaret. Audience members share confessions, and the performer answers them in real time through music, with a live female band.

3e3c9c8e01c04f2d3e97f73263001d53318a2b95.en: Bailaor@, premiering in the Basque Country at Teatro Barakaldo, is listed with a description about how far people can change and whether the past shapes the future. The text describes a theatre piece in a prologue and four parts that follows a couple.

c5680a2fb09ae986e21aed6d13ca8f655d5daab9.en: Interview, a show by Telmo Irureta at Muxikebarri in Getxo, grows out of the short film De agua y arena. The actor, who has cerebral palsy, shares his life story in a live interview that mixes humour and emotion.

ce8f5c04887b55f4a77bae5015a3e4a67fd68d2b.en: Tres noches en Ítaca, a tragicomedy by Alberto Conejero, premieres at the Santurtzi Theatre Festival. Three sisters travel to Greece to bury their mother, who left her family to live on the island of Ithaca.

23a0d8fe07c6675b1e56dccf89923c2f3b8a14fe.en: Sergi Polo brings English stand-up comedy to Teatro Campos Elíseos in Bilbao on 6 November. The Barcelona-born comedian performs entirely in English and has played The Comedy Store in London.

c2d0abec77289bdd0b8249ceff1f022dbfd7c1d8.en: El rey Lear is a minimalist, irreverent version of Shakespeare's play by the Portuguese company, staged at Kultur Leioa. Three actors play all the roles in an 80-minute production directed by José C. García.

6a2dc0d5ebe1451c9a311ceeae49e618ac17cd4f.en: El agente secreto is screened at Romo Kultur Etxea in Getxo as part of the film club. Set in Brazil in 1977, the film follows a fugitive technology expert who arrives in Recife during carnival.

070ca6154d1099a93cb4e5da67ae243a03c5da17.en: Go Cactus perform their new album Vidas Modelo at Cotton Club in Bilbao. The concert is a live show with energetic renditions of their songs.

c4f4a529a25dc7bedfb3dcbf79b4b54a5abbaeba.en: Las Fellini, a comic cabaret company from Bilbao, opens a new phase at La Sinsorga feminist cultural space. The show mixes lip-synced musical numbers, improvisation and social criticism.

7a455b178f674aa3a4ae27614c59ac3a0dc2bc1b.en: El Kanka brings his La Calma tour to Santana 27 in Bilbao on 6 November. The Málaga-born singer-songwriter presents songs from his new album, after the acoustic release Las Canciones.

4b42d37a60d0b509d24d713ad8899137daba461a.en: Muerdo's Volver a donde nacen las canciones at Azkena is a stripped-back version of the Ibero-American singer's biggest songs. He alternates guitars, keyboards and winds with one multi-instrumentalist.

4df929b69b2b4be02dd00fc6c85aaca62ef13a92.en: Raimundo El Canastero, a flamenco singer known for a deep, emotional voice, performs at Bilboko Kafe Antzokia on 6 November. His music combines flamenco tradition with a personal style.

6763325d40f0c1178e23e78929ba4308bbcc8b9e.en: The Jury Experience: Muerte por IA is an interactive courtroom drama at Sociedad Filarmónica de Bilbao. The audience acts as the jury and decides whether the case is guilty or not guilty, after an autonomous car kills someone.

a3a4ea8fd285247577836d43d0a3fd757f996e05.en: MAZ Basauri 2026 on 6 November features Rufus T. Firefly and Maika Makovski at Social Antzokia, with Reeler opening. Maika Makovski marks 20 years of her career with a live double album.

012471b9fe240446ac71277005f6b9a5733d29a9.en: Jardín Barroco, an exhibition by Aitana Rodríguez, is on display at Casa Torre de Ariz from 16 October to 13 November. A guided visit with the artist takes place on 6 November.

451dbb63b7bab6bbd5506fe9119e2f67dfdda447.en: The 14th MAZ Basauri festival runs on 6 and 7 November, with paid concerts at Social Antzokia and free street shows. The line-up includes La Bien Querida, Rufus T. Firefly, Maika Makovski and Fernando Alfaro.

8d49ffcd583698abb0258148f425517be3a0cee4.en: The Humedad neighbourhood fiestas in Algorta run from 6 to 8 November 2026. The full programme is available as a separate document.

a67a10bb96a272859a128d1b9512b9e9d4bc8173.en: Ertibil Bizkaia 2026, the 44th edition of the exhibition, presents work by 18 emerging artists from Bizkaia. It opens at Sala Rekalde in Bilbao and then travels to Barakaldo, Basauri and Igorre.

b58741fb12d62f499e31dd39ed100a4f225e95da.en: Izartxo is a reading workshop in Basque for children, run in several towns of Uribe Kosta from 7 to 21 November. The sessions are held in Urduliz, Lemoiz, Gorliz, Barrika, Plentzia and Sopela.

369b79d08c42b4c6b723c5717e74b744e3dfd697.en: La Trend Bilbao 2026 brings the urban music night of JC Reyes and local DJs to the CUBEC hall at Bilbao Exhibition Centre on 7 November. The event is open to holders of the Bono Cultural.

01ad457f37298f371ea2970775cec7da260341ed.en: Oniro is a visual theatre piece with masks and puppets at Torrezabal Kultur Etxea. A ten-year-old girl must overcome her insomnia and learn that fear is part of growing up.

99429fac67e262ccd682b7cbedcb5434023697a3.en: Xabier Amuriza gives a talk marking the 50th anniversary of the death of the bertsolari Xalbador, at the Casino in Laudio. The event is organised by Laudio council and Lanku Bertso Zerbitzuak.

b24b40585cddf4c18e02892e357b3cf03b0bb035.en: Qué difícil es is a comedy-drama for audiences aged 12 and over at Teatro Campos Elíseos. Four actors explore bullying, sexual diversity, depression and suicide through humour, puppets and shadow theatre.

913f2721262e5c2897eb6d653e09811245673466.en: David Blanco's Extrasensorial at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a mentalism show about psychic powers. Based on Enrique Echazarra's book on the boundary between magic and the paranormal, it mixes humour and sarcasm with illusions.

67f7abdbbd3744e91b5afa9f6c008d4802eb2d6b.en: El cebo is a 1958 German thriller directed by Ladislao Vajda, screened in the Klasikoak 2026 cycle. A dead girl is found in a Swiss forest, and suspicion falls on an elderly travelling salesman.

3ce2fba1c790399708cf59a9eae6fbf3734aa1cb.en: The second Azarock festival takes place at Orbeko Etxea in Laudio on 7 November, featuring punk, hardcore, trash and stoner bands. Entry costs 7 euros and the concert starts at 19:00.

2396eddb7cfc5604484904539aa3117bbae26458.en: Laura Vital and guitarist David Caro perform the album Pura Vida at Instituto Bertendona in Bilbao on 7 November, as part of Mila Musika Haria 2026. The flamenco singer from Sanlúcar presents a stripped-back, sincere sound.

bc5b83a98f2c9d09d45c502b054cad193a6e018d.en: Euskadiko Orkestra presents Aita Donostia's incidental music for La vie profonde de Saint François d'Assise, conducted by Ernest Martínez Izquierdo with tenor Luken Munguira and the Easo choirs. The work is a heritage revival by the Basque friar and composer.

5253c38c25d97269bb632fd397b045d08a293588.en: Pareja abierta is a comedy at Berango Antzokia that updates the classic play about love, fidelity and modern relationships. It uses humour to explore polyamory, open relationships and the influence of social media.

6a3049019314e740b035350276d51caef90b9d29.en: Lohi Gorria is a solo play at Lonbo Aretoa about a man rebuilding his identity through memories of his gay uncle, persecuted under Hitler and Franco. Actor Aitor Pérez performs under the direction of Javier Liñera.

6a69477a6da1b4405d0cd682d95067b08679ba40.en: Recién casados is a comedy at Gorbea Aretoa in Ortuella, part of Ortuellan Kulturaz Blai 2026. It mixes sketches, improvisation and audience interaction around marriage, infidelity and second chances.

8a180085938f94e33e737e678400bd6fbde90ca4.en: PuroIndie is a tribute band playing songs by Spanish indie acts such as Supersubmarina, Vetusta Morla, Izal, Los Planetas and Arde Bogotá. The show takes place at Azkena.

b249dbe708b8e5c8739897e36d84f2cf1aae53b7.en: The tribute bands Sepulnation and Kaizoku perform at D8 Sorkuntza Faktoria on 7 November.

2ac7be832db9d3648391891f3ca4cdd0000d35f7.en: Charlas de azucarillo is a comic motivational talk by the duo Las Couchers at Teatro Barakaldo. Two eccentric characters offer absurd techniques for peace of mind and love, with the audience taking part.

0018abf0ec837459c0c9a7bd0460d6773f767461.en: Herentzia is a thriller-like tragedy by Kulunka Teatro at Muxikebarri in Getxo. A couple spends their last night together in a bedroom, trying to make sense of a traumatic event and their fear.

d2927c7558918f83a405cffcfbfb8c5678d9b8cb.en: The Jamie Baum Quartet plays JazzOn Fest 2026 at JAZZON Aretoa in Bilbao. The group features flute, piano, double bass and drums.

aa5a9a4242faddde8e84ca400e484d7f8d42e5af.en: La Odisea by Companhia do Chapitô is a 60-minute comedy at Serantes Kultur Aretoa. It parodies Homer's epic through the quarrels of a dysfunctional family of gods on Olympus.

3f9a72cb3a9af89dd8555f7ed85e87f5703e7e01.en: Green River Tribute plays the songs of Creedence Clearwater Revival at the Crazy Horse in Bilbao. The show covers blues, country and rock from one of the defining bands of the 20th century.

3aa09883ba967db10b8a6889b45683df461316e1.en: SÔBER and Sweet Rage play Santana 27 in Bilbao on 7 November.

2a502ca05be08f4646fb99b5cca1f05b2db7523a.en: Luz María Carriquiry presents Mujer sin miedo, an intimate concert with guitar, charango and voice at La Sinsorga. She performs her own songs and poems alongside works by Latin American women songwriters.

a5b520be0b8c48b4542bf305850b98df955e8142.en: Las Novias and Serch. play Sala Groove in Portugalete on 7 November.

57a4f0447aaa525f0841774d12aa986a641be50a.en: Canción y reflejo is a project for two pianos and two voices by Nerea Arrieta and Gasti Seguí. The set blends original compositions, reinterpreted songs, jazz, Latin American folk rhythms and improvisation.

4a09cbe610d66a2a47e30079a660dd9a733a40fb.en: Candlelight Bilbao presents a 60-minute tribute combining Ed Sheeran and Coldplay hits, performed by a string ensemble. Seats are assigned on arrival, and the concert is suitable for ages 8 and over.

68b1a8c299f827571aac7abd1c1c97ff14dbfe7a.en: Marquitos plays Santana 27 in Bilbao on 7 November.

6bf782758b10ba7f459d0e97bdd0fdfcd864fdc3.en: Carmen 113 presents her new album Mañanas de euforia at Bilborock on 7 November.

fe829fec15a1fc23fc2c695c90fa8dd6b513dc81.en: Ger, a 30-year-old comedian known for viral mini-monologues, performs at Teatro Campos Elíseos. Ger is also an actor, author and podcast presenter, and is part of the LGBTIQ+ community.

2c2bec4c954ab0c3760f3f19f0cc20935c96838f.en: Los Brazos celebrate 15 years at Bilboko Kafe Antzokia on 7 November.

9df4d7cd079493294620a7ce695845aed63bdeb8.en: Despoblados is a play with music at Kultur Leioa about the abandonment of rural Spain. It is based on poems by Andrés Martín Domínguez, and text and songs carry the scenes.

f7250d70f828ead81a3ce17426fd3db218a42e09.en: MAZ Basauri 2026 features La Bien Querida and Fernando Alfaro at Social Antzokia. Fernando Alfaro will preview songs from his upcoming solo album Convento Freak, produced by Fernando Vacas.

1b717ccd6c4c3f6a765b932eef54e161e2c3ac60.en: The free MAZ Basauri street concerts on the afternoon of 7 November feature Silkat, Reeler and Monos. Monos are from Getxo and released the EP Pensamientos cayendo al vacío in 2025.

3b6c496dfa0f05f1a388285afb7eeb8160e1aaae.en: Txiki MAZ on 7 November in Basauri offers a DJ workshop by Juan Solo, the storytelling concert Ongi etorri paradisura by Perli eta Koxkolo, and a set by Nuria Culla. The events are free and held in Solobarria in case of rain.

3a8294ac147987cf24b51b432d0d372cd0840f2f.en: A working day with the photographer Paco Farero at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea on Saturday continues the Sopela photography days. Farero explains his technique, workflow and decisions from planning to final processing.

08343054caeba441cf2895f3d86fda4321d5f4d7.en: Matraka ma non tropo is a musical show for all ages using instruments made from discarded objects. It addresses climate change and recycling, and tickets are available through Traka Matraka.

5a9e2c43ee4c471e96f07314ac87e9cf978d1904.en: Abao Txiki's Soñando el carnaval de los animales at Teatro Arriaga is a dramatised concert for ages 4 and up. Puppets of a lion, a turtle and a swan accompany music by Saint-Saëns and Debussy.

dd9bc69e7921cd4c7a71b90eae79b3f97e3c7d37.en: Esto iba a ser la oportunidad y ha terminado siendo mi primera despedida is a solo minimalist piece by Mauricio Pérez Fayos at La Fundición. It portrays a generation stuck between unfulfilled goals and abandoned dreams.

7d53f5597d79bb1be6604d03e9af3302bfca134a.en: The visitable storage space at Euskal Museoa Bilbao shows how museum collections are protected and managed. Ceramics, clothing, furniture and photographs are displayed, along with the reasons each object needs its own care.

01524eb34661f2da049f25366787552823db9496.en: Euskal Museoa Bilbao and AIKO Taldea have signed an agreement to bring Basque traditional dance to the museum. The partnership promotes practice and teaching of dance from all seven Basque territories.

3730355c37df1223d346091ef878728ad2c96e99.en: La Bella y la Bestia is a family musical at Teatro Campos Elíseos about seeing differences with empathy. A blind actress plays Belle, and the show promotes inclusion and respect. It won a Broadwayworld award in 2023.

fa82cbf5dae010a4db8cb272d6b3ceebcdd14f3f.en: Crea tus propios colores is a family workshop at BIGGER Arte y Desarrollo on 8 November, from 12:00 to 13:30. Participants make natural dyes and colours from leaves, shells, earth and stones, for 15 euros including materials.

90e07e595e6b8d82d3715179e77fb170436f7610.en: RRUCCULLA performs at TAC 2026, the urban architecture festival in Sestao. The percussion-based project blends live instruments with digital production, audiovisual installations and sound design.

77301c8ee9f5fba307078c2dce7e9659ea6c737a.en: Beee is a family theatre show at the Centro Cívico de Cruces, part of Barakaldo's 2026 family performing arts programme. An elderly couple buys a sheep with their last coin, and the story celebrates traditional crafts.

9bb3693022f98219fd3b49f957814db4ae46d69f.en: Little Amelie is a 77-minute film screened at Muxikebarri in Getxo. It follows a toddler's first years, from learning language to discovering her family and the world, and is suitable for all ages.

0e1dc8196b94638b0882356813772e3715007e54.en: Hodei guztien gainetik is a family theatre piece at Lonbo Aretoa. A father who has forgotten how to play is taken on a journey by a vagrant angel among cardboard clouds, and is recommended for ages 3 and over.

7ee59eed31eb884209d7e8bf72dad5e09d6806a8.en: Deustuko Folklore Taldeak perform at Plaza San Pedro in Deusto as part of Dantza Plazetan 2026. The free programme of Basque folk dance runs across Bilbao's neighbourhoods during the year.

17467e7747ea2fa5be97e0f8a8eb681a1493b5c0.en: Jirafa is a dance, puppet and projection show at Muxikebarri in Getxo. A clumsy giraffe who loves dancing learns that persistence and creativity matter more than perfection.

e974fb4537d1f4d0daab7f796e946b80f812eb21.en: Jordi Merca's stand-up show Yo sobreviví a la EGB at Teatro Campos Elíseos revisits the 1980s childhood of Spain's EGB school generation, with humour and music.

9a0aea678df7cd891617a42ec10b2d6287bf524f.en: Michael Schenker MSG, featuring vocalist Robin McAuley, plays Santana 27 in Bilbao. The evening starts at 18:30 with the opening act and the main artist performs at 20:00.

aa81d2f77586cc54929d0aa9fa4423d5a62770c9.en: Anöa is a 50-minute contemporary dance piece by Elvi Balboa at Torrezabal Kultur Etxea. Five performers explore vulnerability, pressure and catharsis through movement and voice.

ee61cb43eca235cf60e9a4b209d9adddf0168219.en: Imperial Crystalline Entombment play Sala Groove in Portugalete on 8 November.

e011c13e81bbfbd84ac8c6cb1fa649a6080c6d61.en: Non solum is a solo show by Sergi López at Serantes Kultur Aretoa, part of the Santurtzi Theatre Festival. A man confronts his many inner voices in a 70-minute mix of humour, boleros, poetry and absurdity.

7f9c0150b3f243747cd53cf080ae77d292934485.en: Pedro Pastor performs at Bilboko Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 8 November.

6ed78f5d9a2d580fef17e94fde6a60bf71033f45.en: El diputado (1978) is screened at Golem Alhóndiga as part of the Azkuna Zentroa cycle on transition-era filmmakers. After being elected deputy in 1977, a former clandestine militant is blackmailed over his homosexuality.

560badd20323d9011d1cf5929696950eba4bb2bd.en: Vámonos Bárbara (1978) screens at Golem Alhóndiga in the transition-era film cycle. A woman separates from her husband and goes on holiday with her 12-year-old daughter, in one of the first Spanish films to address divorce.

16cb6eccf117762ea638affcd782a6585e2bca9c.en: El crimen de Cuenca (1980), directed by Pilar Miró, screens at Golem Alhóndiga in the transition-era film cycle. It retells the 1913 case of two men who confessed under torture, and it was censored in its time.

e64a8c725224b77a3e4a9d922527b18043c226b4.en: Zinexit 2026, the 16th human rights film festival, runs from 9 to 13 November at the Golem cinemas in Azkuna Zentroa. Each film is followed by an open debate, in the style of a cine forum.

90ab61fa7704212c2452f1bc8e91f0546294d9e2.en: The 14th Thinking Football Film Festival opens at Sala BBK on 9 November with Kenny Dalglish, directed by Asif Kapadia. Nine feature films and one short are screened until 14 November.

62429ac4478b80bd369606f068ffc9f0352336c8.en: Ane Gebara tells stories to children at the Torrezabal children's library in Galdakao. The Tuesday sessions in October and November are free and start at 18:00.

ecef0a94e1bc47fcc556c312fd5917d88c53799c.en: La aventura del Poseidón is screened at Mamariga Kulturgunea as part of the library's Endangered film cycle for the last quarter of 2026.

9ac9dcde2dd387a912dc8d4b753f16a5c68a728f.en: Isa Duque presents her book AMOR(ES) at La Sinsorga feminist space. The psychologist and sex therapist examines healthy relationships and the myths of romantic love from a feminist perspective.

a93a22314f6b4a71a75f1e4ed8ee1fa0d6a8bd83.en: Aixe Getxo 2026 is the 16th edition of the annual cultural awards in Getxo. Invitations for the ceremony can be collected from 5 October at RKE or Muxikebarri.

e5841d5a67887c4101d9e52d1f27c3facf24b21a.en: Jaime Ferraro's stand-up show Fraude satirises his bid for the Peruvian presidency. The comedian presents his proposals to save the country and his strategy to win over voters.

5ea555eba98083ae55ea0f6534cf20378d192bd4.en: The Del Fuegos play Bilboko Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 10 November.

77a9157e339170390591e5c53d589f82de27b894.en: Vida acuática, Ferroluar is an interactive exhibition at Rialia Museo de la Industria on an underwater world. The show is presented as a unique aquatic environment.

bf3544d367817b1ca7b97ae4e848554d53c7fa38.en: Gabriel Pérez-Barreiro gives a talk at the Bilbao Fine Arts Museum on 11 November about the new American republics of the 19th century. The talk accompanies the exhibition Visiones de ultramar, from the Patricia Phelps de Cisneros Collection.

3c99cace1da6a9f5fec97d177d73691230d4ce8b.en: Film Sozialak 2026, the international invisible cinema festival, screens at Teatro Barakaldo. The festival focuses on films about social challenges, with fiction, documentaries and animation.

0fce911c4cfa7654f83298739415b5e29aad3591.en: José Rafael Guzmán presents his stand-up show Cositas bonitas at Teatro Campos Elíseos in Bilbao on 11 November. The show is a tragicomic look at human nature, from family to ageing.

339b7a6ecbdfbbc40bb24497cab8b58ce0aede95.en: Diálogos imprescindibles del cómic at AZ Azkuna Zentroa discusses Monster by Naoki Urasawa. The Komikteka session examines this psychological thriller about guilt, identity and evil.

008ce32a2e4c0f578a7633ec3b8033800095b1f7.en: Dan Flavin: Algo de luz at the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao presents fluorescent light works from the 1960s to the 1980s. The show highlights his early work and his role in Minimalism.

ae978281a4d6fb4603a31374e8ed37c8a90d7d7a.en: The BASOA reading club discusses El libro azul de Nebo at Ekoetxea in Meatzaldea. The group reflects on nature, sustainability and the future of the local area.

0d42bb2cf4e9dece7a6215a94f2bc25624890723.en: El sendero azul is a gender-focused film forum at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea. A 77-year-old Brazilian woman refuses to be sent to a remote colony for retirees and takes a journey through the Amazon.

e869c6a207b6bc6041a892994dff75fe702d45c8.en: The third session of Mujeres e industria musical takes place at Marienea in Basauri on 12 November at 18:30. It is part of MAZ Basauri 2026 and gathers women who share experiences in the music industry.

70f3a13d6c932de746eb6eacbdf5d18590409bbc.en: Teoría King Kong, the stage version of Virginie Despentes's feminist essay, is performed at AZ Azkuna Zentroa. Maria Pau Pigem stars in a 75-minute monologue directed by Isis Martín.

d40c3d15d3d17eab668e7df81e716783bae86030.en: Aquí no paga nadie is a satirical comedy at Otxarkoaga Municipal Centre in Bilbao, part of Bilboko Zirkuitua 2026. Two women rebel against systemic abuse, while their husbands try to stop them.

b2637a1427be2e34e686d8a8b2028faa3a0ea5b6.en: Dormir fuera de casa, the novel by Paula Hoyos, is discussed at the Algorta culture hall. The story follows four strangers stranded by a cancelled flight from Rome to Barcelona.

6eb7c80429b19b9e0c8aba7655dc5915755ef797.en: Homeless Film Festival 2026 screens a programme of short films at Bizkaia Aretoa. The selection includes official section works and films produced by Bizitegi.

7bed52d4c579ba5dac7413d519b5532b6dc64cce.en: El ser querido is a drama at Muxikebarri in Getxo, shown as part of Zinemabarri. A famous director offers his estranged daughter a role on his new film, which reopens old wounds.

619369228cebf6f5b70949daa3677cd1dc505221.en: Fórmula V performs its hit songs at Teatro Campos Elíseos in Bilbao on 12 November. The band, led by Paco Pastor, plays classics such as Cuéntame and Vacaciones de verano.

987addbd8d4a50aa2187fa2eb74b2c2d2df239e5.en: Félix Rossy Sextet plays JAZZON Aretoa in Bilbao. Trumpeter Félix Rossy, son of the drummer Jorge Rossy, leads a group of musician friends with intricate harmonies and improvisation.

a4675fb6fcd61ef73c030d8a10ddff37c9a99c54.en: Disección de la bondad en tres actos is a magic-based farce at Serantes Kultur Aretoa, part of the Santurtzi Theatre Festival. Three stories about deception and the nature of truth are built with the audience.

275e4a2f8ac5b5a521038cac40fa6a689e627c1d.en: Baz Francis plays Bilbao on 12 November. The UK-based singer-songwriter and founding member of Magic Eight Ball and Mansion Harlots plays rock and soul.

ba3bce33f77543cc08568c4fe18d29cfcdd526e8.en: Tiwayo performs at Bilboko Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 12 November.

adbc347d570688007be654def9e4565e25cb9b97.en: Chiquita Movida play Bilboko Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 12 November.

3c921441aed297265556a833c789a3882809fbd8.en: La Carn, a 2025 experimental film by Joan Porcel, is shown as a special preview at the Bilbao multiplex as part of Dantzaldia 2026. It mixes fiction, documentary and performance, and follows a young man's search for connection online.

3504f8b54750986ca9567653ab157a909f28e6d3.en: Bazen Behin 2026 features Nere Ariznabarreta telling legends from Sioux, Tunisian and Basque cultures at Barakaldo's Arteagabeitia library. The 60-minute session, with live music, is for children aged 5 to 8.

8987272d0cef6409f9629a7d86aa8b7464777304.en: Ibarrola: Cubos de la memoria is a workshop at Centro Cultural Santa Clara, part of Euskaraz gozatu. Children aged 8 to 12 study Agustín Ibarrola's painted concrete blocks in Llanes and make their own, with 16 places.

cde584b76dc035aecf99eb9ac7cb3574f3ea7a18.en: Musika galduaren bila is a storytelling session by Eneko Etxebarrieta at Portugalete's municipal library on 13 November. It is aimed at children aged 4 to 7.

0a0f0b8a88d8aa030732de264bafa5f9807751f5.en: Marco Flores presents Cante, guitarra y baile at the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao as part of Dantzaldia 2026. The recital traces flamenco styles such as cantiñas, bulerías and siguiriyas with a Cádiz accent.

d0dd9661dcb7ad0c7e1807f81a3f73f434f3a92a.en: Cambia las proporciones is a collage workshop at Sopa de Sapo for young people and adults aged 14 and over. Participants combine three images and a simple premise to learn the technique.

f38085dbeb121b19b06e22f9db2c4ae7df180a66.en: Beast in Black, Sonata Arctica and Frozen Crown play Santana 27 in Bilbao. The three power metal bands share a bill for a night of heavy metal.

0db71a460d34018a7a8c2057f43582ea18d99e0c.en: Como nos reímos is a storytelling session at the Algorta culture hall, part of the Club de los Cuentistas programme. Adults can tell or listen to stories, and entry is free.

2573bbcbbda68652e373ecfbb526bb698ff5597f.en: Empty Files play the Sestao TAC 2026 urban architecture festival. The Bilbao electronic project, formed in 2013, draws on post-industrial electronica, psychedelia and trip-hop and released A Beginning to an End in 2024.

8e233a4caed8ab9efd70d80a31ec6895845e7019.en: Loratu Quartet, four women musicians from the Pamplona area, perform at Instituto Bertendona in Bilbao on 13 November as part of Mila Musika Haria 2026. The string quartet reinterprets chamber music.

0b2be0482f2550a4eeb5e802237c9999d26866c1.en: The Bilbao Symphonic Accordion Orchestra performs La emoción con los fuelles de Bilbao at the Sestao music school. The orchestra, founded more than 60 years ago, plays arrangements of classical and popular works.

87260ade5e0f2c207c7722edc163a3789f8bbc73.en: Vulcanizadas present their new album at La Sinsorga feminist space. The meeting includes talk about the creation process, listening to songs and videos, and a short acoustic set.

a5dcb97b9ae8178e48a132853ca0a233c43afe21.en: Sacralidad del alma, a poetry collection by Cristina Díez López, is presented at Centro Cultural Santa Clara.

4fce25df01358f17677934384c2a3b42bde5fa5d.en: Señoras y señoras is a feminist pop show by journalists María Guerra and Mariola Cubells at Teatro Campos Elíseos. It celebrates women born in the 1960s through personal stories, humour and audiovisual material.

b2088be47632be7bc53805b990526eec2312a287.en: In illo tempore is a flamenco show and double album by Mayte Martín at Teatro Barakaldo. It gathers more than two decades of her singing, in classical and innovative styles, 25 years after her album Querencia.

79f89f21de015b2f5c85edbdb7c9b311d225116e.en: El ventrílocuo is a solo show by Jaime Figueroa at Muxikebarri in Getxo. He brings to life a range of characters and objects, from a scrap of paper to a gospel-singing vulture.

8afc8df388fc8d2dea60a6e11578d3c2e27a2001.en: La loca historia del Siglo de Oro is a comic show by La Escalera de Tijera and Z Teatro at Serantes Kultur Aretoa. It satirises the Golden Age and figures like Góngora, Quevedo and Cervantes through clown, circus and live music.

cbfd72175aeeb0a51015b8b033f9890f7aa0ce28.en: Disección de la bondad en tres actos is staged at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea. A magician and performers use illusion and three stories to explore the nature of truth, in a farce built with the audience.

e86cd9f7745ee3dd7a20b0350f62fbd994c6311b.en: Bryan Adams performs at Bizkaia Arena - BEC on 13 November 2026, on his Roll With The Punches tour. The Canadian rock singer-songwriter is known for his distinctive voice and international hits.

053592cab47dc5b0fd610d0530ceb3c955228e80.en: Marta Soto plays Cotton Club in Bilbao. The Andalusian singer-songwriter, who first gained attention through social media covers, performs sincere pop songs.

7d33c5589ea3b1cb7fae6b733d7ef6ce561e5bdc.en: Denom play Santana 27 in Bilbao on 13 November.

6891755e4c8d014d4158b3b608b434b339561ff9.en: Aimar Cid and Martes 18 play Azkena in Bilbao on 13 November.

e1f04effbd0393ba3014c2333f86e5b843edb99c.en: Buenas noches in the night is a stand-up comedy show led by Uruguayan comedian Facu Díaz at Teatro Campos Elíseos. A cast of comedians takes the stage with a microphone, a stool and a lot of stories.

ed616a1da3b532e9055650ef7eebce710e5a598b.en: Avancarga and Sanngre play live at the Zorroza Gaztetxe, held at D8 Sorkuntza Faktoria, on 13 November.

ccbefe01aa602bdf4a61132104b6507b82e54ca1.en: +dMANÁ, a tribute band to Maná, performs its Amar es combatir 20th anniversary show at Bilboko Kafe Antzokia. The show recreates the 2007 Spanish tour with songs such as Rayando el sol.

2acc0610a90c5515d57915fcb4ad22fa53c5547b.en: Triángulo de Amor Bizarro play Stage Live in Bilbao on 13 November, on their Mi Catedral Tour.

d24c24b3aeaf29372acf25625166c402664449f6.en: Kandida is a theatre piece by Patxo Telleria at Kultur Leioa. A novelist is visited by an evicted older woman who inspired a character in her book, and she has to take her in.

afb2e5a30e04ab2ddd8172dc0212bd1dd7b94eba.en: Titizé: A Venetian Dream is a visual, poetic show by Compagnia Finzi Pasca at Teatro Arriaga. Eleven artists use clown, acrobatics and stage machines in a dreamlike Venice, with performances from 13 to 15 November.

e8fed533ddf1c8069613912135203b98eb7be2eb.en: Pinceladas silvestres is a workshop at which participants make watercolours and brushes from kitchen scraps and wild plants. No previous experience is needed.

e414760426285a758034fe31cd8be58dd1b47190.en: Metal United Fest 2026 is the first edition of a metal festival at D8 Sorkuntza Faktoria. It features Azrael, Mandragora Negra, BudaSam and Mala Decisión.

9dec6cee0289df59cf03af83138c2a7df0b746b7.en: Semaforoa is a family show by Logela at Casa de Cultura Clara Campoamor, part of Barakaldo's 2026 family arts programme. A boy who ignores traffic lights is drawn into a dreamlike world of characters.

65b5b63be16ad73c3a89471aeb817e8f942034fe.en: Maurice Ravel: un compositor con alma vasca is a concert at Kultur Leioa. Its centrepiece is Ravel's Piano Trio in A minor, written in San Juan de Luz and based on the zortziko rhythm.

88761587cace23ad482d06e6bf611ea17e6664a5.en: Bodas de sangre is an amateur adult theatre production in Spanish at Berango Antzokia.

707c3cd671782361ccaffb8e7053c0ce10767b1f.en: Queen Kelly, Erich von Stroheim's 1929 silent-era drama, is screened in the Klasikoak 2026 cycle at the Museo de Bellas Artes de Bilbao. A prince falls for a convent novice, Patricia Kelly, played by Gloria Swanson.

b8cf471c56566dc819b590fbb29c9fb02b7919c2.en: Amaia Santamaría and Haizea Murguía (Malabaricia) present an intimate concert at La Sinsorga, pairing songs with poems about anger and tenderness.

54889c15acd44900ca3af90f1743bf6c8a322a75.en: La llamaban loca is a comedy at Gorbea Aretoa in Ortuella, part of Ortuellan Kulturaz Blai 2026. A modern woman and her traditional housekeeper become close friends in 1970s Bilbao, despite a mysterious relationship.

59ae65bd1fa0b471fae0ca9c54e4ffe5e62105ea.en: Blow Up Fest 2026 takes place on 14 November at Santana 27 in Bilbao. The line-up includes Swedish garage rock band The Nomads and Madrid's Sex Museum on their 40th-anniversary tour.

1cdbbdc24e96ebc42dc3c42d0ccdb6255d5fbf8c.en: Jorge Santos's Todos locos is a comedy monologue at Teatro Campos Elíseos about mental health. It turns everyday anxieties, quirks and self-demands into humour.

3b2d9b1de8fcc00de00e68bbe3e6278590aa6046.en: On Time, a dance programme in three pieces by three choreographers, premieres in the Basque Country at Teatro Barakaldo. The show features dancers with and without disabilities, and explores time.

1357c5f89a3fd46490fd31b628360c19ab415a59.en: Binguera is a stage piece at Utopian that evokes a bingo hall full of faded characters. Its drab, grotesque atmosphere mixes slot-machine noise with tacky glamour, and it is presented as a portrait of life there.

f471e7f2aa183cc8ebc2769c59b811c1f043898d.en: A.I. (Amalur Indarra) by Lucia Lacarra Ballet, staged at Muxikebarri in Getxo, imagines a dystopian future where artificial intelligence suppresses human creativity. The dancer Amalur tries to reconnect people with the earth.

fd82a8862fe7cab31f967320d8eb93d0edee1e82.en: JazzOn Fest 2026 features Kaleidoscope and Eva Fernández at JAZZON Aretoa in Bilbao. The quartet of saxophones, double bass and drums plays jazz with vocals.

a6ae5c88abc0a9a0c5314466b7e2811a4b838434.en: El hijo de la cómica is a Santurtzi Theatre Festival piece at Serantes Kultur Aretoa. Drawn from memoirs about the actor Fernán-Gómez, it recalls family stories and voices from Spain's past.

5680a1fad8eaa4a514fa30de73473a32afdbf797.en: Anabel Lee plays Azkena in Bilbao on 14 November.

f49f9d3f682ef192735d2e1baa9411cc097e8ae7.en: Knives, Burial Ruthless and Stigma play Sala Groove in Portugalete on 14 November.

442863de03af0c8d0c0583d1efcbd7172926e2ac.en: JP Fernandez's Sombras y Destellos tour stops at Santana 27 in Bilbao. The Spanish urban music artist presents songs about love and everyday experiences, with visuals and lights.

5ddce5b85c5f82179f69350bedcbedca9080c259.en: Amann & The Wayard Sons, presenting their new album Air Creation, and Little Swine play Bilborock on 14 November.

f229147b88895b641c99cfd62e06fe624be030ab.en: Mansion's Cellar, a French psychedelic garage quintet from Douarnenez, plays La Atalaia del Gardoki. Its live sound mixes psychedelic rock with African instruments such as the saz.

4bd4f32fb331cce2cb57aabd2b324444e828a3a8.en: JP Fernandez plays Santana 27 in Bilbao on 14 November, on the Sombras y Destellos tour. The tour covers more than ten Spanish cities in 2026, with visuals and lights.

9fafcc72e1aea2714d7f8cb6714eda698a081f5f.en: El espíritu de la zarzuela is a light, comic zarzuela-style show about village misunderstandings, with musical numbers, for ages 14 and over.

998973fa451f878e630b5c15186a8a21200df837.en: The Rockein 2026 final takes place at Social Antzokia on 14 November. Doors open at 20:30 and the concerts start at 21:00, with entry by invitation.

f454c7e0e194f9326b1ca6681dbaa30b4aab42ce.en: Whodunnit? is a murder mystery game at the Archaeology Museum in Bilbao, part of Musekintza 2026. Three actors play the suspects, and the writer Mikel Santiago hosts the evening.

7b76c354d928bcc103fd0444b35fa5acd893b332.en: Dani Mateo's ¿Por qué no te callas? is a comedy show at Teatro Campos Elíseos. The comedian takes a satirical look at the state of humanity and online culture.

7603c2938c15fffb1aa524c269e04fc705eec910.en: Género de dudas is a comedy at Teatro Campos Elíseos by Jade-Rose Parker, directed by Gabriel Olivares. A political couple's stability is shaken by a letter and the news about their adopted daughter.

4bf00a017f05079e4101c2138151a32261745f4e.en: Evolution is a 2025 Spanish animated comedy screened at Muxikebarri in Getxo. An alien substance mixes the DNA of a girl and her pets, and they must work together to save the world.

dcfeda7ddcbb0c258f82597326a30ef400ed4fba.en: Tretatxu is a puppet show for ages 6 and up at Serantes Kultur Aretoa. It follows a mischievous boy who becomes a famous bandit after a childhood marked by hunger and injustice.

62653acf687dc0389f79f4af256f902584827ca2.en: Kayara. Inka gerraria is a Peruvian-Spanish film screened at Lonbo Aretoa. A young Inca woman dreams of joining the Chasqui messengers and challenges the gender norms of her society.

c3782c8511e7868180852f24dd40053690249e0d.en: Karim's Todo va a ir bien... o no is a comedy show at Teatro Campos Elíseos. It parodies tarot readings in a 70-minute performance that relies on audience interaction.

93a22bf8c42e5c6fc9fb42c578f092ecaf5e1a15.en: Gota is a street show by clown and magician Txema Muñoz for ages 4 and up, presented at Teatro Barakaldo. It mixes object manipulation, physical theatre and silent comedy, and won the MAX 2026 award for best street show.

76cec8f1cee9cd8c70852a086f0d51fb500312db.en: Bidutzi is a family show at Muxikebarri in Getxo for ages 3 and up. A small monster is trapped in a cage on Carnival night and must escape with the help of Ainara before the hunter returns.

8e2b699b5d5dd4ec20a9898c9ab1217dd2b9344a.en: Tor eta Txorroborro is a magic show for families at Berango Antzokia, with performers Tor and Txorroborro.

383c801836279b06f28c5455f29a4c515ce763c2.en: VOO / Vuelo is a physical theatre piece by Teatro O Cubo at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea, part of Camino Escena Norte 2026. Two characters try to fly, combining dance, music, visual poetry and object manipulation.

ffa0471c3a06d68c63e75e075f51e89bde497a15.en: Arrainak bihotzean is a children's theatre piece by Mar Mar for ages 3 and up. A boy is swept into the sea during a storm and must learn the language of fish and fears to return.

65f6603a365639c3e8a761c45eb1b2dae4dc41f3.en: Dirty Sound Magnet play D8 Sorkuntza Faktoria in Bilbao on 15 November.

c3b82b8aa70bdd3b122caf905d6ca4098e856cfe.en: El hijo de la cómica at Torrezabal Kultur Etxea is a theatre piece drawn from memoirs about the comedian Fernán-Gómez. It recalls family voices and stories of survival, dreams and ambition.

8ccd186e56820035f4bf10b40b6123c5a99ebcbf.en: Portrait play Sala Groove in Portugalete on 15 November.

b6f97a77d5e46719b8b51d867d7b95ce658f1b43.en: Miss Cosas y yo at Serantes Kultur Aretoa is a 70-minute show by Diana Pla Solina, part of the Santurtzi Theatre Festival. A lonely character blends theatre, clown, dance and stand-up as she tries to exist beyond the mind of her creator.

7bbf6d1fccef00599b09ef5a09a4af54330c8c23.en: Kuraia 2026-2027 presents Sonografia Irudipenak at the Conservatorio Juan Crisóstomo de Arriaga, as part of the contemporary music encounters.

1e268a9af539b03b113a4e084c4a2caf5419f079.en: The Bilbao Orkestra Sinfonikoa season 2026-2027 includes a programme by Gorka Hermosa and Tchaikovsky's Souvenir de Florence, Op. 70, at Palacio Euskalduna.

942533f05fc5663ba01e7aea011f4b0ce67a2352.en: Función de noche (1981) is screened at Golem Alhóndiga as part of the transition-era film cycle. An actress doing a nightly monologue begins to merge with the character she plays, while she argues with her estranged husband.

53049c3b1f64d0ee0293ef59252530c050dcbe4c.en: ¿Qué he hecho yo para merecer esto? (1984), a Pedro Almodóvar film, is screened at Golem Alhóndiga in the transition-era film cycle. It follows a frustrated housewife in a poor Madrid neighbourhood.

552ae9f494242bb0ac5fd89b2e3ead8db0ee43c3.en: 25 años de sexismo en la publicidad is a touring exhibition in nine Bizkaia municipalities, part of the EMAKUMEAK equality strategy. It also includes Mujeres en la ciencia, on gender stereotypes in advertising and women in science.

e8269b421eb01665ff7c6a88368be8eed723e246.en: Terremoto is screened at Mamariga Kulturgunea as part of the library's Endangered film cycle for the last quarter of 2026.

914c701e69ff4f72f252f294a8bf14046c429515.en: Empowerío is a documentary by Lara Izaguirre at Lonbo Aretoa. Gypsy women improvise scenes in a workshop at the Otxarkoaga civic centre, blurring reality and fiction.

00932a425dec992ebb3dbc7991dbb4558c8abb0f.en: Sabina Urraca and Laura Fernández talk about imagination at AZ Azkuna Zentroa, as part of Gutun Zuria Zabalik. The writers discuss imagination as a form of faith and the role of the observer.

6263b990a93337ab803c95638cce7af40a73c378.en: Luken Munguira and Aurelio Viribay present a recital at Teatro Arriaga. The tenor and pianist perform Basque art songs from the CD Aberri Maitiari, alongside English songs by Vaughan Williams and Quilter.

4a8ea4530f8a0733bf389e2efb6a26973db98f12.en: Promesarik txikiena is a participatory stage piece at Bilboko Kafe Antzokia. Four friends celebrate their bonds, shared promises and disappointments, with the audience taking part.

b1f7e9585839f73f925234097f03da2f672af587.en: Mensajes secretos is a workshop at Centro Cultural Santa Clara, part of Euskaraz gozatu. Children aged 4 to 7 make special glasses and write secret messages that only the glasses can decode, with 12 places.

5e0bf86e43b4e6bbaa04974684cb6fca3a53cb9f.en: The Portugalete library book club discusses Bi marra arrosa by Jasone Osoro. Further information is available at the library.

4cfb5273b129e4179a9a1f851f840c069b8b2754.en: A dramatised reading workshop on Lorca's Yerma runs at the Algorta culture hall, in collaboration with Utopian. The play, the middle part of his rural trilogy, follows a woman trapped in an infertile marriage and social pressure.

26305626b00ba2d520b690e776960692d075b694.en: Paco Blanco presents his book En las afueras de la oligarquía vasca at Romo Kultur Etxea in Getxo. The book recovers the forgotten stories and people of the Romo working-class neighbourhood.

9bc49217da84ef737905fe080d3ef1c759bad6a3.en: La Sinsorga's reading corner, led by Alaine Agirre, discusses Barne zerbitzuak by Katixa Agirre on 18 November. It is the first of three sessions.

e775320ec9b6afa2ae510ae1be1bcb6804010f3b.en: LOBO by Aurora Bauzà and Pere Jou is a wordless piece at AZ Azkuna Zentroa. Six performers use voice, movement and light, inspired by a Renaissance polyphony by Alonso Lobo.

fcadd71bdbdc2ab015f27c0ccf2e2c7826749605.en: Igogailua, also known as El ascensor, is a theatre piece at Teatro Arriaga. A woman trapped in a stuck lift faces her fears and memories, and the show is performed in Spanish on 19 November.

2dd7971ba5a115625164207ebb41eaa461fa0559.en: The Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia's Spanish-language reading group discusses El corrector. Two groups meet fortnightly from September to December, with 20 places per group allocated by lottery.

31e879d5e790f9fc077a2b914fe666b960bb21c2.en: The Santurtzi book club at Casa Torre Jauregia reads Mandíbula by Mónica Ojeda on 18 November. The club runs from October to December 2026, with places allocated by lottery.

ee4b197635fcbc8185bec26d95d0a01e25885f3a.en: The Portugalete library book club discusses La memoria del alambre by Kurban Said. Further information is available at the library.

2f945a8be13412f1ed37d85528d94809c4f9cd3a.en: The Portugalete library book club discusses Todas nuestras maldiciones se cumplieron by Tamara Tanenbaum. Further information is available at the library.

37fb74f4319c0b5ae7c292871ba8dc802dee8cd3.en: Ibai Arte Dantza Taldea performs at a Dantza Plazetan 2026 event. The free programme of Basque folk dance runs in Bilbao's neighbourhoods across the year.

62e78d5312ee66853603aecc507e8e88e621c3e3.en: Bego Alabazan's storytelling session Kutxa txiki magikoak is for children aged 3 to 6 at the Algorta culture hall. The activity is free and requires registration.

a1081796473cf7eb2c8aae69aa757a799dbdbe4a.en: El nombre is a comedy at the San Francisco Municipal Centre in Bilbao, part of Bilboko Zirkuitua 2026. A dinner among friends turns into a fight after a seemingly harmless choice of a name.

df4bfa99840aee1a3f6ba173a0bb572271f3d3b3.en: Las corrientes is an Argentine-Swiss drama by Milagros Mumenthaler, screened at Muxikebarri in Getxo. A fashion professional commits a desperate act during an awards trip and keeps the secret from her family.

42c31e22dfdddc744802709ce2303552f31f170b.en: Igogailua, also known as El ascensor, is performed in Basque at Teatro Arriaga on 18 November. The production is based on a real experience of a woman trapped in a lift.

60b2ba803cc57239ccb349a268f7cd5627926d20.en: San Anton Abesbatza performs a choral concert in the cloister of Euskal Museoa Bilbao on 19 November at 19:30. Tickets cost 3 euros, and the concert is part of the Musika Bizi 2026 cycle.

79eaf856a8ee4e5f51a42aaaeb1159c214476c85.en: Catherine Russell performs at Teatro Campos Elíseos. The Grammy-winning singer is the daughter of Louis Armstrong's pianist Luis Russell, and has recorded with artists including David Bowie and Wynton Marsalis.

6303fbcb3ce9f8817bcd9de248ddb3478877f7fc.en: Soul Witness play JAZZON Aretoa in Bilbao. The organ trio features guitar, organ and drums.

eefeb3ba07442b942b8b09b733c2d5d3e768791e.en: Haritik tiraka is a Basque-language play at Serantes Kultur Aretoa by Bitsa Konpainia. A newcomer to a neighbourhood learns from the woman who lived in her house, and sees everyday errands as poetry.

20ca270539ab8f6159a35f28b4417e88ff0dd722.en: Mugan present their third studio album, Bizitza ozen denean, at Bilboko Kafe Antzokia on 19 November. The Basque band's album has two parts that approach similar themes in different ways.

a7210a1ff7ea62b23df911f29d7ca9c24960191c.en: Besmaya play Stage Live in Bilbao on 19 November. The indie-pop duo started as a digital band in 2020 and has built a following on streaming platforms and tours.

d35b192d6c22b63a533a48056271011b545c68d1.en: Niña Polaca, a Madrid indie rock and garage band formed in 2018, plays Bilboko Kafe Antzokia on 19 and 20 November. The band blends indie rock, pop and 1980s Spanish pop with ironic lyrics.

40d4ac1ae83a3e2f2e2d2cbb71ea0b161b193bb4.en: The Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia's Spanish-language reading group discusses Los extraños. Two groups meet fortnightly from September to December, with 20 places per group allocated by lottery.

c3d1b1b10ad7249960e1aa9928444f71c13f91f8.en: The Bilbao International Puppet Festival, TX Fest 2026, takes place from 19 to 22 November at La Fundición. Further details are to be announced.

5ab3f56da37b0efca553acd43b55c312cacf407b.en: in situ: Zadie Xa at the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao presents the Korean-Canadian artist's immersive installations. Her work draws on Korean mythology, shamanic ritual and science fiction.

4ec83dfdbb9b876af463f212325bd10f19e2b475.en: Otsoko eta Xixili is a musical storytelling session by bertsolari Maren Basterretxea at Lemoa library. The event is organised by Lemoa council.

f509827a68a0358b1a8cb3ab396847c08d4073c9.en: Bego Alabazan's storytelling session Liburuen magia at Barakaldo's Arteagabeitia library is for children aged 5 to 8. It explores the stories hidden inside books.

aeeed47abb67586d7df319c570e33865d3831484.en: A feminist reading club meets at Lezeaga Aretoa in Llodio once a month, from October to May. The group is for women aged 18 and over, and registration is required.

42ae2e010495215086dab560f663fd71364ab543.en: José Antonio Aarnoutse Trío performs at Instituto Bertendona in Bilbao on 20 November as part of Mila Musika Haria 2026. The Cartagena-born musician blends flamenco with jazz and classical music.

b60efaf6449501c7b150e4204bbb53cd34d69945.en: The Bilbao accordion orchestra performs at Escuela de Música de Sestao. The orchestra, founded more than 60 years ago, plays arrangements of classical and popular music.

bf6cd83c8b1935a2be49fa5fff9f306a121a3e8b.en: Raúl Alegría presents Asombro at Teatro Campos Elíseos, a 75-minute magic show with large-scale illusions, including a helicopter appearance and escapes. Alegría is a multiple national champion of grand illusions.

d87beae39f2c65025bed947e7deb0c191626eb38.en: Mazmorra Arcana Liber, a metal festival, takes place at Sala Groove in Portugalete on 20 and 21 November. The line-up includes Criptadel, Khüll and Vespermort.

3049916a2cc0378e1d8e45e42f09f77fb410cee3.en: Shinova present their new EP La Tormenta Perfecta live at Palacio Euskalduna on 20 November. The show features a string section and an immersive sound and visual design.

96e0c79a60f3de53f464bf983d2e7cffeba02d7f.en: Mikel Bermejo's Eureka at Social Antzokia in Basauri is an 80-minute comedy show for ages 14 and over. The comedian takes a satirical look at influencers and modern life.

c61da621f5b3b19f328c4ee1656d8e4a44cbaa9c.en: Danny Bryant performs at Sala BBK as part of BBK Music Legends 2026. The British blues-rock guitarist presents his album Nothing Left Behind and revisits highlights from his career.

bfc97d880a9dfdfc88151a54d6074443fef86096.en: Ai, gure juaneteak is a hybrid stage piece with an actor and two musician-actors. The text reinterprets songs by Mikel Laboa in a minimalist production.

34f3650e5a96823947a1d36f3874299bf172783b.en: Malquerida, a stage version of Jacinto Benavente's play, is at Serantes Kultur Aretoa as part of the Santurtzi Theatre Festival. A widow's daughter and her stepfather fall in love, in a drama about passion and violence.

7dc596b076d74bbf8076ab2e48f08f74d3fec02c.en: Tributo is a theatre piece at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea. A struggling rock band is offered the chance to return to the spotlight and must play one more song, while the company marks its tenth anniversary.

a35aad3e4f9ecf6c84c46516a8a28e08505ad5f0.en: Irantzu Varela's live podcast La Ira at Bilborock explores anger as a force for collective struggle and culture as a weapon, with a surprise guest.

d58e4deec6bb0838b9d6c95101f03d2b799dd399.en: Andrés Koi, a former frontman of DVICIO, performs at Cotton Club in Bilbao. The Madrid singer-songwriter presents intimate, emotional pop from his solo career.

711094278ae8bb8fecda771d6af0ec2a119aac22.en: Vanessa Collier, a Texan singer, saxophonist and guitarist, performs at Kultur Leioa at 19:00. A Berklee graduate, she has played with Joe Louis Walker and has released six albums.

fae8158844f301abfb82589a2946eb4d6c30cc93.en: Tres adioses is a 2025 Italian drama by Isabel Coixet, screened at Romo Kultur Etxea in Getxo. After a minor argument, a couple separates, and the wife begins to feel something more than sadness.

652abb64fc183589f2b41d343355e2599b2e7994.en: El Mentón de Fogarty play Stage Live in Bilbao on 20 November.
