91211acd8831227352564bf8b1f261409e9bf21d.en: Bertso afaria is an evening of improvised verse at a Gatika venue, held on the day against male violence. The bertsolaris are Onintza Enbeita and Etxahun Lekue, organised by Gatika council.

621cd97068029d9e8fa2d77656d2a4a114192c28.en: El Drogas plays Santana 27 in Bilbao on 20 and 21 November. The singer performs songs by Barricada and his solo career, and entries for 21 November are sold out.

bdce047e85e9dcb07424b149f40735d6f76271e5.en: This Is Basque Design Merkatua 2026 is a November market at AZ Azkuna Zentroa, held within Bilbao Bizkaia Design Week. About thirty local designers sell fashion, jewellery, homeware and books at dendAZ and in the Atrio.

a7013589dca83f3d34966e5ba37786c362b928ea.en: Zinebi 2026, the 68th documentary and short film festival, runs in Bilbao from 20 to 27 November. Its poster, by Jesús Mari Lazkano, reworks Durrio's Monument to Arriaga with a 16 mm film reel in place of the lyre.

c22451f977c7785aef106b7b132ce3c93b24e641.en: Holabuenosdías is an exhibition by Abdeldjalil Sahed at Casa Torre de Ariz, running from 20 November to 4 December. The documentary and artistic photography show opens on 20 November at 19:00 with a guided visit.

16c33e708a6ef018abeef26ec5c854e1b66feba2.en: Da Capo Musika Banda presents a concert of solo instruments with the band at Torrezabal Kultur Etxea, conducted by Luis Orduña. The programme highlights instruments that are rarely in the spotlight.

7aa593db2e1f2f8a4bd60a288506bdff6235e3d3.en: Arte Eman Festa 2026, part of Arte Hartze Zikloa, opens at 18:00 at Aiaraldea Ekintzen Faktoria with a roundtable with artists from creative residencies. The evening ends with a concert by the Xiberoan band HOR-HOR.

fb1ca22ad70406bb8ae07e7295913fab17d2d247.en: El abrazo is a folk puppet show by Titiriteros de Binéfar at Lonbo Aretoa, part of the Arrigorriaga Puppet Festival 2026. The company uses traditional tunes and technology in a communal celebration.

fc5be15d4a5404bec2fb6692bed59aea709d79a6.en: Azala is a poetic solo performance at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea that tells the story of a life through the eyes of the skin. It explores how touch and care shape memory and identity.

486ba42663e474444fbca4065918a595688f3470.en: Txiki Rock is a family concert at Sondikako Kultur Etxea that retells the history of Basque rock with humour, songs and dancing.

0f4b2cb6efc01256158a82c08cc9d60631469601.en: Izartxo is a Basque reading workshop for the story, held at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea in Sopela on 21 November at 18:00. It is part of a series across Uribe Kosta.

d85f01f785bfdda68e39953e7e63d85c3b263320.en: Historia de una muñeca abandonada is a puppet show at the Centro Cívico de Cruces, part of Barakaldo's 2026 family performing arts programme. A broken doll is restored by a girl and claimed back by another, raising a question about ownership.

ce95108fd796cf6423551f72b55204261b70c8fc.en: Paloma de parque is the second solo show by Clara Ingold at Teatro Campos Elíseos. Mixing comic monologues and original songs, it addresses the self-destruction of her generation.

50405e51e7e343d8e49b7110f4cf5cd898ee4d60.en: La importancia de llamarse Ernesto is Oscar Wilde's comedy, performed by Sin Remilgos at Muxikebarri in Getxo. Two men hide more than they reveal in a satire of social appearances.

089689bb5381a12fa141ab3ae399447db927ca62.en: Travesía is a guided musical journey at Kultur Leioa through Latin American music. The five performers celebrate the blending of Indigenous, African and Spanish cultures, with rhythms from Cuba, Brazil and beyond.

b51e1085281c0d7bcd2fd0f0548db0254fe29794.en: La llamaban loca is a comedy about friendship and madness at Berango Antzokia, directed by Gurutze Beitia. It draws on the memories of a woman who became part of Bilbao's history.

052b8b3eed4afb9f7e19d4d1cc7f343329bf8bff.en: La amiga, a 1988 Argentine-German film directed by Jeanine Meerapfel, is screened in the Klasikoak 2026 cycle at the Museo de Bellas Artes de Bilbao. Two friends are separated by dictatorship, and one becomes a Mothers of Plaza de Mayo activist.

33902bed599997f06c80f5b403841555879b830d.en: La Tarara is a theatre piece at Utopian about a girl who survives a traumatic event with the help of a transgender sex worker. Years later, her memory is pieced together through her mother's old love letters.

db2e7bb3cdba18e6e72b75e6f8e42fa1aa24c8d3.en: Malquerida, Jacinto Benavente's drama in a new adaptation, is staged at Social Antzokia in Bilbao. A stepfather and a daughter fall in love in a story of passion, power and violence.

b244ea3e9077cf8cec3847ca7cdf7ee3a8696206.en: Niko Etxart performs at Muxikebarri in Getxo on 21 November at 20:00, celebrating more than five decades of Basque rock. The Basque singer-songwriter, a pioneer of rock in Euskara, is joined by guest artists.

8831261521f77ce7ff98a97e12cccd0a8c49a52f.en: Rafael Álvarez El Brujo presents Mi vida en el arte at Teatro Barakaldo, a solo show performed entirely in verse. The show draws on classical Spanish Golden Age poetry and his own life in the theatre.

2e253b95f222bac88a9d0866314a173ffc127ff8.en: The JazzOn Fest 2026 trio of David Ambrosio, Jacob Sacks and João Pereira plays JAZZON Aretoa in Bilbao. The New York bassist leads a piano and drums trio.

f8f505dc449df5923b82dea0e53ff9cc5b7646ae.en: Jasón y las furias is a Santurtzi Theatre Festival production at Serantes Kultur Aretoa. After Jason betrays Medea by marrying the king's daughter, the Furies arrive and force him to face his past.

80b324271aadab81a4f41805737bb384e838873f.en: Elrow Bilbao 2026 is a ten-hour electronic music night at Bizkaia Arena - BEC from 20:00 to 06:00 on 21 November. Adam Beyer and Andrés Campo head the line-up, with a Hallucinarium visual theme by Alex Grey.

a53c1b4620dc668adc2aefd5eab0e37d4e6c08d6.en: Zeballos plays Azkena in Bilbao on 21 November to present the album Amor Fiado.

535291cc281f2cc8e2e0493a52b95e9645a83983.en: Ruth Lorenzo plays Bilborock in Bilbao on 21 November on her Blacksheep Tour 2026, built around her debut album.

e89893b915c6c1c9d17e75e3af360ff5bdd27f95.en: David Puerto's Bien at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a live comedy show combining crowdwork, improvisation, music and stand-up. The audience is a central part of the performance.

338ad3270630b2b6a46b25530303fa6a79dd1631.en: Johnny Irion and Chris Murphy play La Atalaia del Gardoki, blending 1960s Californian rock with the traditional folk of the Woody Guthrie era.

5fd8ccb071f293875ccd5c020c2c3e78103c8778.en: Candlelight Bilbao presents a 60-minute tribute to Ludovico Einaudi, performed by a string ensemble. Pieces include Una Mattina and Nuvole Bianche, and seats are assigned on arrival.

394fe0518f7803965559fddbcdb5bf3d90101fe1.en: MOMO play Nave 9 in Bilbao on 21 November.

27ebc3fc8a2a2487302c7146edef5d320d410b79.en: Su Ta Gar play the final concert of their 35th-anniversary tour in Bilbao on 21 November. The Eibar heavy metal band, formed in 1987, sings in Basque.

aad3ee2918c955f44a42599911c358ee9564a5f2.en: Korrontzi play Sodupe on 21 November. The Basque folk group, formed in 2004 by Agus Barandiaran, blends traditional music with modern sounds and trikitixa.

0d515c1e54e3ff085021bc8c885244126190010b.en: Il barbiere di Siviglia, Rossini's comic opera, is staged by ABAO at Palacio Euskalduna. The production moves the action to 1950s Seville, with Andrzej Filonczyk as Figaro and Pedro Bartolomé conducting the BOS.

c53e4dc3352918e2b138d97f96592a2879274587.en: I Olimpiada del Reciclaje is a family relay course at Ekoetxea in Meatzaldea. Participants face challenges about consumption, waste and recycling.

d1f05a8050b2c95f359d174d35282f9485dcfbdb.en: Alai familian is a dance theatre piece by Lasala at Kultur Leioa. A six-year-old girl dreams of animals and different kinds of families, and learns that families come in many shapes.

1a3f38f02757a1cc2995720b3d2a571590a80e89.en: The Bilbao Municipal Band plays Caminos, with guest conductor Xavier Puig Ortiz, at Palacio Euskalduna. The programme includes Dvořák's New World Symphony and Otto Schwarz's Around the World in 80 Days.

b3f9221949d3b8a2611d8eee9e99badd9b8d4e26.en: Super Charlie is a 2024 Swedish family film screened at Muxikebarri in Getxo as part of Zinematxiki. A ten-year-old who dreams of being a superhero is overshadowed by his baby brother, who turns out to have superpowers.

1b3a051d24cbd6d981620ab09ad18f14bb555277.en: Erresinolaren kantua is a puppet and shadow show at Lonbo Aretoa, part of the Arrigorriaga Puppet Festival 2026. It retells a classic of nature literature with live music and a changing screen.

c15893e421c50179028a9ff460520a2723c00fe6.en: No me toques el cuento is a comedy at Teatro Campos Elíseos. Four Disney princesses rebel and insist on telling the other side of their fairy tales.

2c76487dc92edfb70695b4c2a59b3753ab85ed87.en: Iñaki Urrutia's Perdone, caballero at Teatro Campos Elíseos revisits monologues from his career over more than twenty years of performing, asking whether he has grown old.

9cdc7af3e779e708b2d516a2c6a3f910aa149af5.en: Ehiztari ehizatua is a Basque-language puppet show at Berango Antzokia. The boy Peli meets a bertso-singing frog and a fox caught in a trap, and goes to the San Fermín festival.

3c9fbdac2869ddf1b4750d6f9e6c8078f77f269e.en: L.A. Guns and Stick's N Stones play Bilboko Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 22 November.

7f5bfcc8f532c203658e58d379acdcade29d6285.en: Organo Kontzertuak 2026 at Palacio Euskalduna is a showcase for emerging organists from Musikene, the Basque music conservatoire. The programme of 19th and early 20th century organ music ends with Max Reger, played on the Karl Schuke organ.

20d8b49df8598e9997ff51c79b63601c78307ea2.en: El invencible verano de Liliana is a monologue at Serantes Kultur Aretoa, part of the Santurtzi Theatre Festival. Actress Cecilia Suárez performs a text based on Cristina Rivera Garza's memoir about her sister's murder in 1990.

46949b07f3d5736b27a4b1823d133fa5c9ccac42.en: Abián Díaz's Show patético at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a stand-up comedy show. The comedian promises a performance that will leave audiences laughing.

fc5a5a7fabdf5d1039d19de02d5050fdbc52eb0a.en: Mamuka is a family dance show at Muxikebarri in Getxo. Two dancers turn into creatures inspired by nature, set to Vivaldi's The Four Seasons.

ae3a125d9ef98d7741cc886b8d16db2b31fc2ac8.en: Univers is a sensory performance for babies and families at Teatro Barakaldo. Light, sound and movement invite the youngest children to explore shapes and sensations.

0ff6d62ef36d9eb40dba3503d29e1220c2fe3773.en: Ander Izagirre presents La mochila. Vida de Muñagorri at Bidebarrieta Kulturgunea. The book follows Alberto Muñagorri, who was injured as a child in a 1982 ETA bomb attack in Rentería.

9f5c1e8238116bb61ed44e1409d6fab72905103c.en: The Lords of the Sound perform The Lord of the Rings in Concert at Teatro Campos Elíseos. The symphonic programme features Howard Shore's Oscar-winning score for the film trilogy.

d6ba46392c7427a2e9929120f4042ac7dab5cd3b.en: The Leioa San Juan festival includes THE ONE & the one, a comic duo show by Colette Gomette and Anna De Lirium at Auditorio Aldapa. The contrast between a large and a small performer explores human relationships.

46e811c32ff3a33899bff559530d41d6c9e5cfca.en: Hindenburg is screened at Mamariga Kulturgunea as part of the library's Endangered film cycle for the last quarter of 2026.

580e7fe35151b552640059617c6b72bbbbd751cb.en: Cría cuervos, Carlos Saura's 1976 film, is the subject of the November Diálogos del Cine session at AZ Azkuna Zentroa. The session is part of the transition-era cinema cycle.

0af50a92263cbacd03b5269a51658393860932e7.en: Bidutzi is a Basque-language family comedy with live music at the Sestao music school, for ages 3 and up. A small monster is trapped in a cage on Carnival night and must escape before the hunter returns.

d3d1eb9b0d4c9640cb839b5d8f2d5ffbd810b871.en: Un matrimonio a lo loco is an amateur theatre performance by the Las Amigas de Repélega association at Centro Cultural Santa Clara on 24 November.

26d26a5e7cf7759c591b28f1d3c0d3e9730dd9c1.en: Amnesty International's exhibition Solo sí es sí runs at Kultur Leioa from 24 November to 10 December. It focuses on consent and sexual violence, and is part of Leioa's programme for 25 November.

76dbb51c388f766943688aa66fa4bbea7c100cfb.en: Sala Rekalde presents the exhibition of the Huesca-born artist Jorge Isla as part of Barriek, a programme featuring artists who received Bizkaia arts grants.

5bb17ef3b65a48fc11178ab8610ef7ba0eda9c02.en: Versadas, a poetry club at Algorta culture hall, discusses the work of Sylvia Plath.

b380a31b33b5788b4a6cdc87fb8fc95a3cb4b60f.en: Euskadiko Orkestra performs Falla, Debussy and Stravinsky under conductor Lucas Macías at Palacio Euskalduna. The programme includes The Three-Cornered Hat, La mer and The Firebird.

d6596903ca9bbca254da48f6b10284b86285ed7b.en: Aldatz Gora, an exhibition of 100 years of mountaineering history, is shown at Castaños Municipal Centre as part of Expodistrito 2026. The show tells the story of the mountaineering club over the last century.

c7d4f356404c449eb34b4606ed99220fa8bb6a04.en: Ana Apika tells stories in Basque at the Leioa children's library on 26 November at 18:00. The session is for children aged 5 to 9 and is free, with registration required.

fd6c7543b09ba0b303315a54203b5a6dacf41e3d.en: Un silencio is a film forum at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea. A woman who has spent 25 years in enforced silence in her household is challenged by her children, who begin to seek justice for hidden family secrets.

60b2755d28108e71da187faa33ce9c93781489d0.en: Las hermanas de Buffalo Bill is a comedy at Basurto Municipal Centre, part of Bilboko Zirkuitua 2026. Two sisters are controlled by their domineering brother, and his ghost prevents them from escaping after his death.

09d829781ca403d7b40529089ee4c0b3090d7ec9.en: Alicia Valdés presents Auge. Género, juventud y extrema derecha at La Sinsorga. The book examines why some young men turn to the far right, and how precarity and traditional masculinity shape those views.

0122bcbd9a2706c3c8c080266b251046340fca51.en: Hamnet is a 2025 drama by Chloé Zhao, screened at Muxikebarri in Getxo as part of Zinemabarri. It follows Agnes, the wife of William Shakespeare, as she copes with a family tragedy.

6081ab370deec97c27b4aaaf25bae3daad8fbf65.en: Jac performs roots blues and black music traditions at Teatro Barakaldo. The Basque singer plays acoustic and lap steel guitar and draws on the Mississippi delta, bluegrass and folk.

942d363b71ed18cad2ca0f0cfe1bc445821e249a.en: The Alejandro Mingot and Miguel Villar Quartet plays JAZZON Aretoa in Bilbao. The quartet features guitar, tenor saxophone, double bass and drums.

c720b7fc4db9c7ca293798b4e53a881028f6c305.en: Vulcanizadas perform at Bilborock in Bilbao. The all-women Basque band plays soul, blues, rhythm and blues and funk, and is preparing a second album this autumn.

b4cb1724df2ae7bf18cd5962bb848865d05bac95.en: Santi Campos e Hijos play Bilboko Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 26 November.

74829ddf9eab8e03d38ef8f13b77ad03fdd849e7.en: Comandante Lara's Los 3 tenores at Palacio Euskalduna is a comedy show with three comedians. Opera is a pretext for jokes, parody and improvisation rather than singing.

a0f19181d91dfaa03d61ecb0095f7cb36462a3d9.en: Kaparrak play Bilboko Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 26 November.

1dd9895c42dc6952f24602ce74294c296ac3e29e.en: Carlos Ares plays Santana 27 in Bilbao on 26 and 27 November, closing his tour. The multi-instrumentalist from A Coruña presents his debut album Peregrino, and the 27 November show is sold out.

1264f3a49b30164256a8975f46de4ae3a431949b.en: The Leioa library book club discusses El dolor crónico no es para siempre by Arturo Goicoechea, with the author present. It is free and meets on 26 November at 17:00 and 19:15.

c8c534ac003a0722b2aeb25058807a8bb8cb6cf7.en: La buena hija is screened at Serantes Kultur Aretoa as part of Homeless Film Festival 2026. Carmela and her mother move in with her grandmother after a separation, and the film is an adaptation of the director's short Harta.

b5c7ab706e08bc415342a48effa1ace6e550f312.en: ICONS by Steve McCurry, with more than 100 large-format photographs, is shown at AZ Azkuna Zentroa. It includes his best-known images, such as the portrait of Sharbat Gula.

3d833e2ab4d07f2fd818ba65b294ce333d6db7f1.en: Ixabel Agirresarobe's storytelling session Udazken, ken, ken... at Barakaldo's Arteagabeitia library is part of Bazen Behin 2026. The session is for children aged 5 to 8.

62cdd9704208a971c8e292ccc6f53b8e435ba65f.en: The Portugalete library hosts a storytelling session, Jalilen bidaia, for children.

c1a7aa80159e71f19635b9de5b9e7f8801ed1cf4.en: The International Congress on the Present and Future Generations of Euskadi takes place at Palacio Euskalduna on 25 November, from 09:00 to 14:30. It discusses intergenerational justice, marking the 40th anniversary of the Basque Youth Council.

fac212b06709364887bfe989264c582904a2ae9b.en: La buena hija, a Spanish drama by Júlia de Paz, is screened at Serantes Kultur Aretoa for Cine Club Santurtzi. A girl visits her father at a supervised meeting point, and the film explores the inheritance of gender violence.

4086ef163b0ac90e1cf362ec8283cff0982834b0.en: La segunda venida de Cristo o el yoga de Jesús is a Rafael Álvarez El Brujo show at Teatro Campos Elíseos. Based on Yogananda's book, it presents the Gospels as an inner experience of consciousness rather than a literal return.

dcb4e29997fadd2c534700675dd11be3949fd99d.en: Trío Fa en Cuarta plays Instituto Bertendona in Bilbao on 27 November as part of Mila Musika Haria 2026. The young trio reworks classical pieces by Vivaldi, Hoffmann and Shostakovich with improvisation.

6d63b426dda3f5b01194e38e450cb04e05d01b0d.en: Jon Plazaola's comedy AA Aita at Lonbo Aretoa explores fatherhood, with self-deprecating jokes about his own experience as a parent.

4ae1f3d373ba12f879d28869047cf62c3cc4b769.en: Adulto en prácticas is a comedy monologue by Himar Armas at Teatro Campos Elíseos. It is about the difficulty of being an adult who does not feel ready for it.

5fc6e64bd50d65438d008e3f3c18536a6d0a4e10.en: Hormetan idazten is the third album by Esanezin, the Basque singer Ianire Aranzabal. Recorded in Oiartzun in 2025, its songs use walls as a metaphor for love, wounds and the ephemeral.

d39504e57bc25174be820768318db6a21db8b8da.en: Anonimak is a music collective of six women from Balmaseda that celebrates women whose work was silenced through history. Its show at Muxikebarri in Getxo takes inspiration from Virginia Woolf's remarks on anonymous women writers.

208a977305c3fc87c7f38a31b7cca5974cedaf66.en: Lady Maffin. La última cena is a dark comedy at La Sinsorga. It follows a grotesque serial killer through clown, object theatre and puppets, and is not suitable for those squeamish about blood.

f8bd5b0a1822f14e7a074359a08a8cbb58c3b7b2.en: Imanol Arias and María Barranco star in Mejor no decirlo, a comedy by Salomé Lelouch at Serantes Kultur Aretoa, part of the Santurtzi Theatre Festival. A long-married couple decides to say everything they think.

ad81cfc0ab93aaeb4bf445ade8be0d7dc404b2c4.en: Nuca is an album and concert by Clara Peya at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea. The songs explore loneliness, empathy and the need to meet strangers in an uncertain time.

a02aa9d2c51c548af296a6d19f0cb6a8a3344179.en: TROS_18 and SOMAK play Bilborock in Bilbao on 27 November.

47de47c66417b015b60af25cbe4572bda6c45f40.en: Mi tercer acto is a theatre piece at Kultur Leioa. It follows a 57-year-old actress in her dressing room as she describes the challenges of ageing and of being a woman in the arts.

837e0992eb9530eee7ad87783c2468e8165eb57f.en: Deathbats pay tribute to Avenged Sevenfold at Azkena in Bilbao on 27 November.

88c3a28b1527abbb3a4cab5e44faa431d2926099.en: J.J. Vaquero presents his evolving monologue at Teatro Campos Elíseos, supported by videos and slides. The comedian and writer performs alongside guitarist Carlos Martín Catos.

4cafaec3c2849d0e99db87ba5aa785c2f447f434.en: Hazas play Stage Live in Bilbao on 27 November, as part of their Mii Para Ti Tour 2027.

787c1e43fc5ac1d628a3efd1fc1bed7872c4f588.en: The third Portugalete Historical Novel Conference runs from 27 to 29 November at Centro Cultural Santa Clara. The programme is available as a PDF from the organisers.

bee1161fcd62e68b76b177175e0f6be76f963921.en: Clara Tiscar presents a live episode of the true crime podcast Criminopatía at Teatro Campos Elíseos on 28 November. The show is not recorded, and the 40 fastest buyers can meet the host afterwards.

5f5a5847e477b28e3a24e37b3df3630dcee34b07.en: Obon Fest 2026 takes place at D8 Sorkuntza Faktoria in November. The extreme metal line-up includes Imperial Triumphant, Numen, The Great Old Ones, Foscor and Knoll.

876611f3103c6518ce6632e8e6eefc5c18fbcea1.en: Sergio Bezos presents his first stand-up tour show at Teatro Campos Elíseos on 28 November. Personal anecdotes are mixed with improvisation, and the comedian is a resident of the late-night show La Resistencia.

e99a907f22f4e367e3188884fabfc1b2186e5d0f.en: Rucs, el maleficio del brujo is a family comedy at Casa de Cultura Clara Campoamor, part of Barakaldo's 2026 family arts programme. Two comedians tell the story of a princess turned into a frog by a wizard.

9cc07ecdf979d696147e7e514ec59188929c2b39.en: Revólver plays Teatro Arriaga in Bilbao on 28 November on the tour for the album La 03010. Frontman Carlos Goñi presents new songs alongside past hits.

662b8f5d1828e056fce30964a16c23df97984bf3.en: Cándida is a theatre piece by Patxo Telleria at Teatro Barakaldo. A novelist's life is disrupted when an evicted older woman who inspired one of her characters turns up at her door.

a67a24c96ff255b48d562813c2b0bd5f4c065875.en: Jorge Drexler performs his album TARACÁ live at Palacio Euskalduna on 28 November. The Uruguayan singer-songwriter is joined by seven musicians, and the show draws on the candombe rhythm.

dedebf319638af519ade2eed513e37bbdc30b554.en: La Fuga play Santana 27 in Bilbao on 28 November. The rock band from Reinosa, formed in 1996, sings about friendship, freedom and everyday emotions.

0c167aaee6f83afbcb8c626abb222311f63958b6.en: Big Daddy Wilson performs at Sala BBK as part of BBK Music Legends 2026. The American singer, based in Germany, mixes blues, gospel, folk and acoustic sounds.

0253830c7353076d4d60e8bdfb77abb7171c0208.en: Un siglo de abismos is a play in six monologues at Muxikebarri in Getxo. Women from one family speak across a century, recalling those who fought for a fairer society.

0377ec389266dd6de2072e87164c31ada793fa5e.en: Clara Peya presents Nuca at Torrezabal Kultur Etxea. Sixteen songs by sixteen voices form a minimalist album, with a wall piano, electronic atmospheres and a live band.

6e17f5d044ea01ed6a291955ce994cad0892eb7d.en: Dan Pratt Line plays JAZZON Aretoa in Bilbao. The New York-born saxophonist leads a quintet of contemporary jazz originals.

69b9b27f41493f56d2218911772f4c857a07786e.en: La mujer rota is an adaptation of a Simone de Beauvoir text, staged at Serantes Kultur Aretoa as part of the Santurtzi Theatre Festival. Anabel Alonso plays a woman on New Year's Eve, reflecting on her past.

ca723dd0c3cb3cf5f1ac6c86e2817e8de37642b8.en: Here Comes Your Man is a drama at Utopian. Former classmates of a religious school reunite at a hotel to celebrate a teacher's retirement, and they confront old wounds.

5a333e1294cd06c86873298104beb7a9ad7187db.en: Inurri Itsuak is a historical drama at Kultur Leioa, set in Algorta in 1935. A family risks everything to save a shipwrecked load of coal from a storm.

312dbfc536466e2c4dc2ddaf2340d4dba5def2da.en: Guelmi's Suerte de manicomio at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a raw comic monologue about everyday madness and obsessive thoughts.

2066ab2df2ded0ea4b922b24d9584cee83734fdb.en: Fractal Experience, Madame Rachel and Fugitivos de la Luz play Sala Groove in Portugalete on 28 November.

61e12001c4132ccbc0b82d5ead72e9acf45e6b05.en: Daniel Fez's Estamos cucú de la cabeza at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a comedy monologue about living with constant online opinions. The comedian mixes confessions from the audience with improvised responses.

0cc8d048a5a2b2e3df0e40e1510446994f6a17d1.en: Montana play Azkena in Bilbao on 28 November. The band plays fresh, energetic songs with its own identity.

717cc980730d2ae32e92893e640e20a2d93239b2.en: Band Jovi, a Bon Jovi tribute band, performs at Bilboko Kafe Antzokia on 28 November to celebrate ten years.

ea5e06e6af8e519f835161dd09cd7467ea5f28ee.en: Subir la dosis is a hybrid spoken-word piece by Laura Sam at La Fundición. The 60-minute work combines voice, sound and theatre, and reflects on meditation and antidepressants.

ce1d45a3c04437717e7da32ee445deacbc062e7a.en: Improlocura is an improvised show by Luca Della Gatta that combines mime, clown techniques and sound effects. The 50-minute show has no text and suits all audiences.

2845187d32de6fa714544a93aaef163bd1998495.en: Loa eta Laia Zuzenean is a live musical show for children at Teatro Campos Elíseos in Bilbao. Two characters sing and joke in Basque about healthy habits, respect and against bullying.

9aad959288d73a2615218ac43397cb52cffdd84f.en: Moko is a family theatre piece for ages 6 and up at Social Antzokia. It tells the childhood of Bilintx, whose face was deformed by a fall, leaving him seen as a monster.

13315ee09b59566c2cac8e9e4087d4765e88bc8d.en: Runners is a circus show at Teatro Barakaldo by a German company. Two jugglers run endlessly on a treadmill, in a comic reflection on speed and progress.

44236e8649ebeab5c3edf703755b70a3249eedec.en: Fly me to the moon by the Leandre company is a wordless clown show for ages 7 and up at Muxikebarri in Getxo. Two clowns attempt a journey to the moon, a symbol of fantasy.

8143f97d074e1a80495c34c8219d43bcb44360de.en: Hodei guztien gainetik is staged at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea in Sopela. A father who has forgotten how to play finds a vagrant angel among cardboard clouds and rediscovers childhood. The show is for ages 3 and up.

4895098e92d20861a31fcc883dc86853695f37b0.en: Amaury Santacruz plays Santana 27 in Bilbao. The urban music artist blends modern rhythms with songs about love and everyday life.

fea179f17d2f610f3f745abeff54af1d223bbb6b.en: Viento del pueblo at Teatro Arriaga is a biographical show about the poet Miguel Hernández, who wrote in only twelve years of production. Pep Tosar's multidisciplinary staging combines guitar, song, dance and documentary video.

f347f01b1225a536a21e198f7c8b0126d03f19ef.en: Amancio Prada celebrates 50 years since his album based on the poetry of Rosalía de Castro at Teatro Campos Elíseos. The concert revisits the songs from the first album and its mature reinterpretations.

88f16b73dff47f5f07688530f69e23a6e0bbd33f.en: La ciociara (Dos mujeres), a 1960 Italian drama by Vittorio de Sica starring Sophia Loren, is screened in the Klasikoak 2026 cycle at the Museo de Bellas Artes de Bilbao. A mother and daughter flee wartime Rome for the mountains.

16850174ba000043a438bd46eb50f0cd5ca39b84.en: José Campoy's Campoyadas at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a family comedy that mixes monologues, impressions and deliberately bad jokes.

ebf2531c126c391c291010cd045d3ed7e2fa1cb9.en: La consagración de la primavera at Serantes Kultur Aretoa is Roger Bernat's version of Pina Bausch's 1975 ballet. Audience members wear headphones with simple instructions, and become the performers in a collective ritual.

097bbbfceeb8e18dc07ae68eb27337515589d272.en: Ganbara Sesioak presents the band Tukanon in Ugao-Miraballes on 29 November.

37e490963fb05c7bd86bc0c1ec7ea57c4abb87f2.en: Mikel Urdangarin plays an acoustic show of his songs with his guitar, after 30 years and 20 albums. The concert returns to the simple, intimate origins of his music.

986d65996898eef02f1cf37c871cdaa2fee457dc.en: Adulto responsable is a stand-up and crowd-work show by Manuel Ángel Redondo at Teatro Campos Elíseos. It explores the challenges of adulthood, including family, anxiety, therapy and existential doubts.

39a1b2352ececa03a28632263b29d29f40b31889.en: Orca, la ballena asesina is screened at Mamariga Kulturgunea as part of the library's Endangered film cycle for the last quarter of 2026.

3a7a52f04ef8550dd924eaa195be6b734fd75954.en: The Leioa library book club discusses El último hombre blanco by Nuria Labari on 1 December. The session is free and runs at 17:30 and 19:00.

b2585b7b00fcd9116e510b1f9f6e319aaf82ec1d.en: Bosteko 2026, its 29th edition, is a touring contemporary art exhibition across Amorebieta-Etxano, Basauri, Getxo and Leioa. It is titled No puedo ver el mar desde la plaza, and is shown at Romo Kultur Etxea.

532983bbc482420592547a2d29a42ffbce70a28e.en: Mosaicos is a workshop at Centro Cultural Santa Clara, part of Euskaraz gozatu. Children aged 4 to 7 make animal figures with air-drying clay and coloured ceramic tiles, with 12 places.

111f3656357abc6652af5a408cfe3bb0e821210e.en: Mariana Pineda is a dramatised reading workshop at Algorta culture hall, run with Utopian. It retells the story of a young woman from Granada executed in 1831 for embroidering a liberal flag.

6c95ea003a3dd2ff28432e2338bb819cbba58f37.en: Soen, Tribulation and Vulkan play Santana 27 in Bilbao on 2 December.

0c335ee63d60d4f1cec5a5f1e20564014b8625f1.en: Garaien arteko solasaldia is an organ concert at Palacio Euskalduna, marking the bicentenary of Juan Crisóstomo de Arriaga. The saxophonist Iñaki Bermúdez, the choir Cor Cererols and the organist Joan Seguí explore grief and longing across centuries.

26abdc1afccde91bfeb2ab01ab6f8dc364ae9b89.en: Risk It and Breathing from Dresden play Sala Groove in Portugalete. Risk It is a hardcore punk band with straight edge ideas, and Breathing is an emerging hardcore act from the same city.

fe2dbf646587baa591f65df8f6710fdfd41639c8.en: Kirmen Uribe and Mikel Urdangarin mark 25 years since the Basque poetry book Bitartean heldu eskutik, with an intimate show of poetry and music at Teatro Arriaga.

d91f000ad981ad25661df530fb5acd1a0f771aab.en: El columpio is a Spanish-language literary meeting at the Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia, part of a fortnightly reading group. Two groups meet from September to December, with 20 places per group allocated by lottery.

05f6b2420982b91b7ee197338ffbac42aeb87b9b.en: The Santurtzi book club at Casa Torre Jauregia reads Los astronautas by Laura Ferrero on 2 December. The club runs from October to December 2026 with places allocated by lottery.

2757ba092224d8a0d8ccecbb4c1b412077726a55.en: La risa is a comedy show at Begoña Municipal Centre in Bilbao, part of Bilboko Zirkuitua 2026. A group of five performers aims to make the audience laugh together.

dda92dfbf3bfac280a9b742e5ed1e80601b55fdd.en: A bertso session features Maialen Lujanbio, Aitor Etxebarriazarraga, Jon Maia and Paule Loizaga at Kurtzio Kultur Etxea. Bertsolari and musicians perform together.

6534478f0f6f62e306b7bb1cb2887664f516e315.en: Inurri Itsuak is screened at Muxikebarri in Getxo as part of Zinemabarri. A family in 1930s Algorta risks everything to save a shipwrecked load of coal during a storm.

5b3a43c9730bc802fe015760b02d70361e9453f1.en: The Bilbao Orkestra Sinfonikoa season 2026-2027 features Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 18 and Organ Sonata K. 336, and César Franck's D minor Symphony, at Palacio Euskalduna.

d2b6b8dbc5a6098e265cce0ea9194fd1b476cb39.en: KCANTÁ is a concert at Teatro Campos Elíseos by Anne Etchegoyen, celebrating songs sung in regional and non-dominant languages. Artists from Corsica, Brittany, Occitania, Alsace and Martinique join the Basque singers on stage.

da5fd30c309cbcbaaf1e0b5cb0a4d43f5f73ab23.en: 52 hertz, a Santurtzi Theatre Festival play at Serantes Kultur Aretoa, takes its title from a whale that sings at a frequency no other whale can hear. It explores social isolation and loneliness through poetic, choreographed scenes.

1570ac96afc41f95804e4195e66205c6eb04a3ab.en: Francesco Zampini's trio Somewhere, everywhere plays JAZZON Aretoa in Bilbao. The Italian guitarist leads a bass and drums trio.

1505d830be849c141bd019cc6598624aef9b0e9f.en: La Txama and Pinaka play Bilboko Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 3 December.

8daeaf367af3ad8e1aec0c8f3324b589fa021e99.en: The Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia's Spanish-language reading group discusses Nadie me verá llorar. Two groups meet fortnightly from September to December, with 20 places per group allocated by lottery.

fd805bf16ff886a5f69f641367fbff0f6d6f32eb.en: Fabricando mujeres: indarkeria kontsumitzen dugu is a teaching exhibition at Torre de Ariz from 3 to 29 December, presented by SETEM Hego Haizea and ALTEKIO.

9349c30d0dcca155cf36f905ca5837d60f313af0.en: The Book of Mormon musical, by Trey Parker, Matt Stone and Robert Lopez, is staged at Teatro Arriaga. The satire follows two Mormon missionaries sent to a village in Uganda, and it has won several major theatre awards.

88632a6a79a05fa0aa9223e9af74d10566baae3b.en: Gazte Artea Ezkerraldean 2026 exhibition, presenting four young artists from the region, is at Escuela de Música de Sestao from 3 to 31 December.

29caa68dfd02fdd47c32e84d31e100cc12f1b521.en: Naranja azul is a play at Teatro Campos Elíseos about a power struggle between two psychiatrists who use a young patient as a pawn. It examines institutional racism and medical ethics.

861d89cb612827960b0881113bdb2c14035b7a8d.en: Diego Ramos revives Julio Iglesias's songs in an elegant staging at Teatro Campos Elíseos. The show performs classics such as Me olvidé de vivir and Un canto a Galicia.

433e95de3dab4a53a351b4a9e9ec2e1f23705535.en: Bi baso bat ur is a dance piece at Kultur Leioa by Metrokoadrokoa. Four people stand motionless in a dance floor holding glasses of water, exploring joy after abuse.

cff48cf21d38fecd9c70fa77517149aa2c2c558c.en: Azken erromantikoak is screened at Romo Kultur Etxea as part of the Getxo film club. A lonely factory worker, who worries about a lump she finds, is offered an unexpected opportunity.

30c395287dbdc57be39700049ae5d9fc0fa0cf17.en: CAMIN plays Santana 27 in Bilbao on 4 December. The Almuñécar-born artist blends rap, trap, reggaeton and flamenco roots.

01f60ed2a0eba9bcde71a9c089b1f9f4637eefdb.en: Arene 6 play Muxikebarri in Getxo, presenting their new album Sutan. The young Getxo band mixes Oi punk, hardcore, rock and metal.

20a3b66f5936a7ce80ae3293481f78160f74b4dc.en: Peiremans+, the pop project of Gorka Urbizu, Imanol Ubeda, Marino Goñi and Txiki, plays a run of concerts in late 2026, including four dates at Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao. The band says it will disappear for years afterwards.

ed071c3aa02a8b1a1dd53dc18c44a74c2e7b79bf.en: La reine Margot, Patrice Chéreau's 1994 French film, is screened in the Klasikoak 2026 cycle at the Museo de Bellas Artes de Bilbao. It tells of a royal marriage meant to end the religious wars between Catholics and Protestants.

f0182443d85f1df5b0a311215df040c47e7e7e80.en: Tres noches en Ítaca is a tragicomedy by Alberto Conejero at Muxikebarri in Getxo. Three sisters gather in their family home after their mother's death, and face secrets and old wounds during three nights of mourning.

807d6cc314956c90dd96af7c7cde555e42b86f16.en: Lamine Thior's Más que palabras at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a comedy show mixing improvisation, audience dialogue and wordplay. The performer, who is from Senegal, is known for television and film roles.

14272ec35761c148fb6c39efae53693cafa568d0.en: JazzOn Fest 2026 features the Max Ionata Hammond Trio at JAZZON Aretoa in Bilbao. The tenor saxophonist leads a trio with Hammond organ and drums.

96e298fa05930a1f7c7f0e32b551607bcc81ec6f.en: Alma Culter and Ruta play Sala Groove in Portugalete on 5 December.

103882456ecd7a62157958aadc7239e3f43b8e1c.en: Cyril Kamer plays Santana 27 in Bilbao on 5 December.

3d5929f1dbeb4ccfecfd858f5fc50c81167ef238.en: 48280 and Zilibito Records play Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 5 December.

5cf641e786eeee72facc0bd4c1f2bd52cbc0fb94.en: ¿Hacemos match? is an improvised comedy show by Piter Pardo at Teatro Campos Elíseos. Audience decisions shape the evening, with games and unexpected connections.

ed020b946b23857c0670e1ff7eb3e02ffbf09833.en: La Oreja de Van Gogh, with Amaia Montero, play a concert at the BEC in Barakaldo on 5 December, closing their Tantas cosas que contar tour.

bd2d47e1d52fae44fb1a6efefbb3ea0c9c09bbbc.en: K-pop, el baile final is a family concert at Teatro Campos Elíseos on 5 December. Ten artists perform popular K-pop songs with choreography and LED screens.

e4e968cd042d50122524a0ad69f3b7e32ef5bd2d.en: Sesamo, ireki zaitez is a visual theatre show for children and families at Muxikebarri in Getxo. Books open into fantasy worlds through images, objects, music and movement.

e420641bb1261811d6445577ffe2ad2564b99266.en: Carolina Noriega's Gilipollas por el mundo at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a stand-up show about everyday anecdotes and observations of people around the world.

6dadb57558019d30e03a299c975a95c62186a119.en: Ara Malikian performs at Palacio Euskalduna on 6 December. The violinist moves from classical pieces to rock, flamenco and Middle Eastern melodies, with humour and intensity.

78a4a1d31212b4ffac30546fb6fecf65765748f3.en: The Sadies and Terra Lightfoot play Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 6 December.

02f65b32a12a63fa330d7a771925987c2325b1b9.en: Pero no se lo digas is a comedy at Teatro Campos Elíseos. A friend confides in a wife over whisky while her husband is out, and the confessions reveal the absurd side of her account.

9ceb026a5d152761f8926ac22e45614a1b78c94a.en: Fleshcrawl play Sala Groove in Portugalete on 6 December.

ec4ee0ff94dcd2dffc6c68ddb93b9006c14870d2.en: Mikkey Dee with Friends, the Scorpions drummer and former Motörhead member, plays Santana 27 in Bilbao on 6 December. The night revisits classic Motörhead songs, and Negra Calavera also perform.

be8dbe7c52813caad69eb6a0638b3f06dc92cb92.en: Vulcanizadas perform at Muxikebarri in Getxo. The Basque all-women band plays soul, blues, rhythm and blues and funk, with songs from its forthcoming second album.

7921b809081612bd781ffa124753ed68f8fe84a6.en: Óscar Terol's Terol existe at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a comedy show about the pace of technology, economic uncertainty and modern life.

d1e03a0587b66a503837e4f7e524f1da86642d64.en: Motx pailazoa's Oroitzapen ederrak is a family show for ages 2 to 8 at Muxikebarri in Getxo. The clown revisits memories of his late friend Martintxo.

53f919a21c2b05e9a0dc8b2c8c911a9a2ba0b126.en: The Kyiv Ballet performs Nutcracker at Palacio Euskalduna. The company, founded in 2017, will donate one euro per ticket to UNICEF for its work in Ukraine.

ddf34f864208e3c1f7f03ef022f5fe28fcc4f341.en: Peiremans+ play four concerts at Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 8, 9, 28 and 29 December.

b61684736e065478cce94ec9815f831ac68f8c05.en: La comedia sin título is a dramatised reading workshop at Algorta culture hall, run with Utopian. It explores Lorca's unfinished 1930s social drama and a continuation written by Alberto Conejero.

e8049aed5bab6413785810d5aa1532f39d2d1dd4.en: Irakurketa txokoa at La Sinsorga discusses Zorionak, edo antzeko zerbait by Karmele Mitxelena on 9 December. Alaine Agirre leads the reading corner.

3353fc9dc13474e7023737cf0e87b050efc1ec05.en: A poetry and music presentation of the book Cadencias de amor by Isabel Bravo, published by Ediciones Nogal, explores the intensity of love in three parts.

1b55ddd581b299f7797956f58c562dd15d4212be.en: The Last Internationale play Sala Groove in Portugalete on 9 December.

d1aa6ca5b88848c6a5c3c4eb55255435679b9764.en: Euskadiko Orkestra 2026/27 performs Guridi's Diez melodías vascas, Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 22 with Elisabeth Leonskaja and Elgar's Enigma Variations under Marzena Diakun. The programme marks the 90th anniversary of the first Basque Government.

b4c9e3ec36c6069319992b6ce84e0e4230852396.en: Raya Real's Con Alegría by Amazon Music at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a 90-minute Christmas show. It mixes flamenco traditions with Christmas carols, and includes zambomba-style songs.

523f131628d06b8163657bdc4accd063493f9308.en: Megalomanía is a comedy at Altamira Municipal Centre in Bilbao, part of Bilboko Zirkuitua 2026. An emotional coach gives a humorous lesson on how to reach perfect happiness, mocking online gurus.

4f533473fa3d96615caba5bf5fce04b0bb5f2836.en: Resurrección is a 2025 Chinese drama by Bi Gan, screened at Muxikebarri in Getxo as part of Zinemabarri. A monster adrift in dreams meets a woman who can see the illusions as they are.

eaf1f9c1ba26c3e259810f6cd728d90257f1bf55.en: Lost in Kyiv and Ärabrot play Sala Groove in Portugalete. Lost in Kyiv present their new album We're All Going to Be Fine, and Ärabrot are a Norwegian rock band led by Kjetil Nernes.

67c98a21c82221c6c9550a590198a4f181e3cbc8.en: Víctor de Diego's Haize berriak plays JAZZON Aretoa in Bilbao. The saxophonist leads a quintet with piano, double bass and drums.

35ae83135c74d092c0075eb34cf8894a51ebc8eb.en: Merino, a Madrid alternative pop band, plays Cotton Club in Bilbao on 10 December to present their new album El Bosque.

aad1fd413844815cc0d3311af1c00c41a290e2d9.en: Álex Fernández, son of Alejandro Fernández and grandson of Vicente Fernández, performs in Bilbao on 10 December at Teatro Campos Elíseos. The Mexican singer blends tradition and modern music.

36e5b621dcb4f289e7ff4157ca82ad9d634ce84e.en: Jay Wheeler performs at Bilbao Arena - Miribilla on 10 December on his La Voz Favorita tour. The Puerto Rican singer is known for reggaeton and urban music about love and relationships.

0fa513b1a74c7e04f232edf67cd7b13317141af0.en: Hard GZ plays Santana 27 in Bilbao on 10 and 11 December on his Lacosta tour. The Vigo-born rapper is known for critical and personal songs. The 11 December concert is sold out.

ab9f7efb01e2aea1a7fc8da4920262b3bbffc163.en: Etzakit return to the stage after almost 25 years to play a few concerts at Bilboko Kafe Antzokia on 10 December.

bb0a360ea643371149c23bf363e7178cdfeb4071.en: El club de los/as cuentistas at the Algorta culture hall is a storytelling session with the theme Tócala otra vez, Sam. The programme is for adults who want to tell or hear stories, and entry is free.

dd3165ec5257225dde6bbe85891163476bbd2f83.en: The Bilbao Symphony Orchestra and the Bilbao Choral Society perform Handel's Messiah at Palacio Euskalduna as a participatory concert. More than 340 amateur singers from Bilbao sing the choral parts from their seats.

502b71705d5aedb077c1cb8e2b5e7f6d580fc6a8.en: Mikel Bermejo's Eureka at Sondikako Kultur Etxea is an 80-minute comedy for ages 14 and over. The comedian takes a satirical look at influencers, modern life and everyday absurdities.

666494b694c7907c3d94050423011d9cb5dd0f11.en: Bublé Christmas Tribute at Teatro Campos Elíseos honours Michael Bublé with classic Christmas songs. The show is performed with the Red Velvet Big Band, a vintage-style jazz orchestra, and is aimed at the whole family.

0247497ea28d55b9e6b7a4096f4b41bfb3e7f9df.en: Teoría King Kong at Muxikebarri in Getxo is a monologue based on Virginie Despentes's feminist essay. Performed by M. Pau Pigem and directed by Isis Martín, it addresses gender roles, sexuality and violence.

a1d5066df558a268736a3575114225028aafafac.en: El funeral at Kultur Leioa is a music and theatre show by Teatro Ché & Moché. Romani musicians invite the audience to a funeral for their grandfather, which becomes a chaotic and musical party. It runs 105 minutes.

2bab30c1f7d5002e16181dbf385285a9524ba866.en: El show de Chares y Teresa at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a live show by two social media comedians. They reveal the story of their relationship, answer romantic questions and take part in live dating advice.

67bfc8b1eb423476b01ea8635d22b580783ed57e.en: Eshtadur, a Colombian melodic symphonic death metal band, plays Sala Groove in Portugalete this autumn. King and Fabulae Dramatis join the bill, and Eshtadur presents its fourth album.

cb73a35989f689993e5f73578e992a14756e2bdd.en: El muelle de las brumas, a 1938 French romance by Marcel Carné, screens at Romo Kultur Etxea in Getxo as part of the film club. A French army deserter in Le Havre falls for a young woman who is controlled by her guardian.

c9828ba1e814eefbe0c8096453e38babb24c8bc9.en: Mala Gestión play Stage Live in Bilbao on 11 December.

2d64a857ff191a661c5136130f584134e3f784f9.en: Camela play Bilbao Arena - Miribilla on 11 December on their new tour. The Madrid group, popular since the 1990s, blends pop, flamenco and techno-rumba.

61aa45e85c1b06ffc9be32dbaf43f4011591c233.en: Modus Operandi and Mirari play Social Antzokia in Basauri. Modus Operandi comes from the ska scene and is linked to Betagarri and Vendetta, and Mirari is a Basque-language pop project from Pamplona.

88b7c9e3d51939e51a51617ae60b33876bf2b6d9.en: Sidari, a Basque film by Xake Produkzioak, follows a thirty-something couple on an interrail trip. A meeting with an elderly couple leads them to question the future of their relationship.

4bd11df91b6e20a1b2aeae910603682349b03cd8.en: Iturfest 2026, the contemporary culture festival of Iturralde in Bilbao, takes place from 11 to 13 December. This year is the last edition of the festival.

e6c0d49fac584304297911de9fb6b64bcf053e44.en: Huella Entre Cuerpos, an exhibition by Natalia García Muro, is shown at Torre de Ariz from 11 to 18 December.

6305c906f87d3bf560ead4e45f649b54b02c9557.en: Kuraia 2026-2027 presents a concert by Synchresis and Paula Palencia at the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao, as part of the contemporary music encounters.

e3a0d55e4497e47600665cc90932029a3d2e9262.en: Agur Peter Pan is a puppet and actor show at Casa de Cultura Clara Campoamor, part of Barakaldo's 2026 family performing arts programme. A girl who plays Peter Pan with her grandfather is taken to Neverland.

1bd4fe6afbe84dce233f9f6e960caa70a1d08426.en: Ainhoa Juaniz's Perimenopausia at Berango Antzokia is a humorous show about feminism, equality and love. Each performance is different.

9e23b416fc19ad150f974b8c259b41cec351a568.en: Voldtekt, a 1971 Norwegian drama by Anja Breien, is screened in the Klasikoak 2026 cycle at the Museo de Bellas Artes de Bilbao. A man is suspected of a rape, and the case depends on the rigid justice system.

d02b55ab53f764925b685c462f15e7eb5ea6f442.en: Ke No Falte play Santana 27 in Bilbao on 12 December. The young Basque band mixes festive rhythms, rumba, pop and urban music.

f843c8bb1951464047d917ff45aa0aa05f4ef66e.en: La prodigiosa zapatera at Muxikebarri in Getxo is a dance version of Lorca's play by Manuel Segovia. The two-act comic ballet mixes Spanish dance with commedia dell'arte references.

c8aaa88e93bef985c03150c8b6e7b282748a6d8e.en: Paraíso Blanco by Teatro Percutor, staged at Utopian, retells the epic voyage of Aeneas through the journeys of present-day migrants from Africa to Europe. It uses puppets and manipulation.

f130bc276067fc6a0e49fcefa5a5053e553525df.en: Sergio Dalma performs at Bilbao Arena - Miribilla on 12 December 2026 on his Ritorno a Via Dalma tour. The show features Italian songs, celebrating his album of Italian covers.

074587f609f1f303dd2207bb8b3262c7ae3b8232.en: Candlelight Bilbao presents a 60-minute tribute to Hans Zimmer, performed by a string ensemble. The programme includes music from The Lion King, Interstellar and Dune.

22a4b08617bf7866072cd35bdcd02bb1689f852d.en: Forever, a tribute show about Michael Jackson at Palacio Euskalduna, features dancers, musicians and singers performing live. The production has been seen by more than a million spectators in 15 countries.

e973c75c7a42e85924462637bcae958276d7a628.en: Rox7 Experience is a tribute night to the band Roxette at Bilboko Kafe Antzokia.

1b63de3fac5e3de8409a22f416829598eb3cd6a4.en: Maneras de vivir is a tribute festival at Social Antzokia that revisits Spanish rock and pop hits from the 1980s and 1990s. The band plays songs by artists such as Loquillo, Radio Futura and Nacha Pop.

977df147cf371df20aa28582efcfb0d88dac0156.en: Katiuska, la mujer rusa at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a new production of Pablo Sorozabal's zarzuela by the Masa Coral del Ensanche. Set during the Russian Revolution, it tells of a love between a Soviet commissar and a member of the imperial family.

9cf0c11d5bd33cabb9405b9920faf8b314cba0f4.en: Your Name, an anime by Makoto Shinkai, is screened at Muxikebarri in Getxo as part of Zinematxiki. Two teenagers begin to swap bodies in their sleep and communicate through notes.

0fef995c3f58b2aef456076b61d5ce7e48c184e7.en: Scrooge eta mamuak at Muxikebarri in Getxo is a family adaptation of Dickens's A Christmas Carol. The miser Scrooge meets the ghosts who change his view of the world.

69cdbe260f3d4ab406e87c3c6eaf2249599e486e.en: Olentzeroren sekretua is a Basque-language children's show at Berango Antzokia. Olentzero must protect his secret from Maripetralin, who wants to stop Christmas.

6f82af9f8f8ecc18674aa134cc109be5bc90d0ad.en: Víctor Amilibia's La vida es rock and roll at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a comedy show about everyday habits and experiences, told with humour.

044a502b49344478bb3dd21935c321f63fd64020.en: La Virgen del Rocío se aparece porque se lo ha dicho su psicóloga is a comedy at Torrezabal Kultur Etxea. The Virgin of El Rocío seeks therapy and questions her role in the Bible and society.

98fa5f793b300c5bf00baac19bae4690cda15e9b.en: Cantajuego's Yo quiero ser at Palacio Euskalduna is a family show with songs and games. Children explore career and personal dreams with the band's friends Coco, Pepe and Buby.

7f972da3c80c2fc44e7aed4f3967144dc252bf47.en: Porrotx, Marimotots, Pupu eta Lore's Musu bete urte at Teatro Barakaldo is a Basque-language show for families. The clowns explore a year of kisses through songs and dance.

3a5f69f2842abfe6cc794b9551805c8d46fa6c10.en: The Bilbao Orkestra Sinfonikoa season 2026-2027 includes a recital by pianist Claire Huangci at Palacio Euskalduna, with works by Chopin, Fanny Mendelssohn, Florence Price and Gershwin.

ffc74f247b834a15acfcbc09cc190faaa3202403.en: The Bilbao Municipal Txistulari Band's Christmas Concert takes place at Teatro Campos Elíseos on 14 December. The programme includes the Bilbao Musika choirs, singer Maider Legarreta and pianist Gorka Aginaga.

f94dadfc2578e37ff90d6681570692f73ac0e80b.en: Humor en Corto 2026, the 25th short comedy film festival, takes place in Arrigorriaga from 14 to 19 December at Lonbo Aretoa.

9e01c5c1796b854d4ce4e7ea7034b76241d6bd4e.en: Bienvenidos al fin del mundo is screened at Mamariga Kulturgunea as part of the library's Endangered film cycle for the last quarter of 2026.

79c30a8ad4ef526d1108cbdfecb1a9f55f302f14.en: Dantzaldia 2026 at the Museo de Bellas Artes de Bilbao presents three dance pieces: Nahas, Desvelo and El demà d'ahir. Each explores connection, manual work and transformation.

c7aab059cc3fd7074a4975159dbf1d73133bac12.en: The Blues Brothers Tribute Show Soul Mission at Teatro Campos Elíseos offers soul, funk and rhythm and blues hits with eleven musicians. It recreates the spirit of Jake and Elwood.

9ada86087388c016cadc5754751c0f640eb12eae.en: Así que pasen cinco años is a three-act play by García Lorca, completed in 1931, which explores love and death. The dramatised reading workshop at Algorta culture hall is run with Utopian.

f0add7a9cda9dcff633f556663742eb88dbbca59.en: A nadie le importas is a satirical film screened at Teatro Campos Elíseos with a discussion with directors Cristina Galán and David Suárez. A television presenter's career is threatened after a controversial joke, and he rises to host a flagship show.

688da099f4b22b943e7c1acaebc87a39ced04354.en: El olvido que seremos is a Spanish-language literary meeting at the Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia, part of a fortnightly reading group. Two groups meet from September to December, with 20 places per group allocated by lottery.

4f228f7e7958966612eb5d74d23d910d9701d975.en: The Santurtzi book club at Casa Torre Jauregia reads Todo bajo el sol by Ana Penyas on 16 December. The club runs from October to December 2026 with places allocated by lottery.

cec4b51628e884fbda9304eb3bfefc387529e2ca.en: Ana Apika tells stories in Basque at the Romo library in Getxo, for children aged 4 to 8. The session is free and requires registration.

e9e586f90e0cf81701a75116117aef078aaaf99e.en: María Marín presents Las tres Marías at AZ Azkuna Zentroa. The flamenco singer from Utrera, who has worked with Israel Galván's company, revisits flamenco tradition in an album released in 2026.

eed07d46d9fdade325ef433f92dc39c632289d99.en: En un canal de la Mancha is a comedy at Rekalde Municipal Centre in Bilbao, part of Bilboko Zirkuitua 2026. Friends who meet every year near Christmas face an unexpectedly chaotic evening.

941aca5ca16a736a703663196a3bdbce7933a065.en: Así llegó la noche is a Spanish drama directed by Ángel Santos and screened at Muxikebarri in Getxo. A sculptor isolates himself on the Galician coast until a former lover arrives.

a57d95abb929256b80baa2fd999b9a50d1f0e7f9.en: The Bilbao Orkestra Sinfonikoa season 2026-2027 features Farrenc's Overture No. 1, Liszt's Three Sonnets of Petrarch and Brahms's Symphony No. 2 under Markus Stenz at Palacio Euskalduna. Tenor Xabier Anduaga is the soloist.

77aeb12e89d984ec5106773bd56467dddd291fd7.en: Mocedades and Los Panchos perform their 60th-anniversary tour at Teatro Campos Elíseos in Bilbao on 17 December. The programme includes Mocedades's classics and the bolero standards of Los Panchos.

4e2f81ce2642b14360914c0f4eeecc5872e94935.en: Gustav Lundgren Organ Trio plays JAZZON Aretoa in Bilbao. The Swedish guitarist leads a trio with Hammond organ and drums.

b5d2288c6991ba1414b9885c83ca3794c565c00b.en: The Leioa library book club discusses Miñan by Ibrahima Balde and Amets Arzallus Antia on 17 December. The session is free and runs at 17:00 and 19:15.

f4002dd6d89f2910ee26e62cd932265a83570685.en: The Biblioteca Foral de Bizkaia's Spanish-language reading group discusses Los ojos cerrados. Two groups meet fortnightly from September to December, with 20 places per group allocated by lottery.

274e7f272da25065d5e93dbcaecb4a2e99909e80.en: Palestina 36, a 2025 film by Annemarie Jacir, is screened at Serantes Kultur Aretoa for Cine Club Santurtzi. It reconstructs the Palestinian revolt against British colonialism 90 years ago, and a talk with Amnesty International follows.

d3dcf8f2a96cf092733c47b639983e72b192b028.en: DIB play Santana 27 in Bilbao. The Madrid urban artist mixes rap, trap and melodic sounds, with songs such as Como Myke and his album Focuz.

e20cda1cc9505313f15db8225b19c6b61ab9a303.en: Mi suicidio o El pesimismo alegre at Muxikebarri in Getxo is a solo show by Mario Gas. Based on Henri Roorda's text, it is a witty and fatalistic reflection on love, society, work and pleasure.

e3c355e52e04c2167561d332b093af0a483dd62b.en: OBK celebrate 35 years with their Vértigo Tour at Teatro Campos Elíseos in Bilbao on 18 December. The electronic group presents songs from its new album, including Maldita mujer.

b6384166defa1b5ce4997bfb2bdc6591b617c379.en: Las Bingueras de Eurípides at Kultur Leioa is a 65-minute comedy by Ana López Segovia. Women over fifty sing and dance with irreverence, inspired by the Puellae Gaditanae of the Roman Empire.

5f30f30359322e3ba70cc2f3cc2c864cc00394aa.en: Love Me Tender, a 2025 French drama by Ana Cazenave, is screened at Muxikebarri in Getxo as part of the cine club. After she tells her ex-husband that she is in relationships with women, she fights to keep custody of her son.

672494afe2c3f04a46e1d1f7fadbc6e883d8d1be.en: Gabon kontua at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a bilingual Christmas tale told, sung and danced by more than 170 artists. Two mischievous characters guide an audience journey through a Basque Christmas, and proceeds go to a charity for congenital heart disease.

25aa0eeef59cdb70ba93b44aa33fa220d2f47f0e.en: Candlelight Bilbao presents a 60-minute Christmas concert of Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker and classic winter pieces by candlelight. The programme includes Vivaldi's Winter and Strauss waltzes.

53acf53d47d6adf83114a4a33709671560ac38be.en: The Sugarland Express, a 1974 Steven Spielberg film, is screened in the Klasikoak 2026 cycle at the Museo de Bellas Artes de Bilbao. A young couple escapes prison to recover their child, who has been placed with a foster family.

7e03b8c6126f5d1a83d99d0a0e8e753e2b51cb14.en: Óscar Durán's Sin límites at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a family magic show with visual illusions, humour and improvisation, for ages 5 and up.

4d0411768d9ffaa18be674457dfeb21fd864c8ec.en: The Biotz Alai choir performs its Christmas concert at Muxikebarri in Getxo. The programme combines carols and choral works from different styles and eras.

56701fae29d723466f1f79e59d32fc23faa494cc.en: Lucía Joyce. Un pequeño drama en movimiento at Utopian is a monologue set in 1982 in a Northampton hospital. The daughter of James Joyce writes a farewell letter to her father, reflecting on her life as a dancer.

ecde9390b5fc909889662f511146beaaf9acd5b9.en: The Fall of Atlantis, Kruddö and Odem play Sala Groove in Portugalete on 19 December.

15c0c9084a051f6e1b0f24da99e3acffe7b64247.en: Candlelight Bilbao presents a 60-minute concert of film music from Christmas movies, performed by a string ensemble. The programme includes White Christmas and Carol of the Bells.

a71bb5d666d40dcd17e96dabd30fdd5a438d05b7.en: Lia Kali plays Santana 27 in Bilbao on 19 December. The singer blends reggae, soul and urban sounds with personal lyrics about freedom.

cc30bc2c44210a7ea648b1ea6f631f1856fc48d6.en: Ruper Ordorika and Mugalariak perform a special Christmas concert at Bilboko Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 19 December.

e06052be3a864b0b84b2f8d65c61624fba20b1db.en: Janus Lester presents his new album Lore at Palacio Euskalduna in Bilbao on 19 December. The singer from Bera blends soul, electronic, folk and pop with a band of seven musicians.

a80a25efb532917a6b31de8dba230b90f767ed1f.en: The Jury Experience: Travesía Mortal at the Sociedad Filarmónica de Bilbao is an interactive courtroom drama in which the audience acts as the jury, hears testimony and decides on guilt or innocence.

2dfac72c4122f2bdc13b6c56ef501bbd985d4b93.en: Barrakudaren altxorra is a family show at Muxikebarri in Getxo. A girl named Chispas ends up on a pirate ship whose crew cannot read, and she must help them find a treasure.

3d0a11035c8a554dc930f4c5c7786d59dd0125bb.en: Tadeo Jones y la lámpara maravillosa at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a theatre adventure. A magic lamp that grants wishes reappears in Buckingham Palace, and the characters are separated by a wish gone wrong.

c70c8429996a8f1f4277a14abe647effc0f6833a.en: Tu color, an animated film directed by Naoki Yamada, is screened at Romo Kultur Etxea as part of the children's Sunday cinema. A synaesthetic student and her friends form a band.

f47c0747502ebd318b3fb6dd6550f52b22089fcd.en: Ana Morgade, Raquel Hervás and Laura del Val perform Jajas en el barrio at Teatro Campos Elíseos. The three comedians share humour about everyday life, with a mix of good and bad days.

c370f539c5decd28d7efec45dd8a3200534ff3c2.en: Sopa de piedras at Muxikebarri in Getxo is a family play based on a traditional folk tale. A traveller turns a stone into a shared feast, after the villagers refuse to share, for ages 4 and up.

e65d8076a740d497d2de0d279d7ef266cf4c02d2.en: Jamming Sessions at Teatro Campos Elíseos is an improvised show that changes every night. Performers create scenes from audience suggestions, and the show has been running for more than 20 years.

f49cc4f0c5f5c9322cd03196ba5ee85527205210.en: Ballet Clásico Internacional performs Sleeping Beauty at Serantes Kultur Aretoa. The company, directed by Andréi Sharáyev, is known for traditional classical ballet.

eeafe6ab879dd8e857d24c4ea19d898a779b0046.en: Dantza Plazetan 2026 features Ondalan Erraldoien Konpartsa at Plaza Levante in San Ignacio. The free Basque folk dance programme runs in Bilbao's neighbourhoods during the year.

be08d2e93fd43479147a3849f42bd2d0080ea9e5.en: Amagoia Dragoia is a Basque-language children's play at Palacio Euskalduna by Ene Kantak. The friends travel back to the Middle Ages and must help a village facing injustice, with a dragon and a giant parade.

4b02144ba64072026990aad09dbc555b462e45fa.en: Go Azen 13.0 at Kultur Leioa continues the story of a summer music school. This season, the school becomes the Basque seat of a music academy, and the directors face questions about how students were selected.

16c414089d3f859a62cd80bec82fbaa54e3aa593.en: Rafa Sánchez, former frontman of La Unión, presents Biografía at Teatro Campos Elíseos in Bilbao on 22 December. The audiovisual show uses songs and commentary to tell the story of his life and career.

c84304c211921710956350756ff0111be9bc78f4.en: Versadas, a poetry club at Algorta culture hall, meets to discuss the work of Jaime Gil de Biedma. Participants read and talk about his poems together.

99b0105a294397a111063fff7394971452fc00b0.en: Bizkaia Kantuan, the final concert of the 2026 organ cycle, takes place at Palacio Euskalduna. The Bilbao Choral Society, directed by Enrique Azurza, performs Vierne's Messe solennelle with two organists playing the Karl Schuke organ together.

db035305b5ee63cbd927af33310dfba9842ce233.en: Mikel Bermejo's Euskaraz at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a solo monologue in Basque. The performer, who moved away from the Basque Country at 20, recounts his experiences of leaving home.

f45ebff27d2fa48c85dbcfa349df5998d40a4702.en: Div@s of Soul, an eleven-piece group, performs classic soul hits from the 1960s and 1970s at Bilboko Kafe Antzokia. Songs by Aretha Franklin, Ray Charles and Otis Redding are included.

cbbbe11d06a4464e63596c3b29540fd9ec9936e7.en: Dantza Plazetan 2026 features Gaztedi Dantzari Taldea. The free Basque folk dance programme runs across Bilbao's neighbourhoods during the year.

5f84ebb67015cb1eb8d074ed8038ca6b320045ff.en: tÁ is a dance-theatre piece at Teatro Barakaldo, set in a magical forest where two characters build a friendship through play. It lasts 35 minutes and is for children.

99b9aa2200ff68d64dad5ff159e0693f7769a392.en: Carolina Durante play Bizkaia Arena - BEC in Bilbao on 26 December 2026, on the Fin de la aventura tour. The band's third album, Elige tu propia aventura, is central to the concert.

162175fb496ffecdcd9cae064ca021a792801fde.en: Dantza Plazetan 2026 features Irutasun Dantzari Taldea. The free Basque folk dance programme runs across Bilbao's neighbourhoods during the year.

60608f552899fca5ad4193ed424ca5f52a62df2a.en: Madness at Muxikebarri in Getxo is a musical comedy by Yllana and Primital Brothers. It follows characters moving from the elite to homelessness, in an a cappella style.

9a5ce73897d6fe12d3ae5b3695d32d373fdfe13b.en: Smile, a Getxo band, presents its new album Chispa at Muxikebarri. The pop and rock group plays bright melodies and new songs.

e1477672912fc7ceac011a7ec40dfbc90fb23d0c.en: Las Migas perform Flamencas at Torrezabal Kultur Etxea. The Latin Grammy-winning group returns to traditional flamenco, with song, guitar and rhythm, and tickets cost 15 euros.

c63014951116d9be8e9168bd7d12a2b45eb571b7.en: Divorciarse a los 40 is a comedy by Diego Arjona at Teatro Campos Elíseos. The show mixes monologues, improvisation and a live television-style segment about divorce.

55f3148f1e7d65b5c7b42772489203bb7f84fcdc.en: Mikel Urdangarin plays his traditional end-of-year concert with his full band at Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao. The show covers songs from his early career to recent work.

95ae02863370fe02cf716b5b25ad0b2a1d3b98a3.en: Dakris, El Mago Invisible presents Tempo at Teatro Campos Elíseos. The magician's large-scale show features illusions, invisibility and audience members who take part on stage.

fe359baaec783a659cc0a220d4e710c97e06315a.en: Fito & Fitipaldis' Aullidos Tour, in a theatre format, plays Palacio Euskalduna on 26 and 27 December and on 8 and 9 January. The band performs songs from El monte de los aullidos and classics from its catalogue.

9e5e2a1cbe2c8d7a0cf1e15b79ffe4babedfa174.en: Hansel y Gretel, el musical at Kultur Leioa, directed by Jorge Fullana, retells the fairy tale with songs. The siblings and their dog Fito must defeat a witch who wants to fatten them up.

cd403f52ab9818d19850303737d919377db6ed1e.en: La patrulla canina: la dino película is screened at Muxikebarri in Getxo as part of Zinematxiki. The pups are shipwrecked on a dinosaur island, and must stop the mayor Humdinger from causing a volcanic eruption.

9cd5fc5849facf19a99fcdfdda883d07a01fa34d.en: La Cenicienta el musical by La Tomasa Teatro is a family musical at Social Antzokia with new songs. Cinderella and a prince seek freedom and true love, and one stepsister also finds romance.

ae92c0ccf3cc9eb18fcddb70d8c24f42b1d7b772.en: Miguel Miguel's Acojonado at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a comedy show about life after forty, misfortune and growing older. It also includes some magic tricks.

5ef5c641020472f6e0b1d9fe072d6713d38b6371.en: Cenicienta, un musical sin filtros at Muxikebarri in Getxo is a family musical that reinterprets the fairy tale. Cinderella's stepsisters are influencers obsessed with image, and a fairy changes her destiny.

8a4b445879cb9bcabdf2db53718cc657d80c192a.en: Gala de circo at Olalde Aretoa is a circus show presented by a host, with juggling and aerial acrobatics by experienced performers.

bb4f7005384f2babb5d1649ef50710220410c89a.en: Eva Cabezas's Sirviendo comedia at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a stand-up show about motherhood, love in the digital age and feminism, with improvisation.

fcb7068b618738a0a3418767fbf2e19adf1a2edf.en: Loa eta Laia Zuzenean at Kultur Leioa is a live show for children. The two characters sing and joke in Basque about healthy habits, respect and against bullying.

fa279c3571c317fd041c1489577bc4ace02c3d1a.en: Cocoren basoa at Kultur Leioa is a children's theatre piece about a child whose parents are separating. The action takes place inside the child's brain, in a forest of neurons, for ages 8 and up.

38f99dde9d1ec07176e78793c7f88f5a13eded80.en: Las hermanas de Buffalo Bill at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a comedy about two sisters controlled by their domineering brother, whose ghost stops them from escaping after his death.

9d90623d91fd9f6422f5f6e16f34eda2dbd77471.en: The Nutcracker at Torrezabal Kultur Etxea is a ballet choreographed by Peter Wright and set to Tchaikovsky's music. A girl receives a nutcracker doll that comes to life and takes her to a magical world of toys and sweets.

139fd91111307df2655ea99dfa6429b194842f74.en: Maluta 2026 is a Christmas circus gala at Torrezabal Kultur Etxea by Ganso&Cia. Artists from several countries perform short demonstrations of skill, with no animals.

7b81f7622477ce44f552b386256bd374ada623d7.en: El cerebro optimista at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a 90-minute theatre show by Dr. Mikel Alonso. It combines neuroscience, music and audience interaction to explore how the brain can change.

2d6751363be20344799521717bbe43adaad4c8a3.en: Go Azen 13.0 at Olalde Aretoa in Mungia continues the story of a summer music school. This season, it becomes the Basque seat of a music academy, and the directors face questions about how students were selected.

0142027f52814586fd52010e0abb52cd4073fc8c.en: Leioa Musika Banda performs its New Year concert at Kultur Leioa on 2 January 2027. The concert also marks the start of the band's 30th-anniversary celebrations.

1f8f8198d79f0510361f114d54894552e1188736.en: Madama Butterfly, Puccini's opera about the geisha Cio-Cio San, is staged at Muxikebarri in Getxo. The 1904 tragedy about two cultures is performed with conductor Iván Martí, and runs 120 minutes with an interval.

348b581490f92dc1cb6879be2e0755043703bc91.en: Délica Pop Orchestra performs hits by Queen, ABBA, The Beatles and other pop stars at Palacio Euskalduna. The programme includes Bohemian Rhapsody, Dancing Queen and Hey Jude.

f334e3b614b86e49b99ae297162ca38117a5ff39.en: Eñaut Elorrieta presents his fifth album Festina Lente at Bilboko Kafe Antzokia. The singer-songwriter from Gernika recorded the album with musicians from The National, and celebrates 30 years since his first song with Ken Zazpi.

cf20aa077bb3133004f1f31c66a1185f724c8baf.en: Hodei Magoa's Sentsazioak at Muxikebarri in Getxo is a family magic show. It combines illusions, humour and audience participation.

c5473c40eabdf26eadc68676623afddd15f171ce.en: Operetta at Teatro Barakaldo is a show by Cor de Teatre that blends vocal polyphony and gestural theatre. Singers play theatre workers in sketches built around famous operatic arias.

a91c514560eedd325d4f7a155a427cc363ec6224.en: Royal Film Concert Orchestra performs film music in Morricone and 100 Years of Cinema at Palacio Euskalduna. The 90-minute concert features scores from The Good, the Bad and the Ugly, Cinema Paradiso and The Mission.

d4207ce35f347fb4dcbc27ffe42a5d034f84f274.en: ABAO Txiki's Ali Babá y los 40 ladrones at Teatro Arriaga is a children's opera for ages 5 and up. Ali Baba discovers the thieves' hidden treasure, and his brother's greed sets off a chain of events.

d975e530cbcbf95854ecb892b962441647709dc3.en: Johann Strauss Grand New Year's Concert is staged at Teatro Campos Elíseos. The programme includes famous waltzes by Strauss, including The Blue Danube and the Radetzky March.

29f94ad8434a2cfdf9e7892bccf0f4d2be2f7aaf.en: Cine Philharmonic Orchestra presents the Alabama Gospel Choir at Teatro Campos Elíseos. The 20-voice choir performs from 19th-century spirituals to songs of protest and freedom, with funk and blues.

01370ee8f7532f9c0ac45d8ae87d17b468181579.en: The Nutcracker by the Imperial Heritage Ballet is staged at Teatro Campos Elíseos. Clara's night of dreams brings toys to life, a battle and a prince who guides her through snowy landscapes.

8fb9a66ff61aacd708344c8fbb40dbe2087dc1c3.en: Edu Herrera's Aquí el enemigo, dígame? at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a comic monologue, inspired by an idea of Miguel Gila. An enemy answers in the same absurd language, in a satire of today's polarisation and anti-war themes.

49769ddebe32b18fa20a2744f4bd45b32c398871.en: Bi palillo eta karabina bat, premiered at Teatro Arriaga, is a Basque-language play. A family arrives in a village and runs a shooting range, asking what a home needs in order to be one.

0eb42cbf4f58c0881b08120ee939b1ddf2806398.en: Gazte Artea Ezkerraldean 2026 is at Casa Torre Jauregia in Santurtzi from 6 January to 29 January 2027. Four young artists from the region show paintings, sculptures and mixed media.

1f53236fcb648934774a0314680b3f5a59e3dd9e.en: The Imperial Heritage Ballet performs Swan Lake at Teatro Campos Elíseos. The production tells the story of Odette and Prince Siegfried, with a cast of artists from nine nationalities.

bcad3206c24d5ad3a04343232f6aa9af419a76f4.en: Negufest 2027 at Muxikebarri in Getxo features Carlos Núñez with Celtic Beethoven. The Galician piper plays Irish, Scottish and Welsh melodies that inspired Beethoven, joined by harpist Bleuenn Le Friec and violinist María Sánchez.

e9921257fde9973af290321a649fb4a1c6c93664.en: Poco me parece is a political comedy by Marina Lobo, José Cabrera and Fernando Moraño at Teatro Campos Elíseos. The three comedians comment on current affairs with monologues, sketches and comic acrobatics.

c38645aa387aa0d3e7b733ab67dd4d492e4793f7.en: Sidecars play Santana 27 in Bilbao on 8 January, on their Everest tour.

75d8ffac8df511bc6811f0bb93c40801d7b58db1.en: Los días perfectos at Teatro Arriaga stars Leonardo Sbaraglia in an adaptation by Daniel Veronese of Jacobo Bergareche's story. A man reviews his marriage after reading letters that William Faulkner wrote to a lover.

b563b6a4640aec3ac0a3be77c848b1e4b0a0e0f2.en: El Monaguillo's Efectiviwonder is a stand-up show about childhood, comparing the carefree past with the present. It is staged at Teatro Campos Elíseos.

ef044eb7221c75b73185b249a2ce77f5f83483e7.en: Pasen y vean at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a family circus show presented by Carlos Adriano, who plays the ringmaster, magician and clown. Audience members join in as assistants.

aad44900c2a31137649e26f581244c9dbb46d553.en: Pantxoa eta Peio perform their final concerts at Bizkaia Arena - BEC on 9 and 10 January 2027. The Basque duo, active since 1969, are retiring after a farewell tour; a second date was added after the first sold out.

59dfbfd0c2fd66c43d47e5d90e482b7f1f0b36f6.en: Esencia at Teatro Barakaldo, by Ignacio García May and directed by Eduardo Vasco, stars Juan Echanove and Joaquín Climent. Two old friends talk while waiting for an author who never arrives.

797a1d7e9a754d281b65e280bc590814b2d180c8.en: Walls play Santana 27 in Bilbao on 9 January 2027, on their El día que me olvides tour. The Spanish singer began in freestyle rap and now writes emotional pop and rock.

1e1e7c183e794d51ba0c793bcd1ca4e0a431b310.en: Ballet of Lights: La Bella Durmiente is a classical ballet at Sociedad Filarmónica de Bilbao, with dancers in illuminated costumes. The production reinterprets the fairy tale of Sleeping Beauty.

0d9ae7973b7293fe8ce20af5e0c59e6aae5cc6d0.en: Miénteme at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a comedy about a wife who hides an infidelity and tells a chain of lies. Her home becomes chaotic, with a friend, a shaman and a smart speaker.

1df6ee09c8b2054a4249450e6c5ae8748bc67db8.en: Eduardo Aldán's Espinete no existe at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a 90-minute nostalgic comedy about childhood. It has been performed for 14 seasons in Madrid and reached more than one million spectators.

825e6d3452a2f6194eee8d62626ef4187ae3e064.en: The Bilbao Orkestra Sinfonikoa season 2026-2027 features Schumann's Piano Quartet in E-flat major and Brahms's Piano Quartet No. 1 at Palacio Euskalduna.

412ac88b7d69866c5c3116d83624864cebea92b7.en: Elkarrekin berriz, a Basque-language version of Fred Uhlman's novel adapted by Patxo Tellería, premieres at Teatro Arriaga on 13 January. A lawyer in New York receives a letter that reunites him with his teenage friend from Nazi Germany.

5369c6b7b34c537024555e267e56635752b1af55.en: Reencuentro, the Basque-language premiere of Fred Uhlman's novel adapted by Patxo Tellería, is at Teatro Arriaga on 12 January. A lawyer in New York receives a letter that reunites him with his childhood friend.

2e683fd578cafb56b34ee4e6e561af6ca1637a63.en: Gula / Gola at Teatro Arriaga is a new physical theatre creation by Oriol Pla and Pau Matas. A harlequin figure seeks to be seen and avoid emptiness, in a piece about gluttony.

e61d6ef51c0aaa123d1a7513e289fa4249afcef7.en: Erromintxelak play Teatro Barakaldo. The Basque swing band from Arrasate, formed in 2021, sings in Basque and presents its first album, Nork Erran Eni.

ce16b61eb2b08daa37d8a4a65d22160abedfd223.en: Williams and Zimmer, performed by the Cine Philharmonic Orchestra at Teatro Campos Elíseos, celebrates film music from Star Wars and Indiana Jones to Gladiator and The Lion King.

83bf49ceaf389849716883b6444deca58971df01.en: Julen Axpe's Camino al éxiSto at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a comedy about Athletic Club's long wait for a cup win, told through five cup finals lost and the lessons learned along the way.

f7c31ccadc14abd745e4e2011a318ff2b46b1c45.en: Supercremalleras play Bilboko Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 14 January. The rock band from Gernika-Lumo, formed in 2019, mixes rock, pop punk and indie.

cd33a45fa1d3011918c321c14378aa806cd21ed1.en: Coward, a 2026 Belgian-French-Dutch drama by Lukas Dhont, is screened at Serantes Kultur Aretoa for Cine Club Santurtzi. Two soldiers in the First World War find a fragile refuge in love and art.

a216df817082a16035642a6eb584b258ab1a36f5.en: Bi palillo eta karabina bat is staged at Social Antzokia in Basque. A family runs a shooting range and asks what a home needs in order to be a home.

713ff971a7dd10ba432a426b24bc4e8f88247a37.en: Euskadiko Orkestra 2026/27 presents Bach Inspiration under conductor Paul Goodwin at Palacio Euskalduna. The programme traces Bach's music through versions by Elgar, Webern, Vaughan Williams, Holst and Villa-Lobos.

e0af59c49d4fcaefaa430fa6b5b27d0aa6cd74e6.en: Bodas de sangre at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a Lorca tragedy performed by non-professional actors, as part of the Escena Popular programme. A bride who loved another man runs away on her wedding day.

cbccaa522d53eb98c87053e9f6cfdad89814b444.en: vangoura present their new album at Cotton Club in Bilbao on 15 January.

757f19e1dd57b8c458b9259aab1eb7bfcc247ee0.en: Elefantes perform at Teatro Campos Elíseos, presenting the album Para Todos. The Spanish band, formed more than thirty years ago, plays hits such as Azul and Al olvido with singer Shuarma.

6bfee3445bcd5c602b8fe48bbe7f0eaa033cf7ac.en: Los Enemigos, a Madrid rock band formed in 1985, perform at Santana 27 in Bilbao as part of Negufest 2027. The band, led by Josele Santiago, mixes rock with rhythm and blues.

6ba6a7f423663e85c27615b8265c3fbeadabffb7.en: Las amistades peligrosas at Teatro Arriaga is David Serrano's staging of Christopher Hampton's play, based on Laclos's 1782 novel. It is a story of manipulation, power and sex.

2a80ca7b2a10121b1e9f4c69ba2c6d4d5b7d19e0.en: Madres at Teatro Campos Elíseos follows five very different women locked in a school together. The isolation brings out the shadows and lights of motherhood, whether or not one chooses it.

08348714f4d25fca319210899d4f6d19ae45c75e.en: Bianca Kovacs's Una rumana muy legal at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a stand-up show. The actress and comedian has appeared on several Spanish television comedy programmes.

2ef88e63aeed7b64d4864b1c12d1ac937d98dc8f.en: Alén, a contemporary dance piece by Esther Latorre and Hugo Pereira, premieres in the Basque Country at Teatro Barakaldo. It explores the space between what one was and what one will become.

bb727b875789c865c8a6b744da8c045337ca65c2.en: Malú's QUINCE Tour plays Palacio Euskalduna in Bilbao on 16 January. The singer presents songs from her album QUINCE, which reflects on her career since she began at 15.

f88e3742a23d0c380a915d9bcb9e42f5bc4fc58f.en: De Acero, a tribute to Extremoduro, presents La gran antología de Robe at Santana 27 in Bilbao on 16 January.

a0c92402789661c3f0ae6e41a3a47e96fb8e0413.en: Rodrigo Cuevas performs his La belleza tour at Bizkaia Arena - BEC on 16 January 2027. The Asturian artist mixes traditional music with electronic sounds, humour and a message about freedom and diversity.

3663e015fd6d041ca230bdf9a644fa448223eee3.en: Santi Rodríguez's ¿Nos damos un viaje? at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a show in which the presenter invites the audience to choose where to travel, after disappointing television trips.

71166227ca320aa08cdf27e7a7ae0244353f5e91.en: Standstill play Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 16 January as part of Negusfest 2027. The Barcelona alternative rock band, formed in 1997, is known for the introspective lyrics of Enric Montefusco.

8c8803b765a0a27c86ae9127dcef1cb9360ccdbc.en: Eirenê at Teatro Barakaldo is a circus and clown show by La Troupe Malabó. Artists living among the remains of their tent during a war play games and tell a story of hope and peace, for children and families.

5ed2c11eacf954c3410d40102e04f110ca5412a9.en: Emiliana Artagaveytia's Cosas que me sorprenden de… at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a live stand-up show. The Uruguayan creator, based in Valencia, jokes about cultural differences between Uruguay and Spain.

1ff546489e11d51f8269a44ab826c72e412e33e2.en: Tres noches en Ítaca at Teatro Barakaldo is a tragicomedy by Alberto Conejero, directed by María Goiricelaya. Three sisters travel to Greece to bury their mother, a former Greek teacher who left her family.
