ebd6266125c18d53deda1efec6198fda1e0040d4.en: Veladas: Studio Ghibli Tribute at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a candlelit concert. A string and flute quartet plays music by Joe Hisaishi from films such as Spirited Away, My Neighbor Totoro and Princess Mononoke.

5c00da9d4c509442c991f9e1a0a18dead45bd7f2.en: The Bernaola Cycle 2026-2027 presents Ensemble Sinkro at the Conservatorio Juan Crisóstomo de Arriaga. The programme opens and closes with Carmelo Bernaola, marking 25 years since his death, and includes works by Hurel and Saariaho.

7d7d30b23c65d26aa6033cccf0857aa7da40fa46.en: Mungia's San Antontxu 2027 festivities take place on 18 January with a fair. The council has published the rules and application forms for stall holders, with applications due by 4 December 2027.

a7b9a0c6d392e6d132e2a88eeefab09581bce80d.en: The Bilbao Musika Encuentros de Dirección Orquestal 2026, the eleventh edition, run from 19 to 22 January 2027. Selected conductors lead the Bilbao Municipal Band, and the international guest is Lorenzo Della Fonte.

32822570bcadc0082a2c1a7d6a9a531f1dd0ef44.en: Spheres and Orion Child play Azkena in Bilbao on 21 January.

8694f9631a16e2bcef37d6dd216b7a0a1c5589d7.en: Sara Baras's Infinita at Teatro Arriaga is a flamenco dance show with eight women. It celebrates Andalusia and a shared legacy through rhythm and movement.

6cdf173d023b4a56e2a86b893198ae681364ff68.en: The Bilbao Municipal Band plays the closing concert of the XI Encuentros de Dirección Orquestal at the Conservatorio Juan Crisóstomo de Arriaga. Finalist conductors lead the band, with guest tutor Lorenzo della Fonte.

df49b18a78177bf99b380804de61da927c14aaae.en: Queen Revolution at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a two-hour tribute show from Italy. Nix Mercury, a Freddie Mercury impersonator, performs with costumes, video projections and piano.

7c66f7ea4f09276d05e5de5492fb7c82c26032be.en: Kase.O plays Bizkaia Arena - BEC in Bilbao on 22 January 2027, on his Camisa de fuerza tour.

579945b1f4ff7fd06b1fec19426a810acd4cdb20.en: Pignoise play Santana 27 in Bilbao on 22 January as part of Negusfest 2027. The Madrid pop-rock band, formed in 2000, is known for songs such as Nada que perder.

bcbda9027f6f0c0387433142977fff876e462b43.en: Bernal present their album Vida y Milagros at Azkena as part of Negusfest 2027. The Valencian alternative band, formed in 2022, plays post-pop with introspective lyrics.

7b264dafba285e6b35c6d29ef4a3f7e5da668665.en: Zilibito Records and 48280 play Social Antzokia in Basauri on 22 January. Zilibito use autotune for trap, hyper-pop and reggaeton, while 48280 is a Basque rap collective from Lekeitio.

6d2d31f4f45d19e0ce8526fdbcd98ab3940a7a9c.en: Andreu Casanova's Tinder Sorpresa at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a comedy safari through dating apps. The comedian shares his own stories and answers questions about online flirting.

8b2d525b36c5ba122242c506cdd200552c82aed4.en: La mujer rota is a play adapted from Simone de Beauvoir's text, performed by Anabel Alonso at Social Antzokia. On New Year's Eve, a woman alone with her memories confronts her past.

edf6bcf804d0f1543cc95838fe61e98e178c2276.en: Isabel Rey's Diva de barrio at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a nostalgic show about the early 2000s, before social media, told with anecdotes and a musical finale.

49286e96e8d7ffd01b28738aed668ab663523e9d.en: ABAO Bilbao Opera presents Wagner's Die Walküre at Palacio Euskalduna, the second part of The Ring. Viktor Altipenko sings Siegmund, Pedro Halffter conducts the BOS, and the production is by Guillermo Amaya.

2855e8393a3f4a154cf80b2d7a64e43b96160b9b.en: I Love Rock & Roll is a family rock show at Muxikebarri in Getxo. Live music, humour and audience participation take the audience through classic rock songs.

5f8b2b088988b2a3f14539e66d01c07a57acc38b.en: Javi Medina plays Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 14 January on his Gato Blanco tour.

2ad28f4380706a6064611a4232f481151357e927.en: De París a Granada, a Lied Arriagan recital at Teatro Arriaga, honours Manuel de Falla. It traces his years in Paris, with Debussy and Ravel, and his move to Granada in 1920.

f753b91b064990b0c8872008affd0748e93bca3f.en: Banda Municipal de Txistularis de Bilbao presents LORATZEN at Palacio Euskalduna on 27 January. The concert explores the encounter between the txistu and circus, staged in the Euskalduna's Hall II.

c27b8984d656d7dcdb6662c1818612f97efb6382.en: TOC TOC at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a comedy by Laurent Baffie. Six patients with obsessive-compulsive disorder meet in a psychologist's waiting room and turn the wait into group therapy.

357d6afe474dcac6f90f58050da8ed7f9d36ce68.en: Rose, an Austrian film by Markus Schleinzer, is screened at Serantes Kultur Aretoa for Cine Club Santurtzi. In 17th-century Europe, a woman lives as a man to find work and escape a forced marriage during the Thirty Years' War.

521c3e77d178f52b7937aad9ddd4173881b7890a.en: Volavent play Cotton Club in Bilbao. The band is known for powerful live shows and its own style.

faed206e96ae3d39a0071fbb8ffaa0e9658de569.en: Barry B plays Santana 27 in Bilbao on 29 January on his The Barry B Fortuna Tour 27 Show. The Spanish urban artist mixes rap, pop and modern sounds.

6bf10a22f67784badbc778432d09ebe6922b220d.en: The trio Mujeres play Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 29 January.

a7bd6be8ceae1cbbf483a3fd6596400daebb7e7d.en: Personas, lugares y cosas at Teatro Arriaga, by Duncan Macmillan and directed by Pablo Messiez, follows an actress who enters a rehabilitation clinic after a breakdown. The play shows the group's shared process of recovery, with strobe lighting effects.

110fc3ff4d306706a0c54d46be0f80ab4dba02fa.en: Farsa y licencia de la reina castiza, a Basque premiere at Teatro Barakaldo, is Valle-Inclán's satire of the court of Isabel II. A rogue tries to blackmail the queen with letters, and the court's corruption and hypocrisy are exposed.

31130bf5d494fa92f897ebf5f4809dcc3aec11ec.en: Poncho K plays Santana 27 in Bilbao as part of Negusfest 2027. The Seville-born singer-songwriter mixes urban rock, song and poetry.

06ef7e9dc2519e02d1b87bbbc75b2b03a0846b4c.en: El carnaval animal at Social Antzokia is a children's show based on Saint-Saëns's Carnival of the Animals. On carnival day, a lion who appears fierce longs to play with his friends.

532731757d3990a8ef7dcde3350a3eabd05075dd.en: Cuarteto Emispherio, with "Paisajes sonoros", performs at the Conservatorio Juan Crisóstomo de Arriaga as part of the Kuraia 2026-2027 contemporary music encounters.

72f59a8989d1d3aa0d1208fe8ed24c78402b65e8.en: Cresh K, a rapper from Sestao, plays Santana 27 in Bilbao. He left the Athletic Club youth system at 17 to pursue music, and his lyrics refer to football.

5a8b5c60d255b57e3285e0de50b3a4849eb799e5.en: Euskadiko Orkestra 2026/27 presents Prokofiev and Schumann at Palacio Euskalduna under Philipp von Steinaecker, with violinist Akiko Suwanai. The programme pairs Schumann's Genoveva overture and Fourth Symphony with Prokofiev's First Violin Concerto.

60d0321d628e81f4f947be224dbfce4b471b460c.en: The Bilbao Symphonic Orchestra season 2026-2027 presents Fabio Biondi conducting Mendelssohn's Italian Symphony and Mozart's Jupiter Symphony at Palacio Euskalduna.

095f251d25bb1b0946b91f8087eed4d39f6fc938.en: Fjord, a 2026 Romanian drama by Cristian Mungiu, is screened at Serantes Kultur Aretoa for Cine Club Santurtzi. A Romanian evangelical family moves to Norway, and an injury to a daughter sparks a dispute about parenting and institutions.

1f1c7602d7e701d0aff5076342e60727b5210e8b.en: Wim Mertens plays a solo concert with piano and voice at Muxikebarri in Getxo as part of Negusfest 2027. The Belgian composer performs pieces from Ma Soeur Masculin and solo piano works.

1c986a0b3b72471018714c626440d78e09bf2a91.en: Los Zigarros play Santana 27 in Bilbao as part of Negusfest 2027. The Valencian rock band, formed in 2011 around the Tormo brothers, is known for high-energy live shows.

b7f763e2555dd162932a740d43a32a01b7dc2fff.en: Reality plays Stage Live in Bilbao as part of Negusfest 2027. The tour presents the album Por Si Muero Mañana, which is personal and introspective.

53d7cb0bc303bf80ebc7706e44da7ec89862d88c.en: Eneritz Furyak presents her album HHH at Azkena as part of Negusfest 2027. The new record brings a change in sound and in the live set-up, with electronic textures.

5d563add8618bf787cd80bcca88b6a0523b40c8d.en: Albert Pla announces his new album No quiero hablar de mí, pero yo es, due in November, with a stage show developed with Nueveojos. The album is his first solo record in almost two decades.

30da2b846f1ac8852abe036aa8a21de695dc187a.en: Lamiako 1979, a contemporary opera in Basque, premieres at Teatro Arriaga. Set in the Lamiako neighbourhood in the late 20th century, it explores memory and identity, with four soloists, the Leioa Kantika Korala choir and electronic music.

7fc85960ea814d68ca0df83a66727561be27a6a4.en: Kiev Ballet presents El Corsario at Palacio Euskalduna, a three-act ballet based on a Byron poem, with music by Adolphe Adam. The company donates funds from each ticket to UNICEF's work in Ukraine.

ec303284e1c2e86f5c3378d20db12c579e3f9ed5.en: Negusfest 2027 brings Rubén Pozo and Los Chicos de la Curva to Azkena. The singer's tour extends his 50town tour with rock songs from his latest album.

72a0767219509b8df1be2407b647b0cefa7d0ec9.en: Sho-Hai, a rapper and composer from Zaragoza, plays Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao as part of Negusfest 2027. His lyrics mix reflection, social criticism and humour.

bd33154b21f7979629b87b493424f71782f078a7.en: The Bilbao Orkestra Sinfonikoa season 2026-2027 presents Beethoven's Quintet for piano and winds and his Sextet for two horns and strings at Palacio Euskalduna.

b433508e7bc6766b0bff88c100dda75d6c548756.en: I'M BATH, a premiere at Teatro Arriaga by the company Khea Ziater, is a bilingual play set in a station toilet. A cleaner's observations and encounters with travellers and strangers are told in three stories per performance.

53a7600181db44ed15660b3c07932c103f546e28.en: The Bilbao Orkestra Sinfonikoa season 2026-2027 presents Berlioz's Symphonie fantastique and Ibert's Flute Concerto at Palacio Euskalduna, with soloist Patricia Ruiz and conductor Pablo González.

7bebc3f2b039c1dd7b79c047aef4b36d1452b411.en: Anari plays Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 11 February, a rescheduled date. The Basque singer, active since 1997, mixes rock and folk with poetic lyrics.

4493261d756e40b318f17eb229c3b899cd5dbcdb.en: La Milagrosa perform the official live premiere of their new album at D8 Sorkuntza Faktoria in Zorroza on 12 February. The concert features their atmospheric guitars and distortion.

df5312e68eae6789a419e3720fc3e017fa70422e.en: Al Safir plays Santana 27 in Bilbao on 12 February 2027, presenting his latest album, Príncipe. The Sierra de Madrid rapper will perform his greatest hits.

9178e32e1442957fb9b4e3c0d47b878cba230e3b.en: Puño Dragón, an alternative rock band from Asturias formed in 2021, plays Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao. Their album Juegos Violentos has intense rhythms and ironic lyrics.

ea9240cf2e45785f026232f23a331a4b9eb6cce1.en: Petite Lorena's Tremenda at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a solo stand-up show in which she speaks to the audience about the world with a rural, oral storytelling style.

2c3f8475fbc19245b69c8bed4f77a5decba1224a.en: Morgan closes the Hotel Tour with a concert at Teatro Arriaga on 13 February 2027, presenting the album HOTEL MORGAN. The band last played the theatre in 2021.

210cb1ff41fdc74f1759c147dd2d3b7dd3661688.en: KTULU play Santana 27 in Bilbao on 13 February 2027.

dcf29ece5857974164ae44ae1c752bbfc6727ff7.en: Candlelight Bilbao presents a 60-minute Valentine's Day concert of love songs from classic films, performed by a string ensemble. The programme includes Unchained Melody and Moon River.

8be25b682928217fc6ff8540f8eb73cb4984253f.en: Noticiero Live Show at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a comic news programme. The presenter Nosoloviernes comments on the week's top stories and viral videos, with improvised segments.

8020ba9b5ae21b0fa283038a9085e3684b77eecb.en: La Cabra Mecánica play Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao as part of Negusfest 2027. The Madrid pop-rock band, led by Lichis, mixes rock, rumba and funk with ironic lyrics.

189e2e8c106bcea91f295dd51251b58d1fdfefba.en: Mundua Dantzan, a Korrontzi show at Bizkaia Arena - BEC on 13 February 2027, brings together more than 80 dance groups from the Basque Country and elsewhere. It combines live music and a large-scale staging.

f8e807c9e738dcc40668e2b2ce18ed310f4608fc.en: Amodioa, a Matinées Arriagan recital at Teatro Arriaga on Valentine's Day, pairs tenor Aitor Garitano with pianist Germán Ormazabal. The programme combines Basque song with romantic European lieder.

375fbc09a208c0776a18fb0a58e45f98d1bbb0f8.en: Tito Ramírez and Los Verdaderos Reales play Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao as part of Negusfest 2027. The Spanish band mixes mambo, boogaloo, cha-cha-chá and cumbia.

bf278ad1068feff92ad6f5b6c735a07d94be3b6e.en: ABBORN, a Slovak tribute act, presents Abba Generation at Teatro Campos Elíseos. The show features the group's hits with replicas of the original costumes and live vocals.

e36f38008eb6eb5a3f75b09157429e6a223a3491.en: The Bilbao Orkestra Sinfonikoa season 2026-2027 presents Shostakovich's Fifth Symphony and Castelnuovo-Tedesco's Violin Concerto No. 2 at Palacio Euskalduna, with violinist Francesca Dego.

f30eeef3ba326f2aba2af5ed15abc8413e52900d.en: Íñigo Quintero plays Stage Live in Bilbao on 18 February 2027. The Spanish singer-songwriter is known for the song Si no estás, and his piano-driven style appeals to young audiences.

dc5e7e38e2b8f533fb531f00e2e0518256761359.en: Minotaur, a 2026 drama by Andrey Zvyagintsev, is screened at Serantes Kultur Aretoa for Cine Club Santurtzi. It portrays Russia at the start of the 2022 invasion of Ukraine through a marriage in crisis.

86ffc0cd44405b9e6c3995024e15234e6e369062.en: 7 minutos at Teatro Arriaga, directed by Sergio Peris-Mencheta, follows eleven women workers in a textile factory who must decide whether to accept a cut of seven minutes of break time. The thriller unfolds in real time, based on a real case.

e73129bb03dd82e49bbc0cb47a23b064a77af16f.en: Míster Jägger's Morirse de rabia at Teatro Campos Elíseos is his first monologue, a black comedy about what keeps us alive and what kills us inside. It runs on 19 February.

4727059904b8799f13b88b8ab5f55bfd2fb5eaa4.en: Delacueva plays Cotton Club in Bilbao. The artist combines sensitivity and personality in songs that convey emotions with closeness.

13fb15f877996915270e5e3296d81828ce316c1c.en: Cupido is a music project created in 2018 by Pimp Flaco and the group Solo Astra. It mixes pop, indie and electronic sounds, with guitars and autotune.

c7f28370558115ab45c249510d282b62415891b5.en: La ruina at Teatro Campos Elíseos on 19 and 20 February is a show where audience members and guests share their most embarrassing stories. The comedians Ignasi Taltavull and Tomàs Fuentes host the evening as a form of group therapy.

4e6f750fe199a8f28205f867ff4b50e6f6bfacb3.en: Candlelight Bilbao presents La ley innata, a 60-minute concert by a string ensemble, with a programme that ends in a flamenco coda.

bed0af433fd07f1b6ac8fd075abfeb4c79bec67f.en: Kuraia 2026-2027 presents Álvaro Lozano and the Premio Fundación SGAE Euskadi at the Conservatorio Juan Crisóstomo de Arriaga, as part of the contemporary music encounters.

79a8e2087709bebac8400dc389cb6b240cfc12fe.en: Raul Clyde, a singer-songwriter from Aldaia, Valencia, plays Santana 27 in Bilbao. He mainly makes reggaeton and urban music and released the album El vendedor de rosas in 2026.

6ae8b07597bb42518d8a7034c97ae8c485d7a63b.en: Ginebras, an indie pop band from Madrid, plays Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao. The band mixes bright guitars, festive spirit and catchy melodies.

2c251fb903d5265b87c859fc077feace5271e09c.en: Belén Aguilera's Puro Teatro Tour at Teatro Arriaga on 21 February presents the next stage of her Anela project. The show combines visual storytelling, piano and pop energy.

9aee1d3a657bd3f41be6e86bc3a97949fabd8997.en: Violeta Tour: La última escena in Muxikebarri in Getxo on 21 February is the final stage of her first album era. The show revisits songs from that album and celebrates the audience.

f5b29527a4ab8c845e7d5c13aaec204e4ad1ab8f.en: Roberto Devereux, Donizetti's tragedy in three acts, is staged by ABAO at Palacio Euskalduna. Yolanda Auyanet sings Queen Elizabeth I, with the Euskadiko Orkestra under Iván López-Reynoso.

039bff0667317b6b62ff144133dc7d42831f5ba9.en: Gutun Zuria 2026, the 20th International Literature Festival of Bilbao, takes place at AZ Azkuna Zentroa from 23 to 27 February. About thirty contemporary writers take part.

08553a42ba8a15d8e30b991eeca9bdeb56a3addc.en: Klasikoen txokora, a Bilbao Municipal Txistulari Band concert at Palacio Euskalduna on 24 February, pairs the txistu with piano. Iñar Sastre joins the band.

0615c3eec3509cfe20c13208db12ed9c5f5fc79a.en: Metrika plays Santana 27 in Bilbao on 26 February on her La Orden World Tour. The young Spanish artist is known for trap and reggaeton with catchy rhythms.

0c65d2de5420cae5a3b3c77de6522e3712ebe109.en: Miguel Lago's Miserable II at Teatro Campos Elíseos is a stand-up show with new routines and unreleased material, the next part of his trilogy.

bd7c63459e4cd1b703fa157ec26e6008cd5c70f9.en: Tennessee, a Spanish pop band formed in the 1980s, plays Stage Live in Bilbao. The group is known for vocal harmonies and songs such as Te vi correr.

7ade1305d73f1d64587154b6c3cb80dc1aeebeb8.en: Nationaltheater Mannheim Tanz performs at Teatro Arriaga, presenting works by the Van Opstal brothers, Stephan Thoss and Martin Harriague. The programme includes Mommy, Look and Dreamer.

b11ca4f72151ebc617568f23ba90193d196a5f21.en: Candlelight Bilbao presents a 60-minute tribute to Adele, performed by a string ensemble. The programme includes Rolling in the Deep and Someone Like You.

6ef84f9aa9a24ae23263434528e40f9dca9799e8.en: Izaro presents her new album Arkitektura in a tour at Palacio Euskalduna on 27 February. The Basque singer-songwriter's new work focuses on motherhood and building a life.

7eaac8eb6a178b9ca6437cf060fa1d6c84413cb7.en: Lendakaris Muertos, a punk-rock band formed in Pamplona in 2004, plays Santana 27 in Bilbao on 27 February with a guest band. Their songs address social and political issues in the Basque Country and Navarre.

6aa9f39371251747d98fcf1cfe183c715dd933f1.en: Nøgen, the Donostia folk-pop band, begins its farewell tour at Kafe Antzokia in Bilbao on 27 February. Its fourth and last album, Onak eta txarrak, is due in early 2027.

5094f8ee11495d6806a40a14fcd9f1d1ab902aaf.en: Pica-Pica present Mucho cuento at Teatro Campos Elíseos, a children's show of fairy-tale songs and new tracks from their latest album.

cdfd12120b056322eada6af68fb21a942dcb7d3f.en: The Bilbao Orkestra Sinfonikoa season 2026-2027 presents Hummel's Clarinet Quartet and Mozart's Divertimento K. 251 at Palacio Euskalduna, with Latin American dances by José Elizondo.

f03582df73280e56c97ded46ae1358f692617269.en: El Niño de la Hipoteca and Guiu Cortés present a music show at Azkena that mixes songs, humour, a board game and a karate fight. The audience votes on what happens next in the show.

b4150c5ad933d75f6d36885f08e75925267de67a.en: Gernika, staged at Teatro Arriaga by Aukeran Dantza Konpainia as part of Loraldia 2027, blends Basque traditional dance with contemporary dance. It marks the 90th anniversary of the bombing of Gernika.

0e52256b21cc5c9ce4971417c6cc6279047fc74f.en: Eraikuntzarako materiala, a Basque-language play at Teatro Arriaga as part of Loraldia 2027, adapts Eider Rodríguez's novel. It tells the story of a daughter's relationship with her alcoholic father after his collapse.

4fcf5e090c17e5533510d9786fd04e6ad56788af.en: Ill Pekeño and Ergo Pro, two rappers from south Madrid, play Santana 27 in Bilbao on 12 March. They are part of MG Knowledge and draw on boom bap and 1990s rap.

a0dc2e16cd133d4387628c8940fbb5875be6143f.en: Talco, an Italian ska-punk band formed in 2001, play Santana 27 in Bilbao on 13 March. Their songs address social and political issues.

61ebf238fcc0e090ef974ed6315e1e60afcd4fa4.en: An exhibition on comics from the Bicentennial era of the United States, at Rigoberta Menchú library. The opening has been postponed, with a new date to be confirmed.

5d505bfc1337d7c4f953bf2a8c64f29c597c8f6c.en: A two-stage garden waste shredding service. Drop off branches up to 8 cm wide, then collect the wood chips on Saturday 4 November from 13:00 to 17:30.

7d4020662d425687742792e16839544828eb51b6.en: English-language fall camps at Fabrique Bilingue, with creative projects, games and Halloween-inspired crafts. Places fill up fast.

986b6b958e0f88dfa3932c240d4252f64af254a1.en: Couleurs terrestres, an exhibition from 13 October to 11 December 2026 of art made from discarded objects and materials, with work by artists including Yannick Beslot and Jérémy Gobé. Workshops and tours are offered to schools.

357a8f35a3de754611b334d3395f35a68ce63853.en: A two-stage garden waste shredding service. Drop off branches up to 8 cm wide, then collect the wood chips on Saturday 7 November from 09:00 to 13:00.

9de4c263d0954a5a8c3b3a54eed9a2a066f9e16f.en: Le voyage de Miguelito, a five-morning writing and adventure course for ages 7 to 10, in which children follow a boy on a trip to Mexico and create their own travel story.

937e7b2792524e824944b6c20f00a4349e4365e3.en: A two-stage garden waste shredding service. Drop off branches up to 8 cm wide, then collect the wood chips on Saturday 31 October from 09:30 to 12:30.

69ad9f5faf1fb2cc03dc9d5e959f751f0fb2a475.en: A street-style holiday camp in Cenon: hip-hop dance in the morning, a picnic, then a graffiti workshop in the afternoon. Only available as a full-week package, booked through HelloAsso.

4d612099dfa14d9709a2a3aff0436d0c331e789a.en: Sur les traces de Jean Dupas, an archive exhibition on the Bordeaux-born artist, covering his student years, his 1910 Prix de Rome and his 1937 work for the Bourse du Travail.

a57bac6f72145a9d357dc005c410342df6bef01f.en: Café des bébés, a drop-in for parents of young children at Pessac library, to share everyday tips and ease isolation, with songs, rhymes and stories from librarians.

f6b6f74f9eb4a6e355d67ecb043c1a7ee12d2754.en: The Saint-Michel spire reopens. It is a landmark of the Saint-Michel quarter and gives a panoramic view over Bordeaux.

91db9b0179ffc8e9cd8ae05c9c0d20dd33aad4f9.en: Three sophrology workshops with a qualified practitioner at Bordeaux-Lac library, on 22 October, 6 November and 18 December. Registration is needed for the full cycle.

0b5634e92f994268fb511e6c49a4960ffce8323f.en: A camera obscura photo workshop, in which participants capture an image on photosensitive paper, develop it and learn the basics of optics. Two days, 22 and 23 October, 10:00 to 15:00.

0199acd3960525d65f153316e1d3380531365286.en: La douane aux frontières du large, a temporary exhibition at the National Customs Museum from 2 April to 22 November 2026 on the Coast Guard's maritime role, from the 18th century to today.

5a7497a654149f8f3ecd0e5c24324a4efc8bb031.en: Mois de la résilience, a month of events across Bordeaux Métropole in October 2026 on climate risks, extreme heat and how to prepare for extreme events.

d67229421407614d21ad3c068de8de452e4b4df2.en: NEXUS AQUARUM, an exhibition by the Indépendants Plasticiens de Bordeaux on water in its many forms, at Espace Mably from 20 to 27 October. Opening on 21 October at 18:30. Free entry.

023cc02bf0a17a2072c31c769bd6f8a536ae01d6.en: Autumn holiday activities at the Bordeaux Natural History Museum, with cat legends and a family coat-of-arms workshop for ages 6 and up, a detective game, and stories for children aged 0 to 6.

0a5bbc02fe27c278a9137804ca13e19dba4dd37e.en: A multimedia session at Bègles library introducing Word, what it is and how to use it, with good-practice tips.

65d47f587c6a399bde4b707eca2836f9fc92dd6a.en: Drawing classes for ages 3 to 14 at the Bordeaux Fine Arts Museum during the school holidays, covering pencil, stumping and grid-drawing techniques.

c8c131563df2aa8670945a1b7ec4b4ffe8ce508e.en: Emotional Heritage, an exhibition at Arc en Rêve showing the design process of Flores & Prats through models, drawings, surveys and prototypes, building on existing places.

db3850d84d4b10250f6e9f581075225b9ae86dc7.en: Toussaint holidays at Cap Sciences, from 17 October to 1 November 2026, with exhibitions on the microbiome and circus science, a planetarium, retro gaming and workshops for different ages.

5f5143554191ef97d01111c252e96df8044fb8af.en: The autumn fair on Place des Quinconces, a funfair with around 200 rides, attractions, sweets and local produce. Open daily from 11:00 until midnight, and until 2:00 on Friday and Saturday.

ff9ac97f46882ba0800d23ac4bad091a9c7dddf2.en: Contre-nuit by Dan Potentier at BAM projects, 47 rue Lombard, until 14 November 2026. The paintings explore male bodies, desire and intimacy, in his first solo show in Bordeaux.

2af9bb862bebf6e0446ed1c503c2b0c3763d4c10.en: Pièce et forme, a poetic exhibition at Arc en Rêve by architect Jean-Christophe Quinton, on the basic elements of architecture: room, form, geometry, light and construction.

c3815c135b13b3b6ecb957e8600861b672528369.en: La Chose, a children's show for ages 6 and up (45 minutes) by L'Imaginable Compagnie, about a creature born without a head who searches for identity and learns about difference. Part of the Sous les Loupiotes festival.

a9c5d0821baad5f12d917ab5eff35e9c59d4228d.en: Jean Dupas & Co. Le grand Art déco at the Galerie des Beaux-Arts, on show from 26 June to 29 November 2026. It covers painting, sculpture, graphics and ceramics, with a season of Art Deco events across Bordeaux.

60a1c37d21c44ad491b1e0ede77922ddc7bef8c1.en: FASHION MONSTER by Léonor Lumineau, a photo exhibition at the Maison écocitoyenne from 1 to 31 October. Portraits are turned into creatures made from the sitters' own clothes, to show overconsumption. Free entry.

9d397d4ae2ea79d066a0274540e6fc2c7079485d.en: Via Sensoria at La Cité du Vin, from 1 April to 1 November 2026. It is a one-hour tasting walk through pavilions themed on the four seasons, for groups of up to 15 with four Bordeaux wines or non-alcoholic drinks. Sessions in French, English or Spanish.

1ea9e4d9fd0217e5362951d2bd2cddc533b1c077.en: Les nuages ont aussi des racines by Collectif Specimen, a profile of a travelling artist whose drawings, travel notebooks and workshops turn encounters and landscapes into art.

2940e20a0b595c8cb511d39d2d64df3093638e2c.en: DYS month at Bordeaux libraries, from 10 October to 14 November, with collections, tools and family events for people with dyslexia, dyspraxia or dyscalculia. It includes a round table on learning to read on 10 October.

bd9564dad4c2b2e9fba00487c7e8621c3499be8f.en: 10 pour DYS: L'Odyssée des invisibles at Mériadeck library, an immersive photo and audio exhibition based on Elvire Cassan's book about people with dys conditions. Meeting with Elvire Cassan and Elisa Pichard on Saturday 24 October at 14:30.

17b6e661ef244aff6780ebf9ab16e701ead2012c.en: Epiphania, a sound walk at Mériadeck library that mixes podcasts with rare books from its stacks. It honours three 19th-century writers and travellers born in Aquitaine, with author Aurélia Coulaty and musician Sol Hess.

988f0d2fcac5a118f780069058983ce44432cfe3.en: Festival Gribouillis at Mériadeck library, a retrospective of Québec cartoonist Michel Rabagliati and his Paul series, with a film screening and an artist's opening.

67b4e7dda4cc82e7334500af53ffe1405bfb4238.en: A guided walk through the cathedral quarter at Hôtel de Ragueneau, around Pey-Berland and the Saint-André cathedral, with small architectural details and stories. Dates on 21 October at 18:00 and 22 October at 13:30.

0d9b90badf8500c79af6aa7bd8a2936741e16f83.en: An exhibition of painters and sculptors from Burgos at Jacques Ellul media library in Pessac, presenting work by the Burgos Guild of Visual Artists.

33aea6131be6d632598c84ec245bc35c86b01bde.en: Mine d'Émile s'expose, an exhibition of sculptures made from recycled metal by an engaged artist, at Bordeaux-Lac library from 3 October to 3 November. Free entry.

da74aa03d6e2574cd1e69d29073b610349d0c99b.en: An architecture course for children at 125 cours Journu Aubert, introducing children to architecture and the city.

15ff0082c3a994d72084bdc7fab312dc603b089b.en: A naturalist outing at Le Taillan-Médoc, to observe animals and learn to tell signs of presence from tracks. The meeting point is sent when you register.

483ca77702a56a929564f69779fc42bef8446c84.en: L'Igloo, a continuous audio theatre installation by Compagnie Intérieur Nuit at Pierre Veilletet library, open to all from 22 to 24 October. Visitors lie back in a dark space and listen to six-channel sound, with no images.

f34215aecae1308bde1b963b8f1a38cbd291d0ea.en: BRASILIA, photographs by Lucien Clergue at Galerie Arrêt sur l'Image, on his friendship with architect Oscar Niemeyer and his photos of Brasília as an interpretation of modernity and utopia.

b67ee42339192a0805bca842d15afe5118164f73.en: Un habit trop grand, an exhibition by Paul Peinture and AFTC Gironde at Hôtel de Ragueneau from 16 to 31 October 2026. It grows out of painting and writing workshops with people affected by brain injuries.

c035c4043405db21611a6292b784651e2b3aea60.en: Circasciences, en piste., an interactive exhibition at Cap Sciences on the physics of the circus, with balance, force, speed and mass. From age 6, and about an hour.

c75162546a7de1a529bbd6b42f6ea87752ed7a45.en: Papi, dis-moi pourquoi les arbres pleurent?, an exhibition by Simon Gabourg at Fabrique Pola on the forgotten trade in rubber through the port of Bordeaux and the Garonne.

1cccfc5e66c195e1e48e709069bb04febf59d619.en: A free nature outing at Bois du Taillan Médoc, learning to follow the tracks of animals. For ages 7 and up, with registration and walking shoes.

c6efcdc02b720ea989b760e767e41b92aeab3a44.en: A wellbeing cycle for carers in Bordeaux, with group workshops such as yoga, sophrology, nutrition and cooking with a chef, at two neighbourhood senior centres. For people who regularly help a relative, and for people over 60 or retired.

a630f2eb039c0170f0cc16b6a725004931f6737a.en: Soluces at Pierre Veilletet library, a one-hour one-to-one session with digital mediators on devices, web browsing, online safety, online shopping, office tools and email.

bb5c6225a76faa75447eac4ffd9a7f5538e7fc9d.en: CYBERMOI/S: authentication course 2 at Mériadeck library, on creating passwords and remembering them.

f6aa3ac0d0bb26560955519a4e3ec2dedff269fb.en: A photo exhibition on Dr Jane Goodall at Jean de La Ville de Mirmont library for all of October. It was created by the Jane Goodall Institute with UNESCO.

e2753e90d99aea2aa5b0303cb6a897bf5fbdcf18.en: Variations Pastels at Pierre Veilletet library, an exhibition of pastel works by Bordeaux artist Vic Darrius, in the series États de couleur, Présence and Fragments urbains.

758d55fced1d293d5b43119270c764b79ca8521b.en: La Traversée Ludique by Landry Muñoz, from 2 to 30 October at 2 Promenade des Forges. A playful installation that guides visitors through the Bordeaux-Euratlantique area with a cardboard ball. Free visits, with booking recommended.

069171973022dad4b9d89a57fdbaf3b3c26f54da.en: A talk on the real face of the Mona Lisa at the Saint-Jean senior centre in Bordeaux.

e8bd99d43ea28a8044f75edc3e102a41616615f5.en: De la magie dans l'air at Musée d'Aquitaine, a short visit to the witches exhibition followed by a workshop to make a hanging mobile with a small lucky charm.

189e622af14ed06aec52598c2d787e3ed79c7971.en: Viens t'aMusée, holiday workshops at the National Customs Museum from 20 to 30 October, Tuesday to Friday, for children from 3 to 13, such as a trafficking game and a detective game.

a78be274d17ae06f08202eac5bb5151afcc4cbb8.en: Land Art at the Maison du jardinier et de la nature en ville, making art from leaves, branches, stones and flowers without harming nature.

bd3f1fea118877b7a727ce6c18e123f17d9a2d0f.en: Le MADD en 1h, a one-hour guided visit of iconic design and decorative art pieces at the Musée des Arts décoratifs et du Design. No booking needed.

5ab629bbc63e6f379f30d82267600f0947ed815d.en: A three-day comic workshop for ages 9 to 15, guided by an illustrator and an animation artist, from storytelling and framing to colour, ending with a finished A4 comic page.

e71ed577a88120cfc530e051c6b8e2e5f8ba3b4d.en: Board games at Thouars media library, a relaxed session where librarians share their favourites and new games are on show, open to solo players, couples, families and friends.

e25f4d129bba5edcf34f68c601e98ed268dab1da.en: Halloween English Camp at Augustine language school, from 19 to 23 October 2026, from 15:00 to 17:00 for ages 3 to 8. Games, songs, crafts and a treasure hunt, taught in English by a Canadian teacher, with a snack included. Places are limited.

a83a1503b42a568c771865de04105dbfc394425a.en: 400 000 ans d'histoire(s), a 1h30 visit at the Musée d'Aquitaine led by Nicolas Caraty, tracing 2,000 years of Bordeaux's history from Burdigala onwards.

41e849c5f27b2146b909cac11035620f55a99314.en: La céramique de A à Z, a playful visit at the Musée des Arts décoratifs et du Design that introduces the world of ceramics. From age 7, no booking needed.

5eddd0dd33540fb51b46056e5864daacd8434e7b.en: A guided visit of the renovation site of La Manufacture CDCN on Thursday 22 October from 17:00 to 18:30, with the architects. Wear closed shoes. Booking opens one week before.

156091707f86c9797beb644da1b2b3b8ef40649d.en: A free four-month zero-waste programme run by Ekolo[Geek] in the Bordeaux metropolitan area, recruiting 45 participants. The first workshop is on 22 October at 17:30 at the Maison Écocitoyenne.

e2ee37e17d1655b788406400e92bdcded42d68fe.en: A poetry club session at the Instituto Cervantes Bordeaux on 22 October, on the Spanish poet Ada Salas, led by Nuria Rodríguez Lázaro. Free entry while places last.

e380202f51330157907f417c7400958a201e0137.en: Prisma 360 at Les Vivres de l'Art on 22 October from 18:00 to 01:00. An immersive night of electronic music, visual arts and eco-responsibility, with a jazz concert at 20:00 and DJs. Pay-what-you-choose entry.

e9a9f25035b598d754c4bbcb4e027767e63b7cd4.en: Sewing workshops at Les Yvette. Open sewing is for people already comfortable with a machine, and a beginners' cycle covers machine basics, repairs, hems, finishes and reading patterns.

ceaedd11180c7199ee5c7d9ebb170450ea470403.en: A talk-concert at Capucins/Saint-Michel library by musician Pascal Bouaziz, on the history of haiku and short forms of contemporary poetry. The last event of his curated series.

270fc6f61c1dd68e1f28dbb027a32004807691e0.en: Chaplin, a ciné-concert at the Grand-Théâtre for ages 6 and up, with silent classics such as The Kid, shown with live music.

99a9491859c91b9eedbab61a8943d6af3db893b0.en: Notre Salut, a ciné-conférence at La Lanterne cinema around a 2 h 38 film about a man who arrives in Vichy in 1940, seeking a place in the new administration.

48063e82a218e462a1152eddc78f3d973d303da5.en: A free quiz and blind test at the Magasin Général in Darwin Éco-système, with a happy hour from 18:30 and a quiz for all levels from 19:30. Prizes are made by Emmaüs Darwin.

2efb0216dea2dfc684034cc986c20df9572b1893.en: Oscar et la dame rose at Théâtre Trianon, adapted from Éric-Emmanuel Schmitt's novel. A ten-year-old boy and a former wrestler, Mamie-Rose, make the most of twelve days together.

115bdbc31ee1d8d1c941861d4e5b3bb6703d27ab.en: Les femmes ont toujours raison, les hommes n'ont jamais tort., an interactive comedy at Théâtre Molière about the pitfalls of living as a couple. Suitable for ages 11 to 90.

63905b2081a4698200b4f7227e0cb7bc0f74961a.en: Philippe Lellouche at Théâtre Fémina, a funny and reassuring one-man show of happy memories, childhood and first loves, his first solo stage show.

6d31b43301d4100e0d33f78994f6e604f28a3c24.en: Drag Race France Live season 4 at Le Pin Galant on Thursday 22 October 2026, on the national tour.

8edebc32907b3ac18c9f3c94c63774fda9dd3e95.en: A screening of Gare centrale at Utopia Saint-Siméon, presented by the Institut des Afriques for the Saison Méditerranée 2026, followed by a debate with critic Catherine Ruelle.

213c24d40e0bc35c1613f9a492fdc443be55fab1.en: Les éléphants dans la brume at Les Colonnes, with an introduction by film critic Emmanuel Raspiengeas.

f2cf10d66ae478427c83af74f15753b4f0196042.en: ZENTONE at Le Rocher de Palmer, an eight-member band born from a punk-rock and electro collaboration, playing the roots sounds of the album Messenger (2025).

09eeff0c5c1da0f252c933268fce03e2ae0eb267.en: Marilyn at La Matière, a theatre piece by Jean-Luc Ollivier built on Marilyn Monroe's private recordings with her psychiatrist in 1962. For ages 13 and up. Running time 1 h 20.

6a74782ff2d2a610e16e4bc2133f66b44ab53f22.en: Pollen at the CAPC, an exhibition on how art can help us see nature and its living organisms in a different way, on view until 31 December 2027. Free entry.

ed288d832a8785ebb8b976a5fa41ad915e7f311d.en: L'eau: une ressource vitale at the Maison du jardinier et de la nature en ville, 20 photographs by Yann Arthus-Bertrand on the water cycle, its uses and its protection.

cc0a7dd60a6b39940191ff4025264808c807b9a2.en: An open call for the 12th Bacchanight at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux, where students revisit a museum artwork. Applications close on 5 December 2026. The night takes place on 30 March 2027 from 19:00 to 23:00.

2362919a3c63daa11175910da9ae14e1d0480e6e.en: An escape game at Escape Hunt Bordeaux St-Jean. Your team is locked in a themed room and has about 60 minutes to solve puzzles. The session lasts about 90 minutes with a briefing. Some rooms are wheelchair accessible.

a6598b2d6005838aecfb5c172bf2db4f0efb88b8.en: Félins, an exhibition at the Muséum de Bordeaux from 10 October 2026 on the 38 cat species, with 23 mounted specimens over more than 300 m², on their hunting adaptations and diversity.

de946ab3fe8981c05fd7415f9833c352be7c593a.en: L'habitat social dans la métropole bordelaise, an archive exhibition on 120 years of social housing, from 19th-century workers' estates to 21st-century eco-neighbourhoods. Guided visits on Fridays at 14:00.

b1c185fdc9ac29e9afa894eba7bfa5d7698745fa.en: Architecture workshops for ages 8 to 15 at 125 cours Journu Aubert, where each day offers a project and a model to observe, handle and discuss.

7afdebbac668e0c15f563938e487b14420b2e591.en: Miaou., a participatory exhibition at the Muséum de Bordeaux on cats, from science and behaviour to their place in culture and the imagination. About fifteen members of the public worked on it with museum staff.

4b9a13d09cf847456ef1fb95a2a77a6bbdba5fc5.en: GORU GORU by Seulgi Lee at the Frac Nouvelle-Aquitaine MÉCA, from 9 October 2026 to 25 April 2027. The first French solo show of her work from the last 25 years, built on colour, simple gestures and collaborations with artisans.

d1e8aab40b9aada5eb55a71847164079e2eab7c5.en: L'Horizon de Khéops, an immersive virtual reality journey of about 45 minutes to the Great Pyramid of Giza, with a virtual guide, the Sphinx at sunrise and a VIP visit at dusk. On booking, at rue Saint-Sernin.

b06dc293b4c29b1c3de470cbdbcd839ef3ad6bdd.en: Un globe, des mondes, an exhibition at the Musée d'Aquitaine, and also at Géodock and the Maison des Suds in Pessac, on virtual globes such as Google Earth and how they shape our view of the planet.

93cc821cfb2bee89ae7cc39c5f42b321e70b87b9.en: Sols, an exhibition at the Jardin botanique de la Bastide from 4 July 2026 to 28 February 2027, a sensory walk through the living organisms in the soil and how soils support the balance of the land. Indoors and outdoors.

73e4deb7ab61638f480fc3579433c4e1e45a8274.en: Passions Collections at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux, a hang of ten years of acquisitions from 2015 to 2025, showing how a public collection grows. Free entry. A preview is planned for Monday 30 March.

ea2e2e5f2381ef0ef959f1a0ddeae302a9208b61.en: Céramiques, corps sensibles at the Musée des Arts décoratifs et du Design, with about 80 pieces from the third millennium BCE to today by more than 40 artists, linking ceramics with the body. Opening on Wednesday 22 April at 18:30.

1880ddb3e46611bfd1216c35277eb133ef2f3249.en: An image-reproduction workshop on the 19th-century photomechanical processes of Goupil & Cie, with practical sessions and a look at how art prints were made. Listed on the Pass Culture ADAGE portal.

5656d4ddfa2bc57b596ee601539b48f9a0ab6781.en: Morceaux choisis (2) at the Musée des Arts décoratifs et du Design, a new room for works on paper. The first hang shows drawings from the Jacques Sargos collection, given to the museum in 2024, with rotating shows until 2027.

29f62f501abde8ad0a0afd5da5ecdc0104fd8a92.en: Quinie Araguas at the Centre d'art contemporain Pierre Brana, from 15 October to 27 December 2026. A free exhibition of sculpture, painting, drawing, prints and film on memory, nature and personal experience. Opening on 14 October at 18:30.

c8cc70ce1dcd0272e9eafef550ecdb411e866e2f.en: Drawing, painting and modelling classes for children and teenagers at atelier Citrouille, focused on exploration, imagination and personal expression, with perspective and body drawing for older students.

cf43133a604ab4404635f26beffea26c3417184d.en: Le tour du monde en 50 régions viticoles, a free photo exhibition at La Cité du Vin from 13 February to 31 December 2026, celebrating its 10th anniversary, with photos selected by its wine partners.

d5598dd2820a608f280f6c6f29982a698071fe74.en: Matisse, la symphonie des couleurs at the Bassins des Lumières, from 7 February 2026. A 45-minute projection show on Matisse's career, alternating with a shorter programme on Frida Kahlo.

76e9c7fa552f42cb07f21e6cfcc4c4e2f25d2ba0.en: La Maison du projet, a preview of the renovated Musée de la Création Franche, at the Chapelle Bon Secours. Free visits on weekdays from 13:00 to 16:00 from 22 June to 31 December 2026, with guided visits on set Tuesdays.

c6af3acf3f25cbe985040d7d1ac6cc732d68a666.en: Crotte. Que fait le microbiote?, a family exhibition at Cap Sciences on the gut microbiome, with a giant mouth, bacteria superheroes and a playful toilet cabinet. Made by the Cité des Sciences et de l'Industrie.

fbd61f9bbe761244510054c76a228314de2af0fb.en: An adult drawing and painting course at atelier Citrouille, open to beginners and experienced artists, covering graphite, charcoal, pastel, ink, watercolour, acrylic and oil.

a32f300ba86ab342d9b10f02b0ca6aea2785956f.en: Le Trésor des Bâtisseurs, a virtual reality expedition of about 45 minutes to the builders of the Great Pyramid, from the Giza plateau to the port of Wadi al-Jarf. On booking, at rue Saint-Sernin.

8355945f7151183e9bd944a485295226034f849d.en: SUR UN GRAND CHEMIN by Guillaume Trouillard with Artilus, a long panoramic film on the outside walls of the Maison Écocitoyenne, telling the story of people crossing the Pyrenees along the Basse-Navarre route. Free to view.

a255c3084dfb678fc21962f9b99fb2dd6b2e13e7.en: Paroles de femmes en migration #3, a day at the Musée d'Aquitaine on 23 October on women in migration from Iran, Pakistan and Kurdistan, with speakers including Chowra Makaremi and MSF Bordeaux.

6525ed1bfb30e98687bdac2d7b4d54431009cb11.en: Archéo-conte, vestiges du pays imaginaire, a new exhibition at the Centre culturel Le Plateau. For ages 7 and up.

9de68644dd5fbfc9b259cc0a2edfcd9b23435f87.en: A workshop on becoming an entrepreneur at Adie Talence, covering the steps of starting a business, local support and Adie's services, under the regional Entreprendre scheme.

0306e2944633d28cd8c0ae3a833ad5af16ca7869.en: A workshop on financing your business project at Adie Talence, covering the steps of starting a business, local players and Adie's financing and support, under the regional Entreprendre scheme.

81e09e21f53e6883a462034cb3cb511b9395a19f.en: A drawing and painting workshop at Ehpad Village Terre Nègre on Fridays from 10:00 to 12:00, exploring and deepening drawing and painting techniques.

f8132ee72b5ed92d150dc297720f342bfb7b9d5a.en: A naturalist notebook workshop at the Ferme pédagogique, where you learn French-style bookbinding and make your own notebook. For ages 14 and up, two hours, six places, booking advised.

26dfd64616a9501c31e963761c724145ff85d227.en: Cher grimoire at the Musée d'Aquitaine, a page-writing workshop after a visit to the Middle Ages section of the witches exhibition, for ages 8 and up. The workshops are full.

82d0172e92680d0d02d77ea96cd60db89879caf5.en: Guided tours of Jean Dupas & Co. at the Galerie des Beaux-Arts. Jean Dupas (1882–1964) was a painter, illustrator and poster artist and a major figure of Art Deco.

daf36c95dba1c011a6f640991f6aa978b7451242.en: A musical nap during the Un habit trop grand exhibition at Hôtel de Ragueneau. Bring a mat, rest, listen to words and music, then stay for a coffee chat.

a03af93ca78ca5ffd287116061f8827955902ae2.en: A 50-minute guided tour of the technical side of the Miroir d'Eau, the water mirror on Place de la Bourse, each Friday until October. €10, booking online. Not accessible to wheelchair users or pushchairs.

f702faa7ec02db3b9f01f9245f52ed32baaeedfc.en: Atelier Maquette 2D at the Galerie des Beaux-Arts, where you create your own mini stylised scene inspired by Art Deco and the models in the exhibition.

9b5d888a4d1cda5397b23b5cd63a7947d8ea8145.en: An open theatre workshop at Ehpad Village Terre Nègre on Fridays from 14:00 to 15:30, covering theatrical expression, reading texts and improvisation.

2c91eda77c0b5bc5a64f3d5f41a84a87e2b90cfe.en: Viens construire en terre., a family workshop at the Musée d'Aquitaine with the association Chapeau & Bottes, where children and parents shape and build with raw earth, a natural building material. From age 6.

585e932132161a52ede47cb9bcf528767d22d1cf.en: A family workshop at the Musée des Arts décoratifs et du Design, where children observe and handle everyday objects to learn how designers think about materials, forms and use. From age 7.

3fa955e26eddefe7a6863de0776745d5bd4740a7.en: Sewing for everyone at Thouars media library, where Véronique helps you learn or improve. The projects come from children's picture books, in partnership with Café du Dôme.

5c2365ab19bc780c6f3e0a5565ae74705cb640ac.en: VENDREDIXXL, a queer party in Bordeaux on Friday 23 October, with a cabaret from 19:00 and several dance floors and a club running until 06:00.

28744ebdba49aa50e72feb9d1fb9e711a484e47b.en: A meeting with novelist Jean-Paul Malaval at Mériadeck library about his novel La cousine de Bordeaux, moderated by Monique du Fresnel, followed by a book signing.

928cdb4a4e2a7a4f1f683b3e0b5b3859c9839664.en: Les vendredis au Café at Café d'Abord, Friday evenings from 18:00 to 21:00 with drinks and snacks. The blind test is on 23 October and karaoke on 30 October.

b9433cfeeabbcd85ad2e7bdd789bd69013d86ded.en: A parent and child rebozo workshop at Le Tauzin with Julie Muxu. Hand-woven Mexican rebozo cloths are used for rocking and wrapping. Residents of the Tauzin neighbourhood have priority.

b2902a40c2ab6e9ef6a6c38fa53f177f3b054860.en: Mon père cet escroc at Théâtre Molière, a comedy about a con-man father released from prison, who moves in with his rigid accountant son after forty years apart.

dfbc279710aa71f590ddfe312fca4e58ee8cb456.en: Nono La Grinta at Rock School Barbey, a rapper from Paris known for drill, freestyle and neighbourhood anthems such as 75022, with the songs La Quoi and Paris.

472fcdfc5c3cd63b2f046a595372de98c957e2ac.en: Le Bal Maritime at Les Vivres de l'Art on Friday 23 October from 20:00 to 23:00. A performance on seas and rivers, with a rolling sailboat stage and international artists, followed by a techno DJ set. Pay-what-you-choose entry.

0df1db5bd73cb61f37d76f09228ce48b20c425f4.en: Sein dessus dessous at Théâtre du Pont Tournant, a humorous and emotional play, with music, on a woman's journey through breast cancer, her changing body and the things that keep her going.

bb7a5534499ad281000ae691c414d5323cadc3d8.en: Pink Martini at Théâtre Fémina on 23 October 2026 at 20:30. The American band, which mixes Latin American sounds with French music-hall standards, celebrates 30 years.

65ae4aff60c0053e9a05e83ef794d00809c6f676.en: Baby Berserk and Jasmine Not Jafar at KRAKATOA. Baby Berserk is an Amsterdam trio mixing disco-infused synthpop, post-punk and house, and Jasmine Not Jafar is a duo of women musicians with modular synths.

3e536969bd964cdf6898b5dedaf571841400a800.en: LIVE IMPACT at Hangar DS on Friday 23 October, from 00:00 to 06:30, with rap rave, hardcore, industrial and hard techno acts including TODIEFOR, Ophidian and Ketut. Under-16s are not admitted.

fa799cbf19b970b357dad9c63b8df47321ca88e4.en: It's Ariana Bitch Party at Club l'Entrepôt, the after-show of Drag Race France Live on Friday 23 October. An Ariana Grande and pop-icon night with season 4 queens Sublyme and Fluffy Bidule. Entry is for 18 and over.

dcf16d009a3594f4e9cec6fc99512a1c477889c7.en: Sport in English for children at My Playground in Mérignac and Le Haillan, with bilingual sports sessions for ages 2 to 9. Baby yoga and gentle movement for the youngest, and circuits and games for older children.

0f22a19b65f0b940084e388290415bd9d5488c29.en: Tea tasting workshops in October 2026 at Maison un air de thé, with 14 themes, from discovery sessions and tea around the world to tea and food pairings. Traditional Chanoyu tea ceremonies and Japanese calligraphy are also offered.

1318a19f1bc7e1cfd16f899e4bbb28a6f6fdc00b.en: Immediate garden waste shredding at the Pessac Bourghailh recycling centre. Bring branches up to 8 cm wide, wait 10 to 15 minutes while they are shredded, and take the chips away.

7ab57a6added98af0c535706dcd2bb2978482c4b.en: A visit to the Château de Malle in Preignac, a privately owned historic monument from the 17th and 18th centuries, with 6.5 hectares of gardens. Departs from Le Tauzin at 09:45 and returns around 15:00. Bring a picnic.

820ca28eca0aef17c4a773a71a83420a581534ef.en: A red squirrel walk through Bordeaux Nord cemetery led by naturalist Linda Pouchard, for ages 8 and up with an adult. Free with City of Bordeaux support, about 1 h 30, 15 people maximum, registration only.

09372246da08013ef3609d6576ea21cea19e4d74.en: A naturalist walk through the Barails ecological reserve, created in 2018, which takes in the floral park, Bois de Bordeaux and wetlands. It shows how people's relationship with nature has shaped the land.

dae68bb48d9c0d9b66f0a3bada93ce0ba28463f1.en: A knitting café at Mériadeck library, on the third floor, for people who want to knit, crochet or embroider together over a coffee or tea.

2c7c980bb31d1d23c8262a71a6eb9ca3128d8fe0.en: Natural gardening in Bègles, a two-hour workshop on trees and shrubs, invasive species and the European hedgehog, on Saturday 24 October from 10:00 to 12:00. Organised with Ecosite du Bourgailh.

fa5a1d4deb9eb9c8f6efc4c8e47794822331f676.en: Atelier découverte with Paul Peinture at Hôtel de Ragueneau, three creative sessions for families with children aged 5 to 12, for all ages, and for pairs aged 16 and over. Pay what you wish, booking by email.

c3383cc3550bc7d3223c5f0214d20dff12b5ebb7.en: Halloween fuse-bead craft at the Ludo-médiathèque Simone Veil, making pumpkins, ghosts, bats and witches. Open to everyone.

9e611c05efd75c616dcacbac57f2c9c40c715577.en: Words and gardening at Bègles library, a meeting for lovers of both books and gardens.

937766943dc0f600cce1a1533f4f87834640d09b.en: A bibliotherapy workshop at Capucins/Saint-Michel library on the stages of life, from childhood to old age, with shared reading, discussion and creative expression.

2b021c5477733450d662a6d69f651daf35e4742e.en: An urban walk through Bacalan led by urban guides, traces of its working-class past and the Second World War, in the Cité Claveau area. The guides are local residents trained as mediators.

1ab78ff991d50313140fa6e25850bb03df00c64e.en: BB Bouquine at Grand Parc library, with stories and songs for ages 0 to 6.

d196279ce33c58f5c15c0591545a8466f843053c.en: Peur Bleue., a Halloween musical tale at Château Théâtre Descas, where a cursed ghost called Jack meets the audience while a symphony orchestra plays excerpts from Psycho, Holst and Thriller. Costumes welcome; snacks for children.

36504051e9b15bdf9fb40a23764ac7aedafb5fd7.en: Make your own bookmarks at Castagnéra library, using the library's digital cutting machine.

51d8b1870592b4034cd1165b03939f0d69228847.en: A story and tasting session for ages 3 to 6 at La Bastide library (Espace Miriam Makeba) on Saturday 24 October at 10:30, run with the Laboratoire d'Initiatives Alimentaires. Free, with booking.

bb7705b3af12942c8e48287e0eb05daffd4d23b2.en: Lisons-ensemble, a session at Jacques Ellul media library where young children listen to and read picture books with the librarians. Booking online.

80b7afe33c6d220127f66d694cb5bc2241cf05e5.en: An urban walk through Saige in Pessac, Quand les murs prennent la parole, past tall towers and colourful murals, led by an urban guide trained as a mediator.

28087056dc186a0760a43b7104c97b8a91c0a378.en: Café mortel on climate grief at the Maison écocitoyenne, a space to put into words the emotions raised by ecological disasters. Registration required.

552c6c0c8dc9daaa173dda4dccffb05f851c6395.en: A musical reading for ages 3 to 6, La musique des monstres, at Pierre Veilletet library.

fe2f839d59b3b6c4f5b49ecff11ff82fab8cf012.en: L'échappée verte, an urban walk through Bas Floirac, from the Castel park to the ponds and railway gardens, led by an urban guide. Registration required.

8bb6948b2bd7de261229bea8f90154d745869688.en: Contre-cartographier l'histoire coloniale, a weekend of collective counter-mapping at CAPC to create decolonial maps of Bordeaux. Run by the Printemps Décolonial with RAHMI and CNRS.

f3c39c54212975cd74a1d13671c6c71a8c6208f0.en: A Lebanese cooking workshop at 11:00 and a reader's café on Lebanon at 12:00 at Bordeaux-Lac library on Saturday 24 October. Registration with the librarians.

980b89950bdbd38ce9cbd2c8b424d7015d730ab0.en: Atelier 10's Halloween Day in Floirac, on Saturday 24 October from 13:00 to 22:00. Pay-what-you-choose workshops, horror short films for adults with a discussion with the director, and a goth and EBM DJ set. Membership entry.

39674d0e73d9f51c9ec455086ccfb7a6314fcf59.en: Transition, a podcast workshop on climate and resilience with Résonnance at the Maison écocitoyenne. In four hours with two journalists, you learn to structure, voice and record a podcast. From age 16, registration required.

db121c64c7b2ac48f9d283a22e0a7948badb2aff.en: A sewing workshop at Grand Parc library during Pink October, making heart-shaped cushions for people recovering from breast surgery. The cushions go to the Gironde cancer league.

cb08c202ebce213e4543a6d4c749f6a670b3047f.en: AI, algorithms and online resources, a workshop at the Maison écocitoyenne with Voix Publique on how AI, fake images and recommendation algorithms work. For children from CM1 to middle school, with registration.

5f46d64811403682dc911f167523e8a63b4ef481.en: Reduce your energy bills with everyday habits, with E-graine Nouvelle-Aquitaine at the Maison écocitoyenne. Practical advice for renters and owners on cutting consumption without losing comfort.

f499cb84267fb40e8c66902cfe8803130550769c.en: Natural gardening in Floirac, a two-hour workshop on trees and shrubs, invasive species and hedgehogs, on Saturday 24 October from 14:00 to 16:00. Organised with Ecosite du Bourgailh.

60e3b61c2a94d93faa0b859e7138dd47d58afe9d.en: Caudéran si loin si proche, a countryside-feel outing at Musée d'Aquitaine between La Pergola theatre and the Parc Bordelais, close to the city centre.

0922faf418ace9baf63e1aa057e8612699c81ae7.en: A screen-printing workshop for children aged 6 to 12 at Bordeaux-Lac library, run with the association Sérigolo, on Saturday 24 October at 14:30. Registration with the librarians.

d58ed8755bead82f1e0d7391229318de9d29411a.en: Create & Glow at Clay and Loom, a three-hour session with a 90-minute facial massage and a 90-minute hand-building session to make a mug or small piece of ceramic. No experience needed.

c32428ad1c7c66aacb6f147df7554f4fe5da83e8.en: A meeting with Elvire Cassan at Mériadeck library, author of L'Odyssée des dys, the book behind the 10 pour DYS exhibition, with pastry chef and dyslexic Elisa Pichard.

901ebdd72d2431913db594e3a2b41ddd019f5fe6.en: Du rail au Delta Vert, an urban walk through Le Dorat in Bègles with a guide whose family worked on the railways, covering the area's railway and market-garden past. Registration required.

150c64c3e184e5cf1bdd33e77ddd0ceda35b6c42.en: A concert and readings for Octobre Rose at the Musée des Beaux-Arts, with extracts from Maupassant's Contes cruels et fantastiques and music by Chostakovitch, Elgar, Fauré and Satie. Booking, museum entry fee.

bd3da63faf86011db49478e3f16694e29772a663.en: EKLA., an audiovisual show by Turnsteak at Le Rocher de Palmer, with a giant folded paper book, animated projections and live electronic music, part of the Fify parenting festival in Cenon. It includes flashing lights.

a0608ebdb33d155062164ea90ff2e8016e83746d.en: The closing snack of the Cosy Autumn Challenge at Mériadeck library, with the announcement of winners, mini-games and talk of fantasy and imaginary worlds.

6b03748fdb55de247d83b101157bdf9ab6051537.en: Café des lecteurs at Mériadeck library, a relaxed session to share favourite books, films and music. The 24 October session is about the Lettres du Monde festival of foreign literature.

91d6eb11fa3fcc28dfa8fa4ea05431b392c8b448.en: La France, grande puissance maritime at Musée Mer Marine, a talk by a historian and admirals on the history of the French navy during its 400th anniversary, and on France's maritime power today.

3be5c7e6811f56ddcf2464ee9bded23eac2ff71d.en: ODYSSÉE II at La Grande Poste on Saturday 24 October from 18:00. A techno night with five collectives and 12 artists across 11 electronic sub-genres, with a local organic bar. Students get 50% off.

c43c02f772ac75dddee621fbf36525738e1f3ba7.en: Leo Middea at the Salle Grand Parc, a Rio-born singer and composer based in Barcelona who mixes MPB, samba and bossa nova. His new album Notícias de Puglia is due in 2026.

4035092ad041ef8cf11ca0af019324416380f8c4.en: A tarot tournament at Café d'Abord, with a shared meal at 19:00, seven tables of five players and four 45-minute rounds. Registration required, finishing around 00:30.

50ecc6b0775387c77bcddef867b22b8b6afaa63d.en: Elles pardonnent mais n'oublient jamais at Théâtre Trianon, a 70-minute comedy about Jeff and Sophie, who promise never to lie to each other, exploring love, sex and jealousy. By the authors of Jamais le deuxième soir.

5c75255b2ec72f8c092be07b5b5d8f7df689865a.en: Leo Middea at the Salle des Fêtes Grand Parc, a concert by the Brazilian singer and composer, featuring his new album Notícias de Puglia, released in February 2026.

57103cc1044de93d7c65e80f5037eb5472108328.en: The 20th birthday of Born Bad Records at Krakatoa, a celebration of independent rock by the Paris label, which has released 200 albums and is known for both new talent and cult reissues.

289498de879572563df8674ce8e3613c92b043d4.en: Ahmed Sylla's Origami show at Arkea Arena, a reflective comedy about destiny, choices and what it means to leave one's home town.

f52622d6619c9a4480726022eea9a61d44323759.en: Chilly Gonzales at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, celebrating 20 years of his solo piano album. Intimate, melodic piano that blends classical heritage with delicate pop.

eed28a4d91b96f1de51c4c2c1b5ae021a9817102.en: Une heure avec Le Barbier de Séville at the Grand-Théâtre, for ages 10 and up. The Opéra National de Bordeaux chorus performs Rossini's comedy while an actor narrates the plot.

0ed655faf7e02902c8c05528b67b6ac237aa39b7.en: Covertramp at Le Pin Galant, a Supertramp tribute with six multi-instrumentalists and two hours of live music, including School, Dreamer and Breakfast in America. Endorsed by Roger Hodgson.

cbbd63334da6c899a1ba3249912eebbb8f0b3476.en: Desperate Housemen at Théâtre Fémina, a comedy in which Jérôme asks his two best friends to help him win back the woman he loves, with situations about couples and men and women.

de94702b6820fff615ea11d36409aa49b70dc5e2.en: Jazzy Bazz at Le Rocher de Palmer, a rapper known for technical, introspective lyrics and a magnetic stage presence. Last album: Nirvana (2025).

9f939ddd7a7b5582d16fb8bcd113f6d3d5390db2.en: Dark Side of the Line presents Twisted Minds at Lorganiq on Saturday 24 October from 21:00 to 02:00. A free techno session with four DJs. Capacity is limited to the first 150 people.

46bb5822052e85edb6d3b1a7555624f8f743296d.en: On choisit pas sa famille., a comedy at Théâtre Trianon about a wedding that goes wrong. Five actors play 17 characters.

2e9d8d4250f7fe0da1d9ffddb2dc1eb6ed115bd8.en: La Kermess Summer Rave at L'Entrepôt on Friday 24 October from 00:00 to 06:30, with Trypdo, Amrk, Emira and Zaraki. Under-16s are not admitted, and no liquids are allowed.

197476f6e8db483839cce3afab575a5869fd078d.en: ACIDCORE at Hangar DS on Saturday 24 October from 00:00 to 06:30, with acid, mental and hybrid techno sets. Under-16s are not admitted.

82747390e1ab4f80aa56e28131e0267d49d20396.en: A charity run for the Efrei student union around Bordeaux Lac on Sunday 25 October, with 5 km and 10 km routes. All proceeds go to the association Linkee, which fights student food insecurity.

61aa5eee58a4347ef10ec0b21b584e723f8b4d63.en: A walk through the Marne-Capucins quarter with urban guides Camille and Milan, covering its visible and hidden history, from famous figures to forgotten residents.

1abada6889130cd14dda9d50164d7170ceb919bb.en: A guided architectural tour of La Cité du Vin, designed by XTU Architects. It covers the building's history, concept and construction, and includes the permanent exhibition's architecture and the belvedere. No tasting.

aeb17ab2a0b4fb604ce29082308d54044f6aa482.en: A cycle ride along the water from Cantinolle to the Plaine de Gajac in Eysines, through the Jalles landscape of forests, meadows and springs. Meeting point sent on registration.

6370db27714ac49cd0228666250db5e6d8aeae1a.en: Mériadeck, continuités et ruptures, a talk at the Bordeaux City Hall on the Mériadeck district, a bold architectural project near the historic centre that is often loved, disliked or little known.

e50c758b50524b51595217eca3efb4e8b24e834f.en: The BTS World Tour ARIRANG, live from São Paulo and shown in cinemas. Single price of €20.

4813013732c0804e93afd9c9cd105ab15be6d648.en: A monthly Ciné-Club screening of Marché sur l'eau by Aïssa Maïga, on water scarcity in a village in northern Niger, followed by an open discussion. At the Salle des Fêtes Grand Parc.

c243a8bf7423a9376fb5161e8fc86728ec105e85.en: Board games at Jacques Ellul media library in Pessac. Booking online.

b0c17237d4b444d4eb261db4f1b407ff9995e091.en: Tremblez, tremblez. Les sorcières sont parmi nous, a 2026–2027 exhibition at the Musée d'Aquitaine on the witch trials of the Basque country and across Western Europe from 1560 to 1630. Visits can be guided by the curator or a mediator.

7d21e3348ba2dc730dca215417d179e2b654bc78.en: Ève, a film screening at La Lanterne cinema as part of the Tous en Scène cycle (2 h 18). An actress rises to fame by taking the place of an older star and wins over a critic.

87e43597902c3a18cb2f01f9803db2d880e8b3b7.en: Etre(s) vivants at Les Colonnes, part of the Alimenterre food festival. A group of livestock farmers who love their trade but question some of its practices.

51940197050808b385ec7cf5fd3809975021f152.en: Joe Jackson at Théâtre Fémina, a veteran artist since 1979 with hits such as Steppin' Out, performing songs from his new album Hope & Fury.

2c2704ea7ca2480cd50e372cfde0a4721338b95a.en: A musical theatre workshop for ages 7 to 12 at Union Saint-Bruno, from 26 to 30 October from 09:00 to 16:30. The children make a short musical, shown to families on Friday 30 October. Membership required.

20ffcadc82293fb140b6ddd44cc479d4820f6b56.en: An Occitan language and culture course at Calandreta de la Dauna on Monday 26 and Tuesday 27 October, with beginner and intermediate levels. Cultural interludes and shared meals. A talk on the future of the language follows on 27 October.

6973b478c727360ba0f58a2911cf1dc2ee60ed87.en: La maison des souvenirs, a writing and detective workshop for ages 11 to 14, across five mornings. Participants investigate a missing photo in a Día de los Muertos ofrenda and create their own story.

1f5a815c5692571d6a5564f023c438c15cfd8918.en: Le Concert Malmené at La Matière, a comic show in which a baroque violinist and a singing double bassist-clown share stories, sonatas and songs. From age 5, 55 minutes, part of the Sous les Loupiotes festival.

00192cc66ca311d6c534edfcb7fa681f15f556e4.en: CYBERMOI/S: les fausses solutions miracles du numérique at Sésame, a workshop that separates online myths from good practices, with quizzes.

a6aa6121bc402b2989d6c350d6e62c44a06bdd01.en: Artistes en herbe: Portraits de nature at Le Taillan-Médoc, a pencil drawing session on nature's beauty, rescheduled to Monday 26 October at 14:00.

2d94a74ea24205d33a16d5ed3aadec951a893d1e.en: An exhibition of street art by young people from the MIX'ART workshops, at the La Châtaigneraie cultural centre. The workshops mix debates with painting on canvas.

9d3cf349f1f46792459c2fa6b6e18c7ed9c89c40.en: Cap sur l'Art déco., a workshop at the Galerie des Beaux-Arts in which you explore great ocean liners and decorate your own ship, linked to the Jean Dupas exhibition. The 17 July session is full.

471730ea53ef26961d3fbb50d4563dcc2ee2e392.en: A screening of El olivo (2016) by Icíar Bollaín at Instituto Cervantes Bordeaux. In Spanish with French subtitles, it follows a young woman who tries to recover an ancient olive tree her family sold.

d317cfd58b6bb9f7fa8124d377eb5616be13b4fe.en: LES LIAISONS HEUREUSES at the Cuvier de Feydeau, a multi-discipline show by residents and artists of the Foyer Cypressa Florada with the collective Einstein on the Beach. Twenty-eight amateur and professional performers, supported by the Gironde department.

c8a663ff4f6c17f97c84a38f63077134ec2945e8.en: J'aime beaucoup ce que vous faites., a famous comedy at Théâtre Trianon. A phone mix-up reveals what best friends really think, just before they arrive for a country weekend. Now in its 20th year.

3727088a674cf52b01158da0c1059ba4c87a3b29.en: Espartes: Chroniques de l'Orque Ibérique at Utopia Saint-Siméon, a documentary screening and debate with co-directors and Sea Shepherd Bordeaux about the Iberian orca. Tickets are sold at the box office from 16 October.

a487f8696e061149e462e06076480fc6d83e0f82.en: Drôles d'oiseaux, a clay-modelling workshop for ages 4 to 6 at CAPC with artist Sébastien Vonier, inspired by the imaginary birds in the Pollen exhibition. €7 for a half day, €5 with the Carte Jeune.

c5bfd60587af4c225e7a38b8d3d0b18ab7c18703.en: A weekly meeting at Athénée Municipal Joseph Wresinski to formalise the association's project, which will be presented at its 2027 general meeting.

a72aeccc7698bdd8c31e149461051a86ab5124bd.en: Immersion Sup de Pub Bordeaux, a three-day taster on campus for people choosing their studies, covering art direction, social media and strategy through a real brief. €50, with limited places.

ed7461aa3fb6af79a5fd0c8b4bc400070e6138c1.en: Cartes pop-up Halloween at Mériadeck library, a creative workshop for ages 6 to 12 during the school holidays, with a look at old books up to 500 years old. Six themes are planned for 2026–2027.

04aa482c5812cfce348b497d010874edf2f28b48.en: Blackground: murmures des mornes at CAPC, an exhibition of about fifty artists who work from the survivals of colonial slavery in the French overseas territories.

855739799711a6daabb9a9172b7366fbd1fa65ac.en: An urban escape game in central Bordeaux at place de la Comédie, a detective and puzzle game for families or friends, followed by a shared picnic on the quays. Residents of the Tauzin neighbourhood have priority.

b5f57008799ed2eee56d8b21938e1980b78d9bf6.en: SomaSemaSoma, a major solo exhibition of German artist Alexandra Bircken at CAPC. Her hybrid sculptures explore the body, technology and social structures. Co-produced with Culturgest in Lisbon.

8e886f276df7d9358ea695a673787a7aed724a83.en: CYBERMOI/S: authentication course 3 at Mériadeck library, on a free, open-source tool that manages all your passwords.

12137ecd89d04eb3df2e02dc684eec369b0f5e1a.en: Drôles d'oiseaux, a clay-modelling workshop for ages 7 to 11 at CAPC with artist Sébastien Vonier, inspired by the imaginary birds in the Pollen exhibition. €7 for a half day, €5 with the Carte Jeune.

a912951001ceb0737c0e17f374d689638b126d7f.en: Testing and comparing generative AI at La Bastide library. You create music, images and text from simple prompts, and discuss the benefits and controversies.

c8e01261af69c73541d97b4f8eb10c5d7136cc72.en: A road-safety workshop for pedestrians at Echoppe seniors Billaudel, run by Wimoov, with a refresher on the highway code.

907cbf034f711455f23cccbe6beb7a74d49a08e8.en: A seed library at the Maison du jardinier, to swap seeds and share sowing tips on the last Thursday of each month. Bring the seeds you want to exchange.

4d21dc613157952375a031606f72da35c23c4ba5.en: Construis, Réemploie, Imagine., a family workshop at the Musée d'Aquitaine from age 6, in which children reuse materials to design an imaginary museum. Led by architect Natacha Jolivet.

a6367a34ac5dbe11587d8b8164a65f0ce10838a4.en: A presentation of the Centre national Jean Moulin collections at the Musée d'Aquitaine, including a Wehrmacht helmet, a gas mask, Jean Moulin's 1915 philosophy essay and a parachute fragment.

9052d15d5176d54aa5bf0afa516e54be6cff97e3.en: #RDVdumardi at Grand Parc library on butterflies, with insect boxes from the Bordeaux Natural History Museum, a slideshow and a sound quiz.

d727f9dbc4f08ff3b07664f8af403613ba08b547.en: A guided visit of La ManuCo, a third-place community venue, with a tour of the premises and a presentation of the association's missions and values.

82fb175c8ad572889b451f498c4c9d7fb676b60e.en: A holiday family film at Thouars media library, a surprise screening with a sense of shared fun.

47387db0b7117b9181bbf66390ef1b080e9a8eca.en: Le Cygne et l'enfant at Les Colonnes, a film preceded by a snack and the storytelling show Conte à plumes by Stéphanie Lafitte, a poetic tale about friendship with plants and animals.

b7514826b8d7c042125ea1ad745eba462e69aea7.en: From Pierre-Louis Berthaud to the Molac law: 75 years of teaching Occitan, a talk by Yan Lespoux at the Maison des Sciences de l'Homme on the long campaign for Occitan teaching, from the 1951 Deixonne law onward.

6e06fc3e64610cec0feb92ac7bee1eebdd8f67b5.en: La Vengeance est à moi at Utopia Saint-Siméon, part of the Raretés japonaises series. Film specialist Clément Beuchillot introduces and discusses the film.

29a39b9fbf7527fef85472f02d52f1b8e61e7e07.en: Una hora con Frida Kahlo at Théâtre Molière, a one-hour show by Laurence Ruatti that mixes images, text, music and dance to tell the life and painting of Frida Kahlo, 70 years after her death.

a645ae33a1675c020a9aa58d75dbfc6495b2fbdf.en: A board-game evening at La Lanterne cinema, Huis-clos, played in teams of five around genre films, followed by the film Histoires de la Nuit (1 h 54) about a family whose birthday party is crashed by three men. Not suitable for under-12s.

b6c4cac4189830562ff10dbaec7c9d44d0246e9d.en: Calva Louise + Sun at Le Rocher de Palmer, a psychedelic and surreal punk, metalcore and latin rock show, promoting the album Edge of the Abyss (2025).

f77df5e36ec9a0013d2165ee9eb3635bb848b10e.en: A free monthly public writer session at Mériadeck library, where a professional helps with administrative letters, understanding contracts, private correspondence and CVs. No library membership needed.

56f971fdd6a04de854164bc9dc075afa2fc5da0d.en: Photo workshops and open days at Fabrique Pola, including an open day on Saturday 3 October. Courses run from initiation to darkroom printing, digital retouching and building a photo series.

e99c349efbc52d33fab74406628b6834539ab748.en: A cyanotype introduction at the Carré des Jalles exhibition room on Wednesday 28 October, at 10:00 and 14:00. Two hours to make deep-blue prints from plants and objects, for ages 6 and up with an adult. Registration required.

823c3685fa77c4fdba6070ad794febcec1d084cc.en: Nature for little hands with Murmures Sauvages at the Maison écocitoyenne, a sensory nature session for children aged 1 to 4, held in two time slots. Registration required.

e24fd17d06f6a30ad461f58d380d17e6361dfb30.en: A sensory family visit for toddlers aged 12 to 36 months who can walk, with their parents, at the Musée des Beaux-Arts. The 24 August session is full.

5382869287e27287a0823e486e49c3a9645b0a0d.en: Cartes imaginaires at Mériadeck library, where children become cartographers, look at old maps from the library's vaults and draw their own imaginary map. For ages 6 to 12.

f4db7fbf3e0365c534cf94193fff763ca12e1842.en: Petites lectures at the Léopold Sédar Senghor media library, a story session in which three librarians guide the reading with their favourite books and imagination.

0d99901e69c3ef8aea70c31b3fa1ce3385c45499.en: A weekly clay modelling session at the Ehpad Village Terre Nègre on Wednesdays from 10:30 to 12:00, open to adults and children. Participants shape objects and sculptures.

8616250bd745447ccc96b05ccb79e2c330760925.en: Ciné Goûter at Flora Tristan library, an animated film chosen for its originality, followed by a snack. At 10:30 for ages 3 to 6, and at 16:30 for ages 6 and up.

594eafd5544c49dd20751b44a7ac04a85109fda1.en: A LEGO robotics workshop at Castagnéra media library, an introduction to robotics basics with special LEGO kits.

869292750dba768b640a127098e8c2f735e469e6.en: A discovery session with the Sphero and Cubetto robots at La Source, to learn programming through playful little robots.

716648dc54e81a6b9f3e79d74dd6d98a687bdb76.en: An adapted digital workshop at Mériadeck library on tools for people with dys conditions, including the reading software Sprint Plus and the writing software Dragon. Booking required.

8b2723b19320722fe4279e50318fc831a6c9a67a.en: L'heure des histoires « fais-moi peur . », a story hour at Assia Djebar media library with a selection of tales to shiver or laugh at. From age 3.

262d9fbe94e707bd3344053e87fb445f1ae46231.en: La pie qui dit by Lucie Catsu at Théâtre La Matière. Anouchka sets out to cross the Great Forest and travels through every age of life, guided by her grandmother's song. From age 3, 35 minutes, part of the Sous les Loupiotes festival.

f1b4087757103bd2869329ad4b7891c10a2f1ad8.en: A free mulch giveaway at the Domaine du Grand Darnal. Mulch from green waste covers the soil, keeps it moist and helps biodiversity. Bring suitable containers, while stocks last.

0e7a4a5c408c5ff94f9f7dabe7dabca607d10ae4.en: La pie qui dit by Lucie Catsu at Théâtre La Matière, the same show as the other listing: Anouchka's walk through the Great Forest and the stages of life, for ages 3 and up.

5f86a813e5552c79486aace0d30021ccf44b8b2f.en: La quête d'Halloween at Place Pey Berland, a Halloween quest with magic smells, observation, spell decoding and potion-making. For ages 6 to 10, about 1 hour 30 minutes including everything.

4306fb606a22fc09d2383af004bdd2df65f9ba1f.en: A tree discovery session with the Water Family at the Maison écocitoyenne, with a learning booklet to take home. For ages 6 to 12, registration required.

74119fbc9f3283434f2914894525060cd763587f.en: AgriCafés de la Formation Pro at the Agrocampus in Blanquefort, an open drop-in on apprenticeships, adult training and the VAE qualification route in farming. Wednesdays from 14:00 to 16:00, outside school holidays.

b4e10334f3071301cca943cd33d003d1db365557.en: Club Bidouille at Castagnéra media library, an hour to try robotics, coding, vector drawing, digital painting or hacking, with a facilitator on hand.

e0c421ff6d840dffcd97f9a701f11858a8b8c5b5.en: La Bibliambule at the MADD, a mobile library on an electric tricycle that opens into hammocks around a reading kiosk, meeting residents and museum visitors.

4d290706ef8a3ddeaa1fd90e9bcbc2f42be6734d.en: Bibligames at Bègles library, one Wednesday a month to play video games chosen by the team, alone or with friends.

87b93d4cc00369546884e8bc43814d5bf56605ab.en: Drôles d'oiseaux modelling for ages 11 to 14 at CAPC with Sébastien Vonier, inspired by the imaginary birds in the Pollen exhibition. €7 for a half day, €5 with the Carte Jeune.

8468ccc6c83bc1f0ed8eaded8e40a0d91c3d0b45.en: Mon œuvre de street art at the Musée Mer Marine, linked to the Bleu Sauvage exhibition by street artist A-MO. On 21 and 28 October, a painting workshop from age 6 and a stencil workshop from age 5.

ce231fb37e006d931995f60703cbc88f82c42d0f.en: A carte blanche to storyteller and naturalist Pierre Uribe at Hôtel de Ragueneau, linked to the Un habit trop grand exhibition, with a reading by Thierry Belliard and an evening of writing.

0e22077a32b7206fb776ec7d03d139aee4b1d050.en: An outdoor art workshop on the water cycle in Saint-Médard-en-Jalles, combining drawing, ecology and sensory exploration of water's states.

aa56692407108eb899a9313ce03cda1a0fdd3af0.en: A one-and-a-half-hour charcoal drawing workshop at Echoppe seniors Billaudel led by an artist. Suitable for beginners, with materials provided.

162a27056c79c33ce72e635a994786c7fa304efe.en: A discovery session on metal sculpture at Jacques Ellul media library, with art blacksmith Dominique Segura. After a demonstration, participants help make a collective artwork. Booking required.

f717ff79bb3550a6e1146a3ac98a6f6aa12e10fd.en: A family ceramic modelling workshop at the Musée des Arts décoratifs et du Design, with a different theme each holiday. From age 7.

ffebfa000dd81ebe0f1392f02f8f2acf9ba479d1.en: A visual arts workshop at Ehpad Village Terre Nègre, exploring techniques such as drawing, painting, collage, pastel and printing with a visual artist.

5eaae5ae9cac6a137ef2df0e3f508879a7eec1c4.en: Lectures sur Toile at Jacques Ellul media library, where librarians show their favourite youth books on a big screen. Booking online.

b969f260535b1b3f8a0197703e5f2ce23bc706d4.en: Jouons avec les livres, a book-based activity at Pablo Neruda library in Pessac. Booking online.

3c7681783875bfd9097fc9798b5447b9c92da2d6.en: A Wednesday FabLab session with a 3D printer at Pierre Veilletet library, linked to the Sacré-Cœur exhibition.

976c9d12d2ba3b543b53c4b6a1b09b73215623e6.en: Qu'on se le lise spécial DYS, a kamishibai (Japanese paper theatre) story session for ages 6 and up, during the DYS month at the libraries. Booking required.

0257f7b48d52c865a5ed6fc5be92d4f651c61ef7.en: Linocut workshops for 2026–2027 at Les Yvette. You carve a design into rubber, then print it on socks, paper or fabric, with templates for those who do not draw.

9194755a61488d0cc292b1f9dab8d0c801d7c5f6.en: Science infuse at Castagnéra media library, screenings and science workshops that mix art and science, helping children learn through investigation.

06cca71706f00b1772cdb4082f8d69b2eed5ce8c.en: Dernier coup de chapeau pour Capelito at Les Colonnes, an advance screening followed by a snack and a plasticine workshop. From age 3.
