4d346bfb15964f098d7170d248e32da90c199ae2.en: Life drawing workshops at Les Yvette, drawing a clothed model in changing outfits. Open to all levels. Association membership of €5 for the school year is required.

1d7057e221cb226587c721148f8947cb442f32ae.en: Berger Story by Le Chœur Spectacul'Art at Le Pin Galant, a show with 200 choristers and live musicians singing Michel Berger's hits, with Élodie Frégé on some songs.

0e5255526b804182b7008d15bf12bdbb3e9c37d0.en: The semi-final of the 13th Tremplin des 2 Rives at the Salle des Fêtes Grand Parc, a showcase for emerging local musicians. Past winners include Web, Wizard and EmmaFleurs.

1218992a1e10df6f29ac1efd7f3f55d6080c8860.en: Rodrigue at Théâtre Fémina, a stand-up set that looks at office routine, stress and everyday absurdities, using gentle humour about our own weaknesses.

039f8d647915c9b402341857139b30222f326ce7.en: A diving baptism at Piscine Galin on Wednesday evening, for ages 8 and up, with parental consent for minors. €10, with equipment and 15 to 20 minutes with an instructor. Places are limited.

72061ccd3ba4ef3a1f154f5b4695304457e15561.en: KALÉIDOSCOPE by Paul Vincent and Laure Vincent Salmon at Galerie Sauvages in Darwin, from 29 October to 8 November. Paintings, drawings and objects to explore like a treasure hunt, with proceeds to Les Puits du Désert. Free entry.

6100e5d59ed888a302c80ee1545e496a0f5beeb8.en: La Cantoche at Café d'Abord, a shared lunch where everyone brings their own food. The café provides a space, plates, cutlery and a way to warm food, but no meals.

2ed1d4100097beecd609f6d24a86de9e29a944ff.en: Le regard de Jean-Jacques Issouli sur William Bouguereau, a cross-view talk at the Musée des Beaux-Arts by a teacher of classical literature on the painting Une Bacchante.

0976078c7ae9445c9e3ae656fd4565e5e0c99977.en: O.R. Studio: ten years of creation around dance, an exhibition at the Salle capitulaire Mably with dance photography, films and a documentary. Events include an opening on 29 October and a discussion on 30 October.

aa1b263299f4f2382fde98d9d86c68902000bf6b.en: CYBERMOI/S: authentication course 4 at Mériadeck library, on the method that could make passwords obsolete, and whether it is within everyone's reach.

a27a3dee3663d799fb6875676811eacfef6e966e.en: A talk at Athénée Municipale on how to contact the support network for carers of older people, from the Bordeaux and Graves support centres.

1d71c068b0e1a551ff45eda6c6a88064290ec08e.en: Les petits travaux du jardin at the Maison du jardinier, a practical workshop on harvesting and storing seeds to protect biodiversity and prepare next year's planting.

e524148ec7b067c0837d0b213ecaf9259b400680.en: The opening concert of the Opéra National de Bordeaux, broadcast live at the Magendie senior centre.

68509c189255a791c089fa4f0cdacca9e70223b5.en: Tombé du Ciel, a film (1 h 32) at La Lanterne about a cheerful young man from Roubaix who, after a fire during a mock exam, is accused and sent to a Catholic boarding school in Bourg.

6d6983cb6e92fc4cad958c567397e58471e2658c.en: De la magie dans l'air (for adults), a workshop at the Musée d'Aquitaine linked to the witches exhibition. You make a hanging mobile and add a small personal object to your amulet.

f8687654ca8504df9be392e42ded2ded0dd9c8f5.en: A knitting and crochet workshop at La ManuCo, where volunteers help you learn, share and make unique pieces.

13a44f0eed80d84a153024dfb158e34617a4d6d5.en: A dinner around the works of Un habit trop grand, by the Cheffes Nomades cooking project from Pessac, on Thursday 29 October at 18:00. €25 with booking. The project supports women from the Saige neighbourhood to start cooking businesses.

ee83babaccefe95e0ac36a0c834dfca10d407a09.en: Bordeaux 2040: how did the 2028 super heatwave change our lives?, a fictional TV news programme made by the Bordeaux Citizens' Climate Convention, followed by a debate with the convention members and scientists.

c1ae6fd060f2820128c07b87335b46a30b502b83.en: The opening evening of O.R. Studio's ten-year exhibition, with artists Marina Kudryashova and Oleg Rogachev, dancers of the Opéra National de Bordeaux. Free with booking. The show runs 29 October to 3 November.

6661f0a8a9fbd011d31e6355116f076525a2e107.en: Vins et Thés at La Cité du Vin, an afterwork tasting at 18:30 or 20:30 pairing wines with Tenomi's gastronomic teas, guided by sommeliers.

5da287d58e4b5edd4af05811f0c0998561ad3a95.en: Chameleons and Goodbye Karelle at KRAKATOA. Chameleons are a Manchester band formed in 1981 and reformed in 2021, known for their atmospheric guitars and poignant lyrics.

1642eaab0e9da253ff26d78f4eb3785af5fc0ada.en: A preview screening of the film CAMEMBERT at UGC Gambetta on 29 October at 19:30, with the directors.

46048899a7fbe7eaafae5f69fd28aebf967a31d0.en: The Boo Radleys and a guest at Deus Ex Machina on Thursday 29 October. The Britpop and shoegaze band returns with its three original members. Bar and food on site.

f2f07e969b2806af6b61dcf26986eb6efe4466f8.en: La Bringue Halloween Girls Only at La Belle en Folie, a women-only night with a female-only DJ set, a Halloween show, tapas, cocktails and a prize for the best costume. Solo guests can ask for a yellow bracelet.

47d72e7965aaf2fe5a2e3bdb5c8c8eb7165c8bd1.en: The Boo Radleys with a guest at Deus Ex Machina on Thursday 29 October from 20:00. Early-bird tickets are €15 (50 available), standard €17 and on the door €20.

898e3b580b69e5d125a03cdad565580f80b3576f.en: Félix Castan, un filosòf occitan, a documentary about the Occitan writer who championed cultural decentralisation, screened at La Lanterne with a discussion with the filmmakers.

3fb7942240ce1f5430d260134be6904708f5a6e4.en: Ajna at Rock School Barbey, a dark, melodic artist whose Goldmaker tour sold out, presenting his new project Antidote.

a39264ea2a4d83b55929730acfff05d3c7d3aab9.en: Ajna at Rock School Barbey, a melodic singer whose tracks Ajcension and Paraffine have each passed two million streams, and whose project Boys & Basement portrays life in eastern Paris.

3b264669aa991509a2b5075b6678e2b77595205f.en: Chameleons at KRAKATOA, post-punk pioneers of the 1980s returning with their first album in 24 years and a new line-up. Hypnotic guitars and modern arrangements.

8309f8f531f8626029f5356151a68d798b9b4c54.en: Libre de toutes peurs., a comic play at Théâtre des Chartrons with 15 keys to free yourself from stress, fear and doubt, mixing sketches, theory and exercises. Shown on 29 October, 26 November and 10 December at 20:30.

47965132ac9bd891507cc42686e95715c8d15aa2.en: Alex Fredo at Le Cube, a son of Ramzy and Michel Berger who mixes improvised stand-up with songs and guitar about daily life. 1 h 15. Not recommended for under-12s.

b63491b085de54baec7c887afee7edc987742dee.en: Tremplin des 2 Rives, a showcase for emerging musicians in the Bordeaux metropolitan area, with zone heats from 9 to 29 October and a final at Rock School Barbey on 7 November.

17a4ce86e9413b5b5562dd00234a0425e0b04a18.en: Edouard Deloignon at Théâtre Fémina, a 90-minute stand-up set about feeling different, from age 16. He has over 150 million views on his videos.

c7e533f241ef0a6f0e6ebd8d38e8f707fbf2fefb.en: Amants à mi-temps at Théâtre Victoire, a comedy about two men who each keep a mistress, and what happens when their arrangements overlap.

647267123648021fcfb50c10257f1b4b65936f0b.en: A film and debate evening at La Lanterne on Félix Castan, un filosòf occitan, the documentary made over almost three years, with more than twenty interviews including Bernard Lubat, Claude Sicre and Massilia.

13381594ee4f51b5a6f7aa1e5c90aea89cc864ca.en: Duel and Maniard at PULP Bordeaux Saint-Michel: Austin stoner doom band Duel, with former members of Scorpion Child, and the Bordeaux psych-sludge band Maniard.

e5f39fd80473398d9eaba38ed7d60676f8524204.en: Discovering how wildlife and plants survive winter at the Barails ecological reserve, a naturalist outing on hibernation and food stores. The meeting point is sent on registration.

fdd825caee6953002559bf8563ea7948d9acb0eb.en: A discovery session at the FabLab Copernic in Saint-Médard-en-Jalles, held on the last Friday of each month, covering 3D printing, virtual reality, laser scanning and wood engraving.

3a0ff32b06e878ad0c08b9bac2cbca8580413fa3.en: Partir en jeux. at Assia Djebar media library, with card games in the morning, a video game tournament in the afternoon and team games in the evening. Free, from age 7, with booking.

023d9dd9fed71c71c48f11e55379fca973aac1a4.en: A two-day book and CD sale at Mériadeck library. Thousands of weeded books and CDs sell for €1, and art books for €5.

46f6a9d2466dc1278528c373d496ae554b986a9a.en: Manoir Hanté, a haunted trail built in a room of the Bordeaux Sud community centre, for families or friends.

d4a1d70b9c80d9a18948b4263779ab3fa50d02e1.en: Ciné-Goûter: Mary et la Fleur de la Sorcière at La Lanterne, a film from age 7 in which a girl finds a flower that blooms once every seven years and grants magic for one night.

92e07c790eadf7aee5b038920f6abf4a1095c558.en: Faites de la musique., a nature outing at Parempuyre in which children gather materials to build a mini percussion and wind orchestra. The meeting point is sent on registration.

bd257cf402e76f7f1f2864086d150a6d980e215c.en: A repair café and sewing session at Café de la Route, held on Fridays from 14:00 to 17:00 once or twice a month. Volunteers help repair clothes and textiles. Free, without booking.

128fa6e7385dbfe6cd62efa773eb556cbad9631f.en: A farm visit at Blanquefort to discover shepherding and cheese-making, with the animals in the sheepfold and a cheese-making demonstration. Registration is sent by the association.

7874711ade0a6951a193f8c1405ab81620ec72ea.en: Des maisons pour nos vampires, a workshop at the Maison du jardinier in which you build a bat box for pipistrelles and challenge stereotypes about bats. You take the box home.

c49b3937999bbfcf0920c7bde251115dcf2567e4.en: A history talk at La ManuCo on the hidden origins of the 1789 Revolution, given by the association Faits de Coeur's.

7f88e1d4c3334c9765952650e9ecefa2f61a6508.en: Pendant les vacances, on joue, a games afternoon at Bègles library with the ludothèque, for young and old.

d237e3db6da3a2c50af5e4e8add91ec097f3787c.en: Atelier Création textile at the Musée des Beaux-Arts, where you experiment with styles, motifs and techniques to make your own textile composition.

0bc632e6843e2b6a4b048126d81bb4a4369e25e3.en: Lectures coup de cœur at Jardin public library, where librarians share their favourite picture books. Readings for ages 3 to 6, and new titles to borrow.

f1b73e7e140959aed545bf2570d191212c1b5623.en: An Atelier terreau at the Maison écocitoyenne with RE-Plantes, on how soil works and how to recycle green waste into compost. From age 7 with an adult, registration required.

8b2e0c8526b771215ac83f79a184c20a40212074.en: A Halloween pyjama party at Bordeaux-Lac library on Friday 30 October from 16:30, with make-up, games, readings, virtual reality for ages 12 and up, short films and a surprise film for ages 7 and up. Popcorn and hot chocolate. Registration required.

6721766239264f212efadcf527f5d35ac4d210f5.en: An open mic at Flora Tristan library, where solo or group performers take about ten minutes on stage with songs, readings or music. Instruments and microphones are on site.

0e6015b6d27a28cca377f97d133e30d746cfa270.en: Les vendredis au Café, a karaoke evening at Café d'Abord from 18:00 to 21:00, with drinks and snacks. Karaoke on 30 October during the school holidays.

683f116b699d02f1415d89a4c96b1056f08e1a27.en: Terreur nocturne: Scream 1 at La Lanterne, about a teenager hunted by a killer who uses horror films in a deadly game, a year after her mother's murder. Not for under-12s.

c1469fdf2eb6d4ebf56d73748adae5deed3f7992.en: A giant question-box evening at Hôtel de Ragueneau, an improvised group game of questions and answers linked to the Un habit trop grand exhibition. A food truck and a bar are on site.

0cf2939a35bb01d29072cf3068873d86fd6e37a6.en: Le Marathon du Vertige at the Cité du Vin, a documentary about two women with metastatic breast cancer who abseiled down the building, shown for Octobre Rose, followed by testimony from the women and firefighters.

5ea62bffa8f688c8be552deaf2e9966e87a4ac11.en: A screening of the prize-winning clip Au nom de..., about domestic violence, at the Salle capitulaire Mably, followed by a discussion on preventing gender-based violence. Free, with booking.

97086025679b8e28ceb0058dbfd920249adbd2f2.en: Amphibians in autumn and the mysterious salamander at Bois de Tanaïs, an outing at dusk with the Blanquefort town council. Bring boots and torches.

eb3eeb592e809ee78099bc59c3233e975deeca49.en: An open-air screening of E.T. at Promenade Sainte-Catherine on Friday 30 October, free with booking. On Saturday 31 October, Halloween treats, a treasure hunt and prizes from the shops, all free.

74b6298d692e0a232895f1460fe4e0bcc191af8a.en: Nuit de Sabbat at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, a programme of symphonic poems by Wagner, d'Indy, Munktell and Mussorgsky, played by the regional youth orchestra of 70 musicians, conducted by Debora Waldman.

fe2936797a3eaf5f3328a0480c78ee508fff3fa8.en: Syd Matters and Fyrs at Rock School Barbey on 30 October 2026. Jonathan Morali's band returns with a fifth album and a European tour.

8725892f1540ce02e3cb0395b8f08e1f972e97fc.en: Nuit de Sabbat at the Opéra National de Bordeaux auditorium. The regional symphonic orchestra's autumn holiday academy of 70 young musicians, conducted by Debora Waldman, plays symphonic poems inspired by Halloween.

1d625cf3a132781c358208cf15b521bdd42338bb.en: TIF at KRAKATOA in Mérignac, an Algerian-born rapper who mixes rap with sounds from home, presenting his album SAVASHUIA on tour in France, Belgium and Switzerland.

9d2f30ee0716ab3b129c164f9f3fa103701e7589.en: Comedy Club Halloween at L'Estrade, with 20 Bordeaux comedians hosted by Sylvain Gautier. Doors at 19:30 and the show at 20:30. A snack and drinks package is available.

fef2f4717279c8822a5eb2c4b7484401f41055ce.en: Magie en Musique at Sortie 13 on Friday 30 October, a magic and mind-reading show by Roman Gaume and Pascal Faidy, with guitar and saxophone.

92f4efdbdddbe491fe2974d641705fa75d745446.en: HORROR SHOW at Lorganiq, a free night of heavy bass and dark sounds with Ak.labs and a five-hour line-up. The listing gives Friday 7 August 2026.

9b6bdfdeb67c5e7068fe020a14df545e8c9c6a14.en: Vincent Moscato at Théâtre Fémina, a stand-up show on social issues, from Cro-Magnon man to the organisation of the Olympic Games.

2e887ecbb9dcb2d135426e33b09150f1b73f6928.en: HALLOWEEN NIGHTMARE at L'Entrepôt on Friday 30 October from 00:00 to 06:00, with mentalcore, acidcore and tribe sets from Moldetek, Akou and Ch'aska. Under-16s are not admitted.

14f273092aaa73717eb90ce39cb926efda6aa75d.en: HARDCORE HORROR SHOW at Hangar DS on Friday 30 October from 00:00 to 06:30, with hard techno, rap rave and industrial sets from D-Fence and Chaotic Hostility. Under-16s are not admitted.

0bec1f1b9394f151dc577679edc70301fbbfe9c1.en: ¡Offshore Sauvage with DJ Deep #2 at Bien Public on 30 October, a party with the legendary DJ Deep, Leleon and Bab Mnd, and DJs from Amplitudes Radio.

192a686d255f1e8abd253669483ebcb59c3dfe01.en: A two-stage green waste shredding at the Parking des Ecus. Drop off branches up to 8 cm wide, then collect the wood chips on Saturday 13 November from 14:00 to 17:00 or Saturday 14 November from 09:30 to 17:00.

a29d5deae09ce3dd8f353e29223f69893e42f3a7.en: Cap sur Mérignac., an urban walk through the Yser and Pont de Madame quarters with guide Paul, from Town Hall gardens to shared allotments and century-old trees.

c3ba23b6914564d6369bdb92e7d8a06a884a165a.en: Tambouille at La Bastide library, a theatre and music show for children from six months to age 3 by Valérie Capdepont and Erik Baron, with kitchen utensils and electronic instruments. Free, with booking.

6d38c3ccd4f824bd11a83ed8d23ba40a50698529.en: Bébé Bouquine at Flora Tristan library, a time to share carefully chosen stories with your child. Registration required.

d6299b990225ff06afe97b43feb2e65e21afb6af.en: Halloween clay modelling at Clay and Loom on Saturday 31 October. Duos can join the 10:30 session, and children aged 5 and up the 14:00 session, shaping a stoneware pumpkin or ghost. €65 per duo, €30 per child.

496031d0833445ddab4b9f6507efa4bf46ad0a4f.en: Fresque des Animaux with Drôle de zèbre at the Maison écocitoyenne, a mural workshop for ages 8 to 13 (11:00 to 13:00) and for 14 and over (14:00 to 16:00). Registration required.

f6fd6c0e91c0fd00996203b401ab69dd9c5df866.en: Drawing classes at the Musée des Beaux-Arts for beginner and experienced adults, covering techniques such as stumping and grid-drawing, with close study of artworks.

059076cd68b6b5f47c02aab83fcdb46b84337189.en: A talk at Grand Parc library on Iran four years after the Woman, Life, Freedom uprising, covering half a century of civil resistance from the 1979 protests against the veil to the 2022 and 2026 uprisings.

6a7ff74123c23196bd84ece07f3a713dec9207c0.en: A zero-waste sewing or knitting workshop at Bordeaux-Lac library, run by three volunteer readers on Saturdays at 11:00, from age 9. Registration required.

96f03505500c61fdf04acf65733bda41aeb817cf.en: A literary café on the autumn book season at Pierre Veilletet library, for sharing discoveries and favourites.

20c7beddb2f00617af6fab18ba2629c636a43c2d.en: À rebrousse-poil, a youth show at Les Étoiles cultural centre, for ages 5 and up.

12fb3b6ca44849d48812d4fd1dd85cfd3ff82a7d.en: A three-hour mushroom walk near Bordeaux with mycologist Aurélie, learning to recognise wild mushrooms, including edible and dangerous species. The exact place is shared a few days before. Open to all, bring boots and a waterproof.

29851af579394531301e21c79501cbd27d09805f.en: A Halloween brunch at Sans Pression in the Mériadeck district on Saturday 31 October from 11:30 to 14:30, with a buffet, crêpe station, a creative workshop and a Halloween quiz. €39 per adult, €20 for ages 4 to 11, free up to age 3. Booking required.

9e8fa46b578cb79d56b8e42a0709c222f75857ef.en: A water quiz and tasting with Bordeaux Métropole's water ambassadors at the Maison écocitoyenne, with practical tips for saving water. Free.

7f684a33c3db7a6f9c281dcad8a2feeb8438968b.en: A spider walk at Le Haillan, looking at the role spiders play in ecosystems and their details through a magnifying lens. The meeting point is sent on registration.

f72e3bdd1ca9c2d061a2c19d4a4f34116b821fed.en: A free family Halloween afternoon at Gymnase Stéhélin in Caudéran on Saturday 31 October from 14:00 to 17:30, for children aged 3 to 12 with a parent. Theatre improvisation, storytelling, creative workshops, sports games and sweets.

c65813d112f995ce7bfa22497e6dccabc90efa2f.en: The Brazza quarter, a landscape walk through a former industrial and rail wasteland now becoming a suspended garden, linked to a museum event.

dfe146a7fae609cc78b9629172bd8e5e25042a7e.en: Pop ta carte., a workshop at the Frac MÉCA where you make a frightening pop-up card, inspired by the colourful covers of Seulgi Lee and a Halloween expression.

1d358eb61de9aa0bdf880a1c5ad6011eb0da3de1.en: Halloween at the Musée d'Aquitaine, an afternoon of activities for children from age 4, including a witch-themed craft workshop, a drawing session, a piano performance and a mystery box. Tickets from the museum desk.

b991a8dd1ba7ea8d9ebc59cf0a47c2aef9204c56.en: A surprise Halloween film at Léopold Sédar Senghor library in Carré des Jalles, with an animated film, sweets and a decorated space.

f87fdb9fdf900e6c6b1fb1970459e7319eec216d.en: A slime workshop at Bordeaux-Lac library on Saturday 31 October from 15:00, run by young housemates from the Afev association. For ages 6 and up. Registration required.

aa8fbce3e19c239ea5c774a837599e6e819ed703.en: The closing snack of the Un habit trop grand exhibition at Hôtel de Ragueneau on its last day. Halloween costumes are welcome, and there is a children's space with books, drawings by Bordeaux school pupils and sweets.

fffb8ac946e0037e6427887d7fc72e4a77703b1b.en: A curator-led visit of the Blackground: murmures des mornes exhibition at CAPC with Cédric Fauq, co-curator and chief curator, tracing the traces of colonial and slave-trade history.

5408944f6f5717a39c07e345e808e3b0f845c2b3.en: A walk through Cenon, Histoire et héritage au féminin, seen through the women who shaped the town's past.

0888ab11c26fe873e6852f6683cffd6659ce6805.en: A Darween horror family show at Darwin Éco-système on Saturday 31 October from 15:00 to 19:00, with a haunted path, face-painting, a sweet hunt, storytelling and a dance party. €6 entry, free for accompanying adults and under-2s.

c46999f3fa6c467a7bdaf2a459b98d8e2d2f03ca.en: A walk through the Saint-Michel quarter, Quartier au féminin, on the contribution of women to the district, with associations, women artists and notable figures.

d0ec8eedc520a2d4b1fdfa1f3561066069d0baf1.en: A guided tour of the O.R. Studio exhibition on Saturday 31 October at 15:00, lasting 1 h 30, with members of the team. Free with booking. A second visit is on 1 November.

778e65be37e2c92098c6df0ea7e94d925244ef7d.en: Creative youth workshops at Castagnéra media library, for drawing, making, crafting and inventing. Materials are provided.

9249ee2c8797eba30e9aee75088e800aea43cd7e.en: Bouge ta couche Halloween at Pierre Veilletet library, a costumed party with swing, rock and dances.

6282ac7d48989d43975b27dc07b77cf031c66ec9.en: A family screening of an animated film on Día de los Muertos, chosen by the library team, at Jean de La Ville de Mirmont library.

01522e7371ea75c183cd3a74cc63f5d4d6da30f4.en: Croc-en-jambe, a children's show at La Cabane media library, for ages 4 and up.

f9864bf224d7ac72cdfff8b4058eb60914503774.en: KALÉIDOSCOPE by Paul Vincent and Laure Vincent Salmon at the Galerie Sauvages in Darwin, from 29 October to 8 November. Paintings, drawings and objects to explore like a treasure hunt, with proceeds to Les Puits du Désert. Free entry.

fcf29c77ee8af1845b674a00b3ac77b0a00ebe96.en: Les Viatiques Hecto Daytime Halloween at Hecto Bar, a daytime Halloween gathering with DJs on a Funktion-One sound system. Tickets are €7 or €10, plus fees.

a08ba8069374022b3444dd33e60c25890aaa9697.en: A meeting on Image & danse at the Salle capitulaire Mably, on how to film and photograph movement, with Marina Kudryashova and Oleg Rogachev. Free with booking.

ef505d32a120d842087288f5809a7d033f81ab06.en: Halloween: menace sur le musée at the Musée d'Aquitaine, the third edition of an evening of games and mediation, guided tours of the witches exhibition, a DJ set and a parade, with student associations.

e7494df9b5049e3fc1243a81ae97f7dd1eb4e42a.en: A volleyball match, Burdis against Évreux, at the Palais des Sports de Bordeaux on Saturday 31 October at 19:00, with food, a merchandise shop and festive activities.

89e75328666100efd4b940ca5a60402760f01647.en: HERE WE GHOST, a Halloween party at Darwin with cocktails, DJs and a Ghost Walk, where the ugliest ghost costume is picked.

88e0cb5d217456a0ca341d19124f1d1e5323852f.en: Terreur Nocturne: Obsession at La Lanterne, about a shy young man who finds an object that grants any wish, and a crush who becomes obsessed. 1 h 48. Not for under-16s.

4eb2b7231b7f490ffae29acbc6439fd210fbfc57.en: Halloween Party 2026 at Deus Ex Machina Bordeaux, with The Black Wizards, a Portuguese garage psych punk band, and SIZ, a Bordeaux grunge and indie noise act.

a996c52cfe7649e7e0849f104adf2f00bd00ef93.en: An Octobre Rose Halloween boat party on the Garonne, organised by Queer Nouvelle-Aquitaine from 20:00 to 02:00. A queer party with a DJ set, live painting, dance and food. All proceeds go to the Ligue contre le cancer. Halloween dress code.

4b8f51e5af1a860ebcbcb7bd4921bb21ce5546ea.en: Les parents viennent de Mars, les enfants... du McDo at Théâtre Fémina, a family comedy about everyday scenes between a mother and her children, from babyhood to the teenage years.

1720944b32c1e1f1c0d493eb320f87b4192b2b65.en: Carpenter Brut at KRAKATOA, a retro-futuristic synth show for Leather Temple, the last part of a trilogy begun in 2018.

a570a2bdf430e20dccf543f40a55aa03c2213870.en: Pitch ton pote Bordeaux, Halloween edition, at L'Estrade. Friends pitch a single friend in four-minute presentations, followed by questions from the audience. Free ticket by HelloAsso. For ages 18 and up, two hours.

4dc7ce766b2f69b172b0ea2fb70c004a729d2c7d.en: Elijah Fox at Le Rocher de Palmer, a Californian pianist who has toured with Tom Misch and Yussef Dayes. He presents Ambient Works for the Highways of Los Angeles (2025).

73581afc6e09576548c06f955e1a092a823fde16.en: MOLECULE HORROR STORY at Château Formont in Ambarès-et-Lagrave, on 31 October from 21:00 to 06:00. An American Horror Story-themed night with immersive sets, video projections, house and techno, food trucks and a dress code.

f3e3bb0a883045719d99a40db3925dfebb160275.en: Arch Club at Rock School Barbey, a club and live event series from a label and collective linking contemporary rap, electronic music and club culture.

81a1ab110c9035b171ec36fb8ff9f1cba49b07a8.en: HALLOWEEN STARTS HERE at La Buvette des Quais, with WICKED, on 31 October from 22:00 to 01:40. Hard trance, hard dance, acid and hard techno with three DJs. Free entry, limited capacity.

c8729de13557120111e939e84466578969ebbdc2.en: HARDTECHNO HORROR SHOW at Hangar DS on Saturday 31 October from 00:00 to 06:30, with hard techno, rap rave and industrial sets. Under-16s are not admitted.

8e37ba7586db7bd4332b2795a3c3806b4ccba2a4.en: HALLOWEEN NIGHTMARE at L'Entrepôt on Saturday 31 October from 00:00 to 06:30, with hard industrial and rawstyle sets. Under-16s are not admitted.

5ee85a87fb872af2423fbd2a4bdccf6df8598e9a.en: The Darwin flea market (Dominical Market), on Sunday 1 November from 10:00 to 18:00, for private sellers. Stand applications go through a questionnaire opened each month.

48942d6b0034bbdb163ba21faa89d82cd9f1f4a3.en: Minokino: Le Monde à l'envers at La Lanterne, six tender short films about childhood and difference, from a mouse who lives upside down to a girl who flies away with a jumper.

efc9fd3c50b3c7ec15e73f52ecadecc846c54260.en: The GREEN Market on place Gaviniès, a plant-based producers' market with sushi, savoury crêpes, Asian and gluten-free food, cheese alternatives, desserts and jewellery. Raffle tickets and bookings online.

1ce7ef2706ef1973ef61e83dd8bd2e80a592ad65.en: Bordeaux's municipal museums are free on the first Sunday of each month, except in July and August. This covers the CAPC, Musée d'Aquitaine, Musée des Beaux-Arts, MADD, Muséum and the Botanical Garden greenhouses.

db7af607c5c450b350be0057ed6f1405979db0b7.en: A Sunday concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux with music by Bernard Herrmann from Vertigo and Psycho, including Souvenir de voyage and Echoes. A music-awakening workshop for children from age 4 runs during the concert.

0e45a6e1e2e30d191658c8f4a3d14b871e9a6e07.en: The Nansouty village, a walk through a district between the station and the boulevards, close to the Capucins market and the Saint-Genès quarter, at the Musée d'Aquitaine.

d42efb59289a4ed78988951ab22d58a5de3f03dc.en: A guided tour of the O.R. Studio exhibition on Sunday 1 November at 15:00, lasting 1 h 30, with members of the team. Free with booking.

c28d5eebc08cd640a58732aecd63a2cbdcdbbe26.en: Amine Radi at Théâtre Fémina, a comedian who has drawn three million spectators, with a more intimate show about his new life in France, cultural clashes and bad luck.

6a2d0bba2547707e47a72263902e3c284d7e98da.en: Rêveries by Christelle Chabrier at La Source media library, a photo installation projected on fabric, exploring her mother's memory during Alzheimer's disease.

8aeb555faa61a15e78706d1a970442873a606444.en: Pygmalion, a concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux with period instruments, performing Mozart's Mass in C alongside works by Bruckner, Mendelssohn and Schubert. A commented score talk takes place on 2 November.

20025fd09d11edcd96b55dc96462842449680162.en: A photo series workshop at Le Labo Photo, with eight three-hour sessions on building a personal series with two tutors. A few places are left. A camera is needed.

d3e7fdb5f0218ead88964435ae4b7ccce6665fa5.en: La Bougeothèque municipale, a free-movement space for children under three and their parents, with a child psychomotor therapist. Tuesdays 09:30 to 11:30 on 3 and 17 November and 1 and 15 December. No booking.

a1e82ec7d6f67789e9dfb39680c4b47391b3872b.en: La fabrique urbaine, a walk through the city to see the different types of housing and how to date buildings from their architecture, at the Musée d'Aquitaine.

9c4a18b994d4f191fbf35afc288cfc284fcb91db.en: WORD: se familiariser avec le traitement de texte at La Bastide library, a beginners' session on writing a first sentence and paragraph, correcting and saving.

b0a7e11e42fa013befc3d091f08d9c7b7ec916ef.en: Atelier informatique: posez vos questions at the Ludo-médiathèque Simone Veil, a peer-support session where participants share computer problems and answers.

c4e1ec46784533278c979d8d50cb59d1d70c2bbb.en: Petits secrets et grandes histoires, a 1 h 30 guided walk through Bordeaux's hidden stories and legends, meeting at place de la Bourse on Tuesday 3 November at 14:30. €12 per person, for adults and seniors.

146464f730611d11f07d715d3c2d4114a1c5e7ad.en: Dunes et forêts at the Carré des Jalles media library, a travelling Office National des Forêts exhibition on the coast and climate change, with games and immersive activities.

d42bd8deb8ba8f75cd29ab80ac2218064de3eed6.en: Ciné mardi in Italian at Castagnéra media library, a Tuesday film screening in French, Spanish or Italian, with dates given for each language.

0a3f11f38ec5d4c890d453fa706faccac82be639.en: ORÉ, an upcycling sewing workshop at La ManuCo run by two former fashion professionals, who help you make upcycled pieces. The creations are shown at a couture event.

69301af7d7a38af22bdd75b183d82fe10f404274.en: A closing evening for O.R. Studio's exhibition, with an excerpt from a documentary in progress about dancer Charles Jude, followed by a discussion with the film team. Free with booking.

932ce5b1e42fb5e5edc3546170307536cd02c841.en: Watercolour workshops for 2026–2027 at Les Yvette, covering monochrome washes, colour pairing, wash and gradients. No experience needed, and Tuesday evening sessions.

5d374ac419dd75d891d110739db922bb6b9e4a7f.en: Thomas Jefferson, the oenophile president, a talk at La Cité du Vin for the 250th anniversary of US independence. It covers his 1787 wine tour of France and his visits to Bordeaux estates. Hosted by Mathieu Doumenge.

31647516eff21b55777d2a46bd2a7e0965cae867.en: Jason Mist at L'Inconnue, a slide guitarist and singer from New Caledonia who blends folk, blues, reggae and world influences.

b9e6872183fff927c95673205b4ded8f230498f8.en: Dans les yeux d'Audrey by the Cie François Mauduit at Le Pin Galant, a ballet biopic of Audrey Hepburn, who dreamed of being a dancer, with flashbacks to her youth, films, fashion and her friendship with Hubert de Givenchy.

ae0865d36026cc43f06b576dec5d1fb39645e1a0.en: A surprise preview at La Lanterne of an arthouse film chosen by the team before release. A glass of wine is offered afterwards, in partnership with AFCAE and La Cave d'Antoine.

dca1f6ecbd677dfe88fe114a4bf5d1d2d5d8b5da.en: The 4th France–UK Forum of Local Governments, on 4 and 5 November 2026 at Bordeaux City Hall, with about 200 local representatives. Bordeaux hosts it through its twinning with Bristol, dating from 1947.

971df21b06f9112c7eb07ec6562f9427ba353297.en: Readings at Pablo Neruda library in Pessac. Contact the library for details.

7c729a69fd9241b9fa60cb197e7bd1baf01203ef.en: L'habitat des tout-petits, a play space for children from 10 months to 3 years, run by the Interlude toy library at Bibliothèque La Bastide. Free entry from 10:30.

caec0e62576923d5c7058ae2fc08a623adb371db.en: Polisson, my first steps in the museum, a musical walk for toddlers aged 18 to 36 months through the Musée d'Aquitaine's collections, with songs by Hélène Flore. The 4 November visit is full.

cd763e78f0d97a4b509a6fb26f6e2bb20e454f7a.en: ABCD'ART art awakening workshops at the Maison Ouverte in Nansouty-Saint-Genès, each Wednesday from 10:30 to 12:00 for children aged 3 to 7 who attend without an adult. No annual commitment, outside school holidays.

c2f5e8b5f78c01bd7a35cf6762b15af523bddb07.en: Le rendez-vous initiation et consolidation at Castagnéra media library, every Wednesday from 10:30 to 12:00 outside school holidays. A digital skill is shown and then practised, for beginners and more experienced users.

d43f16b0e438bcd2877dd75818cabfbc5f00d27a.en: An art awakening session each Wednesday morning at La Maison Marandon with ABCD'ART, from age 3, exploring a different artist or theme each week.

50fce056e07f4f3919a74c381921f6565e59743b.en: Reading sessions for children aged 0 to 3 at Léonie d'Aunet library in Parempuyre, with themed stories, tales and kamishibai.

f0554880fb4e262a4ce7f36474532c375b0165fc.en: Contes en yoga at Mériadeck library during the DYS month, a storytelling session for ages 6 and up in which children act out emotions to build confidence, persistence and calm. Booking required.

01ced0e93e60f836f4a7c7cbb99531db2783b455.en: A walk to look for animal tracks and signs in and around Majolan in Blanquefort. The meeting point is sent on registration.

9e8b81dc20e212acf7607dfcc40b39a17640579b.en: Employment support drop-ins with ACT33 at La Bastide library on Wednesday 4 November and 2 December from 14:00 to 17:00. One-hour one-to-one help with cover letters and job interviews. Free, with booking.

976505b6dfcd7c33633c274dd626dbf15ca05ea9.en: La voix sous la glace, a creative writing workshop for ages 11 to 14 at Coworking Now (H14) on 4 November from 14:00 to 15:30. A mysterious voice under the Lapland ice sets the story going. Run by Écri'Magique.

5386f5720b5d71103766d3491e5e915de15638ca.en: Drôle de face., a workshop at the Musée des Beaux-Arts on the art of portraiture, from serious to playful, ending with recomposing a portrait from cut pieces.

a5d8bc7a98c17da27e333ca449befe76864b2f88.en: Plumes et Déplumes, a literary talk show performed by Compagnie Avide Vacarme at Saint-Louis-de-Montferrand media library, part of the Lire Élire 2026 festival with BiblioGironde.

f687d8a8da052505839fa88aa00d8176dcd93759.en: Les petites oreilles: le piano at the conservatoire library on Wednesday 4 November at 15:00, for children aged 3 to 6 with a parent. Stories in music and a mini-concert by conservatoire pupils.

32c391251930647f5a646ccb067342f7efac68e2.en: Lire avec un animal spécial DYS at Mériadeck library, reading aloud to animals with Odile from Médiamimaux 33, for ages 8 and up. Booking required.

6d1f7b61a017576c72b72689742116f201193959.en: La nuit où les aurores se sont éteintes, a creative writing workshop for ages 15 to 18 at Coworking Now (H14) on 4 November from 15:30 to 17:30. It starts from the mystery of the northern lights vanishing in Lapland. Run by Écri'Magique.

5455da22a995efb86a237e86f6dc7d13626ea8f0.en: The launch of the Prix des 9–12 ans at Thouars media library. Children can meet, borrow the shortlisted novels and vote from March to May.

aabbff02e6228145e6219153c57f45167b5fcbbd.en: Jean Dupas, de l'Arcadie aux grands décors, a talk at Mériadeck library by art historian Isabelle Beccia on the career of this Prix de Rome winner, who decorated the liners Île-de-France and Normandie.

2041e7ccd12fd3daadacec956531765fc15ae7e9.en: La diversité pour survivre, an author meeting at Librairie Georges with David Grosclaude on why minority languages such as Occitan matter for culture and for the future. In partnership with the Mascaret festival.

c2acd58f7a2922236bb1c5c58bad51a9dae2e7c8.en: An Apéro surVOLTé with Enercoop Nouvelle-Aquitaine at La ManuCo, a festive evening on renewable and citizen energy. New members who join at the event get a €40 promo code on their first bill.

5c3e477586566251d776f7f537c7e1d664db6e48.en: Monsters and fantastic creatures in medieval Spain, a talk at Jacques Ellul media library in Pessac, marking the 40th anniversary of the Pessac–Burgos twinning. Booking online.

cc4b47299674c0f96d6d3889a5a835ad1a7e516c.en: A screening of the documentary Au fil de l'eau by Georges Tillard on drought, floods and water use in French farming, followed by a farmer's talk on how water is managed on their farms. Debate afterwards.

89973b12aff8e1b20a856cb1ff1e7623859aaa79.en: Philippe Jaroussky at the Auditorium de Bordeaux with his ensemble Artaserse, presenting his own Vivaldi in period-instrument performances of the Stabat Mater, Nisi Dominus and opera arias.

4ed34eebbb9512d240adf842d15ee87111f2f67e.en: B.A.K., La famille ce n'est pas que des portraits punaisés sur des placards, at La Matière. Three women's stories: an elderly woman in a care home, a lighthouse keeper and a teenager in a new family. From age 7, one hour.

ec516145c5d3b1015caddc1f8620a8efeb77d0dd.en: B.A.K, the same production as the other listing, at La Matière théâtre. Three generations of women share family stories, the sea, cooking and love. From age 7, one hour.

76d7f8de26a4cbfded0144c7fe6381095e58d755.en: billie at KRAKATOA, a French-language band mixing dream pop, post-punk and chanson française, inspired by the Cocteau Twins, Joy Division and Françoise Hardy. Presenting her second EP.

463a1fc6bf2ef6499ed0a4648b1dc36b66c572d1.en: Le réemploi par la preuve, a free morning on Thursday 5 November from 08:30 to 10:30 at La Base du réemploi in Mérignac. Project owners and designers share how to deliver building projects that use reclaimed materials.

5e29b2be0b2ff777957337778c0849306d06bf6d.en: An international colloquium on the grand decorative art of the interwar years, on Thursday 5 November from 13:30 to 17:00 at Mériadeck library. It is held with the Bordeaux fine arts museum and the Villa Médicis, alongside the Jean Dupas exhibition.

5ceb6f88cac3c36816b5d4c8a1e275d27cc5a96a.en: Conversation and writing workshops for adult speakers of other languages at Bordeaux-Lac library. Conversation on 1 October, 5 November and 3 December, and writing on 15 October, 19 November and 17 December, all at 09:30. Registration required.

6607bd3ce9fc4cb36ebe896449a9146e39a500df.en: Bienvenue à la retraite at the Ludo-médiathèque Simone Veil, a session on preparing calmly for retirement, covering rights, procedures, health and social ties.

284818d7899a7aa83337a98aa63b67feb8501238.en: Les Biblioblablas at a senior residence, a relaxed meeting where people chat, listen to readings aloud and share books and memories. Open to all, run with the CCAS.

005daa16eb59a5c9dd881abff9392a6e991a2dcd.en: A webinar on the wine and spirits sector, part of the national agri-food jobs week, from 11:00 to 11:45. It covers jobs, training and includes a professional's testimony.

1cb38236e51e367ae05d8310b525658cc5ba1651.en: Le regard de François-Rémy Roqueton sur Jean Dupas at the Galerie des Beaux-Arts. The art historian discusses La Gloire de Bordeaux, Dupas's 1937 allegorical mural for the Bourse du Travail, whose sketch is in the exhibition.

18efb0b6293b9cb334a5265ec6f61af345a87665.en: A colloquium on Jean Dupas and the grand decoration of the interwar period, linked to the Jean Dupas exhibition and organised with the Villa Médicis and Université Bordeaux Montaigne.

6a54e84d3b194faf6cce6483c15ecb2e1450166d.en: A workshop at Mériadeck library on scam messages, calls and emails. It shows how to recognise fraud, avoid the traps and adopt the right reflexes, using examples.

5d5b57e647ba11f28913f6abaf7afaea4f7d1d77.en: SMIP 2026, the pharmaceutical and health careers week at the UFR Sciences Pharmaceutiques, organised by ALLIS-NA. Talks, an HR round table, alumni testimonies, a quiz and speed meetings with employers.

bd256d376436f6d757fd2ee94af9501a94fccbd6.en: A literary siesta at the Galerie des Beaux-Arts. Relax on deckchairs and see the Jean Dupas exhibition at a slower pace.

ae0d5d8f393bc0cebdc5893f985c5230b95a9077.en: Information meetings on childcare options for children aged 0 to 3, run by Bordeaux's childcare team at Athénée Père Joseph Wresinski, on 5 November and 3 December from 17:30 to 19:00.

3dceee5c266e268ce7edc98aea794ef9b90bcb06.en: Isulia Festival 2026 Music, from 5 to 7 November at the Base sous-marine. Three days of electronic music across two stages, including Audrey Danza, Octave One (live), Pelles Melles and Puremblast. Opening day by invitation.

dc383cefe4e50c17e737f52f80265576edb3e8d2.en: Isulia Festival 2026 Talks at La Cité Bleue, from 5 to 7 November, with talks on visual cultures, digital imaginaries and how to inform yourself. Pre-registration is open.

8f6b9a930d39c805e2d2cb205c65f47e02fa16f8.en: Wines of the world and creative bites at La Cité du Vin, afterwork tastings at 18:30 or 20:30. Wines are paired with three products from the So Terroir category of the So Innovation 2026 awards, led by sommelier Sylvain Farthouat.

60695c54790e6f914e14f55050d5aba67740391f.en: Regards sur la collection Jacques Sargos, a talk at the MADD on the 137 drawings donated in 2024, with collector Jacques Sargos and curator Olivier Hurstel.

7e0fd9ece76aca1171d7f4f73497e63929e3138a.en: Ce que raconte le ciel, a creative writing workshop for adults at Coworking Now (H14) on Thursday 5 November from 19:00 to 21:00, inspired by the northern lights in Lapland. Run by Écri'Magique.

6337b6e57bbde5cea18c17d2a34cfd0b63c2727d.en: Don Quichotte de Chine et d'Espagne at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, a programme of Chinese traditional songs and settings of Don Quixote by Ravel and Ibert, sung by Liao Changyong.

d68cf9c8e1188cdcf43a3140cbd283508504bb21.en: Camp Claude at Les Vivres de l'Art on 5 November 2026, a band mixing pop, electronic and cold wave, shown with BAAM Productions and L'Astrodøme.

bb757168b167268101ecada44946bc068577e6df.en: Faire parler les archives des non-alignés at the TnBA, a live film performance by Serbian artist and filmmaker Mila Turajlić, built from forgotten reels of the Non-Aligned Movement. Discussions with the audience follow each evening.

5771c9d2612177089c51898fc17935fb9b92b809.en: Ciné-débat: Où vont les âmes? at La Lanterne, a film by Brigitte Poupart about Anna, 18, who has asked for medical assistance in dying and reunites with her half-sisters.

7be130897fe9be95256db9f001b20f002746d660.en: Tété at Rock School Barbey, presenting his first new song in seven years, Vertige du Seum, which opens a new artistic cycle. Concerts will be intimate and linked to a charity for isolated mothers. Details to come.

aecc1fe5c3f0ff50a5680e9df53eb8aba864f5a7.en: Quentin Sauvé with Disarme at L'Inconnue. Quentin Sauvé plays intimate folk with electric tension, and Disarme is a self-taught Franco-Malagasy musician with a bittersweet 1990s-influenced sound.

fd0ee3a075f8982eb746495ec737e58d11e8bb83.en: Une heure à t'attendre with Thierry Frémont and Nicolas Vaude at Le Pin Galant, a 70-minute two-hander about two men sharing a flat while a woman they both love is absent. Humour and suspense.

cd79d21ec56023650573ea0e7def2877770bc742.en: MAMMAL HANDS at Le Rocher de Palmer, a jazz trio that blends ambient, electronica and minimalism. Presenting the album Circadia (2026), with the brothers Jordan and Nick Smart and drummer Rob Turner.

7925e6c5e2c41e7de3f5bcf705258d86c8f7b696.en: SPIDER ZED at Le Rocher de Palmer, an intimate songwriter who turns everyday doubts and hopes into melodies. Presenting his EP ma révolution (2026).

cb21b59a2af6d0a07d6469a506c9ba705a537d32.en: TERRAINS OUVERTS at Le 308, the architecture centre, an exhibition on cities and sport with a map of sports spaces in the Bordeaux metropolitan area and about fifteen projects. Opening on 5 November at 18:30, on view until 29 January 2027.

89ceedbe4eb8256e5b1693da9e9dee75f71bf894.en: Aurore musicale at the Marché des Douves on Friday 6 November from 08:00. Conservatoire pupils play early instruments for about twenty minutes, followed by a free breakfast.

8027ac18d55d95b34db8b860ca33bc788a49ad16.en: A two-stage green waste shredding point at the Parking de l'église Romane. Drop off branches up to 8 cm wide, then collect the wood chips on Saturday 21 November from 09:30 to 12:00.

a1398a7af52f5fe825a46d9d87b01b0fdf6c7f0f.en: Un globe, des mondes, a tour of the exhibition at the Musée d'Aquitaine led by the GeoDock team, on how virtual globes shape our view of the planet.

1cd8ae6c11b03c63d0806cbb080d96d122fa477a.en: Scroll at the Salle de la Glacière, a theatre piece by the Compagnie des Petites Secousses on how the smartphone takes over our lives, written and staged by Jérôme Batteux.

6a434d6cac9fca2e22b897ae9d01596decc1a0cb.en: A conversation workshop at Pablo Neruda library to practise spoken French in a friendly setting. It does not replace French classes. Contact the library for details.

99a75b2b1fc149660320115c8b1f91d10702a840.en: A knitting and tea session at the Ludo-médiathèque Simone Veil, with snacks. Beginners are welcome.

22efaa1f2520913905197039e7d8615d65ce2876.en: An introduction to Land art at Carré des Jalles media library, a slideshow on the late-1960s movement that took art out of galleries and into the landscape, led by Robert Smithson.

0b142304c0f547a984aa373e16ecce8f0fb7700d.en: A literary meeting with Jesús Carazo at Jacques Ellul media library, marking the anthology My Best Pages. The Burgos-born playwright and writer is part of the 40th anniversary of the Pessac–Burgos twinning. Booking online.

31200949980d2b2ab77ab9c124b40da964f8061f.en: A mixed-media workshop at the Musée des Beaux-Arts, in which you transpose a museum artwork into painting, collage, watercolour and pastel.

06e095abca74a392343f6d5aff15a7018f7a3959.en: Sewing for everyone at Thouars media library, learning or improving with Véronique. The projects come from children's picture books, in partnership with Café du Dôme.

9a3d6993c862ab9c4c56828f1e9b0eeb12a329f6.en: A concert of Spanish classical guitar at Jacques Ellul media library with Arnaud Dumond and flamenco guitarist Elenita Román, celebrating the 40th anniversary of the Pessac–Burgos twinning. Booking online.

55873f2a2a7b0730269d5fa8e958c86228134b53.en: A games evening at Castagnéra media library with Ludiloisirs, the Talence toy library. Enthusiastic mediators help you find classics and new releases.

dffb4572df0c23f7f14d6e80cb5c78543c754ae9.en: Les amphibiens à l'automne et la très mystérieuse salamandre at the Bois du Taillan-Médoc, a damp dusk walk to see amphibians. Free from age 7. Bring boots and torches. Booking through Cistude Nature.

049d830b713cdb0b705017a7a9eaa6de4c052b33.en: The same amphibians walk, at Saint-Médard-en-Jalles, a naturalist outing on species, habitats and how the ecosystem works. The meeting point is sent on registration.

f10559624519087e508a906b502dbe625def22f1.en: Libertad at the Archives départementales, with Turina's Quartet No. 1 with La Oración del Toro, and Debussy's String Quartet in G minor. Bookings open from 6 October 2026.

690ec399104d825103565e563ce87e2da3cf2dc8.en: Le fabuleux destin de Mathilde Chatin at L'Impromptu, an hour of original songs by Mathilde Chatin with pianist Pascal Pistone, mixing tender, funny and nostalgic moments and video.

1a59b1ba21826f8701ff3d7d59e5d11f7bf5e09f.en: Je(s) at Glob Théâtre, with the Deaf performer Emmanuelle Laborit in a show that turns sign language into a tool of resistance and empowerment, blending physical theatre and music.

4ddf39aff3ca5b185f3e08e2ec3cdfd256f75859.en: Lucienne Eden at the Centre d'animation Argonne, a family comedy by the Compagnie du 109 about ecology, the pollution of the seas and love. Free tickets, with a hat collection after the show.

bdc661985ab7122701b46eaeb11b0beea23a8287.en: Le Petit Détournement at Le Cube, an improvised dubbing show by the Compagnie La Poule. Actors invent dialogue and story live over film clips with a musician. From age 14, 1 h 30.

0041beeaeb12eed99c85bccf281c30c650cf22c3.en: Wallace Cleaver at KRAKATOA, presenting his album Marcel, a 15-track personal album by a rapper who has moved into song and pop, about adulthood, time passing and loss.

881e0f40576759a1dc74b729fd8e6ca13ce6de09.en: MERYL at Le Rocher de Palmer, a singer who came to attention with Béni in 2019 and was nominated for the Victoires de la Musique and the Flammes in 2024. Presenting her album La Dame.

3b400d0fb1429f7f74c81f7f5a2ae64b5b3c0267.en: Les fourberies de Scapin at the Théâtre de la Pergola, Molière's comedy staged as a costumed Italian farce, with the famous sack scene. Adapted and directed by Yves André. 1 h 30, from age 7.

c74b6957d42f12fc66d60f54c66b51d9aee39de9.en: Renan Luce – Joue Repenti at Le Pin Galant, a tour celebrating 20 years since his first album, Repenti. He plays its 13 songs in album order at twenty concerts.

1852e447c21cf0510cd66614f806b6c026ff5604.en: Stéphane Séva, Sensuel, at Sortie 13 on Friday 6 November. A French crooner pays tribute to Nougaro, Trenet, Vian, Salvador and Gainsbourg, with a touch of jazz. Seated, free seating.

231602b238360c17b7204b6abe63c55138cf5bca.en: Solar Rush at L'Entrepôt on Friday 6 November from 00:00 to 06:00, an acid, trance and techno night with Kyzwall, Miza & See Rose, Solar Boys and Tulipe. Tickets from €7.99.

8ad02f437d2b852ce848716591b127ffa9ac2a8b.en: A two-stage green waste shredding point at the Parc cimetière Rive Gauche. Drop off branches up to 8 cm wide, then collect the wood chips on Saturday 21 November from 09:30 to 12:30.

e6f43f2678ad8e107c4e6e4c8b68f33f8c7a6c3a.en: Le grand Conte-mi at Castagnéra media library, a storytelling session in which children learn to listen, imagine and love books, with a crocodile searching for its glasses and a princess who refuses to wait.

a5bd86176d8062fa9358442a7e68a67bbf29d4ed.en: REBONDS at Station Marne, contemporary dance workshops with guest choreographers. On Saturday 7 November from 10:00 to 13:00, Camille Guillaume leads guided improvisation on presence and transformation. €35 per session.

89e6ea2cc1717ea6dbe776a630e4a8ce573214a5.en: Pitchouthèque at Ambarès-et-Lagrave library, a family reading session on the first Saturday of each month. Picture books, rhymes and voice games for young children.

aac977ac4adc40053c77190010d1f75c519b0670.en: Créateliers at Mériadeck library: illuminated bookmark. Discover medieval illumination and decorate a bookmark, leaving with the piece and a tutorial. Meet in the Hall -1.

d2104b1217622a12c0fbdb211e10ff2b17c1f5af.en: MARATHON PHOTO at Mériadeck library with photographer Eva Sanz. Colour photography in the morning, black and white in the afternoon. Free without registration, from age 15, beginners welcome. The photos are shown in the library.

11ea8ad878238446a833d62a748720fb241f11ca.en: La maison où habite le bonheur at Jacques Ellul media library, a creative workshop inspired by brightly painted Ukrainian houses. Participants decorate a house of happiness with drawings and paper. Booking online, linked to the Villa Valmont.

37a7fb71434dc46e7552f3963f18f57b602a059b.en: A family linocut workshop at Gabriela Mistral media library, where you carve and print your own stamp with an artist.

578a8d275b0f1cca4d0facbe2426c89b2c192e37.en: Bébé bouquine at Mériadeck library, stories and songs for children aged 18 months to 4. Booking required.

cee375b91ab2cae055d08352a8cdb4499492d8a0.en: Réalisé sans IA: Inkscape first steps at Castagnéra media library, learning free vector drawing software and cutting the finished design on the library's Cricut.

cf7b4590219875222e100b7ebd48e9432577c97a.en: An IT workshop with Dé'Clic St Louis at Saint-Louis-de-Montferrand media library, covering the basics of word processing.

85fef6d5dc6b74f77beeaa1203bc0a6f500d3c60.en: BB Bouquine at the bookshop Le Passeur, with stories, rhymes and finger games for ages 0 to 3 on the first Saturday of each month at 10:30. Booking required.

8785e4bfec99edcd21c878283d9ec1b0f98369ea.en: Café mortel at Castagnéra media library, a free and caring space to talk about grief and death. An bereavement companion leads it, with the Syprès funeral cooperative.

18874f71e2702bb909fa444a636ac420ad093bdf.en: Au fil de l'eau, a nature walk around Lake Bordeaux with urban guide Vincent, through calm wetlands, sandy beach and pines to see birdlife and small animals.

7c5dd77fd9a6693b65001aad319a43194a48b8aa.en: Au fil de l'eau, a walk around Lake Bordeaux combined with a photo workshop with Balast. A cultural walk through the built and natural heritage and biodiversity. Meeting point on registration.

f859267f8937a7d536d9cbd469f07d3009767f67.en: Les dévoreurs de BD at Capucins/Saint-Michel library, where children vote for their favourite comics. The most popular titles are bought for the library shelves.

c5c5c5df7f9e8f309f404d6ab88f649f455ba186.en: Plis et chimères, an exhibition of large abstract and figurative paintings on sheets by Laure Juilan Dallet at the Chapelle Saint-Loup. Opening on Saturday 7 at 11:00, with the artist.

64a1400f283caa48f781609062c75d654b24da2e.en: Bordeaux pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale, a city walk led by a museum mediator past the stone bridge, the Grand-Théâtre and place Pey-Berland, followed by objects from the Centre national Jean Moulin at the Musée d'Aquitaine.

36509bb1819b83a2e0929993858a703e30da1a21.en: A chess workshop at Bordeaux-Lac library, run on Saturdays by Gérard Monange from age 6. Registration with the librarians. Sessions restart on 5 September.

120ecfc85420840b4652ed4e384d9ad321e464b9.en: A Repair Café at Maison RêVée on Saturday 7 November from 14:00 to 17:00. A volunteer repairer helps you fix small electrical appliances. One item per person, pay-what-you-wish. Register by email first.

84ae89e9516e7c2b7c9b7151f1f9fdf7b39b6f1b.en: La fabrique urbaine, how the limits of the city have changed, a walk from the Bordeaux World Heritage exhibition through the ancient, medieval and modern city limits, with remnants and lost traces.

30e0ff9a5857ce2b20e0e22a182900d45ffc6635.en: The Gare quarter, a new departure, a walk from the 19th-century housing of the Compagnie du Midi's workers to the building of Gare Saint-Jean and the quarter's transformation today. Museum event.

cd29cc843490a9dd07741d7e2c0e66a7134e63fd.en: A theatre workshop for children at Mériadeck library during the DYS month, with the Les Porteurs d'histoires company. Through play, children build imagination, speaking skills and self-confidence. From age 6, booking required.

06467310eb163f0ea17e7312c32abc2bae91da8d.en: A musical meeting with Indian singer and percussionist Charu Hariharan at the Musée national des douanes on Saturday 7 November at 15:00. She plays the mridangam, kanjira and konnakol, as part of a residency showcase from the Rocher de Palmer.

e12db26eb5d702f386d2cf35f4e080d1bff1c332.en: An autumn workshop at Capucins/Saint-Michel library: make a hedgehog from leaves gathered in the garden.

027718594d5616115c9105738c920dc953644941.en: Loup y es-tu?, a workshop at Jean de La Ville de Mirmont library with an animator from the Bordeaux Natural History Museum, on the secret lives of wolves.

8410586cadf311fe92ecd46a6d7365268382399d.en: Le concierge vous accueille at the Musée d'Aquitaine, a guided visit led by a ghostly former porter who tells the story of the site and the city. Registration required.

143bfa4ade2bf535f3162622cfb01306133e1c05.en: A meeting with artist Faustine Crambes at Café Luminosa on Saturday 7 November from 16:00 to 18:00. She paints imagined landscapes built on colour and light. €8, including a drink. Booking required.

639853420b7436bb82e2cac11098c244b5e97e1d.en: Hansel et Gretel at Mériadeck library during the DYS month, with Les Porteurs d'histoires. An interactive staging of the tale in a dark forest. From age 6, free entry at the auditorium.

bc6a383160bf68843fdb915eccceb7060d725da4.en: Stellar Impact II at Les Vivres de l'Art on 7 November from 17:00, a psychedelic electronic night with Happy Face and Orbit Grooves. Happy hour from 17:00 to 19:30.

e8795b66fe303261274d6a72fdef9ece8f6ab685.en: A ciné-concert of Charlie Chaplin shorts at L'Impromptu, with piano by Mathilde Chatin or Adèle Pistone and accordion by Pascal Pistone. About one hour, for all ages.

6479c1683a5574b367423402f3e2b71c98255a8d.en: Volleyball, Burdis against Le Cannet, on Saturday 7 November at 19:00 at the Palais des Sports de Bordeaux, with a buffet and a club shop.

d726deb3212cd0dd134ef69a0c7e73b401ca6ba9.en: Bordel bordelais #1 at La Salle des Fêtes Grand Parc, with Cockney Rejects (East End punk, formed in 1978), Basque band Arene 6 and Bordeaux street punk act Ramblin'Firm.

6a9804fdcd931493bdd1a2e6037ca5dbcbbb4b5c.en: Israel Galván at the Auditorium de Bordeaux with Bolero de Blanco y Negro, an avant-garde flamenco piece that dialogues with Ravel's Boléro. Co-produced with the Opéra National de Bordeaux.

ce1652b59d0e265b41371bd5f954d35424d24959.en: Le Cabaret singulier at L'Impromptu, a musical comedy about a strict father who tries to shape his rebellious daughter, until a housekeeper turns the home into an experiment. About one hour, for all ages.

ad05655b3f7ea4364f1cbd2ac97c34d371277dcd.en: GWENDOLINE at Le Rocher de Palmer, a French new wave and post-punk duo with blunt, sardonic lyrics. Presenting their second album, C'est à moi, ça (2024).

24e8971508e5cf6537fe102ee63eb12f8812adbb.en: AURORE at Sortie 13 in Pessac on Saturday 7 November, a melodic hardcore band from Marseille, presenting the album SPARKS. Doors 19:30, concert 20:30.

91983caa799edcdb47dee0e2c7a7e61135841011.en: E.SY Kennenga's 25-year career celebration at Le Pulp in Bordeaux on Saturday 7 November from 21:00. €15 presale plus booking fees, with limited places.

69828ac7450969ab995e7c4aa64625b1ed330046.en: THE FRENCHCORE at Hangar DS on Saturday 7 November from 00:00 to 06:30, with frenchcore, hardcore, raggatek and hard techno sets. Under-16s are not admitted.

29ccda28754fe70e1b311040ad4107f2f4ab3494.en: Anatomik Park at Cap Sciences, a funfair-style exhibition on the human body, with challenges, reflex tests, a skeleton puzzle and games with organs. Designed by Cap Sciences.

e82198f29afda3a3ae923b959876a96f6f12414d.en: The Marathon de Bordeaux AG2R La Mondiale on Sunday 8 November, with more than 30,000 runners over 10 km, a half marathon and a new full marathon. Starts at 08:00 for the marathon, 10:00 for the half and 13:15 for the 10 km.

379c1aaa273542bc6969f3d3e276d05952463573.en: A surprise film at Utopia Saint-Siméon, preceded by a presentation of gazette no. 267. Single price of €5.

4ea27e14a75f912aa722e39d0b2f4fdaddd8622f.en: Bastide-Niel en projets at the Eklo Hotel, a talk on the Niel district, from its railway and industrial past to a future eco-district with contemporary housing. Museum event.

c7e0c151df2308ecee0145b715598564da1377c5.en: Café philo: L'injonction contemporaine au bonheur at Jacques Ellul media library, a discussion on the pressure to be happy and what it reveals about us. Booking online.

17e076f756627419438d84342588a8a45322e30e.en: Le Prince de Madrid by Francis Lopez at Le Pin Galant, an operetta set in 18th-century Spain, with romance, humour and tunes such as Rossignol de mes amours.

93f22be9cb5c418d0bcf8c3b856fc97add41bcdc.en: Vins et Pâtisseries at La Cité du Vin, marking its 10th anniversary. An adults-only Sunday afternoon tea at 16:00 with pastry chef Marilou Tamarelle, with three wine pairings chosen by sommeliers.

d093b11bab468b196064dbdf56d285dd37bb2366.en: La dépression est un panda at Le Rocher de Palmer, a duo show by Céline Cohen and Matthieu Miègeville on depression, mixing confession, live music and a talk with the audience. Part of the Hors jeu en Jeu festival.

4d7453fc41dcd0309bab3b21691722fc7b4c866d.en: Roberto Fonseca and Vincent Ségal at Le Rocher de Palmer, a piano and cello duo whose album came from a five-day improvised session in Havana. Danzón and classical music meet. Presenting Nuit parisienne à la Havane (2025).

70f18101137afd96e1d178a28d9e8ffa3c9ee9fa.en: Cycle Tous en Scène: The Bandwagon at La Lanterne, a 1953 musical (1 h 52) by Vincente Minnelli about a fallen star who returns to New York and stages a musical with old friends.

24912fcb99e6015c4dfbb80472b5b25b7f33f49a.en: LA JUNGLE at Sortie 13 in Pessac on Sunday 8 November at 20:30 (doors 19:30). A noise and trance duo that became a trio for its album An Order of Things (2026).

9e4c89303718edf3bbd66150214684906da61453.en: A two-stage green waste shredding point at the Rue de Guyenne car park. Drop off branches up to 8 cm wide, then collect the wood chips on Saturday 19 November from 09:00 to 17:00.

e5b41988aeeecd61730f7cd267d3b29726833a59.en: Piscine Judaïque Jean-Boiteux, 1934–2026, a museum talk on Bordeaux's first swimming pool of the 1930s, with its Art Deco and modern architecture and its recent renovation.

ee3d875a66ee5bd93f3f02bf8f47454b67f3b454.en: Forindustrie information session at the Pessac agency, introducing the online platform that lets people discover industrial careers in an interactive way during a three-week event.

3d5e2b5347690ba86665b7f04313807b8ca50edc.en: Guide pratique de l'ordinateur 1 at Sésame, a practical workshop on the keyboard and mouse: clicking, dragging, the main keys and a few useful shortcuts.

75f584a847d84777728a83ad8f37840fb928e864.en: Goya's early works, a modern art talk at the Chartreuse de Lussy on Monday 9 November 2026. It covers Goya's apprenticeship years, tapestry cartoons and early commissions. Opens a 19th-century cycle by AGJA.

4b65b0564f4f14f318935b688090ab8fc7f4a589.en: Appartements témoins at the Maison Saint-Louis-Beaulieu, a talk by historians Isabelle Backouche and Éric Le Bourdis on how Jewish tenants were dispossessed during the Occupation under Vichy procedures.

d7f7a32e5162ff3be6e58822cff2637d25bdc750.en: Gurriers at Rock School Barbey, a Dublin-formed five-piece with urgent post-punk and noise rock. Presenting their second album, Nobody's Coming to Save You, after the first, Come and See (2024).

e2572636e6a4eb3d14b0aa74b973968d42c182bb.en: Carmen at the Grand-Théâtre, a new production by Emmanuelle Bastet made with the Shanghai Conservatory. It gives Don José more psychological depth. A talk with the director and conductor is on Monday 9 November at 18:30.

721ebcca25ef3522e900b0da610919683cc6cf59.en: Le lien et l'étincelle at Utopia Saint-Siméon, a screening on local renewable energy followed by a debate with the associations CIRENA and Solévent. Single price €5, presale available.

76f0ce3e5b154dce121ff6d29502ad1953b29832.en: Recruitment open day at the ACIER temp agency in Eysines for industrial jobs in Mérignac and nearby towns, including quality, fitting, welding and painting roles.

b505cf07f4495cfe3a20ac1fe776a6ee1c2c51fc.en: Exhibition of paintings by Esra Trolonge, a Franco-Turkish artist based in Bordeaux since 2005, at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul in Pessac. Her works focus on plants and imagined worlds. A guided visit is held on Thursday 12 November at 18:30.

cef6f2cc3c76a662410fcaa1f08a0e800a5ccb0e.en: A music talk at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck on Sister Rosetta Tharpe, who blended gospel, blues, jazz and rock. The session covers her influence on Little Richard, Chuck Berry, Elvis Presley and Johnny Cash.

bfe5f82871a0e797068723c096bf55fa51e78622.en: A beginner workshop at the Bibliothèque La Bastide on using Word: typing a letter, saving and retrieving a text, and formatting it.

7a2c14d40f8b70dfb2e5edcdff59ead21d2f1c74.en: A practical workshop at Sésame on navigating a computer: opening, closing and moving windows, using the taskbar and finding programs.

3c09534e724f6c689b3d176751f0329446e08c83.en: Playful story readings at the Ludo-médiathèque, pôle Simone Veil, on forest-themed picture books, led by Isabelle. The sessions aim to support language and creativity through shared reading.

c1a85c675b0cda907aad6d58ed6ba2014e72fa89.en: Collage workshops at Les Yvette in Bordeaux for the 2026-2027 season, open to all from age 8, or from age 5 with an adult. Themes include free expression and a creature-building session, with dates listed for each.

46bff49c50c8c62e3ac81bc1bde2811d3cb203bc.en: Live recording of the Bâbord talk show at the Salle des Fêtes in Bordeaux Grand Parc, marking 45 years of La Clé des Ondes within the Hors Jeu En Jeu festival. The talk on voice and access to speech is followed by a concert by Sowge.

0b74bbfceb0f8afe1afc6b480a59ec934eea6d43.en: Acoustic aperitif concert by Jason Mist, a New Caledonian singer-songwriter who plays slide guitar in roots music mixing folk, blues, rock and reggae. Presented at the Maison des Arts Vivants as part of the P'tites scènes de l'iddac. Runs 1 h 30.

5e27d2b2d3649d68614cd7836feeb412f3728cb5.en: A talk at La Cité du Vin, part of the Vendanges du Savoir series, on sustainable viticulture. Researchers discuss how climate change and farming practices affect soils, ecosystems and microbial communities. The event can also be followed online.

aab66a99b2b9650ccea13d8e7b7ef56c0e5009e1.en: Historian Tal Bruttmann presents his research on SS photographs taken at Auschwitz in 1944, which he studies with German historian Christophe Kreutzmuller. The talk covers how the images document the organisation of the extermination of Jews.

5730bdc5d0b1cb99a8838f654ba3c87d4d3f9f8b.en: Screening of a documentary on Julian Assange, organised by Amnesty International with FIPADOC, at the Utopia Saint-Siméon. A debate follows with Amnesty members and a representative of the Free Assange Wave movement. Ticket price is 5 euros.

01d5f0b9242253d5b666439e662d91a8fffbc3c1.en: An evening concert aboard the Normandie, presented at the Musée Mer Marine. The show traces the liner's history from its 1932 launch to the war, with period photos and films, and jazz and music-hall pieces on clarinet and piano.

0974174fb95c040dff67234cc2b7ea1a79327e5c.en: A cine-meeting at La Lanterne screening Le Jeu de la Ferme by Jean-Pierre Vedel (1h27). Shot over four years with children on the Aubrac plateau, it follows children who recreate farm life with Aubrac cattle through play.

ca868118f4653743d9d8ee73f061c3ed5f186f6b.en: Icelandic rock band The Vintage Caravan plays a Hors les Murs date at MAC 3 Pessac on 10 November 2026. Doors open at 19:30 and concerts start at 20:30. The band's latest album, Portals, came out in September 2025.

3022664294b4d20d28fc4f012092019a8ba3ee0f.en: An improv theatre cabaret at The Connemara Irish Pub, where themes and constraints are drawn from the audience. A host takes audience proposals and the performers improvise around them on the first floor.

36dff563b7331f369d9735152b2a38b4ac701841.en: St Paul & The Broken Bones, an eight-piece soul and funk band led by singer Paul Janeway, performs at Le Rocher de Palmer. The concert presents their self-titled sixth album, released in 2025.

f0924b40e53824075b52b3dc0277088b7db1e28c.en: A parent-child creative workshop at Hangar 14 on Wednesday 11 November 2026, 10:00-11:00, for ages 4 and up. Families make a small polar sky scene inspired by the northern lights, at Now Coworking, Hangar 15, quai des Chartrons.

98eceddd5a63db86d0ba8bca37c1ed45eb53d9d8.en: A creative workshop for children aged 3 to 6 at Coworking Now, H14, on Wednesday 11 November 2026, 11:15-12:00. Children hear a story about a northern lights and explore movement and rhythm through games. Lasts 45 minutes.

0f1b5ed7b332cd2d5e72b19b8bf205ddd9913da3.en: A treasure-hunt game in Bordeaux starting at the Grand-Théâtre, where teams follow a notebook to uncover a thief. Teams observe local heritage and neighbourhoods and solve quizzes and riddles, then reunite at the end to reveal the plot.

e71b2c4257e7ed58f0977b26ae92dfdae200b69f.en: Concert at Le Rocher de Palmer where several well-known musicians mix their styles, with percussion, guitars and interwoven harmonies. The show is presented as an energetic, collective take on familiar anthems.

39041c5c723dec23780eceef0c59eb3ac313603a.en: Samy Thiébault and pianist Émilie Aridon-Kociolek perform acoustic reworkings of Weather Report's repertoire at Le Rocher de Palmer, using tenor sax, alto flute and piano. Their album The Weather Acoustic came out in 2026.

6ea3e62519dc339c38815bd6bfcb3fc55ff5d53e.en: Comedy theatre show Previously at Sortie 13, in which Anna, at forty, revisits the female TV heroines of her youth, including Buffy, Monica Geller, Samantha Jones and Lorelai Gilmore. The audience judges the debate. Written by Dot Pierson and Nicolas Roux.

6867777c8e4bb1bae7975f600b867a44e9cd0204.en: Concert by Rosemary Standley and Dom La Nena at Le Carré in Colonnes, set in a forest clearing with magic by Etienne Saglio. They reinterpret songs by The Cure, Bronski Beat, The Doors, Barbara and Bobby Lapointe, plus Venetian and medieval airs.

46d67a7d9c0cbfc1c90580bcc5ddb1647bc4cbd2.en: A thematic meeting at La ManuCo on the pre- and post-natal period, open to discussion. It offers a space to share experiences, find information and talk about the period without taboo.

27338114c76af94a5c50cb71eda17876ef335e82.en: Opening of the project Quoi qu'il en soit at the CAPC, Bordeaux: a 60-day collaboration between artist Thomas Hirschhorn and director Fanny de Chaillé with the tnba school. Opening day on Thursday 12 November, free entry in the morning.

782975538056e463bb3e80c8a758abe2e7fa9cef.en: Guided tours of the Passions Collections display at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux, showing how a public collection grows and changes over a decade through artistic, cultural and heritage choices.

3dc1020b58adeec2a487adb26279ae8f9f8b962d.en: A session at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck on malware, introducing the main types such as viruses and Trojan horses. It is aimed at people who want to learn about the broad family of malicious software.

d4030c44fb0c4c0f0e1b11bbfc13761d19e2423a.en: Constantinople, a trio with setâr player Kiya Tabassian and percussionist Patrick Graham, performs with kora player Ablaye Cissoko at Le Rocher de Palmer. The concert is part of Rendez-vous avec les Afriques and presents the album Estuaire.

cea14e6ae7f76e73717c409ddef7f4dd5da15a8c.en: Opening evening of the Talence equality and diversity fortnight at the Forum des Arts et de la Culture. The ensemble Moultaqa Salam sings for peace and dialogue between cultures, with artists from several countries. Concert at 19:30.

f9df977e1af3ce792c494b0e0c4f5531e1d76196.en: A Thanksgiving-themed wine and food tasting at La Cité du Vin, in two sessions at 18:30 and 20:30. A Bordeaux chef prepares three bites with local seasonal produce, each paired with a wine and guided by a sommelier.

f4a6baab21fccb2076cffe5292f9ec3637508b89.en: A talk at the Musée des Arts décoratifs et du Design with Margaux Wymbs and Etienne Tornier on two Art Deco artists, Dupas and Buthaud. It looks at how they joined the movement and at their major works, in partnership with the Musée des Beaux-Arts.

f11e097bc380b646278633ed067ac3a6dcff2477.en: A talk at the Maison Saint-Louis-Beaulieu by historian Johanna Lehr on the persecution of Jews in France during the Second World War, based on State archives. She argues that the French state enforced its own administrative rules throughout the Occupation.

896af502eac3e049d5fcb6d3ba1d902dfa0bb39c.en: An autobiographical talk by Emmanuelle Ramon at the Glob Théâtre about living with generalised anxiety disorder. She personifies the disorder as a punk bird, speaking openly and without taboo.

a24508bb519a04be6febe482fd61180defce2edb.en: Concert by Zoufris Maracas at Le Rocher de Palmer, a band mixing rumba, gypsy swing and other sounds to sing about ecological and social issues. Their latest album, La course folle, came out in 2024.

ee98cfd9b8b3cfe0716eef724e915da5e7549148.en: Stand-up show Délicieux by David Castello-Lopes at Le Pin Galant, from a journalist and comedian known for work on Canal+, Arte and France Inter. The show explores what causes pleasure, with humour, satire and personal stories. It suits all ages.

9cd15339cb732e4557b983bedebc82c1e19f30e9.en: A short morning concert at the Marché des Douves in Bordeaux by students of the conservatoire, starting at 8:00. The programme pairs readings from Karim Kattan's Hortus Conclusus with Oriental music. Breakfast is offered afterwards.

a0e55b14fe890e6e6177133f2003f2ca2d5e118c.en: A talk at the Musée d'Aquitaine on the Faret moped, produced in Bordeaux in 1927, with Romain Wenz of the Centre national Jean Moulin. It looks at individual mobility and industrial production in the city.

d0bd3d42a4be70b0ec4372c0b2591d94726d1638.en: A beginner workshop on Canva at the Ludo-médiathèque, pôle Simone Veil, for making posters, cards, invitations and social media posts. Participants learn the basics of layout and make their first designs.

425c1e782481918e0d6690e0d0105788f692febf.en: A one-man show at Colonnes by Forbon N'Zakimuena, presented by Compagnie Mantrap, about being forced to drop the name Zola at age 13 during his naturalisation. Mixing storytelling, rap and beatmaking, it draws on young people born in France to foreign parents.

a01292e10878532777776ee6c86533f0690d5ee0.en: The Bliss Yoga Festival at Darwin Éco-système from 13 to 15 November 2026. The programme includes around 90 hours of activities, 50 speakers, live music, round tables, a yogi market with 50 exhibitors and a wellness corner.

e798d8d1886b23f82782e96e3da5e0db094ba6af.en: A talk at the Médiathèque Léopold Sédar Senghor in Carré des Jalles on Lou Reed's album Transformer. Produced by David Bowie and arranged by Mick Ronson, it is a landmark of glam rock and includes Walk on the Wild Side and A Perfect Day.

1d63efb7370bacc8dc9a74822aa0d2bd955a6351.en: A cut-and-paste workshop at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux, inspired by works from the permanent collections and by collage techniques. The Friday 13 November session focuses on the permanent collections.

74f45446e75b0d161c1708e4092c22d722921ce2.en: A monthly literary evening at the Médiathèque de Saint-Louis-de-Montferrand, where attendees bring their current reads and chat over a drink. The next session is Friday 13 November from 17:30 to 19:00.

c3b541523a4e0f6626243bb462deabbc90157159.en: A soul night at the Alcazar in Bordeaux by Lyris Music, with the Émilie Hédou Quartet covering songs by Nina Simone, Aretha Franklin, Janis Joplin and others. Two sessions are offered, 19:00-20:00 and 21:00-22:00.

2d312350f916c829789fe835d4eb9693b6823085.en: A tasting evening at La Cité du Vin with live music from singer Amandine, held with the Rock School Barbey. Four organic wines from Nouvelle-Aquitaine are commented on alongside cheese and charcuterie boards. Guests stand for the evening.

2ddac0c481c3452cb99191476f24fc9414dfba85.en: A Franco-Swiss poetry evening at the Halle des Douves, organised by the Maison de la poésie de Bordeaux. Four poets read contemporary texts on identity, memory and the intimate, with sound loops in one set.

a60d485f7c0a9da83f5a415d94f5e90168774833.en: A Halloween story session at the Bibliothèque François Mitterrand in Ambarès-et-Lagrave, where the librarians read tales of witches, monsters and creatures in costume. A snack is served afterwards, and children are invited to come dressed up.

6fd53f6f000079e46caee08f437c79698d24e8fc.en: A piano and multimedia show, The 24 Preludes by Pretor Part, at L'Impromptu, running 1h10 and open to all audiences. Pascal Pistone plays piano and Mathilde Chatin performs with multiple instruments, voice and dance, mixing sound and visuals.

3aae46d226df225423c787680d0e83591c756707.en: A staging of Nous, les héros by Jean-Luc Lagarce, directed by Wahid Chakib at Le Cuvier de Feydeau. Members of a travelling theatre company talk backstage after a bad show about money, relationships and dreams, around an engagement in the troupe.

a117edd9a14e3b4cd06d3e2ba7a1eb51fc59e17f.en: A concert by Paul Barreyre at Inox, a singer-songwriter from Grenoble who blends French chanson, jazz and Oriental music. His voice and rhythm form a personal style.

7adb20ab4722d805aeae3a6483d7cfb3371c87ee.en: A concert by Chelabôm at Sortie 13 on Friday 13 November 2026, with opening act Mauna la Nuit. Chelabôm is a Gironde pop-prog-groove group singing in French with jazz harmonies and syncopated rhythms. Doors at 19:30, concert at 20:30.

b8c31a373ad4e58ce6fb683e73011edbd359634f.en: A concert by Maëlle at Le Rocher de Palmer, a singer who first gained attention after winning the seventh season of The Voice France. Her songs Lilli and Tic tac preview a third album due in autumn 2026, with R&B touches.

b6daca48205ad5c2fc485f4735abbfff046cca3a.en: A concert by Camille at Le Rocher de Palmer presenting The Sound of Milk (2026), an album in three chapters on maternal bonds, nature and transmission. It mixes family sounds with experimental pop and started with the birth of her eldest son.

14a52b84e0c957b617f7913dbaf939acbe9caae7.en: A comedy show at Le Pin Galant with François Berléand and Max Boublil, two actors from different generations. Written by Laurent Ruquier, it reveals theatre superstitions, rules and anecdotes in a playful way.

6af6b519ddee7fc73140e4d14e0688dc7408e429.en: A concert at PULP in Bordeaux Saint-Michel, presented with L'Astrodøme, featuring Greyborn from Limoges playing heavy stoner rock and the release of their first album, Insoluble. Gliitch is also on the bill.

0bc3121a2ba7195e43cc20e03da586d6c30c7a87.en: A hardcore and hardstyle night at Hangar DS in Bordeaux on Friday 13 November 2026, from 00:00 to 06:30. The line-up includes Krowdexx, Noiseflow, F. Noize and Redlair. Minors under 16 are not admitted.

2b599763d34f6044c219b1b1d0f30ccfb84119c8.en: The student fair at the Palais des congrès in Bordeaux, held with the Académie de Bordeaux, covers three areas: arts and digital, grandes écoles, and health, social and sport. Visitors can talk to professionals, attend workshops and get advice on Parcoursup.

551256eef4f078a53d9226e0d72c769b8572ae3e.en: Writing and photography workshops for secondary school pupils in Le Bouscat on equality, respect and living together. Their works are shown in public spaces from 14 to 29 November 2026. Workshops run from 29 September to 29 November.

54594f84626109680989711720e5e9876e604034.en: A workshop for children on how we eat and why food matters. Through pictures, games and discovery, it explains where food comes from and how to build a varied, balanced plate.

03762c1f7d98d4a18de63ee86aad251633b9e334.en: A collective reading session of Oyinkan Braithwaite's novel Filles maudites, held before her talk on Thursday 19 November. Each participant reads part of the book and reports back to the group.

8b8de6d2f73f3acce11bd9b59c20caba3e367e47.en: Presentation of a study on discrimination experienced by Bordeaux residents, based on 1,554 responses, interviews and focus groups. It was carried out by sociologists Johanna Dagorn and Arnaud Alessandrin, followed by an open discussion.

ccf991e60465508737486f56b853ff8bf96a9df2.en: A storytelling session for young children at the Médiathèque Castagnéra, with tales of a crocodile looking for his glasses and a princess who will not wait for her prince. It aims to encourage a love of books.

60ace84f38a4f2768350e3b687bdfd011da69428.en: A guided sitting meditation in the Bourgailh forest in Pessac, focused on breathing and the present moment. Participants bring a floor mat and a thick cushion, and minors should be accompanied by an adult. Booking is required.
