72a642ace27ea35468a79d14acb41379052b85a1.en: A walking tour of Bacalan with the Alternative Urbaine Bordeaux, combined with photographs by Christophe Goussard shown at the Kfé des Familles during the equality fortnight.

41c6d9d679b3634b51bc81134896bad033c9e58e.en: Part of the Lettres du monde festival, with a conversation with novelist Colum McCann led by a bookseller at La Machine à Lire on Saturday 14 November at 10:00.

1d354dcdeb652d14d26249590b5d427bbb2869d7.en: An exhibition at the Bains de Bègles swimming pool that presents portraits and testimonies of people starting physical activity, showing that movement can bring confidence, autonomy and well-being.

3fc0ffaca09927c2724e232cf07dd8c726cfc006.en: Short stories told with food-related ingredients for ages 3 to 8, with humour and a message about sharing and conviviality. The show lasts 40 minutes.

776a1e7ba5adbb11e196659726aaf4d2fe2a36b5.en: The Donneurs de Voix / Bibliothèque Sonore de Bordeaux presents its work recording school texts for pupils with dys disorders. The session includes reading aloud, a recording demo and an open workshop to try recording audio.

94841c991ab8beee42760982e57e7ba7cbaa0646.en: A theatre-based story about Harry, an organic bean who grows up among pesticide-covered produce and sets out to learn where he comes from. He discovers the hidden side of the food industry.

6f8506e47b39e80360c45a4a00c40d8edfcec554.en: A storytelling show for children aged 3 to 8 with humorous tales that stress conviviality and sharing. The show is presented at the municipal media library.

a2ee8393f18d104311fcc794d33bcd1f0a61a556.en: A sound creation workshop at the Bibliothèque La Bastide, based on fanzines made by residents of a Cenon care home. It is led by sound author Roman Facerias-Lacoste and is open to registration by phone.

c8df2ac0ba82fdb58a4b06f4bab3f4ca96a258d5.en: Reading clubs at the Médiathèque Castagnéra where members discuss a shared selection of books. This year adds a comic book club, 'Causons BD', alongside the novel and crime fiction clubs.

894b1d2dd57b9d7712f6d6a37c478e3d2a15e123.en: A screening of short films from La Chambre Noire, a Mérignac association that has made over 50 shorts since 2010, followed by a meeting with its team. Free entry on Saturday 14 November at 11:00.

d3cb67624bf9e3223eeef80d069b6a6f10bacab4.en: Part of the 23rd Lettres du monde festival, themed Vacarme(s), with Palestinian writer Karim Kattan, born in Jerusalem in 1989. He discusses his work and his new novel Septentrionale, published in autumn 2026.

1ae9a395058f4329fb0aa59750e455079fef75e9.en: A workshop at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux where participants recreate a museum artwork of their choice in acrylic paint.

7b5a3336c27997da712b4ba13647008918f8ad42.en: A short presentation on the Saint-Genès neighbourhood in Bordeaux, known for its grand town houses and mansions alongside more modest but notable architecture. Based on the Maison Saint-Louis-Beaulieu agenda.

fc6a90e29f90d3f5e029303e4221c5c2d784b9ab.en: A monthly concert at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul in Pessac with singer-songwriter Alexis HK, who has worked in French chanson for 25 years and was named a 'Révélation Scène' at the Victoires de la musique in 2012.

eb5a48e7de8b3974a1e2839860ace36546f15af9.en: A marathon pass of three films by Philippe Katerine at Musical Écran, held at the Megarama in Bordeaux on Saturday 14 November. Katerine and members of Little Rabbits attend, with a Q&A after each screening. Three sessions cost 20 euros.

0dbd6762662a9868918ed060c9de08e3846d27e8.en: A guided visit at the Galerie des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux on Art Deco in the Jean Dupas & Co. exhibition. The visit is fully booked, and the exhibition runs from 26 June to 29 November 2026.

712a08ab64b66f4e6e09c4356c4f311841771e69.en: A games afternoon at the Ludo-médiathèque, pôle Simone Veil, with a selection of games spotted at the 2026 Vichy international game festival and the team's end-of-year favourites.

1a6b3cdd9fc9809ed606f0b8733f855df09cb731.en: A walking tour led by Bordeaux Patrimoine Mondial through Art Deco architecture in Bordeaux between the wars. It is held as part of the Jean Dupas & Co. exhibition.

8865aaf117c255e910a3891dc97cc59cccb6dcfa.en: A workshop at Maison écocitoyenne on making a worm composter, which turns kitchen waste into fertiliser for plants. It works indoors or on a balcony and is run with the association Au Ras Du Sol.

9eb518345650cf5c7b8b2f3289e1e4de57d9f0f2.en: A screening at Les Colonnes of a film about the smallest school in France, in the hamlet of La Gurraz in Haute Tarentaise, with eight pupils from nursery to CM2. The film follows the school year, its single teacher and the families.

3b5ddd5390a8945f17485f18ec068e16fc4d8555.en: A walk in the market gardens of the Parc des Jalles in Eysines, to recognise wild plants and their links with crops. It covers local farming history and the issues of intensive agriculture and food.

35795c49c8911013e8e8a2918d474f911dbe44db.en: A reading club at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul called C.L.A.N., where young readers share books and discover new titles together.

c968b7b4e5ebae418718e563dadb9903b1c1a37e.en: A collective fanzine workshop at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck with the association Disparate, in which participants cut and glue photo fragments from books and magazines. The creations are bound into one fanzine.

466038feda9bca224edc1a2650eed161f0ddb66c.en: A session at the Musée d'Aquitaine with the Printemps décolonial collective on everyday racism. It includes a documentary screening, a forum theatre workshop, and an evening digital art exhibition and talk at the Halle des Douves.

daeb8210eb4e5e9ee07f63f39dbce6c02bc5d17d.en: A free-movement space for babies and children under 3 with their parents, supervised by a child psychomotor therapist. It runs on Saturday afternoons from 15:30 to 17:30 on set dates, with no registration and limited places.

9681a944ce226123e97fcb5bb27ee4d72da5da7e.en: Creative workshops for teenagers and adults at the Médiathèque Castagnéra, covering drawing, crafts and making things. Materials are provided, and participants come to try, have fun and make something.

477672682f1c3b144ec7767ae59ab213dc53e0e4.en: A poetry workshop at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck for ages 7 and up, led by author Bernard Friot, who shares his writing methods. It is held during the DYS awareness month and requires booking.

26299a2d30d5f7473073fc5f0a696b28cc2cea5c.en: A round table at La ManuCo on why ageing is seen as a flaw for women, with comic artist Lucie Albrecht. It runs from 16:00 to 18:00 as an open discussion about youth norms and how we view time passing.

f968a5544fe7846db6b3fe621725dea3e8eb9fc6.en: A musical story for children aged 0 to 4 at the Bibliothèque La Bastide, by Betty Blues. It follows a pregnancy and birth, lasts 25 minutes, and includes a sharing time after the show.

4dad6d89f48d1f5789cc504e82cb4c763b244d88.en: A circus evening at the Ecole de Cirque de Bordeaux with discovery workshops from 17:00 to 18:45, an aperitif at 19:00 and the show Parade at 20:00, performed by the school's students.

85d84cccf6db17cb634d3e5116be332e176ac169.en: A talk on luxury French transatlantic liners of the 1930s, held at the Musée Mer Marine with French Lines and the Art Deco cycle. Speakers include curator Margaux Wymbs and auctioneer Éric Lacombe.

307947f4fae3e6f0367b126cc97803c8e4883cf6.en: A selection of feminist books with a signing session at La ManuCo on Saturday 14 November from 18:00 to 19:00. Visitors can meet the authors and leave with a signed copy.

d8836ac8f79c5b2a57e6ca13f84f0d7b8f4e154c.en: A literary meeting at the Bibliothèque des Capucins as part of the Lettres du monde festival, with Karim Kattan in conversation with journalist Henry Clemens on Saturday 14 November at 18:00.

86a2b88da1e03f0d3c5899f747886fb2a2056f6f.en: A meeting with Palestinian writer Karim Kattan, born in Jerusalem in 1989, about his novel Septentrionale, a road novel set over one night in a country at war. A musical accompaniment and a book signing follow.

5e45993f5bdfe0d1eee102a85304463f361d9cfe.en: A recital by tenor Pene Pati at the Grand-Théâtre, presenting his album Serenata a Napoli (2025). The programme is a set of Neapolitan songs, divided into daytime and night-time groups.

5bee8b7bd9128458d51d2d143c4c52c362c4c5be.en: A concert by The Shadows, a recital by Gilnaz Yousefian and Saina Zamanian drawing on Persian musical traditions, held at the Médiathèque Léopold Sédar Senghor in Carré des Jalles as part of Scène nationale Carré-Colonnes.

528670a24a96592f13f774d9c9e7a1d479e238bb.en: A jazz concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux by Tyreek McDole, a young American baritone singer of Haitian origin. He won the Sarah Vaughan vocal jazz competition and presents his second album, which is still to be released.

3479468b08c2ccf49b79aad22105eaeb8b07eb75.en: A concert by Benjamin Biolay at Le Pin Galant, after his acoustic tour last season. This electric version reworks songs from his album Disque bleu in a different staging.

59ef2a9c264e405b2eba439fc9e27d6b3860c557.en: A tribute night at the Salle des Fêtes du Grand Parc on Saturday 14 November 2026, with three tribute bands to Slipknot, Linkin Park and KoRn. Doors open at 20:00, and tickets cost 21 euros plus booking fees.

66878ef1692dc7728b068718cf5d148b69eb6dc9.en: A concert at the Rock School Barbey by Marcus Gad, a singer from New Caledonia touring with his new album and his band Tribe. His reggae and world music is presented as part of a new show.

fcbf3fb624ded6b8606ce11b0c2296e484ebad2f.en: A 10th anniversary night at Mac3 in Pessac on Saturday 14 November from 20:00 to 01:00, with the inauguration of the group's eight bass cabinets. Guest sound systems and DJs play, with a hot-dog stand and presale tickets at 8 euros.

35326b4b2a676e1e07c70ca2708b0f401c6d672e.en: A tribute concert at the Salle des Fêtes du Grand Parc, Bordeaux, featuring Slipknot, Linkin Park and KoRn tribute bands on Saturday 14 November 2026. Doors open at 20:00 and tickets are 21 euros plus booking fees.

0058448ab36a944e7afe87ea81b6d4ff6007cb87.en: A feminist lotto at La ManuCo on Saturday 14 November from 20:00 to 22:00, with prizes that highlight women authors, creators and feminist initiatives. The evening continues with a guinguette.

e8207f197eceb5b7ddfe1c3355f2bd9b563f0c92.en: A concert by Chassol at Le Rocher de Palmer presenting his fifth album, Funny How?, made from interviews and recordings of American stand-up comics. It is performed with singer Ala.Ni, choirs and video projections.

f794f997576b61dd03dd426671d5cc28abc8aedc.en: A concert by Les Ignobles du Bordelais and guests at Le Rocher de Palmer, a seven-piece band formed in 1986 known for comic rock and audience participation. The evening marks their 40 years together.

9883e9b662bdaece9812f246c2a5547deb2837b4.en: A concert by singer Luiza at the Krakatoa in Bordeaux, mixing reggae and pop with a clear voice and songs about freedom.

86c31333e07ecf63752f98941d3d586509459d6f.en: A concert by Daguerre at Inox, a songwriter who writes free and independent chanson, with Nova Sauvageonne as the support act.

d2210df87217819fccb255696aedb1d54d990d06.en: A one-hour live-filmed silent film at L'Impromptu about Louis Le Prince, who may have invented the cinematograph before the Lumière brothers. Actors film in the city while a pianist accompanies the screening.

0de6b259732e97d79c89e456b893e32a113b5fae.en: A tennis match at the Villa Primrose in Bordeaux, where the women's team plays in PRO B for the first time. Home matches are on Sunday 15 November from 11:00 and Wednesday 2 December from 13:00, free to watch.

64c1fed8069883f351d64b4990d38832e4bdf519.en: A memory walk through Bordeaux on the traces of slavery, with a Guadeloupean vocal percussion called Bouladjel. A workshop at the museum at 14:00 precedes the walk at 15:30, and registration is required.

14cddf4fd883c38c131af33dc2f64d9f4d5400b1.en: A visit to the Bacalan and Bassins à flot districts of Bordeaux, which are being transformed while keeping traces of their industrial past. Based on the Musée d'Aquitaine programme.

a22c53a3ded137c44a46328a5d974d8160143e64.en: An art workshop at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul in Pessac on creating joy through body, image, writing and painting. It is created with the show Y'a de la joie and requires booking.

05129ba00bfc9666109989cc4f726e98d802532c.en: A stage reading by Laurent Gaudé with illustrator Alfred, who draws live pages during the reading of their adaptation about Alexander the Great's death. It is part of the Lettres du monde festival.

e19e90e5c08f34e997be77d9dd32086be7b2a280.en: An unusual fashion show at the EHPAD Terre Nègre, a participatory art project on movement and textiles, created by Compagnie Entresols with residents of a day centre and volunteers aged 18 to 80.

89fef3c6808ec03bc78d456930fd1336953b8690.en: A concert by the post-punk band Dry Cleaning at the Rock School Barbey, led by singer Florence Shaw's spoken-word vocals. Their latest album, Secret Love (2026), was produced by Cate Le Bon.

1a83414a3d1ba1f77afcff31799701790f8f6f76.en: A stand-up show by Redouane Bougheraba at the Arkea Arena, with new anecdotes about his career, his background and his encounters, delivered with improvisation.

a0aaf0558c1df46f707aeabd5107a54b9d27c3d0.en: A France-Turkey football match at the Stade Atlantique on 15 November 2026, the last group-stage game of the 2026-2027 Nations League. Tickets are yet to go on sale; the stadium holds over 42,000 people.

944b67659fdf1745f0b12a9a343e889dd5d76152.en: An introduction to industrial welding at the Afpa Bordeaux Bègles technical workshop, during the Gironde industry week. Visitors see the trades and training, and try TIG, MAG and manual arc welding.

2aaac52e72cba3375bd9130d362879e7b58d1bc2.en: A workshop at the Afpa Bordeaux Bègles site in the Gironde industry week, where participants build a dispenser as part of an introduction to industrial boilermaking.

e1800b823dc607c0e7114d9f72581a12eefaad6d.en: A photo exhibition by SOS Méditerranée at the Maison des associations in Lormont, showing images by about ten photographers on board the Aquarius and Ocean Viking, from 23 November 2026 to 28 February 2027.

9eff40afec49321af8029667f081fb120f0f0c5d.en: A workshop at the Afpa composite centre during the Gironde industry week, with an introduction to making a high-performance composite part. It includes a presentation of the training and the work.

6aa9185d85e93c4372e7e9b1db9a38a36f248038.en: An exhibition of portraits of residents made by people from Floirac at the Centre social Unire, from 14 to 29 November 2026, on living together better.

bd64b52ff614f40d752d439e4707375eb5e83111.en: An introduction to reading technical drawings at Afpa Bordeaux Bègles during the Gironde industry week, using a real part as an exercise.

51632baf9e68f55b336dbc0a2d7de66849979572.en: An introduction to industrial maintenance at Afpa Bordeaux Bègles during the Gironde industry week, covering how electrical systems work. Includes a presentation of the training.

2d5ba481c01bfacacfb3cf71f9cc3c08945795d3.en: A morning event at the Pessac employment agency on discovering industry through gaming, as part of the 2026 Coup de Boost vers l'emploi programme.

a1283b77120592d60b7e05a889cdbdc3a95e1c67.en: A commercial and industrial refrigeration workshop at Afpa Bordeaux Bègles during the Gironde industry week, where participants place refrigeration equipment on a model and shape tubes.

c3f6b69d21ccea7a5c5e67a78a5ffc9ccc2f81a7.en: Two-stage green waste shredding at the skatepark car park. Residents bring branches up to 8 cm across, which are shredded later, and can collect mulch on Saturday 28 November between 9:30 and 14:00.

c88d3858f82d0e808cc899067366ec6dc8ed48e8.en: An exhibition by ten women survivors of intimate partner violence from a CIDFF support group, presenting a collective dictionary of words they chose and illustrated. It aims to help the public understand how abusive relationships work.

42cd08c1db15e3fdf61fe46eac02e9fe8ecf1fc5.en: A week on children's rights at the Centre social et culturel de la Châtaigneraie in Pessac, with exhibitions, workshops, art installations, a show and school visits, closing with a buffet by Les Cheffes nomades.

192b027e432aa6024c102131100d810368480231.en: An installation at the Dôme in Talence about the incest taboo and sexual violence against children, based on figures from the CIIVISE and a reworking of Peau d'Âne by the R.O.G.E.R. company.

166ee9e25deac9e03236bf6d4b05c35016c698fc.en: A reading workshop at the Maison des habitants d'Arlac on stories that challenge traditional gender roles, to raise awareness of equality between girls and boys and help choose inclusive picture books.

6d50da618f32977186b62ac80dcd14acce487f8a.en: An introduction to repairing household appliances at Afpa Bordeaux Bègles during the Gironde industry week, using the example of a heat-pump tumble dryer.

4594add8cc8c0b3896290b555a6ad65f9f6d76bc.en: A participatory activity at the social centre in Pessac on discrimination, with a mural and discussions about real situations in jobs, housing, education, health and public services. A street artist will paint a mural with participants.

7e5e90956e632d3f2e716f0d7bcd4bbd686a0f69.en: An introduction to aeronautics assembly at Afpa Bordeaux Bègles during the Gironde industry week, where participants rivet a keyring with the Afpa logo.

f6ced25e36e9529a3ae06f42980c37a8b3b33fc6.en: An introduction to the Forindustrie platform, an immersive game that lets people explore industry careers and sectors in a virtual world and find placements in companies.

e9381368e695627a3127753d8e8a5530f76d143d.en: A participatory exhibition at the Maison des habitants d'Arlac on how household tasks are shared between family members, to talk about family organisation and mental load.

e67e3775d82d973f5060936167c5ab97c5828b1b.en: A practical computer workshop at Sésame on organising files and folders, and finding documents and photos when needed.

d9e15889bcb6902415513cdd0f6650e91a1c9722.en: A forum for jobseekers with disabilities at La Sablière in Le Haillan, during the European week for the employment of people with disabilities. Stands include mock interviews, virtual reality and sign language interpreting.

607cc6e7065bb5ba90f78a03c2739efb9603bca1.en: A programme of awareness talks on psychiatry from the French hospital federation, which gives the floor to seven people affected by mental health conditions in sensitive portraits.

8fca6f43ba3336d849410e77bc63d4be3637378d.en: A Yin Yoga session on Monday 16 November from 19:00 to 21:00 at the AGJA in Bordeaux, with floor postures held for several minutes. It costs 20 euros per session and no performance is required.

b09fe3a8ed5acde7d3ed4586e2a98a2eb300139e.en: A theatre show by three women whose lives were marked by prison, based on real testimonies about before, inside and after detention, at the Halle des Chartrons.

d7b2102efef845352a47d5e5efc2edf38f4bf43d.en: A jazz concert on Monday 16 November at 21:00 at Sortie 13, with drummer and composer Archibald Ligonnière and his quintet, presenting his first album as leader, A New Home.

fc8f021cf9e4a86bf49628f538bb22077c54bfcf.en: A week on children's rights at the Centre social et culturel de la Châtaigneraie, with exhibitions, workshops, art installations, a show and school visits for local schools and families.

174e602d244d73cb2ff980906e7095ac3501d58f.en: An introduction to industrial boilermaking at Afpa Bordeaux Bègles during the Gironde industry week, where participants make a dispenser and fold metal parts. Includes a presentation of the training.

b9d5b3d1d4972120dba352fc0d4c73f5e0b9d39b.en: Conferences and visits of intergenerational housing schemes during the intergenerational housing week, held on 17 November 2026 at the Bordeaux Métropole town hall. Round tables cover demographic change, housing trends and inclusive housing.

a68c4bd014c6abc45a4d82c612d97d2586c6aeab.en: A parent and child yoga and relaxation workshop at the Maison de l'enfant et des parents, for ages 0 to 3 on 17 and 24 November and ages 4 to 8 on 18 and 25 November.

4df5044653a741e9b41d317f329e5a1f4683b878.en: A retrospective and discussion at the Mérignac cinema by the Hand to Hand dance association, with dancers with and without disabilities answering questions on inclusion in dance on 17 November.

18f4f23da8ed9e19a31704550633cdf231e865b0.en: An online session for jobseekers and career changers with a live visit to an EDF power plant, led by a professional who explains the sector's jobs and answers questions.

85c8d6977042a70f675e7aedddc5b6de479c2dfb.en: Cooking, storytelling and sport workshops at Epi'cez tout in Pessac, with a meal on 25 November focused on sexist and sexual violence. Organised by EPISOL Pessac with several local partners.

247767db3208dbe1e81940c104dd8bd2edcd5064.en: A display of eight portraits of women from around the world who played a major role in science, at the Bibliothèque du Haillan, made with Cap sciences.

d3e6d57a28e539a9ae7a767e955a9fc93bc284c3.en: A job-support session at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck, where people register on site at the library's news area.

af42a35bfea42294ebdca69dd002eb1764286d56.en: A practical internet workshop at the Ludo-médiathèque, pôle Simone Veil, on using a browser, searching for information, opening several pages and recognising parts of a website.

b2a294b1d917e45f035b2e3721b45bc278885e46.en: A visual magic show, Goupil et Kosmao by Étienne Saglio at Colonnes, with a fox that takes over the magician's tricks. The performance is silent and set to a film-style soundtrack.

242dba60b7f2125194009818e1d39b33971fd7e2.en: A gentle seated pilates class for seniors at the Ludo-médiathèque, pôle Simone Veil, improving balance, flexibility and posture.

40833e4bd64e45284e4f1c47c8a5bc619ad6ba2f.en: A talk at the Résidence Autonomie Magendie on the life and work of philosopher Saint Augustine, with a discussion of time, memory and eternity.

750d549beb48072420bf9dd02b4f193f6eaee390.en: A round table at the Musée d'Aquitaine on the restoration of the Flèche Saint-Michel, which reopened in spring after four years of work. Scientists and project managers explain the investigation into the cracks.

180abd109c2389afa0ccf0e8265c82e8ec35c998.en: Drawing workshops for children with Nanastar at Les Yvette in Bordeaux, covering the basics of drawing, characters and animals, emotions, colour, mixed media and illustrated scenes. No prior level is needed.

58e61040b5833ccf804e6b6cb83dbc73e14756ec.en: A creative writing workshop at La ManuCo with guided exercises that explore different ways of writing and looking at the world.

4744b71999970b2a408ffe87ef32f3946256b5d8.en: A talk by Pierre Bernard of Mémoire et Patrimoine de Talence on a Spanish refugee family and the camp in Talence, where a girl of 11 arrived in August 1937 after fleeing Franco's bombing.

ea16eea3b3dfe42b3b1aca5d0935deb22d4ecd96.en: A meeting with author Estelle-Sarah Bulle, moderated by literary adviser Martine Laval, at the Librairie Le Passeur, as part of the Lettres du monde festival.

e184cfaab6a4052980951016489f2c0e79390fe0.en: A cinema debate at Mérignac for the equality fortnight, with the film Bombonera and a discussion on gender equality, solidarity and respect for differences, organised by Léo Pour Le Monde.

b16403f2fcfaab744f114c87414a4381a1f7eeda.en: A one-man show by Sapritch at Le Rocher de Palmer, in which he opens his record collection and links blues to contemporary hits. He asks whether a machine can understand what drives someone to create.

46cb947f5742425a730e5f146fc69b0af95f7589.en: A piano recital by Elisabeth Leonskaja at the Auditorium de Bordeaux as part of the L'Esprit du piano festival, playing Beethoven, Shostakovich and Schubert.

d007d94b8542c485eeb12ca3481a227213d74319.en: A theatre improv cabaret at Salle du Mascaret, where the audience proposes themes on equality, diversity and the fight against discrimination, and the actors improvise on them.

d253546eba2bd36382fb4d67d28431813b6e9d6d.en: A solo show by Renaud Cojo at the Glob Théâtre about fascination with pop singer Dua Lipa, mixing video, live music and audience participation.

8910aa9f4de72e2e2eb6f1819d818177c27e9eab.en: A stand-up show by Jérôme Commandeur at the Théâtre Trianon, presented with Beretta and Little Bros. Productions.

3b91669436f9997071c545bb3da04af74c13dde1.en: A concert series at Le Pas de Lune by the jazz and contemporary music department of the conservatoire. Four groups explore jazz and popular music, with five concert dates in the 2026-2027 season.

287b99ce1406a2dba443f3107ca24f401b7501ec.en: A concert by Hiba Tawaji with her husband, trumpeter Ibrahim Maalouf, performing French chanson classics with arrangements by Maalouf that mix classical, jazz, pop and Oriental sounds.

8a761964743f43f82f24f0bfe5a955a98a8ced31.en: A film debate at the Cinéma L'Étoile in Saint-Médard-en-Jalles on Tuesday 17 November at 20:00, showing Une femme du monde (2021), followed by an exchange with a coordinator from Poppy, a support service for people in prostitution.

fe88d1f7f3e95fe973d47089f7f9cd4a86364eda.en: Théâtre de la compagnie Shieveh Theater at Le Carré, adapted from three real stories. The show draws links with Oedipus, Antigone and Medea and addresses exile, war and resistance.

5fb41534d0d227cf1958fcf1c7e179c3349eaef0.en: A metalwork workshop at Afpa Bordeaux Bègles during the Gironde industry week, where participants make a dispenser and bend metal parts. Includes a presentation of the training.

e2803be964a03bf5d28be4f76edb410cced7c5cd.en: Free home composting bins and bioseaux from Bordeaux Métropole, with short training sessions. Residents register to receive the equipment; about 68,000 households already have it. Distribution takes place at the Romane church car park.

55b8654e77dbfb065ec400c7e4c66ddf40b0f06e.en: A two-stage green waste shredding service at the Domaine du Grand Darnal. Residents bring branches up to 8 cm across, which are shredded later, and can collect mulch on Saturday 28 November from 11:00 to 13:00.

8efe9a6b3e4a7297b8aab12053e2de677a5926a1.en: A casual coffee meeting at the Maison de l'Industrie in Bruges with the temp agency ACIER, to learn about local industry jobs. Attendees bring a CV and talk with recruiters.

f55d7b8841a945929248504fb98546bb334a6d9d.en: A training course on how to set up an intergenerational housing project, covering the legal framework, financing, programming and methods. It is aimed at developers, social landlords, local authorities, CCAS and associations.

b9029782cb62b9b34af093f51271cabcf2133932.en: A free day for children and adults at the Salle Son Tay in Bordeaux, part of the 2026 equality fortnight. Workshops, games and a photo booth explore diversity, gender and appearance, with a snack.

bd0b13bdcd0486b7dd8fdad0dce30a775bedc135.en: A workshop for retirees and people near retirement on housing and later-life moves, with four interactive sessions on personal housing history, future needs and ideal homes. Each participant takes home a booklet.

5e109634d07c9e42d516462883894ee7f996e80f.en: A winter wooden Christmas frame workshop at the Ludo-médiathèque, pôle Simone Veil. Participants design a drawing, then cut it with a laser at the FabLab Copernic in a second session.

d6768ff24e81dd8b4ef758669a05bd06698fe530.en: A detective and writing workshop for children aged 7 to 10 at Coworking Now, H14, on Wednesday 18 November 2026 from 10:30 to 11:30. Children look for clues about a polar bear named Nanuq.

5239eeeaed42713ae04104cfc42153a07c75602d.en: A musical session for toddlers at the Bibliothèque Capucins/Saint-Michel with musician Léa Frouté, focused on early discovery through books and music.

42feb8cb14652659951943bab857c7d2983a32f9.en: A puppet and storytelling workshop for children and families at the Centre Social Bordeaux Nord, exploring prejudice and difference with a playful approach to equal relationships.

c579bbaeb3c4ec69ed6bf34173a920ce68930099.en: A sound creation broadcast at the Bibliothèque La Bastide on Wednesday 18 November at 10:30. It presents audio made from fanzine extracts by residents of the Cypressat care home, with readings by the Donneurs de voix. Free for adults.

fbc4b5c83f9d477d7f677ffa41d57cbe53d62ba8.en: A festive day at the Hangar Bouthier on age and difference, with testimonies, forum theatre, textile creations and videos that build a participatory exhibition across generations.

b2717753ae6b2505a861030b113d6825ab1bfd7c.en: A two-half-day thematic conference on biostimulants at Bordeaux Sciences Agro, on 18 and 19 November 2026. It covers regulation, biological mechanisms and field results, with oral talks and posters.

dec67be4ded4757e90e145c138091c17ed94aff8.en: The Interclubs PRO A men's tennis championship at Villa Primrose, with home matches on 18, 21 and 28 November. Each match has six games, and the stands are open to the public.

42ade28c5c68447921b1c5c8ea28e88338dcdf50.en: A citizenship event in the Champ de Course district, with a resident talk collection, an exhibition, an interactive StéréoCube on stereotypes and a closing citizen café, run by Le Carrousel.

99bca020d99904e1bd79ca316b3f0bb8d71b340a.en: A café-philo at the Maison des habitants d'Arlac that asks whether mental load really exists, by discussing the invisible work of thinking, anticipating and organising.

dac8e7eb1358442624075e2f7ceb34046dc313e1.en: A participatory workshop at the Maison des associations on inclusion, with testimonies and group discussion to build empathy and plan concrete actions. Organised by Activ'Action.

e45ca3c562ccb0d847f979ba876aa49dad0e2280.en: A monthly Warhammer workshop at the Ludo-médiathèque, pôle Simone Veil, covering miniature painting, rules of the board game and the story world. Figures and paint are provided.

c22433820e96017ce2342a890ac17caee7887a14.en: A teachers' visit at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux, presenting the permanent collections and temporary exhibitions around a theme. The next session on 25 November covers painting and music.

b1bba24d093bdcadd779ab51b86241b1dd791fad.en: Free career support at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck from ACT, an association of 50 volunteer advisers with recruitment or management experience. They offer job interview practice and CV advice.

b8d90e874a1d87abfae309ff0bac12196c10e0b7.en: A children's show from age 6 in Sadirac, with spooky tales for young audiences.

67649d9ed08a13f42a9f5d2993dc247d9b1e7505.en: Weekly game sessions at the Médiathèque Castagnéra on Wednesdays, where a ludothécaire helps visitors discover games on site.

27a5091c1f272bab3d4dfd4178d4d9cbc96952e9.en: A play at the Salle de la Glacière by Pin Vert Compagnie from Mérignac, co-written and directed by its two authors. A bestselling novelist's quiet village life is upended by a young actress and a bonsai she tends.

c97b6f251902477b38e773de27c06af927df0299.en: A cooking, storytelling and sports event at Place Joliot Curie, meant to encourage everyday action for equality.

64daf8f96e2296df95a9228a0c0b9328bd4dca6a.en: A winter gardening workshop at La ManuCo, planting garlic, mint cuttings and radishes. Open to everyone, including beginners.

471acfccdfb4ce875c0577deda323d718bde839e.en: A poster-making workshop at the Galerie des Beaux-Arts in Bordeaux, following a short Art Deco visit. Participants explore Art Deco shapes, colours and lettering.

8537cd7887a274d27bfbfb93ec4c2d8d5b675545.en: A walk to find mosses and lichens near Blanquefort, using magnifying glasses and maps. The walk is a participatory science activity and covers how lichens help measure air quality.

df461c6a3ec20e45da19f4e1d1e75018d6f33373.en: A philosophy workshop by Léo Pour Le Monde at the Médiathèque Michel-Sainte-Marie in Mérignac, for children and adults, on citizenship, cultural diversity, mutual respect and social cohesion.

de30b9ab1426f463e78c71e240d80bb7f1795dab.en: A workshop at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul where participants draw an imaginary city map, starting from a real plan and adding fantasy places. Booking is required.

065668d5181e1bbb0a7b30457a85787021cf9762.en: A science workshop at the Médiathèque Castagnéra combining film and hands-on investigation, to help children build curiosity and critical thinking.

bb3deb643fb08ec5eb48fa0d069504b6c2fe8509.en: A card-making session at the Médiathèque Carré des Jalles for the holidays. Participants make postcards for residents of the local care home, senior residence and senior village.

ab5d62ce7bec7b20b8e5be01816af9d195117321.en: A Scratch coding session at the Médiathèque Carré des Jalles for people who know the basics. It includes new tricks, programming challenges and creative projects.

db3426d1cd89ab05a4529edaea3a9b1625de832b.en: An immersive board game at the social centre library that adapts Monopoly to show how discrimination and hardship affect people's chances. Players make choices on health, food and relationships, which affect their character.

adcbdc53f08248f606f45076ff225d8cecb178b1.en: A show by Talence's children's council with the company Mr. Patate at the Gymnase Pierre de Coubertin. It plays with prejudice about disability and invites the audience to look at it with fresh eyes, with humour and emotion.

15cf0ba4cad1cc5c5ab7853c5c062927095aea2f.en: A blindfolded musical theatre show by Compagnie Noctilunes at the Archives de Bordeaux Métropole, on 18, 19, 24 and 26 November. Up to 15 people go through the building at once, and it lasts 45 minutes.

79ae5bfd6c0aae35d52842b63b61b1e6b70e4654.en: The same blindfolded show by Compagnie Noctilunes, presented at the Archives de Bordeaux Métropole. The audience moves through the building with the architecture, acoustics and history shaping the piece, and it lasts 45 minutes.

24e3c719edb9714d97c7da2462190dfdb4fa28d7.en: A meeting at the Bibliothèque Grand Parc with Bulgarian author Eminé Sadk, of Turkish origin, about her first novel Caravane pour corbeaux (Agullo, 2026), which touches on forced assimilation of Turkish and Roma minorities. A book signing follows.

4843a24d61c49b27a8b87892bf929eb8c28c2b79.en: An exhibition of collective street art by young people from the MIX'ART workshops, shown at the Pass'âge youth space to highlight their work.

197e574d2954c57dfd19009541aeea99f846be62.en: A meeting with Juan Gabriel Vásquez, moderated by bookseller Pierre Coutelle, at the Station Ausone and Librairie Mollat on Wednesday 18 November at 18:00, as part of the Lettres du monde festival.

a4f2601136deb35e5eb6dd94d0e66b9c5cb3d893.en: A meeting with Eminé Sadk, moderated by journalist and filmmaker Sonia Moumen, at the Bibliothèque Grand Parc on Wednesday 18 November at 18:00, as part of the Lettres du monde festival.

7b6d861f02385ef62b74150e8a5334e7a689fe71.en: A masterclass with Étienne Jaumet of Zombie Zombie at L'Inconnue on modular synthesisers, covering how they work and what they can do, with demonstrations and experiments.

42a63dbcd78e5877651719b4f3f3b9e4f2629131.en: A monthly knitting and crochet evening at Les Yvette in Bordeaux, led by Valérie. Participants bring their own projects, and the aperitif is provided.

4b939895e856165682b939615b933df368172fe1.en: Two weeks of exhibitions and presentations at the Pass'âge in Pessac, with photographs, podcasts, videos, a concert and a fashion show. The works come from participatory projects with residents of Saige and Arago-Châtaigneraie.

537e3166e2bff700d109ed4b8467f22f72e10db5.en: Presentation of two participatory art projects in Pessac, J'HABITE ICI 26 and PASSAGE, with photographs, podcasts, videos, a concert and a parade. The Compagnie LEA organises it with partners including Ville de Pessac and the social centre La Chataigneraie.

44698b23d963dd135f24a2e11620756c4f148079.en: A talk on discrimination and harassment, aimed at helping people understand how these work and what witnesses or bystanders can do to prevent them. Held at the Médiathèque Gabriela Mistral.

8e8b8d6b6b024cf9a1e12c51d589a839f120d75b.en: A wine quiz for students at La Cité du Vin, with about 30 questions on Kahoot and a glass of wine to start. Students compete for their school. Free to enter.

57501d59c9feaf3e86bdf8f41c99247c3e08b535.en: A closing evening of the equality fortnight at Chez Simone, with a citizen workshop on women, followed by a show by Compagnie Coup de foudre that mixes feminism, pop culture and social theory.

dd27e4096ffed3b75967580046946e24a6338696.en: An evening at the Musée d'Aquitaine on struggles for rights in US history, with a concert by Lone Riders, a breakdance demo, a photo booth, a DJ set and a buffet.

48f7bc2aa98893b3641c627d3fded3c89c0e115e.en: A surreal play at the tnba directed by Elizabeth LeCompte and Kate Valk, a new version of Richard Foreman's 1988 work. It is set in a future United States, with a president receiving mysterious messages.

5cc8908be2a668807d8192ff17b80656d15180ce.en: A concert by the young singer Paolo at Lieu Chéri on 18 November 2026. He is 23 and blends rap and singing, drawing on West Africa and years living in many countries.

504c8451ae21e1879b7c53ef81517c57ed6a221a.en: A concert by Paolo at Lieu Chéri in Bordeaux. The artist, 23, grew up in West Africa, writes rap and sung lyrics, and mixes both styles.

dd5a743a4e217aac599ea4e288f543b1a2c270e0.en: A one-woman show by Marie-Claire Neveu at La Matière about living with three chronic illnesses. Through slam, dance and humour, Claire tells her medical story, and the show is for ages 12 and up.

a40e39fbb88b30cf3316971dc8c95dbbabfc3a3e.en: A talk by Michel Cymes at Le Pin Galant, his first time on stage. In a comedy about medical secrecy, four former medical students meet for dinner, until one friend reveals that his patient is running for president.

d21c609b262f49cdf53b312c087721f161bb612e.en: A welding and boilermaking workshop at Afpa Bordeaux Bègles during the Gironde industry week, where participants make a dispenser and weld metal parts. Includes a presentation of the training.

5ddac3d448d1e189423f41fa2bc6b7675afe2a3b.en: A visit by students of the ENSMAC school to the Sanofi site in Ambarès-et-Lagrave. They see a presentation on the site and tour the plant to learn how medicines are made and packaged.

4f01b12c05ae09d416e7f6df849dcef7d50e0186.en: Company visits for teachers and career advisers across the Bordeaux, Limoges and Poitiers academies, to meet staff in science, technical and digital companies and bring ideas back to class.

1ed8af87c1399b6541fd6d19877b6afc2fc38451.en: A day of adapted sports at the US Bouscat football club, with young people from specialist institutions trying fencing, judo and BMX in the morning. The afternoon is open to everyone.

e4d1be5ccd83dd35862d3a8f981213dbd4d80d8f.en: A day of discovery at Enseirb-Matmeca on engineering careers in computing, electronics, robotics and networks, with a visit, a quiz on women in industry and talks with engineering students and staff.

ab71b7853a1cd8b2175887475b81d849e4379d54.en: A World Toilet Day event at the Espace Michel Serres in Bassens about chronic inflammatory bowel disease, with actress Marie-Claire Neveu, co-author of Hépatik Girl, and a trail runner. Organised with AFA Crohn RCH.

4ebb55d979ab1119073d7574eddcbdf88e68c463.en: A feminist biographical play by Compagnie L'Inverso about Laurence, a 23-year-old model who tells how she became anorexic. Written and performed by Claire Besuelle, lasts one hour and is followed by a talk with the cast.

62830e9655ba4dacf657fd2bf2bb85918adf959a.en: A workshop at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck on protecting against malware, covering good practices to block and neutralise harmful software.

9b07cbcc53a6ebf4b4a6e28b0e6490861147a95a.en: The French Tech Day at the Palais de la Bourse in Bordeaux on 19 November 2026 from 14:00. It is free and open to all, with 15-minute talks and a Demo Day presenting ten startups from Bordeaux and Nouvelle-Aquitaine.

6e4f38183255da45cf82a96a729653f95140e013.en: A French Tech Day at the Palais de la Bourse in Bordeaux on 19 November 2026, with 15-minute talks across the local innovation ecosystem. The event is free and expected to welcome more than 2,000 people.

145cca77e82151fcd4cc3f6fe5aeb442cec738d2.en: A workshop at the Carré des Jalles media library on generative AI tools that create text, images and short videos from a prompt.

86abd937db3d02351a27efb9619f9c345f5c0e3c.en: A debate at the Hôtel de Région Nouvelle-Aquitaine on ecological transition and industry, with two round tables on industrial projects and on protecting resources through innovation and new models.

5a6fd0f86fbf526afd45f3f11c174e2026107d04.en: An awareness day on road safety and visibility at the Placette de Munich on Thursday 19 November, from 16:00 to 19:30, with equipment checks, quizzes and a 4 km night walk or ride starting at 18:15.

96764a748b4237b378d2ea588e19363345593045.en: A documentary screening at La ManuCo on how agrochemicals have harmed insects, followed by a debate on alternative farming practices.

2a9f9b47d50f8e4ef8c8d67dfed51a27268e892b.en: A meeting with Nigerian novelist Oyinkan Braithwaite at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck on Thursday 19 November at 18:30, moderated by writer Beata Umubyeyi Mairesse, as part of the Lettres du monde festival.

ecba23947934ee9e48789ff3173605bdc23908a4.en: A road safety evening walk on Thursday 19 November, set off from the Placette de Munich at 18:15 on a 4 km route. Participants should bring their brightest clothing.

cf42fa3e3e20fc5ef6a11df614c9d39240522a28.en: A meeting with Oyinkan Braithwaite at the Bibliothèque Capucins/Saint-Michel. She writes gothic thrillers about violence against women, and her novel Filles maudites is set in Lagos. A book signing follows.

b884d067276e19f315b834847205b452c64f5f77.en: A round table at the Université de Bordeaux, Auditorium Station Marne, on learning and AI, asking whether cross-disciplinary and active teaching can help. Speakers are Chloé Mercier of Inria and Julien Tourneville, moderated by Anne-Sophie Novel.

3ab2ea5571eb10c0c167073d221882f1fe8a16f9.en: An afterwork tasting at La Cité du Vin matching four Châteauneuf-du-Pape wines with four Comté cheeses, in partnership with the Comté interprofession. Sessions at 18:30 and 20:30.

e6382ff3ea36225633ca6a8acc0313a49f7013ab.en: A conference for parents and professionals at the Croix-Rouge Bègles on recognising early signs of mental health fragility in children and adolescents, and how to respond to them.

baa8b66f7620517dbc8544b50a1726aadad1fb5b.en: A reading for adults at Hangar 14 on how writers portray the sky, the night and the northern lights, with extracts and group discussion. Part of Écri'Magique's Lapland programme on Thursday 19 November.

7c25d76171fb88192f4ecbcf3640459846cdc98f.en: A talk at the Musée des Arts décoratifs et du Design by Stanislas Colodiet on the wall of more than 60 vases at the museum, with glass and the Cirva research centre.

e7932e629b8829c1817e2fa00c0ad1db4dd13ba3.en: An exhibition on the female body after motherhood, called MATER, at the Halle des Chartrons from 19 to 22 November 2026. The opening is on 19 November from 19:00.

5a5cd04110954634a41b1fba76ea536597518795.en: A concert at L'Inconnue by Étienne Jaumet of Zombie Zombie, a musician who mixes saxophone, analogue synths and electronic music, with Oonagh Haines, who blends electronic music, performance and fiction.

431555ddf12fb0c547f55c1d69e146698a4aacfe.en: A one-woman show at the Cuvier de Feydeau by Marie-Magdeleine, a young actress who goes to the G.R.A.I.N support group for bipolar users to lead a theatre workshop. Co-written and directed by Julien Marot, it explores madness and representation.

f129404b26bede780c54e0f046f372ee4f76567d.en: A show by Lisa Pariente at Lieu Chéri, a singer who writes personal songs about violence and sisterhood, such as 'Ruelle sombre' and 'Femmes'. Her first album is due in autumn 2026.

4efe9c14d1e23d5bdc901f8539c9a0ded9aa3de3.en: Another performance of G.R.A.I.N: Histoire de fous at Le Cuvier de Feydeau, written and played by Marie-Magdeleine, and co-written and directed by Julien Marot. It examines madness and the act of performing it.

896c491ced2785084a7f4387c46663eb1f162612.en: A concert at the Rock School Barbey by Zélie, a singer who blends electronic, hip-hop and contemporary dance in her show Le cœur et sa dictature.

e81d9a97ce25e2dc0050db961b463d366b15d943.en: A stand-up show by Olivier de Benoist at Le Pin Galant on his personal and universal topics. He describes the way he left his family to buy cigarettes without anyone noticing.

abb4a75cc1aeaa615e04f9269d1c750d71b7f646.en: A stand-up show by Élodie Arnould at La Coupole, her third show, about family, couples, inherited values and the small wounds people turn into strength. The topic is partly chosen with the audience.

fee47b2fcaad1f24bae9d15576d0d897873681c4.en: An information session on the GEIQ A LUNDI employment group at the Eysines agency, which recruits and trains people in industrial jobs through a work-based contract of about one year.

3e3fedeb7a75d8113cbb488bee2562346266527f.en: A two-day sale of withdrawn books, comics, CDs and documentaries at the Médiathèque Castagnéra, aimed at adults and young people. Payment is by cheque or cash only.

a6a89ec601d6ea4376fbfce0e56fcd1cacd0ab42.en: A bicycle repair workshop at the Parc du Bois fleuri with Vélo-Cité technicians. Sessions run on 20 and 21 November and 18 and 19 December, with tools and a bike marking service against theft.

1986e385f10e8b95027a8cbb579179fda6f4b803.en: A pastel workshop at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux in which participants recreate one of the museum's masterpieces.

e0dc08fae306e123a566a063308312398c7ae401.en: A children's show by Ladji Diallo at the Maison des Arts Vivants, with songs and stories about a black hyena, ram, bird and a boy in love. It is for ages 6 and up, lasts 50 minutes and includes a snack.

0906ed019f7120eb51f3afe976086dd8bbd6575b.en: A meeting with comic artist Fabien Toulmé at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck about ULIS, a story of an engineer who becomes a support worker in a special-needs class. It follows how he learns about inclusion and the children he works with.

a6ea08df6f322f8ffb81f0d9206a7b3e9f6a7926.en: Performed poetry and performance nights at the Espace Eugénie Éboué-Tell on 20 and 21 November, with readings from 18:00 and performances from 20:00. The programme explores bodies and identities outside dominant norms.

c090d43db66a91857911424200d30b5bd2dd24da.en: A theatre tale about two women, Abi from Nigeria and Shayda from Iran, who both face violence from their fathers over their futures. Presented at La Salle Le Galet.

0513626d46aeea19f983f22ff38103bcd7b00e8f.en: A screening of the film Plus fort que moi at L'Entrepôt, based on the true story of John Davidson, a Scot living with Tourette syndrome. Organised by the CCAS of Le Haillan.

a2bbcffdd22e0fa0cd94465dc2af3ac319000d44.en: A guided walk at the Parc de Sybirol in Floirac to discover amphibians in autumn, including the salamander. Free for ages 7 and up with registration; participants should bring boots and a torch.

8060e4b5c248b5c64698525d3cdd887592f6f9ea.en: The sixth Night of Drawing at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux, where visitors draw live models and the museum's masterpieces, organised with history of art students from Université Bordeaux Montaigne.

c0f4a0f583d47063a52f02d264be8ab6bb056c39.en: A piano recital by Alexandra Dovgan at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, a young pianist mentored by Grigory Sokolov. The programme includes Bach, Schubert, Chopin and a Chopin sonata.

6f08f00899a11f2a193408075801df4d60ea48bf.en: A silent-film concert at L'Impromptu with Murnau's film L'Aurore, performed live with a pianist and multi-instrumentalist Mathilde Chatin. Runs 1h25.

c86d6bc3881816e65efe9b962b2740bc763d3f4c.en: A concert by Kalika at Rock School Barbey, a singer whose EP J'ai pleuré came out in late 2025. A second album, MA CLAQUE, is planned for 29 May, and an end-of-year tour finishes at L'Olympia on 16 December.

0b80f77a2bbdc57a9cb1603a136d468e7275e5be.en: An improv match at La Grande Poste between the Birdygala team and an all-star team from four local improv groups.

89f5c4b1bb4506b87178ed14fc87af633572d3d4.en: A concert by Sheldon at Le Rocher de Palmer, a rapper and guitarist from the 75e Session collective. He performs his album Les Monstres (2026), which mixes rap with instrumental music.

36389088472785bdc739deaa9f133d2aa712030c.en: A one-woman show by Justine Le Pottier at L'Estrade about her life as an actress, covering Paris, drama classes, auditions and YouTube. Doors open at 19:30 and the show starts at 20:30.

01e1a279db56ff64bfb17c801a01e0cff73df8da.en: A concert by Belgian indie rock band Girls in Hawaii at the Krakatoa, presenting their sixth album, Eldorado, released on 25 September 2026.

ae9bd494def3fab0212560b0c382df66fe7025a8.en: A stand-up show by Jason Brokerss at Le Rocher de Palmer, recommended from age 16, in which he tells his own life story. Directed by Fary.

d3be4884675075d3a75ea4cc43bdfc66b0a0a4d6.en: A charity Christmas bazaar of toys, books, clothes, household items and second-hand goods, run by the Secours populaire.

0ff6d3637c5bf1e1ccf08705ac9160398ae3b48f.en: A first-aid workshop at the Maison de l'enfant et des parents, run by Famille de Sauveteurs, to teach parents simple and practical first-aid actions.

de2caf0ad4957eb60bfb4f3b3e2999ed51bc07f3.en: A guided walk at Parc Rivière to see red squirrels and the ruins of a late 19th-century château. It covers how city parks can support urban biodiversity. Run by Pétronille and LPO Nouvelle-Aquitaine.

409af8af7c2ef3cb272e0d9a586537fd8bab0eaf.en: A show of engaged tales at the Salle du Royal in Pessac about children's place in traditional stories and about consent and inequality, followed by a talk on children's rights and a moving debate.

fc2ee220697082d946fe9b870a87142f555f2196.en: A show at Salle Le Royal in Pessac with engaged tales about children's place, consent and inequalities in traditional stories, followed by a talk on children's rights and a debate.

0ec73b7af930d27d6c8426d29aaeb8abb3b5bdc0.en: A photo walk for families in Bordeaux, Place Saint-Seurin, where children and adults see the city at child height and look at the place given to children in public space. Run by Projet Luna and O'Bord du Jeu.

285425f9b435dc7a2bd8ebe4d1597ca2aaaac35f.en: A storytelling session for children aged 0 to 3 at the Médiathèque Les Étoiles, with nursery rhymes, songs and voice games.

11c457d177538db778f75daca2d58eb479fa62a2.en: A charity flea market at Darwin Éco-système organised by Emmaüs, with furniture, decor, books, clothes and unusual objects. Proceeds support people in need.

8e25ae9c16b3f91439eea1d488cd6b0b2be72635.en: A walk in the woods to identify the wood species used in wild basketry, followed by a small craft in a workshop. Starting point is given on registration in Saint-Médard-en-Jalles.

ca566cac7de9689dd0313aabc69173568009544b.en: A musical reading with Manuela Azevedo of the Cie du Coin tranquille at the Médiathèque Gabriela Mistral, with new children's books read to music.

77ce3a828fb05eeeaacd20f845f09514c560feb3.en: A small-group session at the Médiathèque Castagnéra on generative AI and artistic creation, with a multimedia facilitator and a librarian to discuss the tools and the questions they raise.

4a8820c206f8bfae94de5b3c5ea820a47102f6b7.en: A hands-on session at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul in Pessac to try instruments, this time keyboards. Sessions run at 10:30 and 11:00 for ages 7 to 12 and 11:30 for ages 13 and up, with booking.

909b97c75bb5cb63125b60b2ba22599b9ecabccf.en: A music session for toddlers at the Bibliothèque Pablo Neruda in Pessac, with sounds, nursery rhymes and simple percussion instruments such as maracas and cymbals. Booking required.

91a1d410e97d7335f77ba6bfa22f9032dab58be6.en: A reading in Turkish and French for children aged 3 to 6 at the Bibliothèque La Bastide. It is free and open without registration.

6a70c453ef1da5bedfc3268186b812b63600b651.en: An exhibition at the Médiathèque Bois Fleuri in Lormont, where learners tell their first day in France through written testimonies, pictures and podcasts. It runs from 17 to 28 November, with an opening on Saturday 21 November at 11:00.

52bdf142afe47c01e5691c0310b4bcad3e77b997.en: A dance show for toddlers from 12 months at the Grand-Théâtre, in which two dancers perform in a cocoon of fabric. Touch is the main theme, and parents and children move together.

ca957c0aca920832d96a109991114d9120a08b7d.en: A talk at the Bibliothèque Flora Tristan with Lebanese-French author Manal Salamé about her first novel Habibi Beyrouth, in which a woman returns to Beirut to get an identity card. A book signing follows.

14e0740ae05e8c3a21db459cc7f4b8ecd4ad744d.en: A meeting with Manal Salamé at the Bibliothèque Flora Tristan on Saturday 21 November at 11:00, moderated by literary journalist Sylvie Hazebroucq, as part of the Lettres du monde festival.

a9bbcb6c3fa8511f78f520cd212ee5132a19e297.en: A meeting with cartoonist Nikesco about his comic Dialogues de sourd, which uses humour to show how deaf people and hearing people communicate. A sign language interpreter is present.

6b66fc36f82337fab7492c8811eff5ac77410652.en: A drawing workshop at the atelier Citrouille on coloured pencils and watercolour pencils, covering hatching, gradients and mixing colour with water.

37532a5fd74cfe22d53c8ba658d2a5c19f23e398.en: Circus introductions at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul in Pessac, in three age groups from 5 to 13. Booking is required.

c30bd9c4c9f36fd3c26cd636cbb704635506d467.en: A two-hour natural gardening workshop at the Maison écocitoyenne on Saturday 21 November from 14:00 to 16:00, covering trees and shrubs, invasive species and the European hedgehog. Organised by Ecosite du Bourgailh.

7c235d1f017a9eab26c9985db273cba68f6ce4ed.en: A writing workshop at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul on the border between dreams and reality, with references to Freud, Jung, Alain-Fournier, Proust and Kafka. Booking is required.

ce8e8385c82c00b4ab11791775824fdf1debca84.en: A walk at Central Parcs through the western Bordeaux neighbourhoods, from public gardens to the Cité du Grand Parc, to see their history of large estates now part of the city.

653a1255a057386d2dd0e7910bdfc6e9ef60fdcb.en: A manga illustration workshop with Pops at the Médiathèque Carré des Jalles, with step-by-step tips for drawing favourite characters.

929531ade667cfe1c4ebc842b669e4425665340b.en: A monthly knitting and crochet workshop at the Médiathèque Castagnéra, on Saturdays, where people improve their skills, share patterns and take on group projects.

ce7415406ced3705ce6af0437360ce3305f68f8d.en: A session at the Médiathèque Carré des Jalles on tools for listening to the body and easing the menopause transition.

3070f62682aed8a00966b93a9da7945e3ceb7598.en: An interactive citizenship quiz at the Hôtel Ragueneau, using the kind of civic and administrative questions that migrants face when applying for a residence permit or French nationality. Designed to build empathy.

8f2c94c0af305c7301cb0666a1f41f6132f4a007.en: A visit at the Musée des Arts décoratifs et du Design led by collections manager Alexandre Cordoba, covering the Boulan wing and the new installation of works there.

1b98e0c4370bf356e3d8b771fdc94ed20675067f.en: A card-embroidery creative workshop for adults and seniors at the Bibliothèque La Bastide, run with the Mériadeck library. It is free and requires registration.

c053eb2cba9630dfa03fc493a946773e0c0434c5.en: A poetry, music and dance evening organised by the association Septembre Nuit at the Hôtel Ragueneau from 19:30, with open-mic poetry and slam, dance performances and readings by Bordeaux authors. Writing and dance workshops start at 17:00 on registration.

9d87ec6a8c74e83da609c640fafdea5715e6ee86.en: A concert by the Orchestre d'Harmonie de Bordeaux at La Pergola with a varied programme from Rameau to Piazzolla. It features a flute quartet at 18:00 and a clarinet and percussion ensemble at 18:45.

5ff243d190d6d5c2628eaa142d501e7c04ca5c32.en: A performance of Mozart's Requiem in Robert Levin's completion, by Ensemble Vocal Martenot at the Église Notre-Dame, on 21 and 22 November. It features choir, soloists and an instrumental ensemble.

3ff09efa396c98e4c64dd3d9ae4b52d7713291c9.en: A concert by the Belgian indie rock band The Haunted Youth at the Bien Public, presenting their album Boys Cry Too, released on 8 May 2026.

cf2225e04d48be39fd4c9f387513807722d6ff46.en: A jazz piano concert by Tigran Hamasyan at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, mixing jazz improvisation, progressive rock and Armenian folk music.

d0d4a6bf583a9047a663bf1e429cf2a77366d36b.en: A comedy club evening in Bègles organised with the city, featuring five regional stand-up comedians on the theme of discrimination in health and access to care.

c80af7853479575119bbe1c5ff327b35ab223bac.en: A rock and metal concert at Sortie 13 on 21 November 2026 with Blooming Discord from Marseille, Doorshan from Rouen and Dragon Punch from Bordeaux.

786dbc9bc617db39e8046ceb4d80ab66065b1c5c.en: A show by Catherine Caillaud at Le Cube about love, women's secrets and advice for men, with stories and wit. It is not suitable for under-14s and lasts one hour.

6a0883b7d69537e530a25de72119ee066f3572fd.en: A show at L'Impromptu with pianist Pascal Pistone and his daughter Adèle Pistone, who sing and improvise on Brel, Chopin, Prévert and audience texts, mixing classical, jazz and slam. Runs 1h10.

ea49e929915a07bfee12105ac292a5d23f0d25ed.en: A contemporary dance performance at Le Carré by Salia Sanou, director of the Centre chorégraphique national de Nantes. Dancer Ousséni Dabaré performs solos to the music of Carla Bley, as part of the Biennale des littératures francophones d'Afrique noire.

3c1010583aba0a73ad463549de0f102e6ef68d51.en: A stand-up show by Julien Bing at Le Rocher de Palmer, which asks whether our truths of yesterday still hold and plays with the pressure of social media.

dc62e04514b80d8ece320dbe37c6909251d3717e.en: Another improvised show at the Salle du Royal in Pessac on tales that question children's place, consent and inequalities, with a talk on children's rights and a debate.

74750e2049154315de839ee8acf1f6362fe9d00c.en: A drag and pop party at L'Entrepôt in Bordeaux on Saturday 21 November from 00:00 to 06:00, with drag performances, DJ sets and hosts. Places are limited and booking is recommended.

81167d116e6e2010b18a6dfcc8496aad39da2b9e.en: A second Afro-Caribbean Christmas market at Le Rocher de Palmer, with handmade items, natural cosmetics, food and live music from local artists and associations.

a48d1215fdb248437452dfa0bbcbd2d9bad960ef.en: A wine tasting at Château Couhins with four wine tastings, interspersed with comic tales told by the storyteller Caliconte. It is part of the Parole. programme.

e826a091203a8ea493d7f2b2b36fddd0d9002666.en: A wine tasting at Château Couhins with four wine tastings, interspersed with comic tales told by the storyteller Caliconte. It is part of the Parole. programme.

88dc8c55a6521377a7e8e00c68a621d5c99b5fba.en: A workshop at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul in Pessac, where children and parents cut, draw, colour and assemble a unique 3D object. Sessions run for ages 3 to 12, and booking is required.

1aa337a36ffb6b5d978366404e6cf9748c02ce9d.en: A talk at the Ponton Burdigala on the Cœur de Bastide urban project, the first step in renewing an area hit by industrial decline, with green spaces next to historic Bastide sites.

35c59f29df0da3714b8d840165e4556c0247ea79.en: Tango lessons and an Argentine milonga at Darwin Éco-système, with a beginners' class at 14:00 and a dance from 15:30 to 19:30. Prices are 10 euros for the class, 8 euros for the milonga and 15 euros for both.

31ce5aceae1b47fee8bc735e79edd4f1663abe35.en: A monthly film club at La Salle des Fêtes in the Grand Parc, with a Sunday screening of a documentary, animation, experimental or cult film, followed by an open discussion. The programme is announced on social media.

3646b7d9c21df7db222f921ff69bd4026f687bca.en: A talk by historian Christelle Taraud on the women executed as witches in Steilneset, Norway, in 1621, and on memorial sites to femicide. It is followed by songs from the feminist choir La Râle Co.

0b097867ec2c5dfe7fe783eec401c9033ca2e698.en: A concert by the vocal ensemble Atout Chœur du Tauzin and the Jazz ensemble of Gradignan, performing The Jazz and Mass Project at the Église Notre-Dame des Anges. Tickets are on pre-sale.

d8eff96d6c8f31db98cb4b95e46dc38b6fe322b6.en: A family musical, Lilly le musical, at the Théâtre Fémina, created by Oscar Sisto and Lou Deleuze, with Lou Deleuze in the title role. The show is directed by Mau and aimed at a family audience.

79a33fef532ff6474a69ec0d4e257fe4c998b82a.en: A storytelling show for children from age 4 at the Maison des Arts Vivants with Françoise Diep, who shares tales of scary stories with happy endings. Lasts 50 minutes and includes a snack.

afce5e7be2bf0e7c3703d4d4ac1d5a1d954a2b77.en: A show of gesticulated tales at the Hôtel Ragueneau about parenthood, challenging norms about access to family life through humour and anger.

f0b1519449f6cad14403b6da7291b5256cb27d27.en: Yannick Jaulin's show J'ai pas fermé l'œil de la nuit at Le Cube, a storyteller who makes the dead talk through a cemetery walk. It mixes humour, tenderness and chills, lasts 1h30, and is not suitable under 14.

4e4199e2254d7ac231403e0f1b91fa4dacc27420.en: A show by Roberto Alagna at Le Pin Galant, Caruso, une voix pour l'éternité, about the friendship and rivalry between tenor Enrico Caruso and opera director Giulio Gatti-Casazza in the Gilded Age. It mixes opera with pop, blues and rock.

beb887fcd0ef408b98c6fcd61a97cc3f6dab5306.en: An information session at the Cestas employment hub in the Marticot business park about the Forindustrie gaming platform, which lets people discover industrial jobs through interactive play. Runs over three weeks with half-day sessions.

53157f53d361cf875bce98590542be6f4df04eff.en: A meeting at La ManuCo on perimenopause and menopause, with an open discussion to share information and experiences on Monday 23 November at 10:30.

39bfc9b66e1dba6a594efefc43fd12cfa48e6658.en: Creative graphic workshops at the Centre culturel Le Plateau in Eysines, where participants turn their words into posters and slogans for a collective artwork shown in the hall from 14 November. Led by graphic artist Vincent Falgueyret.

f0d574662ac6cfab36a631681cdc8504a6dae8cd.en: A computer safety workshop at Sésame on passwords, updates, downloads, suspicious emails and common online scams. It helps people understand digital risks and adopt simple habits.

3db843d996c9106ed905d351ab3dd1b980f20077.en: A collective intelligence workshop at the Hôtel Ragueneau on how discrimination works in the brain, and ways to reduce it. Led by Vanessa Robson of La Pangée.

21019230f84c410c96da010c233015c4aa9f33f3.en: A lecture at the Chartreuse de Lussy on Goya's mature work, after an earlier session on his youth. It covers the court portraits, the Caprices and The Third of May 1808, and how he became an engaged artist.

3c7e10a7cd4ccc7b9e782f3aed8952ccae9226bf.en: A discussion at the Dôme in Talence on young people's mental health and how sport and physical activity can support recovery and social bonds. Organised with the Talence Atelier Santé Ville.

d5d4c740e2e1e4f72f5b326e60a3ec664c2772a9.en: A performance of Demain dès l'aube, je m'enfuirai by the company Les chemins de faire, about a couple caught in a cycle of conflict and violence. It is part of the equality fortnight in Saint-Médard-en-Jalles on Monday 23 November at 20:00.

b4adea8fc7a426ebbc7beb186fc30ed91f18b6a9.en: A performance by poet Nathalie Man with guitarist Maxime Delpierre, exploring the other, intercultural encounters and the fight against discrimination. Presented at the Pôle Culturel Évasion.

bc0eba6cc9586339680ad1c6e4d5f63ee26e4e0d.en: An awareness stand on antibiotic resistance at Place Pey Berland, held by the Nouvelle-Aquitaine regional antibiotic therapy centre on Tuesday 24 November. It answers questions on the right use of antibiotics.

1fad9d62cbf948b5ec79b7a4a0d5ec4b3813596a.en: A photo-language workshop at the Maison des habitants d'Arlac on the different ways of being a parent and forming a family. It is used to start conversations and value family diversity.

0dbcb1f56a382d451163ecf05e954eecab7abece.en: A musical nap at Station Marne by students of RésoNAnces, performing a surprise programme on Tuesday 24 November at 12:30. Entry is free and no booking is needed.

130a7605789498da86161a65496346a9e38c0a1e.en: A dance tea at La Coupole with the Didier Laurent orchestra and accordion music, from 14:30. It costs 14 euros, with booking required and payment by card only.

634b2add05249de3f981ddc336dc81677c7aa672.en: A talk at the Résidence autonomie Simone Veil about equality between men and women in couples.

95bc527cd52e2fe5c216ad06b49e297494a0932c.en: A theatre play at the Restaurant Sénior in the CCAS d'Arlac by the Pin Vert Compagnie of Mérignac, about a crime novelist, his veterinarian friend, and a bonsai that changes their quiet life.

0bdb4c51e83205c0034b0f7cc893c58b2b82bd33.en: A workshop at the Médiathèque Carré des Jalles where visitors design a festive decoration, which is laser-engraved on a thin wood board. Pick-up from 15 December.

32a7b450875d4afa761f98f022e108fec0234165.en: A philosophy café at the Bibliothèque Grand Parc on the relationship between humans and animals, open to everyone for an informal discussion.

7eefa91af30ad0a93f8126433a38d0cc8ed1290b.en: A talk at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck by Yann Perraud of the Musée Imaginé on how visual artists have used photography beyond the question of beauty.

03783cfda75fc89f2f2c975c53fe85c260b2ef0b.en: An introduction to Romani dance by the company Romano Dji at the Hôtel Ragueneau, covering dances from Eastern Europe, from Russia to the Balkans and Hungary, with festive and expressive movement.

e92288328c38573c288e55c5df9486979467b93d.en: A session at La ManuCo for people aged 18 to 27 to improve internship, apprenticeship or Parcoursup and Mon Master applications, with career advice from professionals. Bring a CV and questions.

6489a058a3217bf5c1f5a97e3ec7c38dd488493f.en: An open exchange at La ManuCo on migration paths, with games and testimonies to challenge misconceptions and meet new people.

680144c88334a0442075981e743d47519a1ed1ff.en: A talk by the association L'BURN at the Médiathèque de Bassens on burn-out in women, its signs, support options and reconstruction, followed by testimonies from women.

5abbee7d4d5a2848360979715b81e959dca1c6bb.en: A screening of the animated film Zootopia at the Dôme in Talence, followed by discussion of how prejudice and fear divide society. Organised by the Mix-cité social centre.

fffbecb72b28fd1a131c3240fadee7c7edd7f175.en: A screening of Le Corps vermeil (une anatomie du désir) by Ron Vargas at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck, a 62-minute documentary on love and eroticism among elderly residents of care homes. Filmed from a project with residents, many near 100.

41e6ae8a7c3b8e1960886c93697284264fb743cf.en: A discussion at the Maison Ouverte on age discrimination, from no-kids restaurants to mockery of baby boomers. It asks where inclusion ends and is recorded as a podcast.

4fa3b7a7db7f329bbcff07e689d395abf9164d84.en: A talk by psychiatrist Xavier Pommereau at the Théâtre Jean Vilar in Eysines on adolescent psychological distress, warning signs and how to start a conversation about help.

f945692bdcc929c21e4b7275e72b8fd936e513c3.en: A show at the Hôtel Ragueneau by the Brigade Poétique and local artists, with poetry and performance about bodies and identities outside norms, imposed beauty standards and gender.

4606d17c506b18e192e19113d195c4310afb36f0.en: A Swimcross class at the Piscine du Grand Parc on Tuesday 24 November from 19:00 to 20:30, part of Novembre Bleu. It combines cardio, strength and coordination at the usual pool entry price, with information on male cancers.

148cb4d89f4bf230ef3336f82558bb0e82e5dc6e.en: A show by Stéphanie Aflalo at the Maison des arts in Pessac, in which she talks with her father through a television screen, mixing theatre, philosophy, piano, dance and song. Presented with the Université Bordeaux Montaigne.

da0f29d29d2178118cf81a88ce0a5b8e83502564.en: A screening of Le Corps vermeil followed by a discussion on desire and romance at any age, at the Auditorium of the Mériadeck library.

5ad06f66e85a796d570ca3a8f2e29c7b723fd916.en: A dance piece by Israel Galván and Mohamed El Khatib at the TnBA, a duet on the relationship with their fathers and the choice of independence. It mixes flamenco and documentary theatre.

9ef3eba573eeaa806b3d56e1a266ca38421dbe9c.en: A dance piece at the TnBA by Israel Galván and Mohamed El Khatib, presented as a duet with two kitsch altars, video interviews and their bodies as living archives of their upbringing.

6eca7c2146b065a5abea04cb90e5300ebbd70399.en: A piano recital by Arcadi Volodos at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, with Schubert's Sonata in G major and Chopin mazurkas, preludes and the Sonata No. 2. His latest album is devoted to Schumann and Schubert.

e11aba41a99100db0360aa969efd8920e2245172.en: A dance piece for about twenty amateur seniors at the Cuvier de Feydeau, choreographed by Ludovic Guy from movement-expression workshops, showing contemporary dance as a way to reconnect with one's body.

d27be2edd4aa112afb47bf1cbb6860233d8895b9.en: A concert by The Stranglers at Le Rocher de Palmer, celebrating their 50 years with Jean-Jacques Burnel and Baz Warne, plus drummer Jim Macaulay and keyboard player Toby Hounsham.

9cd465a24515c75d53d4cbe72e1bf5d8162f7124.en: A play at Colonnes by Laura Sbdar and Consuelo Iturraspe, about three basketball players who commit a femicide the night before a decisive match in Bahía Blanca. Three actresses play the roles.

78517258e730048bdc6739dd17ae2cd7dafe1f85.en: An improvised musical at L'Estrade, where the story, songs and characters are invented on the spot with a live musician. Doors open at 19:30 and the show starts at 20:30.

edf19e3760e2da71faea446ab3eb2e1773b94d25.en: A comedy at Le Pin Galant about school bullying, in which the parents of two teenagers meet in a bar to settle a dispute. The civility soon breaks down, with the adults revealing their own pettiness.

6491bf702f8d93c154584a03de91b2351662c289.en: A conference in Bordeaux for the second international meeting on stereoscopic photography, on the history of stereoscopy and live performance over 200 years.

b278d4cceb5740af425680fff7891f837c0e0488.en: A group for women entrepreneurs and project holders at the Espace jeune Le Pass'âge, to identify obstacles to work and business creation and to explore possible actions together.

6ad9a3f377839c983a5027b4aa89b2806591f0d3.en: A study day for architects, landscape designers, urban planners and teachers at Le 308 in Bordeaux on Wednesday 25 November from 09:30 to 17:30, on the Visites constructives project for pupils from CM1 to year 9.

029ced9ecb70976576b1fcdc618d00bd19b4f009.en: A workshop at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck where participants make surrealist photomontages with special cameras, cutting and assembling images into imaginary scenes.

1c51bd7b1f79c4cafb2ad3725691b94ecc9204e2.en: The third 1ers regards film festival at the Cinéma La Lanterne, from 25 to 29 November 2026, with five days of previews, special screenings, meetings and workshops. The audience votes for a public prize.

7d9240a829eef9b4110b861353d050332748ddbe.en: A guided visit at the Musée d'Aquitaine with a heritage mediator, of an exhibition that walks through Bordeaux from the museum to the historic centre and the river, with models, films and collection objects.

fddbdfe9d35e995c6f4a6279ce741ceabcf720d5.en: A computer buying workshop at Sésame on the main features of a computer, the criteria that matter for your needs, and the mistakes to avoid before buying.

428c29d3cf49736d8b2b020fbfb1e6200764a3ef.en: A manga illustration workshop with the mangaka Caly at the Bibliothèque Bordeaux-Lac on Wednesday 25 November at 14:30. For ages 11 and up, on registration with the librarians.

3cadafe549513f31e2cffc485b5235fa8c796f6f.en: A philosophy workshop by Léo Pour Le Monde at the Château du Burck in Mérignac on violence against women, gender stereotypes and the roots of equality. Organised with the Mérignac associations.

72654c845b6980e05df3a005e683e265ebe1e8ac.en: A day against violence towards women at the Centre social et culturel du Burck in Mérignac, with a snack and philosophy and pastry workshops, a tribute to Chahinez and a show by Oumou Balde Diallo.

20fc30f3d61dad19abc84a676b48db8dfb09809f.en: Creative workshops for young people at the Médiathèque Castagnéra, covering drawing, crafts and invention. Materials are provided.

eb3d4f1f6947845815af52ff49bbdc16f4d8035a.en: A science workshop at the Médiathèque de Thouars combining film and hands-on investigation, to help children build curiosity and critical thinking.

d48b7b05eb53e0f21ce39f2645e2a8bdd5384081.en: A virtual reality session at the Médiathèque Carré des Jalles, with a selection of immersive 3D apps and games.

0378e2c8e91174c6a9c1e97ac8fc52abf5179b59.en: A picture book read at the Médiathèque de Bassens about Anatole, who drags a saucepan behind him, hides to avoid being seen and learns that differences make us unique.

4b3c808a5276c167532eb65bd424c1c0a5895320.en: An upcycling workshop at the Hôtel Ragueneau with La Chemise Club, where participants adapt sportswear to their own body and identity, then join an 80s aerobics session. It questions the norms for sporting bodies.

cccd4f96cbb75a32792b6ae10fbc35c3c708cf74.en: An exhibition at Design Laps on Barbie dolls and how people reclaim their body and history. Participants can take part in writing, speech or visual art workshops on 28 November.

c9536a64ebf9580d4b19fbf5562d69343d68d7f2.en: An outdoor exhibition in Lormont, Planète Lormont, a sound and visual installation by Compagnie Enyre-Nous with photographs and testimonies. Runs from 24 to 29 November, with an opening party on 25 November at 18:30.

cc53c37ed19089b79a9bf703fdb61d1e458a834b.en: A theatre piece at Le Local about Marie, who grows up in the Jura as a dancer and goes to the École normale supérieure, before a meeting with a feminist activist changes her life. Organised by Le Dôme and Ars Anima.

85b09984c231724b1586db16d9bf17aca522aea5.en: A jazz concert at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux by the jazz workshop of the Conservatoire, playing Gershwin, Ellington, Cole Porter and Django Reinhardt in the spirit of the Art Deco period.

39a11b24ff76f67585c949582bb6ba69afd5ae0a.en: A conference by Sud Ouest on social housing on 25 November at La Salle des Fêtes in the Grand Parc. The theme will be announced a few weeks before.

55a9962c4296ed5f7a5ca1d320cc0699aac042bd.en: A general knowledge quiz at the Poney Fringant on Wednesday 25 November from 19:00 to 22:00, run with the Maison des Jeux.

2773121d15f111e366015180dc4f9a96f8b17cde.en: A literary meeting with feminist journalist Claire Alet at the Médiathèque Léopold Sédar Senghor on Wednesday 25 November at 19:30, about her book Matrice on the origins of male domination, from prehistory onwards.

c41bdf05969f412f42dd5f8b40603ab829a3363f.en: A solidarity concert at the Théâtre Fémina on Wednesday 25 November at 20:00 to mark 60 years of S.O.S Amitié Bordeaux Aquitaine, with Astrid Patay, Maximilien Wang and Christophe Malavoy. Tickets from 10 euros.

2fe6cb166606cac9c822eb9a70743a21737c3728.en: A monologue at the Salle Le Royal in Pessac in which a woman opens her bag and reveals the mechanisms of domestic violence, through everyday objects.

003cab23aa45f6aaf2552ae9e22c08901054e1ca.en: A one-woman show at the Salle du Royal in Pessac in which a woman opens her bag and reveals the mechanisms of domestic violence, through everyday objects, and calls for breaking the silence.

1306fdaf35ac344f1a5c1b43e15d63d93cb6e364.en: A stage adaptation of Nellie Bly's reporting, 10 Days in a Madhouse, at the Halle des Douves, about the investigative journalist who went undercover in an American asylum in the 1900s.

1896f564e7af7cf5e1f125f3d2e71876d0398f4d.en: A concert by Les Amazones d'Afrique at Le Rocher de Palmer, a band of singers Mamani Keïta, Oumou Sangaré and Mariam Doumbia that campaigns for gender equality. It closes the third Rendez-vous avec les Afriques day.

ddd621acda062d38ef0afe2f597567437129a6cb.en: A dance piece by Fauve Hautot and Romain Guillermic at Le Pin Galant, with nine dancers, presented by Compagnie Same But Different. It mixes personal stories and energetic group dance.

4be1b8e6fc179e828ca48bce38c3177a2ab8afe5.en: A concert by Ensemble Sillages at Le Rocher de Palmer, part of the MàD festival, with works by Philippe Hurel, Luciano Berio and others. It looks at how cultures change through exchange and reinterpretation.

9d06e1faa4a06783c4f89753b6c4874936cf553e.en: A screening at Les Colonnes of Un tiro cada uno by Laura Sbdar and Consuelo Iturraspe, about three basketball players who commit a femicide, played by three actresses.

955ac87fd894f3550daeab2cded1aa2a6b2cbb41.en: An improvised one-hour show at Improvidence Café-théâtre, in which the audience gives secrets to the Birdygala players to keep until the end of the show.

bfd511a698dd1bf0b9ed951032e800ec7f4ba823.en: A children's show from 3 to 8 at M 270 for school groups only, with humorous tales that stress sharing and conviviality.

0833ecdc5e7b6a2e077b678b2a03d0d3c12146c8.en: A press-cartoon workshop at the Local Maridor, in which participants analyse stereotypes and discrimination through cartoons, then create their own drawings. First session of a series.

95b7828848894ed4d43287f66bf074744be872fb.en: A walk-through workshop at Aquitaine Cap Métiers on jobs in the nautical industry, including a 3D serious game and five practical activities on boat building and maintenance.

61303b5dbe915b21fd72bd43c7b92714f56285c6.en: The Inventer Demain forum at the Hôtel de Ville in Bordeaux, a one-day village of social economy solutions on jobs, purchasing power and local links, with three participatory workshops.

b0523a259b3d4be581f4798d971eba45278ae613.en: A talk at the Musée des Beaux-Arts by Jean-Jacques Issouli on Théodore Gudin's painting of the Dutch ship Colombus and the rescue by the captain Desse of Bordeaux.

e2b333677edc7fa4c33ae284e3fbe6cf1cece69b.en: A workshop at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck on how internet cookies work, and how to accept, refuse or delete them to browse more safely.

94c268df23df76206f34551b8726eaeeac357728.en: A blood donation session at the Pôle Simone Veil from 15:00 to 19:00, by appointment online. Donors must be 18 to 70 years old (up to 65 for a first donation), weigh at least 50 kg, and a snack is offered after.

e923d2b6067bf5f75f398d1fcee4b4227cd52a1f.en: A talk at the Musée d'Aquitaine by Camille Barbe and David Diallo on the civil rights struggles of Black Americans and gender minorities in the United States from 1954 to 1968, through speeches and key figures.

60a50ce24efdc0f171b8b2811cebe71ab9d645c4.en: A dance performance by students of the Lycée Camille Jullian and the Bordeaux Conservatoire, after a visit on the theme of the body at the Galerie des Beaux-Arts. It is part of a conference on the body in wartime, 25 and 26 November.
