ffb4f33a5a51248f52c36c653f58e4a3acf1e8db.en: A children's show at the Halle des Douves on a birthday gift that worries a mother, questioning ideas about boys and girls. It includes music, an interactive exhibition and a discussion on cultural rights.

4709959007cd74550eb4f27e7205068ca51405b7.en: A play by the Glob Théâtre-linked company at the Maison des arts of Université Bordeaux Montaigne, about patients and doctors travelling to a utopian island. It is a collective work with people with disabilities and professional artists.

ea639a87b728e815e0aa90314d3db2968c2eba7f.en: A screening of Kurosawa's film Ikiru at the Hôtel Ragueneau, followed by a debate on whether old age can be a creative stage.

938116ab464c984a53387b5ec857d3227a1b4753.en: A performance at the Maison des Arts of the same piece, Au delà du bocal, by patients, doctors, people with disabilities and professional artists, on a journey to a utopian island.

28fda4e54ea072b5e55bda05f3cdff0607b2ee1d.en: An evening of performing arts against discrimination at Station Marne, with improvised theatre, gesticulated talks and music, organised by the University of Bordeaux.

515ab827d60763e90dc0d61876b759ef2de2f64f.en: A parents' café at the Médiathèque Léopold Sédar Senghor on Thursday 26 November at 18:30, on how to support children in the digital world, with psychologists and digital advisers.

950e3f3be37920a4dda56f60a41c13d004f9e2ae.en: An afterwork cognac tasting at La Cité du Vin, held for the museum's 10th anniversary, with three tastings and a cooper explaining the role of oak in ageing.

b8872f22cf34e6b34ea38cdc6c34a1b3bacd33aa.en: A round table on feminism and society at La Fraternité, covering education, politics, culture and work.

c3ff3358ceee79e7cb1598b33fda0a3615b0a683.en: A talk at the Musée des Arts décoratifs et du Design on the design of the museum's reception area, with a water bench made of glass blocks crafted by the Martell Foundation glassmakers.

22a5df3f4435395dde06e0f9607d7c401589812d.en: An exhibition by photographer Ken Wong-Youk-Hong at Le Garage Moderne, with the Compagnie du Risque's theatre piece about his work.

82309bd57cb78ad1bf9d474cd11a404a55d26af7.en: A discussion on differences and discrimination at La Passerelle, led by sociopalabrist Marième Diallo with young people from the association Ricochet, inspired by the palaver tree.

06f2dfbc486b593cf652c14c95deb596a65df10d.en: A piece by R.O.G.E.R. at the Dôme in Talence about the fairy tale Donkey Skin, in which two women investigate and break the silence on a subject often hidden. Co-organised with Iddac.

03ad1fc111bf2e855867a62cf9bcf00609565b07.en: A chamber recital at the Grand-Théâtre by harpist Anja Linder and violinist Laurent Korcia, with 19th and 20th-century music, part of the IMAGO festival.

e4220e62e0fcf4765bab154da9a541cdb5df570d.en: A symphony concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux with Tchaikovsky's Violin Concerto and Rachmaninov's Symphony No. 2. A lecture by Daniel Labarrere takes place on 24 November at 17:00.

87756975f5313e8d55c5224b9f6ac3d805c0d680.en: The sixth Afriques en vision film festival at the Cinéma Utopia in Bordeaux, from 26 to 30 November 2026, with films by new African filmmakers and rediscovered pioneers.

7827ee8fd7e484bf632d67c25956c59c887115e1.en: A dance piece at the Cuvier de Feydeau by amateur seniors, with a variety of bodies not trained for dance, about age, dreams and moving together.

843429e735114241c1293223e60a8ca74f884001.en: A piece by the Florada activities service and the Cypressat living home at the Cuvier de Feydeau, part of the equality fortnight.

1cc157ad61de63b8af7a35612fa38511709b15ad.en: A concert by Laura Ferré at Le Rocher de Palmer, singer of the songs Respire and Guérir de toi, who performs material from her EP Poupée Soldat.

78ca2cedfe112c3b54691c728c761c53629e8ddc.en: A concert by Pierre de Maere at Le Rocher de Palmer, a pop singer named best male newcomer at the 2023 Victoires de la Musique. He presents songs from his album, including Je pense à vous.

38baa00924891ffc35d7e9f79212a59d3ca0622e.en: A shredding service for green waste at Allée Jarrousse de Sillac, where residents can collect mulch on Wednesday 16 December from 13:00 to 17:30, after bringing branches up to 8 cm across.

0a99169bdb9878d3aaee66224af06e35eca6d98a.en: A café-debate and individual workshops at the Bibliothèque Bordeaux-Lac on discrimination linked to appearance and self-confidence, as part of the equality fortnight.

40956b988335824884c350a0ae8cfa642d894aef.en: A café-debate at the Bibliothèque Bordeaux-Lac on Friday 27 November from 10:00 to 17:00, on appearance and discrimination, led by two Bordeaux associations, with workshops in a solidarity beauty truck. For adults, on registration.

25f817ccde8722c4b0f41cc666efc4f7ace9db7c.en: The Bordeaux Christmas market at the Place des Quinconces, open every day from 11:00 to 21:00 through December, with stalls and activities run by the Bordeaux Mon Commerce association.

431a25b1a3450bacd9b027d806ad01acce390875.en: A second session of press-cartoon workshops at the Collège de l'Alouette, in which participants analyse stereotypes and discrimination in cartoons, then create their own drawings.

4c4b485dd161dd90db800c18e532e86ba8d1b80f.en: A performance at the Auditorium of the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul, made after months of residency at a care home. It offers a sensitive look at old age and at those who accompany it, lasts 1h15, and is followed by a talk.

d3b7098b0b0f1e1a39a38f53e0a1022eeba98469.en: A collective reading of Ahmed Hamila's book on LGBTQIA+ refugees and European migration policy, at the Hôtel Ragueneau. No prior knowledge is needed.

9ff433cd39a9c587a94e1ee8e7a49b197714b5bf.en: An intergenerational snack at the Salle Sainte-Barbe in Montferrand, offered by the town hall, with games and talks about gender stereotypes. Run with local clubs AS Montferrandaise Football and L'Atelier de la Danse.

07492bdc17ab0e9996f1c50fec49eb39f3ef1f95.en: A talk at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck by Mathilde Ambrosi and Nicolas Labarre on Donald Trump's presidency, its timeline of events and what it means for democracy, rights and social justice, after the midterm elections.

4c6ae772834eb130360b29a21cc4deaa32a99597.en: A sensory musical show for children and adults at Cinéma Les Colonnes, with original songs, gestures and rhythms, celebrating how a person grows in relation to self and others. Performed by Marie Gambaro and Alice Amanieu.

2d3c47a3c073838cf579f92a0f19a6fded8a2aed.en: An open-mic poetry evening at the Salle Sainte-Barbe in Montferrand, organised with the Maison de la Poésie de Bordeaux, exploring gender, identity and what it means to be a girl or a boy.

220f86d799b7e694e61e667834b0283b8fab2a32.en: A musical road trip by Orville Grant at the Médiathèque Castagnéra, told through 18 songs from California to Florida, across 15 states and more than 6,000 km, with a song or artist for each stage.

a684bd67d6fe8fc8d1f6320da5e87691396f6cc3.en: A meeting at the Bibliothèque municipale de Bègles with author Sushina Lagouje about her story of wanting to start a family and facing a series of obstacles as a disabled person.

573096399daa9034d7861b302ac055ca37d119b6.en: A talk on the graphic novel Ce n'est pas toi que j'attendais, based on the birth of the author's daughter with Down syndrome, undetected during pregnancy. It is followed by his later work on ULIS and AESH support staff.

46548f08271065437c049af464183dce7a730431.en: A film screening followed by debate at the Salle Léo Lagrange, showing Trop noire pour être française, a 52-minute film by Isabelle Boni-Claverie on racism in France through her family's history.

ddb256ad5de177968e1bf12ad88d8b8d138c1732.en: A parent and child event at the Maison des habitants d'Arlac on family roles, with children's drawings, a stereotypes wall, group talk and the closing of the exhibition Qui fait quoi à la maison?.

9c57b37d06b7a843f103f273ca70210a06d82530.en: A talk at the Bibliothèque François Mitterrand in Ambarès-et-Lagrave by Isciane de Saint-Marc-Labatut on Romanesque religious architecture, its spirituality, stone and light.

23b45c3c0cb057557b66362a52ba32ec15d15588.en: A mock lecture on feminism at the Hôtel Ragueneau, where a self-proclaimed expert on everything gives a short, participatory and humorous talk that exposes sexist discourse.

8c0a99b544c1f0bb2f16ce3ca2656aa7c37c381d.en: A comedy at the Théâtre Molière by Lucas and Julie, a couple who talk about everyday life and love with the audience taking part. Staged by Larra Mendy with Olivier Sir John and Laurence Ruatti.

18f8bc7939a2e7f6c3b0de95beda77eef49d7d0a.en: A concert of North African migration songs from 1930 to today, performed with traditional instruments at the Salle de la Glacière in Mérignac, presented by the Association des artistes marocains en France.

6b237b17cde56184fa1f64d63e36d720b0f387c0.en: A hip-hop night at the Bien Public, a festive evening of music and dance in hip-hop culture.

46ad8378d72ea9fc8e76c705d3abbc0b63890018.en: A play at the Glob Théâtre about two young women who reclaim their stories from oppressive love models and abuse, and from a world that does not see one of them as autistic.

cf255172c5ad704f9cacd93102a6111191906ace.en: A piano and theatre show by Pascal Pistone and Mathilde Chatin at L'Impromptu, which revisits Bach, Beethoven, Liszt, Debussy, Gershwin and Chaplin with sketches, dance and video. Runs 1h10.

db89f20700b411abfd777fe1a5096cb10eb212d1.en: A round table at the Salle Hélène Dubourdieu in Carré des Jalles on Friday 27 November at 20:00, ten years after the law against the prostitution system. Speakers include former deputy Maud Olivier and representatives of Scelles.

70bf6f3f7214db42e1395a0320a2c1faa9fc8984.en: A show at the Théâtre de l'Inox created with about ten women from the Maison d'Ella, combining writing, polyphonic reading, movement and visual arts around dresses that carry personal and collective memories.

b244eab0be199d4e703aecd44171a43a4895e2df.en: A documentary screening at Cinéma L'Étoile during the documentary film month, showing the series Des femmes dans l'espace, which tells the stories of women who shaped space exploration.

e6b1aba49d1f9a738735cfb7b58e7e77348931ae.en: An improv cabaret at the Poney Fringant on Friday 27 November from 20:00 to 22:00, performed by the troupe La Licoeur.

28c5e2a009070a50b9edb9c2ae6c21264afb9861.en: A concert by Florent Marchet at Le Rocher de Palmer, presenting his seventh studio album Mobil Home (2026), which turns to personal and everyday themes with piano, voice and later drums, guitars and brass.

c74e64d7eb557400d1f5cc410d27d8f12e77fa51.en: An interactive theatre session at the Salle Sainte-Barbe by the Compagnie Paradoxales on gender stereotypes, where the audience makes choices and influences the story.

93c684436add9caafb8fa6cfe344e6aa2a3f80cb.en: A concert by 2L at Le Rocher de Palmer, a rapper from the collective Le Secteur, presenting her EP Aria (2026), which mixes incisive lines with quiet, introspective moments.

57969d77453d83b7f1ccfa10fd44a70999757677.en: A concert by Feldup & The Showerheads at Le Rocher de Palmer, presenting Stared at from a Distance (2023), a frank testimony set to noisy and icy rock.

83930a8bc802054e403a937182c4d4844ad3d821.en: A circus variety show at Le Pin Galant, La Noce d'Alfonse, a kitsch and tender celebration of love with circus acts, live music and interaction with the audience. A couple from the audience is invited on stage.

156594887df55224893681d8de5c43e3085f0b4d.en: A club night at Bien Public from 23:55 to 06:00 on Friday 27 November, with Vitess and Grand V playing a long live set of house and techno. It is 18+ with ID required.

8e5037a40b56db472f185ae61f99f5cea842511b.en: A shredding service for green waste at the Parking du Château du diable, where residents can collect mulch on Saturday 12 December from 10:00 to 12:00 and from 14:00 to 16:00, after bringing branches up to 8 cm across.

25ddd1dcfc0d0d7c2ceed795871473c39d93b327.en: A parent and child workshop at the Maison de l'enfant et des parents on eating well and moving more together, free and run by the Maison Sport Santé in Bègles.

fb0630180318f7ed1d0b6bf146055b53a38dbe42.en: A day of choral singing at the Conservatoire de Bordeaux from 10:00 to 17:00, with conservatoire choirs and guest choirs, and the Chœur de Talents, a choir open to people who are working or looking for work.

eb00705ee67beb53802bc0ff1c8c92428a30f99f.en: The first Nuit de l'orientation at the Palais de la Bourse on Saturday 28 November, a free evening for young people, students and families to meet local employers and talk about industry careers. Registration on the website.

41522d0a19d4272a38cca696f700b50789d31799.en: A women's futsal tournament at the Cosec de Saige in Pessac, run by Pessac Football Club to encourage girls, especially from priority neighbourhoods, to take up sport.

cf7ba210b0e19199e3103073107826954927951b.en: The SINE industry and jobs fair at the Palais de la Bourse, with immersive activities, more than 400 job opportunities, workshops and talks, from internships to retraining.

670a7d3bcd655c8324e73e07b4b6445d340fe643.en: A café talk with psychologist Olivier Maye on gender stereotypes and how they shape our lives, relationships and upbringing. Open to all, at the Médiathèque in Montferrand.

728506e80293f38ed1a10c01ff27a3c811a7ed9d.en: A talk at the Médiathèque Carré des Jalles by Christophe Carreau, who spent 30 years on the ESA science programme, on the history of the Big Bang theory and the Planck satellite that detected the cosmic microwave background.

7bd934632ae39550351cebbe154f812829e59596.en: A manga club at the Bibliothèque Bordeaux-Lac, with the next session on Saturday 28 November from 10:30. For ages 11 and up, on registration with the librarians.

5a269ea02e1a05a8f763c9e3efec8783877db187.en: A café on comics, cinema and music at the Bibliothèque La Bastide, where librarians share their favourite picks. Free, without registration.

c956814efd774037461910b31c30281f6a71559a.en: A literary café at the Bibliothèque des Capucins with American author Eddy Harris, known for Mississippi Solo and Confession américaine. A second meeting is at the Librairie Le Passeur the same day at 14:30.

60eced030432f147b340b74d13b439cf6030cce0.en: A walk through the Saint-Bruno district of Bordeaux, between the Mériadeck slab and the Chartreuse cemetery, to look at its hidden architectural details. Based on the Musée d'Aquitaine agenda.

0088f89e07385268064aa33b16607531a8a0a695.en: A sports taster at the Médiathèque in Montferrand, with football, dance, boxing and twirling, to challenge ideas about sports for girls or boys. Run with local clubs.

5fdebeef1ce0751b92528fb332f31a209fcd3115.en: A shared meal at the Médiathèque in Montferrand to close the equality fortnight. Everyone brings a dish to share at one large table.

db2e7d18779fad9743d0ac7b14544305bc0be423.en: A sports, festive and civic day at the Amicale Laïque la Glacière, with taster sessions, demonstrations, two sports trails open to all levels and an evening meal. Partners include the Mérignac Maison des associations and Handisport Gironde.

4b77b0997db5b5da32d649aebc04a72478749cc6.en: A crime-fiction afternoon at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck with independent publishers from Nouvelle-Aquitaine, including masterclasses with author Yvan Robin and a children's mystery game at 15:00 and 16:30.

d1cc85e137d9a47b40c675e719034c6cebe8bcd6.en: A video gaming session at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul in Pessac, with a selection of games where dreams and imagination open the way to escape. Part of the L'Atelier des songes programme.

16f08e8a1d32ebe1844e1963d13051229d597ae1.en: A nature walk in Parempuyre to see birds, followed by a workshop making bird feeders to help small birds through winter's cold days. Registration required.

eda14800247eba9db218529b383ee4ac10431f15.en: A sewing workshop at the Bibliothèque Grand Parc, where participants learn the basics by making reusable make-up removal pads or a reusable kitchen towel.

bde403dacf055a75bfb4713a815b098cc16bec60.en: Creative workshops at the Hôtel Ragueneau for all generations, sharing skills and viewpoints on the issues of the world, in one afternoon of making things together.

0055315c81197f31e9e11a441fcd180fbdfce65c.en: A Wii Sports tournament at the Bibliothèque Capucins/Saint-Michel, a fun challenge for players of all levels.

1ba6b290ef79988a07e09165af32d03b21d6a971.en: A café-philo at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul on whether dreams are an escape from daily life or a source of inspiration, with booking. Part of the L'Atelier des songes programme.

8bbcc6943f77c4c6ea104af3498e0b7ba54780ab.en: A concert for pregnant women at the Auditorium, salle Sauguet, with short instrumental pieces to create a shared sound memory for babies and parents. Partners can attend on booking.

ee177eaa2b1b231f3cc3093ad17dc5f2432eb7f9.en: Creative family writing workshop at the Médiathèque Castagnéra on Saturday 28 November, where children and adults playfully 'sell' a close relative. For ages 7 and up.

121abeeb2bbe9d6298f5aa9af10c2bed73499004.en: A photo exhibition at the Salle Léo Lagrange in Lormont on living together, by Najwa Benchebab with theatre maker Loubna Edno-Boufar, linking photography, poetry and theatre on exile and difference. Runs 24 to 29 November.

83f79644c1c4dfd7a1578196a87dfe735efabde2.en: A conversation café at the Médiathèque Castagnéra where four volunteers lead conversation in German, English, Spanish and Italian. No need to be bilingual, but no French is allowed at the tables.

7a1b9c9bef867aeea79cb6fde1454d5fa17f6684.en: An artistic walk through the city centre at Place Pey Berland, with large silhouettes and poetic texts set to music, made by Bordeaux residents of all ages to question how bodies are seen. A gathering at the Hôtel Ragueneau follows.

d8b8ebf53edacba4176edfffb47c98363ac25e92.en: An exhibition at the Hôtel Ragueneau of photos from a family survey of Bordeaux streets, showing the city as children see it. It was made by Projet Luna and O'Bord du Jeu and shown at the closing ceremony of the Maison Commune.

49c104b7a2792fcfa08feb3d88d2dafdb5b7a443.en: A drawn musical reading at the Médiathèque La Source by Sébastien Laurier, about the dreams of residents and staff of a Bordeaux care home where his mother was a nurse. Performed by four artists.

5177b8bfe8b78dca6404f9516afb60c6192fb7da.en: A closing fashion event at the Hôtel Ragueneau for the equality fortnight, open to all: people bring a garment, help transform it, and walk the stage. The aim is to celebrate the variety of ways people live.

5452da010ae1d0c61e6ded376fe2533eefd144bf.en: A queer dance party at the Salle des Fêtes in the Grand Parc, the eighth Bal Queer. Bilal Hassani, Lynks, La Familips, Mahaut Drama and La Bordelle perform, with music until late.

d586335cf067fa3afd4f7b46b5a628079310b943.en: The eighth Bal Queer at the Salle des Fêtes in the Grand Parc, with a line-up that includes singer Bilal Hassani, electro-pop act Lynks and the DJ set of La Bordelle.

706b8d090c3d1084aef3c36ddfc5cb1814634613.en: A theatre diptych at Carré-Colonnes, Nom de code: Marichiweu, set in 2054 in a closed film studio where citizens perform plays about the Pinochet dictatorship in Chile. The two parts follow two cousins, one in Chile in 1978 and one in France in 1986.

3bc0d9d2ac99d5f40a6292e0c806f048af2a0610.en: A silent comedy film, Go West by Buster Keaton, with live piano and accordion by Pascal Pistone and Mathilde Chatin at L'Impromptu. A lost young drifter befriends a small cow; runs 1 hour.

2cad06eb7191a31c72b338d001917367a34d853e.en: A volleyball match at the Palais des Sports de Bordeaux on Saturday 28 November at 19:00, Saforelle VOLSTAR matchday 10, Les Burdis against Terville-Florange. Shop, bar and food on site.

4da02625a981778aa1b18776d8c7cee0c106535e.en: The Hecho en casa company's diptych Nom de code: Marichiweu at Le Carré, set in 2054 in a closed film studio under a totalitarian regime, with two plays about Chile under Pinochet and two cousins, one in Chile and one in exile in France.

46f5ce2d81b1e49215a1b7ea8a2b14ed51321116.en: A concert by pianist Shai Maestro at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, a jazz artist known for his work with bassist Avishai Cohen, presenting his album The Guesthouse, which mixes solo piano with strings, flutes and guitars.

609a0dbdc8b3c2761c1569eb89aafa07529889f1.en: A concert at Le Rocher de Palmer by the Ethnic Heritage Ensemble, led by Chicago percussionist Kahil El'Zabar, who reworks songs by McCoy Tyner and Miles Davis. Part of the Bons Baisers from the USA festival.

7cf48398f3e21a01f33dba77a26ed8798489b96b.en: A dance show at La Coupole, an ode to the dance floor, where the audience is seated around the dance floor. The clown DJ invites everyone to dance afterwards.

d6b95c3a8431c8033d377fe1c662b3f79ef7f843.en: A concert by Emma at Le Rocher de Palmer, with a support act, produced by Peel Productions and Veryshow Productions.

92158b9c76f1b358bed0a8ed07bd25885c8dbd5f.en: A one-man show by Rey Mendes at L'Estrade called La Source, a comedy about his path from the 1990s to fatherhood, with personal stories and observations on current affairs. Doors at 19:30, show at 20:30.

d29a8cb94c47b482bccf4b7e2ddda7192bf1f381.en: A concert by the Ethnic Heritage Ensemble at Le Rocher de Palmer with percussionist Kahil El'Zabar, plus Corey Wilkes, Alex Harding and Ishmael Ali. Presented as part of the Bons Baisers from the USA festival.

9cc10156d5e5612fa140fef3ce014882f59a5a81.en: A club night at L'Entrepôt in Bordeaux on Saturday 28 November from 00:00 to 06:30, with Maintrex, Mutant, Nordin Flanders, Octo Kraken and MC Partyneverdens. Under-16s are not admitted.

d57b2ea81e791dd6ba5d4e17702b64742ffd4dc4.en: A 30-hour club game across Paris and Bordeaux, the Club Sauvage Part 3, which ends at Bien Public in Bordeaux from 00:00 to 06:00 on Saturday 28 November, with a line-up of DJs and live acts.

f07701be807a11e7898ceffd6b5b023b0e15e00a.en: A children's clothing and toy sale at the Espace Rossetti in Bordeaux on Sunday 29 November from 10:00 to 17:00, with books, games, toys and clothes for children aged 0 to 14. Free entry; exhibitor stalls cost 15 euros.

f44caf96ac0a17c1aecd41a7e58fb0de93a014a0.en: A family visit to the Galerie des Beaux-Arts on Art Deco and Jean Dupas, looking at stylised forms and refined colours in drawing, painting and everyday objects.

63652fb838c5f75b473a7fe836040fa2da6a7ed3.en: A tango afternoon at Darwin Éco-système on Sunday 29 November, with beginners' lessons from 14:30 and a milonga from 15:30 to 19:00, led by Jorge Rodriguez.

97a8900325707723791e82db3d4ce1a1a10fc652.en: A talk at the CROUS Bordeaux on the Saint-Michel district, a lively area linked to its old port, crafts and religious communities, now being renovated in its public spaces and buildings.

a6e4edec8cfa9478ff10faeb7591d474b87f3147.en: A compost café at the Médiathèque de Camponac, which covers the basics of composting: where to place a bin, ingredients, the balance of green and brown materials and the role of small creatures.

2c2389f164e30637559089984a26e5311ecb5541.en: A piano recital by Arielle Beck at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, a pianist named Révélation soliste instrumentale at the 2026 Victoires de la Musique. The programme includes Beethoven's Pastoral Sonata, Mendelssohn, Chopin and Prokofiev.

6f2f75022b03059147d79f8c8548329de406e84c.en: An exhibition at the Jardin Public by Sylvain Gouraud, La nature des équilibres, based on fifteen years of work with farmers. It includes photographs, testimonies and a talk-show on the tensions between techniques and fragile balances.

0438400b0999827b1638f808389d9e244084c1ba.en: The Vinitech-Sifel trade fair for wine, fruit and vegetable growers at the Parc des Expositions in Bordeaux, from 1 to 3 December 2026. It has over 700 exhibitors and more than 70 talks on climate and agroecology.

0db1e3bbd0acbfddc878fa54f1eeccbc3ef19698.en: A workshop at the Ludo-médiathèque, pôle Simone Veil, on sustainable development through the history of chocolate, with a focus on social, environmental and water impacts in cocoa and a chocolate tasting.

0db50c03d1b9b5e9b4953040f611df929706936a.en: A Spanish-language film screening at the Médiathèque Castagnéra on Tuesdays, with films chosen by the librarians. The scheduled dates include 1 December in Spanish.

e1700959bb869c2a57e27486f93544656a508347.en: A talk at La Cité du Vin on the Ancien Régime, when the French monarchy tried to control vine planting to protect grain fields. It covers the tensions between regulation, public interest and local producers.

0855b5b860e0a0f2a3d380b445dc06a4aa55b4dc.en: A play at the tnba by Julien Villa, the last part of his trilogy on modern Don Quixotes, about teenagers in the 1990s who find their place through rap in a Montpellier estate. Performed with two young actors and a musician.

0629c04770bdf1bd5ec6a7f9d4f12c14b72cebf7.en: A solo show at the Théâtre Fémina by Matthieu Nina, who became disabled after a fall at age 10 and returns to the stage 25 years later, about access and inclusion.

d3d9647b05e86fc1f703e02be72b51ccbdf279dd.en: A dance performance by Xie Xin's Xiexin Dance Theatre at Le Pin Galant, In Satie & The Rite of Spring, a diptych blending Erik Satie's music with Stravinsky's Rite of Spring, created after a 2023 fire at their studios.

30081d8394a498801dda5c2d5dd217ba9cb96dad.en: A blood donation day at the Grand-Théâtre with musicians and dancers from the Opera and students of the Conservatoire, working with the EFS.

fdd28eadee01320731e882abc573808b68c5da10.en: The fourth Sommet Agroécologie Bordeaux on Wednesday 2 December 2026, held within the Vinitech-Sifel fair at Palais 2 of the Parc des Expositions. It has 20 talks and round tables with 34 speakers.

a3a9bdb25cfe2186e95d441d013dcd4b015e25aa.en: A sensory visit and hands-on art workshop at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux for sighted and blind or partially sighted visitors.

f731211e5b63e559b5a7727dfd94a62decc0b4b5.en: A family reading session for children aged 0 to 3 at the Médiathèque Gabriela Mistral, followed by breakfast with tea, coffee and small cakes.

384d155b4f9dc40a7560bd87eb587c206a3f5668.en: A workshop in Blanquefort on ways to help birds during winter. The location is shared on registration.

d09aebc169a4875b08876f9e2eab0c474c230243.en: A music-and-story session for children aged 3 to 6 and their parents at the conservatoire library, on Wednesday 2 December at 15:00, featuring the tuba and a mini-concert by conservatoire students. It lasts half an hour.

694c7b7b2bd62cbfb2caf765be7b8f0739702b26.en: A pastel workshop at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux where participants look at birds in the museum's works and then scribble colours over a picture.

bc6e061771bfeafba4d0715077015b5bb53168d4.en: A parent and child reading and writing workshop on Turkish folk tales at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul in Pessac, with sessions for ages 3 to 6 and 7 to 10. Booking required.

3398a16a64efb660778f94811c580ef3446c08c9.en: An interactive fiction session at the Médiathèque Carré des Jalles auditorium, where the audience cooperates to move the story forward.

d80386f8f69d52782cecc4271474804140f2adf2.en: A guided visit of the Musée d'Aquitaine exhibition Une escale à Bordeaux, adapted for blind and partially sighted visitors, with touch through a materials library and models of Bordeaux houses.

5f0815f3e624e19f98293eb5a2a6141005430112.en: A talk at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul by Sinan Bertrand, a Franco-Turkish actor in Trésor national, and director Victoire Berger-Perrin, on Turkey's recent history and the tensions in its contemporary society. Booking required.

0e3ee2935395c61d7267417662546ef9c7d45230.en: Kino Session 78 at Cinéma La Lanterne in Bègles on Wednesday 2 December at 20:00. Twenty short films made in two months by teams with the theme Surprise and the constraint of a 360-degree pan, followed by a public vote. Tickets are 5 euros, 2.50 euros reduced.

7bed3ab6b3f3245813313020d92aa5bd98d154ad.en: A concert at the Salle des Fêtes in the Grand Parc, where the orchestra musicians join the audience afterwards. The bassoon is the star, in a Rossini concerto, alongside Mozart and Haydn's Symphony No. 102.

ec153f9d424881f71fb664b074d8e51af014ab57.en: A comedy at the Théâtre Molière by Xavier Viton, set in a luxury clothing house where a young heir discovers he is married to someone else. Family tensions and misunderstandings follow.

b54b45dd1b1339f2d9747279e7694ad0d5c4e730.en: A play at La Matière written and directed by Vincent Toujas, a detective story about a Nobel-winning physicist found dead at the LHC. It is about the Higgs boson and is for ages 12 and up.

c298c262512d9bc5563b76448148f24736af9a9d.en: A talk and book signing with Sylvain Tesson at Le Pin Galant about his book Les piliers de la mer, on sea pillars around the world, from Tasmania to Étretat, and on travel and freedom.

d03edabf666e5b7f6c1fe9c1c516b6067234cbaa.en: An exhibition-like display at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul in Pessac by illustrator Christian Voltz, with reworked objects, odd sculptures and a playful bric-à-brac, part of the festival Sur un petit nuage.

11fa8e628f050c5b70c130663419cf470bf0804e.en: A talk at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux by Grégory Michel, a professor of psychopathology, on Fleury Richard's painting of Tasso in prison visited by Montaigne.

12c8bce0a9460fae3b49517f4d85b3b277b38295.en: A museum visit in French Sign Language at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux, for the International Day of Persons with Disabilities, with an interpreter.

a932b2b130b2cf68f5f733272aa8cdf0321f00de.en: A wine and food tasting at La Cité du Vin with produce from Nouvelle-Aquitaine, in partnership with the regional food agency, and three products paired with wines. Two sessions, at 18:30 and 20:30.

4518b555a437fc81ba53e94b7d0d5436e9eb2d91.en: A theatre show by Compagnie Toujours Là at La Matière about an AI-driven robotics company whose machines collect data on people's feelings and desires. It is set in a near future.

12f976656a7238c709f180f4a1be38285159e926.en: A comedy-detective show at Théâtre Trianon, La Méthode Sherlock, where the audience helps Scotland Yard and mentalist Sebastien Harris solve a case involving Moriarty.

9bd4db2351519e4492d1dbe1e4a5b13bc2c80faf.en: A dance piece at Pôle Culturel Évasion by Anne Nguyen's company Cie par Terre, Promenade obligatoire, for eight popping dancers exploring ways of being together.

4cd268c0bafed0a79234fc9fe33bfc76a943d2d3.en: A show by the association Rénovation and Persona at Le Cuvier de Feydeau, Peter Pan, part of the equality fortnight.

78e87c9a30b1ae06e9f0295b45842ae439eef094.en: A show at Le Pin Galant by Raphaël, Karaoké, in which the singer tries to sing and an AI guides him through songs, memories and fears, with four musicians and an actress.

d6e8f418104222f18ecb05e11f7b332539369a89.en: A residency showing at Colonnes on 3 December, with two Moroccan artists, Achraf Chadli and Salmane Mohamed Bougari, sharing a work in progress titled Nafs Lawama.

eb1a9d7abf068c45be70f8cbf3aaac9a4abbd7ac.en: A live electronic set by PACT at Le Rocher de Palmer, a trio of producers who fuse their styles and let the audience take part in the performance. They present their single Unify (2026).

ab56fbfc08ec9893cca19e11ca1ec6c85277cd96.en: A dub concert at Le Rocher de Palmer by Mad Professor, a sound engineer and producer behind Ariwa, presenting Armageddon with Sister Nancy. A documentary screening follows on 3 December at 18:00 at Cinéma Utopia.

c42d584abf54384750dca3ed5f9f962aaeac59e2.en: A concert at the Krakatoa by Belgian singer Mentissa, who presents a dance-pop single, La vie qu'on mène, after a TV talent show final.

a081f72afd2f71400551c6d88ba9fc6ca8ab275b.en: A concert at Le Rocher de Palmer by Coeur de Pirate, the stage name of Béatrice Martin, presenting her seventh album, Cavale (2025), with piano ballads and 1980s-style synth dance numbers.

76be29d40b8d4a4ed91f65faf0e029f72a6c9c95.en: The annual meeting of the Société Française de Biologie Clinique at the Palais de la Bourse on 4 December 2026, in person, for laboratory and health technology professionals.

bb13ff183457ba79f435ed6af9ce4766263c40ab.en: A slideshow at the Médiathèque Léopold Sédar Senghor on Andy Warhol's drawn work, based on the exhibition Andy Warhol, la ligne et l'image at the Musée du Luxembourg, which runs to 10 January 2027.

60f1dfc2b2626419bb97876fa6d73dcfda0f6ded.en: A children's show at the Médiathèque Castagnéra about Santa's workshop in a panic, where the elves are late and children help to put things right.

2dbe52d6a7cf0d85f5e670a467d3718585dce97a.en: A wreath-making workshop at the Bibliothèque François Mitterrand in Ambarès-et-Lagrave, where participants make a flower wreath with plants provided and take it home.

c9ccd8af02c29d5e6ec642505492e1dc67b705e2.en: A wine evening at La Cité du Vin on Bolivian wines from high-altitude vineyards in Cinti and Tarija, with four wines tasted and folk dances. In partnership with the Bolivian wine association ANIV.

e0e4bf6633376b902c1d9322afca79be60d900a0.en: A games evening at the Ludo-médiathèque, pôle Simone Veil, with board games, video game tournaments, cakes and coffee, including a Christmas games night.

f83cd86f4750d3a62a29488aa7cff29668e5c9c3.en: A concert at L'Inconnue by the Belgian duo Doodseskader, mixing grunge, hip-hop, electronic and industrial sounds, with a support set by Youssef Futur, a cyberpunk and industrial metal artist.

522eac6448a61fba1ffb59fccf62ef541305e7c8.en: A concert by Nous Étions une Armée at Lieu Chéri on 4 December 2026. The duo presents their first album, mais le ciel est sublime (October 2025), with guitars, drum machines and spoken-sung vocals.

1490dbd084fde171d1fae35e219861e555e150c2.en: A concert by BEN PLG at the Krakatoa in Bordeaux.

dd8f182307a5ce42e8d0e3e737c7d01a1038dd2a.en: A stand-up show by D'jal at Le Pin Galant, called En pleine conscience, with his recurring characters and absurd situations.

5995a3e50145c8fa4e0653a7ea216ad6fe9596c1.en: A Beatles tribute by The Lonely Hearts Club Band at Sortie 13 on 4 December 2026, a second date added after the first sold out. The group combines Krazolta from Bordeaux and Saults from London.

c66c9c01abfaacadc44a59c870e701e603cb9a25.en: A family exhibition on trees and forests at the Maison de la nature in Gradignan.

5b9d1b2a77d66b5225eb18f81328d0e50ba1a31d.en: A workshop at the Écosite du Bourgailh in Pessac on Saturday 5 December from 10:00 to 12:00, on trees and shrubs in the garden, invasive species, and the European hedgehog. Organised with Koncilio.

1e2d1316c3953cd135f5a968b07939b0dacfefc3.en: A drawn talk by Christian Voltz at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul in Pessac on how he creates a story and a character, followed by a book signing with Encre blanche. Booking required.

490d44643ccce180677723bd25c3b9e33bb1cdf5.en: A beginner workshop on the Cricut cutting machine at the Médiathèque Carré des Jalles, to learn the basics and start turning ideas into creations.

488ef911e80da42512c3c7957fc51d842833c6b2.en: A monthly reading session for children and families at the Bibliothèque François Mitterrand in Ambarès-et-Lagrave, with picture books, nursery rhymes and voice games. It takes place on the first Saturday of each month.

d9cdf34620afdcd5108ffe774f466e7221a4bc65.en: A short talk at the Médiathèque Castagnéra on scams and cyberattacks, in a small-group session on digital tools and practices.

13b6936c57c9ef5aef2aaa1b1fc9b846dbd7bfde.en: A reading and play session for children aged 0 to 3 at the Bibliothèque La Bastide, with nursery rhymes and finger games around a reading mat. Registration required.

86661b22c3887a933de53614ba6ba867c6b2d28e.en: A card-making workshop at the Médiathèque Gabriela Mistral to make a New Year greeting card.

67e582c0682e0e09043cf922c6600a2ddd373dc1.en: A literary café at the Médiathèque Castagnéra where librarians share reading picks, from new releases to personal favourites.

c007e6de411a45d2cbc50f27057b2e88579480d7.en: A tea and coffee session at the Bibliothèque Grand Parc to discover new novels and favourites with a librarian.

df5011707435f9e7774200c912b3a5e78012cbba.en: An exhibition of nine painters and sculptors from the Dites 333 collective at the Salle capitulaire Mably, from 5 to 20 December 2026, with figurative and abstract work in wood, paper, ceramics, metal and reworked furniture. Opening on 5 December at 19:00.

65d96b600223739c810a63bf50b03b9559fb5ed8.en: A visit at the CAPC led by a mediator, in which participants work together on a collective manifesto for a more accessible museum. Part of Bordeaux culture accessible week.

fe543e35d901d01a6de20b63829f911670278089.en: A walk along the Jalles and the Garonne at Parempuyre's Port de Lagrange, exploring the port's history and industrial plans. The starting point is shared on registration.

7f0e28c2c48ef90f0a298f42a617f8a569471676.en: A clay modelling workshop at the atelier Citrouille, where participants make a clay mask inspired by African, Polynesian and Asian masks and paint it with natural colours. No firing needed.

7b0a7ffd4d91bb872227171141a47933a8dfdd1a.en: A tree identification walk in Saint-Médard-en-Jalles, with a recognition rally, magnifying-glass observation and leaf prints. The starting point is shared on registration.

f55276ac8ec0485b7dd58c581e73ee3959537704.en: A plant-dye workshop at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck, where participants extract pigments from spring flowers, fruit and vegetables and make a colour chart. They take home their creation and a tutorial.

00a044e1fcf42c22fb928a728af4cbd9c309f582.en: A children's show by Cirque en Scène at Le Carré on the sea, with acrobatics, comedy, rainbow buoys and an underwater exploration, ending with a splash.

4cf75017ff12d38b807b6a452a2ccd4b6e6a81dd.en: A giant dictation at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux, written by Bordeaux author Guy Rechenmann and read by Monique Dollin du Fresnel. It is part of the Jean Dupas & Co. exhibition and includes prizes.

dcbfc23c7226a5e2f4936468e6de9315e1df5afa.en: A 19th-century costume ball at the Musée national des douanes on Saturday 5 December from 18:30 to 21:30, marking the centenary of Monet's death. Two dance workshops take place on 18 and 25 November.

48804bc712a8c6223dfc0cad1bc8560f6e5fa558.en: A piano recital by Lang Lang at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, with Beethoven's Pathétique sonata and Op. 110, Albéniz and Liszt. He returns after his 2024 concert in Bordeaux.

a2637003979afd9f850dd9828cc25c300bb20a30.en: A chamber concert at the Musée Mer Marine, linking Monet's painting Vue d'Étretat with music by Ropartz, Chausson and Debussy for cello and piano. Performed by Alexis Descharmes and Jean-Philippe Guillo.

f02b71a8ead7b7f5cafca4b0d47d31eb2c17d108.en: A concert by La Ruda, a ska-punk band formed in 1993 in Saumur, at the Salle des Fêtes in the Grand Parc, with Resaka Sonora in support. Standing room only; doors open at 19:30.

a29622e7d1a6575610d1183c55e63512e09e6f43.en: A concert by La Ruda, a ska-punk band formed in 1993 in Saumur, with more than 1,000 concerts and tours across Europe, Canada, China and Japan. Presented at the Salle des Fêtes in the Grand Parc.

78738d76c5f54475de16562bdb7213caf9a0206d.en: Mozart's The Magic Flute by the Opera 2001 company at Le Pin Galant. Prince Tamino seeks Pamina, held by Sarastro, with a magic flute from the Queen of the Night. The opera celebrates virtue, forgiveness and love as a guide.

7048bfff76fd9bf80f1233f88a853b643e431d73.en: A concert by Wamen at the Rock School Barbey, a Franco-Cameroonian singer named after her grandmother. Her songs tell of broken love and of sexism, including the anthem Discipline.

c070760023b9bbff6da5aec6a1b860b4ad706bde.en: A double bill at Sortie 13: Electric Jaguar Baby, a heavy-fuzz power duo from Paris with more than 200 gigs, and Kubota, a Bordeaux heavy indie rock band. Doors at 19:00 and concert at 20:30.

66315a73a19f1c56b07ed1041b4a8f8599d23a71.en: A children's musical tale at the Château Théâtre Descas, Le Roi des magiciens, about young Wolfie in Salzburg, who waits for his Christmas present while telling tales of dragons and mice. A magic workshop comes first, with a snack for children afterwards.

b9b6be466dfe01a973ceca2d721ecf2dc591a65e.en: A children's show from age 5 at the Médiathèque Jean Vautrin in Gradignan, with tales of mischievous hairy creatures.

7114e98b116478b14a01ff365855e01f76b57955.en: Free entry to the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux on Sunday 6 December from 11:00 to 18:00, to see the Passions Collections display and the permanent collections.

427bf727e91db6a11810b169fd1f7eecb8ddaace.en: A bookbinding craft workshop at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul in Pessac, decorating the edges of books with marbled or patterned colours. Participants bring a large-format book. Booking required.

c35f56d9c89b96ad4de2f803ec2888c73e7f2ffb.en: A sensory visit at the Musée des Arts décoratifs et du Design, to explore glass and ceramics through looking, touching and listening, linked to the exhibition.

e062fa80bd96ee3f56ac87f95b7a85cff23e49e4.en: A student showcase at the Conservatoire's Atelier in Bordeaux, a concert and informal exchange with the audience, featuring students from interpretation, sound creation, composition and electronic music.

12c3516dd4de87577ab1e190e163e5767cb4a5f0.en: A concert by the Québec band Lendemain de veille at the Rock School Barbey on 7 December 2026 at 21:00, with doors at 20:30. The country and neo-trad group has played over 1,000 shows.

5b6664ce51da857e89fb6fa0e45044caa6b3c60a.en: A music tapestry for children at the Médiathèque Gabriela Mistral, a play mat that introduces classical music in a playful way.

fcaa1b0e17384713391e0c16bd470b89108f8112.en: A Tuesday music talk at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck, organised with the seniors department of the CCAS.

71c2c9c7580995aec288d61990809f6c456b174b.en: A closing event of the equality fortnight at the Centre social Unire in Floirac, with four cooking workshops and a disco soup evening with seasonal soups from around the world, readings and a disco dance.

da47c6e77b3e9c86a54ecf26ae409cc642784c42.en: A Tuesday film session in French at the Médiathèque Castagnéra, with comedy, crime and drama films picked by librarians. The French-language dates include 8 December.

5e61e923177225bdee455de556a693501378bfd9.en: A relaxed dictation session at the Médiathèque Castagnéra, with no marking and no red pen.

cb9f3465a1202fe74ce49b4ea007944db2cc399a.en: A dance piece by Chilean choreographer Marcela Santander Corvalán at the Maison des arts in Pessac, Agwuas, the second part of her trilogy on the elements, centred on water. Accompanied by a musician and a choir, with a masterclass on 7 December.

60b31895b73e7fcc9ca2489b6931a9ae76954531.en: A performance at the tnba by Jeanne Balibar of a text about a walk through the Sicilian countryside, led by a goat named Miss Coco, meeting an old woman, Signora Rosa. It touches on nature, tourism and fires.

f97cbe338d8f4790996382aaa851c2718163a05a.en: A jazz concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux by the Belmondo brothers, playing famous film themes by Morricone, Delerue, Misraki and Chet Baker.

2d0fb760bcd8aad2553ef9fdd127295e0e735f73.en: A jazz and popular music concert at Le Pas de Lune, the second in the Moonlight Sessions series. The conservatoire's four ensembles present their work, with five dates across the 2026-2027 season.

c0d3b0170c51ff390bf76dc434217cf76b048ffe.en: A comedy show at Le Pin Galant by Arnaud Ducret and Maxime d'Aboville, Cochons d'Inde, by Sébastien Thiéry. A bank customer is blocked from withdrawing his money and trapped in an absurd, bureaucratic nightmare.

09582098eaa6c09be6c66c6a274bbfc0f24e3e01.en: A craft workshop at the Médiathèque Carré des Jalles, making festive geek-culture characters with iron-on beads.

1eebf371796328526489e0f03e84bd2eeb8461ab.en: A session at Sésame to install Linux Mint on participants' computers, to leave with a free, smooth system that respects their data.

1cb97a6a5811bafa5418fecf56f83bfcc1b29e0d.en: A video editing workshop for children aged 6 to 12 at the Bibliothèque La Bastide, using a collaborative mash-up table. Ages 8 and up, on registration.

9423958ee3f58811c83ef6b67879a49bb9b2b507.en: A participatory planting day at Bois Sourreil, where residents plant a rural hedge, learn about hedges for biodiversity and get their hands dirty. Bring gloves and sturdy shoes.

073f42e03a4783cb38c4d11b9bfb263b2f5ec947.en: A solo show for children at the tnba by Lionel Dray and Clémence Jeanguillaume, Olalaland, which mixes dadaist collage, wordless music and drawing on a large screen, inspired by Keaton and Tati.

3cd0e8782016a5850658e80fb1f95eeb33a8c20b.en: An intergenerational drawing class at the seniors' centre La Lumineuse, based on classic works from the Musée des Beaux-Arts, organised with the association ZéLI. From age 3.

8eb3a01306b1d14e3cbc635765240e7145489b21.en: An evening visit to the Réserve écologique des Barails in Bordeaux to see the largest heron roost in the metropolitan area, with hundreds of egrets and other herons arriving at nightfall.

084c088b973d6ced7f18119eed5d4cd545c1663f.en: An improvised show at the Médiathèque Carré des Jalles by the company La souris grise, which discusses screen use with humour, without guilt or moralising. It is for the whole family.

76c92f6c2e83169614ee8dfecdf012e6f9a98b33.en: A theatre piece at the Salle des Fêtes in the Grand Parc by Le Lien Théâtre, Le dos au mur, about men who commit domestic violence, following their path through the courts and asking whether they can change.

86a491f145c1dffc93edbb26ed649294ea476a2c.en: A new production of Swan Lake at the Grand-Théâtre, choreographed by Rachel Beaujean and Colin Richmond, in which Odette chooses her own fate. Co-produced with Northern Ballet and the Opéra National de Bordeaux.

e982e1244e0efd68c26cf69c76a4134f916bf780.en: A sign-language show at Colonnes, Papillons, set in 2068, where ecology, inclusion and feminism are taken for granted. It mixes theatre, sign language, Sufi dance, opera and poetry. Meetings with the artists follow each sign-language performance.

43912421e9bc5ba7d1b9a523c3e76a71170ded2d.en: A talk at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux by Jean-Jacques Issouli, a classical literature teacher, on Titian's painting The Penitent Magdalene.

5e1e9ff3100667fa7b0c98029061ebd009360a62.en: A behind-the-scenes meeting at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux with the museum's staff, to learn about jobs that keep the collections alive and ask questions.

28e90fea7c44dfe50113f3f6264306c5e841c68f.en: A tasting evening at La Cité du Vin with caviar from the Bordeaux-area house Sturia and three caviar and wine pairings chosen by sommeliers. Two sessions at 18:30 and 20:30.

99eeb11c5f6fb1765743265165370c068aed6c64.en: A concert at L'Inconnue by Endless Floods, an ambient band whose EP Passages explores thresholds between what ends and what begins, with a support set by Amelia Tabeï, who plays with continuous breath.

345cb065bffd63ff5084fd6d48884ad9b443c32e.en: Two concerts at the Krakatoa in Mérignac on 10 and 11 December 2026, Luther and Rounhaa, as a pack offer of the Sublime Tour.

41f7882e29c1c590a56e6984a8c85fff77dba829.en: A concert by Magma at Le Rocher de Palmer, the French band formed in 1969 with Christian Vander on drums, playing Zeuhl Kommandöh in a stripped-down, electric set.

9c0a1553ce70ecf5fb9434ed7b84f20a72429bda.en: A stand-up show by Paul de Saint Sernin at Le Pin Galant, seen on France 2's Quelle époque., in which he talks about humiliation at school and an emotional period in his life, mixing humour and feeling.

ab62f2eee44a97902e7f776d2980174da4cdb6c6.en: A DJ set at Bien Public as part of the Sublime Tour, for 18-year-olds and over only, on 10 December 2026.

f231394046aab47aa536e8705af447bf934f6e35.en: An exhibition at the Musée des Arts décoratifs et du Design on preppers and neo-survivalists, and the design objects, infrastructures and systems they create to prepare for crises.

e786305e01df42b683b7b3738c0a31a44d2fd94c.en: A family visit at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux for grandparents, for an hour of tips on answering children's questions about the works. Sessions on 26 June, 15 October and 18 December at 11:00.

b413189d27a0c72061a5f4c39b83d6086f13cf1b.en: A museum visit at the Musée d'Aquitaine on the medieval bestiary, exploring the symbolic meaning of animals in the museum's medieval collections.

ffdc9a1921292305b39cf6a27081c428802dd3ad.en: A history talk at La ManuCo about the lesser-known stories of the people behind the revolution of 1789, led by the association Faits de Coeur's.

7cd1ea77c18487557f64114405b1b7af88bbac1d.en: A study day and debate at La Cité du Vin on how wine is talked about, between institutional messages and social media. It is run with the Master in vine and wine law and the ISVV.

78c448502854071f145f4e3b0c4ba44570c3c1e7.en: Five short plays at the Glob Théâtre inspired by Samuel Beckett, by five playwrights, first staged in London in 2024 and now shown in Bordeaux. They explore Irish identity.

e6a1d72ae2c15c5ca8d6fbd698d19f5bc0a5b203.en: A screening at the Carré des Jalles media library of rare 1980 footage of Gilbert Bécaud, singing some of his songs with guests, including duets.

f9175b49ad3cfaee6addd7d62cbc6bc4e1696c10.en: A cut-and-paste greeting-card workshop at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux, using the works on show as inspiration. Another date is held on 17 December at the Bibliothèque Jean de La Ville de Mirmont.

9f387cc09eb45e948c0236f105355c551621eecc.en: A concert series at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck with students and teachers of the conservatoire, on Mozart's The Magic Flute, as part of the classics series.

531ef4c41adcceb03a0838ba71a0478391688111.en: A talk at the Carré des Jalles media library by Jean-Charles Bouniol, a lecturer at the Bordeaux journalism institute, on media education, sources and information literacy.

8c0ead0c83a63d5f960311460d52d2ab8effb71e.en: A concert by Rounhaa at the Krakatoa in Mérignac as part of the Sublime Tour, which runs over two days with three events, including a Luther live set and a Sublime Club night for over-18s.

da7db69139281ff0dc94b77724d5a0b8fcbfb0f7.en: A concert by Mica Millar at Le Rocher de Palmer, a British soul singer whose second album, A Little Bit of Me, is a more personal record after a serious accident.

b6080be59090240f62eb5e0e00d61c67cb4a7905.en: A concert by Sniper at Le Rocher de Palmer, the French rap group from 1997, now on tour as a duo with Aketo and Tunisiano, playing classics and new songs.

17fea1417f1f96f211dc5ab9697efc450b448744.en: A contemporary dance workshop at Station Marne on Saturday 12 December from 10:00 to 13:00, led by Suzanne Henry, combining gentle yoga, breathing and guided improvisation. Part of the Rebonds series.

358afe789ff7f4fc06de638d36620efe8100f3b2.en: A pop-up card workshop at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck, where participants make a pop-up Christmas card and take home a tutorial.

2068f2f1518f3be7601744b1fc329fe609d4feba.en: The Père Noël des motards motorbike ride for children at Pellegrin hospital, with a new toy from each rider, held at the car parks PE and PF of the Parc des Expositions. The procession starts at 14:30.

3be342a96cb87e118ec8522a379fd2b47445527d.en: A monthly chess session at the Bibliothèque Flora Tristan for all levels, with puzzles, quick 10-minute games and blitz, with a hot drink and cakes.

6366f584fb5a1149d0a73d210e831a722018b789.en: The Bordeaux Tasting wine event at the Palais de la Bourse on 12 and 13 December 2026, its 15th edition, with more than 100 winegrowers, tastings of classified growths and masterclasses.

671481c422f8d5d78ef0ab399d34c16bdb7b7f53.en: The Musée Mer Marine Christmas market, with about 30 makers, food trucks, a raffle and workshops, plus a show, Les Fables de Madame Jeanne, in which La Fontaine's animals come to a party at a café.

480e985a7da7498a6c59f89a21be733eba8984b1.en: A children's story about a small figure waiting for a Christmas present that is slow to arrive, at the Ludo-médiathèque, pôle Simone Veil, about how the smallest gifts can matter most.

e584496bf94ea426209eb7b5e68ded6b873e4eb5.en: A monthly book-sharing session at the Bibliothèque François Mitterrand in Ambarès-et-Lagrave, where librarians and readers share recent acquisitions and favourite books, novels, comics and life stories.

e0733ce57784130a6c79a7a2a22c2efc3d080ab0.en: A gardening workshop at the Maison écocitoyenne in Le Haillan on Saturday 12 December from 14:00 to 16:00, run by Écosite du Bourgailh with Koncilio. It covers trees and shrubs, invasive species and the European hedgehog.

9afa08dcc954663253738af7493904addd0c1ba3.en: Two baroque concerts at the Atelier du Conservatoire de Bordeaux, at 14:00 and 16:00, with chamber groups playing 17th and 18th-century works by Bach, Rebel and Capricornus on period instruments.

bea0d95397b400b0f0fb02d46fb752ac7145216c.en: A pop-up card workshop at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck, where participants make a pop-up Christmas card and take home a tutorial.

f3eccf826e657e1b9f89abe99b1ca9fb716d927b.en: A family musical at Le Pin Galant, an adaptation of Andersen's The Little Match Girl, in which Emma enters a fantasy kingdom to save her grandmother from the villain Fragotov.

b6813eb6e611e518d49b47892d7ea70718df0fad.en: A costume dance party at the Bibliothèque Bordeaux-Lac on Saturday 12 December from 15:00, where children and families dance dressed as their favourite heroine or hero. For ages 3 and up, on registration.

b84c0309bf3d2542753bb3747d09cb52c026a324.en: An expert visit of the exhibition We will survive at the Musée des Arts décoratifs et du Design, with Étienne Tornier, looking at how designers shape objects and systems for surviving crises.

fbbbae056f4d89689999ae27626dde5192451fe9.en: A concert at the Musée national des douanes on Saturday 12 December at 15:00 with Pakistani rubab and sarod player Waseem Sahki, who blends traditional music with sound design.

b9e608f5cc343ad65b832ca758fe9933a5b37022.en: A young adult book club at the Bibliothèque Flora Tristan on Saturday 12 December from 16:00 to 17:30, where participants share the book that moved them most in 2026.

d9a67fc898e2c305866eea2e5c515cc97a004bc6.en: A volleyball match at the Palais des Sports in Bordeaux on Saturday 12 December at 19:00, Saforelle VOLSTAR matchday 12, Les Burdis against Béziers Angels.

704b07175ef96c25ca8d6d883c96d038351fe44e.en: A superhero-themed popular dance night at the Salle des Fêtes in the Grand Parc, with a costume and make-up area, a heroic karaoke, a concert, a costume contest and circus and burlesque shows.

00676d6750a8431ef3344f2df15fc0db590d091b.en: A death metal concert at Sortie 13 on 12 December with Tempt Fate from Toulouse and Sickmind from Bordeaux, plus Altered Shade, presented by Red Water Production.

eabbce4ff456b4884627b9a22b97cfc16e077e54.en: A punk, rap and electro show by Krav Boca at the Rock School Barbey, with a support set by Rotofil Khonäar and Zetkin. The show includes masked rappers and aerial acrobatics.

aaffde42538fdd8a6770e31f0a029ed7aa209610.en: A two-hour private family visit to the Musée des Arts décoratifs et du Design for children under 12 and their families.

be7c642817954b00bda135793c232b14ec9019dd.en: A performance of Mary Poppins at La Pergola, a musical adaptation of the Pamela Travers novel, directed by Loïc Labaste. It lasts 45 minutes and is for ages 5 and up.

2b02e57b1def09ae54f138a04b085e155a90d6bf.en: A monthly film club at the Salle des Fêtes in the Grand Parc, with a Sunday screening of a documentary, animation, experimental or cult film, followed by a free discussion.

7dc142e6a7522452c6cc1b39285c68920ca7e928.en: A yin yoga session at the AGJA neighbourhood house on Monday 14 December from 19:00 to 21:00, with floor postures held for several minutes. It costs 20 euros per session.

62e75ae853cdfe6b7191e7ceba6cddfa4904891a.en: A seminar of the AgroTIC chair at Bordeaux Sciences Agro on 15 December, on generative AI in agriculture, from proof-of-concept to use cases such as data entry, business queries and agentic AI.

c5463f9e6d83553b468f96c5a311c5e843d179ce.en: A talk at the Bibliothèque Grand Parc by Isabelle Beccia, a museum mediator, on the 19th-century painter Rosa Bonheur as part of #RDVdumardi.

a6db2c033276ce6fca6e429c7485c840f1994519.en: A talk by Isabelle Beccia at the Bibliothèque Grand Parc on Rosa Bonheur, painter of living things, a doctor of art history and museum mediator.

114751dbb3bb55edb37b3f787c29ea04298451c0.en: A Grands Entretiens conversation at La Cité du Vin with Bernard Farges, a Gironde grower with a 165-hectare estate in Mauriac, former head of the Bordeaux wine council CIVB, followed by a glass of wine.

34a70a549f33b7579c3122d6c5b88c69c1d853e1.en: A concert at the Théâtre Fémina by the conservatoire's big band and jazz choir, paying tribute to Stevie Wonder with songs including Isn't She Lovely, Overjoyed, Sir Duke and Superstition.

b295e4f65cbdfbdb742ff8de73f5be69c6708038.en: A classical ballet at Le Pin Galant, The Sleeping Beauty, by the Ballet Classique International company from the Czech Republic, directed by Andrey Sharaev, with Petipa and Tchaikovsky's score.

dccf4d84ddac2b540952531afc645e87efad5f4c.en: A walk to see how the forest organises itself in winter, with the plants and animals still active and the strategies they use to survive the cold. The starting point is shared on registration.

8732139a45556f07170f0c4e3034935053497f92.en: Two tales of winter and the stars with songs and instruments at the Cenac leisure centre, with animals that children can gently stroke.

609bbcbd0c608359ef72a4145f8ff4a8b90529b3.en: A musical tale at the Glob Théâtre about Chinook, a girl born a storm who is quick to anger, presenting rage as a tool against oppression.

c362e0f4a6b12e7a5a62ef61c096a7e1b6a189c3.en: A clay sculpture workshop at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux, where children model a clay head inspired by the feelings shown in the museum's works.

e006b84704f9b8679d3b88a2484a2c8fb9840a28.en: A monthly themed visit at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux with a mediator, looking at sleep in the museum's collections.

3b9515c72ef314efb7cb3ecedf526f5012bc6ba9.en: A concert of the conservatoire's wind orchestra at the Salle Antoine Vitez as a prelude to the holidays, with Debussy, Tchaikovsky and Prokofiev. Conducted by Roberto Gatto, with percussionist Alessandro Rinaudo as soloist.

426628a800715e869d7e90bc89fb11efcd888f7e.en: A concert by rapper disiz at the Arkea Arena in Bordeaux, with a band of six musicians and a broad set spanning his career.

277754ce725e412e4f01e79f92d268b7a0b4aa89.en: An improvised show at Improvidence Café-théâtre in which a sleep scientist invites the audience to choose dreams for three patients. It runs for one hour and is built from audience suggestions.

180bd22affccb890105452dc89fde878d3b5acbf.en: A talk at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux by wine expert Hervé Romat on Pierre Lacour's view of the port and quays of Bordeaux, the Chartrons and Bacalan.

4b53cccd22adb691acfa23c1bf185192b72517fc.en: A free lunchtime concert at the Chapelle de l'Annonciade on Thursday 17 December at 12:15, with students of RésoNAnces and a surprise programme. Free entry; no booking.

c5348b2306a24db9d9b1c284af4b952b5a633ee7.en: A discussion of artificial intelligence at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck, the second Illectroniques Anonymes meeting, open to everyone, whether curious, sceptical or new to AI. Participants share experiences and questions.

2b192cf31293a17fc35bf4fc5cbe612b87ead9f7.en: A Christmas card workshop at the Bibliothèque Jean de La Ville de Mirmont, where participants use cut-out and collage with works from the MusBA collections to make a personal card.

22433a518da0ed0c0c4502ed1598469928bddeba.en: A tasting at La Cité du Vin of four Prosecco Superiore DOCG wines from the hills of Veneto, including Rive wines and Cartizze. Two sessions at 18:30 and 20:30, in partnership with the Consorzio.

7adca34d23818dcb0ac8304535c0e9d5f4794fc2.en: The Radio Classique Christmas concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, where the audience votes for the pieces, played by the Orchestre National Bordeaux Aquitaine and the Opera chorus, conducted by Joseph Swensen.

664f29ab264518af64c7fc2cbc2cf191b786ec14.en: A concert by Vincent Peirani at Le Rocher de Palmer with his band Living Being, presenting the third album, IV, which mixes dub, Balkan music, musette and jazz.

000eea27b5f90231939b98d0f2df9e8ccc28c2c7.en: A musical about the Post-it note at La Matière, Les Petits Papiers, written by Meylie Vignaud-Pilarski, Romain Losi and Arthur Billy Livret, directed by Julien Marot. It is for ages 8 and up and lasts 1h10.

07c735831dd0a8e40d2839428d2b344dc403526c.en: A visit at the Musée d'Aquitaine with a mediator on enslaved people in 18th-century Bordeaux, whose presence is seen in parish registers and censuses.

cdc3509556a25591e873f8e1ab263c9092445618.en: A play-and-movement session for toddlers at the Ludo-médiathèque, pôle Simone Veil, to build motor skills and coordination through play.

45beda30a03ac62a68712c60123938f96d9913f6.en: A display of old games and toys at the Ludo-médiathèque, pôle Simone Veil, using posters lent by the association Le Patrimoine de Saint-Médard-en-Jalles.

9b69304f8c1e5589ff65001d5b37a077adbb71c0.en: A family show about chocolate at the Bibliothèque François Mitterrand in Ambarès-et-Lagrave, where actor Jean-Charles Séosse and singer Emmanuelle Troy read three stories by Olivier Ka with improvised music.

100c75eaded647b46da6b99678644a524700596b.en: A theatre piece at the tnba by Daphné Biiga Nwanak and Baudouin Woehl, set in a purgatory where dead artists of many eras meet and try to revive art. A masterclass takes place on 17 December.

733334a4e580bb0e48ff0e6eea279659cb7e0bc3.en: A dance show by Compagnie Yeraz at Le Pin Galant, Pour toi Aznavour, a tribute to Charles Aznavour mixing Armenian dance, childhood memories and his songs.

5f5fe2347cd36189a4d1095cc1b55bfb25ddca0b.en: A concert at Rock School Barbey by rapper Seth Gueko, known for mixing underworld slang, verlan and pop culture references, in a return to punchline rap.

58bf4095725424bf2c761cfefd442b7a64c72e05.en: A theatre-within-theatre show at the Théâtre de la Rousselle, in which a company of seven rehearses A Midsummer Night's Dream, and the process of creation is shown on stage. For ages 13 and up, lasting 1h40.

e36bc519dd31f9a2b3401d4a972ac9759e77627a.en: A jazz dance show at the Salle des Fêtes in the Grand Parc, Freedom Jazz Dance, celebrating 110 years of jazz in Bordeaux with the Orchestre d'Harmonie de Bordeaux. It moves from swing to bebop and Afro-Cuban rhythms.

21c975cd67a4f93cac6ce6c4b1bc92d1cb7fa0ab.en: A show for toddlers aged 2 to 5 at the Médiathèque Flora Tristan, lasting 30 minutes.

3b0c0119a651dc0f0d7490daca64c4314e650a00.en: Bilingual Arabic and French readings for children aged 3 to 6 at the Bibliothèque La Bastide. Free entry; information from the librarians.

85eaa87cc2cc12f8a36c0b125c1ae1f83c05b487.en: A paper-animation show at La Matière, Sage comme Neige, in which two performers make a miniature paper world with a film projected behind them. A winter and forest tale for ages 5 and up, lasting 45 minutes.

366421c37c9e5650825cdcecbfda0bebf16e6fae.en: A watercolour introduction at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux, where participants paint their favourite work from the collection.

c731966f2eb28b969272607fe4ffb72b68026c06.en: A winter story of white and friendship at the Médiathèque Carré des Jalles, with a fir tree, a polar bear and a snowman in a gentle tale.

182b72d69a53877bd6be27c83c481660fa5bae9b.en: A theatre show at L'Estrade by the troupe SpectActeur, Sans Visage, about a mysterious figure in a magic school and the secrets of Talia's family. It has six actors, lasts 1h20, and doors open at 19:30.

739419b7ead1f28b00a911f7ee4a3b68fb4b82b2.en: A family Christmas show at the Théâtre l'Inox, Mère Noël part en tournée, in which Mother Christmas wants to deliver the presents herself. It is interactive, lasts 45 minutes and is part of the Wonder Pipelettes festival.

13ddcc558a08418b63c502f6b39cef458710ca5b.en: Prokofiev's Peter and the Wolf at the Château Théâtre Descas, with a narrator and the Sinfonia orchestra. Children can come in costume, and a snack follows each concert.

b08e1d10f0023c399c16848f09eba999176d3dce.en: A workshop at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux where participants make an embroidered creation based on one of the museum's works.

a85cb6b5a188158f0e81b3706a2f3ad3ed5144ac.en: A session at Sésame on how phishing scams work, seen from the point of view of a hacker, to help people protect themselves against fake delivery texts.

a875e6ea5a9ab4141ac69659979bb1f9aecfba93.en: A holiday family film screening at the Médiathèque de Thouars, with a surprise film shown during the school holidays.

debb65af5d432ad0d5a9b6d0d7810ebc715c363b.en: A volleyball match at the Palais des Sports in Bordeaux on Tuesday 22 December at 20:00, Saforelle VOLSTAR matchday 14, Les Burdis against France Avenir.

138751a8e78bb3436f2d1b355c0ac83ffcd4d84a.en: A session at Sésame on how Shazam and Gemini help identify songs and enrich playlists, with a look at how these apps work and how to use them.

f04af80ad10d7abd7e1853284ebbefe90b1e1705.en: A theatrical museum visit at the Musée d'Aquitaine, Le fantôme de Montaigne, led by the Bordeaux tourist office, which walks visitors through the collections from prehistory to the 16th century through the eyes of Montaigne.

deaeeac3713842ac0b0ae4023d6d3344b8eea922.en: A visit of the Observatoire de Bordeaux at Floirac with guides, covering its history, the experimental forest project and the dome that houses the large equatorial telescope. Visits are currently suspended.

551222253cdd4f54c5ef3c30ff40582bc5efd5f1.en: A boulevard comedy at La Pergola, Pouic Pouic, in which a family's oil concession turns into a series of lies and mistaken identities. Ages 14 and up, 1h30.

322fc4df3477485c233d4aafa08592e9419e88fe.en: A workshop at the Musée des Arts décoratifs et du Design on the prepper movement, for ages 7 and up, linked to the exhibition We will survive.

56eb51f1a7fb69d7c38099e39b4815f2179a56e9.en: A Vivaldi and Christmas concert at Notre-Dame de Bordeaux on Sunday 27 December, by the Violons de France orchestra. The programme includes The Four Seasons, Schubert's Ave Maria and carols, and lasts about 1h10.

e0ec0296ce5e01d830c9c29d286f3cf62afecee1.en: An improvised New Year's Eve show by the Improvidence troupe at La Cité du Vin, with a glass of champagne. The audience sends messages through a QR code, which the actors turn into the show.

a23bb5319806e5add80a151bec3da3f78bbb80f2.en: A New Year's concert by the Orchestre Sinfonia at the Château Théâtre Descas in January 2027, with Satie, Ravel and Bizet. It is a family concert with a snack and a bubble bar afterwards.

614938767d94cfa361c14c97a7c011c97e9b48b3.en: An exhibition of paintings by A-MO, Bleu Sauvage, at the Musée de la Marine in Bordeaux, where colour becomes landscape. It runs from 11 September 2026 to 3 January 2027.

f2c19ea329fdedfe8654f81a0a85da23b81c9537.en: Free entry to the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux on the first Sunday of January, from 11:00 to 18:00, for the last days of the Passions Collections display.

54d43922af650cf42d07e2e4513310c1e7d92add.en: A stand-up show by Patrick Chanfray at L'Estrade, about the pressure to be happy, relaxed and successful in a country that uses many antidepressants. Doors at 19:30 and show at 20:30.

4d23081032cefeb1dc07ae99ef536983987ea0e6.en: A community choir session at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, where amateur singers learn an extract of Mascagni's Cavalleria rusticana for a concert performance on 5 January 2027. The workshops run from September to January.

891539f44b4e82e8bc9ea77405c1b131890f3792.en: A comedy show at Le Pin Galant by Édouard Baer, Le journal de Mérignac, in which local people from the city appear on stage with him in a theatrical cabaret.

73fd6fb3b1b9293e4178fb8bb65906c11f8a0e87.en: A concert at Le Pin Galant, The Musical Story of Elvis, with Nils Strassburg performing hits such as Suspicious Minds and In the Ghetto. The show marks 50 years since Elvis's death.

c6447a3479e45ea9101d18664bdaac979e8b8e21.en: A play at La Matière, Caché au creux d'un matelas, about a Bordeaux shopkeeper and a teenage artist who in June 1940 secretly write a satirical book about rumours under the German occupation, and hide the manuscript.

03f222ad48cc7206fc316ff83abe4a71adae37fe.en: A talk at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul on the Baroque churches of Bordeaux and the architecture of the 17th century, including their sculptures and interiors. Booking required.

322db2ae97613949dffd3e0255255857c660e042.en: A concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux with cellist Edgar Moreau, playing Dutilleux's cello concerto Tout un monde lointain and Franck's Symphony in D minor, with Berlioz's Le Corsaire overture.

0c3f23fc3e7f028fe166c43f076daeb062eaf8f4.en: A concert at the Théâtre des 4 Saisons in Gradignan, De la musique avant toute chose, in which two musicians act as lecturers and lead the audience from solfège to contemporary creation.

62921c1efa9287ac5afeff52b9b5501bbe5885b2.en: A show at Le Carré by Caroline Melon, J'irai chercher ton cœur, a one-woman show about popular French songs, mixing classics, personal stories and historical events.

1b48f21465d0084198d282be38a5a887e86ab408.en: A salons and forums event at the Parc des Expositions for the University of Limoges, with the high school and student fair on 8, 9 and 10 January 2027.

61a9c667eca9da33c75dcb1e4b421c8d08e4a441.en: A lunchtime recital at the Grand-Théâtre with soprano Juliette Mey, who came to international attention with a 2023 win at the Queen Elisabeth Competition.

6abe452ee573d7e2980a6021f386cdd8962c57e6.en: A salsa dance evening at the Grand-Théâtre's Salon Boireau with the Compagnie Freesalsa, open to all, with Latin American percussion and a Cuban-style setting.

024de4020260757d219e8b914403d0e62dee8510.en: A stand-up show at L'Estrade by Dudley, called Tournesol, in which he talks about his path and about the courage to shine on your own. Doors at 20:30 and show at 21:00.

a6bf8a7eb5653cd2aff854eec7c6c3600c4cc619.en: A chamber concert at the Grand-Théâtre's Salon Boireau with composer Bastien David, who plays the 216-blade microtonal metallophone he created. A sound workshop for ages 8 and up follows on selected dates.

25c91a48f2f3427996a21fcb657e67efcaaf1913.en: A show at La Coupole, Track, in which a giant model railway becomes a musical instrument, with trains, barriers and a human beatbox performer. It includes 15 minutes of talk with the artists afterwards.

a40848407b13869f99e61c4225548606a2a2aa6a.en: A volleyball match at the Palais des Sports in Bordeaux on Saturday 9 January at 19:00, Saforelle VOLSTAR matchday 16, Les Burdis against Mulhouse, the reigning French champions.

452fad12f696ff9a8216a6e82727a762ede5e364.en: The regional final of the Voix Nouvelles singing competition at the Grand-Théâtre, run by Génération Opéra, where young opera singers from across the region compete before a national final. Bookings open 9 December 2026 at 13:00.

da79fcfe3de4d6f1bf1324ad09ad4477efabc93d.en: A kathak dance evening at the Auditorium de Bordeaux with the Sanjukta Sinha ensemble, where dance, song and music from northern India tell a story.

2d75dd718698e28ce148e9d686fa7d78a7ec455b.en: A new dance creation by Benjamin Millepied at Le Pin Galant, Barbara, Du bout des lèvres, inspired by the songs of Barbara, with dancers of different generations.

b8d0abed3432f4631901ce46e8312f4dd9f5bff7.en: A comic show at Le Cube, Les Traviatas, in which four opera singers retake a competition, with a piano coach and a mix of opera, songs and musical theatre. Lasts one hour.

132be4dc90be0b2a94daed060b4957f9c2ec41d3.en: A concert by Miossec at Le Rocher de Palmer, celebrating his latest album on tour.

fcf259e52a326c50583a6e9883040ca615d5e7c9.en: A family talk at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul on baroque music, with Rameau's Les Indes galantes, Bach's cello suites and the baroque orchestra. Booking required.

29f197125ba9a1e8084a77761025410ce7d93286.en: A play at the tnba about two criminal lovers in 1980s Paris, told as a confession by two voices. Written and directed by Yacine Sif El Islam. For ages 16 and up, lasting 1 hour.

4b32637b2144ddc299a0fcdbb0b66982a303ba1a.en: A children's concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux by students of the Conservatoire Jacques-Thibaud, playing Ravel's Ma mère l'Oye suite. Bookings open 15 December 2026 at 13:00.

f3ae64af1e2b8999980a217ba59538211ef5b7eb.en: A play at the Glob Théâtre, Robinsonner, about a young man who has shut himself in his room for eight years. It mixes a mock police investigation with a family saga.

ac8cd798faf77fb446fe27ac46ee3bdca8ae3987.en: A concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux on the Spanish influence on French composers, with Lalo's Symphonie espagnole, Ravel and Debussy's Ibéria. A talk with Alexandra Soumm is held on 13 January at 17:00.

a9a31e19d98021266e67e22e3307ee47c6b10389.en: A one-man show by Big S at L'Estrade, En vérité, about social media, love and masculinity, with self-mockery and interactive situations. Doors at 19:30.

3e83f7fb53e5e9489233c61a569feab86423c302.en: A dance and circus show by Cie Haspop at Le Pin Galant, Curiosité, which blends hip-hop and modern circus, inspired by 1930s New York and the view of a young migrant. Ten performers.

6d7294e8fb83400054c8a0017d4431c2ca653066.en: A work-in-progress showing at the Glob Théâtre by L'Inverso Collectif, Asiles, about women who have survived psychiatry and build a community care home.

539940596221839e19e4a091e8245845487af04e.en: A classics concert at the Médiathèque Mériadeck with conservatoire students and teachers Lisa Mancin and Miren Casado.

b2f5179ccbd6953e0458f26000e0dde00efd689e.en: A concert by Zamdane at Le Rocher de Palmer, presenting his show Rahma, the follow-up to Solsad, with a personal, raw and emotional style.

ac5c768e9d54188409211f1f1c13602c34c13fd3.en: An outdoor-style epic at Colonnes, L'appel de la forêt, a stage version of Jack London's novel about the dog Buck, with storytelling, folk and electronic music, and video by Alexandre Machefel.

bc89341bd37812337b68abd513807703ad0b350f.en: A family concert from age 3 at the Grand-Théâtre's Foyer Rouge, with electronic textures and Greek melodies by composer Sofia Avramidou, in residence at the Opera.

79ea8ce385ea9dccdaed6bfbe3c4a8cfa633221b.en: A drawing workshop at the atelier Citrouille on the principles of portrait drawing, from proportions to expressive approaches. A model is present on Sunday afternoon.

faed43e7ffdab37f7e45aaec68445cd4656624a7.en: A round table at the Grand-Théâtre's Foyer Rouge on whether music can build society differently, with Jordi Savall, Bilal Alnemr, Barbara Hannigan and former minister Françoise Nyssen. Bookings open 16 December 2026 at 13:00.

bcfed9da5f0e30a034645254e298179a3c1779bf.en: A concert by Jordi Savall and his ensemble at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, exploring Sephardic, Basque, Portuguese and Spanish traditions and their South American transformations, on period instruments.

f83d26eecbbb4c97923036097ddd94d0267d2af4.en: A show at L'Estrade, PANIC ATTACK, by Kino, a comedian who tells how he was diagnosed with generalised anxiety with agoraphobia and how he turned his experience into a show. Doors at 19:30.

ddd7aa1b0fd15f26c474d278d455181a16dbfd35.en: A concert by the electronic producer NTO at Le Rocher de Palmer. Based in Montpellier, he presents his work including his project with pianist Sofiane Pamart.

c75ccb202d2d5162655c4ccb051b4aeee4ca0fe6.en: A concert at La Coupole by the Lyre orchestra of Saint-Loubès, with a programme of Japanese-inspired music, performed by amateur musicians and pupils of its music school.

a7fa0c161f50bb592dfb3d96d359258953fefbb3.en: A comedy show at Le Pin Galant by La Troupe du Jamel Comedy Club, in which stand-up comics chain jokes, sketches and happenings on stage.

13aa89065c1f34394ec8a4328867e103dd9f4b1f.en: A rock singing workshop at the Centre d'animation Argonne Nansouty Saint-Genès, led by Armand Floréa, to help participants discover their own voice in a supportive day.

cfddb972429bed6d63ebc1b22c28b07ac55fa8be.en: A workshop on drones with Cap Sciences at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul in Pessac, where participants learn how drones work, programme them for challenges, and learn the rules for using them. Booking required.

64f0ee75a2b89d07b2db09c9847458fc5fbd24f9.en: A chamber concert at the Grand-Théâtre's Salon Boireau by Syrian violinist Bilal Alnemr, with Barbara Hannigan and others, on peace between peoples, with works by Arvo Pärt and a text by the young Afghan refugee poet Abdullah Jan Nazari.

3cb5b12f99e45235da985571a8d3de7ecd802e00.en: A tea dance at La Coupole with the Pierre-François Duqueyrois orchestra, from 14:30, with accordion music. The price is 14 euros, or 11 euros for residents of Loubès.

5b2f2c548f5d6f60d38d513b437cf9f2a47907d4.en: A version of Aeschylus's Electra at the tnba, The Mourning Becomes Electra, set after the American Civil War, in a monumental house where a daughter pushes her brother to avenge their father. Directed by Gwenaël Morin.

4cb432832574c86836af468170709758ead92110.en: A concert by Grissini Project at the Théâtre Fémina, playing the music of Joe Hisaishi from Hayao Miyazaki's films, including My Neighbour Totoro, Ponyo and Howl's Moving Castle.

71d367cc955419336904ea3d9893cd16fcbd6305.en: A beginner role-playing workshop at the Médiathèque Castagnéra, with two short games: one for ages 7 and up with friendly monsters, and one for ages 16 and up in which players investigate a mysterious threat.

c8ee980043b1f7309b0b617c3ce7c83c9b8cbc20.en: A one-man show at the Glob Théâtre, Nostalgie du réconfort, by Grégory Fernandes, with 30 television screens. It draws on stories from a working-class family about class, silence and the wish to escape.

15a5f1ef4e76eaf6960f53d9ddfebb0feb0f4a64.en: A playful concert at Le Pin Galant, Oum Pa Pa. Opus 2, by an all-female quartet in which the accordion plays classical works by Bizet, Tchaikovsky, Yann Tiersen and Piazzolla alongside two flutes and a viola.

ffed3ef2e22186e53f45e74c2c1084ec8a09a21c.en: A musical tale for ages 6 and up at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, Momo, l'enfant pêche, based on a Japanese tale, in which a child born from a river sets out with his animal friends to the ogre's castle.

6aa02e22bae9b8d816820acc009ea0f851321e8b.en: A double bill at Les Avant-Postes and the tnba as part of the Trente Trente festival: Alain Buffard's Good Boy (45 minutes), and Ève Magot's Extraction, which draws on the life of a trans woman. Times are listed for two routes.

6fc079bed73b32d33ce0539ac3457304d2b48723.en: A Mozart Requiem staged by Stéphane Braunschweig at the Grand-Théâtre, part of the Opera's zero-purchase approach, with the chorus and soloists. A meeting with the director and Joseph Swensen takes place on 21 January at 18:30.

aa978ee1b8370df91a926cf1163150b8c5d24791.en: A family play at the Médiathèque M.270 about a retired couple whose home is at the foot of a viaduct where people keep jumping. Their plea to the council becomes a national media story. Uses puppets and collages, for adults and children.
