976e4a7bce1e63ba11e3cb9f325b12246fc5e979.en: A talk at the Cuvier de Feydeau by Jérôme Rouger on the role of audiences in the quality of a performance, with humour and practical advice.

431093283d5a29823ed87329e6aac972ea39bcba.en: A concert by Bertrand Belin at Le Pin Galant, presenting his album Watt, recorded with Thibault Frisoni, which mixes minimal poetic lyrics with songs, rock and electronic pop.

be1f61915030a9420c9b9f424976f29c6de2e0d2.en: An acrobatics show at Le Carré by the Galactik Ensemble, Optraken, in which five acrobats keep their balance in unpredictable situations on a giant stage. It is a visual show.

2c4f982daf8a4571890d82b4d1555c7ed513b34b.en: A show for toddlers at the Auditorium by the SIVOC, Zigzague par l'amulecteur, about a solitary figure who keeps everything colourless and a visitor full of colour, teaching openness to others.

7ba1ae579e197e4cb0f2c836b12b1fb7f77946ee.en: A night of reading at the Médiathèque de Thouars as part of the 11th Nuit de la lecture, organised by the Centre national du livre, with games and readings at the Dôme.

9ea7bba98afdb08cd28bfd5253c24cd07d486751.en: A concert by Aloïse Sauvage at Rock School Barbey, an actress and singer who began in dance and circus, presenting extracts from her new, most personal album.

2322a7e5da8a002e4900dbc7ec5707ecebc6434b.en: A trad dance ball and show at Le Cube, Comment ça se danse ?, by Chloé Martin and La D'âme de Compagnie, with accordion, violin and flute, followed by a closing dance. For ages 10 and up, lasting 1h20.

f2f1582a25e0b2dc613b8ec014dd029ac0342281.en: A LEGO workshop at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul in Pessac, built around The Little Prince, where children build and take on challenges. Booking required.

16608114c68339d31ea932f8e71d7ca525a4aac9.en: A play at the Théâtre l'Inox for children aged 4 to 12, Petite Pipelette et le grand malentendu, about a girl who asks questions in a kingdom that dislikes them, and who sets out to find a missing friend. Part of the Wonder Pipelettes festival.

5dd4559128c199135ef35d4697f1fecab585e56c.en: A four-part show at La Coupole, 9 vies extraordinaires de la princesse Gaya, with three actresses, three musicians and an illustrator drawing live. Parts run from 16:00 to 22:00, with breaks.

38c8bed2309c9d4d59d2dbaedab01db2cbeb88e3.en: A magic show at Le Pin Galant by Gaël, in which a magician who dreams of flying brings a real plane onto the stage.

3d38c009ff530d4d35a602a4a06eed4c086da7a2.en: A talk at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul on how Pessac took part in the conquest of the air, from the first balloon in 1847 to an airport project in 1919.

100fb1ced6409d72df860670bf9f1ee9c766bd54.en: A play at the Cuvier de Feydeau, Opération Berlingot, where a scientist and his assistant search for the ingredients of a bubble of consent through clownish experiments about when and how to ask and respect others.

77f642d01fb843cedf5d1eacca2be9d83ef17dd5.en: An evening of performances at the Glob Théâtre as part of the Trente Trente festival, with three short pieces by R. Boitel, J. Sadoughi and J.-L. Terrade on bodies, time and childhood memories.

a725dff786663a7ddaa63e6d55923876d74a05b6.en: A concert by NAVA at Rock School Barbey, a feminist pop-rock singer from Lyon known for the hits Prince charmant and Trop tard.

a1c7d65b4c7afa1d7d82981bfba6d87ba91b3a6a.en: A concert by the French metalcore band Resolve at Le Rocher de Palmer, formed in Lyon in 2017, presenting their album Human (2023), with Silent Planet and Spleen in support.

5c12287ec81035faae08039038ebad420a560b36.en: A cine-concert for ages 4 and up at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, Les Drôles de petites bêtes, based on Antoon Krings's books, with music by Clara Olivares and Aline Gorisse. A calm screening for children from day care centres is offered.

476cb4a690b216e430e073034a54dac4f79e3aff.en: A stand-up show at the Trianon by Hugues Lavigne, a comedian from Toulouse who talks about living with ADHD and mixes stand-up with visuals.

691a1b3bcc0042facdc7df86bb3174d511242267.en: A concert by the Franco-Armenian group Ladaniva at Le Rocher de Palmer, a band from Lille who took Armenia to Eurovision in 2024 with the song Jako, mixing melancholy songs and party music.

bcd7861031c5fc0141e079e6df469a906bb137bb.en: A show at Colonnes by La Boîte à sel, Affects, in which a woman literally confronts her emotions after spitting out a ball of repressed anger. It combines techno-tinkered sound objects and puppets.

0b4096eaa08d2427e73f452506363a05195226c4.en: A concert by the Dutch psychedelic band Altın Gün at the Krakatoa, presenting their fifth album Garip, which blends Turkish-inspired grooves with a mature, eclectic sound.

30a408ba629790d54a5c69b4602adea0a203fc4f.en: A dance piece at Le Pin Galant by Leïla Ka, Maldonne, in which five women in coloured dresses reveal their fragility and revolt, with music by Vivaldi, Lara Fabian and Leonard Cohen.

fd6271aef684d79c51768d7f0e2dc15107f72277.en: A musical lecture at the Médiathèque Castagnéra by Pascal Bouaziz on Leonard Cohen's early years as a young poet, before Hallelujah or Suzanne, drawing on his book about the singer. In partnership with L'Inconnue.

f4c2a54f84b93a47cb23528175cb292bed342500.en: A one-man show at the Théâtre Victoire by Daniel Camus, Happy Hour, in which he draws on years working behind a bar to tell stories about the many people he met there. Written with Arnaud Cosson, Thomas Coste and Benoit Lefeuvre.

bbba361cce35d0a19a6872fa7a6889b626d83687.en: A theatre show at the Pôle Culturel Évasion, Léonard, by the Anamorphose company, in which an actor and a multi-instrumentalist stage Leonardo da Vinci's last years at the court of François I. Part of the SIVOC programme.

bcf48b859a5fc50b84e96b1526e5af1f39ef8641.en: A cult screening at the Cuvier de Feydeau of The Rocky Horror Picture Show by Jim Sharman (1975), with the troupe The Time Slips performing live alongside the film. Costumes and singing are encouraged. Not suitable for sensitive viewers.

66bdd6f0215fab6d6f2201a399b3dd1302de7f56.en: A concert at Le Pin Galant by Thomas Fersen, Comme on quitte un imperméable, marking 30 years since his album Le Bal des oiseaux. A musical theatre piece told in octosyllables, performed with three musicians.

416e206b2beff7764632143400a1321a806f8e50.en: A concert at Le Rocher de Palmer by the French band Thylacine, presenting the album Roads Vol. 3, recorded in Namibia while travelling for three months in a 1972 Airstream caravan.

561cd9473acaa3b651062cf594b7d87b35352768.en: A reading club at the Médiathèque Castagnéra, Causons romans, where members discuss a shared selection of novels. The series also includes crime fiction and comics clubs.

5db527b44a1c7b63dfa82e25f9877001e2730dbe.en: A meeting for children aged 9 to 12 at the Médiathèque Castagnéra as part of a reading prize, where children can read the novels in the Talence libraries and vote from March to May.

bc5f1ed1008b26358032f0211fd12e93762471c8.en: A volleyball match at the Palais des Sports in Bordeaux on Saturday 30 January at 19:00, Saforelle VOLSTAR matchday 19, Les Burdis against Chamalières.

85ee7dbf6d41161f55c5abcfb0639ca21ed05752.en: A concert by Zaoui at the Krakatoa in Mérignac on Saturday 30 January 2027 at 20:30. Raphaël Faget-Zaoui, after Thérapie Taxi, performs his solo pop songs from albums including Pulsations.

9faf507671b76a956dd7e4504f60c33dd41d02d6.en: A concert by Marion Rampal at Le Cube, A song for Abbey, a tribute to singer and composer Abbey Lincoln, reworking her songs with jazz, folk and poetry. Runs 1h30.

8f725ae104470fff57149bd5c5a824a73603b7b8.en: A solo recital by Russian pianist Mikhaïl Pletnev at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, with Bach's Preludes and Fugues and works by Schumann and Grieg.

152c72830995b02215f544c1815b3be7cccbebc2.en: A clay workshop at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul for parents and children aged 2 to 4, inspired by the book Merveilleuses Naissances by Aina Bestard. Children shape eggs and nests with clay and plants. Booking required.

530c769d7434586d69831e02757909f3b62d03c5.en: A concert at Le Pin Galant by the Voices Harmony choir with 200 singers, reviving Jean-Jacques Goldman's best-known songs with four solo voices.

1b45810d6dd20cb4b57faabacebf1b3d661b84cf.en: A play at the tnba by Tommy Milliot, Eden, the last part of his trilogy on Naomi Wallace's work. Set in the mid-1970s, a group of young people sneak into wealthy houses until the return of a brother from Vietnam changes everything.

309503613e46363d1dc8070520f61035fdc81746.en: A chamber recital at the Auditorium de Bordeaux by cellist Gautier Capuçon and pianist Frank Braley, performing all five Beethoven sonatas for cello and piano.

6d0b915ff6ced0517f94c3b49f26186fc125f2a5.en: A dance piece by Beaver Dam Company at Le Pin Galant, Dive, choreographed by Édouard Hue, who explores each dancer's body as a living being, through heartbeat, bones and blood.

27e8702e921749a7617cf2effdf240df01c67194.en: A dance and illustration show at Colonnes, Le poisson qui vivait dans les arbres, a fable about two adventurers searching for a fish that lived in a tree, created by choreographer Sylvain Riéjou and illustrator Hervé Walbecq.

652b658b295d192d18a55b21980b8e20f07d727b.en: A talk at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul on the role of literature in Spain's feminist movement, in partnership with the City's international relations team and the twin-town committee. Booking required.

8cf95c716cfbdf942f16c98969a779f7f8702cbf.en: A staged reading at the tnba, Le convoi, by Beata Umubyeyi Mairesse, who recounts her survival of the 1994 Rwandan genocide and the convoys that evacuated children. Directed by Fanny de Chaillé with archive films and photos.

058e2593524c9d7f496eb296b73d241175bc47cb.en: A stage adaptation of Dead Poets Society at Le Pin Galant with Stéphane Freiss as the teacher John Keating and six young actors. It is about friendship, freedom and the importance of living.

3c40703044545c8ea1338153e665bf770516fada.en: A play at La Matière, Le Rire de David, set in Munich in 1919, where a cabaret fortune-teller is unsettled by a young man watching from the back of the room. For ages 12 and up, lasting 1h20.

d5789e3e53fdf16ce92daced5ad46a5edea4a1da.en: A concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux by the Orchestre National Bordeaux Aquitaine with Rachmaninov's Symphonic Dances, and Korngold's violin concerto as the soloist work.

d487ca0297f3b3e72a263c1bd92597c5de6fcea3.en: A concert at the Arkea Arena by rapper La Fève, presenting his Zénith tour after the single Finis-les and his earlier project 24.

24b3711953d6879b13db1eace252f6d65db21c0c.en: A one-man show at Le Cube by Alexis Le Rossignol, Un tantinet chamboulé, in which a comedian's plan to write a new show is upset by life and news of his fatherhood. Ages 12 and up, lasting 1h15.

e8964000d2f3bc67396086dde597afa610797238.en: A concert by Gauvain Sers at Le Pin Galant, presenting his fourth album, Boulevard de l'enfance, after four years away, written between Paris and the Creuse.

c0034064d62d1874987e2fda13957b74b433297c.en: A higher education fair at the Parc des Expositions in Brive, run by the University of Limoges, the Forum du Futur Étudiant on 5 and 6 February 2027.

3c525df11926a340d745aec4f5ed86fc9e493510.en: An open day at MJM Graphic Design Bordeaux for its 10th anniversary, where students show their projects across the school. Free entry; registration advised.

87e169dc110a2d35a8fd011a39e16953f38c984c.en: A saxophone ensemble concert at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck with Fabien Chouraki, a teacher at the Bordeaux conservatoire, and his students.

461c1acf02f7895b9324311738d05c43cc374ac4.en: A comedy at the Théâtre Trianon, La maîtresse en maillot de bain, by Fabienne Galula, about a psychologist sent by the ministry to help the staff of a nursery school. Directed by Xavier Viton.

8a1198a250323008968619f7789f289ab195bcef.en: A theatre piece at Le Cuvier de Feydeau, Bar ouvert, in which a single bar serves as the setting for about ten different places and a range of regulars, staff and passers-by, exploring everyday encounters and the value of such places.

19c097d19b62bb07b3c047acc548362a806aff4b.en: A one-man show at Le Pin Galant, Numéro 2, about a boy who was auditioned for the role of Harry Potter in 1999 and was not chosen.

00d0bea165ebad67881181796a79ba56eff9c38a.en: A musical tale at the Château Théâtre Descas, Vivaldi, incognito., the first episode of a biographical series in which Vivaldi slips into a Venetian carnival unnoticed. The Four Seasons are played live. Children are invited to come in costume.

a05bd4389c6609d5a7b82396b9af219c2a2f1f44.en: A music concert for children from 18 months at the Grand-Théâtre's Foyer rouge, Ici, là-bas, with lullabies and nursery rhymes from around the world, sung in their original languages by Émilie Decla.

c62fc5eac6efe8a619eb8ec286d712c0b4fdcd65.en: A show at the Théâtre des 4 Saisons in Gradignan, La Fabuleuse histoire de l'opéra-comique, co-produced with the Opéra National de Bordeaux, tracing the genre from its fairground origins to the works of Bizet and Offenbach.

f447cf12b41fa56a1a1365e4dec1ac8bf9b1f6ca.en: A concert by Léman at the Bien Public in Bordeaux on 6 February 2027, a rock and pop singer whose first album, Adieu Musique, includes the singles Les Étoiles and Le Chat.

30e85b3eee4e1fb89dbda7e5ff31ec3c640bc500.en: A Chinese New Year concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, the start of the year of the Fire Goat, with symphonic orchestra works and a strong focus on percussion.

933116be68f957596a2c2e4a5db92fd640d735e4.en: A concert at Rock School Barbey by Johnny Jane, who returns with the single Les roses, ahead of a new album later this year.

c71dcb424cbc00f5047c8ec87b68c74916fc8cdb.en: A concert by Yaël Naim at Le Rocher de Palmer, presenting her album Solaire (2026), where she moves from folk-pop to electronic textures and hip-hop rhythms.

8931a98ed284f10c3d22e92ffb6f809e605489c9.en: A one-woman show by Anne Depetrini at L'Estrade about trying to fit in, and what she learned from being out of step.

24e18b3145e11f19a82a543917aa5d211c35c9ff.en: A comedy by the Collectif Vivarium at La Coupole, Sosie 2, in which a favourite candidate dies the night before an election and a double has to take her place. Co-organised with iddac.

2a66aa54d6bffa0bd7d06431834ad8febc039b60.en: Free entry to the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux on the first Sunday of February, from 11:00 to 18:00, to see the permanent collections.

941f14cfe4c341a63ef5348b01526c962426013b.en: A Sunday concert at the Grand-Théâtre by the Bordeaux Brass Sextet, a film-music guessing game with works by Legrand, Rota and Morricone. A wine tasting by the Pessac-Léognan wine body follows.

347663f7ba7bc2412f88e042c5b0ad15b9b75480.en: A flamenco rhythms workshop at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul in Pessac with dancer Samantha Alcon and percussionist Leon Schelstraete, covering palmas handclaps and basic steps. Booking required.

8c2654d94aed8d900d89a318872d1a2df7326441.en: A musical at Le Pin Galant by the Frères Safa, Pocahontas, a family show about the arrival of English colonists in North America and the encounter between Pocahontas and John Smith, with five actors and a live musician.

807b656f273b0e580119393c813975db5a976655.en: A stage show at the tnba by Julie Deliquet, La guerre n'a pas un visage de femme, based on Svetlana Alexievich's book about Soviet women who fought in the Second World War, performed by ten actresses.

859a7a104480e02dcbfa010e73c10dbe74ec823d.en: A new production by the Opera Academy of the Opéra National de Bordeaux, Manon revisited, a modern version of Massenet's opera set around the heroine and the men in her life. A student evening is held on 8 February.

9e60d5f12b07e034e7928f411caa62cbe6029b29.en: A photography exhibition at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul by the Spanish artist Oihana Marco, who uses photography as social mediation, made in a hospital care setting. Information from Culture Pessac.

f66a388a0488a88261a313adb97aaa170c35442e.en: A show at La Matière, Qui a cru Kenneth Arnold?, a mock lecture by the OS'O collective about UFO sightings in the United States from the 1940s, asking what is true and what is belief. For ages 12 and up, lasting 1h10.

ba18194e74e759a72c6c59552f39a935975d2e26.en: A comedy show by Christelle Chollet at Le Pin Galant, Culottée, marking 20 years of her career, mixing sketches and revisited hits with her band.

51c6835e3d2b0ad3efdb40179532867421fb8dc6.en: A circus piece at Colonnes, Suzanne: une histoire du cirque, in which circus artist Anna Tauber meets Suzanne, an 84-year-old former high-wire aerialist, and they discuss circus past and present using archives and collage.

1c50cee559e39ce1f3b988689d3910af4cda5560.en: A concert at Le Rocher de Palmer by Ugly Kid Joe, the Californian hard rock band best known for Everything About You, presenting their latest album Rad Wings of Destiny (2022).

95779d5d08df1106ae187429d9b0b63be4338901.en: A talk at Le Pas de Lune, part of the Rencards du savoir, on how the series Adolescence shows the rise of masculinist movements among young men. Speakers are Pauline Ferrari, Maelle Noir and Sandrine Rui, moderated by Zoé Keunebroek.

80f2b13b1d4d394d9e29a8a90abcb511715b3a99.en: A play at Le Cuvier de Feydeau, Robinsonner, following the Gillet family over ten years, where the eldest son, Robin, has locked himself in his room since he was 17.

c50af36518ebde80bf1c147618d26978ecf65dd0.en: A recital by Evgeny Kissin at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, celebrating the Beethoven bicentenary of his death, with the first sonata, the Thirteenth Sonata and the Diabelli Variations.

14f079a70003ad6c296c111f5d590853bb97e1d1.en: An evening of two theatre pieces at Les Avant-Postes, as part of the Fragments festival: La Chasse au lapin by Compagnie Désemballer (50 min) and La Nuit juste avant les forêts by Compagnie Des milliers de voix (30 min), an adaptation of Koltès.

99716ca39e037b4c853b11a6090f2df6d3b73e33.en: A documentary-style show at Colonnes by the Franco-Israeli duo Winter Family, Taglit, droit du sang, about the Taglit trips offered to young Jews, with a Palestinian actress describing the realities of the areas visited. Last part of a trilogy.

9ae7357fdf623f74e9dafe498581784e471ebcdd.en: A play at Le Pin Galant, En thérapie, with Francis Huster as a therapist whose own life starts to fall apart, adapted from the Israeli series Betipul.

e5b04cb8d240b0fcfce71f3c24b513e66829fd1f.en: A symphonic concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux conducted by Pierre Dumoussaud, with Dukas's The Sorcerer's Apprentice and works by Holmès, Ropartz, Schmitt and Bartók. Talk with the conductor on 10 February at 17:00.

579ccf8f7ab07f23914b32d9bbc42e4e59c478e1.en: A radio-show style murder mystery at the Bibliothèque François Mitterrand in Ambarès-et-Lagrave, where the audience works out whether a host's death was a suicide, a murder or an accident. Part of the SIVOC programme.

6986f4a5fdc52188720168d8fe4c38ccaba0e0c1.en: A comedy show by Dany Boon at the Théâtre Fémina, his first one-man show in seven years, returning to his childhood dream of making people laugh.

323feb1e1ac17e0807594736c3e27f28b1ad928b.en: A concert at the Krakatoa in Mérignac by aupinard, presenting his first album, spleen. social club, which mixes bossa nova, soul and electronic music, with Anaïs Cardot, Ino Casablanca and Sonny Rave.

6f45bbe0f1d49acf7b7298693f92efdc6cc63a39.en: A one-man show by Justin Barthélémy, Alors là, at L'Estrade, about searching for oneself and the absurdity of life, mixing self-deprecation and stand-up. Doors at 19:30 and show at 20:30.

65f4889a0b3cc360d100e634edc0b591d063dc1a.en: A three-hour yoga workshop at the Gare de Caudéran-Mérignac on Saturday 10 October from 9:00 to 12:00, with sun salutations, breathing, meditation and sound relaxation. For beginners and experienced practitioners. 35 euros for members, 40 for non-members.

c1c8af6a6e0c939bb3ed21cbca651a76fba14acc.en: A family session at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul in Pessac on Bizet's Carmen, with listening tips and musical games. For parent and child from age 6, on booking.

d41a9d99618519b9bea5b543aef6bae07a19f9af.en: A stand-up show by Charly Nyobe at L'Estrade, Plus rien ne vous choque, on the many bad news stories people have grown used to. Doors at 18:00 and show at 19:00.

e54995b4f9611eebfceafac1905113de9bcb9c5d.en: A piano recital by Brad Mehldau at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, presenting his forthcoming album Quatorze Rêveries and the earlier Suite April 2020.

1d73cff4367a499f1af4a453330b18400bdaabcb.en: A family show by the Chœur de l'Opéra National de Bordeaux at the Auditorium, Une heure avec Lucia di Lammermoor, with extracts of Donizetti's opera and explanations between the pieces. From age 10.

8f44b4186995f0c071a6962e80eb194f4fe08a60.en: A craft workshop at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul for children aged 6 and up, making a linocut cover for a handmade notebook, inspired by La Fontaine's fables. Booking required.

01871c56cd7e548dabca88178b0d9d22e615b9d7.en: An event for the Journées des langues maternelles et paternelles in Bordeaux, a free festival of multilingualism with songs, concerts, workshops, films and talks at libraries and partner associations.

48cd91c8783dbf77213553ff37402770ec59036a.en: English-language holiday camps by Fabrique Bilingue for children aged 4 to 12, running from 9:00 to 17:00. Children bring a packed lunch.

8f758dbdb1b8b60d55724fad0321e182a68c6d34.en: A show at La Matière, La Petite Fille et le Corbeau, by Compagnie Mouka, about a girl and a crow left alone with an egg to hatch, an ecological tale. For ages 7 and up, lasting 40 minutes.

999239ea1924b9b854b74a04745de094f2771d7d.en: Architecture workshops for children at 125 cours Journu Auber in Bordeaux, a series of 3-hour sessions in which children build projects through diagrams, drawings and models. Part of a 30-workshop programme.

63711e2a92656ea42a43dd7dc788c6d0712111b8.en: An architecture course for children at 125 cours Journu Auber in Bordeaux, with 3-hour workshops in which children develop projects through sketches, drawings and models.

8bd4f121b0d7ee081bb575af9567f0c6c5c575f3.en: A show at La Matière, Masha et le dernier hiver, by Compagnie La Naine Rouge, in which a spoilt princess of an icy kingdom tries to end winter with the help of a golden fish. For ages 5 and up, 35 minutes.

38bfb7fedac47fd5b0e96dec529a70efd92054e7.en: A ciné-concert for children aged 6 and up at the Grand-Théâtre, Azur et Asmar, with Gabriel Yared's music played alongside Michel Ocelot's animation about two boys raised by the same woman.

d1d4b0b452f7f290849e1935b9b36d6a23e52768.en: An animated tale at Le Cuvier de Feydeau, Flow, in which a cat finds refuge on a boat with other animals in a world flooded by water and learns to live together.

5fd9bc4f2ac24928f7b3a943e3bfacff9b8bca71.en: A work-in-progress showing at Le Carré by L'Association du Vide, La Nostalgie de l'acrobate, a project about circus history, with an aerial trapeze experiment and a film by André Bonzel.

f7f96db0e92becbf302cf39777a6d8afbc7656e1.en: A one-man show by Mathieu Madenian at Le Pin Galant, À pleurer de rire, about becoming a father late in life and the absurdity of the news and of parenting today.

c3fb391a2ca080294e285d3af148e891ce6bc4d5.en: A show by Sacko Camara at the Théâtre Trianon, Up & Down, mixing acting and American stand-up, about his life from Abidjan to France, his marriage and his child.

261111d4137d1813911814a345921d394d0ca50e.en: A family workshop at the Musée des Arts décoratifs et du Design, where participants make a paracord bracelet as part of a survival kit. For ages 7 and up, linked to the We will survive exhibition.

fdd4bfc52a3831e15a29ac27cca852a686a69bdf.en: A comedy night at Le Cuvier de Feydeau by Le Gavé Style Comedy Club, with a master of ceremonies and four professional comedians for 1h20.

00bdba4c5388fb76ff60bebcaeee54e35a475f40.en: A concert performance of Lucia di Lammermoor at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, with soprano Nadine Sierra, a tragic bel canto opera about a woman driven to madness after a love forbidden by her family.

8db1472378b34244bda2c961aee0c300bf6b0379.en: A stand-up show by Anne Cahen at L'Estrade, Moment de qualité, about work, introverts and daily life, with doors at 19:30. Cahen won the SACD writing prize in 2024.

9084dba2f36d013b46aa29fc7d029c1b71b16cff.en: A first one-man show by Nick Mukoko, Chronic, at L'Estrade, from a former dancer who turned to stand-up in 2014 and joined the Jamel Comedy Club troupe. Doors at 18:00 and show at 19:00.

e9e60d98acfa53bc678a47fdea80b52c7136b24f.en: A volleyball match at the Palais des Sports in Bordeaux on Saturday 20 February at 19:00, Saforelle VOLSTAR matchday 22, Les Burdis against RC Cannes.

88f619d0d49d039a956cfedd1f5877ed977998aa.en: An immersive theatre and baroque music show at the Grand-Théâtre's Salon Boireau, Theatres of Madness, about Bedlam, the London asylum that was a tourist attraction, with music by Eccles, Parcham and Finger.

f410250c72f2529588881396fc4cfe5664ce4a63.en: A baroque recital at the Auditorium de Bordeaux by mezzo-soprano Stéphanie d'Oustrac with Ensemble Amarillis, on madness in opera, with works by Handel, Purcell, Marais and others.

808b6d9cea8b9265598762acb8eac9d449da2ff8.en: A puppet-and-actor play at La Matière, De l'autre côté, in which a boy invents a cardboard twin named Ogdog and enters her turquoise world. For ages 4 and up, lasting 35 minutes.

37ebe8681fcca746c111bc206386d8501f0a9c54.en: A tea dance at La Coupole with the Sylvie Naugès orchestre, from 14:30. The price is 14 euros, or 11 euros for residents of Loubès, with card payment and booking required.

f4e221f856b3037715f0478dcd9d810ad82bc531.en: A children's show from age 6 at La Matière, Dans la tête de Monsieur Plume, in which a man who dreams of falling is guided into his dream world by Madame Volenski. Lasts 50 minutes.

d451be29234448a06174a79c1e3908af44aba700.en: A concert by Michel Fugain at Le Pin Galant, C'est l'histoire d'une belle histoire, a new show that revisits his classic songs with the joy he is known for.

97029a77795d7d2280ba96c27b1d9def19a3d61b.en: A one-woman show at La Matière, Cartable, by Gloria Da Queija, co-written and directed by Vincent Toujas, about a primary school teacher and her pupils. Played by one actress in many roles. For ages 7 and up.

6d13909d493e9ac96f551827d5db3fd6800a907d.en: A concert by Bamby at Le Rocher de Palmer, a singer from French Guiana whose first album Muse (2025) led to a tour of France with Caribbean rhythms.

ed94efcedf3eb9a2a5dc25dac2b8a21f5e18f871.en: A piano and voice tour by Marc Lavoine at Le Pin Galant, Dans la peau, with pianist Alain Lanty, covering songs by artists who shaped his career. Dates run from February 2027 and end in Paris on 2 June.

fd0f75dc368695c9d1256804ef751a1e988c1362.en: A painting course at the atelier Citrouille on colour mixing with the colour wheel. Two sessions, the second on Saturday 24 April.

55c92d4333c6a30ca79899919b89d6bcf376aff8.en: A commented presentation at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul of rare heritage editions of La Fontaine's Fables from the Bordeaux library. Booking required.

20afafb446b40a7a975fbd4d954117f9a43aaa05.en: A pop-up card workshop for parents and children aged 6 and up at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul, inspired by La Fontaine's animals and fables, after a look at old books. Booking required.

fc145f2b32e6dcfffb712a147652426b9dd6a3cc.en: A theatre piece at the tnba by Baptiste Amann, Ce qui s'est tu (prière pour Baden), about a teenager's wish to die after his father's suicide, performed by three actors in a bare style.

dc3da2a8a4956c2c653f9235d5117fec786ad0b2.en: A volleyball match at the Palais des Sports in Bordeaux on Tuesday 2 March at 20:00, Saforelle VOLSTAR matchday 24, Les Burdis against Levallois-Paris.

0fb733149921fc2e36f8247926d7025ec56fe69c.en: A concert by Giovanni Mirabassi at the Cuvier de Feydeau, presenting Piu Avanti., 25 years after his album Avanti. of revolutionary songs, sung alone at the piano.

16658e51aab72ae1afaf5ed8655093afdf94d90a.en: A dance show at Le Pin Galant by Antonio Najarro's company, Querencia, which traces the styles of Spanish dance from bolero school to flamenco, with costumes and traditional props.

33994d8d0d212f4fa83b8f8c85b9985fda1c07bd.en: A symphony concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux with Beethoven's Violin Concerto and Bruckner's Symphony No. 4, the Romantic. Talks on 2 March and 6 March.

5b3524edc5c0b93f7c0217f09d762e11553a8c6e.en: A staging by David Bobée at Colonnes of Lorenzaccio, Musset's play linked to George Sand's first version, set in 1537 Florence. It asks what political action can do against a tyrant. Accessible to blind, partially sighted, deaf and hard-of-hearing audiences.

8429889d06655a231ddc2d6b5207a3c420985b31.en: A comedy at Le Pin Galant, Potiche, by Barillet and Grédy, with Clémentine Célarié and Philippe Uchan. When a strike forces an umbrella factory boss to step aside, his wife turns out to be a skilled manager.

1ee876f2beaa8b7e77c2a1a0bf7e7d456f046e06.en: A show at the Théâtre Fémina by Guillaume Meurice, about how democracy has weakened, tracing historical causes from Clovis to Charles de Gaulle and asking how to resist resignation.

b1cc3c415529e76801a5bc1bd1d35fd256228ddf.en: A one-man show at the Théâtre Trianon by David Sun, a 30-year-old with three medical degrees who asks whether to stay in medicine or try the stage.

14b99340200fff6360be381846f1dfb05675a22a.en: A show at L'Estrade by Lotfi Abdelli, Je suis bien chez vous, in which the Tunisian comedian talks about being a foreigner in France, with a self-deprecating and irreverent tone. Doors at 19:30 and show at 20:30.

e83f19ee50c28db211c34305c8000746da3b4b8f.en: A concert at Le Pin Galant by Bénabar, presenting songs from his eleventh album and his best-known tracks, including Le dîner, marking 20 years of Reprise des négociations.

8794a7357b50b6b5abb4d4aa8b784986421aef2a.en: A dance-and-sign-language show at La Coupole, Papillons, by Compagnie Le Bruit du Silence, in which three women perform stories of people who broke taboos. In French and French Sign Language.

a12951475e8f86c2a04a80822b79e44db55f1885.en: A comedy at Le Cube by Yann Guillarme, Libre, about contradictions in freedom, with humour and paradoxes. For ages 12 and up, lasting 1h20.

36f070c381eb247c3b537b31f64598d43ed68b39.en: Four contemporary dance pieces at the Grand-Théâtre by the Opera Ballet, in the 11th Quatre tendances programme, by Sol León and Paul Lightfoot, including Sleight of Hand to Philip Glass's music. A meeting with the team is held on 6 March.

101a2ad25838b94f8bee506be5238693d28fed9b.en: A free first-Sunday visit at the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux in March, from 11:00 to 18:00, to see the permanent collections.

3381fb8c8a8618c29f23b7c47e60c7555794d3ca.en: A writing workshop at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul inspired by Samuel Beckett's Waiting for Godot, exploring the many faces of waiting. Booking required.

8e97ce1cfeddc437e94ce0bbe86405e4dc7ede4a.en: A concert at Le Pin Galant by the Orchestre National Bordeaux Aquitaine, conducted by Joseph Swensen, with Beethoven's Violin Concerto. The orchestra descends from the Société Sainte-Cécile, founded in 1850.

03bb07a5d85b0eb0eecc56333b8c529c22044868.en: A concert by Sofia Avramidou at the Grand-Théâtre's Salon Boireau, Dimorphos, which blends Greek traditional instruments with electronic textures. Avramidou is composer in residence at the Opera.

546dca8bcab1dabcb8f40f272d4156ccd8f2c8b2.en: A work at the Cuvier de Feydeau, Malis, la vieille femme et la joie, about an elderly woman, her care and the memories of war and exile that surface in the present.

c67ee93c5e15087df80b2e63526ac1e690a0c900.en: A show at the tnba by Jeanne Candel, CAPRA (une chèvre), which celebrates 40 years of her theatre with a portable altar and a band of performers and instruments, linked to the figure of Dionysus.

4ee6ae4aabe2b9133f52dacf1cd5e6803622a71d.en: A mock lecture at Colonnes by Jérôme Rouger, Imbécile, about stupidity and its place in the age of social media, with scientific data, photographs and humour.

ba57cd2b4e9e74549dd14cf195c549c03794afac.en: A solo show at Le Pin Galant by rock journalist Philippe Manœuvre, Un enfant du rock raconte, in which he reviews decades of rock songs with music, nostalgia and humour.

c746592557a7c49eda29b578f5a43ad3629e4e0d.en: A dance and music show at Colonnes by Compagnie Emilbus, Kou-Kou., with a dancer and a musician playing hide and seek with moving cardboard boxes, which also become the source of sound.

7f48aa9e8b1e7be744ce9d8b23665c432942e7b5.en: A Rencards du savoir talk at the Librairie Georges on neurodivergence, tracing where the word came from and its effects on science, activism and media, with Bernard N'Kaoua and Adèle Hollebecque. Free entry.

d362ae3a6a9651e0cc4246c8ccf2d5b6be9b279e.en: A concert by TeddyBear at Rock School Barbey, a Belgian singer-songwriter from Mons who writes about grief, family and masculinity on his first album, Le Plus Beau.

cb406b317ce04f3e7b3e2570918dbc5f6be91097.en: A show at Le Rocher de Palmer, Birds on a Wire, with Rosemary Standley and Dom La Nena on cello and voices, staged by Étienne Saglio, with songs by Dylan, Brel, Tom Waits and Renaissance airs.

9a08d728c79899aad729b854684add1feef7468d.en: A contemporary dance piece at Le Pin Galant by Ballets Jazz Montréal, La Revue finale, choreographed by Jo Strømgren, about the hidden stories people carry.

713917865a3544b19ec357f3f6d11a4f9c607e6e.en: A one-woman show at the Théâtre Trianon by Elisabeth Buffet, Mes histoires de cœur, about her past loves and funny anecdotes.

767a73570dd77d36583d876a6a1ca12043ef5754.en: A solo of Inuit and Native American tales at the Pôle Culturel Évasion for International Women's Day, exploring women's identity and freedom.

26cbed086d608edba995caef63f35d8df792625d.en: A production at Le Pin Galant of Sacha Guitry's La Jalousie, directed by Michel Fau, a vaudeville about a husband caught in his own lie and gripped by jealousy.

1ab6baa8edaac84c44082d00d0afacca7dab9da4.en: A poetic and musical show at the Théâtre de la Rousselle about the poems of Jacques Prévert, with a guitar, 1h15, for ages 13 and up. Sessions were in November 2025.

1ab9b3b0f4de167e8bd41b618065f9ee372d117f.en: A concert by the Basque group Kalakan with the Breton quintet Ampouailh at Le Cube, mixing traditional and modern music and dance.

b6ceb4ba3c0f153cdfe8c0cc8372707930ecadc7.en: A mixed-media art workshop at the atelier Citrouille, without judgement, combining techniques such as scratching, rubbing, collage and printing.

1fbbb8cff0d0fdbc213c765b55853d5f67f3f991.en: A manga drawing workshop at the Bibliothèque François Mitterrand in Ambarès-et-Lagrave with Akialyne, covering character creation, expressions, proportions and line.

f21bce8136648de60c01e979833d388e80ab53e5.en: A volleyball match at the Palais des Sports in Bordeaux on Saturday 13 March at 16:00, the last matchday of the Saforelle VOLSTAR season, Les Burdis against Vandoeuvre-Nancy, before the play-offs.

b1fc9d2a836548dd34426eb4eaaae09ce70e0ec3.en: A talk at La Coupole with two descendants of Georges Méliès, who share the story of how the film pioneer saved his career with a sweet and a lunar expedition, using their family's sweets and toys.

aab3e894a4f80bea01073a1b962ddb57b86f545b.en: A new show by La Bajon, Zen, at Le Pin Galant, a comedian who jokes about the difficulty of humour today and invites the audience to take the plunge.

8604e6d02420ab26521191ae9875cf5aac6d2959.en: A family session at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, Une heure avec Don Giovanni, with the Opera chorus performing extracts of Mozart's opera, with explanations between pieces. From age 10.

c274d3f0fb36645b44d0b8e915433f960aab9a7b.en: A concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux by conductor Yutaka Sado, with Beethoven's Egmont overture and Symphony No. 1, and Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 5. Students from the region take part.

aab57f8c897fa1698eada93197d34f54b2c7d643.en: A show at Le Pin Galant, Viva La Fiesta, with more than sixty extracts from the Mediterranean to Mexico, performed by young dancers and singers.

11789783db36e7b1f4fbcfe31049e5872093fd30.en: A show at the tnba by Rébecca Chaillon, La Parabole du Seum, a science-fiction story of survival in a world too heavy for a Black lesbian, inspired by Octavia Butler's Parable of the Sower.

356494f5b5e6ee4f4b79c052e119231bbdc8ce8a.en: A circus show at Le Pin Galant by Compagnie Hors Surface, Face aux murs, with six acrobats on a plexiglass wall between two trampolines, exploring human relationships and the walls we face.

3283152c50cdcfee8d69f07cbb93101db01cb9ed.en: An art workshop at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul for children aged 6 and up, exploring cubism and collage, making a work on musical instruments with paper, newspapers and string. Booking required.

42f64ede39700be7dbc94bcc1746894543896a75.en: A traditional Irish dance at the Grand-Théâtre's Salon Boireau for Saint Patrick's Day with the Curious Bards band. Dance initiation is offered, and costume pieces from Opera stores are lent to attendees.

b4e94dc6488d0e830bcfb756ae64b5c9e91e423d.en: A show by Compagnie Les 11% at La Matière, From Martin to Eden, inspired by Jack London's novel, about a sailor who rises socially to win the love of a teacher and become a writer. For ages 12 and up.

b24fc7b7cec9c399eaba842410a473a7a49d5e60.en: A talk at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul on cubism, from its roots in Cézanne to the work of Picasso and Braque. Booking required.

baf711c6d455b4a7edbb34a6547cb488fa967b2d.en: A concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux with Joseph Swensen and the Orchestre National Bordeaux Aquitaine, playing Haydn's London symphonies Nos. 99, 101 and 103. Talk on 15 March at 17:00.

bbeca883c6a86da07b6b26dedb8a8fb6c9168093.en: A game-based performance at Colonnes by Collectif ÈS, Jackpot, in which the audience counts to 100 aloud, and any shared number costs a dance excerpt from the company's past work.

9925b012b9914f48a99f2a2e872f5bba6fa37695.en: A show at Le Cube by Compagnie Chriki'Z, Imagori, in which a dancer tames a paper creature, with a soprano. For ages 4 and up, lasting 35 minutes.

a78d0f0bc3dbf3a16200d1657d2169da629e4f42.en: A brass concert at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck with conservatoire teachers Louis Verchère and Sylvain Delorme and their students, part of the Mériadeck classics series.

6c0a98b4c584d396dbb01133324a3c8408f9ec0a.en: A concert by Jain at the Krakatoa, presenting her fourth album, Soul System, a mix of electro, rock, funk and clubbing.

626e4208ae55cad8d308b0222be6180f05e94df5.en: A rock concert at Le Rocher de Palmer by Skip the Use, presenting their album Love & Anxiety (2026), which mixes rock with funk, hip-hop and reggae. Each member wrote separately before the band assembled the songs.

6b2fa41b7149982fd76b4c7c53ca47f709545e74.en: A baby and toddler music workshop with the Les Caprices de Marianne company, with sound boxes played by a harpist, cellist and clarinettist, and a concert of the three instrument families on 13 December, 24 January and 14 March.

042527c401d6c0da24fc4a0985911b0466d4eae0.en: A theatre piece at Le Cuvier de Feydeau by Jean-Luc Ollivier, Emma (une vie), a rewriting of Madame Bovary from the point of view of Emma, who dreams of freedom and escapes through reading and imagination.

1bf204e758b87b0dff91307e21cc4f219f0a0231.en: A sketch comedy at the Théâtre Trianon, Comment draguer après 50 ans, with two actors playing 14 roles in situations about dating later in life. Lasts 1h15.

fa8ac597ef9e1dfb4960e780fac324c446b082c4.en: A St Patrick's evening at La Coupole, which turns into an Irish pub with local beers and food trucks. Concerts by the Saint-Loubès music school and the Rennes electro-Celtic quintet Green Lads.

b5f02c88c8a71e2168000d6b5fe1a5cbc776c545.en: A concert by Zélie at Colonnes, Le Cœur et sa dictature, which blends electronic pop with contemporary dance and hip-hop, exploring youth, love and self-discovery.

e7feff9f16d79181a5aa0a56016d9eac1a76a24c.en: An immersive show for children aged 0 to 4 at the Maison des Arts Vivants, Couverture, in which the audience builds a shared nest from pebbles, wood, music and fabric. Lasts 30 minutes, then 15 minutes of free exploration.

2f4a5ed56c89101677ab7b6ee0ec8731b3f58494.en: A magic show at Le Pin Galant, the seventh Maîtres de l'Illusion, with illusionist Éric Leblon, the duo Yurgen and Florette, manipulator Olivier Henning and the Mag Edgard company.

57f0206802bede7aee3869bb30b7173900d4256e.en: A show at the tnba, Mon Frère, in which Christian Gremaud plays his own role in French Sign Language, with his brother François translating aloud at the edge of the stage.

56b846a4711548e44fb979c8af7f47fe063376f7.en: A comedy show at the Théâtre Molière by Melha Bedia, who uses the image of a bus route to talk about her life with a candid, uninhibited tone.

837071550699c6e677be2eed1d4f65242910f005.en: A comedy at Le Pin Galant by Jean-Claude Grumberg, Dans le couloir, with Jean-Pierre Darroussin and Christine Murillo as an elderly couple whose adult son moves back in. Mixes humour and melancholy about old age.

0833e044276772be8d91ac33f92f50d558a9fdb8.en: A duel of hip-hop and beatbox at Le Cube, Candide by Jeunes Princes, with dancer Isma and beatboxer Osy, who is a double French champion. For ages 6 and up, lasting 50 minutes.

4b1075385679f969872873314d6c80237bcf17ce.en: A piano recital by Hélène Grimaud at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, with Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 32 and Schubert's late Sonata in B-flat major, D. 960.

035c45c99978f97e27bd0b5e828832abef41c635.en: A concert at Le Pin Galant by the Groupe Vocal Arpège de Bordeaux with Mozart's Requiem, in the version completed by Süssmayr, a work written in the last months of Mozart's life.

9e4238de42c0a7ab2a234c907145e27233c667bb.en: A concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux with Yulianna Avdeeva playing Prokofiev's Piano Concerto No. 2, with Rachmaninov's Aleko extracts and Tchaikovsky's Manfred Symphony, in the Rachmaninov saga.

0f55dd1ea7f7a4dd3642e6062305a41729e989c9.en: A reggae concert at Rock School Barbey by YaniSs Odua, a Martinican singer known for Rouge Jaune Vert and Chalawa, with a career of almost three decades.

52c92f7ad2632f1fa4d583cd486771641c5871a5.en: A comedy at Le Pin Galant, Un château de cartes, with Isabelle Gélinas and Gérard Darmon, in which a dinner party turns upside down after a jealous quarrel and a guest arrives after a breakdown.

a6b899e7f3ec367fb28befd122dea52b04f09bd9.en: A stand-up show by Ike at L'Estrade, Ike, about relationships, routine and the modern madness of living together, from his background in Martinique, Ireland and Paris. Lasts 1h10.

bf7c9159db8b8512e2811269c8bdd2da0234d633.en: An improvised show at L'Estrade by Maxime Vaché, En roue libre, with no script, where every performance is built on the spot with the audience. Minimum age 12 and lasts one hour.

d88fb3f31b7b7dcc1fc520e0ca361590609b0d8f.en: A show at Le Cube by Compagnie Maesta-Théâtre, Origine(s), which blends theatre, video and electronic music to explore myths about the origins of the universe. For ages 9 and up, lasting 55 minutes.

88df60050483604a219576f2b8005d21a354b18f.en: A concert by Les Arts Florissants at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, two Italian Passion oratorios for orchestra and soloists by Giacomo Antonio Perti and Luigi Rossi, performed just before Easter.

ec1d9ba20682f5f55bf2d4e8c8d079f3d326e541.en: A talk-show-style evening at Le Pin Galant with Sylvie Vartan, Ma vie en chansons, avec vous, moderated by Roland Perez, with personal confidences, questions from the audience and films, plus songs. Dates in February, March and April 2027.

6da3a62f8a90d028cb24d2a8b0cf0113ace320ac.en: A theatre piece at Colonnes by the Swiss collective Dreams Come True, Dear Luigi, I Hate You, a speculative fiction in which the widow of a healthcare CEO meets his killer, after the performers went through a restorative justice process.

c4108d4f2dc98d955b60795c3b48161ee6b40622.en: A concert at the Krakatoa by LGMX, a nine-piece group that plays electronic and brass-band music, with brass in place of synthesisers.

1a63045fa394ef49fd99ee353f2e45e7a245441e.en: A stand-up show by Pierre Metzger at L'Estrade, Gauchiasse, a satire of the world through his own life, between the sickle and the hammer. Not suitable under 12. Doors at 18:00.

5e50e2158cc1920ba906e5f7cddacd9c19c924e4.en: A one-man show at Le Pin Galant by Philippe Caverivière, Tu crois que c'est une bonne idée ?, that finds laughter in painful subjects and turns absence into comedy.

63cfb9a80e947718f2fbef28dc7eeae682b135ee.en: A winter tale at the Maison des Arts Vivants, Sage comme neige, by Les Créants: a girl punished for insulting her father's food walks through a snowy forest. Mixes drawn concert and object theatre. Ages 4 and up, 45 minutes.

3a95a0938300616fe26a0b41ee2a46b9c7360e7f.en: A stand-up show by Julie Conti at L'Estrade, Nuances, a sharp, sarcastic set on stereotypes and social norms, drawing on her experience as a woman, a mother and a partner. Not suitable under 14. Doors at 18:00.

09fe18faca9674cf5f645eb3bbbf65b95b11fedf.en: A tea dance at La Coupole with the David Firmin orchestra, from 14:30. The price is 14 euros, or 11 euros for residents of Loubès, with card payment and booking required.

237ffe5cb78103de8b5b06f029351b6a2b8d44b8.en: A play at Le Cube by Compagnie Idio(m)rythmie, Trajectoire(s), about Érion, who leaves Kosovo for Lyon, and how football helps him make friends and search for Sarah. For ages 8 and up, lasting 45 minutes.

851974b29eb7659fbdfd13dd9903bf8bfdd2da02.en: A play at Le Pin Galant, Le Père by Florian Zeller, with Pierre Arditi and Irène Jacob, the third part of Zeller's trilogy. An ageing father moves in with his daughter and slowly loses his mind.

b272f2787cc7442d239cd845edf48951437adf31.en: A political show at the tnba, Rituel 4: Le Grand Débat, with Laurent Poitrenaux and Emmanuelle Lafon, a cut-up of televised presidential debates from 1974 to today, staged as a TV programme. Lasts one hour.

37e7d3d4a7d1b2c8b98d9c3af0a3a446746e6972.en: A concert at Le Rocher de Palmer by the Vieux Farka Touré Quartet, with a guitarist who blends Malian blues with other styles. Part of the Mali focus.

040fa419daab276f1c8a5cb24f12a0a8838a8c0f.en: A dance piece at Colonnes, Crossover, by (LA)HORDE, the Ballet national de Marseille, mixing contemporary, club and Lindy Hop styles with eight dancers.

afe616e3ce88877d9e600f3f7c60b3c2e874f81e.en: A concert at Le Rocher de Palmer by Hooverphonic, celebrating 30 years, with singer Noémie Wolfs, who was the group's lead voice for more than five years.

2b1d3abd69f1deaab5437ff27aeeae4ceb6f5d8c.en: A concert at Le Rocher de Palmer by Vieux Farka Touré, singer and guitarist who presents his album Les Racines (2022) with Malian musicians. Presented with the Opéra national de Bordeaux as a Mali focus.

12b29a581b227ab596ab97f4133b2f56c1e14ba5.en: The Mois de la Photo, a free photography month in Bordeaux each April, with exhibitions across the city's eight districts, in places such as the Jean Moulin centre and the Halle des Chartrons.

5d3b259a88624441599ff0722d9893fadaaf259b.en: An exhibition at the Musée d'Aquitaine about the Village andalou, a Roma housing estate in northern Bordeaux, photographed by Christophe Goussard from 1993 to 1996 with the children who lived there. The estate was destroyed in 2001.

dc43bb73630239ab7f9ea52241f292c68efaf8de.en: An April Fool's concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux with conductor Simon Proust and the Orchestre National Bordeaux Aquitaine, a programme of comic pieces, kept as a surprise. Relaxed session with easy-read documents available.

41332d7af8b3df2570672b4f4518b9797c37ad36.en: A concert at Le Rocher de Palmer by La Yegros, an Argentine nu-cumbia group that mixes folk, afrobeat and dancehall, led by singer Mariana Yegros.

dfe16cf902aa9a9b79d9c758993a012d003e7a38.en: A concert at the Pin Galant de Mérignac by Fatoumata Diawara, a Malian singer who sings in Bambara about Africa, freedom and women's issues. Part of the Mali focus.

4c558d210bcd3e5bcacc2de44fb2678008402983.en: A concert at the Lieu in Bordeaux by Lushe, a 21-year-old French rapper known for freestyles on social media, whose song Montmartre reached 32nd place in the Top 50.

2caaa205892a8ff225381c5388a1ef03ebf3be9b.en: A concert at Le Pin Galant by Fatoumata Diawara, singer from Mali who mixes pop with Bambara lyrics on injustices such as female genital cutting and forced marriage.

a042b4785ba23a4e1f7a3e92bb136fa432396130.en: A chorus workshop at the Bibliothèque Mériadeck, Le geste et la voix, with students of the Chœur d'application and the conducting class.

fb7ead8fd96c4087080fd07e4a6e0cb58f2dff0c.en: A piano recital by Khatia Buniatishvili at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, a Georgian-French pianist and regular visitor to the Opera since her 2023 residency. Concerts there sell out.

af8680e56a778a3a08e584626bd60b6c0aa76e85.en: A play at La Coupole, Naïa, in which a girl who fled her village after her mother's arrest finds a refuge in a travelling circus where decisions are made together.

b66f6ff9e4ea61c4bcf1a3fa27d01a595066dda5.en: A comedy from Quebec at Colonnes, Le poids des fourmis, by Théâtre Bluff, about two students who stand against each other in school elections while sharing anxieties about the future. Performed by four actors.

93ee0793eba69caabd071bbd04921a984b54e0d9.en: A stand-up show by Margaux Cipriani at L'Estrade, Tout haut, on couples, motherhood, parenting and society. Doors at 19:30 and show at 20:30.

e1045557ade425b91d38e5e72dee5fea29db4f68.en: A stand-up show by Élodie Emery at Le Cube, Ceci n'est pas une religion, about her ten-year investigation into a sexual and financial scandal in Tibetan Buddhism. Ages 15 and up. Contains testimonies of abuse.

b1de30a073a2271068babf46aaa000572fd4bac8.en: A romantic comedy at Le Pin Galant with Clovis Cornillac, Mur Mure, adapted from the film Un peu, beaucoup, aveuglément, about a misanthropic inventor whose quiet is disturbed by a pianist moving into the next flat.

e30eb16ed4482c4f5ab022a52d56cdbbcf065535.en: A concert by Stranded Horse with kora player Boubacar Cissokho, presenting The Warmth You Deserve, an album of long, open songs.

2b0bff0260f05a60e5723f7093065b09fd3306be.en: A photography event by the LUX Tour, a mobile darkroom caravan visiting festivals, in which visitors' heartbeats are captured on silver gelatin paper and taken home as prints.

dbaa17a8c3e4ffa7a27ac8a64107400e506da093.en: A kora concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux by Ballaké Sissoko, who closes a festival on Malian voices. He presents his new album Mande Tabolo, drawing on the Mandingo griot tradition.

9d731ee79bc9b1b8ffbbd9628a414be7ebd44574.en: A tribute concert at Rock School Barbey to Manu Chao, Mano Negra and Radio Bemba, by the band Me Gustas Tú, with songs including Clandestino, Bongo Bong and La Rumba de Barcelona. Part of a French and Spanish tour in April 2027.

2b21bbb2b929bbea5b4cfe4833616225f7891271.en: A stand-up show by Babor at L'Estrade, his first show, an hour of jokes. Doors at 19:30 and show at 20:30.

1fe578b5abb53207e6f5df0464a4aef9612d79ac.en: Free entry to the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux on the first Sunday of April, from 11:00 to 18:00, to see the permanent collections.

3f2c5a8ebcf5902a7d9d9a8ef922e4229bb2eaf8.en: A fact-checking workshop at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul, a participatory game run by a journalist from Far Ouest about telling fake news from facts. Booking required.

877f57c33b7a605b83936a49fe4dd800f0c9d993.en: A solo concert at Le Pin Galant by Jeanne, who first became known with Respire fort, which passed 25 million streams, presenting her first solo tour.

cef7a4618f8352354fa4a06f6b0e094f18ff0fc7.en: A children's play at the tnba by Valérie Mréjen, Pomme-frite, in which three actors reenact children's imaginative ways of saying goodbye to lost pets, through song, dance and small props. Part of the Projet Kids programme.

d6980c06d815b16c722bf9e2453ba2edb5760329.en: A play at the tnba by Audrey Bonnet, rien n'est su, a long chant by a mother whose daughter died in the Bataclan attacks, performed by eight young actors. Music by Dan Levy and lighting by Yves Godin.

8103d1a9f8e09095c52f2e3f74b5b1748eb964ee.en: A wind-band programme at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, Extreme Beethoven by Johan de Meij, a reworking of Beethoven's symphonies for concert band, with works by Backer-Grøndahl, Coleman and Likhuta. Bookings open 6 March 2027 at 13:00.

1c6081efa4039358972e85a6569b47b7ba4fcb2a.en: A family show at Le Pin Galant, Arsène Lupin, Gentleman Illusionniste, a magic and suspense show set in the 1920s Paris, in which Lupin races against the Countess of Cagliostro and the inspector Ganimard.

a13406c1b3c95fb05f98ab1c1f2cab77e0790f89.en: A short show for young children at Le Cuvier de Feydeau, Pied, Main, Bouche, in which a child discovers the body and the world, with beatbox sounds and a mosaic of anatomy.

3476badb45fcae39e50d723fb02985a3b2d260c8.en: A children's concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, Pierre et le Loup by Prokofiev, with the full orchestra playing each character. A school session takes place on 8 April at 14:30. For ages 5 and up.

ab6cd88747e754b29f78f6b195fad8e38fd272be.en: A magic show at Le Pin Galant by Gus, Givré, with illusions set in the high mountains, mixing poetry, interaction and humour.

c21e3b6470f614022b1b8674122f354dc8c075ac.en: A one-woman show at La Matière, Yvonne ou ma Génération Y, by Clothilde Aubert, about a thirty-year-old woman who rewinds her life through the events from the late 1980s to today. For ages 12 and up, lasting 1h10.

6ba4aba4f8d906807b5bb6346259fe3879d49f10.en: A work-in-progress showing at La Vacherie, Savitri la vaillante, by the Agence de Géographie Affective, a storytelling piece set in the outdoor landscape, based on a 2,000-year-old tale from the Mahabharata.

4f7a01a40dec43c48845b9502ff317dca24616b6.en: A stand-up and variety show at the Théâtre Trianon by Walid Jabbari, N'oublie pas qui tu es, a nostalgic show with dancers and references to the 1990s.

c1934af81a80b4afa8e9e799ace316c2c8f271c4.en: A choral event at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, Chante Aquitaine, where teachers and education staff of the Bordeaux academy join schoolchildren for a school music celebration.

63609351aa2295a2614cde725e8536f178e954a4.en: A pop and bright version of Molière's Le Cocu imaginaire at the Théâtre Molière, about a portrait that sparks jealousy and a web of mistaken identities. Directed with Xavier Viton, Nicolas Payero and Clarissa Donou.

3178c0ea82eb9682fb0a43e6f6b337290995c4e0.en: A concert at Le Pin Galant by Youssoupha, Gospel Symphonique Expérience, in which his rap is joined by a gospel choir and classical musicians, directed by cellist Olivier Koundouno.

a3e03fc2798db32dd3e3dd0170adde035e3c3410.en: A comic-book café at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul on journalism in comics, with the bookshop KrazyKat. Booking required.

5e642d1c8164ef2285787b9545863f5b753f035e.en: A stand-up show by Yoan Bertetto at L'Estrade, Une belle surprise, from a comedian on the Nantes scene and co-founder of the Micro Comedy Club. Doors at 18:00 and show at 19:00. Ages 16 and up.

116ea95a44d2f2d8b8b5c7a06436bdfeadbe3ce1.en: A concert by Barbara Hannigan and Bertrand Chamayou at the Auditorium de Bordeaux, with Messiaen's Chants de Terre et de Ciel, Scriabin pieces and John Zorn's Jumalattaret.

56b1eef672995ac8382907ed18d657c7337f61dd.en: A concert at Krakatoa by Peter Hook & The Light, playing the Joy Division albums Unknown Pleasures and Closer in full.

6bfb913570f9b008ff683fe3617566ff472b3e60.en: A concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux by Polifonia, Viva Vivaldi, with Vivaldi's Magnificat, Dixit Dominus, Cum dederit, Gloria and Credo. Polifonia celebrates its 30th anniversary.

d7010f30002642260a0e5a21ffc43f9e20083908.en: An immersive escape game at the Médiathèque Jacques Ellul, to test analysis, puzzle solving and fact checking. Booking required.

69c38c4fbe72687038cac597f3e04eb49a652076.en: A show at Le Cuvier de Feydeau, La légende d'Ochi, about a girl in a Carpathian village who finds a baby creature abandoned by its pack, and goes against the rules to return it.

28a6c02bca99c429b4583f320c732b464997cc23.en: A new production of Verdi's Macbeth at the Grand-Théâtre, directed by Ambre Kahan, co-produced with the Opéra Orchestre Normandie Rouen. Vibrating vests are trialled for deaf and hard-of-hearing audiences on 16 April.

200207862d7aeeb68c6461da6747cec6b8112281.en: A family concert at the Grand-Théâtre, Une heure avec Macbeth, with an actor reading Shakespeare's drama and the Opera chorus singing Verdi's music. From age 10. Also celebrates Salvatore Caputo's 30 years with the chorus.

4d87261058abe27755ef284be040f0df24255200.en: A Rachmaninov concert at the Auditorium de Bordeaux with Vocalise, Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto No. 4 and Sibelius's Symphony No. 2, the last stage of the Rachmaninov cycle.

f57524de46cd7d864b3d12257f4424561d81ace0.en: A stand-up show by Anne Roumanoff at Le Pin Galant, L'âge libre, in which she plays a range of characters to look at the contradictions of the modern world.

3238d10cf9aac060fe9bf612c76fdef686402760.en: A stand-up show by Noam Sinseau at the Théâtre Fémina, Makoumè Superstar, about identity and freedom, moving from Martinique to Paris with voguing and poetry.

20dde1cb17515672da84221093ec56c169888a0c.en: A show by Moguiz at Le Pin Galant, Coucou., in which the comedian, who became known on social media, plays a gallery of improvised characters on stage.

0704a8a2690184799bc746958043660609fd2a57.en: A concert by Tayc at the Arkéa Arena in Bordeaux, presenting his second album JOŸA (2026), a joyful record that mixes R&B with new sounds. Part of the JOŸA tour for 2027.

ce6b505988910bca528d8acbe75b2725340a3112.en: "Overdose", a permanent exhibition of over 650 works by emerging and international artists.

fb039a117a4f7b3f59365b855e8a35d2d2cabb4b.en: Cineville, a film-pass membership giving unlimited cinema visits across Brussels cinemas.

402693578bf918321df3a39650ccaa3fdc731fec.en: "Coward", a film about a young soldier, Pierre, who wants to prove himself on the battlefield in the First World War.

2e94cba8aca15fd3f3b2920d188d56d1a1d4adbd.en: "Wicker", a film about a smelly, single fisherwoman living on the outskirts of a seaside village.

c9fc393d11616ed04b2df590a3700638a4a56e39.en: "Coyote vs Acme", a film in which a luckless lawyer, Kevin Avery, is hired by Wile E. Coyote.

2a08c2b3d6f25c97b73b4ffb8cd3d88402845176.en: "Shaun the Sheep: The Great Halloween", an animated film where Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm turns to dismay.

65ba6a9314af6c689683e634d02ae31435f8efe6.en: "Karma", a film about Jeanne trying to build a new life in a village in northern Spain.

eab9326ccdb60ded9482344d05272b1cd0f28acc.en: Tyla in concert, with Royal MusiQ as support act.

d7377bf93b62ac37588de9e41d9b4dee17225cb3.en: "NAZA", a documentary on the systems behind large-scale civilian casualties in Gaza.

54d1277e45bb3fbf5207d875c6a22152b92558e9.en: A screening of "The Man from Island West" (1989), made alongside Michael Lin's exhibition "Tea Towels and Serviettes" at La Loge.

6186c086c112a58ecae0f5986694b8c0bffc7af9.en: "Legacy of the Builder King", a documentary on the complex history of King Leopold and his impact on Congo and Belgium.

dc216346b16a1f81f6fb9fcf7f7a2628a995e47b.en: Glitchh, a Brussels three-piece playing post-internet experimental metal.

9e1c6536afa34f2ca09a81fa163045c30267fb8c.en: Izzy Nu with NIDA, a vintage-inspired pop act raised in southern Spain and based in Brussels.

82872e0d9e3d7b0df3bfed4e0a0a72a06fa97771.en: The Expat Cinema screening of "Coward", about a young soldier in the First World War.

08c8357f242c4e863b2cdb792a8f13b98ff4a64f.en: NOMAD x SCÈNE, an exclusive international night in Brussels after four sold-out nights.

f7257a231d2f5df8485f45b826781f9a4aa89dd3.en: Buurtkeuken: a weekly neighbourhood community kitchen, this week serving Bissara and fried aubergine.

6f5385f4b81e86da3ba3286f1923289e1f8e3978.en: A Japanese calligraphy (shodo) exhibition showing the art of Japanese brush writing.

f9dcb2be1b69d4f9622d356b5a1e6ae20ac38dec.en: "Monster Mia", an animated film about a girl sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy.

2d7f11dd6758d0a4a6ffac28abd0be9c1cc783f3.en: "Res Nullius", a free screening on living alongside wild animals in the city, supported by the Wallonia-Brussels Federation.

7486e225bb2887b4f085b12011637fed344b9484.en: Camp d'escalade d'automne is a rock-climbing camp for children and teens aged 7 to 16, run in Lancy and Vernier as part of the GE-visIci programme. Places are limited and registration is required.

46537b6890c3fea4f3bdf8b6f59bbc49b57e1762.en: Le Grand Atelier runs an autumn wood-toy workshop for children aged 7 to 13 from 19 to 23 October. Participants design and build their own wooden games, and places cost 250 CHF for the week.

a22218dc17db6ebff80333e61977c41d46b78f16.en: Rencontres is the first group exhibition of the artists Nathalie Berthod, Gill Einhorn, Janet Petitpierre and Sophie Wirth Brentini at Galerie Trajets in Carouge. It runs from 1 to 25 October 2026.

f3a3f1adef35246e0af3c60fef73d16b8e8c9a85.en: The Ferme urbaine de Thônex sets up at the François-Auguste Châtrier park for five days from 21 to 25 October. Visitors can meet farm animals and take part in playful activities.

2bd22c99bcd0c57d3c14a710dc12cb05df7e44e1.en: RIFT is a solo installation by Séverin Guelpa at HiFlow in Geneva. The sound-driven piece explores the rift as a place of listening and relation, with an opening performance and dinner on 18 September.

7f776460a3d93ecc5a6f8df89c04c67d1ee06405.en: The HEM Geneva marks 50 years since the death of composer and harpsichordist Marguerite Roesgen-Champion. The day includes a concert and an exhibition from 15 October to 14 November, based on the library's archive.

63931300d03b63dde2da7fbf43698e4440c586b2.en: Halloween chocolate workshop run by a professional from La Bonbonnière Genève. Participants learn about Swiss artisanal chocolate, taste it, and make a chocolate cauldron for Halloween.

a0f604167dc11c13b42cc7b1ff592378c7f5d73a.en: The Forum Faubourg exhibition shows the projects from the architecture competition to transform the Bout-du-Monde sports centre. The winning design includes new halls, a pool and a skate park, with exhibition visits from 13 to 31 October.

ca0145c9cfa1f264e981cba45fd0a99742fdd40a.en: Tango Argentin beginners' classes take place every Thursday at lunchtime at the Maison de quartier de Plainpalais. The classes are run by Dorotea Schepens and Esteban and are open to newcomers.

99218e7f8e7cddb37673d5c1be1fbfd263cbcee3.en: The 2026 LGBTIQ+ history month in Geneva runs throughout October. Events include a roundtable on missing queer archives, a talk on intersex history, and a conference marking the 40 years of the ILIS conference held in Geneva.

fb218e1f89ffff643e4235550352d85022383a8e.en: Martha Stettler's work is presented at the Musée d'art et d'histoire, followed by a queer-perspective audioguide tour of the museum's emblematic works.

90b882a77f1b1b13e09fa15d7bf9d75512813a94.en: Permanence Numérique at the Espace Ville de Genève offers free, unbooked one-to-one help with devices, emails, online procedures and internet safety. It runs on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 12:30 to 16:00.

b62c5984f6eb33b25f84a2e715f80783cf8f4ee9.en: Sophro Léman is a free weekly group sophrology session by the Léman lakeside, held on Thursdays from 12:30 to 13:15 at the Parc des Eaux-Vives. A first session is free and open to anyone aged 16 and over.

940d89397bf2aaa29ce54b68aadc3ba3350952ab.en: Short Ass Attention Span #3 is a collection of texts by artists and writers, a mix of fanzine and artist's book. This edition is shaped by Ethan Assouline, Gaia Vincensini and Pauline Coquart at L'Arcade.

4fbefc167d75d8c7256d24c628ac413c3d3c4479.en: Histoires gravées dans la pierre is a sold-out reading club at the Musée d'art et d'histoire for children aged 6 and over. Participants listen to sculptures and then do a playful activity, with a further session on 7 November.

491650b6811f40e8978857ed0197a810a53e4fa4.en: Les Impromptus by Cindy Van Acker is a sold-out in situ dance performance at the Musée d'art et d'histoire. The choreographer creates spontaneous pieces in response to the artworks and the people present.

ba49a3fcc5b624e0e03a35574b458fd793238b1d.en: FRENCH MON AMOUR, season 10 episode 3, is a showcase of young French-language bands at the Chat Noir. Albert Chinet, Sacha Maffli, Poligone and Sahëlie perform, and three acts will be picked for the Voix de Fête 2027 festival.

c074fcdb988c6a5efe692d3576b6e7ebf99951af.en: Le Dieu du carnage, Yasmina Reza's satirical comedy, is staged at Théâtre Pitoëff. Two couples meet to settle a playground fight politely, but the conversation quickly turns into a sharp and funny verbal clash.

e2cd1f24b055899bfa75ed24e6d33443501f03c3.en: The 32nd Mondial de l'Impro, the world amateur improv championship in French, runs in Geneva from 15 to 24 October. Teams from Algeria, Belgium, France, Québec and Switzerland compete, with the final on 24 October.

4a50a672623c8c68148d3c93667d3f37c61d5b87.en: Big Band des Eaux-Vives performs Echoes of the Messengers at the Alhambra. The concert reinterprets jazz by Art Blakey, Horace Silver and others, with special guest, the tap dancer Daniel Leveillé.

a5032016d4315b8e454dfcfc58f72675416e2c58.en: The Place du 1er Août market offers fresh bread, fruit and vegetables twice a week in the morning. At lunchtime, a rotisserie and two food trucks serve local workers and nearby school pupils.

0063782e4c3012a7d6efeab3c8d4fe8bd37da6fc.en: À l'ombre des découvertes is a family activity at the Musée d'histoire des sciences. Visitors play with shadows and learn how they helped scientists discover the shape of the Earth and planetary motion.

7e20c4f3e475f08b49be9d3437227ed184111072.en: Humanitarian, by Design? is an exhibition at the Red Cross museum on the design of aid. It presents improvised and institutional objects, from first-aid kits to shelters, used in crises and displacement.

5ca1596a83424a74ba8ca6b88bcc604f1beb1030.en: Louise Desnos's Acedia is a photography project at the Centre de la photographie Genève. Its contemplative images praise laziness as a creative act and a form of resistance to productivity culture.

c6b23bac6a7d25e8370f49858164592b1d4248ab.en: Le verre, au-delà de la matière is an exhibition at the Ariana museum of more than 200 glass objects from the Cirva collection in Marseille. Works by Ettore Sottsass, Betty Woodman and others show a transdisciplinary approach.

86b41096544a7a15099573ac3dbd0f029f01c790.en: Ferdinand Hodler. Profession de foi is an exhibition at the International Museum of the Reformation. It examines the religious roots of Hodler's painting, with around 25 works on his nature-based spirituality.

2eb3e68f148d3c3b4020bc9f1c0d89e18a027466.en: BlackOut is an outdoor escape game in the Parc des Bastions. Players must find the hidden nodes of a power grid across the Old Town, using a hacking tool, in 10 puzzles.

4ab24b12beb7c4bf04326073549c083747e3a142.en: Dance with dad or mum is a hip-hop class for parents and children at the Pont-Rouge neighbourhood space. It runs on Wednesdays at 9:30 and 10:30, including school holidays, for 12 CHF per family.

4c246818aa74eed22dd9e961693247a28b2b8576.en: Organise a natural cosmetics workshop for a child's birthday. The providers come to your home or chosen venue with materials to make fruity soaps, coloured shower gels and lip balms.

4719b96ca32c769e7455c016707d8dff2c166ef1.en: Festival ANIMATOU showcases contemporary animation from around the world, with competitions, a public prize, family screenings and workshops. It takes place across several Geneva venues, and the full programme is published on 17 September 2026.

3c65e16ad91f86395c824f4c47005c3205068df7.en: Le Portail Magique is an outdoor augmented-reality treasure hunt in Geneva's Old Town, played in the Parc des Bastions. Players learn the secret of crystals and defend the city in ten challenges, suitable from age 10.

3eb9b9866988d8e3637306789e2f454dc3d73131.en: Border Forensics presents three investigations into violence at borders, using film extracts and data analysis. Cases include the death of a Nigerian woman in the Alps and a man killed by police at Morges station.

d8a2f1d4ddfe58cff52cccd73663d28b7b4c85c0.en: Bonjour, ça va? is an exhibition at the Bibliothèque de la Cité on everyday acts of care and connection. Fictional characters, drawn from real life, show how small gestures help build a more inclusive society.

58a6e88ce742a96f54636c8734f631380ae0e4bb.en: Opération Mindfall is an outdoor escape game in the Parc des Bastions. Teams act as new secret agents, have 100 minutes to follow clues from a missing scientist, and face 10 puzzles across the Old Town.

3bd694797a07dd7484080dd68a0b120400c56599.en: «Jamais la nature ne nous trompe» is an exhibition at the Geneva Botanical Garden showing a herbarium made by Jean-Jacques Rousseau in the 1770s, bought at auction in 2024, with botanical books.

1b8cb03217f50f13b6d61eae4bdf43d9c251ca16.en: Fuite au Marché Machin is an exhibition at Villa Bernasconi by a temporary collective of illustrators, made during a September residency. Visitors can see the work from 15 October to 17 January 2027.

dd7eeb3ce0fcbcbae744d05e521929212797d053.en: The Place des Ormeaux market is open on Tuesdays and Thursdays, selling seasonal fruit and vegetables, coffee, groceries, meat, roast chicken and hamburgers-frites.

2ffb6396b3dc491f903885776683be5927497bde.en: PROJEKTIL presents GENESIS at the Espace Saint-Gervais, a light show about the origins of the universe. Animations are fitted to the building's walls and ceilings, with ambient music.

beec7f22d2dc009a922d645c343f990e056f7d04.en: The Pont-Rouge market in Lancy sells sustainable, local and low-carbon produce every week. It also hosts an afterwork programme and, in summer, a series of concerts.

a37822d70d102b13f0660aa51071e535ff30c5b6.en: Ateliers créatifs at the Lancy municipal library, run by Compagnie Inès, offer parent-and-child workshops. A doudou-making session and a song workshop are free for children aged 5 and over.

4738910058a2c6f51182623c63c5a6eaab83be6f.en: Atelier du Management Durable at the Maison de l'Avenir covers carbon finance, scaling impact and the Geneva Forum. The programme includes project updates and a consultation on Geneva as an impact capital.

82c24c9807685c25b53b4f990457c41da40e71f1.en: L'École du Chocolat at La Bonbonnière is a chocolate workshop where participants learn the history of the house, make their own chocolate bar with toppings and taste two signature creations.

cc9438f79639e4cff590c06352fad06d735e2d89.en: Par le moi by Sonia Grimm is a musical for children aged 6 to 14, about a girl who talks with her conscience about bullying and self-esteem. It is free and followed by a discussion.

e7e7d54f62de3391ca76fa582097b9ff02e17f5a.en: Compose your own herbarium sheet à la Rousseau at the Botanical Garden's education space. Visitors choose dried plants and learn how to mount and name them, leaving with a sheet to keep.

637c4d99aafd5a57827989241fcbcdec2cdd13fa.en: The Olympics of seeds is a family game at the Botanical Garden about seed dispersal. Teams pick six champion seeds for challenges based on wind, gravity and hooks.

e63c9755a8beabdc9b9893aace1885a8e7046ab5.en: Our Biodiversity memory game at the Botanical Garden pairs before-and-after images of actions for nature. It draws on the city's biodiversity strategy.

c3dc5321071e735a70d05163ce52f7459f068f7e.en: The Botanical Garden's education space welcomes visitors to explore plants and fungi with herbarium sheets, magnifiers and seeds. The opening hours are Wednesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

1bb8fb600f2ce6b0dd5d0365aede8fcd724cf892.en: Le Mystère Lucy Lost is an advance screening at Les Scala. A girl with extraordinary gifts is rejected by her island village and sets out to uncover the secret of her powers.

228de3b1ddd4b82e6fac6c978cd288d5808324ee.en: Chocolate monster is a chocolate workshop for children at a Geneva venue. Young chocolatiers learn about the story of chocolate, taste it and create their own edible monster.

371460b0e81296fecce7173f1cba8d86c8e08439.en: Digital help at the Rive droite Permanence numérique, at the OSEO Geneva headquarters, gives free, walk-in one-to-one advice on devices, emails, online procedures and internet safety. Opening days and a special session on 19 November are listed.

d614ef74fd39d93582d85907a4e2e17368cc17ac.en: The October digital workshops at the Rive droite Permanence numérique cover CV writing in Word, internet searches and CV and cover letters with AI. They are free and held on Friday evenings and Saturday mornings.

7f838e4d6a3141c393c92bc28db3ee34d55bd730.en: La Galerie Diamono in Carouge shows arts and traditions of South-East Asia. Free entry is by appointment, and guided visits are available on request.

719601d4e4f97f5df22887e8b8df3d16b1b294e2.en: Festival du Soir turns Palexpo into a ten-year anniversary festival with electronic music, circus, live concerts and themed nights. Headliners include Madame Loyal, GIMS, Boney M. and Paul Kalkbrenner across October weekends.

c88a0ace42d7dff358effbdc47b39c3f0490c588.en: Toy Under Development is a performance lecture by Geumhyung Jeong at Le Commun, with video and sound. It revisits her works with robots and objects, exploring where the body ends and objects begin.

3b5baf33d02f5b8fdfd9327b1246158417b344b5.en: Benjamin Epps, Sebb Bash and DJ Stresh play Le Rez-Usine. The Gabonese rapper, the Swiss producer and the French DJ and champion mix hip-hop with personal stories.

de9c24756995b0907fa85575d22031f5962a5328.en: Entrez en matière is an exhibition at the University of Geneva that follows the life of a grain of sand, from its use in concrete to the environmental and social costs of extraction.

3b5bb1fa97e30c6748981fe6ce354169acb729c9.en: Luther plays the Alhambra in Geneva on 23 October 2026 as part of the Sublime Tour. Doors open at 19:00 and the concert starts at 20:00, and the minimum age is 7.

1807e72ae6e8814b82b94214db53ebfc8b6c3c13.en: L'éveil du tigre release party marks Noam Antonio's new project at the Usine Kugler on Friday 23 October, from 21:00 to midnight. Guests join him on stage and the entry is pay-what-you-can.

1e9f30ba45ce3ab60687a3e5908fe2b6650f6988.en: Ensemble Ensemble, a quintet started by Eve Risser, brings together musicians from Norway, Romania, Alsace and the Dordogne. It plays organic music rooted in each player's folk traditions, at AMR in Geneva as part of JazzContreBand.

8ed514d07ddd72b6b5bc682447c9fd88791b4059.en: Paolo Fresu, David Linx and Gustavo Beytelmann perform Trama Latina at the Auditorium Ansermet. The trio of trumpet, voice and piano tells a shared story of their Latin roots and the release of their new album.

9ad9ef337762eeb84bdef0bebd56f872a1c4a5f3.en: Arthur Donnot presents his second album, Pontica De Alma, at the Chat Noir as part of JazzContreBand. The Swiss saxophonist plays an intimate blend of jazz and indie folk with a young band.

fbf6f67c57ebc696636e47645e8f66e55cd73f7a.en: DJ Chivi plays reggaeton, salsa, merengue and bachata at the Chat Noir. The Colombian-born DJ, one of the leading Latin DJs in Geneva, invites guests to dance into the night, with cocktails.

b42234ace4fea318bfcc2acca86054526f65a30a.en: The Halloween chocolate workshop at La Bonbonnière lasts one hour. Participants learn the history of chocolate, taste pralines and ganaches, and make a Halloween-themed chocolate.

6404983b03cb2305a5ee27f16d354f077e2367e3.en: Hallomania at Domaine de la Guérite in Gy includes a trailer ride through the vines and a sweet hunt for children, plus a creative workshop, a wine tasting for adults and a grape juice for young witches.

01e459437c925b15fe5c38bdc909f9fafb4d7249.en: MAH Pause créative is a free monthly creative afternoon at the Musée d'art et d'histoire. Superpapier runs open workshops for all ages where people can cut, assemble and experiment.

34beb1704b53e02dce222b723e1dd5511873c916.en: A guided visit of the SaSA and MAMCO temporary exhibition by Joana Hadjithomas and Khalil Joreige, led by the MAMCO's mediation team. No registration is needed, subject to availability.

be1403981629c11c6a3d9810d137392b5378e3a3.en: The film Gardien du monde sauvage, a documentary about wildlife in Bugey and the Jura, is screened at the Salle de la Calame in Sergy on 24 October at 16:00. The director Kévin Flores attends, and entry is free.

c49eed3f932592bbaa4a9684cf646e83386c4c23.en: Hallomania's torchlit walk on the Salève runs for one to one and a half hours with a mountain guide. Walkers enjoy a regional aperitif halfway and may observe the Moon and constellations.

91f78408f6d3f8f8ee422c24c3a37f793d4fa7f6.en: Nostalgia & Disco XXL at Palexpo, part of the Festival du Soir, brings 1980s, 1990s and 2000s hits to the stage. Gala, Boney M, O-Zone and Lââm perform on 24 October; entry is for 18 and over.

8f817ed6512f8acdc544c4cdf2d0a490defa37b7.en: Disco sur glace takes place at the Patinoire des Vernets, where the rink becomes a dance floor with disco lights and music. All skill levels are welcome for this evening of skating and dancing.

dadc92cb16c2ceba18b942d34e300f1f35437bc6.en: Hallomania's lantern hunt in Geneva's Old Town sends families searching for glow-in-the-dark Hallie figures. Children collect Halloween sweets from costumed guides along the way.

e9c134ae09ec8cde3eb5b19664e597590bc550e7.en: Ensemble Musicâme France performs a programme of Ravel, Debussy, Mozart, Piazzolla and others at the Temple de la Madeleine. Five musicians join the ensemble for a concert of French music.

d31f7ca11cc837211e108bd7ffa9a5c08c89faff.en: The final of the 32nd Mondial de l'Impro takes place at the Bâtiment des Forces Motrices on 24 October. The two best teams from the qualifying rounds compete for the world title.

acbc1a0b03ba8b2d0762146b303a9a6074eb840f.en: Rounhaa plays the Alhambra in Geneva on 24 October 2026 as part of the Sublime Tour. Doors open at 19:00 and the concert starts at 20:00.

1c122f1b86ef638b439b932177ec3b6121f286bd.en: Sublime Club's ON STAGE evening at the Chat Noir features Alex Breahna, a pop singer from Switzerland and Moldova, and the accordion-led jazz project Inscape. The line-up draws on modern jazz and indie pop.

b42801a4e473e8fb302b95da580daef551a66b8d.en: Chicago Underground Duo, Rob Mazurek and Chad Taylor, performs at AMR in Geneva. The album Hyperglyph blends improvised trumpet and drums with electronic and folk sounds, and the duo is part of JazzContreBand.

51a73b4be0b8b5a568fb920f7b77a716d5e79fff.en: Electron and Sublime Club take over a Geneva shopping centre with a night of rap, techno and hyperpop. The event follows concerts by Luther and Rounhaa at the nearby Alhambra.

ab21bcee0782bb3d35d44057cf8d9698702a4856.en: DJ Kris plays hip-hop, Afro and dancehall sets at the Chat Noir. The Annecy DJ, a resident of the La Clique hip-hop night, mixes 1990s and 2000s hip-hop with Afrobeat and ragga.

2bd95b7f68697d766cca2d88d4585dda59705c31.en: La Run'Aire is a friendly running and walking event along the Aire river between Lancy, Confignon and Plan-les-Ouates. Routes are adapted to each category, and registration opens in July 2026.
