ab2d9aaf87ba5bf37384fe50a4114b92a7624a06.en: Free weekly hikes on the Salève start every Sunday at 10:00 at the terminus of bus 8 in Veyrier. A leader from the Geneva Friends of the Salève association guides the walk, which takes 5 to 8 hours with about 800 metres of climbing.

caca6ba797ed29b4b25d88fb985bdec61f2bc816.en: Balades Théâtralisées is a historical walking show in its tenth season. Actors perform in natural settings along a route from the Brunswick monument to the cathedral, and a second route is offered alternately.

cafe27da7b2c265a1ee3a75c4e4d3fe90683c06f.en: A guided visit of the Ferdinand Hodler exhibition at the International Museum of the Reformation takes place on the last Sunday of each month. The show, running until January 2027, presents about 50 works.

538c2696663f83e2a054df0543600f7883d845f2.en: A public guided visit of John M Armleder's exhibition Observatoires at the Musée d'art et d'histoire is led by an art historian.

d89fa0cdb174909e3a674c8bf83490191ffdfecf.en: Science and tango is a free talk at the Musée d'histoire des sciences on the global journey of tango, from famines and exile to dictatorships. A milonga dance follows the lecture.

a02e308617c447fc92a6735dcbada2c8cd179162.en: Le futur, c'est quoi? is a participatory guided visit at the MEG about how different societies imagine the future, through tarot cards, robots and artworks. Dates include 15 November, 5 December and 3 January.

76092f2f3231a2b1737686a57fafee3df5778a04.en: Guided visits of the exhibition brave la nuit / poems for ruptures at the FMAC take place on Wednesdays and Sundays at 15:00. The show runs from 17 September to 13 December 2026.

ce46936aa243a1591658f2ef39c4d7b975c899bb.en: The Alliance Française and partners screen Une aussi longue absence, a 1961 film by Henri Colpi written with Marguerite Duras. The film is presented on 25 October at Cinéma Rouge&Noir, with a meeting with Jean Marc Turine.

81e37c92e2d4f0f743c398800d592173c3ffa9f0.en: A guided visit for children from age 6, accompanied by an adult, explores two millennia of Geneva history at the Site archéologique Saint-Antoine. It is interactive and free, with no registration needed.

cd523f6090285fec9ce18658208ef56ff3244520.en: Geumhyung Jeong presents Find Select Copy and Paste, a solo performance at Le Commun. In it, the artist moves without objects, reworking movements she made for robots and objects.

e80dd4c85e0166e8e6e8f727b1c856c97cb00373.en: The MAMCO and Cinémas du Grütli host a film evening at the closing of two exhibitions. Two films by Věra Chytilová are screened, followed by a discussion with director Stéphanie Barbey.

f44c898823cbedff2ad07e3fe36661587b38699c.en: Ton Koopman conducts Beethoven's Ninth Symphony at the Victoria Hall, with soloists and choirs from the Haute école de musique de Genève alongside the Orchestre de la Suisse Romande. It is a relaxed-format performance.

378f35944aa4445151890edb35b0ce6173bde579.en: TWIST is a long-form improvised theatre show at the Impro Comedy Club where the audience suggests plot twists. The Fabulateurs perform on Sunday 25 October at 18:00, with free entry and a hat collection.

e24205bfb0641883ba58de6e4ac496a3ead15f3f.en: The Wright Foundation's sound-and-light show Intelligences en mouvement lights up the façade of the Musée d'art et d'histoire from 25 October to 15 November, with shows at 18:30, 19:30 and 20:30.

f028962422942a5b7cf2c7e57a2beb7a60fbb9ba.en: Genève Borges tour is a literary walk through Geneva's sites linked to Jorge Luis Borges, who is buried in the city. Guided tours run in Spanish, English and French, with the BORGES 2026 project marking the 40th anniversary of his death.

0f4fc58bed6627fd2446a4450ab6f837dc4faea4.en: Pratiques corporelles matinales by Cindy Van Acker is free morning movement at the Pavillon de la danse, from 9:00 to 10:00, on the forecourt or in the foyer if it rains. Everyone is welcome, and comfortable clothes are advised.

3cbbe3c9a92e8bd8b0d80e8af713a76c683fc1e4.en: Mental Health Month workshop Jeux de mémoire at the Fil d'Argent room offers memory games such as spot-the-difference and painted memory matching. It is free and open to registration.

4e498464f3007dcd0c90c8a4cf96c2b25dd3604e.en: Prayers is a lunchtime chamber concert at the HEM Dufour, the first of the "Monday middays". It honours Pablo Casals on the 150th anniversary of his birth, with works by Glass, Part, Reich and others.

34632eeba0169baf4dd80da5cc1b1ba578579e64.en: Cours de français avec vos enfants at La Boîte in Plan-les-Ouates is a French course for families in the Chapelle-les-Sciers area. Registration is on 14 September 2026 and classes resume on 21 September, for 100 CHF per year.

2c8315f83a32cd484050ee9cabb8fcaf1480cde5.en: Ces jeux qui nous lient is a games afternoon for seniors run with the Geneva housing cooperative and the La Marelle games library. It takes place every other Monday, from 14:30 to 16:30, at the Cité Vieusseux.

725b8d594278ae31053ca87f32eabb2690c5625e.en: Easy Boosts climbing courses for children and teens aged 7 to 14 run weekly in the first term of 2026-27. Sessions take place in a private indoor room or on the Salève, depending on the weather.

5fb9970faff6e288140468777609ddec330b8c76.en: Atelier d'écriture créative pour adultes is a weekly Monday writing workshop from 7 September to 28 June at La Maison Verte. Small groups play with language, and no experience is required.

736ddfe0f90cdf800714631415d9c1ba34300350.en: A collage workshop for adults and teens takes place on 26 October from 18:30 to 20:30 at the Villa Freundler in Plainpalais. Materials are provided, and the price is 20 CHF.

bc8b31dce66441d64dea324f139fc6314d3b84d5.en: Apprendre à fabriquer ses cosmétiques naturels is a five-session course in homemade natural cosmetics at the Eaux-Vives neighbourhood space. It runs on Mondays from 26 October to 23 November, for adults with B1 French, at 200 CHF.

064518297ebe7c48419a289881f4de81fbcae67c.en: Ara Malikian presents Intruso at the Victoria Hall with his band. The violinist's show moves between classical, jazz, Gypsy music, electronica and flamenco, lasting about two hours.

e899594bcbaea70e7eeae4c752dc345e2f27c220.en: Picture This, the Irish pop-rock band, performs at the Alhambra in Geneva on 26 October 2026. The concert presents their fourth album, Parked Car Conversations.

6d7b73db2cdca920ddc4e65e575c2167ed336311.en: Soirée PréPro at Le Chaudron presents personal projects by students of the eMa's PréPro course. Young musicians perform before an audience and external experts.

73986af75d1f93f02a721d2093f9825c3a10bcee.en: WonderDays Nature & Company runs an introduction to the Inner Development Goals at the Geneva Botanical Garden's Amarante restaurant. The workshop combines a nature setting with a lunch of local, organic food.

17594a8099aa0b85e7bf68b9b3987023d94bdd02.en: Information research workshop at the Bibliothèque de la Cité explores the digitised archives of the Romandy press. Specialists from the interroge.ch service guide participants, and entry is free with registration.

b648d0bc2afb277ffa8e9e5f7506acdef74fe164.en: The Geneva ethnographic museum library marks UNESCO's World Audiovisual Heritage Day with a presentation of its collection of ethnographic films. Places are limited and booking is required by email.

ef54c246873bc2288323a69ed4382f60c39ce53e.en: Pilates face aux œuvres at the Musée d'art et d'histoire links each Pilates session to a museum artwork to move, breathe and refocus. Bookings are made by email or WhatsApp.

d2cd834c0d29d39648dc8a3e8b531d9a2609fb25.en: Mon amour de livre is a monthly book club at La Julienne, led by Danièle Holweger. Members bring a favourite book and its author to discuss over tea, and the session on 2 May features Geneva author Michel Chevallier.

f346498ee3bd2240c66b6668a5edbc6bbf6b3655.en: The Bibli-o-bus, the mobile library of Geneva, stops in Plan-les-Ouates on several Tuesdays a month from 14:00 to 17:00. It offers books, comics, films and large-print titles for all ages.

ab143e3bdd8f43ce951893831db1f55e7f8b00b8.en: Repair'Textile at Espace 62 offers hands-on clothes mending with a seamstress. Participants get materials and advice, and the workshops now run weekly except during school holidays.

133a1f2bf8e086dd3dc151e52b228f1875b5058e.en: Action Lumières in Vernier on 27 October offers bike lights, safety advice and small repairs under the Écu viaduct. Visitors get discounts on lights, with 20 per cent for PRO VELO members.

0ff8a5c7dccb331181fa22f80f513fc302336767.en: Rédacthon is a training course on journalism and human rights for people aged 18 to 30, run by the Codap and Le Courrier. It is held during World Media and Information Literacy Week.

85c79472fc8c7a64bb01c1bea7ce41c954c49fee.en: The ordinary plenary sessions of the Geneva city council are open to the public at the Hôtel de Ville. Residents can attend to follow local policy and a municipal item on the agenda.

74c191c6a54abffc140bbdcc8329e4d78bd7cb08.en: TerrEspoir's 30th-anniversary tasting in Geneva on 27 October features pineapple producer Élise Chefin and Blanche Djou from the Cameroonian co-operative. Visitors can talk with them about fair trade and enjoy a free tasting.

a47eb1e78da5dcf88d43d7c8b34c9b1164f8fc71.en: Exposition 1602 & Compagnie at Maison Tavel marks the centenary of the Compagnie de 1602, which keeps alive the Escalade celebration. The exhibition reveals behind-the-scenes costumes and stories, ahead of the 425th anniversary in 2027.

951a157d036edec5fc56e3c45540610b006127eb.en: Paulette mène l'enquête is a library event at the Bibliothèque des Eaux-Vives on the history of LGBTQIA+ literature in French-speaking Switzerland. Participants share finds from an investigation with editor Guy Chevalley and historian Edward Mandry.

fe5b54362e5de23a7b9760470ef36a02641f04ab.en: Tango beginners' course, an introduction to Argentine tango, is held at the Aula de l'École Henri-Dunant. No experience or partner is needed.

c928a8c008707631b222920eded1d3813ce3c90d.en: Le Bookclub de Fanny et Laetitia at the Lancy municipal library meets once a month on a Tuesday. Members discuss new books and librarians' recommendations over an aperitif.

e0eaf96e98ea3109c89b91db611df8443defd53d.en: Voir les maîtres anciens is a talk by Niklaus Manuel Güdel at the International Museum of the Reformation. It follows Ferdinand Hodler's study of early Italian painters, particularly Giotto, and his use of gesture.

56fd385e235996deb3ad0de050cda5b7966d4e45.en: Pierre Cormon presents his novel O Grande Dia at Maison OFELIA in Le Grand-Saconnex on 27 October at 19:00. The novel celebrates Brazilian carnival, and entry is free with registration.

4168e86a39c7ec209df2b1ba43794867cb726686.en: As We Are: Joséphine and Bantu pairs a solo by Germaine Acogny, who recalls Josephine Baker, with Gregory Maqoma's work performed by dancers from Vuyani Dance Theatre and the École des Sables. A talk with both artists follows.

58c57d3069a2bca7fc60f8ba1ff032fd4b696530.en: Menace chorale at the Comédie de Genève is Gabriel Sparti's second creation. A village choir prepares a European event under a new conductor, and its harmonies hide a drift toward authoritarian ideology.

398f6c498d868b89619fdff58ffab776ed84e2ed.en: A Geneva city council session takes place at the council chamber. Only the published convocation is authoritative.

4b620cf4cd57092251782f6797c377fe4365795d.en: Bill Frisell celebrates his 75th birthday at the Alhambra with his trio featuring Luke Bergman and Tim Angulo. His new album In My Dreams, released on Blue Note in February 2026, is part of the celebrations.

29d9a57e036ef28ca167e674a8bacfd633cd3f1c.en: Symphon'Hip-Hop at the BFM pairs the Geneva Chamber Orchestra with rappers and singers such as Timar and Aamo. The evening begins with a dance battle in the foyer, mixing hip-hop and classical music.

719716c864752ced4210a4dbec88297c69aa746a.en: Eve Chariatte's NIGHT WALK is a silent night walk for 25 to 30 people through the PAV neighbourhood. Participants move in a group and follow sounds and shadows, in a low-tech choreography.

d4b1e55ecf074e028022956b0123439d52bf14a2.en: Wednesday yoga for toddlers at EVE Grand-Salève helps children discover their bodies and relax. The 10:00 class is full, and places remain for the 9:00 session.

a059b21028ff92c767f2d271977ef7f592858092.en: Musique à petits pas at the Bibliothèque de la Cité offers free musical play for children aged 18 months to 4 with a carer. Each session has a new theme, from weather to animals, through to January 2027.

959630ef80e4cb1aa615b0ff8f0d12840c957d97.en: MataBloK'ids climbing courses for children aged 5 to 8 run weekly in the first term of 2026-27. The groups are small, with up to six children, and the sessions take place in a private room or on the Salève.

381095d1ae5d5226d812214816f487a3808cd2bd.en: Mam'zelle Chapeau is a 25-minute puppet show for children from age one, by Le Cockpit at Arcade Pierrablanca. Mam'zelle searches for her cat and tries on hats from boxes, and group bookings are required.

f3fdadb3cf813ad74c290ad1d99d2bf395c3d595.en: Free Spanish classes for children and teens aged 7 to 17 run through the ALCE programme at the Grand-Lancy municipal hall. They are for pupils of Spanish nationality or with a Spanish parent and are organised by the Spanish Embassy.

d36bc082c89af63fc439cafd540bf6394c788ed5.en: L'herbier des feuilles is a children's autumn workshop at the Botanical Garden. Children collect and identify leaves, learn how herbaria are made and make a craft with their finds on Wednesday afternoons.

c2c549ecba530f7ebe986bd15c6e57f490d87ad0.en: Halloween shower gel workshop for children aged 6 to 12 takes place on 28 October at 14:30 at the Eaux-Vives neighbourhood space. Children make a pumpkin-coloured fruity shower gel, for 28 CHF.

6fdd828c2b867bea4c0dd6c41a7c5e7b6411a9e0.en: Alerte rouge is a playful one-hour family tour of the colour red at the Musée d'art et d'histoire, for children aged 6 and over with an adult. It looks at red as the colour of power, passion and danger.

b1238ed54402e935c3297959dd7aa069895b7e75.en: Illustration workshops for children from age 7 at La Julienne are led by Carole Sémon. The 28 October session explores Japanese Pop Art and ends with a small illustrated book; no prior skills are needed.

4ff05fed594b49e5b1f50a05520c7e366e1fab56.en: A six-session theatre improvisation cycle for teens aged 12 to 15 at the MEG is linked to the exhibition Le futur, c'est quoi? Participants learn listening and storytelling skills, and attendance at every session is required.

a0b0f2b311040762a21a3f6b278a6ffb77cf5fa6.en: Quelque chose a changé is a painting exhibition by Lola Jay from 28 October to 8 November 2026. Her oil works explore how family photographs and images shape what people remember and keep.

98cef51f847c097c195fa21200e67544066f173f.en: Cosmopolemos is a book launch and exhibition at the Centre de la photographie Genève. Edmund Clark and Crofton Black examine the US military-industrial complex through images, data and language.

72aa1177f15f95765867805b746a91de8bd5c13d.en: Ageing with HIV is a round table at HUG and PVA-Genève, marking the launch of a pilot project for seniors living with HIV. The discussion covers care, confidentiality and training for nursing home staff.

ca2d969bf3ae9e41d9a43848f19a899df4d024ea.en: Creative writing workshops in central Geneva run in small groups of up to six people, over cycles of six sessions. Each session focuses on a theme such as narrative structure or perspective.

131033769ae5fd541a8b83151f1973ba88e9f8a7.en: A social media link is given for a Zumba class with Sandrita at the Ecole en Sauvy. No details are included in the listing.

d2f421e9ca55853efb7f1e355a6ec9f2facccf2b.en: Dirty Three, the Melbourne instrumental trio with Warren Ellis, performs at the Alhambra in Geneva. The band, formed in 1992, mixes post-rock, folk, classical music and free jazz.

8fe6d36dee7c02e25dc96737f2558f52c1768e3a.en: Sir András Schiff and Evgeny Kissin play a two-piano and four-hand programme at the Victoria Hall. The works include Mozart's Two-Piano Sonata, Schumann's Andante and Variations and Dvořák's Slavonic Dances.

d672535e80f537003d373082b5e399b0ec4bcdb0.en: CHRÜSIMÜSI at La Comédie de Genève is a multilingual play by Eléonore Bonah and Maria Clara Castioni, based on stories by Basel writer Adelheid Duvanel. The short, poetic texts follow people who do not fit social norms.

f168796fe5b29d56795d3bdd794ae886db89f074.en: Derborence, Le temps des animaux is the first feature by Vincent Chabloz, shown at Les Scala with the director present on 28 October at 20:00. The film follows wildlife in the Derborence valley.

06fb0b72e232fca74e8ad3eeccaa31f6698d2953.en: &sous.les.montagnes by Sami Lea Samira Bernath is a dance piece at the Pavillon de la danse, part of Emergentia from 28 October to 7 November. It mixes Swiss folk traditions, including the Löffelä spoon rhythms, with memory and repetition.

087c90abe82468261ac3d6bb01f49fdb9295f11e.en: Double Jeu is an improvised comedy show at the Théâtre de la Parfumerie where each performer has a secret mission to manipulate a partner. The show is at 20:30, with tickets from 15 to 25 CHF.

0f6eb16507cbd12dc7134088bff10305c12d9d1e.en: Jazz Night Groove Party at Le Chaudron features the duo of Matthieu Llodra and Valentin Liechti, who revisit 1990s electronic music, with improvisation and house, jungle and broken beat.

d804d714dd7ac3647d7237ea17688af53d678351.en: Café avec la police municipale invites residents to informal chats with city police over coffee in their neighbourhood. The sessions run from 3 to 29 October 2026 at eight local stations, and all are open to everyone.

17ebae6cc92d0807a689880604a64f85a78e17b4.en: Taking Care of the Ecosystem #1 is a day about paths for a sustainable, meaningful and prosperous cultural sector. It is held at the Maison de l'Avenir on 29 October, with a forum from B Lab Suisse and an evening drinks.

efa455570356da5434ee85ed9e283fe78d05c217.en: Les études décoloniales ignorent l'histoire et se trompent de cible is a talk with Jean-Pierre Olivier de Sardan at the MEG library. He argues that decolonial studies overlook African agency and the internal dynamics of African politics.

d34c261e008e222895dc78f48e92e2ed261d42b3.en: Voltaire, l'artisan des Lumières is a free one-hour guided visit at Les Délices, the villa where Voltaire lived from 1755 to 1760 and wrote works including Candide. The tour is in French.

daa6a1c4f5f5aa08b734d75c1e7e60a715e63070.en: Affichage public #6: Singularité is a talk with four teams of Swiss graphic designers, about their creative approaches to singularity. It is free, starts at 12:15 at the Bibliothèque de Genève and is followed by an exchange.

fa549023cd9f75987c048a79a154182427ad300a.en: Requiem Aeternam is a free lecture by Nicolas Bucher at the Bibliothèque de la Cité on death in classical music, including Brahms's German Requiem. It is part of the Journées de la mort qui tue, and booking is needed.

2cb03dfe8e19b863067eea4d387d325825cc5c24.en: A free woodwork and repair workshop for children and adults runs every Thursday from 16:00 to 20:00 at the Maison de Quartier du Plateau, led by a specialist, except during school holidays.

616d41b1292273851366a5c2ebacf8e9fcbfe2d5.en: Action Lumières in Carouge on 29 October offers bike light sales, advice and small repairs at the Sainte-Croix church. Visitors get discounts on lights, with 20 per cent for PRO VELO members.

383873f505b2d71361fda1dfd27dcb6407c0ca0a.en: Re:Make Design Project asks eight designers to make new objects for workspaces from recovered furniture and materials. The show opens on 29 October at 17:00 and focuses on resource-efficient design.

bb49720cf14668dfe93049d6fa93abee65604381.en: Mental Health Month workshop on stress management covers breathing techniques and other tips from IMAD. A talk is followed by a drink, and entry is free with registration.

6a06f6a425d733b487a5e300a848f154586dcab3.en: GE-visIci climbing course for children aged 7 to 11 meets weekly at the CEC André Chavanne climbing wall. Places are limited and the programme also includes French lessons and weekend trips.

e2ef8e25b08330709b768459c3fed9009fec6b7c.en: Class photo exhibition at Le Pressoir in Confignon marks the 175th anniversary of the commune. It shows portraits of pupils across generations and invites visitors to look back in time.

dabde5e06b2c070a2506da57f9e83516ee60d4a1.en: A free immersive workshop introduces visitors to Deaf culture and sign language through games and role play. It runs from 18:00 to 20:00 at the Pavillon du parc de la Baleine, with registration advised.

21a1ed585d2afecc581d4315f32162af280f308c.en: Matières vivantes at Galerie Renaissance pairs botanical paintings by Clarissa P. Valaeys with sculptures by Lisa Novel made from biomaterials. The show runs from 29 October to 4 December 2026.

784f3aa54982ae3d15a3daba6ffb754bdfc0b995.en: Atelier tricot & crochet at the Maison de Quartier du Plateau offers knitting and crochet, with tea and coffee and materials provided. Children must be accompanied by an adult.

c9d681debca8232f1d1b69878b69c2ea66c83754.en: ILIS 86 - 40 ans après is a talk at the University of Geneva's Uni Dufour on the 1986 ILIS conference. Paola Bacchetta, who attended, discusses feminist and queer alliances, and her new book is previewed. Entry is free.

6261a209dc8fd9de4279a1642497ac56177f238e.en: Corps et littérature brings together author Marianne Gokalp, who wrote about cancer and bodily change, and editor Marion Muller-Colard. They discuss how literature can express illness and rebuilding.

1d1f6e3f2ffe8c00a5cd383b040bd6ae1b8178c6.en: GE-visIci climbing course for teens aged 12 to 16 runs weekly at the CEC André Chavanne climbing wall. The course is inclusive, with places limited and registration needed.

0707a14a43c22d3048e4b51b8d9d43d3214d515e.en: Afterwork Chocolat Halloween at L'École du Chocolat lets guests create a Halloween chocolate with La Bonbonnière's master chocolatiers. An evening aperitif with charcuterie, cheese and wine is included.

0773129d6514ae636ba119dbde2479bc7b5c4537.en: Témoin de Gaza is a talk at Uni Mail on 29 October at 18:30 with Philippe Lazzarini, who led UNRWA. He discusses diplomacy, political pressure and the humanitarian situation in Gaza, and presents his book.

88ea0317ba4fd99657d6f508a6476f08469bd793.en: Ne détournez pas le regard offers free workshops on how to respond to street harassment and how to protect oneself. Sessions are held at the Maison des associations in Geneva in late October and November, with registration by email.

ed80e56e8073c2e647e295f51282da4f2e9fd946.en: Milonga Brava at the Sécheron neighbourhood space on 29 October features Delfina Pissani and Diego Martín Valero. A workshop on pivots and crosses comes before an evening milonga with open bar.

eb90226bc4255662c7270cd9aeb37a87f5f6e8ad.en: Chœur Chants du Léman is a singing workshop at Espace Léman for people aged 16 and over. Participants learn songs about Lake Geneva by ear, and can join optional small concerts in November and December.

d6069cc38accf332daf8619c9ae68aadab128271.en: Impossible by Barbara Baker and F-X Fernandez-Cavada, at Saint-Gervais Genève, is a thriller about a fall in the Dolomites. Was it an accident or a murder, given that the two men had once belonged to the same terrorist group?

4b2e18fef3812f702a6ef4b67f405cd4f5c69058.en: Invincible Été is a documentary screened at Cinéma Nord-Sud, followed by a discussion with palliative care specialists and experts on ALS. The evening, free to attend with registration, looks at living well until the end.

06471e2c35a0aaa89cfa928995fd04d416f7ed2d.en: Matières inflammables is a three-day festival of contemporary playwriting at Théâtre du Loup, with five new texts read by five directors and six actors. Themes include fire, motherhood, sex work and war. Entry is by pay-what-you-can.

001053dadd2d4da76bcb09548b1220eba1c83aeb.en: The Wall is a dance-theatre show at the Salle Centrale de la Madeleine. Through music and choreography it follows a woman and a man whose lives cross during the history of the Berlin Wall.

c3f0f7880d3ab9a309f956197279ed3ebe0a2b75.en: La Migration des cœurs, Maryse Condé's 1995 novel reworking Wuthering Heights in post-slavery Guadeloupe, is staged at Théâtre Le Poche. Anne Monfort's production follows two families across three generations.

a3d0ad333806dc400fba8166f02778dfaea20515.en: Mémoire sensible: Balanchine en Suisse is a free-to-attend workshop led by Patrice Delay on George Balanchine's work, his relationship with music and his place in choreography. It is for adults aged 17 and over, with booking required.

9c84477a62e3cd051726004809fcfc4d061fbe98.en: Kontact by Compagnie Puéril Péril is a one-hour contemporary circus show at the Petit-Lancy municipal hall. Six acrobats use no apparatus, only trust, and a school performance takes place on 30 October.

55a9451c6f22982aea9e65802df783bfba379584.en: Charlie Winston performs solo and acoustic at the Onex municipal hall. The English singer revisits hits and songs from his album Love Ain't Easy, with audience interaction, and the concert is standing.

2326ed71b858d31bccd927c01dbba4735330b8d7.en: Ensemble Musicâme France performs a Toussaint concert at the Église Saint-Joseph in Annemasse, with works by Telemann, Rachmaninov, Elgar and Vivaldi's Winter, in a programme of familiar classics.

397612a902d154dfd249c66ea682bca2f05df8f7.en: The Dr. Watson Band and The Lawdy Mamas play a blues and rock night at the BAG in Geneva. The Lawdy Mamas, a Geneva quartet, revisits Steppenwolf, while Dennis Watson's band plays blues standards.

49af9ebdc91cc89c1f4528d8ef4acfd6c958ad7b.en: Cosmopolemos by Edmund Clark and Crofton Black is an exhibition and book launch at the Centre de la photographie Genève. The project analyses the US military-industrial complex, presenting Pentagon contracts in encyclopedic form.

811dfff913eeed0239b44dfa696153719b9c7ac8.en: WonderDays Nature & Company runs a biodiversity fresco workshop for companies at the Amarante restaurant in the Botanical Garden on 30 October. It is a serious game with a vegetarian lunch from local, organic produce.

4e5a88e3bbf987a984fa2ae2eb5be4b355a6b877.en: Les Journées de verre at the Ariana museum on 30 and 31 October is a two-day forum on glass, with talks, performances and a workshop. The event runs alongside the Cirva collection exhibition until 3 January 2027.

413c2a7398025dec90de95920ac77cdc1729f9fb.en: The 32nd Geneva International Film Festival, founded in 1995, runs for ten days with films, series and immersive works. Its GIFF PRO forum brings more than 800 industry professionals together.

8781c4172f6b94f934ddc5dc7850ee1c2ccc6b3e.en: Langages Sacrés: Les Métamorphoses, a solo exhibition by Cameroonian artist Martin Abega at Filafriques, mixes photography with textile, embroidery, cowrie shells and charcoal. It explores transformation through a female figure.

e8190a638220cf12489f60832d9061fc781b28aa.en: The Geneva Watchmaking Grand Prix exhibition at the Musée d'art et d'histoire shows 84 pre-selected timepieces. Visits, watchmaking workshops and children's activities are offered, with some sessions booked in advance.

428f88a5668ee7bfc936b6c5065eda39dcd3e418.en: Telluric Silhouettes presents two women artists, Reinata Sadimba and Tiemar Tegene, whose sculptures and ceramics explore black and grey tones, texture and the human figure, with emotions such as grief and love.

51d59955a5549f904cfc2b68891e0761adfab056.en: A lunchtime string quartet concert at the Bibliothèque de la Cité features musicians of the Orchestre de Chambre de Genève. They play Schubert's Death and the Maiden quartet, as part of the Journées de la mort qui tue, free with booking.

e036af0215686d1fc5383a45ca2e21601b9769a3.en: La Douleur, Emmanuel Finkiel's film after Marguerite Duras's memoir, is screened at the Cinéma Bio in Carouge on 30 October at 14:00. The screening is followed by a meeting with Jean Marc Turine.

d772c387bdffbfd73b1faa5c2d99f8e95c721116.en: A costume parade for the Fête des morts takes place at the FMAC's Vélodrome area, led by jazz band TGM2F, with face-painting, a tour of the exhibition, a pumpkin soup and free concerts at Cap Loisirs.

2adc65ce72158b71e57d757338040ed9461ef075.en: GIFF presents the Swedish series Summer of 1985 in Switzerland. Friends investigate a teenager's drowning near an island, and the discovery puts their relationships and lives at risk.

3fbeaf3129a203db0282c7e4d3985b8ff19d8002.en: A free Africa 21 film night on 30 October shows Tsotsi, the 2005 South African film based on Athol Fugard's novel. It is followed by a 30-minute debate and a drink at the Maison Kultura.

d14dc3dee74ae19e979634febbdeee16208c63e5.en: GIFF presents Le Journal d'une femme de chambre in Switzerland. A live-in maid works hard to earn enough to see her daughter in Romania, in a bitter study of power.

c21ed0fd40c6872b2bff602e6929c4e68b469d5e.en: Le goût du verre is a tasting evening at the GamMAH on 30 October. Guests taste drinks in glasses of different shapes to see how form changes aroma, for 5 CHF.

347db270d76fb4caf321212b1b9cd57776828e12.en: Positiv Genève by Festival du Soir turns Palexpo into a large immersive strip, with Paul Kalkbrenner, Mind Against, Nicolas Cuer and La Forêt. Performances, rides, food corners and bars complete the night.

77ad6e2084e4be48cdd333a0805235b28311e45c.en: L'Univers de Tim Burton by Mystery Ensemble is a concert of film music by Danny Elfman, from Alice in Wonderland to Edward Scissorhands, Beetlejuice and Sweeney Todd. The arrangements mix whimsy and menace.

c3c9a529aef3333a1136fa2dd167b4270c1a8f2d.en: Hallomania's murder party at the Brasserie des Murailles in Meinier is a two-hour investigation inspired by Back to the Future. Players explore the brewery to find out who killed Doc, and a tasting follows.

244d790558f1cc6247e54e052201d42fa0fd5a14.en: Sept at the Théâtre du Grütli brings together performers aged 20 to 70, who swap ages, gestures and stories across theatre, dance and film. The show explores the links between generations.

9d96756e8f71cd9a96f28b9bc9d59c259f232777.en: Gitanes at La Cité Bleue presents two works set in Brno and Madrid. Both tell of impossible love, with soprano Isabelle Druet and tenor Petr Nekoranec.

99f53c6a6255c69fd6caafee642b6935dd1a07c9.en: Dark Matter Night is a live radio show and concert at CERN, held on the International Day of Dark Matter. It explores the mystery of dark matter, with regional artists performing in partnership with Radio Vostok.

52c15742a2763740ee349237e652a5b55e11c79b.en: Stand'Impro Show at the Chat Noir presents new improvised theatre talents from the Stand'Impro school. The troupe performs in changing wild and funny scenes.

80b28d5f11ebb2d5dd7d7bd26bf0f86d5e97ab1a.en: Many People Need to Die is a Spanish series, presented at the GIFF for its first Swiss screening. Three childhood friends reassess their lives after one questions her choices at her baby shower.

92a69d0e69a0a673857144d227b05c27a77381c2.en: Hermeto's Mothership, made up of longtime musicians of Hermeto Pascoal, plays a tribute concert at AMR in Geneva. The programme is entirely Pascoal's music, with composed and improvised pieces.

4550048850641d0361c1b5239cdbc56b06b6b107.en: DJ Taloco plays hip hop, grime, dancehall and amapiano at the Chat Noir. The DJ, of Mexican and British origin, has over fifteen years of experience in the club scene.

3d108e57ae2a99794399ce693179dd4f43210121.en: Journée pour ralentir dans un monde accéléré is a day of workshops on slowing down at Espace Arkade in Geneva, on 31 October. Four experiential sessions use Brain Gym, somatic movement and creative methods; a training certificate is included.

297a7990ffe90f8b90aea190a520098f6b6b9a44.en: Hallomania's double treasure hunt at Domaine de la Mermière in Soral mixes a vineyard hunt in a trailer with a fluorescent hunt back at the estate. Children and parents join in, and wine tasting is part of the day.

589560a998d9b1e479289628f2ceb8974c6acadc.en: Écrire le vivant 15 is a writing workshop at the Bibliothèque des Minoteries led by writer and journalist Anne Pitteloud. Participants imagine a future where cities are flooded and nature has returned.

ce84f7bc8af41370837eec9718562e3d3b27399f.en: Café croissant at the Cologny library gives visitors a chance to explore the adult, children's, manga and comics spaces, with a coffee and croissant and talk about library activities.

96229ecffa1429d5db6eacf9419b5b3cb173db5a.en: The World Palliative Care Day in Geneva raises awareness of advance directives and the ProSA care plan. A stand with card games, questions and specialists helps visitors think about their wishes.

e3ad6678684998623c924a9988c9fa910ea1593e.en: Balades d'exploration urbaine: Frontières is a four-part walk by the Association pour le Patrimoine Industriel exploring Geneva's neighbourhoods. The first walk on 31 October looks at visible and invisible borders, and it is free.

15b395011789b687d725ac25b10c3d1e852ab229.en: Fabrique des ombres at the Musée d'histoire des sciences is a parent-and-child workshop. Children make paper sculptures and explore how shadows reveal unexpected shapes, for ages 6 and over, 15 places.

a84ddffd633336200de9b2d38cb88b4115b7719a.en: Onex celebrates its 175th anniversary with two days of free festivities on 31 October and 1 November at Place Duchêne. Activities include guided visits, candlelit tales and the unveiling of a photo mural by the artist JR.

07590d4fbc1967f520191cd2870a577df596a4ea.en: Dr Sylvie Dethiollaz, director of the Swiss Institute of Noetic Sciences, gives a free talk at the Bibliothèque de la Cité on near-death experiences. She shares thirty years of research that changed her view of death.

733bd7b57a2618baeeb6d5cfcb757ce8729f7ccf.en: Guided walks in the Parc des Bastions look at its trees, with 20 species from the more than 200 planted since 1726. The free visits, at 11:00 and 14:00, are led by a garden historian and an independent dendrologist.

3e5818344179d9be9702e21ad64387de32c5d5ff.en: The 175th anniversary of Confignon is celebrated over two days at the municipal hall with local history, creative work, meetings and festive moments.

a4f1cb82109c1757813a608a264e2425fe6b14eb.en: Le jeu de la mort qui tue is a free talk at the Bibliothèque de la Cité, presenting a new game for talking about death with lightness. It also covers taboo questions about funeral work, as part of the Journées de la mort qui tue.

95eed94a4c710207a70dabf56aba935f9f2f4418.en: Writing workshops on rethinking a neighbourhood run at the API industrial heritage museum in Geneva. Each two-hour session asks participants to write a manifesto about a place, and the sessions cost 20 CHF.

ccd57fb79d0b483b24c4763fb9177098b577ddd6.en: Contes à rebours is an improvised storytelling show in Cointrin, where children hold the magic wand and the story is made up on the spot. Sessions run on 31 October and 14 November at 14:00, for 8 to 12 CHF.

a4860d5706066854d0937345081e9a56546fc939.en: Variola Vera is a Polish series, presented at the GIFF for its first Swiss screening. A smallpox outbreak hits Wrocław in 1963, and a nurse and a journalist confront it.

fa34c271efb7869b735127933ef35b289c78908d.en: Sieste musicale is a family music session at La Julienne for children from age one. Singers and musicians play soft songs on guitar, kalimba and percussion, on 31 October and 21 November.

7021730df658322c8425dcce36309d209366ddb8.en: L'assassin des Macchabées is a Hallomania murder-mystery game in Geneva's Old Town. Teams receive a case file and track suspects through the streets, using UV pens and decoders, in a mix of detective game and outdoor escape.

63ada5d0ea4c36173a4c296be895fd1c71275a3f.en: Les feuilletons de la mythologie grecque is a musical reading at the Carouge library. The Greek-born actress Katerina Apostolopoulou narrates extracts from the Artemis series, with images and a double bass, for ages 5 and up.

1395a7c97de66ae73f6061943b24c5b25db48c4b.en: Pillowgraphies by La BaZooka is a show about playful floating and gliding, after which the audience is invited on stage. Participants are encouraged to wear white or fluorescent clothes for the black light.

9ea759942dfe239b7cc6256e4b7b364ef86115c6.en: La Gradiva is a coming-of-age film presented at the GIFF for its first Swiss screening. A class of Latin students on a study trip to Italy meet their first emotions and identity questions.

fc2622ee6accb6d2a69d67c0b76d11692c0f7e9e.en: Hallomania's treasure hunt at the Jardin Anglais follows Hallie the mummy and a family hunt for lost sweets. Players solve riddles across the lakeside garden, with two difficulty levels, and the Jet d'Eau in view.

97974b9aed7c5a8d4bc41d7cb02ad154b852ddf2.en: Breathcore at the Musée Ariana is a performance of collective breath, led by Michael Schmid, with about 50 participants. Breathing creates a shared sound landscape without a conductor or a score, on 31 October.

15787d65a7f0f9719d5383c0b4c298bd7fccd0d0.en: Spitting Image is a three-part dance piece by danced stances, performed by Lisa Laurent, Marie Popall and Tyra Wigg at Le Commun. It is a step in a research project on how movement is controlled in cities.

901c69d0f6c44443f8e71b9d7411f8b38e31c2a0.en: Des histoires dans ta langue is a free session of stories and activities in German and Mongolian at the Grands-Hutins library. It is for children from 0 to 5 and their siblings, and it runs from 16:00 to 17:30.

4c3706654b57655ea9e045720f56ede7315ac914.en: Create your own lamp is a three-hour workshop where participants make a lamp by hand, choosing the fabric and height. Materials are included, except for the electrical fittings.

b407c90fb3ccb81346227620df73439b3d9d5173.en: The Addams Family, a Halloween cine-concert at the Victoria Hall, plays Barry Sonnenfeld's film live with the orchestra conducted by Stefan Geiger. The programme lasts about two hours and ten minutes, with an interval.

1eefbcb39f940070f48c60517f4203bebad2a49b.en: Hallomania's candlelit walk "Tortures & Châtiments" starts from Longemalle in the Old Town. Guests hear tales of torture and punishment and join in with votes and true-or-false questions.

3a7185cf25b3d0a77a82788515063de9aed94dc3.en: Les Esprits at the Geneva Conservatory has writer Mathias Énard talk about the chaconne, with readings and live music by Tedi Papavrami and others. The evening takes place on 31 October at 18:00 in the Salle Liszt.

4b5fed6c55ae6b211cf9375f067bd6f36c802309.en: Día de los Muertos Festival at Palexpo is a Mexican-style night with 10,000 square metres of decor, dance, food trucks and music. It runs on 31 October from 18:00 to 06:00 and is for adults only.

3b9bab63f9102c101f4bafedecd3e1cd28019ac3.en: In Vitro: Creation of Happiness, a Spanish series, is presented at the GIFF for its first Swiss screening. A former researcher starts work as a biologist at a fertility clinic, and finds the job difficult.

fe353e17e2516adafdbd52410adec175675467d5.en: Le retour des Cop(a)ines d'Edmond is a burlesque evening for adults at an unnamed venue. The show mixes Halloween themes of vampires and raw bodies with an appearance by La Compagnie des Murmures.

be66fabf8c73af5bc1cc0aa625ba23fac9109fcc.en: Symphonic Disco brings the United Soloists Orchestra playing disco hits from the 1970s to the 2000s, in symphonic arrangements, at the BFM. The programme includes songs by ABBA, Boney M and Gipsy Kings.

cf72975a6ffd8b7512c3c1f70d5d856865d932ff.en: Louis Billette 6tet, Mohs and Fanny Martin perform at the Chaudron, closing JazzContreBand. The two-night event celebrates bands supported by the local jazz scene over the past decade.

06610564add43421c236cd22e778560a71decb91.en: Megalloween by Festival du Soir at Palexpo celebrates its 20th anniversary as a large Halloween night. Costumes are compulsory, with a themed stage and a dancefloor, and entry is for adults.

0d29a1d61cd15ee8cc7d29682fe16de5d6e7e444.en: Hallomania's fluorescent DJ party at the Domaine des Bossons in Satigny features Anthony Huriez spinning deep house and electro. Guests get a glow glass with a drink included, and wine is also sold at the bar.

56c7858c183e825299ee43c37a116b6a854e2d6b.en: The Sullivan Fortner Trio plays AMR in Geneva. The pianist and his band bring New Orleans jazz, Caribbean influences and original compositions to the stage.

dd434911f991eceaec4f27823aeec05d96b25820.en: Dawning, a Norwegian series, is shown at the GIFF for the first time in Switzerland. Three sisters in a remote forest house take in a stranger, and the family portrait becomes chilling.

9cf4eef43cdbcafcd1e849027f2e2381ae2c02b6.en: K-Pop Night at the Chat Noir features KEvents, with DJs playing the big hits and underground K-pop tracks for fans of BTS and BLACKPINK.

5a4ece9bd6b250a911596c6482c31e36d65cec9d.en: Yoga for adults in the gym of the Pré-du-Camp school runs on Sunday mornings from 9:00 to 10:00 from September to May. The classes are free for residents, with booking required.

a417e7432a40d1274cdc9c2b199e24d06454304f.en: MiniMove is a free Sunday movement session for pre-school children and their adult companions. It runs weekly from 4 October 2026 to 16 May 2027 at the École du Rolliet.

050277e662edbc9492eee737bb9e211848efae63.en: Le futur, c'est quoi? is an immersive family trail at the MEG, led by Myriam Boucris. Songs, music and theatre help children aged 4 to 8 imagine the future. Registration is free but required.

5e6041f40375c542692bbbfba81b41278c4acf61.en: Un matin pour danser takes place at Les 6 Toits on 1 November, with coffee and croissants, a contemporary dance piece inspired by Cuba, and a movement workshop for children aged 3 to 5.

cfba7af8a9da1ec8893baab990edc6999dec48f0.en: Dimanche du futur at the MEG runs on the first Sunday of each month, linked to the exhibition. It includes an immersive trail, a library corner, and creative workshops, most of them free.

dab15122c0c07eb025dfa2232c2d1f790984f3c1.en: Dimanches sportifs at Petit-Lancy offers free women-only sports classes on Sundays outside school holidays. Pilates, yoga, self-defence and zumba are offered, and the classes are for women aged 18 and over.

e70174f43f48dd0353559239ffdd6efe20e79b23.en: The Festival des Tramways Historiques runs on 2 November from 10:00 to 17:00. Historic trams from the 1920s and 1950s run on three public lines and a trolleybus route.

f688688ce62e2c99eaa629867c09dcfce7bc8adf.en: Marathon Bohême at the OCG is a full day of six concerts on music from Bohemia, with works by Zelenka, Janáček, Dvořák and Martinů. The programme begins at 10:30 and includes a final concert at 17:00.

72b8e130ebd58c310b021acacc8df1c888832407.en: Hallomania's treasure hunt at Domaine des Crêts-Malval in Dardagny includes a search through the vines, a meeting with the estate's geese and a creative workshop for children aged 4 and over.

da5233afa434d31b0e300dffbb1da4d7b0dc2758.en: La mort, parlons-en is a round table at the Bibliothèque de la Cité with professionals including a funeral director, a sociologist and an end-of-life doula. The talk is free with registration and is part of the Journées de la mort qui tue.

e261093a9974adcb526940b8b9d9b0a08ea9697a.en: The Fête de la glace returns to the Vernets rink with public skating, ice hockey, and demonstrations and initiations in ice sports. A DJ, activities and a refreshment stand make it a festive day.

46263f326b55d8161cbdbb58047da87ee7ad98be.en: Balades Théâtralisées: De la haute-ville aux bas-fonds is a historical walking show with actors performing scenes in natural settings. The new route runs from the Beauregard fountain to the cemetery of the Kings, with five stops.

bf00044616ca33ab6203b0f59a52709fa35f5ccc.en: Boum Tschak by Compagnie Chamar Bell Clochette is a show by two performers who build an unusual musical composition from old drum parts and oddments. Their work mixes humour with puppetry and object animation.

9b6c78a817dbf31ef5c16df2f9350ca3b88628ca.en: Espace de lecture at the MEG is a free family reading and play corner linked to the exhibition Le futur, c'est quoi? Librarians read stories on the first Sunday of the month.

1456669c7a4eaa24f023ea0216fd2e080b251ef8.en: Free admission to Le verre, au-delà de la matière at the Ariana museum on the first Sunday of the month. A guided tour takes place at 11:00 on 1 November, with similar visits on 6 December and 3 January.

a6926838c1f765c5c63ce3708148ccc7e9490c3b.en: Quatuor Rosamonde performs Haydn, Webern and Schubert's Death and the Maiden at the Musée d'histoire des sciences. The free concert is part of the Matinées décalées and requires booking from 1 October.

9d2adb9f3313eeeee77a8010792b6d1332abec57.en: Rousseau, whistleblower is an audiovisual trail at the Maison de Rousseau et de la Littérature. Seven thematic niches confront the philosopher's paradoxes and invite visitors to question the present.

2b3968e4b1f7e65e73e7f3316095a4f6bd073624.en: Burden of Justice, a Swedish series, is presented at the GIFF for its Swiss premiere. It takes viewers behind the scenes of a Stockholm criminal defence firm and its cases.

dd827a11779fd562545d972dfe9a35029e32f6f5.en: Destination FuturS is a free 90-minute creative workshop at the MEG for participants aged 8 to 108. Two strange creatures invite visitors to imagine future worlds, with registration required.

dc00be3eb349a152300864ce3a7c4a2e97d5cc81.en: Sur le pont, an animated film by the Guillaume brothers, is screened at the Bibliothèque de la Cité, followed by a discussion with the directors. It explores passengers on a mysterious train heading to a bridge.

5602ea90b42112d749ef09e825e151228bcd9f2a.en: Rousseau, lanceur d'alerte is an audiovisual trail at the Maison de Rousseau et de la Littérature. It presents the life and work of Rousseau through seven thematic niches about his paradoxes.

c57f486ff66a03c63f656349ef801feede1dcb4f.en: Anima Sana at the Musée d'art et d'histoire is a monthly session where Geneva artists Serval and Kalonji invite visitors to talk and create in front of the works.

1d535b7421c1545fd88572458f62cb16794d89b4.en: La français c'est tout un art at Villa Bernasconi is a free French practice session. Participants look at artworks together and learn new expressions, and both beginners and advanced speakers are welcome.

bf096a658dd50db7c03970058ecd8efebb6d242d.en: Guided visits of brave la nuit / poems for ruptures at the FMAC are led by the guest curators ghala charara and rita elhajj on the first Sunday of the month at 15:00. The exhibition runs until 13 December 2026.

8d450b49c2bedda6d461011840f2d72b50abe053.en: Ballet Junior de Genève students perform Dream Coat (IV), a textile sculpture performance by Nefeli Papadimouli, at Le Commun. The ten cotton pieces are inspired by the sun cycle, Orpheus and Hypnos.

d2a9a803688940543113806aeabb8ec1f8ecb81a.en: Rififi, a Greek series, is presented at the GIFF for its first Swiss screening. In 1990s Athens, a woman plans a bank heist, and the film replays one of the century's great robberies.

9e8c6ad5cca0f903f088ab0a9a5cd7f75518c2bc.en: L'herbier de Jean-Jacques Rousseau at the Botanical Garden tells the story of a rare herbarium the institution bought at auction. The piece, more than 200 years old, is shown in the exhibition.

9898331511fbab4e1346dc2c0b641fb8fc326c48.en: Les Indes, a French film, is presented at the GIFF for its first Swiss screening. In the mid-17th century, three men travel through harsh lands to deliver the portrait of the Spanish infanta to Louis XIV.

15b9de24c1b248a88c866e06fdfb9ef1a33a1d06.en: Sabbathsong Klezmer Band performs at the Alhambra with a repertoire of Hasidic songs, Yiddish and Israeli tunes, Armenian melodies and jazz. The ten-piece ensemble plays at 17:00.

b42efd41f58d8e364ebffc21d08172fa46df6470.en: The Swiss Youth Symphony Orchestra's autumn tour, Vers le nord, is conducted by Izabelė Jankauskaitė at the Victoria Hall. The programme includes Grieg's Norwegian Dances, Rautavaara's Cantus Arcticus and Sibelius's Fifth Symphony.

89236e65f9641be365ed67f31a7b233c59a9ff1a.en: Martine de Freudenreich sings with guitarist Christian Goza at the Villa Dutoit, launching her book Djakatan. The songs and the book explore the mother-daughter bond, and entry is free with a hat collection.

93a8fe85328e394f1066eec12b2c0626f22639f3.en: The Toussaint concert by Ensemble Memorare at the Église Saint-Maurice plays Biber's Rosary Sonatas on baroque instruments. Entry is free, with a collection afterwards.

fc88c82658778bafec2b26080143e1b58ee31545.en: Haemers, a Belgian series, is presented at the GIFF for its first Swiss screening. While the trial of an infamous criminal is adjourned, his mother visits him to try to understand what led him astray.

5731bc0f50d562669312f9d9f94842e40c5485e9.en: Viendra la révolution, a film by Pegah Ahangarani that won the Golden Eye in Cannes, is screened at the GIFF. It follows five people close to the director through almost 40 years of political repression in Iran.

29a30fa3e9807d380af22793fba60ed91a18effc.en: The Flaws, a German series, is presented at the GIFF for its first Swiss screening. Staff from a company are sent on a retraining course for model employees after a mix-up, in a comedy.

2f82798695f54a95847f830e37f7c279c44818cf.en: A meeting with the author Julie Moulin at the Cologny library discusses her short-story collection about Singapore. The book is a finalist for the 2026 Goncourt de la Nouvelle, and the talk is moderated by Typhaine Marc.

d578972d9d40717a521a50b4b0d9911c0dea4fdb.en: Peccato, an Italian series, is presented at the GIFF for its first Swiss screening. A former actress is found years after leaving the screen by a team who want to interview her, in a mockumentary.

18c99f153a7125aa20d40251072c7e226e870ddf.en: A la rencontre du monde à vélo is a film by C. Bernard about a year-long bicycle trip across 19 countries on five continents. It follows the famous cycling roads of Asia, Oceania, Patagonia and Africa.

a85381d28c46c7c64a1de30900865975035a18e4.en: Dans le décor de Sept at the Théâtre du Grütli sees performers improvise a new play in the set of another show, without knowing it beforehand. Each evening ends with a talk on stage.

5cdd321e068420c2fd51fc19e56422efd7fa0a4f.en: Miles Davis, 100 ans d'influence opens on 2 November at 19:00 at Le Chaudron. The exhibition presents photographs, press covers, archive footage and a new documentary about the trumpeter.

4e67e14a2a0f0b9586cd2e4c660ba859cf2098a9.en: Traktor is a free concert by the trio of Brooks Giger, Anthony Dietrich and Dominic Egli, at a venue run by Action Civique Intempestive. The programme opens at 19:00, with a quote from B. Traven.

747dc5872a9053a5cbb99938a2b466aa22c0b340.en: Louis Matute Large Ensemble featuring Joyce Moreno at the Alhambra celebrates Brazilian jazz, with a duo of Dandara Modesto and Edwin Correia opening. The evening spans several generations of Brazilian musicians.

506fcc7e83d410bfc4e3a36d8f1521e421425ec4.en: Soirée PréPro: BARBARA | LOU at Le Chaudron presents personal projects by students of the eMa's PréPro course to an audience and external experts.

74dd226b7cf39ef2185cd1ac53d2db3d1e88e685.en: Ancêtres en collections? is an international conference at the MEG on 3 and 4 November about human remains in museum and university collections. It covers ethics, law, return and display, and is free with registration.

1c18cb053cce58dbb0543912d2c4b9871037396a.en: Rencontres fertiles with Christian Clot, founder of the Human Adaptation Institute, is a session on new ways of thinking about our relationship with the world. It combines a keynote, a round table and a dialogue on art, science and ecology.

ca9d7c0f6aed2ee85c359407c8feeb5d7170ce2f.en: Comment être parent à l'ère du changement climatique? is a six-session online course for parents on balancing family life with environmental commitment. Each Tuesday from 3 November to 8 December offers practical tools.

232137d09c9c191fcf87ad2a597e62f70c82aab5.en: Tango & Santé at the Musée d'art et d'histoire offers therapeutic tango and museum visits for people with neurological conditions such as Parkinson's and Alzheimer's, and their carers. Booking is needed at least 24 hours ahead.

fc49fadd95d3e4cd2dab843509ec3b7f2be7d8e9.en: La magie des arbres en automne is a two-hour nature walk in Bois de la Bâtie for older people and people with reduced mobility. A naturalist explains how trees prepare for winter.

0659fba1d7d72f6ca952553e14ccde0298ce2e68.en: Ces jeux qui nous lient at the Servette games library is a senior games session, held on set dates in 2026, from 15:00 to 16:00 at Rue Jean-Robert-Chouet 8.

f32aff9e19ff91530fd1ace1f387290d7094f28f.en: Les séismes, attention les secousses is a family science talk at the Musée d'histoire des sciences on earthquakes. It explains how plate tectonics causes quakes and how seismic waves reveal Earth's inner structure.

6add06cef649309b20475fffaf45510794f84ff1.en: The Loneliest Man in Town is a GIFF film, shown for its first Swiss screening. An old blues star lives alone in a building that a property company wants to demolish, and he plans a wild dream.

7f5b3d0b9c00076e6c16e7776f8635611b2fa617.en: Nourrices, a French series presented at the GIFF for its first Swiss screening, is set in Paris in 1889. A young mother new to the capital works as a wet nurse and fights for her own daughter's welfare.

7f96dc964334027eb47f1d39ec723c0c06c34715.en: Taller de inmersión en Borges, a Spanish-language workshop on identity in Borges's work, is held at Maison OFELIA on 3 November from 19:00 to 20:30. It is open to readers and to learners of Spanish.

fd5f71ea01356c25da89013387c3a6edc147c2f1.en: Trilogie de la guerre at La Comédie de Genève is three music performances by exiled Russian artists Elina Kulikova and Dima Efremov. They respond to the invasion of Ukraine and repression at home, and can be seen separately or together on 7 November.

cf22de2e1c95e5bf8b2686f535245c65fe7dd1fc.en: Avant la nuit / L'Oiseau de feu at La Comédie de Genève is a double bill by choreographer Edouard Hue. A bedtime scene about family life is followed by a version of Stravinsky's ballet in which children are drawn into a world of conformity.

dd9e77ec3377aec7b2ead5be0aed12166143f7d7.en: Retour au pays at the Théâtre des Amis is an adaptation by Marie-José Malis of Hugo von Hofmannsthal's letters. A merchant returning to Germany finds the country empty of meaning, until a Van Gogh painting restores his belief in the world.

6c34140a7667ae5659eec1a6691c144d3c10b4c9.en: AGAPÈ at the Bâtiment des Forces Motrices brings together gospel and soul singer Faada Freddy with the Geneva Camerata, under David Greilsammer. The programme opens with Sibelius's Second Symphony, and the singer's new songs follow.

7838842966ed4b77719b16f21b340b96fec3517c.en: Quinceañeras, a dance piece by Estefanía Álvarez Ramírez and Luisa Fernanda Alfonso, explores the Latin American rite of passage at 15. The Colombian artists question how traditions can become acts of resistance. It runs 60 minutes as part of Emergentia.

d5e176ff6df20fe44e665104e50dbb72444d3d6c.en: A Day in the Life of Jo: Chapter Phaedra is a GIFF film, presented for its first Swiss screening. A rebellious teenager in Athens notices a classmate at music class and asks her out.

3d08f2dc8c54fa8603d8e11a7757ef57bf069778.en: Né pour lire is a free library session for children aged 0 to 4 and their families, at the Lancy municipal library. Reading and tender moments are shared, and booking is required.

332465bf13d0c59d5bb0f471699eeee6cc48b144.en: Douce châtaigne et peps de clémentine is an autumn cooking workshop for children aged 2 to 5 at the Eaux-Vives neighbourhood space. Chestnuts, mushrooms and clementines are explored by sight, smell and texture, with a simple recipe for parents.

a9f70142de23eb13856d0eeb4358faa5b05e96a3.en: L'éclate en cuisine à 4 mains is an autumn cooking workshop for children aged 2 to 5 at the Eaux-Vives neighbourhood space. The focus is on apples, pears, squash and leeks, and families create a recipe for December.

d1682009a1dd00fb00effeeb59b4f485ff09235c.en: Parcours mini MEG: Le futur, c'est quoi? is an immersive family trail through the MEG's exhibition on the future. It is for family visitors, and groups must register separately.

389219ee6c4eb171d09d066fe02cb099bd857711.en: Benjamin and his guitar is an interactive family concert at EVE Grand-Salève, part of the Wednesday early-childhood series. It introduces young children to songs and music.

b131abfbc730321fba01fbe02f853a6b7e3d576c.en: Archiver l'invisible, a workshop with Front Row at the FMAC for people aged 15 and over, explores emotional stories held in clothing. Participants document wear and memories, and a public presentation takes place on 12 November.

846b1f814405e6349e7df04b30fb368e8dae4311.en: Mercredi Comédie at La Comédie de Genève is a free afternoon on the first Wednesday of each month for children under 12. Workshops in various arts are offered, and the theatre bar serves coffee for adults.

752ef156abc17289af32ffdabf9c904551d0c0d8.en: Visit of the Pregny greenhouses at the Botanical Garden tells the history of 1880s Canadian pitch pine houses. The guided visit is in a building usually closed to the public, once home to the rare plants of a baroness.

c7fb256bca2750b744accc477df9b23ebbf3c881.en: Un atelier découverte de la nature for children aged 6 to 12 explores the hive in autumn, with honey tasting. It runs from 14:45 to 16:15, costs 10 CHF, and is run by Swiss Food Academy.

5c4c4d31abed35541f7f40907dfc4d67867cfb0c.en: Cafés quartier: Le futur, c'est quoi? is a free informal chat at Café Le Nyamuk in the Jonction area, linked to the MEG exhibition. Participants discuss how they imagine the future, over coffee.

25fdd0ed4fbecde7c09ebf70869b627099644f06.en: Le Petit Black Movie at La Julienne is a free ecological story session for children aged 4 and over, based on the saying that those who respect nature harvest the future.

ee51d775e27edf9e7bd79fdf633707977712682b.en: Un mercredi au MAH offers families a Wednesday of visits, games and a reading at the Musée d'art et d'histoire, supported by the Banque Cantonale de Genève. Activities include a visit on the move and an amphora-themed visit.

710f44f54abe7ffada728ec2ad336aa823672f4e.en: The First Taste of Loneliness is a GIFF film, presented for its first Swiss screening. It portrays the grief of three generations of women after the sudden death of the family grandfather, with striking painterly images.

e56b5d5cf43c771ad6dca37d9ef918be37deb3b3.en: Atelier Mieux Vivre au Naturel at La Julienne is an upcycling sewing workshop, in a warm and friendly atmosphere, for breathing new life into clothes.

b1e120b0e355417a7fae92f24539f69ad1bfa71c.en: L'art, un langage universel at the Carouge library is a series of five art history talks. The session on 4 November is about Frida Kahlo and the tradition of the Day of the Dead, and registration is free.

205fe9c437df13bfb9157bf4b6d5667de63aae53.en: Improoo, the long-form improvised festival, presents Casting: Le Retour 2 at the Théâtre le douze dix-huit. The improvisers imagine sequels to famous films, such as what happened to Rose after Titanic.

e0e409dff028e6ad6c804c36c8f0ada944bc72b2.en: Toutes les femmes sont des aliens is a one-woman show at the Théâtre du Grütli. A woman sits in a cinema seat beside four Alien posters, and recalls her teenage self in a feminist monologue.

ef71fbd449dcdb94d0b28bfc2e5daa2242489737.en: La B.O du Chaos at the Chat Noir is a film-music show, with more than 2,000 tracks played live. The Troubadours du Chaos build stories from audience music choices.

4f524c1e8f089a0ee17f51ee987362f25b0bebe3.en: MIKI and Kay Yōko play the Alhambra on 4 November. MIKI, a singer, writer and filmmaker, mixes hybrid pop with humour and sensitivity. Doors open at 19:00, and the concert begins at 20:00.

83e19a7dffc55b5ea77d308f5609358bc8be952b.en: Brasser de l'air et s'envoler at the Onex municipal hall is a one-man comedy show by Xavier Guelfi. He plays a clumsy and naive happiness coach talking to the audience from his kitchen.

088acfd90ec1c298f9a4db24e02dbe0b2060c6e1.en: La Bankize at Floky la loutre is a monthly improv night, Swipe and Jam. Three improvisers build one story together, and volunteers from the audience take part, with free entry and a hat.

15f522e7c1f2375564a406cc211443740547b5ad.en: Yesterday the Eye Didn't Sleep is a GIFF film, presented for its first Swiss screening. Two innocent women become the victims of a revenge cycle between two clans, after an incident on the Lebanon-Syria border.

657ec3ced5c3392672635ad9bbc173134fa27d6a.en: Lignes de traverse at the Fondation WRP is an exhibition by Geneva artist Olivia Malena Vidal, with works from 2015 to 2026. Photography, painting, drawing and collage move between one another to explore the image.

918d901104c60d1f0f882e71a1641bd1d84dc698.en: Trésors cachés des arts graphiques at the GamMAH is a free pop-up on the first Thursday of the month, showing prints and drawings. This pop-up focuses on portraits by Jean-Étienne Liotard.

73d965a05254423dff09dca71d178ca8c28fb193.en: Ces jeux qui nous lient at the Champel neighbourhood house is a games session for seniors from 14:00 to 16:00 on set Thursdays, run with the Prêt-Ludes games library.

7d0e69693d1c69569d3006bba21ae258c221ba21.en: A two-part podcast-making workshop with Karine Pollien at the Bibliothèque de la Cité covers recording and editing. The sessions are on 1 October and 5 November, free with registration, and the results feed a 2027 exhibition.

ee8a7c3bab074c7146cb4a041e5d410e3cbfc7ea.en: The Burning Giants is a GIFF film, presented for its first Swiss screening. In Thailand, a man from the Karen community is arrested as an unexplained smoke spreads through the jungle, and his wife searches for him.

6fe73e123153786dae77a1cfad75b89b9b6edfda.en: Art en Vieille-Ville, the autumn joint openings in Geneva's Old Town, links galleries across the old quarter. Shows range from ancient masters to contemporary photography and graphic art.

e419280d91366be79683abe160067687138db320.en: Olivier Louvel Masterclass at Le Chaudron presents the guitarist's pedalboards, used in the So Miles project. He explains how effects shape colour and composition, followed by questions.

60019b772d314df696542e0317e9c1b15f5eb769.en: The Nocturnes at the International Museum of the Reformation take place one Thursday a month, with the Ferdinand Hodler exhibition. A guided visit at 17:00 needs booking.

f5e19f9e369fcd9d3d3abb8d65530736ab924f80.en: De l'ombre aux lumières, a two-voice visit of the Geneva school of painting from 1444 to 1782, is led by the conservator Victor Lopes and Professor Frédéric Elsig at the Musée d'art et d'histoire.

3ad37f72952485e60a428e97aa1b684df6951785.en: A guided visit of the exhibition Liotard et Marie-Antoinette: Visages sous enquête at the Musée d'art et d'histoire, led by the exhibition's curator Marie-Ève Celio-Scheurer.

a12e0a9bb742def8f9f1a108a8330a2676903b65.en: Rythmes et paysages cubains is the first concert of the Saison mosaïque at the Conservatoire populaire. Teachers and students of guitar and dance perform Leo Brouwer's 20 Simple Studies and other Cuban-inspired works.

351cea2ad1f0a31e3173c0a816fd0f8d4be2a12a.en: Milonga Brava at the Sécheron neighbourhood space on 5 November features Cristian Correa and Miriam Copello. A tango workshop runs before an evening milonga with open bar.

6ac917c1b92646d50e063a605296127855cd2540.en: Les rendez-vous publics du Projet H107 presents Cap Origami on 5 November at 19:00, a dance show about origami by Compagnie Pipóka. Entry is free, and a second event follows on 12 November.

463a0e75c57174a70f5191cfeec5e578db105bda.en: Singing sessions for everyone are held on the first Thursday of the month at Le 99 in Geneva, from 19:00 to 21:00. The sessions include warm-ups, circle songs and group exercises, and are free with donations welcome.

18be81aba441f12c439b50d43e861cd563cc1244.en: Fragile, La Valise du Grand Départ is a theatre piece by Sandra Widmer Joly, an independent funeral celebrant, at La Julienne. It explores illness and how we remember loved ones, followed by a discussion.

76c81b42279114e2efdb5c8aa0197093c9f42923.en: Recluses Fest #10 brings the tribute to Parabellum, with Ring of Cash and Vikie, to the Alhambra. The alternative festival is run by volunteers, with a line-up of French bands and local acts.

44477fcedcecedfefd09833364229d7d8a2414cd.en: Improoo's Sur un fil is an improvised show by a company with three actors and a musician, building a story live from audience input. The show is part of the Improoo festival at Théâtre le douze dix-huit.

fedf62d40c19b31fc72d75ca7ff064a199011bfe.en: The Berner Symphonieorchester, conducted by Krzysztof Urbański, performs Brahms's First Piano Concerto with Francesco Piemontesi and the Second Symphony at the Victoria Hall, as guests of the OSR.

f0a1431e3e297d9d064312761da4c277bdadae53.en: La Revue de PLO, 175 ans, toujours plus de scandales is a satirical revue at the Salle Communale of Plan-les-Ouates, on several dates from 5 to 21 November. It is part of the commune's 175th anniversary.

c9ea4555cd7ec6a5ee131e8e99cc8f2646cb79df.en: Fast. Funny. Made Up. is the Renegade Saints' improvised comedy show in English, the oldest of its kind in Geneva. Scenes are built from audience ideas, and tickets cost 15 CHF.

39ef5ab68150aea7a79721ec9997fd64e285aaeb.en: Quatuor Terpsycordes performs Beethoven's Grosse Fuge and Schubert's Death and the Maiden at the Salle Grand-Salève. The Geneva quartet, formed in 1997, has been performing Haydn's complete quartets on period instruments since 2021.

85fe5aa2802d5eb28267d17f3e80571996257568.en: Mentir lo Mínimo is a cirque show by Cie Alta Gama, with a woman, a man and a bicycle. Acrobatics and minimalist choreography explore the body. Late arrivals may be refused entry without refund.

062c37487fb158687f6a867e5fd6240bdb15ca12.en: L'Immense Gala by the improvised dubbing troupe is a cabaret of live improv at the Théâtre de la Madeleine. Each number is created on the spot, and the show runs on 5 November, 4 February and 6 May 2027.

50c0ab76f5747466084e3558ee4a9a09ab97b1cf.en: W(H)O CARES? is a scientific day at the HEdS-Genève on preventing obstetric violence. Speakers from Turin and HEdS discuss psychology, perinatal mental health and consent, and attendance requires registration.

02c09fd486df315466850d8f8e5a123d463dad1e.en: WonderDays Nature & Company's Travail Qui Relie workshop takes place in the Botanical Garden's Amarante restaurant. It uses Joanna Macy's four-step method for change, with a vegetarian lunch and a flexible price.

bc49d471573dedf1f94c390498681cf7f50b1fdb.en: Et toi? Quand tu seras grand is a sensory visit at the Musée d'art et d'histoire for babies aged 3 months to 2 years with an adult. It features works by women artists and sounds, with a music specialist.

3cca4a38354e6d99c0018a1b3c0ed672a2b0f1f7.en: Les Automnales 2026 at Palexpo is a food, shopping and emotion festival with a food area, market and sport and passion space. Opening hours are extended on Fridays and Saturdays, and the guest of honour is Swissint.

50dc552349e574cd82b5e86d602ca4cefdc628b8.en: Sieste musicale at the Bibliothèque de la Cité is a collective listening session with a new theme each time. The themes run from Cuban music and French chanson to cool jazz, Dolce Vita and ballads.

b3fcc846d2685f3195df491bb764d5234671cf4c.en: Conte en musique at the Lancy municipal library is a storytelling walk with music by the Compagnie des Contes Joyeux. It is free for ages 5 and over, with registration.

034399896765604745eaf00e244ad054de72cd10.en: Tagada Jones, Darcy and Bob's Not Dead play the Alhambra as part of Recluses Fest #10. Tagada Jones, a French punk and metal band, bring a new show, and the festival is run by volunteers.

9f7e186884fefd192292760c21bc497ec7895392.en: Soirée Jeux de société at the Pont-Rouge neighbourhood space is run by La Table Ouverte. Three board game evenings are held during 2026-2027, each followed by a day off, with a free-price donation.

41e15a563d358eaecb1bb581960c049ea8a1a7ee.en: Alain Dellamaestra Trio plays the Musée d'histoire des sciences on 6 November at 19:00. The trumpeter, who lived in North America for ten years, plays jazz, bossa nova and standards, with a surprise guest.

99399b440a61f7605188b0223313167de0c13698.en: Saison du 150e opens with three concerts at Les Salons from 6 to 8 November. Works by Fauré, Offenbach, Jaques-Dalcroze and Mussorgsky are performed by students of the HEM, with a free workshop for children on 8 November.

64f129543afeb385a1b45d4a69ffe56773d10465.en: The People's Emergency Briefing is a documentary with ten scientists on extreme weather, food security, health and cost of living. It is screened at Cinelux, with a discussion with Nick Oldridge.

2ca9c69bb8b3569e14f3d1c54c16a5699a9a7ea0.en: Coming Soon by Soraya Leila Emery, presented in Emergentia, reworks Ingres's Grande Odalisque with humour. A shifting performer moves between roles and paintings, questioning the orientalist gaze.

2b3dc46314a6a2b2e0819acfb1b32959d227c0e5.en: Faubourg Tango is a trio concert of tangos, valses and milongas with guitar, guitarrón and bandoneon. Between Paris, Geneva and New York, tango remains their compass.

2c5fb513801acefad8fd3f2a9d59cb9a1c9cc006.en: Octopus is an improvised show by the BoB Compagnie at the Théâtre le douze dix-huit, part of Improoo. It explores generations of a family, with secrets and silences told with humour.

720296d070b4e718fbb8ec06a26d7025a8422862.en: Cycle Beethoven 1 at the Victoria Hall is the first concert of a two-season Beethoven cycle by Daniele Gatti. The programme includes Symphonies 1, 4 and 5, marking 200 years since Beethoven's death.

444a87e5de3f9b33d3c41a96a66a22937c1dc78b.en: The 80th Geneva Competition's opening concert features two former prize-winners, pianist Kevin Chen and cellist Michiaki Ueno. The competition, founded in 1939, includes a return of the conducting competition.

21bb9c7237a81957896b5b4a0c775f59ffe9ad5c.en: Soirées Jeux at the Plainpalais-Jonction games library are themed game evenings. Librarians suggest games by theme, from aquatic to co-operative, and the evenings are open from 12 years old.

fd464aa8a25ece8a67ae682e5349c7b4a145871e.en: Bernex Comedy night at the Forum de Bernex features stand-up by Edem Labah, a father and radio presenter, and Karim Devaud, whose show covers his Algerian roots and Swiss upbringing.

6d337fe4f0cb6aba09cc74e70acc9f596cab4900.en: Autothérapie by Mackenzy Bergile, presented in Emergentia at the Pavillon de la danse, is a series of solo fragments. The dance explores memory, trauma and cultural references, and includes nudity.

ad18cab977e6760261e7439c89590e1e1f9657bb.en: Rempis, Adasiewicz and Corsano play AMR in Geneva. The Chicago improvisers, Dave Rempis on saxophone, Jason Adasiewicz on vibraphone and Chris Corsano on drums, present their album Dial Up.

6bdfd9d3be408dda6d20a2e43e94f827c144221d.en: DJ Beto plays reggaeton, bachata, merengue, salsa and mambo at the Chat Noir. The DJ from Mexico brings Latin American energy to the night.

5f613acbf38ac38c7c6d2c687d361eae45b47f0e.en: Saturday Bicy Tour takes guests on a free guided e-bike ride around Geneva on the first Saturday of each month. Coffee and a croissant start the morning, and e-bikes are available to borrow.

57cba61f7ec7a317aedeb03cb249eb12602c18fd.en: Médiation sensible, méditation intérieure at the International Museum of the Reformation offers early-morning visits before opening. Guided looking at a Hodler work is followed by a short breathing or meditation exercise.

55d8953c2a3d8e5d76381ce34661ed1ff4b5b757.en: A workshop on Ukrainian traditional singing with Antonina Mitrakhova at ADEM over two mornings. Participants learn ritual winter songs and lyrical folk songs, with no music background needed.

a399e91014a5189cedd33854b6e6b5d49e83ab23.en: Riposte is a two-day self-defence course in French Sign Language for deaf women and queer people, from age 16. It is held in a cooperative setting and does not require good physical condition.

d4921b313df86e80102f729a7def8d4a3121ff63.en: LOOK UP, a hundred hot-air balloons in the sky, is an installation at the Eaux-Vives library by Rosanna Baledda, encouraging visitors to protect the atmosphere. A related talk with Pierre Kunz takes place on 17 November.

3b5f90bb7b9fd1e40dc61d2ad3451fe521eeeaac.en: Parent-and-child woodwork workshop at Le Grand Atelier takes place on the first Saturday of each month from 3 October. Pairs make a wooden object together from 10:00 to 12:00 for 60 CHF per pair.

6abce3165135dc59a65824b025a95a30799605d3.en: Le Salon du Design returns to the Pavillon Sicli on 7 and 8 November 2026. Some 25 dealers sell vintage furniture and lamps from the 1910s to 1990s, by designers such as Jean Prouvé and Le Corbusier, and the Bourse aux Montres appears for the first time.

8a6e67773c071dc6478c68b553167ba32620bf24.en: The University of Geneva's Faculty of Medicine opens its doors on 7 November to mark 150 years. Visitors can tour labs, join interactive workshops and meet research teams on topics from genetics to artificial intelligence.

077eafa7d8cdfceb67360ae521561006ad0c36b5.en: Initiation to aikido and bokken at La Cité Bleue accompanies the show Le chant du sabre. Participants learn the basics of the wooden practice sword in a safe setting.

b6bdcbd387543544e365ddcc9392cca4237162c6.en: Lire et relire at the Bibliothèque de la Cité is a free reading session for children, about why books are worth reading again and again. Registration is required.

e6c26cd12c25ac55e712703feeaedabf160155c0.en: Nom de code: Beethoven 5 is a family concert at the Victoria Hall. The OSR, conducted by Daniele Gatti, decodes Beethoven's Fifth Symphony, from its famous opening notes to its final chord, in about one hour.

1f8f0f9d1f17578029001a6bbbcab82f482b181e.en: Notre santé à l'heure des changements climatiques is a health and climate day at the Maison de l'Avenir. Speakers cover the effects of environmental change on health and the eco-anxiety, with workshops on food, mobility and nature.

b3d9a3892c1b2e7dea1e9e92f52195376b22d809.en: LIKAMBOTE is a therapeutic programme for people who experience racism, held inside the MEG's colonial collections. Participants share experiences in a safe space, with registration required and French comprehension needed.

d18e11c0dee50a80011862233b2dc40d4099af12.en: La zone nono at the Bibliothèque de la Cité offers a behind-the-scenes meeting with the team of the Théâtre des Marionnettes de Genève. Visitors learn how the musical fable of puppets and objects is made, and can try a puppet.

5f85316689993e512c075995c497bcce9e380395.en: The 80th Geneva Competition's first conducting semi-final takes place with the Orchestre de Chambre de Genève. Six candidates conduct excerpts by Bizet, Farrenc and Mendelssohn during a 45-minute open rehearsal.

ae78b09388a1a4eb763066e01bc3b9768f10ecbd.en: Piano chantant at La Julienne is a free singalong with piano. Participants choose from 270 songs, with lyrics projected on screen, and a hat is passed round.

dfdfde5759eb91ad53bb36c25c145489e25e20b8.en: Des insectes entre les pages at the Saint-Jean library is a creative workshop in which children make a small illustrated book from recycled pages. They also study butterflies, beetles and dragonflies.

163286ebfd2ca0e640427b069e33cc70d32aa366.en: Histoires gravées dans la pierre at the Musée d'art et d'histoire is a 90-minute mini reading club for children from age 6, with an adult. It explores sculptures that seem to have stories to tell.

815b9817162f4e74bc75077e5f4640561db7bcba.en: La Grande Histoire de l'opéra is a one-hour sung and spoken show by Louis Geisler, presented at the Conservatoire de Genève. A professor's talk on four centuries of opera is interrupted by a prima donna and a pianist, for ages 12 and over.

2f79e5ac9fc4b8a4d719447d219a06b9433ebda7.en: Voyage de Kawi le colibri au pays des droits de l'enfant at the Grands-Hutins library is an artistic session for children from age 4, on children's rights. It is free with registration.

9bb7091f9c8133cd83801db96e6f29f8fc6e4795.en: De fil en traits at the Ariana museum invites children to explore the world of Marie Ducaté, where drawing, ceramics and textile meet, and to create their own works. The session lasts 1.5 hours.

de232e2389e3de656011cbbfaa899fe838b510fd.en: Atelier Danse en famille at the Arcade Pierrablanca is a 1.5-hour dance workshop for a child and an adult, led by two dance teachers, for ages 2 and up. The cost is 5 CHF per person.

f1bf336573eee5bff63cf4f20a9faa94b73244b6.en: Paper Lane by Olga de Soto is a durational performance at the Maison des arts du Grütli. A single slow gesture of tearing a long surface becomes a ritual of endurance and meditation, a protest against digital acceleration.

68f7b3598ab13a89ce2b78e1406aeb0a1f946b91.en: Improoo's Mythique is an improvised show at the Théâtre le douze dix-huit. Two actors and a pianist turn a story from the audience into everyday myths and legends.

23235aaa4c7276b20a2a9c0551f615797899df63.en: The People's Emergency Briefing is a film featuring ten scientists on extreme weather, food security, health and the cost of living, with its first Geneva screenings. A short discussion with Nick Oldridge follows.

bb56c2dc81c0de0487bdbb4efdedc11b3a35fc8d.en: The Exploited, Les Clébards and Bad Nasty play the Alhambra as part of Recluses Fest #10. The punk and street-punk line-up is the festival's tenth edition, run by volunteers.

c4a2e34e2aa91213c5103dea6aa0e22c17c35424.en: The Curious Bards perform airs from Ireland and Scotland at the Temple Saint-Gervais as part of Festival Celtiques. They play tunes from 17th- and 18th-century collections on viola da gamba, Irish cittern and triple harp.

824d3b7d3e057c8769730adceffc4b8cc4a3cfb8.en: Festival Celtiques: Entre Écosse et Galice is a programme of Celtic music, song and dance across Geneva venues. Highlights include a concert by The Curious Bards and a Scottish film screening with Joanne McIver.

1bb26f7b84f3cf079302bac3c85eb2bc42891508.en: Or Bareket Quartet plays AMR in Geneva. The bassist and bandleader leads a quartet with saxophone, piano and drums, with pieces from his albums SAHAR and YŌM.

8779f6852061216a29053e0bc930c24d473f6041.en: DJ KenKylla plays Caribbean, soca, dancehall and afro sounds at the Chat Noir. The Martinique-born DJ, also known as Captain Jamaica, has mixed in Paris and London.

f02d247b0c74d7b3714b06990e89b9143f4d7861.en: Sunday Training at the Aimée-Stitelmann sports hall in Plan-les-Ouates is a Sunday exercise session for people aged 16 and over. Participants can attend one, two or three 45-minute classes, with registration required.

c7328817fd2b0e0a492e046651a57688d7987814.en: Des histoires à créer, a library session for children from age 2, combines reading with a creative activity inspired by the story. Registration opens one month before each date.

58638b1f78a2a648ef94bdf0e48e1df9defbf553.en: Dimanches sportifs at the Grand-Lancy school offers free sports sessions for women on Sundays outside school holidays. Pilates, yoga, self-defence, zumba and circuit training are on offer, for women aged 18 and over.
