db89f0315aa318bcf79eb1e0dd7abafa6011ed37.en: Le Gruffalo, a musical tale for children from age 3 by Compagnie Jolla at Arcade Pierrablanca, follows a mouse who invents a monster to escape her animal companions. The show lasts 20 minutes and is followed by a 15-minute workshop.

c53b84b559ebac5f02186f0d2bc1d01b8c345636.en: Demi-finale at Concorde espace culture presents six candidates conducting the Ensemble Contrechamps in Ligeti's Kammerkonzert and another chosen work. It is part of the Geneva Competition for conductors.

10193f2f4f1416afc3430fa56d3d8d6c9f31f3b9.en: Visite des créateurs at the MEG offers a guided tour led by the people who designed the exhibition Le futur, c'est quoi? The exhibition was built with teenagers and is aimed at young visitors. The next visit is on 13 December.

7a4ecda04d884a0003a3230334f18e1e78136007.en: 80th Geneva Competition's second conducting semi-final takes place with Ensemble Contrechamps. Six candidates rehearse Ligeti's Kammerkonzert and a contemporary work by Chin or Saunders in a 45-minute public session.

7f17030ac636ee66dd57881f2d128c0a75f53c1a.en: Improoo's En thérapie is an improvised show by the Carré Rond company, where five patients meet in a single session. The show is directed by Dardan Shabani.

a850b89b745e951d9ecd366cb1e459e68ea463b5.en: Emmanuel Pahud and Éric Le Sage perform Mozart and Schumann sonatas, and Clara Schumann's romances, at the Victoria Hall. Pahud plays the flute in arrangements of works originally for violin.

91e50613ce584b5c57603e86ac8a0bf5967d049c.en: Amistat, the twin brothers Josef and Jan Prasil, plays the Alhambra with Orange Oak. The duo grew up across Germany, Italy and Australia and sold more than 30,000 tickets in 2025.

2fa969070db3cf37ad743c764dfb923aed941183.en: 80th Geneva Competition's third conducting semi-final takes place with the OSR at the Victoria Hall. Six candidates rehearse Debussy's La Mer and a concerto movement by Schumann with soloists Kevin Chen and Michiaki Ueno.

1f5d7ccc847a395004a9806f9463a0a6bd8d7728.en: Masson, Duboule, Ruiz and Vandenbulcke form a new group that plays Nicolas Masson's recent compositions over four residency evenings at Lex Madone. The audience sees the music being shaped, with free entry.

ba09ca6923af373f09ddfd0e18ca697fbc381536.en: Bientôt morte by Compagnie Tandem is a comedy about a woman who learns she has three weeks to live and plans her own grand funeral with her friend. It runs from 9 November to 1 December 2026, from 15 CHF.

8c024030f4a93f87a70ff866e59959e988205104.en: Milonga at the Pavillon de la danse hosts an evening of Argentine tango in its foyer on some Mondays. Beginners' lessons run from 19:00 to 20:00 for 10 CHF, and the milonga is free from 20:00 to 23:30.

37e72cb2deb0032ba5221dd8af49e1ac64b9d92f.en: Les Duels du FG Club at the Impro Comedy Club pits teams from the Geneva improv league against each other. Players leave their own team to take on rivals in short head-to-head challenges.

c6484edc2e097a0f27103a800a6a1b1f0a37817e.en: Soirée PréPro: ARNO | SEBASTIAN at Le Chaudron presents personal projects by students of the eMa's PréPro course to an audience and external experts.

f343383c9f996d05049375b1cddc126a1b3324aa.en: Midi recherche et innovation santé at the HEdS Geneva is a lunchtime talk on postpartum recovery in the first month: its determinants and predictive value. Attendees may bring their lunch, and the session is open to the public.

9519858a004ff57784dc30a8fa132b372823b686.en: Méditer au MAH: La patience is a mindfulness session in the Musée d'art et d'histoire among the works, led by therapist Erwan Tréguer and cultural mediator Murielle Brunschwig. It explores patience as a theme.

6a151180ba9037a2c9fbf5a9938af4f3da7ea249.en: Thé dansant at La Julienne turns a hall into a dance floor with live music on a free afternoon. Couples and singles are welcome, and a snack bar is open.

6b73cbebae8dd8dc4b358127c1f20eab98835804.en: Bodil Manz's installation at the Ariana museum is presented on 10 November at 18:00. The work, of more than 130 clay and porcelain elements, is a model city made from her signature porcelain cylinders.

2c6c42e214d79b1fe2a2b1d1b515c77830e681e7.en: ULISSE is a talk at the Espace 3DD about an under-lake system that would store solar heat and waste heat through the seasons. The speaker, William van Sprolant, argues it could help cover Switzerland's winter electricity shortfall.

ba64f1ac794bfe63dca4322f6312877b75cd7033.en: Taller de inmersión en Borges, Encuentro IV, a Spanish-language session on destiny as an existential concern, is held at Maison OFELIA on 10 November from 19:00 to 20:30. It is open to readers and to learners of Spanish.

00ad93ec62ac485e4d5733ee23d1df2bde9d68cc.en: Le chant du sabre at La Cité Bleue is a show that blends choral singing and Noh theatre. A man withdraws from a fast-paced society to search for the meaning of his life.

55e5965aac3fe8726dd07a8d0cfbc0fef20456a5.en: Olga de Soto's Une introduction (revisitée) at Concorde Espace Culture revisits Kurt Jooss's ballet La Table verte. The performer shows the research process, with video and archive images, against the political background of the 1930s.

dbcb0921d9166c0e9dede43426dfa7c3149b6f77.en: Nessi Gomes plays her first live concert in Geneva at the Alhambra on 10 November. The Anglo-Portuguese singer-songwriter blends fado with contemporary British sounds, and Mike Rauss opens.

18a68684dbe0f801d468dbe3dc6e9451301502cc.en: Rock on stage HEAVY with Christophe Godin at Le Chaudron lets guests join a band and play riffs and solos with the group. Participants can sign up by email to take part.

46b6f8ce87ecdcf7b58a098ff7825f50f216439f.en: Mercredi de la petite enfance at EVE Bois-Gourmand is a creative workshop for young children, making sock puppets from different materials to free the imagination.

42189af1197b59740f715033c92b6a9a093fd11d.en: Qu'y a-t-il au bord du Nil? is a short family visit for children aged 3 to 5 at the Musée d'art et d'histoire. It mixes stories, sensory discovery and wonder, and lasts 30 minutes.

529aabcb957e8cc1969d83518f81e4858cf26fb1.en: Couleurs d'automne et structures végétales at the Botanical Garden is a children's workshop. Children explore autumn colours in the garden and make temporary artworks, as part of the Ateliers verts on Wednesday afternoons.

873a852ca296f08010b124ce7762012b11a796bb.en: La cabane de tes rêves is a creative workshop for children aged 6 to 12 at the Jonction neighbourhood space. Small groups build their own cabins from the materials provided on 2nd and 4th Wednesdays from 14:30 to 17:00.

cab2c2621b3a2de320b929c649d7b59d3e294d47.en: Atelier Art-Maker: la machine à point is a workshop for children aged 5 to 7 at La Julienne. A motor and a felt pen produce drawings that participants take home.

5cb8a0054183ca92a92818bfe2cd27630b0ae7aa.en: Compagnons de balade at the Ariana museum is a one-hour storytelling walk for children from age 4, with a short craft workshop at the end.

723e1a1c107625b49fa16429e0e689539fb80b60.en: Mondes Parlés at L'Arcade hosts a reading by Noah Truong, an extract from a novel project about a diasporic traveller in Ho Chi Minh City. A discussion with the audience follows.

75ddb4165c080d1dc0ef267e03c75384a458f876.en: Dans l'intimité du peintre explores Ferdinand Hodler's 241 sketchbooks, held by the Musée d'art et d'histoire, at the International Museum of the Reformation. The presentation shows how the notebooks reveal the artist's spiritual thinking.

da3aa3a1874f11fb9c24e940a6596aae92be6a58.en: Mahjong evenings at the Plainpalais neighbourhood house bring together beginners and experienced players once a month. Anyone who wants to learn can join in.

cce359bd7bcfc5b4177f7b474d72ce941895c30c.en: CinéClubturel's Blade Runner is a film night from the 2026-27 season, Humans vs AI, at the Bureau culturel. The film, by Ridley Scott, asks what makes us human, and pizza is included.

288801d649eab928217bd58458654aed2b8be1f3.en: The 80th Geneva Competition's first final brings together the three conducting finalists, who draw lots to conduct a work from the composition competition with the OSR. The composition prizes follow.

dd3daa2245a55eb7fe13135b140e489a2bda3624.en: Café des parents on supporting a child with ADHD, autism or learning difficulties takes place at the Plateau neighbourhood house. It is free, with registration required, and places are limited.

17ef888abb74402ca237fe9782ee19c90a0978b5.en: Jusque dans nos bras is a play by the Collectif Sur Un Malentendu at Théâtre du Loup. Six friends retell the story of Alice and her childhood friend Mad, who enter a marriage of convenience, exploring friendship as resistance.

748a1a479068c0a2e3481a8e83f8fec804fef548.en: Thésée, sa vie nouvelle at Saint-Gervais is a stage adaptation of Camille de Toledo's novel by Guy Cassiers and Valérie Dréville. The show looks at how myths help us question each era.

123f89af3ec7574abd76d8e41704616964e26a27.en: Telemann's Parisian Quartets, The art of conversation, is a concert of five quartets from Telemann's 1730 collection, played by Chouchane Siranossian and colleagues on flute, violin and viola da gamba.

77bb309ffd1902a9814b67f3abf7147f6281e6d1.en: An improv match, Bâtardexs d'en face vs Thorel, is held at the Villa Tacchini. Two teams compete on themes set by a referee, and the audience decides the winner.

7260bfa54d5a9d0aad3c1a89bcd983f90e4e7593.en: Alceu Valença's 80 Sunflowers Tour stops at the Alhambra to mark the Brazilian singer's 80th birthday. The show mixes north-eastern Brazilian rhythms such as frevo and maracatu with modern sounds.

3f2faaf7f6bec0851c7aae98f7fc4da3f260c9bf.en: Jazz Night LATINA with Edwin Sanz at Le Chaudron brings salsa, cumbia, merengue and Latin jazz to the stage, with improvisation and open audience participation.

0b9da59920ac9273116144f7c16ab9883cd30f62.en: An introductory human rights course for young people aged 18 to 30, the Classe d'automne, focuses on sexist and gender-based violence. It is part of the 25 November campaign against violence against women.

ae55e1791f4a3d578748a7229ffce09b26a94b1f.en: Un siècle de luttes syndicales at the Bibliothèque de Genève looks at Geneva's labour movements from the 1920s to the 1990s, through union posters. The talk by historian Patrick Auderset is free.

60f04b8166bd1ce5e284f178b1ca657e4d833992.en: The Tradwives of America is a 25-minute documentary screened at the Geneva Graduate Institute, followed by a round table. It examines the traditional-wife trend on social media and its impact on women's rights.

342a18349280489c68b0ebba4ac6c4af2eb04a8f.en: Partageons nos lectures at the Bibliothèque de la Cité lets visitors share a favourite book, comic, film or game during a lunch break once a month. Listeners are welcome too.

e250befc784d7a7db3b02a72d17d2df6a44d5859.en: Estime de soi is a talk at the Espace Palettes on self-esteem as people age. It looks at how retirement and changes in the body and life can prompt a new view of oneself.

bf468ec772eb8df2001305b46b5c3d93d6ecdcfd.en: Ces jeux qui nous lient at the Jonction neighbourhood space is a senior games session on set Thursdays from 14:00 to 18:00, run with the Plainpalais-Jonction games library.

17e4617020d4b3b6ef1e05d420b36d739227837f.en: La Nuit des Bains turns the Quartier des Bains into an open-air art trail, with museums, galleries and art centres opening together for a collective evening opening.

511a116bf0e3613d5d4e314fce11853276d41e7d.en: Entre crise et régulation is a talk at the Musée d'art et d'histoire by historian Johann Boillat on Geneva's watch industry during the 1930s crisis and restructuring. A Swiss-American brooch watch is the case study.

7eddaec93f09062d46b66abae6aa4d1ad9a3e5cc.en: Désirs brutes by Rubén Barrios-Rodríguez at Espace Kugler Gallery explores masculinity, desire and vulnerability through drawings, photographs and football imagery. The show runs from 12 to 15 November, for ages 16 and over.

1eba362198a2e9f3a165fc618c01a488a6e37db4.en: Entreprendre sur le terrain is an English-language talk by Francesco Urso, founder of Wolf Project, for The Marketing Meetup Geneva. He shares lessons on building a brand and selling a business.

0786da05cb581601c0d522643585a98ec2800dac.en: Espace vers... by Deyrmon at La Mansarde is a retrospective of about a quarter-century of work, shown with extracts from the artist's journal. The opening takes place on 12 November at 18:30, with the artist present.

6361ccf9785d1a73d1cf6430958075745c902f1f.en: Atelier Care, run by Viol-Secours and sexologist and psychotraumatologist Fiona Bourdon, teaches accessible techniques to ease sleep, stress, anxiety and panic. It covers mindfulness, breathing, relaxation and writing exercises.

9ff8e3c4ec91e5f86e789d01884078fe01a5fe3b.en: 2 copines et des livres at La Julienne is a relaxed chat about favourite books and discoveries, held in a warm meeting with the two organisers.

8bf3a2b33fa07e20de25fbe6ef9fe90d4039ae50.en: Milonga Brava pre-party for the Sueño Azul Tango Marathon takes place at the Sécheron neighbourhood space on 12 November. A waltz workshop with Emilia Andrada and Maria Kownacka comes before an evening milonga with open bar.

f101f5190700ef9428260bdcae137987c39b0faf.en: Opening evening of the 25 November campaign at HES-SO Geneva's social work school addresses incest and childhood abuse as part of the continuum of gender-based violence. A round table brings together experts including anthropologist Géraldine Morel.

cde6b0505053be70558dde800dba8e6f6a0bf575.en: Malte Marten's Autumn Tour 2026 stops at the Alhambra. The handpan player, who began in Berlin, performs with percussionist Conrado Molina and multi-instrumentalist Bummela.

6c06fb26cf4d331ce11ebf371d909ca7ab6f63ae.en: Baby Teeth at La Comédie de Genève is a dance piece for ten dancers about the mouth as a site of taste, bite and speech. The Rio-based choreographer Catol Teixeira leads a multilingual, collective creation.

9251b8d3d6074985da09016d56e69c5a4cb359af.en: Lise Davidsen, the Norwegian soprano, gives a recital with pianist James Baillieu at the Bâtiment des Forces Motrices. The programme features Schubert lieder on Goethe poems, including Erlkönig.

9ef0f19e27624a9ab667a7ef283f6ae65fbce820.en: Merci d'y croire - la vérité c'est fatigant is a one-man comedy show by Jean-Marc Zgraggen at Floky la loutre. The show explores the power of beliefs and horoscopes, with humour.

3190cf7fed3bb617b8ce4539118f44aadb40f943.en: BAG Blues Challenge invites selected bands to play two songs each on the BAG's backline. Prizes include a professional studio recording session and gift vouchers.

981e69dac29f58c06425cadd5962c965b5efcffe.en: Open mic ALL STYLES at Le Chaudron lets singers and musicians perform one song each, backed by the house band or their own group. Registration is by email at least 48 hours in advance.

cda4f7e586510089a3ea51e954b33da1faef0996.en: À Fleur de Plume at the Chat Noir is a hip-hop open mic and talent contest run by the Eloge Record label. The winner gets a free studio recording and a place on a bill.

4e0774e5fa07a8b7c8dc5da68cea43a1961db56e.en: A special screening of Whiplash at Cinéma Nord-Sud is on 12 November at 20:45. The film follows a young drummer at a New York conservatory under a fierce teacher, and the cinema chooses its screenings by audience vote.

237fa5551d6c9d938acb1d67446fa642a3c6ed2d.en: Energ-IACK is a two-day hackathon on using artificial intelligence to help Geneva move away from fossil fuels. Teams of two to six build prototypes with mentors and pitch to a jury on 14 November, for ages 18 and over.

e75a7fe28fc2d2ccdd7bbd81551fbebd2d47e911.en: La Nuit du conte at the Jardins de la Jonction brings storytellers together for an evening on the theme of voice. Stories are told from 16:30, with a buffet from 16:00.

0bad2cdfa596be0257130e3810c45f13267e658b.en: Écosse, terres de légendes is a documentary film by Christophe Maillet and Gérard Pont, screened at the MEG as the opening of the Celtiques festival. Joanne McIver and Jean-Sébastien Tingaud join the discussion.

9e234ad58dd0525d4415e97c51c2d27b3b065715.en: MEG for the Nuit du conte 2026, on the theme of voice, invites young children with an adult to imagine the voices of the future. Booking is required by email, with places limited.

2010ddbe174dd430e3f171c72f8004e429a4b5cc.en: A writing workshop at the Lancy municipal library explores different ways of creative writing. Participants may join one or several sessions, and booking is required.

8001cd35b0098532f3d05240289b3528633ea55d.en: Poulpe Fiction is a storytelling show for the Nuit du conte at the Saint-Jean library. Giant shadows, sea legends and deep-sea creatures are brought alive through sound, games and body percussion.

7d91029a8269690a50b73263f5fc48991c48e395.en: Créatures de la Terre is a storytelling show for the Nuit du conte at the Plainpalais neighbourhood space. Cathy Sarr, a Senegalese-Swiss storyteller, explores the links between humans and other animals.

8f1c11ecbf837b70300634c40956208c60a31583.en: The 80th Geneva Competition's second final brings the three conducting finalists to the OSR at the Victoria Hall, with works by Bartók, Mahler, Prokofiev, Strauss and Stravinsky. The conducting prizes are presented afterwards.

9156ce9b20bc1b9a2764cb21a77f1040a7747511.en: Lenio Kaklea's An Alphabet for the Camera at Le Commun is a video from her dance piece, shown before a performance inspired by the queer artists and the song I'm Coming Out. The work builds a dance alphabet of figures.

49278d6e4c3c22f866bc3570152721d12ac55d70.en: Interstellar: Hommage à Hans Zimmer by Mystery Ensemble at the Salle Centrale de la Madeleine reinterprets the score of Christopher Nolan's film with electronic and acoustic textures.

7018f2fb8a770df89741cc9867fbe0e44926222b.en: Scènes Croisées at the Centre des Arts Ecolint on 13 November pairs Area Jeune Ballet from Geneva with Equilibrio Dinamico from Bari. Four choreographies explore human experience through movement.

497f55f47585cdb489c12a413755361425e46bc4.en: Un corps pour deux is a comedy at Uptown Geneva. A womaniser's body part takes control, and he consults a doctor who has given up on love, with two actors playing seven roles.

98eda9adfc695e31b851809f3f0e58bec5ff3810.en: Julienne Impro Show at La Julienne is a cabaret of improvised theatre by the impro.ch team, moving from laughter to drama. Tickets cost 10 CHF per person, booked in advance.

ccf69aece0728a873da09e79245edda2c095189c.en: Amants à mi-temps at Uptown Geneva is a comedy about two married men, each with a mistress on different days of the week, and their wives. The farce explores fidelity, friendship and marriage.

ec3eb1f6ad6df4834713430e73d128edb12ea611.en: Christoph Irniger and Marc Perrenoud play AMR in Geneva. The saxophone and piano duo presents original compositions and reworked jazz standards, from their first album for Unit Records.

c71d51f1cb43cba92a64194bf34c06e8d368118a.en: DJ Arias plays afro beats and afro-Latin sets at the Chat Noir. The young DJ from Colombia, based in Geneva, brings energetic rhythms to the dancefloor.

6a2f304fc39518e0eaa2fe0454319b51f1b799fd.en: An information-integrity creative workshop at La Tour en Communs, run with the artist Zoé Aubry, lets participants build "informational creatures" from press photographs. The session asks what living together means today.

1e0999ade9ae55f07acfc39e8769dd23be12214a.en: Atelier d'autodéfense féministe antiraciste, the RIPOSTE self-defence course at Théâtre du Loup, focuses on racist attacks. Teachers who are themselves racialised lead practical and verbal techniques suited to all ages.

44690baf6c7f446cd6d2bb34537b27c0e5996de8.en: Plan-les-Ouates à deux voix is a guided walk through the village and watchmaking zone, led by a long-time resident and a watch-industry guide. It ends with an aperitif in a historic house, with registration by 12 November.

7136c811b0c9830cb7b06e3538945486c21891e1.en: Fem Do Chi self-defence course for women runs over two days in groups of 8 to 14 at the former Charmilles post office. The course is in a confidential, non-judgemental setting and excludes cisgender men.

b73a3e00d42f884e8572085af3cc719848badde0.en: Éveil sensoriel: Le futur, c'est quoi? is a sensory visit to the MEG exhibition for babies and toddlers with their carers. Colours, shapes, sounds and materials help infants explore the museum.

e32a768367675905461f794367ca32594b7a11cc.en: The 56th Geneva Mineral, Fossil and Gem Fair gathers dealers and collectors from around the world. Visitors can get free jewellery appraisals and see Swiss gems and meteorites.

691c10c19e718158fafca92f790f88da40afbfd0.en: Café mortel at the Musée d'art et d'histoire is a warm, secular, non-therapeutic space for people grieving to share feelings. It is led by a bereavement companion together with a cultural mediator.

f1a627d8385070e093939bff9c612b2e87af763f.en: Somatic movement introductory workshop, held at ArKade Thérapie & Training on 14 November, has two parts: an explanation and exercises, then a guided session. It costs 60 CHF.

e73011c3ac42ae2f3d4539670647a3959089523a.en: La lettre à soi is a writing workshop at the Minoteries library, in which participants write an introspective letter to themselves. Letters are sealed with wax at the end, and the workshop is led by Typhaine Marc.

c711000fd4d767d3617ff0c3753119358b25e9b0.en: FILMARcito 2026 presents Cartographies du vol des oiseaux, a set of contemplative short films about birds, shown across Geneva venues during Climate Week. The films have no dialogue.

73c1e3c6dfce34b4ef080280a5c903895c04e2bf.en: Cœur d'amour by Compagnie Inès is a 35-minute show for children about love in all its forms, with music, theatre and drawing. Performances for Lancy schools take place on 12 and 13 November.

7e69ea58c38f2cc37b6d8382919ef7a48e03fb96.en: Nuit du conte 2026 at the Grands-Hutins library is a storytelling session in French and French Sign Language, run by the association Viens voir. It is for children from age 7, with free registration.

e30efb895bfe4dd7a2310b97cb9242f8265e612f.en: A free writing workshop for young people at the MEG, run by Mondes Imaginaires, pairs a visit to the Le futur, c'est quoi? exhibition with a writing session. Registration is required by email, and no experience is needed.

28c168a582bf94328035ab77651c9fb93162fb7b.en: Donald MacInley and the Witch of Caisteal Abhail is a Scottish family show of storytelling and music at the MEG on 14 November at 15:00. It tells of a farmer visited by a fairy, who reveals the cause of a village's misfortunes.

87d3e13807fc3fd61060c412466b03e54dc92c5c.en: Atelier créatif de Noël at Patrimoine suisse Genève invites children aged 6 to 12 to build their own clay house on 14 or 28 November. The houses become Christmas decorations, and a snack is included.

f62510789fcd7e84f6f4cb5cd7ba5391f697550c.en: Chicas tristes, a 2026 Mexican-French-Spanish fiction by Fernanda Tover, is screened at the Cinémas du Grütli as part of FILMAR. Two teenagers' friendship is shaken after a rape, and a revenge story follows.

08e5a19a043a90e9332be48d9d4a0cace5888737.en: Atelier de reliure artisanale at the Grands-Hutins library runs for three hours, making a notebook from recycled paper with materials provided. It is free with registration, for adults and children aged 14 and over.

71ed13ba97dc036fc0e514954ea0e8711f1258fc.en: Au-delà du regard is a descriptive and sensory tour of the Fuite au Marché Machin exhibition, aimed at blind and partially sighted visitors. It is led by Benoît Billotte at Villa Bernasconi.

128b137ec7a5a4974f9ee3087fd7ffd1c17a753d.en: The 80th Geneva Competition's prize-winners perform at the Temple de Jussy in a chamber concert. Violist Brian Isaacs and the Quatuor Elmire play Beethoven's Quintet and two other works.

2acff8eeefb726c3ce6b117f8cc911e87b6eb140.en: Vuelvo al Sur is a piano recital at La Cité Bleue by Loïc Vallaeys. The pianist plays works from Latin American repertoire with rhythmic energy and varied national identities.

469fbc40e85464d195d1a63868c4bcf76be9aba6.en: Orchestre symphonique genevois performs Grieg's Piano Concerto with Lan Anh Nguyen and Brahms's First Symphony under Anthony Fournier at the Victoria Hall.

d243452b94c6a7bc1fe80169eb09c34e30ea5c2d.en: A poetic and musical evening at the Salle Duvillard features French and Québécois texts and songs. René Davet tells stories of Prévert and others, and Sébastien Gabriel sings, with free entry and a drinks stand.

af35aa2f212f9801d1b327cf9eea6a9d086fb4e5.en: Tales of the Rigged City is an improvised detective show by La Compagnie des Murmures at the Plainpalais neighbourhood house on 14 November at 20:30. It follows a cybernetic detective whose own memory becomes the case, for ages 12 and over.

d4b4b293a5f699508cf726ecf3a8a40c9cb4e247.en: Mailin, a 2025 Argentine-French-Romanian documentary by María Silvia Esteve, follows a woman abused as a child who decides to seek justice. It is screened at the Cinémas du Grütli, with a discussion on 15 November.

29f599767b556d452832e75015a14aa966e9385d.en: Blind Test musical with DJ Mr Hobbs at the Chat Noir is a free music quiz. Teams identify tracks from pop to rap, and the winning team receives gifts. Booking is advised because the room is small.

79c5b62639b75130668bd74320bf3a2ff151e2d2.en: Porta Jazz and AMR is a concert by two Porto musicians and two Geneva musicians, after three days of residency at AMR. Ricardo Moreira, Pedro Molina, Théo Duboule and Manu Gesseney perform.

048626c02138785413ece1c57b8811d5b232edae.en: Mr Hobbs' All Style Pop at the Chat Noir is a DJ set that mixes rock, pop, soul, funk, disco, hip hop, bossa nova, house and techno.

7d5987b4ffc0417b81d98775180abb6aa3fb706f.en: Mange ta soupe is a 45-minute show for children from age 5 by Compagnie Mademoiselle F. It is free, with registration for groups, and is based on the story of a recipe that a grandmother once told.

05c08c01c2874c5e051ec8c8d49e1d53eac3fe5f.en: Pachamama, an animated film directed by Juan Antin, follows two children in the Andes who try to recover a sacred treasure stolen from their village. It is screened at the Maison des arts du Grütli.

69431f20f17631f4722dce6fd1c1d250f6a53d42.en: Piano chantant at the Musée d'histoire des sciences is a free sing-along on 15 November at 11:00. Olivier Grimm plays piano and the lyrics are projected, with a coffee and croissant.

c051f584edf6cf5a605c21328341f41cce8a9947.en: Art et IA is a two-voice visit of the Musée d'art et d'histoire, led by curator Marie-Eve Celio-Scheurer and professor Sébastien Marcel of the Idiap research institute. They explore artificial intelligence and art.

57d116e0f9ab079428acb9d2b9340777bb321b64.en: A volunteer guide is available to answer questions about the paid Marie Ducaté exhibition at the Ariana museum on 15 November, from 14:00 to 16:00.

30e3287623759ca2fe70ac81a7cf4e4c77b6aff2.en: Le Laboratoire d'une soirée plus sûre at FOOUND is a workshop for cultural organisations on preventing and responding to sexist and sexual violence. Participants take part in an interactive training, then a team role-play.

12e02e1329b2f5ddf636f4417d27e43ba8835345.en: Les contes spontanés at La Julienne is an improvised show of storytelling, theatre and music, where the performers accept any suggestion from the audience. Tickets cost 10 CHF per person, booked in advance.

264296435027c1c9cce1319b9d30478ab03552e9.en: A public dictation for Bernex and Confignon, with a text by Jacopo Rivara, is held at the Confignon municipal hall. It has three categories and is free, with a drink for participants before the prizes.

98c928c4a70a0e5094939e853d2066c166ee6d46.en: Niñas escarlata, a Dominican-Mexican-German documentary by Paula Cury, shows the lives of women in a country where abortion is banned. It is screened at the Cinémas du Grütli, followed by a discussion on 15 November.

de6279e13e6b03184aa20a388e66fcb05ca6b936.en: The 80th Geneva Competition closing concert at Les Salons features prize-winners Brian Isaacs and the Quatuor Elmire. It is hosted by the INGE and includes Beethoven's Quintet.

a9b8fcdd4196e056f347ba3aaef10955e8ef12e9.en: L'Harmonie Nautique performs at the Victoria Hall with violinist Rachel Kolly and conductor Eric Haegi. The programme includes Rossini, Bruch, Saint-Saëns and Gershwin.

763af807d9645f21102c3c5dde4e43ae094089a5.en: Héritage(s) at La Cité Bleue features singer and composer Lia Naviliat Cuncic, who explores her South American roots in Latin music, with her quartet.

17a7681463b885c9704c496bf979e5f6ab669b9b.en: Madame Shakeapeare, or the Woman of Stratford, is a performance based on Anca Visdei's book at the Château de Voltaire in Ferney-Voltaire on 15 November at 17:00. It imagines the letters between Shakespeare and his wife, Anne Hathaway.

f691f1a5ae0db6ec9e2f5ddc9299ccb4c8aac899.en: Bi-2 play the Alhambra in a world tour supporting their album Journey Around the Sun. The concert combines songs from that album with the band's biggest hits, with doors at 19:00 and the show at 20:00.

0921b45d7b2032d5c7707474e2967c4cdd834fc7.en: Ari Hoenig gives a masterclass with his trio, including guitarist Tom Ollendorff and bassist Conor Chaplin, at the Auditorium Ansermet. The session covers rhythmic vocabulary, improvisation and composition.

73412566a0a10600f53283185959c0b100f1703a.en: Manas is a Brazilian drama about a 13-year-old girl in an isolated Amazonian community, screened with a round table on making the invisible visible. The round table is organised by LANI, Femcol and FILMAR at the Geneva Graduate Institute.

573b96fe463404a1dad98701704c9c0cd81067df.en: MasculinitéS is recruiting volunteers aged 18 to 30 to work against gender-based violence in Geneva. An information session takes place on 16 November at 19:00 at the Maison de quartier de Chausse-Coq.

c6dec4c4468e214a69e7372f5cacc2d3bfa090b4.en: Morphong is a jazz and electronic trio at the Lex Madone venue, with compositions and improvisation. The venue is provided free by Action Civique Intempestive, and doors open at 19:00.

277564bb8757c1d5a2977d192b810a5ebfa5637d.en: La chair du mâle est aride is a performance by Rubén Barrios Rodríguez at the Théâtre du Grütli on 16 November at 19:30. The body of the performer resists the gestures that shape masculinity through football.

3b943fa4cfd9a30aefed4180094ec17b0c601f41.en: PréPro night: MILAN | MACÉO at Le Chaudron presents personal projects by students of the eMa's PréPro course to an audience and external experts.

98edd5cb703f0b41fe07fb6f3ce921cba13eb774.en: Ari Hoenig Trio at the Auditorium Ansermet presents music from the album Enchanted. The jazz drummer, a noted rhythmic innovator, performs with Tom Ollendorff on guitar and Conor Chaplin on bass.

a4cfb2eab9efcdfd551848d8587a4d952e6d3577.en: Lab'Industrie is a day of hands-on workshops at Pays de Gex Entreprises on production, maintenance and design. It includes a virtual reality workshop and a serious game, run with employment and association partners.

a060c114006345b2612354c8d1c91fa4526891e5.en: Comptines et jeux de doigts at La Julienne is a 30-minute singing and finger-play session for children aged 1 to 4, with an adult. It is free and drop-in, except for groups.

1834c4074c804d83af92b1c6e1d9c80b0efcbcd5.en: La nature au ralenti: que deviennent les animaux sauvages en hiver? is a two-hour nature walk in the woods around the Drize river in Grand-Lancy. Participants look for animal tracks and clues about winter survival.

ef5fdd2dd16d240027bb00ab72b2dae2b91fb87c.en: Azur et Asmar, Michel Ocelot's film with a score by Gabriel Yared, is shown as a live cine-concert with the Geneva Chamber Orchestra. A widow raises her son beside a noble's son, a tale about difference, for ages 7 and over.

c81db4a82a1a00e64cffee7d2ecf374d17afcf94.en: L'atmosphère, c'est dans l'air is a talk at the Bibliothèque des Eaux-Vives by Pierre Kunz, a former head of air-quality work at the cantonal environment office. It covers air composition, pollution and protecting this shared resource.

33d07c6e00cf7a00593e14a5dc65e01b0bd9de1b.en: Forum des copropriétaires PPE at the Maison communale de Plainpalais is a forum for condominium owners on energy renovation. Round-table sessions cover legal duties, costs, heating options and how to start a project.

deb915b1facf27d43211d143737319caa5ade2d3.en: Café mortel is a monthly evening, on a Tuesday after work in a Geneva bar, where people talk about grief. The palliative care association runs it, and details are on its website.

8e54111d012679eefe649205f81a994dce09f1fd.en: Le goût des choses is a 2025 documentary by Alain Wirth about two market gardeners in the hills above Vevey. It is screened at the Bibliothèque de la Servette with a discussion with the director.

14efad76998c768bcef09b674a840f3b1bfb5388.en: Le Cercle 10, a prevention-focused evening for health professionals, takes place at the CMU in Geneva on 17 November from 19:15 to 21:30. It includes a free meal and small table discussions on involving patients and institutions.

5489d58f5a375fa5a31a0abfa1bdd7a35636573c.en: Un futuro brillante, a 2025 Uruguayan-Argentine-German dystopian film by Lucía Garibaldi, is screened free at La Julienne as part of FILMAR. An 18-year-old is chosen to leave for a mysterious northern land.

12fadac4a8d98f078a8349d5beb6b37c8d03c636.en: Rock on stage CLASSIC with André Schmid at Le Chaudron presents two Geneva rock bands, The Resylients and Electric Paradise, with guest appearances. The evening starts at 20:30.

baa1cc19d8fea718d1a2497b3b2b0eb40a6108f6.en: Danitsa and Mercee play L'Usine PTR as part of the Les Créatives festival. Danitsa, a Geneva singer signed to Big Dada, returns after four years, and Mercee is a Zurich singer with Cuban and Italian roots.

355778b2984cc096366e16db09c7793bf8ac66bf.en: Festival Les Créatives 2026 runs from 17 to 29 November in Geneva with feminist concerts, talks, performances and literary events. Highlights include Virginie Despentes's Romancero Queer and concerts by First Aid Kit and Camille.

c40be177bb69ea0512bed944ce529bce8134de0e.en: Mercredi de la petite enfance at EVE Bois-Gourmand introduces toddlers to sounds and stories to tell and sing, to help them develop language. It is led by La Bulle d'Air, part of the Né pour lire programme.

b4fefd06cf75e8c15ff5bc9a3da5a403d62f93ed.en: A guided visit of the exhibition Ferdinand Hodler. Profession de foi by its curator, Niklaus Manuel Güdel, at the International Museum of the Reformation. He shares how to read the show of about fifty works.

779d75e0a47a3e8727895ed9b31a68a955b1107d.en: Rencontres aquatiques at Espace Léman is a playful session on the fish of Lake Geneva, covering their features, lifestyles and role in the aquatic ecosystem, for children and adults.

19516371b178cc62b92ba1d80b3d4e9ead2ab04c.en: Futur[s] at the Théâtre du Grütli is a hybrid performance for ten spectators, mixing live performance and digital art. It immerses the audience in the graphic world of the comic Naturellement by Yannis La Macchia.

d80e924de76c206ab48de0cfdfa1bf49e4774561.en: Le zoom du vivant at the Botanical Garden is a Wednesday workshop for children, showing how scientists use microscopes and other instruments to observe plants at different scales.

6bbaa0f2409a29c12b1d78b88ea819738ded9764.en: Un objet, un son, une histoire at the MEG library presents the story of Vany, who turns seven and makes wishes. After an exhibition object, a story and a museum music piece follow, with booking required.

5e4b0036350ebd8778e1a938b42f34f11f0b4809.en: Balade de quartier aux Pâquis is an evening walk for people aged 14 and over, visiting three addresses where people borrow rather than buy. Stops include a culture bureau, a clothing reuse project and a tool library, followed by an aperitif.

57cbfc5096eec4df22f25452347441923cf1a748.en: The 4th Innovation Debate asks whether AI should be for everyone. Held at Westhive in Grand-Lancy on 18 November, it features four debaters on control, autonomy and the costs of AI's spread.

1058b51bec29923c220118447c300ea48738a23b.en: Fresque du Bonheur Durable et Partagé is a three-hour participatory workshop on sustainable and shared happiness, held in Geneva on 18 November with a shared dinner. It is limited to 12 people.

b680d7d770e0548adae220af8b86e880f965fc2c.en: Lucioles by Luca Rizzo at the Centre culturel du Manoir is an exhibition inspired by village feasts in Puglia. Ceramics, textiles and glass form a procession from the village square to the dinner table, with an opening on 18 November.

e16e4f95caa0d8654a0076b2ee92b7ff7d446382.en: FILMAR round table on violence against LGBTIQ+ people at the Maison des arts du Grütli on 18 November. The panel presents a new BPEV report on violence in Geneva, with speakers from the Geneva LGBT federation and Buenos Aires.

7ca117396578127e9d89e0970a92925b215aff05.en: La Force de la Farce by François Herpeux takes audiences back to June 1977, where a would-be comic plans to send all of Earth's humour into space. The comedian is known for his physical and burlesque style.

4e4c575c3781ff38ae36a52a86947846d4e07783.en: Un futuro brillante at the Villa Tacchini is a Uruguayan dystopian fiction by Lucía Garibaldi. A young woman prepares to be sent to a distant northern zone, where she doubts that anyone who went there has come back.

dae9be049f89eb19a3905eeff661615c98266f11.en: Et pendant ce chaos by Les Troubadours du Chaos at the Chat Noir is an improvised show in which the audience chooses the places and eras of the scenes performed live.

fe6aadb296c289d4a2f5d9fc3a05c47668755b2b.en: Linton and cheapjewels play an alternative rap show at a Geneva venue. Linton, based in Brussels, blends rap with electronic and club sounds. cheapjewels, also from Brussels, performs emotional, raw rap.

ff06cb899e95cdcf5b38621bff5503a9112befba.en: Conseils aux spectateurs is a work-in-progress comedy by Jérôme Rouger at Espace Vélodrome. It is a lecture-style show about the influence audiences have on a theatre performance.

dd1665fe3dc6c9fcb276c97fca1e6b79a9164571.en: Jazz night HEMU: Tribute to James Brown at Le Chaudron is a soul tribute to the godfather of soul, led by Etienne Mbappé, with a band of horns, guitar, bass and drums.

67313062dac4fd1158630b32e61d72b20f7425a4.en: Dessine-moi une histoire at the Fondation Martin Bodmer is an exhibition on illustrated children's books, including titles from the Bodmer family's own nineteenth-century collection. Its title echoes The Little Prince, and the set evokes a forest.

1e649eca411cc7a7baec3787ccf389815a8a6a5f.en: Non-demande ou non-accès? is a morning of research and round-table talks at a Geneva venue on why people who are entitled to care or legal aid do not claim it, in the context of gender-based violence.

398e13d3a4e2d165b36ab94fe632e7083c239a5f.en: Conversion therapies is a talk at the MEG presenting research by the CIC on practices that try to change sexual orientation or gender identity in religious settings in Geneva and Vaud. Booking is required by email.

b1bc2d51d10c13394f1875d3bd5b464e5e817e99.en: La Bibliothèque de Genève à travers le temps is a free guided visit of the library, from its founding in 1559 to today, with an introduction to its collections and history.

ef8504e6ea4e378194778663275a9355b9ef2fcd.en: MEG and FILMAR's evening on Violeta Parra features a talk on her sound archives, a screening of the 2011 film Violeta se fue a los cielos, and a peña. Parra recorded Chilean folk music and gave tapes to the MEG while living in Geneva.

22994dd43f89576060a8149abcdaacf8fc18373c.en: Elie Aufseesser and Boodaman at the Musée d'art et d'histoire present a film premiere, with 45-minute screenings and a live concert. The event celebrates the museum's cinema and music artists in residence.

07ff3faed8d6575ef8f5a16dbee3c94bdda76056.en: A round table and workshop on LGBTIQ+ violence and discrimination in football, with a discussion of women's and men's football and a prevention exercise using the Violentomètre tool.

3773f84ef6fe0fa056764746d2fa474058c53ee3.en: Milonga Brava with Lautaro Cancela and Vida Lisaite takes place on 19 November at the Sécheron neighbourhood space. The workshop covers the waltz, followed by a milonga with open bar.

ef601d2b83c5eec77bdaf7c316267498fd6f0fd9.en: A round table on the mental health of women and gender-diverse artists in nightlife, looking at their working conditions, substance use and harassment. It is recorded live as an episode of the podcast Sous les radars.

ef248feade2ff46877923532ab185b0e500a34cb.en: Ceci est mon corps is a documentary by Jérôme Clément-Wilz about his own childhood abuse and his decision to file a complaint. It is screened at the Bibliothèque de la Cité, followed by a discussion with the director.

31164cd13bfda291f95392faea494630bd6c24bd.en: The 100th anniversary of the Motet choir at the Victoria Hall features Verdi's Nabucco in concert, conducted by Romain Mayor with soloists and the Motet chorus.

0d79d3f9675f1c609ec1b90986f4f044486a9338.en: Radar Créatives: Louisadonna at the Caves de Versoix is a concert by a French pop artist who writes feminist hits. She works as a psychologist for women and children who have suffered violence.

21b88bb5e69a7317a7a5c6573f33c655783d4a2e.en: Océans at the Bâtiment des Forces Motrices is a double bill by the Ballet du Grand Théâtre de Genève. Brise-lames is by Damien Jalet and River Without Banks by Kyle Abraham, and the show runs 1 hour 40 with an interval.

11fa47a757a7a79baa175e6b63552a95c59aa73e.en: Bulles d'automne 2026 at the Grands-Hutins library hosts Dora Formica, author of the comic Certifié humain, about artificial intelligence and creativity. A drawn performance and book signing follow, for ages 16 and over.

c00d6192516f17bcf7a09df9f2f94db82e391bbe.en: An open mic for French-language songs at Le Chaudron, led by Nicolas Hafner and his team. Singers and musicians can perform songs they love or their own compositions, with registration by email before the Saturday before the evening.

bfa8b77193607908bc666ef240055144f5004a1a.en: A training course to become a certified facilitator of the Fresque de la Biodiversité workshop, for use in companies. It requires having already taken part in a workshop, and a workshop is held on 30 October at the Botanical Garden's Amarante restaurant.

b1f2d17863f187e20332c8581d03ba7e9ab07a84.en: A Relax visit of the exhibition Le futur, c'est quoi? at the MEG, with a guide who adapts to visitors' needs. Visitors can react freely, and the visits are free with compulsory registration.

c29f64916ce4a7f171407f12c7dfe32bf5b0c054.en: A Relax screening at the MEG of five short films about the future, part of FILMAR, lasting 48 minutes. The films are in French or have no dialogue, the event is free, and it is open from age 8.

80ea697906d391a97ade7c348ae606972e893ddd.en: An exhibition at the Galerie Aux Portes de la Champagne of engravings, oils and sculptures by Germaine and Robert Hainard, marking 120 years since Robert Hainard's birth. The opening is on 19 November, with drawing and printmaking workshops and a guided visit.

3adc8efea08e5160686610c8ae40534a1751e413.en: A MEG and Les Créatives visit on adultism in museums, held in French around the exhibition Le futur, c'est quoi?. It asks whether power was truly handed to the students who helped create the show, and it is free with limited places.

943b48a10a42aea2c8a19a004684e71f3237ba77.en: A youth evening for people aged 18 to 25 at Impact Hub, to discuss the cantonal vote on free contraception. A debate led by young people, a look at the voting material and pizza are included.

006142e9d8770a93c2b047d6ca38136e1382375f.en: A citizen meeting for people aged 18 to 25 who want to understand the upcoming votes and how to take part in them. Young people from the same age group discuss the issues.

396f6c448821ed8c35c46e816f415e181128ca76.en: A short Nabucco Express concert with the OSR and Romain Mayor, featuring mezzo-soprano Maria José Siri and Le Motet de Genève, at the Victoria Hall. It presents extracts from Verdi's opera in about one hour without an interval.

d98171f4a91f5449529237fd3d78deca24cce50d.en: A round table at the MEG on how adults set boundaries with children without humiliating or controlling them. Speakers include the French artist and author Mai Lan Chapiron and the Swiss actress and director Lola Giouse, part of the Les Créatives weekend.

6381ec7131fb15e8b7b14b548afe70ef394d4859.en: A free evening at the Ludothèque du Petit-Saconnex with a varied selection of board games, with no registration needed. Children from age 7 are welcome, with those under 12 accompanied, and light snacks are provided.

59e0b629cf1bc35fa53cc0fb8c13675d602842b6.en: Célie Pauthe stages Mathieu Belezi's novel C'était notre terre at La Comédie de Genève. Six members of a French colonial family in Algeria tell, in a choral account, the collapse of their world during the Algerian War of Independence.

d3d739bc29db4b79f99b0821b4c0f6d51bde109b.en: This Is The Kit, led by British singer-songwriter Kate Stables, performs at the Salle Grand-Salève. Her work combines folk, organic textures and poetry, and a new album is planned for early 2027.

3bee74535493259c8976ec694bcebffdd714bbb1.en: Eh Vous Là Bas Au Fond is an improvised comedy show by the Cie La Bankize at the Impro Comedy Club in Geneva. Three long stories are built with the help of a volunteer from the audience, and entry is free with a hat passed round at the end.

fa4a07c8d50d7f6c45e63a0d80c1c05c5c8c485e.en: CHRISTA, by Perrine Le Querrec, is a sensory performance that imagines a new world after power struggles and divisions. Its music, sound and objects create a sonic and visual hypnosis, with a cast of five.

158089f41ddeec18a34fae02321b2cb8f7603ca9.en: This Is The Kit appears with Swiss singer and composer Cori Nora, whose second album Pleasure And Focus was recorded live in Porto. Cori Nora's voice is the thread of her music, which moves between calm and tension.

538d0542d28461b6e20462b05d6e377c3baaf356.en: Najat Aâtabou, the Moroccan chaabi singer known as the Diva of Chaabi, performs at the Alhambra on 20 November at 20:30. Seating is numbered, and doors open at 19:30.

6301eb2da1609022eb142294c5c1e76e014ae8cf.en: Noé Tavelli Double Drums Quartet, led by Geneva drummer Noé Tavelli, mixes jazz, Afro-Cuban percussion and electronic sounds. The group includes Eric McPherson on drums, Ohad Talmor on saxophone and Fabien Iannone on double bass, with doors at 20:00.

f8ca4c97e6cc07097353c3274a8ddea94568f58e.en: DJ Toots and guest DJ Akrav play a dancefloor night at the Chat Noir, with afrobeats, shatta, amapiano, hip hop and dancehall. Toots, a Geneva DJ with a background in dancehall, hip hop and funk, often adds surprise guests.

0dd1c54ae0903151fbd0aff5df061fb6bd310cf3.en: A day for trans and non-binary people at the L'ESPACE third place and Spoutnik, held on 21 November from 9:00 to midnight. Workshops, discussions, performances and round tables are offered, with a lunch buffet and an evening meal, and entry is free.

bcf2ab496865b1dcfebdb760713c7ce9448627d0.en: A one-day Fem Do Chi self-defence course for women and girls in Geneva, with a mentoring format where experienced participants support newcomers. It costs CHF 15 and is reserved for residents of the city of Geneva.

0257caca439c47aa9b6ee666e494f8cc4206f2c1.en: FILMARcito Premières lumières is a selection of short films for children from age 4 and their families, presented at the Bibliothèque des Eaux-Vives. The programme is made in collaboration with the Festival FILMAR en América Latina.

b9819e34ed87ff26fee8cacbbda355d7cdb59516.en: The third Garderobes fair on sustainable fashion takes place at the Salle des fêtes de Carouge on 21 and 22 November. It offers sales stands, creative workshops, a repair café, a fashion show, a clothing swap and a talk with experts.

6db5d40e5a4712bbdd737a0375079c04ff794f1b.en: A yoga session at the Musée d'art et d'histoire, led by yoga teacher Sandrine Huber, with an introduction by a cultural mediator. The session lasts 1 hour 30, and booking is by email, with comfortable clothing recommended.

5ebf9a1383b99394a8fc547197e9448c767cf9ff.en: Clédat & Petitpierre's Funny game is a visual theatre piece for children from age 3, in which giant soft dolls play with a huge broken rocking-horse head. A doll-making workshop follows, with 30 places, and a Relax performance is held on 21 November.

1710ebe1c427ffc82fa9618171042ce889698957.en: The Club des Magiciens de Genève, celebrating its 100th anniversary, performs outside the city at La Julienne on 21 November at 14:00 and 20:00. It is an intimate show for audiences aged 8 to 88.

de5e4f51a9f88075943af3dca5c2068f97df2652.en: Initiation and practice of tango "La Ginebrina" at the ADEM Ateliers d'ethnomusicologie in the Maraîchers hall. A práctica is a relaxed space to dance tango, train a step and enjoy social dancing with good music.

c4156d8e28a5a12f41488ec2748abb6be028037b.en: Lectures at the MEG, part of Les Créatives, offer stories for children from age 5 that question gender stereotypes without giving set answers. The readings take place inside the exhibition, in French, and are free with limited places.

cffe3414069eab4d0b6e1cbb00fe45b8bd11fd8b.en: Roshâni, a Geneva electronic pop duo with Persian, Moroccan and Bulgarian roots, plays a kid-friendly show at the MEG as part of Les Créatives. Their first album is due in the autumn, and under-18s enter free.

2d24e30f514944f167f60eef67e5547f2d1f4b70.en: A discussion on democracy and totalitarianism based on the work of Albanian author Ismaïl Kadaré, at the Maison de Rousseau et de la Littérature. Two writers and an institutional speaker take part, and a concert by Elina Duni follows.

0984fbf76a6a0eea1405e45368268afd53cc1054.en: KIDS PARTY: ROSHÂNI is a kid-friendly version of the Roshâni show at the MEG, co-produced with the museum as part of Les Créatives. The duo mixes danceable electronic pop with texts in Farsi, French, English and Spanish.

5b33f0a179935c706ee0a107495df48e82e2db96.en: L'Univers de Tim Burton by Horizons Ensemble is a concert of film music from Burton's films, built on the scores of Danny Elfman. The programme includes Alice in Wonderland, Beetlejuice, Batman and Sweeney Todd, with unique arrangements.

984426d54643fa74450b2a7abf5519c1042539fd.en: The Gewandhausorchester Leipzig, conducted by Andris Nelsons, performs at the Victoria Hall with cellist Gautier Capuçon. The programme includes Dvořák's Cello Concerto and Brahms's First Symphony, about 90 minutes in total.

5151d873246c08a88ae572cde3414e568641f219.en: Camille, from France, plays her only Swiss date at the Alhambra, presenting her album The Sound of Milk. The album is a triptych made of Naissance, Enfance and Adolescence, and the concert is co-produced with Inouïe and Les Créatives.

41c7753d8320b6a11571304002e0fcc2bd58a1f0.en: A concert at Les Salons for the Celtiques festival, with two duos that join as a trio. Violinist Angelika Hansen and harpist Thomas Loefke bring together North Atlantic traditions, and Máire Breatnach brings Irish music.

aff1ab04478a46e41da8c65a3109b066a5bbe9dd.en: Wamen, a Franco-Cameroonian singer named after her grandmother, performs live at the Chat Noir. Her direct, poetic writing tells of broken love stories, and her project RE marks the end of a cycle.

d7ea0552108bf17bcb26ba0e4e0e073cadaa2e33.en: Belén, a 2025 Argentine fiction by Dolores Fonzi, follows a woman who is judged for abortion after a miscarriage at hospital. The story is based on real events, and the film is shown at FILMAR on 21 and 22 November.

ccb51ce3aae5bdb3e7df707785e8525f3f665725.en: Juste Shani, a French rapper who runs her own label, plays at Autre lieu with Nelia Masengu opening. Juste Shani's music mixes trap and introspective writing, while Masengu's music combines French and Lingala with indie soul.

5fcade8a1baf74bf9fe9cb4a722da0a589636ab0.en: Kris Davis trio presents the album Lost in Geneva, by the pianist and composer who has won a Grammy Award. The free jazz trio, with Robert Hurst on bass and Jim Black on drums, is at AMR, with doors at 20:00.

e977e76a2a9fef72cfb5ec3ebdca9dfef8e89921.en: A screening of the documentary Water for Life at the Cinémas du Grütli, part of FILMAR and Climate Week. It follows three Indigenous activists in Honduras, El Salvador and Chile who defend water and land, with a discussion on 20 November.

b557f6817bd29346a1626cacb41883e20a18e703.en: A night of dancehall n'afro rhythms at the Chat Noir, with DJ Tasty playing the sets.

dd99e13e9b961b50e611a635576c6ac7fec5fc30.en: An event at the Ariana museum on 22 November at 11:00 about glass as a material, drawing on the Cirva collections. Entry to the exhibition is paid, and no registration is needed while places last.

2f2130d02128377586cf45ffd8214d24c3669e8e.en: A Ciné-dimanche at the MEG with FILMARcito, showing five free animated short films that look at the future through repetition, dreams and everyday life. The films come from Bolivia, Argentina, Colombia and Chile, and some have no dialogue.

b9433372c44ea75e90b626fa324094f182dd4aa9.en: An antiracist workshop for children aged 6 to 8 at the MEG, built around a selection of children's books. It lasts 45 to 60 minutes, with adults in a parallel activity, and places are very limited.

7aa331633ca9f10f3f1327138d51771317fea1a6.en: A ceramics workshop at the Ariana museum on 22 November at 14:00, inspired by Marie Ducaté's colourful work. Participants make a ring, bracelet or necklace over two hours, for CHF 30, with booking from 12 October.

035929cfd7cd0ecb834730c9b79c8355e1562bda.en: A café for adults only at the MEG, where parents and carers discuss racism and how to talk about it with children. It lasts 60 to 90 minutes, is free with limited places, and is part of Les Créatives.

b032943ad1dbb589c7b9418413bcf5a81614f9d4.en: Seasons returns to La Cité Bleue as a hybrid show by Fabrice Murgia, mixing theatre, cinema and music from Italian baroque to pop, tango and motown.

78e8d74431e6c6f313cb89c7ca6da714fc7a3332.en: Joëlle Sambi's Caillasses Live Solo at the Théâtre du Loup is a 60-minute poetic recital that mixes slam and electronic beats. It is for ages 16 and over, and draws on her book of the same name.

959a36251b4c6f2ab46eb0044958a6f049833aff.en: The High Seas, part of the Celtiques festival at Les Salons, features Caitlín Nic Gabhann on concertina and sean-nós dance. Fiddle, bouzouki and bass play with Donegal music and Gaelic songs.

01e233258ecad9333f7977ee97ff6e919a3abfed.en: The Trout by Schubert, performed by six musicians at the Victoria Hall for ClassiCosy, opens with a warm drink. The concert ends with Schubert's Trout Quintet, and a Parlons musique talk at the Bibliothèque de la Cité comes before it.

044e2e2639c7bf92f7c173800b8e86473aaeb687.en: A self-defence course for people aged 55 and over at Cité Seniors, held as the second part of the Ge Peux course. It is for people who have taken part before, and it excludes cisgender men.

c9e03f769509e7e0b0cc80255083c97298df440e.en: A lunchtime debate during Climate Week, run by Ethos and The Positive Project, on whether nature should have a voice in company governance. Short talks are followed by a role-play of a board of directors.

f1790cb7905e02fadbcc120326a0c131d1c5e721.en: A round table on 23 November at Autre lieu, organised by Ellemploi of the Réseau femmes*. It covers including women in male-dominated jobs, tackling harassment and recognising women's skills.

3c4a96d2295ec4cc403b26cc48714b348f046eef.en: Les Clés de l'Avenir honours local projects that reduce waste and support the circular economy, in five categories. The awards open Climate Week at the Maison de l'Avenir on 23 November, with a ceremony, drinks and a resources corner.

d8c38e94671ee62418e54be90f4c5d0db44ef327.en: A PréPro evening at Le Chaudron with the artists Paloma-Lou and LOU, who present personal projects by students of the eMa's PréPro course. An external expert, Eric Anderson, takes part.

1cff2b8915b5ec0ec7b8673c16007f483318ca79.en: Lab'Industrie is a day at the Collège Jacques Prévert in Saint-Genis-Pouilly that introduces 4th-grade pupils to industry careers through playful activities. The Mission Locale OBG runs one of the stands.

f49f63a3869e9b1d3cc72d4b874148b0aa0752a1.en: A design fiction discussion at the MEG, part of Le futur, c'est quoi?, on how to imagine and test futures that do not yet exist. Urbanist Matthias Lecoq and researcher Fabien Girardin join the talk.

5d20412dceb3301f9b4e3bb12531cafbe559988d.en: The awards ceremony for the 5th International Competition for Artists from Minorities, on the theme War and Reconciliation, is held at Ecolint's Centre des arts on 24 November. Nine laureates present their works, alongside an exhibition.

7b563bed825ffb7e06cfa7726ff411676abdf17a.en: Grand Conseil is an immersive show at the Théâtre du Grütli in which the audience becomes members of parliament for an evening. Without speaking, the public votes and can influence the debate.

2faafc7f9889612e6d19bac225969b151f674e47.en: Radio Live – La Relève at La Comédie de Genève brings young people from Bosnia, Syria, Ukraine, Rwanda, India and France onto stage. Live sound and images explore memory and identity, drawn from a radio series.

32ffe97e12e83bd246fcb7f99758099028857d70.en: The ice rink at the Parc des Bastions runs from 24 November 2026 to 21 February 2027, in one of Geneva's most beautiful parks.

ee17208d770ce450dfc61bd3c04312c828dd360b.en: A show for toddlers at the Salle Grand-Salève, part of Mercredi de la petite enfance. Two OCG musicians on violin and cello mix classical music with nursery rhymes in a miniature theatre set.

0b8230c8bd5c425838a282c17e8dd66301d6894b.en: A self-defence workshop in Spanish, run by Aspasie for sex workers only, marking the International Day for the Elimination of Sexist and Sexual Violence. It mixes a short theory part with practice, and registration is by email.

cb94e7568ba788d92f41788a461e98a3962fe76a.en: A free workshop at La Julienne for unaccompanied children aged 8 and over, making Christmas decorations from old books, wooden balls and upcycled fabrics. Registration opens 30 days before the workshop.

dbbc189a6f7b626e8e86e3be9e70fea0a4fff745.en: A children's workshop at the Espace Eaux-Vives on 25 November at 14:30, making bath salts for the Escalade festival. It costs CHF 28, is for children aged 6 to 12, and has limited places.

9f03305560f6fcbb3b4ca009c6a499e4d53c487a.en: The Inner Wheel Club Genève, as part of Orange Days, screens Paola Cortellesi's film C'è ancora domani on 25 November at 18:30. A photo exhibition, Postale/Verso, is shown alongside it.

cb812f12eb901c2d9417273fac7545e831bf3652.en: A talk by the progressive jurists' association and F-information on how family law reforms in Geneva and Switzerland can serve feminist causes. It is aimed at the general public, and an aperitif follows.

749ca10185710ba7493836f83ab4ec2838aef0d8.en: Rituelles, by cie C2C, is a participatory performance held on 8 March, 14 June and 25 November at Marché Helvétique. Each date explores a bodily material and invites a collective gesture of feminist mobilisation.

6b74870117ab1f1c94efd7d948499bf2577a8e47.en: Sometimes I Imagine Them All at a Party is a documentary at Cinelux by Daniela Magnani Hüller, who survived an attempted femicide by a classmate. It combines conversations with people around the case and is followed by a discussion.

3e008f5f93dcf2dcc20ff0aac37759496f91dc19.en: The 34th Réveil des archives sonores pairs the MEG with Bongo Joe for a 90-minute set by Lucas Monème. The selection comes from the Marco Botta collection of about 5,000 vinyl LPs, mostly from the 1960s and 1970s.

3021344852714b55c0e08e3fbdd96cc4886acbf8.en: Orélie Fuchs stages La misère du monde at Saint-Gervais, adapting Bourdieu's text with four performers. Chairs and wooden structures change on stage, reshaped live with artist Tan Chen.

f403862f5229b4a973be80278e924b5ee5c991b5.en: Et si on changeait d'histoire? at the Maison de l'Avenir looks at how new stories can encourage action on climate. The evening screens the short film La voix de l'orchidée, followed by a panel, and registration is required.

abc7506f89d6e7b06eceae2cf61aed03dd7bb85b.en: The opening evening of the Palestine film festival, with the MEG, shows Conversation with the Sea by Muayad Alayan. A short film by Fairouz Hasan, made with Dar-Al Kalima University in Bethlehem, has its preview.

95e071e3cee6ae9203f6511e02d124684db28d6b.en: HEXES is a public performance at the Promenade de la Treille, with a choir of 40 women giving voice to Eléonore Mercier's texts on violence. It asks for an end to the order that excuses abusers and silences victims.

af65b0af3ddeb7c7543e42f92f515329224701ae.en: Daniele Gatti conducts Beethoven's Symphonies No. 2 and No. 3 Eroica at the Victoria Hall. It is the second concert of a Beethoven cycle marking 200 years since his death, spread over two seasons.

9fafd365d86c6aa17a558615a8b24e8057c7efa8.en: À l'écart at the Théâtre du Grütli is a metaphysical and poetic inquiry, inspired by a real case in the forests of Maine. It follows a man who lived apart from the world for 30 years.

e95bd82d2ffecf68171472d8347c479087880263.en: Dopamine at the Théâtre le douze dix-huit is an interactive musical show about the brain's reward circuit. It is a theatrical lecture with music, similar to Inside Out, for adults.

e347d8050300c4d3cbb6f9f1e91bd6a46bf0c70c.en: Donne ton slam au Chat is a monthly slam night at the Chat Noir. Poets read themed verses first, then open-theme pieces of up to three minutes with no music or props.

6be2d188a61be003e2b8c35dff994742446e3d65.en: Viriles by Cie Kynlaus at the Salle des Fêtes de Lignon follows five men who question the ideal of masculinity. Five women dancers portray them, and the show is staged on 25 November, the International Day against violence.

14a6da9825ce618a59bce854f41031090a247acf.en: DIVA Syndicat, by Mise à Feu at Espace Vélodrome, is a musical theatre show tracing 1,000 years of women in music, from Hildegard of Bingen to Aya Nakamura. Gentiane Pierre and Noémie Lamour play it with humour.

3ec34856fca29ea7ee37dcb38f028192ed8036a7.en: Zeppelin Bend, a 50-minute duo by Katerina Andreou and Natali Mandila at the Pavillon de la danse, built on physical effort and the states it creates. A RELAX performance is on 26 November, and a body workshop follows on 28 November.

26fdb2349d2ea1d50a7145d3f6910c2ae8ed733f.en: Flore Benguigui and The Sensible Notes at Autre lieu bring jazz that mixes 1930s sounds with 1970s analogue synthesizers. Swiss singer Lea Maria Fries also performs, and the event is presented with Concorde.

6e0297a9389afd9626946b300a2b917b1427c302.en: A jazz night at Le Chaudron led by Matthieu Llodra, with Maxence Sibille, Ivan Rougny and Manu Gesseney. A concert and a jam mix jazz, funk, electro and contemporary sounds, and audience members are invited on stage.

f6b38fca6644302b6bca909b74548330db266852.en: Nathalie Froehlich presents her first album, Et la fin sera belle, at L'Usine PTR as part of Les Créatives, with dancers. LUM, a queer Swiss artist who mixes rap, pop and reggaeton, also performs.

ac6a8f8fb3f5965b3af8728ee3aae65e00dca08e.en: Wound Up-to-Date 2026 at HEdS Geneva is a day on the future of wound care, covering diagnosis, AI, care from hospital to home and patient partnership. Registration is compulsory, and a lunch buffet is included.

07633cca9503fd480e92346d05b240946619687b.en: A writing workshop at the Maison des arts du Grütli, for the University of Geneva community, led by director and dramatist Nalini Menamkat. It explores how social violence can become theatre, and no personal experience is required.

e27dad18b19a5b5f4469b3aaff2e09023d79817f.en: A 90-minute masterclass by Leïla Olivesi at the Auditorium Ansermet, open to the public, with a talk on her compositions and their place in jazz history. Fifteen minutes of questions follow, before her concert.

2860188b0382fc34ab09ceedd9f0787d38700d1a.en: La Brisolée at La Julienne offers chestnuts, soup, a light installation, electro music and juggling, with free entry and no booking. The Widefield Series exhibition opens the same evening and runs until 19 December 2026.

d72acb98e2d6c7443e0f004b76a985334a5af527.en: A science café at the MEG where Claire Galloni d'Istria of the University of Geneva discusses living in a changing mountain, using historic photos and traditional objects. Places are limited, and registration is required by email.

6485e0b39ab75beee582ffc7d7938073c7ecf6a9.en: The 2026 Prix Töpffer comics awards at the Cube, HEAD campus, honour young and established artists. Anna Sommer, Grand Prix Töpffer 2026, meets the public, and the evening has free entry with drinks and a buffet.

02588bfb1c33351c4c35409b09718ac853a2d5a2.en: A Milonga Brava evening at the Sécheron neighbourhood space on 26 November, with a workshop from 18:45 by Nadia Aguilar and Erik Deslarmes. A milonga with open bar follows from 20:00, with entry at CHF 15.

afed52fa28c391f6cf70d153ac0c22d47b85c4d0.en: A concert at the MAH celebrating the 100th birthday of composer György Kurtág, performed by students of HEM Geneva with soloists from Ensemble Contrechamps. University of Geneva musicology students also take part.

80fe00453bcb5a00e3b54415d6b8578846d9de90.en: Philippe Lüscher reads Robert Walser at the Bibliothèque de Carouge, with twenty-five short prose pieces written between 1899 and 1920. Walser, admired by Kafka and Benjamin, died on a solitary walk in the snow on Christmas Day 1956.

a22b6533e33298d6e3ab1d2a52fb80bd5ddfc83a.en: The Peace Philharmonic, conducted by Nikolay Khozyainov at the Salle Franz Liszt, plays Beethoven's Coriolan and Egmont overtures and his Fifth Symphony. Oboist Varvara Petrova is the soloist in Strauss's Oboe Concerto, the orchestra's last concert of 2026.

46ab301e12d02228861e957c1d8fa32afe696cdd.en: Kneecap, a Belfast trio, mixes Irish-language rap with heavy bass and rave energy at the Alhambra on the FENIAN Tour. Doors open at 18:30 and the concert starts at 19:30.

b5461506685ff9bf7b06f7f56ada28c3d71e8ad7.en: Julie Campiche's solo show at Le Groove celebrates women through harp, electronics and voice, drawing on Virginia Woolf's line that anonymous was a woman. It has moved to 26 November 2026, with doors at 20:00.

7b2f78b83cfc472c0d497e2492a4f378d1ff0711.en: FRITEUSE by Jeanne Spaeter at Autre lieu, part of Les Créatives, follows the Bernese artist as she moves to Brussels and follows a protocol that leads her to sell fries. The piece asks whether identity can be deconstructed and rebuilt.

b1858d2e519e6aed4239dc01e778b5782f710f4e.en: Friteuse at the Villa Tacchini is an immersive performance of about 1 hour 30, made with Les Créatives, based on Jeanne Spaeter's six-month change of identity in a Brussels friterie. The audience moves through a living archive of stories, sounds and objects.

399e5ba136b80d582c394c9f15e04083604420a5.en: YULE, part of the Celtiques festival at Les Salons, brings four celtic voices from Brittany, Scotland, Ireland and Galicia. Pascal Chardome and Didier Laloy direct the show, with Joanne McIver, Liam Ó Maonlaí and others.

75b0fe289fddb917205d8b71cb1aa08fc1bd0028.en: Corps Ô Plurielles at La Comédie de Genève is a participatory dance performance by Germaine Sikota and Caroline de Cornière. It closes a cycle of four workshops held from 18 to 24 November, building a shared story of many bodies.

6340b142cd7e30d584fafc980f1f5339dd13e04f.en: Espèces menacées at the Théâtre des Grottes is a comedy in which an accountant swaps his briefcase on the RER and finds millions. He plans a new life in Buenos Aires, but his wife, friends, a policeman and a hitman get in the way.

f1e19b162b9c96cee29f77b12f0d9cff97e777c5.en: Luca Leone at the Salle du Manège is a show that mixes music and theatre, taking the audience to Rome for a night. It revisits statues and myths, with three musicians and a blend of poetry, absurdity and humour.

87cf102f829ef65a59b57f6dacd9261ca84282b5.en: The HEMU Jazz Orchestra, conducted by Leïla Olivesi, Jean-François Baud and Thomas Dobler, performs at the Auditorium Ansermet. The students play Olivesi's compositions, including music from her album African Rhapsody.

67c46d0f6e2f302af110c6bd9fc8eb117786228a.en: An open mic for hip-hop at Le Chaudron, led by Stan Breynaert and Maxence Sibille. An MC, beatbox, dance and live music meet around freestyle and improvisation, with all styles of hip-hop welcome.

f354f8ff6b9aa4b55591e029d7b635fd6f82294c.en: The Widefield Series exhibition at La Julienne shows screen prints acquired in 2025 by the art fund of Plan-les-Ouates from ten artists linked to Widefield. The Geneva platform, founded in 2016, publishes artists' editions.

d8068fda85a25115644ef709c3b4f16222ba8347.en: Rencontre instrumentale #11 at the MEG, with ADEM, has Trio Eris introduce the music of Upper Brittany, the fest-noz, the biniou and the bombarde. It comes before the group's concert at the AMR at 21:00, and places are limited to 25.

a0533884a7d4b9ea8039566142b0ba3c54b526ec.en: A Wool and Wine workshop at the Maison de l'Avenir on 27 November, where participants make Christmas baubles from local Geneva sheep wool. An aperitif is offered afterwards.

dcdacde55945d05137fe1b0f5ac48e11cc421d32.en: A Festival Celtiques course in Shetland fiddle with Maurice Henderson, held at ADEM Montbrillant. Participants learn reels and jigs, and the course is aimed mainly at string players.

93a2e38ca7bd72752a902dcb89a52f3d29ff3ce4.en: Dambé: The Mali Project is a 2008 Irish documentary by Dearbhla Glynn, screened at Cinélux in the presence of Liam Ó Maonlaí. It follows Irish musicians across Mali, where Irish and Malian music meet.

3a9c7242b23074f8c35da333926a01c81bc448a9.en: A card magic workshop at the Lancy municipal library, run by the Centre de Magie de la Côte. Families learn tricks to repeat at home, and it is free from age 7 with booking by phone, with an adult present.

f5b398d4eaeacc65222e58cc3ee286032ee7930b.en: A round table at the Palais Eynard on gender, sex and borders in sport and chess, covering gender tests ahead of the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. Anaïs Bohuon, Yosha Iglesias and Anne Schmitt take part, moderated by Emma Thibert.

edd4b240c7d0f0d14e65ced3a73287a178db0b6b.en: Maman Sort Danser is an early clubbing night at the Cercle des Bains, from 20:00, for women who want to dance without waiting for clubs to open at midnight. It offers a DJ set and cocktails, with tickets sold online.

f51d78fd84a013f11f00fd90ab979023ddcb5115.en: Piazzolla's María de Buenos Aires at La Cité Bleue is a tango work with bold harmonies, sharp rhythms and raw lyricism. Bandoneon, strings and voice play in constant tension, and the work recalls the barrios of Buenos Aires.

9164fce0e7d3b0920467276e4acd4b5157635672.en: Deux pianos pour trois pianistes at the Conservatoire stages three pianists who stay on stage throughout. The OXY MORE duo plays with Denis Kozhukhin, winner of the 2010 Queen Elisabeth Competition's first prize.

68141324215d23f0ec69324c07f2af33c57feb40.en: Aunty Rayzor, a rapper and singer from Lagos, performs with DJ Blue Mush at Autre lieu. Her 2023 album Viral Wreckage was praised by critics, and Blue Mush plays open-format sets, moving between many genres.

ff29372bc6b2d009510d85418969303b89ead388.en: Jolagreen23 performs at the Alhambra with the album 23 Jours Plus Tard, a 23-track record in two parts. Doors open at 19:00 and the concert starts at 20:00, with children under 16 accompanied by an adult.

1e018c3a57e311dcb69a76c6d345c94568fc899a.en: The 2026-2027 game nights at the Ludothèque 1-2-3 Planète offer five evenings for teenagers and adults aged 16 and over. Librarians introduce new and classic games, and players of all levels are welcome.

71a99e744cbe09eafd29748d57adc3b9c6fbc48d.en: Vendredi de l'Ethno: Trio Eris, a Rennes trio, plays Upper Brittany music drawn from the fest-noz, with diatonic accordion, saxophones and modern sounds. It is organised by ADEM and the AMR as part of the Celtiques festival, with doors at 20:00.

aa786f95e92c02430b97dd49ec5b2694c5b8c59c.en: A round table on cyberviolence at the Maison des associations socio-politiques, part of the Geneva 25 November campaign. It presents a digital self-protection guide with Pauline Ferrari, Ela Bulen Öztürk and Carolina Gonzalez.

b7936d88aac5305512e8fb8955ec5ac527257cec.en: The legend of the Wandering Jew is a stage show at the International Museum of the Reformation, based on Gustave Doré's 1856 engravings and Pierre Dupont's poem. Lydia Weyrich sings, with cello, harp and classical and Jewish music.

79f23a64ca7a2a7482453ad562b6448f8380b8cb.en: Grace Cummings presents Bloodhorse, her fourth album, recorded in Topanga Canyon with producer Jonathan Wilson. Her songs explore life, death, free will and self-discovery, with synthesizers, strings and hypnotic grooves.

92c3f68b7b84fcda40c6b2fdf451ff5b744df018.en: Two tango introduction evenings at La Cité Bleue extend María de Buenos Aires. Claire Rüfenacht and Pedro Ratto lead the first on Friday 27 November, and Marthe Krummenacher and Adrian Ciancio lead the second on Sunday 29 November.

732b1cac6e05e3f0f5b2bf132c9809b8d8e25f06.en: A Fem Do Chi self-defence course for adults aged 16 and over, run as part of the Ge Peux project. It is a one-day course at a symbolic price of CHF 15, reserved for residents of the city of Geneva.

ad6c42270c90268ced945c88aeadf26506f00970.en: Cosmos de lumière at the Ariana museum starts with a visit to the glass exhibition, then children build a luminous cosmos from transparent plastic balls. It lasts 1 hour, is for children over two, and registration opens on 9 November.

f4ea4cfad2e3bdad87e23ea1d68d4ecc22a79382.en: A Repair Café run by FRC Genève at the Plainpalais neighbourhood space, where volunteer technicians help people fix household appliances, electronics and toys. It is free, open to all and needs no registration, though spare parts are not included.

2d93381b032e4820f68afe61214d806d3b48f0ea.en: KESKONFABRIK #3 at La MACO is a day of creative and craft activities on making and upcycling. Textiles, wood and electronics are among the materials, and the event is open to everyone.

c75896e97492da7b9cdc9f0cf5d2e09c8bd069a7.en: A Photolangage workshop at the CTAS offices in Carouge on 28 November 2026 from 10:00 to 12:00. Groups of up to eight people use photographs to encourage exchange, and registration is required by 7 November.

c54e43afdfad9b67c8aadd6fb0247fbb592049ba.en: A Fem Do Chi self-defence course for teenagers at HEPIA, held over two days in groups of 8 to 14. It takes place in a confidential, non-judgemental setting and excludes cisgender men.

97b84c45d94d8a7b6ef130b961bdfe62ca2786e2.en: KRYSTAL is a roleplaying introduction at the Bibliothèque de la Servette, run with La Horde. Players are Heralds travelling a Europe ravaged by a mysterious plague, with sessions for ages 9 and over in the morning and 13 and over in the afternoon.

a5d3f0bfa5638d61cb229f037b1bc9b4f68c552e.en: NAINS ET JARDINS is a roleplaying introduction at the Bibliothèque de la Servette, run with La Horde. Players are garden gnomes who resist the Menace and its grey magic, which spreads city pollution.

e437273174cfd78b90e0dbce9075be449c536863.en: Illustrator and author Christine Flament presents three illustrated books about birds at the Bibliothèque des Eaux-Vives. Participants then make a watercolour leporello, an accordion book on birds, insects, butterflies and plants.

5b22dc54c1df7bda0f8b005af9d4ea666cec28f6.en: LOUP-GAROU L'APOCALYPSE is a roleplaying introduction at the Bibliothèque de la Servette, for ages 16 and over. Players are werewolves protecting Gaia against the agents of the Worm, run with La Horde.

8befdc805b97c3fc5cda0f9006f28b27e72e3c7b.en: Visite flash: Futur ancestral is a short visit at the MEG that imagines a future behind us, where the past shows what has already been lived. Contemporary works and visitors' own reflections shape the futures imagined.

87eb4f6a8472f54f543658b9e98e28ebec531b1e.en: A Shetland dance workshop with Maurice Henderson and Martha Thomson, from 14:00 to 16:30 in Vernier, with no prior training needed. Musicians from Haltadans accompany it, and a Shetland session takes place at the Pickwick pub on Saturday evening.

c63403f367c0c9bc13233c9aeaeee6ff1bd485c9.en: Planet C-Play Again is a game for 5 to 20 participants who steer the development of a shared territory. A facilitator then helps players identify the barriers they faced and the strategies that lifted them.

63de98f2ab50de8c99ccd351cec1e66ed7fde9be.en: A participatory walk through the Beaux-Arts collection of the MAH, led by feminist author Eva Kirilof, on the painters Louise Breslau and others. It is part of the 22nd edition of the Les Créatives festival.

93c7c1467d08f7bc6a639280a07b159698b1c4a3.en: Natacha Farquet meets children aged 7 and over at the Bibliothèque de Carouge, presenting her novels, including Graine de secouriste, and teaching first-aid gestures. A book signing follows the workshop.

0bdf4a1ef33fed03989e8e89525f31be968804da.en: Ce fut en 1602 is a one-hour storytelling session at the Maison Tavel about the night the Savoyards tried to enter Geneva in 1602. It is for children aged 6 and over, accompanied by an adult.

2ec94af3256f028433b5613122480f3edb6130a5.en: Des histoires dans ta langue offers storytelling and activities in Arabic and Spanish for children aged 0 to 5, with the association Mes Bottes de 7 Lieues. Families come and go freely from 16:00 to 17:30, and they can borrow books in their language.

bee8eeea6dcfca617a4de532feb7a1a789536d14.en: A series of talks at La Cité Bleue on Jorge Luis Borges, his link to Geneva, his books, the Martin Bodmer collection and the role of music in his work. Bertrand Lévy, Nicolas Ducimetière and Leonardo García-Alarcón take part.

8c87b01fa29f4291db9028adc98ed1eef6695505.en: Concertissimo at the Victoria Hall, a joué-dirigé concert with the OCG and the Fondation Géza-Anda. Three young pianists play Mozart's concertos K. 488 and K. 491 and Beethoven's Second, each leading the orchestra from the keyboard.

c7df260c6eb28ad4c3f4f6a16edb84b422e3de29.en: Black Lights by Mathilde Monnier at Autre lieu adapts nine true stories from H24, a series of 24 episodes written by 24 women about everyday violence. Dance and the body carry the words, with humour and anger in the mix.

5195893614c6883028d9de30f2529281d41fdaf5.en: Les Élémens at the Salle Franz Liszt presents orchestral suites by Rebel, Bach and Rameau, from chaos to balance. Students of the HEM's ancient music department play under the direction of Francesco Corti.

31a17fbfa77ad0bdf18f76deae4bb68a4951f825.en: Haltadans at the Pickwick pub gives a Scottish-style session, starting with a concert and then an open dance where no level is needed. A beginners' workshop with the musicians takes place just before, and the music draws on Shetland fiddle tradition.

daecaa80c065815ec83cf7eb2cfabff1aafd6f83.en: The LusoSonic Festival at the Alhambra features Brazilian singer Chico Chico, who presents Let It Burn, a mix of blues, folk, Brazilian rhythms and gospel. Portuguese pop singer Bárbara Tinoco opens the evening, with doors at 19:30.

91402b4b6d8791e7bfd40c83feb2cd202361fc75.en: Un grand cri d'amour by Josiane Balasko at La Julienne is a comedy about two actors who once succeeded together and then split badly. Forced to work together again, their old rivalries resurface and blur the line between rehearsal and real life.
