5b9071d4fbe3ca32c5a097086991668c789352da.en: LATE NIGHT returns to the Bâtiment des Forces Motrices in 2026, co-produced with the Grand Théâtre de Genève. DJ sets, live acts and visual performances imagine more desirable futures, with Tatyana Jane and deBasement among the artists.

8d912fa8c2c850b016c6b424c159e9e02dc1ffa8.en: Natalia Doco, an Argentine singer, presents her new album Hacha at Autre lieu. Her music mixes Indigenous heritage, spirituality and urban pop, with themes of emancipation and female power.

5ca8fd54647736a41c09de6d84742d3e1696f1be.en: Anna Webber's Simple Trio at the AMR plays collective improvisation with John Hollenbeck and Matt Mitchell. The concert celebrates ten years of collaboration, with the album simpletrio2000, and doors open at 20:00.

7153800febfd1a93338f6585e15e8e38434ef2a6.en: DJ Scalpa brings a hip hop, R&B and soul set to the Chat Noir, aiming to set the dancefloor alight. The Geneva DJ is known for getting crowds dancing.

3efdf71db12e0e9fd82f119df48358670501720f.en: Vernier Ludique, now in its 5th edition, is a free day of board games on 28 November 2026 at the Salle des fêtes Avanchet-Salève. Librarians present favourite games, with a family morning, afternoon sessions and an evening games night until midnight.

76ab843eb1949cef6d62db7829be444786d30fa5.en: A morning screening of the film WOMAN by Anastasia Mikova and Jann Arthus-Bertrand at the Cinéma Empire on 29 November at 10:00. The film gives voice to 2,000 women in 50 countries, and a discussion follows.

23db3952fa7cba4967005b1a277fcd7489d8e513.en: An immersive family workshop at the Bois de la Bâtie, where parents and children aged 7 to 12 co-create a temporary artwork about their link to living things. The meeting point is sent to registered families a few days before.

2b38e465b9373742de8e2de04d738d2385d2b8be.en: Griff et les Fabuloptères is a show for children aged 3 and over at the Salle du Manège. A singing cat named Griff discovers a world of tiny insects beneath the tall grass.

fb2c8a9f273f7fe7b63dcec34ec3a16f89120ee9.en: A chamber music concert at the Conservatoire on a Sunday at 11:00, performed by OSR musicians. The programme is devoted to French composer Rita Strohl, with her string quartet and her Grande Fantaisie for piano quintet.

b889591d5a28ded466a39cfe36159deb5a613dc7.en: Carte blanche to the Centre Culturel Afropea at the MEG. Mawena Yehouessi gives a talk in French at 14:00 inside the temporary exhibition, and Daniela Nofal gives an English talk on arab-futurisms at 16:00.

12d43c33c66ae42218b908bf217d0ba36160ebef.en: MEG x CCAfropea: Afrofuturisme aujourd'hui? is a talk by curator Mawena Yehouessi on afrofuturism. It traces the idea from Def Jef's 1989 song to Mark Derry's term, and draws on her collaborative works Sol in the Dark and Black Afterlight.

a1dfd276580cc3b49bb22695e6a902ebb1f53c48.en: Drôles d'oiseaux at the Bibliothèque de la Cité is a storytelling show by Patrick Mohr about birds, from hummingbird to ostrich. Words, calls and flutes bring the animals to life, as part of a research project by Théâtre Spirale.

ba5fd95f63f762bf6caaa775022fbf3baee63d6f.en: Bravo les Goudoux is a bingo game at the MAH, built from the lesboqueer archives of Lestime and from the life of Louise Breslau. Jeanne Graf and Cassandre Poirier-Simon lead it, as part of the 22nd Les Créatives festival.

c9b2a2d868007832a87b93594b7bb5d3a8dfe230.en: MEG x CCAfropea: Une question de temps is an English-language session by Daniela Nofal on arab-futurism and how artists from the SWANA region challenge linear time. Three films mix memory, history and speculation.

d6d55b806393ab3fa985e22585f91721d8aabe4f.en: Gli Angeli Genève, directed from the double bass by Stephan MacLeod, plays Bach's Brandenburg Concertos and overtures at the Victoria Hall. The programme also includes the cantata Ich habe genug.

086ec3d7c000013546e0ae565e17c244e0e666a1.en: Casse-Noisette at Autre lieu is a children's telling of Tchaikovsky's ballet, based on Hoffmann's tale. On Christmas Eve, Clara and Fritz receive a nutcracker soldier who turns into a prince, with a piano duet and narration.

9b2679e57507ff0edc5f14b07d3ef895ce538eb7.en: The closing ceremony of the Geneva 25 November campaign is a lantern tribute to victims of femicide, held at the Plainpalais cemetery. It is open to all, and Soroptimist and Zonta clubs take part with partner associations.

75d7380d7635cde20a4d683c065636fb2ebbbd1b.en: First Aid Kit, the Swedish sisters Klara and Johanna Söderberg, play the Alhambra on a stripped-back tour called Visions of the Past. The show revisits songs from Drunken Trees to Palomino, with doors at 18:00 and the concert at 19:00.

5068eedcfc6154f1953f3810eb9368d080bf74d3.en: Bizet's Carmen at the Victoria Hall is performed by the Orchestre Concertus, Ensemble Vocal Orphée and a children's choir, conducted by Matthieu Schweyer. Nora Sourouzian sings Carmen and Louis Zaitoun sings Don José.

2048cfb8fa9faf3cd0fe7050db38f4eb2232ba35.en: A PréPro evening at Le Chaudron presents personal projects by students of the eMa's PréPro course, including Yohann and Léon. The work is shown to an audience and to an external expert, Eric Anderson.

6f2b8d7983b3d0c65ec43f73a73a6ecb76803a2a.en: Alliances vivantes with philosopher Dominique Bourg at Autre lieu asks how to design places and materials where living things have a place. Sociologists, builders and designers join him for a discussion on habitability.

ca8c3a0f5734efbc0fb79ad629d029ad684d4db7.en: Isabella di Lenardo of EPFL shows how AI and prompting turn heterogeneous sources into spatio-temporal datasets, at the Bibliothèque de Genève. The talk is free, starts at 16:15 and lasts one hour, followed by discussion.

396e08ebf85ce05797b2406d7908ff2a1d2396fc.en: Mode durable at L'ESPACE covers the life of clothes, from fibre to second-hand and upcycling. Stalls, demonstrations, a round table and a second-hand fashion show run alongside talks, and registration is free.

bc13a64fbaa34797e2f1106ff5de3c18d6f292b1.en: A stand-up evening on humour and sustainability at the Maison de l'Avenir, where four comedians tackle ecological crisis and social injustice with irony. Doors and a welcome drink are at 18:00, and the show starts at 18:30.

bf8bc16241c1be790c0941436aca6b6fec35fde3.en: The Ferdinand Hodler exhibition at the MIR runs from 25 September 2026 to 24 January 2027. This evening pairs Schoenberg's Verklärte Nacht with a new work by Dzovinar Mikirditsian, and guided visits at 18:00 need booking.

4012898eb6e5cfe51ccb2dcd2edb64586a829b23.en: Les Clairvoyantes by Compagnie Yvonne III is an immersive mix of theatre, magic and mentalism at the Salle communale du Petit-Lancy. Card readings and illusions invite the audience to take part, and the show runs 1 hour 15.

f9df371e7b846831aa67ccef943cb9ff4906079e.en: A family cooking challenge at the Eaux-Vives neighbourhood space, where families bring a simple seasonal dish to make a shared buffet. It is for ages 2 to 5, costs CHF 5 per child, runs in the morning in December, and has limited places.

1f4b5987a7c75fde4aa654f571a62fdde4786b0d.en: Les graines du passé at the Botanical Garden looks at how seed banks cope with climate change, and whether stored seeds can still survive in nature. Scientist Andreas Ensslin presents the research, as part of Climate Week.

848263f3ed4be9f84a7bdac174dc24996830cd62.en: A Choco-folie cooking workshop for children aged 6 to 12 makes chocolate parcels with a small handmade surprise inside. It runs from 14:45 to 16:15 in December, costs CHF 10 with tasting, and has limited places.

12d65f906b106e528e95879c289cb4ada29dbcbd.en: Urban Climate Circles at the Maison de l'Avenir is a free evening where about 10 people mix art, science and action. Participants develop a climate idea alone and then in groups, with an aperitif in the middle, and no prior experience is needed.

e1d41016a63720cb68c18524a1317e097bc3e79e.en: Hayato Sumino plays piano at the Victoria Hall, with Chopin's Scherzo No. 1, Sonata No. 2 and several études. The programme also includes Saint-Saëns's Danse macabre, Stravinsky's Firebird extracts and Sumino's own works.

62bc901d6b3328aa2416dae79ae7d0e59425c7bc.en: Julien Lieb presents his first album, Naufragé, at the Alhambra on 2 December 2026, a concert that is unique in Switzerland. He won the NRJ Music Awards 2025 for best francophone male revelation, and doors open at 19:00.

cc7799887919bf84d992794f7698e6781305da3c.en: A financing bootcamp at STATION A on Thursday 3 December, organised with La French Tech and the Village by CA des Savoie. Round tables cover funding at creation, seed and acceleration, followed by one-to-one meetings with funders.

ca7f4933a90655cc1ef6e11130dd8c1b7549c811.en: A round table at Uni Mail on 3 December from 12:30 to 14:00, linked to the exhibition Entrez en matière about sustainable cities. Speakers include Aristide Athanassiadis, Cyril Royez and Marlène Leroux, with the City of Geneva.

51719749076bfbcbcac3d0d294aacd81eafe63d1.en: A Mission Genève Durable workshop in the Charmilles neighbourhood, based on Kate Raworth's doughnut economy. Teams play a board game, then walk through the neighbourhood to the Parc des Franchises, and the event is free with limited places.

db7a5acd101f955ecd59dfe93076e633e5ec449a.en: A talk at the MAH on the Beta 21 quartz movement, developed from 1962 by Swiss watch industry partners. Archivist and historian Amandine Cabrio looks at how the watch kept at the museum shows the sector's response to technological change.

510ac89a70ffabfe97ad23abd46f165e8686f1a5.en: IA: puissance ou prudence? at the Maison de l'Avenir is an Oxford-style debate on AI, judged by a panel of political leaders. Specialists prepare two teams before the debate, and a wrap-up and aperitif follow.

1ecca08afa87950adc85928b8f971f2ef393f392.en: Dans tous les sens at the MAH is a sensory visit for deaf and hard-of-hearing visitors, led by cultural mediator Julie Abbou-Brendel. Visitors touch, smell and taste elements of the collection, from pigments to Impressionist paintings.

4604e25178e8eb2e1502d65261f64edc39a032aa.en: A lecture by historian Patrice Delpin at the MIR on events outside Geneva's walls during the Escalade. He also presents a 19th victim of the Savoyard attack, ahead of the 425th anniversary of the Escalade.

9902c22e89fd027eff2c749c282625194066476e.en: Stravaganza, part of the Saison mosaïque at Autre lieu, takes the audience through three centuries of European music. Teachers of the Conservatoire populaire play period-instrument copies in works by Charpentier, Gabrieli, Lully and Bach.

2a2669c875b5764dea19d5cfc8673e91bb731d48.en: Le Paradoxe de John by Philippe Quesne at Saint-Gervais is a playful show about art in everyday life. Five performers turn an apartment, left by Serge to Annie, into a gallery-like space where artists create from almost nothing.

a9e862f4f40ee998a7ddd63b34678d2606ecfbb5.en: Le Poche Cabaret II, Le Chant des Bruants Fous, is a show by Lou Ciszewski at Théâtre Le Poche. Three women search a beach for a box that hides the secrets of a summer cabaret that disappeared thirty years earlier, mixing fiction with cabaret codes.

4a594afa0c62472aa37841ed022910fa4a6b8e56.en: The OCG's Christmas concert POP, at the Victoria Hall, brings the Big Up' Band to play hits by Michael Jackson, Quincy Jones, Stevie Wonder and Al Jarreau. The audience is invited to sing along, with the orchestra conducted by Raphaël Merlin.

8dd615fcd6661b6383a1819b4cdad674cc03d721.en: La Grande soirée du Doublage improvisé at the Salle Centrale de la Madeleine sees actors dub clips they have never seen, improvising new dialogue live. It is the fourth season, and tickets cost CHF 25 full or CHF 20 reduced.

12ea5869030fbc682004ce2c8eee87b1043c4933.en: Macy Gray, the Grammy-winning soul singer known for I Try, plays the Alhambra with her band. She revisits her classics and new songs, with doors at 19:00 and the concert at 20:00.

4e778f536e19608631487e9c78c7e4f5ad2a2154.en: Catol Teixeira's solo ODE is a 60-minute dance piece for ages 14 and over, reflecting on mourning, ruptures and transformations. A body workshop with Caroline de Cornière takes place on 5 December, and the show is staged at the Pavillon de la danse.

f926e9f9e0d687329e2a40ab116778904189539b.en: The BAG jam session at Autre lieu opens with a set by Blues Rooster from 20:00, and the jam starts at 21:00. Anyone can bring an instrument to play.

8a6e63dea7307240442acddf3071bccfa72009dc.en: The Anaïs Rosso Trio plays at the Salle du Manège in Onex. The French chanson singer blends blues, hip hop and indie pop, with her EP Facing Roses and the single Les Colombes.

91f3d645acc43c29f1152e3151fef4d4e344f179.en: Los Mariachis, a Mexican show with El Mariachi Mezcal and soloists of the Geneva Camerata, is at the Théâtre de Carouge on Friday 4 December 2026 at 19:00 and 21:00. The 19:00 show is part of the Relax cultural outings.

488a58a2fe4d07fde8b5389708ecfbe47b9caa05.en: A programme at La Cité Bleue on Arcadelt, born in Namur in 1507, one of the first great madrigal composers. Monteverdi noted that his collections sold better than his own, and one of his scores appears in Caravaggio's The Lute Player.

e0e0125de8539d92e7b4bea5fe5d28b04de85c73.en: Le Serment d'Europe by Wajdi Mouawad at La Comédie de Genève is a tragedy about silence and the handing down of trauma. It draws on Medea and Europa, with an international cast speaking French, Greek, English and Russian.

e3994dc9a9d21e4472ee08e3c10a986b06e30f1e.en: Ameigas, part of the Celtiques festival at Les Salons, presents Galician traditions with gaita, flutes and piano-accordion. Sandra Tamayo Ramos, Cassandre Balbar and Phil Alexander blend Galician, British and klezmer influences.

7b320d2e75fe11e2e5cd99a1b0d274ccf9878b62.en: Mariam sings the songs of Amadou & Mariam at the Espace Vélodrome, after Amadou's death in April 2025. She shares the new album L'Amour à la folie, and late arrivals may be refused entry without refund.

f8c1e7f1a830219a331a1cbc4109da3e0194bfa3.en: Freaky Friday, run by the HEM's music and movement department at the Institut Jaques-Dalcroze, is an evening of participatory improvisation. A guest performance opens the night, followed by an open contest that the audience judges, with a bar between rounds.

db47d09ac531553eecd08785cf0a4f846571508b.en: A nursery rhyme and finger-game workshop at Lancy library, run by La Bulle d'air for children from age 1 and their parents. It is free, with booking by phone, and an adult must be present.

cc3f5caf3fe9a4446d71b5b7d14cd7eea0c12b8f.en: FILMARcito's Abuelos y abuelas at the Minoteries library is a selection of animated shorts in which grandparents guard memory, tenderness and tradition. Some films have no words, others have soft voices, and the programme is made with FILMAR.

718c29b52eb7fbca02494553d1f8c2f428846f82.en: The Cologny Christmas market takes place on 5 and 6 December 2026 at the Place du Manoir. Detailed information is due to be published in November.

e5bcbd520326009ab918733e659bd80d9ed33f8e.en: An improvised show inside the exhibition Le futur, c'est quoi? at the MEG, where young people from the Alliance créative workshops perform invented futures. Two one-hour performances take place on Saturday 5 December, at 14:30 and 16:00.

ecd2d762c5a24b356d702d6a0724ce643813641a.en: Métamorphoses lumineuses at the Ariana museum starts with the glass exhibition, then children play with transforming plastic to make shapes and effects. It lasts 1 hour 30, and registration opens on 16 November.

b5b6f5ee3349bef086364361c7c920f679cdf176.en: The third Prix Radu Lupu, created by the Radu Lupu Foundation, supports young talents whose artistic intensity and musical sensitivity reflect the spirit of the Romanian pianist. La Cité Bleue hosts the 2026 edition.

7b4b491ccf6e11446013e7dcb17b937ce654e3d6.en: Remix by Les Impertinences at La Cité Bleue is a joyful show by young musicians who revive baroque music. European baroque meets the sunny rhythms of Latin America in a lively mix of styles.

43a4f349a8c7daa4848e5da06dff4a664b759300.en: Cocoon celebrates twenty years on stage with an acoustic tour, playing the Alhambra on 5 December 2026. French folk-pop band Cocoon, founded by Mark Daumail, is joined by The Woohoo, a duo of Valérie Martinez and cartoonist Zep.

64c8edd7a9e1c44d3000c4152c367154a7bbfea6.en: The 48th Course de l'Escalade is a popular race held on the first weekend of December at the Parc des Bastions. It aims to mix broad community participation with a high-level competition for national and international athletes.

498705623a8cbd72011a29dc388171608e5e6ed9.en: A Flash Orchestra workshop at Autre lieu, where children and parents choose an instrument, from percussion to brass, and learn a piece together. Two musicians of the OCG lead it, and no prior experience is needed.

5e9df42cf8e229e2338e6338db7a5bfe715e046b.en: The Orchestre des Nations at the Victoria Hall performs Mère Royaume, conducted by Antoine Marguier. The work has music by Robert Clerc and a libretto by Antoine Courvoisier, with the singer Capucine Keller.

2227b7ef7432c497f9952c1402f5e330020788e1.en: La dernière at the MAH is held on the first Sunday of each month. Geneva artists Serval, a graffiti artist, and Kalonji, an illustrator, welcome visitors for an exchange and creative session in front of the artworks.

134676ff72fe9024d28f76e084fcc3be4edd872d.en: Des mots-valises qui font du bien is a parent-child workshop at the Bibliothèque de la Cité, led by Typhaine Marc, a former bookseller who works with creative bibliotherapy. The collaborative session explores the idea of taking care.

aadda0aff760c792bf7eb6595a811dbcd9297734.en: A Ciné-dimanche at the MEG, echoing the exhibition Le futur, c'est quoi?, with free films about the future. The film line-up is to be announced.

a9c6753e722763874e17c3a840a076b4358cf34f.en: Outre-Atlantique: un dialogue romantique at Les Salons on Sunday 6 December at 17:00, performed by the Quatuor Magenta and guests. It pairs Bruch's Octet with Dvořák's American Quartet, linking European romanticism to the rhythms of the New World.

1b6966a1f30dff9e994fd00a3ca8e99bad223857.en: Easy Boosts weekly climbing courses for children and teenagers aged 7 to 14. Sessions take place in a private indoor room or on the Salève depending on the weather, with all climbing gear included, and meet at the Douane Croix-de-Rozon bus stop.

7572c3839eefa96d3d8a91ed97542348bd4ba20b.en: The Haute école de musique de Genève holds its diploma ceremony at the Victoria Hall. Graduates receive their diplomas and special prizes, and the students with the highest marks perform.

6a78a46ad8a0b0c4572d201412ce1e9a30b1e4df.en: Votation 2032 is a three-hour workshop at the Maison de l'Avenir that simulates a Geneva ballot campaign on a fictional cantonal initiative. Participants take roles, use generative AI tools for campaign material, and join a collective debrief.

40236fed804cc8de5faa9d43deb78c50d648ac5c.en: Laurent Nicolet's farewell show RIDEAU returns the Swiss comedian to the stage after nearly 30 years. Directed by Gaspard Boesch, it revisits his career, his era and his contradictions, at Les Salons.

c067fe536f85e0dcc280a0d5c1c0315f7f59ea0a.en: Une étoile dans le ciel at the MAH is a 30-minute family visit for children aged 3 to 5, with an adult. It mixes stories, sensory discovery and the magic of the museum, and is reserved for family audiences.

367b8b6371dbb67a22e812bece60664d8f223d70.en: MataBloK'ids weekly climbing courses for children aged 5 to 8, in a group of no more than six children. Pick-up is at the Douane Croix-de-Rozon bus stop at 10:25, gear is provided, and places are limited.

180ed6ab2a34efddfabfbf224cc5d79beff4979e.en: Café Savoirs Part'Âgés at the UCG i-formation is a free two-hour meeting for older people with questions about smartphones. It runs on Wednesdays from 14:00 to 16:00, including 2 September, 7 October, 4 November and 9 December 2026.

7ac5ccf4ef4ecf13eec7feaf766828da614e5c8a.en: La vie cachée du Léman at the Espace Léman is a hands-on session with magnifiers and microscopes. Participants discover the molluscs and crustaceans of Lake Geneva and their role in the lake ecosystem, for families or friends.

7b675ca721b892346991d7e8ac16ba086fae97d9.en: An atelier for children aged 6 to 12 at the Eaux-Vives neighbourhood space on Wednesday 9 December 2026 at 14:30. Children make a Christmas shower gel with glitter and a gingerbread scent, for CHF 28, with limited places.

f109a070a82b8a62b34c00057c434bdf32e9d5e9.en: Cornebidouille is a puppet show for children from age 4 at La Julienne. A boy who refuses his soup meets the witch Cornebidouille, in a production by the Geneva company Cie Anadyomène, which mixes puppetry, dance, theatre and song.

6e5e07ed649f5ab4abad174375c43ed5638a08cf.en: Ah la belle Escalade is an intergenerational session at the Eaux-Vives library on the night of the Escalade. It uses Elzingre's prints and the Compagnie 1602 to bring back the events of that historic night.

4be1baa0b98104abe8ff6685fd3cefb34d7f58db.en: A talk at the MEG by Lukas Pairon of Ghent University, on positive fatalism, drawn from his fieldwork with young musicians in Kinshasa. It is part of a six-talk cycle for the 2026-2027 ethnomusicology master's, open to the public.

bf3101b563fe1dd7608343518a7980a21a1a320e.en: Mondes Parlés: L'Enfant hors champ at the Centre d'art contemporain is a bilingual staged reading of Sarah Elena Müller's novel. Translator Raphaëlle Lacord and composer Benoît Moreau use slide projectors and cassette recorders, followed by discussion.

2f35dad60685a2fcef492a0956d50d4abc83e8de.en: Le Corps de Claudine by Fabrice Gorgerat at Saint-Gervais is a stage poem based on the body of the author's mother, who has lived with Parkinson's for 20 years. Three performers question the body in a shrinking space.

693a77de39b00d70383a386bdd266e82aeff33be.en: ABBA Hits by Mystery Ensemble at the Salle Centrale de la Madeleine offers original instrumental arrangements of songs such as Dancing Queen, Mamma Mia, Waterloo and The Winner Takes It All. The concert takes place in an intimate historic hall.

1c5d0fd24c3122d8b96a7ff51086ac2519c78ccb.en: élégie, nos yeux fantômes at the Théâtre Pitoëff is a new piece by iDYLLE production, following élégie n°5. Five performers search for ways to stay connected with those who have been lost, after a death.

f06905a981f8d5a568b90ff0050595a96f1680c8.en: Andromaque at the Comédie de Genève is staged by the Belgian collective La Brute with the full text of Racine's tragedy. The bare production avoids modern adaptation, letting the violence and passion of the play come through.

0ad21275b5e88bd8bb8a85d05fd8b5137d73644f.en: Grégoire Maret & Friends at the Alhambra features the Geneva-born harmonica player, who has lived in New York for thirty years. He has won several Grammy Awards and has worked with Herbie Hancock, Pat Metheny, Sting and Marcus Miller.

e98bc5046256a2d02eaa893c27bfe5c1feb9af31.en: Pedro Abrunhosa and Comité Caviar at the Victoria Hall. The Portuguese singer-songwriter has been known since the 1994 album Viagens, mixing pop, soul, jazz and urban influences, with lyrics on love and social issues.

da293d3a6d71ad2e4f7bd815655093834ba52dee.en: An improv match at the Villa Tacchini pits Bâtardexs d'en face against Bloody Pingouins. Teams improvise on themes and constraints set by a referee, and the audience decides the winner.

dec0e690010e0497216c3bb5cfdbe54824a6e93a.en: The Concours Hippique International de Genève marks its 100th anniversary at Palexpo from 9 to 13 December. Founded in 1926, it is one of the four majors of the Rolex Grand Slam of Show Jumping, and this year includes five days of competition.

94e98de95ff800bfb2708830361422cf3662069a.en: Herbert Libiszewski, between Paris and Zurich, is a talk by historian Jean-Charles Giroud at the Bibliothèque de Genève. It looks at the Swiss graphic designer who worked in Paris from the 1920s and later designed tourist posters.

9dbf073ef26903968086f3b44225644aba4276b2.en: L'enfant prodige et l'archiduchesse is an introductory visit at the MAH to the Haydn Integral concert by the Quatuor Terpsycordes. Cultural mediator Isabelle Burkhalter leads it.

3a7b0737e2e2895d0413b875dcd03793fb90dd4b.en: Noël en mode slow is a weekend of local and ethical makers in partnership with the Maison de l'Avenir, on 5 and 6 December. It offers talks, a snack bar, creative workshops and a Saint Nicolas surprise for children.

cea15f8284f9bb3bf348c754852efd3184ba84ba.en: A Vladimir Cosma piece for narrator and orchestra, based on La Fontaine's fables, at the Victoria Hall. OSR musicians share the stage with young players under Philippe Béran, with narrator Joan Mompart, for about one hour.

9a344eed425bf959aafa76394436c2d60e91fb00.en: A Milonga Brava on Thursday 10 December 2026 at the Sécheron neighbourhood space, with a workshop by Jorge Calabrigo and Tiziana Silva from 18:45. The couple won at the 2025 Mundial de Tango, and a milonga with open bar follows from 20:00.

2f80a51608b814b692f186618e7f21190dc6050e.en: Intégrale Haydn #24 by the Quatuor Terpsycordes at the MAH plays two Haydn quartets and Mozart's Clarinet Quintet K. 581, with clarinettist Lorenzo Coppola. A free 20-minute visit led by Isabelle Burkhalter comes first at 18:30.

0d98c7046aea3ea3745d5807a8cc894f5034411b.en: Prophéties de Noël at the Cathedral Saint-Pierre pairs Bernard Reichel's La vision d'Ézéchiel with Frank Martin's Christmas cantata. The concert ends with an excerpt of Bach's Christmas Oratorio, performed by HEM students and choir under Daniel Huertas.

f364b533859a9d9a70fa0446770bafd4fe855af0.en: The 2026 Fête de l'Escalade, marking the 100th anniversary of the Compagnie 1602, runs from 11 to 13 December in Geneva's Old Town. It commemorates the 1602 attack by the Duke of Savoy, with costumes, parades and animations.

c5e566ec409b2308901617ae0fefbadd1ff168aa.en: Stacey Kent sings at the Victoria Hall with Jim Tomlinson on flute, saxophone and percussion, and Art Hirahara on piano. Her clear voice and subtle expression have brought her millions of streams and many awards.

ba92e9549d352def028de13fe6a1fc8596bc1cde.en: Geoffrey Secco's Au-delà is a concert under hypnosis at the Alhambra. Combining Ericksonian hypnosis and music, it explores what might lie beyond life, drawing on spiritual traditions and near-death research.

2c5b2644990550b59f1c5932e37c1c958ffc5d5c.en: Monde Libre Party Vol. 1 at the Alhambra on 12 December brings together the label Monde Libre, of Geneva rapper Mairo, and artists from a wider scene. Supremnova and Huitballe also perform, with rap, trap and phonk.

6b81a905005bdec8d25123f9d511706aa6d0d51d.en: SOUVENIRS, a family concert at the Théâtre du Loup on Sunday 13 December at 11:00 and 15:00. Claire et Antho mix shadow theatre, dance and video with Geneva Camerata soloists, and the 11:00 show is a Relax outing.

e99eee37cb4b71cfb338a4f500c662d22e33919c.en: Mozart's Le Nozze di Figaro is a new production at the Bâtiment des Forces Motrices, sung in Italian with French and English surtitles. It is conducted by Marta Gardolińska, directed by Jetske Mijnssen, and lasts about 3 hours 30 with an interval.

608cff6222667a8ec6dd27fbedc98d0cfc38b6fb.en: Book afterwork at the Bibliothèque de Carouge is a reading club with themed sessions through the year. Topics include romance tropes, writing workshops with Klimte, and a closing jaspage session on 15 December.

611da04255208f82bc8f754aca28daf91eead343.en: A talk at Maison Tavel by Jean-Quentin Haefliger, co-director of the MIR, with an exceptional late opening of the Hodler exhibition at the MIR until 18:00.

9e7042f018901809720c0901a5b1614cac943edc.en: Coup Fatal at La Comédie de Genève, created by Alain Platel, Fabrizio Cassol and Rodriguez Vangama, mixes opera, concert and ballet. Thirteen musicians, most from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, blend Gluck, Vivaldi and Nina Simone with Congolese rumba.

34fc188fc2104f17286a72f94b519c40b6008440.en: A winter solstice event at the MEG, where Amandine Casadamont and Madeleine Leclair create a live sound piece from vinyl records in the temporary exhibition room. It starts at 18:30, lasts 50 minutes, and entry is free.

a9d8232789280f9872a57fc49fe172f9b312bc68.en: Brahms's Fourth Symphony, with Stravinsky's Pulcinella suite and Shostakovich's Second Violin Concerto, is performed by the OSR under Pablo Heras-Casado. Patricia Kopatchinskaja is the violin soloist at the Victoria Hall.

cc2521e75a977a2baba414453dd4418079d572c1.en: La fête du slip ou le pipo de la puissance at Le douze dix-huit is the third part of Mickaël Délis's trilogy on masculinity. With humour, it looks at the obsession with performance and the value of vulnerability.

7f02cfe03041501679fe4f9ff84fbc2907d0125c.en: Lea Desandre's recital Idylle at the Bâtiment des Forces Motrices, with lutenist Thomas Dunford. The mezzo-soprano sings works by Charpentier, Françoise Hardy, Barbara and Offenbach, among others.

ebade7383c4530ea977bb1497360f62c13d8210b.en: Lynda Lemay and Jean-Félix Lalanne's Autour de leurs Guitares at the Alhambra is a guitar-and-voice concert celebrating French-language song. Their album, recorded in two days with 15 tracks, came out in February 2026. Doors open at 19:00.

2e161713fca672295fd4d813685333d342e5bc57.en: Was Voltaire a vegetarian? A free visit in French at Les Délices, led by cultural mediator Lucas Arpin. It looks at Voltaire's late abstention from meat and what it reveals about ethics and animals. It lasts one hour, with no booking needed.

ce08ba55a5a76583fbe5c9684c7d5175fa841bb8.en: A Gaga dance workshop at La Cité Bleue, led by Mermoz Melchior of the Batsheva Dance Company, before the show Kósmos. No experience is needed, and only ticket holders for the show may take part.

79da18ab307eb1ab79ca32aaff762afdecff0923.en: Herbiers sous-lacustres at Espace Léman is a session on the underwater plant meadows of Lake Geneva. It covers the species that shelter animals and how they indicate the health of the lake.

18c281e158d65b92279cd02fdace9a290b2ef6ba.en: Le corps à l'œuvre: Archéologie at the MAH uses the Feldenkrais method to explore the permanent archaeology collection. A Feldenkrais practitioner and a cultural mediator lead the visit, which focuses on body awareness and space.

5d5154a773138906e17bff4ff5b48d91e8fce64d.en: Autour de Jean-Étienne Liotard at the MAH is a visit with opera airs with a drink before or after. It offers a musical way to rediscover the work of Liotard.

14656e07c3b10534b4e20d304b02548664bb1636.en: A Milonga Brava on Thursday 17 December 2026 at Sécheron, with a workshop by Lucian Stan and Vida Lisaite from 18:45. The theme is to be announced, and a milonga with open bar runs from 20:00.

aa1181f17d29c91ab28b36762ab63c4f1788abde.en: Hermanos Gutiérrez play instrumental music at the Alhambra, combining western and Latin sounds. The brothers, raised in Zurich, recorded El Bueno y el Malo with Dan Auerbach, which earned a Grammy nomination. Doors open at 18:30.

6ac5f3f2507bcaaa0a8b3e4eeb498a263ae2aa20.en: Insân at the Théâtre du Grütli features three bodies on a stage of stone and rubble. The title means human in Arabic, and the show asks about memory and the lightness of forgetting.

5579bcb7bf92203a61cff9b6b8abed5feda6660b.en: Confectionne ton cadeau at the Lancy library is a workshop by the association Tricochet, which turns old advertising banners into Christmas gifts. It is free from age 5, with booking by phone, and an adult must be present.

94b450915585e8d8b7aba0d2960edd51612e6db0.en: Les Classiques de Noël at Autre lieu brings Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker, Swan Lake and Sleeping Beauty into a chamber setting, performed by Mystery Ensemble. The programme is a festive concert for the whole family.

b6459c680b3277b0e25a682ffe8e62e39ce08642.en: Méditer au MAH: Au cœur de la tourmente is a mindfulness session among the storm paintings of Calame and Diday. Therapist Erwan Tréguer and cultural mediator Murielle Brunschwig lead it, exploring active acceptance in hard times.

0cf79d018986ceb8a7933ab455f92f3c4005f8b7.en: A free creative workshop for children from age 5 at La Julienne. Registration opens one month before the workshop, and the exhibition on show runs from 27 November to 19 December 2026.

4971f6a91861fdd95eaf357f1da4aa5a4124fdcb.en: Éternel Beethoven at the Victoria Hall brings together La Psallette de Genève, the OCG and soloists for Beethoven's Mass in C major and Morten Lauridsen's Lux Aeterna. Steve Dunn conducts.

2dbe6de2b6eadf1d06a84c3a10b22161c638821b.en: The Mikaîl Aslan Ensemble plays at the Alhambra, with songs in Zaza, Kurdish and Turkish. Traditional and Western instruments meet in a set led by the tenbûr, and Aslan has released ten albums since 2000.

a00b3af4b53a120ad96924291503cefe27d2b10a.en: Contes d'Hiver, a shadow-theatre show for children from age 3 at the Arcade Pierrablanca by Compagnie Dryades. Lasting 45 minutes, it draws on northern legends of snow, ice and reindeer. Groups must register in advance.

9eb4f1fe0515a528c9c92f1a889e61749af4a826.en: A Christmas market of creators at La Comédie de Genève, with illustrations, ceramics, jewellery, cosmetics and accessories from local makers. DJ sets play in the Grande salle and the Salle modulable.

4cd7af8fda8fe2b15bb2574a4027872273d2b044.en: Violonissimo and Camerata Contrepoint present young violinists with Nathaniel and Barry Shapiro. The programme includes Mozart's Sinfonia concertante and Vivaldi's Winter, with festive melodies.

88b74f440a7b0a5dcb31f092af625fabad29839f.en: Noël à Broadway at La Cité Bleue combines Christmas songs with Broadway standards, from The Christmas Song to West Side Story. Three soloists and a pianist are joined by a participatory carol karaoke at the end.

926bb5ad135a4e903a29e121e29e91e652933fc5.en: A White Christmas with Matt Dusk at the Victoria Hall. The crooner sings classics such as White Christmas, Let It Snow and The Christmas Song, with the OSR Jazz Band and six gospel singers.

07a4214553decf9064ebc4737ce58721c3d73bad.en: Francesca Caccini's La liberazione di Ruggiero dall'isola d'Alcina, staged at the Victoria Hall by the Geneva ensemble I Gemelli with no conductor on stage. This 1625 Florentine ballet puts voices at the centre, after a talk at 14:00.

ca0f79e6ee19fa469b67480e86d240bfc86a6bca.en: Jean-Quentin Haefliger's 45-minute talk at the MIR looks at Ferdinand Hodler's 1886 scenes of the Escalade for the Taverne du Crocodile, including Mère Royaume riding her donkey. It links the Maison Tavel and MIR exhibitions.

a04570ee0679a65b7f12449d7039530867745d08.en: Un objet, un son, une histoire: si tu étais roi, si tu étais reine, at the MEG library, follows a look at the temporary exhibition. Stories of African kings and queens who wanted change lead to a piece from the MEG collection.

070599f17ba78553df03501cb84989f0568d134c.en: Kósmos at La Cité Bleue marks 30 years of Canticum Novum. The programme travels from the Tigris and Euphrates, linking the Song of Songs with Mediterranean and Oriental music, with original works by Khaled Aljaramani and Landy Andriamboavonjy.

9b5920a5e0ca553bbcdc9171717f77fa3a62cf03.en: A Christmas concert at the Victoria Hall with the artists of Concertus, mixing carols, classical pieces, opera airs and duets, and jazz improvisations. Tickets cost CHF 25, and children enter free.

ecc82e8dc7969c76dcb74fd368f909f392769869.en: Le grand gala de Giuseppe Verdi at the Victoria Hall is a concert of well-known extracts from La Traviata, Rigoletto, Aida, Il Trovatore, Nabucco and I Vespri siciliani. Costumes and choreography accompany the arias, duets and the chorus Va pensiero.

31f807e384a1057440ee67de313751a83cbda89e.en: BORGES 2026 is an international festival in Geneva celebrating the Argentine writer's link to the city. It offers concerts, literary walks, tango lessons, talks, films and a tribute at his grave on 14 June.

7c0d2c15afce264d8f6b7a052b33cd8c1b05c0ae.en: Le tour du monde at the Autre lieu sees dancers of Studio Zou, with a string quartet, take families on a choreographic journey through time. The show is designed for families across all generations.

46a5926a4a81630fdcbafc1200fca1da6c9ad18d.en: The Philharmonie der Solisten, led by Vladik Otaryan, plays Vivaldi's Four Seasons at the Victoria Hall. Works by Bach, Mozart and Brahms complete the programme, and each musician is also a soloist.

8db912426b9cfab5ca9142d7cb56d13e18855fcd.en: Daniil Trifonov gives a piano recital at the Victoria Hall with Handel, Stravinsky and Schubert's Wanderer Fantasy. Latin American works by Villa-Lobos, Ginastera and Guarnieri also feature, along with Trifonov's own tango.

c8a79997477a2a3820cdf5e8547105cf5761154e.en: The Concert de l'An at the Victoria Hall, conducted by Karen Kamensek, features soprano Juliana Grigoryan. The programme includes opera overtures, intermezzi and arias.

e257667560f35823efdd253d2246e83c57150982.en: A talk at the MIR on Ferdinand Hodler's 1913 mural L'Unanimité, painted for the city of Hanover. It asks whether the Reformation fostered democracy or a forced collective consent, and why the work was removed in 1914.

7a775973373a6a8d24f2f7b7af96082b94579e9e.en: Hell. by Laura Den Hondt and Guilhem Causse at Saint-Gervais is a piece built from an intimate investigation. A woman rediscovers a hard drive of her old internet archives and confronts a version of herself she had forgotten.

b642660e264ddc962fb2b8700953bf751d4acb60.en: GOOD SEX at La Comédie de Genève, by the Irish company Dead Centre, has two actors who have never met or read the script. Each night they play a love story with lines fed through an earpiece, guided by an intimacy coordinator.

b5e37b8ef99e799763b8f39a15f4e1b70f8ea331.en: Nikolay Khozyainov's piano recital at the Salle Franz Liszt opens 2027 with Liszt's Sonata in B minor and the pianist's own works, several of them in world premiere.

98e993c07ec590f07d4eb588729f849eb4e2c4ba.en: Rien que de l'eau? at the Théâtre le douze dix-huit is a documentary-style play by Production d'Avril, written and directed by Isabelle-Loyse Gremaud. It asks how people recover after rivers flood their lives.

b4cdf7156b23ad47ff7c450895d6ddfe644a6a84.en: Espagne intime at La Cité Bleue marks the 150th anniversary of Manuel de Falla. Harpsichordist Benjamin Alard and dancer Israel Galván perform with Geneva Chamber Orchestra soloists, in Falla's Harpsichord Concerto and works by Victoria, Bach and Scarlatti.

866a54af5283a8f3b00be55defb920919dee7e86.en: CHIEN BLEU MEETS GECA at La Gravière on 14 January 2027 at 21:00 pairs the Geneva rapper Chien Bleu with drummer Valentin Liechti and Geneva Camerata soloists. It is for ages 18 and over.

3f0480aa499e8b2d9b69d106f188d79ef4f9a95a.en: Aurela Gaçe and AG Band perform at the Alhambra, blending modern sound with traditional Albanian music. Doors open at 19:00, the concert runs from 20:00 to 22:00, and seats are numbered.

e286495a091f2c2e60db6f3364002f9fd95503eb.en: Jarry returns to the Geneva Arena for an extra date on Friday 15 January 2027, after his Bonhomme show sold out. The fast-paced comedy aims to bring laughter, kindness and a sense of shared euphoria.

b0788cbe531557c73802711dd21ef5dd1254e233.en: Portes ouvertes 2027 at the HEM Dufour offers public masterclasses for pre-college students during the day. In the afternoon, the admissions office explains academic pathways, and students and staff answer questions.

a9d53b1402645817485a431328c8a70ad5fad33f.en: Musica transalpina at the Salle Franz Liszt has HEM students of the Grand Ensemble Renaissance, with conductor Christina Pluhar and sacqueboute teacher Stefan Legée. The programme traces Italian music from Venice to Vienna and Kroměříž.

0f5847f7756e9333ac837933d14a6dba62ff78b1.en: SUZANE plays the Alhambra on 16 January 2027, presenting her album Millénium. Doors open at 19:00 and the concert starts at 20:00, as part of the Voix de Fête festival.

5e0404261bd6dff6cbce8c564ddaa21ea6ed336b.en: A chamber music concert at the Conservatoire on a Sunday at 11:00, with OSR musicians. Mozart's String Quintet No. 3 in G minor, K. 516, is paired with Brahms's String Quintet No. 2, Op. 111.

5a4f8da84351b0be4766a098898e1268b8cac2b9.en: Les Musiciens du Louvre, conducted by Marc Minkowski, perform Mozart's Requiem at the Victoria Hall. Wilhelm Friedemann Bach's Adagio and Fugue and Mozart's Ave verum corpus open the programme, which lasts about 1 hour 30 without interval.

d888d2c7fac3af50f7ed6de955a2e4b7468526de.en: A one-hour guided visit in Italian of the Hodler exhibition at the MIR. It explores the artist's Protestant roots and his pantheist view of nature, and how his landscapes became spaces for contemplation.

3864e4f16220d5d8e22daf05174448c6b174df68.en: Stravaganza at La Cité Bleue, with Maud Bessard-Morandas and the ensemble O Tempora. The concert brings to light lesser-known Roman baroque composers, with music ranging from madrigal to oratorio, under the direction of Quentin Guérillot.

830795f2b8b508e8a7367b23b832c855f5af472a.en: Gisèle Halimi, une farouche liberté at the Salle Communale in Onex is a biopic on stage, staged by Léna Paugam. Two actresses trace the life of the lawyer and activist, from her childhood in Tunisia to her fights for women's rights.

9208ddfc644de31409510dc62d989b69507480c7.en: Café des parents on food and behaviour, the first part of a two-part series at the Maison de Quartier du Plateau. A parent-child cooking workshop follows on Saturday 6 February from 14:30 to 16:30. It is free, but registration is required.

1d24b7592476ab21a5f8fe307d0322a8be2c0673.en: Marcel Khalifé presents a new album marking 50 years since his 1976 debut, Promesses de la tempête, with four reworked songs for oud and voice. The Alhambra concert starts at 20:00, with doors at 19:00.

7c6868a824202fab4d93fec961e0518a049688cf.en: Nawell Madani adds an extra date at the Geneva Arena on 20 January 2027 for her one-woman show Tout Court. The Belgian comedian mixes stand-up and confidences on mental load, fame and the temptation of botox.

4dd093fe4a49589196caeca96d4c945791078461.en: L'invention de la Genève internationale at Les Délices features Pierre-Etienne Bourneuf and Olga Hidalgo-Weber, who ask how Geneva became the capital of peace. Alexis Favre moderates, and entry is free, with student musicians at 18:00.

f3af6ea12f2af6a5b71e2350e3734a8460ece2b5.en: TATRÏZ by Valentine Sergo at the Théâtre Le Poche is the third and last part of her Cyclone triptych. A couple from different geopolitical realities, one with a passport and one who cannot leave Palestine, shows how politics shapes love.

def13f4eede7a9dc8887bf91c874dd25753062b7.en: Out of Australia at the Auditorium Ansermet presents new works by Nardi Simpson and Jessie Cox, commissioned by Contrechamps after a tour of Australia. A guided visit of the MEG's Aboriginal collection begins at 18:00, and the concert is at 19:30.

6a1fdb771306b1a7ee1f8a2fb052d8f8262ce6a9.en: Médine's acoustic show Enfants du destin at the Alhambra retells children's stories shaped by colonisation, war and slavery. Piano, guitar, voice and cello carry the 1 hour 30 performance, with interludes by Karinale Lo van Zaouiche.

e0b2db16b8715f62ad6c6c94d51c4df3e33663f0.en: L'école des femmes, a musical theatre version of Molière's play by the Frei Körper Kompanie, is set in today's society at the Espace Vélodrome. Agnès is raised in ignorance by her guardian Arnolphe, until Horace arrives.

9b45de03daf5e66732b664ffc3fe129cc4a7f6cf.en: Fuega by Compagnie Mon Grand l'Ombre at the Ferme Marignac is a 35-minute paper-theatre show for toddlers. A curious wild boar travels following a smell, a colour or a melody, with live sounds and songs. School shows take place on 21 and 22 January.

c1d2b94b945aa3f4baccd6c378702e479f95af52.en: Pierre de Maere, a 24-year-old singer-songwriter, plays the Alhambra with a romantic and ironic pop style. He was named revelation of the year at the Victoires de la musique 2023, and his debut album Regarde-moi is certified platinum.

c68f021493a664ead7113387f616443f37098db7.en: Fabuleux at the Salle Communale in Onex is a musical about Hans Christian Andersen's 1857 stay at Charles Dickens's home. It is seen through the eyes of Dickens's son Henry, with tales told in shadow puppetry, and is based on a true story.

e31888908ae62cc772a550e1edacb5851ea21944.en: A world premiere at the Victoria Hall by the Ensemble Polhymnia, conducted by Franck Marcon. Nicolas Bolens's L'intime... comme l'Eau du Temps sets poems by Philippe Jaccottet, with the HEM orchestra.

6ca384a5c4fe552390189d21e75d8e16de11e766.en: A concert-lecture in homage to Sofia Gubaidulina at the Autre lieu, led by Lausanne musicologist Mathilde Reichler and journalist Charles Sigel. Swiss musicians of international renown perform her works.

48e748f485325b319d987d69cff899da7d83f0b0.en: Rencontres de la photographie, a 2027 cycle of round tables at the Bibliothèque de Genève with the Centre de la photographie and the Transbordeur review, marking 200 years of photography. Each evening opens with a historical piece or artwork.

3ff1aa69657adfdbb68d9526b2580fc870f75497.en: An English-language talk by illustrator Anna Haas at the Bibliothèque de Genève, part of Les Jeudis midi de l'affiche. Based in Fribourg, she works on illustration, editorial design, visual identities, apps and posters.

8d966645a80c1c0e1da5af8d1f52dc5c4bc855ec.en: FROM NEW YORK WITH LOVE at the Bâtiment des Forces Motrices on 23 January 2027 features Veronica Swift, Zacharie Ksyk, Maxence Sibille and conductor John Axelrod with GECA. It mixes Broadway, jazz standards and works by Gershwin, Ellington and Bernstein.

174715a5da3d73c89eba5093969687488b5190ab.en: Casting Lear at La Comédie de Genève has Andrea Jiménez as Cordelia and as a director. Each night a different actor, with no rehearsal, plays Lear, in a play that mixes autobiography and Shakespeare to reflect on fathers.

408e92e103a4434a0db4e4e5708c8f078535e4ae.en: A light painting workshop at the Eaux-Vives library, part of the Eaux-Vives Lux Festival. Participants try the technique of capturing light to create luminous shapes and leave with a photo of their creation.

8d1acdecb3513aeb01224b07b3ae171be4d90940.en: Craignez la nuit at the Théâtre du Grütli is a historical thriller. Archaeologists uncover the grave of a 13th-century abbess, and her story sheds light on the violence women face today.

d44b29a4e0f26c2825aaf4a68ada5d2e324c3e3b.en: Mathieu Madenian, known for the series Un gars, une fille, presents his fourth one-man show at the Salle Communale in Onex. He talks with tenderness and self-mockery about fatherhood and the arrival of his son, in a world on fire.

d8e67c903c29619ff529b0265dcc83e719316e3c.en: The Antigel 2027 festival runs from 28 January to 21 February 2027 across the canton of Geneva. Since 2011 it has taken arts into new spaces, sometimes where audiences would not expect them.

6c228f2b43ec30a9cf9352a389fca87df4382ce0.en: Patatas Fritas Falsas at Saint-Gervais is the third part of a trilogy on violence. It deals with Franco's dictatorship from 1939 to 1975, mixing satire, political cabaret, techno and puppetry, with Agnès Mateus.

19cae879dbff34ec0a3276aad9c4af7136c0ad4e.en: A chocolate workshop at Autre lieu with the chocolatiers of La Bonbonnière, a Geneva shop over a century old. Participants taste chocolates, learn its history and practise tempering, lasting two hours.

492a2299e1ab65dab3fca55d12a89611b3929e2f.en: Leonardo García-Alarcón's talk on Spanish baroque music at La Cité Bleue, lasting one hour. It traces the music from 16th-century Roman polyphony to new styles that emerged in the Americas, shaped by local languages and cultures.

d5799fb88a95f89dbe8cf5ad2d69e3748632035f.en: L'Effet Papillon, a long-form improv show by Les Fabulateurs at the Impro Comedy Club. A story is replayed with one small detail changed, and the audience sees how the characters and their relationships are affected. Entry is free.

1d646fb65d99381767db022b53f0f64e15ab9a7a.en: Oh les oiseaux, a bird walk at the Eaux-Vives library led by ornithologist Laurent Vallotton of the Natural History Museum. Participants discover the water birds that winter in the lagoon.

63e060c26b8f9bb660fd26aa75199601e9566fad.en: Ultra Saucisse, a backstage meeting at the Jonction library with two Geneva artists from the Théâtre des Marionnettes. They explain how a show about school bullying uses visible puppetry and humour to handle a sensitive subject.

831fdbfcb24c71bfbcfa59dd472e12d89f565d2d.en: Momo l'enfant pêche, with the OCG at the Auditorium Ansermet, is a small opera for ages 6 and over based on a Japanese folk tale. A boy born from a fruit travels with a dog, a monkey and a pheasant to challenge an ogre.

cf4b7b5efa31a3ba0874a0c16529758c90b7be2e.en: A screening at the Servette library of the animated film Persepolis (2007) by Marjane Satrapi and Vincent Paronnaud. It follows a girl growing up in Tehran through the 1979 revolution and then exile in Vienna.

9f6a75fe5b486a77390fb043eb929e0db91826b0.en: Carmina Latina at La Cité Bleue, conducted by Leonardo García-Alarcón, is a sacred programme of Iberian polyphony taken to the Americas. It includes works by Juan de Araujo, Tomás de Torrejón y Velasco and Gaspar Fernández.

fc30fcb3f026ac5abb5ace6c38fc88b00d244d85.en: Enfin dimanche at La Comédie de Genève offers three free family Sundays each season, with immersive shows and creative workshops. The programme for each date is announced three weeks before.

10d26e74db725601c129a63f0e95fd7d2d507255.en: Dans le décor de Craignez la nuit at the Théâtre du Grütli is an improvised show. Four performers learn a title minutes before the curtain, with no text and only a set, then improvise for the audience, followed by a talk on stage.

0d464f8211d7bb028392df01966489bb0cbeb7bb.en: Comme tout le monde, a show for ages 3 and over by Groupe Maritime de Théâtre, tells of Roulotte, a red round caravan. Criticised by a village, she tries to fit in before daring to be herself, at Espace Vélodrome.

8e7d67a8234c356b035734e059dd67d10c976396.en: Body Electric by Swiss-Iranian choreographer Kiyan Khoshoie at Saint-Gervais is his first group piece. It celebrates the power of dance and its benefits for body and mind, and the energy of the group.

973eb804c9665eccf8b4ad86416df03573ea2d80.en: Dear Luigi, I Hate You at La Comédie de Genève follows a fictional restorative justice process inspired by a real 2024 killing in the US. Two actors play the characters, and the play is written by Adèle Yon and staged by Yan Duyvendak.

aa19c4f68d5689416774ec6f5ea6c3f9169f0728.en: Objectif projet at the Théâtre le douze dix-huit is a piece of theatre and song about a meeting of managers in a company with no project. The four performers present the show as a light, musical comedy.

536fc1ec8360725a1485ddc0da3631e2d2776978.en: De Florence à Moscou at Les Salons, on Wednesday 3 February 2027 at 19:30, has ClassiCosy's string ensemble with Pierre Fouchenneret. The programme includes Tchaikovsky's Souvenir de Florence and his Violin Concerto in a new commissioned arrangement.

0c0a60a73a2eb498d483250dff000b9da4dfa93b.en: Avelune, part of the Saison mosaïque at Autre lieu, brings together teachers of the Conservatoire populaire and students. They explore contemporary harp, mixing acoustic sound with electronics and music technology.

1d750eea7e57dc7f711786712c326265f05015d2.en: The Peace Philharmonic with Nikolay Khozyainov, at the Salle Franz Liszt, performs Barber's Adagio, Shostakovich's First Piano Concerto, and the pianist's own Intermezzo and First Piano Concerto, both world premieres.

2bef714490a35119cfc51615ac4d9a578d3d3f99.en: A second parents' café on food and behaviour at the Maison de Quartier du Plateau. It is followed by a cooking workshop for parents and children to prepare a balanced breakfast and snack, with free entry and registration required.

fbb14a62eecba4fe9685a279f38efda060b6cb3e.en: Brass Time Machine by Geneva Brass, directed by Bastien Blanchard, at the Aula du Centre Geisendorf on Saturday 6 February 2027 at 17:00. It is an all-ages show that takes audiences through music history, with humour and audience interaction.

ddcd09ea0884357a7ee86277505c7421862f9d95.en: La Nuit du quatuor at the Auditorium Ansermet, from 19:00 to midnight, is a night with over four hours of live music. It includes Ligeti's Second Quartet, a Marc Ribot Quartet set and two films shown continuously.

ac2ab1bc3a5786036e0b7878da12e8c868b08d90.en: L'opéra s'invite aux 6 toits, a family morning on Sunday 7 February with breakfast from 9:30 and an opera show at 10:00. Children aged 5 to 7 can then try a choral class with the Maîtrise.

572031568f7023c8b3a2982f3fb20fa002421c6c.en: Les Tableaux at Autre lieu presents Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition in Bruno Rossignol's four-hand piano version. Jean Françaix's Renoir portraits and an invented museum text by actor Bastien Blanchard complete the programme.

5ca456adfe92ab15ae4fea57ceb32e8a0080f75e.en: Beforz Week at the Halles de l'Île, from 8 to 14 February 2027, is a Swiss event on spatial computing. Visitors can try the Apple Vision Pro with the Beforz team, and wearers of glasses should bring contact lenses.

4da7665fb35982f763c4a62be50688c287d08064.en: Murmuration Blue Edition at La Cité Bleue, by Dance Area Genève, is a recreation of Sadeck Berrabah's work. Ten young dancers perform a precise choreography inspired by bird flocks, with music as a structuring force.

8001e4e35ac2c28c8d4bd5656fe2ac3de937c457.en: BUNKER at La Comédie de Genève by Marion Siéfert is a dystopian fiction set in a France five degrees warmer. An oil company chief hides in a luxury bunker with his daughter, who has fallen silent, and the text is written with Matthieu Bareyre.

5bc8cdbf720638414192ff75c526f51f3084a4b7.en: CinéClubturel shows Tron: Ares at the Bureau culturel, part of the season Humans vs AI in seven sessions. Pizza is included, and viewers are encouraged to watch the films beforehand, since only short extracts are shown.

6d1a449d75f8e83027e878157eb1b0aaf54d1ab4.en: La Fondation du Rien by Nicolas Heredia at Saint-Gervais is a collective experience of emptiness by La Vaste Entreprise. People sign up for activities that are always cancelled, so they have time with nothing planned.

0370a381c1b737b787bb10332738ed4b96e15c8d.en: Ino Casablanca, a rapper born in Spain to Moroccan parents, plays the Alhambra with hybrid, danceable rap. He was nominated for the Victoires de la musique 2026, and doors open at 18:30 with the concert at 19:30.

9346e98ed4a4a2cd460a48218aad45d0c39876c0.en: Nask Studio, Nadja Zimmermann and Skander Najar, talk at the Bibliothèque de Genève on how encounters shape creative work. The talk starts at 12:15 and lasts about 45 minutes, followed by discussion, as part of Les Jeudis midi de l'affiche.

e24237f5b77cea3dd8758b24286407e2188ffb85.en: Hugo Barriol plays the Salle du Manège in Onex with his third album. The folk singer-songwriter began by playing in the Paris metro, and his songs carry the memories of his travels.

b649f2ca44a18c1ea7e4d0aebe31d4b7c0b65a48.en: Yael Miller plays the Espace Vélodrome with her album Fairuz, sung in Hebrew. Her electronic and Oriental sounds are joined by opening acts Laure Betris and Yann Hunziker, who mix Swiss yodel and dialects with other languages.

1ad46ee01225957fdfc27c3a4007b1ff74355f4f.en: A carte blanche at Les 6 toits in which Contrechamps musicians present Mathias Spahlinger's doppelt bejaht, 24 studies for an orchestra without a conductor. An orchestra refused to play it at its 2009 premiere, and the audience can move freely.

71f72dd1464b73c6ec7ff2faab50a4d646fb236b.en: Florian Cafiero and Grégoire Mallard of the Geneva Graduate Institute ask how archives of multilateral negotiations can become research tools. The talk is at the Bibliothèque de Genève at 16:15 and lasts one hour.

d80ae78205e50c38c515f467233a819dda71afae.en: Après moi, le déluge by (LA)HORDE for the Ballet national de Marseille, performed at La Comédie de Genève. Twelve dancers move through a monumental set, capturing the feeling of living before a collapse, with music by Pierre Aviat.

9f482afa65327893bc5ad83f9df99fe6fd655395.en: Bertrand de Billy conducts the OSR in Rêves de violon at the Victoria Hall, with violinist Alexandra Conunova. The programme pairs Chaminade's Callirhoë suite, Saint-Saëns's Third Violin Concerto and Josef Suk's Pohádka, which the OSR plays for the first time.

2c107ffc4344bac6344857bc1fdded6a1a90e844.en: Made in France by La Poursuite du Bleu is a satire staged in the Salle Communale in Onex. A man leaving prison takes a cleaning job, then leads a union to save a factory threatened by relocation, and the story reaches the president.

92bd5de9646f9975cd7b3034759814e02fa8d694.en: A round table at Les Délices on Geneva's international image, with filmmaker Jean-Stéphane Bron and Marie-Luce Desgrandchamps. They discuss how art shapes the story of International Geneva, linked to Bron's series The Deal, moderated by Alexis Favre.

cf9467aa8e4fb84bd4bf1922dfe7f6dbe61a0cb1.en: Lio plays the Alhambra on 25 February 2027, presenting her 12th studio album, Geoid Party in the Sky. The album features songs written by Louane, Hoshi, Sophie Ellis-Bextor and others, and celebrates the encounters of her career.

6ce7bc64beefd6307a14bbb45f25d0bfd3941386.en: Macéra by Compagnie Pyramid at the Salle communale du Petit-Lancy is a 1 hour 10 hip-hop show. Dancers take the audience on an odyssey, with the journey as a metaphor for life and the search for freedom.

8b54452dc0c349e171b9145cd5a8f9767e1e1f57.en: Hansel et Gretel is a musical theatre show for ages 6 and over at La Julienne, by Collectif Ubique. Three actor-musicians, three chairs and eight instruments retell the Grimm tale, with a gingerbread house.

b518ab6b567db8119d43e7df69830621ad7adc03.en: Yuston XIII plays the second leg of the tour for his debut album, Les Enfants du Chaos, at the Alhambra. Isïa opens the evening, and the concert is mostly standing.

ca75db86b4b6b0803beda8363a6d56fb01a81da4.en: Beatrice Berrut's carte blanche at the Victoria Hall, part of the Sunday concerts, is an introspective programme of her own compositions. Her classical roots meet her love of bands like Muse, Portishead and Massive Attack, and the concert is a Relax outing.

8df60f1f3ba173e483cd7f5d4edc9259c816cbe4.en: Au nom du père at La Julienne follows Anissa, who searches for the father she never knew, with Ahmed Madani as her companion. The show mixes theatre, pastries and video to explore fatherhood, chance and destiny.

0aa925cc3b18d782c084d9b13c276bffbe3fdc91.en: The Smallest Things at La Comédie de Genève, by Marc Oosterhoff and Owen Winship, builds a show in front of the audience from almost nothing. Acrobatics, sound and light changes are all visible, and the illusion works even when its tricks are shown.

d9c3fbd78dabf4224e473c764064b025f864efb8.en: Zoom at the Salle Communale in Onex is a solo show by Pamela Ravassard, based on Gilles Granouillet's text. A mother defends her difficult son Burt at a parents' meeting and tells of her struggle to raise him alone.

afb24c5135cd046f0c21aac80c5fc4867acdf02b.en: A talk by Filippo Bonini Baraldi of NOVA University in Lisbon at the MEG, one of six talks in the 2026-2027 ethnomusicology master's cycle. It includes a presentation of about 30 minutes, followed by an interview led by students.

dfa5221b884c29a9c7d3a63bd7b2f7472343b8f7.en: Bouffer les pissenlits par la racine at the Théâtre le douze dix-huit weaves a mosaic of voices from interviews about death. Memories, rituals, fears, love and humour come through songs and ceremonies, by Alenka Chenuz and Amélie Vidon.

5a40a94efc8591bd7a69a3296ffa9dd9f1b7ff6f.en: Magic Carousel, part of the Saison mosaïque at Autre lieu, features percussion teachers of the Conservatoire populaire and their students. Works by Eric Sammut mix jazz, groove, Gypsy and Latin influences, and entry is at a free price.

d2f5c0e44fb396848753653723c4faae7036e79a.en: LES ROSES FAUVES at the Théâtre LE POCHE follows Lola Cam, whose family passes on sewn hearts holding their secrets. A novelist who settles in her village crosses her path, in an adaptation of Carole Martinez's novel by Martine Corbat and Carine Corajoud.

20358962d7cc500dadbf67fb74883e5f6eb0e376.en: Norma Jeane Baker de Troie by Maya Bösch at Saint-Gervais is based on Anne Carson's text. Helen of Troy becomes Marilyn Monroe, and her husband is named Arthur, after Arthur Miller, in a story about a woman shaped by men's gazes.

e387fef6b81130d2728a06d9733e4199bb1cbcc3.en: Moncef Genoud plays a jazz piano solo at the Victoria Hall, in a programme titled La sensibilité au bout des doigts, l'art du piano jazz. The recital is about sensitivity at the fingertips.

afd2d321a8499500cea5d28917298dd3d79f9573.en: ON M'A TROUVÉE GRANDIE by Valentine Losseau at La Comédie is set in 1896 at the Salpêtrière hospital. A patient who believes she levitates meets a doctor who uses hypnosis, in a fantastical show that mixes magic, dance and acting, inspired by real events.

3b537a9175f04270313cdcc1895f30de4f4f8e9f.en: Verlaine et les femmes at La Cité Bleue is a talk by Nicolas Ducimetière on the women who shaped Paul Verlaine's life and work. Mathilde Mauté and others are part of the talk, which links to the show Verlaine en prison.

d3f692056e6685baddd6c0238a01ed4f8386dbf3.en: Verlaine en prison at La Cité Bleue follows the poet after he is sentenced in 1873 for shooting Arthur Rimbaud. Belgian countertenor Logan Lopez Gonzalez uses Verlaine's own words and melodies by Fauré, Debussy and Ferré, with pianist Stella Marie Lorenz.

fbaa82fd49ac3a49a20af32be360bc3de84dcc55.en: Carpet Diem at the Théâtre du Grütli is an absurd family fable in which a Persian carpet and an enigmatic being are the heroes. The show is about imagination and freedom, and is for all audiences.

a73046e4ac80c66844af7fd1365f969b90874926.en: Olivier Giraud's How to become a Parisian in one hour at Uptown Geneva is an English-language humour masterclass. It offers a survival guide to Paris, from ordering in restaurants to behaviour on public transport.

ea2fcefbdb1d981ba26eca5fc045ce836897bf05.en: Une baignoire sur scène at Autre lieu is an interactive concert with Ensemble Contrechamps. The audience hears the music and life of John Cage, with dice, white noise and a bathtub played as an instrument.

519bbdc8f7f5515f32d8cc28054c9363fa7b7821.en: A chamber music concert at the Conservatoire on a Sunday at 11:00, with OSR musicians. It pairs three contemporary string quartets, by Jacques Hétu, Jennifer Higdon and Henri Dutilleux.

246c37128d9c83a9fb329778387460ecbe64b47c.en: Laboratorium Pieśni on its SEPTEM tour at the Alhambra is a vocal ensemble of women singing arrangements of Slavic, Balkan and Baltic folk songs. Some songs are sung a cappella, others with drums, shruti box and flutes.

22f2bb9da4fcd3af1ad8ab84eadeb0d2dd455b80.en: Le Sacre du Piano at La Cité Bleue presents piano transcriptions of Prelude to The Afternoon of a Faun, The Rite of Spring and Daphnis et Chloé. HEM students and teachers play led by Cédric Pescia.

c698ea0ee3103559fffea1eaf87bffd48972df84.en: Splean, a rock band with more than 30 years of history, plays the Alhambra on its European tour. Singer Sasha Vasilyev leads hits such as Orbit Without Sugar and No Way Out, with doors at 18:30 and the concert at 19:30.

361aaa52bbac8fbbfc52dc32d1dd3297007eef09.en: Gautier Capuçon and Mirabelle Kajenjeri play cello and piano at the Victoria Hall. The programme includes Debussy's Cello Sonata, Mendelssohn's Second Sonata, Schumann's Fantasiestücke and Brahms's Second Sonata.

24b360850aaccff711dbf2466fae707542076cc8.en: Royaume(s) by Cie Virgule at the Salle Communale de Plan-les-Ouates is a street-style hip-hop trio show for ages 5 and over, followed by a dance workshop. It is part of the Groove'n'Move festival, from 4 to 14 March 2027.

1b76bbaddc89f8cb0857847bf93604bae3601db7.en: Three introductory urban dance workshops at the Villa Tacchini, held by the Groove'n'Move festival at 17:00, 18:15 and 19:30. They are open to all levels, and registration opens on 19 January 2027.

3be1ce948b2a223bde27e7dc440353da330e2999.en: A film screening at the Institut Florimont, with the Geneva human rights film festival FIFDH. The film of about 1 hour 15 is followed by a meeting with the film's team.

1c11cb1b36ac62774774bb110013629ac59a2486.en: Daniele Gatti conducts Beethoven's Fourth Piano Concerto with Mao Fujita, and the Pastorale Symphony, at the Victoria Hall. It is the third part of a Beethoven cycle marking 200 years since his death.

4a0a5b72b93d5b21e531f22b5bbb67bbbcb8e5fe.en: Warhaus, the solo project of Balthazar singer Maarten Devoldere, plays the Alhambra with The Donkey. Raw vocals and rhythms from gqom and grime move the show from elegance to trance, with doors at 18:30.

d0df42d2e3bff903a8842290cd597486f6cd5e54.en: Mathilde Veuthey, a Geneva and Valais graphic designer, talks at the Bibliothèque de Genève on the printed poster as a space for experiment, with 1970s and 1980s punk influences. The talk starts at 12:15 and lasts about 45 minutes.

6d344ead0e3571c5cc884497a1a32d294d68338e.en: CinéClubturel's Pinocchio at the Bureau culturel is a screening for children, with extracts and drawing followed by group discussion. It asks what makes us truly human, and parents are welcome to attend.

42dd049f93055fe73de765fe7c011c4a5ae38b54.en: Orpheus Chamber Orchestra, with Branford Marsalis on saxophone and conducting, plays Duke's Harlem, a Swiss premiere, at the Victoria Hall. The programme also includes Jeff Beal's saxophone concerto and Gershwin's An American in Paris.

b40796f96b35a87bf6626d9a74afdd964beac137.en: PROMENADE OBLIGATOIRE at La Comédie de Genève has eight dancers who cross the stage in one direction without stopping. Written for popping specialists, the piece shows individuals struggling against the flow of collective life.

85b4acd8f6e7c585e841daa874177a233db28a0a.en: MEG x BiblioWeekend 2027 at the MEG library joins a Swiss weekend of libraries, with the theme Rencontre. Events will link to the temporary exhibition Rencontres, and the programme is still to be announced.

e76fec9f8a6b2d26e491cb98259132f3490ff53c.en: Plume at the Salle du Manège is a show for ages 4 and over. A girl who dreams of becoming an artist falls asleep, turns into a bird after hearing a blackbird sing, and sets off on an adventure.

ae6c75f0bab6922687502aaa7a2b19b2bf2b7eb8.en: J'ai 8 ans et je m'appelle Jean Rochefort at the Salle Communale in Onex is a play by Thomas Drelon, who plays Rosalie, an eight-year-old who wakes with Jean Rochefort's moustache. It is adapted from Adèle Fugère's novel about childhood depression.

ef4b0606ba4f74ed1b283bf5af4eceddbf8b2e9c.en: Leonardo García-Alarcón leads Bach's St Matthew Passion at the Victoria Hall with Cappella Mediterranea, the Chamber Choir of Namur and the boys' choir of the Conservatoire populaire. The performance lasts over two and a half hours.

b739bd95c1623dd3e861f64ce96461b561157308.en: Portuguese fado singer Gisela João plays the Alhambra on Sunday 14 March, with doors at 18:00 and the concert from 19:00 to 21:00. Her voice brings desire, revolt and joy to contemporary fado.

6609972cbfccdeff9e1b8ee52fa2c1ce35788683.en: Easy Boosts weekly climbing courses for children and teenagers aged 7 to 14, third term 2026-2027. Sessions take place in a private indoor room or on the Salève, depending on the weather, with all gear included, and places are limited.

ad114b1374c02a033226678b6668383e02ab7db1.en: Voir clair avec Monique Wittig at La Comédie de Genève is an evening of reading, music and performance. Adèle Haenel and Caro Geryl, directed by Gisèle Vienne, read Wittig's 1978 essay La pensée straight by a fire.

1157163112dea2345153fd4eeca5cc6d5ef07462.en: THÉA, a French artist, plays the Alhambra with songs that blend punk, rave and pop. Her lyrics tell of a queer young woman's chaos, with doors at 19:00 and the concert at 20:00.

88e14deb94cc9ee8415d4f3ef4677002796869a2.en: MataBloK'ids weekly climbing courses for children aged 5 to 8, third term 2026-27. Groups have no more than six children, pick-up is at the Douane Croix-de-Rozon bus stop at 10:25, gear is provided, and places are limited.

1cc201c5bb97586a3cb4217ce009e43766842289.en: The 46th AMR Jazz Festival runs from 17 to 21 March 2027, with five evenings of double bills featuring local and international artists. More details will be posted on the AMR website.

d9f0f44c5d2cec858860de0d94673baf53aff9fb.en: The Festival du Film vert at La Dépendance in Lancy shows committed films on climate change, followed by discussions with specialists. For the fifth year running, the City of Lancy hosts the festival.

31b2c92352cf0e9af7e8a704a301089d8dc1cd8f.en: Le journal intime de Bernstein at La Cité Bleue is a concert-theatre piece about Leonard Bernstein's life. Pianist Shani Diluka and actor Charles Berling bring it to life, from the young Lenny to West Side Story, with a text by Marianne Vourch.

0b7f806a853c086d118018f53f150d64a3011df6.en: Florent Marchet, a French singer-songwriter and storyteller, presents his seventh album, Mobil Home, at Voix de Fête. The album was made in Tunis, Paris and Brussels, and it blends melancholy, humour and a sense of narrative.

b43d3f876d5ca05f661cabf22aad260cb3f5a362.en: Genève internationale: l'envers du décor at Les Délices is a discussion on the workers hidden behind Geneva's diplomatic image. Marine Julie Pierre and Sabine Pitteloud examine hierarchies and social divides, moderated by Alexis Favre.

190684fc51bb92c105849d254dfc1b95a16e5110.en: Au Nom du Ciel by Yuval Rozman at Saint-Gervais is the last part of his Quadrilogy of my Land. Three birds investigate the 2020 killing of Iyad Al-Hallaq, an autistic Palestinian man, in a contemporary fable with humour.

684b6a2f40569550a39d1609ba4974b50a843184.en: Nelson Goerner plays Janáček's In the Mists, Schumann's Kinderszenen and Toccata, and Beethoven's Diabelli Variations at the Victoria Hall. It is a piano recital.

801663767ce0abb1f5b6dc2f631321cbb13316e3.en: Les Wriggles, a French group of comic chansonniers formed in 1995, present their new show at the Salle Communale in Onex. Four performers with acoustic guitars mix bitter humour and playful songs about today's world.

b26dc251ed233f1e238d82de89a836857c6a29a3.en: La Yegros, Edwin Sanz and GECA perform MI ALMA at the Bâtiment des Forces Motrices, conducted by David Greilsammer. Cumbia, carnavalito and chamamé meet Dvořák's Seventh Symphony.

0d3abe6832d09746089f8d5a1f3838426e90c422.en: Contez sur nous, by the Baukauf brothers, is an interactive storytelling show at the Théâtre le douze dix-huit. Audience suggestions shape each story, which comes alive with live music, sound effects and twists.

ec3e2ff7648629492d4d2f70b2e40e157a4922a5.en: MALDOROR at La Comédie de Genève is Julien Gosselin's first visit to the theatre. It links Roberto Bolaño with Lautréamont's Les Chants de Maldoror, asking what literature owes to evil, and premiered at the 2026 Avignon Festival.

1987400fbbd59e6c300896f50927161f4827a763.en: Jeanne, known for Respire fort, plays a solo tour at the Alhambra. The show is intimate and sincere, with doors at 19:00 and the concert at 20:00.

62ebce0ba8ebb2de48da347f4a12355479399c90.en: Clarisse Bardiot of Université Rennes 2 looks at the Avignon Festival archives to study more than 2,000 shows since 1947 by computer. The talk at the Bibliothèque de Genève starts at 16:15 and lasts one hour.

a5c0c7f22197b7bb6373c063eea945f969acffcf.en: AMOR – choisir sans renoncer by Compagnie Marjolaine Minot at the Institut Florimont is a contemporary tragicomedy about a couple. A man and a woman try to reinvent their story, and the show lasts 1 hour 15.

31ebe079fd8f65bc968f71d88c5fd6cb2528b155.en: Smile at La Cité Bleue sees soprano Sabine Devieilhe leave opera heroines behind for cabaret, café-concert and musical theatre. Songs by Poulenc, Satie, Sondheim and Piaf are staged by Laurent Pelly with the ensemble I Giardini.

a9fe4c1c90185f4ac8759c920ebc764a889bbbc7.en: Daniel Harding conducts Debussy's Prelude to The Afternoon of a Faun and La Mer, then Lili Boulanger's Faust et Hélène at the Victoria Hall. Mezzo-soprano Fleur Barron and tenor Andrew Staples sing, and Boulanger was the first woman to win the Prix de Rome.

910796545b832d7c391487bf12a16f303cd85952.en: Fête des mères at the Espace Vélodrome is a two-part theatre evening. A stand-up comedian returns to her family on Mother's Day, then a romantic tragicomedy follows, set three days before a wedding.

bec1b0052eb5b6861ecbd571bae1f7d1726c556b.en: Une Ville à Soi at the Théâtre du Grütli is an immersive sound piece set in 2075, built from testimonies gathered in the neighbourhoods. Two guides lead the audience through a city seen from a woman's point of view, in a pop-up show.

7f1c7a542a7b070f453468ae6deb09988a864e74.en: Adèle Castillon, 24, plays the Alhambra with her first album, which tells of a breakup and of dependence. Her music, with producer Surkin, moves between French pop and influences from Taxi Girl to Billie Eilish.

19aa9f11a17d50247dcbf83f3a7ac16fe6d48bb6.en: The Peace Philharmonic and Nikolay Khozyainov, as pianist and conductor, play Brahms's First Piano Concerto and Fourth Symphony at the Victoria Hall. It is the orchestra's spring concert.

c0b611f9ca0b056aa27414c23844b9452d682c92.en: Oesch's die Dritten, a Swiss folk group, celebrates 30 years with an anniversary tour at the Alhambra. The afternoon show runs from 15:00 to about 17:45 with an interval, and is open from age 3.

e0b6454d681e4ad6fb790286697c80b369d7d68f.en: Deep Democracy by the Close-Up ensemble, made of amateur musicians and Ensemble Contrechamps members, is a collective creation. It is inspired by an inclusive decision-making method that gives minority voices more weight.

13463b2e682bbf73d548b52646b27d17ce4af202.en: C'est beaucoup de petits poissons... by Cédric Djedje is a docu-fiction for ages 11 to 19 at Saint-Gervais. It explores Berlin's Afrikanisches Viertel, where 25 street names honour Germany's colonial past.

c6a77f5ca2539c7df439e7583c00e54b61f62b81.en: À l'article de la mort at La Comédie de Genève is a tense play set in a newspaper newsroom close to bankruptcy. A new editor refuses to publish an investigation into a controversial play, and the work closes Adrien Barazzone's Trilogie des systèmes.

f0e73e080c4d0ff958e132305d21cd4b08580db0.en: Forma, a Valais humorist and singer, tells her story in her first solo show, Formats. She dreamed of recognition and glamour, and the show looks at fame with frankness and humour, at the Salle Communale in Onex.

1d459fdf9d78e10e26ab0817e0e0a9f6448f8915.en: CinéClubturel shows 2001: A Space Odyssey by Stanley Kubrick at the Bureau culturel. The film, of 2 hours 29, is part of the Humans vs AI season, with a discussion on HAL 9000 and pizza included.

1cb120aaa9153dfe34c5853a925794ac0dab0376.en: HUITANTE at the Théâtre LE POCHE marks Yvette Théraulaz's 80th birthday. The actress and singer tells her life story on stage, linking her career to the struggles of women for their rights.

f520fdbaa8d7f7039f4dfff7404a7bb4b7d8dd76.en: Yulianna Avdeeva plays Bach's Chromatic Fantasy and Fugue, Beethoven's Appassionata and Ravel's Pavane and La Valse at the Victoria Hall. The programme is a solo piano recital.

5bcd91e49ced4d0ce63db80ba0558e289244ac2e.en: Jésus Triste at the Théâtre du Grütli follows a group of bus fare-dodgers. They look for a way out of a system that crushes individuals, using twisted words and parables.

478398a255d6cd6f2a0685bc860c3fa05d6f9208.en: Voltaire et l'Encyclopédie at Les Délices is a free one-hour visit in French with cultural mediator Lucas Arpin. It looks at the Encyclopédie of Diderot and d'Alembert, and at Voltaire's contributions to it.

6911c69661fcac8c064f8e4e80f21de608fdbef3.en: Geminus, by Catherine Lamb at the Salle communale de Plainpalais, is a piece for twenty musicians. Its tuning follows a precise protocol based on just intonation, and it is co-commissioned by Contrechamps and Ensemble Dedalus.

eebdf37d8428e068bdf450ff6d975881c972fb2c.en: Snatam Kaur's Living Light at the Alhambra is a devotional concert by the Grammy-nominated singer. Mantras and reflections are shared with her musicians Ram Dass, Bruno Justi and Sukhmani.

58297340ef6d74d6b7b171d150214802dd5a515d.en: Press Start: Explorations numériques n°2 at the Villa Tacchini is a day of digital culture, with video game tournaments, Swiss games and meetings. It is run with the association Wunderbard and is open to all ages.

ce6e13a1d63fb5ba512eba2b5b4b812737eb1719.en: Ladies First, by the Geneva Brass at the Espace Madeleine, celebrates its 25th anniversary with women who shaped its history. Five women and five men perform works by Berlioz, Koetsier and Gilloz.

d6fb624472258f63275d7a737d3900d84bdc0213.en: A Sunday chamber concert at the Conservatoire at 11:00, with OSR musicians. It features music by Lili Boulanger, Amy Beach, Mel Bonis and Germaine Tailleferre, composers who stayed in the shadows for a long time.

cfc50bc8729f4b544ce4a6a79bf19f737de47032.en: L'Amour de l'Art by Stéphanie Aflalo at Saint-Gervais is a comic lecture by two eccentric art historians, played by Aflalo and Antoine Thiollier. They revisit classic paintings with deliberate clumsiness and playful image-making.

0716ee0b9ab13f8927cbf820c3b17c304421dfbf.en: The permanent exhibition on astronomy in the Observatory building. Booking a guide adds the old observation towers and a planetarium show to the visit.

c466337f606d17c717a701a6e4df00db7b0baa50.en: An exhibition at the Museum of Technology on how technology and industry have shaped Finland, from the home to infrastructure, production and recycling.

ce370d13f4b098b53d76d9d8e9c10ce29c96538c.en: Early 20th-century paintings from the Sigurd Frosterus Foundation Collection in Amos Rex's Frosterus Hall, with strong colour and works by Magnus Enckell and Alfred William Finch.

35f2b479d6b399ec23914f60fc03fceb4a0ad50d.en: An interactive exhibition for children aged 5 to 9 at the Museum of Technology, where they learn about inventions through play and tasks, then switch on the Ghost's Invention Device.

f9d9c6d0049ea007a2f22acde47103359d13ca59.en: The Sinebrychoff family's historic town house, on permanent display at the Sinebrychoff Art Museum. Entry is free.

5b3345342dd5518968fb0d5d90c832668f41c44d.en: A sports exhibition at the Tahto centre, using audiovisual stories from the Helsinki Olympic Games to e-sports, athletics, Formula One and ice hockey.

7d84416ff35adfc94dbd6a8b59b63f88296971bd.en: A collection exhibition at Ateneum that reflects on present-day questions through art, and on how Finland's oldest and largest art collection was built.

dfd8424d15a48996edb6fac45ac37530478e3994.en: An escape-room style game played across the whole Rikhardinkatu library. It runs on a web page reached by QR code, needs no download and suits all ages.

83cb6e03bdeb8522603353fde6ef3ffbd897e19b.en: "Voices from the Plague", an audio drama set in the Old Church Park in 1710. It is free through the Echoes app in Finnish, Swedish and English, and runs until the end of 2026.

e42ed66c81d012eaa55ae53f334a82440cfbd2a8.en: The Tove Jansson Gallery at HAM, across three halls, with its first show on the Jansson family of artists. It marks 80 years of "Comet in Moominland".

8808ccd6a3681655f44b4de5996b0c7af9bb1654.en: A collection exhibition at Kiasma of about 40 artists, including Cindy Sherman and Bruce Nauman, built around the idea of dreams.
