c3d4c44046df6ec3a83e685b293c8c0bca993bbb.en: A display on Anna Sinebrychoff, a 19th-century Helsinki businesswoman who led her family's brewery and was known for her charity work.

18b019a561e5936c760f8334684dad951a971905.en: A touring exhibition on handmade glass, which UNESCO recognises as intangible heritage, with glassmaking from Suomenlinna and works by Heikki Kallio.

495ab994bb81b43fcb586458f99cf914bd9db16b.en: The opening show in HAM's new collection space, pairing Mauno Markkula's 1940s and 1950s landscapes with Petri Ala-Maunus's recent paintings.

808ed19c5aa8b5f6c33c5be415b0055b11b65997.en: A space at the Museum of Technology on the history, principles and debates around artificial intelligence. It is updated regularly with experts.

683cc849f464d6a849e16004aabd3f19bda4f031.en: A small exhibition at Tamminiemi of paper dolls by Rauni Palonen, drawn for Apu magazine from 1968 to 1982, showing celebrities of the Kekkonen era.

f3e959b25fdba8c38c16803de8b4fec48192df65.en: A puzzle game in Esplanade Park, where players decipher a hidden message among the statues of writers, from May to October 2026.

6304b72358f0be6d65964a1487be06934b749529.en: A family exhibition at the Media Museum and Archives Merkki, where visitors follow the story of Puss in Boots through puzzles and challenges. Entry is free.

e320aedd5cd164976238baf5ee4528e1233ad578.en: An exhibition on pollinators at the Natural History Museum, with interactive games, bingo and specimens. It is based on a non-fiction book.

e56060ac2bd5d798cd61cd3425a55e7634a25dbc.en: A location-based puzzle game in the Old Church Park, known as Plague Park, from 22 May to 31 October 2026. It is free and uses five puzzles across the park.

874f78b9f97d7ed9f864860782e5b72a8ce98601.en: An exhibition on the Aaltos' architecture and design through the lens of wellbeing, with drawings, furniture and a calm Aalto Lounge.

2e4c064d81456f308a1b537cfc9f4745c2695a3a.en: Library books lent and read on a library bus at a playground in Maunula, on two dates in June and July. Bring your own library card.

f682ba9289e44514da996628c799abe7f9af60ee.en: "Lady T" at the Finnish National Theatre's Small Stage, a new drama about Margaret Thatcher and an underpaid hotel worker. It is in Finnish and runs 2 hours 5 minutes with an interval.

5460ae2d210c5ee6d9d56a77d0609d6b28b325fb.en: "Toinen tasavalta" at the National Theatre's Main Stage, a 2026 play on Finland's postwar years, with Urho Kekkonen at its centre. It is in Finnish and runs 2 hours 45 minutes.

aa59ec3923b372496660622a9c597445b921d76e.en: The first show in the Modern Classics series at Ateneum, on the 20th-century artist Elga Sesemann, with works from the national collections.

505c0c0302564d5371f6a7e9da5cff2002d5b01b.en: A first solo show in Helsinki by South African-born artist Daniel Kruger, with jewellery and ceramics that mix nature, history and everyday objects. Entry is free.

4bf1eb511e9560c603ec34dd374e1d39065da0a6.en: Paintings by Heli Heikkinen of Helsinki and everyday life, shown at the Tauko gallery in Myllypuro Senior Centre from 26 August to 22 October 2026.

7cb49cf71b66a9fb5196b3742087cf23d5360b34.en: An audiovisual concert at Kiasma Theatre, combining Sámi yoiks by Ánnámáret with electronic music and video. The ticket includes Kiasma's exhibitions that day.

46ab68b44217a3419a9a1a6bb1cebddb7562fbcf.en: "Orvot", a new Finnish-language play at the National Theatre's Taivassali, about two orphaned brothers whose lives change when a stranger arrives. Premieres 2 September 2026.

d9f301aadae955cbc92527f8ad2e536c708fb487.en: Johan Eichhorn's staged photographs move forest roads and drained wetlands into domestic spaces, asking why we accept such changes in nature. At the Natural History Museum until January 2027.

aab2fc8ad6aac109324742a6597194628ed7c775.en: A wooden pavilion called Darkness Library Suomenlinna at Levyhalli, which gathers local knowledge about darkness. It is free and runs until 25 October 2026.

3717569b02b855e559f4637e9ecf5c6498376c45.en: Free evenings of mantra and music with Karuna Flow, held on Thursdays at Oulunkylä Seurahuone as part of the Night of Arts.

aa19ae1bed7bbf4e61b7d2c2e17e85c73c18c962.en: Weekday morning activities for families at the Maunula playground, from 10:15, including climbing, art, music and outdoor play. Not held during school holidays.

aa2997373b6f3e9cd6105b2155570d83a2fab0dc.en: Outdoor activities at the Nurkka playground. The weekly schedule is posted on the park's social media and at the park itself.

c1de36c4bd9c827799277821615735424063deb7.en: A traffic town at the Nurkka playground where children can practise scooting and cycling, and learn some traffic rules. The yard is shared with a school.

c7378ed28069eb7419d28afd00e5264373402bc0.en: Sculptures by Isabella Chydenius on safer-space club culture and queer nightlife, shown at MUU Window from 10 September to 1 November 2026. Free and open 24/7.

62c6c55eabb62139e5fb8fb7ea627ae0c0841104.en: A large textile mandala, made over a summer by a group led by Lidia Kivinen, now hangs in the Charlotta hall of Oulunkylä Seurahuone.

88772d12f6930d7f847dab9beb3512270aee8748.en: An exhibition on painter Elin Danielson-Gambogi's self-portraits and her identity as a woman and artist, at the Didrichsen Art Museum until January 2027.

c9130b5c3dd5a820ed9b2d58b75f0acf4861f2f0.en: "Viidakon villit naiset", a satirical reality-TV-style play at the National Theatre's Main Stage, with a premiere on 16 September 2026. It runs until 19 December.

c7746dc2805b0c86d018164ac35f3bcb836a73b3.en: "Lopetus", a stage version of Imre Kertész's Nobel-winning novel, following a publisher's search for a lost manuscript. It is at the National Theatre's Small Stage from 15 September to 19 December 2026.

f26614114a4692c8825234606f0345ea838a00ba.en: The University of Helsinki's Art Room moves to the Flame exhibition centre this autumn, with plaster casts and works by former students. Drawing from the casts is included in museum admission.

ec7344cab4f8f877217b282e862bd03801ad28ed.en: A weekly Monday baby-and-parent meetup at Playground Ida, from 10 to 11, with guided activities such as food painting and singing.

7c784906e92cea241060135c94e12ec0ce941b57.en: A Tuesday play session at Playground Ida, from 10 to 11, with changing yard games, an obstacle course and movement activities.

70fa8de33a63361af680923298c601316446446a.en: Paintings by Mathias Withoos and other members of the Bentvueghels, the Dutch and Flemish artists' group in Rome. The show runs at the Sinebrychoff Art Museum until January 2027.

2c9e4906af8379e035f6c1d791dd91389150966a.en: "Sivuraide", a Finnish-language play at the National Theatre's Small Stage, about two former sweethearts who meet again on a train. It runs 2 hours 15 minutes including an interval.

de49e2f4412c519ea3770d734632133750f36fee.en: A photo series by actress and photographer Zsuzsa Hullan, showing the behind-the-scenes life of theatre, at the Liszt Institute from 25 September to 6 November. Entry is free.

eaeb17241cf571239e5e2e10d74044f1f817c45e.en: "For Organ and Pause" by Antti Tolvi, a long-running sound installation and performance with an organ and beds, open at HAM until January 2027.

cf14a93381479f9783ec787673b2a8f9b4162301.en: A book sale at Oulunkylä Library until 23 December. Books cost 0.50 euros, or three for one euro, and only card payment is accepted.

a6e8ecfedfa627270c3f6af30cb2b0604f23860e.en: "Vaikenemisen kielioppi", a visual theatre piece about LGBTQ+ people's lives in Russia, staged at Vuosaari Tilajakamo from 29 September to 4 November. It is for ages 16 and up.

96605f84fd8caea0c826f534f2998edfbfc19efd.en: An October art exhibition at Kontula Senior Centre, open only to pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

73ddd81683083553e00617f9141119daba9f4f0f.en: "Helios", a seven-metre model of the Sun by Luke Jerram, at Helsinki Cathedral in October. It combines solar imagery with a specially made sound piece. Admission is 8 euros.

b474d00cf3a1fe81d5ee13476638dba6165e18f5.en: A family space adventure through October around Luke Jerram's Helios, with art, space questions and activities. It has a short route at the Cathedral and a longer one to the Old Church.

28275118348447ad04a8a2ee46443de04a9daedd.en: Paintings by a Helsinki artist and art teacher at Arabianranta Library, on people, nature and change.

252a7b5149fde6a942fcce94d2558e44dfaf8eb3.en: Paintings by Katri Hirsimaa at Suomenlinna Library, which take statues, flowers and landscapes seen on journeys and give them new meaning.

411b212e31cc37414b679f8487ac0732408cf44c.en: A Thursday coffee meetup at Playground Ida, where families with young children can meet and practise Finnish.

3713239412898cd0474ac0ae7d61d8e8056295bb.en: Unna Nguyen's "Ốc-tober", about 31 snail paintings made for an Inktober challenge in 2023. The title is a play on the Vietnamese word for snail.

f05b37790c3f2947e32da5951baca287e6dc7d51.en: Photographer Valeria Azovskaya's first move into painting and handmade techniques, shown at Kallio Library. Her photographs serve as the starting point for the new work.

16fa0da23c07677094885ef10f1907619f9410b5.en: Photographs by Anne Heinonen from a South African monkey sanctuary, where primates relearn how to be monkeys after life in captivity. Shown at Kallio Library from 2 to 30 October.

6e02b390a24c313a3c171435dfded44e200afd24.en: Around fifty photographs by more than twenty Kameraseura photographers on the theme of War, Peace, Love. It is free and open daily at Galleria West from 2 to 30 October.

1a53d441542a44064dda455adf423df5734b16ba.en: An exhibition of 44 artworks by pupils of Maunula Primary School, showing their neighbourhoods and everyday places. It is shown in the lobby gallery of Maunula House.

2de623d589b87efd85f1bae9d96198af0485f558.en: "On Fear and Evil", a 25-minute short film by Alisa Javits that combines anonymous interviews about fear and violence. It is shown at Forum Box from 2 to 25 October. Entry is free.

7ef1338d8e4fae4068bb079b055433e72b4346ea.en: "Going Nowhere", a show of steel and aluminium sculptures by Eetu Huhtala, some of them mechanical, that explore division and distance. It is at Forum Box from 2 to 25 October.

e3a0fefd8ba407d6dce3eaed668c4052e429db17.en: The Finnish Painters' Union's Autumn Salon, with 183 paintings covering the walls of tm-galleria from 2 to 22 October. Works are also online and can be bought.

9be6bbf72561f0c04826125a9c6ab8abe85bb517.en: A family Halloween event at Puotila Manor, where more than a thousand jack-o'-lanterns light the courtyard from 2 October to 1 November.

8f48aa5f59a2f9da5ab398d9fe5f50a9088629cf.en: Viivi Prokofjev's "Chop Chop", the Graphic Designer of the Year 2026 exhibition at Luonnos Gallery. Its performance of chopping vegetables runs for a month, with the opening on 2 October.

d433837904036688ba5441db174aa4cc10d76153.en: Forest photographs by Sanna Siirilä at Malmi Library from 1 to 30 October.

ce83fddb36f84b1ce83f139dd6fc919d95716380.en: A projection of Igor Lora Romero's animation "Developing Bodies in Space" on the first-floor walls of Oodi, from 5 to 30 October. It explores the link between body and mind.

cfaa001f7b2185238a1ebe5a9dbcd65e2d2b02bc.en: A sewing workshop at Saunabaari where people make practical items from materials on hand this autumn. Before Christmas, the items go to a hospital for patients.

082f47bb2f39629e40d61387ed875b5ac2031b74.en: Self-portraits by young people aged 15 to 29 from the Sankarit activity for young people with disabilities, shown at Lauttasaari Library.

b78b6ae091ac8b03aaafd370a7b1e3364668fa3f.en: Krista Kemppainen's "2nd Chance", a set of fruit paintings made on top of older practice canvases, at Kallio Library.

cd040e3322aa8a1d2374fbb1772f824150e459c8.en: Nina Orell's exhibition at Pasila Library, with two collections of paintings inspired by nature, forest textures and quiet.

a939d22a64f745deab07a60bdc860cb469d040b9.en: A four-part workshop series for tourism businesses on making their services more appealing and climate-friendly, using the Climate-Smart Business Toolkit. The first session is on 8 October at Scandic Simonkenttä.

7b4d49a2c77c8fa6a586245968bece9d7b7c3982.en: Daniel Arsham's "Prometheus Bound" at Makasiini Contemporary from 9 October to 13 November. His sculptures resemble eroded artefacts, and the opening is on 8 October.

9cae701e1dee732e7a325ebd44363ffe55b1114f.en: "The Whole Nation's Lions", an exhibition on the people and moments of Finnish ice hockey, at the TAHTO centre in the Olympic Stadium, from 9 October 2026 to 29 August 2027.

0fc31a249cc8c6b2e363a9291a714d14ba061c8c.en: "Like a Prayer", an exhibition of Emma Ainala's paintings from the past ten years, mostly of women and girls in nature or enclosed rooms, with references to pop culture and art history. It is at Kiasma.

a70d61c0e115abba65f2302b00d685d880d3f9ad.en: "You Are Not the Centre", a show by Emma Talbot at HAM with silk paintings, textiles and drawings, and an animation that puts humans back among other living things. It runs until April 2027.

9c25854f352566f88bc47cf4bb7663540dea8c74.en: "Misfit", the first joint show of Leena Luostarinen's monumental paintings from the 1980s and 1990s, from HAM's collection. It runs until April 2027.

11a2422ebf98887f7ce88f65911c5204e701ba49.en: "Tutankhamun: The Immersive Exhibition", on its first visit to Finland, with 360-degree projections, a VR journey and replicas of the treasures. It is at Malmi Ice Hall until 24 January 2027, for ages 6 and up.

d677cb8a6b17c6e043a31fdf6f1bada20f17a389.en: A selection of about 50 works from the Sampo Group's art collection, including 19th-century landscapes and Finnish Golden Age paintings, at Villa Gyllenberg until 14 February 2027.

f7244d8e209ecbc51906855214e2aec9dcb737bf.en: A short show by Jokér Kaké at Galleria Kookos from 13 to 24 October, with the opening on 13 October at 18:00. Entry is free.

d78d8ce6ea306c3ecdc09a81dcc125d7fcfe3775.en: Jyrki Tammi's paintings, based on textures from nature such as water, sky and ice, shown in the downstairs space of Galleria Kookos from 13 to 24 October. The space invites quiet and a pause from everyday noise.

bc6784625088ef19f8f49afb3293bbc8fec955e6.en: Amos Rex's main autumn exhibition, made with Southnord, brings together 11 artists from the Afro-Nordic diaspora and the African continent, with nearly 60 works. It runs from 14 October 2026 to 21 March 2027.

5d2be5487ca23f04076927134d423a96495f4d24.en: "If you ask us", a play by the Finnish National Youth Theatre, a group of young theatre makers from several countries. It runs at the National Theatre's Small Stage from 14 October to 2 November, for ages 12 and up.

8bb44d3c9068e7b9bbbac81f89ad07f5089eccaa.en: A group show at The Blue Verve on superstition, with nine artists exploring omens, rituals, dreams and numbers. It runs from 15 to 25 October, and entry is free.

f312a4d4fc2593c1bf8095ab93ddf3086984dbd3.en: Antti Jussila's small assemblages at Photographic Gallery Hippolyte, which run alongside Gertrude Stein's "Tender Buttons" and Charlotte Perkins Gilman's "The Yellow Wallpaper". It is free, from 16 October to 15 November.

0d880e6246b306dde2734d23fae02a2515e4e60a.en: "Landscape of Traces" by Wanda and Naomi Holopainen at Photographic Gallery Hippolyte, on archives, memory and what is carried across generations. Entry is free, from 16 October to 15 November.

c48c20452a3a8e7e4ad5681ecea94da0b44674fd.en: "Chim*" by Salla Myllylä and Sari Palosaari, video and sculpture inspired by the town of Kemi in Sea Lapland. It is part of MUU's 2026 programme "Where is the North", and entry is free.

6fba85f66a40e7d4d0b343a88a62d9fa6a6bde6e.en: "Roots en Route", a multi-sensory installation at Kaisaniemi Botanic Garden about rootedness and displacement, with soundscape, scent and drawings. It runs from 18 October 2026 to 10 January 2027.

a340828cd9926138392213374b9ba6d2bbf92f34.en: Self-service weaving at Kinapori Senior Centre, on two looms, for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card. Slots are booked from a waiting list, and a fee applies for the warp.

d7e9a00a47e7a27f5a2123a82433dd45bc7a6a3e.en: A week of free digital help at Oodi, from 19 to 23 October, where a city digital adviser helps with phones, tablets, computers and online services. Personal slots can be booked in advance.

e70068175a062a1df25e71adc44f0fb7724ff8a9.en: A sign-up for the Christmas market at Kinapori Senior Centre, with 15 stall places. Stalls are drawn on Monday 2 November and cost 10 euros, with proceeds going to the residents. Only handmade goods can be sold.

2fd8c6409be5baba291c375cb333134c27000a88.en: A first Finnish exhibition of handmade textile and surface designs by Shaista Malik, a self-taught Pakistani artist, at Oulunkylä Library. The opening is on 21 October from 13:00 to 15:00.

d81de555a064c7837ea9d9ef6574d589c94a900e.en: A songwriting club for children aged 10 to 14, held at Oodi on Wednesdays from 21 October to 2 December. Small groups write a song from start to finish, and it can be performed at Oodi's children's party on 6 December.

50d645e3e910644070f3d5a74e1fc106723f773f.en: A table tennis session at Kamppi Service Centre, for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

41ae861adb7b3dcf44ea2f113b183287841b1cae.en: A one-hour introduction to the gym equipment at Riistavuori, suited to people new to strength training. Places are booked from the notice board list or by phone.

5067f82a63b131a3254d686d7b4d71e69899eeb1.en: A gym induction at Jakomäki Service Centre, after which members can train on their own. It is compulsory, and you need a service centre card and a chip card such as an HSL travel card.

b55b144b085a350ba2f96f4beaa714b398f359f1.en: A fabric printing session at Kamppi Service Centre, for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

ce64d1e03fe0b59fe10dd0d45e82edb89adeb70a.en: Women's water exercise at Kontula Senior Centre, for pensioners with a valid service centre card. It builds fitness and muscle strength, and booking is by phone.

4dfb16372662b1f422171a93e18b11253008b32f.en: A family café at Playground Linnunrata, where families with babies and toddlers can meet. Food can be warmed and eaten there.

f9cef2d13910e66d4a3c11b258a47d5396fd3e48.en: Story sessions at Pasila Library for children of all ages, on Thursdays at 9:30 this autumn. Groups can book other themes at a time that suits them.

9a01984d1760e037d64ff9a457b7c3504fb1d285.en: Baby mornings at Playground Viiri for crawling and early babies with a parent, with music, movement, crafts and stories. Families can meet each other too.

701172f62429e2ce0d2d0330ebf4332958c3aaba.en: A relaxed baby meetup at Playground Orava for families with babies and parents-to-be, with changing activities. The weekly programme is on the playground's social media.

2e9a3ac343d2ead190b678567f0c8c13f2474cf0.en: Handicraft help at Riistavuori Senior Centre, where an instructor is available during set hours.

55626e4a2399d51d928ebaa780d273c04a7a44f4.en: A story session at Tapulikaupunki Library, with Finnish stories for children under 7 and their parents.

1cc871f7554e80f3ef266699b5b9bb83788065a0.en: Free peer-support groups for retired people who are balancing substance problems, meeting once a week at Roihuvuori for 1.5 hours. No change in lifestyle is needed to join.

3b6774ded4f982f5ea85ec501a8282c136a6fbd2.en: A singing session at Kannelmäki playground with familiar children's songs and theme songs, which supports language and group participation.

795aed9ddaad02fc3cdc2cb197d2dbcfa921e5d1.en: A Thursday movement session at Santahamina playground for young children with an adult. It includes play and running, and the weekly programme is posted on Facebook and Instagram.

4c3310d1532706606f551e700601a83f587d30aa.en: Sewing help at Pihlajamäki community house for hemming, mending or new projects, with sessions on several days a week.

042187594bc4c9d6388b8cbdd7999cb400bf5642.en: A baby meetup for children aged 0 to 1 at Lohikäärmepuisto, with a different theme each time.

ddff22a311937eaafbf4c6adc965550c144a76a6.en: A choir for retired and unemployed people at Kamppi Service Centre. It is free with a service centre card, which is available from the centre.

b84c22f6fdc76ce002deea15915f5700b7271a1a.en: "Taidetorstai", a Thursday crafts session at Munkki playground for young children with an adult. Topics change with the seasons.

3805b43e69ea11601465c29212003bd5bc9124a0.en: Every Thursday at Kontula community house, free porridge and coffee with the newspaper. Everyone is welcome.

705b0b3629b2a93c0dc9d8d33de79cd4017f5b41.en: Baby meetups at Kankarepuisto, open to all families with babies. They include music, movement, crafts and stories with a parent.

1178c034fa655c231c1945ac5bd939accc391221.en: An open brain-teaser session at Kannelmäki service home, with word games and puzzles that change each time. It is for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people, and it is free unless stated.

81eecbd078285e5d6e2026f76f02459d4390959b.en: Free one-to-one digital help from volunteer peer tutors of the Enter association, at Vuosaari Library. Bring your device and the logins you need, and book by phone or at the desk.

7934f7ea5107a98bd5a37e9fd122af23c30282a8.en: A Thursday café at Pihlajisto playground with a "tooth fairy" game and a talk on children's oral health.

2a41eb7dfa27371d1cdd514915d0a02d63e35ceb.en: A pop-up consultation at Kamppi Service Centre by Suvanto ry, on safe close relationships. It can be attended anonymously.

9594736b2c3854c420b4fa84ec3330db31a6c4db.en: A 12-session peer-support group at Kamppi for retired people who feel low or depressed. It has up to 10 members, and each one meets the facilitator before the group starts.

1a9ca41cc73dba0261e9d6ffc602efc84b9a77f6.en: A baby morning at Playground Nuoli from 10:00, with a guided session at 10:30 that includes songs, rhymes and baby massage. Families can warm food and make coffee or tea there.

35c8fd87fd3df49fd77d722276f59ea6ab168919.en: A music session for all ages at Playground Brahe.

2031e73a9ae474cdb369582be1ebcdcbdccbf3d9.en: A Thursday play session at Etupelto playground, where an obstacle course and a hobby-horse course are set up in the yard. Plans can change, so follow the playground's social media.

7c41e0a49ed83965072845f38c86e38a3315d8fd.en: A Thursday crafts session for children aged 0 to 6 and a parent at Lampi playground, with modelling, painting and other crafts. It moves indoors in winter.

1be3c13cecfb876e1068030570f3326ace1ca15b.en: A Thursday family café at Strömberg playground for children and parents, with guided activities at 10:30, language play through stories and songs, and free entry.

c4eeafa3ceef02eda5ee1abe80fbff4264c7d470.en: A music session at Malminkartano youth centre, with singing from 10:30. The door is locked, so ring the bell.

45fe72055e8056e26797678380ec2d51350ec841.en: An indoor family morning at Vähätupa playground, with gentle exercise, singing, crafts and story time, plus space for families to meet and warm their own food.

9c6c7d509f71a24661f7f19477f18907de47cd4a.en: Singing and playing instruments together at Rudolf playground. The weekly schedule is on the playground's social media.

d8aec32afe5e76a2bf882b2c449af5c8dcfc6b8a.en: Yard activities at Trumpetti playground, such as searches, exercise and games with changing equipment. Families can come to play at any time.

784196bf644c373289c0b785dabb3bf9c7f86852.en: A memory-training group at Myllypuro Senior Centre, with word and writing tasks to exercise the brain. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

a055eea6525106e618b1bc0fc92a45e1ec217274.en: A baby morning at Kimmo playground for crawling and early babies with a parent, with music, movement, crafts and stories. Families can also warm food and make coffee or tea there.

e9581b74fbb6343c318f5c6a85df86fe49a8d212.en: A toddler morning at Viikkari playground every Thursday from 10:00 to 11:30, with a guided session at 10:30 mixing play, movement, music and crafts.

40373f4c537557ea8169cadfdaf46966f3478b38.en: The "Tänään tavataan" café at Kipinäpuisto playground, a free meeting place for baby and family groups from different cultures, with Finnish language learning through stories and songs.

3c2d54c6c8c57880515f8bce795d19075e1bdee0.en: A planting session in which families plant flower bulbs in Topelius park. Participants leave from the lobby of Töölö Senior Centre at 10:00.

f7762d4c5508dab92b4329c327658fda6b26bb3c.en: Walk-in digital help at Oulunkylä Seurahuone every weekday, for phones, computers and online services. No booking is needed.

a734c6988fde44062f295b12c9349d9d0e68e163.en: Weekly billiards on Tuesdays and Thursdays at Saunabaari, plus a beginners' billiards group on Wednesdays from 13:30 to 16:45.

5566c8bac4405dc5b25ec73de2b0756420027553.en: A creative session at Tuorinniemi playground. Details are on the playground's noticeboard and on its Instagram and Facebook pages.

fa3c0b057a1847974266b4f7b6aff756b5072029.en: The "Tänään tavataan" café at Mellunmäki playground, a free meeting place for baby and family groups, with Finnish learning through stories and songs.

2dbb7ea0469752a5cf999ad86f6de2aa85d3016f.en: A treasure-trail activity at Arabia playground, following Aapo the Monkey's route around the play area, with a monkey climbing course to try. Parents can meet other families too.

f32b072e1c2ddd8664ad0e541a957f33bf207847.en: Music sessions for families at Kiikku playground, with chants, singing and playing instruments. Parents and children can help plan the activities.

b1b3a6166c8c28ebc5fc745c6c91d47eb578208a.en: A baby morning at Lahnalahti playground, with guided play, movement, rhymes, crafts or music indoors. Details are on the playground's Instagram and noticeboard.

3ae68473d5ede6b033acac0008816d3a6e4ff909.en: A knitting circle at Koskela Senior Centre, for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card, which is available from the reception.

71016ad6b67470e4dc05cd48d94eee0e513164a0.en: Yard activities at Rusthollari playground, with games and movement for families. Parents can meet other families while children play.

e6f37a3af015d8176e4f78477c200fbebb6dddda.en: Guided group walks for older people, on Thursdays from 10:00 to 11:00 from Jätkäsaari Library until 26 November. The walks are free, require no sign-up, and tea or coffee is served afterwards.

776acdce06ad9b1ae6e567a1d929483faadb7535.en: Yard activities for children aged 2 to 5 at Mäkitorppa playground, with obstacle courses, treasure hunts and themed games. The weekly programme is on Facebook and Instagram.

6ba31ca8b1654c1cb89d4437314b47dcccb9f444.en: A chair exercise group at Roihuvuori Youth Centre, for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card. Coffee is served after the session, and there is no class on three listed dates.

8b80e4d57bb9e83e0684877244fdd47d09b61532.en: Free one-to-one help from volunteer peer tutors of the Enter association, who are older people themselves, for computers, tablets and phones at Lauttasaari Library. Bring your device, charger and logins, and book in advance.

7335d003cd360764bae0911f5a3955d0cea9e2e8.en: A Thursday baby meetup at Torpparinmäki playground for babies under one with a parent, from 10:00 to 12:00. Families can bring their own packed food and make tea or coffee.

95e16895f81f39dbdce785b85fbd2f8efe6d5d9c.en: A free, open group at Laajasalo Health Station for pensioners and unemployed people who want brain-training tasks, or who are worried about their memory. It requires a free service centre card.

172e633232e76c4a92316ac0fd766db155e347a5.en: A singing session for everyone at Kivenkolo, with singing, rhymes, playing instruments and dancing. It does not run in the autumn holiday week.

00882f4aa3ab89cfb27e7402a21a8e1edc80ab2f.en: A weekly neighbourhood drop-in in a local club room on Reiherintie, open to everyone in the area for company and chat.

a79b0bf329d289e453f70d6722c488aac1c6cef9.en: A group at Kustaankartano Senior Centre, aimed at reducing loneliness through peer support and varied activities. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

640aef7bb388565c0588d1946fb80e66ab8440ec.en: A Thursday discussion group in Finnish on current affairs for men from different cultures, at Kontula Senior Centre from 10:00 to 11:30. No sign-up is needed.

9ba88034b3a2e9622c6080494c1e5eebd851a67a.en: Indoor baby and toddler meetings with changing activities for families at Kesanto playground.

cf487fd442cf1aeb30f026cfca317109036d602e.en: "Ilo liikkua", a family exercise session at Laurinniitty playground for children and parents, moving indoors in bad weather. It practises basic motor skills with balls and other equipment.

82ecfd804f9c1a3e335cd75ddc7b7d8153cfbcf2.en: A playgroup at Filpus playground with singing, crafts, peer support and time together. Each child gets a club booklet with a stamp for every visit. No sign-up is needed.

6e6c907bf3f176f98236b367421a60b455ec3782.en: A weekly Thursday play session at Roihuvuori playground, where children play with their adults. The schedule changes each week and is posted on Facebook and Instagram.

04576f46f78d353962908447965f3cbd340a6c3f.en: Sewing machines can be booked at Kontula community house, with a maximum of two hours per booking. Bookings are released if not started within 15 minutes.

9fb4225d73ee49cd6bd9bf60693539a7b48c376c.en: A toddler morning at Intia playground, with a guided session from 10:00 for about half an hour, then time for play and packed lunches.

c0e8b40b64ea64694c9f952884dbd086bad5424e.en: A toddler morning at Maasälpä playground, with a guided session from 10:00 whose content changes each week, including songs, rhymes and play.

7fe83705f49b197661d9fcb49e4c4ba0538aeb9a.en: Board and card games at Pihlajamäki community house every Thursday from 10:00 to 11:30. Everyone can learn new games or teach one, and entry is free without sign-up.

15b4f2ff16475c46a9067e32c28eb9e0fb7e62b2.en: Free art and crafts for all ages at Ruoholahti playground. Details of the session are on the playground's Instagram and noticeboard.

fae33dd0d126ab2cf40465c71d8251ddf00d7ec9.en: A singing and rhyme session for children from about one year old with a parent, with no sign-up. Each session lasts 20 to 30 minutes, and younger siblings are welcome.

135ee73115cf268b53ca70681c66dc837d706511.en: A baby morning at Linja playground for crawling and early babies with a parent, with a guided session at 10:15 of songs, rhymes and play.

c829c50038ee00007bc57e60954000c846312e19.en: A chair exercise session for people who use wheelchairs or other aids, at Riistavuori Senior Centre.

1fb2fcc574dcf7a6dd800cf5157d61edf0a62a76.en: A crafts session at Iso-Antti playground, with art and craft activities on changing themes. Families can meet each other and warm their own food.

cab3689bc119f5e5792955a887e718d560a4c71d.en: A music session for all ages at Seppä playground from 10:30 to 11:00. Details are on the playground's Instagram and noticeboard.

542fd0e48d3e38afbfd8c2d30918f8907abe48ee.en: A family meetup at Sahrami family house for all ages on a changing theme, with play, singing and crafts. It is open Monday to Friday from 9 to 16, with changing tables available.

88cac46eda833a01f4b7b512efb69debb571bb71.en: A visit from Äimä ry at Taivallahti playground on 22 October 2026 from 10:30 to 11:30. It shares information on mood changes during and after pregnancy, starting with a short song for babies.

e47d1ac51ec002ac935a09f61a0299722a21308a.en: The Loru playground programme at Oodi for 19 to 23 October, with baby music sessions, gentle exercise, puppet theatre and play for children of all ages. Sessions are held in two languages.

5ce74d4fe92a43638562c42e551a0c2b418618fd.en: Gentle Asahi health exercise at Malmi community house on Thursdays, with soft movements and conscious breathing for all ages and abilities. Groups are limited to 14 people, and no sign-up is needed.

defc326f1e27e307ad3434a7c7af9f0e42c59642.en: A library reading group at Roihuvuori Senior Centre, reading books about animals this autumn. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card, and the library reserves the books in advance.

24c5d35af09b18f2feacf3871dbe0048c71500e1.en: A baby morning at Sanna playground for crawling and early babies with a parent, with music, movement, crafts and stories.

94e0eebaf162e9de17bd97a5cf6e9b572b3ec4d6.en: A German-language group for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card, which has met weekly for several years at Kamppi Service Centre.

4539ac79dfbda98d046aec61a4a3c4d8595af3dd.en: Gentle yoga at Saunabaari on Thursdays, led by a trainee, with a standing yoga class and a seated class, with options for each body.

975f3e74ee847eb3dff7ee53a2c8becc927acfac.en: A group exhibition at Pirkko-Liisa Topelius gallery, from 20 October to 15 November 2026, with works by several artists and Arabia's Art Department. Entry is free.

3410787a667a6c13c2fb1e092e62b9601a0f15e8.en: A free singing group at Kinapori Senior Centre on Thursdays at 11:00, singing folk songs, popular hits and classical favourites, with talk about the songs' memories. No lesson is held on 17 September or in the autumn holiday week.

98008cb044ce4b74c04c1dc2e920dbadb0410aa0.en: A cooking day at Saunabaari every Thursday, starting at 11:00, with plant-based food. Everyone can cook, or come just to eat at 13:00.

07072ae5a32e98a0d383841302a1dfd91d29f20b.en: Tiina Ketara's bead sculptures at Pirkko-Liisa Topelius gallery, from 20 October to 8 November. They include a life-size work inspired by Steinbeck's The Red Pony, and a jumper leaping into the unknown.

b13ce4528a3c1588604744487c64934b78b535ef.en: "Between Earth and Sky", paintings by Heidi Heinonen and Maj Sjö on nature, memory and colour, at Galleria Dromig.

817a386bfaeaba9ff6e4daddc296bf2fb247a60b.en: A monthly meeting for volunteers at Riistavuori Senior Centre, open also to people new to volunteering. Coffee is served.

6865de3ceaec016458d5a9f238db8b572ed176b8.en: A free English speaking club at Alppila community house, hosted by a social services trainee and a volunteer. No registration is needed.

f73e0b39057f20d8553d97fda621f2d0181befd0.en: A Swedish-language discussion group for older people at Töölö Senior Centre, covering current topics and exercises for wellbeing. It is also good for keeping up Swedish.

5e414d539266552e4885f715a8060dff9e3f6eb0.en: Free, personal peer tutoring from Enter ICT Association for Seniors, where older people guide others with digital devices at Oodi.

3a9691c61609fd06635f9a9b25e9b5bf322f2cb0.en: Chat and coffee every Thursday from 11:00 to 12:00 in the youth area of Vuosaari Library. Everyone is welcome, and the library provides the coffee.

d1c511a8f78291b65cff1a357d260be11bb9b5cc.en: A series of talks on the history of Finnish sculpture at the Finnish Adult Education Centre, running from September to November. Entry is free.

298d39d211506cf3a8f5799c2f37cc703d220a93.en: A volunteer-led English conversation club at Pihlajamäki community house on Tuesdays and Thursdays, running from 14 August to 18 December 2026. No sign-up is needed.

e0f6fb6523db60468c32d111277bd953f7703eb1.en: A bowl-sound relaxation session at Lassila community house, in a calm room with mats available. Only comfortable clothes are needed.

76bb1c6f4bd77a7136246705507d9c02f318fc5f.en: A lecture series on Benjamin Britten's operas, including "Peter Grimes" and "Billy Budd", at Munkkiniemi Service Home. No musical background is needed, and there is no lecture in week 42.

4e4310832d6c1b1c31851e647898f446d4b9995f.en: A peer group at Riistavuori Senior Centre with changing activities, a light exercise section and a self-paid lunch. Contact the staff by phone to join.

89f0fb6cdba31b4f9c0cdf06b6be2e76cf2bc12f.en: Free, low-threshold exercise sessions at Riistavuori Senior Centre that improve muscle strength and balance.

a772290dd080f6b009dbb23af62a4ce5415ee108.en: "Moon, no thought of reflection. Water, no thought of reflecting.", Ken Matsubara's first solo show in Finland, with a new site-specific video installation at Helsinki Contemporary. It runs from 2 to 25 October, and entry is free.

6e0e0f91eca8f84b21725276d91625a78a732ab5.en: A peer-support group at Kamppi Service Centre for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

7fbfc1b57b00817545be9cde9c44077ef7e2d134.en: A chair yoga class at Saunabaari on Thursdays, led by a trainee, with a standing yoga class at 10:45 and a seated class at 12:00. Warm socks and comfortable clothes are advised.

5bd381ce9e17bfbdc18f1579a102e06c058a987e.en: Free digital help from volunteers of Enter ry at Pohjois-Haaga library on Thursdays from 12:00 to 14:00 this autumn. Each session is one hour, booked in advance.

e609a1227a65d92970212ba72d8166fe85ba3851.en: Digital help on demand at Myllypuro Library, with a 60-minute session that can be booked online, by phone or at the library. Entry is free.

de35e756ac8d3589b08c228f52968fe0db219795.en: The Myllypuro Senior Centre choir, which rehearses on Thursdays from 12:00 to 14:00. Its only requirement is wanting to sing together, and new singers are welcome.

7bf26cb13c1481ec60670579e7010497a82ddd7d.en: An English chat club at Malmi community house, for people who know the basics and want to practise real conversation. It is informal and not a class, and mistakes are welcome.

fda55eec9996e8f0e06f8ec326acfe48c651158e.en: A free board-game club at Kustaankartano Senior Centre for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

5661539da88942c66bca123f0ba870b4df9618c6.en: A half-hour chair exercise session at Alppila community house, with movements guided by Helsinki's senior exercise videos. Light clothing is recommended.

f8b673a06e76bf74045f4b219314cac81756a9ec.en: Digital help from older volunteers at Kinapori Senior Centre, with bookings in advance and Swedish-language help available.

f882aaed7013630d1101400f754ce373e930cc59.en: Swedish-language employment advice at the Kamppi office on Thursdays, with no appointment needed. It helps customers, who are entitled to Swedish-language services by law, with work-related matters.

f6897cd2d46e6874449cfa29a960f0afa24bed94.en: A casual morning chat group at Jakomäki Library on current topics, with coffee and tea served. Everyone is welcome.

3e136bdf651c39e193f9c3605ae8dcc43b922f6d.en: A crafts group at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

56b4306dd2f06422cb4f737b37b2ab4fd3962290.en: A digital skills group at Kamppi Service Centre, where participants learn together. Sign up in advance at the desk, and a free service centre card is required.

d4feabe23df5b3879b77305c6fbb9b2790d78f33.en: A relaxed bingo evening for all ages at Lassila community house, with prizes for winners.

ebd246829475cd1fa229372ac5bf081081e9c7a1.en: An open poetry group that meets on Mondays in Oulunkylä, led by Marjut.

6e714b1cbfbf00cdea274bcd3d16f3a5a64c046f.en: An open sewing workshop at Alppila community house, with sewing machines and overlockers. A volunteer instructor gives advice on Monday and Thursday afternoons but does not sew for you.

90916a210797b5eee41c0fb057ee01595128b35b.en: A memory-training group at Itäkeskus Service Centre, with memory games, quizzes and conversation. It is for Helsinki pensioners with a free service centre card.

6095fb7722de42fdb24e436c24b880f360cae0b5.en: A social bridge group at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

18d8bc2dd1d1e1f0ccfb603b29439821ebe9902c.en: A group singing session with accompaniment at Töölö Senior Centre, singing familiar songs together.

ffdc6e5b09a4b1664071cfa19210a4e0cf0ef8b8.en: A peer group for people with a memory-illness diagnosis at Kannelmäki Service Home. Activities include brain exercises, music and reminiscence, and sign-up is by phone.

26aa663be82d603b7b757ca91e4e15d2ba389e49.en: Samba card games every Thursday at Myllypuro Senior Centre, for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

ef04d6e7097e86fc20604f2fce7dc16ae5ef32f4.en: Table tennis on Mondays and Thursdays afternoons at Saunabaari, in a relaxed atmosphere for all players.

16040f2fa2b6c26e94e378984d77f02e3959b3bd.en: A knitting and crochet group making blankets for residents of a service home. Patterns and materials are provided by the house.

23416b0f778c58f0b23ebc6be39f169db13974e5.en: An open poetry group at Malmi community house for beginners and experienced writers who enjoy poetry.

e2a5692f0de56be3d7de91809179c3a4071bbd20.en: A crafts club at Roihuvuori Senior Centre, where people bring their own projects or ask a volunteer for tips. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

a71926e6fedc6e0a851474939dd84e4fe7f37c4a.en: A free group singing session at Pohjois-Haaga Senior Centre every week in the canteen, with folk songs, hits and classical favourites. There is no lesson in autumn holiday week 43.

dcfbcd2af8584d1f3da9afefa2f702f5403e47f0.en: A low-threshold multicultural meeting place at Kamppi Service Centre, where people try out crafts together. No skills or Finnish is needed.

ad24198f2a9614aeb5c45a8ee501630c092e2bfe.en: A popular bingo session run by volunteers at Alppila community house, with small prizes for winners.

5bab15593db925747d6164ecd8a4913fcf72523c.en: A record club at Pihlajamäki community house that listens to all kinds of music and discusses it, with themed and request sessions.

d1f9bf64ad4db10102d7d3fefa60dadc399317d9.en: A play and movement space for children at Sahrami family house, with an obstacle course for crawling and toddling children. The house is open Monday to Friday from 9 to 16.

7d09875ab2f1901dc1bfb08ec375d72aa3d90c98.en: A free chair exercise group at Jakomäki Library on Thursdays from 13:30 to 14:15, suited to older people and people with mobility limitations. No sign-up is needed.

122fa122241e9c2898c1c1dc1cf862b7a5eb858c.en: A free peer group for first-time mothers at Kajuutta family house, with half of the sessions guided and the group later continuing on its own. Coffee or tea is served at the first meeting.

fc8f0828e7c20d29f29cc72b01361823d8aa1d9a.en: A talk series on the Roman roots of European cities, covering Paris, Cologne, Vienna, Budapest and London. Entry is free, with no sign-up required.

b824ef22af832c522d38f034eb2c7f97c59e8f78.en: An accordion singing group at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

0f5bee52f1d0cf4ab1dad3b99411e1c7a32bf70f.en: A singing and karaoke evening at Oulunkylä Seurahuone, where people pick a favourite song and join in with audience requests.

6e400e33232ff94b0a99dac1b00f2e0a0219e443.en: An open, ongoing crafts workshop at Lassila community house on changing themes, such as jewellery, paper flowers and felt figures. No experience is needed.

3d4da9e6ce0b399f75b12674c607fd8c8e2d26c2.en: Free peer help from Enter ry for older people with computers, tablets and phones at Itäkeskus Library. Bring your device, charger and logins.

0365385442272e71048e8e098f8ed29cf7190f36.en: A weekly Thursday club for schoolchildren at Itäkeskus Library, with changing themes, crafts, films and guided games. No sign-up is needed.

e07e5d7b4dfb16007a67bb67dba6b604064b7950.en: A Thursday club for schoolchildren at Jätkäsaari Library, with crafts, drawing, board games and word art, planned around what the children want. Library staff lead the activities.

609035bf19fa6e27cb67b647088808ef5a4a357e.en: A free Thursday crafts session at Roihuvuori Library from 14:00 to 15:00, making things from recycled materials. No sign-up is needed and there is no age limit.

1674a22c0adc4fe599f006e75129d4e395cab185.en: A language café at Kontula community house, where people learn Finnish and Arabic over coffee. It is led by a worker from the Finland-Syria Society.

96b05f78f6726e242d8e9923a7b16cccc2dd65d5.en: Free, unbooked peer help from Enter ry for computers, tablets and phones at Oulunkylä Library. Bring your device, charger and logins for the services you want to practise.

8f85f04f3ab6de83bde8554ad315d4731238675b.en: A language café at Malminkartano Library on Thursdays from 14:00 to 15:30, for practising Finnish and discussing current topics. Entry is free.

f461fbc313dd4fb202309517947a5c1f60ba72fb.en: A free group singing session at Roihuvuori Senior Centre with folk songs, hits and classics, and talk about the songs' memories. There is no lesson in autumn holiday week 42.

99c3719d129688b3a9a478416a9c23eeccf11353.en: A peer-support group at Kamppi Service Centre for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card, covering mental wellbeing, life management and substances.

be00f510d5653102f05dba9ae66228314f957817.en: A card-game group at Koskela Senior Centre, mostly playing Skip-Bo but open to other card games. It is the clients' own group.

51bafe4a72d2d2c862ebd507b6c7589166200852.en: A monthly afternoon book club at Kannelmäki Library, on Thursdays from 14:30 to 15:30 in the Tempo space. Titles include novels by Musso, Supinen and King.

fcb260d5d91548d75cd9883e3b764ee9f5c0ebdf.en: A coffee meeting at Alppila community house where people share ideas for the house's future activities. Listeners are welcome too.

7b57d3b5e133174c4b3f7458dd6ad98b53c8e757.en: A coffee meeting at Kontula community house where people share ideas and help shape future activities. Listeners are welcome, and light refreshments are served.

c65b947e761aaa1abc96a34ff4b74e15e16f4a7f.en: Shared art sessions at Alppila community house, working with watercolours, charcoal and collage. The sessions are led by social work students.

97e006431305174facda848b90a475ec4dd9e821.en: A Finnish conversation group at Malmi Library about everyday topics. Your Finnish does not need to be fluent, but some basics help.

4fc40c5fb554a192ebdf73118fc82e1e212d9308.en: A comic-making club at Jakomäki Library, mainly for pupils in grades 3 to 6 and open to older pupils too. It meets every Thursday except in autumn break until late November, with no sign-up.

0c5ff63376ed6af0ca245e1ff37bb0f3df44bbf0.en: A free Winnie-the-Pooh 100th anniversary party at Munkkiniemi Library on Thursday 22 October from 16:00 to 19:00, with bilingual storytimes, crafts, a bee treasure hunt and biscuits.

5bc9e13d8b89c72efefb9ef51ca78631609a71de.en: A book club at Töölö Library on Thursdays from 16:30 to 18:00, reading "En handfull vind", "Tre äpplen föll från himlen", "Rent hus" and "Hoppets tåg". The group is full, and a waiting list is kept.

47575cdad1d5b1e59d0e70199d8a59c4cd03981b.en: An Arabic language café at Oodi on Thursdays from 16:30 to 18:00, from 3 September to 3 December. It is free and suited to people with some Arabic already.

a43efd45a88b7bfeb6e878042270248984497545.en: A two-part lecture series on the history of money, from Mesopotamian credit to the Bretton Woods system. The autumn lectures run on Thursdays in September and October, and entry is free.

2c0e1556f7b8efe2bac52f89facb75af637c0a53.en: A Thursday lecture series on the Byzantine Empire, from its views in Constantinople and Rus' to the Crusades. Entry is free, with no sign-up.

6572f5d5c071fad0a8a1bd6a199b8ede9e3cdcb2.en: A lecture series on how Helsinki's nature has changed over the last 200 years, from birds to fish. Entry is free, and the lectures do not run in autumn break week 42.

372e234182779f9f7795d2ae6cd4d6b6ceb7a888.en: "Echoes of Freedom", an exhibition at Kulttuurilabra with seven views on freedom by seven young artists. It is open Mondays and Thursdays from 17:00 to 20:00 until 1 November.

cceba6ddf7c18649d9c41d40918b29bbba4972c9.en: A writer evening at Töölö Library with Martti Heikkilä, on his book about lyrics for classic songs, which finds errors in many songbooks. Free entry.

e42980e02163b8b7a954793e78d5e5e1377eef46.en: An adult crafts club at Tapanila Library, meeting monthly on Thursdays from 17:00 to 19:00. Topics include felt, embroidery and upcycling.

530a9027a02ccbff811aca61a02c1edb224aa74c.en: A Finnish language café at Kallio Library every Thursday from 17:00 to 18:00, running until 17 December. It is informal, and you can bring a friend.

b1e016a643cdc98667c646fa5baae84fdf7e59b3.en: A talk on resilience and love, for young people's wellbeing, at Oodi on 22 October from 17:00 to 19:00. It is the third such evening and is free.

7e946b0def71b617fba271867bdd0b5db7754d71.en: An afterwork jazz session at Manala on 22 October from 17:00 to 19:00, featuring trumpeter Mikko "Gunu" Karjalainen and a trio. Entry is free, and arriving early helps you find a seat.

0fbea38525f8cf14710eb4b07f016309f40808cc.en: A free group for young people at Alppila community house, helping with job searching, strengths, goals and CVs. No experience is needed, and drinks and snacks are included.

fe29e602e00462d199fdd55ffba687f7930e57a9.en: A free English-language movie club at Pasila Library, with films shown in English with English subtitles. Age ratings range from 12 to 16, and some screenings are on 21 and 22 October.

859e0588c0811d1cbd90489c47fee503afc11c36.en: A monthly book club at Rikhardinkatu Library on literature that inspires music, meeting on 24 September, 22 October, 19 November and 17 December from 17:00 to 18:30.

6a46e4877f0f74239e78082e5c413cc66904fe44.en: A casual Finnish language café at Jakomäki Library about everyday life and the Finnish language, with tea served.

23f4d817506257190e0f1456f1adae0198fb4173.en: A premiere of "Ghost in the Machine" at Cinema Orion on 22 October, a documentary on how racism and power shaped artificial intelligence. A discussion with the director follows. Tickets cost 10 to 12.50 euros.

932aca7054e00ba8a54cf0392aa4caf72cfabd95.en: A beginner workshop series at Kannelmäki Library on building a small smart device with sensors and lights, for ages 12 and up. It is held in English, on 15, 22 and 29 October, and places are limited to 10.

24db7edcefd069efa2a2ae839a3cc6b047ff782a.en: A rainbow evening at Kontula Library with expert guests on drag, gender diversity and rainbow families. The one on 22 October is about gender diversity.

36506d05a464cbad304798f82d8bc1858a7c888e.en: A free open writing workshop at Malmi Library, where people write and read aloud and give each other encouraging feedback. There is no sign-up and no fee.

6646dedbe2f599e3e8095ff1ce8f40449c3a8069.en: An evening for children under school age with a parent at Kalasatama Library from 17:30, with bedtime stories and crafts. Programmes run from 20 August to 26 November.

80f117ff2986e31f57cf395d64c87f64b37f0245.en: A book club at Töölö Library on Thursdays 24 September, 22 October, 19 November and 10 December, from 18:00 to 19:30, reading books about love. It is open to all, with no sign-up.

f7fd2bdd88229e4d1ce07016088a6ce207525697.en: A public meeting in Munkkiniemi on urban planning for the Munkkivuori church site and on tram works, along with other traffic plans. Entry is free.

c18abef82ab0b5757c29aa4186174e8e613d515f.en: The 50th anniversary programme of Sirkus Finlandia at Käpylä sports park, from 23 September to 25 October. It features acrobatics and the Wheel of Death, and children under three can sit on a parent's lap for free.

e2b7179c2128002b4c7f9c8bd1e2db8fa852f505.en: A concert of flute music at Svenska Klubben on 22 October, with works by Bach, Mel Bonis and Kent Kennan. Tickets cost 10 to 28 euros.

9292da310703afb47a452d8d1738c726bc4d9283.en: Free reading advice at Töölö Library from HERO, the association for different learners, on 22 October from 18:00 to 19:00. It covers reading difficulties and useful apps and aids.

7b86088e8c4613f903098af0cf04199f0bf54bfd.en: Free breakdancing workshops in Kontula for young people on four Thursdays in October and November, with power moves for advanced dancers and beginner guidance.

f2322c22c0fbfed9ade5499ec6a1406e02e879a5.en: A monthly crime-fiction book club at Maunula Library on Thursdays at 18:00, with books by Dusse, Vargas, Creed, Nugent and Malin. Sign-up is by email.

7a500cea31d7fa819826bd10a8a99050b0c53155.en: A free folk concert at Puistola Library with the band Rautakoura and singer Paula Wolski. It is part of the autumn 2026 Helsinki Folk series in 13 libraries.

999002a9005627e151c9dc6a19f2694577329e92.en: A sound and text event by artist Ilia Ollikainen at Oodi on 22 October from 18:00 to 19:00, on a near future shaped by medieval history. Entry is free, with no pre-registration.

19b00d88386034db8d27f6f12017c5f73b5eb128.en: A relaxed Finnish language café at Oulunkylä Library, where people chat and play games. All levels are welcome.

50caeb4fb1cc2cde16e95425d8acdebad2474814.en: A silent reading group at Vuosaari Library, where everyone reads their own book in peace. Light snacks are provided, and there is no pressure to discuss.

a586672e8f378c9ca79c71406d8797f31c2a4065.en: A Finnish easy-language book club at Kallio Library, on "The Hound of the Baskervilles" in an easy-read version. It suits Finnish learners and readers who find reading hard.

8263400bb1fb042474aa089940544f9cd2397904.en: An online Finnish language café on Teams at Pasila Library on Thursdays from 18:00 to 19:00, from 20 August to 17 December. It is free and needs only a web browser or the Teams app.

607aecfab30bc965a34258c4c1d38e3f887c4173.en: The Metropolia Chamber Orchestra plays Tchaikovsky's Serenade for Strings, Cimarosa's flute concerto and a world premiere by Ville Koponen. The concert is on 22 October in Kammari, with tickets at 5 to 10 euros.

9ca7218476305ecd1f9decc7d0d503219ee636e9.en: Reading with Sella the reading dog at Jakomäki Library, for children learning to read, on several Thursdays. Book a 15-minute slot with library staff in advance.

219460c1824acf9e52670b9d686bf127c31b5f6c.en: An open reading group at Suutarila Library, discussing books read in advance. You can join at any point, with books by Harvey, Karila, Mornstajnová and Murata.

4cf3c56a0a05a0e2f6728c248398a7ef9ce9cc52.en: Traditional runo-singing sessions at Rikhardinkatu Library, where people learn melodies from the Kalevala tradition and can sing along. The autumn sessions run in September, October, November and December.

7735e15aff2af7c0bed15edf29cfdd6490392930.en: Timo Tuominen performs Jacques Brel songs from the chanson master's early years, alone with his guitar, at the Finnish National Theatre's Lavaklubi on 22 August and 22 October.

6d06c1182f5650993ed4b9336878542d21865277.en: Dario Fo's "Mysterio Buffo", a set of physical, sharp monologues on power and the voice of ordinary people, staged at KOM Theatre by Erkki Saarela with Pyry Äikää. It is in Finnish, runs 1.5 hours, and suits ages 15 and up.

74cec6ba3901b7910ccde517e2a9efa81566c6b4.en: "Collage – Stage of Things", a living collage by four artists from different backgrounds at Teater Viirus, which explores collaboration and messy encounters. It runs from 10 October to 4 December and suits ages 16 and up.

155d8469843f6825e8be4cf3d931fd45ac19ac45.en: A lecture series on Soviet and Russian history from Stalin's death to today, with talks on the 1960s, the stagnation years, perestroika and Putin's cultural policy. Entry is free.

2c49c0012ad88ff1cff54568404bbfba4fd88c5e.en: A six-week Yin yoga and sound bath series at Heartful Space in Ullanlinna, with singing bowls and seasonal themes, from 6 October to 10 November. Prices start at 25 euros for a single session.

691493bd1b8a47c3c88796fdcb0b6d5152e1d6f6.en: A monthly English stand-up comedy night at Limbo Bar in Kallio, with local and international comics, on 22 October. Doors open at 18:30, tickets cost 11 to 20 euros, and the age limit is 18.

8813599ffe0e040af2fe261803f9fe47f9cd1076.en: Leandro Roco's house band plays classic Latin American songs at Tinku Café Bar on Thursdays until 29 October. Entry is free, and booking a table is recommended.

5930bd6d951b5ce741302c546111bc2e470a64ae.en: A Russian-language team quiz at Satama Bar in Herttoniemi on 22 October, with 15 euros per person. Solo players can join a team.

60d1c2e39acad696a6c981b3ba4b170aafc25d01.en: The autumn concert of the Pakila pop and jazz singers, with piano students from the music school, at Maunula House on Metsäpuro hall. Entry is free.

35f4cb966b95d3b5cf5328598504c0c40cbd6399.en: Swedish deathcore band Humanity's Last Breath plays Tavastia on 22 October, with Vildhjarta, Enterprise Earth and Karmanjakah. Tickets cost 41.50 to 44.50 euros, and the age limit is 18.

83852f7046572f93721f67ca8637bdb082b897c6.en: "Battle of Metal", a Mexico versus Finland metal night at Lepakkomies on 22 October, with People As Machines, Chainline, Averlanche and Louhi & the Tropical Sauna. Tickets cost 8 euros in advance.

67bcbfb8a4933a16debc5f8f4e64beaac4762d92.en: Free digital support sessions at Etelä-Haaga Library with the "Digitalkkari" advisor, for laptops, tablets and smartphones. Book by the counter, online or by phone.

e73d63b771e4cde9354ca90ad375f3b4e27aa788.en: Helsinki Book Fair at Messukeskus from 22 to 25 October, with four days of new books, talks and meetings with writers, and some events online. Tickets cost 15 to 44 euros.

7b40ad63829c029792c41b681b6cf378b04a1843.en: Wine & Food at Messukeskus from 22 to 25 October, with tastings and food experiences for wine and food lovers. Tickets cost 15 to 44 euros.

7649aadf7f596863b8b95a4b08bdba8b5714d8d3.en: "Life in Colour" by Bresley Mansio at Mimosa Galleria from 22 October to 3 November. The paintings explore colour and memory, and include a Día de los Muertos altar. Entry is free.

3ae9cc99dcfac63d2454819fcb73d0def91107a2.en: Mozart's comic opera "Le nozze di Figaro" at the Finnish National Opera and Ballet from 22 October to 27 November, sung in Italian with surtitles in English, Finnish and Swedish. Tickets cost 29 to 118 euros.

38a41662bc7c7d285479ff889d379a774324ed2f.en: An open group at Kustaankartano Senior Centre for sewing and knitting useful textile items to donate to charity. It is for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

e72f92575de733cdc5a1aebd48a4ff47199c2452.en: A relaxed family café at Kankarepuisto playground, with a short guided session on a changing theme.

0afb2ce2062a0d04baf401168ddc23a067de19b6.en: Student nurses from Metropolia offer free blood pressure and blood sugar checks at the Kontula Senior Centre lobby. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

2135283acb7f511cb407b5791a6f1f647687a1e2.en: Free sewing space for clients at Töölö Senior Centre on Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings from 9:00 to 12:00. It needs a free service centre card.

0f5ff6f2208feec81dbb491769e44566022e493a.en: A family café run by Mll at Nurkka playground, where parents meet others in similar situations and children play. There are chats, coffee and sometimes expert talks.

790b43b851839ee0651cc5809fda6b0931216ef1.en: An MLL family café at Isoneva playground, for families to meet, play and talk in a low-threshold setting. Everyone is welcome.

c96b54d5e5debae91d168a4932a1b58d34d45c3b.en: An MLL family café at Viiri playground on Fridays from 9:30 to 11:30, with coffee, company and shared activities.

e23105e9f497603d43de510cef93dd924c5d6828.en: An MLL family café at Kannelmäki playground from 9:30 to 11:30, with coffee and snacks. Families can warm and eat their own food indoors.

cd73f4350e481742957e90dc04efda2ee34dacea.en: A peer-support group at Töölö Senior Centre for pensioners balancing substance problems. Participants can come as they are, and the group plans activities together.

88f53a452c429088e0b1db45af38e30900208388.en: A Pilke group at Kinapori Senior Centre, offering company, peer support and activities chosen by the group. Breakfast is served.

65870e0bd00ef49cfb02967ebca55a5d91dae282.en: A five-week fitness circuit at Töölö Service Centre gym, on Mondays and Fridays from 9:30 to 10:30 from 12 October to 13 November. Sign-up begins on 29 September, and seats are limited.

5ae535cbd85584dc28de377118b59d88601646a2.en: Weekly Friday outings to museums, sports sites, nature trails and playgrounds in and around Helsinki, for people at Kivenkolo. No outing is held in autumn holiday week 42.

4dac3790d497d766c2ffdbae8bc5619cba2792f5.en: A family morning at Maasälpä playground for the youngest children, with play and activities indoors.

1470158e1450330b5d379e9cd789a57f7b6f31ed.en: A Friday lecture series at Kontula Senior Centre on preparing for emergencies, the Maisa client portal, memory care, and nutrition in older age. Each talk is at 9:45 on Fridays in October.

025fbeb551f2c2110012be2d5019cb72e8a3ff05.en: A café at Lehdokki playground for baby and family groups from different cultures, with shared activities on changing themes.

5838c69f33953fe42fd1816ad6b2fc61c53941bf.en: A baby morning at Santahamina playground on Fridays for babies and their families, with a grill for packed lunches from 10:30 to 11:30. Plans can change, so check the weekly programme.

d605e21f923d203847ac25b6c73a5b08fba45016.en: A group at Itäkeskus Service Centre for older people who want to talk about mental health or alcohol. Coffee and a small snack are served, and a free service centre card is needed.

f79a0974f953735f67f9868d4dba0ae8576e1634.en: An activity morning at Orava playground with changing guided sessions indoors or outdoors, such as singing, movement or stories. Music sessions run from 10:30 to 11:15.

68b4e6f4988e8c6d8e4931dbbd265550852cd0fd.en: Outdoor movement games at Munkki playground, such as obstacle courses, exercise tracks and ball games.

a4091deed64dcebf6b003fc8a45c596144c8926a.en: Songs and rhymes for babies at Malminkartano youth centre, with a guided session from 10:30. The door is locked, so ring the bell.

2ea69ce6818bb3e25550ff1aff936ddf2b805b32.en: A baby meetup at Pihlajisto playground on Friday, when babies play with soap bubbles. Everyone is welcome to play and relax.

04fe46b577fe20fad382bb74c628e434e332e056.en: A family morning at Seppä playground with guided play, movement, rhymes, crafts or music, either outdoors or indoors.

ee187d857c9b983c67688b519628084fe7ab7d40.en: A short film morning for the youngest children at Jätkäsaari Library, watched with an adult. Groups can book in advance, and all films are rated S or 3.

a1724b875b97c183f1c3bdf43cb3f758d03b648d.en: A baby families' morning at Mellunmäki playground, for crawling and early babies with a parent. Songs, play and crafts are on offer, with coffee and a small snack.

da8ee2dbe7aaf285ca5dbeb710ded678dfcead4d.en: A relaxed art morning at 10:00 at Nuoli playground, with crafts, music or other creative activities indoors or outdoors. Families can warm their own food there.

3018434f1fefc11e4a9d571fd646dacfe2ea9ba8.en: An art morning at Brahe playground for all ages, trying varied art and craft activities on changing themes. Families can meet each other.

b763e73888d09ee1c90a8b656ea917500a663efb.en: A crafts group at Saunabaari on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays, open to anyone who wants to work on their own craft. Bring your own tools and materials, and chat along the way.

732da119e440f643190c1bead4f73c8dbf9db16b.en: A Friday movement session at Strömberg playground from 10:00 to 11:00 for children and their adult, with changing themes. Families can help plan play ideas with the staff.

f122cd124b341cc971ba6b36a6b3c9aa4d69dbd5.en: A session at Rudolf playground to try out play equipment with an adult. The weekly schedule is on the playground's social media.

8f2525ca384018d112d102678d972589bcb50520.en: A workshop at Kipinäpuisto playground for all ages, with varied art and crafts on changing themes. Families can meet each other and warm their own food.

53a528267b7a5a004b3e44f08ed6e02b9227eb94.en: A Friday family session at Kannelmäki playground with guided activities such as treasure hunts, art or movement. Packed lunches can be eaten indoors.

0c363ef4e06ca39eaceb5ca905a658489feb913b.en: A baby morning at Lampi playground every Friday from 10:00 to 11:00, with changing themes such as baby food painting, songs, rhymes and movement.

8ef7693089b6a07407ab1ddc09e868b6dff77a4b.en: A morning for babies under 1.5 years with a parent at Oulunkylä Library, with rhymes, play and tea. It is a relaxed meeting for families.

64ff8ec2bf22a1cc9ef86ccfe1f7f35319b753d1.en: A toddler morning at Kimmo playground for toddlers and parents, with play, movement, songs and exploration. Families can meet each other and warm their own food.

1640bb74220c0ab86f37b09b5826ce38ae78fabb.en: A baby meetup at Arabia playground for crawling and early babies with a parent, with music, movement, crafts and stories.

69d611886105cbbac641cf78da9da67f9911a717.en: A Friday grill and coffee session at Kiikku playground for dads and children, where fathers can meet other dads. Everyone is welcome, including mothers and other carers.

1b2342674b2ac6ef14803a1245bb34007abef269.en: A family morning at Lahnalahti playground with guided play, movement, rhymes, art or music, indoors or outdoors.

0c62890a4e20cccc429673a469ea16625ef2ae05.en: A family morning at Trumpetti playground, with songs, rhymes and crafts at a guided session from 10:30.

e11af8712160b1a1e1c2577ff640c39be2f6df8a.en: A family morning at Rusthollari playground for play, singing, movement and exploring, where parents can meet other families.

ea2ea746a504073cff5a3c183fc4efa70925a988.en: A Friday family session at Mäkitorppa playground with changing themes, including games, crafts, painting, music and exercise, indoors or outdoors.

aaa49fdea0113cf31f2fcf0635bc4b4ff9819d55.en: Playful rhyme sessions for babies and toddlers aged 0 to 3 with an adult, at Töölö Library, lasting about 30 minutes. Entry is free and no sign-up is needed.

1f8f523345b949318b90c3edfad9cb58772e455b.en: A baby morning at Laurinniitty playground for crawling and early babies with a parent, with music, movement, crafts and stories. The play room is reserved for babies during the session.

e0dfd4f9ff1db5840f74143b9247f2b7efda17af.en: A Friday family session at Kesanto playground with changing activities for all ages.

83379435cb98b3f186e7bb16b020ad91638faf1d.en: Themed role-play at Linja playground, where families build play areas such as a shop, a harbour and an animal nest with the staff. The themes change with the seasons.

4b0e856ff6704012eb4532f705461ee381f450ab.en: A stick exercise group at Kinapori Senior Centre, led by a volunteer exercise guide. No sign-up is needed, and about 15 people can take part.

e6816a7d1d5dac23350ecbb3560fb38e83d570de.en: A meeting place at Maatulli playground for families with young children and different cultures, with Finnish practice for adults and coffee. People without children are welcome too.

045d52a634449a86f17ac7d63a74624673a138e1.en: Sports and movement activities for young children and their families each Friday, in the gym and outdoors, at Roihuvuori playground. The schedule changes weekly.

4e2c56589896b8ddadb13b6e20c07fb941664da7.en: A picture hunt at Filpus playground, where you search for pictures on a changing theme and mark those you find.

b67351be60fe6ccf3123ec99d672a9422d23c350.en: A bridge club at Kinapori Senior Centre that meets every Friday at 10:00 in the Kertsi meeting room.

a5e657757d76738b11b629ded075f4bc0261e6ad.en: An orienteering activity at Intia playground, with checkpoints around the yard on a changing theme. Families can meet each other and eat or play inside.

e4d8399f65606a9aadbc31192d218e7cfde30686.en: A family morning at Sahrami family house, run with Paavali parish, with a guided session from 10:00 and changing themes. The house is open Monday to Friday from 9 to 16.

359ac7e96ed1ee31f05b49d3e8f35298bb819955.en: A Swedish-language reading session for babies aged 0 to 12 months at Oodi.

090bbf847b8c8a0343b26c8e4a4c7e3e61c943a8.en: A balance group at Riistavuori Senior Centre. You can sign up by phone.

681dd28bfee5ec68aebed71d383eb17688f91296.en: An open memory-training group at Kontula Senior Centre with quizzes, memory tasks and brain exercises. It is free of charge for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card, and no sign-up is needed.

0a23503646d7258c63c34141bb8f9a9a12489556.en: A family morning at Ruoholahti playground with guided play, movement, rhymes, art or music from 10:00 to 10:30, in the yard or indoors.

97fd395fa11cbbfd126266023726be6af0bea565.en: A workshop for job seekers who already have a CV, focused on updating and improving it and writing a profile text. Registration is required, and participants must live in Helsinki and have basic digital and language skills.

80d9811756f42984f9a1d84a182d7037a57f9edf.en: Songs, movement, games and rhymes on changing themes at Etupelto playground, with updates on social media each week.

087fef40c341f98d7fae4145980a8b7948fad04d.en: A free dance session at Kamppi Service Centre, for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

41d9f10c681d689728b51342b3ba58bfe04df1c8.en: A baby meetup at Iso-Antti playground for crawling and early babies with a parent, with music, movement and stories.

4449aca1242e099d5e4b13714e7c4a128a83223e.en: A peer-support group at Kamppi Service Centre for people caring for a family member, with a parallel exercise group for relatives living with memory illness. Contact the organisers to sign up.

9126bfaaa74ce908ef3799a1d7c09ddd1c857edd.en: A picture hunt at the outdoor park on Maistraatinkatu for all ages, on changing themes. Indoors, the playground at Pasilan puistotie 8 lets families warm food and coffee is available.

8d18ab84cf17d047d8f50fb3dc04c95d614bd9c4.en: A movement session for children aged 2 to 3 and their parents at Kajuutta family house, with sign-up in advance. Each block of sessions lasts 5 to 6 weeks, and the next groups start in January 2027.

687b4219d5dad071459a26ea8360791c5c80e32a.en: A movement room at Tuorinniemi playground, where toddlers can climb, play and move in the gym.

5f0d6194e3c42444969dd809deda2fb32b403cb9.en: A singing and rhyme session at Lohikäärmepuisto playground, with familiar children's songs on changing themes.

f861324e2be19a1eaca03a29e130c91caad641ba.en: Songs and music for schoolchildren at Taivallahti playground, indoors or outdoors. The weekly schedule is on the playground's Instagram and noticeboard.

a1397341d2371f86acd26751dd21fb3b592d1cc9.en: A Pilke peer-support group at Riistavuori Senior Centre, starting with breakfast and a round of news. Activities are planned together with the group, and you can contact the group leader by phone.

bc3cf88f432b2a8383999f8064bb2c93581048df.en: Free darts for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people at Kamppi Service Centre, with a free service centre card.

f043e982fc12d11097bdf9910ddf303e4ccb841f.en: A singing group at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

5487742831a77c865f8e7a0698305e62a7dd0b68.en: A stained-glass (Tiffany) group at Kamppi Service Centre, for people who already know the basics. It is for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

3c3844c02ba0ecf1b0616e688d8605f65b73cf74.en: A low-impact exercise class for family carers at Kannelmäki Service Centre on Fridays from 11:00 to 11:45. It mixes standing and seated exercises, and sign-up is by phone with a physiotherapist.

f4fab3f540ae6246cc0697e84b0a6d6d8bdf8f91.en: A live online back exercise class at Saunabaari every Friday at 11:00, led by a physiotherapist for 45 minutes. Some exercises are done on a mat, and options suit all fitness levels.

e94e0a226c60c50faa4eabcd54c86f2f1548749c.en: An armchair trip around the world at Oulunkylä Seurahuone, guided by language trainees who tell stories of their countries. Coffee and snacks are served.

e3644dcc2a9db912c26f7af8149966e2674d89e2.en: A classic bingo game run by a volunteer at Kamppi Service Centre, for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card. Winners can take home new books.

95ec0786fa0e7e1503a4560544f64bfb7fa5b5e9.en: A live-streamed online back exercise class from the Back Association, shown at Malmi community house on Wednesdays and Fridays at 11:00, with a recording shown on Fridays at 16:00.

039607e0ee8d8c859c1628e47ca9d8ef989e2fbb.en: A traditional Friday bingo at Oulunkylä Seurahuone, with prizes including coffee packs and other treats.

05690b87de845d3c8afaa6bafaca0a7969b815af.en: An online Asahi health exercise session at Alppila community house, following a video. It is gentle, suits all ages and fitness levels, and needs no sign-up.

118366d7a71af2a81bea3047a49942fe69454932.en: A Friday talk group at Itäkeskus Service Centre on current topics, aimed at helping people make new friends. A free service centre card is needed, and no sign-up.

f59ea1c124db9d08cc04c88b86febffd1784c426.en: An open memory group at Roihuvuori Senior Centre for people with a memory diagnosis, offering peer support and information on brain health. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

a0b407c607dd4afc4b4ed52b7112c1feb8ff2e9b.en: A music club at Riistavuori Senior Centre with no sign-up, where people can join any time.

4ac72a2a04b032899d53fa0e06e052d4399fe24a.en: Free digital help at Malmi community house on several weekdays, for computers, tablets, phones and online services. Bring your own device.

fb48a39f18acf0eedbb62d01ff628e67fc648558.en: "piano piano", a painting exhibition by Nanna Susi at her studio from 23 October to 15 November, inspired partly by a trip to Japan. Entry is free.

d9eac833bdaf9415049e6e1bfa213cba118a6e64.en: A marjapussi card game at Kamppi Service Centre, for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

ca8f932518bc095508281d271cdaefb226966d77.en: An open memory group at Töölö Senior Centre for people who have memory difficulties or a recent memory diagnosis. It offers peer support, brain health information and everyday help.

57d5dc67d7f1b40a7ef1da1fc51c5843a92a801c.en: An information session on family caring at Saunabaari on 23 October from 12:00 to 13:00, with Lena Lönngren of the Helsinki region carers' association.

12ea5cd4130a05af98614dd6dca48260c9863544.en: A beginner painting workshop at Malmi community house that turns realistic objects into simplified, expressive shapes. No drawing experience is needed, and groups are limited to 10 people.

a41ac9e1ecdbde761862923b47903373cd64a058.en: A 12-session peer-support group at Kannelmäki for pensioners whose relative has a substance problem. Meetings run on Fridays from 12:00 to 14:00 from 11 September to 27 November, for up to 10 people.

d9053fac8b8b29c0ce64da7fbbba393feb79b850.en: A sound bath relaxation session at Saunabaari in the Maple hall, where the sound of bowls helps you relax. Mats are provided, and you only need comfortable clothes.

e09559cebbbf66c8c67914a6663804a7c97b7b2d.en: A short talk on cartoon characters and their history at Alppila community house, followed by a chance to create your own character.

6f20039cfa05fd4bf0c9188dde432cd40dfb843b.en: A relaxed walk from Saunabaari every Friday, at whatever pace suits the group, with conversation and a look at nature along the way.

6569b1e582dccce8f35a2b6abf372dc60b4389ca.en: A weaving kiosk at Vuosaari Library's youth space, open to all with a free loom on a first-come basis, on set dates in October, November and December. It is a project by Danish textile artist Rosa Tolnov Clausen.

2d2574414e50675221e2e539b3ddb3e6519ee308.en: One-hour appointments for calm digital help at Vuosaari Library on Wednesdays and Fridays, plus Enter ry sessions on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and ICT students on weekdays.

c4127add20ffcfcd5a98270bee46dd2cc093ea98.en: A weekly Arabic-language advice point at Kontula Library on Fridays from 12:00 to 15:00, from 11 September to 27 November. It is run with the Finland-Syria Friendship Society, is free and needs no sign-up.

87ad2b5cb5e331d9ae128caa61ae178d7c549d5d.en: A karaoke session at Pihlajamäki community house on Fridays from 12:00 to 14:00. Everyone can sing, whatever their skill, or just listen.

d77feb698bd37106ef55260a06436292c733e9eb.en: A popular memory-activation group at Koskela Senior Centre, with exercises and quizzes. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card from the lobby.

23b4406b0334005dd795aa45ec08fa8cfd4090f3.en: A crossword group at Kontula Library, where people solve puzzles together, including cryptic clues. Tea and coffee are served and no sign-up is needed.

151a166dcaef70b1e1a2ebbae9921593ad54c733.en: Free digital help at Oulunkylä Seurahuone on several weekdays, for computers, tablets and phones, with bookings available online.

497f67764c820acdff74b14dcfe23ef1e890a0e4.en: Table tennis at Töölö Senior Centre's hall for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card. No instructor is present.

014fb5e0687e2b2132dd1bed93e2a9f11749d3b3.en: An open art workshop at Alppila community house, with a guide on hand to help with different techniques. It is open to all, and beginners and experienced hobbyists are welcome.

e34a825de932adde976e2c340a96326c5cf6c3a3.en: A chair exercise session for older people at Vuosaari Library on Fridays from 12:30 to 13:30, free of charge, and not on 16 October.

aeb8f24050e0b2970346d0921cd8ad7c2b4cb7a8.en: Watercolour painting on Fridays from 12:30 to 15:00 at Pihlajamäki community house, with no instruction.

dcbb3258514693b85ac4dd572097a59cde5dba90.en: Tonkkumi, a playful accuracy throwing game using milk tankard and teat-shaped rubbers, held at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

b4895d7dd94b551f95ac9514057d371fd8881af8.en: A language café for people who know basic Finnish, at Ristikko Library on Fridays from 13:00 to 14:30. The address is now Konalantie 10.

7e1b9624bc3ce547fa5a66c07557c4a395b6e2c4.en: A gentle video-led chair exercise session on Friday afternoons at Kontula community house, suitable for all fitness levels.

f4f64936c4c360aabb271e4683cfe238cb408aec.en: A free Friday games session at Kallio Library for school children, playing on a Nintendo Switch in the children's area. There is no session on 30 October 2026.

4235ef0c6ca4b27bc9a9849fbb73246c8bfece68.en: Afternoon dances at Kamppi Service Centre through October, with a different band each week from 2 to 30 October. Only Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card can attend.

8aeb5a1f3432530d1af9826e63c9538931219352.en: A Swedish-language book club at Laajasalo Library. Borrow the book from the library, with no sign-up needed.

ab46c75bf324f8f02162f038a9af07ff742bf61a.en: A bingo session at Riistavuori Senior Centre where every round has a winner.

f482c7889b05a028e4a3045aaf2bf5cf2d6e245b.en: A baby cinema at Malmi Library on Friday afternoons, with a film for families with babies on 23 October. The room is dim and quiet, and families can feed, change or rest there.

96835a246fbd65d5c5cc1e668fc075c05fd98380.en: A discussion group for older people at Töölö Senior Centre on everyday life and wellbeing, aimed at easing loneliness. It starts on 4 September from 13:00 to 14:00, and new members are welcome.

b2931ff74dd77915feb79c58cf1257b3443b1616.en: A volunteer-led English conversation group at Roihuvuori Senior Centre, open to native speakers and to people who want to practise. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.
