a6dfec9095a362cd0f583f867c443759f9848ced.en: A baby meetup at Kajuutta family house, where babies can use different motor toys on Friday meetings.

f5d75d1607120f13d32ff741e2d4850c758f7ee6.en: A monthly Friday session at Oulunkylä Library with board games, crafts and small treats, where people can bring a little candy or biscuits.

ab799a274764b8473d013844050bb4d1a41c55bd.en: An open-mic Friday jam at Oulunkylä Seurahuone, where people can share their own or borrowed music, singing, poetry or thoughts. The Ogeli House Band plays, with guest artists.

ed3ea8e0dd5f49f3876db07ca38695c6d646ddcd.en: A discussion and crafts group at Kustaankartano Senior Centre for older Ukrainian and Russian speakers. No skills or Finnish are needed, and you can join at any time.

d73901f93c7c30aa5ba20fd77228c4198a4a5c4f.en: A shared evening prayer at Kontula Senior Centre, for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

f54ddc5f9f08abe1eb20a9141cbb959264b6c437.en: A launch event on 23 October at 13:30 at Pasila Library for two new books on Helsinki's history, with a panel discussion. One book covers 1863 to 1939, and the other is about Helsinki's cultural identity.

c53e3fe441c9418f5d6cc51404be0975484eece5.en: A guided walking tour in English of the Suomenlinna fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, covering its 270 years under three states. It runs from 16 October to 21 December, and costs 6 to 16 euros.

66fa1c006770cdbe97d60c9dd8051d456561c431.en: A baby meetup at Sahrami family house for crawling and early babies with a parent, with music, movement, crafts and stories. Families can warm their own food there.

ffb9b3ea3d1f3a228b43b044530a3f241d49378b.en: A men's group at Laajasalo Service Centre for conversation and time together. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

4c3696e311f6493a90cba30f66e2c939e53e5f52.en: A karaoke session on Fridays at Roihuvuori Senior Centre, where people sing or listen to requested songs. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

d21b4c9b166eed243207b40c420ed933fe935913.en: A board game session on Friday afternoons at Saunabaari, with card games, Uno, Yatzy, Trivial Pursuit and more. You can bring your own game, and no experience is needed.

d461a37f009a3f132e9899ec85cd8b1aefaa3694.en: Senior taekwondo at Kontula Senior Centre on Tuesdays and Fridays from 14:00 to 15:00, with a focus on fitness and flexibility. It is free, and you can sign up by phone or at the community house.

e068f53175b96dbb8104183c709b0445b571ffe4.en: An English club for children aged 7 to 12 at Laajasalo Library, reading books, playing games and having simple conversations.

3734875ad5dc9b580315f04461c60f0f28f6591c.en: A children's film club at Jätkäsaari Library, where children vote on the films. The films are rated S or K7, and younger children can attend with an adult.

54f188668794dfe1a084777aee7f9e9303033d19.en: A quiz at Malmi community house on Fridays, where players can win or lose on knowledge or luck.

ec88f691d3310132f37baa892ebd8851af981884.en: "Soteorpo", a comedy-drama play at Teatteri Avoimet Ovet based on Minna Lindgren's novel, about a couple whose life changes after a husband's Alzheimer's diagnosis. It runs from 7 September to 21 November and lasts 2 hours 10 minutes.

338eb23e4f7be0ce04ddf847276b3b7ec0bcad06.en: An after-school club for primary school children at Kalasatama Library, with crafts, games and other activities chosen by the children. Staff lead the sessions.

b61d4c97a009cb0e9b9a378bad571b6ffb76c5c5.en: A Rummikub club at Kinapori Senior Centre on the second and fourth Fridays of each month, from 14:00 to 16:45.

8bee6bfdba14dbc6fdb56aa2c961f4b4a3817cdd.en: A quiz night at Alppila community house on Fridays, with topics that change each time. The winner gets a small prize.

eb5d563bdc53310a7e95b1894da5fea1692d600b.en: A crafts club at Vuosaari Library's children's area, inspired by stories and imagination. It includes art experiments, jewellery and card making, and no sign-up is needed.

d0dc7c9f771cf3af14924204f42cc749ee163db5.en: A Friday lecture series at the Finnish Adult Education Centre on Japan and Thailand, Queen Christina's court in Stockholm, sacred pilgrimage sites and Finnish women artists. Entry is free.

46e34141bdeeceecbaaea9060f8f6a07bd79ce84.en: A Friday outing for women at Kamppi Service Centre, with window shopping and a walk, chosen by the group. Places are limited to six, and you must register at the desk.

3bae300d40df7b8453a7ff6320ba5da55d5279aa.en: A weekly karaoke at Alppila community house, hosted by a staff member. People who do not want to sing can listen.

06c8dd8eb61df5ce9befb6c15458d1c511ad98d4.en: A relaxed Finnish language café at Kontula community house, where learners of all levels chat together to start the weekend.

bf66f18fc07444530bd10159f8cbe88c769c7c3d.en: An Arabic-speaking group at Myllypuro Senior Centre for pensioners and unemployed people, with exercise, cultural talks, art, cooking together and trips. It is open and needs no sign-up.

fe02f093a18ea7ddbbf388c25df40deb4cc8d7db.en: A beginners' Spanish club at Alppila community house, led by volunteers Andrea and Julio. The first session is on 11 September.

e78ee25c58b793d2b6822ed3358195f613b95811.en: A cultural festival at Merirasti youth centre with dance, music, art and circus workshops for all ages, plus food from different cultures. City planners are present from 16:00 to 18:00 to discuss local plans.

f6b521fc0db5edbd53b6d31c9352c1091a87100a.en: A lecture series on opera from the 1900s to today, covering impressionism, expressionism, minimalism and new opera. There is no lecture on 11 September or in autumn holiday week 42.

2788580ee0ea543f1e7f5fe2e50c304bfffd751e.en: A Spanish language café at Oodi on Fridays from 16:30 to 18:00, led by a native speaker. The event is organised by Lili Carrion, and registration is needed.

7d9ced9c5f3b5daf797c8d53faee82025d175e66.en: A free speedfriending event for LGBTQIA+ youth aged 16 to 25 at IrisHelsinki on 23 October from 16:30 to 21:00, held in Finnish. Registration closes on 22 October.

aabdc0d4a4f57115ed4322aeaecefacf3e9a7739.en: A guided tour of the new organ at the Helsinki Music Centre, with its 124 stops, on several dates in autumn and winter. Tickets cost 9.50 to 19 euros, and the tour is not recommended for under-school-age children.

e6d86e390e5e1022df80afb3bd91df0a9e494233.en: A ghost walk on Helsinki's boulevards from the City Museum on 23 October, with stories of hauntings in the centre. Tickets cost 13 euros, and advance booking is advised.

684d3485e4eeaa7a0454b3c0171141967d358be6.en: A discussion of "Verikyyhky", a graphic novel set in a dark alternative Savonlinna, with creators Sami Makkonen and Lauri Ainala. It takes place at Itäkeskus Library, is free, and is hosted by Hippo Taatila.

8d7343e2eea7e0b4de30a57ef07f305f66e650e0.en: A concert by Lyckokatter Vocal Ensemble at Kannelmäki Library, called "Re-Grow", on growth and decay, with the poet Aleksi Moine as a guest. Entry is free.

6a0ae84662d8d2203c2d877dfdecaae131de2ccf.en: A film club for young people aged 12 and up at Tapanila Library, watching and discussing films on 25 September, 23 October, 20 November and 18 December.

713838bb7162e780c2bf0750fd8afed3a977b553.en: A creative evening at Mimosa Galleria on 23 October from 17:30 to 19:30, where you paint a Catrina, decorate a milagrito or make a clay piece. Materials are included, and no experience is needed. It costs 25 euros, or 20 each when booking with a friend.

978e7e27186e96826a19e9823160ebda7ad00231.en: A series of talks at Lavaklubi, linking the National Theatre's plays with new WSOY books, on 1 September, 1 October, 23 October, 16 November and 7 December at 17:30. Tickets cost 15 euros per talk or 50 euros for the series.

e3f197b5aaa11c923a7f03b2fd1a699b06e656f1.en: A PopJazz evening at Maunula House with "Sadetta luvassa", a Sade tribute band, and the singer-songwriter ēsau's show "untethered", which blends ambient and alternative R&B. Entry is free.

3cbdf0128047cd6f00dbc1d4a2a59559e9a481b5.en: A gentle hatha yoga class at Alppila community house, focusing on poses, breathing and body awareness. No experience is needed, and mats are available.

f29b6a72432b2815d963c02d2c1d8580332e6c71.en: A feel-good charity dance party at Rymy-Eetu on 23 October from 18:00 to 22:00, with disco hits mainly from 1990 to 2020. Tickets cost 13.50 to 18 euros, and the age limit is 18.

f98e6a1b5226047f1b83b49648c9815d6eeefb82.en: A brewer's dinner at Suomenlinna Brewery on 23 October from 18:15 to 21:00, with a three-course menu paired with five beers from Viaporin Panimo. It costs 65 euros, and guests should take the 18:00 ferry from Market Square. The age limit is 18.

5a85e1f08b58c5f917d2882408b9dae0135f2f24.en: Rapper and singer Senya plays Tiivistämö on 23 October, with doors at 19:00 and a support act to be announced. Advance tickets cost 15 euros, and the main venue is all ages with a K18 area.

17ab04f4780194c4e723ba384df5253619629550.en: Rock band Litku Klemetti and rappers Lyttä & Tohtori Getto play two separate sets on 23 October at Tavastia, at 19:00 and 23:30. Tickets cost 29.50 to 35 euros, and the age limit is 18.

04a40498c35db281e6c6deb1a381adbce2c8e813.en: A candlelit sound healing session at Pranama Kallio on 23 October from 19:00 to 20:30, using crystal bowls, gongs and chimes. You can lie back and rest, and an oracle card can be drawn at the end. It costs 33 euros.

567ab6114e20cab48dad2447d355941725e2884c.en: British Festival Ballet's "Swan Lake" at Finlandia Hall on 23 and 24 October, with guest artists from Astana Opera. The performance runs about 2.5 hours with two intervals, and tickets cost 65 to 110 euros.

e98dce8c9b72ca6f066f613beffbb05a25eda586.en: "CCC Does Drag", a monthly comedy night in English at NoName Theatre on 23 October, with comedy drag and burlesque acts. The age limit is 18, and tickets cost 13.60 to 17 euros, including two free drinks.

ad922369200b51fdccde1f31970a9ba4d28d2af7.en: A close-up magic session by magician Robert Jägerhorn at Nostage, a small magic room with 12 seats per show. Several dates run from August to December, and tickets cost 49 euros.

2419357bbbc1a3ce5444372b1fb0367f09291058.en: A Friday social forró dance evening at Jazz Factory on selected dates from 18 September to 27 November. No partner is needed, and dancers of all levels are welcome. A single ticket costs 7 euros, or 35 euros for the season.

60656fdcbd7ead1819bcfc3ba84ef643ca4b24f6.en: "Sea Creature Rescue Squad" at SEA LIFE Helsinki from 23 October to 30 November, an interactive session on small actions that protect ocean animals. Tickets cost 19.50 to 24.50 euros.

7ae7641cc2f9fbb4b1ab1fe8319d1195eedde34f.en: "Arcana Borealis" at Ateneum, on Northern women artists who mixed art with esoteric currents from the late 19th century. It runs from 23 October 2026 to 28 February 2027.

ef84aa5663fbdc7c7447f747bcc1bb05dc639cb7.en: "Strange Dale", mixed-media sculptures by Marja Patrikainen and woodcuts by Tuukka Peltonen at HAA Gallery from 23 October to 15 November. Entry is free, and the gallery is also open on Viapori Kekri on 31 October.

c57983245feb3b63562fcdfe348455a21f4e4501.en: A family Halloween event at Hakaniemi Market Hall on 23 and 24 October, with a spooky atmosphere, seasonal food and activities. Entry is free.

ab1d3debd6108b7a3bccadcd915373efb9129f2b.en: The Helsinki Dollhouse Fair and Old Toy Swap Market at Arcada on 24 October from 10:00 to 15:00, with vintage toys, miniatures and handmade dollhouse items. Tickets cost 6 euros for adults and 3 for children aged 7 to 15.

f62ed8db455a4874bd163119f4b390c0513b63e8.en: A vintage film camera and photography flea market at JAS Kamerakauppa on 24 October from 10:00 to 15:00, with dealers and a technician who can check shutter speeds. Entry is free.

792626cbb7e36161134a01f09a53393425cdd844.en: A Saturday for children with Minecraft at Malmi Library, with crafts, games and a quiz at 11:00. Minecraft books can be read in the library or borrowed.

301e91484cd1d0a3fb61cc699d8ce8f3c7309741.en: A free fair at Alppila community house for Helsinki's residents' spaces and community houses, with information on hobbies, volunteering and meeting places. Activities include choir performances, art workshops and a family circus.

a9c818655a9898cb07e1b82f7e45bd4bb1160045.en: A family Kekri event at Lauttasaari Library, with crafts such as ghosts, pumpkins or bats, and a Finnish story time at 11:00. The event is also held in Swedish.

93ccb7c1bbbce3192bb37ad20b559407be093782.en: A Saturday story time at Munkkiniemi Library at 11:00, aimed mainly at children aged 3 to 6, with all story lovers welcome.

c6f7918ca6d62a4d1ff3e5157f469f575620eaad.en: A reading group at Alppila community house where adults learning Finnish can get support in English. Children can come along, the group runs from September to May, and it is free with no registration.

4c1a8d80f69b0fe7ded4899d2cd48b3c0efaffcf.en: "Taste of Kontula", a food event at Kontula Shopping Centre where eight local restaurants serve tasting portions of up to 5 euros. Dishes come from Turkey, China, Afghanistan, Syria, Vietnam and Iraq.

ee46cdf293cc16733cc02a6762c1bf028b36e6f2.en: A free beginners' Mandarin Chinese course at Itäkeskus Library, from basics to advanced, taught by a certified teacher. It is taught in Finnish, English and Mandarin, and registration is needed.

a448d4047665bfed6346703e2573589cef72b4ba.en: "The Presence of Vajra" by Lizzy HyoLa Kim at Take Me Home Gallery from 7 to 31 October, blending Korean Buddhist symbols with Baroque and Rococo ornament. Entry is free.

f425b7ec32b22dfc4eca6bb4ca79693efb2231ee.en: "Safety Circle" at Vuosaari Library for children and their parents. October's theme is personal boundaries, and a year-long skill lab offers sewing or creative writing. No registration is needed, and snacks are included.

f7fd7ebde5489122cb0628b0fa19e6edd52aebe8.en: A poetry reading by Pavlo Matyusha at Oodi from his new collection "Place 11A". Nadiia Fedorova moderates, and Oleksii Prykhodko translates the poems into Finnish.

12b4432f45693776d8cfdb257675306f6ff7c261.en: A launch party at Oodi on Saturday 24 October from 13:00 to 15:00 for the children's picture book "Sisu ja surusiili", about grief and hope. There are crafts and games, and the authors Essi Suotula and Milja Laine attend.

63253b559782cddcc9a40221865844d9ff858951.en: A family day in Vuosaari on Saturday 24 October from 13:00 to 17:00 at Rastis youth centre, with local services, a kids' corner, a fire truck and mini-talks on city services.

0fee5d1c1b25cfb0ace4082a121b11fed0472269.en: A temari ball workshop at Roihuvuori Library for a child and an adult together, making the traditional Japanese balls. It is led by Gulmira Akbulatova-Loijas over two sessions.

f1f91db73d3553c62e1eb5c013bd39ebebe72dbf.en: A painting session at Teerenpeli Kamppi on Saturdays and Tuesdays from 3 October to 28 November, with an instructor and materials included. It costs 49.99 euros, is for ages 18 and up, and is held in English and Finnish.

1b610905a015b5a32b8dcdbac53cd6f6983b11ad.en: The Meren Sisaret ensemble performs "Tempo di caccia" at Puotila chapel on 24 October from 14:00 to 15:00, featuring medieval Italian hunting canons. Entry is free, with programme tickets at 5 to 15 euros.

3c0b328bb62ecdb53ba4094babfd468b1fc5ec48.en: A guided tour of the PUNK exhibition at Villa Hakasalmi with curators Teijo Hintikka and Vilja Joensuu. It is included in the admission price.

a7c305382e526e32cdf908d55004c9a42ce1cf0b.en: A guided painting workshop on upcycled glass at Daruma Kitchen, with a drink included. It runs on several dates in autumn and suits ages 13 and up. Places are limited to eight people, and the cost is 37.50 to 40 euros.

f4d972f0ba62a41a26afb0ae6588202a6c860a9b.en: "Untamon matka talviunille", a multisensory family show at Kääntöpaikka on 24 October, about a bear who helps the fairy Aarnitar in a crisis. It is performed in Finnish with Ostrobothnian dialect, and suits children aged 4 and up.

5ff059b55a67fbf4493b51e59331a7a8fe386bd6.en: A talk in English at Oodi on 23 October at 17:00, based on the book "Mom, Are They Toys or Apples?". It tells of Kurdish children and civilians poisoned by chemical weapons in Iraq in April 1987.

220d86508a6722b0f6fb6b7c9d706b53ff0b25bc.en: The "PUNK, 50 years of buzz in the streets of Helsinki" exhibition at Villa Hakasalmi, tracing Finnish punk from late-1970s venues to today with photographs, zines, album covers and a practice space.

12e25556c63ab2c9ef28abfe04e6859820ad2a86.en: "Yksi halusta, toinen rakkaudesta", a comedy-drama by Kari Heiskanen at Elannon Näyttämö about three couples at a country-house dinner, with hidden pasts. It runs from 24 October to 20 November, for ages 13 and up.

a647d331a00ca9ee4cc0340862da3fd234496ee1.en: The 75th anniversary concert of the Helsingin Laulu choir at Paasitorni Congress Hall on 24 October from 16:00 to 17:30, with a world premiere of Jaakko Mäntyjärvi's setting of a Shakespeare sonnet.

b37715094837ced824bfee2d378e0f763475f820.en: A tabletop role-playing game anthology at Oodi, held in English on 24 October and 7 and 21 November. No experience is needed, and dice and materials are provided.

2e9410829c328b365c2356a64ba7d87431a56008.en: A guided painting session at Studio & Bar Helsinki on selected dates from 3 October to 28 November. Drinks are available to buy, and the cost is 49.99 euros for ages 18 and up.

0b87568c9a6109b1863f995e99a68ac32f36f23b.en: Veikkausliiga match IF Gnistan against AC Oulu at Markku.fi Areena on 24 October from 17:00 to 19:00, with the teams fighting for a place in European competition. Tickets cost 10 to 35 euros.

3b8cf908888df832f403af2c7cae5f79b1d39347.en: A Finnish premiere of an arrangement of Mozart's Requiem for small ensemble, performed by Utopia Chamber Choir and soloists at the German Church on 24 October. Tickets cost 30 to 35 euros.

6bb57a490f3e197af954f277054ed1f45341dd90.en: The Pixelache Festival 2026 at Tiivistämö, with screenings, performances and music on 24 October, under a theme of solidarity and cooperation. The venue section is 18 and over.

f030c294a7b2647483195fb3e98c7efb16a7d54d.en: A dance game at Pihlajamäki Youth Centre in which the music switches at random and dancers try to recognise the song and dance along. It is for young people aged 12 to 20.

b66f73379eecd4323601a5c5ab975e4e3d8148b7.en: The folk group Maan Haldiit at Vapaan taiteen tila on 24 October from 18:00 to 19:00, playing minimalist music on handmade instruments with a short film. Entry is free.

b38862f86aefc06bcf4c5b1b8c5f4ab5dcc94f54.en: A Swedish-language Halloween party for brave children at Rikhardinkatu Library, with spooky characters and activities. Entry is free, and dressing up is optional.

f90589fa591ac1e9b3296a876cc0b43588bfc6e1.en: Finnish pop artist Viivi plays Tavastia on 24 October, with doors at 20:00. Tickets cost 32.50 to 36 euros, and the age limit is 18.

6a36d331e163b06e5b8f5dc8f75ab5485cdacd9b.en: The Night Sun, a duo from Georgia, plays ambient, folk-rock and indie sounds at Eurohostel on 24 October from 20:00 to 22:00. Entry is free, and the age limit is 18.

7d0d761f08541719c4ee99e691417cb7f5f5bc15.en: "Entanglement: I am a tree, I am a mouth", a sensory performance at Kiasma Theatre that mourns the loss of our connection with ancient oaks. It runs on 24, 25, 28 and 30 October, and the ticket includes Kiasma's exhibitions.

7ab3c68e468f0d445d06c9089f2ad86a46896e68.en: A free Sashiko mending workshop at Oodi on Sunday 25 October from 13:00 to 15:00, which turns a repaired area of cloth into a decorative pattern. All tools are provided, and no sewing experience is needed.

2bdc2df67d8788316213001a873af9cf5e6895e5.en: A symposium at Oodi on Namibian colonial history, centred on the artists Lebo Tlali and Sasha Huber and on Rosa Emilia Clay, the first person of African origin to receive Finnish citizenship in 1899.

0b16e57a0720a7e9db7cf996eaa2c9b2c4768f70.en: A Russian-language book club on modern myth. The 25 October meeting, on Rilke's "The Notebooks of Malte Laurids Brigge", runs from 15:00 to 18:00 at Rikhardinkatu Library. Entry is free.

2c840ec62fb751161fdcc775c0041eb7ccba4a09.en: A "Musical Instruments of the World" session at Oodi with Chilean-Italian flautist Constanza García, playing Andean wind instruments such as the quena. It is supported by Taike and the Sibelius Academy.

a5007c0b581712a6efd7f202ee9796173cb95f59.en: A concert by Cantores Minores and the Windsbacher Knabenchor at Kallio Church on 25 October from 16:00 to 17:15, with Brahms's Alto Rhapsody and Tragic Overture. Tickets cost 15 to 25 euros.

7c1c78cc55ae65e40ac8bd7a78000320b7cee926.en: Organist Jan Liebermann, born in 2005, plays the 124-stop organ at Musiikkitalo on 25 October from 16:00 to 17:00, with works by Bach, Karg-Elert, Mendelssohn and Liszt. Tickets cost 12.50 to 39 euros.

a859f42e1391834853719e3610cadf8ebd3c2ec6.en: The British indie rock band Razorlight plays Tavastia on 25 October, with doors at 18:00. Tickets cost 31 to 35 euros, and the age limit is 18.

af2e7176f453fce31e4b9f2107f4b423b9a5dfb5.en: A concert marking 100 years since Bo Carpelan's birth, at the House of Nobility on 25 October from 18:00 to 19:45. Violinist Antti Tikkanen leads the Finnish Baroque Orchestra in music by Sibelius, Haydn, Mozart and Bach.

4fe179f90dbebad887b7d041b683d0e1d9d818e0.en: A stand-up comedy night at Bistro & Baari Kustaa Vaasa on 25 October from 19:00 to 21:00, in Finnish, with professional comedians. Tickets cost 10 to 15 euros, and the age limit is 18.

d0729f2c7967cc38eace58a2e424a22a5e03b228.en: The AMICI FRIENDS exhibition at Meilahti Art Hall, until 25 October, bringing together artists the organiser met at international biennials. It marks 30 years of his career and is open Tuesday to Sunday.

eb19ea5ee688fb25f1fa0683c39a4494a8e67d7d.en: Monday craft sessions at Kontula Senior Centre in October, for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card. Come and make and spend time together.

135330238eb803e0ad3aedaf0fcdc4799a8fdb35.en: A self-guided family play session at Sahrami family house, where adults and children build play areas such as a shop, a harbour or animal nests. The house is open Monday to Friday from 9 to 16.

69f8b7950fbee3704e3e0191e342c30d1e90b16c.en: Helsinki-info at the Stoa cultural centre, offering free, multilingual advice on city services and immigration. Personal help is available Monday to Thursday from 9 to 16, and on Fridays from 12 to 16.

cbaed23f153d4a267ccb9ada90b26202e95fa572.en: Free digital help at Pohjois-Haaga Library with the "Digitalkkari" advisor, for laptops, tablets and smartphones. Book online, at the counter or by phone, and bring your own device and logins.

f421e2694d7fce4c1fb63ca62ea67e466c6b9c24.en: An open family morning at Viikkari playground, with the red hall open from 9:00 to 11:30 and guided activities at 10:00 or 10:30. The format changes with the day.

24a40a9e245317def933727e3926d77f393a4abf.en: A family morning at Isoneva playground with play, singing and art on changing themes. There are rooms for childcare and eating, and families can suggest themes to the staff.

b61883a214b5d4ded2cc9c820e86df0ba9fe96eb.en: Water exercise for men at Kontula Senior Centre, for pensioners with a valid service centre card. Sign up by phone.

a639dbe4fb36341cab64930b810880b6c68e88e0.en: A bridge card game at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

9201881dcf02b63572256fa18b09f5cfe134ec54.en: A small obstacle course for little children at Torpparinmäki playground on Mondays. Everyone is welcome to move, play and meet others.

1bbd57a08f18348ea3696c3b804b43b71e29d17e.en: A discussion group in Finnish for older women from different cultures at Kontula Senior Centre, covering current topics. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card, and no sign-up is needed.

ba49beb05d37c635acdfc1e15f9c337bdd6ecc9c.en: Baby mornings at Kalasatama Library every Monday from 9:30 to 11:30, with a rhyme session at 10:00. Families can meet others and spend time in the library.

649d870928c02225d22c28f1da09a7ee40f178f1.en: A movement and play session for all ages at Ruoholahti playground. Details of the session are on the playground's Instagram and noticeboard.

77ab4decdbdd3a34676b60277e047546110f8fbf.en: A family morning at Lehdokki playground for all ages, with togetherness, play, movement, rhymes and music.

43dff1c80def5d22c050b2eb6785f025d7fdeefc.en: A Monday art session at Santahamina playground, where children and adults paint, model, cut and glue together. No artistic skill is needed.

399c853a040100f70393fede78ca02d76cce13c0.en: Hide-and-seek games with an adult at Orava playground, outdoors or indoors. The weekly schedule is on the playground's social media.

f3be4f1e2fe78cd0442fb0e227aa912c050dc8c0.en: An open sewing workshop at Oulunkylä Seurahuone, where the sewing machines and overlocker are free to use for people who already know how to use them. No sewing instruction is given.

202e323b001ed5bc0c08a86807a178f9999761a6.en: Yard games at Munkki playground, such as hide-and-seek, movement sessions and obstacle courses. The detailed weekly programme is on Facebook and Instagram.

154a6d30cc4aa56acc07a80ddd58676cb169e60b.en: A memory group at Kustaankartano Senior Centre for people who find remembering difficult. It uses memory exercises in a friendly setting, needs no advance sign-up, and requires a free service centre card.

2f796164e69cb011db78dc391917c12c6f084b98.en: A memory club at Malminkartano Library, meeting every Monday from 10:00 to 11:00 in autumn 2026, with questions, puzzles and word searches for brain exercise.

c97b2c9218a8932550757b60525699b32f722997.en: A guided play session for toddlers at Nuoli playground at 10:00, with an obstacle course, ball throwing, car tracks and soap bubbles. Families can warm their own food there.

639a76409b422c36eb6050d416562554d6588eb6.en: A toddler morning at Seppä playground for children over one, with guided play, movement, rhymes, art or music indoors or outdoors.

4c7a4f9b3df9b5d8c270a7008f70cbf7410019c7.en: A family play session at Viiri playground, using changing toys and themes chosen by the families, such as obstacle courses and treasure hunts.

5d70275fadc7692637dc6fcc48a4d2a2923681ad.en: The "Tänään tavataan" café at Brahe playground, a meeting place for families from different language and culture backgrounds, with singing, play, exercise, stories and art.

33da0332324ef2051ec88eb1465a5250a672fe4e.en: A family Friday at Etupelto playground for all ages, with activities at 10:00 indoors or outdoors, and the chance to grill your own food.

5cbba989a65d554b45e76620bfafd86690abff9f.en: A Finnish language café at Pukinmäki Library, for talking about current topics and meeting new people.

ee49755dfb88d052792f0d462ee63c9ef0a93cc0.en: A baby circus session at Alppila community house, where a baby and a parent exercise together, led by a Brahe playground worker. Prams are left by the main entrance for fire safety.

8d764dabb6bfe141c95e4c5240894d8dd0b8a871.en: A knitting café at Riistavuori Senior Centre, where people can work on their own projects or continue the shared ones.

5355eaa32477f439f52a9b4739cb57dab95ebdaf.en: The "Tänään tavataan" café at Iso-Antti playground, a meeting place for baby and family groups from different cultures, with free activities, coffee and tea.

25d7bff8204c225f6649a992728e81222250a385.en: A morning for toddlers at Mäkitorppa playground, with togetherness, peer support and play indoors and a guided session at 10:15.

a6967d76f5099cf5481b0b3f5f1e873de88383b4.en: Yard activities at Strömberg playground on Mondays from 10:00 to 11:00, for children and their adults, with changing themes and help from staff to plan ideas.

ffcd605161977071960f55b7aff1da4537e1e68a.en: A movement session at Lampi playground every Monday for children aged 0 to 6 with a parent, using changing toys and themes. It moves indoors in winter.

03b969d5489600c09de06bd6aca940e292889385.en: A play morning at Kipinäpuisto playground, where children and adults play imaginatively with changing themes and can help plan activities.

520a34d37892243bcd1a15be3b4eb9c6f168e61b.en: A brain-teaser group at Riistavuori Senior Centre, with tasks based on reasoning.

19c0b8390218cab8eceec6d40b3b182a030bab42.en: Yard activities at Vähätupa playground for children aged 1 to 5, with guided sessions in movement, nature, rhymes and stories. The indoor space is also open to families.

ec9080d235abff07afaaa9c769ced444c518ef6a.en: Free digital help at Pihlajamäki community house on a weekly basis, for computers, tablets, phones and online services. Bring your own device.

db333074d527e7adac10789a9dd9c7184e034042.en: A baby morning at Rudolf playground, for families to meet and relax with peer support and themed sessions.

479aeae718ef3199acf6cfd2d759bc3ab2c4f61d.en: A free outdoor movement session at Kannelmäki playground, where children and parents can move together and meet other families. Food can be warmed and eaten indoors.

9168a44fa3765c324112101fd5fe59e7dddb19fa.en: Self-service sewing at Kinapori Senior Centre for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card. Bring your own fabric and threads, and pay in cash for using the overlocker. Volunteers are on hand to help.

2532d0ecba95ed34f88bf7f45c20bf506304b782.en: A circus session for babies and toddlers aged 4 months to 2 years, with songs, rhymes and play. Sessions are free, and the playgrounds have rooms for care and feeding.

e73b4e432bf2d7eb743de199282fb81244a400f0.en: A movement session at Tuorinniemi playground. Full details are on the playground's noticeboard and on Instagram and Facebook.

ceb547575bec1b91b4d81089bb1344f00f13b02a.en: Story sessions at Puistola Library on Mondays at 10:00, with Finnish stories for children under seven and their parents.

3031938132a97333b2791d86c4a9ecac2ff72b63.en: A memory and brain-training group at Roihuvuori Senior Centre, for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

ad8c08812f275e977a41295661feee5ef1745e72.en: An art morning at Kimmo playground for all ages, trying varied art and craft activities on changing themes. Families can share food and coffee.

bdc26ab0dccb6579729764c8d9e0fcce9282e89a.en: "Picassot", a family art session at Kivenkolo with painting, drawing and collage using fingers and brushes. It does not run in autumn holiday week 42.

575ba5b540ea248f45720ce1f42dc70bcc875a78.en: A toddler morning at Kotinummi playground, with play, singing, movement, rhymes and learning together.

46b8804fe8b9c3d61c5ecb9ef810285c44bcd743.en: A chair exercise group at Kinapori Senior Centre, led by a volunteer exercise guide, for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

6f0f246588695e9708879c669955f39df8f351c7.en: Yard activities at Laurinniitty playground, with changing toys and themes, such as obstacle courses and bike games. Bad weather moves them indoors.

77814e07378db2cc07354ebcfde5f2a097e5be21.en: A music session for small children at Roihuvuori playground every Monday at 10:00, with a programme that changes each week.

51aa4bd1c0c79f5ce741744b4d95150bad28cc49.en: Free Finnish classes for adults at Itäkeskus Library on Mondays from 10:00 to 12:00, running from 7 September to 21 December 2026. Children can come along, and you can start at any time.

a2e6cb5dca4cc1b790bd9c35774ed0fa8feff830.en: Self-guided outdoor and movement games at Maasälpä playground on changing themes, held outdoors where possible and at Rospuutto hall in bad weather.

1ae6ae8eb6cc8d87ab59174e557a4b0d921e158c.en: A baby morning at Intia playground for crawling and early babies with a parent, with songs, play, rhymes and sometimes massage or dancing. Families can share food and coffee.

4e0caf7ca77c0bb1f100be0b540a002e0567b878.en: An open memory group at Itäkeskus Service Centre, for people worried about their memory or with a memory diagnosis. It uses activities, conversation and reminiscence.

98d1242a5e2ef8977ec2cced690b31a2339cfa6a.en: A treasure hunt for children and adults at Kesanto playground, looking for the "Pikku Kurre" caches in the yard.

45c41884a9a547b007a6422568d9cad1986717a4.en: A baby and toddler morning at Nurkka playground, with music, crafts and stories, plus chances to meet other families.

e0f44d38c80add040ab131067e53a76c159464af.en: A movement group at Kajuutta family house for children aged 1.5 to 2 and their parents, with advance sign-up. Each block lasts about six weeks, and new groups start in January 2027.

15db649ca15c65876c23d33d1c66cbe8fa9f663f.en: An open meeting of the Maunula Network, for residents and organisations to plan better activities for older residents, music groups and support for people with memory problems. It is open to all residents.

a2e910d7cfe370aeb7680f75b0a26380f92a68d0.en: A German conversation group at Kamppi Service Centre, for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

0bfef54c822a2fce7e28ee0a539f80999f024730.en: A singing and play session at Linnunrata playground, indoors in winter and outdoors in spring unless stated otherwise. Everyone sings, plays, moves and makes music together.

60aaa86fe457dcb27626827b3682811b8a3c9ade.en: A baby circus session at Mellunmäki playground for babies aged 4 to 12 months, to build body control and movement with a parent. The best laughs usually come from babies aged 6 to 12 months.

57c9150d68c2c9bc3fc939e040a479619189cf7d.en: A music session at Rusthollari playground, with singing, rhymes and music-making for children and parents. Families can help plan activities with the staff.

32c8e0b462e350f88b87596fdc89903e6e392a36.en: Guided play and movement for children over one at Taivallahti playground, outdoors or indoors. The times are on the playground's Instagram and noticeboard.

979eae0561058413668026f1ac3b23af59143e51.en: An outdoor movement session at Lohikäärmepuisto playground, with play, jumping, balls and tricks. Families can grill their own food and make coffee or tea.

c65430bfc99c9a2b4658c952fa3cdbe7bdac30fb.en: An art morning at Sanna playground indoors, with crafts and drawing on changing themes, for all ages. Families can meet others and share food.

ade352ccd055c76ef458ac94c23ba91e190f0fcb.en: A music session at Linja playground for all ages, with rhymes, singing and music-making. Families can help plan the activities.

cb88248a416c131353c8c55c0942beba946b0573.en: A memory group at Kamppi Service Centre, with memory exercises in a friendly setting for people who find remembering difficult. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

30404d6152e62856f53ed9ac840b2af6eca33dd0.en: A Monday Finnish language café at Oulunkylä Seurahuone, for learners of all levels to chat and practise in a relaxed atmosphere.

340c54eaffa7cc0b6c051c3e20c11e2885e42243.en: A relaxed bingo session at Kontula Community House, with friendly company and a fun game.

9e4fc268b8c651b5ac58c534838f53cac683699a.en: An open bridge group on Mondays at the Maple hall of Saunabaari in Maunula. There is no instructor, so players should know the rules of bridge.

56c21d285c7e03649a3db4850f392cc0777ba912.en: A discussion group for women at Kinapori Senior Centre, for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card. The group picks topics and aims for a good atmosphere.

ee51338365d5aa2674b5886308336270f625ec0e.en: A body-care hour at Töölö Service Centre, with exercises to open the body, strengthen it and improve balance. Some are done standing and some on the floor.

85738b36a9973b59db0e664027f50a647c7f4495.en: A Monday Swedish conversation group at Malmi community house, for people who know the basics. It is free, limited to 10 people, and needs no sign-up.

ad8ff2f3e8db0a8551e999fffc1c255c5845c3d0.en: Group singing at Riistavuori Senior Centre with folk songs, hits and classical favourites, with talk about the songs' memories. There is no lesson in autumn holiday week 42.

264b6cb1c313bcaa07a0d11910b5f39f4fe1b082.en: Free peer help from Enter ry at Töölö Library on Mondays from 11:00 to 13:00 from 7 September to 7 December. No booking is needed, and people are helped in order of arrival.

4cd1d277c060dd9d34ced315ef810dcc30e2307e.en: A Monday peer group at Riistavuori Senior Centre with changing activities chosen by clients, a light exercise section and a self-paid lunch.

cb82f9cf96e8f31c4d5932c3f12845499ede19fe.en: A group at Myllypuro Senior Centre for learning the Samba card game. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

b27a8613036c6aed18d2491e883c09402d753f35.en: A male singing group at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

03b40319bd51ef3dc7175ec5f3051a76f1929c85.en: Group singing at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

d7a8bb52fc703d48dd77d4fb604320421a5b78da.en: A weekly poetry group at Kontula Community House on Mondays from 12:00 to 13:30, writing and reading poems in Finnish under a volunteer. It suits Finnish learners.

17821d51ce4be965fae78c0a64b372f7fc3a0960.en: A German reading group at Malmi community house, reading German articles, translating sentences into Finnish and discussing them. Up to 10 people can attend, and basic German is enough.

4a2b2e5be34c3989da6f294c9fafb22b8f649743.en: Open co-development meetings for the planned Aapelinkulma community and culture space in Kontula, at the community house and the library. Coffee is served, and no sign-up is needed.

651f2d58b3faff8489317a8afd00c12ee4588222.en: Free one-hour peer digital help from Enter ry at Suutarila Library on Mondays from 12:00 to 14:00, from 7 September to 7 December. Book at the library or by phone.

0b5939c59b7a9d5e0aec532935414ae22d3c57aa.en: A volunteer-led games group at Riistavuori Senior Centre. You can bring a favourite game or learn a new one.

9b18bbfce98769f6bcfd1e81f8fb347a902df2f4.en: The "Liekki" discussion group at Kontula Senior Centre on Mondays from 12:30 to 14:00. It is a relaxed open group for older people to meet and share thoughts, with no sign-up.

51f4e823c40a28fc009e09542aad8d3fc65ff0da.en: An open painting group at Töölö Senior Centre on Mondays from 12:30 to 15:00 with watercolours. There is no instructor, and people bring their own materials.

db176e98153e539166a1df7e772871587a7f1d3e.en: LäksyHelppi, a homework help session at Vuosaari Library on Mondays from 13:00 to 15:00 for primary school pupils. Red Cross volunteers help, with no sign-up needed.

b136f9c04879d018955caea0111c63fdfaf133d7.en: A crafts workshop at Pihlajamäki community house on Mondays from 13:00 to 15:00, with changing themes such as NeuroArt, Halloween crafts and jewellery making. It suits beginners and experienced crafters, and needs no sign-up.

b825e96b9856d23cde91c773aa55cde2b9cd4ece.en: Group singing at Kannelmäki Service Centre on Mondays from 13:00 to 14:00 on selected dates, with folk songs, hits and classical favourites. It is free and needs no sign-up.

93ceeffd36503cb8daf7d6b579c2e25fa4b17e23.en: Group singing at Munkkiniemi Service Home with folk songs, hits and classics, plus talk about the songs' memories. There is no lesson in autumn holiday week 42.

ecc512f129f4ea4d9077864781ec763fdb3cce81.en: A Swedish discussion group at Koskela Senior Centre, with a cheerful group that meets at the Forsby service centre.

e804ff345f66ab4072dcf6c4284939dcea2d7fd2.en: Homework help at Kannelmäki Library on Mondays from 13:00 to 15:00, given by a library volunteer. No sign-up is needed.

99f427cd8f3b491a24685c620ebc90cbb53ee70c.en: Swedish conversation at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

c78c2c54872f957fc627c3f2b3fbd9755bedd629.en: A knitting café at Myllypuro Senior Centre where people can knit together over coffee, bringing their own work or joining shared projects. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

1342d5882b1e03c3670435d97cfe575dcc64f163.en: Ideas coffee at Jakomäki Service Centre, where residents and staff talk and share wishes and ideas for future services.

70e5adfba83b5105bd02aec983f3b3998f1ae4ad.en: A singing session of peace songs at Kontula Senior Centre on Monday 26 October from 13:00 to 14:00, in Finnish and English, in the spirit of UN Day.

fb25355ac96650fbc08104590e935cf142ebfaf0.en: An open peer group for carers at Töölö Senior Centre, meeting on the last Monday of each month. You do not need to be an official carer, only caring for a relative.

41d703c1d64783c813218fc999a6043e2c2ff4fe.en: A community singing session at Saunabaari to sing evergreen hits. Once a month a volunteer pianist plays, and at other times the music comes from recordings.

f894201f877c51fe055915209e83e58e29c20614.en: A multicultural senior group at Roihuvuori Senior Centre, with coffee, games, conversation and movement. Finnish is used, but you do not need to speak it well.

914e23b3adca41b7e44bfd71ea77394d1042e170.en: Traditional gymnastics and stretching classes led by Sisko Salonen every Monday from 13:00 to 13:45, from 14 September to 14 December, at Kinapori Senior Centre. Classes are open to all.

ea53a9b28660de5e538b49b85b6c5ca01c00c3da.en: A workshop at Ohjaamo Helsinki to write a short profile about yourself, covering what you can do and what interests you, for use in job or school applications. The language is Finnish, and no advance sign-up is needed.

050a73dc8be64b11a1d8db455333cefb4eba8346.en: A watercolour group at Itäkeskus Service Centre, with small exercises and conversation. It uses sensory cues such as imagery and music to set the mood for painting.

c76b18438eafdcdd538902f2ac8916b76b20a986.en: A peer-support group at Kamppi Service Centre for people aged 50 and over whose first language is not Finnish, to practise Finnish through conversation. Each session covers a different topic, and there is no formal teaching.

6a0c8f371a9caa3d9747630afaa38e4da99f2752.en: A job application workshop at Helsinki Employment Services in Itäkeskus, covering how an application differs from a CV and its structure. Participants bring a job advert, must be Helsinki residents, and need to apply beforehand.

eed55ac4d5e08482e5be15cbdc50a0bf995af357.en: Homework help for school-aged children at Malmi Library on Mondays, with a light snack. It is run by the library together with Malmi parish.

9d1e11b926046a669070fa8a92b1edb258be53f4.en: A parkour club for school pupils at Roihuvuori Library, practising body control and agility through games. The first 12 people to arrive can join, and it does not run in autumn holiday week 42.

53add3774fd173470e8dcc42ab1d43abcd6cd6db.en: A nutrition talk on food memories and newer habits at Roihuvuori Senior Centre, given by Heljä Tuomarla. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

d2b03ae87b142f6ab3a3c6611da84405ef0ab04b.en: Water exercise for mixed groups at Kontula Senior Centre, to raise the heart rate and build muscle. It is for pensioners with a valid service centre card, and you can sign up by phone.

9e20f84c80e2ed87cb0e5c74e7e0ff6157618b4b.en: A karaoke session at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

74f91803b40048ab671377b9f0ad2efb8704bd87.en: A singing and rhyme session for babies held with a parent at Kajuutta family house, lasting about 30 minutes. Families can stay for a meetup from 13:00 to 15:30.

ad7c662cac762d0956c040de631e633fe9de7110.en: An open memory group at Ankkuri community house in Herttoniemi, for people who find remembering difficult or have recently been diagnosed with memory illness. It is for pensioners with a free service centre card.

d8a84f99bbe517d3c5ad777994356706d8e7015c.en: Group singing sessions at the Laajasalo assisted living facility in autumn 2026, with folk songs, hits and classics. The sessions are free and need no sign-up.

3ededdd668100e5df1ea4712831c0f525114e08a.en: A social worker at Töölö Library on set dates, to help people find the right services for everyday life and paperwork, including care and power-of-attorney forms.

b2973fbc273cc12efbf13e5e39410e17d528664c.en: Free and open peer digital help from Enter ry at Kallio Library, at a pace set by the person. Bring your own device and logins, and book in advance through the library.

1a54a154426b04ae786abf31e5ca7ce72175666f.en: A confidential, alcohol-free peer group at Kinapori Senior Centre for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card, offering support and a chance to be heard.

759a5e19a7d142da6ccef335e58b833438d6469c.en: A chess club at Oodi that meets on Mondays from 14:00 to 16:00, starting 7 September, on the ground floor.

d2dca5e0ec8cb870800e8f61bd251a25bc0a0e71.en: A creative writing group at Kinapori Senior Centre for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card. Details are from the volunteer contact.

49d71a7b0e184c96371125fbedcca92a52cb767a.en: A Finnish discussion group at Pasila Library on Mondays and Wednesdays from 14:00 to 16:00, from 17 August to 16 December. It has several level groups, and you can bring a friend.

9100a890f1b6ba8d264f432bdb87ff2fc3497b15.en: A club for girls aged 9 to 17 at Luuppi youth centre in Kontula, with gatherings on Mondays. Entry requires a digital membership card, which is free after the first visit.

d02b804b12f4d271901291dad62b8c5e498d2f12.en: A memory-activation session at Laajasalo Service Centre with riddles, games, quizzes and word exercises. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

121708400efa84871fc1a09235391b62ee24913d.en: A Pilke group at Kamppi Service Centre, where you can come as you are without changing your lifestyle. The group offers peer support, company and activities chosen by members, with coffee and a snack.

f1df0ea31a570254be06f3e4d83fddaa3f276ea9.en: A chair yoga session at Riistavuori Senior Centre, where the exercises can be done entirely seated.

e083e2911b703f8b6f84b1fcbbb16d5d4622d1f4.en: A talk series on Egyptian history from the pharaohs to Muhammad Morsi, at Stoa on Mondays. Entry is free, with no sign-up needed, and there is no lesson in autumn holiday week 42.

0fadaf8e1a5ff6157e4653632d3de3162365bbb5.en: Homework help from Red Cross volunteers at Itäkeskus Library on Mondays from 15:00 to 17:30, for schoolchildren and adult students. Volunteers can also listen to worries.

99f21f3e60bd96b412da57d7bd50c4fd08c00611.en: A knitting, coffee and chat group in Swedish at Lauttasaari Library on Mondays from 15:00 to 17:00, run with the Drumsö pensioners.

cb81e508ecac112add0ba7dbcca7d9605c0dd9ec.en: A group at Itäkeskus Service Centre for practising laptops and tablets, using services such as Omakanta, Maisa and Kela, based on client wishes.

791945b70bf92671617eaf7cfd8aec6a876a5a80.en: A beginners' Dungeons & Dragons group at Lassila community house, learning the 2024 edition. Game equipment is provided, and character creation runs from 14:00 to 15:00, before the game at 15:00.

447b78506f021fed889bb69045d3f3b91760db56.en: Gentle yoga and meditation led by Dada at Oulunkylä Seurahuone, focusing on balance. Mats and blankets are provided.

25657ac05ee3d0d4ef33fcb245845db5301473f8.en: A mat yoga session at Riistavuori Senior Centre, with some exercises on the floor and standing ones that can use a wall or chair for support.

00f13397b1f335c85932bdd25d21b40da855a94a.en: An open painting group at the small living room of Kontula community house, painting independently without instruction. Watercolours and paper can be borrowed.

b74c4fa68de0c9a3cd43266b1509a0d6a1836af7.en: A language café for people learning Finnish at Myllypuro Library, with tea and a chance to make new friends. It is not a Finnish class, and entry is free with no sign-up.

e5e4eb50d82e1b2e89cc0bba1a1cf5aeebe3fe04.en: A course on digital security at the Finnish Adult Education Centre, on topics such as scams, data protection and online shopping. Participants can take it in person or online, and it can lead to a digital safety skills badge.

e83522b10ae669bed2b008dbfdd4c1bad4cdc36b.en: A lecture series on Hinduism and new religious movements in the West, given by Jyri Komulainen on 19 and 26 October, 2 and 9 November. Entry is free.

b551ae8880f12dfa5b861c90a03296e09e6cf29f.en: A cultural trip series around Finland's towns, from Lappeenranta to Rovaniemi, with talks by Soili Poikonen on 19 and 26 October and later dates. Entry is free.

7db641cc502c702e3c9bc63e11aa38d7060d57e8.en: A cooking club for children at Maunula youth centre, where eight young people cook and bake together and learn household tasks. It is free, meets eight times on Mondays from 17:00 to 19:00 until 2 November, and sign-up opens 26 August.

fa9cdf2f69b280270a51e4e2f713946816019770.en: A talk by Harri-Pekka Pietikäinen on the pike's place in Finnish myth and nature, based on his new book. It runs for an hour, with time for questions, at Oodi.

ffef941947dc3bfa09544f32cf476752c85593f1.en: A writer visit at Rikhardinkatu Library with Pia Heikkilä, a journalist and novelist who has lived in India since 2010 and writes about South Asia and Delhi.

96a1873059aa2818990b291d89ef532bd6d310be.en: Free chess lessons at Lauttasaari Library on Mondays from 17:00 to 20:00, for all ages. You can come at any time, in Finnish or English, and the club plays without a clock.

d40a26d574a808a440f2f4d05b39ec5821e83482.en: Let's Read Together groups at Alppila community house for Finnish learners of all levels, running from September to April. Children can come along, and you can start at any time without registration.

ffe5a50b0fca516d711ca866f9838c28490b015c.en: A free Finnish language café at Oodi every Monday at 17:00, in Learning space 3 on the second floor. No registration is needed.

b550338208411182d6174d5889b6aba4bf78e236.en: An easy-reading book club at Töölö Library for people who find reading in Finnish hard, or find it hard to find time to read. Books include easy-read versions, and you can join even if you have not finished the book.

073b00b8ba44518ac8024428377238f7d675bdad.en: A Russian-language comics book club for teenagers aged 14 to 17 at Itäkeskus Library, on Mondays on 28 September, 26 October and 23 November. Entry is free.

1617e7e29e3b06c195cdcd140efd55ed5095872e.en: An Italian-language book club at Rikhardinkatu Library, meeting monthly on Mondays from 17:30 to 19:00. Anyone who reads Italian is welcome, and no sign-up is needed.

8a9e2e305a8e3253f6e369cb1a5641ca8fd0c76e.en: A cultural evening on Ella Kivikoski, a forgotten pioneer of Finnish archaeology, given by Pirjo Uino at Kamppi Service Centre.

503ffdb7b37c078d27bfb59a0364c6cf7b65a7d7.en: A lecture by researchers Outi Lepola and Riikka Taavetti on LGBTQ+ members of Finnish parliament, at Pasila Library on 26 October at 17:30. Entry is free.

eacca48834af15b0ec92ef8d67b49f208980f452.en: Low-threshold French-language theatre workshops and courses in Helsinki, run by LiikeLab at Alppila community house. Contact the organisers in French, English or Finnish.

a6db65991c559fc38e37eb598499fadf1b0c734a.en: A manga book club for people aged 15 and over at Vuosaari Library, meeting on alternate Mondays from 18:00 to 19:30 in the meeting room. Conversation is informal, and there is a Discord channel.

0c439787779a82286cd153c459df7eac69d0ff8c.en: A lecture series on the Middle Ages in art, from the idea of the "Dark Ages" to Christian imagery and rose windows. Art courses run on student responsibility, and there is no teaching in autumn holiday week 42.

e77918393633d93715800c7e51758fb690c38e67.en: A bedtime story session for families at Etelä-Haaga Library on alternate Mondays from 18:00 to 18:30, in the children's section.

b7161c16824901d80e1387636014bfb3b4ed430b.en: Open bedtime story sessions at Töölö Library on Monday evenings at 18:00, in the children's reading corner.

4ca755fcd7e673548b8f62ad758e0699136d5306.en: A monthly book club at Jätkäsaari Library on Mondays from 18:00 to 19:30, with books including Orhan Pamuk's "Kummallinen mieleni". Books are held at the library about a month in advance, and you can join single sessions.

a69656556a899a61075b312241046eab77f72fd9.en: A monthly crime-fiction book club at Oulunkylä Library on Mondays at 18:00, with books by Dusse, Nugent, Malin, Vargas and Creed. Sign-up is by email.

fd5aecbbadc9beaa5c416229436dd2c110a090ff.en: A monthly comics book club at Itäkeskus Library on Mondays from 18:30 to 20:00, with classics such as Junji Ito's "Uzumaki". The September meeting takes place at the Helsinki Comics Festival.

24ec8f2547942d45035a0738bc62b3c12deda88e.en: A bedtime story session in Swedish for families at Etelä-Haaga Library on alternate Mondays from 18:30 to 19:00.

dc810beddf8979d7fdf46fb0f3ed9a6c5d51cadf.en: A jazz concert at Temppeliaukio Church on 26 October from 18:30 to 20:00, paying tribute to Hungarian jazz guitarist Gábor Szabó. Entry is free.

86510c764eb73a9a66c3e9a77c4686e02740f8da.en: An autumn 2026 literature lecture series at the Kanneltalo centre on Monday evenings, on writers such as A.W. Yrjänä, Mika Waltari and Margaret Atwood. Entry is free, and there are also author interviews in the concert hall.

577d9f715fcd0cce0a3149f3fbe733f9b7b466fa.en: A lecture series on Siberia in Russian history, from its conquest to the Gulag and today's oil and gas. Entry is free, and there is no lecture on 12 October.

7e3336f644e28c0950c350121cee398facd53ab2.en: A lecture series on Roman architecture, from Vitruvius's ideas to Pompeii's houses. Entry is free, and no sign-up is needed.

08176dd1977753dd8771951003ceec472292b99d.en: Free digital help at Oodi on weekdays, for computers, tablets, phones and online services. Book in advance by phone or at the Helsinki-info desk, and bring your own device.

81b4dbef067e349cc931492995b06ada9388444a.en: A pop-up micro cinema at Itäkeskus Library with short animations, early cinema and visual stories for children and families. Special screenings include Mexican animations on 31 October and an early-cinema workshop on 7 November.

2d03ae9ba9c9b83c0fbdfce72cd2f9482d0b3bd1.en: A pop-up reading room on colonialism, by the C& Center of Unfinished Business, at Oodi as part of Southnord Artfest. It includes books selected by Ethel-Ruth Tawe and an art reference collection from Southnord.

803102b92634f174f289299e6d7a8752228d6513.en: A Pilke group at Kannelmäki Service Home for older people who have had substance problems. It offers peer support, breakfast and a round of news, and you can join as you are.

7e46f67cfe70641aef7271ba368033a5dd8c49a7.en: Free digital help at Munkkiniemi Library with the "Digitalkkari" advisor, for laptops, tablets and smartphones. Book online, at the counter or by phone.

ad89c9f9aab9facdd29105a0f69699913ba81c35.en: A patchwork crafts session at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

bd6561a1d923f90a9cbc280e07c203663bcbb375.en: A dance exercise session at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

4ff50892b709e8d529274bb2b1ad57150f199353.en: A Pilke peer group in Vuosaari for older people who use or have used substances. It is closed, with registration through social workers, and the group plans its activities together.

e456632ac87dc4c037e2ae1447d046930384d6a2.en: A baby morning at Isoneva playground for babies under about one year, with play, singing, art and stories on changing themes, plus meeting other families.

760070fc0a1ad6c95ce8484471f1d93cc0d9a6a2.en: "Kivet kertovat", a group at Kinapori Senior Centre for people interested in stones, minerals and fossils, with research, visits and trips. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

a3e66d4891d683f1ac905be3622912865be55083.en: A Swedish-language session at Seppä playground for families with young children, with the programme planned together with the families. It is a chance to practise Swedish and warm your own food.

e16a9f8850912db54cc501a18d073c56c7011022.en: A baby and toddler meetup at Maatulli playground on Tuesdays, with changing activities from 10:00 to 10:30 and a chance to meet other families.

d9d843797315dc529cee88e89b748930c6a21de8.en: An open story session at Tapanila Library on Tuesdays in even weeks, from 9:30 to 10:00, for families and family childminders.

9bd724fe0edf3e8e61043c676fd37f2e9b845555.en: A simple outdoor movement session at Kannelmäki playground for children who can already walk, with running, jumping and ball play.

8dcda85460a907fbac4101dea252cfe7c3c97188.en: Songs and music for all ages at Ruoholahti playground, held outdoors or indoors. Details are on the playground's Instagram and noticeboard.

2cffaeaec049657b8d460fb0668e79ef114aaa9a.en: A Tuesday morning at Santahamina playground with songs, rhymes, stories and time together for families with young children.

b7145ba76f5754b1ab442da27944a4dabbda7cae.en: A family morning at Taivallahti playground, with guided play, movement, rhymes, art or music from 10:00 to 10:30, outdoors or indoors.

ff1b9543cbc65dc2a7abdfb0ef3e496fb58903c6.en: A singing and rhyme session at Munkki playground, indoors or outdoors, with themes that change with the seasons. It suits children of all ages, and no sign-up is needed.

835d08fb43fbee8af750c2e95df67005c6895099.en: An art morning at Orava playground with changing creative sessions shared with an adult. The weekly programme is on the playground's social media.

ddf135e45d0293abfc8bb6fac05405d06dd3695f.en: A bobbin lace session at Töölö Senior Centre, where you can try lace making without bringing your own tools. A volunteer helps at the start, and a free service centre card is needed.

4790b287058bdb7c21fcee18d5fa3b8bac851a13.en: A coffee morning at Kontula community house, with coffee, tea and a small snack to share. Everyone is welcome.

6e073780e0050d26c49d37a3ee489084bad51b8d.en: A "Tänään tavataan" café at Viiri playground, a weekly meeting place for families from different language and culture backgrounds. It offers play, singing, exercise, stories and art, with coffee and a small snack.

e2cdf210d612403bb16bfc4ed8cdaddece8d6703.en: A morning of art on changing themes at Mellunmäki playground, suitable for both the youngest and older children in a family.

585d419b50f72841e2916cd969ba72cc5e27e4b6.en: An open day at Kontula Senior Centre, with a programme of songs, memory information, a chair exercise and a tour of the centre's activities. It is for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

ef3b1919518ade46b8e2670539b4201e8cd4f786.en: A baby morning at Etupelto playground for babies under one, with themes and guided sessions that change each week. Families can eat their own food or warm it.

c58047332bb4b13f27f8e723e739a2b6bb816fbf.en: An open, peer-led support group for family carers at Kustaankartano Senior Centre. It is confidential, and you do not need to be an official carer.

bc6a7f574bef859413ec3c12d363048c2f94299d.en: Asahi, a slow, low-threshold movement method combining gentle flowing movement with deep breathing. It is for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

4f750a88f43c93b19f44a71fdc4430e00b36b5f1.en: A baby morning at Strömberg playground for babies aged about 0 to 1, with peer support and a short rhyme, song or exercise session at 10:30.

61a93c63606954c0b029debe3c6ebd3d9ea31925.en: A baby morning at Trumpetti playground for meeting other families, with guided songs, rhymes, art and baby circus at 10:00.

0cebd2548de07c13f5ce55bd9016a5f176c3a96d.en: A music session at Lampi playground every Tuesday for children aged 0 to 6 with a parent, with singing, rhythm instruments and dancing. It moves indoors in winter.

f622fcf3e9b6a4d17ea1394b6ae1606181641766.en: A music session at Kipinäpuisto playground, open to siblings too, with rhymes, singing and making music together.

9bdcef5d9f45f4d951fa87efde57d3c30e4a5b62.en: A search patrol at Rudolf playground, where children look for favourite characters in the yard. The schedule is on the playground's social media.

dbd53f5d9eca96266bb277cb48f84bd61e56a471.en: An AA group meeting at Myllypuro Senior Centre, for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

ee5d76d718e4d64316787bcd574eca0398189359.en: A baby morning at Viikkari playground, with music, baby food painting and baby massage. It takes place in the red hall, entered from the maple yard side.

5494c18dfc680e991adde44fa941ad981ba7aaa6.en: A crafts and arts workshop at Kiikku playground for all ages, trying varied activities on changing themes. Families can meet others and warm their own food.

efd689316760708bda2012b9d8fd5ef56ade1bc1.en: Small yard events at Tuorinniemi playground. Full details are on the playground's noticeboard and on Instagram and Facebook.

5e89d9e320eae2f4ba28786498501a09511f2a12.en: A toddler morning at Arabia playground for toddlers and parents, with play, movement, singing, rhymes and learning together.

81824f0f7c4edbb92ff50dc96eb5c905f0e95782.en: A Tuesday meditation session at Töölö Library, led by musician Kalle Ylitalo, exploring body awareness and deep relaxation with Buddhist-based practices. It is free, lasts about 90 minutes, and you can leave early if needed.

8143555ad7be19c7a3514246459ae6f2e994a1d9.en: An outdoor movement session at Rusthollari playground, with play, tricks, exercise and ball games. Children can meet friends and parents can meet other families.

299e390bb0c550e3b4458cfb1264f308ed025a0f.en: An art and crafts session for all ages at Lahnalahti playground indoors. The details are on the weekly programme.

824786a49bee517051bd0db3d10308c8dbc60d53.en: An open memory group at Koskela Senior Centre for people with a memory diagnosis, offering peer support and meaningful everyday content. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

4516f1b149469fc2af31c78e8ab60fb0c331dd39.en: Free, personal digital help from older volunteers at Enter ry in Alppila community house, for tablets and mobile phones.

f13e3e4fc6a320048895fa42b23dd27860aa38ca.en: A shared yard activity at Mäkitorppa playground with games, sports and play with club children. The programme is on the playground's social media.

80cb34667ba8cc5d73168a2ea402885b731c2d27.en: A Tuesday meetup at Käpylä Library for families with babies, in Finnish and Swedish, with first book tasting and coffee. The sessions run from 10:00 to 11:00 on dates in 2026.

9e0fad209fb427292680cd064344361e6a5f0de0.en: A meeting for families with babies at Itäkeskus Library on alternate Tuesdays, with a rhyme and play session for babies and toddlers with an adult. On 20 October a Molli theatre show replaces it.

d3c47efde4eb728d0e40c869822dedcc376bde79.en: A toddler morning at Torpparinmäki playground, with a gym session for toddler families from 10:15, and the indoor room for play and eating from 9:00 to 12:00.

82521a174e43dcf408285784830e3b248708cb65.en: A story session at Kimmo playground for all ages, reading stories together. Families can meet others, make coffee and warm food.

9e4305f235986845790e057065895f8fcf534bdd.en: A morning porridge and coffee at Oulunkylä Seurahuone, for everyone who wants to join.

8de7417338469a57bdc846705982f481871da20d.en: Free digital help at Kontula community house on several weekdays, for computers, tablets, phones and online services. Bring your own device.

02c42191e3086d0950eb5523d438242146310f21.en: The Pilke programme at Kustaankartano Senior Centre, peer-support groups for older people who have substance problems. Join through a social worker, and you can come as yourself.

8ef3c4519fc6430279a5e4f13984bdcbde3b33c9.en: An active play session for children aged 1.5 to 3 with a parent at Kivenkolo's Mikael church. It lasts about 45 minutes, includes an obstacle course, and must be booked in advance. It does not run in autumn holiday week 42.

8c8869f433bbbcd376e9d475df2dc55de0348f75.en: A toddler morning at Linja playground for toddlers and parents, with play, movement, singing, rhymes and learning together.

fb41be52c210861f308f263532354f41bcc5d1f3.en: A Finnish language café at Suutarila Library on Tuesdays from 10:00 to 12:00. A volunteer leads it, and people talk about current topics.

5219080cf0bdba73227a631e87b547e9419cdf67.en: Asahi, a Finnish-developed health exercise method focusing on prevention, breathing and balance. It is a group led by a volunteer exercise guide for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

5ce86cb44f8cfb570c6e153dedbb5a0d6b20fb36.en: An arts and crafts session at Laurinniitty playground for all ages, held indoors or outdoors depending on the weather.

7a21ef3fc38c6ce3320b03ed06ce04e8e2ee2d15.en: A fixed four-week programme of baby meetups at Filpus playground, from 10:00 to 11:30, with songs, yoga and baby circus.

ad176a3498c1ec441a4c2278d765c3c52b413346.en: Families gather for baby meetups at Roihuvuori playground on Tuesdays, with activities on changing themes.

8a8905489eadf74ed3e80c8fbab66d6ee29778d9.en: A baby meetup at Maasälpä playground for parents to meet others and get peer support. There is a separate safe, unhurried room for babies.

d607804beaa792cb2be39aca23a031c81b741a45.en: An art morning at Intia playground for all ages, with guided art and crafts on changing themes from 10:00 for 30 to 60 minutes, then free play and time to eat packed food.

01089c766f64b610e54ce382aa7912e8a536c9cc.en: A strength and balance exercise group at Riistavuori Senior Centre. Register by phone.

3e5d481069d67628b11b6ba00e218bbd910da92d.en: A rhyme session at Jakomäki Library on 29 September and 27 October for babies and toddlers aged 0 to 3 with an adult. It lasts about 30 minutes, and no sign-up is needed.

a32508deea28bd356d8aa73e1db79fc6859ddb0a.en: A movement session for babies aged 1 to 1.5 and their parents at Kajuutta family house, with advance sign-up. Each block lasts about six weeks, and new groups start in January 2027.

ec8d5b7d66ebf34b9b8f72078c6bfda4a0f85444.en: A traffic-themed play session at Linnunrata playground, where children ride bikes along a track, learn traffic signs and lights, and visit a petrol station.

af676ab29bd4ebd887b2dc1648394298e008ee53.en: A knitted sock workshop at Alppila community house, with yarn and guidance provided. You can also bring your own knitting project.

a4e3cb3e3670b4477b7857ec8ef8603b90b0d298.en: A baby morning at Sahrami family house for crawling and early babies with a parent, with music and movement. Families can warm their own food, and the house is open Monday to Friday from 9 to 16.

af207e408783186207c7053c37f17b8f4d2164e8.en: A music session at Iso-Antti playground for everyone, with rhymes, singing and music-making. Families can meet others and warm their own food.

0e94a10b9cfa180df522080a8d25d04afdef0ec3.en: A nature-themed session at Lohikäärmepuisto playground for children and families, with exploring, crafts and short outings nearby.

a78cc8e429f20804dc283d1ddd0c387702068dda.en: A community theatre group at Myllypuro Library led by Teatteri IlmiÖ, looking at themes of interest to older people through theatre, music and visual art. No experience is needed, and the group pauses on 13 October.

f3c8758f36eee00528f7d220f2623c0f9df8060b.en: A chair exercise session at Pihlajamäki community house on Tuesdays from 10:00 to 10:30. Movements build strength and flexibility and are done mostly seated to varied music. No sign-up is needed.

e8d5750547870371defd85043f81a22bd3c78fd3.en: A live online body-care session at Saunabaari every Tuesday at 11:00, led by a physiotherapist for 45 minutes. It uses standing and seated moves to ease back pain and improve balance, and can be joined from home.

806774b0a71ded42fc574db1922e5657d25b3101.en: Mummorock, a popular, lively exercise class at Kamppi Service Centre. Sign-up is in advance from 1 to 11 September, with a waiting list for new people. It is for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

24de4b833f066605d6f3d3c8e31d37309fc2afb3.en: Free peer help from Enter ry at Rikhardinkatu Library on Tuesdays from 11:00 to 14:00, from 1 September to 8 December, for phones, tablets and computers. No booking is needed.

57f6259d24644d451a059c742b49307634d6b763.en: A watercolour group at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

32449a8b6a8315a5a1650c016c5e961ef8b470ff.en: A low-threshold circus exercise session at Myllypuro Senior Centre, run by Sirkus Magenta. It is free, needs no sign-up, and is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

770ac0f6204189bbf6d803c833ae985d55cb1e36.en: An art group at Kontula community house, painting together with different materials such as watercolour, tempera, gouache, pastels and charcoal, under guidance.

808da4d852096797cf07e52384b438f03cde4649.en: A dance fitness class at Riistavuori Senior Centre, where people learn steps from Latin-style line dancing without a partner. It costs 7 euros per session, and the first session is free.

5d5468304521fd8ace13c4bbd0d7abc476e24850.en: Group singing at the Opistotalo Castrén hall on the fourth floor, with folk songs, hits and classics. It is free, needs no sign-up, and building repairs may cause some disruption.

20500372507d78b586023da58fabbbefd9167b7b.en: A clothes repair workshop at Saunabaari on Tuesdays from 11:00 to 15:00, where a helper repairs clothes and textiles. People can also sew on the house's machines, and thread and fabric are provided.

638c73dcef223faf5ca26eb5a2095c39f77ce1f2.en: A chair exercise session at Oulunkylä Seurahuone, using a warm-up, strengthening and stretching. Participants can hold onto the chair for support.

9d0e1cffdc453358b6eec5ad9c2d21c394d886b9.en: A brain training session at Kamppi Service Centre with easy exercises that stimulate different parts of the brain. Participants work in small groups of up to 10 people, and it is for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

5046149f00436eef2e220dcd92ac1270f59c1af2.en: A Tuesday music listening session at Oulunkylä Seurahuone, with either a theme chosen by the host or song requests from participants.

db79420500d02fc2451fbe91d4271249b94d1ce5.en: A wellbeing exercise session at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

4894b14c30249bc3fab42f55200622f0a222708a.en: A bingo session at Roihuvuori Senior Centre for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

1442d79efc892e312613d669952d43e72d5d82d9.en: Free peer digital help from Enter ry at Tapulikaupunki Library on Tuesdays from 12:00 to 14:00, from 8 September to 8 December. Book an hour in person or by phone, and you can borrow a laptop.

b48823afd433535151dc3a219836fc7b9ce4d509.en: The "Laulusiskot" singing group at Kinapori Senior Centre, meeting on the second and fourth Tuesday of each month from 12:00 to 13:45. New singers are welcome.

a78e2a14d6b363cd08b7fc542824ed410fc4404a.en: Free digital help at Pihlajamäki community house on Tuesdays from 12:00 to 14:00, from 22 September to 24 November, given by a volunteer trained by Helsinki Mission.

480a65304ffbae149002557b11f3b058b70233d6.en: A free, playful bingo at Pihlajamäki community house on Tuesdays from 12:00 to 13:00, from 11 August to 15 December.

6c5bfab0c47a08de55cbdc44339f149d0e9b9635.en: A poetry group at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

e410836a57e802a78ebb045ea8a291fc9fd9413a.en: A Spanish and Finnish language café at Kamppi Service Centre, with open conversation with native speakers and no pressure to speak. It is for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

445cef4e92e607dfd18de43765e322c019843aa5.en: A knitting café at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

0a3aefc659ccb15f2b242fff1efd73ba56613359.en: The "Liekki" discussion group at Vuosaari Library on Tuesdays from 12:30 to 14:00, a relaxed open group for older people, with no sign-up needed.

6772ba863b0d95ed3d2c2bd04efe3df226f32af3.en: A memory group at Itäkeskus Service Centre with quizzes and memory tasks on different topics. No sign-up is needed, and you can arrive on any Tuesday at 13:00.

06b360f1921e16234245a087813e719bc01f0b0f.en: Group singing at Stoa with folk songs, hits and classical favourites, with talk about the songs' memories. It is free, with no sign-up, and there is no lesson in autumn holiday week 42.

08f2ee39ce610c1fcd338dd10a795e4cbe8932cd.en: A device lending service presentation at Kamppi Service Centre, where people can borrow a tablet at home for a month with a task pack for tips. It is run by the Vanhusten Turva foundation.

c099161d44f2ee09819443cb5c86c7c079208e4d.en: A reading group at Kinapori Senior Centre for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card. Details are from the volunteer contact.

b9d6ef07b3ab4c983fc2fc87ede76b856e3a579e.en: A fitness class at Töölö Library with Elina and Tapio, changing each time with stretching, muscle work and a chat afterwards. It suits all levels, and you should bring a water bottle.

233eb2afd6edae28ced945e5452bba60c30ef27c.en: A memory and brain-exercise group at Jakomäki Service Centre with quizzes and brain tasks. It is open, with no sign-up needed, and suits people who want to check their memory.

acaeeae9febe989e80b38871ce734a6edff3dd63.en: A men's group at Roihuvuori Senior Centre, supporting functional ability through games, conversation and shared activities. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

416301da445154b452ece724f480b59ef157a483.en: A light yoga class at Alppila community house, led by volunteer Dada. No previous experience is needed.

3b5a764ff5ef0f2d9c88f50eade7b307cb3105c2.en: A job search workshop at Helsinki Employment Services in Kamppi on the hidden job market, showing how to find unadvertised jobs. Participants must be Helsinki residents, apply in advance, and need basic language and digital skills.

7458b5887554ce8039c1d70aa07abbbe0d8dbef9.en: A lecture series on Romanticism at Community House Ankkuri in Herttoniemi, on the blue flower, Britain, early German Romanticism and the darker side of the era. Entry is free, with no sign-up needed.

9f2a3288ac7f4e558cd2193f91fc6aeff9207b79.en: Homework help for primary school pupils at Suutarila Library on Tuesdays from 13:15 to 15:00, from 18 August, with a light snack. The library runs it with Malmi parish.

623e319986fb6e407cdb73c34dfc117afd1b22e2.en: An open art corner for school-age children at Malmi Library on Tuesdays, with art supplies for solo or group projects, and sometimes guided activities.

6198ba3254516c331fbef93da2edf20ecd03d5d9.en: A writing workshop at Vuosaari Library, led by Hilpi Marttinen of PerformanceSirkus, for people who want to write. It uses memory and recall exercises, and you sign up by phone.

d31c8a43ecfed15fef7821518a6916753953c2ab.en: A children's and family crafts session on a changing theme at Sahrami family house, with a parent and child working together. Families can help plan the activities.

a1ab53d2389b1d65f82a12a78c6a945a5bc54ef8.en: An open family café run by Mannerheim League for Child Welfare at Töölö Library, where children and adults meet and take part in activities together.

a7ae264e9bf5f42d171560b28e648c3250c2e96a.en: A talk in Swedish at Kamppi Service Centre for people who are thinking about hearing aids or are starting to use them. Sign-up is needed by 19 October because coffee is served.

2a59d658d801152559cdeb09ce448e1501ef2e05.en: A circus group for older people at Roihuvuori Senior Centre, with low-threshold circus exercises that anyone can join in their own way. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

7a9820fc8f0157fe0d66c611d16ff322a238a715.en: A singing and rhyme session for babies aged about 6 to 12 months with a parent, lasting 20 to 30 minutes. Families can stay for a meetup from 13:00 to 15:30.

decf1b7a2da57d072ffdf2cd3710ae1084060f1b.en: Beginners' yoga at Kinapori Senior Centre for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card. It suits all fitness levels, as long as you can get onto and off the floor on your own, and no sign-up is needed.

409221d59108a99b1f778e70bb9c5363493961c1.en: A workshop for school pupils at Oulunkylä Library on Tuesdays, where children can try a 3D printer or a vinyl cutter. It does not run on 13 October.

ef6021b51e06eebd4a55ed28ead6a3a2280d7dd2.en: A sewing workshop at Lassila community house on Tuesdays, for repairing favourite clothes or shortening trousers. Machines are free to use for those who can sew, and beginners get an introduction.

1bc80b44c8ff4f359ff8594236360825da727b2b.en: An open art group at Oulunkylä Seurahuone, where people try their own ideas and techniques together. All materials are provided by the house.

6bb3f5aff3c116bad60ba8e750b8a125a91891e2.en: A reading dog session at Kallio Library every other Tuesday from 14:00 to 15:15, where you can read aloud to Ebba. Book a 15-minute slot, and the session suits everyone over six.

6835e2e5036ed23b9955071ae84ec359ac009b33.en: "Kukkia kaikille", a flower workshop by FloweRescue at Lassila community house, using surplus flowers. Participants make a bouquet that can be given to a neighbour or friend.

fdd19d0e5c170d327f6f32aabe3911766924f8ce.en: A Helsinki slang group at Kontula community house, listening to songs in Helsinki slang and talking about it. It is led by community worker Ari.

8bfda55bc6fb2db242bdaa058939331cd8bf9b7f.en: Finnish conversation for all levels at Pihlajamäki community house, led by a volunteer. You can join informally.

15592f43dca7cce82c161bbe833bd7233b706e81.en: A Tuesday play session at Tapulikaupunki Library for schoolchildren from 14:00 to 16:00, with PlayStation 5 games on alternate weeks and crafts on others.

a45b948d96c6c2d8c207a4bc6a58ee435dbfd7a2.en: A children's activity afternoon at Jakomäki Library on Tuesdays from 14:00 to 15:30, with crafts and games, starting 1 September.

c246f08e52768b11ce6f8bc5a7f7dcae34365e33.en: A quiz at Saunabaari on even-numbered weeks on Tuesdays, for fun and to test your knowledge in a relaxed atmosphere. Scores are not compared.

79998bc31ff2270b819d9fca0372ba21dbf02436.en: Tuesday game afternoons at Kalasatama Library for children aged 8 to 12, from 18 August to 24 November. Each session learns a new board game and plays selected PlayStation 5 games.

b4d6dbbf09f0ec33102a3d965ae8a36d7113937f.en: A comic workshop for children at Maunula Library, led by art educator Petra Rapo from the Comics Centre. Children practise planning, designing characters and writing stories.

1bf9e217df663d854cc1853bb85774e6d34f283a.en: A library grandmother at Vuosaari Library's children's section, available to read, play board games or talk.

2236daf74f6cdd17bd1dce49a326d911f9d54a76.en: A Finnish culture and future-planning group at Alppila community house for Galimatias students. It is free, needs no sign-up, and drinks and snacks are included.

0a657b2d539806e504adf18fee433fcf6cd5ee8b.en: Free Enter ry digital guidance for seniors at Kannelmäki Library, for phones, tablets, laptops and apps. Book at the desk or by phone.

7faf86c8a235cb9535bf8ff317b690b1ad36ff4a.en: A cheerful discussion group at Riistavuori Senior Centre, led by volunteers.
