b0fe26596a9b847cefd4ff658b175f0971eb36f2.en: A Finnish practice group at Riistavuori Senior Centre, run by volunteers. You can also sign up to become a volunteer leader.

6ca5ca191a03365194cf2f1c626181975202577c.en: A light exercise and balance class for older people at Syystie Senior Centre, led by a senior exercise guide. Coffee is served after exercise, and the activity is free.

81b90bb5225f58ae2a46809ac71dec01a5e0b648.en: An open crafts club at Malminkartano Library on Tuesdays from 14:00 to 15:30, for an afternoon of making things together.

613bb156c86ca87649c2dd2141d3558584f31834.en: A Finnish language café at Töölö Library on Tuesdays from 14:30 to 16:00, from 1 September to 15 December, run by fluent Finnish-speaking volunteers. Coffee and tea are served.

d9ad9184472d57e48ef16e236b9fe771fe413369.en: A creative writing club for children in grades 3 to 6 at Laajasalo Library, led by a writing teacher. It is free, held on Tuesdays from 15:00 to 16:30 on set dates, and you sign up online.

ffa2e4dd6ef5b11c096ec94db5b14a430383ec0a.en: A coding club at Itäkeskus Library using Minecraft to try programming with practical experiments. The course is fully booked.

b90be2024303fa24e078f6a2ab73b6f50172fd81.en: An open table game session at Kontula community house on Tuesdays, where people can try the Dutch game Shuffle, a points-based game that is easy to learn.

a125d895ea428bbf842c82de457be5066923175e.en: A dance group at Kinapori Senior Centre that practises in the gym from 15:30 to 17:00 each Tuesday from 15 September to 22 December.

7a1dd6ca25a9b36a10f8f5bf0bdd6290070bee98.en: Free digital help in Arabic and English at Itäkeskus Library for Windows computers, tablets, smartphones, internet, email and electronic forms.

ef453761379b9030bc0be998e62fc2669d625ad3.en: Relaxed hangouts for young people aged 11 to 16 at Myllypuro Library on Tuesdays, with games, chat and snacks. Themes include jewellery making and a repair workshop.

82c3c5485a1c1c8657d042186bbbdecf9da6b93d.en: Digital help in Russian at Vuosaari Library, with a personal 45-minute session for devices, software and online services. Book by phone in Russian or Finnish.

ed30e0a42ea5bf5fb0c4349613faee06d0c18538.en: Tai chi with a volunteer instructor at Roihuvuori Senior Centre. The group is full, but you can join a waiting list at the desk.

5766a5c82dad00db169d749e2b89de56ffac0503.en: Free evenings at the Architecture & Design Museum on the last Tuesday of most months, from 16:00 to 20:00. Exhibitions and the programme are free to enter.

a9bea7f3ce887866ef652881d28830d80a046b6b.en: Bridge at Oulunkylä Seurahuone, a four-player card game played in partnerships where players bid and win tricks.

01675822d6432996b6af4766cba22d7e5fd380c5.en: A cultural club at Pasila Library on Tuesdays from 16:30 to 18:00, starting 25 August. People share traditions and customs from their own cultures, with no advance sign-up needed.

11d67921f77d09fd9af66e97ff787c93e4a7d2c4.en: A seven-part lecture series on Russian music from the 1800s to today, from national Romanticism through modernism to Soviet-era tensions. It is at the Finnish Adult Education Centre, and the building renovation may cause some disruption.

529f6d0b681f563615dcf00ecc2a885aac9f7cc9.en: A lecture series on Finnish architecture by period, from granite churches and manors to 1960s-1980s suburbs. It is held on Tuesdays from 20 October to 1 December, with free entry.

74b0bdf89efdf9e0281345f00363ca5de82d2027.en: A free guided tour of the City Museum's new main exhibition "Helsinki", in Finnish on Tuesdays at 17:00, in English on Thursdays at 17:00, and in Swedish on the first Wednesday of each month.

684271a42c74b59def023cfdfac76c7b482801eb.en: "Mitä kuuluu, Maltsu?", a relaxed coffee meeting at Malminkartano Library on the last Tuesday of each month from 17:00 to 18:00, to hear about local activities and services. Entry is free.

71fec7faf2b79cc40c522ddd2d35fa3ca174c66f.en: The opening of the C& Center of Unfinished Business pop-up library at Oodi, with readings, a panel and the launch of "Southnord Vol. 1: 2023–2026". The discussion starts at 18:00.

fc5dc7573b7a2469f2717901c36dfc6eaf059389.en: A lecture series on the great ideas of the modern age, including rationalism, liberalism, conservatism and nationalism, linked to historical examples. It runs on Tuesdays from 27 October at the Finnish Adult Education Centre.

b05e4e8410e7aa4c7189ffe9ab516fc6f77d991b.en: Youth Tuesdays at Kannelmäki Library for ages 14 to 20, with drama, creative writing, films, CV and study help, and board games. No registration is needed, and light snacks are served.

3874c37b3cd324d43b5d12a6d216a36dc960c4a5.en: Free homework help at Oodi every Tuesday from 17:00 to 19:00, given by Red Cross volunteers for learners of all ages, from comprehensive school to university. Registration is optional.

ef61421579b79a5d7bcbfa8665e84456cdf28b24.en: An open session at Oodi where you can learn how to thread a sewing machine and sew a fabric keychain. It runs from 17:00 to 19:00, needs no advance sign-up, and is free.

1e4a23db6e32433729276b26a1e3848df1e81c19.en: A quiet, dark walk of about 3 km to Uutela, starting at Café Kampela, on the natural paths of the capital region. It is free, needs no sign-up, and phones are kept silent on the walk.

95b5e22451747403c14e72732fdf0c9af279d074.en: Let's Read Together groups for adult Finnish learners at Alppila community house, running from September to May. Children may come, the groups are free, and you can start at any time.

079f3dd93f062f19c371cd73cb4c9caa9f5d4039.en: A voice and expression training for volunteers at Töölö Library on 27 October from 17:00 to 19:30, with book tips at the end. There is space for 45 people, and registration closes on 23 October.

fa5967c063c5c0a6d6ec5c60117d3a3b805d8472.en: A creative arts and crafts club at Kannelmäki Youth Centre, where children explore self-expression through art and craft. Children help plan the activities, and no prior experience is needed.

594703561173625d93503a238974849e2b20d726.en: A free Finnish language group at Oodi for immigrants, meeting on Tuesdays from 17:30 to 19:30. The teachers are volunteers, and men are welcome too.

36b11c28000fe5678db02537e47d9d2ed8f7351f.en: Let's Read Together at Vuosaari Library, a free Finnish class on Tuesdays where you can practise reading, writing and speaking. Children may come, and you can join at any time.

3e476ae4f2be2ed2181fdfe26bafa4e27478aaf6.en: An open evening story session at Jätkäsaari Library on Tuesdays from 17:30 to 18:00, in Finnish, for children, parents and grandparents.

faf68fc37364e91df3c76798a1b929281a327164.en: Evenings for children under school age with a parent at Kallio Library on Tuesdays from 17:30, from 18 August to 24 November, with bedtime stories and crafts. Entry is free and no sign-up is needed.

4d3bb689e9f04dd7f6b77afc61dee07862c84f37.en: A relaxed Finnish language café at Kontula Library, where people meet new people and chat in Finnish over tea. Entry is free.

55f183db5076f8eef3168ec45303102d6a13a936.en: Local history talks with city guide Markku Jalonen at Etelä-Haaga Library, on fortification history on 27 October and old-time jobs on 24 November. Coffee and tea are served, and entry is free.

7e56d9c55585551eb9fc267ae4b3e884beb9e773.en: An author visit at Roihuvuori Library with happiness coach Auli Malimaa, who talks about her book on learning to love yourself. It is part of the library's autumn 2026 "Rakkaudesta" events.

fa6f8258b50875a4d77c78c236e8ec366d7654ed.en: A wine yoga session at White Lady restaurant on 27 October from 18:00 to 19:30, combining gentle vinyasa and yin yoga with tasting wine by the senses. Tickets cost 30 euros, wine is not included, and the age limit is 18.

864ad16811d0860daee6eb544474d7e9c2fa71f8.en: An essay book club at Munkkiniemi Library on Tuesdays from 18:00 to 19:30, on 15 September and 27 October, reading Tanizaki's "In Praise of Shadows" and Tokarczuk's "Ognosia".

70d97caccb1d463fe6bc5dee49a21b4ff8cf0fcd.en: A French music pub quiz at Bar Café Apéro on 27 October from 18:00 to 20:00, organised by the French Institute, in Finnish. Entry is free, and the winning team gets a small gift.

17c21b04551d1916ca71640235e4899fc5561f9a.en: A book launch for "Ystäväkirja", a queer psychological novel by Kalle Vilppula, at Kallio Library on 27 October from 18:00 to 19:00. The novel explores dependence and power in a circle of gay men.

8bcdf38d5266bc122a6e8398354c67b4b8853617.en: "Leppäkerttu Pilkuton", a puppet show for children aged 2 to 8 about a ladybird without spots who learns that difference is valuable. The audience can sing along to familiar songs, staged by PikkuKulkuri.

d6267f45c7f90417a116355d5b136d28aa5f84c0.en: A documentary screening of "Haaveiden kääntöraide" at Kino Regina on 27 October from 18:00 to 19:30, about three men living on the metro in east Helsinki, followed by a panel on who has a right to use city space. Entry is free.

3796196b7cc3d76e189f0f9a6692e851eaa33606.en: Evening story sessions at Arabianranta Library from Tuesday 1 September at 18:00, with various stories. Each child gets a sticker on a story passport at the end of each session.

dba0dcd96e7151428143f7289c7557bf8b7a8da7.en: A romance book club at Tapulikaupunki Library on 27 October, reading Ilona Tuominen's "Seurustelusalaliitto" and discussing love and popular fiction. Books are available a month in advance, and the group is open to all.

47542c14fb3a32d3388bd041cd37d2e385c913ac.en: A Finnish conversation café at Itäkeskus Library on Tuesdays from 8 September to 15 December, from 18:00 to 19:30. It is open to learners and native speakers, and no sign-up is needed.

674026af7a16b7e8961afd60b326bceb6abaf232.en: A Finnish audio-described guided tour of the exhibition on Tove Jansson and the Moomins and their link to architecture, design and the built environment, at the Architecture and Design Museum on 27 October from 18:00 to 19:00. Entry is free.

7f0561be3303a27e7e018a97f0ae2d61539ffd0c.en: An open reading group on African American literature, with monthly sessions led by different facilitators. Books include Colson Whitehead and Toni Morrison, and entry is free.

eafc86b7818da4802a31239341e6e10ae59c3682.en: A lecture series on ancient Greek drama, focusing on Aristophanes and Euripides, given by docent Markku Koivusalo at Stoa. Entry is free, and there is no lecture in autumn holiday week 42.

52a7a6118aa13a6b595dee073b8cbff873c35c3d.en: A lecture series on the thinkers of the 1600s, from Descartes to Spinoza, and the intellectual revolutions of that century. Entry is free.

5b83f2c6326ae1589373577cc71ba7e3c53021f5.en: A folk concert at Wine Café Feeniks on 27 October from 19:00 to 21:00, with the duos Cienna, of Kaisa Leskinen and Senni Eskelinen, and uni uni, with Ella Isotalo and Mikko H. Haapoja. Tickets cost 10 to 15 euros.

00e97f07a51ad1bfa6d2e6e4898d749971c8ddf3.en: Gershwin's Rhapsody in Blue and Dvořák's Cello Concerto with the organ of Musiikkitalo, performed for the first time in Finland with pianist Irina Zahharenkova and cellist Artturi Aalto. The concert is on 27 October from 19:00 and tickets cost 24 to 54 euros.

8bfc041c3bd52b50166eb16162bffdcb2a53c563.en: A Japanese language community at Oodi, meeting most Tuesdays from 19:30 to 20:30. It is open to learners, Japanese speakers and fans of Japanese culture, and the language is Japanese and English.

254cafca9fc94fde176e0f8503f9a3cade46e9fe.en: A free jazz concert at Hi-Hat Art Bar on 27 October from 20:00 to 22:30, with the Argentinian trio Integral and singer Heliä Viirakivi, mixing contemporary jazz and free improvisation.

02fd6cf1e0e60860ba9cdb7e226b44979a1f4c90.en: Black metal bands Behemoth and Dimmu Borgir in a co-headlining show at Helsinki Ice Hall on 27 October, with Dark Funeral in support.

c62f7f4bbb1981758dbf6a99711efd8740082997.en: Bridge 47 is an organisation that promotes global citizenship education and sustainable development through cooperation and advocacy. It holds events at Alppila community house.

75d08236dae0ab02af998ca580039d8535b5e9e7.en: A baby morning at Munkki playground, with the indoor space reserved for baby families from 9:00 to 10:30. Some sessions, such as baby circus, need advance sign-up.

1b3c3d15c1ecfef48fd39d1c730f40164d90d695.en: A Pilke group at Kontula Senior Centre for older people who use or have used substances. It is free, closed, and joined through a social worker. You can come as you are, and the group starts with a shared breakfast.

4ab8e9b02c3945f751ed28694ea2f0fe44c56fb6.en: An art morning at Viiri playground with painting, drawing and crafts that change each week, for children and an adult together.

05ecd87f68fdee8b10fcc25e62b4f047d857dbfe.en: A Wednesday coffee meeting at Lampi playground from 9:30 to 11:00 for baby and family groups, with coffee, biscuits and play. It moves indoors in winter.

173335ebe636d5626d3c85d670e41567b3158b3f.en: A knitting group at Kinapori Senior Centre for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card, where knitters meet and share their craft.

1e08cb9ad5ee7bdd86a4fca1815cb1686a93bf7b.en: A morning for under-ones at Mäkitorppa playground, with peer support and activities from 10:30 such as rhymes, songs, exercise and rest sessions.

cafeb21d969484a4e1e040eaac95ffcf8973fcc6.en: A movement session for the youngest children and a parent at Kivenkolo, with gym equipment, a bouncy castle, music and a small play area. It does not run in autumn holiday week 42.

3c16eb231e4f00e9bb31335b739a99c175578f96.en: A needle-felting workshop at Pihlajamäki community house with a guide, where people make simple shapes like animals or key rings. No sign-up is needed, and entry is free.

36e7b320943e5a76c8016cf96debed00f9e0bf59.en: A baby morning at Ruoholahti playground with guided play, movement, rhymes, art or music from 10:30 to 11:00.

aba6dbc1d57529dcd73653de91804568a4e97a57.en: An outdoor play session on Wednesdays at Santahamina playground for small children, with games, jumping and exploring the environment.

5f6e2cc09a04c4079da21615fbc9483189df38e8.en: A strength and balance class at Itäkeskus Service Centre for people whose functional ability has declined, have balance problems, fear falling or have osteoporosis. Sign up by phone with a physiotherapist.

ad5bbc6a3471af9464a8105ecfcb813f646df6f6.en: Changing guided sessions for toddlers at Orava playground, indoors or outdoors, such as play, song and activity sessions. The schedule is on the playground's social media.

8ba10b7a86875ad97a14e4b98b989fd477ea7de0.en: A baby circus session at Vähätupa playground for babies aged 4 to 9 months with a parent, with songs, rhymes and play. It is free, has limited places, and you sign up by text message.

574c30ce3dde3acbb4600f69d66214554a1c821c.en: An open memory group at Kannelmäki Service Home for people who have recently been diagnosed or have memory difficulties. It offers peer support, practical information and activities.

2a8d13a4e7c4caf993e6134d192a51e4d44352af.en: A music session at Kankarepuisto playground with singing, rhymes, playing instruments, movement and listening to music.

3d1df2863ccb26d4e82a00efb22869a28d784cfd.en: A baby morning at Seppä playground with togetherness and guided play, movement, rhymes, art or music indoors.

98e0f1a8f97cbc0b2c8be124692f3522886d85c2.en: A yard activity at Mellunmäki playground with changing toys and themes chosen by participants, such as obstacle courses and bike games. Families can warm their own food.

b20df1331d498aee2073bafd845bf9be92e92220.en: A toddler meetup at Etupelto playground for children over one with a parent, with themes and guided sessions that change each week. Families can eat their own food or warm it.

538e3f66a83638b4e121649949e0d7fe6927fd06.en: A morning of play, movement, rhymes and music for all ages at Lehdokki playground.

ba8ae5796f45c4dd930755facddc41d5716489af.en: The "Tänään tavataan" café at Trumpetti playground, a meeting place for babies and families from different cultures, with songs, rhymes and crafts at 10:00.

407b6f5e7f1bb0f0bb8b6167a26d738979501ec8.en: Art and crafts sessions for all ages at Strömberg playground, with varied activities and small art experiences shared together.

4e9cfbb21dfdb29f135e1e822a8e14bd6c1c9a78.en: A crafts session at Rudolf playground, making things together on changing themes.

6cfa3f17c05792c10103b2ec573c83ff00afd7b9.en: A creative colouring group at Töölö Senior Centre on Wednesday mornings from 10:00 to 12:00, for older people who feel lonely. Participants draw in marker and colour, and the group has a small exhibition.

e288796f035b442dbc6f0e7296f4744bb66431ee.en: A knitting club at Myllypuro Senior Centre for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card, where people can bring their own craft or learn traditional techniques such as needle lace.

d7115252636cf6308b5818f2ff25cd492a41b777.en: Art and crafts for all ages at Taivallahti playground indoors. The details are on the weekly programme.

5a7f3690f0340eb485f3c0db522578c8500e2bcf.en: A bridge card group at Myllypuro Senior Centre for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

4436d86dc5bc4ca0427df82718f47124724f62cb.en: A yard activity at Kipinäpuisto playground with changing toys and themes, such as obstacle courses and bike games.

663a11cf59ede926f58caf05ea8938b38415389e.en: A baby morning at Kannelmäki playground from 10:00 to 11:30 for babies, with activities such as baby circus or colour play. Registration is by email.

b482954e86dcb6a75e00eb887f2c8008fa0270ca.en: An open memory group at Jakomäki Service Centre offering peer support and everyday practical information. No sign-up is needed.

0aef33952680c68c8909eaa59616edccfa734127.en: Music and movement sessions at Arabia playground, combining music, movement, singing, stories and play.

561d17c43948ba2015b54d569d884e99225adb15.en: A men's group at Kinapori Senior Centre for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

26daefdc747146599e83fdde0421642912619f00.en: A baby morning at Rusthollari playground, with rhymes, songs and movement for crawling and early babies with a parent.

9984ac5b5fd59b2161fabd1aa57489dca1b40281.en: A meetup for toddlers and pre-school children at Kajuutta family house. A guided session starts around 10:15, with music, sport, circus or painting. The Early Childhood info is on 16 September.

0e6be04fc68cc2bfecbd0029ce2679488a6fa85d.en: A yard activity at Kiikku playground with changing toys and themes chosen by participants, such as obstacle courses and bike games.

3d1944378b1880470539910d7924cc4639da84a7.en: A story session at Sanna playground with books, table and shadow theatre, led by the Pasila library story reader on set dates.

6a287edf4edbe3bb3b6b968def46a05d58b4932e.en: Changing play themes and movement for children over one at Lahnalahti playground, outdoors or indoors.

a136922efa9625c8b671ae47c1861ee2ceb5f4fb.en: Cheerful rhyme sessions at Myllypuro Library for babies and toddlers aged 0 to 3 with a parent, lasting about 30 minutes.

40a2f2e33004ebd4bec745e4833de6e6afda5d4e.en: A residents' meetup at Tapulikaupunki Library, with coffee and tea and a free bingo once a month after 11:00. It is run by local residents.

8e851aa1d9d5303d80a8cffc783cd86a2f0464aa.en: A ten-session wellbeing group at Myllypuro Senior Centre on Wednesdays from 10:00 to 12:00, for finding sources of energy and tools for a gentler daily life. It takes ten participants and is for pensioners with a service centre card.

04e136ab7b3d7e3721ea5d4968cfed32a387d1d0.en: Free digital help from Enter ry for older people at Malmi Library, on Wednesdays from 10:00 to 12:00 by appointment. Bring your device and logins.

0ed61a6fa950c16d79dd25a7d4c1cff32937a5f3.en: An MLL family café at Torpparinmäki playground, where parents can meet others in the area, find playmates for their children and take a break. Snacks are served.

aae892134866dd1bb24a8635e1862b08c0da65d6.en: An imaginative play session at Kimmo playground, where families build play areas such as a shop, a harbour, a car wash or animal nests together with staff. The themes change with the seasons.

29cd8306de56ed2fb4c9eafea1cbee6d542cdef6.en: Free peer help from Enter ry at Puistola Library on Wednesdays from 10:00 to 12:00, from 2 September to 2 December. Book by phone or at the library, and borrow a tablet or computer if needed.

68c496784ad272f75c88044745314f8cbe6432c4.en: An art morning at Linja playground for all ages, trying varied art and craft activities on changing themes. Families can meet others and warm their own food.

2f38d55593b459905dcace30ae64b64938535860.en: A singing and rhyme session at Laurinniitty playground for all, where children and adults chant, sing and make music together.

61b8308a08fbe8a90df5587907210ca3bed44ba1.en: Crafts every Wednesday from 10:00 at Roihuvuori playground, on changing themes. The weekly schedule is on Facebook and Instagram.

527fda32b6b0b2233e4dc88ee76885eb2e4a0315.en: An activity session at Maatulli playground at 10:00, with drawing, modelling, painting and crafts, plus movement with obstacle courses and play areas.

1d9c4b444c573829d28987a92e579275227109de.en: A Pilke group at Koskela Senior Centre for older people who are balancing substance problems. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

5e1a7f150f49b813e6e26915aed7fb7e3d3b53c6.en: A crafts Wednesday at Maasälpä playground, where people make handmade items through a range of creative methods.

cd0776de24c585e81535736f3ebb0256b6b7d7bc.en: A family morning at Intia playground for playing, singing, rhymes, movement and art, with parents and children playing together.

c1057247e3629f1c937bf5b821e75d8455762c8e.en: A Finnish story hour at Pohjois-Haaga Library on Wednesdays from 10:00 to 10:30, from 2 September to 25 November. Entry is free, and no sign-up is needed.

a52f9334c3dc58772cd649daa3149824b97b77ce.en: A final rehearsal at Musiikkitalo before an evening concert, polishing the performance for the night's programme.

3bd4ab9c95597f4cf7099d7ad68403121f17f596.en: Family movement at Nurkka playground, where children and parents learn basic motor skills by moving in different ways with balls and other equipment.

8f191d15836ac0f0cdb8df722b40d922b60b5151.en: A baby morning at Brahe playground for families with babies, with play, movement, art, music and story sessions for crawling and early babies with a parent.

a75cc6175c6b402c7eb1a16bbb182533d9de7657.en: Yard activities at Linnunrata playground for young children, with changing toys and themes, such as a bike track, stick horses, shop play and a car wash.

ed80461d2a73b403f99b70df85cf1be52be783b5.en: A play, song or rhyme session at Kesanto playground, held outdoors or indoors.

a2103f2f975bd41236421703fab19e2cc611cc46.en: A TaideLiikutus community theatre group at Suomenlinna Library, using theatre, improvisation, movement, sound and music to explore participants' interests. It aims to build wellbeing and community, and does not meet in autumn break week on 14 October.

505c679971354cf495ae37324cbe477b9445e1fa.en: A movement session at Iso-Antti playground outdoors, with play, exercise, running and balls. It can move indoors in cold or wet weather.

7cefd13313c7557e517f479af3f1b1457849e5a9.en: A rhyme and movement morning at Sahrami family house, with play and exploration for parent and child. The house is open Monday to Friday from 9 to 16.

c1d14f05333941b82b4a4d28d47868d80a327f4b.en: A cultural corner at Riistavuori Senior Centre on the last Wednesday of each month, with discussion, talks and library book tips.

30b96fa699fae4c42a918b4942711fd89004df98.en: A baby morning at Tuorinniemi playground, for relaxed time together and peer support for all babies and families.

300d565dd5ddcf52a6469db11d4e9ce5a08f010a.en: A story session at Lohikäärmepuisto playground, reading different stories on changing themes. Families can bring their own book to read.

92f7c2d235befb15600e7fd2ad8db0bb32bcb7c0.en: A strength and balance class at Itäkeskus Service Centre, standing and guided, for people whose functional ability has declined, who have balance problems, fear of falling or osteoporosis. Sign up with a physiotherapist first.

8e69604a2fe8dc722049f00db26bba6aedaa3a43.en: A strength and balance class at Kontula Senior Centre, mostly standing, with a chair to hold for support if needed. It is for pensioners with a valid service centre card, and you sign up by phone.

85ba3e3765da957d376a68b8ae616776273ca546.en: A short digital tip session at Oodi on phone and tablet memory and cloud services, lasting 30 minutes, followed by questions and personal help. It is free and needs no advance sign-up.

87ca0821cdf19de6f69dc7f0a256a39fe854e98e.en: Light standing exercise led by a volunteer at Alppila community house. Everyone is welcome.

6d60a871953403ed32feba4cf79c8a62538cb1c5.en: A discussion club in Swedish at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

e7a327d88eac562d6f5a9edb3b521f7b127c014d.en: Group singing of Finnish favourites at Vuosaari Library's Siimes room on 28 October (themed on 1950s-style hits) and 16 December (a Christmas theme). No skills are needed.

70abf034993fab1ae4563e83623d918d2c8e933c.en: An open memory group for people recently diagnosed with memory illness at Kustaankartano Senior Centre, with peer support and memory exercises. Sign up by phone.

11b48ecd076387b29a45dd7ab6973779a329a137.en: Group singing at Maunula House's music room every week, with folk songs, hits and classics, plus talk about the songs' memories. It is free, with no sign-up, and there is no lesson on 7 October or in autumn holiday week 43.

e3387519ec517f8fc79f52907a9aa30e836cef25.en: A lecture series at a climbing hall in Ristikko on Wednesdays, covering Thai food history, Egypt and Mesopotamia, Greek ideas of the afterlife, the Madonna in Renaissance art and Berlin as a stage of power.

dfc251db5ac699b7b129c87716d0939e2df4f995.en: Walk-in personal digital help at Myllypuro Senior Centre, for online services such as Kela and online banking, for phones and computers. It is free and needs no appointment.

1f98de54556742fd5d28d0ba902deaab51115054.en: Enter ry's free digital help for seniors at Kalasatama Library every other Wednesday from 2 September to 9 December. Book on site or by phone.

a3004d3c2e08d26c9741f28b70e0bb4eb042a670.en: An English reading and conversation group at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

6a1fe89d3752fd8e9b920294b7962c4cb9dbd7e1.en: A handicraft club at Kinapori Senior Centre for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card. The items are sold twice a year, and the money goes to community activities.

a42d831cd8572b02d426a7dd114b156f4640d7b8.en: A mending service at Kinapori Senior Centre, where volunteers make small repairs such as broken zips or long trouser legs at a reasonable price. Pocket zips are not repaired.

e6c57ecbca16afb088c07cb2d55ab5029b026773.en: A peer group at Riistavuori Senior Centre with changing activities chosen by clients, a light exercise section and a self-paid lunch.

39f5e92016ef056bbce38bcc3151f95f6e429243.en: A lecture series on Verdi's best-known operas, including Rigoletto, La Traviata, Don Carlos and Falstaff, at Kamppi Service Centre. No prior musical training is needed.

e1a94d4bb61d312007e9b7ad74fc07e0d9635977.en: A crafts session at Kamppi Service Centre, making Anna and Toivo dolls for UNICEF, for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

99a6acc702c5a080290694fbeeb682a362557588.en: A peer-support group at Kamppi Service Centre for older people who have lost a loved one, meeting eight times. At least six months should have passed since the loss, and there is a personal meeting beforehand.

1943293486c21ff06ec3f4d149ed80f8979ee263.en: A canasta card game at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

c948eedbc87dce2777d1b0fcd232b0edaf6f4cf4.en: Free personal digital help from Enter ry at Herttoniemi Library on Wednesdays from 13:00 to 15:00, from 9 September to 9 December, for phones, tablets and computers. Book by phone and bring your own device.

283e54b74d48fbba42e780e785738ba132392820.en: Stories read aloud by a volunteer at Kannelmäki Service Home on every other Wednesday from 13:00 to 14:00, with coffee and talk. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

cc7d157ac56314400c5982c8417f93417d58729b.en: A closed memory group at Roihuvuori Senior Centre for people with a memory diagnosis. Sign up through the social worker, and it is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

24697f78f9decce2c8cc0b71d0f348bf80d2e73d.en: A Swedish language café at Pasila Library on Wednesdays from 13:00 to 14:00, from 19 August to 16 December, for practising Swedish at your own pace. No registration is needed.

bcd564333bde18cd5ee9b8c05e3d43e6fa091b28.en: An afternoon game club for schoolchildren at Tapanila Library every Wednesday, with board games and a Nintendo Switch.

38da4db8756eecaadb39b7591c659a32591cbab5.en: A closed memory group at Kustaankartano Senior Centre for people who have recently been diagnosed with memory illness. The group offers peer support and memory exercises. Sign up by phone.

80e72ec503bb96045b691ad29be1f9b9f2891e39.en: An open memory group at Kustaankartano Senior Centre for people who have recently been diagnosed with memory illness, offering peer support and memory exercises. Sign up by phone.

a4e571d09399673f46365a816e26b41446db9ea2.en: A low-threshold art group at Koskela Senior Centre, testing different ways of making art. A volunteer leads it, and the group meets in the centre's lobby before going to the cultural space.

0ba868042bf71ffa9fc6236b81a08684d80ea060.en: BabyKino at Kallio Library every Wednesday at 13:00 in Satulinna, with a film for parents and babies. The sound is quieter, the lighting is dim, and it is free with no sign-up.

29c520b42c6da35a52b0c44666b1ccd373f35f50.en: A low-threshold conversation group at Laajasalo Service Centre for people who want company. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

40d892ea105301a8d20139327fb41760c774c93e.en: Guided outdoor strength sessions with Sydänliitto at Roihuvuori Senior Centre, using natural objects such as stones and trees. No sign-up is needed, and the centre is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

4fe51a5e0ccbc679f2fea089b1653b9feb8db30c.en: A Martta nutrition talk on family diets and food for under-ones, with everyday tips and recipes for all ages. It is at Kajuutta family house.

067eae125da9bc7391c8dc6ea26c77a2a80aabfe.en: The "Tänään tavataan" café at Sahrami family house from 13:30 to 14:30, a meeting place for families from different cultures, with language play through stories and songs. It is free.

76eebb7e000a9ef53009cd22f6d4d07ee8fb66d6.en: A quiz at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

8a7905517a1545b2f0448779f18001333a611c2f.en: A knitting clinic at Oodi, run with the Kädentaitomartat ry volunteers, for learning knitting, fixing patterns and darning socks. It is free and open to all, meeting on alternate Wednesdays from 14:00 to 16:00 and alternate Tuesdays from 17:30 to 19:30.

0db4f5b17a9b9fc2d6c9d33bbfa52a43328868a5.en: A lecture series on East Karelia between Russia and Finland, from the Middle Ages to the Soviet period. Entry is free with no sign-up, and there is no lecture in autumn holiday week 42.

381e7e157aaa1e4012bbed83a6040bd5e3c88f25.en: A gym induction at Itäkeskus Service Centre, where a physiotherapist shows how to use the gym equipment. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

8bee1d03524752740ac85b77ae566045c5f01bac.en: A storytelling group for pupils in grades 3 to 5 at Malmitalo, led by children's author Maami Snellman. Participants invent and write stories together, and no experience is needed.

109161ecc13b0c0ed8488e1c7c4b780212f5c4a1.en: The same storytelling group at Malmi Library for pupils in grades 3 to 5, led by children's author Maami Snellman. It does not meet in autumn holiday week.

ce90bbcc28f3e1e08d2672ded906f142f761fad3.en: A Somali-speaking peer group for men over 50 at Myllypuro Senior Centre on Wednesdays at 17:00, run by JADE. Entry is open and free.

16eb915684adb28021dc4b547d591dcca23c3932.en: An intuitive painting workshop at Malmi community house, led by art therapy student Jenni. No experience is needed, and the session is slow and unhurried.

76459cfb21818161d63a6e4060684d61c7ff004c.en: A pop-up for small arts, science and culture magazines at Oodi, with Ilmiö, a sociology magazine, presenting on 28 October from 15:00 to 19:00.

d010569f4bd258704d686a35a76308c295a49de9.en: A game afternoon at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

1606a0b310e10e697185f7864ff7dd91ea8e4531.en: A low-threshold chess club at Myllypuro Library, open to all ages and levels from 16:00. Stop by for one game or join every week, with no registration.

d2da61473b9ac51a07b2f4d20a2cee451385d221.en: Free help with Windows computers, tablets, smartphones, the internet, email and online forms for agencies such as Kela at Vuosaari Library. No booking is needed.

65ea2c4599e069045309b1d74ead3591c07dbdf2.en: The Mieli Maasta peer-support group at Kontula community house, a free, confidential and alcohol-free group that helps people feel less alone.

f7130b8768c773c1156d59527df5b45fea70fc30.en: A UNICEF doll workshop at Alppila community house, making dolls that are sold to families for 20 to 40 euros to fund UNICEF's work on children's health and education. The dolls are not suitable for under-14s.

f7b2ed9e2708d7286dc99740c39da89faba18a05.en: An Arabic language café at Pasila Library on Wednesdays from 16:30 to 18:00, from 5 August, with native speakers and learning tips. All levels are welcome.

d04c64dab4103b4685d14268187c330989740f1a.en: A free quiz on school dinners through the decades at the Hotel and Restaurant Museum on 28 October, with two sessions at 16:30 and 17:30. Up to 20 players can take part per session, and it is held in Finnish for ages 8 and up.

d5b321bec46c8fc1e098e835c682d77c791655c3.en: LGBTQ+ gaming night at Gamehouse Sture alongside IrisHelsinki youth evenings. Games are age-rated, and you can bring your own gaming account or consoles.

33349a744c16cd6a3141eab1a4b53d145392d381.en: An improvised theatre performance called "Elämän makuista" by an improv course at the Finnish Adult Education Centre. Entry is free to all performances.

0f6dd61c8fe8ddee6d837d81e662d7ad0bc72c5a.en: A lecture series on questions of war and peace, past and present, with talks by experts on working-class women, the Finnish welfare state, language and militarisation, and the UN. Entry is free, and there is no lecture on 14 October.

c90d60c6ccb795c79d2e1c91b0cb8d22b2c14292.en: A book club at Jakomäki Library, discussing books read in advance. Newcomers are welcome at any point, and the autumn sessions are on set dates.

8821edac1b38f3b54b9c4a2b9c01f988a87452a7.en: A Finnish language café at Rikhardinkatu Library on Wednesdays at 17:00 in the Aurora room on the third floor. It suits people who already speak a little Finnish, and no sign-up is needed.

c73f3920252423af76531c7828c4a496631f6dcb.en: Homework help at Pasila Library on Wednesdays from 17:00 to 18:00, extendable to 19:00, aimed at lower-secondary pupils but open to all school levels. The session on 21 October is cancelled.

2e01464d62dffe1571b1fd768ada1a75f8189d85.en: A World Psoriasis Day event at Kamppi Service Centre on psoriasis, hair scalp problems and sleep, with a raffle and coffee. Registration is at hepso.fi.

e9ea5a53364903f66d405cb59a508618bebdf3b0.en: Read aloud to a reading dog named Kaffe at Etelä-Haaga Library. Book a 15-minute slot at the service desk.

f64a746f66c26e89f4a0a48528806f08d6e807ba.en: A reading dog session at Pikku Huopalahti Library on 28 October from 17:00 to 18:00. Read aloud for 15 minutes with a dog and its handler, and book by phone or email.

63d9d391ab2826139a2b922550c78e34480534dc.en: A support group at Itäkeskus Service Centre for family carers and the people they care for. Each joins its own instructor, with exercise for some and peer talk on wellbeing for others. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

8396658739c9c46c134d7a07aefa938fe2c2a429.en: An info session at Helsinki Employment Services in Kamppi on supported job searching for foreign-language speakers with at least Finnish A2.1. It covers retail, tourism, restaurants and real estate, and a two-week coaching programme follows. Bring ID.

f21517512e91c9abd75bde7fdde5683dd10a84d5.en: A library chess club at Tapulikaupunki for players of all levels, from primary school age upwards. It meets on the last Wednesday of selected months from 17:00 to 19:00, run by two volunteers.

3317426ae6338734ecbae5c7bb7dc13573d2b40a.en: A lecture series on architecture and power, from neoclassicism and brutalism to the buildings of Turkey and Ukraine. Entry is free, and there is no lecture on 14 October.

0dd0b76e4ef3347b4e85eee61eef38d9133cc2dc.en: A Sámi-language literature circle at Nordic Culture Point on 28 October from 17:30 to 18:30. This month's book is "Cuvkejuvvon bálgážat" by Johan Kitti, and no pre-registration is needed.

71ca8827a6b693a0afd684b5ac3fcbbf253bae89.en: A Finnish conversation group at Vuosaari Library, where members practise spoken Finnish on topics they choose together, such as news, job hunting or cultures. You need the basics of Finnish, and entry is free.

5105684d733cf916a4201b56baddef472d0a5df0.en: Author Maiju Talvisto talks about her book "Tätä ei tapahtuisi miehelle", on gender and power in the music business, at Kallio Library. Books can be bought at the event for 25 euros.

cf7a96e7d7a1c8d7280ff9e3f081e1bfebc91c8a.en: A casual book club at Kontula Library, reading fiction and non-fiction with coffee and tea. No sign-up or commitment is needed.

c87f024623dc10881123a27f3d11c39635ecdc08.en: A weekly card game group at Malminkartano Library, playing the Shanghai card game. Sessions last about 1.5 hours, but you can join for less time, and no experience is needed.

c258cf3e3cca144f6966f312481fbed3ba996cd0.en: A relaxed Swedish language café at Oodi in group room 3, with tea and conversation. It is run with the Föreningen Luckan.

6cf5b4e95986f5bf323d62b92d996091fe7cdb03.en: Eila Kautto talks about classic books and the culture of Spain and Latin America on alternate Wednesdays from 18:00 to 19:00 at Pohjois-Haaga Library, from 2 September to 25 November. Entry is free.

c0854192474bedd35d440fd602478bf945e13477.en: Leo Stranius, author and CEO, explains why cutting emissions and consumption can make life better, and how compact living and a plant-based diet can improve wellbeing.

2cfc94cddd7589d0e53264adbcc56acea3d1f3bf.en: A launch event for the debut poetry collection "En ymmärrä tätä elämää" by engineer and poet Eetu Autio, at Rikhardinkatu Library. The evening features poems and a talk about how the book came to be.

34c2379cb5049964b0e1abd56769bc0e4896978e.en: A reading dog session at Itäkeskus Library for people learning to read, with a 15-minute slot booked in advance.

3f88060b8461451f706c1fe91042272886a4be0c.en: A dance film evening at Kannelmäki Library, where short dance films by the Myrskyryhmä company are shown, followed by discussion. No experience of dance or art is needed.

98d13a464d54b3e8b589cb0499778877804653ab.en: A launch of two new Latvian poetry collections at the Finnish Adult Education Centre, with the translator Mirja Hovila reading her translations of poems. Entry is free.

41a49f21deb65d7ff826ec990df1a95b4d7a1442.en: A reading dog session at Töölö Library on set dates, from 18:00 to 19:20, for practising reading aloud. Book a 15-minute slot in advance.

ad3f89120fbdfc9328e963375ff3ec02b0a5fdaa.en: Reading dogs Nöpö and Pippi at Myllypuro Library, for reading aloud on alternate weeks. A 15-minute slot is booked at the info desk, and it is free.

093f369342d8884458b33def6cdf20580514d87f.en: A reading dog session with Tuisku at Laajasalo Library on alternate Wednesdays from 18:00 to 19:30. Book a 15-minute slot in advance.

e558f4974bdee0cd463a07e25d5a94e0bddc35d6.en: A group at Oodi for building courage in spoken Finnish, talking about news, job hunting and cultures. Basic Finnish is enough, and the group is free with no sign-up.

f71a33f2123dfa202f39864c73bc92efbfbec389.en: Author Severi Hämäri talks about his book "12 filosofia", on the great insights of ancient philosophers, at Lauttasaari Library. Entry is free.

e6ea82cb25185212c042401bd4075e105ba721bc.en: The international power metal band Gloryhammer plays Tavastia on 28 October, with support from Majestica and Arion. Tickets cost 55.50 to 58 euros, and the age limit is 18.

006e3055d3162001367d2b71d5bdf55ae7ed81f9.en: A creative writing club for children and young people at Malminkartano Library, where members write, draw and invent stories. A creative writing teacher leads it.

c8f5f28a5d830ff3800c972253e669c0a3841c19.en: A knitting club at Puistola Library on Wednesdays from 18:00 to 20:00, for beginners and experienced crafters. Bring your own yarn and needles or hook.

9523c81053f523e58ca4d8737d47f1c203f7853e.en: A conversation and music evening at Jakomäki Library on Finnish spell tradition, with Petra Streng and Jouko Kyhälä talking about mantras and charms in Finnish.

a9cda7bf7e1db48ca4c5edec3f7401f554042b96.en: A paint and wine evening at White Lady restaurant on 28 October from 18:00 to 19:30, with guided watercolour around the moon theme. It costs 35 euros including materials, wine is extra, and the age limit is 18.

b45c2292044e3b86a6d1270df6e7c324096ebd64.en: HIFK against Ilves ice hockey at Helsinki Ice Hall on 28 October at 18:30. Tickets are sold through Ticketmaster. HIFK, founded in 1897, is the oldest team in the capital region.

63949a2fa948abb9996b30a737c9369e43e79f88.en: A monthly book club at Tapanila Library on Wednesdays from 18:30 to 20:00, reading books that explore norms and fitting in. You can join at any time.

7ed87d713b674045decf7ce0d2d6c7973799fb97.en: "Zone Critique", a dance and poetry performance by Liisa Pentti and her company at Konepaja Stage, based on a poem by Martin Enckell. It runs from 28 October to 8 November, lasts one hour, and suits ages 13 and up.

2c55064bbb944d488335d24341fe8d3c07c71458.en: Violinist Inmo Yang, winner of the 2022 Sibelius Violin Competition, returns to Musiikkitalo with Brahms's Violin Concerto in a Helsinki Philharmonic concert, "Return of the Heroes".

1c2530886f684fb8b3cecc710a043fb0dea47ee5.en: A long-form improvisation group at the Finnish Adult Education Centre, performing an improvised story built from the audience's ideas. Entry is free to all performances.

e124030500550759f74067938dca4e2d901d78bd.en: Swedish pop star Benjamin Ingrosso plays Veikkaus Arena on 28 October at 19:30, as part of his "What Happens Next?" arena tour. Tickets start at 49.90 euros, with no age limit.

8f28cf4a24af5bc21de4bd8933e98629783fd64d.en: A two-part training course at Business Helsinki on using LinkedIn for B2B sales growth, on 29 October and 12 November from 9:00 to 11:30. It is for early-stage entrepreneurs.

2930685800a4bdb10a3d70b1580c4d88a1e20f56.en: An open discussion group at Kamppi Service Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

24b74697c7afef1ec08ce23674d54dd074fa867a.en: A library in the playground at Viikkari, with rhymes and reading together, plus a small selection of books to borrow while the Viikki library is closed.

c55d82cab0f6e3a8d3ca3c02cb5b10b8f2f306cc.en: The Brain Health Fair 2026 at Kamppi Service Centre, with information stands, a sensory room and memory exercises, plus talks on sleep, hearing and wellbeing in the hall.

d29c1a1a7cb747bf399f1ab5e1a9da05500c69ac.en: An autumn 2026 literature lecture series at the Finnish Adult Education Centre, on writers such as Krasznahorkai, Patti Smith and Emily Brontë, and a Finlandia prize preview. Entry is free.

1e3f4bb9938c325dae85f14b73069d8299b16cb3.en: A baby morning at Taivallahti playground, with guided play, movement, rhymes, art or music indoors, and a guided session from 10:30 to 11:00.

2dab9879b8f6ed3943fd98d21368140ecca45de0.en: A senior reading group at Käpylä Library, meeting on the last Thursday of the month from 10:30 to 11:30 in the reading room. The first session is on 27 August.

c4af0a2cf2e8861e681900156bfa4328c57c7eaa.en: A monthly coffee talk at Saunabaari on the last Thursday of each month, where staff and local residents discuss what activities the house should offer in future.

d369ed452cc364670e7dc4492cdeb976ce1ac80e.en: Coffee talks at Pihlajamäki community house, where people share ideas and learn about future activities, on 27 August, 24 September, 29 October and 26 November from 12:00 to 13:00.

733582a945551af3fa0cac6dd11b32d9a456db8a.en: The "Louder" gig night at Tiivistämö with young bands Khaos, KryoniX and Fatal Divine on 28 October. It is free and all ages, with doors at 18:00.

a7291b57a5fde2ba9aa2b84eb1d982f5144b8a5f.en: A free two-day training course at Vuosaari Library on 29 October and 5 November 2026 for volunteers who want to lead exercise groups for older adults. No experience is needed, and the course includes hands-on practice. Registration closes on 22 October.

5e37aa197f99909c0d573461dd5a6641ff5914f7.en: A community house coffee gathering at Malmi, where people share ideas for activities and hear about the autumn events. Tea, coffee and buns are served.

a733a32ef6a62cda27232e0d8d33b4028aaadf89.en: A prayer and communion service at Jakomäki Service Centre, open to the centre's clients and residents of the service home.

8cbad6c21438712814fa124c451af14563266265.en: A two-part training course at Business Helsinki on social selling and LinkedIn for early-stage entrepreneurs, on 29 October and 12 November from 13:00 to 15:30. It covers building trust and turning expertise into sales.

2bf728a07a23a70fbb31835ba9b5c3fdf39b8fde.en: A jewellery-making workshop at Malmi community house, suitable for beginners and experienced crafters. Each piece is a personal creation.

8e3d2807b8d89f47e9e2b687831a539f0e54d367.en: A Halloween mystery party for older people at Töölö Senior Centre, where guests act as insurance company staff and vote on real-life mishaps. Coffee and treats are served, and a free service centre card is needed.

a2db9ad5318f3f50bc3ab5608175341f60be95f4.en: A Halloween disco at Laajasalo Service Centre, with a "Mummodisko" dance session. Costumes are welcome, and it is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

85a76330d64e8f73b87a1337fee86f5b0c19eed6.en: An English-language craft group at Alppila community house, led by volunteer Selce, using materials already available in the house.

f85c15909ebcfaf9680dcb348c730b3e615925e9.en: A reading group at Ristikko Library, meeting at 15:00 once a month on Thursdays, at Konalantie 10. Books for the autumn include Anne Tyler's "Sininen lanka" and Claire Keegan's "Nämä pienet asiat".

43bbdadcf9a906e256cd29ba261e29091a0ffa67.en: A neighbourhood afternoon coffee at Kontula community house, with coffee, tea and light snacks, plus chat about local topics. Everyone is welcome.

8c3b42c9cd4b0123f6c0c8b6d80e65c221f4f1be.en: A lecture series on the history of Finnish film, at Kino Regina on Thursdays from 29 October to 3 December, from 15:15 to 16:45. Entry is free, with no sign-up needed, and the lectures are in Finnish.

96f561463ae479a544112c6aebfa1c4d8a76cfc8.en: A club for young cat warriors at Roihuvuori Library every other Thursday from 17:00 to 18:00, starting 3 September. It is open to all ages, and mixes tasks with fun activities.

5fad4b130a95efed7c4bdceba65a26a68d2ddd8c.en: A residents' meeting in Malminkartano on draft street plans for the area, where people can talk with experts. The plans are part of the Malminkartano Heart renewal project.

ce22c690e7b73dac0750cde58db8f595b6b38065.en: A sleep evening at Kamppi Service Centre by the Helsinki Sleep Association, with a talk on better sleep by a specialist insomnia therapist and a demonstration of a sound and light device from 18:00 to 19:00.

6eac0a9e3ac1eb8d303db5d50b87564a258f2a0c.en: A farewell tea party at Lassila community house, with a Mad Hatter theme and a Halloween twist. The evening includes live music, a fancy-dress prize and a fire dancer.

9dbba965c6b44990eaa7662c1e4743c310f48989.en: Family craft sessions at Vuosaari Library, where a child and an adult make things together with a guide. Dates include a Halloween-harvest craft session and a family card workshop on 28 November.

0cbf0c7a80e66a3bd3ed95ec17b73ffb53c761db.en: A horror film screening of "The Blackening" at Kallio Library on 29 October at 17:00, in the Detective Library, with a snack kiosk. The screening is free, and only the first 15 registered people can attend.

9e6bf8783f690e586db7e36b95410e1508f32bd1.en: A Thursday afterwork jazz session at Manala on 27 August to 17 December, with a trio and changing guest soloists. Entry is free, and arriving early helps find a seat.

e7bcd2cd63b0283401ac426b3c8019ccc5222ba5.en: A lecture series on the history of theatre stages, from caves and open-air theatres to the Baroque one-stage theatre. It is free to attend, and the 29 October lecture covers the earliest venues.

722d145cee72f03bccce66e7f64f29b97f171f7a.en: A walk in nearby nature in Herttoniemi, slowly covering about 2 kilometres with breathing exercises and book tips. Dress for the weather and bring a curious mind.

38e53582e89a382fa578ebdf3248fe7c8e680c3c.en: The third part of a workshop series at Kannelmäki Library on building a mini smart system, for ages 12 and up. It is held in English on 29 October from 17:30 to 19:30, and places are limited.

3dae959ec0a9294f768dc782d6239f64d5c4168a.en: A Finnish documentary screening at Maunula House on the autumn cinema programme, with a talk by director Jukka Kärkkäinen after the film. The audience can join the discussion.

ccef8d04e315790b396b8b43d3daed007a3c3b22.en: Open jam evenings with the Orivesi All Stars at Pasila Library, held about once a month on Thursday evenings in the auditorium. Any acoustic instrument is welcome.

fd1998a10fa93ff9f60c882e757c2e97be46a23b.en: A panel on race and racism in art institutions at Oodi, exploring why Afro-Nordic curators and cultural leaders remain under-represented in Finland. The panellists are Alayo Akinkugbe, Maryan Abdulkarim and Päiviö Omwami.

aa37b403834c7ed3d5e4ad830bbcd6e4df962102.en: A talk by Vuosaari photographer Eddie Iles on his nature and bird photography, given at Vuosaari Library, with his photos of birds and animals.

17bff1123c2f4b63ba28a9c1fe49607b2d0f7e65.en: A reading dog session at Tapanila Library for people learning to read, with a 15-minute slot booked in advance from the library staff.

c6d131ea7fa2e21fb926dcb37feef057472cb27b.en: Author Mirva Karkinen discusses her debut novel "Leviatan" at Oodi, a story about women and the hidden structures of power. She reads excerpts, and a signed copy can be bought at the event.

17920ca20d36c6e5158ea1902d63086a6860b344.en: A crafts circle at Jätkäsaari Library on alternate Thursdays from 18:00 to 20:00, from 20 August to 10 December. Adults of any level can bring their own project, and coffee and tea are served.

54c21d01591f311838b475922d3338ad19f79159.en: A Russian literature book club at Rikhardinkatu Library on set dates, in the Ture room from 18:00 to 20:00. The autumn books include Ulitskaya, Trifonov and Zygar.

36efd47d7bd54974a36adecdb5abbd3d33146c5c.en: A short performance before HPO concerts at Musiikkitalo's main foyer, where music schools from Helsinki perform.

df6c350f07abf1710565a4a5f1607c26dde4f2e2.en: A theatre evening with poetry, music and cultural history about the writer Olavi Paavolainen on the Riviera. It is in Finnish, for ages 18 and up, and is held on 29 October and 18 November.

1189cfb55ac13c51accffcd05641f21ffa929f32.en: Lilla Halloween at Hotel Lilla Roberts on 29 October from 19:00 to 22:00, with saxophone by Anna Sax, themed cocktails and bar bites. Entry is free.

d22f1b349eae1d69634502e9bd5539c155adcaae.en: A concert at Temppeliaukio Church on 29 October from 19:00, with video game music arranged for medieval-style voices, harp and organ. It also launches the debut album of the ensemble Munx Gregoriana. Tickets cost 20 to 30 euros.

7f21c277a5b205182a4b316eed10c0e172670fd1.en: A concert at Kallio Church on 29 October from 19:00 to 20:00, with the Finnish Chamber Choir singing music by Schumann and James Whitbourn for All Saints' Day. Tickets cost 15 to 25 euros.

69ede271408f1dcc4a043e3f7f15eb6a1d0fd501.en: "Gardens of Memories", a candlelit All Saints' Day event at Helsinki's cemeteries on 31 October from 16:00 to 19:00, with pastors and volunteers on hand. Entry is free, and children can take part in an Angel Trail.

4e8634f69ee6a32da27ff17277fb065aec8ae911.en: An exhibition of paintings by Mari Helisevä at tm-gallery from 29 October to 22 November, using tempera and earth pigments, with neon pink hints. Entry is free.

db458982e4729a6ebe6102cd7f00114eaa079709.en: A morning for babies and toddlers at Malmi Library, starting with guided play and then free play. The autumn theme is rhymes and nature baths, and no sign-up is needed.

d63fcca7a995b229440848d2117f64c22760d7b7.en: A family singing session at Torpparinmäki playground, indoors, with singing, rhymes and music, for all ages. The room is open for play and eating from 9:00 to 12:00.

3a06107f5fb55db72cb2a0b850448cfcee267147.en: Free one-to-one digital help from older volunteers of Enter ry at Kontula Library on Fridays in even-numbered weeks from 10:00 to 12:00. Book at the library.

f2b9d81aba2d1e64b34f54fe1c81a66c5427b526.en: A free side event for the Etnosoi festival at Itäkeskus Library, where Marian Friedl presents Carpathian flutes and their traditions. The interview is by Robert Conaway-Bothwell and is mostly in English.

0ef1043b8e046865eec05b5272595b8d23077526.en: A Swedish-language baby session at Herttoniemi Library for babies up to about 18 months with a parent, with rhymes, songs and first books. Coffee and chat follow, meeting every other Friday.

a5c5c8607ec27411b5dd06d5c43b050879d54e2a.en: A morning for the youngest children at Tapanila Library on the last Friday of selected months, with a guided session at 10:00 and time to play afterwards. Books can be read or borrowed.

30e49fcb8c2d4ca08d1f0c9ff40b393d507cc7ac.en: Coffee and tea on alternate Fridays from 10:00 to 11:00 at Tapulikaupunki Library, a time and place for talk and meeting others.

2bd2e7bf5d8e31f4b806dcc82bb3dd0c9e187176.en: A workshop at Helsinki Employment Services in Kamppi on creating a job applicant profile on Job Market Finland. Bring online banking details, and apply beforehand. Helsinki residents only.

4b37d960f90574b796ffaaf5264d002652f25c9b.en: A free weekly morning exercise session at Vuosaari Library, standing and suitable for all ages and fitness levels. It focuses on mobility, balance and opening the body, and needs no sign-up.

d7adb3cae1b15389395a2a0a6aace8dd4c91fcd1.en: Free entry to Villa Hakasalmi from 11:00 to 17:00 on the last Friday of each month, including the PUNK exhibition.

6c7103d1948228643e7635c5f71cce7f24509fbc.en: A series of Friday memory talks at Tapulikaupunki Library by the Helsinki and East Uusimaa memory guide, on 4 September, 2 October, 30 October and 27 November. The talks cover memory changes, illnesses and brain health, and are open to all.

80f0869ae2174e257f8bd52fdd79ce52d0be7088.en: A shared lunch at the Vuorenhelmi restaurant of Jakomäki service home on the last Friday of each month, from 12:00. No sign-up is needed, and the pensioner or service card lunch price is 10.15 euros.

5819614562d00e2e77ec66c086e53c8b7dc3b851.en: A livestreamed talk on liver function and liver health at Jakomäki Service Centre, given by a liver expert from the Kidney and Liver Association, followed by discussion.

de380df475d490760c55640e933c70ed04cc2423.en: An All Saints' Day service at Kontula Senior Centre, after which people can light a candle for loved ones in the memory garden. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service card.

e488900ee019b49486116fdabf1aa884c16f1fd8.en: A music service organised by the Roihuvuori parish at Roihuvuori Senior Centre, with a devotion, talk and hymns sung together. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card.

cf5e6d8fecdce9254b684e8a10b7de7172394034.en: A Halloween event at Kontula Library with a disco, badge making, a monster craft and an outdoor bouncy castle. Dressing up is welcome, and entry is free.

219b52157e764d3364a96fc4bb313bccc2327641.en: A film screening for school pupils at Oulunkylä Library on set Friday afternoons and one Tuesday, with films including Madagascar, WALL-E and Annie. All films are rated K7.

aca047e4e6b32c469f249c5389eff4fdad4134c3.en: A farewell snack afternoon at Lassila community house, with the last treats from the cupboards and a "take what you need" point for items to take home.

f54edaa921e173811ef77ccab1d11e62e331d577.en: Crafts supplies for children to use on their own at Käpylä Library's children's section.

29d14ad3a0386e01b8e3029efcd52bf1da7c5528.en: A Halloween ghost walk from City Museum on 30 October at 16:00, with stories of Helsinki's ghosts and urban legends, ending at Restaurant Kappeli. Tickets cost 13 euros, and the walk starts in a steep attic.

965f1cfdd48fc43e5a0e969dedc643173bc47e36.en: A games evening for women and girls aged 16 to 28 at Gamehouse Sture on Fridays of even-numbered weeks from 16:30 to 22:00, with PCs, consoles, VR and board games. A free Jässäri membership card is needed.

154f521fe23a3e1393a793d7dc82db461a120c0b.en: A Halloween show and dinner with Hanna Pakarinen, singing classics by Carola, with a three-course dinner at Hilton Helsinki Kalastajatorppa on 30 and 31 October. Tickets cost 109 euros.

fa413dd3f93280604094028455f0ea2569caf47b.en: A free Halloween event for teenagers under 18 at Tiivistämö on 30 October, with artists, a DJ and a best-outfit prize. Tickets can be booked in advance, and the age range is 13 to 17.

112abda5c8203207cf7eb38da6bf167068af87db.en: Hangouts for the Uusimaa Cerebral Palsy association at Malmi, with a trip, face masks, a themed evening, a Halloween party and a Christmas party. Some sessions are free and no sign-up is needed.

d03d4516660c6e341f75b70ff6c6087b9432fac6.en: The Canta Girls' Choir from Lübeck performs a mix of choral, solo and organ works at the German Church on 30 October from 18:00 to 19:30. Entry is free.

3a5791ccbf50f78dfa3777e00e95dbb101691eaa.en: An open youth room at Vesala Youth Centre for rainbow young people aged 12 to 17 and their allies. No sign-up is needed, and the whole building is available.

c96bde8bfe67881fe835d60abaf9597dc36fa98a.en: A Legazy Seat ticket for Kaija Koo's concert "Tuuleen piirretyt vuodet" at Veikkaus Arena. It includes a dedicated entrance, a welcome drink, small bites and a premium wristband.

b91f3f61e25301c22d71f87190971e1c5cbd2d67.en: Premium Suite tickets for Kaija Koo's concert "Tuuleen piirretyt vuodet" at Veikkaus Arena. Tickets are non-refundable and non-transferable, and names cannot be changed.

27c3059ee3e8b73d790894744b7ce31cc9014619.en: The Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra, with conductor Anja Bihlmaier and violinist Sergei Krylov, plays Gubaidulina's Offertorium and Schönberg's version of Brahms's Piano Quartet at Musiikkitalo on 30 October from 19:00 to 21:00.

2a9fce4fd0386b6cfce483de9b6f416a18105ce1.en: "The Red Room", a Halloween murder mystery play by NoName Theatre, where the audience acts as detectives and solves the crime. It runs in English from 30 October to 1 November, for ages 13 and up.

a9f3b6417ee515f2fb8cacbd9f8f43523377e02e.en: The Cantores Minores and Windsbacher Knabenchor perform Brahms's "Ein deutsches Requiem" at St John's Church on 30 October from 19:00 to 20:30. Tickets cost 15 to 75 euros.

4ae38ab85a616d8fca9e35be1e1cc6b24dc1199a.en: The Helsinki Philharmonic Choir sings Dvořák's Requiem at Temppeliaukio Church on 30 October from 19:00 to 20:40, with soloists and conductor Erkki Lasonpalo. Tickets cost 28 to 34 euros.

f4dc6afd89692fe68240a4b51cba5b06da30615f.en: Three solo exhibitions at Forum Box from 30 October to 22 November: Tommi Pasanen's wood, canvas and paint works, Linda Roschier's cave-inspired paintings and Hemmo Siponen's watercolours. Entry is free.

ef9b717b3669dedeaa594b8c67ca862344ac7c43.en: "Eanan", a video work at Forum Box by Marja Viitahuhta, Ánnámáret, Ilkka Heinonen and Turkka Inkilä, with a yoik for the luohti, the Sámi reindeer and the land. Entry is free.

6fab791c6812a12610594b5707fe23af3a7a3b92.en: A Halloween overnight camp at Villa Meriharju in Vuosaari on 30 and 31 October, where young people try to solve the mystery of the house's strange disturbances and spend the night there.

f14bd863a5c152df05f80c197a7f20199cea6058.en: Krzysztof Pastor's ballet "Dracula", with music by Wojciech Kilar, at the Finnish National Opera and Ballet from 30 October to 18 November. Tickets cost 29 to 130 euros, and it is for ages 10 and up.

04849d5497403839e2e5e0e572679b40c8b86f98.en: A Halloween craft party at Maunula House on 31 October, making glowing wands, pom-poms and decorations from recycled materials. Entry is free.

c4b55a73e434df8fccbf73f23b40ab0927b2f29c.en: The Viapori Kekri celebration at the Military Museum on 31 October, with a community textile artwork, a hunt for Kekri characters and two ghost-story tours in the evening.

7fd95904abe508be09cf6cb9493d7de247ca0738.en: A Pokemon Go day at Oodi on Saturday 31 October from 11:00, with crafts, games, a bingo and a PvP tournament in the evening. The tournament needs advance registration.

c6ec6c2003112726d22b47cdd3e76e246db71df0.en: A cat wellbeing event at Oodi on Saturday 31 October from 13:00, with the Finnish Cat Association and three cat-book authors talking and answering questions.

5f8f4e8dfb5f92fce7f707b01e599bcb0f8fa6e0.en: The Battle of Ideas festival in Helsinki, a day of panel debates on populism, AI, Gen Z and free speech at Balder Hall on 31 October. Tickets cost 12.50 euros, and the age limit is 18.

ea5e070a4d55b12df8baa610b934a2d08fa9544e.en: Saxophonist and flautist Jorma Tapio plays a solo concert at The Winter Garden on 31 October from 14:00. Entry is free.

51f6858b2dacce9ec3c70f4c0e3f0a5901d74641.en: Youth House Saturdays at Maunula Youth Centre on 5 September, 31 October and 28 November, with games, films and board games. Grades 3 to 6 come at 15:00, and older youths at 18:00.

d920d7fd98deb80f976972e14e16e2fe994e1056.en: A Halloween disco for pupils in grades 3 to 6 at Metsäpuro Hall on 31 October from 15:00 to 17:00, with games, costume prizes and a café. It is free and substance-free.

bcd8fda4f83ab2f9f5a8416693f2b123bc5de65c.en: A Halloween-season evening at Itäkeskus Library with the Stoa's dragon and creative costume play. Visitors can come as themselves or dressed for All Saints, and can take workshops for transformations.

ce7460ca79670b7b370f9094f3cec8c7652023d7.en: Open studios at HIAP Gallery Augusta and the HIAP studios on Suomenlinna on 31 October from 15:00 to 20:00, with an English guided tour at 15:15. Entry is free, and the ferry from Market Square is advised at 14:40.

83e7f4cca76499bace20e9b1ef745be75f4de14a.en: Viapori Kekri on Suomenlinna on 31 October from 16:00 to 22:00, a contemporary urban festival with guided tours, films, museum visits, local food and drink. It is organised with Haaga-Helia hospitality students and local artists.

4e97e3ad507f9af394947461f233f9538e6d1006.en: "Yöväen messut 2026", a horror festival at the Finnish Adult Education Centre with talks on Helsinki ghosts and horror fiction, a murder-mystery game and a Soul Gutter concert. It is not suitable for young children.

21e118d6422ae26ffb2a748dc90116e6ba77f071.en: "Kurja Viapori", a dark-history guided walk on Suomenlinna on 31 October at 18:20 and 20:20, about crime, prisoners and the hidden past of the fortress. Tickets cost 18 euros, the tour is in Finnish, and it is for ages 18 and up.

67fbf02f2967e21d6ece33504f88e46f916ca2fb.en: Finnish punk band Nyrkkitappelu plays Tavastia on 31 October, with doors at 19:00. Tickets cost 28 to 32 euros, and the age limit is 18.

022598ec66f0386b99b7faedcc5dd79c6b2bf34b.en: "Night of Dalai" at Tiivistämö on 31 October, a memorial evening for Jarkko Laakkonen with Uhrisavu, Teksti-TV 666 and Sydän, sydän. Proceeds go to Oranssi ry, and the age limit is 18. Advance tickets cost 22 euros.

a670e9874684ff18146a8fe1f91ec622a9e683b0.en: La Luna, a band from Estonia, plays Eurohostel on 31 October from 20:00 to 22:00 with well-known hits from different eras. Entry is free, and the age limit is 18.

72b80312afe688ad39c1fc323befd4dbd8b7fc1e.en: A Halloween céilí at Korjaamo Culture Factory on 31 October from 19:00 to 02:00, with live music by the Helsinki Harps Folk Group, group dances and costume prizes. Tickets cost 16 to 18 euros, and the age limit is 18.

1e129854af215bbaa609cca11c377bcdf68ee294.en: The Falkman studio at the City Museum, the oldest surviving artist's studio in Finland, built by Severin Falkman in 1872 and staffed by volunteer guides. Entry is free.

70033bb4c58c5b2cf310c7a7f34e78476130dc3f.en: A Sunday Finnish language café at Itäkeskus Library from 13:00 to 15:00 on set dates from September to December, led by volunteer S2 teachers. No sign-up is needed.

45ee28ce1f2a32c7c8beb3680cd3a98766443bab.en: A guided gallery walk, the Helsinki Art Walk, from Forum Box on 1 November from 13:30 to 15:30, in English, visiting several galleries. Entry is free.

915663aefd5941d575e3d5f78fb0e5bda9c8744c.en: Spottiklubi, a Helsinki musical club of theatre professionals, performs songs on the theme of "Golden Age" at Villa Hakasalmi in early November. It is included in the admission price, and seats for two people can be reserved.

17b3300ed1860efaa90f8eaa8bfb0e835322d513.en: An afternoon at Töölö Library with Marja-Leena Tuurna, talking about her letters and meetings with the writer Eeva-Liisa Manner and presenting her new book.

cfc4a9116e60db5bc87bc45aa63107b90a22c9a4.en: A Día de Muertos family day at Oodi on 1 November from 14:00 to 18:00, with multilingual storytelling, a make-your-own altar workshop and other activities. All activities are free.

e74491dc5d82f6412801be15d70a8b2d768f63a5.en: The ballet "Viva Verdi" at Aleksanteri Theatre on 1 November from 16:00 to 17:50, paying tribute to Verdi's music through dance. Tickets cost 39 to 48 euros, and it suits ages 5 and up.

35d8ab9dbd52bea036792fe5a93c1e3150bcc7a0.en: Salsa Borealis hosts salsa dancing at Tiivistämö on the first Sunday of selected months, with the 1 November session. Entry costs 5 euros for members and 10 for others, and card payment is only.

db28fad30ebe78b131d9ee03bf3898d25ae51cc9.en: Michael Haydn's Requiem in C minor at Temppeliaukio Church on 1 November at 18:30 and 20:30, with Purcell's funeral music for Queen Mary. Tickets cost 8 to 35 euros.

682e1f69139c39968246b761c8499ebc963a015b.en: A digital survival tips series for seniors at the Finnish Adult Education Centre, on Android phones, on set Mondays from September to December. It covers settings and emergency contacts.

fafbab753fe63eac4cf72ca8d4e5b5469df82a19.en: A chamber concert at Lauttasaari Library with Piazzolla's "The Four Seasons of Buenos Aires" played by a string quartet. It is the first of 12 free library concerts from 2 November, run by the Helsinki Philharmonic.

3b942afef791e2f5a9b6344767e72ea44eafe267.en: A positive reminiscing discussion group at Kamppi Service Centre, about improving mood and self-esteem through good memories. It is for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

4bab4d5e50c16d1e0048751958f82328b7475fe7.en: A library game week at Itäkeskus Library, starting with a Minecraft exhibition opening on 2 November, a Kahoot quiz on 3 November and a Pokémon afternoon on 6 November.

ee3fc886df4c7442db031ddd2f098b4ecccce6ba.en: A Spanish conversation club at Malmi community house on Mondays, for people who know the basics. It is free, and no sign-up is needed.

2809eb67da2a9120a08d6e17aaab020e69c092d4.en: A Winnie-the-Pooh family day at Malminkartano Library, marking his 100th birthday, with a story session, crafts, BeeBot, honey jar fishing, bee orienteering and juice and biscuits.

f6cf8d78f1e594d6f620f641823be1d7613a797d.en: The "Roiskis" choir at Roihuvuori Senior Centre on alternate Mondays from 14:00 to 15:00, led by Henna Dolk Viksten. It is open to people of all ages in the centre's community.

bb86e2a019ee5baa46aaf985c1991afbd498bd5a.en: A repair café at Kontula community house, where people bring damaged clothes or textiles and learn mending by hand or machine. It is free and suits beginners and experienced menders, with guidance in English too.

b7caae12d273f219b14b698f6d6a2e162ce5620e.en: A line dance class at Malmi community house, where dancers perform steps in lines without a partner, to all kinds of music. It is led by a volunteer.

190b53c12b66672dd21a2858157cdeb365f1a285.en: Free initial legal advice from volunteer lawyers at Töölö Library on set Mondays, with about 15 minutes per client. Booking is by phone and only from the Thursday before, and the service is in Finnish.

dbeff88862f38ff11b2d513cca35ebb64f6c0d7c.en: Girls' evenings at Vuosaari Library, with activities from crafts to games, and a place to hang out and chat. No sign-up is needed.

9e5fff5b5b1d9ea78cfc49440f6ba415727b9a9e.en: Knitting sessions at Pasila Library on alternate Mondays from 17:00 to 20:00, where finished knitwear can be brought in for Ukraine. Yarn and helpers are available.

9ba7e977a5f09b69044fbc92d26ef3baa1a1c5b4.en: Board game evenings at Vuosaari Library on alternate Mondays from 17:00 to 19:30, with games chosen in advance and a host who explains the rules. No sign-up is needed.

d0395a06b38ed6ca0246ec523d49858e6e843921.en: A Spanish-language club at Laajasalo Library, for reading, talking and enjoying conversation in Spanish. It meets every other Monday, and all ages are welcome.

414331df0cf373668dbf4fe4ae27b3b4b8aa76c6.en: A drawing and crafts club at Roihuvuori Library, run by an 11-year-old, meeting outdoors in the Porolahti primary school yard.

864424f223cda50aec43e0f0feac350f18fb1e8d.en: A talk at Oodi on 2 November from 17:00 to 18:30 by brain-health expert Sari Mäki on exhaustion, brain health and healthy habits. It gives no medical advice, and it is part of Oodi's open event programme.

66720c8b34ae81562d497376be16c1610a2c44d2.en: A talk by Professor Camilla Lindholm at Arbis, the Helsinki Swedish adult education centre, on easy Swedish in Finland and who needs it. It is part of Swedish Week.

2e685e34725c536a89fc9b24a7a748f236f93fb1.en: The fourth lecture of Pasila Library's science series, on 2 November at 17:30, by Laura Kihlström, who studied health centres to understand welfare reform and democracy. It is part of the "Future of Democracy" series.

3f5f8de91ce1e77376efd1471c2abf40f7e97d5e.en: A three-session reading group at Kallio Library on Palestinians and Israel, with set dates on 5 October, 2 November and 7 December at 18:00. It is led by Päivi Takala and Tuula Haavisto.

b5ff8a10033ca41157096b4ccaba57e96bf8ab55.en: An author visit at Itäkeskus Library with Markku Haussila, the actor and writer behind "Kaikki kauniit kukat" and "Miehet joita luulin rakastaneeni", interviewed by Pilvi Pääkkönen. It is free and part of the Rakkaudesta events.

d88020ac4dfa0a5709d9e4cc48988c0a13de3f05.en: A book presentation at Kannelmäki Library by Mirja Kolehmainen, who reads from her book "Beautiful Stranger" part 2. It covers mental illness and offers peer support and hope. Entry is free.

717c9c23c53c8d0c8f74f03732eebb4080e0a688.en: Open writing dates at Kamppi Service Centre, where people write and read aloud and get encouraging feedback. No sign-up or fee is needed, and writing by hand is encouraged.

7b8b7be7358283579fbffdaca055bf86db682b9a.en: Author events at Cultural Centre Stoa in autumn 2026, including Ulla Onerva, a book influencer with two romance novels, on 5 October at 18:00, and Markku Haussila on 2 November at 18:00, free.

ec83d46e2eced877da1096e4a7e393ed3cc096c8.en: An open reading group on James Joyce's "Ulysses", meeting every two weeks. The first session on 14 September at 18:00 is a lecture on Joyce's wider work. Free entry, and the group continues into spring 2027.

e176a409e946ba0247b4f6eefc9f4a7dcff49044.en: A "Rakkaudesta" lecture on romance scams at Roihuvuori Library, covering how scams work, how to spot them, where to get help, and how to talk to a loved one. The speaker is Helmi Korhonen of Sosped.

094d6ee402e142d314e7b5632ce94e7d4226509c.en: "Nobelfestivalen – The Peace Prize" at Konepaja Stage on 2 November from 18:30 to 20:30, on democracy and human rights, with two world-premiere short plays in Swedish. Pay what you can.

35447b7ae290feee776d993f7f4143dc76e6b889.en: A Swedish-language evening story session for families at Munkkiniemi Library on alternate Mondays from 18:30 to 19:00. Entry is free.

75e0bd76372097e439df0f1f6a6058fff42946ea.en: Tatu Tuominen's four-minute video "A Near Approach to Immortality (Hercynian Forest)" on Oodi's first floor from 2 to 29 November. It explores the lost European primeval forest through Pliny's account.

cd48f24eb6297b3c5ffe4e7a199f7e3a5af33d20.en: Pia Männikkö's installation "Kesäyön unelma" at Oodi from 2 to 29 November, made of joined emergency blankets that ripple like waves. A dancer from M Art Lab performs with it.

2e59ab4298a5af281aa45f64d29935452313b338.en: Paintings by Tuija Lepo in the lobby gallery of Maunula House, made with acrylic paint and markers in the ITE method, meant to bring joy. Entry is free.

d60a1b8cfa2284ada06fdb340502440cf5f58e48.en: Oodi's digital help week from 2 to 6 November, with a city digital adviser on weekdays, except Friday. Personal slots can be booked in advance by phone or at the Helsinki-info desk.

397de15fd3d26a884033f6a99517b50f24d7eaee.en: A breakfast event at Business Helsinki on 3 November from 9:00 to 10:30, for business owners thinking about hiring their first employee. It covers contracts, employer duties and the Helsinki supplement.

1aa5e28b75403952676a7b6bf08406fee91ed2f9.en: A story and rhyme session for children aged 0 to 3 with a parent at Etelä-Haaga Library, lasting about 30 minutes. Families can stay to read and play.

7bda438e66fbf5c4108c78167eb50551fc660d96.en: A rhyme session for babies and small children with an adult at Herttoniemi Library, where children set the pace. Songs and rhymes are sung together.

81a25df64b6ebae97c93fdb8632d7c67f5089814.en: A Christmas calendar workshop at Kinapori Senior Centre, where people help decorate calendars for residents. Bring spare decorations or craft materials if you have them.

a4b52e48c4b048ff24fd0d6ff95b8da398e6515e.en: Free, confidential one-to-one talks at Oodi on Tuesdays in November from 12:00 to 15:00, about wellbeing, relationships, stress or substance use. Register by email or phone, and the organisation is Valkonauhaliitto.

ebd68ca4bcb280228e4f2737895608973defeb71.en: An English conversation group at Kinapori Senior Centre for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card. The aim is to talk and reminisce in English, not to study grammar.

71479274d07f7cfd4eb2000e4e2709251f3a228e.en: A recruitment event at SPR Kontti's Malminkartano logistics centre on 3 November at 13:00, for online-shop tasks such as product photography, order handling and packing. Quick interviews are held.

6a623b36c9af652c7f0d6615810d06b728a8feda.en: Baby Cinema at Pasila Library on Tuesdays every three weeks from 13:00 to 15:00, showing adult films in a baby-friendly setting with dim light and quiet sound. Free, and it is mainly for parents of children under two.

72bb77f8a5b1de22754af3ec494c73763a938ac3.en: A Swedish-language wellbeing event for older Helsinki residents at Töölö Senior Centre, with talks on service centres, care aids, senior exercise, dental care and Seniorinfo, plus an info market.

98b604d86a96663574efe21b5d50a4ac9d10bec4.en: A Tuesday talk at Syystie Senior Centre by Virpi Jussila of Suomen Latu on the wellbeing benefits of outdoor activity. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service card.

ef1e2b5f329a456ef60325c9aea032cc50285877.en: A record panel at Saunabaari on alternate Tuesdays, where people listen to and rate songs from different decades, linked by a loose theme. You can suggest themes and songs to the coordinator.

a4f8f7db96855b238454b2d28dd6b0c8966aea13.en: A Swedish creative writing club for pupils in grades 3 to 6 at Itäkeskus Library, led by a writing teacher. It is free and meets on set Tuesdays from 15:00 to 16:30.

d535d83ee860c4230273b63487d2abdf05e1da1f.en: A board game night at Oodi on 3 November from 16:00 to 19:00, on the first floor by the chess area. Bring your own games or play ones on site.

bf372a65f426bd1b99340501b6c191112a6efc24.en: A monthly Socratic café at Munkkiniemi Library, with philosophy about everyday life, led by Severi Hämäri. The 6 October theme is "Mind and environment".

0f365b1c95cf1d4c2f2b2d2c488a9e99e4cd0550.en: A mending workshop at Maunula House, where people learn to patch and darn clothes in visible, creative ways. Entry is free, and the workshop was suggested by residents.

b89247ac1f13ef151e90b73348e76929111a75f7.en: "Sähkeet Uutiskomediashow" at Pasila's Old Roundhouse from 3 November to 9 December, a live comedy show about the year's news, performed in Finnish. Tickets cost 26 to 28 euros.

9fc13157f3e6c2bbbf4491eceb02a755b907fe64.en: An evening walk along Longinoja stream in Helsinki to spot spawning trout by torchlight, learning about the stream's water quality. It is about 1.5 km and suits families, and no sign-up is needed.

4a616f944a7044bf8c764c527f4a8db338926f9c.en: Monthly board game evenings at Pohjois-Haaga Library on Tuesdays from 17:00, on 1 September, 6 October, 3 November and 1 December. Games are chosen in advance, and beginners are welcome.

76881dd7880ed54bdd34ec87bf64bdf7d2ce0f7c.en: An adult story hour and tea at Maunula Library on Tuesdays from 17:30 to 19:00, on 8 and 22 September, 6 and 20 October, and 3 November. Storyteller Ulla Tarvainen leads it, with up to 14 people.

c5d69ba2b6e743a35c8054ec7fb955301f2893b8.en: A Spanish language café at Etelä-Haaga Library on alternate Tuesdays from 17:30 to 19:00. The group is full, and places are held for people who sign up at the library.

aa23f5a8a75f1bd9532db7f8c1e350b0cb928718.en: A reading dog session with Häxa at Rikhardinkatu Library on set Tuesdays from 17:30 to 18:30. Book a 15-minute slot in the children's department or by phone.

fa22c183d2fde5a683f5363054bb707c7a28eb70.en: An open reading group at Oulunkylä Library about social pressures, nature and fast technological change. The autumn books include Johann Hari, Rutger Bregman and David Attenborough.

1fd536b1dd8cab052a41cddc066282b0c69df73d.en: Public lectures by the Helsinki branch of the Finnish Rose Society at Rikhardinkatu Library on 6 October, 3 November and 1 December. Topics include roses in Ainola's garden and a garden in Iitti.
