1f951b6a4e7a6de7bd11bcbbd6bf3718c40feff3.en: An author visit at Töölö Library with Leo Stranius, author of "1,5 astetta parempi arki", on why cutting emissions and consumption can make life better. Entry is free.

5fbf3422d3b7e84ddbe9a3e92ccad5bc34705104.en: An author visit at Malminkartano Library with Maria Vakkuri, on her book of strange Finnish stories and urban legends, on 3 November at 18:00.

8869a545d05801c080d0ff83792619508570da3a.en: A 30-minute magic and comedy show by magician Kari at Arabianranta Library. Entry is free.

4632af35b3e7b8d75f659ecb62de36779b97718a.en: Students of the Helsinki Conservatory perform at Jätkäsaari Library on 3 November at 18:00 and at Kallio Library on 4 November at 18:00.

0b4e972aaf418a9e1a9545e42e7df9638f32970b.en: An author evening in Swedish at Laajasalo Library with Mårten Westö, reading from his short-story collection "Den hemliga staden" about Helsinki in rapid change.

0fe9efe16f281f81630c3b9aff08f2775956a2b1.en: An interview at Oodi on 3 November at 18:00 with easy-language writers Esa Juntunen and Eve Hietamies, conducted by adapter Hanna Männikkölahti, about easy-read books and their adaptation.

ba83f655befbca5151d58168a4bb6aa5e3b2371e.en: A book launch for "Kolmastoista päivä", a short-story collection by Pekka Minkkinen, at Kallio Library on 3 November at 18:00, with an interview by Konsta Lapinoja. Entry is free.

f65bb1b346d769b999d6ed83a118cb71a07db4bf.en: A reading dog session at Puistola Library on Tuesdays 15 September, 6 October, 3 November and 1 December from 18:00 to 19:00. Children need a parent's written permission to take part.

3907fd2c5b1593f28f3d2c1514c72a712894df84.en: Kosteusvaurio, a four-person comedy improv group, performs short scenes built from audience suggestions and inspired by books and the library setting at Kannelmäki Library.

4c3f4b009aaa9861e4337f2f3a9c4ab3b87f0129.en: "Poiskatsojat" at KOM Theatre, a dark-humour documentary-style play by Susanna Kuparinen and Maria Pettersson on why Western countries look away from crises such as Gaza. It runs 7 September to 5 December, lasts 2.5 hours, and suits ages 15 and up.

50d288245e1b8aa5091cda34b896592fdab36ccb.en: A lecture series on the nature of time, covering cultures, clocks, the natural sciences and philosophers, given by Tuukka Perhoniemi at the Finnish Adult Education Centre. Entry is free.

b00e77a3cc27eb123568e1c85b7333b0bd153b46.en: An exhibition of work by pupils of the North Helsinki Art School at Paloheinä Library from 3 to 28 November, from groups taught by Soile Kinnusen. Visits are during opening hours only.

dfee09f66b14efc794fbb7eb8891430dbeb7814e.en: "Kirkas puhdas hiljaisuus", paintings and works by Mayah Holmberg at Suomenlinna Library, about the boundary of landscape, light and silence, and the weight and lightness of space.

f5d520e0b105c5ad53c99474bbe8853c56f7a4a5.en: The Light Carnival at Säveltäjänpuisto park in Pukinmäki from 3 to 8 November from 18:00 to 20:00, with light art, circus and performances. It is free and suits all ages.

d48fd82e7d6d930da202d639860a0602bd6a84bf.en: Free digital help from Enter ry peer tutors at Kustaankartano Senior Centre on alternate Wednesdays. Book by phone, and bring your own device, charger and logins.

5604677e475d47d9f3ced0c7f936a484d74a5127.en: Digital help from a student of information technology at Kalasatama Library on alternate Wednesdays from 4 November to 16 December, from 10:00 to 15:00. Book at the desk or by phone.

dc89ac00905f4f4c3a9e0e02c0134cd301401270.en: Enter ry peer digital help for seniors at Ristikko Library, held in the neighbouring Konala community space. It is personal and unhurried, and bookings are made at the library or by phone.

a42def190c37225d73a53d349579ec4e8a922509.en: A record panel at Oulunkylä Seurahuone, where people listen to music together and act as an expert panel to rate it. Everyone is welcome.

604decd9ad77e02ee2e00a7b4c31075bed6a7f21.en: A social worker from Kinapori Senior Centre is available at Kallio Library's Dome Hall on 4 November from 11:00 to 13:00, for seniors to learn about city services in an informal way.

bed6fa664b288a33ce9f87bbfda877dab1378915.en: Piano music in the café at Arbis, the Swedish adult education centre, on 4 and 5 November from 11:30 to 12:30, as part of Swedish Week.

52bbebcea4c2c3162c8b84e7c087c319007aba4e.en: A youth budget negotiation at Pihlajamäki Youth Centre on 4 November from 12:00 to 16:00, where young people decide which proposals to take forward and how the €150,000 Youth Budget is spent. No experience is needed.

383ebd99d630d456da920e6374baa21ae4217809.en: KirjaGallerian Keskiviikko, a monthly meeting for all seniors at Kallio Library on the first Wednesday of the month, with coffee, book tips and conversation in the second-floor gallery.

76a8223169a3ddc0f08750844b6c2762265c9618.en: A singing group at Kamppi Service Centre's café every other Wednesday from 12:00 to 13:00, starting 9 September. The group sings folk songs, hits and familiar tunes, and is free.

652633698523bf6b9d78ae928258bbcd2a853ac3.en: A crafts workshop at Oulunkylä Seurahuone with a theme each session, including reflectors, autumn lanterns, Halloween decorations, bookmarks and Independence Day candles.

037a2ea1899f8b2ed57bbe40c576cb0e0ff94777.en: A monthly Estonian-language conversation café at Pasila Library on Wednesdays from 13:00 to 14:30, on 9 September, 7 October, 4 November and 2 December.

076a427dca826f052c6048c7a12bbac838cd8838.en: A listening and rating session on music at Alppila community house, where people give their own scores to songs.

ffd87b852535fd024e619525194e0a3e2a8e45b6.en: Karriärdagen, a career day at Helsinki City Hall for jobs in Uusimaa with employers who value Swedish. It offers CV tips and contacts for people working in Swedish or English. Bring several copies of your CV.

a6a75b59dbd8be66abc44bd74e1bfd2ca250f19c.en: A series of free literature lectures at Töölö Senior Centre's hall on 16 September, 7 October and 4 November at 13:00, given by Katri Sola. Books discussed include "Lucrezia's Portrait" and "Pariisin kirjakauppias".

c2ccbd1623e70fce3cd66400a197f05d6646f0ef.en: An open literature lecture at Töölö Senior Centre on 4 November at 13:00, given by Katri Sola on "Pariisin kirjakauppias", about the Shakespeare and Company bookshop.

f87e3ec200e8faf7418c6559d48b9555a930cb76.en: A beginners' billiards session at Saunabaari's Maple hall on Wednesdays, for people who are new to billiards. Staff are on hand to help with the rules.

8f252142538543a85a19a8082a24340f9e69e17e.en: A lecture series on five famous paintings at Laajasalo assisted living facility, from van Eyck's Arnolfini portrait to van Gogh's Starry Night. Entry is free.

e46935673dcc591bfd952416bd2d20b961a15e62.en: A free financial advice clinic at Oodi on set Wednesdays for people living in Helsinki. Advisers offer help in Finnish and English, and anonymous help is available.

20544ed105612ee0ef5a2dc269a3069f19fb3e18.en: A Finnish language practice group at Alppila community house, led by volunteer Max. You need at least basic Finnish, and no sign-up is needed.

4d0038a190de7c4fdbe260f2b6d90cd82eb726e0.en: The FIFA library cup 2026 for 9 to 12-year-olds, with qualifiers at four libraries from 2 to 5 November and the semi-finals and final at Oulunkylä on 7 November.

0334c240d592e83eef99fa94b8fdba3009f3b908.en: An information and discussion event at Vallila Library on Helsinki's plans for green areas and a school street trial on Inarintie. It covers park improvements and how the street could become more pleasant for walking.

587727c284dd7988e11b3ecd8fdd2cf74708a39c.en: A residents' evening at Metropolia's Myllypuro campus, with news on the expansion project and construction, physiotherapy, a self-check station and a client panel update.

3a1186a37a5b762fcef3c1f76d5813f95c86a7ad.en: The Friends of Finnish Crafts event at Oodi on 4 November from 17:00 to 19:00, showing how a ryijy rug is made from sketch to weave. Visitors can try a loom, and actor Karim Rapatti speaks about weaving.

557fd09a8a58a4f8f742063d622931a517cb0b49.en: A residents' evening on making east Pasila's streets and parks more pleasant, organised by Kalliola Neighbourhood House and the city. Coffee is served from 17:00, and the programme runs from 17:30 to 19:00.

93a0eb3dade25e67698fc89b710e0daf312ce9a1.en: A simultaneous chess display by National Candidate Master Tamás Martinec at Oodi on 4 November from 17:00. No pre-registration is needed.

73fe6466ae2a330ed3b4f2febfe05463a57e02f8.en: A crime-fiction reading group at Pukinmäki Library on Wednesdays at 17:30 on 2 September, 7 October and 4 November. The books include Patrik Berghäll, Helena Steen and Joel Kangas.

d9009783db3e883e188f76d08eb3dff020d4ce33.en: "Spotlight" open mic nights at Tiivistämö on 7 October, 4 November and 9 December, with doors at 17:30 and a show from 20:30. Artists can sign up by email or message.

db8c7c15b64326f7ba7301e617d0306a22a919ff.en: An ideas café at Kontula Library on set dates, exploring themes through literature and everyday life, such as laziness, sin and shame, words and things, and money. Coffee is served.

852601f5795e92a50f62fa704f662eaa36cbf920.en: A reading group at Paloheinä Library on Wednesdays at 18:00, roughly every four weeks, discussing a book that everyone has read. Dates include 2 September and 4 November.

153643a257aedf973d4446b4a2956e565de8e497.en: A recycling craft workshop at Pasila Library, where people make butterflies from discarded books. The library supplies the materials.

6ac8f8e0487cc8094c91c7c3403b65742b67091c.en: Students of the Helsinki Conservatory perform at Kallio Library's Dome Hall. Entry is free.

076ad07e3e3d4c04e4ad9a64a5224d912cb767d2.en: An author visit at Itäkeskus Library with Meritta Koivisto about her crime novel "Erakko", set in the pharmaceutical industry, and interviewed by Elo Lammi. Entry is free.

8fb32866f4f862a4f8ff1f56eff46d83137ad022.en: A free writing workshop at Itäkeskus Library on Wednesdays at 18:00 to 19:30 on 9 September, 23 September, 7 October, 21 October, 4 November and 18 November, run with the Helsinki Workers' Institute.

f4792789e8423bd2d3a3b78157b67fafa07f97ef.en: An author visit at Arabianranta Library with Tuire Ranta-Meyer, who presents her biography of the composer Melartin, "Niin nuori, niin palava", as part of a Helsinki history reading group.

d7fbecf698b3d6184196620c279c220b04922696.en: A writing workshop at Stoa, held with Itäkeskus Library, where people write and read aloud and give each other encouraging feedback. It covers character portraits and storytelling basics. It is free, held every two weeks, and needs no sign-up.

451b57e0a7ab7dd698f376680e26294d17a9d6d9.en: Kennel Union companion dogs at Töölö Library on set Wednesdays from 18:00 to 19:00, where visitors can pet the dogs without booking.

d03501d5848b2df9228c596d5b0a11307957882b.en: A lecture series on the four fundamental forces of nature, from electromagnetism and gravity to the strong and weak nuclear forces. It is free, needs no sign-up, and runs on Wednesdays in November and December.

de5b27700a750432ae2071f4b3e06ad2f2778fee.en: A meetup for families with young children at Myllypuro Library on the second Thursday of each month, with free play, first-book tastings and a guided session from 10:00 to 10:30. Topics include baby food painting and story massage.

10b1c2c72fc63c94690519aa8b8a31d2661a97ee.en: A rhyme session for babies and toddlers aged 0 to 3 with an adult at Kannelmäki Library, lasting about 20 to 30 minutes. It is free, with no sign-up needed.

a1f48bc55483dd6c043e726daabe53c5627a3ba1.en: A dental health professional talks about children's oral health at Pihlajisto playground from 10:00 to 11:00.

ea2ef4528170b221497819f352cef38f8a1305d0.en: Gentle qigong exercise for older adults at Maunula Library on Thursdays from 10:00 to 11:00, taught by a certified instructor in the Aquarium room, for up to eight people. Entry is free.

27f6ea0556338328522ca70e366f08f19af874d4.en: A monthly karaoke at Töölö Senior Centre, where anyone can sing a favourite song. It is open to all.

a2340981c7b29233e1b0cb4143279e53defaf497.en: A digital skills workshop at Malmi community house, where people learn to use laptops, which the house provides. Topics include email, word processing and searching online. Finnish and English are used, and no sign-up is needed.

5807f4bc93c5ba0b82727b140fbae44c962c2f42.en: A Swedish creative writing club for pupils in grades 3 to 6 at Käpylä Library, led by author Annika Sandelin, on set Thursdays from 15:00 to 16:30. Sign up by email.

863fc55c7d07d9307fdae6d89acf6c785735b6fb.en: Founder Forward at Business Helsinki, a workshop on customer acquisition for international founders, open space at Kamppi's Innovation Home from 12:00 to 15:30 on set dates.

9cb61159fe6164da66603aed3bff5ae7bed53fe2.en: An author talk at Kallio Library with Tiina Salmi, who writes historical novels about her family's history, including "Matilda" and its new sequel "Alma".

7a5a77ae1e7988b43f85b56befc59fde66e54662.en: A Swedish Week event at Oodi on Thursday 5 November, with Kjell Westö interviewed about his new book "Coda". It is held on the Saarikoski rug.

83bfd2781c7c40761f6677490e20cf114678c237.en: A free repair workshop at Oodi on 5 November from 17:00 to 19:00, where volunteers help fix or speed up laptops and computers. The workshop is in English, and device owners sign a liability waiver.

87855f6e1c7278760742acd17f86bc5144584695.en: A board game club at Tapulikaupunki Library, for adults and young people, meeting once a month on Thursdays from 17:00 to 20:00. You can bring your own favourite game.

ea4515c33e666b296edb6e540ced0e5f282bd6ee.en: A jazz night at Manala with guitarist Hector Lepe, organ and drums, on 5 November from 17:00 to 19:00. Entry is free.

f7be106d5785d8567e054572625c774e5fe9a3e2.en: A sashiko mending workshop at Herttoniemi Library, where people learn basic Japanese stitches and mend old jeans or other clothes. All tools are provided.

68aaefc91bd32857ea3ceaaa5df7b84db4973278.en: An open reading group on short prose and poetry from South America at the Finnish Adult Education Centre, with sessions on 3 and 17 September, 1 October, 5 and 19 November and 3 December. Entry is free.

ef07417f7f9d5a98c51c044876ca0031b4e5624a.en: A reading dog session with Zita at Malmi Library on Thursdays from 17:30 to 18:30, for practising reading. Sessions last 15 minutes, and an adult books for children aged four and up.

28b6440992c4685f70cfe63985de8cc29c354c8c.en: An open record panel at Itäkeskus Library, where people listen to and score songs about the days of the week from different eras. The hosts are library staff.

6b05a7548cbc24d13c22c42ac0b3959dcd5fea88.en: A monthly reading group at Munkkiniemi Library on Thursdays from 18:00 to 19:30. The autumn books are by Peter Sandström, Jean Echenoz and Riitta Jalonen. You can join at any time.

f3866c299a30b443c5b790e9aeef9c6482f0d586.en: A "Vuosaari Live" evening at Vuosaari Library with rapper and producer Laineen Kasperi, starting at 18:00 with an interview about the books and records that inspired him, followed by a short set.

4f920c2c46c67f5f111c47959f19c1447cd38a42.en: "40 Days of Rain", a dark comedy about antisemitism in Finland, performed at Maunula House by a group of young performers. It is recommended for ages 14 and up.

6a606ef59ec81a5665e98de405aad167a958fe36.en: A concertina concert at Töölö Library, playing modern arrangements of Irish and Nordic folk music on the six-sided concertina, with stories about the instrument.

542c2c89fda638a1109cf0cf959ef31bbf05894c.en: A Céilidh dance evening at Pasila Library with Helsinki Cèilidh Band. Doors open at 17:30 and dancing runs from 18:00 to 19:45. No experience or partner is needed.

34732af2c1204d2305e38721e64acac8c35c3cca.en: A solo concert by singer-songwriter Nikolai Blad (Eero Lehtinen) at Puistola Library, with songs written over 35 years mixing folk, tango and blues. Entry is free.

ffe39fa7a9483139972bc60539a1cb702eb389a1.en: A monthly feminist reading group at Kallio Library on Thursdays from 18:00 to 19:30, with books including Olivia Laing and Olga Ravn. No sign-up is needed, and the room is accessible.

aef34bd240cfa3bbf9622250d66de6dd015d29cf.en: A reading group at Lauttasaari Library on set Thursdays at 18:00, reading Nordic novels such as Khemiri and Tove Ditlevsen. Books can be borrowed a month ahead, and coffee is served.

4b4efa11fb45c0e5062ac79045cf9522dc687816.en: An autumn reading group at Vuosaari Library on Nordic writers, including Merja Mäki, Trude Teige, Jonas Gardell and Stine Pilgaard. It is open to all and books are at the desk.

3e99ac0cd68d5ecde4815bb320ffec64c38cefab.en: A fiction reading group at Laajasalo Library, reading novels from start to finish with lively discussion. Anyone can join at any time.

56d55e934f5698f83ec2321528e21f2319f20233.en: Norwegian pop star Kyle Alessandro at Tiivistämö on 5 November, with his album "AURA". The show is sold out.

9b38ec3f7a521f649fdaec580f83e2464faa5a05.en: Semmarit, a Finnish men's choir whose concerts blend a rock concert, a choir concert and contemporary dance. Doors at 19:00 on 5 November, with tickets at 35 to 39 euros. The age limit is 18.

509c995ac43b724c38e73b66be7b6bb0749555db.en: A puppet theatre piece by Poiesis collective at WHS Teatteri Union on 5 to 7 November, about the poet Katri Vala's life and death. It is in Finnish and includes strong scenes on death and illness, for ages 15 and up.

228c83c21d6e5aba072005ed685c661a7cd2d9d5.en: A charity concert at KULT on 5 November from 20:00 to 23:00, raising money for homeless animals. Artists include Sara Siipola and Younghearted, and tickets cost 20 to 55 euros. The age limit is 18.

919bb301934e057bc4377c1ad31062ea49e55305.en: A night for writers at Eurohostel on 4 November from 20:00 to 22:00, with paper, pens and prompts. Participants can share their writing, and it is held mainly in English. Entry is free.

f0c6e56e9a2c4e4dc6b6fb8ce3a618e3fb0916bc.en: School photography at Linnunrata playground on 6 November, with sign-up through the online photo service.

fb9eb7a9ddd46158cf08b68b219b8d3ff73fe2d5.en: Health measurements with personal guidance at Kamppi Service Centre, at cost price. The service is run by Sydänliitto.

4cf2796ee6c16778bb8041c2e82d50dfd97175a3.en: A baby morning at Vuosaari Library on set Fridays from 10:00 to 11:30, with rhymes and play for children aged 0 to 3 with an adult. No sign-up is needed.

735c726930915f81220bd2558f29660606b07b85.en: A Swedish Week film event at Oodi for children under school age, with films from the Finland-Swedish film centre. The sessions are on Friday and Saturday from 11:00 to 12:00.

f7d5ea7f935ddefffca70d481f871b023bab2afc.en: Finland Hockey Day at Veikkaus Arena on 6 November from 13:00 to 21:00, with open practice, meet-and-greet with national team players, a locker room sale and a donation drive. Entry is free, and some events need pre-booking.

a2a5e86bf966af69fc63795ca0f1e8ecc5df5df5.en: A culture lecture series at Roihuvuori Senior Centre covering Lake Geneva, the layers of history in Rome, the Spencer family's art collection and Prohibition-era Helsinki. Entry is free, and the lectures are in Finnish.

f455d9d2e12973aa06c0f7f3c20b54c70c76c9da.en: Open writing dates at Maunula Library on Fridays from 14:00 to 15:30, on 18 September, 9 October, 6 November and 27 November. Participants write short exercises and give each other feedback. It is free with no sign-up needed.

1b79a6c141bfae52cdbdff40e612ef437bdeb6bc.en: Girls' Friday at Maunula Youth Centre on 11 September and 6 November, with crafts, cooking and music. Grades 3 to 6 come at 15:00, and ages 12 to 18 come at 18:00. A membership card is needed.

d0dc6473f8069c51787c429a7edca20925860c85.en: A talk at Oodi on 6 November at 17:00 about Juha Itkonen's travel book "Teidän Amerikkanne" on the United States under Trump's second term, with guests Nely Keinänen and Jalo Itkonen. Entry is free.

aa8bb66dda8aa9e6725d1ae90d3167c2e4816871.en: A reading retreat at Puistola Library after closing, where participants settle into a quiet corner with a book for two hours. Tea and snacks are served, and people are collected at the door at 17:30.

cf3608da0ed6791622020c628a5dd41505822781.en: Maunula Unplugged, a concert evening at Maunula House with Hugo Cajan and Todellisuus, followed by Samae Koskinen. Doors open at 17:30, and free tickets are available from the library and by link.

a81b4cdfae913d6f6e8dc29e463b08b5fd8f0bd5.en: The Helsinki Philharmonic concert "Heavenly lights", conducted by Olli Mustonen, with composers inspired by the supernatural, mystery and mysticism. It is at Musiikkitalo.

9cb9bebb9cd1f00996625c726a35293d2caa4c73.en: Finnish rock legend Popeda plays Tavastia on 6 November, with doors at 20:00. Tickets cost 39 to 42 euros, and the age limit is 18.

4fe1284dbc56ef71a9e213bc5df3d3a80772aeba.en: Electronic producer Halina Rice's immersive liveset with mixed-reality visuals at Tiivistämö on 6 November. Tickets are sold out, and the show uses strobe lights.

c4bb26a8c148bee452f4c26a1bab427750b25bae.en: A Helsinki Philharmonic wind quintet concert at Musiikkitalo, joining Olli Mustonen in a programme of hushed to thunderous sounds.

5123e4d093024659a774aa699a200e9a97af3fb5.en: Hanneriina Moisseinen's award-winning animation "Valokuvat, joita ei otettu" at Oodi's Aura room from 6 to 8 November, about the photographer Julia Widgrén and the women in her family. It runs 11 minutes and is shown with Swedish Week programming.

5ae3bfc61658361b9fa8f774141e4ceca43d5e36.en: Oliver Beer's installation "The Cave" at Kiasma, with eight singers including Rufus Wainwright and Woodkid, filmed in a prehistoric French cave. Their voices, recorded with 16 audio channels, fill the gallery.

e42668e6db23cf27790096f533657707f445079c.en: "Our shared village", an exhibition at the City Museum by Sámi people in Helsinki, about everyday life, language, identity and the Sámi community in the city.

eea972f5bf08c43e0ed97198641dd85d79dab130.en: A robot workshop at Arabianranta Library with the illustrator and children's author Linda Bondestam. Young children make a robot or other imaginative creature with an adult.

8b1c97f1487262b0fc4e383ecbe64ca664c8c36d.en: A Swedish family carnival at Oodi with a FlipFlop concert at 13:00 and at 15:00, along with crafts, play and organisations presenting their work.

62917cd11b0a3b9071a44865123ea6f6111046b4.en: An author visit at Tapanila Library with Sanna Pelliccioni for a story hour about Onni and Dad, with a small table theatre and a Father's Day craft. It suits children aged about 2 to 7 with an adult.

38827fa329a04c1b07f69f23777c2154adcb9cd2.en: An art workshop at Annantalo Arts Centre for children who need extra support, making a soft owl with textile and paint. The workshop is free and limited to about five children per session.

ceaf86b2adb48e833196097053122c02d000421c.en: A stand-up session on love at Myllypuro Library on 7 November at 13:00, with comedians Ida Akkila and Amanda Hiekkataipale, followed by a speed-friending session from 14:00 to 15:00.

9ff4409c69e5afeb9157162124cb26fdf7aaee27.en: A robot workshop at Käpylä Library with illustrator and children's author Linda Bondestam, where young children make a robot or creature with an adult.

aa8e79b2ea16d441e644152d0f6d91749d0728b3.en: Helsinginkadun Filharmonikot play Tchaikovsky's Romeo and Juliet, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G and Sibelius's Fifth Symphony, on 7 November at the Opistotalo hall and on 10 November at Temppeliaukio Church.

43d7a03309d51e0dd9043bad6d99fc53c8c38b2e.en: The male choir Valkia celebrates its 10th anniversary at the Finnish House of Nobility on 7 November at 16:00, with works from its repertoire and from a new album. Tickets cost 15 to 50 euros.

96b13041cf306b1f74cb0220e5d11dfbd1019534.en: A sake lecture and tasting at Zen sushi on 7 November, with sake sommelier Kikizakeshi. The lecture is free, and the tasting costs 69 euros. The age limit is 20.

bb0ae2b30a1c1849d87b341af12cbf020b97b1c6.en: Loud Visual's improv night at NoName Theatre on 7 November from 18:00 to 20:00, with the group Pioneerit performing experimental improv. Tickets cost 5 euros, and the age limit is 16.

6139a35d7b38d84ba1bb1e34e93ac99c60c8a073.en: Kissa, with Akne POP Group and Babestation, plays Tiivistämö on the night of 7 November. The band is known for a high-energy live show and the album "I Hate Music".

296595046719eb428c05f3ed2936591bad44854d.en: Timo Tuominen performs "Rendez-vous avec Brel" at the Finnish National Theatre's Main Stage on 7 November from 19:00 to 21:00, with Brel songs from his 100 translations. Tickets cost 21 to 55 euros.

e9bb662dbaa8a2d3699611ab3e8cfe43a0255000.en: "Huolto 4:18", a site-specific tragicomedy by Myllyteatteri and Helsinki 98 at Vuosaari's former school building on 7 and 8 November, following a caretaker's mind. It is in Finnish, for ages 13 and up.

4d56aa085a57cb390df7d67dbb7ec725d3084bca.en: Singer-songwriter John Westmoreland plays Eurohostel on 7 November from 20:00 to 22:00, mixing blues, folk, jazz and Americana. Entry is free, and the age limit is 18.

7d82ac5da8704689932b95edca525053192937b6.en: Helsinki Antiques at Wanha Satama on 7 and 8 November from 10:00 to 17:00, with around 40 dealers selling antiques, vintage, design and art. Entry costs 15 euros, students 10, and under-18s enter free.

61b3233987794e6adee633149cdeace142bc9148.en: The Southnord Afro-Nordic Literary Festival at Oodi on 7 and 8 November, with readings and dialogues by poets, authors and researchers from the Nordic countries.

75e4aa9e06f9c350152dbac19bc1b0b940013532.en: Forró X-Tudo club night at Playhouse Bar on 7 November from 19:00 to 01:00, with the band Pra Forrózia, a house band and a dance class. Tickets cost 15 to 20 euros, and the age limit is 18.

d57d12202300ad8d629f02341f5ff97840c1d070.en: Father's Day brunch at Suomenlinna Brewery on 8 November, with three seatings from 12:15 to 20:15 and a menu at 55 euros per person. Children under 12 pay 2 euros per year of age.

6a967d239e1aa1deb5cfc2f3db48b814fe085677.en: An afternoon of poetry and music at Villa Hakasalmi, with Ulla Welin reading her poems and musicians playing Schubert, Sibelius, Dvořák, Chopin and Bach. It is included in the admission price.

a95822a93f02b42a69421c90f8e0863143c61a0a.en: A chamber concert "Insights" at Paavo Hall in Musiikkitalo on 8 November at 15:00, with string music on coded language, nature and more than 1,000 years of music, from Hildegard von Bingen to Caroline Shaw.

5dba735458793aca285963a17b87d413bfe08e5b.en: Veikkausliiga match IF Gnistan against VPS at Markku.fi Areena on 8 November from 15:00 to 17:00. Tickets cost 10 to 35 euros.

b07a7414d00ce5a42f4a0812b491f465887bc7e9.en: Folk singer and multi-instrumentalist Geneviève Andræssen, known as Juniper & The Wolf, plays ballads, folk tunes and storytelling with a Swedish nyckelharpa at Oodi. It is part of the "Musical Instruments of the World" series.

51c149e19c65ba19a21e86580060353d24f93b37.en: A Father's Day concert by the Lauttasaari Orchestra at Lauttasaari Church on 8 November from 18:00 to 19:00, featuring Strauss's "Morgen", Sibelius's Violin Concerto and a rarely heard Sinfonia Piccola by Heikki Suolahti. Entry is free.

00a5b164d04418306f1db470f568e103c8ce393c.en: Japanese saxophonist and composer Yasuaki Shimizu plays Tavastia on 8 November for his first Finnish show. Tickets cost 38.50 to 40 euros, and the age limit is 18.

680e4dbb9ced723a32a46da2fd82cdcf8e632527.en: A music session at Mellunmäki playground for all ages, with rhymes, singing and making music. Families can meet others and warm their own food.

08f830f09045d17703bfe5f897b32f607fe73aad.en: The SYO Weeks restaurant festival from City Magazine, from 6 to 19 November. Restaurants across Finland serve dishes for 12 euros a portion.

56352e09b5f02d0df0bf0922c7be129e2c3caa6a.en: A Finnish singing group at the Kanneltalo Auditorium on Mondays from 11:00 to 12:00, where adults learning Finnish practise pronunciation, words, folk traditions and songs. It is free and needs no sign-up.

d6876a3a20d655a57d07618391724a3f8926aea1.en: A devotional moment led by a deacon at Töölö Senior Centre, open to all. Afterwards you can leave a request to contact the deacon for your neighbourhood.

c5d13f6e9f1dfe67ebb030e6106fc014ba4372ad.en: Group singing at the Kanneltalo Auditorium on Mondays from 13:00 to 14:00 on set dates, with folk songs, hits and classics, plus talk about the songs' memories. It is free and needs no sign-up. The hall has a sloping floor and steps.

3eb11e1be5c6884fd64f4f4d3cb29ff67cbeb648.en: A short-film evening at Malmi community house, with nine award-winning films from a hobbyist championship, including documentaries, open-category films and one-minute comedies.

02c62efbebb1cb9af64d8837d762fe61356d0f9f.en: An informal peer-led chat group for older LGBTQ+ people at Kinapori Senior Centre.

92eb3303d3d289e9a4c717d7e0c88ebd2022e730.en: A monthly book club at Myllypuro Library in cooperation with the Myllypuro pensioners' association. In December it meets on a Thursday from 14:30 to 16:00. Entry is free.

44268d82487151b7154525cb9003ad128d71b388.en: A lecture series on ancient Sparta, covering its origins, the Persian Wars, its collapse and its legacy in politics and pop culture. Entry is free, and no sign-up is needed.

6c4c4937b76e01c019fe7b7cf2c1805a1d269fc0.en: A dusk walk in the nature near Viikki Library, about two kilometres at a gentle pace, with book tips to continue the nature experience afterwards.

74de7828d53371cccaf9da61be4ca2256d9cbcdd.en: A conversation with novelist Agatha Zaza about her new novel "The English Speakers", a crime story set among Helsinki police detectives, at Oodi on 9 November at 17:00.

cb42703e5eafa287ea0f829cb59b0140b4d99bf8.en: A puzzle game evening at Tapanila Library on set Mondays, with brain-teasing board games such as Katamino and Rush Hour. There is no age limit.

8f909f34d9d5ee15496d8524a1235b9edfdccd2f.en: Pacemaker meetings at Kamppi Service Centre for people who have a heart pacemaker, on 14 September, 12 October and 9 November from 17:00 to 18:30, with an online visit from manufacturer Abbott in October.

9543c9558accb547bded4da0b56818be821c3aa4.en: A lecture at Pasila Library on why not everyone's voice is heard in social and health services, with researchers Satu Paatela and Sonja Verkasalo. It is on 9 November at 17:30, and entry is free.

b2f275beebb2ac1df74492acdbc50ec60c64cd93.en: Co-development meetings for the planned Aapelinkulma community space in Kontula, held at the library and community house on set dates. Coffee is served, and no sign-up is needed.

e335bf609b340cff17b38b20b907809f07d4c5c4.en: The Helsinki Balalaika Orchestra with vocal soloists Heli Jormanainen and Slava Druzhinin at Malmi Library, playing Slavic folk tunes. Entry is free.

93e997f1898259b01db39c18d0ed2fc17ef2412c.en: A chamber concert from the Helsinki City Orchestra at Käpylä Library, with Barber's String Quartet and Shostakovich's Eighth. The "City Orchestra at your library" tour begins on 2 November, with 12 free concerts.

b52857cad4d107594d3a6ccf4a87b096545c7d40.en: A fiction book club at Pukinmäki Library on Mondays at 18:00, reading Thomas Mann, Marko Hautala and Kafka's "Amerika" on set dates.

ea4d5399b48f9790eb246fdfbdf3b5df949aed3b.en: A garden club at Puistola Library on set dates, discussing gardening topics informally from 18:00 to 19:30.

e030efd7894a7198bdbf7c4c45729947a79b73a9.en: Esko Valtaoja, emeritus professor of space astronomy, is interviewed by Tuija Takala at Kannelmäki Library. The talk covers his essays and his popular science, and entry is free.

e9d3f56a7b01a05de45252ad8b4f648a5975a854.en: A talk at Töölö Library on how Tove Jansson's illustrations for the Swedish edition of Tolkien's The Hobbit came about, in the 1960s. Sonja Virta explains the archive material behind the images.

1179c6f9415485c5fd433dac61827d9e5e14f1c6.en: Shared reading at Töölö Library, where people read poetry and prose aloud together and talk about them in a calm setting. Tea is served.

56c342eb94d9dcc4aac22f55446615be38e7a18d.en: The autumn 2026 author events at the Kanneltalo centre on Monday evenings at 18:00, featuring Riko Saatsi (7 September), Monika Fagerholm (14 September), Esko Valtaoja (9 November) and Emmi Itäranta (30 November).

59276e28d09793c1dc04e495acb5ccb7b7d915e0.en: A piano concert with a string quartet playing music from "The Lord of the Rings" films by Howard Shore at Temppeliaukio Church on 9 November at 19:00. Tickets cost 29 to 35 euros.

f091d4989c418d04659740b04bf3899229c611c5.en: Memory info sessions in Maunula at Maunula Library on Tuesday mornings from 10:00 to 11:00 on 22 September, 13 October, 10 November and 8 December. They are free and open to all.

bbc80528e46b17462f07df11b257a1218972f83d.en: A group singing session at Syystie Senior Centre for older people and centre clients, on set dates from 13:30 to 15:00. Songbooks are provided, and entry is free.

d7401a892350f4037794a17fe62c70966927839a.en: Tuesday lectures at Vuotalo in Vuosaari, covering the sinking of the Ilmarinen in 1941, the history of the Vartiokylänlahti bay and early seafarers' welfare in Helsinki. Entry is free, and no sign-up is needed.

78fd09c8ead5622da13af94eb086c9e19853888f.en: An artist talk in English at Nordic Culture Point on 10 November at 16:00, in which Sakib Khalid Saboor discusses his project on the layered history of Suomenlinna through photographic work.

180c57aade24096904a91f8b67400e6d62b237f1.en: An Archives Day at the Finnish Literature Society, with four short stories from the archive, a talk by archivists and a stage show. The main show is at 17:00, and entry is free.

c6dc1aecca300c106f96cf5754f9be9cf1c44c1c.en: A book talk at Oodi on rock music and leadership, about the book "The Hard Rock Core of Leadership" by Harri Palviainen, with contributions from musicians.

635bc6fa66a6b916c0279152904e688e5a3c98ab.en: An English book club at Pasila Library, held on set dates with the host Jann. Books include "The Book Thief", "Beautyland" and "Yellowface". Reservations can be made at libraries.

c32cc7e1aaf0d04d5832191763184fc92c808f1e.en: A concert at Herttoniemi Library in the autumn Helsinki Folk series, with the band Rautakoura and singer Paula Wolski playing acoustic folk. Entry is free.

6720a37482189b675cc89f5660e76c368bb90e0b.en: Author events at Vuotalo in Vuosaari, with Aki Ollikainen on 6 October and Maija Kajanto on 10 November at 18:00. Both are interviewed, and entry is free.

5223d41e498566463ac1aa671c1b7e44e6ec77ad.en: A talk at Vuosaari Library with author Maija Kajanto about "Lasipallotalvi", where the story of Heta from the Café Koivu series continues. The talk is part of the library's love events.

4fc8cb2b5defdcc23c563408e09d5bde2df6ae42.en: A literature evening at Töölö Library marking 80 years since the birth of the Estonian writer and poet Viivi Luik, with readings in Estonian and Finnish. Entry is free.

e06428712bceb607f793eb43e8f924fc25c9cd1a.en: A reading group at Maunula Library on Tuesdays from 18:00 to 19:30 on set dates, discussing recent fiction. Books include Lisa Ridzén, Petina Gappah and Antti Heikkinen.

ef78f6f03f55e557e7f4b8c2811cbcfe24acc30c.en: Latin American baroque music at the Church of the Good Shepherd on 10 November at 19:00, with two choirs singing songs from an 18th-century Peruvian codex and indigenous Andean songs. The programme costs 15 euros and entry is free.

4bdfdc20782d1e61768c2c8afda01756d1d045bb.en: Janne Reinikainen directs David Ireland's play "Viides askel" at Taivassali, about two recovering alcoholics who meet at an AA meeting. It is in Finnish, for ages 15 and up, and runs 10 November to 9 December.

1ade278b99b946e35f50591a8fe85ec52fa55db3.en: The Finnish youth nature and climate group NUOLI presents the demands of young people on Finland's environmental policy at Oodi's pop-up area, based on the Youth Environment Summit's statement.

1ddf99210a2068dee5c1288447fc3ed96b313dea.en: Group singing at Töölö Senior Centre, where familiar songs are sung together with accompaniment.

92aa71a3ed19882300e61dd31add6abaa0a88d9f.en: A workshop at Töölö Senior Centre on writing a living will, for care preferences at the end of life. It is for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with a service card, and printing costs 4 euros.

934ab15393b68baff0a5c5e72e58b9d9114215a6.en: An open peer-support group at Kinapori Senior Centre for people who have had a stroke and their relatives. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a service card.

4141c28d7eb1e923f49582e0a1d3af893d1615f8.en: A relaxed afternoon of coffee and positive activities at Kontula community house, with the activities chosen by participants. It is mainly in Finnish, but everyone is welcome.

13b69e816faeda798d0aa65bb87336d238fe4f80.en: A free creative writing workshop at Pihlajamäki community house on 11 and 18 November from 14:00 to 16:00, where people write stories from their own lives. It is run by Performance Sirkus, with no sign-up needed.

1849d3a258c6bebe0581bc3bf9ef0bf21e9ec8d0.en: Stadi Rise Up 2026, a free entrepreneurship event for Helsinki residents aged 15 to 29 at Aleksanteri courtyard on 11 November from 15:00 to 18:00. Participants can try hands-on entrepreneurship points and join a panel. No experience is needed.

3b349c74f8c76cf1bda98278bbf522502c3bcafa.en: Two guided museum tours at the Hotel and Restaurant Museum, on 16 October about school food and on 11 November about food and drink culture. They last about 45 minutes, are in Finnish, and need no sign-up.

48cef6084c21fa0c6a956593e71a0bfa0a324ed4.en: A Nordic literature circle, held with Nordic Culture Point and Oodi, meeting monthly in Swedish or Scandinavian languages. In November the book is the first volume of Solvej Balle's seven-part series. No registration is needed.

a0695cfa01fc2adb5ddd334cbf7828941bf31b13.en: An information event at Oodi's Maijansali on 11 November from 17:00 to 19:30 on ways to keep reading as eyesight declines, including aids, digital tools and support. Talks in Finnish are at 17:15 and 18:15.

08d0f8340b039834c20fa38d3f1d0cd2d678d9b9.en: A lecture at the City Museum on poverty and hardship in 19th-century Finnish towns, especially the experiences of children and young people. It is given by Noora Viljamaa, on a Wednesday in the Culture Corner.

0ae27bbd1a89a2b3ad58d0b13224ecf92a915817.en: A lecture series on the Sámi in Helsinki, covering history, identity, architecture and Sámi handicrafts, and a look behind the City Museum's Sámi exhibition from 6 November. Entry is free.

9c604a68717b6f02f3661e939f4f802cc1f488c3.en: A practical training session for volunteers at Malmin kauppatie on 11 November from 17:00 to 18:30, on helping older people move, using aids such as wheelchairs and rollators. Sign up by 7 November.

d22a224f163c34dfd3135f6153f617ed888ef1e5.en: A talk at Malmi Library by Professor Hannu Toivonen on the basic concepts of artificial intelligence, its effects on society and tips on using language models.

38fa44a2e1da9117895b9a009ffa51801f70956d.en: A writing circle at Munkkiniemi Library on Wednesdays from 18:00 to 19:30, on 23 September, 21 October, 11 November and 16 December. The group is full.

324bde4f7ba8998bc3d884a2ba46c05361fcc5ce.en: A climate reading group at Herttoniemi Library on Wednesdays from 18:00 to 19:30, with the first two sessions held outdoors in nearby nature. Tea is served, and no sign-up is needed.

2c00c89478d690ef468a55193d1d15ce6a85043b.en: An open Marxist reading group, run by the Democratic Education Union at Oulunkylä Library. Everyone is welcome.

833f32851dd4014c9387424910ce6560505658cc.en: The first autumn "Häiriöklubi" at Pasila Library on 11 November from 18:00 to 20:00, with the lo-fi synth-pop acts Ty Roxy and Future Box. Entry is free.

43ede0c303aa34070a4a1915c30ca1a460eaeb20.en: The "Muuttuvan maailman" reading group at Itäkeskus Library on set Wednesdays, reading about the most pressing issues of our time. Anyone can join, with no sign-up needed.

2e9f5afd4d64f4ecf2edc1f8a1b4506812a567f7.en: An author visit at Vallila Library with Leeni Peltonen, about her debut novel "Daalioita ja sipulinvarsia", set in a city allotment garden. She talks about the allotment's everyday life.

43bea8ce8575577c6c37298bd4006d2598546931.en: A crime-fiction reading group at Tapulikaupunki Library on Wednesdays from 18:00 to 19:30, with the autumn theme of revenge. Books include Martin Österdahl and Harriet Tyce. Entry is free.

cfe886b3ad39a598de4adf1915938cd81303be05.en: A paint and wine evening at White Lady restaurant on 11 November from 18:00 to 19:30, with a guided watercolour session. Tickets cost 35 euros including materials, wine is extra, and the age limit is 18.

5def43e98d910e234b94e951dc61a0617f4a412c.en: A reading dog session at Munkkiniemi Library for people practising reading aloud, with a 15-minute slot. Book in the library or by phone.

5edf1277b87015a3e889886a387fc1d4d701cd6e.en: An Estonian-language book club at Töölö Library on 23 September, 11 November and 16 December at 18:00, also online on Teams. The books are by Eva Koff, Sven Mikser and Kristiina Ehin.

dabe66cbdd6dde49dd5df7bb02aceed2d138de66.en: "Punainen viiva" by Red Nose Company at Konepaja Stage on 11 and 12 November, a comedy with live music based on Ilmari Kianto's classic, about voting rights and equality. It is in Finnish, for ages 14 and up, and lasts about 2 hours.

cc52a6da8a85a513f7e47b48dc06130a062a2327.en: HIFK plays Jokerit in ice hockey at Helsinki Ice Hall on 11 November at 18:30. Tickets are sold through Ticketmaster.

8854b738bc60fc5eeb47a5254400213a841caf96.en: F, real name Fanni Sjöholm, celebrates her album release at Tavastia on 11 November, with R&B, pop and hip-hop. Doors open at 19:00, and the age limit is 18.

8443d26a8d41e72c9cdff5b93617d2526b0c05b7.en: "Radicalis 2.0", a pole dance performance about the meeting of built environment and nature, at Galleria Unika from 11 to 14 November. Tickets cost 10 to 15 euros, and it lasts about 40 minutes.

c0d3c8cd207732a86904aab3b00e987c6df77831.en: Conductor Adam Fischer leads Viennese classics with Swedish soprano Miah Persson, a celebrated Mozart interpreter, in a Helsinki Philharmonic concert at Musiikkitalo.

515c8f07513ff385669f7ed5e218a69331125f7e.en: A karaoke evening at Eurohostel on 11 November from 20:00 to 23:00. Entry is free, you can bring your own food and drink, and the age limit is 18.

30bfbb4edab4dad96b417c33f839a8875cb90bbc.en: The Night Visions International Film Festival in Helsinki from 11 to 15 November, one of the largest genre film festivals in the Nordic countries, focused on fantasy, horror, science fiction and action.

711e7e95f1dba70cc7f6db4898e6eacf05ce4b80.en: A health point at Töölö Senior Centre where the Red Cross offers talk and blood pressure checks, and support on food, exercise, mental wellbeing and substances.

9645757c3b6663adeabb196ad3f2e374ed4fe8fc.en: MatchXR, a day on emerging technologies such as XR, AI and spatial computing at Metropolia's Arabia campus on 12 November, from 10:00 to 18:00. It is in English, free to enter, and needs pre-registration.

1e2c0fa3cd028dea0323371355a0538f24674b82.en: The Philharmonic at the Library, a free string quartet concert with Barber and Shostakovich at Kontula Library, one of 12 library concerts across Helsinki from 2 November.

41ef70ca3b702a51e54d2db3f31eb4a25fdd0f42.en: A monthly bingo at Töölö Senior Centre, open to all.

641cc670944b329054b9bc9f8875083111799d5c.en: A monthly afternoon film club at Kallio Library on the third Thursday of the month, showing films at 13:00 and 15:30 for up to 15 viewers each. No sign-up is needed, and seats are taken in order of arrival.

b1f16fe5c20fca2c794c086793e40fef166d4a85.en: A fan convention at Maunula House on 12 November from 15:00 to 18:00, with cosplay, K-pop dance, an artists' alley, a pin workshop and an anime film. Entry is free and open to all ages.

5290b58d780719e2b775d3352fc9dd699d2e821e.en: The afternoon film club at Kallio Library at 15:30 on the third Thursday of the month, showing films to up to 15 viewers. No sign-up is needed, and seats are taken in order of arrival.

0f7a888b02aa70ea6b862991ebe01a322ded7b48.en: A gathering at Pasila Library on local life and services in Pasila, with coffee and chat. Stops are on 12 November at Silmu youth centre, 26 November at Pasila Naapuruustalo and 10 December with the Mannerheim League for Child Welfare.

1f4b8abe6e9affe2a3be07374ed1a5eb763bebf8.en: A lecture series on forgotten women scientists, from prehistoric women to Émilie du Châtelet, Hypatia and Lise Meitner. Entry is free, and the lectures run on set Thursdays in November and December.

e377469d307bf6408ad50a5b5e760fd8dc4bb707.en: Lectures at Stoa on home preparedness, on 12 November on keeping the home ready for long power cuts and water problems, and on 19 November on 72-hour preparedness as a hiker would. Entry is free, with no sign-up needed.

93e0bb912f80c15685b7698da3d9054fdc42d703.en: A monthly board game evening at Etelä-Haaga Library on Thursdays from 17:00, on 20 August, 17 September, 15 October, 12 November and 10 December. Games are chosen in advance, and beginners are welcome.

3326372088d4edfb7ab98b81851a3e3db9a2aadb.en: A panel at Oodi on who decides which Black Nordic histories are preserved, with archivists and scholars from Sweden and Norway. Curator Savannah Wood presents her Afro Archives project. The panel is part of the Southnord Artfest.

17a49d5a2c2473b29936d61eedf13a0f95727dd7.en: A talk on weaving as an expressive art form, by Outi Martikainen, and on craft, art and design as critical practices, by Ana Nuutinen. It is part of a lecture series on textile craft and art, and can be followed live online.

e360152a37051945c8c44077cf2d8a9a4f98ad0b.en: A panel at Villa Hakasalmi on the Riot Grrrl movement in Finland around the turn of the millennium, in Finnish, followed by a screening of "The Punk Singer" at Kino Regina. A film ticket gives a reduced 11-euro exhibition entry.

6a6cbe8261a75187a214fc1abdc6a059251988d9.en: A reading dog named Einar at Vuosaari Library, for one-to-one 15-minute reading practice. Book through the library's service desk or by phone. Good for people learning to read.

fe8b1070997bb080118ffc752a1622796e0618d7.en: A monthly evening crafts circle at Töölö Library on Thursdays from 17:30 to 19:30, on 13 August, 17 September, 15 October, 12 November and 10 December. Participants can speak Finnish, Swedish or English. Bring your own project.

be6e76778ca3da0149371e93056afb0f12a7ebfe.en: A casual coffee session with the Kannelmäki library director, where people can ask questions, give feedback and make suggestions. It is free and held twice a year.

d8caebdf186eb990b5421d076fe6d54931815fda.en: The Helsinki Folk concert series at Ristikko Library with the band Rautakoura and singer Paula Wolski, playing acoustic folk. Entry is free.

40075e1e8e63771c6bd44984346267635e1637a5.en: "Sähkeet Uutiskomediashow", a Finnish-language comedy revue about the year's news, at Cajsan Helmi on 12 and 19 November and 3 and 26 December. Tickets cost 49 euros including a meal.

e20050136df6eb710bba8412b7617e8e58936370.en: A rainbow-theme reading group at Kallio Library in November, reading the verse novel "Kummajaisten kesä" by Sara Norja. It is open to all, with no sign-up, and the book can be borrowed from the library.

709bed9e2fe4acfd9bebbe371bf26a69c28d66d0.en: The "Dear Käpylä" concert series at Café Saurahuone from October to December, with free concerts, often outdoors in good weather. Concerts start at 18:00 unless stated otherwise.

40e3f08867bf16d8ba0017a88dc97d597efbdfac.en: The band Heili, performing modern songs that blend jazz, folk and tango, at Itäkeskus Library on 18:00. It is part of a tour of libraries with further concerts on 24 November, 25 November, 3 December and 10 December.

32fabb627283f56e6d2af5e4caee320d9aab54bf.en: A reading group at Itäkeskus Library for learners of Finnish at level A2.2 and above, reading Minna Canth's short stories and an easy-language version of the Odyssey on set dates from 18:00 to 19:30.

c5a1c79c14c4cdd5b421b8a72a40c1469c862061.en: An author visit at Töölö Library with Mirva Karkinen about her debut novel "Leviatan". She reads from the book, discusses its themes and writing, and signed copies are available.

7248b1e1b1cc4f207d7ebf1e4d62cd12caece0c4.en: A concert of songs by Kaj Chydenius, sung by Ritva Sorvali and Helena Ryti at Pasila Library. Ritva Sorvali worked with Chydenius for almost 30 years.

aea03cc5668502a6f93f8907ff2d78d781899f78.en: An author evening at Kontula Library with Vehka Kurjenmiekka, a writer and priest, discussing romantic fiction. It is part of the Rakkaudesta events, interviewed by Lois Armas.

bfe3915196021dedf47590822c59d5c206a421db.en: A non-fiction book club at Itäkeskus Library on set Thursdays, with books on the Middle Ages, newspapers in the civil war and the history of Helsinki. Books are borrowed in advance.

546ee0469c9755052918984d2dabda190f7781a6.en: A crime-fiction book club at Lauttasaari Library, reading one thriller a month with coffee or tea. The autumn books include Tom Ryan, Lisa Jewell, Tove Alsterdal and Jo Callaghan.

f94806b4686de820400444032f35a6f93ad2444c.en: A silent reading club at Pasila Library on the second Thursday of each month from 18:00 to 19:45. Everyone brings a book and reads quietly in the auditorium, with tea and light snacks. Participation is free.

7aaad8f0db8f064ef3766476e5137d807948d45d.en: A repair pop-up at Oodi on 3 September, 8 October, 12 November and 10 December from 18:00 to 20:00, where people fix or alter clothes with help and tools. No experience is needed, and it is free.

07fea28bd976bd1a402d72616dcf307c972c0391.en: A charity concert at Tavastia on 12 November from 18:30 to 23:00 for the fifth anniversary of Viral Vegans, with Pete Parkkonen, Anssi Kela and others. Tickets cost 25 euros.

3a4d3b65e42485ba01935842c2c2b1a392e459df.en: Two NHL regular-season games at Veikkaus Arena between the Carolina Hurricanes and the Seattle Kraken on 12 and 14 November. Several Finnish players are on the teams.

f4e6bcc1b6e8ae67356f1c9e984f7bcfbf312da3.en: A rhyme and song session at Tapulikaupunki Library for babies and toddlers with an adult. Visitors rhyme, sing and play.

135313860c1dc6efd10769dd3edd1c9e63565ccc.en: An open-to-all sexuality and wellbeing day at Kinapori Senior Centre, with talks, workshops, a burlesque show and a disco. It is free, for the centre's clients, and runs from 10:00 to 15:00.

8a7977032ada79d12fe3b8b7d6f29fccc114b234.en: ODE to XR, a free immersive art and film exhibition at Oodi from 10:00 to 18:00 on 13 November, with works from six countries and meetings with artists. It is part of MatchXR.

976b52443d9322152264d33936842da6f0880a28.en: A baby cinema at Maunula House on Fridays of selected months from 10:00 to about 12:00, with quiet, dim films suited to babies and their carers. Entry is free.

f6fdc5820374f223c9824c40ba80c52e8041a9ae.en: A Swedish reading session for toddlers aged one to three at Oodi.

23e58b7104a513454aff8a5c6b82a349da82fcc2.en: A Swedish-language book club at Kamppi Service Centre, starting on 16 October with Kerstin Ekman's "Löpa varg". November's book is by Lina Wolff and December's by Alex Schulman. No pre-registration is needed.

64a4d74dca5ec87825b84d7caa4adab72d5839c4.en: A farewell party for the Kontula community house on 13 November, with speeches, cake, music, crafts and photos. The house pauses from 16 November and reopens in January 2027 in the Aapelinkulma space.

3b8352b8a32ac559cf71d5b5c04b2331b0ef50d9.en: A monthly growth circle at Innovation Home in Kamppi for Helsinki entrepreneurs. On 13 November it focuses on brand, storytelling and competitive advantage, with a three-hour workshop led by Toni Lähde.

34cdf95da8b5d33dbbdb62801688c33e1aa81d3d.en: A monthly adult film afternoon at Oulunkylä Library on the second Friday of the month at 13:00. Entry is free, with no sign-up needed, and the films are rated according to their age limits.

ee7597710a0c91983098eaa33bb6ebfc8651e5a7.en: "Date Friday" at Kiasma, a night of conversation cards to help people meet and talk in the exhibitions. Cards are available in the lobby.

c1829443693eec9ff3b97684080c498a3169ef1c.en: A monthly sewing and clothes-alteration workshop at Oodi Urban Workspace for ages 13 to 28. Machines and materials are provided, and no booking or experience is needed.

6f2021f338bd81700012a8356762213e33cdd26e.en: A reading retreat at Kallio Library on 13 November from 18:00 to 20:00, when the library goes quiet for reading. Books can be borrowed, and tea, coffee and snacks are served.

df82f35d7975797e25e691c64a76c3ba4304669f.en: "Don Quixote" by Red Nose Company in English at Konepaja Stage on 13 and 14 November, with a comedy about a knight-errant and his squire. Tickets cost 10 to 22 euros, for ages 13 and up.

7d698f2f1f823764516db35ed862e25010206622.en: Karl Jenkins's "Stabat Mater" at Temppeliaukio Church on 13 November, performed by two choirs with the Helsinki Police Symphonic Band. Tickets cost 20 to 30 euros.

1e643b2c7146ec5145a8ca2323b186ee48b01423.en: Isaac Sene, with support from Pesso, at Tiivistämö on 13 November, an all-ages concert by the pop singer with an R&B edge. Tickets are sold through the venue.

33994a3a19910ca9b197a84cb8c68a8be8625519.en: "Bländad av död och kärlek", a dance performance at Tanssin talo on 13 and 14 November, where Baroque music by Monteverdi and Strozzi meets Piazzolla's tango and contemporary dance. Tickets cost 22 to 35 euros.

23c79f53f21024670cbc50c1a5fa16e365e8a031.en: Rapper Etta plays Tavastia on 13 November, with doors at 20:00. Tickets cost 24 to 26 euros, and the age limit is 18.

9a409cee1565d77ae52d44f32f6559c2ce45e6fa.en: A monthly English-language book and culture café at Itäkeskus Library on Saturdays from 10:30 to 12:00, where people share books and films on a chosen theme over coffee.

7b58013b186532d384db1f7ad6e12fc8ac8aeb2e.en: A Saturday film club at Myllypuro Library, with children's films from 10:30 and adult films from 13:00 on set dates. Coffee and tea are served during the adult film. No sign-up is needed.

7ebccbbfc4b8a4666219d9d9caa7c1098d3d07c6.en: Teater Kojan's "Kalas", a story about Alfons Åberg's birthday party, at Berghäll Library on 14 November at 11:00, in Swedish, for ages 2 to 6. Entry is free.

ee9b36e2071ac4f33b625f806a7fdda5a34b8c9a.en: "Urkusatu BUU: Kertun ja Hukkasen seikkailut", a fairy tale for children aged 5 and up by Kari Hotakainen and Jouni Hirvelä, with organ played by Eerik Ohtamaa. It is at Musiikkitalo on 14 November at 12:00 and is in Finnish.

1e09812d2179d15ef3e56602bfec70343c6c89e6.en: WAM World After Malaria, a two-day festival at the University of Helsinki and Lapinlahden Lähde, with films, theatre, music and talks on how malaria was overcome in Finland and Cyprus. Entry to the Lähde day is free.

566a3e8f21a06364b4ab67fa5e35d1ae796658c2.en: Usagicon, an anime and pop-culture convention returning in November, with applications open for performers, the open stage and the artist alley. Details of the programme will follow.

75878ecbae1fd77b15244cd7054d574d587cb6be.en: An open synthesiser jam at Oulunkylä Library, organised by Echo Collective. Players bring their own synthesiser and cables, and listeners are welcome. Entry is free, with a sign-up advised for players.

9b89c19d9420ee816928253d8e48e0c078c0fb57.en: A monthly Saturday book club at Tapulikaupunki Library from 13:00 to 14:30, with the autumn theme of art. Books include Yoko Ogawa, Virginia Woolf and Jennifer Clement. Copies can be collected from the desk.

f5ee81f2ec0df8c270f9899a52043f73e66ebb52.en: "Plastic-Shaped Journey", a free workshop tour at Kalasatama's Vapaakaupungin Olohuone where discarded plastic is turned into art and useful objects. It runs on set dates and suits ages 4 and up.

0ef28c91819015e8cc9dd3f6d13c9f0ada7dc60c.en: The Maunula Book Fair in Metsäpuro hall on the second floor of Maunula House, with conversations with well-known authors from Maunula and nearby areas. Entry is free.

52ca23909da06b4b880e01252700320b9ad79e4b.en: Pinkki and Fankki, two wild-cat singers who perform their own children's songs with dancing and a quiz, at Kannelmäki Library. It suits ages 3 to 8 and lasts about 30 minutes.

485226a559f41b455985f552d0c37457bed6e824.en: A Somali-language story session for children aged 3 to 6 and their families at Malmi Library, with stories and time together in Somali.

6e2f482a4a1a8b724496b0b36ac1bb0cae73e749.en: An artists' meeting at the Theatre Museum on 14 November at 14:00, with Erkki Saarela and Pyry Äikää talking about political satire, physical theatre and Dario Fo's text. Tickets cost 8 to 16 euros.

1e56edab8e64ecd220758ac5c640eb43a253960b.en: A family guided tour of the "Pako Muumilaaksoon" exhibition at the Architecture and Design Museum on 10 October, 14 November and 12 December at 15:00, in Finnish. It suits children aged 6 to 10 and includes play in the Moomin Valley theatre.

45d10504f9eb7f21117bc83152289d3cd7af0418.en: "Myself/Myself/Myself", an opera for voice, actress and electronics about a neurodivergent young woman at the threshold of adulthood, at WHS Teatteri Union on 14 November. It is in Finnish, with English surtitles, for ages 15 and up.

231e1a00d65a9fb8dca9937c009420b366340ba3.en: The Comedy Store, the famous British stand-up brand, at KULT on 14 November, with doors at 19:00. Tickets start at 32 euros, and the age limit is 18.

17e0ec427e03870a087a577f8588bb7a63dc32d4.en: Buko Shane plays a solo acoustic set at Eurohostel on 14 November from 20:00 to 22:00, with original songs and covers in an Americana style. Entry is free, and the age limit is 18.

adcdcf126eab6011121371b8d3e467067dd4061b.en: Helsinki Symphonic Winds perform stage music such as West Side Story and The Phantom of the Opera at Lauttasaari Church on 14 November, with soprano Júlia Arquillo. Entry is free, and programme booklets cost 10 to 15 euros.

463e54c38b3c87f6f427931c4800cfedfab7ccb1.en: VIP packages for the NHL Global Series game between the Carolina Hurricanes and the Seattle Kraken at Veikkaus Arena. Packages are non-refundable and non-transferable.

3b594d486c252bf3a71aa5ad135d95789db532a2.en: "Taru hohtavasta helmestä", a family fantasy play at the Finnish National Theatre's Main Stage from 14 November to 19 December, about a gnome who takes a glowing gem into the world. It is in Finnish, for ages 7 and up.

9a0818ef553dfeb555e9300ed9976775e31559b8.en: "Disco K-50", a disco night for people over 50 at Restaurant Pörssi on 14 November from 19:00 to 01:00, with music from the 1970s to today and some Latin hits. Tickets cost 22.50 to 24 euros.

8e1b276077c063748640618929541e3721b44413.en: A flea market at Käpylä 26 on 15 November from 10:00 to 14:00, organised by fewGOODS. Entry is free, and more dates are listed on the organiser's website.

db9f310a1c362e50ed918c4bba4887042fd43679.en: A robot workshop with illustrator Linda Bondestam at Kallio Library, in Finnish and Swedish, where young children make a robot or creature with an adult.

532a5b8297e275a704bf8a617f70aa1020a5591c.en: The tenth-anniversary programme of the Photography Sunday at the Finnish Adult Education Centre, with exhibitions, slideshows, a light-painting workshop, a book launch and a panel. People can join the parts that interest them.

cea3fc42619c417dbf18fd8cbfbb526f83b70c82.en: The make-a-thek Embroidery Club at Oodi, on Sundays from 13:00 to 15:00 each month, for hand stitching and other crafts. Beginners and experts are welcome, and some supplies are provided.

8d81a118acfdb5e2ecaf9913dfaca20546eb7b39.en: The Helsinki Art Walk from MUU Helsinki at the Cable Factory on 15 November from 13:30 to 15:30, a free guided tour of galleries, in English, led by artist Jane Hughes.

98c8d2f7672c2e28aaf16744b33c21db04db95e2.en: Violinist Lotta-Maria Heiskanen and pianist Yes It's Ananias play at Villa Hakasalmi, with an experimental mix of classical, jazz and punk. The concert is included in the admission price.

389e2acc4594cc54228c3cd049902929cffe2128.en: "Frankenstein" by Red Nose Company at Konepaja Stage on 15 November at 14:00, a family comedy with disco music and interactive play, based on Mary Shelley's story. Tickets cost 14 to 22 euros, for ages 6 and up.

29cb42faf867d48d85a22cdf74bc3d1486f35c38.en: A book launch at Oodi on 15 November from 15:00 to 16:00 for "Jaarli 2.0 - Vastuunkantajat" by Pekka Paloheimo, a book of portraits of influential Finns. The author answers questions and signs copies.

c22c17ee9890fa07b792b4bdaa20d09a79ac328e.en: Helsinki Event School Evenings at Tiivistämö on 15 November, on the business of artist tour production. It is for people aged 18 to 29 who are interested in or work in the event sector, and entry is free.

907fd74c15d53d1337bafa1cbc842570beb41227.en: "Gentlemen on Stage", a concert at the House of Culture on 15 November from 17:00 to 21:00, with Finnish schlager legends Danny, Eino Grön, Pasi Kaunisto and others, led by conductor Jari Puhakka. Tickets cost 59.90 to 122.65 euros.

43587cecdfe4ffd250202efe8faaef481db702dd.en: Organist Wayne Marshall performs improvisations with the Lahti Gospel Choir at Musiikkitalo on 15 November from 18:00 to 20:00, in gospel, American and Finnish spiritual, and pop music. Tickets cost 12.50 to 49 euros.

aafb38c56661c34837dab004e752263398edd61a.en: Finland plays San Marino in the UEFA Nations League at Bolt Arena on 15 November at 19:00, with the national team's new coach. Tickets start at 14.50 euros.

4add00c707e51713cf62966314d85bb01721940f.en: A horn quartet from the Helsinki Philharmonic plays romantic pieces, including Rimsky-Korsakov and Franz Abt, at Munkkiniemi Library. It is part of the free library concert tour.

a589b49e741a236560a0d5e40550119c9f03b278.en: Two open classes at Annantalo for the ILMI Ö theatre school, on 16 and 18 November, with several groups for ages 8 to 17 and 16 and over. No advance registration is needed.

67d429794d52c28b351b4138a8c460a6319fc05f.en: A monthly easy-language book club at Oodi, reading and discussing easy-read books. Everyone is welcome.

42d73e2f0890ae6ca9f5523723c2d9607ecdbaa2.en: Heart failure peer meetings at Kamppi Service Centre on 21 September, 19 October and 16 November from 16:00 to 17:30, for people living with heart failure. Book on the website.

35f4e131f31c798121c96349bd4850f7c73020f5.en: Two lectures at the Finnish Adult Education Centre on the United States under Trump, given by Atte Korhola on 16 and 23 November, covering education, science, immigration and Christian right-wing politics. Entry is free.

37c1533ee93a7166c4ec873b5657b57262655b11.en: The Browning, a deathcore band from the USA with electronic soundscapes, plays Tavastia on 16 November, with support from Within Destruction and Abbie Falls. Doors open at 18:00, and the age limit is 18.

3c088e73292195dc34f9471b44f6bd0598c617a6.en: An evening story session at Myllypuro Library on set Mondays, with activities and a small supper. Children come with an adult, and the session is free.

39bc7065876d920139718a1b6bf9db83e3253009.en: A Children's Rights Week concert at Koskela Church on a Monday, with pupils from the Käpylä Music Institute and a sing-along. It is suitable for everyone and has no religious content.

94d16b2c49365e5901efe34d4a8814ceed3098c5.en: Author Anneli Kanto speaks about her book on Mika Waltari's life at Töölö Library, as a guest of the Mika Waltari Society. Entry is free.

0b252618f155823c061ff8f4cd66505da3dbc126.en: A reading dog named Totti at Arabianranta Library, where you can read aloud to the dog for 15 minutes. Book by phone or at the library.

d7afb3f90693ff2b5d85ce2ade7d067464ff94ab.en: A tribute evening to Tapio Rautavaara at Oulunkylä Library, with group singing of his songs, memories and poems, performed by Matti Reittamo and Maritta Widberg.

474c1ca1cc02a794ba9eb659da43c7c2d4e7701f.en: A Helsinki Baroque Orchestra lecture series on Monday evenings at 18:00 at Oodi, on people and ideas behind baroque music, from Queen Christina's court to C. P. E. Bach. Entry is free, with the first lecture on 7 September.

ae4135fd229f490fcf493b313e3875c9ed5591aa.en: A family session at the Helsinki YMCA Music College with songs, games, rhythms and dancing in Spanish and Finnish.

3ce6c729aa9c8f569ef03146cccefdbfaa02587a.en: A drum and percussion workshop and a break-time concert at Kankarepuisto Comprehensive School during Children's Rights Week, run by the Meri-Helsinki Music Institute. Families can attend if there is room, and others can confirm by email.

c461d2276bb2e35c42b525ae5dd20bab30906933.en: Musical instrument demonstrations at Latokartano Comprehensive School during Children's Rights Week, run by the Meri-Helsinki Music Institute. Families can attend if there is room, and others can confirm by email.

159b0c14f5779bc40ef5db04fe696c0267dffc84.en: An interactive museum trail at Suomenlinna Museum led by Lighthouse Keeper Svante, for preschool children and pupils in grades 1 to 3. Groups of up to 25 are registered by email.

106cb6d094f4240e57ac9feb533b3a625085be9e.en: Free entry to the Kindergarten Museum during Children's Rights Week, with play, exploring and a craft workshop for tea light holders. Families with babies are welcome on the morning from 10:00 to 12:00.

787ae872efe9191182af079050dc5a1662bd2fc0.en: Two free 45-minute baby and toddler circus workshops at Sirkus Magenta, for babies aged 4 to 12 months at 10:00 and toddlers aged 1 to 3 at 11:00. Each group takes 10 children with their adults, and registration is online.

392df2fad66808897f9e9c03f34480baedfa086e.en: A Lounasajan laulut singing session at Oodi with Musiikkikoulu Demo, on 7 October and 17 November from 11:00 to 11:45, with songs from the Finnish popular repertoire. No experience is needed.

fd784d6b8e9dbbb0154d5c2ad95ca59729aaf286.en: The oldest reading group at Itäkeskus Library, meeting monthly on the third Tuesday from 13:00 to 15:00 in the Kanerva room. Coffee and biscuits are served, and listeners are welcome.

d0a59fe64583fd941eb459aafd33e5d990832c45.en: A painting session led by art teacher Mauri Sihvola at Malmi community house, where people explore colour and nature. Beginners and experienced artists are welcome.

bea2d692cfae8b0c520735e7c747c00408524235.en: A knitting and short-story session at Oulunkylä Library, where people knit for charity while listening to short stories read aloud. On 20 October the actor Johannes Holopainen reads love stories.

e83b160dffb08aacb39c440c2e8bb668b3e9c9e3.en: A philosophy café at Stoa on 15 September, 20 October and 17 November, led by Severi Hämäri. Each session starts with a short philosophical introduction, followed by shared discussion. Entry is free.

779956949b32b6755ef7a30bab7ceb109085539e.en: Heart arrhythmia peer meetings at Kamppi Service Centre on 15 September, 20 October and 17 November from 16:00 to 17:30, for people who have heart rhythm problems.

be1df398c19877d7369f6c55cbd4b05f8a6f33bc.en: An open day for primary school children at the Cantores Minores boys' choir, held at the Meritulli Parish Hall from 16:30 to 19:00 on 17 to 19 November. Children can watch rehearsals and learn about the choir.

dbe2242345476e998cffd98bfa0c5d03f0f0c82b.en: Sport Finland, the sports and wellbeing side event of the Slush festival at Tavastia, where companies pitch to investors. It is co-hosted by Helsinki and other Sport Suomi cities.

9ad704eaf7d13a8bb7858299a6983789d881d615.en: An information session on volunteering at Vuosaari Library on 17 November from 16:45 to 18:30, on the basics of volunteering and the roles available. Registration is by 16 November, and a certificate may be given.

ab07d499038a272bb9f7cdb44b8b8cd74987e8bd.en: A talk at Oodi on the book "Epätäydellinen tiimi", about team coaching and leadership, with its authors and KTT Tuula Mittilä. It is part of a series of book events by the Economic Association.

58d9e2eeb49b1c08349e78f560373fc2df7197e9.en: A monthly book club at Kalasatama Library, discussing a novel read in advance. The November book is Karin Erlandson's "Koti", and no sign-up is needed.

8083504771cf29fc4ee19db89fd01a13e5057ca7.en: A quilting and story club at Vuosaari Library, with crafts and short stories read aloud over coffee. Dates run from August to May, and no sign-up is needed.

19806f3787102a5e28f41d1056542a0dc5873e92.en: A reading dog named Hannu at Malmi Library, with 15-minute reading slots on Tuesdays from 17:30 to 18:30. Booked by an adult for readers aged four and up.

2e40b5c714c133aecbd4f471118671d6f5de2399.en: The Helsinki Folk series at Jätkäsaari Library, with the band Rautakoura and singer Paula Wolski, playing acoustic folk. Entry is free.

09e09bfbcac7441b6a5f78a1f210c01be46695fd.en: A monthly reading group at Puistola Library on Tuesdays from 18:00 to 19:30. The autumn theme is power, with books including Maria Stepanova and Jamaica Kincaid.

b13cd94335c3fff0a74b01824aa6f71e4e992447.en: A crime-fiction reading group run by the Finnish Crime Fiction Society at Kallio Library on the third Tuesday of each month at 18:00. New members are welcome.

0c4582585b25856de728b4e7f785ab4bbed4c755.en: A fiction reading group at Malmi Library, reading books such as Juli Zeh's "Yli-ihmisiä" and Kjell Westö's "Rikinkeltainen taivas", with the books borrowed a month ahead.

342045c56af12817937ec52578bd7e23379fa739.en: A love-themed reading group at Malmi Library, reading Miranda Cowley-Heller's "Paperipalatsi" and discussing its views on love. Books are available a month ahead.

bccb74c1eb96b015d41782bed398be32a9a61d8c.en: A horn quartet from the Helsinki Philharmonic plays romantic music at Arabianranta Library on 17 November at 18:00. It is part of the free library concert tour.

bb2b28283672686804646ebe7517ef6d1759f550.en: A Russian-language book club at Pasila Library, held over tea, with the host Zhenya. The club reads a mix of classic and genre novels, meeting on set Tuesdays.

93d11ea7af524e0e0439a0dd0dcb4277c760cee1.en: A free English-language lecture at the Finnish Adult Education Centre on Margaret Atwood's "The Handmaid's Tale" and "The Testaments", and why dystopias remain popular. No sign-up is needed, and seats are limited.

f5cc93109227189f925acdf9b913c79130a99112.en: An open-mic night at Oulunkylä Library for songwriters, run by Kertsi ry, where people can perform finished or unfinished songs and gather feedback. Players are limited to two songs and should arrive by 17:30.

2f076ed157b2891338b4e41480fa89aec3de89d9.en: The Guards Band's "Festive march" concert at Musiikkitalo on 17 November at 19:00, celebrating Finland's military music tradition. Tickets cost 10 to 32 euros.

5e65e33d5eac299b8d87b9f5a4a0ef1632128ba7.en: The Tapio and Tuomi duo, playing free jazz with folk and classical influences, at Oodi's Maijansali on 17 November at 19:00. Entry is free.

af1062c30f8b3c085e085b2cb95295b4e0309f76.en: A piano taster session at Puistola Comprehensive School during Children's Rights Week, run by the Meri-Helsinki Music Institute. Families can attend if there is room, and others can confirm by email.

27ff586a6c220de68926bb453dd0381d0bad67be.en: Band and instrument demonstrations at Aurinkolahti Comprehensive School during Children's Rights Week, run by the Meri-Helsinki Music Institute. Families can attend if there is room, and others can confirm by email.

2748ddf2c550d2b796d2deec23e2cf407d8bc499.en: An interactive guided tour for children aged 5 to 10 at the Hotel and Restaurant Museum, with Professor Pea hunting for flavours. No food is tasted, and groups of 8 to 20 children must register in advance.

ba2d5cf6f2d16eb443e00f1b97db1a07bf68c5c5.en: Open rehearsals of the chamber opera "Sorsa Aaltonen ja lentämisen oireet" at Kapsäkki, based on Veera Salmi's book, suited to 3 to 5-year-olds. Attendance is for part of the rehearsal, with advance sign-up by email.

52cf7c15c118c3e915f65db0691252491dedbed8.en: A baby and toddler meetup indoors at Vähätupa playground, with a guided session at 10:30 of music, circus, art and rhymes. The indoor room is open to families, and food can be warmed.

763361281952a421e92f4d7d8f265d9b74e656c5.en: A low-threshold craft session at Kurkimäki community centre for children and families, with materials and guidance provided. No experience is needed.

ee902e7f1e75db14c19801110cf66e80c832fd4c.en: A reading group at Kustaankartano Service Centre Library on set dates, discussing a book read in advance. Books for the autumn include Valérie Perrin and John Williams. Entry is free.

102d1f7cde6611989baecbf264ebad7351ff03df.en: A housing advice session at Alppila community house on Wednesdays from 12:00 to 15:00, on 19 August, 16 September, 21 October, 18 November and 16 December. No booking is needed, and staff help with finding a flat.

fc1afaee9c3f8f2dc93be8c753477de41d46565e.en: Two free guided tours of the "Huimaa" circus exhibition at the Theatre Museum, one for primary and one for lower secondary school pupils. Groups are limited to 20, and registration is by email.

16a6eee12ee2e289f864e926d6625a961b754c2f.en: A free guided tour of the "Huimaa" circus exhibition at the Theatre Museum for lower secondary school pupils, up to 20 people per group. Registration is by email in advance.

e7d8524abf33265814a9a8018062cd8ebf10c811.en: Cultural lectures at Munkkiniemi Service Home on the Danube, covering its history, art and nature, and on Mediterranean pirates. Entry is free, with dates in October, November and December.

95c6b4cf92548485245c07e72f10b28700d93066.en: Lunchtime concerts at Rikhardinkatu Library on 16 September, 21 October, 18 November and 16 December at 13:00, performed by early-music students. Entry is free.

646adcdac49c73af47832c2632556a702fb527e7.en: A monthly seniors' news group at Töölö Library on Wednesdays from 13:00 to 14:30, on 19 August, 16 September, 14 October, 18 November and 16 December. Members read the day's papers and talk about the news. Listeners are welcome.

13d7ac27ddbd5a0e72b156b7002f47c81ba070eb.en: A peer group for older LGBTQ+ people at Kontula Senior Centre, meeting in person and online from 14:00 to 15:30. Topics include faith and rainbow identity, and visitors come from the library's rainbow shelf.

4d7a7b6a14f942d4c8c1c25957fd77680570081f.en: Two lectures at Stoa on Finland under Kekkonen, on dissidents in foreign policy (18 November) and on the Finnish media and the Soviet Union (25 November). Entry is free.

358c189e8a71e86bb89bda983cd9017afd744cc4.en: An open day at Vuotalo for the ILMI Ö theatre school's basic classes, on 18 November for children aged 8 to 13. No advance registration is needed.

1ec480ad0740e6ee599cdca63c209a217f53d73d.en: A library reading group at Myllypuro Service Centre on animal books, meeting in the centre's restaurant. Books are reserved in advance, and no sign-up is needed.

a5cf1a94e508ad415443ddccba84517ce2ec76e9.en: Instrument Adventure at the Helsinki Christian Music School, a family event to try different instruments, listen to performances and talk with music teachers.

435ab32bed3678f6fc9c360e275925e351e105fc.en: Digital help at Kinapori Senior Centre on the third Wednesday of the month from 16:00 to 16:45, for phones and computers. Bring your own device.

54c0b16d0ad3c68d9cdf3e5ed978786e4ddbe029.en: The Nuori Voima stop of the Oodi pop-up for small magazines, on 18 November from 16:00 to 18:00. Nuori Voima, founded in 1908, is Finland's oldest literary culture magazine.

9fd3b80997ea870b8cde0fd448ae1102cd77f19c.en: An open day at Meritulli Parish Hall for the Cantores Minores boys' choir, on 17 to 19 November from 16:30 to 19:00. Visitors can watch rehearsals and take guided tours every half hour.

3bdf451170934e27be4e23dd350bdd839d06c516.en: A casual book café at Lauttasaari Library on 18 November from 17:00 to 19:30, where people talk about favourite books, swap books and buy discarded library books. It is part of the "Kirjava keskiviikko" day.

baf8cabadf1e7e74ddc965b99a1ea30b3f4703c0.en: A recycled-material workshop at Pasila Library, making butterflies from discarded book pages as part of "Kirjava keskiviikko" on 18 November, an event about sustainable living.

32df65318189660b89450da9f837e7a46ebf65c9.en: A reading dog named Häxa at Maunula Library on set Wednesdays from 17:00 to 18:20, where people practise reading aloud for about 15 minutes. Book a slot at the desk or by phone.

d5ffbc0a108c91517ce07ff93b031055355949ca.en: A novel-and-knitting group at Jakomäki Library, where people knit for charity while listening to short stories. Tea is served, and no sign-up is needed.

da52131d4d2f37a44578cb36579d5652502ca647.en: A poetry salon at Töölö Library on 17:00 to 19:00, where people share and discuss favourite poems in free form.

79a589bcad7ad9d3bb714174d50c8c4b4abd41c6.en: A shadow-theatre and set-building workshop at Teatteri Tuike, where people help build sets for a summer 2027 production.

60d2f2064cb6a772ba902324d8efa3b1564fc27a.en: A sewing machine pop-up at Tapulikaupunki Library as part of "Kirjava keskiviikko", with a library guide showing how to thread a loaned machine and use its basic functions.

ef9d7c1fd504753e534e18f82bb718e9d11a1880.en: A reading group at Kontula Library, reading fiction and discussing it over coffee or tea. It requires no sign-up or commitment.

a68e3d4ef3328ba826ad719fe10a743ae395920a.en: A mending workshop at Munkkiniemi Library on 18 November, held with the Munkkiniemi Martha Association. Participants learn to darn and repair knitwear, and wool and a sewing machine are provided.

269e057487374386fd29ba5e17aed543e333c32c.en: An adult story hour at Pasila Library on 18 November as part of "Kirjava keskiviikko", with tales about climate change, unemployment and relationships, and some humour. It is recommended for adults.

2f05bb0f5760ad05df261b58d22b19bce01d9b7a.en: An author event at Itäkeskus Library with Kristian Helanen, a poet, on his new collection "Erosinko molemmista", about the end of a relationship and the search for oneself.

b37a30b7378d5ad0fdcb1424402f4e18a44a9146.en: An open story session at Puistola Library on 9 September, 7 October and 18 November at 18:00, with evening porridge served. All kinds of stories are read.

de43d34ca390a5e5d95e5c41ddebe79be56c30bb.en: A Nordic Language Café at Nordic Culture Point on set dates from 23 September to 16 December from 18:00 to 20:00. Each language has a table with a native speaker, and entry is free.

264fc30910b03beb8d27d02a9ffa3b18b25f65ea.en: A free piano concert at Sandels music school's Gyllenberg Hall. No advance registration is needed.

5f49da5d66a364a45c2932c9af8281905041ab6e.en: The Turku Philharmonic Orchestra at Musiikkitalo on 18 November at 19:00, under Kevin John Edusei, with violinist Minami Yoshida in Bruch's Scottish Fantasy. Tickets cost 12.50 to 42 euros.

fb05d098abf4df66c8c63f1e9138eb30b056f83a.en: A Children's Rights Week concert at Oulunkylä Church by pupils of the Käpylä Music Institute, with a sing-along. It has no religious content and suits everyone.

97b6357a3717da492370d3f6a021350beff6fc6b.en: Slush, a two-day startup and tech conference at Messukeskus on 18 and 19 November, bringing together startups, investors and media from Europe and Asia.

e9690d6b7852a61ccfb0301e6815ad114cf4d648.en: Instrument demonstrations at Myllypuro Comprehensive School during Children's Rights Week, run by the Meri-Helsinki Music Institute. Families can attend if there is room, and others can confirm by email.
