5dd76d5e8a919d19d8aa9ebbda1b8c16e26b8204.en: An interactive guided tour for children aged 5 to 10 at the Hotel and Restaurant Museum, where Professor Pea searches for flavours. No food is tasted, and groups of 8 to 20 must register in advance.

569d3c9fb1e492faa9a77b202083cf94d7ad75da.en: A Swedish-language music play session for children aged 0 to 5 and their carers at Solhem in Malmi, on Thursdays from 10:00. A free family café follows, with a voluntary coffee fund.

536fcf9aa555160b012606c6f71de5754edf4b4d.en: The "Töttöröö" concert by Lelukavereiden laulukerho at Kapsäkki, a singing concert for children, with soft toys and hobby horses welcome. Advance sign-up is by email.

3e964457dad124788e27b4388b84544568327e33.en: An open studio at Nordic Culture Point Suomenlinna on 19 November from 14:00 to 15:30, where artist Sakib Khalid Saboor presents his photographic residency project on the layered history of Suomenlinna. Entry is free.

aed659f1d39d18ebf61681346d4bc7221d62b1f5.en: A novel-listening group at Maunula Library on Thursdays from 14:00 to 15:30 on set dates, with knitting for charity and stories read aloud. No sign-up is needed.

0b2213efc1e4ef1dd364f5846c01ab54fbb3e7a3.en: Reading advice from HERO at Etelä-Haaga Library on 16 September and 19 November from 15:00 to 16:00. It covers reading difficulties, reading aids and learning games, and is free.

527e9cbb40681ceb213fbcb90b18e8543b0cfb86.en: A Minecraft event at Myllypuro Library for children and young people, with a quiz, crafts, pins and a photo spot. Entry is free, and no sign-up is needed.

9616dc73bf58f48d756251415c6df58c8257e2db.en: A walking concert at the Central Helsinki Music Institute, where children perform for other children, who can join or leave at any time. Daycare children's artwork on children's rights is displayed.

4d14c40b8631e7e15e823baf191d37695b05f18a.en: A word-art session at Annantalo Arts Centre for pupils in grades 1 to 6 on 19 November from 16:00 to 17:00, inspired by Roald Dahl's "The Witches". An adult may come along.

83a8b2bac95975274c49d4a5095ec56812ea8cbb.en: An art workshop for families at the Helsinki Art Museum, where children aged 4 to 12 paint tigers with acrylic paints after looking at Leena Luostarinen's works. Places are limited to 12 pairs, so book in advance.

fb5eea24fc00cb581fc869819449b15b4053a08a.en: A Cantores Minores open day at Meritulli Parish Hall for early-childhood children and young people, with rehearsals and music playgroup sessions as part of the Children's Culture for All campaign.

6247c661d81833f4803b5b794a3b364ffa91427f.en: A theatre play workshop at the Cable Factory for children and adults, improvising forest scenes, making sculptures and building a shared nest for forest animals. It is for 15 children with their adults, and registration is by email.

784df6f23e0f87a9ba2e4bd4f3122f9c7e7e9abd.en: A guided tour of the "Yhteinen kylä" exhibition at the City Museum with its curators, artist Helmi Hagelin and dance artist Laura Feodoroff. Entry is free.

f0c1afd2a10cb6ef15722f3387be461463ac61b9.en: A silent book club at Nordic Culture Point on 10 September, 15 October, 19 November and 10 December from 17:00 to 19:00. People read quietly together, with tea served. Entry is free.

a8d66ff2cf4595a87f5cdd90aa6e557e7eb72b66.en: A Manala afterwork jazz evening on 19 November from 17:00 to 19:00, with guitarist Johannes Granroth, organ and drums. Entry is free, and arriving early helps find a seat.

f461742573f53c8177aafb155d24e29656784f84.en: A lecture at the Finnish Adult Education Centre on how the value of a costume is formed, by designer Enni Lähderinne, and on national costumes in art, by Mari Kosunen. It is part of a series on textile craft and art.

297a49188989daa32f36e8f9be791cd48f77e357.en: A poetry circle at Lauttasaari Library, meeting monthly at 18:00 in the multi-purpose room. Books include Kirsi Kunnas and Bei Dao, and they can be borrowed a month before.

1b5d603684bd4bb0669264784ddeda49f105c56a.en: A knitting and short-story group at Munkkiniemi Library on set Thursdays, where people knit for charity or listen to stories read aloud. Tea is served, and entry is free.

7a0cd46ee86022506c82131016d2b984b2d1007e.en: A monthly book club at Kallio Library on the November novel "Koti" by Karin Erlandson. It is open to all, and no sign-up is needed.

456a6b16e5b6fa2f06c0b8e29bee231737a133b9.en: A talk at Oodi by Eino Uikkanen on what artificial intelligence really is and is not, covering how it works, its limits and how to use it responsibly. It suits anyone interested.

d1fd5cbae05a2c936e6fa4e12c1656578473e83f.en: A music night at Maunula House with the bands Avaruusasema and Qumma Connection, with doors at 18:15 and free tickets from the library. The café is open in the lobby.

e43716bf0b85eed2cc6f4fea4e2f5f6cbf170f8c.en: The world premiere of Susanna Leinonen's "Head x Space" at Konepaja Stage from 19 to 21 November, about visual overload and its effects on the body. Tickets cost 45 to 55 euros, and it suits ages 12 and up.

cb3b32ed939cc153888eed5ecc62ea8f9e666091.en: The women's choir Vox Femina, with around thirty singers under Hanna Mustaniemi, performs a musical journey at Töölö Library. Entry is free.

c038cefe455a38b0cae776c600d337d9097fcd0c.en: "Är : Grus", a family dance, juggling and shadow play performance at Dance Theatre Hurjaruuth on 19 and 21 November. It is non-verbal, lasts 35 minutes, and suits ages 4 and up.

6c27ea77640de83d169913737e2ac213f91ce5e8.en: A children's creative trail at Pakila Music Institute, where pupils try circus, music, art and gymnastics in an interactive tour at the art centre. It is aimed at daycare groups.

68dbd4f48c0090d3ae6c85af11f662b6ee655b3e.en: A monthly reading group at Töölö Senior Centre on Fridays, with books by Mika Waltari, Ian McEwan, László Krasznahorkai and Édouard Louis. It is for pensioners and unemployed people with a free service centre card.

c6d854d820bfa8abb40c161008a1f1bb390f4298.en: "Ringmaster Vasiljev Vitelloni's Mini Circus" at PerformanceSirkus, a circus theatre show for families with small magic tricks, balancing and juggling. Advance registration is by email.

1bdf718aaeaf0e545b130cee94007f8c965cfe94.en: A Christmas card workshop at Suomenlinna Museum, where people make their own card and enjoy the festive atmosphere. The workshop is part of the museum's programme.

33147446b8867e06592f2961c8197f8cb796194a.en: A local-history club at Kinapori Senior Centre on the third Friday of the month, talking about Helsinki's recent history and personal memories. It is open to residents and free.

887d64fa66369b36e151219059353c8655f4a7b4.en: A non-stop darkroom workshop at the Finnish Museum of Photography, where people try darkroom work. Materials are provided, and new participants can join when a place opens.

520b4a806f0c39e6207e0ec5d3e9ef0df4958012.en: Free swimming for all children and young people under 18 at Helsinki's swimming halls on 20 November from 14:00, with one accompanying adult. Yrjönkatu requires a swimming ability of at least 25 metres.

05ef91aad2ea3625ee77b33b0fb5268694cd6f01.en: Circus workshops at PerformanceSirkus with juggling, balancing and props such as stilts, diabolo and scarves. No experience is needed, and each workshop takes 10 children with an adult.

89fad6d3e4d6cd6c7c18eb5965964f91a4ddb3b6.en: A non-stop iPad music jam at Kanneltalo by Music School Demo, where people make music together in the moment. No experience is needed, and the workshop is part of World Children's Day.

cfd7daa8ae0b3d159b57e0639548d10e226e6274.en: A Jamkids music workshop at Kanneltalo for families, with a variety of instruments, singing and movement, as part of World Children's Day.

2e90617db49ce1298bf174ffe73f1d8eb0ed93b4.en: Valokartano, a light art event at Ströms Manor by the Helsinki School of Visual Arts, with light art, animations and sculptures made by children and young people for World Children's Day.

6b83afb78e6b2abacd929521c5e2a837e0380477.en: The Uusimaa CP Association's Christmas party at Malmin kauppatie 26 on 20 November, with light food, porridge, glögi and music. Sign-up is by 8 November, and food allergies should be stated.

1a900efb8d6564f7d515bc61e2eb764c038b072b.en: A free concert at Sandels music school's Gyllenberg Hall on Friday, with no advance registration needed.

072a193f0a81f8fc09349eeb68cbae6db9a4e4c8.en: A Legazy Seat ticket for the Viki & Köpi 10th anniversary show at Veikkaus Arena. It includes a dedicated entrance, a welcome drink, small bites and a premium wristband.

68294df5c583c8722ea23d2107bf987e8b8e1c43.en: A quiet reading group at Kannelmäki Library, where people read in silence for an hour with tea and coffee. The library is closed to other visitors during the session.

c5e9dc1fd9b8e8f7e584e2ad845883be6609f733.en: A VIP ticket package for the Viki & Köpi 10th anniversary show at Veikkaus Arena, with a seat, a dedicated entrance and access to the lounge with a light buffet. Packages are non-refundable.

169e61a7466dd2a19e36a4c133044b2d1c144d6a.en: HPO perform Stravinsky's "Petrushka" at Musiikkitalo. The puppet's love for a ballerina leads to a tragic story.

4873ef82048cc71001fbde6c0b2b48ef8bac4c86.en: The ISU Grand Prix figure skating event "Finlandia Trophy" at Helsinki Ice Hall on 20 and 21 November, with the world's top skaters in men's, women's, ice dance and pairs events.

1cccad5eb6d539020c5c6a378e242a26cba9bdd6.en: A family disco afternoon at Dance School DCA, with dance classes for ages from toddlers to adults, an obstacle course, disco performances, tattoos and balloons.

b05b78fed5182eaa08a2a5a8d8e2c53ed6a2f88c.en: A family film screening at Cinema Orion on 21 November at 10:30 of "Urpo ja Turpo johtolangan jäljillä", a restored children's film for all ages. Free tickets can be booked from 1 October.

cacf4c41c09c66e264441946a86eefb5aa05d556.en: A non-stop children's theatre workshop at Ilmaisukoulu Valo, where children create a character and explore acting, costume, lighting and sound.

0d3f22089feaa49495dd1eae3c168b9d80f077d3.en: A gingerbread decorating workshop at the Hotel and Restaurant Museum on 21, 28 November and 5 December from 12:00 to 15:00, and on 25 November from 16:00 to 18:30. No advance registration is needed, and entry is free on 25 November.

aec0b9f25ce0a7c622b51de0fcc3e6e955d3ee19.en: A make-a-thek workshop at Oodi on 21 November from 13:00 to 16:00, where people make a simple e-textile wristband with conductive thread and LEDs. It is free, for up to 10 people, with sign-up in advance.

5bd19247141c784a960d7b501e14684d948a0dbd.en: A day for women at St Paul's Church on 21 November from 13:00 to 20:00, with music, empowering talks, workshops and an evening celebration. Entry is free, and no sign-up is needed.

2fd98d9a93021ba1c121acc5290f2d3c74463e2c.en: An advanced creative writing group for pupils in grades 3 to 6 at Luckan, drawing on the fantasy genre and Harry Potter. It is taught in Swedish, is free, and needs registration before 8 November.

b1e98dc68acba3d6295c5971725dad75a5a96491.en: The Cactos Kipinä Run at Markku.fi Areena on 21 November, with a Kids Run for children aged 3 to 9 at 15:00, and 5 km and 10 km races at 17:00. Tickets cost 20 to 62 euros.

a0b0c5d7ae77217b1852575d5159492f9d99d6ba.en: The Day of Remembrance for People Who Died by Suicide at the Finnish National Theatre's Lavaklubi on 21 November from 16:30 to 17:30. It is free and is also streamed online, organised by Surunauha ry.

b7f228e154f2407de3945f185a35e6cf93ff76cc.en: A free all-ages punk evening at Maunula House with the bands Tuhon enkelit, Roskis and Juggling Jugulars, and a café. A restricted alcohol area is for adults only.

984dddda6d393b51f9b13f2360793f63d3a2fdf8.en: The Pihlaja women's choir presents "Towards Christmas" at Temppeliaukio Church on 21 November at 19:00, with winter landscapes and Christmas music. Tickets cost 20 to 25 euros.

e6f8f750e3e8e8c1281d89f78e441e4b78a18cc6.en: "Evening of Great Songs" at Finlandia Hall on 21 November from 19:00 to 21:30, with Tarja Turunen, Jarkko Ahola, Ukrainian artists and Estonian singer Uku Suviste, backed by the Riku Niemi Orchestra. Tickets cost 59.90 to 69.90 euros.

e8134b5996916f0aeeedd3698fee4fe154d6eced.en: "Louder Than Sirens", a charity concert at Musiikkitalo by the National Presidential Orchestra of Ukraine, with soprano Karita Mattila as a guest. It raises funds for a children's civil defence shelter in Ukraine.

d6b365c909aff13261478b725ab3327df292fda6.en: A karaoke and upbeat music night at Eurohostel on 21 November from 20:00 to 23:00, mainly in English, for meeting new people. Entry is free, and the age limit is 18.

137de99021b9f069c61c8b4ea56c2d5820cde013.en: Jiri Geller's retrospective "Perfect World" at Kunsthalle Helsinki from 21 November to 10 January, with large sculptural installations, mechanical works and newer animal-inspired pieces.

25ed1191440bd86e141a09454581a993bac1a6f7.en: The Finnish Motorcycling Federation's 2026 prize-giving gala at Vanha Ylioppilastalo in Helsinki on 21 November, with a dinner and awards for champions. Dinner tickets must be bought before 6 November.

a73a2c9937f8933442467c35709ec5b7c31f40ad.en: Music playschool sessions at the City Museum over three days, with songs from different decades for babies and families. Each session lasts 30 minutes.

33af12e8de5185555b53921c5442a2ebd4247ba2.en: The Järvenpää Chamber Choir sings much-loved Finnish Christmas songs at Villa Hakasalmi, under Johan Myllynen. Entry is included in the admission price.

f55bb3c386936de95355595f454a7656b4b9e85c.en: Mendelssohn's "Lobgesang" by Viva Vox and the Helsinki Cathedral Chamber Orchestra on 22 November at 18:00 in the chamber arrangement. It is linked to the cathedral's "Let There Be Light" theme. Tickets cost 30 euros.

d644c6f2d16b3157d0e18d5d0bc8b0df6dfe6566.en: A talk at Arbis café on travel dreams, based on two personal travel stories from Asia and Svalbard. It explores how images and longing shape the places we want to visit.

6870c95c17d9e2fe38e384d59c68abc0a097f804.en: A monthly book club at Myllypuro Library on lesbian literature, open to all who feel they are sapphic in some way. Books include Sanna Hirvonen and Emi Yagi. It follows safer-space principles.

dd8505689a452bb1f85dbf3f0e98a53d7d2facac.en: An author visit at Itäkeskus Library with Kati Tervo, a novelist and columnist who talks about her books and writing as a job. Her latest book, "Ukko ja onnen aika", was written with Jari Tervo.

18156894fb27c8e6fbaf3844cb22c40617bc3f0f.en: "Mirdja", a new production at the Finnish National Theatre's Small Stage from 23 November to 19 December, based on L. Onerva's decadent novel about a free-spirited woman. Tickets cost 24 to 49 euros.

5f657b312fd09daaf226b1e68087fc252a3ccfe6.en: A seasonal instrument jam at Vuotalo's Vuosali hall, with a christmas song list and singing welcome. Participants bring their own instruments, and the two sessions run from 16:30 to 19:45.

2f6f886e3d6a2b584ce7e46a8254b9b50fcc259b.en: A three-week short course at Helsinki Employment Services in Kamppi, training jobseekers as multi-service workers in kitchen and cleaning jobs. Applicants must be Helsinki jobseekers, speak at least Finnish B1.1, and register for an interview on 24 November.

00f5de26e11464c3968acee3b4ca3872c16ab080.en: A free marketing training day at Business Helsinki on 24 November from 13:00 to 16:00, covering business ideas, target groups, competitor analysis, product design and goal-setting. It is practical and suits business owners.

c9ec17206b94eb57ab95c99926ed76f97d93be3f.en: A book group at Laajasalo Library for non-fiction, where a book can be borrowed at the desk. No sign-up is needed, and you can simply come along.

34827ee960d3e48b4a6f6ee1c691cd8403aefe77.en: A "Slangitreffit" event at Oodi on 24 November at 17:00, where Harri Saksala talks to Pentti Arajärvi about his book "Näe Stadi", photos and moods from walking all of Helsinki's streets.

3ea6beba3842e70780e3f793da749c130b9309a1.en: A monthly Bengali café at Pasila Library, with conversation and community connections. This time International House Helsinki talks about job application documents and services for jobseekers. Children can read Bengali books.

b0b657d716eb412bc0180727210c88a7b6974eb4.en: Markku Jalonen, a Helsinki city guide, talks about old-time jobs at Etelä-Haaga Library. There are coffee and tea, and entry is free.

547f1029d1b43c87345c5777bcc76fd6a03a16db.en: A five-course Thai-inspired pop-up dinner on the sixth floor at Aleksanterinkatu 13 on 24 November from 17:30 to 20:30. Prices start at 139 euros, with wine pairings available, and seats are limited.

0db62312f03ed712015238d2d8de11f64cd351df.en: A classics reading group at Pasila Library on Tuesdays, reading works of Western literature. This autumn it reads Bulgakov's "The Master and Margarita" on 20 October.

5718479cc3322730a42e63c99392966ade338c1c.en: The Philharmonic at the Library at Oulunkylä Library: a string quartet and vocalist performing Elvis Costello's "The Juliet Letters", songs of fictional letters to Juliet Capulet.

9a0c5d9a23b8939a27a892917b611a54cc338ab5.en: The same Philharmonic at the Library concert at Oulunkylä Library, presented in Swedish, with Elvis Costello's "The Juliet Letters" sung and played by a string quartet.

c79ae6d40b1d451d49c1041f182efaf94682b59b.en: An author visit at Laajasalo Library on 24 November from 18:00 to 19:00 with S. K. Rostedt, a fantasy writer known from BookTok, on her Moorna trilogy and romantasy.

8571cb859d7adfdd045ae5ad264db2715a7257d5.en: An easy-Finnish introduction to the "Pako Muumilaaksoon" exhibition at the Architecture and Design Museum on 24 November and 29 December at 18:00. It is about 30 minutes, with a short photo show and an optional QR game before it.

de2007abc103417caf914a1fdecae94a1831cc9f.en: A full-moon yoga and wine session at White Lady restaurant on 24 November from 18:00 to 19:30, combining gentle vinyasa and yin yoga with wine tasting. Tickets cost 30 euros, and the age limit is 18.

97ea6dd9c898570700b2cce7d11b49d691e2d3cf.en: The indie-pop band Heili, mixing jazz, folk and tango in storytelling songs, at Kallio Library on 24 November at 18:00. Entry is free, and the mini tour visits other Helsinki libraries.

181200fa4c6773e687d32b20461a663bbfc35cf4.en: "Starman", a satirical monologue on nature loss, at the National Theatre's Main Stage with actor Martti Suosalo on 19 September, 24 November and 1 December. Tickets cost 21 to 55 euros.

5360dace6c0571f6c2539ee27781193398984ac1.en: A Finlandia evening at Tapanila Library on 24 November, where Suvi Ahola presents this year's fiction shortlist. The Finlandia Prize is announced on 26 November.

bf1bc2ec179c4e15df8fbac5f854b880a1a9f6e5.en: "BabyTango", a non-verbal dance performance for babies with a shared dance session for the child and their adult, at Hurjaruuth on 25 to 28 November. Tickets cost 10 euros for babies and 17 for adults.

77f7b4e93aaf6956ca9575a1793a51ea52218818.en: A Musiikkikoulu Demo singing session at Itäkeskus Library with the theme "Iskelmän aikamatka", about Finnish popular songs. Singing is optional, and the next session is on 9 December.

787a012a2d95ac8a5e4cbe873c94d627e5f8aba7.en: Senior coffee at Herttoniemi Library on 21 October, 25 November and 16 December, with talks on memory health, sleep and the services of the Metropolia nursing students. The library provides coffee.

5d208d16b768ffe4e0b39cd5881a09b3ef678267.en: The Mustekala stop of the Oodi pop-up for small magazines on 25 November from 16:00 to 19:00. Mustekala is an independent, non-commercial online magazine that promotes cultural debate across the arts.

ffe56042711d3659bf9de3a37c2547a715fdcb98.en: A silent candlelight procession on 25 November at 17:00 from Esplanade Park to the Havis Amanda statue, to end violence against women. It is organised by the City of Helsinki with UN Women Finland, and everyone is welcome.

cc68d6fd6d1d47a41c1f87b25facd2470f764a4b.en: A local nature evening at Itäkeskus Library on the planned Bredbacka housing area in Mellunkylä, with city planners and residents discussing building scale, the Ojapuisto park and its meadow nature.

5b60fe7c51aca0388b5763c6006f1081a4fd120e.en: An evening story session at Oulunkylä Library for all families, where stories come alive with a crocodile, a dinosaur or a story fairy.

4452244f42c8769d81229ec18333b4bc72e97866.en: The Bookworms Club, an English book club at Rikhardinkatu Library. Books include Brontë's "Wuthering Heights", du Maurier's "Rebecca" and Tove Jansson's "Fair Play" on 16 December.

8831fa77903951b43a31e4c522b484bf7e44fc66.en: The Heili concert at Oulunkylä Library, with modern storytelling songs that blend indie pop, jazz, folk and tango. Entry is free.

b9da7ce455de89ac18164a469355374450e09780.en: Three clowns set out to write the perfect musical, guided by the Sumerian myth of Inanna's descent to the underworld, as their bodies and dreams begin to fade. Performed in Finnish at Konepajan näyttämö, ages 14+, 2 hours.

46bea6174889c3999e031c7b40bf418d8e494114.en: A pre-concert talk in the Terassilämpiö lounge at Musiikkitalo, where guests gather to share thoughts on the evening's performance.

425678c562f96da5e698341d326d6585b4e6caaf.en: Ice hockey at Helsinki Ice Hall: HIFK meets TPS on 25 November 2026 at 18:30. HIFK, founded in 1897, is the oldest ice hockey team in the Helsinki metropolitan area. Tickets from Ticketmaster.

4add2a664a54d17f0b0f65415be4c7b1ba6cbcc5.en: Singer-songwriter Aliisa Syrjä performs at Tavastia-klubi on 25 November 2026, with doors at 19:00. Tickets cost 25-28 euros from Tiketti, and the age limit is 18.

33d23ba574fff597a06c6a76c476362dca77b76c.en: Europe celebrates the 40th anniversary of The Final Countdown with a tour stop at the House of Culture on 25 November 2026. The setlist covers highlights of the band's career and the full album. Tickets 69.90-99.90 euros.

3f4d3f4ad88916f4a969cf62a792735333e33c95.en: The Helsinki Philharmonic premieres Sebastian Fagerlund's organ concerto Ad Spiram at Musiikkitalo, with Latvian organist Iveta Apkalna as soloist.

894e4544d1e5286d5c429066f026cbb540d9a33e.en: A relaxed card game tournament hosted by Nicola Lombardo at Eurohostel on 25 November 2026, 20:00-22:00, entirely in English. The games are inspired by UNO. It is free, unofficial and 18+, with no bar service.

ba0bdf4e313fb9d26cc7e0797504ee2941250059.en: Studia 2026 at Messukeskus on 25-26 November is one of Finland's largest study and career fairs. Visitors can meet Finnish universities and universities of applied sciences, and explore study options abroad. Admission costs 0-10 euros.

3d7cf20e71d27f3505e9602caede6fe36827ae4c.en: Helsinki Philharmonic musicians perform Elvis Costello's song cycle The Juliet Letters for string quartet and voice at Itäkeskus Library. The concert is part of the free Philharmonic at the Library tour.

a3dd476ac3bc58370c8dc0418b841a310c386239.en: A literary event at Kinapori Senior Centre for pensioners and unemployed people with a service centre card. Helsinki City Library staff present new autumn books, followed by an interview with author Matti Röngä.

da832c300dc84250ec42e76768bad70334bbb761.en: A lecture on the enduring power of attorney, which sets who manages property and care decisions if you can no longer decide for yourself. Master of Laws Jussi-Pekka Hanhela speaks at Opistotalo on 26 November, 13:00-14:30.

0973c57c6574641a99bbf045e8a3505db0f27583.en: The third part of the Art and Craft series at Opistotalo. Milliner and designer Paula Kasurinen talks about working as a craft entrepreneur, followed by a discussion on the boundary between craft and art. Also streamed live.

e94a82b9a8889639d23aa70773da24a11e792c25.en: A screening of the documentary Soap Fever at Maunula House. The film looks at 1990s Finnish fans of The Bold and the Beautiful, and director Inka Achté joins a discussion with film historian Harri Kilpi afterwards. Suitable for all ages.

fd00a485d2e43d9ec79fc88ed41ac2428a28bb36.en: A puppet show for all ages at Puistola Library on 26 November at 18:00. The little troll Tonkka Mooses looks forward to Christmas, but things do not go as planned. Runs 35 minutes.

1d082db171cc9cb20af9481868e760743fbcc1f2.en: A free folk concert at Etelä-Haaga Library as part of the Helsinki Folk series. Helsinki band Rautakoura plays modern folk and bluegrass, and singer-songwriter Paula Wolski brings Finnish folk into americana.

a96d0fd2242748790f4c323782b4b2277b511571.en: Experimental musician Vilho Koivisto performs as Aprapat, his solo project, at Vallila Library. Koivisto is known from the duo The New Boyfriends and the Satatuhatta label. Free admission.

f8d3cb8f21ef5281bf224e5d8cfc88fe971e6e4f.en: A lively musical at Aleksanterin teatteri set in a 1920s Helsinki restaurant during Prohibition, with smugglers, jazz musicians and a young Mika Waltari. Performed in Finnish, ages 7+, 2.5 hours, from 14 October to 16 December 2026.

90de008d266431a659e3691212020253884f284e.en: Haapajärven Elvis at the Finnish National Theatre is based on Katariina Vuori's book about one of Finland's best-known crimes. A boy finds protection from his grandmother and from Elvis music. Performed in Finnish, 16+, on 26 November.

c9d7de75ee03c27de75e9066c3d6be6f0353bf5d.en: The Pakila Martha Association holds a Christmas market at Maunula House, selling baked goods, preserves and festive items. It is a good place to find gifts and Christmas inspiration.

6280e516f1ac768db0018a46c88771b6e2c29eed.en: The Philharmonic at the Library tour brings Elvis Costello's song cycle The Juliet Letters for string quartet and voice to Pasila Library. The free concert is one of 12 across Helsinki libraries.

a724986ac02c35c967d2b756b276ba2fd9efa6f4.en: Red Nose Company's About The Rite of Spring is a wordless physical comedy in which four clowns explore Stravinsky's famous ballet through their own dance. Konepaja Stage, 9 September to 28 November 2026, ages 13+.

9f6bbad6234c778bfd700be43e17389ab58a10be.en: Finglish Stand Up Night at Teatteri Tuike on 27 November 2026, 19:00-21:00. Top comedians perform in Finnish and English, mixing rising stars with seasoned veterans. Tickets 20 euros, ages 16+.

1ba38f3cb596ab19a8e0c97688fed0402339410a.en: Ice hockey at Helsinki Ice Hall: HIFK meets SaiPa on 27 November 2026 at 19:30. HIFK, founded in 1897, is the oldest ice hockey team in the Helsinki metropolitan area. Tickets from Ticketmaster.

be8c40060653201d5ff864658908fdc95e4349eb.en: Helsinki's oldest outdoor Christmas market at Senate Square, open 27 November to 22 December 2026. Visitors find handmade gifts, food, a beloved old-time carousel and a festive atmosphere. Opening hours 11-19, Friday and Saturday until 20.

ef5229410f8e116219503cf9a98e3621ac81a10d.en: Baltic Circle and Kauri Sorvari present Forevermore, a dance work on desire and eros at Kiasma Theatre, inspired by Byung-Chul Han's The Agony of Eros. Performances run from 27 November to 5 December 2026.

c53ecb458415936c0d9568745b44f848b6003f01.en: A free Christmas carol workshop at Opistotalo, where you can ask for piano tips on favourite carols, browse carol sheet music and try the piano with a teacher's guidance. No registration needed; come between 11:00 and 14:00.

1e18bda02aca5dc097944e205b33652495e0a308.en: Valoa ja iloa is the Helsinki Workers' Institute's Christmas event at Opistotalo on 28 November, 11:00-16:00. It has craft workshops, a choir and concert programme, a 50+ disco, and a card collection for elderly people.

06d375b114807c399c6e6d69b82c28514a4216b4.en: St Nicholas' Christmas Bazaar in the crypt of Mikael Agricola Church on 28 November, 11:00-14:30, free entry. Local makers sell eco-friendly gifts, charity stalls offer decorations and toys, and there is a tombola and a band.

cd67448c78d5762ff1288b980b0b07e8fdc0aa37.en: K-Let's Dance is an all-day K-pop event at Tiivistämö on 28 November. It takes guests back to 2016 with iconic trends and legendary K-pop hits. More details will be announced during the autumn.

0fd8d99d9249685ed1a36cbfa24959aa984ff9db.en: A 50+ disco session at Opistotalo that plays 1980s disco hits from a playlist prepared in advance. Participants warm up together and learn a simple disco dance. Wear comfortable clothes and indoor shoes. Part of Valoa ja iloa.

14da81c62404b1ab20a95510697490bd688c19fe.en: Musician Stenari gives a singing history lesson on country music at Juuristo Club in Töölö Library. He covers its American roots, its development and its future. Open to everyone interested, organised by the Finnish Blues Society.

7c5a217b2ea6126b5a63caf9b8d9942d9072165f.en: A free Christmas concert at Opistotalo with the institute's own singing leader Satu Luomajoki, pianist Vesa Lintula and guest musicians. The audience joins in with festive songs as part of the Valoa ja iloa Christmas event.

4f626c911a14242cdf9da99179e1f3454ae5381b.en: The Finnish Double Bass Club's annual autumn concert at Oodi's Maijansali on 28 November, 17:00-18:00, marks its 50th year. The programme shows the bass's range, and after the concert the audience can ask questions and try the instrument.

ae3ce9104ecd19e63a2a54c080f27e172c43da3e.en: KUUMAA 10 at Veikkaus Arena, with doors at 18:00. Tickets range from 59 to 250 euros, with standing floor areas, seated stands and a VIP option with dinner. Age limits apply, and visitors must prove their age.

ba6f7177a46edac9a44bc0224c14af3faa4b436c.en: The Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra, led by Tarmo Peltokoski, makes its Helsinki debut at Musiikkitalo on 28 November, 19:00-21:00. With pianist Martin Helmchen, they play Saint-Saëns' Carnival of the Animals and Wagner's The Ring orchestral adventure.

a3d20d41a99fedede0e7f76f1a17b46e141648e7.en: A disco night at the House of Culture on 28 November, 19:30-23:00, with Baccara singing Yes Sir, I Can Boogie and Sorry, I'm a Lady, and Afric Simone singing Ramaya and Hafanana. A live DJ plays all night. Tickets from 34.70 euros, 18+.

eb6921b363d93c9b56538c77543817d6461005c7.en: A stand-up comedy night at Eurohostel on 28 November, 20:00-23:00, mostly in English, hosted by comedian Sofia. An open spot at the end lets anyone try comedy. Free entry, 18+, with bar and food service.

4f330fb22725db3c8b79d6b5327d612c7626439d.en: The Helsinki City Museum's Christmas market on 28-29 November, 11:00-18:00, free entry. Craftspeople and small producers sell unique gifts and treats, and Santa Claus meets visitors from 12:00 to 17:00 on both days.

9c9a227adff66c2da27c76ebb6fb596b29ebd341.en: A 1950s-style Christmas exhibition in the former home of Signe and Ane Gyllenberg at Villa Gyllenberg, rebuilt from old family photo albums. It runs 28 November 2026 to 3 January 2027, Wednesday and weekends 12:00-17:00.

6f7c80417515580754a41851173e671ea7c2584e.en: YöKuvis at Munkkiniemi Youth Centre is an overnight art event from 28 November, 15:00, to 29 November, 13:00. Visitors can try different art forms and techniques, and no prior experience is needed.

cd63c5d40d9ce3da66f15cc0cec0284d949b458e.en: Premium Suite tickets for KUUMAA 10 at Veikkaus Arena. Premium tickets are non-refundable and non-transferable, with refunds only if the concert is cancelled, and names cannot be changed.

51bd5f13763913c400be17958961b9e7d404e3b8.en: Legazy Seat tickets for KUUMAA 10 at Veikkaus Arena include a lower-tier seat, a dedicated entrance through the Legazy Restaurant, a welcome drink, small bites, a cloakroom and premium staff service.

27359a994ab418271ef078c3efb379c448598bb2.en: The Foreigners in Finland ry's multicultural Christmas market and food fair at Kalasatama Comprehensive School on 29 November 2026, 11:00-17:00, free entry. Global food stalls, gifts, crafts, live music and a Santa visit for children.

d12dc0f8dce4122aabef44d6f2272eb201a7b1ac.en: Trio Teos plays a matinee of piano trios by Rebecca Clarke and Maurice Ravel at Villa Hakasalmi. Both works come from the same era and mirror each other in theme and mood. Included in the admission fee of 17 euros.

ad4401f8c9786043d8621f9bbcd9ad0f571436a2.en: Appeal Paudel, a sarod and voice artist rooted in Nepali folk and raga traditions, performs at Oodi. His playing blends improvisation, songwriting and non-dual philosophy, as part of the Musical Instruments of the World project.

601ed5b93cc2c676a6b2b214869ee67bd108ae4a.en: The end-of-term concert of the Helsinki Workers' Institute's opera ensemble, stage music and solo singing courses. The programme includes songs to poems by V.A. Koskenniemi and classic opera arias. Free admission.

d5b5d73a1a41be2126a45c65de46226453722390.en: Sound artist and wellbeing trainer Mariela Sarkima presents The Touch of the Sound at Kamppi Chapel on 29 November 2026, 17:00-18:00. Singing bowls, wind chimes, nature instruments and a gong create a relaxing soundscape. Tickets 25 euros.

4a2b3f79617bb31bfd29613f79d1e24c739668b9.en: American alternative rocker Moon Walker plays Tiivistämö this November, with a support act to be announced. Doors open at 19:00, the age limit is 18+, and tickets cost 30 euros in advance or 35 euros at the door.

83e4c0a5acfcec91bda91a63db10baa09e4852dc.en: Jesse Kaikuranta and Sointi Jazz Orchestra play Kaikuranta's original songs in new orchestral arrangements, alongside gems of the Finnish jazz repertoire. Konepajan näyttämö on 29 November, 18:00-19:30. Tickets 22/25 euros.

645a5ae867351099162f1e776958bdc205c6759f.en: Italian metal bands Master Boot Record, Fulci and Arottenbit perform at Tavastia-klubi on 29 November 2026. Master Boot Record mixes old video game sounds with metal and synthwave, while Fulci plays horror-inspired death metal. Tickets 33-35 euros, 18+.

378d37e69d564095fd0dc9359c02a83641ce4856.en: Helsingin Laulu's traditional Advent concert Waiting for Christmas at Temppeliaukio Church on 29 November, 19:00-20:30. The choir, led by Hanna Remes, takes the audience through Advent and Christmas melodies. Tickets 30/20 euros.

4b3c859162c64d8a0de31d5675540277ed82457d.en: Author Emmi Itäranta presents Lumenlaulaja, her new book that retells the Kalevala from a feminist view, centred on Louhi, the mistress of Pohjola. Finnish critic Kati-Annika Ansas interviews her at Kannelmäki Library. Free entry.

342be1b6de45272e59e564521ef30213845d6817.en: The Helsinki Workers' Institute's ProMus choir presents its autumn programme at Stoa, conducted by Markus Holthoer with piano accompaniment. The concert lasts about an hour and admission is free.

556c6c9ebb5128016740abb402680e5567f20f26.en: The improv group Kosteusvaurio performs short improvised scenes at Töölö Library. The four performers create characters and situations from audience suggestions, inspired by literature and the library setting.

422b19cb5395c0ad33a8e67d5b78a1ad9c6b339d.en: Ukrainian rock band Hardkiss plays Tavastia-klubi on 1 December 2026, with doors at 19:00. The band combines rock, electronic and pop music. Tickets 52.50-56.50 euros from Tiketti, 18+.

da84c56ad40c98ec1880bfbafb9b5cdbd1a86def.en: An exhibition of photographs by Helsinki amateur photographer Helena Blomqvist, taken on a summer 2025 trip along the Daugava River to Riga, including views of Riga's Old Town. Held at Maunula House.

b6813e148370fc9b4a4e4edae72b9853581c4ac0.en: A reading dog session at Oulunkylä Library: children read aloud for about 15 minutes to a patient dog and its handler. Book by email with the subject LUKUKOIRA. Remaining slots are on 2 December at 17:20 and 17:40.

258dbbf421a4e4c7c7755b2f2ab4143b8e12b400.en: Saiturin joulu is a family show based on Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol, staged with music, physical comedy and Ebenezer Scrooge's transformation. Directed by Toby Park at Konepajan näyttämö, 2-13 December 2026, 1h40, ages 7+, in Finnish.

b255b25f726f5c5ddbd5da553a22309b2156f6ba.en: Author and CEO Leo Stranius talks at Itäkeskus Library about how cutting emissions and consumption can make life wiser and healthier. The talk draws on his book 1,5 astetta parempi arki (2025).

27378c906c2c701f1851149d877c3dd51f87afc8.en: The Liveä & Lyriikkaa club at Oodi's Maijansali on 2 December 2026, 18:00, features singer-songwriter Joose Keskitalo. Expect about 60 minutes of songs and the stories behind them. Free entry, all ages.

15a40cfff76badcba7fa77ddabcff96d24ab60b6.en: Swedish author Ida Therén talks about her novel Det osynliga templet, which follows painter Hilma af Klint in London in 1928 before her first exhibition. The book won the Prisma literary prize in 2025. Held at Arbis.

69eb8cf3fbc79b72acce8d510097db133a77c5b0.en: A karaoke evening at Oulunkylän Seurahuone, open to everyone from shower singers to seasoned performers. Choose a favourite song and take the mic, or simply come to listen and cheer others on.

d118429a384806fe50d1c177bad9f196bccbee29.en: Reading advice from the HERO association at Vuosaari Library. Learners with reading difficulties can get free guidance and practice tips from special education professionals. Reading advisers are in the lobby on Thursday 3 December.

4f3dcc2822c262e910a3418b1d92c2e308006337.en: Manala Afterwork Jazz with trumpeter Kalevi Louhivuori at Manala Restaurant & Bar on 3 December 2026, 17:00-19:00. A rotating guest soloist joins the Manala Afterwork Trio in a New York-inspired jazz club setting. Free entry.

e2e71d8b7a66b832bea33e145ee82a8aa7af3593.en: Artist talk with Swedish author Ida Therén at Nordic Culture Point on 3 December 2026, 17:00-18:00, free entry. She discusses her residency work and her planned trilogy about Hilma af Klint, exploring the fault line between doing good and supporting harm.

2f750fcfbd7e6b970ef39b973ba4c59ebbb1dc03.en: An evening for reading ambassadors at Töölö Senior Centre on 3 December, 17:00-19:30. New and returning volunteers, who read aloud to older people in care homes, get training, book tips and a Christmas-themed peer meeting. Sign up by 1 December.

1e5a7dcb59f68a100260cd99ecd7ce46857b2668.en: Indie-pop band Heili performs stories set to music at Helsinki Central Library Oodi on 3 December at 18:00. Their songs mix jazz, folk and tango influences. Part of a mini tour through Helsinki libraries, with free admission.

9ee7d310f0e71df4378e4c803be0c7e84c96ae52.en: Jazz at Lincoln Center Orchestra with Wynton Marsalis plays Finlandia Hall on 3 December 2026, 19:00-21:00. The 15-member orchestra marks the 40th anniversary of April Jazz and closes the Jazz in Finland 100 jubilee. Tickets from Lippupiste.

19ee2a350955c40afbbf3ad6ba3e02284cb5a5bc.en: A guitar groups' Christmas concert at Opistotalo, with guitar pieces and group singing. The rehearsal runs from 15:30 and the concert lasts about 90 minutes. Free admission.

ac672287c6230c66b19e81a9b2176c2cfadbec5c.en: Didi vs. The World is a work of ten dramatic scenes for female voice and electric guitar, performed at WHS Teatteri Union on 4 December 2026, 18:00-19:15. Performed in Finnish with English surtitles, ages 15+, tickets 8-29 euros.

54c536979f370bf46c00569461860d9f3d3d2020.en: Theatre Academy students present 12-minute documentary solo pieces at Maunula House on 4 December 2026. The pieces explore personal histories, from military service to family, and the event lasts about 2h15 with an intermission. Free tickets.

4cc4e46924c3d620c2d1f367ce96ca527cfef78b.en: A Luontosinfonia dinner package at Finlandia Hall includes a ticket with excellent seating, a buffet dinner before the concert and free coat check. Packages are non-refundable, and Live Nation is not liable for their extra content.

b7f32a9771fd0aa98f3a670722ed537828ea52b6.en: Singer Sonia presents her EP JOKU PÄIVÄ SUOMI HIFFAA at Tiivistämö, and rising artist Leyla opens the evening. Sonia's pop combines playful hooks, strong productions and direct lyrics, and the EP is released on 6 November.

37fbf7d3593a9e05d510ff0f4db1e5b2602f679c.en: A flute players' Christmas concert at Opistotalo, about 60 minutes of music with free admission.

4bb8e5f7a851354ecf01052cc20c943a6afa6c59.en: HPO and UMO bring the glamour of Golden Age Hollywood, jazz interpretations and beloved Christmas tunes to Musiikkitalo. The concert combines classic film music with festive favourites.

d080e8ec026a9e1d6764867042dbda6c5413a914.en: Ice hockey at Helsinki Ice Hall: HIFK meets KooKoo on 4 December 2026 at 19:30. HIFK, founded in 1897, is the oldest ice hockey team in the Helsinki metropolitan area. Tickets from Ticketmaster.

7f4e306814ec219f7b18b74cc5f20923af92eec0.en: HPO's Encounters Club with UMO Helsinki Ensemble at Musiikkitalo brings a Latin jazz programme. Soulful jazz melodies and improvisations meet Latin American rhythms for an evening that moves from New York jazz clubs to Cuba.

c82bbb445d4751f49660b6826f48f76dda541fae.en: Manta's Christmas Market at Havis Amanda Square runs from 4 December 2026 to 6 January 2027, daily 11:00-19:00, free entry. New this year is a covered ice rink, a winter village with food, stalls and events.

75291fc7c0c641b1d6e5c627303398ff19cb92cd.en: Masked Singer in Concert Premium Suite tickets at Veikkaus Arena include a private suite for up to 10 guests, early entry, private drink service, a premium menu and a private restroom.

4e15194a71d72e37b266e61f35c747290ae479d0.en: A guided tour of the PUNK 50 years of excitement on the streets of Helsinki exhibition at Villa Hakasalmi, with no pre-registration needed. Included in the admission fee of 17 euros, and free for under-18s and Museum Card holders.

c9228bd56075f3215db415b653845602343facad.en: Pola Ivanka and Iiro Ollila's cabaret Mitä nyt, Lea? revisits Lea Laven's hits in fresh arrangements and explores midlife questions with humour and warmth. Performed in Finnish at Konepajan näyttämö on 5, 10 and 11 December 2026.

47c9d5c3fd4c5a9e0b064ca5885ee42eea0e7cfc.en: Sami Hedberg's stand-up show Lupa nauraa at Finlandia Hall on 5 December 2026, 18:00-21:00, features only new material. Lasting about two hours, tickets cost 39.90-129 euros and the age limit is 18+.

ce760b6e85f792c9965d9a62661ca2c39a417cfb.en: Beast in Black headlines Helsinki Ice Hall on 5 December 2026 at 18:00, with goth rock legends The 69 Eyes and rising act Rabbit Cult also on the bill. Tickets start from 59 euros from Lippupiste.

c0b4583a208aea01e03e0e566ca5cd5a5b90150e.en: Swedish rock bands Blues Pills and Graveyard play Tavastia-klubi on 5 December 2026, with doors at 19:00. Tickets cost 55-58 euros from Tiketti, and the age limit is 18.

5de7c87bc5ee132e51ef696e8951af350147ff6d.en: A battle between Möyhy-Veikot and Draamakuu, the new duo of Draama-Helmi and Kuupuu, at Tiivistämö on 5 December 2026, on the eve of Independence Day. Advance tickets 15 euros, age limit K-18.

c534c575f87c7ba4501620bb3e3a6c056936f319.en: Premium tickets for HECTOR 60V Taiteilijajuhla at Veikkaus Arena are non-refundable and non-transferable. Refunds apply only if the event is cancelled, and names cannot be changed.

4e40a4090a9d401edc5cced7e95406ab15bcf481.en: Legazy Seat tickets for HECTOR 60V Taiteilijajuhla at Veikkaus Arena include a lower-tier seat, a dedicated entrance through the Legazy Restaurant, a welcome drink, small bites, a cloakroom and premium staff service.

46ce99a08ce3c4594b0bea1d1766e31f629987df.en: VIP packages for HECTOR 60V Taiteilijajuhla at Veikkaus Arena are non-refundable and non-transferable. Live Nation is not liable for the content of the VIP packages, which it produces itself.

01cbe28cf42ffc251d3e3cd2eac8d90a25b53d09.en: Finland's Independence Day on 6 December is marked by church services, an ecumenical service at Helsinki Cathedral at noon, flowers at the Soldiers' Grave in Hietaniemi and a University Students' Torch Parade from 17:00. Residents light candles at 18:00.

eeb8c4079c4dbf82b93cad729414bbbd517e81c9.en: An Independence Day concert at Angelicum Hall on 6 December 2026, 15:00-16:00, with baritone Esa Ruuttunen, mezzo-soprano Laura Mäkitalo and pianist Risto Lauriala performing traditional Finnish classical music. Tickets 35 euros.

495f0db90fcfdaedb87faa7b640070c4079274af.en: A free talk at Oodi on online public services and strong authentication with bank IDs and mobile certificates, followed by questions and personal digital guidance. No pre-registration is needed.

babc52bc9c9c69843eeb6c17e32e1f3a769357c3.en: Lackluster's listening set at Oulunkylä Library: melodic ambient chillout music with fresh ways of playing older and newer songs. Audience members suggest tracks from earlier albums before the set, and the band reworks them live.

6d4e988734500f20ccf545f98627a8727cb31964.en: Legazy Seat tickets for Pitbull's I'm Back show at Veikkaus Arena include a lower-tier seat, a dedicated entrance through the Legazy Restaurant, a welcome drink, small bites and premium staff service.

b3a456131ec8f6c1e57d951e44cb2d5ad07664b7.en: US superstar Pitbull brings his I'm Back tour to Veikkaus Arena on 7 and 8 December 2026. Doors open at 18:30, tickets cost 89.90-169.90 euros from Ticketmaster, and there is no age limit.

83bb19d63b1e1faec95ca6b01e2c441f9f776e2e.en: Demoni's Designyule 2026 at Metropolia's Arabia Campus on 8 December, 14:00-19:00, free entry. Culture and arts students sell their artwork, crafts and handmade gifts. Payment is by cash or digital payment such as MobilePay.

0ae912869908d8bffb2d6de91bd98ce71a9a7f18.en: Ice hockey at Helsinki Ice Hall: HIFK meets Sport on 8 December 2026 at 18:30. HIFK, founded in 1897, is the oldest ice hockey team in the Helsinki metropolitan area. Tickets from Ticketmaster.

79cb48b003d8090eba145397047870431ccceaeb.en: A Christmas singalong at Itäkeskus Library, themed Sydänten joulu, led by a music school. No prior skills are needed, singing is optional, and the familiar Finnish tunes bring back good memories.

a094ccbac4f62c3843127f6fe20d351610c6b186.en: A partnership event at Helsinki Congress Paasitorni on 9 December 2026, 13:00-16:00, on the role of organisations in crisis resilience. It includes talks on examples from Ukraine and the city's preparedness, plus a workshop. Registration closes on 24 November.

66bb32616f10e9a4389bc4b30576f3a9d64efae7.en: Coffee with Poetry at Nordic Culture Point on 9 December 2026, 14:00-14:30. Participants read a poem together and reflect on it without literary theory. Free entry, no pre-registration, held in Swedish.

d2a1b36ea1b4bf306df971f19f6f01715518568a.en: A talk by FM Johanna Lehtonen at Stoa on 9 December, the name day of Anna, about the origins and popularity of names such as Anna, Päivi and Tuula, and Finnish name-day traditions. Free entry, with coffee and cake for name-day guests.

ac215e9af593fe7f2ce7400498f0ce7fc26adcb8.en: The Humane Drug Policy association's reading circle at Kallio Library welcomes new members. On 9 December at 17:00 it discusses Psykonautti, a psychedelic concept book, in the accessible group room Otso. Remote participation is available.

4dcdcd5969b75e56511778183cb110a1260157d4.en: The Nordic Literature Circle, run by Nordic Culture Point and Helsinki Central Library Oodi, reads Nordic fiction together. Participants do not need to finish the book, and the group chooses the next one. Next meeting: 9 December 2026, 18:00-19:00, free entry.

c28bdcefac96140a7b72c9a7dc6331f4888e3dc8.en: Paint & Wine at Restaurant White Lady on 9 December 2026, 18:00-19:30. A guided watercolour session helps you think about your dreams and goals, with no painting experience needed. Tickets 35 euros include all materials. Age limit 18+, wine is extra.

c4b1780da4af25b58cbab45e3b105377e3d6c3ab.en: HPO's Sounds of the North concert at Musiikkitalo features violinist Otto Antikainen, who charmed audiences at the final of the most recent Jean Sibelius Violin Competition, playing works including Englund's.

6b37937bdb81ebfd177ad665ed1e09033de9e51c.en: Symphony of Magic at Bio Rex Lasipalatsi on 9 and 10 December 2026, 19:00-20:30. True Vibe Orchestra plays music from Harry Potter, including Hedwig's Theme and Nimbus 2000. Tickets 39-65 euros from Ticketbest.

d80ce39bb4551e9648c6022df12ca8e6e28bdadb.en: Winter Circus Colour at Dance House Helsinki's Erkko Hall runs from 9 December 2026 to 24 January 2027. The family contemporary circus show explores individuality and togetherness through colour, with jazz, tap dancing and live music from Hurja Jazz Trio.

b9014938d2e8c7063e28aeed2f124b00489670a0.en: Christmas instrument jam at Vuosaari House, where musicians bring their own instruments and sing along to a song list. Two sessions run back to back, 16:30-18:00 and 18:15-19:45. Free entry, with keys that suit the kantele.

19ba8d6813d4450a5be48cba48a57e8712ba7236.en: Manala Afterwork Jazz with guitarist Mathias Sandberg, Arto Ikävalko on Hammond organ and drummer Ville Luukkonen, at Manala Restaurant & Bar on 10 December 2026, 17:00-19:00. Free entry, and arriving early is advised.

ed207734f6740372ada60e646ff022a91070af07.en: A book launch at Oodi for Ilkka Kemppinen's novel Vuoksenniskan teloitetut, a historical novel about eight people who end up in the Vuoksenniska prison camp during the wars. It takes place on 10 December at 17:00, 3rd floor.

36327ab8e67cbee3656fb67a11536807e19779b7.en: Helsinki artist Heili performs stories set to music at Tapanila Library in December. Her music blends jazz, folk and tango, and her first EP, Huvin vuoksi yksin Kouvolaan, came out last November. Part of the Laulettuja tarinoita tour.

a9aea7b1153e7cfaf19aa5dd30c0f1f97ff106a7.en: The Suomalaisen klubin kuoro male choir gives a Christmas concert at Lauttasaari Church on 10 December 2026, 18:00-20:00, led by Teppo Salakka. It sings classics and rarely heard pieces by Sibelius, Praetorius and others. Free entry.

6662b263dc4e12778ec99313b4b1b5e446ea8562.en: Two free, drop-in Christmas workshops in the Vuotalo lobby: one makes felt balls, the other a white Christmas tree from makeup remover pads. The tree workshop uses hot glue, so it is not suitable for small children. No registration needed.

5971a4c2ac43beb77d63c4591197e820cb2a1c80.en: Alma Alanko and a support act play Tiivistämö, presenting songs from her second EP Askeleen edellä, released in spring 2026. Her danceable pop blends dance pop, hyperpop and trance. She is currently working on her first album. Age limit S/K18.

d63940666fa186a04118ca474d15000773b171ad.en: The Cantores Minores boys' choir performs the first three cantatas of J.S. Bach's Christmas Oratorio at Helsinki Cathedral on 11 December 2026, 19:00-20:30, with the Finnish Baroque Orchestra. Tickets 10-75 euros from Ticketmaster.

b04b1026107a4f9f71a7b4379b5d658535c6e0af.en: Dog Fair Finland, Finland's largest dog event, runs at Messukeskus from 11 to 13 December 2026. It features big dog shows, breed presentations, dog sports demos and a plush toy dog contest for children. Tourist dogs are not allowed.

837ee6124395232e928c4857105ca4788410bce3.en: Käärijä plays Tavastia-klubi on 11 and 12 December 2026, with doors at 20:00. The artist received by far the most audience votes in the Eurovision Song Contest in 2023 with his entry Cha Cha Cha. Tickets 45-50 euros from Tiketti, 18+.

55832ef5fbfbac94cdf4a324d1c5d160265c130e.en: A traditional Christmas market at Karjalatalo on 12 December 2026, 10:00-14:00, free entry. Stalls sell homemade pastries, sweets and cookies, and the SieMie shop is open during the event.

b87460d2115c2d305bcdb1e459efd317f68913e9.en: Maunula House Christmas Carnival on a family programme: a wreath workshop from 11:00 to 14:00, carol singing led by accordionist Mari Kätkä at 13:00, and the Sampo puppet concert with Duppaduulix from 14:15. Suitable for all ages.

c243f6fc2608700772838347516e9449ed0f2cc7.en: Tähti 2026 is a new one-day art and culture event at Jakomäki Youth Centre on 12 December 2026, 13:00-17:00. It offers performances, hands-on crafts, an art alley and a range of activities for all ages. Bring cash for purchases.

d41600c8184cff101a3273ac104455d9cec97001.en: A Christmas card and gift-tag crafting session at Tapanila Library for children and adults, plus a festive playing workshop for children with Jamkids. Visitors are invited to join in the Christmas elf spirit as a family.

53c21f7fb1ebed903bd42ce2e85229509f2bd0ae.en: Jamkids' Christmas playing workshop at Tapanila Library for the whole family, with playing, singing and rhymes in a festive mood. Christmas card crafts run from 13:00 to 15:00. Free entry.

549044a94e07c57a4903e5287aad9de2c39458bc.en: A discussion at Villa Hakasalmi with former punk activists Elviira Heikkilä, Janne Nyström and Kaide Laaksonen on rebellion then and now, hosted by Timo Kiippa. Afterwards the documentary White Riot screens at Kino Regina at 17:00.

14d6a144f9881aa74c6c1e60c839a6ec985eb5a2.en: Tango King Juho Punkeri, mezzo-soprano Laura Mäkitalo and pianist Risto Lauriala perform The Most Beautiful Melodies of Christmas at Huopalahti Church on 12 December 2026 at 16:00. The programme mixes Christmas favourites, tangos, duets and classical music.

768dc9666426038199e3313f04cdd4951e9e91c0.en: The Suomalaisen klubin kuoro male choir gives a Christmas concert at Vanhakirkko on 12 December 2026, 17:00-19:00, conducted by Teppo Salakka. It sings classics and rarely heard pieces by Sibelius, Praetorius and others. Free entry.

8d7d0022bae1735504093425b38df91c823a2ced.en: The a cappella ensemble Rajaton performs Christmas music at Finlandia Hall on 12 December 2026, 18:00-20:00. Tickets cost 24.50-52 euros from Tiketti.

34f0babad2157d43b59f1973a62a3491697350f5.en: The Finnish Baroque Orchestra performs Telemann's rarely heard Christmas oratorio Die Hirten an der Krippe zu Bethlehem with the Helsinki Chamber Choir, conducted by Nils Schweckendiek. Irma Niskanen leads the orchestra in works by Vivaldi and Bach.

433bda33379359cfbea697bd70589ba29abd879d.en: Turisti Presents: Magic City Arena Tour at Veikkaus Arena, with Premium suite tickets. Each suite holds up to 10 guests and includes early entry, private drinks service, a private restroom and a premium menu.

72e146d3756a07552391ff063f3bc6a753d4c4e1.en: Students and instrumental groups of the Helsinki Conservatory play mood-setting music for the Christmas season at Villa Hakasalmi. The concert is included in the admission fee of 17 euros, and free for under-18s and Museum Card holders.

7071bf44f35f6a5c818652a158f5df3badd5897b.en: A Lucia is crowned in Helsinki Cathedral at 17:00 on 13 December, and the Lucia parade starts from Senate Square at about 18:00. Free of charge.

08117f72e9f5445c5a93dd74843e011db8f08b90.en: The opera-style family show Heinähattu, Vilttitossu ja suuri pamaus at Konepajan näyttämö follows a family awaiting a new baby, told with humour from a child's point of view. Performed in Finnish for ages 3+, 40 minutes, on 13 December at 17:00.

a1163125cfd10a4aeb4ffb442d2c1c1ac09692d7.en: The HALO Choir, Puistola's own choir, gives a heartwarming Christmas concert at Puistola Church on 14 December 2026, 18:30-19:30. The programme mixes traditional carols with new melodies, some created on the spot, and the audience is invited to join in.

bfdb86a42b4ff4e3455f136c79163758ffc42311.en: Organ Baroque Christmas at Musiikkitalo on 14 December 2026, 19:00-21:00, with organ works by Bach, Handel and Albinoni, soprano arias, trumpet solos and a carol singalong. Tickets 12.50-42 euros from the Musiikkitalo box office.

17ae939df7d2ee93228bc327ed501f2e6afa37f3.en: Juurilauluja, an open participatory music session at Jakomäki Service Centre led by Veera Railio and Johanna Viksten, turns participants' life stories into songs. Nobody has to sing, and the group is free to attend. A Christmas special is held on 15 December.

205fe28fcc7f04d4c194eec5fae5630fdd2a5f4c.en: Hetki Itsellesi, a relaxed wine yoga class at Restaurant White Lady on 15 December 2026, 18:00-19:30, blends gentle vinyasa, yin yoga and tasting wine through the senses. No yoga experience is needed. Tickets 30 euros, wine not included, K-18.

edc6c341eed0f1cdfdd2732a4ba74ca697f9d704.en: Archaeologist and author Andreas Koivisto talks about his book Ikiaikainen kotimme, an archaeological journey into ancient Finland, in conversation with Kalle Kivinen at Vuosaari Library. The book gives faces to the people who lived there.

9a70afe0dd866b3c309c195b238e8651ffe4a18b.en: Vanhan Joulutori, a traditional Finnish Christmas market at the Old Student House from 15 to 22 December 2026, with interior items, graphics, ceramics, jewellery and delicacies on two floors. Free entry, Sun-Thu 11:00-19:00 and Fri-Sat 11:00-20:00.

0fc1ad1e188189d3a44a0954c359d634d3ad481f.en: Lounasajan laulut, a community singalong by a music school at Vuosaari Library's Siimes space on 16 December 2026, themed Sydänten joulu. No prior skills are needed, and familiar Finnish tunes bring back good memories.

20dae7ab897e74001701ba42d46b8a1b152f6673.en: Leo Stranius talks at Oulunkylä Library about why cutting emissions and consumption can make life better, drawing on his book 1,5 astetta parempi arki. He argues that compact living and plant-based eating need not mean a hard life.

574d3d68626d3e036bb5b8a0a32f036fb7be0d48.en: Ice hockey at Helsinki Ice Hall: HIFK meets Pelicans on 16 December 2026 at 18:30. HIFK, founded in 1897, is the oldest ice hockey team in the Helsinki metropolitan area. Tickets from Ticketmaster.

15b78e8169c4704308e9555e91ab5278943cdd68.en: Finnish baritone Waltteri Torikka gives a Christmas concert at Finlandia Hall on 16 December 2026, 18:30-20:30. The programme features beloved Christmas classics from Finland and abroad. Tickets 44-55 euros.

77044de6405f375f1d29777eb8989a57a45778eb.en: Leavings-Orkesteri, with vocalist Timo Rautiainen, plays Christmas carols and the biggest hits of Leevi & The Leavings at House of Culture on 16 December 2026, 19:00-21:00. The concert honours songwriter Gösta Sundqvist. Tickets from 42.90 euros, 18+.

f1c6ceec53ef4bd55ce9fc8db800f69e2cab1086.en: Pepe Willberg's 80th birthday celebration at Finlandia Hall on 17 December 2026, 18:00-24:00, with music, food and a warm journey through decades of Finnish music. Menu and prices are on the Finlandia Hall website.

9517bfb9d938136df8ad851ca43e9d04f6cc2603.en: The Cantores Minores boys' choir's traditional Christmas concert at Helsinki Cathedral on 17 and 18 December 2026, at 18:00 and 20:00, centred on the Christmas Gospel. The whole choir performs, from first graders to A-choir veterans. Tickets 10-40 euros.

3b5aacf1f723cf00c44a8aa8c240624208249ee7.en: The premiere of 10,000 Spins at Maunula House, a dance work by Elina Hauta-aho and Kati Raatikainen. The autobiographical piece looks at 20 years of dance, the politics of the body and social attitudes. Free tickets are required.

a089593770fc5affa704de726982ba234670cbad.en: 10,000 Spins at Maunula House, a dance work by Elina Hauta-aho and Kati Raatikainen. The autobiographical piece looks at 20 years of dance, the politics of the body and social attitudes. Free tickets are required.

d6f3c9c13c4f7cd00ed8c9ea4ff681758bf80e2f.en: Anna Airola reads E.T.A. Hoffmann's Nutcracker in Finnish while the UMO Helsinki Jazz Orchestra plays the Ellington and Strayhorn jazz arrangement of Tchaikovsky's ballet. A family Christmas show, with loud moments warned for the youngest guests.

62e7297ab72985ac7994ea7212ec487aa7c9ed98.en: Ice hockey at Helsinki Ice Hall: HIFK meets Lukko on 18 December 2026 at 18:30. HIFK, founded in 1897, is the oldest ice hockey team in the Helsinki metropolitan area. Tickets from Ticketmaster.

6c199f562bbb9f7f660d6aa1d2383cea84e57ba2.en: The Helsinki Philharmonic, the Helsinki Music Centre Chorus and conductor Antony Hermus lead the audience into the festive season with works by Verdi and Wagner at Musiikkitalo.

4f357bff79762d5a184abee332ee8abca670855a.en: Raskasta Joulua, a Christmas concert for hard rock fans, at Veikkaus Arena on 18 December 2026 at 20:00. Performers include Marko Hietala, Tony Kakko, Timo Kotipelto, Elize Ryd and Laura Ruusumaa. Tickets from Ticketmaster.

c724a7b8cb276292acb8c9d35863f386b333fded.en: Ice Cage 9 with Panorama Restaurant tickets at Veikkaus Arena: a table for four on the third floor with full bar service, and a menu served at your table while you watch the ring. Drinks are charged separately.

534e5af21a91e8e6efe5ccb2349bf337bcce74c1.en: Sami Hedberg's stand-up show Lupa nauraa at Aleksanterin teatteri on 19 December 2026, 18:00-21:00, features entirely new material and lasts about two hours. Tickets 39.90-129 euros, K-18.

80a5a551995bf7c798b210186a19e5fc138c8dd1.en: Linda Lampenius and Perttu Kivilaakso, loved by audiences at home and abroad, perform new and surprising versions of beloved Christmas songs at St John's Church, 18:00-19:15. Tickets 40/32 euros from Tiketti.

67b807192de57f5311c58d3ed920ca6974b55cf5.en: The a cappella ensemble Rajaton performs Christmas music at St John's Church on 22 December 2026, 18:00-19:10. Tickets 41-45 euros from Tiketti.

b1442100e27b3969ec0f4e70c22062319a9cb7b9.en: Sleigh rides on Stephen's Day, 26 December 2026, 12:00-16:00, at the Festival Ground on Seurasaari Island. Free admission, sleigh ride 7 euros, weather permitting, and the kiosk and Café Mieritz are open.

afc053e2d01a1a2ab93337fabb1744c4ea8a2b6c.en: Äänen kosketus, a sound bath concert at Villa Hakasalmi by Mariela Sarkima. Singing bowls, wind chimes, nature instruments and a gong create a relaxing soundscape, enjoyed while seated. Included in the admission fee of 17 euros.

5eff58cecadd8ae80a68d4a4f085ea9f868a1a8e.en: Lux Helsinki runs for eight days, from 30 December 2026 to 6 January 2027. For the first time, it invites people to ring in the New Year with light art, beginning the day before New Year's Eve.

d47c79fcb1dd7e905d961fe200e33c71512b1a4b.en: Helsinki's New Year celebration at Kansalaistori Square on 31 December 2026, a tradition held since the 1930s and produced by the Helsinki Events Foundation.

dd66b57ee310507e5c3d4813222b9bfe19951376.en: The Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra, conducted by Dima Slobodeniouk with soprano Helena Juntunen, celebrates two composers who turn 100. The programme includes Sibelius's Tapiola and Kurtág's Stele, plus the Finnish premiere of Betsy Jolas's piece.

01e111108a3902319868e589b244bff07ce67981.en: British Festival Ballet performs The Nutcracker at Finlandia Hall on 18 December at 19:00 and 19 December at 14:00. Clara's Christmas Eve adventure includes the Mouse King and the Kingdom of Sweets. Tickets 59-109 euros.

982984f62d70524129d1f79e8a6c3441cb6f37b5.en: A matinee at Villa Hakasalmi built around two Robert Schumann song cycles, with songs by Pauline Viardot-García, Schubert, Alma Schindler-Mahler and Nadia Boulanger. Sung by Emilia Juvonen and Sonja Honkamaa, included in admission.

51e57d9d91fc45e205c73e1c8816107852f319db.en: Ice hockey at Helsinki Ice Hall: HIFK meets Tappara on 2 January 2027 at 16:00. HIFK, founded in 1897, is the oldest ice hockey team in the Helsinki metropolitan area. Tickets from Ticketmaster.

69f1f494ebe2349faa16390ece216be3b3567b6f.en: Robert Jägerhorn's Intos at Nostage is an intimate close-up magic show with 12 seats per session, mixing storytelling, playfulness and small illusions. Runs 5 January to 8 May 2027, 49 euros, 1 hour, in Finnish, 16+.

f614999a0e7208c52e2a074e3252eaf03b69790f.en: HKO Re:Sonata gives classic orchestral works an electric reinterpretation in a new concert production at Musiikkitalo.

10bd3d644838f63a5e21db0f266157634cfb3c2d.en: Ice hockey at Helsinki Ice Hall: HIFK meets Ässät on 8 January 2027 at 18:30. HIFK, founded in 1897, is the oldest ice hockey team in the Helsinki metropolitan area. Tickets from Ticketmaster.

52890306d90a6c1afccb080e3d9a9210e416f95f.en: HPO Re:Sonata gives classic orchestral works an electric reinterpretation in a new concert production at Musiikkitalo.

453df9018038da967461b0e6b90168d5db392643.en: Vienna's Schönbrunn Castle Orchestra, conducted by David Scarr, gives New Year concerts at House of Culture on 9 January 2027 at 15:00 and 19:00, with sopranos, baritones and classical masterpieces. Tickets from Lippupiste.

30aa483777508058a213b5e6d109aca26a0b202d.en: American writer Andrew Mayeshiba reads from his novel Taiga, set in Finland, about an aging man living alone above the Arctic Circle. He discusses self-exile and folklore in English at Oodi, free and open to everyone.

ef828cec944bb5ce5e474b02c229e5f8b412503f.en: Teatteri-Id's new show Matkalla Digitoon at Oodi gives voice to people left behind as services moved online. It is moving and humorous, and shows the lives of those struggling in a digital society.

2fc31d9fad06ea409de7d8ad0f9cf490ed300663.en: Ice hockey at Helsinki Ice Hall: HIFK meets K-Espoo on 13 January 2027 at 18:30. HIFK, founded in 1897, is the oldest ice hockey team in the Helsinki metropolitan area. Tickets from Ticketmaster.

25837849641c80e3df13edd4f0f4b46c90686286.en: HPO with Saraste and violinist Hadelich at Musiikkitalo plays Erich Korngold's Violin Concerto, bringing the romantic energy of 1930s and 1940s Hollywood film scores to the concert hall.

d89e6405656796de648195687819c2af7c1c0be1.en: The Big Election Evening at Vuosaari Library brings top candidates from five parties to discuss the future of Finland and Vuosaari. Visitors can listen in or ask the candidates questions.

b75accd56e21a27519b39d67174d27691bfde29f.en: Male Choir Euga's Elements of Euga – Fire at German Church on 17 January 2027, 18:00-19:30, is the third concert in a multidisciplinary series, with fire-themed visuals, sound art and activities. Tickets 10-25 euros.

c40795cdeb15a74bb46edeed4d152abfd22987d8.en: Lords of the Sound plays the music of Hans Zimmer at House of Culture on 18 January 2027, 19:00-21:30, celebrating his 70th birthday. The programme includes Pirates of the Caribbean, Gladiator, Interstellar and The Lion King.

2b9b0d51a8fd150da8651f008c8eb7f9ebd7adda.en: Ice hockey at Helsinki Ice Hall: HIFK meets Kalpa on 20 January 2027 at 18:30. HIFK, founded in 1897, is the oldest ice hockey team in the Helsinki metropolitan area. Tickets from Ticketmaster.

edd83b3699ec6a463e49a7c6118e4ae6f46c5937.en: A free Tieteiden yö panel at the Helsinki City Museum on working together, drawing on the Yhteinen kylä exhibition, which a Sámi curatorial team shaped. The discussion covers ethical co-operation that keeps Sámi culture in Sámi hands.

77ed57e703f0434e55bfddde694068ee528805ec.en: Matka Nordic Travel Fair at Messukeskus, the largest travel industry event in Northern Europe, with talks on travel trends, package deals and sustainable tourism. Held 21-24 January 2027, and the ticket also covers Caravan.

b17ab6715676fe361639a8da5551bf8a70594bf4.en: HPO plays Thomas Adès's violin concerto and Sibelius's Lemminkäinen Suite at Musiikkitalo in a concert titled The Swan of Tuonela. The programme moves from Adès's whirling cycles to powerful Kalevala imagery.

4c4a90ba945cf89900fbe080f17a2d082ed27e70.en: The Encounters Club at Musiikkitalo is an arena for creative ideas and surprising encounters with Helsinki Philharmonic musicians. This edition features Ráidu, with performances by the orchestra's players.

74b19099bc14b95cb5a389a7a1d3bdf085147761.en: Caravan at Messukeskus, 22-24 January 2027, with major caravan and trailer brands, a wide range of accessories, new and used caravans, and stage talks. Beginners and experienced campers both find useful information.

1908e465cfae2e43f470fbc7900cfb7743ae0c70.en: A drop-in recycling workshop at Opistotalo where you can safely wipe personal data from a computer, phone, tablet or storage device before recycling it. No registration needed, but the facade renovation may cause some disruption.

51b609b7a259b614faea7090ea2586da8df879b0.en: Researcher Ville Lähde presents the book 12 käsitettä maailmasta at Tapanila Library, offering tools to rethink environmental thinking and counter misconceptions in a changing world.

f1faaaf81a48628c71d56b142893cf723d414148.en: The Helsinki Chamber Choir, with the Polish ensemble NeoQuartet and conductor Nils Schweckendiek, performs My Garden is Filled with Fragments, including a new work by Sebastian Hilli that asks whether hubris threatens democracy.

d72db7534d9422d6478064e6e6dbe711f55df3cc.en: A tribute concert at Tavastia-klubi on 27 January 2027 to the music of Katri Helena, with Arja Koriseva, Anne Mattila, Antti Ketonen and Antti Railio performing her classic hits. Tickets 42-45 euros, 18+.

5a726959c994d36a4f3c7bc95014eca7e9d28ae4.en: A premiere of a new piece by Icelandic composer Anna Thorvaldsdóttir at Musiikkitalo, alongside works by Ottorino Respighi.

350f29718dc447e20d5dfebf1b795446b2b87847.en: Helsinki Noir, an international crime literature festival, runs 29 January to 5 February 2027. The main event on 29-30 January at Alexander Theatre features crime and true crime authors. Tickets from Lippupiste.

e01c4b59b0e2ab98fac719dd9f1d5f2abf4fa54d.en: Vegemessut, the largest plant-based food event in the Nordics, takes place at Cable Factory on 29-31 January 2027. Hundreds of samples from a 100% vegan selection suit newcomers and long-time vegans alike.

0662da94becba33550e70b69e8ed8e908aadeb5d.en: The Well-Fed Artist, a group exhibition at the Hotel and Restaurant Museum from 29 January to 4 April 2027, challenges the myth of the starving artist through food-themed works by Elli Maanpää, Sini Kallio and Mammu Rauhala.

44bab54ff82fb1be82b93de39a5764c64aeb3f3f.en: Ice hockey at Helsinki Ice Hall: HIFK meets Jukurit on 30 January 2027 at 16:00. HIFK, founded in 1897, is the oldest ice hockey team in the Helsinki metropolitan area. Tickets from Ticketmaster.

c6ef328bd8ee1d6716fbbe76e2493065f2f3715e.en: The Ukrainian company Kyiv Classic Ballet performs Tchaikovsky's Swan Lake at Finlandia Hall on 31 January 2027, 15:00-17:00. Tickets from Ticketmaster.

60c7bef11c9706d7993e0a1e2a58a8f9029b819e.en: Young Gun Silver Fox from the UK, with Miller Campbell from the USA, play Tavastia-klubi on 2 February 2027, doors at 19:00. Tickets 34.50-37.50 euros from Tiketti, 18+.

a88a259667eaae20ba06e92f2db742e0c4f3b20f.en: Ice hockey at Helsinki Ice Hall: HIFK meets Kärpät on 4 February 2027 at 18:30. HIFK, founded in 1897, is the oldest ice hockey team in the Helsinki metropolitan area. Tickets from Ticketmaster.

64524c3ffcd78c56fab1364258b67319afc6aac5.en: Swedish sleaze rock band Crashdïet returns to Tavastia-klubi on 5 February 2027 to promote the new album Art Of Chaos. Doors at 19:00, tickets 46.50-49.50 euros from Tiketti, 18+.

43db6b9e2af0a0c6848bf90750534c6a92a15dcc.en: DocPoint, Finland's biggest documentary film festival, runs in Helsinki from 5 to 14 February 2027. It offers festival hits, more experimental gems and a range of other events.

5dafb9ec86f444b93243e97295eabd42b9e80968.en: MP Motorcycle Show at Messukeskus from 5 to 7 February 2027, with hundreds of bikes, discounted accessories and equipment, travel ideas and custom choppers.

8874e99e125338ab0ffe4e8c60573d41fd2f3b61.en: A bone health course at Töölö Senior Centre for Helsinki pensioners and unemployed people with osteoporosis or osteopenia. Five sessions run from 9 February to 6 April 2027, 13:00-15:00, covering bone health, exercise, nutrition and falls prevention.

ecd3bde7b7cc24031d42500fe934510dbbe2127c.en: Helsinki's graduating students parade through the city on trucks, throwing candy to passers-by. The parade starts at 12:30 on 11 February 2027 and is best seen along the Esplanade around 13:00. Free admission.

52d08ca9f7b1dcbab85e49756acd4d97e9819adb.en: Premium suite tickets for Disney On Ice's Mikin Etsintäpartio at Veikkaus Arena include a private suite for up to 10 guests, early entry, private drinks service, a private restroom and a premium menu. Children's tickets include a Disney On Ice fan product.

e8610ad9261d0fa016c786418c2bacaeffe2b094.en: Disney On Ice: Discover the Magic at Veikkaus Arena, 11-14 February 2027, follows the search for Tinker Bell through worlds from Coco, Moana and Belle's enchanted chandelier to Frozen. Ice skating, aerial stunts and Toy Story moments.

e7a02e2f10cb0821998ac49d24a542f26f0f6201.en: Premium suite tickets for Disney On Ice's Mikin Etsintäpartio at Veikkaus Arena include a private suite for up to 10 guests, early entry, private drinks service, a private restroom and a premium menu. Children's tickets include a Disney On Ice fan product.

bc774fe88e868794db8e5441d61bacaf2c892601.en: Vene Båt, one of the largest boat shows in Northern Europe, runs at Messukeskus from 12 to 21 February 2027. Boating enthusiasts meet to share experiences and shop, with information on boating, sailing, fishing and water sports.

2f1dfe3cabe3b7dcef2207db90ece2fd6a669135.en: Helsinki Outdoor Expo, a nature and outdoor fair at Messukeskus on 12-14 February 2027, with hiking trails, gear and wilderness activities. Fishing and water activities from the Helsinki International Boat Show are included with the same ticket.

157ca7e376bc440f7a5c89759ed185a1bfe46be7.en: Antony Gormley: Hold at Kiasma is a broad overview of the British sculptor's work, from individual sculptures to whole room installations. Visitors can crawl through cardboard Body Buildings, exploring how art shapes our movement and sense of space.

949cdf5f9e1e6b32d74c0aa1be81764a04a9a68a.en: Premium suite tickets for Disney On Ice's Mikin Etsintäpartio at Veikkaus Arena include a private suite for up to 10 guests, early entry, private drinks service, a private restroom and a premium menu. Children's tickets include a Disney On Ice fan product.

08bb34f8e886c0829bb5964a3cb98a2ae7100de4.en: Nordiska vinterdagen at Arbis is a family day of winter games, crafts, music and song, organised with Pohjola-Norden in Helsinki. Activities for both big and small visitors, held in Swedish.

296e9aa71b489cb55a756e61cc3e24696a982ed6.en: US rock band Catch Your Breath plays Tavastia-klubi on 13 February 2027 on their Not Broken Enough Tour. Their hard rock mixes heavy guitar walls with synth-driven production. Doors 18:00, tickets 38.50 euros from Tiketti, 18+.

d8b7fb7badf1f0b5775af290fa37fb4615ae7523.en: Ice hockey at Helsinki Ice Hall: HIFK meets JYP on 16 February 2027 at 18:30. HIFK, founded in 1897, is the oldest ice hockey team in the Helsinki metropolitan area. Tickets from Ticketmaster.

b06a8b3e9638d7c01facb0e319336190926c1d74.en: Australian rock band Melrose Avenue plays Tavastia-klubi on 16 February 2027, with doors at 19:00. The band is known for energetic live shows and catchy songs. Tickets 48 euros from Tiketti, 18+.

aca8dfd0c4cc9663ce30c20e626521719cf74603.en: Guitarist Mikko Siirola presents classical guitar at Oodi's Maijansali on 16 February 2027 at 19:00, as part of a library tour. He plays and talks about the classical guitar world, and audience questions are welcome.

862ec217fe8ba083aa5f002d2e1812c8301b51f6.en: An English-language public lecture at Opistotalo on Ray Bradbury's Fahrenheit 451, a dystopia in which firemen start fires and some characters become living books. Free entry, no pre-registration, limited seats.

d0c6e9e16438fee31ca6bb1d1cb339876800cd2a.en: Musica nova Helsinki 2027 at Musiikkitalo invites audiences to explore phenomena, art and the essence of sound from different perspectives, presented by the Helsinki Philharmonic.

51226f4b7ccbead723db4c35f9884dfa7e709c09.en: Five Finger Death Punch plays Veikkaus Arena on 22 February 2027 on their 20th anniversary world tour, with Lamb of God and Bleed From Within as guests. Doors at 18:00, tickets 67-137 euros from Ticketmaster.

7a5aaddfed44ea4f3cce3b4dde84341fad4a000a.en: Tarja Turunen brings her Frisson Live 2027 tour to House of Culture on 24 February 2027, starting at 17:30. Tickets from Lippupiste.

fb3c78ebfd6c02fbb07d291317f81565f9cc0401.en: Assembly Winter 2027, Finland's biggest gaming festival, runs at Messukeskus from 25 to 28 February 2027 with games, digital art, cosplay and a large variety of programmes. Tickets from Tiketti, recommended from age 13.

8f5d5f63c85c9cdefbcf5449d66f53ba0bdb4e42.en: American performer Morgan Jay brings his La Dolce Vita tour to House of Culture on 1 and 2 March 2027, mixing music and stand-up with an autotune microphone and audience improvisation. Performed in English, 16+, tickets from 35 euros.

4cd74749a37899e6bc157e20b34cd34c8d77eafc.en: Helsinki International Horse Show at Messukeskus on 4-7 March 2027 combines top sport with family entertainment, including the Longines FEI Jumping World Cup. The show attracts over 50,000 visitors.

142261ca4637849ae5084e3ee9e96730ab8adfbf.en: HPO Fokus: pianist Jean-Yves Thibaudet returns to Musiikkitalo by popular demand for three evenings of piano art, presented by the Helsinki Philharmonic.

94e652b7a2d04ec2d51dbce33811e5fd1e8e5151.en: Dead Poet Society from Boston plays Tiivistämö on 5 March 2027, their first show in Finland. Their alternative rock blends hard rock, grunge and blues rock. Doors at 20:30, tickets from 29.50 euros plus fee, 18+.

d5dfab84792ce6dfb97205c90fd38f931f25338c.en: Ice hockey at Helsinki Ice Hall: HIFK meets HPK on 10 March 2027 at 18:30. HIFK, founded in 1897, is the oldest ice hockey team in the Helsinki metropolitan area. Tickets from Ticketmaster.

e8288a9aef7cd507bcbdc54d881b8e300b67d0ed.en: HPO Fokus: pianist Jean-Yves Thibaudet plays George Gershwin's Piano Concerto at Musiikkitalo. Gershwin did not abandon his musical mother tongue, and the work is jazz from start to finish.

2a82f061bf2afa5e6367ff929eba4cea166352bd.en: Swedish musician Tomas Ledin performs his Symphonia Politropou project at Veikkaus Arena on 12 March 2027, with doors at 18:30 and the concert at 20:00. Tickets from Ticketmaster.

a316fa5395da22e2d7c7d088520bb98d27320a0d.en: Toxic Fest 2027 at Lepakkomies on 12-13 March brings Finnish death metal, grindcore and extreme metal bands together, with Swedish grindcore legend The Arson Project as the main guest. Tickets 36 euros for two days, 20 euros per day, 18+.

c89bafd57006f99d6d558d9432409012c007175a.en: The HPO's traditional Junior Concert at Musiikkitalo, where Helsinki fifth-grade music students perform together with the Helsinki Philharmonic Orchestra in a shared celebration of music.

e05bde42f5ac86ebd5459f53e5a67a2cc142e49e.en: Villa Gyllenberg presents Finnish women sculptors of the 19th and early 20th centuries, including Essi Renvall, Viivi Paarmio-Vallgren and Venny Soldan-Brofeldt, from 17 March to 29 August 2027. Admission 10/12 euros, under 18 free.

0c911648bc7c27dd6e477bf6c91c55e26af92415.en: Premium suite tickets for the Carreras & Domingo concert at Veikkaus Arena include a private suite for up to 10 guests, early entry, private drinks service, a private restroom and a premium menu. Suite balcony seating.

ad4e298855e6c49cc61b3eac34178025f287bb00.en: Ricky-Tick Big Band and Julkinen Sana perform a charity concert at House of Culture on 18 March 2027, 19:00-21:30, blending jazz, hip hop, soul and funk. Tickets 53.60 euros, 18+.

17d126d9685b1e0b192650f6ed761628ad2dab98.en: José Carreras and Plácido Domingo perform Legends Together Again at Veikkaus Arena on 18 March 2027. Doors open at 18:00 and the show starts at 20:00. Tickets from 79.90 euros from Ticketmaster.

201ebe9509df3daf907e0da364a4382380d332a1.en: Legazy Seat tickets for the Carreras & Domingo concert at Veikkaus Arena include a lower-tier seat, a dedicated entrance, a welcome drink, a three-course menu, a cloakroom and premium staff service.

5897471cea849b90fb9f432fd4315bb6f38c5c61.en: Spring Fair 2027 at Messukeskus on 18-21 March brings new products and ideas for home, garden, cabin and interior design, plus organic food and adventure sections. Admission 14-20 euros, and the ticket also covers the Golf Fair.

fc923a5c81a3847a9c6ca38c71779ffed2fcc789.en: HPO Symphonic Dances at Musiikkitalo marks the long-awaited return to Helsinki of conductor Ariane Matiakh, leading a programme of symphonic dance music.
