9fa5002eb464e0f317cddf8b62f1e87a1079cd03.en: The Encounters Club's Evening with the Winds at Musiikkitalo, an arena for creative ideas and surprising encounters with Helsinki Philharmonic musicians.

7bb3913b2c4f60460b34c1acd2d9fd868c077d8d.en: In Kalervo Palsa's World at Kiasma explores the work of Kalervo Palsa (1947-1987), a maverick who painted in a small outbuilding in Kittilä. His themes include loneliness, death and life in the remote north, shown alongside contemporary artists.

8094c72e901db0a5e192cde56b57655233682c20.en: Golf Fair 2027 at Messukeskus on 19-21 March offers rule updates, competitive highlights, new equipment to try and a Start Golf area. The ticket also gives access to the Spring Fair.

aecec6a9994eca47a124da6ed68ec491ed1bad95.en: Swedish band Dina Ögon plays Tavastia-klubi on 20 March 2027, 19:00-23:00. Their sound blends folk rock, indie, soul, jazz and hip hop with the Swedish pop tradition. Age limit 18+.

5fc58a79de27428a79fe3b53b0eea066ffd0541c.en: HPO's Towards the Heights, an Easter programme of works by composers who distanced themselves from traditional church music, at Musiikkitalo.

967b03e52f8c2c99a6a15a3bbf8d9b445c396908.en: The American Car Show at Messukeskus on 26-28 March 2027, with hundreds of vehicles, family-friendly side events and Easter activities. Tickets from 20 euros.

35540b3b51d5a88d44d8b9899d5c15a251e1b944.en: The Helsinki Philharmonic Orchestra performs Béla Bartók's Concerto for Orchestra at Musiikkitalo without a conductor, which makes for a high-stakes evening.

0b10f10990a9dbcbd4ce132cacd5f15fa1a879e4.en: Food 2027 at Messukeskus on 2-4 April 2027 brings food and drink companies together with consumers who want to taste, discover new products and find ideas for everyday life and celebrations.

984fb7e8969cbc36283acf5ea53a03a1b6cfb728.en: Arctic Lights Comic Con 2027 at Messukeskus on 3-4 April 2027 brings superheroes, comics, influencers, K-pop and cosplay together for tens of thousands of fans of pop culture.

187da4218080813c380af8b51bcd42d54b330f62.en: Arctic Lights Comic Con 2027 at Messukeskus, 3-4 April 2027. The venue is fully accessible, assistants enter free with the same ticket, and guide and assistance dogs are welcome.

400a5c62d84c4571291c1996cb4916d09e668780.en: A talk on La Movida Madrileña, the Madrid youth counterculture of the late 1970s. It rebelled against Franco-era repression and coined many colloquial words still in use today. Held at Arbis.

9dbbc16ac4957a63c16572baab02aa9156d0c656.en: HPO's Bach, Beach & Brahms at Musiikkitalo features Amy Beach's Piano Concerto, heard in Finland for the first time. Beach broke through several glass ceilings as a composer and pianist.

438e8c97563dcac68b778ef1f7bcef218864c3fe.en: Helsinki Ink, one of the largest tattoo events in the Nordic countries, takes place at Cable Factory's Merikaapelihalli on 9-11 April 2027, with many Finnish and international artists. Age limit 18+.

f10ca0f7c77bc39130b8428672b83964bde351ca.en: Elin Danielson-Gambogi, a retrospective at Ateneum from 9 April to 19 September 2027 with almost 200 works from her career in Paris, Brittany, Italy and Åland. She was the first Finn to exhibit at the Venice Biennale in 1899.

364e66cdcad9a1a43456f64dac4dfc346495df9d.en: Arbis ensembles, soloists and music teachers close the school year with a swinging spring concert. Everyone is welcome to attend.

98b62fe599817749860371e2e49847fecb18c8fc.en: Legazy Seat tickets for Rush's Fifty Something show at Veikkaus Arena include a lower-tier seat, a dedicated entrance, a welcome drink, a starter and main course, a cloakroom and premium staff service.

190e079e23c42ef773ec25b77c0f1774dcb686f4.en: The progressive rock band Rush returns after more than a decade for its Fifty Something tour at Veikkaus Arena on 10 April 2027. Each night they play two sets from a catalogue of over 40 songs. Doors 18:30, tickets 84.90-159.90 euros.

d2f7b5bccb5c909c3a8c3461e59e34154e52d325.en: A free English-language public talk at Opistotalo on Kurt Vonnegut, marking the 20th anniversary of his death. It covers his anti-war humanism, his concern for the planet and his legacy. No pre-registration, limited seats.

a30d40398a1c9b9388df578896c9a9be28620344.en: HPO's Kingdom of the Seas at Musiikkitalo is conducted by Jun Märkl, a specialist in French music, with principal flutist Niamh McKenna as soloist.

18f85951d6275dd0c4cb34c96eb999a85478dfa4.en: HPO Encounters Club: Journey of the Sea Cow at Musiikkitalo, where Klimatkvartetten joins author Iida Turpeinen to combine classical music, climate science and nature conservation.

423296e60cea7091d1de4c97cf22883905f131a4.en: A free language taster day at Opistotalo on 17 and 18 April introduces courses from Greek and Chinese to Hindi, Arabic and Korean, plus refresher sessions and a sing-along. Free entry, no registration.

ab3ef1fd9e7f4e63de2143d6413c704f6be32931.en: An exhibition in the Hôtel de Ville's Grande Galerie, from 18 September to 31 October 2026, on the 90 years of the Comité d'entraide Saint-Sauveur, founded in 1935 and now supporting older residents. Built from photos, programmes and members' memories.

144929cd72e42030cd4e4d2cb327cc72ec8746b3.en: A month of events in Wattignies for Octobre rose, breast cancer awareness: a floral exhibition by local residents in the town hall from 1 to 29 October, and a women's health workshop on Friday 16 October from 9:00 to 11:00.

643eebc415a562f33fa6734f54de48c01f2d032c.en: An exhibition at the Maison des associations in Lille, Nos vies entrelacées, by La Leche League, with photos of 24 breastfeeding families from the Nord and Pas-de-Calais that celebrate breastfeeding in everyday public life.

6d321c9a730653514ee573a08ead42dfb2033118.en: An industry breakfast meeting on 22 September 2026 at AFPI in Marcq-en-Barœul, for industrial leaders and CSR or QSE managers, organised by the Métropole Européenne de Lille, the Pévèle-Carembault community and partners.

9d09f4614798db32390a82fae668c2f2fa05799d.en: A touring exhibition at the Maison des associations in Lille by the association Les Papillons Blancs, a photo comic strip titled Une visite surprise: Je ne peux pas, j'ai piscine.

55b6d39cb4c38f779fed7ebbdd221f119a7cc641.en: An acting-for-camera course for children aged 10 to 14 with actor Valentin Maerte at QUANTA. It covers lighting, sound and shot types, and requires at least one year of theatre practice.

abb96e99a802b781795135d3c78e2f19ec15600f.en: Bike confidence sessions for adult women in Roubaix, free, in small groups of eight. Four two-hour sessions per neighbourhood, from 19 to 31 October, with bikes provided. Registration before 12 October.

ad50bb71304a2bec08276e91d4e2f0dce67dc8f5.en: Five mornings of cycling lessons over two weeks in the school holidays at the Parc des Sports, led by qualified instructors. Places are limited and registration is required.

34ce06f0c6b342165b1a05ef987f28f3edf629d5.en: Circus courses for children during the autumn holidays at Le Cirque du Bout du Monde, from 19 to 30 October, for ages 3 to 15, with a sign-up opening on 18 September.

430c0c2d720a7edbf9fc4ec93dcd71fbd0e92eca.en: Week-long holiday craft courses at MUba Eugène Leroy in Tourcoing, for ages 5 to 7 and 8 to 12, in the weeks of 19 and 26 October. Each course creates an object.

9334be1648f4e5883dccf6cec85a0cfc97ab3ab1.en: A Plantu caricature exhibition, Drôle de peuple, at La Source, presented by the Roncq-Delbrück association. It looks at French-German relations since the 1970s, marking the 50th anniversary of the Élysée Treaty.

2190eccbde873044bb14513e5e203763cdf08367.en: An ancient Greece course at the Asnapio archaeological park, with an introduction to the Greek alphabet, the Olympian gods and Greek theatre. Bookings by phone, with picnic lunches to bring.

560cd476e4bc1a39b458773d38f9d617c5d32f4d.en: A participatory exhibition by the association Ensemble Autrement for the mental health awareness weeks, about links between artistic practice and mental health, with works by emerging and established artists.

b4ab2a3cc494c9b11a4fb302cc325c870655b099.en: A parent-child visit and workshop at the Hôtel de Ville in Lille on the history of the song Le P'tit Quinquin, followed by a workshop to write a new lullaby in any language. Free, booking required; for ages 10 and up with an adult.

dde61b2b25a8a4e87bd6ee60976060bec1d46949.en: A weekly story and play session for babies and their parents at the Médiathèque André Malraux in Tourcoing, every Thursday from 10:00 to 11:30.

68d9a8a995676a3eb9cc60d5c04b9ef3a4214ef4.en: The Beatmaking week at FLOW in Lille from 20 to 25 October 2026, with workshops, a radio education programme and a Beatbattle.

075ea931235d3eed8c943cf4129849456d1444f5.en: An art workshop at Atelier 2 in the Ferme Saint-Sauveur for children aged 3 to 5, on winter accessories such as gloves and hats, turned into characters and stories. Bring an apron and a snack; a 9-euro stage membership is needed for a first course.

39309095fa71bd3b4444ea530c6b4fe5ef77a370.en: Four media-education workshops at FLOW from 20 to 23 October, on radio and beatmaking, with a public showing on Sunday 25 October in the FLOW hall, just before the Beatbattle. Free, with registration.

9e418e231ed4bf14786196669a1be8e1c83924ca.en: A kitchen-play installation at the Médiathèque André Malraux in Tourcoing for children aged 3 to 8, as part of the science festival.

3788e8887b5eff5e5a20239ca6646fc5e9fa7f07.en: A reading and talk at the Hôtel de Ville in Lille on the song Le P'tit Quinquin, with an archives visit and a call to write a new version of the lullaby.

091e3eed5a3ca18101368c145bedce44ed235410.en: Three beatmaking workshops from the Lille collective La Session at FLOW, for teenagers on 20 to 22 October and adults on 24 October. Registration by email, 3 euros on the day.

5c2534c92ce2d6a98215b1dd81db34e06f7eee22.en: A sound walk and workshops at the Médiathèque de Roubaix, Quartiers en résonance, with a musician and a visual artist, collecting sounds from the neighbourhood and making music and paintings. Sessions on 21, 22 and 24 October.

30f56e66c5e9535dbdc58ad77427632181ccf992.en: A marionette show, Chatô Pointu, by the Théâtre Mariska at the Spotlight in Lille, about a boy who becomes a knight to save a princess. For ages 2.5 and up, lasting 45 minutes.

e6fe8c8d39aa7cb511bab4cbd2571c35d0d2c2f1.en: Four anniversaries at Le Vestiaire in Roubaix, from 15 to 31 October, with an art installation by the Grand Bassin collective, a poster retrospective for three neighbouring institutions, and an evening on 23 October.

9a6843193c5436f938ee7c72034e2f6461a30631.en: A Swedish gymnastics class at La Condition Publique in Roubaix on Thursdays from 12:20 to 13:15. No booking needed; bring trainers and a mat.

d65471b6d201d372d758c526a8bd2f93f3cdccb2.en: An exhibition at the Colysée in Lambersart, Paysages en transition, with thirteen artists looking at how landscapes change, with a children's project on plant growth at two local schools.

2698bcf3d1fc316271769e72444435040b6219c6.en: Autumn holiday activities at the Médiathèque Till L'Espiègle, including painting, a board game afternoon, a pumpkin workshop, a Halloween workshop and storytelling sessions on various days.

5eadf506eba26bece4cc7184e73f11e538c39f97.en: Mill visits and workshops during the autumn holidays at the Musée des Moulins in Villeneuve-d'Ascq, with guided tours of the two 18th-century mills and workshops on flour and windmill models.

cba055ae6e1d31965a662ed076ad12fb32eacf95.en: A holiday visit to the Musée du Terroir in Villeneuve-d'Ascq, on Wednesdays 21 and 28 October from 15:00 to 16:30, with a guide showing life in the early 20th century. Free workshops include gaufres and writing with pens.

6c56f94372b8c6a93b55cb6a022f8cb463281a50.en: A Halloween workshop for children aged 7 to 10 at the Musée des Moulins on Thursday 22 October from 13:30 to 16:30, making scary creatures from nuts and visiting the seed library and the oil mill.

15df3efbe4237e485f1895dc33f75f7321feb6eb.en: An exhibition at the Musée La Manufacture in Roubaix, Roubaix Génie Textile, on the 70-plus textile players now based in the city, from fibre makers and schools to fashion brands, artisans and artists.

72ea0cf35ea9300afa6d4071d0474b49db6c5734.en: A ceramics workshop at the Asnapio archaeological park for children aged 3 and up, making pots, whistles and dice with clay. No booking; guided visits of the buildings are included.

15d3d9e65989a2d6ebd04b3026126f4c720a22a1.en: Sports holiday activities in the autumn school holidays, from 19 to 30 October, with climbing, handball, boxing, badminton, swimming and futsal. Places are limited; register at your neighbourhood town hall, priced by family coefficient.

f5b51e63928db77a2ff00af484c719917b3c67b6.en: A family games afternoon with oversized games at the Médiathèque André Malraux in Tourcoing. Bad losers are welcome.

3cf3c379076136f6bb2e5e0b9dc01c1ecc6daa5d.en: An exhibition at La Pouponnière, Mémoire d'enfants, by artists Naomi van Niekerk and Arnaud van Vliet, based on archives and testimonies about the children once cared for at the site. Opening on Wednesday 14 October at 18:00.

6dd27a5f190051540866b54759b038c0b4b792a6.en: A games afternoon at the Médiathèque Till L'Espiègle on Thursday 22 October from 14:00 to 16:00, with the Vaisseau Fantôme ludothèque. Free and open to all.

eaa7a7b92297913215a515692f4bad380e69433a.en: A winter-themed art workshop at Atelier 2 in the Ferme Saint-Sauveur for children aged 6 to 12, turning gloves and hats into characters and stories. Bring an apron and a snack; a 9-euro stage membership is needed.

3d4dc99e3c51c94b46a660cd4049ef63a3ad6d0d.en: An exhibition at the Espace Le Carré in Lille by Hideyuki Ishibashi, Le Ciel céleste, a dialogue with the Swedish writer and photographer August Strindberg, made as part of the Bicentenaire de la Photographie.

f47315ab2f034210566e8a4e14ee3d2f2d13d495.en: The same exhibition, Le Ciel céleste, at the Espace Le Carré's municipal contemporary art space, with works in moon dust and silver images, co-curated by Ishibashi and Lucie Ménard.

17ee9a85b2450d27a9069d6155f4671115732c0c.en: A puppet show for children aged 3 and up at Le P'tit Jacques theatre in Lille, Intrigue au château, in which a tour of a gallery of portraits turns into a mystery with secret passages.

2552afff5b9d7470d1a45278198d600710abcb1a.en: An immersive, playful sensory route for young children at the Forum départemental des Sciences on urban birds, touching, listening and learning about nature. Booking advised; 16 places.

86083bdfe663c480826d0395aa90bab448d2d698.en: A photo reportage course with photographers Julien Pitinome and Kelyan Blanchard at the Condition Publique in Roubaix, covering shooting, interviews and portraits. For ages 12 and up.

f7164e3974b18f0ea0ea983a8364c04a5821a2f1.en: A parent and child craft workshop with recycled materials at the Médiathèque Lille Wazemmes, for ages 6 and up. Registration advised.

93d3189db1a27b411c1f7491dd7bfdf491283355.en: A guided visit of the Maison Thieffry Frères in Roubaix, a linen maker since 1837, housed in a former textile site in the Épeule district. Free on booking, part of the Roubaix Génie Textile exhibition.

acabfd8f33f6a0c0b0140ca83b5aba492bbd887c.en: A surprise monthly creative workshop for parents and children aged 4 and up at the Médiathèque de Fives, run with the association L'école et son quartier. Free, registration needed as a pair.

dc20317e1c667fe5d2ca0d4258e85bdff923aeab.en: A workshop at the Forum des Sciences on the history of flight, how animals fly and a paper plane contest, linked to the Tous à plumes. exhibition. Booking advised.

4815870261c9c0e61340b1ed1ec417e3d3c92794.en: A family film, Les Tourouges et les Toubleus, at the Médiathèque de Roubaix La Grand-Plage, a Romeo-and-Juliet tale between two alien tribes, with three short films on difference and tolerance. 37 minutes; groups must book.

0285601d6b6302a2e96723fff708a7e092e6d430.en: A drawing workshop at the Médiathèque du Vieux-Lille on Thursday 22 October from 15:00 to 16:00, where an adult and a child aged 4 to 6 paint a portrait of the Megalosaurus with inks. Free, booking required.

adddee18eda72357ac03e067c18ed953675a728c.en: A playful family visit of the Maison natale Charles de Gaulle in Lille, with challenges and puzzles in each room. For ages 7 and up, one hour, 2 euros extra per person.

9aaa827595eb52d96eb63b14a5a3b8df5a1bda51.en: An exhibition at the Bureau d'Art et de Recherche, Plaisirs de plage, which looks at the Mediterranean beach through photos, paintings and documents by four artists. Runs 19 September to 14 November 2026.

3a6d5b3eea02b2c3841fca66228daf219d65520c.en: A week of Semaine Bleue activities in Lille's Rouges Barres hall, including an adapted walk on Monday 19 October, a board game afternoon, and a fall-prevention workshop on Thursday 22 October. No booking.

819786ba03cf4212eadb6e6c3bf849a76a11d478.en: A concert at the Opéra de Lille, L'archipel du désir, with mezzo-soprano Brenda Poupard and pianist Kaoli Ono, performing songs by Augusta Holmès, Pauline Viardot, Rita Strohl and Debussy.

2f97b1c68e3b7d2849d5606c26c79cc19408bfd0.en: A meeting at the Espace Le Carré with historian of photography Clément Chéroux, moderated by curator Lucie Ménard, around Hideyuki Ishibashi's exhibition Le Ciel céleste.

88bc55b19b07c6faf410f473ee09edb5901bf0b3.en: The same meeting at the Espace Le Carré with Clément Chéroux and Hideyuki Ishibashi, with an exchange about the exhibition, its sources and technical aspects.

dc9c32168942597a98548e6abc3f3e71282ed4d6.en: A talk at the Hôtel de Ville in Tourcoing on how to choose a heating system, with a focus on heat pumps. Covers efficiency, noise, cost and grants. Thursday 22 October from 18:30 to 20:00, booking on the city website.

e8276b3eeb54f90167f9ca778ccb2274d53425d3.en: A tasting, workshop and dance performance by the company Nos Corps and Albedo Kitchen, with a cookery demonstration on eating better, a body workshop and a show of two solos based on Sylvia Plath's poems. Free; places are limited.

ffd650947ed7b6877d56a8bc8ab62e0b35d87061.en: A deep-listening session at FLOW in Lille on 2Pac's album All Eyez On Me, with the journalist and author Maxime Delcourt, covering its context, legacy and musical signature.

1ac0f037d038d76313159d0bfb53e1bc5de9c202.en: A flamenco-inspired cardio fitness class at Ibérica in Seclin, on Thursdays at 19:00, using flamenco gestures, no flamenco shoes needed. 4 to 5 euros per session, with reduced rates for Seclin residents and members.

a7bbc13b2ceda49a7869f63f1a680b6b0539c2f4.en: A talk-show with comedian Jonathan Lambert at the Tripostal in Lille, part of the Éclats du rire. exhibition by lille3000, discussing his art influences and his photo-novel Qui a volé mes jambes?.

f4898b4fd198d643c9cdbb00690ffbcd5d86e82e.en: A concert by the rapper Orelsan at the Zénith de Lille, with a new 2026 tour. Presale began on 4 March 2026 at 12:00.

e587323018f4e8ba66d8ac349e8212c8f007726f.en: Two experimental documentaries by James Benning, Allensworth and Two Cabins, shown at the Palais des Beaux-Arts auditorium as part of a US cycle. One portrays a self-governed Black town in California; the other recreates two cabins.

e0f76b231d33aa7af75d72117ec0d16234b5ce18.en: A concert by the rap group Sniper at La Condition Publique in Roubaix, a founding French rap group from 1997, now touring as a duo with Aketo and Tunisiano, playing classics and new songs.

e88d754ff7bcc724ede2e9e2ba2e0d3996c106fa.en: A concert by Sniper at La Condition Publique on Thursday 22 October 2026, organised by Tu m'étonnes Productions. The group, founded in 1997 in Val-d'Oise, returns as a duo.

584aad93864873c43552f6b1fc8028760e7a4662.en: A concert at La Malterie by the free-improvisation duo Tashi Dorji and Audrey Chen, with the support act Kaze, as part of the Muzzix series.

5d002a2a7aa43ced841b422143f819d191d773f8.en: A weekly Thursday night at Le Bistrot de St So, Shii Foo Miix, with a happy hour from 18:00 to 20:00 and a snack from 19:00 to 22:00. On 22 October the DJ set is by the Paris digger Peet.

16a22c2c87805e45824e0b555892057a0a5c4252.en: An Irish session at Le Musical, with fiddle, guitar, harmonica, flutes, bagpipes and mandolin, plus a whiskey tasting. Free entry; the bar is open from 17:00 on most days.

f0582529ea7541f4d714b0bf2b0067400d4e0d51.en: A concert by Sniper at La Condition Publique in Roubaix on 17 October 2026, the founding French rap group from Val-d'Oise on its duo tour.

bb190a4f38575f0b5151626013ab85c5d20aefd1.en: A show by Bernard Werber at the Théâtre Sébastopol, V.I.E. (Voyage Intérieur Expérimental), a guided inner-journey performance mixing storytelling, meditation, humour and relaxing music.

1a04ec6d6a354a278910a0b4c5138424c56e1139.en: A concert by the duo Picon Mon Amour at the BAM on Thursday 22 October 2026 at 20:30, with their irreverent songs sung in two voices. Tickets 9 euros, 6 euros reduced.

acf97d7d470d104161007b46e88c9136d2183d0c.en: A film programme chosen by the volunteers of the Lille short film festival at L'Hybride, a selection of favourites from hundreds of films viewed. For ages 16 and up, about 1.5 hours with an interval.

78a2877dcdbe90482c84a2295c87db81e0b895fc.en: The Luminiscence show Lille #2, L'Odyssée Céleste, at the Cathédrale Notre-Dame de la Treille, with 3D projections, live music and immersive narration, after the company's tour of cathedrals around the world.

0a644b5a75af171bfb4a68fb35c8db355248b78f.en: A party at the Slalom club in Lille on Thursday 22 October from midnight to 06:00, Kiss My Erasmus: Latinos vs Le Reste du Monde. Under-18s are not admitted, and ID may be checked.

5f64b114bbc1cb7b6f7f220d994b751088b0d80d.en: A visit to the Musée de l'Hospice Comtesse in Lille, a former hospital founded in 1237 by Countess Jeanne of Flanders, now housing the city's art and history museum with period rooms.

144f69dd3b2a8dc57d2922fd5d32a512b6e96a03.en: An overview of La Condition Publique in Roubaix, a creative venue with temporary and permanent exhibitions, concerts, theatre, dance, workshops and a recreational hall.

eff41ab680116e758cda713970a9b6f6cb47e52b.en: The LaM collection re-hung as Obsession, a thematic route through the 20th and 21st centuries that pairs modern art, art brut and contemporary art, with monographic rooms for Modigliani, Henry Darger and Miriam Cahn.

8d6481061fc7493f5edc7298f3dcd7c97d6c1d3a.en: The exhibition Singulières at the LaM, with more than 300 works by 70 women artists, many self-taught or from outside the art world, drawn largely from the L'Aracine collection and several loans.

5043e08aa351b86f2c47649626b59ca320a03be4.en: A visit of the La Manufacture museum in Roubaix, set in an authentic industrial space where the noise of looms recreates textile mills and the working conditions of their workers.

4b76c422924c7d5e9a70e0f59e96d121df2476e7.en: An exhibition at the Forum départemental des Sciences on the history of telecommunications and the transformations of digital technology, made with Orange, Proscitec and the regional telecom museum.

21730574b9325b7886a4fb84e101a2b3567ec422.en: Free entry to the Mémorial Ascq 1944 each Wednesday from 13:30 to 17:00, which commemorates the killing of 86 civilians in April 1944. Guided walks around Ascq cost 3 euros on booking.

1255dca6861f3b8582939e07a0108825b8815535.en: The LaM's new raw programme for young creation, with its first artist Jessy Razafimandimby, born in Madagascar in 1995, whose installations use found objects, some bought at Lille's Braderie in 2025.

e37b8cb7fe93bd30493d54c36b5ab7f1438b074c.en: Weekly Wednesday art workshops for children at the LaM, exploring art movements and techniques. In partnership with the Opéra de Lille, with a singing workshop each term. A 10% discount applies for a second child.

d760f1bebe53af430384f1286a1e06fd413f3f16.en: An overview of the Palais des Beaux-Arts in Lille, with works from Donatello, Rubens, Monet, Goya and Picasso, covering European art from the 12th to the 20th century.

18295e0987404abe6003f3bafb4195b865ae421f.en: The collective exhibition Callisto at Albedo Kitchen in Lille, with works by six artists including Chantal Joffe, Paul Noble and Georgina Starr, as part of Forgotten Floors. Opening on 26 September 2026.

9bf1022f98f5ffa00b3c073fb7d6dc2b64acc045.en: An exhibition of American fibre artist Sheila Hicks at the Palais des Beaux-Arts, the first woman to exhibit in its atrium, with a new route through the collections. Guided visits on Saturdays and Sundays at 15:00.

55c5fc895c15188a98d11bac6466745ce252115f.en: A museum on the Battle of Fromelles in July 1916, when British and Australian soldiers fought three German regiments across four kilometres. It has been a Musée de France since 2023.

aaaba377d5f95805a909ebec81067b4d6a69cd7f.en: A visit to the Villa Cavrois, a modernist château commissioned in 1929, designed around air, light and hygiene, restored after its listing as a historic monument and completed in 2015.

b0fc76c40656d0f156ee28e5ad11b411776b3fba.en: A photography exhibition at the Institut du monde arabe in Tourcoing, Le Liban de Serge Najjar, showing building-site photos by a self-taught Beirut photographer, which echo geometric abstract painting.

4bc6fe070ed655bdd853110f70baaf598bd7bcb7.en: A community bar at La Ferme d'en Haut in Villeneuve-d'Ascq, the Estaminet, run by a collective of five associations, open on weekends from 15:00 to 19:00 with local products and an exhibition every two months.

828756087521a786d19ee74b86baa9a7fe19e72c.en: A photography collection at the Médiathèque Jean Lévy in Lille, Collection Pecqueur, with prints, glass plates and autochromes, on show from 19 September 2026 to 20 March 2027. Monthly guided visits on first Saturdays.

6c8674ee6dc675ec2a031e8ccc1d114afad2a75a.en: An exhibition at the Forum départemental des Sciences on the diversity of birds and why many species are threatened, through sensory immersion, sound, touch and sight. For all ages.

8e02d033f02a4f950465473357a58af9ac1341bf.en: A dialogue between two architectural sites at the Villa Cavrois in Lille, linking the 1911 Palais Stoclet with the 1932 villa and its influences.

93b7da55179b21ac8e1a37a8363475089d366bf3.en: A 45-minute virtual reality experience, Éternelle Notre-Dame, at the Centre d'Art Sacré in Lille, which lets visitors move through Notre-Dame de Paris with a headset. The show has already drawn about 700,000 viewers.

b9f9fe6c01d84ad6af27cbabb7e8e46542a73e60.en: An exhibition at the Maison natale Charles de Gaulle, Fiat lux., on the 19th-century quest for light, from candles and oil lamps to gas and electricity, including the electrification of Lille.

0c97f231f50a84addcc2f0fde2f4203c61ec14ae.en: A photo exhibition at the Théâtre du Nord, République, by Bérangère Fromont, showing young people and skateboarders on Place de la République in Paris, as places of protest, calm and quiet resistance.

5c2c858df84ae2de073fa27798063508fa69a97a.en: An exhibition at the Galerie Nadar in Tourcoing's médiathèque on 40 years of the Tourcoing Jazz Festival, through portraits by the photographer Jacques Grossemy, who has been the festival's official photographer since 1989.

8c7846707a00d20b39613ae0e336cbd947754e61.en: A free exhibition for children aged 6 to 10 at the Palais des Beaux-Arts in Lille, Musée des enfants: Grandeur Nature, about living things, climate, seasons and the place of humans in nature. Family flash visits run on Wednesdays, Saturdays and Sundays.

97c578c1571d2bba4435b996a4abc6036d137cd5.en: An exhibition at Le Tripostal in Lille, Éclats du rire., where the 22 regional contemporary art funds come together for the first time to show art linked to humour, with works from emerging and established French artists.

7028c2c69f11a73d42574f19aaf9f9ee27c57e47.en: The 28th Panorama exhibition at Le Fresnoy in Tourcoing, showing nearly 50 new works by its artists, films, installations, performances and interactive pieces, themed on the invisible.

6efdeecbd8d4fa48067454f6ed276a5e5e891f4b.en: An exhibition at the Musée du château de Flers from 19 September 2026 to 29 January 2027, Formes d'eau, showing local artists' work on water, with children's activities.

10728ad4ed4bdb7b941d73cbc704a0a6f0dda91b.en: A joint exhibition at the Maison Folie Hospice d'Havré in Tourcoing, ça Jazz., with photographers, writers, illustrators and musicians, running from 20 June to 19 December 2026.

77982b4da8bbeacedbc3851d77b35240dad2433d.en: A guided tour with a mediator of the Maison natale Charles de Gaulle in Lille, a Belle Époque family home where the young Charles de Gaulle grew up. Stories of family life are told room by room.

00638ecb72d5f7af673a6f96486a91b2496f978e.en: A free trade fair in Wattrelos at the salle Roger Salengro on 23, 24 and 25 October, from 10:00 to 19:00, with around 80 exhibitors, a quarter of them from Wattrelos.

8c6d3ae902fe3e24d6b4fad8ab694996d5317099.en: A shared lunch for the Semaine Bleue in Wattrelos at the Salle Georges Brassens, prepared by a training centre and served with young people from the youth centre, followed by a bingo. 3 euros with the Lez'aînés card; registration by 5 October.

6c1d323229c45af1f19220de659400608b2fd2ea.en: Free visits for grandparents and grandchildren at the Institut du monde arabe in Tourcoing during school holidays on Fridays, to see the Serge Najjar exhibition about Lebanon.

c7b98011cedac1e2280882356f3b1dbfb2138796.en: A mosaic workshop for children aged 7 to 10 at the Musée du Terroir in Villeneuve-d'Ascq on Friday 23 October from 13:30 to 16:30, using pieces of tile to make a personal picture. A snack is included.

8bbbefe1e3aaa18aecd048e3cbf303dc07a37ff1.en: An escape game for ages 6 and up at the Asnapio archaeological park, where players explore habitats, solve puzzles and uncover the secrets of ancient civilisations to save the park. No booking.

25100c92efd52020f18ea7785fffe1d01b59befc.en: Free Friday afternoons at the LaM for people aged 65 and over, with short visits, art history talks, lectures, readings and workshops, followed by coffee or tea. Intergenerational sessions run in school holidays.

9bd6f4eeb0c81184dbca59ff0d929a64f00a804c.en: A free board-game session for adults and children at the Médiathèque du Vieux-Lille, with games selected by the librarians. Children stay under the supervision of an adult.

0b28d09205aa7357dace71d74c7af0dcd9607639.en: A practical workshop on energy poverty at a venue in Lille on Friday 23 October from 14:00 to 16:00, showing small devices that cut energy use and bills. Limited to 8 people; run by the Compagnons Bâtisseurs.

f2958bf4d874d65c241e4bfed092a9f7e5453098.en: A live music session at FLOW in Lille with Lucci', in which a local artist's unreleased track is reworked and produced on stage. Artists from the Hauts-de-France region can apply by sending two unreleased tracks; attendance needs registration.

7768d09e5821a7fb00b5fb6e9df10a54da63a5a2.en: A photo exhibition at the Bibliothèque de Lys-les-Lannoy, La Méditerranée, entre deux eaux, by the association Les amis de Poséidon, showing the underwater side of the Mediterranean and its fragile ecosystem.

f50a654ab7ece6cc32a839adefc70deb95d1d9dc.en: A pumpkin paper-craft workshop at the Médiathèque Till L'Espiègle on Friday 23 October from 14:00 to 17:00, ahead of Halloween. Free, for ages 10 and up.

29a3d3de26ea5911f23a70f6ea03594e645a29db.en: A manga workshop at La Source, where participants draw inspiration from new releases to create their own story.

82f496d4492de5b3d37971ade845fad6adc65031.en: A farm investigation for ages 7 and up at the Ferme pédagogique Marcel Dhénin in Lille, where children use clues such as fur, feathers and tracks to piece together what happened. Free, registration required.

23e89df2e68f8563dfacfe69c8fa1aa921ef23c5.en: A family visit of the Ca jazz exhibition at the Maison Folie Hospice d'Havré in Tourcoing: adults take a guided tour while children listen to jazzy stories. Dates include 23 October at 14:30 and 16:00. 2.50 euros per person.

18e040d55dc3d2a3771a2fff55731b46b8000f4f.en: A workshop for children aged 8 to 12 at Le Fresnoy led by artist Constantin Jopeck, on how to film the invisible, such as wind, heat or time, making a collective film with sound. 10 euros per child.

486ea0849659f64e56662236ef59784ce8c76c8a.en: A children's game workshop at the Médiathèque de Fives on Friday 23 October from 15:00 to 16:30, a seven-families card game about insects from the region, for adult and child pairs from age 7. Free, booking required.

d1f94440dfd397f1d5552b0637107fd585cc7b0b.en: A guided tour of the Éclats du rire. exhibition at Le Tripostal with a guide who invites visitors to experience the artworks physically, with their bodies.

2c156951389627732eeff92dc401645f319970cb.en: An exhibition at the Médiathèque Andrée Chedid, C'est comme ça, c'est la vie., of photographs on adults with intellectual disabilities who age early and face Alzheimer's disease, a subject little documented so far.

6d7308b7df8745b74013d81d09a4b75b3bc3a26b.en: A theatre road-trip at the Théâtre de la Verrière, Pas la fin du monde, about a teenager offered a 1,700 km walk with a companion as an alternative to a residential placement. For teenagers and adults.

6e94868d4dff51e1b281527a60dfce04451ff310.en: A free public reading workshop by Ô La Voix at the QSP Galerie, on the theme of sensuality, where listeners hear texts and imaginings that stir the senses and can take part.

b105a4a894b994b08c77d34f57e7675223796975.en: A birthday weekend at La Piscine in Roubaix from 23 to 25 October, celebrating 25 years of La Piscine, La Manufacture and Roubaix Ville d'art et d'histoire, with dance, concerts and a banquet.

7ee120d0ca72227d2e4563f345db4a53ef1b3e61.en: A relaxed cycle ride around Haubourdin on Friday evenings, about 1.5 hours at 10 to 15 km/h, leaving the town hall at 18:30. Open to all ages, including children and people with disabilities.

8a1e0f0f090902cffcd5f933578d390158912b90.en: A night-time walk in the Brigittines courtyard in Lille, Archi express: le mystère des Brigittines, a 17th-century courtyard where monsters and witches are told about. Visitors bring a torch.

9e684ee53b83d766bd75ba687aea9a7b73445806.en: A theatre show at the Centre Socio-Éducatif in Lille on Friday 23 October at 19:30, Les colocs, about two broke would-be actors looking for a shared flat. Booking on Billetweb.

b86f8263ce7367bae2a65ec23c85c014df7694da.en: A rap double bill at Le Splendid in Lille on 23 October 2026, with Mig Moula and Kerchak and guests, in one date and two concerts.

66f5f0b2823a7b8027a1e56e3d44485c2f5d9ca8.en: A show at Le Splendid, where the rappers Mig Moula and Kerchak perform on 23 October 2026, with guests.

a2638cffef5ab8201fb6ac355252565f8d0f8ced.en: A comedy at Le Zéphyr in Lille on Friday 23 October at 20:00, Orgueil & Préjugés... ou presque., five actresses and a musician retell Pride and Prejudice with humour, in a French version directed by Johanna Boyé.

d87299efd9658b37a9aa706ba0aa284ba4838d88.en: A dance-music festival at Luminaria in Lille, Banger Festival: STV invite, with two stages of electronic acts including Dimitri K, F-Noize, Kemal, Akkix & Lebin and Tony Hunter. An affordable entry price for such a large line-up.

8e8a927d1c189a4e15f8fcfa2e5af90e07e844ec.en: A karaoke night at Le Musical in Lille, with a giant screen, free entry and beer offers. All levels welcome, alone or in groups.

1e8391f574c6cd4a6eb9cb18a28d955bca62a5ba.en: A concert at La Malterie with Mohamed Dali presenting Rest Up, a post-punk trio from Angers that recorded its album Real Sensations (2025) in England, with Cauliflowers in support.

c26447345f8e71662ed4ab68f015150efa71c591.en: An aquatic musical comedy at the Salle du Temps Libre, Les Belles Sorties, based on Offenbach's operetta about two rival fishermen, mixing opera, operetta and song with music by Ravel, Saint-Saëns and Poulenc.

5b489b1deb4589f9d5a732a247d9da4d1a217fc5.en: A concert at La Condition Publique in Roubaix by the rapper So La Lune, who started in 2019 with the project Tsuki and has released albums including L'enfant de la pluie.

69ca7d689c03b7b89fb0dc8036dc656b6d7bf894.en: An open screen at L'hybride, where anyone can show a film of under 15 minutes on the night, in any genre. Filmmakers must be present on the night. Film time is limited to what is available.

8dcd9d7982b5371e639656492438ca00e1c24e14.en: A house-music night at Le Maloot in Lille on Friday 23 October, celebrating Jason Hodges's birthday, with the Toronto DJ and guests Fayce Anane and Nask.

6c04ba968c940452662a824c789ea26da16beb28.en: A show at Le Flow in Lille, BlastMafia XXL, the pre-party of the Futvre.XP festival, with BlastMafia inviting Bedry and a line-up of DJs and producers.

7b312ae54c7422b9ea301b5439ccffe50aea33e2.en: A night of funk and soul at the Gare Saint-Sauveur in Lille, with the trio Yass Body at 21:00, the nine-piece all-female Atomic Ladies at 22:00 and DJ Pass at 23:30.

1def931b0a4634ef733d6b6cd8010c6831ac06b2.en: An electronic music night at Kodz in Lille, with A5KM, Fouyou, NWK, Pig and others, under safe-space rules where abusive behaviour is not tolerated.

da5f207825c931b9585304f6726f6610c70a4e20.en: A repair café at the Maison de l'Habitat Durable in Lille on Saturday 24 October from 9:00 to 12:00, where volunteers help people repair everyday objects. Registration required.

6cc362ff5777cd0e0995bbd3649a9b4c24505631.en: An introduction to baby sign language at the Maison des Genêts, with a presentation on Tuesday 13 October from 18:00 and two practical workshops on 24 October and 7 November.

e4b3ee16450710f96b145db8f8c880a988fc4fd8.en: An intergenerational workshop at the Médiathèque de Roubaix La Grand-Plage for parents, with quizzes and play, on children's video game habits and healthy family routines.

ff90ca55586b13438dbe09480bbbc054f694f740.en: Immersive short films for children from age 4 at L'hybride, Infiniment petit, infiniment grand, five short films on scale, from the Earth to the universe. Extra sessions run in school holidays.

64cd010553569655421d60b63a7835aec91c48d3.en: Garden waste collection at the Centre Technique Municipal in Lille, every two weeks on Saturday from 10:00 to 12:00, for grass clippings, dead leaves and hedge trimmings.

8ed85555ac0781cbdca3568cc290561ca73bf7d6.en: A walk to see the gargoyles on the cathedral, followed by a workshop making monstrous prints from them, at the Église Sainte-Marie-Madeleine in Lille, with the Atelier Zing.

88b42cfdb5a9156b4c75c7eaec89f4cf56e70de3.en: A walk under the trees of the Parc de la Citadelle in Lille to learn how to tell them apart, led by Nord Nature Environnement. Registration via the link.

b1b42f365b38942dbf14c3df1062cc911ce16aea.en: A reading session for children aged 0 to 3 with a carer at La Source, with stories and a sensory approach, run by two storytellers.

212b80ed8a926a6e6e8d79d1cbe8f5701e95b74f.en: A Linux install party at the Médiathèque Till L'Espiègle in Villeneuve-d'Ascq on Saturday 24 October at 10:00, where volunteers from the Club LinuX Nord-Pas-de-Calais help people install free software on older computers.

850c3e24d819dc68e989ea912e4d1f8fbb254cd8.en: An immersive reading programme at L'hybride, Au-delà des lignes, about women novelists, with five female artists taking up their works in a multimedia show.

ead78db7b33124b07df4d5b97145a0cdc2ec62c8.en: The annual exhibition of the Arts Plastiques association at La Source, with a wall-sized painting made by 100 small hands.

5c596196f563594850164694edc41276ae403306.en: A free outdoor storytelling session for young and older listeners at the Bibliothèque municipale in Mons-en-Barœul, with tales from the shores of the Mediterranean.

b4e2f5131b483eb33727c0cc3a93dffa5abeb150.en: A storytelling session at the Médiathèque Bois-Blancs in Lille on La Maladie des nuages, in which the tortoise Annaëlle calls an assembly of animals to find a cure for unhappiness and flies with the eagle to the clouds.

46e3ca44fbbf1f9137176c7868218acd0c34aa55.en: An exhibition at the Villa Sonneville in Roubaix, Anima, Animae, from 3 September to 14 November 2026, with embroidery and paintings by Mai Khanh Pham To and ceramics by Elisa Uberti, around the Jungian idea of the anima.

04bd9652dd95bf9401cb59e476225c5235abc5e5.en: A reading of La Maladie des nuages at the Médiathèque des Bois-Blancs in Lille, in which the tortoise Annaëlle gathers the animals to find a cure for misery.

260d6f9c0f0ca1254680d3437191faecaf164445.en: A comic-book café at the Médiathèque Lille Wazemmes, where librarians present and recommend the library's latest comic purchases. Free entry.

b65e3ad192c9cf8db7ca418e1ed46c1f7ce7aa14.en: A storytelling session for children aged 4 to 6, without a grown-up, at La Source in Lille, with stories and a magical approach to reading.

18aa3ab221a6e0b6c4eb71860d9321aef7d6f84a.en: An exhibition at the La Condition Publique in Roubaix, Au-delà de toutes les mers, open on Wednesdays and Saturdays from 14:00 to 19:00 until 1 November 2026, linked to the Mediterranean season.

9ba03f6a75d2db49b4e3ea1fabe789b277b068c6.en: A board-game afternoon at a Lille library, Lez'après-midis, where participants learn rules and play together.

249f4ad710b47f978442dd1f37251c4d5d0c6a80.en: A solidarity day at El'Cagette in Roubaix on Saturday 24 October from 14:00 to 21:00, with a writing contest on Gaza, Palestine and exile, which received more than 100 entries. Free entry.

6208919b7f07b69a57a5eb0da5bc60e3d048e7ab.en: An afternoon at La Condition Publique on the traditional Constantine wedding, with rituals, songs, food and the traditional djebba dress. Part of the Mediterranean season, organised with Cap Sud.

f909b1c82a58fcadc11fb5e51b573c47df5fe7e7.en: An immersive exhibition at the Quartier Créatif in Lille, Les mystères du Sahara, a bestiary of creatures from Maghreb legends, followed through the notebooks of a fictional traveller.

67e4f5cf44ed72fca44fd3f237a0ebcdd0ab10cf.en: A birthday weekend at the Musée La Manufacture in Roubaix from 23 to 25 October, marking 25 years of La Piscine, La Manufacture and Roubaix Ville d'art et d'histoire, with dance, concerts and a banquet.

b50b024f1f2b67935d23bb5d3b5a21dbb029ed8d.en: A reading for adults at the Médiathèque Lille Wazemmes on Friday 6 November 2026 from 18:00 to 19:00, on erotic literature in all its forms. For adults only; it is linked to an exhibition.

e9965f12952b58276c2df9a59aa899cb327da04f.en: A Sacem masterclass at FLOW in Lille, covering copyright, pay and the specifics of music production, with a look at international writing camps.

71636b76d9a4adb6331789c1768521abe7755c67.en: A guided walk through Lille in 1913, from the Vieille Bourse to the wealthy districts, showing the role of coal and textiles in the city's industrial transformation. Starts at Place Rihour.

7b6686710c8d34f393846fa85e1d2626db8252a5.en: A clay workshop at a Lille library with Brigitte Brulois, making small moving figures or animals in terracotta. A parent-child session is available for younger children; from age 5.

536740083af56aba24cfcba89e4b417c13a147ef.en: A Saturday workshop programme at La Condition Publique in Roubaix for adults, covering woodwork, upcycling, sewing and ceramics, led by resident artists. Designer Denis Plancque also shares a new storage furniture project.

3a9e1074e48975522962f1e5ba38330de669dd71.en: A year-long Mediterranean season in Roubaix, with a second round from September to October 2026 of exhibitions, shows, workshops, concerts and festive events across the city.

56458f32e64c7d76100e8cf6941e97bb989bc462.en: A guided visit of the Roubaix Génie textile exhibition at La Manufacture, with a visit to the weaving studio of Danielle Jouen. Free on booking; organised with Roubaix Ville d'art et d'histoire.

8cebe18fcf4f0e9441f93d33edc2bc063fcb1472.en: A Mediterranean wedding afternoon at La Condition Publique in Roubaix, with the association Cap Sud, presenting the traditional Constantine wedding, with songs, food and dress.

68ba28d0d3b3bed327239d6d90dfa674609b8a0b.en: A creative writing workshop at the Médiathèque Till L'Espiègle on Saturday 24 October at 15:00, on the crime novel theme. Texts are read aloud on 28 November. For ages 14 and up, booking required.

2c36b14598e20adacba249dbc53f270a61bcf667.en: A caricature workshop for parents and children at La Source in Lille, where they draw and imagine funny portraits to take home.

d7b79e2142be5e77426a95b3f66be6a0f7ad762b.en: A collective digital-nature exhibition at La Ferme d'en Haut in Villeneuve-d'Ascq, Nature numérique &+, with the Lille collective Les Yeux d'Argos and Scenocosme, offering interactive and sensory art.

f36c9ae10e8e60360b9f99315c9e2800a817f6c9.en: A museum visit at the Musée de l'Hospice Comtesse in Lille covering the building's medieval hospital origins and Lille's artistic and social life from the Renaissance to the French Revolution.

56c8f7b57791104f2a635e0a1e9d31d2642eed46.en: A free creative workshop at the Médiathèque du Vieux-Lille every Wednesday and Saturday afternoon, with cutting, drawing and games, where the theme changes each session.

e93b72dbc76f15a5065fe8f76cf886928eb12542.en: A music workshop at the Médiathèque de Roubaix, Quartiers en résonance, where families and neighbours record the sounds of their area in sound walks and make music and paintings with a musician and an artist.

928ed1d0d5aa13a6aad296ce41596f99145f107b.en: A talk at the Médiathèque Jean Lévy in Lille on the first photographic processes from 1839 to 1865, marking the government's Bicentenaire de la photographie.

dc77b47e85311c291266b29813f54ae1afb24757.en: A storytelling hour for children aged 0 to 4 at the Médiathèque Till L'Espiègle in Villeneuve-d'Ascq on Saturday 24 October at 16:00. Free.

74f13bce116c835ff18cefdf6933eb75ef79cc84.en: A masterclass with beatmaker Ysos at FLOW in Lille, covering the business of music production and whether producers should put themselves forward. Runs 16:00 to 18:00 in the large studio.

cdc94a589c96068684bcc4717abae10182ca377e.en: An intergenerational afternoon on Saturday 24 October in the Alma district of Lille, with an exhibition of portraits and objects from the Maghreb, a Maghreb-style snack and a karaoke, organised by the AFEV.

e8007fc2173fe896706f70e610408a48cf191970.en: A guided tour of the exhibition Au-delà de toutes les mers at La Condition Publique in Roubaix, co-designed with Le Cube, showing about fifteen artists exploring movement between France, Morocco and the Mediterranean.

17a359c40a86f224b541a7a94f4ecc4f238ca979.en: A science fiction and fantasy reading club at the Médiathèque du Vieux-Lille, for ages 15 and up, where members share books, comics, manga and films that shaped them. No booking.

2088a6b8c2bafb960d4c1dfc28f4c6a54f518a20.en: A book signing with author Oriane Dardres at the Médiathèque Lille Wazemmes, about her novels Eros Macabre and Noires sont les âmes perdues, for adults, moderated by an influencer, as part of a horror week.

eedb310dd3d393c44e81955f1bb062114fecfdd0.en: A Lille performance of Offenbach-based Les Belles Sorties, a water-themed musical comedy about two rival fishermen, at the Salle André Malraux.

b35f086001fc458d5c342719fc870093f17942db.en: A drag story show at Le Hangart in Lille, Les Illuminé.es, by Will Shakes Beard and Scrap Boo King, about two performers trying to write their best show without burning out. Suitable for all audiences.

d0315583649ab194f0a9af92b640ac533f37c9a8.en: A podcast recording at FLOW with Junior Alaprod, a beatmaker behind hits for PLK, Damso and Ninho, in conversation with the journalist Raphaël Da Cruz. Lasts 1.5 hours, with a live audience.

ecfcd3f662ca0bb578f9ad6a794785b7f47ad5be.en: A gospel concert at the cathedral of Notre-Dame de la Treille in Lille, with powerful choirs and live singing, as a single evening.

e5e86d9ece9add54a02d19e04a2f6aa8d49390ea.en: A rock evening at Le Musical in Lille with the post-rock bands Inverness and Hibou Chevelu, with Inverness presenting its EP Crushing Waves (January 2026).

1497f0a48e73e2114f7add794af998c3cc3f6905.en: A concert by Laurent Voulzy at the Casino Barrière in Lille, on his return to the stage after a long tour of churches and cathedrals in France, Belgium and Switzerland.

609bf05609a1e07a7dc15eca2b009479c3f7da93.en: A concert by the Paris gospel group Gospel Church at the Cathédrale Notre-Dame de la Treille in Lille, with powerful voices, for families, friends and colleagues.

6d780e0e973f7e6b75f06eaf67b0aa2370e71979.en: A schranz night at Kodz in Lille, All About Schranz, with Belphë, Mez, Perle, Nønname and A2QL, under safe-space rules where violent or discriminatory behaviour is not tolerated.

1a259e10b6a7e247a4bfc0f5b8b85d7d2d64b9ce.en: A night at Le Troisième, the JOY club in Lille, with ChemixLab inviting 6CLØNE. A DJ contest for a 90-minute warm-up set, with an industrial sound.

fe90dc152f75e83b65c3707162046866ff8cef9d.en: A rap, trap and dancehall night at Slalom in Lille on Saturday 24 October from midnight to 06:00, Gang Gang with Hoodini and guests. Discounted entry for Pass en Nord members.

e972eb2f754837eb667860f5630553dc37477dde.en: A storytelling session with a single voice at the Jardin des plantes in Lille, with mysterious readings about witches, pumpkins and autumn.

fc358bab042e83122c1210ba456f1f0939132093.en: A brunch and yoga session at Albedo Kitchen in Lille on Sunday 25 October, with yoga from 10:30 to 11:30 and a vegan brunch at 12:00. Yoga only costs 14 euros, yoga with brunch 39 euros.

5948a2bf2bb836cd12a042cd05246fa23d8bfd34.en: A charity walk in Villeneuve-d'Ascq on Sunday 25 October at 14:00 from Lac du Héron, for Octobre rose, with 5 or 12 km routes. The 4-euro entry goes to the Centre Oscar Lambret.

3b910cb79b92a8a8a5cc62e6978c725ea4fe7893.en: A Halloween storytelling session at the Jardin des plantes in Lille for families, with thrilling legends and laughter.

73980bbf1a99db674fe3a27ab1a2792d9eee6fed.en: A family film screening at the Fresnoy, Petite Casbah, from Antoine Colomb, about children in Algiers in 1955 who look for a missing brother. For ages 6 and up, lasting 1h24. Sunday 25 October at 15:00.

f748d1cfb295ac3ec303d210989a344daa08efb9.en: A Halloween festival at La Ferme d'en Haut, with fantastic readings, a musical floral device, the zygophone, and an eerie performance. Costumes welcome.

70a5b57e25aee679e0e4d997270594099ed566ed.en: A theatre show at the Centre Socio-Éducatif in Lille on Sunday 25 October at 16:00, Meurtre, sexe et trahison, in which a police inspector and her colleagues investigate a serial killer. Booking on Billetweb.

02b1b4705a2fd47c9992226ad5a94cd9ae9e0719.en: A two-part Halloween festival at the Asnapio archaeological park, with workshops from 14:00 to 17:30 on the Egyptian Book of the Dead, Viking tombs and funeral rituals, and special guided visits on death in history.

2295e8fc74e82ed0af7ca9b8f4e9d8404d43fcd1.en: A Halloween party at Le Grand Sud in Lille, with a parade, a show, a dance and a costume contest, run with the town hall and local associations. Make-up and mask workshops start at 14:00.

7a3940dd890e9faf7457d49410c9b07a94b62e56.en: Bike repair help at the Busabiclou in front of La Grand-Plage in Roubaix, a participatory self-repair workshop with mechanics on 17 October, 31 October and 8 November, from 14:00 to 17:00.

fea649331ee4ecedf9fb5ae7cd4538b4a393a684.en: A Lartconserve art event at the Maison Folie Wazemmes, where artists turn empty tins into art, to be exchanged for full tins for the Tente des Glaneurs charity.

6ed998567fecd8438b366fa5333c27c2aa9463a2.en: A Halloween afternoon at the Palais Rihour in Lille, Le Monstrueux Palais, in which children look for monsters hidden in books and rooms and then draw their own creatures. Run with the Lille libraries.

45a8bc772b82f5e2c108c97cd22d5ded70a663fc.en: A video-game session at the Médiathèque de Lille-Moulins for families and friends, with solo and multiplayer play and tournaments.

d508dc51dd0503bdb6d5ac499ced377c66847ad6.en: A Halloween kids' party at Mama Shelter Lille from 14:30 to 17:00, with a snack buffet, sweet hunt, cupcake workshop, make-up and a children's DJ set. 19 euros per child.

6537b9f1ed86ae16a079810fbca16d2f1a098691.en: A scary-stories and games session at the Médiathèque Lille Wazemmes, with horror readings for ages 5 and up, and creepy games for all ages.

a79cdf85c4fad66e45ee190532af5e0fccddd6bc.en: A workshop at the Pouponnière in Lille making Halloween costume accessories, hats and baskets for sweets, with Atelier Moon, for children and adults.

3d996b4956eac6f6ec12b36cee74298b9a23f3e6.en: A guided tour of the art route at La Condition Publique in Roubaix at 15:00. Visitors should arrive at least 10 minutes before the start.

db95222b0565446afcc97190dcfbff2cad4cf0bd.en: A guided walk around La Manufacture in Roubaix to trace the history of the Craye factory, founded in 1914, part of the Roubaix Génie textile exhibition. Free on booking.

bc37db63966edb2031dccd7878c1f85ee8caea06.en: A children's art workshop at La Condition Publique in Roubaix on Saturdays, where parents and children make a mini tipi and other creative projects with resident artists.

b8425fa26248190c6fcf4ae2aebb6becd8e0695d.en: A tour of the MUba's odd and eerie works at Eugène Leroy in Tourcoing for Halloween, the Nuit des Lumières, to share facts about a selection of works.

e9f500401435dbe57104d952c216837ccccf02a5.en: A storytelling hour for children at the Ludomédiathèque Colette, with illustrated tales told by the librarians.

262018e5aef1a673c05d2604486e24a319b54535.en: A Dabkeh workshop at the Institut du monde arabe in Tourcoing, led by the Gaza-born dancer and choreographer Mohammed Alaloul, a collective dance of joy and cultural memory.

2d124971df97692b69a67e2eca2db8ff208969f8.en: An afternoon of games at the Médiathèque Bois-Blancs in Lille, with co-operative and speed games, and the library's manga, comics and novels to explore.

c69b2f46498fdd263c2ff6d73670bcd48f1d3c39.en: A mystery film screening at the Médiathèque Vieux-Lille for Halloween, linked to taste. Entry by registration.

82e4a835c72c4c1ed82dc6f5161b1d6cc259f0be.en: Saturday guided visits at La Piscine in Roubaix, at 16:15 and 17:15, of the exhibition Ni Dieu ni maître. Arts et anarchie de Courbet à Banksy, on anarchism in art, running until 23 January.

c55127938eabdbcbcbd4fdd0997368e97ba73c74.en: A Halloween night at Le Grand Bleu in Lille, La Caravane de l'horreur, with partners in the Bois-Blancs district, offering a route and many activities for friends, families or solo visitors.

37600d139678213701ec6944fa26ecda7b1888c4.en: A talk at La Condition Publique in Roubaix by architect Jean-Paul Philippon on L'inachevé, the transformation of heritage buildings, including the Musée d'Orsay and La Piscine in Roubaix. Organised with Métropole Label.le.

37058a67c4f1da55c7a332827390a4b3ddfab2da.en: A reading club for ages 11 to 14 at the Médiathèque Jean Lévy in Lille, where young readers share books they like. Free entry.

06b821f361e84c1d01d3049a07b5acfe9cb638dc.en: A story session for children at the Médiathèque de Lille-Moulins with Halloween tales, enchanted stories and laughs.

b8c0c383279b449a8ade901d0a34b967af261784.en: A wrestling night in Halle B at the Gare Saint-Sauveur in Lille from 17:00 to 01:00, the Drag Attack Wrestling show, with drag performers and wrestlers. The second room hosts Cumbia del Infinito.

354fecda173d6a0bc20f7cefebb487b3becc7097.en: A night walk at the Cimetière du Sud in Lille by lantern light, exploring memory, funerary heritage, symbols and rites. Guided, with a respectful approach to the dead.

8985f3cd1fc7007e3921836997fd7fd93d521b8c.en: A Samhain party at Chez Ben in Lille on Saturday 31 October from 18:00 to 02:00, with a witches' market from 18:00 to 22:30 and hard music. Costume not compulsory.

39f2d6cfbc8cd64a8c38ead2a49c5d4b0220c5e7.en: A talk on the slasher film at the Cinéma Le Méliès in Lille, a playful exchange with critic Enzo Durand on Scream.

05e1735dfbf8607ff53b7017196788a5cc902179.en: A night walk in the Parc de la Citadelle in Lille to find owls and birds of prey, with Nord Nature Environnement. Registration via the link.

9da8cb8ff2fb66905c58351c33fa7ea6dcd41782.en: A women-only Halloween party at JOST in Lille, La Bringue, with a dance floor reserved for women and people identifying with the female spectrum, and an all-female DJ set.

c06a9278ddb4ea0a2a3977b7a988c1165c8fef9a.en: A tribute to AC/DC by High Voltage Therapy at the Bunker Paillettes in Lille on Saturday 31 October at 21:00. Tickets 10 euros in presale, 12 euros on the day.

2cf6f59a9036526ac24fe2e749a8887a1026c764.en: A family Halloween evening at the Palais des Beaux-Arts in Lille, La nuit des ombres, with hybrid and fantastical creatures moving through the collections. Costumes welcome; workshops are offered.

7055f326abcfdf0e110b2ee3ead05d46f16a5573.en: A Roots Rock'Kabylie ball at the Salle des Fêtes de Fives in Lille, with Tamasha Roots and Cheikh Sidi Bémol, curated by the Echo du Monde association.

03dbb56425ff81898eb59f623bd60a85b823a301.en: A DJ and live-video night at the Tripostal in Lille, with the Lille collective Chicken Wave, running from 20:00 to 02:00 with a series of DJ sets. Part of the Éclats du rire. programme.

d6d37e6fbcbe32e71b9aae5fabfb15fdaffb605e.en: A ciné-concert of King Kong at the Grand Bleu in Lille, with Joachim Latarjet's live soundtrack from a crowd of instruments. For ages 10 and up.

c3fc6b5c43ac7b7c33388fa895e00577dd0dc163.en: A Halloween edition of the women-only Tanalloween at Lille, with DJ sets, a fortune-teller and other activities, doors open at 20:00.

ea517d6cfc0e29b31a462330a0f0b0040c8c70db.en: A concert at L'Aéronef by Mike D, the Beastie Boys member, presenting his first solo album Thank You, with playful collages, post-electro grooves and his voice.

68d8676a0fbb962dec5b84b41c0ad04d193c7f98.en: A rooftop Halloween party at Mama Shelter Lille on the 6th floor, with DJ sets, signature cocktails, snacks, a free photobooth and costume contest. Fancy dress required to enter.

827e0803b5524516cc9eec7766963bcdd9ba18f5.en: A Halloween screening at the Fresnoy of Flush by Grégory Morin, 2026, 1h10, with Jonathan Lambert. Rated 16 and over. It follows a drifting addict trying to win back his ex.

7786caaf941f34612f95fb3ae6cb04d36cd7df7d.en: A dark electro and VJ night at the Lokarria in Lille for Halloween, by the Sombrelectro collective, with a DJ line-up including Tao B2B Transgression and BrHume.

439746b9babc59d406415655e92bec2d9327884e.en: A live-music screening of Nosferatu (1922) at Mama Shelter Lille on Saturday 31 October, with popcorn and a live score played by Samvel.

0b51efe43dc958ed098db9eacaecf8add877601f.en: A Halloween zombie party at La Canopée in Lille, with a DJ set of 1980s to present-day hits, bloody shots and costumes encouraged.

3aa507dc14bccbed9e4a4ccad153fd97f7eb6cee.en: An all-night set by the Dutch hard techno producer KLOFAMA at Kodz in Lille, starting at 23:59 on Saturday 31 October. Safe-space rules apply.

ed7f784d617da5073cf33c2e7b9a20299f90cc49.en: A family event at the Ferme pédagogique Marcel Dhénin in Lille on witches, with myths about animals, bats and autumn fruits. Free; a workshop on autumn fruit needs booking.

2e9ffe18432021f55f49f88cbf1ebc32bf638dc1.en: Opening hours of the Musée des Moulins in Villeneuve-d'Ascq on public holidays, from 14:30 to 17:30, with mill tours at set times, each limited to 15 people.

0a30cbde1ce3ea61fa790045f38a5a13610c4bb4.en: A Día de los Muertos event at Maison Folie Moulins in Lille, with a calavera make-up workshop, then a drag show, built with the Minuit Cinéma Club.

4eff54c09a812c84c63e874b6db881e5ff9150ce.en: A coat-of-arms workshop at the Musée du Château de Flers on public holidays, where visitors create a heraldic shield and a motto in calligraphy, as the lord of the castle did in the Renaissance.

81b4a90af808e3bf945236595e5d0d2ba4ba420f.en: A metal-themed afternoon at the Musée du Terroir on Sunday 1 November from 14:30 to 17:30, with gold-leaf gilding, a blacksmith and wire sculpture workshops, free for all ages.

266c3b8560b8e376fd12d74c5a02896492391bb0.en: Free entry to the Mémorial Ascq 1944 on public holidays from 14:30 to 17:30, which commemorates the killing of 86 civilians in April 1944.

578e0e671d491ae85536910b4c416aafb7f3adc3.en: A Sunday family lunch and acoustic concert at the Bistrot de St So in Lille, with a restaurant from 12:00 to 14:30. Booking advised.

082519c8e4dad0088bd1dc9703b0cf2089c60f65.en: A comedy at the Théâtre Sébastopol in Lille, Secret(s) médical, by Michel Cymes, about four former medical students who meet for dinner and find one has learned that his patient is running for president.

846189a0079d916c74bb9dbf7c5d074fdc0218e4.en: A talk at La Source in Lille on night-sky photography, from one amateur's journey from family star-parties to his own telescope and camera.

fe1920cfbc436372738cf705680896d645b362a4.en: A bike visibility advice session at Templeuve-en-Pévèle station on Monday 2 November from 17:00 to 19:00, run by the ADAV Pévèle Carembault for safe cycling at night.

9f9c5b723427141b0bef2aa56355a8270bcaeb9a.en: A concert at La Bulle Café in Lille by the Connecticut indie-rock artist Schur, who mixes rock, hip-hop and reggae, after a sold-out date.

002017bd2a898673392d12df1768171eae34368b.en: A photography exhibition at La Source in Lille, Regards croisés, for the bicentenary of photography, with works by contemporary art photographers.

a4209ac11bd85e4e9e71a4d9490491bba83f9c02.en: Parent and baby wellbeing sessions at the Piscine du Triolo in Lille, teaching baby massage for infants up to about eight months, in five sessions from 3 November.

080039c3999ea42082046227294dd569bc2d2ea9.en: An exhibition at the Médiathèque Vieux-Lille on the comic series Le Château des étoiles by Alex Alice, a steampunk alternate 19th century inspired by Jules Verne.

c7d1345f3264ba43384fe88c9f7d8db0bd3da1fc.en: A reading at the Médiathèque Jean-Lévy in Lille of Voix du corps, a philosophical essay written as letters to other women, linking sense and the body.

bf3bc66f3f23bea583fd9bdaf52ae9c014830ddb.en: A talk at the Hôtel de Ville in Lille on the Salengro affair, the 1936 suicide of the Lille mayor and interior minister after a campaign by the far-right press, and what it reveals about 1930s politics.

c26fa6a91a45ce7220a3244102294c7371a9505e.en: An adult printmaking course at the Musée de l'Hospice Comtesse in Lille, Instants gravés, covering each step of making a print, from preparing the plate to the final impression.

1e1085056a8bc88b0c60fde37de260da2be5697d.en: A talk at the Salle Masqueliez in Lille on Tuesday 3 November at 18:30 about the role of physical activity in toddlers' development and how to encourage it every day.

3e3afa4d07470355720e7b10abdbfd0b7ac7d49d.en: A show by students of the lyric singing and theatre departments at the Conservatoire de Lille auditorium, Le rire d'Alexandre (ou la vengeance du Phyloquasicollus), on Tuesday 3 November at 19:00, about a child's birthday with the adults who shape his life.

84e9ce7a89948a1ccb5228f61340ff1994711b53.en: Docs en Vue, the international documentary film festival at the Palais des Beaux-Arts auditorium in Lille, in its third edition, showing films that use documentary as a space for creation and reflection.

6157b26f367d304af7fad86198133d258402f2eb.en: A play at the Théâtre du Nord, La fête, by Joëlle Sambi and Anne-Cécile Vandalem, about a tragedy that moved a whole community. Performed in French and Dutch with French surtitles.

277831c3e9c377b24e48c9458ed793ab1b747f07.en: A concert at L'Aéronef by Sam Sauvage, whose first album of 13 songs was written in his kitchen in Paris's 13th arrondissement.

237670ee31853111215a95c2a78fedf4b2a991d5.en: A concert at Le Splendid by Vernis Rouge, a singer known for a cover of Bande organisée on The Voice, who mixes ultracontemporary rock and French chanson.

5ba946315c571637aec21f5a7cc1cd7ac73e87be.en: A concert at Le Vivat by the Korean-born artist Jihyé Jung, Am I real?, about the in-between identity she feels after living equal parts of her life in Korea and France.

663a08b164d43971f1f53cdb2d1b7d65df18e896.en: Two days of talks at the LaM on women artists who are self-taught, on the margins or left out of art history, in echo of the Singulières exhibition, running 3 October 2026 to 14 February 2027.

a0fc581cdefe8c800d9a3df7011208601d7caa6f.en: A participatory exhibition at the Médiathèque Lille-Moulins, L'art, un bien en commun, with amateur, professional and disabled artists, linked to the Semaine de la santé mentale and run with Les Partageurs and Ensemble Autrement.

9db0139f3e93f5380e8c88f2f8cec23ffa2fc1a1.en: A story time for children aged 4 to 6 at the Médiathèque de Lille-Sud, with albums, tales and legends that leave room for imagination.

51a2bb95619a2c2068a52ac30667a10dd2cdda0c.en: A story hour at the Mons-en-Barœul library, with librarians reading stories to travel, marvel and laugh.

fa6c636752f6c0a4dfd49116c2f55c0885085106.en: A storytelling hour for toddlers at the Ludomédiathèque Colette in Lille, with words, pictures and colours to introduce books early.

348070afd32cce45563f0f7f9ab86f217c9aa56c.en: A family story at the Ferme Marcel Dhénin in Lille, Petite poule rousse, a tale of helping and treats mixed with cooking, for ages 3 and up. Free, registration required.

bec462f99461d4349c260114309fd3cd5d217f52.en: A music awakening session for ages 0 to 3 and their parents at the Médiathèque Vieux-Lille, with musical books, small instruments and nursery rhymes.

e7bed3944e61bc07e56068aab71a89d527289139.en: A music session at the Médiathèque Andrée Chedid in Lille, Bulles sonores, in which families sing, play with voice, explore sound objects and dance with sounds. Musical direction by Laetitia Gallego.

dfbe048e5ea9d8e81992984323b9222e88e2c806.en: A reading session for children at the Médiathèque de Saint-Maurice-Pellevoisin, with enchanted tales and laughter, led by the librarians.

bc5af653429616e954fadcb1267c3f5240569e74.en: A detective game at the Médiathèque Till L'Espiègle on 4 November, in which players, as the new police commissioner, solve puzzles to find the missing Doctor Dewey. For ages 9 and up, two one-hour sessions.

9150e31abc6190d5fba040b16331c8fc8c43ef4d.en: A family workshop at the WAAO architecture centre in Lille on the habitats of chimeras and monsters, asking where they live and what their homes need.

09ae28b728415021fd0aa63b79b72dc96130155c.en: The fifth Enfants à l'Œuvre at the Maison Folie Wazemmes, where around 700 children from Lille, Hellemmes and Lomme make art linked to the Convention on the Rights of the Child, celebrated on 20 November.

535a6b237023493e02e8866a1190bd44a0ba2b23.en: A training session at a Lille library, À vos manettes, to prepare for a video-game tournament on Wednesday 2 December.

141ae73cc989c955da953070f98cac38600f05df.en: A talk at the Médiathèque Jean-Lévy in Lille by Bertrand Quentin, a philosopher, on how we picture old age, and how it can be read as a time of deepening rather than decline.

01f2b1f53b8fbede56992c34d72aa64a5dd8d666.en: A marionette show for ages 5 and up at the Théâtre de la Verrière, Battement d'ailes, about a girl named Nina who grows up in a hostile place after losing her mother. Part of the PasCap' festival.

ba51523cff79c831ea616fc121169df52b72021e.en: A residency of the artist Fleur Mautuit at the Centre d'Arts Plastiques et Visuels in Lille, part of the Archipel programme across the Denain art school and the CAPV, with an observation period from 5 to 16 October.

b86617185767065a63d195b12e963f217a1449e2.en: A philosophy workshop for children aged 8 to 12 at the Médiathèque Andrée Chedid in Lille, in which they discuss and think together about what solidarity means.

e2034e371ad65b2eed5c12f2ea521b53b5c4be64.en: Free play sessions at the Lille-Centre neighbourhood town hall, Mercredi Mairie, one or two per month from September to December, open from 15:00 to 18:00 with play areas for all ages.

6085f4238d16e47d7d9fac8e56d2c286feed389e.en: A drawing workshop at the Mini-Lab of Maison Folie Moulins for children aged 7 to 12, with naturalist illustrator Vincent Gavériaux, drawing a new animal species at each session. Dates include 14 October and 4 November.

4544e99ed7ed27764fd93f7a44930eb6950ba988.en: A guided visit of the Salle des fêtes de Fives in Lille, built in 1928 for the city's Art Deco and eclectic style, commissioned from architect Marcel Cools by mayor Roger Salengro.

18d8e2207867b0540384e4fa02f3fae4f605365e.en: A reading in the dark at the Médiathèque Aimé Césaire in Tourcoing, with a selection of horror texts for those who want to be frightened.

86cc0f94de22a2b898696ee7499b16fc98e29eb2.en: A free sewing session at La Condition Publique in Roubaix on the first Wednesday of each month, with the textile artist Marine Bigo, to create, mend, adjust or upcycle clothes.

23eb26c24de36579f85da7908cbb0911ac46958f.en: A radio club at the Médiathèque de Lille-Sud for young people, where they learn the microphone, interviews, writing and editing and make their own programmes.

044291d2f792394e801dadfd5c1a3c907088b40d.en: A talk at the Maison de l'Habitat Durable in Lille on the MEL's Petits Travaux grant scheme, for owners and tenants, on Wednesday 4 November from 16:30 to 17:30.

a6b428c53da48e8730dd8643478f6ddf87f17115.en: A story reading by librarians at the Palais des Beaux-Arts Children's Museum in Lille, to explore the Grandeur nature exhibition with stories. Booking required.

b5af2da22b008e24132838629489f49e450b1b66.en: A talk at the Médiathèque Jean-Lévy in Lille by M. Teretchenko on his book about blindness, written with blind people rather than about them, on shared humanity.

63b6a23a37ffa1fbd7b4e85d20418a888f725fde.en: A repair café at La Condition Publique in Roubaix on the first Wednesday of each month, at the FabLab, where volunteers help with clothes, furniture, electrical appliances, bikes and toys.

aca859d082f9c1dfbc166d93fe66d04ee22183e0.en: An interactive talk on swallows and garden insects at the Jardin écologique de Lille, by Nord Nature Chico Mendès, which asks participants to imagine being a swallow.

c4ca6edd2abd2c85ae3aebe589b18788782deb0f.en: Free late openings at the LaM called 1000 Morceaux, on the first Wednesday of each month from 19:00 to 23:00, with an open stage, performances and other participatory activities.

e171643df80eaaab79db5a0c8d4d0825403a8d9c.en: A blindtest and general DJ set at Le Bistrot de St So in Lille on Wednesday 4 November, with a free blindtest from 20:00 and a DJ.

fe160ae0c8c58505f8dce948ef6a8ad1296ea16a.en: The Molière-winning play Les Gros Patinent Bien at the Théâtre Sébastopol by Pierre Guillois and Olivier Martin-Salvan, a cartoon cabaret mixed with a Shakespearean epic, made of cardboard.

f4075bd14a7829dce57542380b288c1267c1be17.en: A concert at the Opéra de Lille, Une nuit pour tout changer, with the Tana Quartet, playing Debussy's string quartet, Patricia Alessandrini's Forklaret Nat and Schoenberg's Transfigured Night.

df5fc7382d0b7cc032aada1d4cacdb11810e01ed.en: A concert at Le Splendid in Lille by the electronic artist Fakear, presenting his album a nice place to be, which he has played from the Olympia to Glastonbury.

495d5f0cec9530663a4307033e44e623e6858aba.en: A cybersecurity and AI day at EuraTechnologies in Lille on 5 November 2026, the Campus Cyber Summit, on how companies can anticipate new digital threats.

85405e68a5a4248ebda7c850692f321ca9a6453d.en: Parent and child body-awareness workshops at the Crèche Nougatine in Lille for babies aged 6 months to 2 years, with play that uses the imagination to explore movement.

83586316d1ac2ea165d494835ec1053015e93675.en: The launch of the ESS month at the Préfecture du Nord in Lille on 5 November 2026, on how the social and solidarity economy responds to an ageing population.

b4f59a99b732e6f25e8edad81843c20cd1f4fc3c.en: A French conversation workshop at the Médiathèque de Roubaix La Grand-Plage for non-French speakers who want to practise speaking. It is not a language course.

8ca064faea0688db9c56cf3929dd0b956d411354.en: A talk at the Médiathèque Jean-Lévy in Lille on what the history of philosophy is for, based on a collective book, asking whether it seeks eternal questions or the specifics of each doctrine.

6164d21c27333ac786e66b32c70cb8eb87309f2b.en: A talk at the Hôtel de Ville in Lille on the building from the 1920s, planned as the first stage of a major development programme, and the mayors who left their mark on it.

72d1b6eea26599bd371be264ce51bde3d6a3e28d.en: A talk at the Médiathèque Jean-Lévy in Lille, Le vrai du beau, on how to look at paintings and what knowing how to see requires.

cb9b642b89c5b989c76661432653d3c03de79f05.en: Guided exhibition visits at the Tripostal in Lille by the drag queen and comedian Lolla Wesh, of the Éclats du rire. show, followed by a party with a DJ set from Brigitte Pintade.

5e8cfcb42ff7bd05b8525539ecec3c7fcaaa92db.en: A workshop at the Maison de l'Habitat Durable in Lille on Thursday 5 November from 17:30 to 19:30, a review of 2026 and plans for 2027, with the toolkit given out.

8aa8e5a041cdd2b718c6a0b98ea6be55ff24cb26.en: A meeting with poet and publisher Réginald Gaillard at the Médiathèque Saint-Maurice-Pellevoisin on Thursday 5 November from 18:15 to 19:30, with free entry on registration.

058f66acfc2e99db98f61c61b5f0cb37aa042bb8.en: A free self-guided visit of the artothèque and the collection of the CRP Hauts-de-France in Lille, Faire Collection, marking the bicentenary of photography, with 40 years of regional photography.

dfc9c13a599e101010b17862bc703338566b9b46.en: A talk at the Médiathèque Jean-Lévy in Lille on Rakky Nouha, a provocative musician whose formal inventiveness brought both fame and painful failure.
