1560f39871222565e12e4c4b811bce165bd438fa.en: A guided event at the Observatoire de l'Institut catholique de Lille around Le Ciel céleste, with research, archives and creative process behind the exhibition.

2015071e60e231bb707a3537fd17ee4c9b41dc27.en: A thermal walk in Tourcoing with a thermal camera, to see where energy escapes from homes and to learn practical fixes for insulation problems.

31b63e155445a0a0da95827da14909d7a41a74f5.en: The Trophées de l'Industrie et de la Jeunesse at the Cité des échanges in Lille, celebrating industrial success, committed firms and young talent.

b8a2dbdbef4b98885c505ed80c1e92477b9aeec7.en: A screening at the Centre social du Laboureur in Wattrelos of the documentary Le Sang et la Boue by Jean-Gabriel Leynaud (2025, 90 minutes), part of the Docs en Vue festival.

f8c97434c7dcd34e8bdff3c3f833202f5848cae6.en: A lecture at the MUba Eugène Leroy in Tourcoing by Marie Castelain on why artists such as Vermeer, Chardin and Bonnard painted the table, as a symbol of gathering and ceremony.

7f4b27fe28ae3f6b58dc09da064e63d7e2268c4a.en: A free special evening at Le Bistrot de St So on Thursday 19 November from 19:00 to 00:30, showing the new GTA VI on a giant screen.

d38f63bece2df686510fed6ad7f16e08a76af2ed.en: A guided visit of the Petit musée des horreurs at the Théâtre de la Verrière, a short awareness piece on domestic violence against women in heterosexual couples.

1463f3995e48c9d6407c7050f23ac49878ec5522.en: A circus show at the Prato in Lille, Revers de paillettes, by Cie Tourne au sol, in which a courtier prepares to welcome the return of the king. First performance.

c9dae4493a0d7f9f2692bf5f27c3fa5c4dedceac.en: A women-only stand-up night at the Tripostal in Lille, with Méchante Coline, Ruby Pinata, Céline VDB and Stéphanie Machart, in partnership with Le Loko Comedy Club.

77538e3946024e8b54e0bc3b8a20c6e9be65d412.en: A concert at La Ferme d'en Haut with Jessica93 and Seedy Liars, part of the 20th Tour de Chauffe festival from 19 to 29 November, which showcases eight emerging artists.

d587c70c47b4ce13a5807adec8e53775d02ae4e5.en: A concert at La Bulle Café in Lille by the rapper NOBODYLIKESBIRDIE, a rising Lille rap voice from Fives, who mixes raw lyrics with music.

66dd9199182214fa550051effa23c958191fd17a.en: An exhibition at the Galerie Gilbert-Sailly in the Ferme Dupire, 3 filles et une expo, by three friends, one who writes and two who paint, showing their first joint exhibition.

6b9a8e0f9c2e8a65d8a589974052c918794d9b70.en: A housing-adaptation forum in Roubaix, Bien chez soi, at the maison des Associations on Friday 20 November, where AMELIO and SOLIHA advise on adapting or renovating homes.

526a038e6a9618e5a89b9410fe72b7e255d6279b.en: A lunchtime talk at the Médiathèque Jean-Lévy in Lille with the author, critic and translator Guillaume Contré on his ideal library, about an hour.

cd5dcdbfd6275afeebdcab7396b07dd294db6d7b.en: A show at the Gymnase CDCN in Lille, Ditto to the Sand, in which choreographer Marion Carriau dances with her two sons on stage, building a shelter where family life and creation share the space.

ab027bd06a2cbfe5dc7de7d7e0d09755da461580.en: A talk at the Musée de l'Hospice Comtesse in Lille on how psychiatric conditions in older people were treated from the 19th century, drawing on archives. By Marie Derrien and Mathilde Rossigneux-Méheust.

21c75be0fb044290be8e9eaadc59727f81c803e4.en: A monthly games evening at the Salle des Dintellières in Lille from 18:00 to 22:30, open to all levels, free and for ages 10 and up with an adult.

a9877376bcd803481a4a818a2f68e8a7518463d2.en: A birthday event at the Institut du monde arabe in Tourcoing, Le bal des 10 ans, with a ceremony at 18:30 and then a dance concert with the Quartet Areski, to mark the institute's tenth anniversary.

c51389ed965829eca6dd73340aba7f96b106fe22.en: A talk at the Hôtel de Ville in Lille on Roger Salengro as a builder mayor of the interwar years, who worked for the city's growth and for the wellbeing of the working class.

2bb6c579c28636188205647845c44bb9c04ef0c7.en: A cosy-crime knitting and film evening at the Médiathèque Till L'Espiègle on Friday 20 November at 18:00, bringing needles and enjoying a crime film.

fa1079fbdd1528afce25a39357daaab31d0540cc.en: A Friday evening at the Musée La Piscine in Roubaix from 18:00, L'œuvre s'écrit: papier, with drawing, writing workshops, screenings and surprising visits.

cba245503509c2e366643148998f9199e0b5dbda.en: A Friday party at the Bunker Paillettes in Lille, DJ Gauthier's Macumba Forever, with happy hours from 18:00 to 19:30, street food, and DJ sets from 21:00 to 01:30.

b531a7224ff92a07cc50b9c0fb43faa715047c0c.en: An inaugural talk at the Palais des Beaux-Arts in Lille by David Blayney-Brown, the curator and former chief curator of British art at Tate Britain, on 18th and 19th-century British painting.

3388d86100d1a9ae96b61e76663d72eed9608081.en: A concert by the Quatuor Poulenc, four brass players from the Orchestre National de Lille, at the Conservatoire de Roubaix, with French and other works for brass.

6584d433bd8ccbfa067b1efe581b016e22598d84.en: A monthly pottery evening at the Coopérative Baraka in Lille, two hours of modelling led by Saul Vélazquez de Castro, with a meal in the restaurant room.

95ddce46a7cf483583105e9abf9b18e3db5b0440.en: A show at the Salle des Fêtes de Fives by the Compagnie des Vagabondes, Je suis une libre, performed by a chorus of six women, the 'sentinelles', who dance, sing and watch the world.

3b4f1e930feb4f87370cadd835f98e10ce7a8186.en: A stand-up show at Le Zéphyr in Lille by Florian Lex, Imparfaits, on Saturday 20 November at 20:00, about the everyday grumbling and self-recognition of the French.

2349575f3296850a8150bef3e225d939dee13b43.en: A concert at Le Splendid in Lille by Ferdi, whose debut album Take 01 was a success and who is preparing a second album, mixing jazz and rap.

89a69ca9569fc4f5cd343552c4380f17f6b32ea8.en: A double concert at La Cave aux Poètes in Lille with Le Talu, a queer and intimate digital rap and trip-hop act, and Rolli, an electro-pop artist.

8515b651114a31a0d267369181f6a3e0bb18788e.en: A concert at La Bulle Café in Lille on Friday 20 November 2026 by the 21-year-old rapper Ly, one of the new voices in French rap.

e7ce49f5cb713caa3eabc159484fdf358406e9c0.en: A cabaret at Le Vivat by Gurshad Shaheman, Cabaret Téhéran, about women and queer people in Iran, with each number portraying a Persian pop diva.

5ad499ca25fb9f4db36b2a42ce56269e5f03cda0.en: A charity concert at the Cathédrale Notre-Dame de la Treille in Lille by the Rotary Club Lille La Madeleine, featuring Mozart's masterwork with the choir La Cantarella and the Arcanes orchestra, for children with disabilities.

2754f07474da3e2ddaf61951c0e97a97d2b70a86.en: A play at La Rose des Vents by Yan Duyvendak, Dear Luigi, I Hate You, based on the real killing of a health-insurance chief executive, turned into a theatre experience about justice.

c83c354b53d4fa11e900ddc3c72a2163c33b9eda.en: A theatre production by Cie En tous lieux, adapted from Carole Fréchette's play. Grâce marries Henri into a luxurious house, but her curiosity turns to the room upstairs that is forbidden to her.

c1fffafece5797cecdb878424d5d4842f00f6e0f.en: Kodz hosts the Skip The Beat festival at the Kodz venue in Englos, with a line-up of DJs and performers. Entry is restricted to adults with an original ID card, and a safer team handles reports.

93da2f843f4b8d6f43d4a34f1833931502ef7785.en: An exhibition at the Palais des beaux arts de Lille on William Turner and British artists of the Grand Tour, focusing on how travel shaped landscape painting. Guided and workshop visits are offered on set days.

5c40b213073e1f386c7a98d6dc46dc2d5fc9608d.en: Festibambins, a festival for children aged 6 months to 6 years, marks its tenth edition from 21 to 29 November across Wattignies and Templemars. Tickets are 3.50 euros per show, and booking is required.

be9ffe063c965f2cff6f6222e237623aa897929c.en: A beginners' theatre workshop led by Sébastien Lenglet, a Conservatoire teacher, covering basic acting exercises. It takes place on Saturday 21 November 2026 from 10:00 to 13:00, is limited to 12 places, and is open to people aged 18 and over.

47111d51e4e7b3e7a74834535c927dd3e36e2175.en: A visit to the Roubaix library and archives to learn how historical documents are processed before they join the digital library. The session includes coffee and cake with other enthusiasts.

aee6f1214092a617505d37725092cb2ae592ecf9.en: A digital café workshop on maintaining and securing a computer, covering file clean-up, updates, passwords, antivirus protection, online scams and backups. A question-and-answer session follows.

21bfacfcd3f0b83a86eb29a23418f28955427538.en: A creative workshop on making children's books with illustrator Malika Doray, who publishes with Ecole des loisirs, MeMo and Didier jeunesse. It takes place at the Lille-Sud library.

be31b15ed8fe9e4d4bcbe8bc3dc22b4fbc718507.en: A musical storytelling session for children aged 0 to 3 at the Moulins library, with guitarist Jérôme from the association Filofil singing nursery rhymes and songs. Registration is required.

38659c4b16a55687beb0c8a6441c682c529cf831.en: A monthly reading club hosted by the Till L'Espiègle library in Villeneuve d'Ascq, where members discuss books, films and series. It is free and open to teenagers and adults on Saturday 21 November at 10:30.

1764556c6496f07005cff353a4fe966389cfcf62.en: A workshop at the Fives library in which participants make a small book from a bookmark-sized paper strip, showing different translations of one text. It is run by La Contre Allée with translator Marie Van Effenterre and author Fanny Quément.

860d4b63845e5c24fcee0a40b84bd900df10b4e3.en: A playful reading session at the Tourcoing André Malraux library, with words, music, songs and a practical workshop for young children accompanied by an adult.

cfa193f7374599936b256df632903ddb9ac84ad6.en: A free serious game at the Till L'Espiègle library on the justice system, in which participants act as defence lawyers and judges while a Lille lawyer represents the accused. Suitable from age 14.

45ee1aad9599bbffb2c00bc54aba03538a8d368e.en: A selection of previously recommended books from the Ludomédiathèque Colette, shared as a list from earlier sessions of the Livres & papote series.

a0b87ab4e2a8763f3feb2f7eb22d5e71eb0aca63.en: A musical awakening session for young children at the Saint-Maurice Pellevoisin library, led by the association Afriskaspora with world percussion instruments, followed by a rhythmic musical show.

67d1977db611804373ff5baec1185e41b70922f8.en: An open writing club at the Vieux-Lille library, run by Kimberley, where aspiring and experienced writers share their practice, their worlds and their difficulties, and can write together.

74ecfb62225e519aea59a9a4d807412c2afbde8c.en: A family weekend at the Opéra de Lille, with the Zonzo Compagnie, featuring shows, sound installations, a treasure hunt and workshops. Some activities cost a single 3 euro fee and need booking from 3 November at 13:30.

3182ae023d1a28af9fbbbacd6ea7892572827449.en: A children's workshop at Le Tripostal in which participants decorate a clay plant pot with felt pens to make a character and add seeds. It lasts about 45 minutes, is for ages 6 and up, and children must be accompanied by an adult.

fed20aecce187d13b60d082907dee21b33005ac5.en: A writing workshop at the Andrée Chedid library using word games to explore personal and individual commitment through writing. It is light-hearted and open to all.

2ac013cbbc98873487ec93a32148781aae697cd2.en: A book club called the Club des Tulalus at the La Grand-Plage library in Roubaix, where readers share favourite and least favourite books in a friendly setting.

8b94ab465955fe0197cbd983de1fb1ea52981707.en: A Christmas craft workshop at the André Malraux library in Tourcoing, where participants make paper decorations to keep or give. Materials are provided.

9ad7f59a29b4254c99685453484d84fe7f8de3e5.en: A parent-and-child workshop at La Source, combining a Micro-Folie visit on fashion and art with an embroidery workshop for children and adults. It draws on Vermeer's The Lacemaker from the Louvre.

2cf8ccfe9641a93624194d5c53ea0c1d3580f05a.en: Two days of dance and discussion at the Centre Eurorégional des Cultures Urbaines in Lille. On Saturday 21 November, a 3 euro jazz-to-house dance workshop runs at 15:00, followed by a 18:00 discussion on house culture.

a06c2df8ede8261dd52bf7fd023e422d63048790.en: A creative theatre reading of The Monologues of Gaza by students of the École du Nord, presented as part of the Théâtre du Nord's carte blanche at the Institut du monde arabe in Tourcoing. It is directed by Nam Du.

1cdf1970b234ae77a0f88097f72c83ec1b94861a.en: A reading afternoon at the Théâtre du Nord in which Ismaël Allem and Forbon N'Zakimuena retell picture-book tales. It runs one Saturday a month for children from age 5 and their parents, followed by a snack.

fa01d182dc0c8633dded53100eb7d8bc60fedfde.en: FUTVRE.XP, a showcase of emerging artists on two stages at La Condition Publique in Roubaix on 21 November 2026, from 16:00 to midnight. An official after party follows from midnight to 6:00 at Slalom.

79f0de304faa30038cf37547a5b82e1c8cb3f25e.en: A workshop at the Lille-Moulins library in which children and adults design tattoos on a large whale, which is then displayed at the library. It links to the show La Baleine tatouée on 14 November at 17:00. For ages 8 and up.

1107fb53a567fcb4b6a4043bdfef89ad8d807fdd.en: A preparatory workshop at the Lille-Moulins library before the show La Baleine tatouée by the Compagnie du Bonjour, on 14 November at 17:00 at the Maison Folie de Moulins. It uses puppetry and shadows. For ages 8 and up.

b264329598b5b53acf7f025abf188780e374411c.en: A restorative justice film screening at the Till L'Espiègle library in Villeneuve d'Ascq on Saturday 21 November at 17:00, followed by a discussion with a probation officer. It is free and open to ages 14 and over.

1705ffd5e6a60037a16ccbe724eb2c52bf9a1b9e.en: Writer Samira El Ayachi talks about becoming a novelist after growing up far from literary centres in the Lens mining basin. The session is part of the Institut du monde arabe carte blanche series in Tourcoing.

95fdc10e26d038ce02b8bc8821d065978b614368.en: A musical gathering for children from 12 months and their parents at the La Grand-Plage youth area in Roubaix, with traditional songs from around the world performed by Karim.

05bb5a3c8aad3a7ad204185a4ebd5b2a02db1131.en: A nightclubbing event at the Halles de la Mairie in Villeneuve d'Ascq on Saturday 21 November 2026, with underground house and techno sets by several DJs.

0699dc30ce9518348eadc10dc64b3123cdbd242f.en: A 10th anniversary evening at Le Grand Mix in Tourcoing, with karaoke of songs of exile from 19:30, the Fanfaraï Big Band at 21:00 and Ben Bella Jazz at 23:00.

a8b71ea2131e7befcb2b39ccdd6dec2ebf691305.en: Voix de Traverse at the Maison Folie Wazemmes is a collective show that brings together photography, writing, voice and music on migration and identity. It is part of Lille's international solidarity festival.

d1711a76f01e23cb9ca52ca295aa82800d34721a.en: Singer La Grande Sophie performs a hybrid show adapted from her book Tous les jours, Suzanne, staged by Johanna Boyé. It mixes song and reading about her career and life at Le Splendid in Lille.

39d5474cc5da294691f262292b73cb4ad14e840e.en: Comedian Edouard Deloignon performs his show Grandira plus tard at Le Zéphyr on Saturday 21 November 2026 at 20:00. It lasts 1h30, is for ages 16 and up, and tickets cost 33 to 37 euros.

514428fc3c23718fcc7ea71803efc22bfe0c6fa5.en: The Groove Des Familles, a Lille DJ collective, plays disco, house and global grooves at Le Bistrot de St So on Saturday 21 November. Free entry from 21:00 to 01:30, with food from 19:00.

1521aa74bf12eeb9037afe27867d63327f735d99.en: Arch Club at Slalom in Lille, an immersive club night from the arch label, which blends experimental electronic music and new-generation rap. It is part of the Futvre.xp after-party line-up.

61bc0e18a736797367157d73b99183b46e4d9940.en: A traditional Sainte-Cécile concert at the Salengro hall in Lille on Sunday 22 November at 11:00. Entry is free.

c54540504663434aa5705206c434a913cf56a4b6.en: A micro-conference at La Source on the Bayeux Tapestry, the 11th-century embroidery that depicts the Norman conquest of England by William the Conqueror.

7f0691116e9863d197c36c3cf0d28d357bbfe76d.en: A bingo afternoon organised by the Association des Jardins Familiaux de la Basse Marlière at La Ruche, on Sunday 22 November 2026. Doors open at 12:30 and the game starts at 14:00.

4b67677ee3e8ca1417b142e76cfce064d1b5e078.en: A guided walk through Lille in the First World War, looking at the statues and monuments built after 1918 to remember resistance figures and civilians. Lille was occupied by Germany from October 1914.

820d0a55da734f3f960665d9d95be0225fc6501b.en: A painting workshop at the Maison Folie Moulins in which illustrator Vincent Gavériaux teaches acrylic techniques, painting one local species per session. Sessions run on set Sundays from 15:00 to 17:30, for ages 14 and up.

527e8ea4f43e8cade3b4cf151bbbf9f456c5a126.en: A concert at the Institut du monde arabe in Tourcoing by Christine Zayed, whose music draws on classical Arab music, maqam and contemporary Palestinian poetry. It is part of the Attacafa carte blanche.

3c6b1a5ae27a79e24b031d13e78a9464805dad9e.en: A presentation of the Maison Folie Moulins, a Lille arts venue housed in 19th-century brewery buildings and rehabilitated in the early 2000s. It hosts multidisciplinary artistic projects.

9ad6332b4719f84a44374bb2d6c35818c901326a.en: A guided tour of the permanent collections at La Piscine museum in Roubaix, held every Sunday.

3f393b9effb297a002aeda8d379d01d831dbaae3.en: Savannah Bay by Marguerite Duras, staged by Dumme Kuh Théâtre at the Grange de la ferme Dupire in Lille. It is a one-hour two-voice play about an ageing actress and a young visitor who questions her past.

5ee666443e0f440cd3125b780289acfc83c36165.en: The Fakir Trio plays jazz at the Institut du monde arabe in Tourcoing, celebrating the institute's 10th anniversary. The trio's second album is due in October 2026.

7d9736e351998884ad1feaa640b61a38f8e67c8e.en: Respire par la Manivelle, a play by Daniela Ginevro at La Ferme d'en Haut. It follows a girl and her overworked single mother, dealing with single-parent families and everyday pressures with humour.

2131d3369311c3b21a43d9be5a7433d7f13df052.en: A screening at Le Méliès cinema, echoing the show Corvidae at La rose des vents. The film follows director Emmanuel Cappellin as he meets scientists such as Pablo Servigne and Jean-Marc Jancovici on climate collapse.

5faaf22adec09adede3ff7c3801a400df36f2851.en: Trouble Fête #2 at the Maison Folie Moulins, a festival for artists living with psychiatric conditions or autism, with concerts, workshops, talks and an exhibition programmed by the association En Marges.

f7c35acbf6bb5bd06dc1b3213c3dc73c0528ac89.en: A manga drawing workshop at La Source, where participants explore new manga releases to create their own characters.

41be16e1b4f077990476a6e88cf09c904618f1c4.en: A film screening at a Lille cinema about communities in Cambodia and Cameroon fighting land grabbing, and in France. The director attends the screening for discussion.

962ead98ae39e5b888ced5826cc9ddd95dae9256.en: A heavy music evening at Le Splendid in Lille with Norwegian band Årabrot, a noise rock and post-metal act, and Lost in Kyiv, who open the show.

0b92609d1ba2063118387f53aa30c4ba32e3f3a5.en: The Zac Schulze Gang, a blues-roots power trio from Great Britain, plays at the BAM in Lille on Monday 23 November 2026 at 20:30. Tickets cost 9 euros or 6 euros.

a8d50e1081ee45e3108645bfe4cc927b02d118d7.en: A monthly lunchtime talk at the La Piscine museum on the Paris Commune, held as part of the exhibition Ni Dieu ni maître. Arts et anarchie de Courbet à Banksy. It takes place on Tuesday 24 November 2026 at 12:30.

c3827078523572c3c1766286f18b75ec8b3c5db4.en: Trailer Park, a dance show by choreographer Moritz Ostruschnjak for ten performers at La rose des vents. It draws on more than 600 social media videos and combines voguing, hip-hop, waacking and popping.

34312d67a6f6b6c54f5a69d31fb31ae6e872e9cb.en: A guided visit to the Claude Huriez hospital in Lille, which shows the plan for a single hospital and university campus, designed with architect Jean Walter. It is run by the regional hospital museum association.

d8f379de661d13b4634d12eb02679734a7f43204.en: A charity music festival in Lille where every concert ticket pays for one new toy for children from social centres. Four themed evenings aim to reach 1,500 children.

095a5c8071149c870127589adb794e238ff984fb.en: The first issue of the psychoanalysis journal Jocaste, themed Vertige, is launched at the LaM museum with talks by guest speakers, including psychiatrist David Deneufgermain.

d4f61b168fae8830e9f9b28f5851500c94499407.en: The Anthropocène Museum, an exhibition set in a future where a buried city is discovered by teenagers in the year 5940. It is staged at the Grange at La Ferme Dupire in Lille, metro Triolo.

aa510b5708b9f8ac49a5121d9d2a119d3d3c405f.en: A free blind test hosted by Victor, with goodies to win. It is open to all.

dd6ae1d4ff21d70b0c51e26a5cbed7ec1e32b983.en: Feu. Chatterton returns to the stage at the Zénith de Lille, three years after their album Palais d'argile, which was certified platinum.

073159cf76fc9a3595181f240b69bf877514cff4.en: Rawww: the musician Yanamko plays at La Bulle Café in Lille on Tuesday 24 November 2026. He comes from Ariège and is based in Toulouse.

a28f6fb1f7bad33fc954fad92bc9352f2b6cb5f8.en: Minitel, a tribute concert to the band Téléphone at Le Splendid in Lille. It is led by Christophe Dubois, a musician with Calogero and Florent Pagny.

2bb66530f715df850e101238d0a65b6dc325f8ac.en: Cabaret Express B.D., a show by Théâtre d'à côté at the Grange at La Ferme Dupire in Lille, adapting short comic strips with a bar open during the performance.

ae8bb895b9a508808ead83c1d80d98573e5353d7.en: A story time for babies aged 0 to 3 at the Bois Blancs library in Lille, with songs, nursery rhymes and finger games.

a3463fa396e237d307e2a60071134311d3360bd5.en: A baby yoga session for parent and child at the André Malraux library in Tourcoing. Participants should wear comfortable clothes and socks.

1aea8ac680fc9dc2b8842fff7a0ba8999398a3d1.en: An exhibition of 50 favourite albums chosen by figures from Lille's cultural life, marking the 20th anniversary of Caf&Diskaire. It runs from 6 November to 4 December, with an opening on 6 November at 19:00.

79fdd1fe5952250c2f6896947e0cfcd5baccde8f.en: Cap40, a musical reading at the Lille-Moulins library in which five women around 40 share their personal lives, with a question about what can be said on social media.

4fd4cc4beae3f5de442e9669611bbfda4f84162a.en: A screening at the Cinéthèque in Lille of the film A King in New York, as part of a partnership with La Piscine museum. The film follows an exiled king who arrives in the United States.

2b7583cf3b9ca77d30cfa52e62dc69a9efae30f9.en: A talk at the Forum départemental des Sciences in Lille with physicist Jean-Marc Lévy-Leblond on whether the universe really had a beginning, questioning the Big Bang as an absolute start.

bbeae50f5c06bdb73b56cc847dd3b801fd344282.en: Crevarde., a musical reading by Compagnie Thec at La Ferme d'en Haut, given on the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women. It follows a woman in a police station, preceded by a speech.

0aba4276562ef4a1d3d32be3816843cb8507454a.en: Biographies, a circus show by Cie Ea Eo at Le Prato in Lille. A juggler's thoughts are voiced by a rapper while she moves between virtuosity, doubt and euphoria.

4f2441903c15723749d4daace719dbf9ee2c8c02.en: An evening at the maison Folie Wazemmes with the duo Jeannette & MAJ, playing garage house and electronic pop, followed by Michel Hubert's audio-visual show Electro-Tonique.

c1f0e076d87f5d6cbdb6fa97ac31be69f50e8093.en: A jam session open to all levels at the Musical in Lille, with drums, keyboard, microphones, guitar, bass and amplifiers provided on site. There is a large terrace.

65c8cfcd5b62f74a1de673f93aa8e870e7c098a6.en: Stabat mater, a solo dance piece by Lou Cantor with Cie Ulysse & Ernest at Le Vivat in Armentières. It starts as a recital, and draws on the Renaissance tradition of women mourning Christ.

6a24c6e25e460b5b777edd8a4f8859a54023fdf4.en: Stephan Eicher performs at the Théâtre Sébastopol in Lille. His songs, written with novelists Philippe Djian and Martin Suter, grew out of piano and guitar sessions with friends.

29b4304ad10ada6497271215b33b0160cd8d492d.en: Gravier, a raw garage rock band with post-punk and surf influences, plays at Amul Solo in Lille, followed by the Wednesday evening jam session.

cfb47c89d18f864b45950cef71bfb4552dda88f3.en: The FDTour 2026 at EuraTechnologies in Lille, a one-day event for entrepreneurs with morning workshops and an afternoon networking lunch. It includes speed meetings with more than 15 investors and support organisations.

2fad808a4ed39cce360d62990c99b871974f3ba2.en: A guided talk at Lille's town hall on the monument to Gustave Delory and Roger Salengro and its restoration. It also covers Salengro's legacy as mayor of Lille from 1925 to 1936.

1ebb5519c24dbb1ef6395a25a8f28de6b0147762.en: A performance by Naomi van Niekerk and Arnaud van Vliet combining sound and animation at La pouponnière, followed by a night visit of the exhibition Mémoire d'enfants and a talk with the artists. The performance starts at 18:15.

2ba69eb8207f472aa4d579663ab01a372caa8bdf.en: A chamber concert at the Opéra de Lille with works by Laure M. Hiendl and John Cage, performed by soloists of the ensemble Ictus.

358f7c14f254e6d16a660e6fc995f1f7d0649b51.en: An interactive talk at the Charles de Gaulle birthplace on how humans learned to capture and draw with light, from basic physics to the invention of photography.

c2db30b54df67a9c63434867699b73b08882b557.en: Les Rencards du climat, a meeting at Le Bus Magique in Lille for people who are involved or want to get involved in environmental action.

95562439a0daf694f357de75b6844274c63e8e35.en: An open mic night at the Musical in Lille hosted by Le Clan McLeod, where rappers perform 16 bars over an instrumental by DJ Stamiff. Sign-up is through Zeuzloo.

143dfd6f6097385e8dbed20bf1afed210be073cc.en: A screening of the film Un hiver russe by Patric Chiha, about young Russian exiles between Paris and Istanbul. It is followed by a discussion with the director on Monday 26 November at 19:30 at Le Fresnoy.

87e4e23c5ed91cdb4bb295f2c720e52cf51b5a00.en: Elephant on a Wire, a rock, pop and folk band playing at Amul Solo in Lille.

8f09f60a816698b368b6de2f621098a78c04f0f4.en: Luiza performs at Le Splendid in Lille, presenting her self-titled debut album, which is built around her voice and the languages of her childhood.

16bad25df25c3f021a29c9138426a559b72fa327.en: A conference at La Source on the effects of artificial intelligence on families, covering benefits, risks such as data protection, critical thinking and dependence on digital tools.

77b696fedfb2fd60d9d07c295bb6ddebbedbd7b3.en: Helena performs at the Zénith de Lille on her first solo tour. She rose to attention after a Star Academy tour, where her single Summer body became a summer hit.

83bc2722c005ae0756343c1d53bf96fed0b6c401.en: Yogahahaha at Le Tripostal, a laughter yoga and movement session at 19:00 as part of the exhibition Éclats du rire. No experience is needed, and a soft drink is served afterwards.

917ae8ce3cc470cb8af8a2ae1e14b7d79579854d.en: Les Mains de ma mère, a theatre piece by Compagnie Ratibus at TOK'ICI about a mother, her daughter and their grandmother. Live music is composed from the text.

92764da3ab27dfb43e68f2495aa21c7a108a6824.en: A video game quiz hosted by Thomas B at Caf&Diskaire in Lille, linked to current gaming news.

7289fd266410fa693a69202a8b7c5e7da0b63386.en: Raven Paul Collection, a band playing at Amul Solo in Lille.

b1c264f655410e899b807e59173903f06328a451.en: A weekly jam session at Amul Solo in Lille, held on Wednesday evenings.

50c99a7748b6c13dbf19e2b3bc0e80ef06fba5e9.en: A practical electrical workshop on Friday 27 November 2026 from 14:00 to 16:00 in Lille, covering bulb and fuse replacement and radiator upkeep. It is limited to eight people, and the address is sent on registration. It is run by Compagnons Bâtisseurs.

fb623685fe19896b7b6bef6ccbb4847e293cc8f3.en: A monthly conversation café for people who speak French as a foreign or non-native language, at the Ludomédiathèque Colette in Lille.

ac51ae9e945629b99a0697a2c7a73876b61c0b77.en: Les Belles Sorties, a moving-reading theatre piece about Zouz, whose mother makes him try a new sport every Wednesday afternoon. It is part of the Pôle Culturel Maurice Schuman programme.

43bbe0da313666dda5a5d4f073483d0a8dda2d4b.en: Kill Me This Monday, an alternative rock, metal and post-psychedelic hardcore band from Dunkirk, playing at Amul Solo in Lille.

8686a6307ac21cc9951aed9257f8b21a9cd8bf22.en: A punk and rock evening at Caf&Diskaire in Lille with two bands, Pounque and Dudin, who have played punk and rock for more than two decades.

a46c55bd120a2a7b0ae66f88a43003134c7a7236.en: A rock evening at the Salle Henri Watremez with the duos Bandit Bandit and Madam, both guitar-driven acts with French lyrics.

7d2b9dd1fbf6bf50c2a592fc3ddf91b4e6c4740e.en: Handsome Jack, a three-piece roots rock band from New York State, plays at La Source in Tourcoing as part of the Jazz en Nord series. Their latest album, Barnburners, came out in 2026.

6cefc4b1a912afe3174f2beb2ed94cf141981cab.en: Kulturr, a young urban rap artist aged 24, performs at the FLOW centre in Lille. His songs blend rap, R&B and African sounds, and he has released the EP HOPE: Imany.

b729e488d2c01488bd6df07f61800003ed2defe4.en: Bandit Bandit, Madam and Nûr play at the Salle Henri Watremez in Roubaix on 27 November as part of the Haute-Fréquence festival. Bandit Bandit's new album is Cavalcades.

683a98509607f4ffbca3373ac88960511d93e6ed.en: Rua Philadelphia, a Brazilian band with saxhorn, pandeiro, cavaquinho and seven-string guitar, playing calm and lively music.

bf47837409b64c907bf78032bc55c758f6a7646d.en: The Depeche Mode Experience, a tribute show at Le Nouveau Chapitre in Lille that recreates the band's sound and visual style, with singer Rod Mak.

82b694e229794e731e7a6df2c59a60f84bc61d37.en: Alex Lutz performs his show Sexe, Grog et Rocking Chair at Le Zéphyr in Lille on Friday 27 November 2026 at 20:00.

109b1f83e0a89ac96d17d28877d481fc4e151610.en: Cat Nothing, the solo project of Lille artist J.Eztak, playing sparse folk with noisy, shoegaze and lo-fi influences at Amul Solo.

2d43f0b53333d790c3de640521174043c44e793c.en: Tour de Chauffe #20 at the Centre Musical Les Arcades in Lille, a festival where eight young bands from 2026's programme play alongside established artists across six cultural venues from 19 to 29 November. Siân Pottok and Houda perform.

ca8aa4f0a2624eb8d8c7abd8c918183a385a9bcf.en: Matt Van T, a one-man country band performing retro country and honky-tonk from a suitcase turned into a bass drum, at TOK'ICI.

240855f82d0a077da4f1cc5fbffcf2e7d4e38327.en: Zababoum, a Brazilian forró pé de serra band with diatonic accordion, percussion and voices, playing at a musical venue in Lille.

b38b3c0222b48cc52693fab839c792dc8065ba3a.en: Sunset Motel Vacancy, a musical project by a Lille group where each track tells a story linked to a motel, with arrangements built like soundtracks. It plays at Amul Solo.

1122296a052e1fdcc3cf1235d7d9116d39067849.en: A one-session workshop at the Roubaix La Grand-Plage library, run by volunteers from Club LinuX Nord-Pas-de-Calais, on installing and using the free Linux operating system to revive a slow PC.

794773c0cdd30357b234b036b35a968ce7521c91.en: A storytelling session at the Lille-Moulins library with enchanted tales for children and families.

74b2bda3c8ec6ca5e53ac96dd3ab59f2df87420b.en: A Dutch conversation café at the André Chedid library in Lille, led by a Dutch host. It is open to all levels, and aims to share the language and culture of the Netherlands.

3278429cec59fd01109d4cd4c5d9827bd02c4808.en: A speed-dating style session at the Roubaix La Grand-Plage library, where groups of two or three move between rare heritage documents brought out of storage. Each document is shown for a short time before moving on.

9f6a5121cd1d7d79ebaee2f784882d17c978be73.en: Author Walter Baud, a former gendarmerie investigator, discusses his crime novels at the Till L'Espiègle library on Saturday 28 November at 11:00. It is free and open to ages 14 and up.

45a1f410adaa2a2c13a4eb41dbbdddb637f5d11b.en: A deduction game for children aged 5 to 10 at the Till L'Espiègle library on Saturday 28 November at 14:00. Players search the shelves for clues to find the culprit, alone or in teams. It is free.

e4c04f20ed2df28ee55fb8290f49ba25fd3cb637.en: A screening of the documentary Hitch, une histoire iranienne by Chowra Makaremi (2019, 72 minutes), which links the 1979 Iranian revolution to the director's family history. It is held at the Andrée Chedid library.

ac6a9a64e2089ca321bac6ee345d8850b1602681.en: A lantern-making workshop at La Ferme d'en Haut, with stories and activities, ahead of the Saint Nicolas parade on Saturday 5 December. Lanterns are made for the parade, and free tickets are given to children with a lantern. It is free.

e995455644e5a0e36907989ac0e6561651601757.en: A poetic cookie-decorating workshop at the Jean-Lévy library in Lille, run by the publisher Vous Êtes Ici with Amandine Hubert, as part of the Lille Poésie Festival.

cdd504009d3fea5ca1069ea1c54e6cec4037ef4b.en: Plastik Kwack, an energetic rock band from Lille, playing at Amul Solo.

a4a9dcfe890fc371a49697a52fde1bca4815c6b6.en: Blandine Lehout performs at the Théâtre Sébastopol in Lille, a stand-up show about being a young mother, couple life and grief for the life before children.

17ce73f7b057634bc89660a1dfce99f6c24111e1.en: Les Belles Sorties, the moving-reading theatre piece about Zouz and his weekly sports, performed at the Espace Jean Noël in Lille.

09f7964150541bf7b3066a963631b80ddab24daf.en: A thriller-themed blind test at the Till L'Espiègle library on Saturday 28 November at 17:30. It covers films, series and soundtracks, and is part of the closing night of L'affaire novembre. It is free.

91a8615f14c2c05ebdfb05cb37ff75ba0ea5c4e9.en: 9 Dollz, a band playing at Amul Solo in Lille.

c439431676f85892e3b425373711e026e971e7a2.en: Apollo 71, a band playing at Amul Solo in Lille.

54626e21b9e8422aad13347c392878949c845ad2.en: Emel Mathlouthi, known for her song Kelmti Horra, plays at the maison Folie Wazemmes as part of the Haute Fréquence festival, with Hajar Benhsaïn. The show follows her fourth album MRA.

e1f6bd068fc987f8eb73c3f97a22d6eac9a13a8c.en: A double bill at Caf&Diskaire in Lille with Frame, an alternative and post-rock quartet, and Lorem Ipsum, a hardcore and post-rock band with folk guitar, violin and piano.

f4ba6d72ec2961811c621df73b4fa5015336f27a.en: Revers de paillettes by Compagnie Tourne Au Sol at the Salle Octave d'Hespel in Lille, a show mixing juggling, dance and theatre about identity and the courtier who waits for a king's return.

dc0624322b40cec4e8466d1a776542b14a908f15.en: Emel Mathlouthi and Hajar Benhsaïn at the maison Folie Wazemmes in Lille as part of the Haute Fréquence festival, with Attacafa.

5350ab7bd82e7ac4e6ddcbb84c583568a04e44b0.en: Laura Calu performs her show Senk at Le Zéphyr in Lille on Saturday 28 November 2026 at 20:00. Tickets cost 35 euros or 30 euros.

b41ab9af1e1383b32116d5bead9631596ab616c7.en: Les 2010, a contemporary dance piece by Sylvain Groud with the Ballet du Nord at Le Grand Sud in Lille. Seven dancers perform a portrait of adolescence, with conversations written by novelist Samira El Ayachi.

047615993d886ebf6b3d9b8d187f7acc4c05dd60.en: Jwles, a French rapper raised in the United States, performs at the FLOW centre in Lille. He has worked with US underground artists and with French producers Blasé and Mad Rey.

df38f7a0263e9556a5596ceca29202462e5864f9.en: Comedian Anthony Kavanagh presents a new show at Le Splendid in Lille, mixing personal stories, observations on modern life and improvisation.

584634cd326592edd48e26e6ce1bee6903dfe317.en: Jwles, a French rapper raised in the United States, performs at the FLOW centre in Lille with guests to be announced. His style draws on rap, fashion and visual culture.

8014ea73fdd7bb565b7335ca15a196c05188bb41.en: Sylvain Groud's dance piece [Les 2010] at Le Grand Sud in Lille, created with seven young dancers under 20. The show uses light and body precision to explore fear, desire and adolescence.

3d991effb2e605f6fe019601de1462707b311fdc.en: A show at the Grange at La Ferme Dupire in Lille of four short pieces by René de Obaldia, mixing humour, fantasy and satire. It is co-organised by the collective Arts Scènes à Dupire.

cf777f26abc362ee7676c73bd695f67a51089e4c.en: Cobalt and Daysy perform an intimate acoustic tour date at Le Verlaine in Lille, sharing songs on guitar in a small-format autumn show.

43c49d869093f7a308628bb5924b723da61dacb2.en: Manu Le Malin and David Asko play hardcore, techno and acid sets at Le Bistrot de St So in Lille on Saturday 28 November. Entry is free from 21:00 to 01:30, with food from 19:00.

a53708f26dec0e88b435795c1458f29d41b6211a.en: Sea Horse Shoe, a four-piece alternative rock band from Lille with grunge influences, playing at Amul Solo.

46ec71d57738ab56f446d650c7c954f454cafbe1.en: Request Failed, a pop and rock cover band that plays at a musical venue in Lille.

08cc78c9b904172955fbaf4ffdfbd0b7affb61c7.en: A hard rave night at Kodz with NOSS, featuring hard techno, acid, industrial and hardcore sets by a line-up including Yoshiko, Doruksen and Area One.

cfbde918bc0be276140d3135c04f99b663a117df.en: K-Pop Shadow Slayers, an original musical mixing singing, dance, theatre and cosplay, staged at Le Zéphyr in Lille on Sunday 28 November 2026 at 11:00. The show is sold out.

bf486c3027bcc950eff3cbe88d10ddd92645ccda.en: A monthly seniors' dance at the Salle du Gymnase in Lille, organised by the city's P.A.S.S. Seniors service on the last Sunday of each month. Music covers rock, 1980s, French songs and more.

fc79442e805a6f3a42dedbba029fdee5c265291d.en: A piano recital by Andrei Leshkin, a prize winner of the Étoiles du Piano competition, held at Le Fresnoy during the exhibition Panorama 28. A guided tour of the exhibition comes first.

091345b7ab50a01e3344cd9a5d83578853918a07.en: Pop Up, a dance piece at Le Gymnase in Lille by Pauline Bigot and Steven Hervouet with illustrator Bastien Contraire. It turns the stage into a giant pop-up book.

6d65b58fda32c760e67176753c9210d53fb23acb.en: Hazel, a rock band from Lille with 1960s and 1970s blues and psychedelic influences, playing at Amul Solo.

60f7a8e6646a3b4b99579df6a3f4a106b6f6c1ac.en: A family concert at La Source in Tourcoing featuring film music from Disney and Pixar, performed with the Philharmonie. It is designed for all generations.

80215210fa8d670b91ccdbac3da314f0b82f4f11.en: Revers de paillettes by Compagnie Tourne Au Sol at the Centre culturel du Moulin in Lille, a show mixing juggling, dance and theatre about identity and the courtier who waits for a king's return.

46547465134ccbbefa0093ac8e2cda51c5619ebc.en: A Tour de Chauffe #20 festival evening at Les Arcades in Lille with Célia Kameni and Jeanne Desf. Eight young bands from 2026 play across six partner venues from 19 to 29 November.

b410e1c08d7542d21b222a93a76ddadf19dcd5ff.en: Treefingers Kid, a solo musician whose dark poetry mixes Leonard Cohen and Radiohead influences, performing at Amul Solo.

0b7f3a1d41073a1614297c981ebb0ac232bf5ec6.en: Shake'Em and the Jukes, a band playing electric blues in the style of 1950s Memphis and Chicago, paying tribute to Muddy Waters, Little Walter and John Lee Hooker, at Amul Solo.

7ef68d33ad3468916aaeac183c408bef49d02f27.en: An additional date of the acoustic tour by Cobalt and Daysy at Le Verlaine in Lille, in an intimate autumn format with guitar songs.

57d1bdf16f6d6c986c71a87a539db72f72629d2d.en: Un virage pour Jacky, a solo dance piece by Magda Kachouche for Jacky Medefo, mixing African dance traditions with waacking and pop culture. It is staged in situ at La Piscine museum in Roubaix.

d1ac9d34bb83074d737a59c07eed146a15d32b2f.en: A nature discovery programme at the André Malraux library in Tourcoing, with documentaries, picture books and games. It runs in weekly themed sessions from 1 December to 2 January.

9a49a061a1cee303f55d408de2fc55e58e27cf2d.en: Am I Real?, a dance piece by Jihyé Jung at the Théâtre de l'Oiseau-Mouche in Roubaix, mixing digital tools with memory fragments from her South Korean and European background.

0450de002013ce53ed05515b5e4588ddf993562a.en: An adult autumn drawing course at the Musée de l'Hospice Comtesse in Lille, covering charcoal techniques and contrast in several sessions.

e23dd8c62ca9036cfc2ec1a6f834eded0f6012ee.en: A showcase of the Voix de Traverse project at the Conservatoire de Lille auditorium on Tuesday 1 December 2026. It is a collective show combining photography, writing, voice and music on migration and identity.

cea4514d83df516ba49a2adbd2a65f8db229e4a3.en: Peter Doherty performs a solo guitar and voice concert at the Palais des beaux arts de Lille, following an earlier date at L'Aéronef.

9c5e7a519575ed05f7d0c7b6c43b908c65bbeba2.en: Mora, an artist from Lille with Algerian roots, plays her first solo date in her home city at La Bulle Café on Tuesday 1 December 2026. Her music draws on nostalgia and childhood.

1c5c87c828d4730af5a3abe53ba29a832682b23b.en: Un jour j'irai à Vancouver, a theatre piece by Rachid Bouali and Cie La Langue pendue at Le Vivat in Armentières. It tells of a Hem youth who discovered theatre in a neighbourhood workshop.

8b7f0de0aa5a304506ad4a5012ccb1efbd6d5e40.en: CLAC, a 1h30 play by Théâtre d'à côté at the Grange at La Ferme Dupire in Lille, about a family dealing with a dying grandmother. It is for ages 14 and up, with themes such as prostitution and domestic violence.

b110a3340a19396ca96f30a73412e7871a734bc8.en: Autonomic Lille Europe 2026, a trade fair on disability, ageing and care at the Lille Grand Palais, bringing together providers and innovators from France and Europe.

31e42bd933356a9d1f5d23ecf224e93fd0ec2cb1.en: A Christmas display at the Charles de Gaulle birthplace in Lille from 2 December, recreating a 19th-century family Christmas decorated by antiques dealer Johan Hennart.

b87dbcb083734b5af6ddb830128f968cfd1da15e.en: Tout petit pixel by Compagnie Sous les étoiles at Le Grand Sud in Lille, a sensory show in which a singer and a musician play hide-and-seek with an unseen cat.

ccd8cbdf746604d6ffc72dce11cd94bc24ccba33.en: A library book sale at the Tourcoing library. The programme will be published later.

a2ddad1b677133978b64f98980060ee733c0f1d8.en: A Christmas decoration workshop at the Saint-Maurice Pellevoisin library in Lille on Wednesday 2 December from 15:00 to 17:00. Children aged 6 and up make snowmen, trees and Father Christmas hats. It is free, with registration.

a7af2997b2ed24b69d4eeb508ab065a023ee3b6e.en: A talk at La Maison de l'Habitat Durable in Lille on the responsibilities of tenants and landlords for repairs and upkeep, on Wednesday 2 December 2026 from 16:30 to 17:30. It is run by Compagnons Bâtisseurs, with a maximum of 15 places.

9eaa20eac6d1b66d6d931a8ea6312e824d8277e3.en: Corpo da Ballo Kids, a collective walk-through dance piece by Silvia Gribaudi at La Condition Publique in Roubaix, created with children and adults after work with a school in Roubaix.

0aa9211e8187f85411853c351b0730ef1d18aca8.en: A blind test and DJ night at Le Bistrot de St So in Lille on Wednesday 2 December, with blind test host Claudy at 20:00 and DJ Saiz. The blind test is free.

312a5c55e70271fe8cf3dbc4ac858ee890c956d7.en: Figures of Speech by Lander and Femke Gyselinck at La rose des vents in Villeneuve d'Ascq. Seven dancers and four musicians stage a meeting of rhythm, music and dance.

6f2f16661686953ebc2e5c00c2d4633652fa7e9a.en: A study day at Le Gymnase CDCN in Lille on queer cabaret, combining talks, performances and historical papers. It is organised by the Centre d'étude des arts contemporains of the University of Lille.

1c6f0190bdcf5e72d13e13c934d785c4fc368250.en: A talk on women's heart health by Professor Claire Mounier-Vehier, part of the CLIO lectures of the regional hospital museum association. It takes place on Thursday 3 December 2026 at 17:45 in Lille, with online booking required.

09b9b0a08602f5f88465fa1a2d794eacb2f69605.en: A screening of Kaouther Ben Hania's film The Voice of Hind Rajab at the Gare Saint-Sauveur in Lille. It recounts how a six-year-old girl in Gaza was trapped in a car in January 2024 while in contact with Red Crescent staff.

8feddd8205b12c562ce8d7ef3005d914b8d1c6ee.en: Flux Cabaret, a festive evening at Le Gymnase CDCN in Lille that closes the queer cabaret study day. It features the Flux Show trio with guest artists mixing performance, music and dance.

b79cb8f7ba683ceb583740a0f561245470e7d510.en: Ermonela Jaho, the Albanian soprano, performs in an opera recital at the Opéra de Lille, with works from La Traviata and Suor Angelica.

188651886491a7456596373412b8c4d910e636df.en: Lisa Pariente, a comedian with a sharp, unfiltered style, performs at La Bulle Café in Lille.

309f1f0d978b56599b01516aa29a17ac2c186189.en: A free business networking event for entrepreneurs and public bodies at the Hauts-de-France regional headquarters in Lille, organised by the Région to support entrepreneurship and territorial appeal.

ba5a4588f546099b06d2cc5160848b7727c2e77f.en: Washing Machine, the Sound of the Waves, a sketch by the directing students of the École du Nord, presented at the Théâtre du Nord in Lille. It is written and directed by Ella Amstad Ngoko.

c3c094990920a1bfcdeae48051726222ddc8efa6.en: A family screening at Maison Folie Moulins: a documentary on digital family practices, a debate led by Internet Sans Crainte and tips on children's online use. Free on registration, Friday 4 December at 18:30.

090fbada3e5cd68233054d51e9d7eea0ec594fcc.en: A guided tour with a mystery guest at La Piscine museum in Roubaix on the history of anarchist press, as part of the exhibition Ni Dieu ni maître. It takes place on Friday 4 December 2026 at 18:30.

dcbd2488bc502354bba86a108933ef633e8554a4.en: A showing of an improvisation workshop by professional actresses at La Ferme d'en Haut. They perform without script or prepared staging after a week of training.

f63735f8145393afd7175cdf69cdb8f0f125a88c.en: Lymph Blood Story 9424, a solo dance, theatre and photography piece by Julie Botet of Compagnie Yonsk at the maison Folie Wazemmes. It is based on her childhood tongue surgery.

f64382bf96e9c04de9bfea5d602519de87945e1d.en: A reggae night at the BAM in Lille on Friday 4 December at 20:00, with the cover band Selektaz and the roots rock reggae group Tamasha Roots. Tickets cost 9 or 6 euros.

c83a3fb806614ca76d4555176b0bf8a2b4f5ae29.en: Nuttea, a figure of French reggae since the 1990s, performs at the FLOW centre in Lille. He is known for songs such as Elle te rend dingue.

d95baae97895b16e405d46454a31ca26f60a8747.en: L'imposture, a puppetry one-woman show by Lucie Hanoy and Big up cie at Le Vivat in Armentières. It tells the story of someone who never feels in the right place.

29b0a6e93442ec0ae22cfc99dec3e1db5bd8e6f5.en: Kad Merad and Michèle Laroque star in L'Âge bête at the Zénith de Lille, a comedy about two lovers in their sixties who refuse to act their age.

86651706bb1e60d4dcafbc398c7652b6deba359c.en: Jamais, a clown show by Cie l'Heure Avant l'Aube at Le Prato in Lille, reimagining Peter Pan as a man aged 45 who has lost Wendy.

c13d18112ead12e4e56a76ae78423a2ca3ceb183.en: The Stranglers play at Le Zéphyr in Lille on Friday 4 December 2026 at 20:00. The show is sold out, and the set includes Golden Brown, No More Heroes and Peaches.

7afce49ef7df06051a71557bc95b128fa165325f.en: Bardix Le Gaulois plays at Slalom in Lille on Friday 4 December, from midnight to 06:00. The venue is 18+ and has a discounted entry rate for Pass en Nord members.

3a47192063d7c70b231a2188bb0d3d4425d2f689.en: A Christmas workshop at the Ludomédiathèque Colette in Lille, where participants write haiku over a breakfast and then decorate a personalised book object to keep or give.

a583accaa5261d99d31d0baab2ce96495bcca551.en: A workshop at the Saint-Maurice Pellevoisin library in Lille on Saturday 5 December from 10:30 to 12:00, in which children make and decorate a Christmas stocking with the association La Trame. Free on registration.

034aaeeca635bd73b8f48e4df15d40cdcb3fa498.en: A remembrance tribute at the Square de la Mémoire in Lille to veterans from Algeria, Morocco and Tunisia who died for France, held with the Amicale des Anciens Combattants.

8798a2e7e6447ffbff1a0a2d5155a9c060e2fcb8.en: A science workshop at the Mons-en-Barœul library with Les Savants Fous on how the eye and brain perceive colours and images. Two sessions run at 14:00 and 15:45.

53b3f0235c09f1039f8d16266ce688f4c15874bf.en: A café on artificial intelligence at the Ludomédiathèque Colette in Lille. It covers how AI works and where it is used, with concrete demonstrations and open discussion.

e798f835aa5a7696b0e350d1808cfb8a53d8cb5c.en: A pop culture session for teenagers at the Andrée Chedid library in Lille, presenting new books, comics, manga, games and digital news, followed by a digital activity.

fcbd86e13bd094a4ce635a5c3755762c56337a5d.en: A role-playing game session at the Ludomédiathèque Colette in Lille, where participants create characters and adventures, guided by a game master.

ea2d526704d6f4ef113125ce173f8ba972a2059b.en: A writing workshop by Lille poet Dominique Quélen at the Vieux-Lille library, drawing on his work with language, the body and composers.

033dcdabbcc968742030016031985264031c62fe.en: A tribute to Jamiroquai by the band Synkronized at the Bunker Paillettes in Lille on Saturday 5 December, followed by a DJ set by Wallace. Tickets cost 5 euros in advance.

c4854df3cf02bea5142fd7f59ce8a3bb0d16359f.en: A 25th anniversary evening for the Da-Mas Family at the Salle Watremez in Roubaix on Saturday 5 December from 19:00 to 02:00, with a showcase by Mc Acondize and mixed Afro, Kabyle and rap acts.

8997714d3781abfcd30eeacad7229d2031157767.en: La Saint Sida, a festive night for World AIDS Day at Le Prato in Lille, with talks from associations and a show by the Sisters of Perpetual Indulgence.

002ea98815ca74a3251bb912d89b2ebfbfa835cb.en: Sofia Belabbes performs a one-hour stand-up show at the Lille Grand Palais, built around everyday anecdotes.

c26296674467f750f6df79098e0fe7be49ca4c6d.en: Archimède, a French chanson and British pop duo, performs at Le Zéphyr in Lille on Saturday 5 December 2026 at 20:00.

7ade0934db3c181a286bd94f83c481a3a71fd3b2.en: Scred Connexion, a French rap group, performs at FLOW in Lille on 5 December 2026 after a postponement. Earlier tickets stay valid, but holders must re-confirm to receive a new QR code.

da42e1c158b0861b4c7cc0d79fcd088bf9b37141.en: The fourth Salon Cré'Art at the Musée des Arts et Traditions Populaires in Lille on Sunday 6 December from 10:00 to 18:00. About fifteen makers exhibit, with demonstrations and a free prize draw. Entry is free.

179e5b820ed50854a8fca6522401dd601531e527.en: Classiques à la Ferme with Vivat Musica at La Ferme d'en Haut, a chamber concert of duos and quartets performing works from different regions. It is designed to be accessible to all.

c50dccb4d8e179b78984b743201813ca491d203d.en: On the first Sunday of the month, La Piscine museum in Roubaix opens its permanent collections for free. On Sunday 6 December, the exhibitions Ni Dieu ni maître and Révolution Denim are available at reduced rate.

791e4f0307b0f58dbd2254fde55309b84cff0f8d.en: An Arabic calligraphy workshop at the Institut du monde arabe in Tourcoing, led by master calligrapher Ahmad Dari, born in Jerusalem and trained in Damascus.

d40b45c44944aaaec154fe005f58cecb8131855d.en: A Sunday visit of the exhibition at MUba Eugène Leroy in Tourcoing, led by a museum mediator, for ages 15 and up.

18344244a10d3d4038dccb8a092495f7d9a890b7.en: MUba Famille at the MUba Eugène Leroy in Tourcoing, a playful visit of the exhibition followed by a collective practice session. It is for ages 5 and up.

dd9d9bd5dfb2e77db7ede6758fcc2a02467cbecb.en: The Roubaix Harmonie orchestra, conducted by Jean-Noël Oldman, performs with trumpeter Romain Leleu at the Roubaix conservatoire. The programme includes film music such as The Godfather Trilogy.

bf690395e240a11eac51de97ef1f6dede267fb8c.en: Samuel Bambi performs a stand-up show at the Lille Grand Palais, presenting himself as a bold and funny performer despite his youthful appearance.

82dc03bfb2f992cf6f59f056065b0fd3ed41ece2.en: A blood donation session at the Salle des Fêtes du Centre in Lille on Monday 7 December 2026, from 10:30 to 13:00 and 15:00 to 19:00. Booking online is recommended.

2744eb72746fec9c1d331c16180b9c21b17fa438.en: The Tout Petits Concerts at the Roubaix conservatoire, the fifth year of a vocal arts showcase by the Chapelle des Flandres association, which has worked in Roubaix for 35 years.

38e06d991cdedfa7e440d3f5c9f83260e1d18043.en: Cosmix, a concert at the Opéra de Lille by beatboxer Mystraw and singer Coline Dangre, combining hip hop, neo-soul and jazz with improvised sounds and voice.

de8e57198832e701fe9b1f5d98dae71ef15c7145.en: An HIV prevention evening at the Gare Saint-Sauveur in Lille on Tuesday 8 December, with testimonies, a film, cultural recommendations and on-site testing.

773c9b39cc91d4b8e2900f2d061d98f53f78276c.en: A mini block party at the Roubaix conservatoire, run by Cie Art Track, with hip hop performances, teaching moments and cyphers. It is open to all.

e08839e5e92e94c2e331d0c9e57470986ed490b1.en: A Digital Fresco workshop at the So Watt third place in Saint-André-lez-Lille, in three parts: a card game, a debrief and planning action. It follows the format of the Climate Fresco.

c7604f390470619bf9dc9379b79590a1a4138612.en: A talk at the Forum départemental des Sciences in Lille on whether evolution is a progress, questioning the idea that living forms become better or superior over time.

2db32109a37d4bdee56210ef92418e2e724f9806.en: A talk at the Tourcoing town hall on Tuesday 8 December 2026 at 18:30 on applying for planning permission for façade changes or extensions, including rules in protected areas. Registration is on the city website.

2e153c885e2b5474d91b86671ddafe3b17d6936f.en: The Dire Straits Experience, a tribute show at the Zénith de Lille as part of its The Long Highway Tour in December 2026, with Electric Pyramid as support act.

60e9531d047d76ccd75f0adc9094a27ba29bdfc1.en: Gribouille and the Father Christmas letter, a Christmas show at the Ludomédiathèque Colette in Lille about an elf who tries new jobs in Father Christmas's workshop.

e12333465a6f9b5d2616eac8b5ab43191a7454f1.en: A music session at the Aimé Césaire library in Tourcoing, revisiting classic nursery rhymes and new versions of them.

1c84d5efa418db6396ba7b7538c4367c8b05fd10.en: Wool: a great adventure, a family visit at the Ferme pédagogique Marcel Dhénin in Lille, exploring the history of wool from sheep fleece to textiles. It is free, for ages 3 and up, with registration.

d09cb1924156e6ab185906350b3c794862e3b227.en: Wednesday is anything goes at LaM, a monthly family session where children dress up, play and take part in art activities around the collection, with a new theme each time.

ceb313aa2fda0e30d914481e3cabac5484c1fe3b.en: A watercolour workshop at the Maison Folie Moulins in Lille on Wednesdays, where participants paint animals in their natural habitat with illustrator Océane Azeau. It is for ages 7 and up, on set dates.

3232de8463e61f2a6e33a0fbc8c7cb128b5b624c.en: À l'ombre des grands arbres, a musical play by Tony Melvil at La rose des vents, with original songs performed by a singer on accordion and a singer on ukulele. It is written for children.

28b525aacb9e3033614d01708c643acd71b86831.en: A Repair Café at the Forum des Sciences in Villeneuve d'Ascq, where volunteers help repair small appliances and everyday objects. Registration is optional.

e883fefb46c19a804c3164c423088fee214d1723.en: A screening of the documentary Paris Is Burning by Jennie Livingston, followed by a discussion, at Le Gymnase CDCN in Lille. It covers the ballroom scene and the birth of voguing in 1980s New York.

91f226e3fa2729ade9f6877b9480a1bfb00f02a6.en: The Award, a show by Back Pocket at Le Vivat in Armentières. A stage manager runs an awards ceremony in which backstage tensions unfold, mixing humour with acrobatics.

5dc3fefdc3d959eea3e6c8c67a6dd5395cdd1aca.en: Disiz performs at the Zénith de Lille with a six-piece band, presenting a show that mixes emotion and tension across his repertoire.

0529eda58f9346f87c65e3589ec69bb132b03d15.en: Eclisse Totale by the Quatuor Léonis at the Rose des Vents in Villeneuve d'Ascq, a musical show mixing virtuosity, humour and slapstick. Classical works are blended with rock, soul and Irish melodies.

aa475b93f1a4be6fe61d7812c84a739da4eac293.en: Théo Juice and the Sexy Music Live Band at La Bulle Café in Lille, an independent French artist mixing many influences in his live shows.

f84bb58ca9e8b6d071c2b1fe42c70aad79e4a744.en: A public event by the Lille branch of the LDH marking 10 December, the anniversary of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, on access to reliable information and public broadcasting. It takes place at the Gare Saint-Sauveur in Lille.

1343c5f4f3376eb430012d20d3b8ab2bda550200.en: Ennemi, a contemporary dance duo by Mélodie Lasselin and Léa Pérat at the Théâtre de la Verrière in Lille, created in 2022 after research in the Balkans on reconciliation after conflict.

d9305c0b3af52ebbd97e5ce50573b020621773ac.en: An opening event for the exhibition Dessin-Dessin at the MUba Eugène Leroy in Tourcoing, with a chance to talk with the museum team in front of the works.

2cd718bdc12b27809168526695aa47599bbe38b8.en: Dope Saint-Jude and Jeannette & MAJ at La Cave aux Poètes in Lille, with queer hip hop, electro and soul sets for a dancefloor night.

29ca67ce8ac54b576720ae6ffca34a6112a6118e.en: Témoin, a dance piece at the Opéra de Lille staged by Saïdo Lehlouh with twenty dancers, mixing krump, waacking and hip hop with the Gymnase CDCN.

e8dc9aa9b57914ae0f05c21a259bf288684298b2.en: A stand-up evening with four comedians from Le Loko Comedy Club at the Tripostal in Lille. Entry includes access to the exhibition Éclats du rire from 18:00 to 20:00 on showing a ticket.

86297751cd31b8156f6f9de62a4e623b2bd8e056.en: Java and Winston McAnuff, a reunion show at Le Splendid in Lille, with a joint EP planned before summer 2026 and two new studio albums to follow.

6c5e30d71067920365b57fea234333d80f51e5f1.en: Marie Jay performs at La Bulle Café in Lille, a 24-year-old French pop artist whose songs mix electropop and intimate chanson.

991d72fb224518f2f956ada30c08539e2fba66f5.en: A housing adaptation forum at the Tiers Lieu l'Épine in Hellemmes on Friday 11 December 2026 from 10:00 to 16:00. AMELIO and the Compagnons Bâtisseurs answer questions on adapting or renovating a home. Free entry.

ac6f877a680b90598a7992220b62b93af95d092f.en: A lunchtime visit at the Palais des beaux-arts in Lille, guided by Barbara Eckle, director of the Opéra, and Miron Hakenbeck, programme and dramaturgy director, through works on the stages of life.

6a3ea5f3bf35085ed3c466a79672d7bdd7395397.en: Monographie by Cie Defracto at La Prato in Lille, a juggling show in which a single-minded character plays with constraints and gravity to produce surprises with balls and hoops.

44c5a6a646404f6de1a604347874d40d8fb60554.en: The fourth Urban Trail at the MUba Eugène Leroy in Tourcoing, a colourful evening with music. More details are to follow.

848a093eef5f79539dc476e93c7d1a19ac0bc288.en: A meeting with poet Dominique Quélen at the Vieux-Lille library, who won the grand prix of the SDGL in 2026. He works with language and the body, with composers, and writes criticism.

730aaa28155b0c9917270047a7524a740dced33b.en: The Adventures of Baron Münchhausen by Compagnie Joker at the maison Folie Wazemmes, where a travelling troupe stages the tall tales of the famous baron with mechanical sets.

7ca7737f055b4e3929f0c0e7973cc522c7b8b982.en: A showcase by CJM'S, winner of Hip Hop Games France 2025, followed by the battle Faut Pas S'Looper, where beatboxers, loopers and beatmakers create music live. It is at FLOW in Lille.

14e207572a58d69d2cf5893d0331237b2ae534a6.en: Kalika performs at the Le Splendid concert hall in Lille. Her second album, the trash pop MA CLAQUE, is due out on 29 May 2026.

b0f520c16d67913022c791f53bf0cf410d7d905b.en: Greg Duth, a stand-up comedian at the Lille Grand Palais. The sketches are chosen at random by the audience, and each show is different.

aa73d4bc2d5318113af7f9a52e37bc06d7bf472f.en: Saez performs an exceptional concert at the Zénith de Lille on 11 December 2026 at 20:30.

35f24df8b730f12cad6eb3f6ea463e136e453485.en: Louise Contre Attaque, a tribute to Louise Attaque with five musicians playing 1h30 of live songs at the BAM in Lille on Friday 11 December 2026 at 20:30. Proceeds go to the Restos du Cœur.

9b3896416d35c796aa6646b57430f01c4d59b884.en: Swamp Evil, Project and Red Cloud play stoner, hard rock and heavy rock at Le Bistrot de St So in Lille on Friday 11 December. Entry is free from 21:00 to 01:30, with food from 19:00.

5b9ab8d4a4c6af33376ceab519b2a215b8f781a3.en: The Permanences roubaisiennes in December 2026 at the salle Pierre de Roubaix, where residents can talk directly with the mayor, councillors and city services about everyday issues.

09b608057915dd4a1c1521810d06ed899e997fb9.en: The early childhood programme 'En famille, l'atelier.' in Hellemmes, with free Saturday workshops for children aged 0 to 6 and their parents, covering music, reading, movement and art.

33034b179040b88974f0676d87ebd0addba62115.en: P.A.L (Pile à Lire), a reading session at the Ludomédiathèque Colette in Lille, presenting fantasy, romance, dystopian and mystery stories.

d4f22d66683874ea4996486084cb0ddb79c68c59.en: A Christmas market at the place de la République in Lille. The programme will be published later, and exhibitor applications were open until 10 October 2026.

84f73feaac91c98878a2daa4755a44d9ad6fdff8.en: The Father Christmas hike at the Base de loisirs du Fort on Saturday 12 December 2026, organised by Athletic Club de Wambrechies and Alliance Nord-Ouest, with two routes through fields and woods.

47d4df90f889e4c20690475763152183cbee7c25.en: A free family event at the maison Folie Wazemmes on Saturday 12 December from 14:00, with a show made from residents' testimonies by Compagnie Joker, face painting, creative workshops and a snack.

0bcb61e93d52f968530ab3b1f86948a26cb3a80d.en: A children's book fair. The programme will be published later.

66b6d005bf10d3ae176775870513a76f19616cea.en: A literary meeting with journalist Sophie Fontanel about her book Shéhérazade et la 602e nuit, at the Théâtre du Nord in Lille. Fontanel has written 21 books and is a Chevalier of the Légion d'honneur.

6f9b7a669d353a8e90b15eaeaf823a8de5eac1ac.en: Stories that resemble us by the association Dire Lire at La Ferme d'en Haut, with tales of wisdom, tenderness and humour. Tickets cost 8 euros or 5 euros for under 12s, and doors open at 15:00.

309b8638140bad1bd388b85fc526d18974ca31c9.en: A choir concert by Digue Dondaines at the Saint-Maurice Pellevoisin library on Saturday 12 December from 16:00 to 17:00, with Christmas songs. Free entry.

c724d840a2f360643c25110df2a506b17a7f6476.en: The international final of Hip Hop Games, a choreography and improvisation competition created by Romuald Brizolier. Day one takes place on 12 December at Le Grand Sud, with four teams from several countries.

6583fddd9b455a5c9a14ec05e362e9b5a15df02e.en: Downterra with guests at the Brat Cave in Lille on 12 December, mixing metal and drum and bass in a hybrid live set.

67d8f244526385cd8112e6be84869cbd032282cb.en: Au revoir et Merci, a farewell show by the three musicians of Chanson Plus Bifluorée at Le Vivat, celebrating their 40-year career with songs and parodies of French chanson.

b97ae688b03e85276704899aa192e924f05adda0.en: Teletech Lille, a night at Kodz in Lille for adults only. Photo ID is required at the entrance.

adfc42c6f6399ebbcb9ce23d4ec2d7a06210b175.en: A lecture at the Palais des beaux-arts auditorium in Lille on the Popular Front (1934 to 1938), by historian Ludivine Bantigny, in partnership with the Université populaire de Lille.

f90b0b8ffd29744d887cf9c073c8f6ecf87cf8e6.en: Make your gifts, a family workshop at the Maison Folie Moulins in Lille, where local artists teach how to make recycled gifts. It includes a 15:00 and 17:00 show by Insolit'a Danse.

83d1a5ed81a06277b42dece3e0b278c81b01b2e0.en: Hip Hop Games, a hip hop improvisation and choreography competition created by Romuald Brizolier, whose international final closes its 15th-anniversary tour. The second part, on improvisation, takes place at the Opéra de Lille.

58edeb0dd818f5a9ce079d602429ca09d49e4550.en: Attention à ta tête by Cie Le Polpesse at the Salle Courmont in Lille-Moulins, a 45-minute juggling show for ages 6 and up, on Sunday 13 December at 17:00 as part of a family Sunday.

6d4c24ab79a8dd74d9787b9fc6e4af654d986c66.en: Shooqa 22, a jazz concert at La Ferme d'en Haut, presented by Jazz à Véd'à. The six-piece band mixes rap, jazz and rock, and was selected by the national Grand Zebrock scheme.

a9eff01eaa64de7427db46f801101a440ba73fa7.en: Rosa Bursztein at the Lille Grand Palais, a new show on her search for love and her contradictions as a would-be feminist, ecologist and leftist.

7c9feae901d308ebce77885d6c4d754d00b1d071.en: A talk at the LaM museum with Martin Béthenod, head of the Centre national des arts plastiques, on how art explores relations between humans and dogs, in partnership with the magazine Bâtard.

408bd5c553652ea3c71b4a0c2537143295b27d1e.en: La Vie Rêvée, a solo play by Kelly Rivière at La rose des vents in Villeneuve d'Ascq, following a woman who became a stage intermittent rather than a star, with a mix of hope and hard reality.

d567d98797130cfc7313230b76871b7b04818b11.en: MUba bébé at the MUba Eugène Leroy in Tourcoing, a session for children from 18 months, with a visit to the current exhibition and workshop activities.

ef6f987488f11ccb5ec7721fc7169413524977e7.en: A winter decoration workshop at the Marcel Dhénin teaching farm in Lille, making decorations from natural materials. It is free, for ages 5 and up, with registration.

cf76e2cfabbb549fd28a78a80860df0854d1e9b2.en: A youth session at the Maison de la jeunesse in Lille on civic service for ages 16 to 25, with presentations, volunteer stories and missions in Lille, Hellemmes and Lomme.

7d31f2e8adf26400c5aaf39d970c0fa3317f2d9d.en: A creative workshop at the Lille-Moulins library in which participants make a snowman greeting card for the holidays. It is for children and adults.

9856fdb870d1888bc7e4a75e59f4965f5770e705.en: A thermal walk in Roubaix on Wednesday 16 December 2026 from 17:30 to 19:00, using a thermal camera to show insulation faults and practical fixes. Registration is needed.

d38c96da0d0db82753528db44326a248fbf60b02.en: Les Belles Sorties: Attention à ta tête by Cie Le Polpesse at the Centre culturel Thérèse Bourtry, where three jugglers use balls, clubs and a bathtub, treating mistakes as part of the play.

5ce4f21fbb276eb58f92e4dc7c97476eb8ed6624.en: Mahabharata, a history of violence, adapted and directed by Pauline Bayle at the Théâtre du Nord in Lille. It draws on the ancient Indian epic and its rivalry and warfare.

f250a986923651bb1a243f76d636013cd8464fdc.en: Le Cabaret à Gilles, a cabaret show by Gilles Defacque and the Hors-Pistes team at the Tripostal in Lille, with music, clowning and pranks.

fa6ac1cabc177c935d0f8b7e66bca734ee1f1d81.en: Échos de l'exil, a concert at the Opéra de Lille by the Kharkiv Piano Duo with works by Chopin, Liszt, Bartók and Ukrainian composers. It includes a world premiere commissioned by the Opéra de Lille.

5e9e657be8350d242efd63ab760963bc417c7ceb.en: A talk at the Forum départemental des Sciences in Lille on how science popularisation began and how science centres and CCSTIs have helped spread knowledge.

312f0d7ea15fcf8fdf95d07119938ba66044184f.en: Passons à autre chose, a performance by Jeremy Dubois, also known as Malkhior, at the Théâtre de la Verrière in Lille, exploring how men are shaped by patriarchal norms.

b949f9f8629c3d8a2a87a7de5e94a410bae7f3d5.en: A climate networking meeting at Chaud Bouillon in Lille for people who are involved or want to get involved in environmental action.

8d05ff3736f2c07b2cff9ca53eb6572bbc5b7fe4.en: A screening of five animated short films from the Frac Picardie and Le Fresnoy collections, held with the exhibition Dessin-Dessin. A discussion with museum and Frac staff follows.

b5ff326ca3c1173df38bac9b0a44647bcb930e83.en: An evening of animated short films at Le Fresnoy in Lille, from the Frac Picardie and Le Fresnoy collections, held with the exhibition at the MUba Eugène Leroy in Tourcoing. It is organised with the Amis du MUba and the Amis du Fresnoy.

c99915c8d40be81673b4930cee43489249d5ad9b.en: The Orchestre National de Lille plays its end-of-year concert at Le Zéphyr on Thursday 17 December 2026 at 20:00. The audience chooses the programme by voting for works online in the autumn.

5445b7a1757eb66aa7a574ce81cdf1393ea1725f.en: Hiba Tawaji invites Ibrahim Maalouf for a tribute to French chanson at the Casino Barrière in Lille, with classic songs reworked by the couple.

fd0bbc59aa4bd72cbb615233e8966efaa15343ed.en: A talk by the Ateliers Mémoire group at the Roubaix La Grand-Plage library on the history of Roubaix, which also invites audience members to share their own memories.

6cfbbeaeb7b0316ffb2be07c90cb052f90e9b197.en: A festival of words at the Palais des beaux-arts in Lille: a guided visit of the exhibition Voyage à l'Anglaise from 17:00 to 18:00, followed by a writing workshop at the Jean-Lévy library from 18:30 to 19:30.

b0b7e1000abb6cb8927c4e437d4d209f783eccf1.en: Philippine Delaire performs at the Théâtre Sébastopol in Lille, a show built around characters who made her known on social media, about family and growing up.

edd79c3ab922a68648e3c4167ce6d2d1ba8d59d4.en: Saltation by Ludivine Large-Bessette and Mathieu Calmelet at Le Vivat in Armentières. Three performers make sound and body visible, drawing on geological forms and cymatics.

725befeea19536c37a3fb6c7161b9467cf65868a.en: The Wackids present Futur 2000 at Le Nouveau Chapitre in Lille, a concert tour through 21st-century music culture, with songs from Auto-Tune to the Star Academy.

e406df0887dd9366d90122e197ebc2c9b24d4448.en: A family video game breakfast at the La Grand-Plage library in Roubaix for children aged 6 and up. Registration is required.

89297d30aab0185fd6c105f7e167fcf5ca2c9a76.en: A free discussion session at the Ludomédiathèque Colette in Lille, open to all without prior knowledge, on everyday topics chosen by participants.

0b66885c58e538611903ae010a7f8c54ffd25bd0.en: A reading café at the Saint-Maurice Pellevoisin library in Lille for book lovers to meet and discuss novels, essays and comics.

836e77723719a025b22dce22683570388ad7f79d.en: Les racontées musicales, a musical reading for toddlers aged 18 months and up, with tongue twisters and playful language at the La Grand-Plage library in Roubaix.

eec7c9144e24ec1ca52e3d0acbd147d66d1596f8.en: A Canva workshop at the Ludomédiathèque Colette in Lille, where participants learn to make posters, invitations and social media posts with templates.

fac6b69c64fcedb6eaf6798874c90b73e11d8208.en: A talk by Tarek Abouelgamal at the Institut du monde arabe in Tourcoing on the history of teaching Arabic in Europe, linking orientalism, language policy and learning methods.

163a94bc017e878fa17556ed3aad94e5c60ecb0e.en: A family Christmas film at the Andrée Chedid library in Lille, showing two animated short films for children and adults.

5111630ae0daa58c6355641186ccbdcda172afc6.en: Flocon, a show by Compagnie On disait que at the Centre Municipal d'Expression Musicale in Lille, mixing theatre, puppetry and light juggling for young audiences.

ce908e67e55d9a9da59436cea405526052201337.en: Disney on Ice at the Zénith de Lille, a family ice show featuring Mary Poppins, The Lion King and Aladdin.

7a56ef2fbaf578852bc516bab01629afa07f0cd1.en: Yann Guillarme performs stand-up at the Théâtre Sébastopol in Lille, joking about freedom, reggae and his own life.

82c2ee4da69b5420eefe85b64765942c8c35649f.en: Lille, land of film shoots, a guided walk through Vieux-Lille with a guide and an actress, showing locations used in TV series and films.
