40abc486a2d4962162535ce8bc2184b589be916d.en: A listening session at Totems in Rennes on Saturday 5 December at 11:00, with an Irish-themed music programme played on headphones by the library's staff. It is for ages 12 and up, and booking is advised.

578c0fe544e1d237367524f73ee573546e6ba8eb.en: The Quiet Girl, a film by Colm Bairéad screened at Totems in Rennes as part of the Irish weeks, followed by a talk. It is set in Ireland in 1981 and follows a neglected girl sent to relatives.

51292be7dcdd376c1eb7e313f0f4bfd3a6df5f75.en: Sniper at Le MeM in Rennes, presented by Krumpp Music. The French rap group, formed in 1997 in Val-d'Oise, released albums such as Du rire aux larmes.

a36f78f04c4b97b18ab4150c0d7070c503a425bd.en: A jumble sale of toys and books at the Carrefour 18 social centre in Rennes, for Christmas, in aid of the Secours Populaire charity.

89283fb52f5e7737d26dcff34a28fe11ec6332a4.en: An art and craft sale at the Halle Martenot in Rennes with more than 80 exhibitors, held by Amnesty International Rennes, selling jewellery, ceramics, paintings and more.

2d596b40c37226558427a237b0351e922d55946c.en: The Bintinais market in Rennes, with about fifteen farms selling products from local breeds, including Rennes chickens, black-and-white cow cheeses and seasonal vegetables.

00c1117fe66ba743e4cad1184d4e797fd4fe1eaa.en: An advanced aerial fabric class at Bing Bang Circus in Rennes covering swing and kick basics, the mechanics of falls, and moving smoothly from one move to another.

197d6c8dd18cbf0375c6694ae24a580f57186083.en: Ceci est mon corps, a documentary at the Champs Libres auditorium in Rennes about a filmmaker who records his own legal case after another victim of religious abuse came forward in 2018.

7491f56030033bfa3a8b174d4d02f326b379214c.en: The IGDR keynote lecture by Julia Mahamid of the European Molecular Biology Laboratory at the Campus Santé in Rennes, on cryo-electron tomography to image molecular complexes inside cells.

1d4e272e92614ff3e1a7341478ec69e6a077528b.en: Faire des vagues, a 45-minute CNRS micro-talk at Antipode in Rennes on 12:30 to 13:15, free entry while places last, part of the library's season theme on waves.

2381adb91376efd49cafee4ffdedaaeabc1164db.en: Les échappées inattendues du CNRS: Faire des vagues, three ten-minute talks at the Antipode library in Rennes on the physics of waves and how waves form, by researchers from different fields.

8bf9361f76b8c627e1fac79d20f93765c86863ab.en: A smartphone photography workshop at the Landry library in Rennes, led by Jean-Christophe Godet, artistic director of the Glaz festival, covering composition, shooting and portraits, for all ages.

373c7b52c1c8a736501403194193cc78dff0ab5d.en: A beginner's workshop in lyric and choral singing at the Opéra de Rennes, led by singer and conservatoire teacher Eleonore Le Lamer, on freeing the voice.

b2993265e9d0104ae561f4ccef0bf4b7b9fbed08.en: L'Abolition des privilèges, a solo show by Hugues Duchêne at the Carré Sévigné in Rennes, adapted from Bertrand Guillot's historical novel and set during the 1789 Estates-General.

dee94d2a2d2289e490a6e3f026b4f62ac53a3cf1.en: Tatiana Giraud on biodiversity collapse and its consequences for human societies, a talk at the Champs Libres auditorium in Rennes. She is a CNRS research director.

f9459b33e32829b71f185dcd80a7975820febaff.en: Songs from the North Country, a concert at the TNB in Rennes with singer Rosemary Standley, François Lazarevitch and the Saint-Julien musicians, mixing Anglo-Celtic ballads with early music.

f9b843a9f4d9c49312405a3457eb5fa5ba220809.en: Tristan Lucas, Français content, a stand-up show at Le Bacchus in Rennes, with jokes about hipsters, life coaches and social topics.

3889a0bcb290ac5da4d7a762ad97600691711a81.en: L'Ours, a puppet and live drawing show at La Paillette in Rennes, adapted from Frank Tashlin's picture book about a bear trapped in a factory.

e1977e1d98930dde97002b237bb471537791e1da.en: A stop-motion animation workshop at the Thabor-Lucien Rose library in Rennes, run by the French animation association AFCA, linked to the Raconte-moi le cinéma exhibition. Booking is advised.

a6711d1e7dbe8af4db479ec037a45f320b536626.en: Storytime for children aged 3 and up at Totems in Rennes on Wednesday 9 December at 17:00, with or without their parents. Booking is advised.

3e550efaa6de4b592cede6f680f4e36f49b56eac.en: A feminist reading club at the Champs Libres café in Rennes on the second Wednesday of each month at 18:30.

1789265f80722f0aaead8c0f54235ac55cc02c45.en: Java and Winston McAnuff at L'Étage in Rennes, a reunion show 20 years after the Paris Rockin' tour, with a joint EP planned before summer 2026.

04c2798c1e6a89f55aed05c857bb2e255e46f22a.en: Cobalt & Daysy perform an acoustic show at Penny Lane in Rennes, an intimate autumn tour with songs on guitar.

e8b25d457778b6b401aaddd231af78279e05685a.en: Le lac des cygnes by L'Éolienne at Le Grand Logis in Rennes, a circus-style contemporary version of Tchaikovsky's Swan Lake, with five performers as a community of swans.

cf1aa5e1eff88db79837d6963e5e76c8eb221d73.en: Bébés lecteurs at Totems in Rennes, a play session for toddlers aged 9 months to 2 years with stories, nursery rhymes and songs. Sessions are on Thursday 10 December at 09:30 and 10:30. Booking is advised.

1bd6024d03231fad69f9dc47000d50da89431d3b.en: A collective immersion day in earth and environmental sciences at the Beaulieu campus in Rennes, covering how plastic debris moves through the environment, its sources, and its effects on ecosystems.

e6ee5a31ea3ce32fafb31b952bfe56961d129197.en: Agriculture: champs contrechamps, a talk at the Salle de La Cité in Rennes by journalist Nicolas Legendre, who spent about ten years investigating Brittany's agro-industrial system, with stories behind his articles, book and documentary.

6ef3baca9b763581c76841ab7f2691f8ce72e3c8.en: Thé, café ou chocolat, a talk at the MJC Pacé in Rennes on how tea, coffee and chocolate, once prized as medicine, shaped the European breakfast.

c37c282bd7f3d60be0c44cefbbb374cbbcee1824.en: A talk at the Archives de Rennes on photographs taken by German soldiers in Rennes during the occupation, 1940 to 1944, from two collections held by the archives.

694169ccdf7eb20a6d2bde76790b62a2acd34749.en: Repenser la vie en commun, a talk at the Champs Libres auditorium in Rennes by anthropologist Philippe Descola, comparing ways of relating to the world. It is followed by a book signing with the Comment dire bookshop.

63827995328d1ec2322d1652c0efcade8df6d312.en: OSUR: Exils américains, a concert by the Orchestre Symphonique Universitaire de Rennes at Le Diapason, opening its anniversary season with Korngold's violin concerto, performed by Orphée Courant.

0e98e51735c1b9e433c33b89bf8a8881244dbddf.en: Gabrielle Giraud, Au naturel, a comic one-woman show at Le Bacchus in Rennes, drawing on mythic characters and the Mediterranean.

0d975ab6d809fc8e5266550ad432a8f64c12ea27.en: Café IA on artificial intelligence and the making of news, at the Villejean library in Rennes, discussing how AI affects information.

31dc795498b32f8b24f92f224fa8c1ab7d998a46.en: Boom Boom Buzz special Ireland at Totems in Rennes on Friday 11 December at 20:00, a team pop-culture quiz on music, films and series. It is for ages 14 and up, with registration.

0f17f4c5ea36c2c609bd0c6bc4dad6acbf1111d8.en: NeS performs at Le MeM in Rennes, presented by Krumpp Music. The rapper from Val-de-Marne is known for a cathartic and sincere style.

e9645320b6a82fb50440cfefb41904cda1c89f08.en: Un fil à la patte, a Feydeau farce staged by the ADEC amateur theatre in Rennes, in which a man tries to rid himself of his mistress to marry a rich heiress.

f32acc35ab3ce87b91b7c42882b82c4ccf5f8541.en: A driveshaft and gearbox training course at La Ferme de la Harpe in Rennes, covering how an engine works and how to replace a timing belt. The September session is full.

a7286867a9255935f189a1886b5b6cfb894204f6.en: Et si on pensait? on beliefs, a discussion for children aged 7 to 12 at the Maurepas library in Rennes, held with the association Mycelium.

3c9dbafbb6d1f32df89bd9d8a0a9a4a442da113e.en: Louves, a Rennes feminist choir that started as a group of friends singing protest songs, led by Ellie James, performing a repertoire of feminist songs.

c553dea5085acf853d3fcdf4ccb43f0d794211ea.en: A free role-playing session with the Ludovores club at the Chantepie toy library, booking recommended and places limited. A snack is included.

4ca7077a91ff4ee70939a33af34e1d51df76facd.en: La bobine du samedi, a Christmas family film screening at Totems in Rennes on Saturday 12 December at 17:00. The programme is confirmed at the desk.

1d7a6b8808ece040336622defde4a335fb39b456.en: PACT, a live techno performance by Joachim Pastor, Joris Delacroix and Teho at Le MeM in Rennes, with custom-built machines that blur the line between performers and audience.

ea1a6b0b305207fdf85ad3409dca53beabda8a99.en: Dakeez performs at L'Étage in Rennes, presented by Krumpp Music. The Franco-Italian singer, songwriter and dancer has a solo tour ending at the Olympia on 18 December 2026.

8c48d033c075e420f89b192bc52f05fb3ce23cde.en: Ni d'Eve ni d'Adam, a documentary by Floriane Devigne at the Champs Libres auditorium in Rennes about two people born intersex who question the non-consensual surgery they had, with a second short film.

5a31a94196c19140e27882c034c95937fb0c67ad.en: A multidisciplinary workshop on magnetic resonance imaging for the north-west of France, run by and for young researchers at IRISA in Rennes, with invited talks, a poster session and short presentations.

99bd582a5d47e0f3265c5a1de68c3b6f9f70e1b7.en: La peau du lynx at the MJC Pacé in Rennes, an ecological tale in which forest animals ask a seamstress to make a magic coat to protect their lynx from hunters.

fe4af93ca2daac467d45443aa1ecf10a0207d03c.en: A Holiday Season Party for students and researchers at CMI Rennes on Tuesday 15 December 2026 from 17:30 to 21:00, to mark the end of the semester.

4b6ec8f9d1c7a908856cc50fd582c8726cc729c4.en: Lire au Landry, a 2026 favourites session at the Landry library in Rennes, where people share their best reads of the year. It is for adults.

218f06b2b5bfa9ab9dcb385e4a87b54ba28f6832.en: Les Paravents by Jean Genet, directed by Arthur Nauzyciel at the Théâtre National de Bretagne in Rennes. The play, written in 1961 during the Algerian War, caused a major scandal when first staged in Paris.

24ea00af8bac5e5cdc7e32dd228870b1b2be9be1.en: disiz performs at Le Liberté in Rennes with a six-piece band, presenting a larger show that mixes emotion, tension and more explosive moments.

c47cdefb1e4af4f6704fdd97486ca9de3eda05c8.en: Free concert by Ledeunff at Le Grand Logis in Rennes, a singer and guitarist who was in the band Hocus Pocus and has played more than 500 concerts. Seats are limited.

3efa4a00f7bb274a28169ac89dc0ba74bddffa56.en: Olivia Moore, Oui, je sais, a stand-up show at Le Bacchus in Rennes on everyday pressures, family ghosts and the mental load of daily life.

10765a8c532d73f7d3e0782b44c31868c28b5eeb.en: Mamita by Compagnie Koki&Co at Le Grand Logis in Rennes, a story of a girl who travels through time with the help of a bat to meet her grandmother, who died 74 years earlier.

57e5c99ef9a6d06230a382aa71b80aa2e56f0481.en: A surprise Christmas film session at the Landry library in Rennes, with animated films and short films for children from age 5.

65cee93b8152343c9d0ee66826276902687ef2ea.en: Ego le cachalot sets sail at the Salle de La Cité in Rennes, a children's show in which Ego joins the climate activist panda Yaya on a boat trip to a summit in New York.

7fd003abcf127e4abecd2c730577be24f7d2242c.en: Les habits neufs du Père Noël, a storytelling reading at the Longs-Champs library in Rennes based on Brigitte Delpech's picture book about how Father Christmas's clothes came to be.

80d810f3ea5f24a8c7b606b4510b69e5e31c619b.en: Cypher Afro at the Dalle Kennedy in Rennes, an open-air dance gathering of residents and dancers of African and Caribbean music, held as a free public event.

774d8ec3b9ef600839187ee8cb22b489fbef62e3.en: An aperitif concert with Hanry at Antipode in Rennes on the evening of a set date, with doors at 19:00 and music from 19:30. Hanry is a Rennes post-rock quintet formed in 2022. Entry is free.

cd3426ede03c36b7d1588230b816ece98fde1321.en: Maldonne, a dance show at Carré Sévigné in Rennes in which a choreographer dresses five women performers in forty dresses to explore fragility, revolt, multiple identities and freedom.

2c6ac446b421917941dfa0392576bdb2cc612b63.en: Maëlle performs at 360 Rennes, presented by Krumpp Music and Halo. She became known at 17 as the youngest winner of The Voice.

f703d984b1d8cea21c3dc8633981fb098889006f.en: A smartphone skills workshop at the Champs-Manceaux library in Rennes for adult beginners, covering navigation tips. Registration is required.

1fe481321b0d38a20cecb335ea184d8840cd45d4.en: Camille performs at Le MeM in Rennes, presenting her album The Sound of Milk (2026), which is built as a triptych of a sound diary, a pocket musical and a pop album.

9a19820d557cfc418c5c2d1084fd649912e6e2ba.en: A concert at the Couvent des Jacobins in Rennes that opens with classical works on strong women and love, then plays Rachmaninov's second piano concerto.

b757f8b7312ded8625dcc10d5728fcfaf5cef397.en: Lisa Pariente performs at 360 Rennes, presented by Krumpp Music and Halo. She has 1.5 million combined followers and writes personal songs like a diary.

d33011f543f0e0145b05e4769e80f657f2acaa46.en: Poetic Lover performs at L'EMC2 in Rennes on the Lover Tour, presented by Krumpp Music and partners, after returning from a break in music.

513602d9e608c82d894f40e2f90f50eec0b1ad41.en: A connected café on avoiding online scams at the Clôteaux-Bréquigny library in Rennes, with tips and habits to avoid fraud.

eb730e7ad9a99775fb978158721652e692d2e2dd.en: Video games for all ages at the MJC Pacé in Rennes over two days, with retro gaming, arcade classics, tournaments and cooperative games.

3a03624c2b046843bd7bcf93a8fbd2584573749a.en: Rencontrer l'histoire, a talk at the TNB in Rennes with historian Patrick Boucheron and TNB director Arthur Nauzyciel, around Nauzyciel's staging of Genet's Les Paravents.

cf4566ea0e4f2da16c573a6b9778d9e0f790411c.en: L'avare by Molière, staged by the ADEC amateur theatre group at the Maison du Théâtre amateur in Rennes. Harpagon's obsession with his hidden treasure creates chaos in his family.

5362cd19862063f25239ec520f4eacdcb7d5501b.en: A literary café at Totems in Rennes on Saturday 19 December at 10:30, where people share favourite books and gripes over tea, coffee and cakes.

1578b32cb4f958b801d83f3c6d29bf2ce5b5dcdb.en: Petit à petit at the L'Autre Lieu media library in Rennes, a story, music and object theatre show for children from 6 months.

8e436c44b63e4e65836bc0cc3197b40c2bb14387.en: Le Noël de Gaston le lutin grognon at Le Bacchus in Rennes, a show about a grumpy elf who delivers children's Christmas letters.

eb475a459d8e1880e74e19969c96d73d4ecc6ff5.en: AJNA performs at L'Étage in Rennes, presented by Krumpp Music. The dark, melodic singer is known for her nocturnal atmosphere and her project Boys&Basement.

c821c8dd5a14428b71f1658a939ab27b0c60694f.en: WEB performs at 360 Rennes, presented by Krumpp Music. The Bordeaux boy band plays French rock with four lead identities and a modern sound.

514f5fb21607eb705287d8b780d0b491e670ce1a.en: Le Noël des Établis, a Christmas market in Rennes with about 50 stalls from makers, artists and craftspeople across the west of France, with food and drink on site. It is the sixth edition.

efc3da16f1c160d4b06e7a30dc8c8b1a95ee74f8.en: Le chant de la mer by Tomm Moore at the Hallouvry amphitheatre in Rennes, an animated film about a girl who discovers she is a selkie and is pursued by a sorceress.

467654b485bacfae839ee87ea044477965e74040.en: Douce nuit, a Christmas concert at the Protestant church in Rennes with British soprano Madeline Claire de Berrié and the Ensemble Baroque de Rennes, with a soft winter programme.

c13b72331f7e98b9863e494cc4b90964bf611d6b.en: Cooking workshops for students at the Beaulieu university residence in Rennes, run by the Maison de la Nutrition et du Diabète 35 during the holidays. The workshops show how to cook balanced, low-cost meals.

c3a6ec7cd7190b4029109396057a18e64d5580e0.en: Cooking workshops for students at the Erêve building on the Villejean campus in Rennes, run by the Maison de la Nutrition et du Diabète 35 during the holidays. The workshops show how to cook balanced, low-cost meals.

224ba2a7a67c7fa2f126d6bc5ff2c8aa292e8400.en: Christmas stories at the Musée de Bretagne in Rennes, told in Breton by museum gnomes. Tickets are issued at the desk on the day, subject to availability.

8729c4e863fe55def7117502d00a14e68c4a4080.en: Aymeric Carrez performs a simple, funny stand-up show at Le Bacchus in Rennes. He has won 13 comedy contests.

dfd1196d219eb5fa4dad5e7579fc60293b6ee7a7.en: A Christmas film session at the Antipode library in Rennes, with animated and short films for children aged 4 and up.

736b557a8134a326cf92a23789035f28e55ef24c.en: A children's film session at the Thabor-Lucien Rose library in Rennes, with animated and short films for families, for children from age 6.

d3368cce611601e23aec6636a297fe57e6521a71.en: Gloria Gloria by Groupe Odyssées at La Paillette in Rennes, a pop-scored theatre investigation into how social monsters are made, told through the last 24 hours of a woman who confesses to her friend.

9be2899de89f17dd3e27f7bc75721f96ff3c2369.en: L'arbre à danser, Le Grand Bal by Compagnie Système B and Les Petits Dimanches at Le Liberté in Rennes, a free indoor street-style dance ball for all ages with travelling musicians and dancers. Booking is required.

9462a94ec9640c75d1b4a79dc04fd85c12d5cd27.en: Patrick Chanfray, Advienne que devra, a stand-up show at Le Bacchus in Rennes on the pressures to be happy, successful and healthy in modern life.

f00eb9f4282f52e57faad38482e4cbcdab15963d.en: Les Limbes by Étienne Saglio and Monstre(s) at the TNB in Rennes, a circus and new magic piece set to Vivaldi's Stabat Mater, in which a man crosses a river into a strange in-between world.

e4b123bee6b90ed8c443fb8440a9962946710b96.en: Barbara (par Barbara) by Marie-Sophie Ferdane and Emmanuel Noblet at the TNB in Rennes, a portrait of the singer Barbara built from her own words, set as a radio studio.

871bbf726d12a8a0d46fa5ff23f95bb61a0293de.en: Bistrot Photo at the Pôle Sud cultural centre in Rennes, an informal photo session held in local bars and cafés, linked to the La Traversée Photographique festival.

80a843a699721362d43244011ae78ceb51446e61.en: A clothing collection by L'armoire des étudiants at the Le Diapason venue on the Beaulieu campus in Rennes, ahead of a temporary student clothing shop. Only good-condition items such as sports bags, hats, watches and shoes are accepted.

1bdb9929b1f72cbd206f5d630f180574f4538750.en: Thibault Cauvin performs at Carré Sévigné in Rennes, presenting an album made entirely of original guitar works.

79f75e349689040e39154968e0271ce208d66912.en: The Rennes student and pupils fair at the Rennes exhibition centre on Friday 8 and Saturday 9 January 2027, from 09:00 to 18:00, with the University of Rennes's courses.

6de3a6c5918855db726d9ee74859001407405ae0.en: Ala.ni, a London soul singer with a golden voice, performs at Le Grand Logis in Rennes, with calypso, bossa, rocksteady and jazz songs from her album Sunshine Music.

15f1c5ec334b30d3e66d50acffef5f192b3f1129.en: Violence dans les champs, a documentary by Magali Serre and Nicolas Legendre screened at the Champs Libres auditorium in Rennes, with testimonies from farmers criticising the productivist farm system, followed by a talk.

5e300249edf3a2e9d16d90fa60d8a4e5950bb348.en: Jemima & Johnny, a silent film with live music at Le Grand Logis in Rennes, set in 1965 London, where a boy and a Caribbean girl's friendship crosses racial lines.

9eed3d14897f08977cac13618e4c3e329d157998.en: A talk on braille at the MJC Pacé in Rennes, part of the Histoire de savoir series.

8a0aa16322e095ed473e7a2cb2add43025632d2c.en: La photographie manquante, a stage show at the Champs Libres in Rennes by photojournalist Guillaume Herbaut, who talks about the stories behind his projected photographs, with a light and video set by Xavier Courchinoux.

ae58d084fce87d963a5b00e34ebb031ffd784236.en: Je n'aime pas le classique mais avec Alex Vizorek j'aime bien, a concert-show at Carré Sévigné in Rennes, in which comedian Alex Vizorek takes on classical music with a playful approach.

b30459e703df3676ce5f6acfdd38eea1fff9945a.en: Mélodie Fontaine, Nickel Nickel, a comedy show at Le Bacchus in Rennes on the messes of life, from her Nord childhood to her recovery after childbirth.

8fc650d80d3f0752732b05481c181189759284ee.en: Tout part du ventre at the MJC Pacé in Rennes, a play about a group of young people at school at a crossroads in their lives.

da68219cd3e5c6ca8c0e63bd450c1777a32a47cc.en: La fête à venir by Compagnie La Littorale at the Théâtre du Cercle in Rennes, about a 15-year-old girl at an agricultural school who is refused the family farm because she is a woman.

404a5b99544520848b81b61e13fd0d1c914c9656.en: NTO performs at Le MeM in Rennes, presented by Krumpp Music. The French melodic techno act has played Tomorrowland and Sonar, and presented the album APNEA.

634cd62da5b75264bea83b8d0309825db85bf00c.en: Arthur Gomez, Please Stand-Up, a stand-up show at Le Bacchus in Rennes about his love of Eminem and the fan culture that the rapper's song Stan inspired.

9a9f9b62c689c47c60a90cd747b5d2812b61776b.en: A clutch-replacement course at La Ferme de la Harpe in Rennes, covering how the gearbox works with the engine and how to replace a clutch disc in a manual car. It is 7 hours, with 3 hours of theory and 4 of practice. The October session is full.

8df0892513e6734cfda336d9b39f239986475629.en: Toenn Vor by Denez at La Confluence in Betton, a Breton singer from Haut-Léon who reworks Brittany's vocal heritage, drawing on gwerzioù and sailors' songs.

2d0e5b3a0fb6aeceb639e910bb4f3cf958961ebf.en: Terra Luna at the Champs Libres auditorium in Rennes, where four women farmers talk about low-input, self-reliant and supportive agriculture and their place in a field long run by men.

99cc109caa9926f3b23dd05d9166a137a070e810.en: The Party, a 1968 Blake Edwards comedy starring Peter Sellers, screened at the Hallouvry amphitheatre in Rennes. A clumsy extra is invited to a studio boss's party by mistake.

9d0fc6fa77f311efe04b6c3d2d7dfe5eff9eec10.en: A joint concert at the MJC Pacé in Rennes by the Orchestre Symphonique du Pays Pourpré and the cello ensemble Les As de Pique, playing Offenbach's La Belle Hélène overture and a Beethoven movement.

a7c4be0dd421b16e0bf97280d524a352741b56cf.en: Mes applis, mes amours, mes emmerdes, a modern comedy at Le Bacchus in Rennes about a husband who seeks revenge with a date from a dating app, only to find she is his son's new babysitter.

62c61b89ce27c84fbc93e99f69d2c779812021fa.en: Mona Guba at the 4bis Info Jeunes centre in Rennes, a performer whose sharp, sincere lyrics mix genres with humour.

2af3444b7bb466c18b7138955affa21ffdda108b.en: La Rue Kétanou performs at Le MeM in Rennes, a French band that has built a loyal following for more than twenty years.

eeba2641e1b9efdcd93c50db367df1769c3f88dd.en: A networking forum at the IUT de Rennes Clos Courtel site where students and companies meet to discuss work-study placements in the GCCD programme.

3389e19fd03ae94ad8f32cc106579540efb699d1.en: An immersive day on management careers at the IGR-IAE in Rennes, covering marketing, finance, accounting, logistics, HR and management control through a role-play.

bacb2529ed7f9b4498e6da0221163ef7d6f7e52c.en: Oiseau [guide de survie], a play by Marie-Christine Lê-Huu at La Paillette in Rennes, for adults and children, about how people react to difference.

39f0a0e9ecaf6371155ef3df96fd613cd71516a5.en: Thylacine performs at Le MeM in Rennes, an artist who has travelled widely in search of creative inspiration.

c26c653f969d9ddb9df1e03f87439a6677cfde35.en: Ah. Kosmos and Melaine Dalibert at the Théâtre l'Aire Libre in Rennes, part of the Autres Mesures festival. Turkish electronic artist Basak Günak combines machines with piano.

5448ec8d69431e4b25c107d9d189b416b13b5b16.en: A study day of the ARDoISE workshop on research data and the environmental and social transition, held in hybrid form at the Inria centre in Rennes on Friday 22 January 2027.

e085d35ee2c62ce5c927d3d0773e0d38500917b4.en: Soirée Complicité 'Coup de Pouce', a showcase at the Théâtre du Cercle in Rennes of two emerging companies, Big City and Gronde.

a018dbd632fc3aa5d78c46c8801901826d3d6cec.en: Zinée performs at L'Étage in Rennes, presenting her EP BIL after her 2024 album OSMIN. The singer and rapper writes about a new start.

e3747aea65c87a5a778f7418d7314e427ff4cdd0.en: Terreur at the Sabot d'Or in Rennes, a play in which the audience sits as jurors in a German court case about a fighter pilot.

d4e2be6d6e95bd8f216ea0b1496300ffab926ff9.en: The British and Irish Film Week at Le Grand Logis in Rennes, in its 19th year, with competition films, previews and new works from Britain and Ireland.

584cc23676c5e2a8501f01e1a1bd76f1b739b962.en: Free visits of the university collections at the Beaulieu campus in Rennes from 14:00 to 18:00, including the zoology gallery, scientific instruments, the geology museum and a listed Breton painting collection.

6fb7c4525cf6ba9088499909c949724d6f295cb1.en: A Ludovores detective-game session at the Chantepie toy library, free and open to all. Registration is recommended and places are limited. A snack is included.

864b4ac9e3ec258c37dd05067bcd5f049dcc3790.en: Lumière, l'aventure continue at the Champs Libres auditorium in Rennes, a 2025 documentary by Thierry Frémaux that restores more than 120 unseen Lumière brothers films from the start of cinema.

84ae40dc7c5f165ed75ae84384a869511e982612.en: Un fil à la patte at the MJC Pacé in Rennes, a Feydeau farce in three acts in which a man tries to end his affair with a café singer before his wedding.

5422b2934383646291988e23939ea5c1fb0b74da.en: A company forum at the IUT de Rennes Poincaré site, where students and employers meet to discuss work placements and jobs.

9313b93549938a6c8fd58e27491eea103f4bcd49.en: Le petit trône de Faltazi at Le Bacchus in Rennes, a storytelling show in which the bards of Faltazi reveal the stories behind medieval rulers' nicknames.

543ce0f96885a8891b62ba0856efe5363d8e192c.en: Altın Gün at Ubu in Rennes, the Dutch-Turkish psychedelic folk band that first played the Trans Musicales in 2017, a few months before its debut album.

271beadeb7688d26d8c0f9b91f658c6ad57d741c.en: Requin Chagrin at L'Étage in Rennes, presented by Krumpp Music. The band's fourth album, Décollage, moves towards brighter new wave sounds.

912c0904d01efd910fd665955606631bfa22e022.en: An Accident / A Life by Marc Brew and Sidi Larbi Cherkaoui at the TNB in Rennes, a solo dance-theatre piece about how a road accident left Australian dancer Marc Brew paraplegic at 20.

653ea3ea1fdcf324d3f739b58d8075e6c42bbb40.en: Zaoui performs at Le MeM in Rennes. After the success of Thérapie Taxi, he launched a solo project in pop, sharing songs with his fans.

d6816ca52a74dee8af796a7a5d7ca0e1e100e263.en: Adèle Castillon performs at Antipode in Rennes, presented by Krumpp Music, singing intimate songs from her first album about heartbreak and dependence.

43cf0457985dd6a1793f44c2bb915606acb2fddc.en: Same Old Songs by Maud Blandel at the Théâtre l'Aire Libre in Rennes, a satire inspired by Virginia Woolf's Three Guineas, with three dancers in a parade of changing power.

a2ffa519fdeb60d643191ea1939b8b1485d3c4dd.en: Tourmente by Étienne Saglio and Monstre(s) at the TNB in Rennes, a dancer, a musician and a magician shake up the space in a stripped-back stage with bright light.

c46bf207bd45364de571d5eb299515d347a9856a.en: NIRO performs at L'Étage in Rennes, sold out, with a new album expected at the end of 2026 and songs from his catalogue.

39226b36ff06acae31768e1c208a890e0c6c47b0.en: Pierre de Maere performs at Antipode in Rennes, presented by W Spectacle. The 24-year-old singer-songwriter is known for flamboyant French pop.

a63858c2b0d8dcf78c3bd56fbc2665397114e563.en: Sébastian Marx presents a new stand-up show at Le Bacchus in Rennes, still in preview, so its theme is not yet fixed.

5007d6558857e720581e3affaafc2ac012c78fba.en: La Pointe du compas at La Paillette in Rennes, a monologue for a circus performer with a Cyr wheel, who challenges pressure about appearances and seduction.

2d906e1b4de3b567f64f0ae107ccd0b2fade7c8e.en: ABC Devos at Le Bacchus in Rennes, a show revisiting the wordplay and paradoxes of comic writer Raymond Devos through an alphabet.

c74dd5529f865c87c7a219e4d070a59960cbfde3.en: Lee Fields performs at Le MeM in Rennes. The soul singer recorded hits in the 1970s, was rediscovered in the 1990s, and later lent his voice to house tracks.

3703100e6d79224c9e09c43c54f46511d471df42.en: Jazz Magic by Compagnie Blizzard Concept at Le Grand Logis in Rennes, a magician and a musician trade jokes and improvisation in a show that links magic and jazz.

a324e3c588d49e7d182017c7cd8c35db7a55d671.en: Rebonds at the TNB in Rennes, a series in which two Rennes 2 researchers respond to a season show from the perspective of the human and social sciences.

fe9a62720832e019bfcb256415a8c9ddd059ed3d.en: Zed Yun Pavarotti at L'Étage in Rennes, a surprise intimate run of dates called the Before Tour, before his next big announcements, following his single Si Dieu fume.

fba4222feb8ea475fef04cdb96c26249cd2f1021.en: Lutte.s at the MJC Pacé in Rennes, a dance piece by three women and a man on how people stand together, confront each other and get back up, staged as part of the Waterproof festival.

52a73ae15e77ea9cb957a54b5c64f19c0f3d9c03.en: The Sea Is History by Betty Tchomanga at the TNB in Rennes, a piece for ten performers exploring what survived the silences of colonial history, with the sea as its memory.

0268ab916bc26d4cb19ace159aad1944d5e5a7cb.en: A physics immersion at the ESIR engineering school in Rennes, showing how wireless transmission works and linking radio waves with light.

b93b1ec6340db79443ac2e5074e2aac22f1263f9.en: A general mechanics course at La Ferme de la Harpe in Rennes, 30 hours of two-hour evening sessions, covering the parts of a petrol car, from injection to battery charging. The course is full.

9c544d2411ebd8a8b6475ba18c6320b7b6e1be02.en: Ino Casablanca performs at Le MeM in Rennes, presenting his album EXTASIAAAAA, a 10-track release that mixes Caribbean and Mediterranean rhythms.

58468ef19cab255c764f957670d1c866078692a2.en: BEN PLG performs at Antipode in Rennes, a concert that returns to his home city.

6b60338d4c7d7c278fd4140dd50b541849af8a04.en: Jardins d'hiver 2027 at the Rennes library hall, a winter season of author meetings, musical readings, workshops, shows, games and literary walks for all ages.

f91f096d5779f4ab153212efaa0265ea34edad3a.en: A pruning workshop at the Jardin des Mille Pas in Rennes, from 15:00 to 17:30, on cutting shrubs, bushes and trees, using the garden's fruit and berry plants. Full price is 20 euros, with a reduced price of 15 euros.

58d5d430bfe2ccfb8a9ae1a2044eb6bcd107d751.en: Jazz Magic at Le Sabot d'Or in Rennes, a magician and a pianist perform card magic and jazz in an arena, with humour and poetry.

58738b8a690d5816ef3c5754d992fd39f539543e.en: An open stage at the MJC Pacé in Rennes on the first Friday of February, focused on dance, as part of the Waterproof festival, and open to local amateur dancers.

5499ee3b2ed2b4aff674c1bbf0280232f9e80c82.en: Marguerite performs at Le MeM in Rennes, presented by Arachnée Productions. The singer rose to fame on Star Academy and has a platinum single Les filles, les meufs.

03edaf4398dcd638955d004954bc2b9bd96f2dbe.en: Angie Degrolard, Je repp, a comedy show at Le Bacchus in Rennes about a young actress preparing for the entrance exam at the Paris Conservatoire with a piece by Pierre Repp.

52ac9bcdd89ca6a015f03661c90360d92b4725c9.en: An open day at the University of Rennes and the Rennes grandes écoles on Saturday 6 February 2027, from 09:00 to 17:00, to see the campuses and course offers.

d856832ff262598c84b9b408147c9a6d43efc97c.en: The student fair in Rennes on Saturday 6 February 2027 from 09:30 to 17:00, at the Rennes exhibition centre, covering apprenticeships and work-study courses from Bac+2 to Bac+5.

507a12824b466380984781c7e3c81a3f77197be9.en: A self-defence course on MEVIP, an approach that combines physical, verbal, mental and emotional strategies, taught by Rozenn Tregoat and Chloé Masniscalco at the Théâtre du Cercle in Rennes.

bafe91cfef719694c299f01798a1f9673738286b.en: A two-day theatre improvisation course with Kevin Hetzel at the Théâtre du Cercle in Rennes, covering basic games and tools for creating scenes on the spot.

00a12a47cdbed5cd282e5371b0132d6ab71c177c.en: Lutte.s Deployed at the MJC Pacé in Rennes, a teaching and dance project with 30 secondary school pupils and amateur dancers, asking what people fight against today.

d93aaa17168d4152340b66fa4681a4f249796968.en: Fondations by Compagnie Barks and Bastien Dausse at La Confluence in Betton, a dance piece in which four still bodies, like statues, come to life among steel structures and search for a way to live together.

09b723ab450a30bcc200013b233add231a5bf286.en: Abîmé, Fané, Usé, a winter photo exhibition at the MJC Pacé in Rennes, showing work by the MJC's photo club on the theme of wear and decay.

7a0a39b5d15e08f1d08a9e30e1dcc1ec6fcfbaf3.en: Quand on dort on n'a pas faim by Anthony Martine at the Théâtre l'Aire Libre in Rennes, an Afro-queer medieval-style comic quest about leaving the suburbs for an elite school.

7a04d655deb1158035372cc8b7224e70a7cfa9b6.en: Pretty Old Soul, a free concert at Le Grand Logis in Rennes, a vocal group with guitar and bass that revisits 1950s styles in the manner of Sinatra and Nat King Cole. Seats are limited.

3f4b7ad0e78f8a7c2d422994a3039531a1e6922a.en: Kallagan, En roue libre, a stand-up show at Le Bacchus in Rennes on politics, feminism, love, fatherhood and society.

e4348f0bff490012c075b5775e08b390e7462c31.en: Face à la mère by Jean-René Lemoine and Guy Cassiers at the TNB in Rennes, in which a son speaks to his mother after her death in Haiti, the country she returned to after living in Africa and Europe.

72393f6b8592ad21203ae372c3a532ae24474c8a.en: L'imposture, a puppet one-woman show by Lucie Hanoy at La Paillette in Rennes, drawing on stand-up to explore gender, difference and fat-phobia.

ea6d92ae5b3f284951690a43995efed7e0ae67ad.en: Anne Depetrini, À côté, a comedy show at Le Bacchus in Rennes about never feeling in the right place, and what being out of step can offer.

36e8d1321a2f333968b5c05bcf6c07b63155304e.en: Bouche Bée at the MJC Pacé in Rennes, an a cappella show mixing Anne Sylvestre, Simon & Garfunkel, Piazzolla and Clara Ysé, with a moving audience layout.

04b8a2305038d19cdbb55bc874e427df679a4e65.en: Creative open days at MJM Graphic Design in Rennes, where students display their work across the school and visitors can explore the courses on offer.

fe73ef5911b64c582db3d1d45306da37aa417391.en: Stand High Patrol, a dub band with twenty years of career and seven albums, plays at Antipode in Rennes on 12 February with the support act, presenting two new albums.

18c5f2c1388cab4a857e47977230ab0a68eed340.en: Globe by Cie Kislorod at the Théâtre du Cercle in Rennes, a visual show between theatre and art, following a humanity trying to carry on as everything starts to break down, with handmade special effects.

a1e35cbb509710fe2864ec4810fbc8691734ba9b.en: Affranchies by Compagnie Bahia at Le Grand Logis in Rennes, a dance piece on how women's bodies are shaped, constrained and set free, moving from restraint to resistance and solidarity.

3df5b0fd2e9d96e400dc27401e23ee993ee9b78f.en: Manuel de libération at the Champs Libres auditorium in Rennes, a documentary about women who are not free and cannot work or start families, and who fight for their rights from the state, followed by a talk.

aca08a4724deb79be5f1f31192c659c133bbcce2.en: Olli & The London Radio Pop Orchestra, duo version, at the Escapade in Rennes, with the Maîtrise de Bretagne choir, mixing contemporary pop, orchestral breath and classical echoes.

2050efe8f7e7b2c14df0bf1df0bb3f41141240e8.en: Archives of Feelings by Gisèle Vienne with Marie NDiaye at the TNB in Rennes, eight characters in a night-time conversation at the end of a wedding party.

eba469b17dcfe5883fd172fbaaad23599c9608b0.en: Harold Barbé presents a new stand-up show in preview at Le Bacchus in Rennes. The France Inter columnist is known for sharp observation.

720a91143662cd343ed55118ccefd652dbbf35e1.en: The Beauregard carnival in Rennes on Wednesday 17 February 2027, starting at 10:00 at the picnic tables near La maison du parc and ending with a snack at Le Cadran.

e4af60335a7be80d664c8792e474807500939b45.en: Petite galerie du déclin at La Paillette in Rennes, a marionette show in three scenes with six characters, mixing comedy and tragedy about the end of the world.

db59d19da1f96e2db1c6bc03b0c922965a0c593e.en: Qui a tué Jacques Le Mareuil?, a talk at the MJC Pacé in Rennes on an unsolved 1811 case in which the mayor of a Calvados village was shot on his way home from Bayeux.

b10e3090e8b5045cc8863a2e7232b7598061279c.en: Parlons ciné on Italian cinema, a film chat at the Champs Libres in Rennes for the Travelling festival, with recent films, cult classics and series. All genres and periods are welcome.

83808456a730daa6fb2bcca9430511e2812eef44.en: Le Malade imaginaire by Cité Théâtre at Le Grand Logis in Rennes, Molière's last play, a satire of hypocrisy, cowardice and folly, and a warning about collective blindness.

6a4fd7b4c1ecbd4ca6cd66fe47922fe9d2662be1.en: Dystopia 2027, a hard music and techno festival at the Rennes exhibition centre on 19 and 20 February 2027, from 18:00 to 04:00, with two stages and about 40 artists.

eb9d9331845e19dc9ed74d14ba72b88f7ab16114.en: A tribute concert to Naâman at Le MeM in Rennes in February 2027, with his songs from La vie est un cadeau performed by a group of singers.

8a7b47f582bb88a4d1d57b37770169f7b968381a.en: Camille Tissot, Heureuse, a work-in-progress comedy show at Le Bacchus in Rennes by an actress and former Canal+ columnist, about anxiety, motherhood and happiness.

9305cb8a4b8349126221783d179574a85e4a50b1.en: Assassin at L'Étage in Rennes, presented by 213 Productions in agreement with X-Ray Production. The listing gives no other details.

8f47494e6ce2ff2ecc1272b7051be33be422d839.en: A drag workshop with Gloria Godass at the Théâtre du Cercle in Rennes, a course on creating a transformed alter ego that plays with gender categories.

9d4651c35b8f58aec5dd69adb98b894d59d2bce0.en: A three-day improvisation course for teenagers with Sophie Galle at the Théâtre du Cercle in Rennes, covering games and exercises to play scenes that have not been rehearsed.

4c7451a2ff1fc53ea204384c79fea8863119b40e.en: A vegetable garden workshop at the Jardin des Mille Pas in Rennes, on setting up a natural vegetable plot and preparing growing beds, with prices and times listed on the site.

f0713ee0c4077b4e0b205d628b5ff0052b17fec6.en: Komodor and Moundrag at L'Étage in Rennes on Friday 26 February 2027, a seventies-style rock night by two bands that have played together before.

5054a61f9ba96ef91f4c1e1251c88a5d1ac33571.en: A one-day forest-garden design course at the Jardin des Mille Pas in Rennes, covering ecological succession and garden layers in the morning, using permaculture design tools.

a8323b3fdef2bd5582ebce567e99e5a08266ffbb.en: Aupinard performs at Le MeM in Rennes on his Spleen.Social Tour, presenting his first album spleen. social club. He has sold out a Paris Olympia and two Salle Pleyel dates.

0401c05c8e2ce28c9e4bd858a94bcde3be3e717f.en: A textile screen-printing workshop at the EESAB school in Rennes, where participants print a single-colour design by hand onto a T-shirt, tote bag or other textile they bring.

7810ec6609cbfc926862a7c931b13ff5668d844e.en: Absolem, a Brussels rapper of Liège origin with a precise flow, performs at 360 Rennes. He is known for sharp rhymes and a deep voice.

95bf56b24c202ee13f37fb253d21d76d2fb9f069.en: A karaoke night at the MJC Pacé in Rennes on the first Friday of the month, with canapés.

69c81385f3111721f25bee79c2e1050baa4978e6.en: Eva performs the Summer Girl Tour at Le MeM in Rennes, presented by Miet Corp in agreement with Vertigo. The listing gives no other details.

b4d8e88a70c6899dd29cc60f76af7fa6b9e13092.en: Opéra by Compagnie Ladaïnha at the MJC Pacé in Rennes, a dance, music and performance piece built around a founding myth and the human condition, with interactive staging.

77bf38967c1ac1642dfe56d27d2d72c590a2ecc1.en: Sous la neige at the MJC Pacé in Rennes, a wordless sensory show in which two actors work among drifting tissue-paper snow, with the audience seated around the stage.

18926ee8a4f24a8b81ab1bc03c097334763eed22.en: Clytemnestre at La Paillette in Rennes, a musical, drag and spectacular retelling of the Greek myth of the queen who killed her husband, reimagined as a revolutionary figure.

bed2a869c289e3d5f51f636236ea309798caee3a.en: A talk at the MJC Pacé in Rennes on Mary Cassatt, the American painter who worked in Paris for six decades and was a key figure of Impressionism.

2decf454764723ff0b750df2bc1f77cd06e92ecc.en: Les caddies de la colère, a talk at the Archives de Rennes by Hugo Melchior on the 1975 strike at the Mammouth supermarket in Rennes, led mainly by women workers against authoritarian management.

395a95395e74fe2f6a648f4ad98bf10d21aa8bd5.en: Mathieu Madénian, À pleurer de rire, a one-hour stand-up show at Le Grand Logis in Rennes about how the late arrival of his first child changed his life.

1e6acf35dc8b90017db1493704017a9a00e4fd38.en: A herbal medicine workshop at the Jardin des Mille Pas in Rennes, on choosing tree buds for health and preparing a glycerine maceration, from 15:00 to 17:30. Full price is 20 euros, reduced 15 euros.

f380a785496990e74b97bc132bdb6a859b55d6af.en: Jahneration, a Breton reggae duo who recorded at Tuff Gong Studios in 2017, performing at Le MeM in Rennes.

deaa40129ef9cf78b66e8e0695695bd6e5fcc69b.en: Nuit Incolore, a pop artist presenting the album Re:Naissance Part.1 at L'Étage in Rennes, presented by W Spectacle.

11a43a4d83aa79506ef21496bcfa468e0a04d680.en: Guigui Pop, Full contact, a stand-up show at Le Bacchus in Rennes about a midlife break-up and a bare-hand combat sport.

2147d01177e808206d52765ef844efe6e21ff36b.en: A drag show at the Théâtre du Cercle in Rennes, ending a one-week beginner drag course for ten participants, with the acts they created.

e0f7899192f53129d1f961104e46294b4e07d559.en: Le petit détournement by La Poule theatre company at Le Sabot d'Or in Rennes, an improvisation and dubbing show in which actors voice film clips live with a musician.

91245674203e4903d2b15892b097ccec0bd4122c.en: Walid Ben Selim performs Here and Now at La Confluence in Betton, a voice and harp recital mixing Arabic poetry, Sufi poetry and contemporary music.

a5a3c74554ccb272724406268d7a998e8b7c9de6.en: Jazzy Bazz performs at L'Étage in Rennes, presented by Krumpp Music, a French rapper from Paris's 19th arrondissement.

260ae710a0b301c6edf8cabdc51948b4fc587370.en: Égaré et merde aux sapins., a family show at the MJC Pacé in Rennes about an overworked man who falls asleep at a station and meets odd characters in his dreams.

f17066e8fc995ba5da3df0b147a4a9dfec117358.en: The Rencontres Chorégraphiques at Le Ponant, a dance day held by the MJC Pacé for dancers of all ages and levels, with groups presenting their year's work.

8d106083a70120286aa3754f2ad978bf04279c77.en: Steve'n'Seagulls at Le MeM in Rennes, a band formed in 2014 with four studio albums, who have toured widely in Europe and North America.

bc03be34971b4567875cf72323f30f042ecd782c.en: Des fil.les rouges at the MJC Pacé in Rennes, an exhibition by Marie Parent, known as Marnie Chaissac, using reworked and recycled works to explore women's place in society and art history.

d6b7e592c7ea67ce8f2e35226e45eda50ddcedfc.en: A summer seed-sowing workshop at the Jardin des Mille Pas in Rennes, covering seed choice, sowing, germination and transplanting.

52c7d7b22505d1b6e24c6309c158661a4434768c.en: L'Amante anglaise by Marguerite Duras, directed by Émilie Charriot at the TNB in Rennes, based on a real crime in which a woman kills her deaf cousin and the investigation that follows.

590eff8d2f6629913f7e90246dde138c33ae6974.en: Fête du court-métrage at the FRAC auditorium in Rennes, a free programme of short film screenings for schools, leisure centres, families and adults, held in March.

c5934b95195e737e4fedcf654373d03a7a5dca17.en: Nos Assemblées, a participatory show by La Paillette in Rennes on how collective decisions are made, staged in a portable theatre with a greased maypole.

f131dfe1efc252ba3777e99ad3bc8d432a7a52ff.en: Juste au-dessus du silence by Yasmine Youcef at Le Garage in Rennes, a trial performance about inheriting history in fragments, using a carpet, dance and voice, drawing on Algeria.

ee6250a170c4772cbf0cf7926084d5dc606d282e.en: La nature des équilibres by Sylvain Gouraud at the Théâtre l'Aire Libre in Rennes, part of MONDE·S#3, a stage piece built from a long field survey of farming, using photographs, gestures and interviews with farmers.

eda6dd4c8b65baeb02a4455cc4c46e0c8be59b71.en: Michel Hubert at 360 Rennes, an unpredictable comedy performer who is not the old man his name suggests, with an unlimited imagination.

d7aa24054e3f682f60cdc87e898efcaf6fa20dd5.en: La Maison Tellier at Le Grand Logis in Rennes, the eighth album by the Normandy band, presented as a value-for-money live band that plays the music it loves.

61f098214bb451b8d19f137bdf984973e793483d.en: Nos futurs 2027 at the Champs Libres in Rennes, an exhibition of projects by young students and activists, supported by the Champs Libres, Sciences Po Rennes and Le Monde.

ba324ade247e839589d47ac23cd32cd7c3e5932c.en: Train Train Blues by Compagnie Les 3 Valoches at the Théâtre du Cercle in Rennes, a show on a station platform where the audience boards a blue train and follows a woman's journey and memories.

fbc67b7fd7b2706c5f7d3874ac526f28c1a7cc11.en: Autoportrait à ma grand-mère by Patricia Allio at the Théâtre l'Aire Libre in Saint-Jacques-de-la-Lande, part of MONDE·S#3, a solo sound walk in which she talks to her late grandmother using archive sound and photos.

1a27059088d06e74b8b0073b77c2f446402c61cd.en: Bertrand Belin performs at Le MeM in Rennes, a French singer-songwriter who explores inner life and the coexistence of people in his songs.

a928f5c86bc754e15fc7478b993ae385879a25d7.en: Tumulte, a queer traditional dance ball by the Tumulus collective at the Théâtre l'Aire Libre in Rennes, part of MONDE·S#3, which reworks Breton, Auvergne and Occitan dances.

6e00f8c0849b00b4ee5e96ab2a3e186e78466bad.en: A strategy games session at the Chantepie toy library, with the Ludovores club. It is free, booking is recommended and places are limited. A snack is included.

21f77bf662c4f6e31a998e7c7fb983bbe0782546.en: Gibraltar, Identités réconciliées by Abd Al Malik at the TNB in Rennes, a stage version 20 years after his album Gibraltar, combining slam, rap, dance and visual art.

824882a74c86355604de8bdfdb5e9bb2f835681e.en: A pop medley by the Appoggio choir at the MJC Pacé in Rennes, finalists of the Meilleure chorale de France TV competition, with cinema-inspired songs.

e89005f679119f71276ba74934ad67067a68d7ee.en: Grand Reporterre #9: France dégage., a show at the Théâtre l'Aire Libre in Saint-Jacques-de-la-Lande, part of MONDE·S#3, on the breakdown of relations between France and West African countries in 2023 and the legacy of Françafrique.

d3d0d75af9eec885aa2186b0e5bfa9ddd7e6ec72.en: Les Sales Gosses, a free concert at Le Grand Logis in Rennes with a violin, accordion and two voices. Seats are limited.

335a087ebf1a44448ef23ee09a9555d7eeac3a03.en: In relation to whom?, a dance piece by Palestinian dancers Marah Haj Hussein and Nur Garabli at the CCN de Rennes et de Bretagne, part of MONDE·S#3, examining the link between dance training and military training.

b9e2f9df7cc240245c46b2bd2fd380de1c09a4ff.en: Esquif, a show at La Paillette in Rennes by Anaïs Allais Benbouali, which gives voice to the Mediterranean, to the rescue ship Ocean Viking and to survivors of crossings.

a4815c4f96a288796f204263e2925138cc7f2d17.en: Lescop performs at Ubu in Rennes, a French singer known for post-punk, new wave and pop, presenting his album Polaroïds.

614dc155ddf6cd8ab9745a855d1b5c8d50778a41.en: Alexis & Trem, Rien que pour vous, an improvised one-hour comedy show at Le Bacchus in Rennes, built from audience suggestions with no script.

76d586cc443a8c21a40c1320bd7e8439fdd01e0a.en: Notes on Texas by Alice Loumeau and Valentin Bansac at the Théâtre l'Aire Libre in Saint-Jacques-de-la-Lande, part of MONDE·S#3, a work-in-progress from a residency in Marfa, Texas, with writing, sound and maps.

b29837fd0eafda332ac4e256ef32efe4cf786b0e.en: Tout part du ventre by Cie des gens comme tout le monde at the Théâtre du Cercle in Rennes, two performers recall their school days and tell stories of young people they have met.

7ddf34b4cb4b7bd37766b010e8a12ba34869e204.en: JeanJass performs at Antipode in Rennes, presented by Krumpp Music. The Belgian-Moroccan rapper and producer builds his songs from fragments, including on Les Champs de Sacs Plastique.

36819219c494c60592b4557a87e478e0f6471f03.en: Wayqeycuna by Tiziano Cruz at the Théâtre l'Aire Libre in Saint-Jacques-de-la-Lande, part of MONDE·S#3, a search for his childhood community in northern Argentina, left 27 years ago, using ritual gestures, songs and memories.

843cca4222af6e70c413d480474d74ec9e053de5.en: Rodrigo y Gabriela perform at Le MeM in Rennes, a Mexican instrumental rock duo with metal influences, playing solo and rhythm guitar.

f4b6f59ba3180349549acef723a13e8e8d83521c.en: Antichambre by Stereoptik at the TNB in Rennes, a visual and musical poem in which drawing and painting are made and projected live alongside music.

fc36417b36f29ebe0c38104b6498e1a9c2b2ff05.en: Dark, a new show by Bruital Compagnie at Le Grand Logis in Rennes, a violent and anachronistic medieval world in which a woman called Jeanne is reborn through mime and lip-sync.

54c74437c942f2f210e28fbff40861a3a586fef7.en: A work-experience forum at the IUT de Rennes Clos Courtel site where apprentices and employers meet to make professional links.

9b3db0baa709d61a5146cd0d6d204b4345122145.en: Le Liban dans la tourmente du Moyen-Orient, a talk at the MJC Pacé in Rennes on how conflicts in the Middle East since 7 October 2023 have destabilised Lebanon.

130d51eba8d6f981b224f09152521b68eb9761cc.en: Min el Djazaïr at La Paillette in Rennes, a poetic exile story that mixes music, shadow theatre and video, set in 1960s Algeria as a sister joins the struggle for independence.

e5a3ee34443c729ccfe21a05421becb70b9e9b57.en: Chérub', a theatre and music show improvised around children's imaginations, with three Chérub' adventurers on a cinema-themed quest. It is at the MJC Pacé in Rennes.

a2698d6a6d01a8a4597e437ca57c290bc9dc4994.en: A first-Friday theatre open stage at the MJC Pacé in Rennes, with hidden-role party games such as Werewolf and Saboteur, plus improvised sketches from local companies.

5e9ed87599f1bee0da7b5900a588d93ad88374b1.en: A one-day course on growing aromatic and medicinal plants at the Jardin des Mille Pas in Rennes, covering planting, seasonal care and propagation. Participants take home small pots.

3c7f80e8521524fe065d9392135bd56e2eef78b7.en: Carte Blanche Improvisée at the MJC Pacé in Rennes, a weekend of improv shows, social moments and workshops by improvisers.

af756b226779241a5a4027eaf259ba615368d4b4.en: Big Ukulele Syndicate presents The Party at La Confluence in Betton, a playful ukulele band from the Grenoble area that mixes comedy and music about bosses and workers.

2927f1f2e3387c679ed8a2eb6f5cd99e4ee4024b.en: Les Fatals Picards at Le MeM in Rennes, a stage band that mixes rock, French chanson, humour and political engagement.

821f9681ad7ec245d5c4eb62b20eca6086bf6b3a.en: Les veilleur·euses, an exhibition at the MJC Pacé in Rennes by artist Oraaage (Nathan Lepage), a puppeteer and set designer with the Gronde company, with dreamlike forest installations.

dea2926dbacdf1c784b667bb67a98acc39bcb260.en: A guided visit of the geology museum on the Beaulieu campus in Rennes, showing about a million minerals, rocks and fossils. It is free, on Monday 5 April at 17:30.

d589fb7754018ca69dad7680dee3febd4bdd96bc.en: A guided visit of the zoology gallery on the Beaulieu campus in Rennes, showing about 150,000 animal specimens. It is free with booking, on Tuesday 6 April at 17:30.

5c50fc497489e406e53a2079898f8e5a77de9862.en: Kontact by Compagnie Puéril Péril at Le Grand Logis in Rennes, a high-flying acrobatic show by six performers with no equipment or safety net.

182aa2bb2f25e44896e2ec1014751acb3c742fc3.en: A herbal drying workshop at the Jardin des Mille Pas in Rennes, covering drying methods that keep colour and flavour. Participants take home a sample of plants to dry.

b3bbe5f8f35a3aa66e65536cb024a8af8016cb8d.en: Monster Parade by Nathalie Béasse at the Théâtre l'Aire Libre in Rennes, a family spooky show in which objects move, bodies appear and disappear and lights create strange worlds.

b747016da6ebab59cf66eba6fb3be1ffa44a5c8a.en: Amour sourd by Théâtre des Silences at the MJC Pacé in Rennes, a piece that questions love between deaf people, starting from a quotation from Claudia Durastanti's novel L'Étrangère.

d123645dd7a3bb87b6be3d91849a5b28c084503a.en: Roman Doduik, Première dame, a comedy show at Le Sabot d'Or in Rennes, in which he talks about his mental health, origins and sexuality.

851931bdcbb644b099f5ded63db109815edb34f7.en: France périphérique by Pierre Faure at the Champs Libres in Rennes, a photo and talk project documenting rural France, taking a year or more in each region.

28575aeedf858875628a1642ce949efe77207ff0.en: A Ducky open-mic night at the Bourg-l'Évêque community hall in Rennes, where six comedians try out their jokes. Anyone can sign up and no audition is needed. A bar run by volunteers supports the local association.

36a9b11570da16d11340b67f3e846cceb0ad57a1.en: A guided visit of the paintings by Mathurin Méheut and Yvonne Jean-Haffen at the geology museum on the Beaulieu campus in Rennes. The 25 paintings were commissioned in 1941 and are listed as historic monuments.

0dee3acbc990374102638148ef5a00cf99eb5b78.en: A guided visit of the scientific instruments gallery on the Beaulieu campus in Rennes, showing about 5,000 objects from physics, chemistry, biology and computing.

0770d8ef592d6f37b0bfed24293d7ff36a1f58cd.en: Chicandier and Mathou Cann at Le Bacchus in Rennes, two comedians playing themselves and other characters in a sharp take on modern life.

4e1793e3132c51cbda1e003957a9dc0771bb5ebb.en: L'avenir des reflets by Lazare and Vita Nova at the TNB in Rennes, a play on the stories and myths of the French Revolution from 1789 to 1793, asking about the desire for freedom today.

8e073ae104ec946990d74ea240f73b01832bbff9.en: En friche by Alexandre Koutchevsky at the Lormandière site in Chartres-de-Bretagne, a photo and sound work in former industrial sites where factories are gone but their traces remain.

1b36191922c0c02c2c981502b4f433a6d3f5958f.en: Bel-Ami by Compagnie VIVA at Le Grand Logis in Rennes, the story of Georges Duroy, a penniless opportunist who rises through Paris high society by seducing women.

a158ea2b492ab4e19ccf34d7c5f8e803501b8d4f.en: BEY performs at 360 Rennes, presented by Krumpp Music and Halo. He mixes pop rock, emo and French chanson, with lyrics about doubt and being different.

e1fdea2c235fb37e1177419c6c9b06ba61cbbade.en: Noir comme le diamant, a graphic detective story at the MJC Pacé in Rennes, in which images are drawn and projected live while two manipulators and a musician tell the story of Léonore, a women's rights activist.

cfb9e66ce654f21eea49b6bba1c37e437dfd8522.en: A two-day permaculture course at the Jardin des Mille Pas in Rennes, looking at how permaculture applies to the garden, drawing on nature, farmers' knowledge and science.

df74abaae7ffc2939d2c09d8145d54c86a3830c9.en: Jazz Fusion at the MJC Pacé in Rennes, a jazz dance show by students of the Calabash school, with a piece by Carl Portal and choreography by Cie Wayne Barbaste.

060c8ba7bf3e7daf76d9f6c8c94fb6caa121cda5.en: A clown workshop at the Théâtre du Cercle in Rennes led by Christelle Kerdavid, covering breath, emotion, body training and improvisation with movement and voice.

403b9dd4090c8b618e093c597d802201d6e7043f.en: A two-day screen-printing course at the EESAB school in Rennes, where participants layer colours and make their own prints from drawings and cut-outs.

3cf93713d740a94b58c02e77417b56c76298d434.en: A three-day illustration course at the EESAB school in Rennes on telling stories in pictures, using drawing, paper cut-outs and colour fields, with basic animation.

0a5f8b4d2c07a51b9e928119293fe056c97a51c1.en: Dictionnaire (presque) complet de la photographie, letter O for Ouverture, presented at Le Forum in Rouen by the EOP festival and the Réseau LUX. Ouverture is the aperture setting that controls how much light enters the camera.

0f8d36afa92632c76ce5820ba0ba5cecc4bb655a.en: Dans la rue, a photo exhibition at the Jean-Prévost social centre in Rouen, showing street scenes from markets, parks, seaside and carnival. The opening is on Friday 9 October at 18:00.

a94a3dbf91f1966778d1ed8fd97fb9488b3520ed.en: Histoire(s) de cimetières, an exhibition at the Georges-Déziré social centre in Rouen on the city's funerary heritage. The opening is on Friday 2 October at 18:00.

e1b9751948edf9ffd4eaeef1dc9f64956bd15baa.en: A solidarity drive at the Elsa-Triolet library in Rouen, collecting cotton T-shirts to make hats and caps for women undergoing chemotherapy.

ed8c9e54c1edcd41caeae5f835bc59044eeaf392.en: A chess introduction at the Simone de Beauvoir library in Rouen for players from age 7. Beginners are welcome.

2ecd7f6d6376721c49926a5eb99a5597853e3e51.en: À vous de jouer, calm video games on the theme of slowing down, in the Émilie-du-Châtelet libraries in Rouen. The programme includes dreamy walks, gentle music and exploration.

009a8659becc1c7e27bef80c0e322b5185b6fb65.en: Wucan and Dream On at Fury Défendu in Rouen. Wucan is a German retro rock band playing heavy folk rock with stoner and doom touches, often compared to Jethro Tull.

436663854af1783c10deb8c81982b5f4417ea0ce.en: Amazonia Tribe at Le Velvet in Rouen, three nights of jungle-themed events from Thursday 22 to Saturday 24 October, each from 23:00 to 06:00 with a different DJ set.

077d73f59a6b5eef477c64790eb4ae564e87e8ef.en: Plein les yeux., an exhibition at the Rouen Normandy Photography Centre celebrating children's photo books as an art form, opening the Bicentenary of Photography.

ba9a687596919a91d801ffbd3492764359846ffc.en: Territoire et climat, a forum debate at MAN in Rouen on how climate change is already changing Normandy's landscapes, including rising temperatures, rain patterns and coastline retreat.

00e36304ba0f80e53fc8f1761e03079440d0d7d1.en: Club Bouillant with Povoa and Calypso B2B Garba (Helios Crew) at Le Fait Social in Rouen, a night exploring sound territories that blend genres.

6c1a2cee1fd65759f74acb0d3867c58dccb4c1ba.en: 4-CTRL x Online at Le Spot Club in Rouen, with the line-up Horas, R3zok, Tosmoz, Kormor and CYMK. Doors are from 23:30 to 06:30, under-18s are not admitted, and original ID is required.

40e7cbe31f25364211580a1f09de453d8133903b.en: Jardinons. Mon massif zéro arrosage, a gardening workshop with Green Up in Rouen on plants and techniques for a flower bed that needs no watering. Venue to be announced, and registration opens 22 June.

127bef597cd703c4abb91c9978646d0599bbaa63.en: Tapis à histoires, a storytelling session for toddlers at the Aretha-Franklin library in Rouen, with picture books read to babies sitting or held in a parent's arms.

08b95a89e053efd9adfd996c17e39d8fa6ebf8d7.en: Conversation in French at the Aretha-Franklin library in Rouen, a relaxed meeting over tea or coffee for learners of French at all levels.

5f21ef1418be3b26319d785b8bfbaf5416071480.en: Paper weaving at the Émilie-du-Châtelet library in Rouen, a workshop in which participants weave paper to make a small picture.

e80aa718e6f2cb6ecb653bb01c18d873d5819fd1.en: Make your mask at the Amélie-Bosquet library in Rouen, a workshop making a pumpkin or monster for Halloween from cardboard plates.

6ceef8b9aaf6a4a9a36ba0d9fa410139f8bd87d1.en: Écoute créative with composer Hubert Michel at the Émilie-du-Châtelet library in Rouen, exploring silence, speed and sound in electroacoustic music. It is for ages 8 and up.

04a78a110b9c4348b8ead4f082047d5fa00cd93b.en: Rêverie d'un papillon at the Simone de Beauvoir library in Rouen, a calm evening of soft lights, poetry, lullabies and stories, with tongue drum, kalimba and rain stick music.

2161d195c0106dfd7856d7074d4e01c7ccc57cd3.en: Crunchy stories and tinkering: Halloween at the Aretha-Franklin library in Rouen, with spooky stories and a scary card-making activity to ward off bad spirits.

4ed3c9cd1faf87ea3bee6aca8283e266a098a508.en: Supersuckers and Dirty Dogz at Le Fury Défendu in Rouen. The US punk band, with nearly 40 years of career, presents its album Liquor, Women, Drugs & Killing.

d68b516c4e7c2006981d383e6e14a67192e705ae.en: Empreinte, a first-anniversary birthday party in Rouen with DJs Daddy Chulo, Chiarranna, Bydone, Polly and Citadium. Wristbands give 15% off at a shop, among other surprises.

6be9e8903bd8710b56ade697fc43c7bf9e1a9da8.en: Le Spot invites Schlass at Le Spot Club in Rouen. Doors open 23:30 to 06:30, under-18s are not admitted, and original ID is required.

f64a1b25dcb6da0b40a2b9abcb5b50e3ce3a8b5d.en: Noapology and ODC at Le Fury Défendu in Rouen, Ukrainian alternative modern metal combining hard rock with female vocals, on the band's first European tour.

06f8016a74aba1ab83cfb12d44de924e9b83ec51.en: À petits petons vers les histoires, a storytelling session for toddlers at the Émilie-du-Châtelet library in Rouen, with picture books read to babies on an adult's lap.

2a7b70c2f2f54bdc0e491a018646413eb3259b31.en: Decorations of death, a craft session at the Parment library in Rouen for the Day of the Dead, with crochet garlands, decorated skulls, felt decorations, colouring and readings.

323806c1a1b95b2fb8ad7266aac6ff4859f12bb4.en: Tu me lis ça?, a one-to-one reading session at the Aretha-Franklin library in Rouen, where the child chooses the book and the librarian reads it aloud.

02c4fc40730103b3fd2b6b0280405e69446c5388.en: Crunchy and tinkering: Day of the Dead and Tracas dolls at the Émilie-du-Châtelet library in Rouen, for ages 5 and up, with stories from Central America and a Guatemalan doll-making workshop.

714f51db5466b5fd50125a7ca73beea3f9c884e6.en: La Fresque du sexisme at La BASE in Rouen, an immersive workshop on gender inequality that uses card games to explore how to spot and act on sexism.

d7f3a3285b24d6e2c80ba4f445443e72d4a8b149.en: Horskh and Lifewaves at Le Fury Défendu in Rouen on Thursday 29 October at 20:00. Horskh is a French trio blending metal, grunge and electro.

3ebac0e640c435ed5091ce02cb188a9b66880348.en: A cooking workshop at the Elsa-Triolet library in Rouen, using vegetables grown in the Champ des Bruyères park, followed by a shared tasting.

d785d61805a48dafa7447b22a00521878c872f17.en: Je suis venue vous lire, a storytelling session at the Aretha-Franklin library in Rouen, with cushions and soft lighting for listening with eyes closed.

6e3df36936a8713f842b795a6d3d9fd0615bf335.en: Club Bouillant closing summer night at Le Fait Social in Rouen with KRL MX, boss of the Kapitalist Dance Club label, Yenkov and Balzam.

fcbafc55c407c1f8252679c443efbce749a454e4.en: Schranz Night by Le Spot at Le Spot Club in Rouen, with Zeke, Bantam, Nesko and ILR. Doors open 23:30 to 06:30, under-18s are not admitted, and original ID is required.

3e26f27d9368092b89bc2be5b64cd8bf58ae5be0.en: Jardinons. Building a keyhole garden with Green Up in Rouen, a workshop on a small garden that uses waste to grow vegetables or flowers. The venue is to be announced, and registration opens 22 June.

bcaf2e69f70b5d974fc26522f736c1cdf4ca3a30.en: Introduction to role-playing games at the Louis-Aragon toy library in Rouen, for children from age 7.

13ab7bd08c483bf92692e299ade1553ffa564cef.en: Horror brunch at the Simone de Beauvoir library in Rouen for Halloween, where readers share favourite horror books, films and comics. Drinks are provided.

d9da81c5446eb8aae601c7221a5f5e2f13c1615c.en: A Halloween jigsaw puzzle contest at the Simone de Beauvoir library in Rouen, for families or friends, to see which team finishes fastest.

34e586f51c255b4c4ad921e87a71cb69eac60f65.en: La fête des morts mexicaine at the Parment library in Rouen on 31 October, a Day of the Dead event with face painting, costumes, virtual reality and shows, for children from age 7.

1ad34e314cc8502f338f14c751d4978de6cce50e.en: The virtual reality horror experience returns to the Parment library in Rouen for a third edition, with 20-minute solo sessions in the game Metro Awakening. Teenagers from 16 are admitted with parental consent.

876501f4ea90a28a136a97e3f51b6997e5b4dbcd.en: Halloween masks at the Émilie-du-Châtelet library in Rouen, where participants design a mask on screen or paper and make it with the ChamaLab digital cutting machine.

1234b647ce8918ab8e27246225cc50cfbaf2bde9.en: Les affûteurs d'histoires, a storytelling session at the Parment library in Rouen for ages 8 and up, with a Halloween special in which stories are sharpened while being told.

e346fe6ebd2f717fda00031419579b5e06106fbb.en: Les affûteurs d'histoires, a storytelling session at the Parment library in Rouen for teenagers and adults, with a Halloween special.

f48b6a48f76392b01fad9f661529b718788a0c75.en: À livre ouvert at the Parment library in Rouen, a monthly meet-up for retirees and people over 60, around a theme, with library documents to borrow. Sessions include slowing down and connecting generations.

c1eb1cec090b36454fc09bb426e3b43c06323efd.en: Déclics, free individual digital help sessions for November and December at the Amélie-Bosquet library in Rouen, for questions about PCs, smartphones and tablets.

1375887ef87c42debb0ae4fb6f7a3587c6d722da.en: Applikids at the Aretha-Franklin library in Rouen, a chance to try digital apps and video games alone, with friends or as a family.

30ed0a6811a0fab748bfaabd5d9983e66702c64f.en: Study support sessions at the Madeleine-Riffaud library in Rouen, run by the association Le LAB'HAUTS with two young volunteers. No booking is needed, and they cover study methods from college to higher education.

f7389690a99964610487ec479a619a62c1104027.en: Knitting and pompoms at the Émilie-du-Châtelet library in Rouen, with the Citémômes association making pieces for future exhibitions. It is a drop-in workshop from 15:00 to 17:00.

6af8fe72119b051b0e996c2329a5130b04540b10.en: Croquants et bidouilles, nature and the seasons at the Madeleine-Riffaud library in Rouen, a storytelling and craft session on Celtic festivals linked to the autumn and winter seasons.

b0078ee090ba7be55096038052031a69839e8268.en: A vegan cooking workshop at the La Maison Bleue coworking space in Rouen. All ingredients are provided, and it suits beginners and curious cooks.

08efeffd30321bed40044e59b4db11322730221e.en: Proto jeu at the Louis-Aragon toy library in Rouen on the first Thursday of each month, a meeting for people who want to create, test or play board games.

bdf7869d1f96bf8791b4e3ec1334aa9fbf0bd9d5.en: A visit to the Tessenderlo Kerley France liquid fertiliser plant in Grand-Quevilly, Rouen, organised with the UPSIDE-Boucles de Rouen business network.

152c7a03f3e00a7aa9717f141c15dfc6322b513f.en: Soirée enchantée at Le Charleston in Rouen, with a fairy-themed concert by Misalicious, flute and electro music, plus stalls of CDs, prints, flash tattoos, illustrations and jewellery.

b95b93c0383dd2c5c4ecd637f587a21b1ac35414.en: SOS Paperasse at the Émilie-du-Châtelet library in Rouen, a drop-in service where social workers and volunteers help with paperwork, online or on paper, on topics like housing and pensions.

b598906af4cbae55fee2b3e5660166826b20d9a6.en: Nuit de l'orientation at the IFA Campus Marcel Sauvage in Rouen, an event to guide people in career choices, for pupils, students and job seekers.

ff7db4cef5d40100cca43c7c6292603655bdcae4.en: Loudblast, Ataraxie and Stronghold in Rouen. Loudblast is a French death metal band active since 1985, presenting its album Altering Fates and Destinies.

fa93c27b5122526c84c68c1a98153ebc9d6bdaff.en: Jardinons. Using nettles in the vegetable garden and kitchen, a workshop at the Repainville site in Rouen, where participants pick nettles to make a nettle liquid fertiliser and recipes. Registration opens 22 June.

b2e33390278f609d3031ae9ec81f56342136cd92.en: Bornéo, l'art de ralentir, a photo exhibition at the Aretha-Franklin library in Rouen by Rouen-based traveller Nicolas Ternisien, on Indonesia and slow living.

901e318f1927c6453a2a88dc0e00f073ea42f4c0.en: Aquarelle sous hypnose, a watercolour workshop at the Simone de Beauvoir library in Rouen with illustrator Camille Garoche, painting hollyhocks with the drawing gum technique.

7c2c6312628bd484f26fdf85b237cee8b044f804.en: Créathé at the Émilie-du-Châtelet library in Rouen, a monthly craft workshop where people share materials and explore creative hobbies.

77f3c76abf6f312100406b51176bafd0dae0fdc8.en: Viens lire avec un chien, a reading session at the Amélie-Bosquet library in Rouen, where children read aloud to a dog, Freyja, who listens without judgement.

7d90c30621f78ab93e0fd71b46c3f406d2dad27e.en: Les usages des écrans, a three-session family workshop at the Simone de Beauvoir library in Rouen, where parent and child pairs work with researchers to observe their own screen use at home.

2673cfe0b635a64f1400de269ccc442b53ea4ca4.en: Discover computer music, a three-session music production workshop at the Aretha-Franklin library in Rouen, on 26 September, 7 November and 12 December, where participants create a first track.

5357638e9a78b8b46cb65e381dfcfb68a6a50666.en: Bornéo: meeting with Nicolas Ternisien at the Aretha-Franklin library in Rouen, with photos of a bike and canoe journey through Borneo, followed by a tasting.

12051c1a18c28fbc0f67cce4c7eb4afe13d22aab.en: INN Old School Night, Drop 2, at Bouillon d'Isno in Isneauville on Saturday 7 November 2026 from 21:00 to 03:00. Entry is 8 euros in advance or 10 euros on the door.

abfd183680f4cd98fc223af30a979e1d39b7c6e0.en: Le Diable au corps at Spot Club in Rouen, a night with SENO of the Narkotek sound system.

01f079eef1d93e7551187d01b82ed75d655978ae.en: Lol Tolhurst of The Cure, with Battan l'Otto and Sebastian Erik Klein, at Le Fury Défendu in Rouen on Sunday 8 November at 20:00. Tolhurst is a founding member of The Cure.

251d5fba4439065fc715a5b9deb6e8e2bcc3901f.en: Time travel: an introduction to palaeontology at the Aretha-Franklin library in Rouen for children, with simulated digs in a sandbox, clay footprints and a reconstruction of a giant fossil.

d0e8813edfc16ea40bc19c55d0c04032dd5dc66b.en: Tangente, an art and social science project at the Simone de Beauvoir library in Rouen, asking what six workers would do with a funded real break from work.

0cba6b8d9814abc6e0132f52d413291fea7d6b07.en: Musiquiz at the Aretha-Franklin library in Rouen, a family singing and quiz game to recognise well-known children's songs.

b4090da7845c3946ea9f8ab4b3566f6dace575ec.en: Passe-temps at the Parment library in Rouen, a collective drawing workshop in which participants map their own sense of time as a personal map of moments.

0a53b29cd5222f91444836a56c229111866fc7d6.en: Electro-sonic nap at the Émilie-du-Châtelet library in Rouen, an immersive listening session in which music is treated as cinema for the ears.

aed552ec5d592b2a36a5f986f349ff4f3c003c87.en: Zinée at the Trianon Transatlantique in Sotteville-lès-Rouen, presented by Ovastand with Hooh Agency, performing the EP BIL after her album OSMIN.

4b007e20e324decee87d919a8e908a3a76ec8d7f.en: The Next Movement, Karma Dojo Tour, at Le Fury Défendu in Rouen. The Europe-based funk trio plays explosive groove and soul.

f4e0449edadfe3ebb6725c15b3cd53fb15d00e48.en: Wake the Dead and Devotion at Le Fury Défendu in Rouen. Wake the Dead is a modern hardcore band formed in Marseille in 2010, with over 450 concerts.

af7c25a4ba3f25c543e380a93a19e0a7e0d5ea3b.en: Ajna performs at the Trianon Transatlantique in Sotteville-lès-Rouen, a dark, melodic singer. Her projects Boys&Basement (2023) and Goldmaker (2024) were followed by a sold-out tour.

8fc647cfc583337b8362b0d50e171851eaad5f79.en: L2B at the Zénith de la Métropole Rouen Normandie. The trio of childhood friends has a 2027 zenith tour after a 2025 tour with two sold-out Accor Arena shows.

91666e7840349369630706992972199dcb1386fd.en: Tayc at the Zénith de Rouen. He is known for the platinum single Fleur Froide, and is touring the 2026 album JOŸA, his second.

712aa326a203d8adcb174c3a4f5b9665638a9823.en: A guided visit in Basque to the Walker exhibition at Tabakalera. Three video pieces by filmmaker Tsai Ming-Liang follow a walker, played by Lee Kang-sheng, through Hong Kong, Taipei and Marseille. A mediator leads it, and no prior knowledge is needed.

9f0e544219e534267a4aa8e68cedfdbd43c8624b.en: A dialogue-based visit to the Walker exhibition with a mediator, on Tsai Ming-Liang's video works about slowness and the way we look at our surroundings. Sessions take place on 24 September, 22 October and 19 November.

72bcd8d9b3068371f2a1111e5379fd94f7711e30.en: ASESINATO EN EL JUBILETXE is a comedy staged by the amateur group Oroimenak, with members who are visually impaired. When a beloved resident dies at the retirement home, old secrets surface, and the performance is in Spanish with free entry.

76c8da56be26a637e9690d5069045cd5179420a8.en: A dialogue-based visit to Walker at Tabakalera, on three video pieces by Tsai Ming-Liang that mix contemporary art and film. A mediator leads the sessions, and no prior knowledge is needed.

5e490f605012afabb6397f56fecb5733284c5604.en: A reading group on basic feminist texts at Lekuona Fabrika, led by Nagore Pérez, held on Thursdays in Basque and Spanish. It is for adults aged 16 and over, with places allocated by lottery and library membership required.

dec16843a927a3f6317f55c5850fbd4f4cf53661.en: Director Igor Legarreta talks about making his third feature, Inurri itsuak, based on Ramiro Pinilla's novel Las ciegas hormigas, at Tabakalera. The film is not screened at the talk.

4c976843566a7d8463ae1754821bd9e6d26d4106.en: Gregoria is a humorous one-woman show at the Casa de Cultura Manuel Lekuona. It asks whether feminism is born or made, following the influence of a family of women, stories, television and feminist friends.

d78c5aba804f0db159225f26e8bae9e8849a8b9d.en: A guided visit to the exhibition Kanthoria eta autotunea at the Centro Cultural Ernest Lluch, led by curator Xabier Erkizia. The opening on 7 October at 19:00 includes an acoustic concert by Maite Larburu, with more visits in Basque.

3fb26ac4dced2178d39138b1be32e0bd18bb0165.en: Anastacia performs at the Kursaal on 22 October 2026 on her #NTKTour 2026. The pop singer celebrates her hits and the 25th anniversary of her debut album, Not That Kind, which has a special edition.

91d08cbd7b4bf4a83c1538817659495a0387bf86.en: Lipe Court presents Brazilian Waves at the Altxerri Jazz Club.

7ad9fb8ea5cd96911ce31a39cc84c617a2b9ed54.en: The tenth day on gender-based violence in adolescence at the Centro Cultural Intxaurrondo focuses on the community. Sessions cover good treatment, bullying from a gender perspective, coeducation, intersectionality and cyberviolence.

36e807e28b8af03f7f9c3558626b8563405236f1.en: Habitat. Ezkutatu diguten historia is a free exhibition of 14 wall panels at Potxoenea in Usurbil, organised by Beñi Agirre Udarregi Ikastola. Secondary pupils visit first, and then the public is welcome.

d44701f5a19894d7e08ba4ba08288fcb1de1643f.en: Inurri Itsuak, directed by Igor Legarreta, is shown at the Antiguo Berri cinemas. A storm runs an English ship full of coal aground off Algorta, and a family risks everything to keep the coal that could save them.

69b8d7da17f0db18f58615269dc32911cafe0076.en: Inurri Itsuak, directed by Igor Legarreta, is shown at Cinesa Urbil. A storm runs an English ship full of coal aground off Algorta, and a family risks everything to keep the coal that could save them.

0387b7a7061ab7848a63875e0f04a88c32f2f9e2.en: Gure Zirkua 2026 is the ninth tour of the first circus performed entirely in Basque. In Errenteria from 2 to 24 October, its 14 family shows mix juggling, trapeze, magic and music.

4f066713be2951ad61fe6852c1defa05d7e29c1b.en: Parecidos razonables is an exhibition by Kresala Dantza Taldea and Herri Arte Eskola in Errenteria, around the dance piece Hiru, based on Eduardo Chillida's work. It shows costume sketches by stage tailor Paloma de Alba.

cefff7027c4fe8b6034aa8654a9bb49b2095d5b1.en: San Sebastián Moda Festival runs from 19 to 24 October in six venues, including the Balenciaga Museum in Getaria, San Telmo and Tabakalera. On 22 October the Balenciaga Museum hosts shows by Mans and Eder Aurre.

b7bc83e6d7bdf6398066d5bd2c3d74d47f6e2c1e.en: ¿Y además dibujan? at the Centro Cultural Aiete shows drawings by children who had to flee Spain, 90 years after the start of the Civil War. The exhibition reveals a wounded country's memory.

0087d1734475dbd39abc417affbdbae75db59050.en: PUAJ 2026, the 45th Pasaia humour theatre festival, runs from 16 to 25 October. Six shows at 19:00 take place in Trintxerpe, San Pedro, Donibane and Antxo, mixing indoor performances and street theatre.

36b1455017531de25cff1146db15404614ce264e.en: Cuerpos geométricos at Chillida Leku traces Eduardo Chillida's career, from early plaster works to architectural projects. Two artists, Nora Aurrekoetxea and Larry Bell, add works as interventions.

1018e9f855093e5695faacf489e974d7d69bce38.en: El océano en imágenes, by the CIMASUB festival, shows ocean photographs by leading photographers from many countries. Winners include Joan Barcia Ubeda, Daniel Sly and Miguel Ramírez, and the images aim to raise awareness of protecting marine life.

efad41debdc7d21506d730eaa46ae455e15f0b0a.en: De cero a cinco mil metros de altura is an exhibition of 35 photographs by Juantxu Abasolo at the Okendo cultural centre. Twelve images come from the Artikutza forest, and 23 show landscapes from sea level to nearly 5,000 metres.

62795e70819737c06cb6f4d2bbefe9e612ef6752.en: Arte, sufrimiento y acogimiento at the Okendo cultural centre shares the experience of young people in care homes in Asturias and specialist foster care in Gipuzkoa. They explain how art helps them manage painful pasts and imagine a better future.

4d076293ad929394b009ee92512c0542ac52c022.en: The 2026 European Heritage Days in Gipuzkoa, under the title Gure eskuetan, offer more than 98 activities and 157 events in 36 towns. The programme focuses on cultural heritage at risk and on ways to protect and revive it.
