614dd287080565de3203f01802701aea8cd5018c.en: Fotografías que vuelven a la vida at the Museo San Telmo is an installation in which AI turns old photographs into videos. It reflects on memory, conservation and passing images on to future generations, as part of the Heritage Days.

f8d67239141c09d827e389b33109f232f01b6b22.en: 10 años de memoria histórica del mar brings together 20 exhibitions from 2016 to 2026, with panels, wreck remains and nautical charts. A documentary on the 1961 galerna and a talk on sea rescue are held on 22 and 23 October.

8b947819e9449ace38d0aecf24b7be45046cce7e.en: Isabel Coixet's collages, Kaosaren diziplina, at the Museo San Telmo show a less familiar side of the filmmaker. She builds compositions from photographs, clippings, texts and found objects in the Laboratorio room.

89599490d346365ebbf4687530cab87dddaa8238.en: Conflictivos Productions, part of the San Sebastián Fantastic and Horror Film Week, shows the stop-motion work of Sam Ortí at the Okendo cultural centre. Models, sets and puppets from Encarna and La valla are on display.

79ae6e2e6df4160fcabbe827f52543c758a1ef47.en: Catálogo de ausencias by José Ignacio Agorreta at the Bastero Kulturgunea reflects on the passage of time through traces left in the home. A literary talk on 27 October and a short performance on 5 November are linked to the exhibition.

ef13110863a8963885eb85e3e5beb5db5fa69078.en: Animedon 2026, the anime encounter of San Sebastián, runs from 26 October to 6 November as part of the Fantastic and Horror Film Week. It includes three premieres, a Shin chan tribute, a yokai exhibition and a live Basque podcast.

f91d6bb8f4ea1a91ce052b86b5aa7bb06d8a8975.en: Paisajes de San Sebastián by Tomás Hernández at the Ekain Arte Lanak gallery shows pen drawings of the city by the Donostia artist, who died in 2021. The drawings form a graphic diary across his life, and the show runs until 7 November.

a017dda2b99aa59af64731c4d42579afea780d26.en: BIDAIDEAK at LaCENTRAL Art Gallery brings together sculpture and prints by Ricardo Ugarte and Julia Otxoa, marking 48 years of their work. The opening is on 8 October at 18:30, and the show runs until 7 November.

76d7d8ab7af4f9d45604c777c39aa154577595d3.en: Kanthoria eta autotunea, at the Centro Cultural Ernest Lluch, marks the tenth anniversary of EHMBE. It traces Basque music from the 17th century to today, with guided visits in Basque and an acoustic concert at the opening.

68a442954f0fd66cf0235bf3e4af5d3946d2eb54.en: Aitzinera at the Sutegi Aretoa asks why Basques have answered five centuries of pressure through uprisings, both open battles and quiet struggles. The event is held in Basque.

01881267057da1b6ae453e971fa93e4deb8e5780.en: Itsasoa eta euskal kantua is the fifth edition of a choral meeting by Eresmin Abesbatza, with choirs in Donostia churches. It runs from 3 October to 14 November, and the closing concert takes place on 14 November.

fe67f3b19fac98fae446047c9fe79f8ec7d3a19b.en: Repensar nuestro museo at the Museo San Telmo is an art lab by Entretejidas-Sareginak with Zehar-Errefuxiatuekin. Through visits, dialogue and workshops, participants reflect on how a museum serves culture rights. It is free and needs no art experience.

3f93061df88b4dc348c6f62eac5d74bf5c9d3046.en: Debt, an exhibition by Nooshin Askari at the Galería Cibrián, shows work by the Tehran-born artist who lives in Berlin. She graduated from the Städelschule and took part in the Whitney Museum's Independent Study Program.

71d0960c5b875416a13815f7b6c7ba172692d0b7.en: U.Lab 2026 is a leadership programme based on Theory U from MIT's Presencing Institute. It runs from 8 October to 26 November, with Thursday sessions from 17:00 to 19:00 at Medialab Tabakalera, and is free thanks to the Gipuzkoa council.

c9e54e477cfe5e08fa9e437ed486ea7088e4e86b.en: Homenaje a las víctimas del franquismo by Héctor García, at the Centro Cultural Loiola, marks 50 years since the last executions of the Franco era. The exhibition shows posters, leaflets and books from the 1970s and 1980s.

818dc57cb6952f8a1708a9846ba8dd357c7c1429.en: Emakume zientzialarien argitan, an autumn talk series by Elhuyar and Donostia Kultura in Basque at the Centro Cultural Ernest Lluch. Three women scientists explain what drives their research and which obstacles they face.

cafa30aed0c211b92a5befd0b20ea9be67c05fd4.en: Zeu irakurle, ni kontalari at Lekuona Fabrika is a Basque storytelling group for children aged 6 to 8. Riddles, poems, games and stories are adapted to each reader's level, on Tuesdays from October to December, with enrolment from 7 to 20 September.

a21ef21176ba586099bf8a22ef0be380f474bbb6.en: Walker at Tabakalera is an installation of three video pieces and prints by Tsai Ming-Liang, starring Lee Kang-sheng as a slowly walking monk-like figure. The series now has twelve works shot in ten cities, including San Sebastián.

f1d72a9413b15c9321c47dd86ea0058fff54a880.en: Rincón de la Ilustración at the Centro Cultural Aiete shows the work of illustrator Oihana Egaña, born in San Sebastián in 1973. The display is part of a series that features one illustrator every three months.

30b16a64f0434d4810858005523a9b32ddf8458a.en: Aztarnak 2026 is a cycle of ten film sessions at the Elías Querejeta Zine Eskola, organised by students of its eighth curatorship class. Starting on 15 February, the films explore futures through traces and signals, with free entry until full.

aef5e73828a6a8b3bcb35fb75b35f2e4d35c0d31.en: Maíz local is a photo exhibition at the Cristina Enea centre, part of Asteklima 2026, from 24 September to 21 December. It shows the work of a 2025 survey that identified 27 local maize varieties and their risk of disappearing.

f541ae9eb70c3aaab31cc1ed7c9dcf2d0f1cf6ed.en: Rivage is the first solo show of Alex Bloc at Sakana Gallery, running from 2 October to 28 December 2026. Its 25 works, inspired by the coast between Biarritz and San Sebastián, use lines, reliefs and optical effects, and entry is free.

bea217d1057c3a71c1dff0d216e268ba4b0f835a.en: The Nosferatu 2026 cycle on Billy Wilder begins at Tabakalera on 14 January with Sunset Boulevard. Organised with the Filmoteca Vasca, it runs until December and traces his work as writer and director, from Germany to Hollywood.

eda507bbc3ec9ae9df8f8e7d7a508d02545d9adb.en: Donostia en las postales de Galarza shows postcard photographs from the Galarza collection, which was published from 1905 into the 1970s. Each period of the year focuses on a different neighbourhood of San Sebastián, at the Centro Cultural Ernest Lluch.

80cafbe2cafa285919d0982261b3d362629b3025.en: The 10th Donostia Kultura poetry contest, run with the publisher Balea Zuria, is open to authors under 35 writing in Basque. Entries of 600 to 1,000 lines are due by 31 December 2026, and the winner receives 1,000 euros and publication.

8da04ee87b6a0a07c026c24f308bd9ee8330ba89.en: Noúmeno by Nori Ushijima presents 32 works from four decades, mixing fresco and encaustic. The Basque-Japanese artist's paintings explore the boundary between the visible and the invisible.

d61a53ddda44bff4d18f8fe9b30ec031f9883743.en: KOOPERATIBA at Tabakalera brings together Carla Filipe and Taxio Ardanaz, who work on projects that never happened or were corrupted. A shared archive in the entrance hall moves from documents to works and links past collective experiences to today.

e5ef172b0770674906a5a607c2755e48e14ab2e6.en: Atlas emocional del Urumea at the Cristina Enea centre gathers personal stories from people who live near the river Urumea. Ten thematic tributaries organise the material into an artistic exhibition about reconnecting with the river.

c4e787e3de772b6fc91238587bdb1cf5720bb574.en: 100 años. Lo moderno y/o lo contemporáneo at the Museo San Telmo renews the Basque art room, curated by Peio Aguirre. It covers the period from the 1920s to today and will be the first of exhibitions held every two years.

0b288fd3841f75d66e96561306c581239d3ff58c.en: Cuentacuentos: Storytelling for kids at Lekuona Fabrika is an interactive English storytelling session for children aged 6 to 8. It mixes a traditional tale with a choose-your-own-adventure format, held on Thursdays with registration required.

ac988160cb6b8bbf1465fac25cfb958c8d3e88cd.en: Museo Bikoitza, "Baltzune + P-003687", at the Museo San Telmo features artists Usue Arrieta and Ainara Elgoibar of the Tractora cooperative. They explore the museum's history through the sculpture The Founders and a set of 1917 letters, using sound.

fb35a4e60a7b47fcdf7d16392837767d0b5e6eb8.en: The Museum Cemento Rezola takes part in the European Heritage Days with a guided tour of brutalist architecture in Donostialdea, led by architect Olatz Ocerín. A free visit to the museum and factory, in Basque and Spanish, takes place on 14 November at 10:30.

aa308f7d647f3d8dbe97b0fb04636947d0859414.en: The Centro del Traje's third permanent exhibition, in the Jantziaren Zentroa in the Basque Costume Museum, shows 40 original costumes across two rooms. Mourning dress, a 1900 déshabillé and a 1920 swimsuit are among the pieces, and the display changes yearly.

9d98fd2da9e7773d12d091af8270e8107d64378d.en: Sagardoetxea, the Basque cider museum, combines an interactive exhibition with an open-air orchard of Basque apple varieties. Visitors can taste cider and learn about the txotx ritual.

a70cf0ceb5b46a3fd3b2839cf61363c0c1e08d03.en: Soinuenea, the Basque popular music centre, holds a permanent exhibition of more than 400 instruments from the Basque Country and other continents. Visitors can listen to them through an audio system, arranged by instrument family.

2e0a6307128705798ec8756cfe875d8df3875960.en: The permanent exhibition of the Museo San Telmo follows how individuals and society have shaped Basque culture over time. Multimedia displays and audiovisual pieces by Basque creators offer keys to interpreting the past.

3072e7dd8c17704dbfc99905f62b528df55c4406.en: The permanent exhibition of the Museum Cemento Rezola explains what cement is, its role in society and its future. Prototypes show new uses of cement, and the story of the family firm and the Añorga industrial colony is told by local workers.

5bec97ef454e0543753b72468e6a7da2c418755e.en: Chillida Leku is a museum where Eduardo Chillida's steel and granite sculptures stand among beech, oak and magnolia trees. Group guided visits for up to 20 people cost 120 euros, and families with children can take part in Sunday activities.

ecf5c9ffba1946d362b5bce732e34bde83b78daa.en: Albaola La Factoría Marítima Vasca in Pasaia builds historic boats and teaches traditional maritime skills. Free visits and guided tours for groups show shipbuilding, navigation and the Basque maritime heritage.

c20881cc71a9c050a1d5f6363064248fb0b2f8e8.en: MATER is the last large wooden Basque tuna boat, now an eco-active museum ship based in Pasaia. The non-profit association ITSAS GELA runs guided visits to encourage care for the sea and the environment.

20c4259ba1fa25d6095cf82e64c680a028e9b15e.en: The Luberri geology museum displays hundreds of fossils and minerals from the Basque Country. A geologist explains the region's geological past, and workshops and field trips are offered for children and young people.

0930608d0c35d87bbe1f67aa93a0e8b81499ac27.en: Superthings: Filma is a film screened at the Cines Antiguo Berri. Three sixth-graders find a portal that merges their grey city with a world of living everyday objects turned into superheroes and villains.

d0a58b6b261370e7c823309a1dd1767f378ce29d.en: Das kleine Gespenst, a German children's film directed by Alain Gsponer, is screened at the Centro Cultural Aiete. A small ghost who lives in an old castle gets lost in the city after the sunlight turns him dark, and only his young friends can help him.

509ca2230aaed35c500f68336089abc549a990e8.en: Otsoko eta Xixili, a musical storytelling session by Maren Basterretxea, is held for International Library Day. It is organised by the Errenteria council with Lanku Bertso Zerbitzuak, and the event is in Basque.

588b1b149d590bb1a1ca9990676bcdbe6d555f76.en: Itsasoa is a musical puppet show by Firulete Antzerkia at the Centro Cultural Loiola, for ages 3 and over. A girl refuses to leave home when her parents decide to cross the sea, and she meets eccentric characters who teach her about fear.

9c21014c4ff249bff45e5fe01874732647b11198.en: Eraldaketarako kontuak is a storytelling show for ages 6 to 10 at the Centro Cultural Erribera, part of Asteklima 2026. It encourages reflection on the imbalance that humans create in nature and the climate.

5953aea12c7df290ae0fb7878697e543de694159.en: Euforia, a new creation by Cielo rasO, founded by choreographer Igor Calonge, is a dance piece at Biteri Kultur Etxea. Performers change the scene with objects and humour, exploring freedom, beauty, time and love.

166a7243f648340dac6f94397fb75fe2069713ff.en: Loratzen is a show of theatre, music and circus within PUAJ 2026, the Pasaia humour theatre festival. The story follows dreams, shared journeys and humour, written and created by Izaskun Rueda.

da3eb8e0a0a0aca1f2f68256861aabab119e25e9.en: Gure kontuk, from the amateur group TXALO TALO, is performed at the Centro de Artes Escénicas Sarobe with free entry until full. The new show's script never arrives, leaving only a mysterious message in a box.

2220bea67f2e58b9176745298edc948cf05a51b2.en: La bola negra, a Spanish film by Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi, interweaves three men across three eras. It draws on an unfinished late work by Federico García Lorca, and is screened by Okendo Zinema Taldea.

42fc5518bc6bc28499d517b61851b013280c4bc9.en: A book presentation at the KMK hall on La memoria en las pantallas, which studies how film and television shaped memory of ETA terrorism. It moves from early works to recent stories about victims and reconciliation, with three speakers.

a00d04bab045c9a3cb4dfdb61524762ade85d124.en: The Frédéric Chopin cycle 2026 at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia and Teatro Principal runs from October 2026 to June 2027, with ten concerts. Pianists including Miguel Ituarte open it on 7 October, and Donostia Kultura members get a presale.

19e35dd88e00863fc0207c3fe0a8039e839e421a.en: A retrospective on the architect Martín Domínguez at the Instituto de Arquitectura de Euskadi, in its new Tabakalera home, opens on 6 October 2026 with prior registration. Domínguez left Franco's Spain and later Cuba, and the show runs until 4 April 2027.

ae774b9595638960920d6cbcc88f954191a3adf1.en: Sananda Maitreya, who debuted as Terence Trent D'Arby, plays the Teatro Principal in San Sebastián on 23 October. The two-hour show, with a 15-minute break, mixes hits such as Sign Your Name and Wishing Well with recent songs.

7f70f3bd6ab621a1dcc23a0d94789a31db7c838c.en: Qué le pasa doctor is a comedy show by actor Alex Salaberri at the Sala Imanol Larzabal in Lugaritz. It offers laughter as a remedy, poking fun at small human miseries and finding reasons to hope for a better future.

ac2e5c2d2ea9069fcf13584847fe27f9a8c81bb9.en: Two pieces in the Iturritik Jaialdia 2026 dance festival, in the club room of the Teatro Victoria Eugenia. Street Pole Dance by Japanese artist Meriko and Otros Aires by Argentine company Duo Laos mix pole dance, acrobatic tango and comedy.

c1a33d9fa07bc1e3533e25d046504096586f79b3.en: Azala and Kea are two dance pieces at the Bastero Kulturgunea that explore collective memory through the body. Azala reflects on the cycles we repeat, and Kea recalls the lives of women workers in the Basque industry.

d45012e3c36f9aa89001809e8b32b342663bbd3e.en: Eskailerapekoa is the fourth solo show of comedians Idoia Torregarai and Mirari Martiarena, performed in Basque at Landetxe. It tells of hidden themes, experiences and crises with fine humour.

2350e660bc1f046d897be5a4f6cb3d87a006e091.en: El Pony Pisador, a Catalan folk band, plays the Kutxa Fundazioa Kluba as part of Bizi ala Iraun 2026. Its eclectic mix includes Catalan dances, Celtic and Mediterranean tunes, yodel, Tuvan throat singing and Balkan rhythms.

4bcc407fcde91ffcf106eb07989a668e8c1f2b4f.en: Ronnie Lynn Patterson plays the Altxerri Jazz Club. The self-taught pianist from Kansas has lived in Paris for over thirty years, has played with Aldo Romano, Billy Hart and Archie Shepp, and has recorded Morton Feldman and Rachmaninov.

49d9e8f21b884bc277509fff2aaaab1db7974593.en: Arianna Puello, a Dominican-born rapper raised in Spain and a pioneer of Spanish women's hip-hop, performs with La Basu at Dabadaba. La Basu, born in Bilbao, is a leading figure in Basque-language rap and founded the all-women rap group Jungla Urbana.

6a06e699b0acf87757ad1c44bfbd492e8ee5adb9.en: Revólver brings the album LA 03010 to the Kursaal on 23 October. Carlos Goñi's record revisits the stories of his beginnings, and the concert also features his older hits.

d3c9ff235fa536a20035ee9cf3d1dcbc3b0c56e9.en: Iturritik Jaialdia, the fifth dance festival in San Sebastián, runs from 23 to 26 October with five indoor shows, two street shows and workshops. Artists from the Basque Country, Argentina, France and Japan take part, and tickets go on sale from 1 September.

d0d04c524c505cc57d818705a94bcf2c1a5c9873.en: Xabier Morrás at the Kutxa Fundazioa Kubo presents the Navarran artist's work, from his rural and urban landscapes to his use of photography, collage and screen printing. Two key installations are shown, and entry is free until 24 January 2027.

b255c0549984e67707905b5d3e9c469791dce9f9.en: CONTRA EL NEGACIONISMO, FEMINISMO is a day held on Saturday 24 October from 10:00 to 18:00 at the Gipuzkoa medical association. It covers the denial of gender-based violence in schools, support for victims and misogyny online.

496c37194a6ecf0c9cf99e7636b249e68a740a2d.en: A six-hour cosplay workshop at Tabakalera led by a professional cosplayer. Participants learn the basics of cosplay, from materials and costume to props, including book props from anime, horror and fantasy films.

2cc5781de69f325673f412eddb4a04d63da72623.en: Entrepensando is an open session where participants think together through books, films, songs and artworks. The next meeting is on 26 September, and reading materials are sent to people who sign up, though they are optional.

0b2bcc83b57284ded95b3427438d6576043bd5d4.en: Magia Potagia is a children's magic show by the magician Marsel as part of Amara Berri Eguna. He uses cards and coins for comic situations and acts like one of the children, for ages 3 and over.

4d6f7823fbff6960dfd76d4bc1c0d45bab73c067.en: A chamber concert by Euskadiko Orkestra in its Matinées de Miramon series, the 35th season. The programme includes works by Turina and García Leoz, and the series has 16 Saturday concerts this season.

a125a773b159ae7765a1bfb0d86f6b0d369a6900.en: Liburu Baby Kluba is a playful book-based session for children aged 0 to 3, held with an adult at the Lasarte-Oria library. It aims to spark interest in literature, music, art and nature, and is run by the Mestiza association.

88a299ba5822571330ccaf6bf80d3895a78d1377.en: A guided visit in Basque to the restoration of the Salvador church, with an organ demonstration. It is part of the European Heritage Days.

03b7d37bbe0aac13dc72fff8d7dbce835045b764.en: A 30-minute micro-concert by violin student Sergio Muñoz of Musikene at the Biblioteca Municipal Central of San Sebastián, as part of Libraries Day 2026.

cee50520f2da79856824c21736eaaa3b88f11bc0.en: Clarinettist Michael Tag plays in the Okendo library in the Gros neighbourhood, to mark Libraries Day 2026.

19a7724411c6b47ec9b3331f73913d78a9459ccd.en: The Karmenzinak 2026 festivities in Trintxerpe take place on 24 October, and the full programme is published separately.

9269a0b12aa639e37c44427704b79d14f177d4e8.en: A bertso lunch, an event of improvised Basque verse, with the bertsolariak Peru Aiartza and Andoitz Urdapilleta Gurrutxaga.

5c45016e32021754907df8bad5c027ecd3957f56.en: The Urnieta Rol Days at Lekaio Kultur Etxea bring roleplaying games and board games, organised by the association Habitantes de Innsmouth.

70ca1914df552d0077f8f4173a79db2b4d17adef.en: Turbo, a children's film directed by David Soren, is screened at the Centro Cultural Aiete. A garden snail dreams of becoming the fastest snail in the world and joins a gang of street snails.

34849d6606a35ca07742d1cf600c47211bbd5506.en: A K-pop dance workshop for teenagers and young people at the Ispilua space in Tabakalera on 24 October from 17:00 to 19:00. It has two age groups, 12 to 15 and 16 to 25, and is taught by the group Averix. Entry is free with registration.

c8b779c0f0122fa3b51b1c943e9b5532107f126f.en: BASATIA NAIZ, a multidisciplinary show at the Kursaal, combines music by Bartók, Debussy, Ligeti, Delage and López-Montes with puppets, shadows and projections. It is about freedom, innocence and the bond between humans and animals.

9b78db9c3acb7eb3622adb2d1d0fa770aea439b4.en: Iparratik, a street show by the dance group Gero Axular, is performed at the Plaza Okendo as part of Iturritik Jaialdia. Dance and music connect tradition and the present, and the company has given more than 380 performances.

dfc1d63de5216be3e5a50f569331977b49b2ebc1.en: Sagutxo tuntuna is a musical story for children, in Basque, at Lekuona Fabrika. Based on a Shostakovich score, a mouse mother sings to a child who will not sleep, and the free show is performed by Andra Mari Abesbatza.

060cd857073a2707be0ed731f89b8eed99d1da25.en: The Wanterheim String Quartet plays chamber music. Its four members are 17-year-old players trained at Music Mundi in Waterloo, and the programme includes Mendelssohn's String Quartet No. 2 and Shostakovich's String Quartet No. 9.

15f790d7e5215b773a15a6abeea3481710c9542f.en: Kutixik Jaialdia 2026 at the Centro Cultural Intxaurrondo features local artists Gartxot, Xabier Badiola, Harat and Ithaka. The festival, organised by the collective Balio Dute, aims to showcase local talent.

e6230401647f927b2af2317a73c51c6d2258d620.en: Espíritu sagrado, Chema García Ibarra's 2021 fantasy film about a UFO association and a missing girl, is shown at Tabakalera. The musician Betacam plays his score live over the screening.

e2a8c63f2d5672c261aa0d30086404245039d701.en: Rigor Mortis, a family comedy by Dorleta Urretabizkaia, is performed at the Juanba Berasategi Aretoa for PUAJ 2026. A woman, her daughter, niece and a neighbour gather around a dead man and start revealing family secrets.

d92a195b4876b2fc0901e028fb422a45e18c2529.en: The final of the small-format performing arts contest is held at the Centro de Artes Escénicas Sarobe. Theatre, dance and performance by emerging creators compete to show new scenic languages.

e3d1a282bcfb80734f3c1a3159a6b3225e5a4b1c.en: Zinema Paradise is a musical journey through film history at the Casa de Cultura Manuel Lekuona. Singers Iván Azkarate and Lide Hernando perform the most famous film songs of the last 100 years, with the stories behind them.

3c15ba9ffbc3cdf517adbe77b40e6662f7de3a32.en: Aitatxo is a documentary that shows the grief of a father who has lost a child. Through four fathers' testimonies it looks at their suffering and their right to mourn, and a talk with the film's promoter follows.

b13f5a8ce7454e2f9ef97c9cf8e0a9efd8489878.en: The second concert of the AHOBER cycle at the Centro Cultural Erribera features the choirs B-Tenors and Eragiyok.

33b808d4d783fe740f712c83490baba22350c580.en: No hay ladrón que por bien no venga is a comedy by Dario Fo, performed by the Pasaia theatre group Trebera at the Centro Cultural Niessen. A thief breaks into a house, only to meet the owner and his lover.

1ef242f489260d608f28a31bcf1c6c309a5c6f17.en: Mutar. Romper. Vibrar, by Dácil González and Carmen Fumero, is a dance piece at Gazteszena about constant change. Three performers explore how our perception and the brain adapt, with live music by Elisa Tejedor.

b35756bcd293c5bf309f35bbecda912f34ef5e2d.en: Frankopoleon, by KulturArteCo, is a play set in 2070 in a dual state, part of the Geuretik sortuak project by Udalbiltza. It asks what makes people Basque, and which Basque language they speak, at the Sala Imanol Larzabal.

37c241b1afae6a122ba199f34ffabc61411e17a4.en: A family art workshop on 24 October that visits the Walker exhibition and continues with hands-on exercises. At least two families must take part, and every participant must register.

002d8c1032ac4d2734fe8d560d4dcd7aabdf88c1.en: Metal Norte, in its 17th edition at the Centro Cultural Larratxo, features El Reno Renardo, Sphinx and Jolly Joker. The bands mix humour, classic Spanish-language heavy metal and glam, and several celebrate 20 or 30 years with new recordings and tours.

9432bc5e8d492405e400c286dbe72ed09f43fb16.en: The Zarautz Abesbatza choir gives a concert on Saturday 24 October at 20:00 at the San Ignacio church in Gros, as part of Eresmin's choir cycle. The programme includes songs by Basque composers, with Jaione Eskudero conducting.

2e7c1c68e165f425984d4f5e7a5b3a4a2d22b398.en: Almere, a jazz quartet formed by Musikene students, plays arrangements of classic standards alongside its own songs and versions of Silvio Rodríguez. The members are Izan Quintela, Abel Cabello, Antonio López and Maren Seijo.

08b759363354c40325995373fb7d017da397e3d6.en: Mykki Blanco and World Brain perform at Dabadaba on 24 October.

f850283bf8c0b5435cd763b80b0a94ae187d2c59.en: OBK celebrates 35 years with its Vértigo Tour, which stops at the Kursaal on 24 October. The Spanish electronic group presents songs from its new album, along with older hits such as Maldita Mujer.

4f8161d6eb207c5248bfde51fa8d0262eba5fedc.en: Losado and Lepora play the Andoaingo Gaztetxea in Andoain on 24 October.

1d1a96ce5a717f09d35c160e621289e94ee66080.en: The fifth Itsasoa eta euskal kantua meeting of choirs in Donostia churches includes a concert on 24 October at the San Ignacio church. Eresmin Abesbatza sings with the Zarautz Abesbatza, and the closing concert is on 14 November.

79e0ed7f3b53f4415c4a4fa2afbc8a71014d9b39.en: The Itsasoa eta euskal kantua meeting closes on 14 November at the Carmelite church with the Coral de Barañain from Navarre. It is the last concert in the choir series organised by Eresmin Abesbatza.

751584c78ebc871f81aafb00f2462a4ffba9d9fb.en: Soul Project brings a street show to the Plaza Okendo as part of Iturritik Jaialdia. Acrobatics, exaggerated dance and humour make up an intergenerational show by six performers.

ea3485e58eb04fd4bf58ab8c09aa13d3efa95617.en: Superthings: Filma is also screened at the Cines Niessen in Errenteria. Three sixth-graders find a portal between their grey city and a world where everyday objects become superheroes and villains.

5380791b76105a62efb4a8e35f0b01240d594a67.en: Arte y paleontología at the Museo San Telmo is dedicated to the career of Bilbao paleoartist Mauricio Antón. Guided visits in Spanish and Basque start on 31 October, with bookings open from 23 October.

9055d59f7897dbf57efaad4bd4973b3e481e279f.en: The Errenteria municipal txistu band plays a concert in the Xabier Olaskoaga square.

1f2d96035b22aaa140497877b8322b440415634c.en: The San Sebastián municipal txistu band plays traditional Basque drummers' music in the Plaza de la Constitución, with dance tunes, songs and street marches. The band plays a reveille earlier that morning at 9:00.

7ecb3aadc71eead799c6bb053723a36edb9b67d0.en: Txepeldunak is a children's Basque bertso theatre show by Uxue Alkorta and Maren Basterretxea, organised by the Astigarraga council. A boy who loses a game learns that other play matters more than winning.

de2b7e72098bafa310d02337dca50f5f5533d461.en: Xaboi saltzailea by Teatros Mágicos is a magic show for all audiences. A young soap seller in a 16th-century French forest discovers his craft and creates soap bubbles with music and light.

b3c8490c54c9340c19313efcbdd76642a1c65b37.en: Sara Zozaya and Ke Lepo give a double concert at the Teatro Principal. Zozaya presents her EP attä, with minimal electronic and bedroom pop, and Alejo Orbegozo presents his second solo album, after Izpi.

3ea0245d71a4ca8b0518ee1dd3777c889cfae599.en: Arkaitz Añorgako Dantzariak celebrates its centenary at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia, as part of Iturritik Jaialdia. The group presents a Sagar-dantza, an apple dance based on melodies collected in Baztán, and dances from Lapurdi and Zuberoa.

f3fd533ecfb9429fcf043963e1c0bad56fc2db43.en: La estrategia del caracol by Sergio Cabrera is a 1993 Colombian film, screened at Tabakalera for Libraries Day. Tenants resist eviction through clever strategies that turn each of them into a surprising version of themselves.

34ff7b491f4b9bdfaac900914f2bda51fc8111a4.en: Tierra at the Centro de Artes Escénicas Sarobe is a two-act play in which a woman wakes up underground. A grotesque view of what we are reveals hidden desires, staged by Anabasa Kultur Elkartea.

b56fc0f4ffc444947ff013f2cb8f0a5f6247ebc8.en: Desobedienteak 18/98 at the Gezala Auditorium follows a young political scientist defending her thesis on civil disobedience. It also recounts the 18/98 judicial case, which followed activists linked to social movements.

63ede0060daad8a5954e11d44f731fc5bc94c0d3.en: A night of blues with Alvaro Gaviria and Paul San Martin at the Altxerri Jazz Club.

ec3943eed10a559d2b1e8beeecd748fc76208730.en: Plaka, a trio from Barcelos, plays at Dabadaba with psych-funk, afrobeat and psychedelia. The music sounds like loose improvisation, built from jams, studio work and rhythms from around the world.

dfd1b72191f55eda6050477e6e3814cbd998e268.en: La mujer del camarote 10 is screened at the Centro Cultural Casares-Tomasene. Based on Ruth Ware's novel, a journalist on a luxury yacht believes she has seen someone thrown overboard, but no one believes her.

450e45abcd06fae143e3c8b23313a3d294fce07e.en: A book presentation for Hegal egiten by Eneko Bidegain at the San Jerónimo central library. The novel revisits the 1986 escape of two Iparretarrak prisoners from the Pau prison, and follows Maddi Hegi and life inside.

8e9bc1ef66dae31505343715fcf30ae2b7b78e4d.en: The Quasar Quartet, a saxophone quartet, shares the Musikene programme with Trio Zukan. The trio plays txistu, accordion and percussion, mixing Basque traditions with new music.

64fe9c05a871e5d28434f9963b9f122fc605e121.en: A reading group at the Centro Cultural Erribera discusses a novel by Thomas Pynchon, A Oscuras. Participation is open to all.

9b2a58bcc47a17d10c3211591eafc5792538f030.en: Libraries Day 2026, Aprendiendo a enredarnos, is a professional day at Tabakalera on 27 October, organised by the San Sebastián library service. It includes a talk by Ferran Burguillos of the Barcelona library network and practical workshops on networks.

1b17b079639bd17a65a719bd05ace83233379fc1.en: A Basque reading club for children aged 3 to 5, with an adult, on Mondays. It mixes stories, songs and wordplay, led by the association Galtzagorri, and enrolment runs from 7 to 20 September.

a5d2b96c101f8641da9105da85e2d8fdbd383798.en: A film forum at the Sala Imanol Larzabal, screening Hans Steinbichler's Toda una vida as part of the +55 programme. A discussion follows the film.

4cd1e5eb70b96565f65a7c02ad56b4714d301595.en: Josu Ozaita gives a talk, Gau beltza ez da Halloween, at the San Pedro library in Pasaia.

75c60174ed5beb7893115745a392b788b786a922.en: Mari Carmen Basterretxea talks about Basque matrilineal culture at the Usurbil library, organised by Aitzinera. She describes a society in which women and men shared power, based on peace and cooperation.

0b69fa15d20d5ec74528e7d50b30bfb93febcb2a.en: Galerna: El horizonte infinito, Lucía Goñi's documentary about the great storm of 1961, is screened at the Casa de Cultura Xenpelar. The storm sank 21 boats and killed 83 sailors, and the film draws on survivors' testimonies.

c519cb2e0ed810c836c10f49571a8a98b2570da3.en: A book presentation of Bajamar by Ibon Martín, a new thriller after his Inspector Cestero series. Tourism, interests and secrets surface when the tide goes out, and a signing follows.

842dff743399726a6127608a170310d61b14d9ee.en: Piotr Anderszewski plays the Kursaal, travelling through Bach's Partita No. 1, Bartók's Bagatelles and late Brahms pieces. The programme moves from clear architecture to fragments and reflection.

6b518d3ef8a7df059c834346d3e1e726528c86bd.en: Rose of Nevada, a British film by Mark Jenkin, is about a boat that returns to a fishing village 30 years after it was lost at sea. Two new crew members find that the villagers treat them as the original crew.

d2535333950c2c4c019738198cb0eea0c3204631.en: Hiru, a dance piece by Kresala Dantza Taldea at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia, is part of Iturritik Jaialdia. Dance, music and poetry evoke Chillida's sculptures through sea, rock, wind and sky. Capacity is limited.

a7e6e028855a7742e67a87baad86a2555aedf036.en: A double session at the Teatro Principal, part of the San Sebastián Fantastic and Horror Film Week, screens The Matrix (1999) and REC (2007), a horror classic that started a genre.

60faed4fedcae4c81a76bbb55a94faf98f79b6aa.en: KAMELEOIAK GARA is a family cinema session at Tabakalera with three short films: a girl's first school day, a tiny fish in an underwater city, and a friendship between a bossy girl and a chameleon afraid of heights.

fdee60ec410bbd76103c9e13266f15987962ede6.en: PUAJ 2026 presents Ahora at the Juanba Berasategi Aretoa. Martina has waited a long time for this moment, but things do not go as planned, and the comedy asks whether it is time to change course.

4293d39a187e2b4b6194a5e2a37859466cfb9f02.en: Kresala Zinekluba screens Rose of Nevada at the Cines Trueba. A ship that vanished 30 years earlier reappears in a forgotten fishing village, and the crew who sail it find that they have travelled back in time.

e0461085cfbf2b0ddc2dedad875fd5c53339fe16.en: Comando Comas plays the jazz concert Chordless, with Pablo Comiskey on trumpet, Hugo Domínguez on alto sax, Juanfran Comas on double bass and Iván Álvarez on drums.

64b4707f97138a0dcb871185d8d5914f509d6197.en: Código Habana play a concert at the Altxerri Jazz Club in Donostia.

01e1f8e55e79c9f01ca032942ebe58f760b6a420.en: Manon, Kenneth MacMillan's ballet for The Royal Ballet, is screened at the Cines Niessen. Manon is torn between her love for the student Des Grieux and the wealth of Paris high society, to the music of Massenet. The film runs 165 minutes.

5c3e2e88d9c7d740ceeceb594511cf3c1ebf13e7.en: The German men's choir Ensemble Vocapella Limburg, of about twenty singers under Tristan Meiste, performs at the Loiola church on 27 October at 20:30 as part of the Choral Mass Week. The programme mixes romantic works with demanding contemporary pieces.

aa1a35b89c75f1cf3b9601534391ca58f82126f0.en: Feli Colina, an Argentine singer-songwriter, plays Dabadaba with a mix of folk, rock and traditional Latin American music. Her intimate, experimental sound blends roots and contemporary textures.

bad29d20361e8ee809ff70ff4bf7df45f6145b17.en: The Work We Live With: Regarding The Photobook offers twelve individual portfolio reviews by photographer Matthew Genitempo. Participants get professional feedback, and the session is linked to the STM-GCBC photobook collection.

50d6426d473493f44229275b9314cebf9abe0a1a.en: A guided visit for over-55s to the permanent exhibition at the Museo San Telmo. It explains how the Basque Country modernised in the 19th and 20th centuries, through society, clothing, industry, culture and leisure.

0ac7bfdaa5b3117fb7672ffe9c87eb63cbd5a7ac.en: The Choral Mass Week 2026 in Donostia brings five free concerts to churches in Ibaeta, Altza, Gros, Loiola and Amara. Choirs from Indonesia, Latvia, Germany and Italy take part, in connection with the Tolosa choral competition.

5cff4504609da6755d11f64188d3a1c61d768677.en: A literary discussion in Spanish at the Centro Cultural Okendo on Javier Cercas's novel El móvil. Ana Merino leads the conversation.

9f1746b2a30cf68b318d47fa614ea1d42747c2df.en: A guided dialogue visit in Basque to KOOPERATIBA at Tabakalera, with a mediator. Visitors look at the works of Carla Filipe and Taxio Ardanaz, and sessions run through the summer and autumn.

e7592c74c50253f92bfe6aca557c5c03b2e76d19.en: Atlas_Bucles en papel at Tabakalera is a paper workshop mixing drawing, animation and origami. Participants create a looping animation with repeated actions, and no experience in animation or illustration is needed.

35ce42d57c11a967ba1c5dfb67012885947be1aa.en: Ameli eta Xirrikituren jostunak, a Basque-language session for the whole family at the Usurbil library, led by Amaia Elizagoien and Irati Celestino.

c49106f6357e6feadea9daca17be2eb902203a2a.en: A literary discussion in Lezo library, led by Ane Mayoz, on Mikel Ayllon's novel Zoriontsuak izatea aukeratu genuen. Participation is open to readers.

548d4f965085888b8a4304e3f316248c97d4cf9c.en: The reading club discusses Montserrat Roig's Gerezi Denbora, set in Barcelona in spring 1974. Natàlia returns after years abroad and uncovers her family's past. The Basque edition appeared in 2024.

b0a1affc8d78364b3892f16fb7ef784d20424e5f.en: A book presentation at the Elkar bookshop of Orden desordenado by Asier Olaizola, the final novel of the Un instante trilogy. Artificial intelligence, identity, grief and climate change run through the story, presented by Lide Aguirre.

9d8118d4de5f90209bbf8b143fb6fb40d3dc56f1.en: Bésame, tonto, Billy Wilder's 1964 comedy, is screened at Tabakalera as part of the Nosferatu 2026 cycle. Dean Martin plays a famous singer whose car brings him to a small town, where two local men dream of a music career.

dd185a3e4fa1cfac331f016b0562da5112279590.en: A literary discussion of Mohammed El-Kurd's Rifqa at the Centro Cultural Egia, led by Edu Zabala. The translator Eider Beobide attends the session.

295982f3b88d83686ada6bfb2905c996bb246c54.en: A literary discussion of Percival Everett's James at the Biteri Kultur Etxea. It retells Huckleberry Finn from the point of view of Jim, an enslaved man who learns to read and decides to escape. Slawka Grabowska leads the discussion.

e4d762b5eed3148503e2a126758ef490d2633c8d.en: Linger at the Museo San Telmo sees Matthew Genitempo trace his path from early photography to making books and founding the Trespasser imprint. He talks about how the past remains present in his work, in line with the STM-GCBC photobook collection.

ff608d54262b5c9e38f1543d897c193a184a7ab0.en: Rob Mazurek and Chad Taylor perform as the Chicago Underground Duo. The New York Times ranked their album Hyperglyph as the eighth best jazz album of 2025, with trumpet, drums, electronics and kalimba.

7f3b481d80a55d10a99e990bbad534db7a9cca00.en: The Latvian Mixed Choir Juventus, conducted by Valdis Tomsons, performs as part of the Choral Mass Week. Founded in 1920, it is the oldest university choir in Latvia.

f69972dc7ec83318e346263b09222c552888d3c9.en: A book presentation of Kaiolan by the writer Arrate Peña at the Biblioteca Municipal Central de San Sebastián.

df105b391e759c780d00531a35d400c6826c11b0.en: A film forum for older people in Usurbil, where the title of the Basque film is announced on the day of the screening.

e26039ab6eb9e25f3ea9eb4f1fcf087df6a39b42.en: Arte makina. KOOPERATIBA at Tabakalera is a course in which a guest leads each monthly session on the contemporary art exhibition. The aim is to build a shared toolbox, with sessions on 29 October and 26 November.

7d946ddf44c5fa90d9a5cc5c7b38c70159825e2b.en: Memories of Murder, Bong Joon-ho's film, is screened at Biteri Kultur Etxea as part of the Hernani film club. In South Korea in 1986, a special team hunts for a serial killer of young women, led by a local detective and a Seoul detective.

3358c2a8e21407df23e8da62a39a584658deb535.en: Kimua Abesbatza performs as part of Musiklasik 2026 at the Centro Cultural Aiete. The chamber choir was formed in September 2025 within the Coro Ametsa society in Irun, under Leticia Vergara with pianist Amaia Zipitria.

f9973f78468f3d2e7243fb135a5604dd69dba697.en: Todo documento de civilización, a 2024 Argentine documentary by Tatiana Mazú González, is screened at Tabakalera with a talk by the director. It follows a crossing on the edge of Buenos Aires, and a mother who lost her son to police.

3689dd34cc6d373ee099cab23bf7cae7146fdab1.en: The Trio Magadis concert at Musikene, part of the Musikagileak 2026-2027 cycle, is played by three harpists. They perform new works by Zuriñe F. Gerenabarrena, Nuria Giménez-Comas, Gabriel Erkoreka and Hélène Breschanden.

bacdb45ba8bda537830ce6a3b52d4d9048b02a5c.en: A talk at the Museo San Telmo on the state of the international humanitarian system, almost three years after the escalation that began in October 2023. It looks at Gaza and the West Bank, and the talk is streamed online.

fd84bb1fbca285af44243ba0b33126478717afde.en: A pesar de todo, part of the OFNI theatre cycle at the Kutxa Fundazioa Kluba, is a comic piece with philosophical touches. Two performers, Txubio Fernández de Jauregui and Esperanza López, reflect on forgiveness, ageing and the future.

49b7e6cd9eb35f5654f6a8e55199bbb49f738e34.en: Samantha Hudson performs at the Centro Cultural Intxaurrondo in an intimate format, a non-stop set that mixes hits with songs from her albums. It is a blend of concert and DJ set, and she is the face of the horror week poster.

8b1897613f0385250fc033ac29343a10e44f3749.en: The Indonesian Vox Angelica Choir, founded in 2002 in Manado, performs as part of the Choral Mass Week. The choir has won prizes at several international festivals.

84f5d62c116b368836a4c967986f6c69c487e588.en: The Italian choir Musicanova, conducted by Fabrizio Barchi, performs as part of the Choral Mass Week. Its repertoire ranges from medieval to pop, with a focus on Renaissance and contemporary music.

16c8bc52059c7e3c23ae110092ad60a92c3ad542.en: Despertando la historia de Donostia, a walking tour led by volunteer Luisa Martín Terán on the last Friday of each month. The route explores the city's cultural heritage, and registration is by email from 1 October.

5a838147e5a9ffc259b8e817adeb5955a83e7091.en: Irakurketa Kluba: Komikiekin mintzoan kux-kux is a reading club for children aged 8 to 12 at the central library's children's section. Lur Korta leads them into the world of comics, and advance registration is required by email.

c112632bc2e15c6656b3f27e6c18da48aae3b253.en: Xabier Erkizia gives a talk on Jorge Oteiza's Montevideo memories of 1961 at the Sala Salatxo. Erkizia is a musician and journalist.

e6c688f5d33131ae12397d67f508c5d7c160f478.en: Booktegi Jaialdia 2026 features a concert and conversation with Ruper Ordorika at the Sutegi Aretoa. Moderators Itxaro Borda and Aritz Branton take questions from Booktegi members, and guests should arrive before 18:45.

9f6e5046faa82a697cae9849362e100fc716595e.en: Ander eta Yul, directed by Ana Díez, follows Ander, who leaves prison and returns to his family home with nothing. He reconnects with Yul, his best friend, and both face a fate they cannot avoid. The film is screened at Tabakalera.

40ae988e68e8f2f0be72309e947ac7990842ca42.en: At the Centro Cultural Ernest Lluch, the HI Hiriko idazleak 2026 event presents the revised second edition of Finalmente soy yo: mi noche oscura del alma by its author, Gemma Díez Rodríguez.

0eacf9d4d4079a619dc26e709921fbcb69181e6c.en: A book presentation of Sergio Pereira's Las hijas de Amari at the Centro Cultural Egia. The novel is set when the Basque lands are under Roman rule, and friendships are torn apart as rivalries between leaders grow.

bf96377d9c9ca6cce7abf7cee5ec41029d5dc910.en: Manttalingo Alaba at the Casa de Cultura Manuel Lekuona is a recital based on Mikel Etxaburu's poems. It remembers the women who drowned in the Saturraran prison, where more than 4,000 women were held, with singing, accordion and violin.

41a16a0f102decb71b8715eabca83f3f966b1aff.en: A presentation of Otras voces de mujeres, a continuation of the project Voces de mujeres. The book explores poetry born from pain and loss by writers including Isak Dinesen, María Zambrano, Clarice Lispector and Sylvia Plath.

09d7e05edfbce5bf0801f08ee5506c1c0d5156bf.en: ACT 3: LOVE Acts of Liberation is an artistic action and social experiment about new ways of relating. It asks whether you would kiss a stranger, hug one, or hold a real gaze in the street.

1132f3bc62c6be92bb95892cb6a1e9df87aa35cb.en: 3 en impro, by Impro Impar, returns to the Sala Imanol Larzabal in Lugaritz. Seven improvised theatre scenes are accompanied by live music.

6acc01198b7b12466777628aaccf0963e7fed47a.en: Bastero-café with the band Karena, whose name means the thread that binds them. Voice, drums, electric guitar, accordion and piano bring new sounds to the stage.

1ebb63dc521dc7b5f0d4ad0b26b9d30d9b8a82ee.en: An opening concert of the school year by several groups from the Norberto Almandoz music school, at the Centro Cultural Erribera.

434f026b5abf525b7d8cfdd0848bde1f4acfa9be.en: The Orfeón Donostiarra's concert for its friends at the Kursaal features Prokofiev's Ivan the Terrible. It is conducted by Sainz Alfaro, with youth choirs, the Euskadiko Orkestra and Iñaki Gabilondo as narrator, and lasts 1 hour 30.

6ef11da082290e7773f55e68d6ea75238aa77de6.en: Cristina Len's live show Martiago es mi pueblo draws on her EP Martiago and her album Es mi pueblo. It moves between the city and the village, combining traditional music with synthesizers and electronics.

b3594fd8785d0acf129df59c70108b94d3af819a.en: ZwoZwoEins Men's Choir, conducted by Marco Barcon, performs as part of the Choral Mass Week in Donostia. Its repertoire is mostly for male choir, from the Romantic period to the 21st century.

02d5166e86aaee8a129374c87efd30b952b5ac3b.en: The blues and gospel singer Gladys Amoros performs with pianist Michel Queville at the Altxerri Jazz Club. The duo pays tribute to the great female voices of international jazz.

53e6f4c454a51f4561d71bc26f3a74474ee3ba6a.en: Sara Hebe, who fuses rap, hip-hop and urban music, performs at Dabadaba with La Neni. Sara Hebe's live shows are known for their strength, message and energy.

f41626797e2bf9e09ea640a78b27ffe225151312.en: Booktegi Jaialdia 2026 in Usurbil runs from 30 October to 1 November. It offers a conversation with Ruper Ordorika, readings by writers, booktuber videos, a role-playing game and a concert, with registration for some events.

23ffbec51b4751e650485e9e7bcc9bf9408e6446.en: The 37th San Sebastián Fantastic and Horror Film Week runs from 30 October to 6 November. It opens at the Teatro Principal with Salitre, a Basque psychological horror film about motherhood, directed by Norma Vila.

d5efee1029b9c71a9a98720a96c53847bca981a3.en: Hyakki yagyô, an exhibition at the San Jerónimo library by Álvaro Herranz of Fuego Fatuo Art. Twenty sculptures and photographs show yokai, the monsters and spirits of Japanese folklore.

eb258379607e73418c28a433f3210a3cd381c288.en: An exhibition at the Biblioteca Municipal Central honours the Basque illustrator and comic author Mai Egurza, who died in 2025. It shows work from the last decade, many of it unpublished, and is curated by Jorge Madejón.

ed1a4b8aae4907628c11d96da0cfc95f8f1dc89d.en: The Euskal Irudigileak exhibition Pasado y presente de la ilustración vasca, shown at the Centro Cultural Aiete as part of Literaktum 2026. It reviews the richness and diversity of Basque illustration, past and present.

f36c813fe2cb00038491908b130a61e3b97d0e52.en: Ensemble Diatessaron performs Renaissance humanist music in the Matinée de Miramon at the Euskadiko Orkestra series. The programme includes works by Anonymous, Ortiz, Sanz and Gervaise, and the series has 16 Saturday concerts this season.

f6c389ffadd7373dc797da3cbd50ae911ca00416.en: Grimm anaien parkea, by Erre Produkzioak at the Centro Cultural Aiete, is a children's show. Two street sweepers must clean a park built for the Grimm brothers, where fairy-tale characters step into their lives. It is for all audiences.

4c7a540878bee25504b4da2714e4cd30b9c67c2a.en: Elektro-festa #6 at Tabakalera is a dance session for children and adults together, with DJ Fresa Morango. Dance, sound and light are shared on the dance floor.

a2153f1c0ed7e3b0a5b2e38cf00409bf86a5e2ac.en: An Ecstatic Dance session called Gau Beltza in Donostia marks the night of souls. Introspective music, polyrhythms, Gaelic folklore and rock are on the programme, and guests are asked to wear black, red or both.

214e3050ac69612f04c6411509f4737e85da7273.en: La luna de hambre by the company Tora is a physical, poetic dance piece at the Centro Cultural Larratxo. It mixes contemporary dance, performance and visual arts, and follows two bodies that cross into the hidden.

8498982bca5a3d32e292d6188c485e583464662b.en: Ruper Ordorika and the group Mugalariak play the Sutegi Aretoa as part of Booktegi Jaialdia. They perform songs from the album Lurra ikutu barik, which has eleven songs, along with highlights from his career of over 40 years.

f59b2aac910cf9b471299a94c5821177e4f1f007.en: Abrir puertas y ventanas by Milagros Mumenthaler is a 2011 film about three sisters who live in their family home in Buenos Aires after their grandmother dies. The film, screened at Tabakalera, won five prizes at the 2011 Locarno festival.

bec24cef9b0805fabd5587d784ca0d6bebf07a32.en: Melón pelado by the company ButacaZero mixes oral narration, documentary theatre and object theatre. Two puppeteers open an old trunk and uncover the silenced story of women whose heads were shaved during the Civil War.

9ecc7377e2e4d24f3286a78f2dd0e4276e0a717d.en: Akelarre, by the clown Virginia Imaz, is a comic piece at the Sala Imanol Larzabal. Her character Pauxa invites the audience to an improvised witches' gathering and questions the stereotype of the witch and historical violence against women.

b5ab2a9af3a9738db7a6386fc9a16fceab4f3ea8.en: TECHNO POP is a two-hour tour of the classics of 1980s and 1990s techno-pop at the Kursaal. Depeche Mode, Talk Talk, David Bowie, U2, The Smiths, A-ha and Pet Shop Boys are among the bands, with a band and international singers.

7a149ce1a83574372d4054229b9a08451da4264e.en: La Amenaza Constante, a Donostia band founded in 2023, plays the Kutxa Fundazioa Kluba. Its sound blends pop melodies with dense guitar walls, close to noise pop and shoegaze.

eea025a7e3a5fd15eede65056b03583f4d587090.en: The Saul Andreu Quartet, led by the trumpeter from Zaragoza, plays at the Altxerri Jazz Club. The style mixes jazz with Latin music and Afro-Cuban rhythms, with touches of funk and soul.

7ae1aacd28bd631c3c03462b6711f72a7382f2c3.en: Erik Urano, an experimental rapper and electronic artist from Valladolid, plays Dabadaba. Dark beats, futuristic synthesizers and introspective, dystopian lyrics shape his universe.

4ec0dd3f1259deefeb3f3d9942a4b0701a68ceae.en: Me Vale Madre and La Txama play Lekuona Fabrika for the Day of the Dead. Their night fuses Mexican folklore and traditional music with current sounds, starting at 21:30.

e4466f81a8f3a03da3ae1d01736bf31457909032.en: The Gau Beltza, or Night of the Black, takes place in Orio on 31 October. Schoolchildren take part in workshops in the square, and Txurrumuski runs a fright route for older children at 19:30.

039bfa07668f12b0f1b353f59f7c09ea830c9a2a.en: The monthly talk at the Museo San Telmo looks at the Loyola barracks and their centenary. It explores how the garrison and its regiment, the Sicilia 67, related to Donostia before the Civil War, starting from a 19th-century chair.

71d6dc71515e6c1daedffa0d0cc676f0ac677cf4.en: A bertso session at Intxapain, in the Mural tour organised by Donostia Kultura. Nerea Ibarzabal, Alaia Martin and Maddi Ane Txoperena improvise verses in Basque.

55e5bfa03cfe3cfdc04418aecb3c58873b65617a.en: Errigora, sustraitik espaziora is a 54-minute documentary in Basque about the Errigora cooperative. It follows the work from the canning line to the Santxikorrota race in support of Basque, and the shared effort it takes.

22bdcb663a56ba38a6e1c17cba8a9676a6d6d8a7.en: Julio Iglesias Jr. sings the classics of his father, Julio Iglesias, in the Experience show at the Kursaal. The concert recreates the glamour and romance that made his father a global star.

29cd56688f1e5abbb6c62ad3f6e6dafbd7df1862.en: Memorandum of Understanding plays the Altxerri Jazz Club.

d7efb37314147b6018bf2dd41568ac987b4133ef.en: Visible Cloaks, an Oregon electronic duo, plays Dabadaba with Reichmelt. Minimal ambient textures blend with digital sounds and traditional Asian music.

da030ae57ea2575ebbee17dff345b92a88280ae8.en: A walk for people aged over 55 from Loiola Kultur Etxea to Martutene and Astigarraga. The group meets new people and enjoys the city together.

437ea7d2b69b1ca8438042c7238c5e47ed974e52.en: A literary discussion in Basque at the Centro Cultural Okendo on Jose Antonio Loidi's Hamabost egun Urgainen, led by Ane Mayoz. The book is available in Donostia Kultura libraries.

7af95180e94e68262f8aa2b4660699a3dabf96a4.en: KLUBAK 2026-2027 at the KMK library opens registration for reading clubs in Basque and Spanish. The Spanish group, led by Mónica Leiva, reads ten books in the year, from Pedro Lemebel and Marjane Satrapi to Chinua Achebe.

e52597d6603824262e90e99542b63677ecbba51c.en: Dr Mario Alonso Puig gives the talk Haz lo (im)posible at the Kursaal. The Harvard-trained doctor and author of 12 books combines humour and practical tools to help people overcome limits.

3c48b52d02033cae6e1349618b9769576e01e456.en: Liburu Baby Kluba at the Aldakonea library is a playful session for babies aged 0 to 3, with an adult. It mixes Basque, Spanish and English, and each session needs separate registration.

6b198fcebf498a5d2e2042e5630e59cb9bfc63bd.en: Sustraitik espaziora at the Landetxe Kultur Aretoa is a 54-minute documentary on Errigora, a citizen initiative built on Basque solidarity. It works in southern Navarre, where Basque is not an official language, to promote local foods in the Basque Country.

bf3c64fff811d7ec738b771fbcf82604bec9ce21.en: Garbiñe Elizegi, a nurse and researcher from Lesaka, speaks on Basque women and non-normative gender in health care at the Centro Cultural Ernest Lluch. The talk is part of the cycle Emakume zientzialarien argitan and is introduced by Ana Galarraga.

79bc85c5b88f01e89ff52c26a682b766bb7d3b14.en: A literary discussion in Basque on Maja Haderlap's Ahanzturaren aingerua, led by Iñigo Aranbarri at the Plaza de la Constitución. The book is available in Donostia Kultura libraries.

1e1d2c576a645126a4467d5d57ae36f465e80549.en: Gatza 4tet, a jazz quartet of four friends, plays at the Altxerri Jazz Club. The group keeps tradition in mind while exploring how far jazz can go.

fb68990265a3d6f61d6317454dae84b1efceeefd.en: Eli "Paperboy" Reed plays Dabadaba. The American singer draws on soul, rhythm and blues and gospel, and is known for his powerful voice and the 1960s soul sound.

237419ed9353305f15d8d437892898f14ec1b675.en: A guided visit for over-55s at the Museo San Telmo, focused on the industrialisation of the Basque Country. It is one of six themed routes in the +55 programme.

fe4e01c9c8d8a62e99efe1663fad81b358014950.en: Feministaldia XXI, the feminist festival, takes place from 3 to 7 November and again on 18 December 2026.

24294ee837621ebb35aafaa9b80f8a7cc0f888b5.en: A literary discussion in the Lezo library, led by Ane Mayoz, on Mikel Ayllon's book Zoriontsuak izatea erabaki genuen.

398301fb6509ab30c2fb4794d990d34142d040eb.en: The Black Magic with Buddha, a 1983 Hong Kong-Thailand horror film by Lo Lieh, is screened at Tabakalera as part of the horror week. It follows a man who steals the preserved brain of a mummy that grants wishes, and it has been restored in 4K.

fd07159aca5a042116e243d2acb3292e1cd2eccd.en: Algoritmo, territorio y población is a talk by Júlia Nueno Guitart at Tabakalera. Based on Forensic Architecture's research, it studies Israel's military use of AI in Gaza and suggests tools to examine the opaque system behind it.

bc0103833ef48209c30b49d11fe6a4db8fa39d96.en: Eva Cosculluela, writer and cultural journalist, talks at the Museo San Telmo as part of Un mundo de escritoras. The conversation is moderated by Luisa Etxenike, and the talk looks at her novel El club de las modernas.

06ef11bad3534107dd897d9b4411970b6cfc57d4.en: A literary discussion of Philip K. Dick's The Man in the High Castle at the Centro Cultural Egia, led by Liss Evermore as part of a science fiction club.

fcf54fe82cea041b6350ca9296300939e7581e60.en: Kelley Stoltz plays Dabadaba on 4 November. The San Diego musician mixes alternative rock, psychedelic pop and the sound of the 1960s, with atmospheric songs.

8355d0e7352fd35d070decaa6845fe93a7435c27.en: A reading club for adults at the central library on Euskadi children's literature awards, led by Imanol Mercero. The next session is on 28 January, and registration is by email.

23c9ecba5c55079bee78b2032a72e73a67ed0ea7.en: A guided visit by scientific illustrator Mauricio Antón to his exhibition at the Museo San Telmo, which charts his professional career. The visit is also part of the EHU Science Week.

a0a2b4844947b5e2afff5c1297548819a34b7ad2.en: Asesinato en el Jubiletxe, staged by the Oroimenak theatre group at the Centro Cultural Okendo. Directed by Jonathan F. Txakartegi, the play follows a resident's sudden death and who among them holds the truth.

55e57b7c8bfc792269411ecc4647cb5ab8ae1083.en: Musikagileak 2026 presents Chroma Kollektiv at Musikene. The international ensemble, formed at the International Ensemble Modern Academy, performs contemporary pieces by Urquiza, Ibarrondo, Barajas, Iturregi and Helga Arias.

514165396e7399210ca22b443ffe0816dbe0ae1c.en: Venceremos, a 2021 film by Taxio Ardanaz, is screened at Tabakalera as part of the KOOPERATIBA seminar. It follows the search for a monument to the International Brigades and questions how history is represented.

fee44691f7dbdc511a7509cb686f4aa396cad859.en: María Sánchez, a vet and writer from Córdoba, takes part in Un mundo de escritoras at the Museo San Telmo. Slawka Grabowska moderates the talk, which covers her books on rural life, including Tierra de mujeres and Fuego la sed.

6596e291a475b45038b7dae31739a2bf86706266.en: Rosana plays the Kursaal on 5 November. The Spanish singer, known for El talismán and A fuego lento, starts a new stage with the Vamos a Star tour.

89b7154da2506b0d0966b77f187530fbcc29f909.en: HARIAK 2026, a film festival about resistance, celebrates its fifth anniversary from 5 to 15 November at the Kulturarteko Plaza Feminista.

b16055099073dace0b9eab3ae422111f1b621e9c.en: Cartas fílmicas, a workshop with Maider Oleaga at the Larrotxene cultural centre. Participants exchange film letters with a film school in San Isidro, Ecuador, through sessions from November to March.

a0dd89c7e59cb835c4352b34c07d4485312bb3a5.en: A workshop by Francisco López at Tabakalera on sound creation. He draws on 40 years of practice, the home-music network of the late 1970s and environmental sound, which he uses as a starting point rather than a copy of the real world.

3556a63ec8b49959d7cf49740a8893e8db3e9e25.en: A masterclass by Francisco López at the Kutxa Artegunea, on experimental social audio, environmental sound and immersive listening. It covers his practice of 40 years and the international community of sound artists.

fdd6ecbaebc8b57020b3373d35c250cff37590d5.en: Kuko, Truko eta Bolenwaider, by Erre Produkzioak, is a children's show at the Centro Cultural Ernest Lluch for ages 4 and over. Bolenwaider cannot control Kuko and Truko, and asks the children to help them get along.

17fdfbbe7d342a1e4d64b20a3d07c9a9e77a848f.en: #PLANETAFARIA at Tabakalera is a relaxed talk with CIC biomaGUNE postdoc Andrea Rizzo. He explains how a plastic-eating microbe might help fight pollution, and participants are invited to bring a snack.

21dae4503df7c72d9e130c5db865a5815a25bfe3.en: Alle reden übers Wetter, a German film by Annika Pinske, is screened at the Centro Cultural Okendo. A Berlin philosopher returns to her hometown in Mecklenburg for her mother's 60th birthday, and her urban life clashes with the countryside.

5a90f11332c83bdc5e5d9ec4f79dc4075ac5198c.en: HI Hiriko idazleak presents La flecha que me asignó Cupido, about Antonio Machado, and Miguel Hernández, la voz truncada, by José Andrés Álvaro Ocáriz, at the Centro Cultural Ernest Lluch.

48ec1162ae280c07316c19fec6918ce5a315ef5d.en: The Musikene Big Band, a group of jazz students from the Musikene conservatory in San Sebastián, performs.

1fcf297f8f2ab45a5a1485d116a2f3edb641ebd2.en: El cebo, a 1958 German film by Ladislao Vajda, is screened at Tabakalera as part of Klasikoak 2026. A girl is murdered in a Swiss village, and the old peddler who found the body is suspected, but only the inspector doubts him.

97fdf79bf80ee31126e81b204460a443a2c0e257.en: A book presentation of Esnatu ala hil by Garikoitz Goikoetxea at the Sala Salatxo.

4deca13718a7fa8d293a8338b19e093f572b4edf.en: Chares y Teresa's comedy show Aquí hay match at the Sala Imanol Larzabal is about love, dating and couples. It is interactive, with improvisation and audience challenges, and is recommended for ages 16 and over.

d86261ac3b2193fda9bacc637995c854dc7dc752.en: Mikel Urdangarin presents a solo show after 30 years of career and 20 albums. It is a return to bare songs, an intimate dialogue between the singer, his guitar and the audience.

72aa36f731905c5629e2604e9c3089a4482b0469.en: Katapulta Tour Gipuzkoa 2026 features emerging local artists Nuria López García and Isora at the Kutxa Fundazioa Kluba. The show is open to all audiences.

e7c1aecd110c080785a3bd892fa65aa7e92e3683.en: The sixth conservation workshop for photographs at the Museo San Telmo is a theory and practice course for professionals. Held from 4 to 6 November 2026 for 20 hours, it covers colour photography, with enrolment closing on 2 October.

c1dcbd450530fa1382fe1a48697edfe019944707.en: Habi and Etxekalte play Dabadaba on 6 November.

460a2b91c7a79bd73102472e94197ee381f16d76.en: Pablo Maza 4tet plays the Altxerri Jazz Club. The band presents its first album, Iduzki Denean, which blends popular tradition with contemporary jazz and experimental sounds, with a bright and positive mood.

a9eb051c36ede1645f8a1e6e61946666a5e6bcfb.en: La hora del cuento at the Lekuona Fabrika is a Basque storytelling session for children aged 2 to 5, with one adult per family. Sessions run on Saturdays from October to May, with enrolment from 7 to 20 September.

c5b30c5c3cddf75a2e3e166d5c1eb174d25dde00.en: Baba Yaga eta sorginkerien liburua, a 2023 Russian animated film by Vladimir Sakov, is screened at the Juanba Berasategi Aretoa. The witch Baba Yaga tries to recover her stolen spellbook from the sorceress Belladonna, with help from Princess Safir.

4f7c598734e80b4d95c01ac5745566173241b205.en: The Doble Check Festibala 2026 takes place at Dabadaba on Saturday 7 November.

8f83e72fe3b7f55bb7813c0925b0c02b7b7266c3.en: Gazte Tour in Gipuzkoa 2026 at the Bastero Kulturgunea in Andoain offers music for young people. Artists KM0 Oihane, DJ Nrea and singer Ben Yart perform, in a programme run by the Gipuzkoa council.

eb218708bb41eef3c33b2d7c359387cefcf08d7f.en: Kaka, by Xanti Agirrezabala and Erika Olaizola, is a Basque play that premieres at the Casa de Cultura in Orio within Korrika Kultura. A heap of dung in the village square raises questions about who is responsible for cleaning it up.

5db5416e851c31e48536a245acc50cf1420a3832.en: Hard Boiled, a 1990s Hong Kong action classic by John Woo, is screened at Tabakalera as part of the horror week. A policeman whose partner is killed teams up with an undercover hitman to hunt the gang, with Chow Yun-fat in the lead.

7d02539d4bdca0e4701dd9360c82f085665cabcf.en: Sidari, by Xake Produkzioak, follows a thirty-something couple on an Interrail trip across Europe. They meet an elderly couple who advise them to swim the canal at Corfu, and one of them begins to suspect the pair may be their future selves.

9ab12ae5ed5870cee1eb60d23c2fbd5993331343.en: Ciclo Bibra 2026 presents Putochinomaricón at the Kutxa Fundazioa Kluba. Chenta Tsai Tseng performs hyperpop and futurepop, mixing synth-pop, J-pop, disco and autotune, with a strong activist message.

28c3c70a9df17a02c7edbc5c96261630d4bcb16c.en: Iker Piris & His dual Electras play the Altxerri Jazz Club.

d58150fc00d54ec820fc1ce56f9e368075a4124d.en: bROTHERS iN bAND, a tribute to Dire Straits, plays the Kursaal on 7 November. The show marks the 40th anniversary of Brothers in Arms, and recreates the 1985-86 tour with Angelo Fumarola in the role of Mark Knopfler.

62d4576b1a8fd40f80f47dbfd5901da1f76ebba0.en: The bands Cobra and Kuartz perform at the Centro Cultural Niessen in Errenteria on 7 November.

f1db222da62da71bc9f0303794be60bd0583b65a.en: Criaturas Sónicas by Francisco López is an immersive sound piece at Tabakalera on 7 November. Audience members wear blindfolds and listen to a multichannel surround system that plays environmental recordings from around the world.

a960ff0434a205807c5c3ce707de7b9ff58c2078.en: Ángel Martín's comedy show Somos monos at the Kursaal lasts 70 minutes. He jokes about how the internet has dulled our everyday thinking and how we no longer know how to do simple things.

94f9a51c237c9b890c667668132f5d67592a5ecd.en: Amatxi, a musical by Pontx Pailazoa at the Centro Cultural Larratxo, is about humour, love and a grandmother who is ageing and unwell. The performer helps her at home, and the show is for ages 3 and over.

952371e8749ecea01bea98329bae38f302e111ea.en: GER, a 28-year-old comedian who went viral with mini monologues, performs his show at the Kursaal. He describes himself as a mocatriz and is part of the LGBTIQ+ community. The show is recommended for ages 16 and over and lasts 120 minutes.

bb910b1db2af5e28bf65299946595151f22d64bf.en: Oskarbi's concert 60 urte kantuan in Pasaia marks 60 years of singing in Basque. The singer-songwriter has given about a thousand concerts and recorded thirteen albums, mixing folk songs with his own compositions.

ee8fcc3ec5d0902d5d23f8fd1b13738ee06ce8a7.en: Herentzia, by Kulunka Teatroa at the Gezala Auditorium, is a Basque thriller. A couple faces their fears and their past on their last night together, in a dreamlike journey through a family mystery.

5acaaed4cae0f60453c852b8170e7d265153dbb3.en: Rey Lear is an irreverent, minimalist version of Shakespeare's play by a Portuguese company at the Centro Cultural Niessen. Three actors play all the roles in 80 minutes, and the staging is directed by José C. García.

8a3d9c69bb1fd74a1167e7c2aa78be9ea4cee4af.en: The Miguel Blanco 4tet plays the Altxerri Jazz Club, with atmospheric Latin jazz. Guitarist Miguel Blanco leads Erik Niemietz on keyboards, Victor Merlo on bass and Manex Olazaguirre on drums.

150a8f4dcc4a2bea31428068882e250fe69a1f7f.en: Sonic Beat Explosion plays Dabadaba, with rock and roll, garage rock and rhythm and blues. The sound is powerful and danceable, with a raw live intensity.

96a414f78a1da3a054fa703e22251e9638c49f09.en: Liburu Txiki Kluba at the Aldakonea library is a reading session for babies aged 3 to 5, held in Basque, Spanish and English. Each Monday session is built around an illustrated book, and the club is run by Mestiza.

b56362b1d428d4f06ad5dcf948d98a1fa7a877ef.en: Ameli, a musical storytelling session for children and parents at the Orio cultural house, for ages 1 to 4.

b3fc7d4c5bf23403759ee8603f800b496f49afee.en: A literary discussion in English on Daniel Kraus's Angel Down, led by Slawka Grabowska at the Plaza de la Constitución. The book is available in Donostia Kultura libraries.

2e6ba89125a7f4d72394786b31f84aebfde1ff1e.en: A literary discussion in Basque on Mohammed El-Kurd's Rifqa, led by Edu Zabala. The book is available in Donostia Kultura libraries.

3c03444862ead021cb5b203c1bc819394b8d7bc2.en: Literaktum 2026 presents Juan Gabriel Vásquez in conversation with Juan Carlos Etxeberria at the Okendo cultural centre. The talk is about his book Esto ha sucedido, a collection of columns on memory, politics and shared truth.

c34bca2fec42573cd508bcbf8f7283d1143e4a99.en: A reading club at the San Pedro library in Pasaia discusses Julen Apella's novel Sakelako bihotzak. Two university friends from different backgrounds face the choices that will shape their lives.

13e924f749aaf4821548b5f5cea5eb49f7a5cf7b.en: Carmen, a ballet on film, is screened at the Cines Niessen. Damiano Michieletto's production for The Royal Opera moves the action to contemporary Spain and focuses on gender violence, and it runs 185 minutes.

9218e01f3899e0c548df1f73a376dd97b8faf1f5.en: The band Txorinho plays the Altxerri Jazz Club with mandolin, cavaquinho, guitar and percussion.

b4cc9ce398fa523a0a99e201c4d425b4800bface.en: A guided visit for over-55s to the permanent Basque art display at the Museo San Telmo, covering 20th- and 21st-century art. It is one of six themed routes in the +55 programme.

d18619e09ffbad62d6e830dd6683060e549a4bae.en: Komiki Kluba at Lekuona Fabrika is a comics reading club for young readers aged 8 to 12, held in Basque on Wednesdays. Galtzagorri leads the sessions, which run from October to May, with registration from 7 to 20 September.

14df3bd2b902eaa27fe2c38330658b99f981f7a6.en: A storytelling session by Ameli at the Lezo library on 11 November, for children aged 4 to 7.

64a35d418800596ebcbd0147133ce5df41891c90.en: A literary discussion in Spanish on Margaryta Yakovenko's Ocupación at the Centro Cultural Ernest Lluch, led by Javier Mina. The book is available in Donostia Kultura libraries.

c05bd6ac1d039b0fe3f4ffa68da73cb74ee4d52e.en: The Fortune Cookie (En bandeja de plata), Billy Wilder's 1966 comedy with Jack Lemmon and Walter Matthau, is screened at Tabakalera. A TV cameraman fakes a serious injury after a minor collision, on the advice of his lawyer brother-in-law.

88429b2869a59a9276cd6e164b5405732878551c.en: A talk at the Museo San Telmo about the legacy of Elena Tuduri, a pioneer who began fieldwork on Basque clothing 100 years ago. Ane Albisu, who never met her, explains how Tuduri's work shaped her own research, and the talk is streamed.

88e5564bb234028e03484b3112f96c92f294b11d.en: Cosmopaark, a German indie and psychedelic rock band, plays Dabadaba. Its dream pop and melancholic melodies create hypnotic soundscapes.

ad252c4d10e816329585037461eef5d2c4195a7d.en: Gipuzkoa en el tardofranquismo is an academic day on opposition to Franco's dictatorship in Gipuzkoa, covering politics, society, culture and human rights. Registration is by email.

77197d324c7b144e251724567be7735e4f4615dd.en: The Literaktum festival runs from 9 to 22 November in San Sebastián, under the theme of strange and forgotten voices. Juan Gabriel Vásquez, Irati Jimenez and Yasmina Reza are among the writers, and a children's drawing contest is held.

de1d3323ea0e8cbcba9858a1236ce36642bf850b.en: Basker, a 9-minute ethnographic film from 1963 about Basque culture, is screened at the Museo San Telmo as part of the Fermin Leizaola ethnography days. It was made by Swedish reporters and is followed by a talk with researcher Argibel Euba.

a1d853afcad6bcf74272398acbce80c23d398da3.en: Patatekin, by the Basque comedy group Barrexerka, is a show of theatre and sketches at the Centro Cultural Niessen. A man of 54 gets nostalgic over a night out and finds the courage to do what he would never have done.

738171e63f18ff0ee21dea5856facc172204d499.en: A literary discussion in Spanish of Patrick Modiano's Dora Bruder at the Centro Cultural Aiete, led by Lola Arrieta. The book starts from a 1941 newspaper notice about a missing 15-year-old girl, whose name later appears in a list of Auschwitz deportees.

36889cd490cced608260720e7460421dfe043535.en: Paris 1900, a 1947 montage film by Nicole Vedrés, is screened at the Biteri Kultur Etxea as part of the Hernani film club. It builds a chronicle of Paris from 1900 to 1914 from historical documents and extracts from some 700 films.

18245ce5e333aaea72fcf50f564c351dc0c88403.en: Literaktum 2026 hosts a talk with writer Irati Jiménez and Harkaitz Cano on her first short-story collection, Gaupasa Kluba, a manifesto for literature and love, at the Centro Cultural Ernest Lluch.

5b09b47c779de926feac378de207e7bb59125b93.en: La idea de un lago, a 2016 Argentine film by Milagros Mumenthaler, is screened at Tabakalera. In the last days of her pregnancy, a woman prepares a photo book about her childhood summers by a lake, and old family wounds surface.

439ff403b3b57002b9bf03bd8c9d3a305a8e41ce.en: Literaktum 2026 hosts a conversation with Yasmina Reza and Olga Grande on Casos reales, a short book of court cases. Reza's portrait of human weakness is severe yet empathetic, and invitations are limited to two per person.

a31eeaf1f5fd700d4816c65ec6b0d4763c7fab45.en: 27 de septiembre de 1975 is a book by Plataforma Abierta Al Alba, published in 2025 by Ediciones Garaje. It tells of the last executions of the Franco dictatorship, drawing on survivors' memories, lawyers' accounts and family testimony.

bb3df902bbae3252014d3be9f1f6f41226704a87.en: The 50th CIMASUB, the international underwater film festival in San Sebastián, takes place on 12, 13 and 14 November at the Teatro Principal. The festival mixes underwater films, photography and environmental awareness, and the film sessions are free.

e40486a47347443523c59710163e2b1c2920b397.en: Geordie Greep, an English singer and guitarist and a founding member of Black Midi, plays Dabadaba. His solo work mixes rock, jazz and experimental music.

3a6ceb7f7b49cf0563de15c95c8f84bd130c8e92.en: Teoría de la fatiga by Puntu Gu, a joint photography project of the collectives Punto de Catástrofe and Gu, is shown at the Bastero Kulturgunea. It looks at the critical point between what we can still bear and what is about to collapse.

9cf057b36bee19e3a587434e266dae1f73cfa715.en: Barrexerka, a one-hour Basque youth comedy show mixing monologues, theatre and sketches, is staged at the Casa de Cultura de Pasai Antxo. It is organised by the Bokaleren Gazte Elkargunea and tours village to village.

858406f6861541eef50ee0a5ee99389b15cab882.en: A talk by Marta Lloret at the Museo San Telmo on the masia, the traditional Catalan farmhouse. It covers its features, evolution and current conservation challenges, and it is streamed online.

02bcdb17ec0c3dda2b57d199abcd20b080914e42.en: Literaktum 2026 presents 85 Kopla, with Xabier Amuriza and Agus Barandiaran at the Sala Imanol Larzabal in Lugaritz. Music and coplas recall the village festivals of Amuriza's childhood and his research into their songs.

e6021bd62b91d887bc69be2dbc9125014440622d.en: Esencia, by Ignacio García May at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia, stars Juan Echanove and Joaquín Climent. Two old friends reunite and wait for a mysterious author who never arrives, and the play won two Premios Talía 2026.

30f304f2cd63afee25fbda58b542fdd4d0e6a723.en: Soriazu, Surmenian and Mingot play the Altxerri Jazz Club.

c02489495298833a5d213cc1c5be034d99ef7117.en: Los Ganglios, a Catalan group, plays Dabadaba. Their songs mix electronic music, punk and absurd humour with surreal lyrics.

2e01d2ca8448415fe1711ef9069f8f9b6cd7ed62.en: IKUSKA 2026, the 28th short film festival of the Bay of Pasaia, runs from 13 to 21 November. It includes an official section, a Basque-language section, Femenino Plural on gender equality and a comedy short film session.

3a3ac72b69c1df9c4021b9883c569a52b3cbc649.en: Dudak dakarrena, a Literaktum 2026 exhibition, is a creative project that uses only words beginning with D. The misadventures of a dromedary called Diógenes reveal the drama that dominates us, and doubt is its theme.

9fda9daa06c92138e29af7dca8ce0712ece269f6.en: Matinée de Miramon 4 by La Brisa Ensemble, a flute and harp group, is part of the Euskadiko Orkestra chamber season. The programme includes works by Schmitt, Daniel-Lesur and Cras.

90c35a41aed5ba821787ee84d1ae819416f7f0db.en: Bidutzi is a comedy show for children aged 3 and over and their families, staged at the Biteri Kultur Etxea. On a carnival night, monsters and costumes come out, with puppets and live music.

5e090a9e6099935096921434653b7ea164be503c.en: Pinocho, the 1940 film by Ben Sharpsteen and Hamilton Luske, is screened at the Centro Cultural Aiete for Literaktum 2026. A wooden puppet, given life by the Blue Fairy, needs the cricket Pepito Grillo to become a real boy.

bfd9c31743944b2de3c0f890ff8f0f4ba8bacf38.en: Eko eta itsasoa by Irati Castro Henrich at the Kursaal is a music and song show for children. A magical creature called Eko faces the dangers to the sea, such as pollution, plastics and climate change, and the audience learns with it.

b0fe17dcb19ce0c703b9fa2a3e21f81474efdbe7.en: Enperadorearen kondaira by Patata Tropikala, a shadow-theatre show at the Centro Cultural Larratxo for ages 4 and over. It tells of Emperor Wu-Ti's grief after the death of his beloved Wang, mixing shadows, magic, juggling and theatre.

97a080ff7ffc2914d7b391f02b6d2df3741ebfe0.en: Iván Ferreiro plays the Kursaal on 14 November on his Hoy x Ayer retrospective tour. The Galician singer marks 35 years of career with hits from Los Piratas to the present, and songs he has not sung in over 20 years.

2b63bdc15d2fad71eda4c044ed583cfd067d2283.en: Pablo Torti 4tet plays the Altxerri Jazz Club. The saxophonist's quartet, formed in Madrid in 2022, has just released its first EP, Las tres heridas, based on a poem by Miguel Hernández.

9f49c1b775448a684efc16c867918d271c339053.en: Izaki Gardenak and Hondora play the Centro Cultural Intxaurrondo. Izaki Gardenak give their last concerts in November before an indefinite break, and Hondora present their first album.

37ae6cf07a95d0d61271c782a5889026341b8a81.en: ØDEI and La Furia perform a rap concert at the Centro Cultural Niessen to launch the new season of Zintzilik Irratia. It is for adults, in Basque and Spanish, and tickets cost 12 euros.

c08858953949e4547190cc5fecd162055f87eee6.en: Lamiaren ispilua at the Bastero Kulturgunea follows a girl who finds a mirror that asks questions. Her adventure meets creatures from Basque mythology, in a 55-minute show for ages 2 to 12.

d5b38a991d174583220e2402427e5a0d2f342601.en: Cloud Nothings play Dabadaba on 15 November.

d7e87d74c237ea6cb92c459e917ddd1f212dbb6b.en: Fantasma Sur at the Teatro Principal brings together Alondra Bentley's voice and Ylia's electronics. The songs were written with filmmaker Isaki Lacuesta, whose films are projected live with artist Albert Coma.

5327727708693a0217b3b4414eb3abf352fb4147.en: Teoría King Kong, a stage adaptation of Virginie Despentes's feminist essay, is staged at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia. It deals with violence, sexuality, motherhood and capitalism, performed by M. Pau Pigem and directed by Isis Martín.

eb4c057659fa1a86349c0c9d8ebc0b25eb6d3252.en: La loca historia del siglo de Oro is staged at the Gezala Auditorium by La escalera de tijera and Z teatro. The show traces Spain's Golden Age through gestural theatre, clown, circus and live music.

d46d8029d82de90bfa808cc9cba01e6816392704.en: Antzarra zerumugan, a 62-minute film by Xabier Villalba, examines the history of the Antzar Eguna goose festival in Lekeitio. Researchers and ethnographers take part, and it is screened at the Museo San Telmo.

497f8f5f353b41c1a0c0046de2644c330d264977.en: Literaktum 2026 presents Homenaje a las hermanas Feillet at the Centro Cultural Aiete. It honours two pioneers of women's illustration in the Basque Country, on the Basque Illustration Day of 12 November.

674643f8c10f4c0346223cc706b8c853d8b5136b.en: Las corrientes, a 2025 Argentine film by Milagros Mumenthaler, is screened at Tabakalera. A fashion professional gives in to an impulse at a prize ceremony in Switzerland, and a past she left behind returns on her return to Buenos Aires.
