a4a93d91e7ea218effa648e694b6cd790f5dc0b4.en: La loca historia del siglo de Oro at the Sala Imanol Larzabal in Lugaritz, by La escalera de tijera and Z teatro, traces Spain's Golden Age through physical theatre, clown, circus and live music. It touches on war and the status of women.

95957629fc9f44b00006e23c92609532758224f0.en: Peppermint Sextet plays the Altxerri Jazz Club with Euskal Latín Jazz Ska Project. The band draws on Basque song, jazz and ethnic music, with inspiration from across the world and from Africa.

f3ce52785627399599ba08511617e86018fa89bf.en: A storytelling session with Miriam Mendoza at the Casa de Cultura de Orio.

98840370bf1384c7483759c3deabed6bc4cbaf9f.en: Hiru bit is a monthly cycle where a video game becomes a tool to explore emotions, worries and connections together. It works like a book club played instead of read, and the next session on 20 October looks at Time Flies.

57db6cf63654552b3d001b95fb73d9acb1aed45e.en: El Rincón de la Poesía at the Centro Cultural Intxaurrondo is an open space for people to read their poetry or listen. Registration is required by phone in advance.

cd414a9ea8e7c5c62378cfda383970c0cd55bd51.en: A literary discussion of Elizabeth Taylor's Prohibido morir aquí at the Lezo library, led by Javier Minak.

a6ed989e155983cdd34a5de3f9b9f6c487199d1e.en: A dramatised reading of Miguel Mihura's Melocotón en almíbar at Lekuona Fabrika, organised with the Ateneo Guipuzcoano.

93a66c8f2aabc665160a701f5cc393f2f557e726.en: Xabier Erkizia talks about Memoria de Montevideo, the only musical composition Jorge Oteiza recorded. It is a brief unfinished poem on magnetic tape, and the talk examines Oteiza's sound thinking at the Museo San Telmo.

76fee2b2b679e081c15bcae0f7fcfc761e3ab849.en: Scapino Ballet Rotterdam performs La Mer at the Kursaal, choreographed by Nanine Linning. Debussy's music contrasts the romantic sea of the early 20th century with pollution, rising seas and endangered ecosystems.

47b14d867501dfccf4d2c8616d187650edc9f167.en: Kasting-a by Zurriola Antzerki Eskola is a play with eight actors competing for a role in a casting. It won the junior category of the 37th Muestra de Teatro Joven, and is staged at Gazteszena.

0a78440fd518eacf1b3717a35794d36ed3b6abd2.en: Iñar Sastre, a Basque pianist, composer and improviser trained in Paris, plays the Altxerri Jazz Club. His work mixes classical music, jazz and folk, and he teaches at Musikene.

1e424f9424995d15c1aa5c5f90d18757d94bdf67.en: A guided visit for over-55s to the Museo San Telmo's historic art collection, starting from the 15th century. It is one of six themed routes in the +55 programme.

bd2568ad6f95069cea09948c42044ab5c01cf43d.en: A guided visit for over-55s to the Museo San Telmo's permanent exhibition, covering the museum's history and the canvases by Josep Maria Sert in the church.

b2faba85c3c6bd21c6316050f8a43cb6b3eba4ea.en: Late Fame, a 2025 film by Kent Jones, follows a forgotten New York poet played by Willem Dafoe. Young creatives rediscover him, reviving his passion and testing his vanity, and it is screened at Tabakalera.

3caf081a263e361def85c02adf938addf02c4600.en: MALETA MOLETA is a storytelling session for children aged 4 to 7 at the Lezo library, led by narrator Mikel Susperregi.

804cc70676cfbdb64027f9af800d1dc94bb9ae9c.en: KLUBAK at the KMK library runs a Basque reading club, led by Uxue Alberdi. Its programme of ten books includes Alison Bechdel's Fun Home, which the group reads on 18 November, and Virginie Despentes's King Kong Theory.

249c876e1c19a9b3751692053a0e07db1fec0013.en: Etxe bat norberarena, by Yolanda Arrieta, is a poetic essay that claims a home of one's own, where dreams can keep growing. Written from old age looking back to childhood, it was published by Alberdania in 2026.

214e6aa002c3fd2c94876fca28e54c174543b322.en: Billy Wilder's 1970 film The Private Life of Sherlock Holmes is screened at Tabakalera as part of the Nosferatu 2026 cycle. Holmes and Watson go to Scotland to find a missing man and uncover a secret society linked to the Queen's intelligence service.

26b6a19ad54afb19a5db280f2be80c2ec87a1ab7.en: Epidemia Ultra, a talk by political analyst Franco Delle Donne at the Museo San Telmo. It explains how the far right now governs and shapes policies, with Silicon Valley as its new patron, and it is streamed online.

52e80283e00902c1a6923e5df21aa5988b96c6c3.en: C.R.A.Z.Y., a 2005 film by Jean-Marc Vallée, is screened at the Centro Cultural Egia. A boy realises he is different and suppresses himself to keep his father's love, growing up between 1960 and 1980.

7e0fd07e7cee1b7d1133876771a5b4ce892b0702.en: Mary Halvorson, a Brooklyn guitarist and composer, leads a new quartet called Canis Major at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia. The group premieres her unpublished compositions with trumpet, bass and drums.

d168d26d6bfaa843880ec981d9dc370ddcc48df7.en: Wedge, a Berlin rock band, plays Dabadaba. Its hard rock and psychedelic sound is inspired by the 1970s, with powerful guitar riffs.

f33756a229e8404fd69c4b9a94e79b554226b7f4.en: Julieta tiene la culpa, a play by Pixkol@bis, is directed by Cristina Torres at the Centro Cultural Loiola. Three women discover that they were never taught to love themselves or to enjoy who they are.

a49023b4967d2050cfd8cad6cab515d5dc7db2c6.en: Ainara Ortega and Joaquín Chacón perform an intimate jazz concert at the Biteri Kultur Etxea, with voice and guitar in the foreground. The repertoire by Duke Ellington, Cole Porter and Billy Strayhorn is supported by Pablo Martín and Bobby Martínez.

f1a0d26da18f38328720b93a0e0b1a401ea66ab3.en: Zazpi, a documentary by Mikel Lizarralde, is screened at the Centro Cultural Okendo as part of the Nature and Mountain cycle. Lizarralde climbs the highest peak of each Basque territory, and he lives with multiple sclerosis along the way.

bd3ff24dcbf04650353771a5b65a6b941590a24e.en: A talk-based session on Milagros Mumenthaler at Tabakalera, with clips from her three feature films. The talk looks at her creative process and her idea of cinema.

61bb7a5a51ae73eb5bf8273c5796121e7f6e2e23.en: Wedge and Moondrive play Dabadaba. Wedge is a Berlin rock band, and Moondrive, from Logroño, plays hard rock inspired by the 1970s and 1980s.

14e5dc8d4b824e1bcc6c1813e013b7157177c2c0.en: Michel Cloup Trio, a French group, plays Dabadaba with alternative rock, post-punk and experimental sounds that explore the edge between rock and experimentation.

840cbf973f69abd912f0e12078d1cc6d93074762.en: Asomar al horizonte at Chillida Leku is the first joint exhibition of Gonzalo Chillida's paintings and Eduardo Chillida's sculptures. It marks the centenary of Gonzalo's birth in 1926, and brings works shown for the first time since his death in 2008.

aea6bed12749fa16d7869b79b98f0ccc1c3d5b84.en: Hernanikomik 2026, the fifth comics festival, takes place on 20 and 21 November. It is organised by the council, the municipal library and comics enthusiasts, with more information to come.

691df58234cceada8dfef15be47a2d7ab68c828f.en: Une aussi longue absence, a French film by Henri Colpi, is screened at the Centro Cultural Okendo. A bar owner on the outskirts of Paris is drawn to a homeless man who looks like her husband, deported in the war.

93357221d67105fc73dd7ba9fb496a96a79d47de.en: Lo peor que le puede pasar a un niño by Jaime Liñera and Ekoma teatro is staged at the Sala Imanol Larzabal as part of Literaktum 2026. A man in his forties and his alter ego, Barbie, examine how they became men, deconstructing masculinity.

3c1ba22d85ca15cdc147ef94af178e170b184e28.en: Gabriel Aresti Mug(h)arri, a sound and poetic piece by Joxan Goikoetxea and EusKamerata, is staged at the Teatro Principal as part of Literaktum 2026. It explores the figure, ideas and imagination of the poet Gabriel Aresti.

959e135a6ebf6fc8aa58f9df08c24fa667e06623.en: The bands The Capaces and Rejected play Dabadaba on 20 November.

c067650a9cce0f5b7de36cff3718386d8047c5f5.en: Artea abian features sculptor Mikel Escobales, born in Mondragón in 1991, at the Sala Laboratorio of the Museo San Telmo. The programme supports artists in the early years of their careers, with works in wood, glass, aluminium and brass.

d24efa2e30e7a7c2cbe47343605ce7b34ddc2952.en: Ground Rules, by Alejandro Cartagena, is an exhibition at the Kutxa Fundazioa Artegunea. It runs from 20 November 2026 to February 2027 as part of the joint programme of Tabakalera and Kutxa.

24d3d580343cbd7ebed21b10224869c04b8d4319.en: Cuerpos en frecuencia is a workshop by Alba Fernández and Irene Balzategi at Tabakalera, linked to Debris Stevenson's sound installation. Participants explore sound through the body, using stimming, tapping and echolalia, and no prior experience is needed.

18c30459103ff99f75f1dd11bdf72fa4eefe6e72.en: CANDLELIGHT Donostia presents a Hans Zimmer tribute at the Aquarium-Palacio del Mar. The 60-minute candlelit concert plays film scores from The Lion King, Dunkirk, The Dark Knight, Interstellar, Dune and Pirates of the Caribbean, for ages 8 and over.

f9073f2535a6029fb2aa8455ee94a2daa3d5af22.en: Hauspoa & tunela is a short documentary on the origins of the Basque trikitixa accordion, shown at the Landetxe Kultur Aretoa. It follows a small accordion brought in 1859 by an Italian railway worker, and director Gorka Hermosa gives a short concert.

2a8c1b049f0deb572306793ab9d81c0a7d9f910b.en: A family art workshop on the work of Carla Filipe and Taxio Ardanaz, who study recent history through photographs and press. Participants make poster-style slogans and a collage, with at least two families.

a56d73f92dfc11926f84c42abb62c826f8dd739e.en: Agur Peter Pan by Yarkelu teatro is a children's show at the Centro Cultural Aiete, presented as part of Literaktum Txikia. María spends afternoons playing Peter Pan with her grandfather, until the Lost Boys take her to Neverland.

1b9e09ae6ef55bb33fb2c7d8e7354317e71b607d.en: Ezer ez by Behibi's Teatro is a children's show for ages 3 and over at the Okendo cultural centre, presented for Literaktum 2026. Puxka wants a present for her best friend Pipo, who already has everything, and the perfect gift turns out to be nothing.

5b67f9693d13fb76c4b3ecbb201da520b24579ce.en: FEMMM is a vocal jazz group of four young women, which calls itself a vocal laboratory. It mixes jazz and pop with a piano, bass and drums band, and has played the San Sebastián, Getxo and Vitoria jazz festivals.

ae9b10b90843be4c7b107e186fe1b40f35de84d2.en: Catherine Russell, a New York jazz singer and daughter of Luis Russell, plays the Kursaal on her Spanish tour of jazz classics. The 90-minute show comes from a singer who has recorded with David Bowie, Paul Simon and Wynton Marsalis.

ea7de53cb5b1707db16f883bccb18b3e6618bba8.en: Revolution JamRock 2026 takes place at the Centro Cultural Intxaurrondo on 21 November. Joe Yorke, Alpha Steppa and Nai-Jah, and Revolutionary Brothers play Jamaican music, and this year there is a Boiler Room-style space.

0b184537e54d7ef08c261308dc429584b2aa442f.en: Stray Dogs, a 2013 Taiwanese film by Tsai Ming-liang, follows a father and his two children along the margins of Taipei. They live in an abandoned building, and a woman's arrival may release buried emotions.

729cb745d50db711342766df8324ad9836578c30.en: Té de construyo by Sobria y Serena at the Sala Imanol Larzabal stages three conservative ladies over tea. Their acid humour, with cello and guitar, hides three silenced women who challenge religion, politics and feminism.

22595651e8606241b1b20d3b56053656696b91e4.en: Patatekin, Barrexerka's latest show, is staged at the Teatro Principal. A 54-year-old man, nostalgic after a night out, finds the courage to try something he would never have done, with theatre and sketches.

40a1d6d603e5378d75605d4090c4b1dff38f1f7b.en: SABINA – El mejor homenaje is a 120-minute tribute to Joaquín Sabina at the Kursaal. Produced by Moon World and performed by Malas Compañías, it covers his rock phase and later poetic work, from Pacto entre Caballeros to Quien me ha robado el mes de abril.

1a85c209352c366e3da4517317eb4d695e8b4526.en: Marina y su Melao, a Barcelona band led by Puerto Rican singer Marina Molina, plays the Kutxa Fundazioa Kluba as part of Bibra. Their debut album, Rezo al agua, expands the bomba rhythm of Puerto Rico. Eire and Atodamadre share the bill.

1ae7fac2b603cda6ff6a00e4a84a93691708f264.en: ZAHARAVE:lite is an electronic show by singer Zahara at Dabadaba on 21 November. Her songs are combined with techno and dance, and the show champions freedom and community.

a53e73f63148992c83f4bc96128eab5d8708ee65.en: The Kike Arza trio plays the Altxerri Jazz Club in Donostia.

bf6ddcf3a02b523d339eddbf9963717358caee35.en: Olaia Inziarte presents Zerrautsa at Lekuona Fabrika, her second album. Its visual world explores inner search, with ash as a symbol of what remains after creation, and the band includes Eric Deza and Josu Erviti.

61662387a9a3475a147506a447eedfc788490fc0.en: The choir Kantaka performs a concert organised by the cultural association Maria Magdalenaren Lagunak.

da3c2275df6f870c80d84f625c73f77ff922a5ce.en: CANDLELIGHT Donostia presents a 60-minute candlelit concert at the Aquarium-Palacio del Mar, with pieces including Dulce introducción al caos and Si te vas and a flamenco coda. It is for ages 8 and over.

29ca99f9f49f3564b220e88ad83db5b40701277b.en: Munstro arrosa, a puppet show for ages 3 and over at the Sarobe centre within Titirijai 2026. A pink monster, unlike the others, travels by bicycle and paper boat to a place where everyone is different and happy.

6de94827fa70398d77256458fcc55f597a9093a4.en: Zir Zir Hara's Presente is a show at the Kutxa Fundazioa Kluba about a clown girl who lives on a plastic island. A large box with a bow shows her that what we throw away may be a treasure to someone else.

6c0814e979eb5c4aacc97cab96d3a10984342a5b.en: El Corsario, a three-act ballet by the Kiev Ballet, is staged at the Kursaal. It is based on a Byron poem, with music by Adolphe Adam, and tells of a pirate's love for an enslaved woman.

8c6484dd6f1564ec0f99770b6fd5af239e22ea93.en: Darius Jones Trio, with Gerald Cleaver and Chris Lightcap, plays the Teatro Victoria Eugenia. The alto saxophonist presents his album Legend of e'Boi, with five original pieces and an arrangement of No More My Lord.

2e159bacb883d4d6b5d112e3276a5b4072d28bef.en: 52 hertz at the Juanba Berasategi Aretoa takes its title from a whale that calls at 52 hertz, out of reach of other whales. Garbi Losada's play uses that lonely whale to explore people who suffer unwanted isolation.

9357c270ed78ba4a66d27a4efa4a40494cea4b76.en: The Haunted Youth, a Belgian band led by Joachim Liebens, plays Dabadaba. Their sound mixes indie rock, dream pop and shoegaze in a nostalgic, melancholic mood.

3e28c72da116a20b4ff0b8eeec17e4abea87541e.en: Tela Sonora is a film-concert at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia, presenting Brazilian animated shorts. Electronic music, Indigenous songs and field recordings accompany the images, and the event is organised by the Txikijazz festival.

1a7e8441749b90d39334cc57589df349ac214fae.en: Plan de vuelo: Desaparecida, a Robert Schwentke film, is screened at the Centro Cultural Casares-Tomasene as a video-forum in the +55 programme. Jodie Foster plays a mother whose daughter seems to vanish mid-flight from Berlin to New York.

2b43d0164416662d1cabc7e18dab1152d04fc5ca.en: Neurociencia, emociones y bienestar is a talk by Montserrat Pérez. She explains in simple terms how the brain relates to emotions and wellbeing, and offers tools to manage stress and mood.

aa76f1b55ccaba493a44c92a36a2fcf9ea820172.en: A literary discussion in French on Leïla Slimani's J'emporterai le feu at the San Jerónimo library, led by Miren Garmendia. The book is available in the municipal libraries of Donostia.

16a88ec86484737782d11320c12c57b91102bcb3.en: Broke Carrey, an Argentine rapper and producer, plays Dabadaba. He mixes hip-hop, trap, reggaeton and candombe with jazz and Argentine traditions.

58f4861a2ec840750a68c89413379087843f840b.en: La gran noche del pop is a documentary that goes behind the scenes of the 1985 recording of We Are the World.

85966e5f617b0de48a91e03f8b8b338eb8b07f17.en: Alfabetatze mediatiko aurreratua, a day on advanced media literacy at the Museo San Telmo, with Basque experts. The NAIZ Begirada Kritikoa award is presented to this year's winner at the end of the day.

c91e19840c48f8c13a90a6c27aaa55b066659291.en: A literary discussion in Spanish of Natalia Litvinova's Luciérnaga at the San Jerónimo library, led by Ylenia Benito. The book is available in Donostia Kultura libraries.

c10ac95f65fdb6dd57e218acd0c9156eea14dcec.en: A book presentation of Júlia Salander's Uñas sucias at the Centro Cultural Ernest Lluch. The political scientist and feminist data writer makes her debut as a novelist with this crime novel.

ac9f41541f0fc04103dcc415b46473ad66dffc54.en: An open rehearsal of iZULOA, a new stage creation by Garazi Egiguren and Inés Osinaga. Audiences watch a show take shape, with body, movement, words, live music and video about invisible bodies and memory.

d9ddbb1d487f42ba6525530ee549d55626386942.en: Titizé – A Venetian dream by Compagnia Finzi Pasca at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia is a wordless visual show. Clown, acrobatics and stage machines bring a dreamlike Venice to life, with eleven artists.

c7d2e90aeae4ac29d97eeed5c73f076ffd4c8dfb.en: Dinosaur Pile-Up, an English alternative rock band formed in 2007 by Matt Bigland, plays Dabadaba. Their music combines grunge and power pop, with powerful guitars.

2ab822831cfc677b9d518e1d2fa7682103c52952.en: A guided visit for over-55s to the Museo San Telmo on the museum's history and the canvases of Josep María Sert in the church. It is part of the +55 programme.

6cd910688a84853e5f6e35df6b06a0a23ad596e4.en: A guided visit for over-55s to the Museo San Telmo's historic art collection, starting from the 15th century. It is part of the +55 programme.

ad0f1f60277d7fa5e47c1b179d5c5b2d5ae47fbe.en: El club de los mayores vivos, led by Valeriano Pache Perianes at the Centro Cultural Okendo, is a wellbeing activity for older people. It works on reducing suffering, reusing experience and renewing emotional education, with registration from 2 November.

fe3eca1520bf9bdbf0a178e2927d600325b98f63.en: A literary discussion in Spanish of Jorge Ibargüengoitia's La ley de Herodes at the Okendo cultural centre, led by Ana Merino.

230a3e81d14d7a74b0f6ae2fd5a232f116878264.en: Bidaia galdua by the Orratx theatre group, staged at the Landetxe Kultur Aretoa. Seven women reflect on their own journeys while they wait for the train of life, and a discussion club follows.

5597814f664d6a5badec2a2a1439a5abd6f672cb.en: A guided visit to the exhibition Mauricio Antón. Arte y Paleontología at the Museo San Telmo, led by scientific illustrator Vega Asensio.

983dea6b566ab5ab6ec38386cbfc5c6377b000f6.en: Atlas_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz at Tabakalera is a hands-on lettering workshop using transfer letters. Participants look at letters as graphic forms, play with them to make images, and finish with a personal project.

97fa2ba792a73eee0c5cea78a401e39d3158b35d.en: IPUIN GOZO ETA GAZIAK is a storytelling session for children aged 4 to 7 at the Lezo library, led by narrator Ines Bengoa.

ead767d58976daba9089bc8eb89467ccd0cf1b62.en: Nosferatu 2026 screens Billy Wilder's 1972 comedy, in which Jack Lemmon plays a conservative American businessman. He travels to Italy to collect his father's body and discovers that his father's lover died with him.

736ca200177d5a80a24eccfe2d82470d5e85cf03.en: A literary discussion of Julen Belamuno's Iragan atergabea at the Centro Cultural Egia, led by Edu Zabala. The book is available in Donostia Kultura libraries.

5f297077f71c8afd1c135d8481584a30da9f1a76.en: Joel Sarakula, an Australian-British singer, plays Dabadaba. His soul pop looks at the present through a 1970s lens, with soft-rock, funk and disco influences.

c15024d3f50b4a2bd1932ca042e0ef11cf344b0f.en: La última cena, a play directed by Josema Langara and staged by Kemen Antzerki Taldea at the Centro Cultural Intxaurrondo. It is a comedy about the dreaded company dinner, and what not to do there.

4ce41fa32f3f58a53c259b852d0aada6f328fb3c.en: Jo, by Magma mia at the Sala Imanol Larzabal in Lugaritz, follows two old friends who meet again unexpectedly. Through sport and absurd situations, they carry out an anthropological study of their own life stories.

8a1e0b069acbee5da21d09d188433666abf3d32f.en: Quatuor Béla play the Victoria Eugenia Club on 26 November as part of the Contemporary Music Circuit. The programme includes works by Basque composers Jon Esnaola and Pablo Franchelli, along with Alvin Singleton and György Kurtág.

c53c26094a1b191730f065a191cd1bb3e517268e.en: Feliz día by the Argentine company Sutottos, staged at the Biteri Kultur Etxea. Twin brothers celebrate their 40th birthday at their mother's house, in a comedy about the pressure to be happy.

88958a8e50e092183e073557f7fd03efc0421527.en: Volver a casa tan tarde, a 2025 documentary by Celia Viada, is screened at Tabakalera. It follows the writer María Luisa Elío, who returned to Spain in 1970 after three decades of exile in Mexico.

2b59cb82c88a5f119ab3987a84a5c2efb5046282.en: 43º13'44''N at the Kutxa Fundazioa Kluba is a performance and documentary piece by Olatz Gorrotxategi. She searches family and collective memory, and the work includes testimonies from twelve people.

ea6409d3ef5a17b542803b103d9e1044ed9577e9.en: LEVITANTS, a Valladolid alternative rock band, plays Dabadaba on 26 November. Post-punk intensity meets synth atmospheres and strong melodies.

95e435d494e85c7e0d0f570e1bc8f652b522e210.en: HDEH2026 is a session at the Habian Torrekua building on our digital consumption, in Basque. It looks at Basque-language digital content and disinformation, and aims to open a space for reflection.

217a305b99c34e4d6f74f3362465ccba0f3bfa7a.en: Babel-17. Euskararen hiperstizio fabrika at the Museo San Telmo combines a short film, dialogue and a collective performance. It uses Samuel R. Delany's 1966 novel Babel-17 to imagine a future for the Basque language.

6e67b8239206c0c3ee372c28b1a3d48819acde09.en: Un poema del dolor, by Manuel Pineda, is presented as part of the HI Hiriko idazleak programme.

e29aef91f1664590612e3d8b34f805ce1d60fe19.en: Bafi presents the album Etxeko loturak at the Centro Cultural Casares-Tomasene. Adrian Perez recorded the Basque-language acoustic rock album in autumn 2025 at the Tolare studio in Egia.

67d9c65a6b8a6e22c13e60bed1230af4b1811a0d.en: Donostia Bertsotan 2026 at the Sala Imanol Larzabal brings together improvising bertsolariak Maialen Lujanbio, Nerea Ibarzabal, Amets Arzallus and Aitor Mendiluze. Iker Iriarte hosts the event.

4ffdf121604e4e1480339c85a9ad22e276a53c21.en: Feminissimas, by Esther F. at the Bastero Kulturgunea, follows three teenage friends who meet after years apart. They hold very different views on feminism, and the play is a black comedy about friendship and ideology.

de9b5c66f43d390171cf678910ce55136a29eaa5.en: Ciclo Bibra 2026 presents Brava and Lorea Argarate at the Kutxa Fundazioa Kluba. Brava mixes punk, hardcore and rap with club styles such as footwork, grime and jungle, and speaks of anger, sexuality and vulnerability.

b3ee84d3aa4569260116525300a6c277a158681e.en: The Nikita Sipiagin 4tet, led by the New York-born saxophonist, plays the Altxerri Jazz Club. Formed in 2022 with musicians from the US, France and Spain, the quartet plays New York-style jazz and standards from the American Songbook.

513b8909811eb7753e023e14b2de127d4da9dfb8.en: Maika Makovski, a singer and instrumentalist born in Mallorca, plays Dabadaba. Her music blends alternative rock, folk and experimental sounds.

fa08121fd6a1b5ee6c51c58df47c85b413cfdabe.en: A concert night at the Lekuona Fabrika with Brigade Loco, Hell Beer Boys, Against You and Arene 6.

b1921204ea66ed8dcc3718b06c23b940e5ae6f5f.en: A workshop at Tabakalera on using data to tell stories beyond screens. Participants see examples, build participatory prototypes and learn how communities can take part in data work.

06573d8a85783acc25ada0f9f5a711807876ce9d.en: Matinée de Miramon 5, Eguzkilore, is a chamber concert in the Euskadiko Orkestra season. The programme includes Mozart's oboe quartet K. 370 and flute quartet K. 285, with works by Pujanek and Süssmayr.

be7b83cc57d8e43091af38b83ac7b73776ef7a69.en: Liban/guerre, by Rania Stephan (2006), and A drone story, by Laura Menassa (2024), are screened at the Museo San Telmo. A talk with Margaux Chalançon and Palmira Sabaté follows, on the diary as testimony and on restoring images from war.

c904e9585fca3076dd4ec74c2133848e08524e7a.en: Petites histoires sans paroles, by Brice Coupey, is a glove-puppet show at the Juanba Berasategi Aretoa. Three short pieces, including Histoire du Sac and Petit Sisyphe, are played with live improvised jazz by Jean-Luc Ponthieux.

1c2ef1780e9c19fe0473e75e8ad94b433b287f9f.en: NUUR, a performing arts show in the Kameleoiak family series, follows a soul from the innocence of play to the vertigo of emotions. Movement, music and light tell a universal story about life.

46be99130f244ffa7befcdecab7a93a55621e1d4.en: Mia et le lion blanc, a French film by Gilles de Maistre, is screened at the Centro Cultural Aiete. A girl who moves from London to Africa forms a bond with a wild lion and crosses the savannah to save him.

96bbe3dd1e8c0fbece416236a9fa89e09d774a11.en: Epa Txiki by Demode Quartet is a children's musical show at the Sala Imanol Larzabal in Lugaritz. The four comics play wild versions of classic Basque songs, arguing that all musical styles come from Basque folklore.

21a4a580d1bbd15c4d5e25be0acbe4fb645d6b26.en: J.J. Vaquero, the Spanish comedian, plays the Kursaal on 28 November with a monologue that changes from day to day. Guitarist Carlos Martín 'Catos' joins him, and the show uses videos and slides.

1eabb4b490f08e2ebc72f6c867d4c43b066ee8d2.en: Ensemble Les Surprises and soprano Véronique Gens pay tribute to the queens of 18th-century French opera at the Kursaal. The programme of arias, dances and choruses by Rameau, Destouches, Dauvergne and Gluck is conducted by Louis-Noël Bestion de Camboulas.

f7bb0de77cb0bac5985d81f559492433167f2b12.en: Muerta de amor, by Manuel Liñán, is a dance piece for twelve artists at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia. It explores the human need to connect, with copla-like choreography and singer Juan de la María.

6e4165ae477428b66ef9d726ecf596edf5819dd5.en: Gaza: Doctors Under Attack is a documentary that won a 2026 BAFTA for current affairs, screened at the Centro Cultural Casares-Tomasene. It gives testimony from doctors and health staff in Gaza, followed by a discussion with the Gernika-Palestina network.

1725ac49cd115f76a4b13c628a218e2346cbadf0.en: Ibantuta, a musician who travelled through 12 Silk Road countries, plays the Centro Cultural Ernest Lluch. He worked with around 40 musicians on string instruments, led by the oud, and his album Zetaren bideak musika hariak honours ancient traditions.

680600ae7ba7687bd7c9e497a43b0e72af8c76e2.en: Lutxi eta zuhaitza is a documentary by Lander Garro about the ETA militant Lucía Urigoitia, who died in Pasaia in 1987 at the hands of the Guardia Civil. It draws on testimony from the family lawyer and the forensic doctor.

b80f0ccb3b83ecf0efb5f73218f45ce501ef1fef.en: Zinecittà 2026, the Italian film festival that began in Bilbao in 2016, comes to San Sebastián for the first time from 27 to 29 November. Its films at Tabakalera include La ciociara, Gloria by Margherita Vicario and Il lungo viaggio on Franco Battiato.

4583849393082d5329af8f43a3534e4182a5165f.en: Maruxak, a travesti collective founded in 2019 in Mendillorri, Pamplona, plays the Kutxa Fundazioa Kluba on 11 November as part of Bibra 2026. It mixes drag, music and Basque tradition to rebuild folklore from a queer and community perspective.

f33a19dafe1c49cbdf9310c538fdd6b64a9405e8.en: Alejandro Mingot and Miguel Villar's quartet plays the Altxerri Jazz Club in Donostia.

4be688df6af0d1e458ab00b8526a913daca427f5.en: Lie Detectors and Garbayo play Dabadaba on 28 November.

284f9753039b2c5f8aeea4d033284ccfdd88d7b1.en: Josetxu Piperrak and Arpaviejas play Lekuona Fabrika on 28 November.

342ad07c1cd69f0216b6eee8aea8a25828598e5d.en: David Suárez's stand-up show Humor blanco at the Kursaal is an hour of dark humour from the Galician comedian. It covers his controversies, sex, trials and ageing.

73db5b4a9b38f62c171006acbc4f4d2983569bc2.en: 7 urte, by Vidania Teatro, is staged at the Teatro Principal, directed by Agurtzane Intxaurraga. Four partners meet on the eve of a police raid over tax fraud, with a mediator present, in a play by José Cabeza.

bc5a470d57935e76b7518878dbe39f8b7f845c85.en: Exacticamente diversa by Ezezagunok is a surreal inner journey at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia, inspired by Alice in Wonderland. The large amateur cast won the 2026 Max award for amateur or social theatre.

f7aa32155e4a5679568baf069fbd13d7f1d60e9f.en: Un sorbito de champán is a tribute to the Spanish pop band Los Brincos, marking 60 years since the song of that name. Félix Arribas leads the band, and Lys Pardo honours her father, Juan Pardo, a founder member.

2e6d56db1a38036f908a52f3c3ddb85292cb4c8b.en: Me too, directed by Aitor Gabilondo at the Centro de Artes Escénicas Sarobe, has Tessa and Ainhoa explain the new wave of feminism and its many terms. They reflect on living through this exciting time.

353157133a688d82b8aacf8d864afbf0089caa20.en: Artantxuriketan at the Landetxe Kultur Aretoa recreates the corn-husking nights of Basque farmhouses, when old songs and stories were shared. Maixux Zugarramurdi and his three daughters, the Ansa sisters, perform it.

acbeb381bc9def026c4dd2021b563c7b33601e91.en: Este himno llevará la palabra euforia by La Intrusa at Gazteszena is a theatre hymn about vital impulse and collective support. It is created by Virginia García and Damián Muñoz with seven performers.

f82fb280d50cc3be15eb5c6c16d79da89c73448e.en: Beavers, a folk-bluegrass trio from Ariège, plays the Altxerri Jazz Club. Mandolin, guitar, double bass and harmonised voices bring Kentucky-style songs about love, work and history, from their 2025 album The Gist of Things.

9850e959fd0241ecc6cd169ad34ef8af1e28639a.en: KLUBAK at the KMK library runs its Spanish reading group on 30 November with Gabriela Cabezón Cámara's Las niñas del naranjel. The ten-book programme for 2026-2027 is led by Mónica Leiva.

13b5a08101ce193f8dc68092ed4df986213da6e0.en: The documentary human rights festival in Errenteria runs from 30 November to 5 December 2026 at Niessen Zinemak. Its fifth edition takes short documentaries up to 60 minutes, and the call for entries closes on 11 October.

2e22acfb22f90f6435d4f98a2d7be15028d3257e.en: El Cascanueces at the Cines Niessen is Peter Wright's production for The Royal Ballet, set in a Victorian home. Clara's Nutcracker takes her to the Kingdom of Sweets, to Tchaikovsky's score, and the film runs 140 minutes.

c3f6fe7a665d8af1361a7448378fbb48a331e3b1.en: Estitxu Villamor Lomas, an EHU professor and researcher on renewable energy, gives a talk on the energy transition at the Centro Cultural Ernest Lluch. Ana Galarraga introduces the talk, part of the Emakume zientzialarien argitan cycle.

679bc645ad176d7e6d705c2fc872bdb498831230.en: Pupa, pupita, pupila. Un masaje visual is a one-hour show in the OFNI theatre cycle at the Kutxa Fundazioa Kluba. Audience members lie on a couch with closed eyes for a gentle visual massage that feels like a dream.

99ba2759df3bbca96419357db071957acd7dc790.en: A guided visit for over-55s to the Huellas en la memoria hall at the Museo San Telmo, which traces Basque history from prehistory to the 18th century. María Sánchez leads the morning visit and Juan Mari Pérez the afternoon one.

13f9c7db0a2e26f11a75fbac8e9cbabe912b7fb3.en: Mintzodromoa offers Basque-language practice sessions for adults who are new speakers. The topics link to the museum's programme, and registration is by email.

e0c0dcb7d3f1e41c1632bf18289201ac00a67c4a.en: Primera plana, Billy Wilder's adaptation of the Ben Hecht and Charles MacArthur play, is screened at Tabakalera as part of Nosferatu 2026. In Chicago in 1929 a condemned man waits in the press room, while a reporter tries to quit and marry.

0f059ea21f0683d2fb845d2f3976c9531fb14572.en: Bilintx orain dela 150 urteko Donostian is a talk marking 150 years since the death of Indalezio Bizkarrondo, Bilintx, the great bertsolari of San Sebastián. Luzia Alberro and Xabier Euzkitze speak about his work, and the event is streamed.

994a2d20005bc4a14d6debeb8ecaf3ed3c332640.en: 3 + 3 = 33 by Verdini Dantza Taldea is a dance piece at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia. Dancers with and without Down syndrome share the stage, and the piece treats difference as a creative force.

b560cabfe6bc99b31672b34e1144e6af2d8e9096.en: Nortasun agiria, the third solo show by Zuhaitz Gurrutxaga, is staged at the Centro de Artes Escénicas Sarobe. It draws on real experiences, including a painful breakup, the difficulty of being a good Basque, and obsessive-compulsive disorder.

a33dd5f4c3bbc9ef72796b79f26f1bbb480a4e2a.en: Neal Sugarman, an American saxophonist from The Dap-Kings, plays Dabadaba. He leads The Sugarman 3 in the spirit of classic soul, funk and jazz from the 1960s and 1970s.

045602bd41bb66930396318086a8623acc0a1e8a.en: Txondor plaza is a street theatre and circus show at the Landetxe Kultur Aretoa. It revives the memory of the charcoal makers of Navarran valleys, with theatre, circus skills, music and puppets.

eadd412bcc91dbd4c38a4a011ebf956793631e2e.en: Lamine Thior's show Más que palabras at the Sala Imanol Larzabal mixes classic comedy with improvisation and dialogue with the audience. Topics include generations, ChatGPT and the Royal Spanish Academy.

75ea733bf2392f102a125fc9fe597d56c2eb50ae.en: The Francesco Zampini Trio plays the Altxerri Jazz Club with its third album, Somewhere, everywhere. The Italian guitarist, a bass player and a drummer explore the album's songs.

f4a24a3e61102dc651ff74c1790588ac2593dbb6.en: Frente Abierto, an Andalusian collective led by Marco Serrato, plays Dabadaba. It blends flamenco singing with dark rock, doom metal and experimental sound.

71636aa7c97166d743f13ed441beb9847d654b8d.en: CANDLELIGHT Donostia presents a 60-minute candlelit concert at the Aquarium-Palacio del Mar, playing hits by Coldplay and Imagine Dragons. It is for ages 8 and over.

1f264293b4cdaea73be85d41196601ec6e05009c.en: CANDLELIGHT Donostia presents a 60-minute candlelit concert of Vivaldi's Four Seasons and La Folia at the Aquarium-Palacio del Mar. It is for ages 8 and over.

d719479012d5893cb93d6dcbac7fa5f8121b9fc5.en: Ara Malikian plays the Kursaal on 5 December. The violinist moves from Bach and Paganini to rock, flamenco and Middle Eastern melodies, moving and joking with the audience.

b16da860287235aaf8db894de99fc75c1eaa4fb6.en: WE, nosotros y los tiempos, by María Muñoz and Pep Ramis at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia, shares a poetic language with twelve performers of different ages. Based on John Berger's poem Separation, it explores migration, the loss of place and the act of walking.

89ef8ef8fa282af08c63d2f2feb0f1959291237e.en: The Nico Wayne Toussaint Trio plays the Altxerri Jazz Club in a blues night.

176b7daa19337900bce9973ac987aa715f39f416.en: Las Bajas Pasiones, a Barcelona band, plays Dabadaba. Their mix of punk, rock and electronics addresses love and social issues with a direct emotional voice.

a52bfc78499930f5a7762f8ee838a45d2e9e8102.en: The cast of the 13th season of the Basque children's series Goazen performs at the Teatro Principal. A music school's new Basque base brings new students into chaos, for ages 6 and over.

0f60e264aade1313d433c31d3b498de14e203540.en: Redondo analyses the luxury art market of the Renaissance, which grew from courts and merchants and linked Flanders with Castile. The talk starts from a 16th-century Magdalene from the Prado, as part of the monthly work series at the Museo San Telmo.

a48951d1bfd443e756c8593be9d3c75240670892.en: El Gran Show del Rey León at the Kursaal features 24 cast members who sing live, with dance and special effects. The 90-minute musical is staged with humour, and children under 12 must be accompanied by a companion aged 16 or over.

694591b6eba4ee19d1a026587c56cd4ec6a7986f.en: A conversation with filmmaker Gala Hernández López, part of the POV series. She discusses how the internet shapes imagination and desire, including misogynist drifts among young people, with clips and web pages.

ae5c324fee5483995920becd6fdfa5e16c9558ef.en: Mengers, a trio from Mexico City, plays Dabadaba. Their sound mixes garage rock, punk and psychedelia, with raw and experimental energy inspired by urban life.

70d9820826c80af0d79608a2e9ed635c81aecee2.en: El amor que permanece, a 2025 film by Hlynur Pálmason, is screened at Tabakalera. It follows a year in a family whose parents are separating, with bittersweet moments that pass with the seasons.

7876fad2605d857da43b4ac0458d686df2530377.en: A literary discussion in Basque on Mariana Travacio's Barkamena existituko balitz bezala at the Lezo library, led by Ane Mayoz.

4aad6f37945b8ecd7bf2ed7cf9902c133f5cdc93.en: A guided dialogue visit in Spanish to the KOOPERATIBA exhibition at Tabakalera. Sessions last an hour, led by a mediator, and no prior knowledge is needed. They run through the autumn, including a talk by artist Taxio Ardanaz on 4 November.

ba0618447e97bffda82203c7de2cf246cfbb2c7c.en: Nosferatu 2026 screens Billy Wilder's Fedora (1978), in which a Hollywood star retired in Europe ends her life under a train. At her funeral, a producer recalls his last meeting with her in Corfu.

6c5890a727830d3d03fc7cebd340dcd5dee6a702.en: Contar lo vivido, a 2026 book by Maider Maraña, gathers the voices of people who suffered politically motivated violence in the Basque Country. The author and some of the victims talk about memory and coexistence.

c948504d286caeb2f6a4c57a675506fe80d95c8f.en: Mi gran obra by David Espinosa is a miniature theatre show, staged at the Kutxa Fundazioa Kluba. The stage is built at a scale that fits in a suitcase, and each session has three rows of twenty spectators, followed by a discussion.

86803155bd9ee7abe6613c927cb80d158a485762.en: Itzulera, by Dejabu, is a comic road movie at the Biteri Kultur Etxea. Three theatre makers travel to Mexico to interview Basque emigrants, and their journey is upended by an unexpected event and a chihuahua.

0c52693836b0a3c93ebaf7a1883c6434778777fe.en: Una transformación social en marcha is a day on immigration, reflecting on personal experiences and tested data about its effects on coexistence, culture and the economy. Luisa Etxenike moderates.

f1e2187572b5971b0c91ad46a65c70b66d3b67e7.en: Løse, a new band led by Diego Vasallo, plays Dabadaba with twilight rock from Gipuzkoa.

c31c086bc5168351db90a9f24b8a73d7cce9bb6b.en: Estudios abiertos at Tabakalera is the second open-studio day of its artists' space. Ten resident artists, including Eduarda Camargo and Leyre Arana, show their projects.

96005a0959d4092e495e5764afba22fbd31d7585.en: Prudenen Bidaia at the Gezala Auditorium combines music and puppet theatre. In a dark room with light effects, the ant Pruden makes a journey of self-discovery, a metaphor for growing inner potential.

6a272ddd77f6f2357e83034d60a103799f87bc8d.en: 013 Origen by Juan Amodeo is a stand-up show at the Sala Imanol Larzabal. Amodeo returns to the uncensored child he was, with honesty and humour.

13f13b52aeb1db961551f828b4d0d98123d9d4b4.en: 52 hercios at the Bastero Kulturgunea takes its title from a whale that calls at a frequency no other whale can hear. The play uses this lonely whale as a metaphor for unwanted isolation, in poetic and choreographic images.

40baf83a5872b3745c3723adfdce85dd15944e76.en: Erromintxelak is a Basque-language swing band formed in Arrasate in 2021. It plays at the Kutxa Fundazioa Kluba, presenting its first album Nork Erran Eni, and its single Esperoan has won awards.

2102251477cd8eb4ef9c02b671c45dec652bf30f.en: Astronauts, a trio of cello, trumpet and keyboard, plays the Altxerri Jazz Club with its first album, Manuscrito de Voynich. The songs contrast with one another, and the group has no leader.

55777bd0a760b9f664374b351ed859a3be126c68.en: Niña Pastori plays the Kursaal on 11 December with her album COLOR FANIA. The flamenco singer reinterprets classic salsa from Fania Records, combining Latin music with flamenco.

aac6fa7bd6adc9e635a5103a2dac6d179fd40a05.en: Bolo-Bolo Weekend 2026 takes place at the Centro Cultural Intxaurrondo on 11 and 12 December. Two nights of rock, pop-rock and electro-punk bring together established bands, Basque-language groups and young talent, many of them with women members.

13387d6dcdaf755159666aecee00b9888f6a7976.en: Matinée de Miramon 6, by Camerata Iberia, is part of the Euskadiko Orkestra chamber series. The programme includes works by Górecki and Britten, and Shostakovich's Eighth String Quartet in an arrangement.

4c8d9d19cba9e36b94a968b20d9ab8f4e47e663f.en: The flamenco singing contest at the Teatro Principal is organised by Camelamos Adiquerar. After the contestants perform, the invited artist of the year takes the stage.

c16ae358a5e4e2480e86fbeb279a4d4870674e57.en: La Traviata at the Kursaal is Verdi's opera in three acts, with a libretto by Piave based on Dumas's La dame aux camélias. The Excelentia Vocal Ensemble and Orquesta Clásica Santa Cecilia perform, under José Luis López-Antón.

34f1383ff5f7177b950bfc9c153d5cc260f5b536.en: La Reina del Arga tells the story of Remigia Echarren, a Pamplona tightrope walker, 100 years after her death. Estefanía de Paz Asín uses archive research and invention to bring her to life at the Sala Imanol Larzabal.

890f62188690a49b498255b294728158b2640257.en: Oskarbi plays 60 urte kantuan at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia on 12 December. The singer marks 60 years in Basque song, with about a thousand concerts and thirteen albums.

46d1906f6623d2340e69da3f309e62dddbaa9495.en: Duo Signal, a saxophone and trombone duo, plays the Museo San Telmo as part of Musikagileak. The programme includes Pedro González's Azpian, inspired by the sacking of Donostia in 1813.

f522abbc9d7f7a92db0b31bbab43966855cd6315.en: Duo Signal plays a concert in the church of the Museo San Telmo. The programme includes the premiere of Azpian, a work by Pedro González commissioned by Musikagileak.

8b50f6f1fca5aed7e7df10c552f421b49cf94e79.en: Argazki bat behelainoan and Geminiss are emerging local artists in the Katapulta Tour Gipuzkoa 2026, open to all audiences.

38ca572f7b14b97b8ebf291e882649ecf4de9f34.en: Zombie Jaialdia 2026 at the Centro Cultural Larratxo replaces two cancelled bands with Tierra Santa and Hijos de Overón. Lordwitch from Bergara opens the heavy metal night, which is part of the 14th edition of the festival.

72d6c74caf9293d8a7c8ed15059cc48328186ba1.en: AIKO EL GRUPO plays Dabadaba on 12 December.

44b4aa31e6557c2d08479fd489bf0bf7f4458c9c.en: CANDLELIGHT Donostia's Clásicos de Navidad is a 60-minute candlelit concert at the Aquarium-Palacio del Mar. The Sugarra string quartet plays Christmas classics, for ages 8 and over.

6a9df61314af1d83cd0b0f714e8da17f68e5842f.en: Musi+meet is a day of talks at the Museo San Telmo on creating and sharing contemporary music. It presents a book on the thematic projects of San Telmo and Musikagileak from 2013 to 2023, and ends with the premiere of Azpian.

6a98d78a25bfedf54c7c6944efe1e02d11f9da9a.en: Mamuka by Elirale is a dance piece for ages 3 and over. Based on Pantxika Telleria's world of hidden creatures, the duo plays a children's game of hiding and reappearing.

41ef7d821d08b9829edba60971c7e81ed75e4730.en: Bajau by Ponten Pie is a show at the Kutxa Fundazioa Kluba within Zir Zir Hara 2026. It takes its theme from the Bajau sea people and from the idea that we begin life in water, with much of the show in water.

b64fb9ad48f3ddb0e104098c70f429ed7fbd9157.en: Ismael Serrano performs a 135-minute intimate concert with just guitar and voice at the Kursaal. It covers his greatest hits and a first look at new songs.

042612ea883e0ce06842f1bf584347cdea0d6110.en: Macy Gray's The Trouble With The Truth Tour at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia presents her new album of R&B and soul. Her voice and funky spirit carry the music.

7787dcf60deeae6920e28339f40105978ad333d8.en: Zanbuila by Lolak kolektiboa at the Gezala Auditorium follows Itziar, a 39-year-old nurse in an existential crisis. She meets an older woman and her daughter, and begins to rethink her life, with stories drawn from interviews with coastal women.

d11e270d0ebbfd94f7ca68470124e707c4c37aa4.en: Fake Cousins play the Altxerri Jazz Club.

470a4c84a2ef6a8e8ebc848c90c29b1f46e8aa08.en: Tony Putaggio, a neoflamenco guitarist trained in Bayonne, plays the Altxerri Jazz Club. His instrumental concert draws on Paco de Lucía and Vicente Amigo and mixes Andalusian tradition with contemporary influences.

ff2ca77fcd2ca87bb285b9fdbbb4cb95566a4f71.en: Tasha & Tracie, twin sisters from São Paulo, play Dabadaba. Their hip-hop, rap, trap and Brazilian funk speaks of identity, Black culture and life in the outskirts.

4309f9c7f9ab743ec6effd2eced41e2a2e4e19fa.en: Eddington, a 2025 film by Ari Aster, is screened at the Biteri Kultur Etxea as part of the Hernani film club. A clash between a small-town sheriff and the mayor sets off chaos in New Mexico, and the film runs 145 minutes.

efe7ba4ecfaddf3e3f45064cc9b1e0a3b46ad616.en: Juana by Jon Artano is a travel book published by Elkar in 2023. It follows Juana Perea Plata, a Basque sailor and diver who was killed in 2020, and the writer's trail through Colombia to find out who killed her and why.

86c0c305a937c6e0ac85cafe8824ab72cbcffb49.en: Buddy, Buddy, Billy Wilder's last film from 1981, closes the Nosferatu 2026 cycle at Tabakalera. Jack Lemmon and Walter Matthau star as a hitman who hides in a hotel opposite a courthouse, until his neighbour tries to take his own life.

1e64b71a61d362e549e2e994fceaa1f53164b55e.en: Collegium Vocale Gent, conducted by Philippe Herreweghe, performs Bach's Christmas Oratorio at the Kursaal. The choir combines contrapuntal clarity with dramatic and festive expression.

f3b5677b68b351f8c42ddb5402072a86b8c9a312.en: The João Barreto Trio plays the Altxerri Jazz Club. The young Portuguese pianist and composer leads original pieces and jazz versions of Portuguese folk songs, in a European contemporary style.

6b8657c3697462a15bdf763a6603f4be0de21bb9.en: The congress Joxe Azurmendi. Euskal pentsamenduaren ur-jauzia II takes place at the EHU Gipuzkoa campus from 16 to 18 December. About 150 speakers take part in 40 sessions on Basque thought, moved from the Museo San Telmo to the Centro Carlos Santamaría.

eb1c6dd97e0f7ad951fdd077de13dfacb4efe88e.en: Ecos de la tierra is a documentary with six women who lead struggles against extractive capitalism in El Salvador, Colombia, sub-Saharan Africa and the Mediterranean. It is followed by a discussion, and the film links ecofeminism, care and justice.

b75cac9417255609f3f629e799c54b7952308c26.en: 1TZ4L1 3T4 P1ZTU at the Biteri Kultur Etxea brings live electronic music together with improvised bertsolaritza. Under the Lagunekin bai cycle, bertsolariak and musicians explore friendship and transfeminism in Basque.

cff3c2267ca4b870adfa71a829a0db4758628cad.en: Virginia Riezu's monologue Poderío at the Sala Imanol Larzabal tells of women who stop apologising for being themselves. It covers ageing, motherhood, fertility and self-acceptance, with humour and no preaching.

019634a0d093d5acc193d9b856e63e3c9b237c0d.en: Alex Ubago marks the 25th anniversary of Qué pides tú at the Kursaal on 18 December. The concert is part of the Super Amara charity Christmas show, and it supports ASEBIER, the Basque rare diseases association.

6473f82b15d5f3834a14a755193846af68f7c7a2.en: The Paul San Martin Quartet plays the Altxerri Jazz Club. Paul San Martin sings and plays piano, with a tenor saxophone, bass and drums.

e622c95ce79516af26d386efd34b262c9faba310.en: 12 CM, the 31st edition of the small-format art exhibition, is held at the Pasai San Pedro municipal hall. It is organised each year by the Pasaia council.

b3dadf424e791bd131f4c0bdaa7c1ec263d50623.en: Abentura Historiaurrean, a 2020 Chinese animated film by Leon Ding, is screened at the Museo San Telmo. Two bears are trapped in the past, surrounded by hungry animals and a human tribe.

fd30d655241865156c0b7c7782d5609ac0e0c510.en: Tretatxu, from the group Anita Maravillas & Portal 71, tells of a bandit who grows from a hungry child into the most admired thief in his land, for all audiences. It is staged at the Sala Imanol Larzabal.

80e3907aaa7a03219c00daf509abca45e6ea98f8.en: Jeanette celebrates 50 years of career at the Kursaal on 19 December. Her songs, including Soy rebelde, Por qué te vas and Corazón de poeta, are reinterpreted by a band with a stage design.

0df435e564bbbb7af38a2dd5652874d6f7526192.en: Afines by Marcat Dance is a duet at Gazteszena. Two dancers speak one movement language, drawing close and pulling apart, and the piece takes its theme from Kae Tempest's idea that creativity connects people.

8df476959db5e3e9277794162c4d525fb3bec427.en: The Ocón/Chandler 4tet, led by Álvaro Ocón and Dylan Chandler, plays the Altxerri Jazz Club. The group brings original tunes, with bassist Jon Carranza and drummer David Gimeno joining them.

6c5a4ec94a91c9885887d5e9d6e36c8393a9c8c9.en: NEOMAK, a band that mixes Basque folklore and electronics, plays Lekuona Fabrika on 19 December. The group, now made up of four women, presents its album Lazturak Orbain and has toured Japan, South Korea and the United States.

04325047fbc1f1db68cae99ff897a95d089f5790.en: Ezpalak, a Basque band, plays the Centro Cultural Intxaurrondo with a guest band. The concert marks a break from the stage after six years, four studio albums and a live double album.

aded6c0072a14a8c2ac8b12e8a298bff89997c4f.en: Inolvidable is a homage to Rocío Dúrcal at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia. Her daughter Carmen Morales is asked to star in a musical about her mother, and she reads the script with its writer. Morales and Alejandro Vera sing the songs live.

7cb587761eeb9dd7c9e7278cf15840a4ee414db3.en: El Gran Showman, the musical based on the film about P.T. Barnum, plays the Kursaal. A team of 26 actors, singers, dancers and acrobats recreates the film's best moments with live voices.

b7c8a806577447b3c229bb9a582963ff81c67a5c.en: Ultrashow by Miguel Noguera at the Sala Imanol Larzabal is a solo comedy monologue. He presents ideas from his daily notebook and drawings, using projected images, with improvised digressions.

1b5c3a1f8920aa4f536a8985e3009908dbdda72c.en: So in love by Ainara Ortega and Joaquín Chacón is a voice-and-guitar album presentation at the Teatro Principal. Pablo Martín Caminero on double bass and Bobby Martínez on tenor sax join them.

71e33f09d3ae3279d60442a626633757e15cdc41.en: ISPIRIT, led by the voices of Noa Eguiguren, Lidia Insausti and Lide Hernando, presents Aretha Gospel at the Landetxe Kultur Aretoa. The show honours Aretha Franklin's legacy with gospel songs rooted in African American music.

71640c485c0c770ce2fe4416aa384b1cc4b4c6ef.en: Peiremans+ play Dabadaba on 20, 26 and 27 December. Gorka Urbizu, Imanol Ubeda, Marino Goñi and Txiki plan a tour of about seven concerts, after which the project goes quiet for years again.

2fcc9ca60780a9eea4400d5c129d2ca3d6525a43.en: 3 elementu by Hodei Magoa, at the Centro de Artes Escénicas Sarobe, is an immersive 360-degree magic show for 40 people. It follows creativity, curiosity and passion, which we lose as we grow up, and it is for ages 7 and over.

fa3f92bfbd3fc381c0a02d71ed2d398eea74bc7b.en: The 3 elementu show by Hodei Magoa, held at the Sarobe at 18:30. The immersive magic show seats 40 people per session and is for ages 7 and over.

5dba8e37cf4a3ed03030cf278ddace75daa5d908.en: Musikagileak 2026 presents Miguel Ángel Acebo at the Victoria Eugenia Club on 22 December. The programme is inspired by Scriabin's late works and notebooks, with pieces by Jesús Torres, Jon Esnaola, López Balada, Gabriel Erkoreka and Francisco Domínguez.

b78f56f4288bc14fa396ed950cc7ddbc40d99f8d.en: The 3 elementu show by Hodei Magoa, held at the Sarobe at 19:30. The immersive magic show seats 40 people per session and is for ages 7 and over.

ed73bd8c628b3617b80f3bf4d716b67b94664d9b.en: Buba eta Bubu by Kresala Dantza Taldea is a simple dance show for children at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia. It explores emotions through movement and play, with an animal and two young performers.

0c0e42ab1a574dfbed1f062489098bc45bfae4b5.en: BURUTIK is a pop-rock band formed in Iruñerria in 2020. Two guitars, bass, drums and accordion carry complex harmonies and metaphorical lyrics, and their latest album is Ipuinak.

4c77c44869c6695c7e82d4df66f1c186420e208f.en: Forever, The Best Show about the King of Pop, plays the Kursaal. The 2-hour tribute to Michael Jackson has been seen by more than 1.2 million people, and its producers say three members of the Jackson family have endorsed it.

6bc9452e70ad02dfe937909674a878fc90687e89.en: Pailazo by Txirri, Mirri eta Txiribiton is at the Biteri Kultur Etxea. The clown trio celebrates 50 years, with slapstick and their classic songs.

9e1d32b28e92d68f01c68c5cae74a03db7d720ab.en: Ines Osinaga eta ahizpak at the Juanba Berasategi Aretoa is Osinaga's most personal project. It mixes street parades, batá drums, Cuban music, Latin jazz, afro rhythms and coplas.

b08a82b220fb9d5a970423f06389876f9afc7091.en: Janus Lester plays the Kursaal on 26 December, one of the first dates of a tour for his new album. The staging and band are more ambitious than before.

fbe1b71b9af295df0eaca0ca7032750abeedff23.en: Scrooge eta mamuak by Khea Ziater is a children's play in Basque at the Landetxe Kultur Aretoa. It is a free adaptation of Dickens's A Christmas Carol with actors, puppets and film techniques, for ages 5 and over.

b294c333927a8604edab8a25494a3e0cd63be400.en: The OYE trio, a jazz group based in Barcelona since 2024, plays the Altxerri Jazz Club. The three composer-performers build their music through constant interaction, mixing bebop, free jazz and folk influences.

0a00207f453d47a6de231ea454e62d080e6d0c02.en: The Orquesta Clásica Santa Cecilia, conducted by Kynan Johns, plays a New Year's concert at the Kursaal on 27 December. The programme of waltzes and polkas by the Strauss family includes other composers, and it lasts 90 minutes.

67132e50c98318790c8b338b4173a17f72696ae8.en: The Spolem Girls bring their Christmas Show to the Centro de Artes Escénicas Sarobe. Four singers and a band perform 1960s-style soul, gospel and popular Christmas songs, with close vocal harmonies.

3875a864f5f87dda0ab5d6d2624b15465461ef7a.en: Olaia Inziarte ends the tour of her album Zerrautsa with two concerts at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia on 27 and 28 December. The band plays songs from the album and the earlier 14 + 3 repertoire.

9c4449825ab3077535f8d82356d4d0f98e05281c.en: Gota by Txema Muñoz is a wordless show for ages 5 and over at Gazteszena. Magic and theatre make imaginary rain become rhythms, cups, coins and spoons, directed by Leandre Ribera.

36b98b5297f72b8f1ba1abb5e1891c8c821f3150.en: El Cascanueces by the Tchaikovsky National Ballet is staged at the Kursaal, with Lev Ivanov's original choreography. The two-hour production follows Clara and a Nutcracker, based on Dumas's version of Hoffmann's tale.

4cc3e8fcbb7c30111712df5a3d12c9d628a20aad.en: Só by the Galician company Xampatito Pato is a family show at Gazteszena that blends circus, theatre and juggling. A meticulous character tries to put a pile of boxes in order, and it is for ages 5 and over.

522ea89ae5e6180a773f95770669e6ac17538c15.en: The Alabama Gospel Choir performs Oh happy day at the Kursaal. Its 20 singers move from 19th-century spirituals to freedom songs, with funk and blues rhythms, in a two-hour concert.

b543e0467a9dc74efa4710fc4e7f4c47da18e14b.en: Gala Tchaikovsky, lo mejor del ballet, from the Tchaikovsky National Ballet, is staged at the Kursaal. The programme gathers highlights from Swan Lake and The Nutcracker, including Odette and Odile.

1b7c7a9e6fff0a27b34b37caece0701064df1df9.en: Bele, Lide Hernando's project, presents its second album Muturrez Zerura at the Biteri Kultur Etxea. The record moves from R&B towards 1980s disco, funk and electronic dance, and the concert is in Basque.

fb2cdc152b3aa7a35712c30da3a4f33fee1aca78.en: ABBA Tribute, Masters of Scene, at the Kursaal recreates the Swedish group's story from its Eurovision win in 1974. Costumes, staging and songs such as Mamma Mia and Money, Money, Money fill the two-hour show.

c081eb629745d93e4f018d7852fbc06ffb6a6a1c.en: DJ Symphonic, with the Royal Film Concert Orchestra under Fernando Furones, plays the Kursaal. The orchestra and DJ mix songs by Coldplay, Daft Punk, Queen, Gloria Gaynor and others.

6ed1fbd033f94acd52853b84c37ef68c5c5c24bd.en: Potato plays Dabadaba on 9 January, with Treverb also on the bill.

b95fe8b01cecadcabca8f88439df7c726b555699.en: Malú brings her QUINCE Tour to the Kursaal on 9 January. It follows her most personal album, and she reconciles with the girl who began her career at 15.

b587db46f4c471a2134f7ab7a1aca3a653558ede.en: Amagoia Dragoia, a Basque children's play by Ene Kantak at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia, is based on a book by Nerea Urbizu. Friends travel back to the Middle Ages in Amaiur and face injustice, while a sly dragon has her own plans.

6ddf7f40c9354fc1fd25756bf33b2a9daec31b8a.en: El Lago de los Cisnes by the Tchaikovsky National Ballet is staged at the Kursaal. It tells a love story with the double role of Odette and Odile, and includes one of the best-known pas de deux of the repertoire.

01d19950371685a943a921b8117aea7c1d88ee87.en: KLUBAK at the KMK library runs its Basque reading group on 20 January with Elizabeth Hardwick's Insomnio gauak, part of the 2026-2027 programme.

4e88e7da5225be069d2420b5c26f7e32323daaa8.en: Bach Inspirazio, from the Euskadiko Orkestra, reinvents Bach through works by Elgar, Webern, Vaughan Williams, Holst and Villa-Lobos. Paul Goodwin conducts the programme at the Kursaal.

10cb36ba985b50281130ee5bf59a0daf8d3da7f3.en: Martin Kohlstedt, a German pianist and composer, plays Dabadaba. His atmospheric music mixes contemporary piano, electronics and experimental sound.

102b5fab7fc4a40c6e834e3e9f6a1057c8828ae9.en: Me cuesta tanto olvidarte, a tribute to Mecano, is staged at the Kursaal. It recreates the band's concert, with original arrangements, costumes and choreography, with Belén Alarcón, a lookalike of Ana Torroja, on vocals.

f2ed06f8e960b9c824976155fd6d3f6a87ddd78c.en: Boyanka Kostova, a Galician duo formed in 2016, plays Dabadaba on 15 January 2027. The pioneers of Galician-language trap mix urban music with Galician folklore and a rave-style show.

91f97fadd3e966a4a89d39423dffd35bdc4f5761.en: Matinée de Miramon 7, Irauli, is a chamber concert in the Euskadiko Orkestra season. The programme, Donostia: el sonido del invierno, includes works by Sarriegi arranged by Joaquín Lecumberri.

501a5b8d017408d0e036627b18c7c24149c70c4d.en: Dani Mateo's stand-up show Por qué no te callas at the Kursaal lasts 90 minutes. The Spanish comedian and presenter is known for direct, acid humour.

77e1c84f0772b7288c0d7c2fe509b3b7bd01226d.en: Eñaut Elorrieta presents his album Festina Lente at the Centro Cultural Intxaurrondo. He recorded it with musicians from The National, and the tour also marks 30 years since his first song with Ken Zazpi.

c4f8e9bb5ffea1299258db29d792c85cb0a23ea3.en: HOFE plays the Lekuona Fabrika on 16 January with Naxker. The singer presents the album Bihotzak badaki, a varied record made after a demanding process of experimentation.

51ac8d2ad44745dddb79cb63c7125e403ab98869.en: KLUBAK at the KMK library runs its Basque reading group on 20 January with Elizabeth Hardwick's Insomnio gauak. Participants read the book and discuss it with the group.

c933d28f43e32893213a5207f1811e2a7fcb2d18.en: Def Con Dos, Pandemoldium and The Kraven play the Centro Cultural Intxaurrondo in a three-band night.

f5f70631194689de8fc7c72c40a7e8b43dc4f1fa.en: CANDLELIGHT Donostia presents a 60-minute candlelit concert of Ed Sheeran and Coldplay songs at the Aquarium-Palacio del Mar. It is for ages 8 and over.

f75bf6d368b3bf8e74163bd0eb1fec9c36bc5152.en: Suite Seda and Cosmicar play Dabadaba on 8 February.

df60a9ca509163b11dd82d916943ad7187e6012f.en: Sylwia Salamonska-Baczyk and Teodora Oprisor perform Chopin's 17 songs in their original Polish at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia, as part of the Chopin cycle. The soprano is part of the opera studio of the Zurich Opera.

67e77a8503dfebfb74d2f207654ad46f4382f816.en: The concert by La La Love You, a punk pop band, has moved to 28 January 2027 at the Kursaal. The band has multi-platinum albums and a European MTV award for best Spanish artist.

88fd615652f1816851c0aa4fe07e33f03d0b1870.en: Young Fresh Fellows play Dabadaba on 28 January.

ea9af924bc5f075a68c94f406bdedd2404f337d3.en: Musikagileak 2026 presents the vocal ensemble Kea at the Museo San Telmo, as part of the Musikagileak circuit.

63cdee30ee6a7b26f612059083998c77d12dc5db.en: CANDLELIGHT Donostia presents Queen VS. ABBA, a 60-minute candlelit concert at the Aquarium-Palacio del Mar, for ages 8 and over. It plays hits by both bands, including Dancing Queen and Bohemian Rhapsody.

5bfb9bd5a762cc6d8220ab8e001d82997a61562c.en: Ruper Ordorika and Mugalariak play the Teatro Victoria Eugenia on 31 January. They perform the eleven songs of the album Lurra ikutu barik, and the concert includes highlights from his career of over 40 years.

d5b86f50066a377d61ffff48496b3c8709b466d6.en: KLUBAK at the KMK library runs its Spanish reading group with Irene Solà's Canto yo y la montaña baila on 1 February, part of the 2026-2027 programme.

84f679ca8dd704328129658b8f668bcf3409b822.en: Sara Perarnaud, a 20-year-old pianist from San Sebastián, plays Chopin's Piano Concerto No. 1 in a version for string quartet. Musikene students first play the first 12 preludes, as part of the Chopin cycle.

14e5f10649bd46db570d4565ca9513e9cce21fdc.en: Sho-Hai, a rapper and songwriter from Zaragoza, plays Dabadaba. He is one of the leading figures in Spanish hip-hop, with direct, witty lyrics that mix reflection, social critique and humour.

f5ea5a7d1023a003bf1a4814d9bf6403e0d1dd4f.en: Matinée de Miramon 8 by the Clasijazz Quintet, from the Euskadiko Orkestra chamber season, celebrates the music of Claude Bolling. The programme includes his Toot Suite and a suite for flute trio and jazz piano.

bca0b07cfa8cc720d452c2f9ef81d0774d1b11da.en: Motown at the Kursaal is a 150-minute show about the Detroit soul sound of the 1960s. It features songs by Stevie Wonder, Marvin Gaye, The Supremes and The Temptations, with a multi-level set, screens and singers flown in from New York and Detroit.

e2fe0bf17e4b64738ec7c1969e934d23ce224334.en: Tatta, Mutiko and Marmitako Trap Banda play Dabadaba on 6 February.

f1f1c3414fbf16faa588615d26327c370d3da9db.en: El Príncipe Idiota and FYRS play Dabadaba on 8 February.

a7f50ca4aba28b4b1965d2d290bd84924bb2552b.en: Bosco Herrero, a young artist of Basque-French origin, plays Dabadaba. His indie folk and experimental pop features melancholic piano and intimate, poetic lyrics.

a02821de3e4a7e8c197790dffd786ef0a03f0832.en: Tito Ramírez plays Dabadaba on 12 February.

15c7aab026a1ec9d7c1449df6cfd0705721ec092.en: Matinée de Miramon 9, Xarma, is a string quartet programme in the Euskadiko Orkestra chamber season. It includes Beethoven's String Quartet Op. 18 No. 4, Turina's Oración del torero, and Shostakovich's String Quartet No. 7.

226a5b3ef5e0136fcba179ed9b40a6cc812b0fb2.en: CANDLELIGHT Donostia presents Queen VS. The Beatles, a 60-minute candlelit concert at the Aquarium-Palacio del Mar. Cuarteto Sugarra plays songs by both bands, and it is for ages 8 and over.

d9e00f3a4073bdc4e5dfe328c5cb2bc98dd73341.en: Izaro starts a new tour at the Kursaal on 13 February to present Arkitektura, her album centred on motherhood and building a life. The Basque singer-songwriter, now also an architect, will play eight European countries in 2027.

1d5a6d744243d95da80b4f6c6202dd3cee32e03f.en: The Japanese band MONO plays Dabadaba on 13 February 2027.

7d94dae91becaba6d072a17e16526164f2e8c4c8.en: CANDLELIGHT Donostia presents a Valentine's Day programme, a 60-minute candlelit concert at the Aquarium-Palacio del Mar. Love songs by Elton John, Céline Dion, Edith Piaf and The Beatles are on the programme, for ages 8 and over.

dd5f124a675d645f8a57733317f18471aa1f9382.en: COCO, una fiesta musical is a musical adaptation of the Pixar film Coco at the Kursaal. Live voices, choreography and projections tell its story of family, memory and dreams.

89f387eb83ca096d0ec45e3b28b63c63f12b904b.en: KLUBAK at the KMK library runs its Basque reading group on 17 February with Garazi Arrula's Dakigun hori, part of the 2026-2027 programme.

b387cfcdf5c6821d2e2073f7ff367c780ab458f1.en: Sofía Huerta, a 15-year-old pianist from San Sebastián, plays Chopin's Piano Concerto No. 2 in a string quartet version at the Teatro Principal. Her concert is aimed at young audiences, and Musikene students open with Chopin's last 12 preludes.

bdf2daded946f2ae1d951f13f74a1b28e930ee31.en: Madison McFerrin presents her album Scorpio at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia. The daughter of Bobby McFerrin, trained at Berklee, layers her voice in loops to create a cappella soul-jazz harmonies.

a7dd9be699bc1d80b9878873c184c522e2e67090.en: Xoel López, a key figure of the Iberian independent scene, tours with Oniria Popular 2027 at the Kursaal on 19 February 2027. The concert presents his 17th studio album, an introspective pop record that draws on folk tradition.

6d9df8d35a1d6cbe26e264f8071ffa42cf5b1327.en: A children's concert in the Chopin cycle at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia is led by pianist Samuel Arroyo, who is studying for a master's at the Stuttgart Conservatory. He improvises on Chopin's best-known melodies, with the audience taking part.

7652b04bc32214334de9e30dd53dce29e88f4441.en: The Donostia folk-pop band Nøgen announce their farewell tour, Como llegar a casa, and their fourth and last album, Onak eta txarrak. The tour's first date is at the Lekuona Fabrika in Errenteria on 20 February.

b10b9712ffd7d0806bbad04779a704c7972716ab.en: Così fan tutte, Mozart's opera from the Royal Opera House, is screened at the Cines Niessen. Two officers test their fiancées' loyalty by pretending to be strangers, in a comedy of fidelity and human relations. It runs about 3 hours 15 minutes.

6ae0746add87d23b2c08740b5f8cb7b37b1aa782.en: The Monsters, a Swiss rock band from Bern, plays Dabadaba. Their garage rock, punk and rock and roll sound is raw, loud and humorous.

acc26ae37585807d2760422c9f67f1b02dfb23a7.en: DJ Symphonic New Edition at the Kursaal pairs the Royal Film Concert Orchestra and a DJ, under Fernando Furones. The 90-minute programme includes ABBA, Daft Punk, Hans Zimmer and Gloria Gaynor.

50d27fa68c63ca022a6badbdc88bd5a53785a2a9.en: Matinée de Miramon 10 presents Kea Ahots Taldea and Josu Okiñena celebrating Kea's 30th anniversary. The programme includes works by Barber, Boulanger and Basque composers.

7e08357cda88502f89c81b0702e8d7e2bceae170.en: Ivan Herzog, a singer-songwriter, performs at the Kutxa Fundazioa Kluba. His direct, honest pop has folk touches and is made with creative independence and manual work.

f346b1513c14bd76b2142f1815c28a03a3b8a1cd.en: Winona Riders, an Argentine band formed in 2018 in west Buenos Aires, plays Dabadaba. Their garage rock, psychedelia, noise and post-punk make an intense and hypnotic sound.

62cfd5c58254f0e6f97772e76b478dd734f8f4ec.en: Henge, a British electronic and psychedelic band, plays Dabadaba. Their concerts have science-fiction aesthetics, positive messages and mix electronics with rock and humour.

84e9f963d4ef43e26216dd258fa9b9dfd10e9974.en: KLUBAK at the KMK library runs its Spanish reading group on 1 March with Marjane Satrapi's Persépolis, part of the 2026-2027 programme.

3653c9f2252eadb27620346adb406daa00893617.en: Alfonso Gómez, a pianist from Vitoria who teaches in Freiburg, plays Chopin's nocturnes in a personal version at the Teatro Victoria Eugenia. He is a prize-winning pianist.

a560c4a97a1422e2cb0093585b60236cfc6f4112.en: Carmen Lancho, a jazz-trained singer and songwriter from Madrid, plays Dabadaba on 11 March. Her first EP, Dramitas, turns everyday feelings into direct and personal songs.

53afe3d8abfbf986dbbb8e933774e3f66cc61919.en: Toundra and Mycrocemento play Dabadaba on 12 March.

d74d46c4c22991f1148eff50ac53b68419cde75e.en: Matinée de Miramon 11 features pianist Steven Lin in a recital with Scarlatti, Gershwin, Beethoven's Waldstein Sonata and Mozart's variations on Ah vous dirai-je, Maman.

d475fc622d2616cc476f687020cf6a3f32ba9758.en: Elliott Murphy and his band play the Kursaal, marking 50 years since the album Just a Story from America. The rock veteran performs the album in full, with a selection of his best-known songs, in a two-hour show.

e1d8b17c0e6ad624165218fdb2cd00181c7b55b7.en: Diálogos de Cocina 2027 takes place on 15 and 16 March, marking 20 years of talks about food. Past speakers at the Basque Culinary Center include Carlo Petrini, Alice Waters and Héctor Abad Faciolince.

0a6b5630fe2041fa113d4fce3f877c3b61f30d4c.en: This Is Lorelei and Liam Parsons play Dabadaba on 16 March.

6b4318da86ebf45e18395195caa72199dfc65200.en: KLUBAK at the KMK library runs its Basque reading group on 17 March with Fatima Mernissi's Terraza debekatua, part of the 2026-2027 programme.

113278f44c3469d3898acaea08ec97be435a2651.en: SOYUZ, a musical collective formed in Minsk in 2017 and now based in Warsaw, plays Dabadaba. Its jazz, folk and pop has Brazilian influences and the warmth of the 1970s.

2dcc0afeeae62dd56b2e35061d4e0f09bf4f780e.en: Götterdämmerung, the last part of Wagner's Ring cycle, is screened at the Cines Niessen as part of opera and ballet on film. Barrie Kosky sets the apocalyptic drama in a contemporary world, with Antonio Pappano conducting.

5cf47f0d509acc90b8696203cfd9eabb9d505a47.en: Carmina Burana by Orff and Beethoven's Fifth Symphony are performed at the Kursaal by the orchestra and chorus of the Odesa National Academic Opera and Ballet Theatre. Carmina Burana, a medieval satire on pleasure, premiered in 1937.

a85d0f40643cfe9d4e90345475d3da54918f8f53.en: La ruina at the Kursaal on 3 April is a show in which guests and audience members share their most embarrassing stories in public. Comedians Ignasi Taltavull and Tomàs Fuentes host, with a guest who comments on the night's stories.

af9693a00b3598f7c51d6a4fdf22b4ba51dac010.en: KLUBAK at the KMK library runs its Spanish reading group on 5 April with Emilia Pardo Bazán's El encaje roto, part of the 2026-2027 programme.

b446a77550e64feb30aadd2a1cbc5cceb7f90843.en: Matinée de Miramon 12 features the Tcha Limberger Quintet in gypsy jazz. The Belgian multi-instrumentalist and singer is one of the great international names in manouche jazz.

a37517146a19a02752adf653e0f8ee638ebfa117.en: Drugos, an Asturian rock band, plays Dabadaba on 10 April. Their alternative rock has direct lyrics, powerful guitars and an intense live sound.

1da729b92a2a0953e01c6b8d06f7b1aeecef68e8.en: El Último Vecino, the project of Barcelona-born Gerard Alegre Dòria, plays Dabadaba. Its electronic pop and new wave have nostalgic melodies and danceable live shows.

6d02058a8fbe52867804b490ac2d3be5f8998e97.en: Stevie Wonder's Songs in the Key of Life 50th anniversary performances at 3Arena, sold as Ticketmaster Platinum tickets.

e2a77553d745aa260ec2a3318ea7f00195429c3b.en: From piggy banks to Swish, an interactive exhibition at Tumba bruksmuseum where children and adults talk about money and how it has changed.

a13c35caf2ac532741fce13d63fea1a1fef54550.en: Life in color and form, an exhibition at Millesgården on the sculptor Robert Nilsson and the textile artist Barbro Nilsson.

6995686d138a1d133452b969cdd9c951e0620c40.en: Descendant, the autumn exhibition at the Thielska Gallery curated by Lars von Trier.

5a8b7a67d916c81e6634dba4661cad01d853d489.en: The 1950s at Spårvägsmuseet, a retro evening with live rockabilly, dancing and hot dogs among the trams.

56e2bece2c7dc6ba974096fe1ef82243a124714a.en: Mamma Mia! The Party, an interactive ABBA-themed night with food, drinks and entertainment.

5718d6f0cfba85fbcd7ed41c350504e98464b256.en: Blowing Figures into Space by Davide Rivalta, a large outdoor sculpture show of twelve animal figures in Kungliga Nationalstadsparken.

4426bd3a3f61bf359f87241ae436b5061986bcce.en: An autumn kayak trip in the Stockholm archipelago, with a Swedish fika and a hot sauna, from Skärgårdens Kanotcenter.

80486ec0acbdad61eff291b14e44e43b04e54b33.en: Harder Better Faster Stronger: Are Men OK?, a Fotografiska exhibition on what masculinity means today.

6c9773897a16cc8b450b4c999de863f5de51a38e.en: Embraced, an exhibition at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern where visitors become part of the art through sculpture, textile and painting.

28d23b5820d21939eeb7ce344c75e1c1a48d6681.en: City Faces at the Stockholm City Museum, which brings 19th-century Stockholmers to life using historical photographs and facial recognition.

ca539111b8aef43c39f77f23ac4b7ebd014862f3.en: A Stockholm food tour at Östermalms Saluhall, visiting restaurants that have shaped Sweden's food scene.

ff3b4fc8660911b077d9a7427694d52d6b0ada85.en: Jesus Christ Superstar at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern, Andrew Lloyd Webber and Tim Rice's rock musical about Jesus's last days.

0245a9c60bf04397bf158256700c3860d94f451a.en: Pottery painting at Måla Keramiks studios in central Stockholm, a new concept where you paint your own ceramics.

e72c908118c321a971688822f153c87013d32504.en: Big Ben Stand Up, a daily stand-up comedy night at 20:00 at the Big Ben Pub.

f778171ecc6fe9ed4c178702536b3d4fea593aeb.en: A walking tour of Gamla Stan, the medieval heart of Stockholm, through its alleys and squares, from the Royal Palace.

a817279c2d2bf65821bc78bab05e58f2502e0337.en: The autumn holiday at Junibacken, the children's museum, from 12 October to 1 November.

2d7c0e36ebfbb273ac843206292e743c42760755.en: Shul!, the synagogue of the Old Town, at the Jewish Museum on Själagårdsgatan, where a synagogue once stood.

72b671acf0c8c45a51ea1837ff8d56ed116b122d.en: Dancing Queen at ABBA The Museum, a look at how the 1976 ABBA song became a song for new generations.

8944db609f9a42211aad4e712cec7001a510e423.en: Before One Assembles Itself by Erik Madigan Heck at House of Photography, his first public exhibition in Sweden.

4e75ca1d8de59207f59e7776bb85598be3ffb4ac.en: Chamber/Cacti at the Royal Swedish Opera, two 30-minute modern dance pieces with kinetic energy and humour, by Medhi Walerski.

dfeea57b8ada3e1e683610448dbbc5d2c872436f.en: DREAMDNVR at Kollektivet Livet, a cinematic pop act with emotional songwriting and big melodies.

e3a9dc3da4e9425aeaa83f33b28308e5be349ca9.en: Gröna Lund's Halloween, an autumn of spooky experiences, rides and horror at the amusement park.

e0b3e6c2a73f3b7b6eca411b259a87f5c2f7a970.en: A walk along the heights of Södermalm, from Slussen to Medborgarplatsen, with views over the city.

d545ea21c3d13232088129f993133a4cbb3b1594.en: Barnängen – The People Who Built Södermalm, a walk through the industrial history of eastern Södermalm.

525bcbb51d344b8e79ff738809da143d7ac4b215.en: Parken EMO, an emo night every other Thursday at Parken Söder, with DJs or karaoke.

dff6de96d9f7e2b0f19790246694558472f8f4d3.en: Stockholm Thursday Mingle, an international social evening for locals, expats and travellers at Den Gröne Jägaren.

82a7881e94476249595f14c7dcbcf118992c7090.en: The Metro: in step with the times, an exhibition at the Stockholm Transport Museum on the metro's place in society's history.

768e48b3379fb550a8110ceadd152b48a7749f69.en: An art exhibition at Åmells gallery on Birger Jarlsgatan, with around ten carefully chosen shows a year.

cdf578ea04001428ed99027c485d24c24624bd1d.en: Open sauna and cold plunge at Saunify Bastu Hässelby, by Lake Mälaren, in an old orchard park.

30d581a85226aca59389d47110e22048b8d7e6c0.en: To the Sea! at Nationalmuseum, an exhibition on modern seaside tourism, the beach and the sea in art.

42cf9bd7de7bfee81b315e4ac853c1052a717725.en: Like Share Hate, an exhibition at Forum för levande historia on antisemitism and other forms of racism, and how to stop them.

ecb4010257e1bd7a53c1c91b3ad843bbade0ba64.en: A wine tasting hosted by Amfora at Cajsa Warg Foods, featuring wines from renowned regions.

78b1faed6579d86d8eae83da411811c23bcadcc3.en: An art cruise afterwork on Tallink Silja Line from Stockholm to Helsinki, linked to Southnord.

86a088afbcd4b2357272dd423e4e8117ef7cbfe4.en: Jewish Värmland at the Jewish Museum, on what remains of Jewish life when a synagogue has been demolished.

871dc3bb6e565c00692096bf60f1b321e7952ce4.en: The Zinken Indie Choir in concert at Söderhöjdskyrkan, with about 50 singers and a band performing indie-pop arrangements.

722af3d73a9d5634dcab1232906ac47d5e0c014d.en: The Il Merlo literary stage, opened with a launch event with poets Lina Hagelbäck and Vendela Fredicson.

53df3aac8f97bd2f3b5cb2e89c06240cd098a62b.en: Six years of Slussen in watercolour, artist Elisabeth Biström's paintings of the Slussen transformation at Slussenrummet.

0aa80b20298a95c06e575478c2acef24f917668e.en: The Gothenburg Colorists in a new light, an exhibition at Prince Eugen's Waldemarsudde on the expressive colourism of the 1930s.

256dfb68b5894b8475225b33659238a8cde24f56.en: Nordic Moments at the Nordic Museum, an evolving display of photography collections, opening with Metamorphoses.

ab262f8dbb0bd22c1644653c69979e2e598338d3.en: A talk and film screening, The Secret Life of the Forest, with biologist Anne Sverdrup-Thygeson at the Museum of Natural History.

4fe2c4aebc9e39c7ca1c3537e5b2369ef37c2ceb.en: Det mörka ljuset by Lars Lerin at Elverket, an immersive audiovisual show by one of the Nordic region's best-loved artists.

f8efd37e54e7a49e4189cb7ecf41daa4e426f33d.en: Guldgruvan Standup Club at Sofia Common, darker and more alternative stand-up comedy.

cd4e30f2bef0e46c9dc77bd88a433d1aa9874948.en: Colour!, an exhibition at Nationalmuseum for children and curious adults. It is open at weekends and in school holidays.

2b4c6ad81138d62666f8ebfc3deb7461e551f2d4.en: Making the Impossible Possible at Scenkonstmuseet, five decades of the choreographer Efva Lilja's work.

23c0e7ed97990242462ce4e4170f1ce59a5f79d1.en: Kindfulness Gatherings, themed evenings for women in Stockholm who want real conversation and connection.

15ee7c53eb05cf2ad5ceff7caab03b41daedd9c0.en: A winter city kayak tour through the canals of Stockholm, the 'Venice of the North'.

ff3646803d69d857d8daf5c30d9fc4109e99cf5a.en: A talk on Brylcreem and greasers on the metro, on 1950s Stockholm at the Spårvägsmuseet.

681d7ba7e2b956a452be66e4eb2c44a2d06be61e.en: A guided tour of the historic Östermalms Saluhall food hall, renovated and reopened in 2020.

09ce15ce6213a41ca1fa42a075300e1ca18a316e.en: A private guided bike tour of Stockholm's streets and parks, suitable for casual riders and enthusiasts.

6a3c85ca7dd48f6b96561c24826f412e2c234923.en: James Cameron – Challenging the Deep at the Vasa Museum, on the filmmaker's ocean exploration and technology.

b0d2c33ef80dd2a5a0ad46397b7bdc90bd975e4f.en: Joe Bonamassa live in concert, sold as Ticketmaster Platinum tickets with a limited allocation.
