51cfede41c2afbf6a6f2c387cc322fa113cf8516.en: The Improvised Schlager Festival at Stockholms Improvisationsteater, celebrating 30 years of improvised schlager shows.

0694a8f926809c867fd206795bfdf913b964401f.en: The Stockholm Beer and Whisky Festival 2026 at Nacka Strandsmässan, the original festival since 1992, with more exhibitors.

76f75a4afb4285ba08f77488480f32f30ae5a8be.en: A pick-your-own dahlia field at Siggesta Gård, run by Dahlia District, with dahlias of every colour.

83b8d419b8045b642afb4cc1b1f5ff6697189b91.en: The play Jag ... about Isaac Grünewald by Peter Perski at Långholmens Wärdshus, about one of Sweden's great artists.

3469accea6f8549078ee410af1946dfe7ae9c762.en: O nata lux at Ersta kyrka, English choral music from the Norwich Cathedral Choir.

9452a182ac7b7d6d01b1797a85c091fe3ca46ffc.en: A guided walking tour (in Swedish) of the former prison on Långholmen, with lunch.

cfe1d544945c3e0a022657a68912d3f92e71b564.en: Oyster Friday at Bonnie's in the Bank Hotel, with oysters shucked in the dining room every Friday from 16:00 to 18:00.

62554a2de832cdc525bca159f89013976138d6d0.en: Free Friday at Moderna Museet, free entry on Friday evenings in spring and autumn from 18:00 to 20:00, with a free guided tour.

0f48ddac95c514a0cbba1b00c606bc12442798ba.en: I am the goose, a monologue at Kulturhuset Stadsteatern based on Nina from Chekhov's The Seagull, years later.

a4ec00f2af4a2f0303f705f656b0f0e4c0cb01f8.en: Tosca at the Royal Swedish Opera, a classic opera about a dramatic 24 hours in Rome.

0a6f45adbda699a6b3a382906154e3a8c47fe046.en: Nietzsche vs Wagner at Folkoperan, a play about the friendship and break between the philosopher and the composer.

2b0d60b64dca397298ebafbe4c629eebdf2ebd6f.en: A social gathering at Trolls Stockholm for internationals, expats, travellers and locals to meet and make friends.

b2e46289b038c7673e8d8555520a0b268561ebd0.en: A fall break at Siggesta Gård, with a cosy hotel stay and a forest obstacle course.

9dd0344b3fc8a77b0e6afc38ec776f19af7918b0.en: The Esmé Quartet at the Jane Mallett Theatre for Music Toronto, a programme of drama and energy.

6b52186aea06828d779f26f0103038f1db3a0fb5.en: Jim Cuddy Orchestrated at Koerner Hall, the Juno-winning singer with new orchestral versions of his hits.

4df664f121000a25b1d3f059ac0efb70d5c36e22.en: Cabaret at the Bluma Appel Theatre, the musical set in Berlin as the Nazis rise.

2e41c557b206dc90f812158dde67c643bde71dcb.en: Une Vie d'Amour at Koerner Hall, a Valentine's show of French love songs.

e9ce5b86c9dd8ea94880e1b4466df9e4448c730b.en: RacquetsUp Expo 2027 at the Enercare Centre, Canada's dedicated racquet sports expo.

31b60d83975b33d6affd86bab3fe0d5ad49a0fcd.en: Leticia Moreno's Bach in the Americas at Koerner Hall, a Spanish violinist leading an ensemble with piano, bandoneon and bass.

65fa21745d4bbc676658e4f0ffb3fb9d4c498b2a.en: KUNÉ at Koerner Hall, Canada's global orchestra marking its 10th anniversary.

9572abfde47f7bbafd26566b296683afa9322bba.en: The 45th Toronto Postcard Club sale at the Japanese Canadian Cultural Centre, Canada's largest vintage postcard show, marking 50 years.

8b83fcaa89e64b07156cc117b0c35bfe913f14bf.en: Schmaltz and Pepper at Koerner Hall, a jazz concert with Grammy-winning Drew Jurecka and other Toronto musicians.

12ab3b91fb518a323a666fdfb79618965ec311c5.en: Music Toronto's Duo Concertante with the Dior Quartet at the Jane Mallett Theatre, violinist Nancy Dahn and pianist Timothy Steeves.

1b8d5aeeed5b1d6879a36d9f21359183dd4cdcdc.en: Laila Biali's Joni Mitchell and the Canadian Songbook Reimagined at Koerner Hall, a tribute project of covers.

27221233e9c05157a07070cb7248e826d32799e4.en: Ratatouille in Concert at Roy Thomson Hall, the Pixar film screened with its score performed live.

3c40d6a3355b3ee8583452f76f33a731a5e30f1a.en: Johannes Moser, cello, with Marc-André Hamelin, piano, at Koerner Hall, an all-Beethoven programme.

9f99d8e9e589000e010437677b6ca22b35b5b2fb.en: A Beethoven Celebration with John O'Conor at Mazzoleni Concert Hall, marking the Irish pianist's 80th birthday with Glenn Gould School students.

c4884488d72a4dcd7c09c0770aecf064d3d55ef6.en: Pablo Ziegler Quintet with Roberta Gambarini at Koerner Hall, a Piazzolla-inspired tango and jazz programme.

e5115163cd7c051c992eceec33b3a3fe6badb4f5.en: The Kronos Quartet with its new lineup at Koerner Hall, an avant-garde string quartet.

e6c56612ef64109e750c2a16cf1e796ecb103fb4.en: Harp Hues Beneath the Sea of Time at Trinity-St. Paul's Centre, with a world premiere for the harpist Teresa Suen.

cf6dd7530d051e312129700ec6d0ee46e8b5441a.en: A Rebellion Talks session at Colborne Lodge on the Lower Canadian rebellion and its links to the Rebellion of 1837 in Toronto.

f19ed37dee669555662fde0ec9b81cee7dde57fa.en: Orbert Davis's septet playing Miles Davis at Koerner Hall, with the Toronto Tenor Madness set.

09469e64ee0ef4c0e14bd9eb27d65035d5bff014.en: Simone Dinnerstein, piano, at Koerner Hall, an American pianist known for original interpretations.

8cecb44c4cc1f344435118abb9b5bece1da2beda.en: The Life of a Creature by Nadja Lubiw-Hazard, a By the Lake Book Club discussion at Assembly Hall.

65bc26c96c3cc9e1e3191e46209cc59c03811f86.en: Taylor Academy: The Stars of Tomorrow at Mazzoleni Concert Hall, young winners of the Florence Man and Bernard Sze Concerto Competition.

055f9915fbde31444339ef1a23a8bfa7fec83de5.en: Danny Driver's third Music Toronto recital at the Jane Mallett Theatre, a programme of waltzes and other pieces.

00be7f38b5d86e351d144f4fd4792ce24516f457.en: The Glenn Gould School's spring opera, Mozart's The Marriage of Figaro, fully staged at Koerner Hall, conducted by Judith Yan.

6a9df7b381d2c388f2346ca00de144368f2535c6.en: A Rebellion Talks session at the Scarborough Museum on rebel blacksmiths and radical farmers in 1837.

d592e6f0ff3ebbe7a66c69b822fc534dd52e2001.en: Kevin Chen and Illia Ovcharenko, two pianos, with the Amadeus Choir and Glenn Gould School students, performing Beethoven's Ninth Symphony at Koerner Hall.

cf9b2a7f5a5a48fb9225cad58afdb50c0315e631.en: Martin Hayes Quartet with Ye Vagabonds at Koerner Hall, an Irish music evening with guests.

aad1d6ec978985dafde4a33f16b4693ff80bf1ac.en: The Escher String Quartet's Music Toronto debut at the Jane Mallett Theatre, from Classical brilliance to late-Romantic intensity.

c5bf8baab351df18ebe28e7334468b2a8fb24c71.en: Raised by Women at Berkeley Street Theatre, a funny and searching solo show by Métis playwright Keith Barker.

a836fd7ac315fa4566442038badbe8d62d54e122.en: The Royal Conservatory Orchestra under James Conlon with cellist Mira Kardan at Koerner Hall.

e7144e7840deae57855210a5b45ddf8e42db6f2c.en: The Glenn Gould School Chamber Competition Finals at Koerner Hall, with student ensembles competing.

81bb87dfe12cc0912c5e8d0e943de65998c91204.en: The final Rebellion Talks session at Gibson House on the burning of David Gibson's home in 1837.

44f49c7e4506edcd3bcc13529d7cf5e724b2df9e.en: Artemis performs a tribute to Miles Davis at Koerner Hall, with Toronto supergroup Trane of Thought, featuring former Coltrane drummer Terry Clarke, paying homage to John Coltrane. A postlude performance follows in the Leslie and Anna Dan Galleria.

ac9e63980bb121337efd1204c2518c08f3683e4c.en: Yuja Wang, piano, at Koerner Hall, one of the most important pianists of her generation.

b1cd02a2a7bb1dfc0c19230cc45f2e67c4c9cb70.en: Ladysmith Black Mambazo at Koerner Hall, the Grammy-winning South African a cappella group from Graceland.

6a7c8ce5e160ea1edab2eb15e1f91d09ce1329cd.en: Creditors, a Canadian premiere at the Bluma Appel Theatre, about a young artist and his wife at a seaside hotel.

9ce63876482f656b4e1249be58e524d76d36c1f6.en: Mozart's Spring, Calla Lilies at Trinity-St. Paul's Centre, two soloists and works from Bach to Mozart.

2157848a3d523b5883a506cf6280403d1e48116c.en: Seven Heavens Away by Ashraf Zaghal, a By the Lake Book Club discussion at Assembly Hall.

dc90701679192ac453fca3b42261d95cbcf8a094.en: The Glenn Gould School New Music Ensemble at the Temerty Theatre, celebrating Linda Catlin Smith's birthday with her works.

29837456cf3659339f9dc4b54add0ad6d8bfa361.en: MAYRIG/MOTHER, by cellist Karen Ouzounian and composer-pianist Lembit Beecher, at the Jane Mallett Theatre for Music Toronto.

229c0c0d1f5d45129e6001224d136759af57a68d.en: A holiday workshop for children aged 6 to 12 that mixes climbing with creative play. Run by SensActifs, which lets children shape their own experiences.

a6bc69c3ae942861da00110d51c846aaf15414da.en: An exhibition of 16 portraits of women scientists whose work was often credited to male colleagues, the so-called Matilda effect. Free entry at Espace Pour Tous in Saint-Orens-de-Gameville, 12 to 23 October.

9f189a668b4c4ecacc6058513bb47c67d1c9bb73.en: A photo exhibition by the architecture studio Lubies d'archi, showing its projects through before-and-after images of how people live in their homes.

d02f7fd17fc8e9ba74cda77acea9c767675279fd.en: Free sophrology courses for carers of people with disabilities, funded by the Haute-Garonne departmental council. Seven group sessions aim to reduce stress, improve sleep and offer a break, held at the Saint-Simon social centre in Toulouse.

b673ed9e433925700bd225b739c4f81be5967d00.en: An exhibition at the ENSA Toulouse architecture school showing 19 contemporary buildings made from earth, stone and plant fibres. It highlights the beauty, performance and environmental benefits of these materials.

2a1821381a19bc7c1b48b0bcd8e52316dac48aba.en: Free wellbeing course for carers of people with disabilities, funded by the Haute-Garonne council. About ten 90-minute sessions in Toulouse cover stress management and preventing burnout, from mid-July to mid-November.

dd7fddc852a3261b32658cacec83dc5e22e111c1.en: An exhibition at the Bonnefoy cultural centre telling how residents of one building used art to look at their shared heritage and build community. It features photos and animated objects by Marie-Stéphane Salgas.

a61da8f08b293252cca2ec25b6f821af16019772.en: A workshop for building professionals at the Maison de l'Energie, run by Toulouse Métropole Rénov'. It updates the method for checking quotes for wood-burning stove installations and gathers professionals' feedback.

b6c82ea3c82d833fd7e3088a16e1d19c3e3fb80d.en: Free training for carers of people with disabilities, funded by the Haute-Garonne council. Toulouse offers include a Humanitude approach course run by ADMR, and a path from carer to peer supporter run by Format Différence.

7f59ef73765fba0c36ba5713d7d5a179d38c6d6f.en: An exhibition marking 70 years of the Poutou de Toulouse, a group devoted to Occitan culture, with costumes, instruments and archives. An anniversary day on 24 October offers free dance classes, a private view and a traditional dance ball.

b77e9e38bab001ba4736e3fae413a385c5f5c64f.en: A treasure-hunt style activity at the Noviciat that asks you to spot Toulouse's building materials, from river pebbles to the famous brick. Each material tells part of the city's history.

11eedbae101080d81d6b0c638151f4d02883bb5a.en: An exhibition at the Toulouse Departmental Museum of the Resistance and Deportation, from 3 July to 31 October 2026. It follows 16 Auschwitz survivors through about a hundred objects, photos and archives, with a booklet for teenagers.

7558b066ac9ccc479422b860e55852951d1ca435.en: Free training in Colomiers for carers of people with brain injuries, run by YMCA Occitanie. Five sessions of two to three hours cover understanding brain injury, communicating better and preventing burnout.

941b8202c682e1e97273fdc075bf02993d501bde.en: A 45-minute game at the Quai des Savoirs, part role-play and part escape game, where players identify a microbe to save a patient. No science background is needed, and it is suited to ages 9 and up; booking is free.

0babf5b0940534012118f994b4d03ef4d2ae5824.en: A storytelling show with illustrations by Eric and Terry Fan and live music by David Mimey, at La Péniche Didascalie. Finn sets out by sea, guided by a golden fish, to find where the sea meets the sky.

3446d807d5e4c4c2430dee5d52be20adb91a7ba5.en: An exhibition at Galerie 24 of student projects from ENSA Toulouse, marking 30 years since the Canal du Midi became a UNESCO World Heritage site. It proposes new uses for 15 sites, from Toulouse to Marseillan.

3a42fd1e23228549e3ecad26e62aa0cfbdf7b924.en: A memory games session at the Ancely library. Booking is needed by phone or by email.

a22a751119c4e70a6b4a2661680fc116da0f3c82.en: Free theatre and workshops for carers of people with disabilities, run by YMCA Occitanie in Colomiers. Seven two-hour sessions act out real situations, then look for solutions together.

b1daaa3a7faf64d22f3f2318b45ac89bc46b3f3f.en: A day at the Quai des Savoirs on 22 October, part of the Lumières sur le Quai festival, on how science fiction imagines the future of science. It includes a round table on whether the future still frightens us.

177ae725020bb63f753fb892bc78e0b50be60f96.en: A triple exhibition of illustrations by Laurent Moreau, from 17 October to 22 November, across three Toulouse libraries. It shows his mixed techniques and sketchbooks, with pieces from his books.

c2aa88db558a8b482aeb80ece9387bdd8c33c402.en: A photo exhibition at the Roseraie library from 8 October to 3 November, pairing books with plants, flowers or trees. The library's reading club prepared the selection.

79c33dff1e2fc549ce2a870be489e6adb4aae25b.en: An exhibition of sound diaries by Émeline Rétif, recorded on journeys from the Amazon to the Arctic. Each listening invites you to slow down, at the José Cabanis media library from 3 October to 22 November.

898bdb961f4357a5dfaf5818da711b813ff14299.en: A 30-minute guided visit through the underground parts of the Monument à la Gloire de la Résistance, where memory meets contemporary art. The guide offers keys to the artist's work, and the welcome is also given in English.

783da7ddc4048944ef5e275e102b983c2cdfe28f.en: Listening sessions every Thursday from 2 to 6pm at the José Cabanis media library, run by volunteers from La porte ouverte. Anyone can come to talk freely about difficulties or successes and break the isolation.

b15b09ab8c43eccc387a842a76715fd5d51aa985.en: An intensive introduction to music production with Ableton Live, led by artist Tryst Temps at the Centre Culturel Bellegarde from 22 to 24 October, 2 to 5pm. Suited to ages 13 and up, it covers beats, composition, effects and samples.

4e1515ce118098679c40b98990d1c0b3a99bff65.en: A two-part workshop at the Église du Gesù: visitors find patterns in the church and learn their symbolism, then make a stained-glass-style picture from coloured tissue paper. Suited to families.

53d61c1b25597e04b18f061bdc20efb35dc23b6d.en: A screening of Petite Casbah at the ABC cinema, introduced by an exchange between generations in the cinema hall.

ee76eab6f68888550c71fc9541d30b68e7a03d08.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins on the painters influenced by Caravaggio, and how his new approach to light and shade spread across Europe. It includes the work of Nicolas Tournier.

b6b94cf264053042f0598d9eaf46e290242288ab.en: A free weekly French conversation group at Médiathèque Grand M, every Thursday at 2:30pm except during school holidays. Librarians lead relaxed talk about books, films and culture, open to all levels.

f990f93ff559e6aeabc1d2b679cdd5a8c23651f0.en: A quilling workshop at the Chapelle de La Grave on 22 October, free with booking. Based on the paper-rolling art once used to make reliquaries, each participant takes home their own card or piece.

6482d64f8195caa24516cd9010f9edc98cad8a8b.en: Three evenings and a daytime programme at La Halle de La Machine from 8 to 11 October 2026, closing the Pink Paradize Festival. Artists include Purple Disco Machine, Paul Kalkbrenner and Caravan Palace, with living-machine shows; Sunday's programme is free.

45633c42ea0c024f389aac3e8b951becd24cdf35.en: An exhibition at the Tiers-lieu Culturel Le Moulin on food and flavour, from bitter and sour tastes to tomato, apple and cherry varieties and kitchen tools. Part of the Articulinaire project.

4d79aa7c1c6835a07fc791ff0edfea034fc18661.en: Digital help every Wednesday and Thursday outside school holidays, 3 to 5pm, at the José Cabanis media library. A mediator can answer questions on library resources, email, computers, smartphones or AI.

8028eaafc33d0706bfd3a8c6862eac1942171395.en: A one-hour family tour of the Musée des Augustins, led by Béatrice Forêt of L'arbre à plumes. Families explore medieval works on beliefs and questions about life and death, through humour and fantasy.

985ae4d05a67bd1b1f239d257cf6792e9a72aeba.en: A guided visit of Le Castelet, a 19th-century former prison gatehouse in Toulouse and one of the few surviving examples of prison architecture of its time. It explains how the prison worked and how the site became a place of memory.

c9f1a7823a39ca4d284d292fa06239510750734b.en: A general guided tour of the Musée des Augustins, a former convent, covering paintings and sculptures from the 12th to the 20th century. Themes include mythology, the Bible and history.

ca7678d04e3ae440a81e9a775b4fc894b756afc0.en: A series of two-hour workshops in Ramonville-Saint-Agne on assistive aids for everyday life, run by UNA 31 with the departmental council. Topics include moving, adapting the home, digital tools and access to funding.

bada8c20f34ade63e16aa1b453f372e64ab0ba22.en: A talk on Thursday 22 October at 5.30pm at the Bibliothèque d'Étude et du Patrimoine by medievalist Katy Bernard, on her book D'Âme Brune. She explores nature in the songs of the 12th-century troubadour Marcabru, as part of the Occitania festival.

08b80ed2114a973313d5200f49825fe73290acc1.en: A talk on Thursday 22 October at 5.30pm by Katy Bernard, Occitan lecturer and medievalist, on how nature appears at the start of the songs of the troubadour Marcabru. Part of the Occitania festival.

69742f9e8db61c1b690fc9e5290319965b5e152e.en: A talk on Thursday 22 October at 6pm at the José Cabanis media library on why running has become a mass phenomenon. Speakers include Running Mag founder Rémy Jégard, coach Véronique L'Hôte and sociologist Philippe Terral.

f4fcd8795a06c1396b4e0aa411945b896adfad06.en: A project by the Le Clair Obscur art lab imagining a radical UN-style programme in which humanity is paused in stasis pods for 200 years so Earth can regenerate. It is part of the science-fiction day at the Quai des Savoirs on 22 October.

a30dc017dbb408aa2a6084da0c6870a6a2fa269f.en: An acoustic concert by Caiana Duo, a Munich-based pair playing choro, samba and Brazilian jazz, at Les Marins d'Eau Douce in Ramonville on Thursday 22 October at 6.30pm. Booking a table is recommended.

9ef398a5228c55d46b766dc1e7c5205d0aafdae0.en: A weekly stand-up night in central Toulouse, where several comedians share the bill, mixing local talent with new and established names from across France. This session is on 22 October at 7pm.

0fe6734a36683d6abd061f63261beaeb6294120c.en: A night-time detective game in the Chapelle des Carmélites, played with torches as teams search the architecture for clues. No prior knowledge is needed, and the chapel lights up at the end to show its ceilings.

5d5f098ff3a455d7c8392218f1c0535b7eda76e2.en: A French-language rap concert by Mohand Baha at Le Metronum, Toulouse's live music venue, on his tour La tournée en vrai. It mixes 90s and 2000s nostalgia with socially conscious rap.

f767d93f03953eb27f7548e581b29e72062b138d.en: A Halloween show at Le Zapata by the Magic Boys, mixing dance, stage performance and choreographed striptease. The early part, from 8pm to 11pm, is reserved for women; entry with a glass of sparkling wine is 12 euros.

3b45c4bbb2307848d71ef3d455685521a97c0d5d.en: A weekly stand-up night in central Toulouse, where several comedians share the bill, mixing local talent with new and established names from across France. This session is on 22 October at 8.30pm.

efe05adaa8c7f8c9375c6a66a813f86562ffa408.en: An electro-trad night at Le DAda on Thursday 22 October at 8.30pm, part of the Occitania festival. DJ Aimé from Nantes plays alongside Mr Brun and La Mascanha, who mix Occitan vinyl from the 70s and 80s. Entry is 3 to 7 euros.

12e29db4a6b14d7b5557b41fc6a4b9caceb8a067.en: A short, intense visit to the Monument à la Gloire de la Résistance, a brutalist memorial with crypts and a tunnel. It has no display panels, so visitors engage with its architecture and the history of the Resistance.

f0c3a7495e6990e84211aa33b93fdf812be2a60b.en: A multisport session at the Centre culturel Thieu Lam in Frouzins, part of the Haute-Garonne council's Ateliers Inclusifs. The programme gives young people aged 6 to 19 access to sports and arts activities in regular clubs, with support for individual needs.

a4153fa9f046f41e80ebd637d0a2ebad940f8a39.en: An exhibition at the Musée Saint-Raymond on the meeting of Gallic and Roman cultures after Caesar's conquest, covering daily life, beliefs and religion. It was made with the Musée de la Romanité in Nîmes, with playful family activities at the start.

f79e435a6962fe3738ccbc3ef6fef019270191c2.en: A hands-on 3D printing workshop at the Quai des Savoirs where participants model a small object, print it on site and add it to a shared artwork. Suited to children from 7, who must be accompanied by an adult under 12.

c2b81ca2e10070b3cc770adb10e69ac605109e90.en: A field hockey taster run at several sites in Haute-Garonne, part of the council's Ateliers Inclusifs for young people aged 6 to 19. The programme opens sports and arts clubs to everyone.

59193a61d28e451f1bd616cce8931e3f879b06ef.en: A permanent exhibition at the Bibliothèque d'Étude et du Patrimoine, created during the residency of the poet and artist Serge Pey. Art Deco display cases hold his artworks, books and personal archives, now part of the city's heritage.

bd491f560347b65c79e181df3180b0c52e1d305e.en: A retrospective of Spanish director Jonás Trueba at Le Cratère from 3 to 27 October, with four of his films and a film he produced for José Luis Guerín. His films explore love, friendship and time through spontaneous dialogue.

bc9a5c088afb1de4c4daffdc14f29d27cc53195a.en: An exhibition by The Pokémon Company and the European Space Agency at the Cité de l'espace, running until 30 April 2027. It pairs Pokémon with ESA missions to Jupiter, the Space Station and the Moon, and Pokémon GO events run during the visit.

d4aa14bcc09964e4b7f98803e9b651a26f07d039.en: An immersive installation of nine interactive pieces by Cie Adrien M & Claire B at the Quai des Savoirs. It turns familiar sensations, such as walking in grass or touching water, into an abstract digital landscape, and marks the centre's 10th anniversary.

6e361bac7882f5c7b7d19ba5311d17ddd6076ade.en: A photo exhibition on the bargemen who lived and worked on the Canal du Midi from the 1950s to the 1980s. It shows their daily lives, the ports and locks they used, and the wooden and steel boats they lived on.

3d52ae53b735d3f37281f234d90c992a99adf06c.en: A Pokémon and European Space Agency exhibition at the Cité de l'espace until 30 April 2027. It links Pokémon with ESA missions such as Ariane 6, Euclid and the Space Station, and invites visitors to play Pokémon GO on site.

c38ab7de01c969ce3f73815593222fe92e7502a2.en: An exhibition in three chapters across three Toulouse museums, marking the bicentenary of photography. It traces the many lives of the medium from the 19th to the 21st century, as a technique, an art and an everyday image.

3e210b0493796876aee15e18e5708d7658613ec1.en: A weekly outdoor market in Vieille-Toulouse, held every Tuesday from 4.30pm to 8pm under the covered hall at Borde-Haute, near the new town hall.

ab06db2ac9dc835faac2eb9d2a8268a5abbe129b.en: The Aéroflorale II, a flying greenhouse 15 metres high, stops at the Halle de La Machine in Toulouse through 2026. Its crew of 17 explorers gathered plants that can generate electricity, and a photo exhibition shows their journeys.

5ee7807ccfd89bf05d4348ccdb68656bd22db570.en: Horse-riding walks across Haute-Garonne run by the departmental equestrian tourism committee. They are part of the council's Ateliers Inclusifs programme for young people aged 6 to 19.

80885d4444e0829fd00b8a769dfde9174933c504.en: A group exhibition at the Bonnefoy library and cultural centre from 1 October to 16 January, showing nine illustrators from the Toulouse studio Le Canapé. Most pieces are original drawings in ink, watercolour and gouache.

76fec0336b4d3893546c9dc16c9a86040d987726.en: A theatre workshop at the Centre culturel Le Kiwi, part of the Haute-Garonne council's Ateliers Inclusifs for young people aged 6 to 19. It gives access to arts activities in regular venues.

f5c8975126eaa63b5fbb96977f78e2f2f48166a8.en: Learn-to-cycle sessions across Haute-Garonne run by the departmental cycling committee, part of the council's Ateliers Inclusifs for young people aged 6 to 19.

f08053603c96d30f76693ef94883e1375a9515cd.en: An exhibition at the Pavillon blanc Henri-Molina that treats landscape as an art form in its own right. Drawings and photographs blur into one another, exploring how landscapes shape us and how we shape them.

e5a09bc01e1ff2fe79278a951dec634e7fa02282.en: A self-guided puzzle trail for children at the Chapelle des Carmélites, following the angel Carmela through the chapel's architecture and paintings. The kit must be booked online and is available Wednesday to Sunday, 10am to 7pm.

596de8fe5901ca5c8600a63ba248c957cd86bc83.en: An exhibition of pastels, graphite and photographs at the Musée des Augustins, arranged as a walk among an artist's skies and the museum's architecture and collections. Its title refers to things that fade and transform elsewhere.

28520ba06ea0bf84a800eb7a1355671348532e9f.en: A self-guided visit of the Carmelite chapel in Toulouse, a little-known Baroque site whose painted ceiling is often compared with the Sistine Chapel. The chapel's history spans its founding in the 17th century and its years as a convent.

a8b13b7b87697b77791be6a4ee723098ad6acc43.en: An exhibition at the Musée des Arts Précieux Paul-Dupuy on drunkenness through history, from ancient bacchanals and Belle Époque posters to prevention campaigns. It looks at intoxication through moral, medical and legal views.

66a4cbd21923b4963856353084a49560a47e324a.en: From 12 to 25 October, students get free entry to Toulouse's municipal museums and monuments, along with exclusive visits.

17104218be7890acfc3a6ef2dde0bb3c9ee24574.en: A programme of five short films about imagination and magic, for children from 3, at the Quai des Savoirs during the Lumières sur le Quai festival. Each screening lasts 37 minutes and must be booked in advance.

2c5d2208116f22943830895f163ca74dc3e63f2a.en: A drawing and painting workshop for children aged 6 to 12 at the Musée des Augustins. They discover works in the museum and try techniques such as drawing and modelling, on the theme Under the waves in ink. No parent may stay with the child.

ffa9c11af5c4b8561b29a0e56aeada30227f22da.en: A two-hour creative workshop at the Musée des Augustins for children from 3 and an adult. Families draw, collage and model around the museum's artworks on the theme Under the waves in ink. Booking is needed for at least one adult and one child.

b6885523994ab0d66405a3b18758b622cc05e4d8.en: A concert on Friday 23 October at 1pm at the Bibliothèque d'Étude et du Patrimoine, part of the Occitania festival. Duo Cafoutche gives traditional songs a fresh and humorous reworking, on themes of mountains, spring and love.

72998fd745f0256684c14201064cdb6d1ef10dd0.en: An accessible exhibition on the scientific method, using the blob as its example, at the Quint-Fonsegrives media library from 17 to 27 October. It is co-produced by the Quai des Savoirs and CNRS Occitanie Ouest, with free entry.

6adafb1c70d621a455db2477c6e54e0cb903f225.en: Video games every Friday from 2 to 5pm at the Médiathèque des Minimes, with a FIFA tournament on 30 October at 3pm.

567b5286e90375631873cc5fad5da2b188dc4084.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins on how sculpture and painting show the body from the 12th to the 19th century, with themes of art, body and movement.

a398441b019ef9966a6b2944d4935246606af06b.en: A short family visit at the Musée des Augustins for children from 2, lasting 30 to 45 minutes. It is free and needs no booking, while places last.

9b27c524be6cec1f7ec0992b3396c18f0fa03eb6.en: A storytelling visit of the photography exhibition at the Château d'Eau, where a storyteller guides families through the show. The exhibition runs from 16 October 2026 to 21 February 2027.

ab3df7d93aa552f39761c60ea1516b34f43b455c.en: An interactive show at the Théâtre Sorano asking children how screens, fake news and images shape their minds. Using perception illusions, it shows how the brain brings puppets and algorithms to life. For ages 8 and up, 55 minutes.

8ba54ae9b55331d36fd5330b823360f354f8acbc.en: An ecological fable that retells Noah's Ark: a motley group led by Ferdinand faces a new flood. Screenings at the Quai des Savoirs during the Lumières sur le Quai festival, for ages 7 and up, 90 minutes long.

4d0cb1f54bbcf31dfe4de654f3b9fb8b32d8c021.en: A short activity at the Couvent des Jacobins, included with entry, on medieval clothing from the 13th to 15th century. Visitors learn how dress signalled social status and power, play a quiz, and dress up for a selfie.

4fd51b629290997c43368e7adae1da833878cadd.en: A Halloween film at Cinéma L'Autan for ages 6 and up. Ducobu returns when two teachers move into a house haunted by Anatole, the greatest dunce in school history, and the ghost leads everyone into comic mishaps.

fa800ac85d9fdceb218c185f13971cc8bb64588f.en: A guided tour of the Couvent des Jacobins, a 13th and 14th-century landmark five minutes from Place du Capitole and the Garonne riverbanks. An experienced guide shares anecdotes and architectural details for visitors of all ages.

e9cb24e938ce8c710c652f127f68d10658a10a9b.en: A Halloween story session for children aged 4 to 8 at the Médiathèque Danièle Damin on Friday 23 October at 4.30pm. The 45-minute reading is set in the library.

bf6b683e7970b14dcb6bc8d271a035e7807939e4.en: A film screening at the Quai des Savoirs during the Lumières sur le Quai festival. In 2075, 10-year-old Iris meets Arco, a boy from a far future where time travel exists, and helps him get home. For ages 8 and up, 90 minutes.

29861bb8dc3cb93fb39b2035e054e32d8cb5bc31.en: A poetic performance by Cie d'iElles, made with residents and students of the Grand Mirail during a long residency. It celebrates everyday gestures of care and mutual support. Friday 23 October at 5pm, 50 minutes, from age 8.

c298b756e52804599722692deeee9f459a7d35bd.en: A family escape game at the Bibliothèque d'Étude et du Patrimoine on Friday 23 October at 5.30pm. Teams of investigators must solve a case of contaminated books before visitors can be welcomed again. For ages 8 to 12, parents welcome.

f287553f3979544186bce5cf36c53b444a4c3db0.en: A Hatha yoga session at the Musée des Augustins led by teacher Géraldine Avisse, designed to awaken the senses. It lasts 1.5 hours and is free for students.

6068412615df69a6bd0b97375a0a42ce73056280.en: A weekly stand-up night in central Toulouse, where several comedians share the bill, mixing local talent with new and established names from across France. This session is on 23 October at 7pm.

2d5d26cfd87acb70f441a06a1349ca6bcaa96bd4.en: A Spanish-language party night at the Dozo sushi restaurant in Toulouse, themed around heartbreak songs. It has collective karaoke, Latin pop, a DJ and cocktails, from 7pm.

0077e35c9a1d8f52220da10c07d6f14bc1c25c64.en: A concert by rapper VEN1 at La Cabane in Les Halles de la Cartoucherie, Toulouse. The Nanterre artist, whose hit Hakayet is diamond-certified, mixes melancholy, pride and his Algerian roots in his music.

16858848627a86330f8ea825f623d179152c8fc4.en: A weekly stand-up night in central Toulouse, where several comedians share the bill, mixing local talent with new and established names from across France. This session is on 23 October at 8.30pm.

1da45628ba7af3353a508e67d721c76e6c9919bf.en: A rock and blues concert at Les Marins d'Eau Douce in Ramonville on Friday 23 October at 9pm. The band reworks songs in the spirit of Texan singer Calvin Russell, from acoustic ballads to energetic blues-rock. Tickets are 8 euros, sold by the artists.

bc11e7f686a24d10097484086c5d507d32a21250.en: A synthwave and space-disco night with DJ Pasteq at The Petit London in Toulouse. The cellar goes dark for dancing; entry is free from 10pm until closing.

ec128f38159093e9a1c989ae4249615466cf2265.en: A night with Jack de Marseille, a pioneer of French electronic music who co-organised Marseille's first rave parties in 1992 and was the first DJ on the Daft Punk album tour. Part of the Frankielanuit night series.

4e3f8eec37ccfebc611f20622a0824b2c9b164dd.en: A 90s versus 2000s party at La Voile Blanche on Friday 23 October from 10pm to 4am. Guests pick their decade, with R&B, hip-hop, dancehall, zouk and pop hits, and are invited to wear vintage clothes.

9fff9278294a74c6b37c59b80732fae3a9c03ecc.en: A night of intense electronic music at Le Bikini on Friday 23 October from midnight to 5.30am. Five DJ duos face off on a 360-degree stage in the middle of the crowd, with techno, bouncy trance, hard groove and rave.

3dacff924e44dc1d13cf21ee5356c6ee6e906465.en: A techno, hard techno, rawstyle and hardcore night at Interference in Balma on 23 October, from 11.59pm to 6am. Samuel Moriero, Dual Damage and Schlass are on the line-up. Entry is for over-18s with ID.

77536cb90e7f645352a300cec17e66733c9651d0.en: The first showcase in Toulouse by Yanamko, a rising urban artist from the Pink City, on Friday 23 October at O Club by Charleston. He drew attention with his appearance in the latest season of La Nouvelle École.

1c31ea80bec2be1826f6bc4f6dd91a154b803825.en: A drum and bass night at Le Rex in Toulouse that launches a new partnership between Vandal Records and Flexout Audio. The line-up includes ENEI, Molecular, Rido and Kräx, Revan and Broma. Tickets are 18 euros in advance and 20 euros on the door.

e0f36d49501c430b218dbc9a1b2f6a25a8f3e12d.en: A monthly Saturday at the municipal archives when visitors can meet other researchers, ask questions and exchange findings, for an hour or a full day.

121204c9c58698fc2782af5419234d94ea0e31ab.en: A one-to-one digital help session on Saturday 24 October from 10am to 11am at the José Cabanis media library. A mediator shows how to speed up your computer with simple tips.

0e3d456ea7ab7ba57ee57f71a99b3754ca509418.en: An interactive exhibition from 17 to 31 October at the José Cabanis media library. Through a tablet, ten pages of the book Acqua Alta become dancing miniature worlds, blending theatre, dance, comics and animation.

f4ab408125bba6904877bb7494e834c18eb737c2.en: An introduction to genealogy at the Médiathèque Danièle Damin on Saturday 24 October, led by members of the Cercle généalogique de l'Union. Bring your questions and any personal family records.

0f1bb19a33287d38cbcb7e1e5354357cf8bef7c6.en: A 30-minute Halloween story session for children from 3 at the Médiathèque Rangueil on Saturday 24 October at 10.30am. Booking is required by phone.

b1e006353d72fd5c956ccdae81a7b94d0b293399.en: A reading club for readers aged 10 and up at the Médiathèque Saint-Exupéry, where members share favourite novels, comics and manga. The sessions last one hour, on 24 October, 21 November and 19 December at 11am.

bae8c2f2b8e0565ce9153706a404206e39d48de1.en: A workshop in the art of movement, a discipline that uses urban furniture to move with control, taught by Chau Belle, one of the founders of the Yamakasi movement. It is held at the Karben gymnasium on Saturday 24 October from 11am, and beginners are welcome.

cd8275e9e01559f5f6bdb0eb844efe2c91b396fa.en: A themed guided visit of the Castelet, the former administrative building of the Saint-Michel prison in Toulouse. It covers political imprisonment under Vichy and the Nazi occupation, using documented accounts and testimony.

b66af2977875cf03cce9bf919efbe6755dea88c6.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins on the gods and myths shown in its paintings and sculptures. It looks at the fascinating, flawed divinities that mirror our own weaknesses.

9e696d5329c92445c22c7b6bcfb05d2fb192a350.en: A walk through Toulouse's streets with Avelina Fabre, exploring notorious local cases from the city's past, including the Calas affair and the beheading of a duke in the Capitole. Part of the Occitania festival; booking is needed through HelloAsso.

b09824184f2a2ce12e6eeaabaa3f67c33c207b84.en: A photobook club meeting on Saturday 24 October at 3pm at the José Cabanis media library, organised with Belén Jiménez. Places are limited and booking is required.

47d932378606d4c6dcab9cecc670f5a670c94ad7.en: A reading club for comics and manga fans on Saturday 24 October at 3pm at the José Cabanis media library. Members share favourites and frank dislikes for 1.5 hours; booking is needed.

161409274fd731a35428f1b7161491dd1f13c3ea.en: A 30-minute visit of the Castelet, a 19th-century relic of the Saint-Michel prison. The guide explains why and how the prison was built, its surveillance design, and its role in the Second World War, through personal stories.

0d05bb36afedc2a70b01cbcc1a619c2d31499b8f.en: A time-themed visit at the Musée des Arts Précieux Paul-Dupuy for ages 12 and up. The detective Clarisse Tinquiette traces how people measured time, from hourglasses to clocks, guided by the 18th-century clockmaker Antide Janvier.

7320341b6e22e2d896fe498fef758360c7b169ad.en: A screening at Cinéma L'Autan of a film that won the Palme d'Or at Cannes. A devout Romanian-Norwegian couple's strict upbringing of their children comes into question when a teacher finds bruises on the eldest daughter.

5314fe4814ad693de4c4fe89e2c178a8745e22d7.en: A night organised by FREE Time on 24 October, in a raw venue in eastern Toulouse, where 1929 newspapers meet colour and music. It is about building new spaces to create, share and be together amid uncertainty.

93e542b336b2c7dc5444cfc6771ea9d5be665409.en: A two-day accordion festival at the Chapelle des Carmélites on 24 and 25 October. Acts range from Balkan jazz and musette to Mediterranean and Latin American tunes, with a dance piece in the courtyard.

9465f4eefe3c9c5f76ce3e8c831f069abe26480e.en: A Taylor Swift 20th-anniversary party at Delirium Café in Toulouse on 24 October 2026. It has a DJ set of hits and fan favourites from every era, a cocktail menu, a photobooth and merch to win. Doors open at 7.30pm.

cceef6af49ed35e3293036dec0c585b8c7b4431a.en: A concert by rapper Nono La Grinta at the Metronum on Saturday 24 October. One of the most talked-about young rappers in his area, he gained wide attention with the 2023 duet La Quoi.

7bc874fb790cae671b01f3e939f1983090d70473.en: A weekly stand-up night in central Toulouse, with several comedians sharing the bill, from local talent to new and established names. This session is on Saturday 24 October at 8.30pm.

87ef6cb963f5d90e490f7614730df57f7a091cfb.en: A duo of Lebanese musicians, accordion and percussion, performing at the 24 Hours of Accordion at La Cave Poésie. Their Levantine music mixes spontaneous improvisation with folk and popular traditions.

cb493c62d1c58c70e927dc4ba80842a4c23a300f.en: A dark, hypnotic techno night at Le Chorus in Toulouse, where two collectives join forces for a second edition. Local DJs and guests play groove, techno and hypnotic sets, with a cool bar and a harm-reduction stand.

f08e1cb541d6dece25e2775bb0048b671fc9c8b9.en: A live machine techno night at The Petit London with Geargeist, a new Toulouse collective. Three live performers play sounds ranging from hypnotic and mental to raw industrial and electro-groove.

e864d0df71e97eddd2fc78cacb04f8db956b95bb.en: An XXL Halloween night of hard music at the Arena Electronic Club on Saturday 24 October, doors at 11pm. Three promoters combine for two stages and an outdoor zone. Under-18s are not admitted, even with a ticket.

ed7a1ba3e5811744d72378fb041f142871149432.en: An all-night techno, acid and trance set by Milio Ruando at Le Rex de Toulouse on Saturday 24 October, with surprise guests joining during the night. An emerging talent with energetic, hypnotic sounds.

271fa39f7d7337214d1b2998358e2075f42e79db.en: An all-night electronic music event headlined by OMAKS at Le Bikini in Ramonville, open from 11pm to 5.30am. It is not open to under-18s, and ID may be requested.

b417310f47ea24ff343408c2fd9df2a59ac7b36f.en: A hard techno and hard bounce night aboard the barge Le Cri de la Mouette in Toulouse on Saturday 24 October, from midnight to 6am. Bowod and Michi build heavy kicks and groove through the night.

4041deb4b5018136bd37da8eb3a5a8b377db580a.en: A Saturday night party at L'Étoile club in Toulouse, billed as Five Stars, promising a festive night out with its regular crowd.

fbf777db5419143563c18a30a50a0f227269d8a8.en: A non-competitive ride across the Lauragais, from the Salle de l'Oustal in Escalquens. It is open to licensed and unlicensed riders of all ages, with marked routes, no timing and a new gravel route in 2026.

a54e7d0eee701d2d605ab2cf96192ec601e74aab.en: A guided tour of the Église du Gesù, a former Jesuit church in the Carmes district. Its neo-Gothic interior has wax-painted decor, stained glass and a classified Cavaillé-Coll organ, built between 1854 and 1861.

c46b2219c7bfd41bb5d6888ee27494f4cfb60e76.en: A free French conversation group at the José Cabanis media library every Sunday from 2 to 3.30pm, all year except summer holidays. Librarians guide relaxed talk for all levels and nationalities.

44eaa9f594fbd3658f4375d0c728e335cb7b5c0a.en: A talk for ages 7 and up at the Musée des Arts Précieux Paul-Dupuy, where clocks and watches are opened up to reveal their mechanisms and the craft of the people who care for them.

3c1f32872d0a2ec899f62b7c2c7b931bb02249c0.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins' collection of carved capitals, taken from three Toulouse cloisters destroyed after the French Revolution. Each stone tells a story sculpted in the Romanesque style.

07bf7c22b16241ed3626387cf9e5284a4db2537c.en: An architectural walk along the Canal du Midi in Toulouse, on one of two routes. Each bridge and bank reveals the city's history, gardens and architecture from a new angle. Run by Parcours d'architecture.

a6ef33fd59f69ac1e023b9fe9f34a126050807e0.en: An architectural and urban visit starting from the Esplanade de la Capitainerie. Along the towpaths, two routes show Toulouse through its trees, bridges and architecture, seen from the Canal du Midi.

3cbaf7747fd4115b8fb3e56b41c78754dbed4d55.en: A guided visit with a mediator through the photography exhibition at the Château d'Eau, running 16 October 2026 to 21 February 2027. Visitors explore the artistic message and share their reactions to the images.

5f197bb81a00f0d7cb9d292f02f0de244479f48e.en: A Sunday electro night at Frankielanuit with DJ B-Maïky and an all-local line-up. Entry is by free donation, and food can be ordered from two partner restaurants on site.

b971a44baa1ea9bfce320bcbd6350c0e0b14ce86.en: A weekly Sunday session at 4.15pm at the José Cabanis media library, with discovery through music, images and words. Suited to children from age 3.

2cf78a77c8a978d54a9f96bae14f0d880dd53d3b.en: A creative dance week at the Conservatoire, where students work with the invited choreographer Dylan Crossman, a former Merce Cunningham dancer. Their original piece is shown publicly on Friday 30 October at 3.30pm.

537cef392abb607f1cdc62e7a7f54fa1ec672f24.en: A fortnight of energy-renovation events in Saint-Jean: an exhibition at the town hall from 26 October to 6 November, a workshop, a market stand and a conference on Thursday 5 November at 6.30pm.

914a2d223b6361a0f97e14d8762b2995bbd7f357.en: Free training for carers of people with disabilities, funded by the Haute-Garonne council. Six two-hour practical workshops in Toulouse, from October to November, teach good posture and help prevent burnout.

f6603447540aee29be99545eeb7aeedbc09ad839.en: A storytelling visit for children aged 3 to 5 at the Musée des Augustins, with rhymes and tales told by Douyou Démone in front of the artworks. The 45-minute session needs an adult companion.

80d9a854dcbdb3c44f040b3ab844621479318ee9.en: An intensive DJing course on Pioneer digital decks at the Centre Culturel Bellegarde, 26 to 28 October, 2 to 5pm, for ages 13 and up. Led by Ryukken, it covers mixing, effects and live improvisation for beginners and experienced players.

18711784c696726a3e84c0af115bfa85bd281bc6.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins on Orientalism, the 19th-century fascination with the East. Paintings and sculptures explore travel tales, observed cultures and idealised visions of elsewhere.

fcc8e9ee7329a6e080ede03c7cb12fbabe78e15e.en: A blood donation session at the Salle des fêtes Jean Cassan in Escalquens on Monday 26 October, 2.30 to 7pm. Blood is needed every day for emergencies, surgery and cancer care, and no synthetic substitute exists.

6461a13bdf929075bdfa9d4ae67f0dbbcf4bd6ab.en: A screening of L'Odyssée at Cinéma L'Autan, in French. The IMAX epic, shot around the world, follows Ulysses on his return to Ithaca. Not suitable for children under 12.

b16589e011c260f223641c853a2538242dbb798e.en: A blood donation drive at the salle des fêtes in Ramonville on Monday 26 October, 3 to 7pm, organised by the French Blood Establishment (EFS). Appointments can be booked online.

6290ef4cfa54901618cd98b51d12eb515fc0bbde.en: A screening at Utopia Borderouge, preceded at 7pm by a Palestinian meal prepared by Kamoune. The meal and film cost 20 euros and must be booked; the film alone is at usual rates.

49da1f90149dc8ad50720c0cb8cf1b87d6d3bb5b.en: A three-hour collaborative workshop on energy renovation at the Centre Social Café des Granges in Saint-Jean, run by Toulouse Métropole Rénov'. Players use 47 cards to map the steps of a renovation. Limited to 8 places.

fff55afcb9f0bc0aea6abe189093f145206a5d91.en: A weekly public writer service every Tuesday from 10am to 5pm at the José Cabanis media library, for help with letters, admin files and CVs. Booking is by phone only; there is no session on 10 November.

237cebd1b51c515eb332344100c2f5cfb1862108.en: A family show by Marine Baousson, adapted from her science podcast for children, for ages 6 and up. Children choose the topics, from volcanoes to dinosaurs, and get clear, funny answers. Tuesday 27 October at 10.30am, 8 euros.

45d702d7ddea6da8ab406368edfd1e0b5ae7acf5.en: A two-hour art workshop for children aged 6 to 12 at the Musée des Augustins. The children explore the museum's works and try techniques such as printmaking, on the theme of trees and leaves. No parent may stay with them.

088733fc941aef65c1f0ee9019b20d339e911a26.en: A workshop at the Couvent des Jacobins for all ages on medieval letter-making and illumination. Participants choose a letter, perhaps their first initial, and learn to make a gilded lettrine with traditional gold leaf.

ba2d947db165762156fad6ed23957ed9fc34c8f3.en: A meeting with children's author-illustrator Marie-Constance Mallard at the Musée des Augustins, with a 30-minute cloister and gargoyle visit at 2pm and a book signing. Booking is required; places are limited.

4722bbe82890c6f983dc8493f97769651b4434b4.en: A paper pop-up workshop for children at the Castelet, inspired by the panopticon, a prison design for watching without being seen. After a short visit, children cut, colour and glue a pop-up card of the site to take home.

227f7405bd1cdebfb0fa2ee964babdf5de0b8a49.en: A free French conversation group at the Serveyrolles media library every Tuesday from 2.30 to 3.30pm, outside school holidays. A host leads the first Tuesday of each month; the other three run on their own.

43f0d9a3ad88118e5b3ef09103dee005c1ae9638.en: A book signing with children's author-illustrator Marie-Constance Mallard at the museum shop of the Musée des Augustins, from 3 to 5pm. It is held in partnership with Éditions Privat.

ed70e03a03242206b63cdb525c06c11a6c9a39f4.en: A screening of a Jacques Tati classic about Monsieur Hulot's holiday in a seaside resort, at Cinéma L'Autan on Tuesday 27 October. A free, no-booking acting workshop follows at 4.30pm.

9f47f2444b0bc8c66c86730974408c7f0338a897.en: A free conversation at the Quai des Savoirs on Tuesday 27 October at 3pm about how artists and scientists explore the world together. Speakers include Lauriane Gricourt of Les Abattoirs, artist Hélène Virion and Florence Clément of CNES.

138b1c8b07e123f78fb29f3b6a5999c76a06c1a7.en: A musical reading for families at the Médiathèque des Izards on Tuesday 27 October at 4pm, built around picture books about the circus. Voice, accordion and playful instruments fill the stories with songs and sounds. For ages 6 months to 5.

2c94069206551e1582fb31e09f8421163143f011.en: A weekly digital help session every Tuesday from 5 to 6.30pm at the Médiathèque Grand M, outside school holidays. Bring your device and prepared questions; a digital mediator helps solve computer problems.

f157f790d54b90af40a817c7fd9599115d29b3a7.en: A book club at the Bibliothèque d'Étude et du Patrimoine on Tuesday 27 October from 5.15 to 6.45pm, where readers share a book they loved or disliked. Booking is by email, and you are welcome even with nothing to share.

3e5d4ab36472000145765399edafe5a8f9bc7915.en: A talk at the José Cabanis media library on Tuesday 27 October at 6pm by Thierry Fusco of ONERA on adaptive optics. The technology corrects atmospheric turbulence in real time and is key to giant telescopes; the talk covers recent examples.

bb5d06a2702fd5d1fa4df4c37f21efc54414fe35.en: A one-hour live science show by physicist Julien Bobroff at the Quai des Savoirs on Tuesday 27 October at 6.30pm. Using modelling clay and no slides, it traces the first atoms of the universe to the matter around us. Free, with booking.

4a458c06bb184f0e51688771c27f05398ca33d17.en: A free three-hour awareness workshop for young project leaders aged 15 to 25 at Espace Roguet in Toulouse. It covers the basics of structuring a cultural project, hiring in the arts and turning an idea into a project.

a408441e32702faccb9c7df829a65cccb756dd38.en: A week of free creative workshops at Le Kiwi from 28 to 31 October for the fifth Fiesta de Muertos, inspired by Mexican culture. Activities include costumes, cooking, dance and an offerings altar, closing with a festive parade on 31 October.

5e0d2c9b000e85889152e23e8b889945485a0d51.en: A weekly reading and nursery rhyme session for children aged 0 to 3 at the José Cabanis media library, every Wednesday at 10.30am. Sign up on the day, subject to places.

6294d0be7b9fde327d9b494d25901d55e075a8f0.en: A visit at the Couvent des Jacobins on the principles of heritage conservation, looking at restorations around the cloister and the Saint-Antonin chapel. The medieval building was once a military barracks and has been restored in many periods.

b2e349a20e9c1668e31009b06af6726cabd9dda3.en: A short guided visit of the Chapelle de La Grave on Toulouse's left bank, focusing on its architecture and one of its artworks. The collection includes sculptures, paperolle reliquaries and large religious paintings.

5d98304a7f191bdcbbe3233ccdc3ec20ad83787f.en: A guided visit of the Noviciat to learn about the heritage and architecture of Toulouse. Visitors book a time slot to join a guide and discover the city's buildings.

94cdefb7cc7871abe17c7f1fe8af4568794ae9cc.en: A Halloween crafts session on Wednesday 28 October, 2.30 to 4.30pm, at the Serveyrolles media library. Children make a cotton-bud skeleton to decorate the library for the spooky evening on 29 October. For ages 6 and up, no booking.

e90c27eafa2d6a38346e7d09d0ad8d661c9c6180.en: A screening of two animated short films at the José Cabanis media library on Wednesday 28 October at 2.30pm, with stories told by storyteller Mara de Patagonie. The films are Lola et le piano à bruits and Mon petit frère de la lune.

7f66aacc63fef474bcaadc3db2c3401660d7fb03.en: A live recording of the Quai des Savoirs podcast Détour vers le futur on Wednesday 28 October, 3 to 4.15pm. Its guests, including CNES astrophysicist Aurélie Moussi, ask what science still seeks in space. Free, open to all.

48547cacbbb561ba1cd0d3ac4787a6e94b4a8d2d.en: A short visit of the Chapelle de La Grave on the plague remedies of early modern times. It covers herbs such as sage and thyme, and the famous vinegar of the four thieves, whose recipe visitors can take home.

8ce13441827f3f6d264906c4947fb5f88bd76813.en: A reading session for children aged 5 to 8 at the Médiathèque des Pradettes on Wednesday 28 October at 4pm. Stories are chosen by the library team, sometimes around the season or current events.

81dcc42a2534f987955385acb2da923aa1e4b270.en: A two-part workshop on traditional music of the Colombian Caribbean with Jorge Aguilar y sus Embelecos at Samba Résille: percussion from 6.30 to 8pm, then dance from 8.30 to 10pm. Open to all levels, 20 to 25 euros per workshop.

46f8d6b380acb5a84ea6a989220a56999b180938.en: A storytelling evening at Le Kalari Toulousain, based on the third volume of Les Messagers du chemin, a collection of spiritual tales from around the world. Arnaud Pelletier tells stories gathered in Mexico, from myths to everyday life.

b5c0fc48922e5542b5c5eadcdcc2d76768d911b6.en: A screening at Le Cratère of Vincent Dieutre's film Chantal A., Bruxelles (1h25). A director shaped by Chantal Akerman's films traces her footprints in Brussels, her birthplace, and his own way of making cinema.

5f88898f966737180a835fc350f97bdb7183067c.en: A screening of Vincent Dieutre's film Chantal A., Bruxelles (1h25), followed by a meeting with Isabelle Labrouillère and Emmanuel Cano on Wednesday 28 October at 7.30pm at Le Cratère. The film is a wandering tribute to Chantal Akerman.

d448545cb4dbcc7d28f544bfd60e9219ce1379ae.en: A two-hour collage workshop for children aged 6 to 12 at the Musée des Augustins, themed Lion hunt. The children discover works in the museum and try techniques such as drawing and modelling. No parent may stay with the child.

960654120dcadd4c10809decdf281dd31a369aaa.en: A free lunch debate with writer Mathieu Simonet at the TO7 Maison des chômeurs in Reynerie on Thursday 29 October, 12 to 2pm. He presents his inquiry into cloud seeding and the rights of clouds. Booking is by email.

23ba006fa58060071f6ebb454ab2d67f3db5f9a4.en: A free cloud-watching session at the Lac de la Reynerie on Thursday 29 October, 2.30 to 3.30pm, led by Mathieu Simonet. Participants lie on the grass, watch clouds and write what they see, for a poetic petition on cloud rights. Suitable from age 7.

886866f7eeb3642c9955dbe8f08ccc48b48465ed.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins that pairs artworks with scents such as musk, cinnamon, jasmine and tobacco, inviting visitors to smell the paintings. Two routes cover the painting and sculpture salons; a third explores the medieval rooms.

49db0d1521039981d7eec60e54fa444d19e85668.en: A film screening at the Quai des Savoirs on Thursday 29 October, about a large scientific cloud-observation campaign in Barbados that echoes early 20th-century cloud films. Followed by a discussion with the directors and Météo France. Free, with booking.

5ad1733c34942844a08508d88de8561ffacb50d7.en: A photography workshop at the Pavillon blanc Henri-Molina. Participants turn ecology-related word-plays into keywords, then translate each keyword into a photograph.

48c91bed1a23b72106dd7e97d0d8ab1fc1e39955.en: A screening at Cinéma L'Autan for ages 6 and up. Christophe, 11, must wear a back brace to straighten his posture while his farm family faces hard times. He discovers music and a new friend, Clara.

4c35b1ba885f853a4637d22a9d4e5c083c2db465.en: A mock trial at the Quai des Savoirs on cloud seeding, a technique used by around fifty countries. Experts and lawyers present the arguments without taking sides, and the audience acts as the jury.

7478c2439de0c2a0e3bd31fe3adfe2a6fe3d9175.en: A Halloween story evening at the Bibliothèque d'Étude et du Patrimoine on Thursday 29 October at 6.45pm, held in a former library. Children aged 8 and up can listen to or share frightening stories. One hour; booking is by email.

071bfef9f3091177a7ffe54c9dc8fc60de04fd33.en: A drinks meeting from 6.45pm at the Salle Ginette Forgues, where car-sharing users, Sicoval staff and the Citiz Occitanie cooperative explain how the service works, what it costs and whether it might suit you.

6e49675d8186a3016c139c460b4a4d8955273775.en: An evening of music at the Chapelle des Carmélites to open the Halloween season. Barnabaie's soft guitar textures, Elizabeth Vogler's ritual echoes, The Cradle's freak folk and Radio Hito's minimal songs share the bill.

262561be7e76ba8027c3e1c731530591da61c17d.en: A weekly stand-up night in central Toulouse, where several comedians share the bill, mixing local talent with new and established names from across France. This session is on Thursday 29 October at 7pm.

6bd29131313b131f8e496664f864c4419e56e640.en: A monthly Irish and Celtic music jam at Le Grenier in Castanet-Tolosan, on the last Thursday of the month. The bar opens at 6pm, musicians play from around 7.30pm, and food is served on site. Musicians can join in.

30f08635091e56e189c2a47ae1b8388b6c82f648.en: A family night-time detective game at the Église du Gesù, played with torches. Players search for a plan hidden by the architect Henri Bach, using puzzles, codes and his journal, based on the church's history and architecture.

14d33a900252841f208c3192910675d1bad9ddcb.en: An improvised concert in the Music Box of the Metronum, a women-led edition of the series Are You Experienced. Leïla Martial and other guests each bring three secret melodies, and Gérald Toto turns them into a unique creation.

3b409eac72c16fdcd72d26ef946ff38fa64875ea.en: A concert by Algerian-born artist TIF at Interference in Toulouse, on his tour for the 2026 album SAVASHUIA. His live shows blend rap, Algerian-influenced sounds and melodic songs, with his band on stage.

910a3c573a90d29a3c1470314963ffc10e71a031.en: A weekly stand-up night in central Toulouse, where several comedians share the bill, mixing local talent with new and established names from across France. This session is on Thursday 29 October at 8.30pm.

975b7a3962e6fdcb603ff4d1a6ee5b99799f4dad.en: The first 100% bouncy night by ElectroNyx in Toulouse, at Little O'Clock, with an all-female line-up. Rorenu plays from 9pm, Voluptia at 10.30pm and Blakarm from midnight.

fc7f91f58965643d7bf39a18a293f82ce50627ae.en: A party at Le Bikini where the DJ teams of the 2000s and 2010s nights battle through playlists spanning two decades, from Daft Punk and Madonna to Lady Gaga and Amy Winehouse.

0f5cd308b9ae1de93c7d94ed8e48c31873475a00.en: An all-night dark techno and peak-time set by Hamslow at Le Cri de la Mouette, a barge club in Toulouse. The minimal sets build tension continuously. The listing is dated Thursday 29 September.

bdcc631a6ef89a27cbb710b7f8245f402fed03af.en: A singing session for babies at the Médiathèque Côte Pavée on Friday 30 October at 10am, with babbling and nursery rhymes. Booking is by phone on 05 67 72 84 50.

08a776264bb8a2ffea824945060473fe118d3bfa.en: A two-hour clay modelling workshop for children aged 6 to 12 at the Musée des Augustins, themed Funny faces. The children explore the museum's works and try techniques such as drawing and modelling. No parent may stay with them.

2c8ceffb604f23462a2f3723213cb8080bf70edd.en: A Halloween programme of short films for ages 3 and up at Cinéma L'Autan. Monsters turn silly, witches turn gentle and a little ghost might become a friend, including the story of Gary, a monster who is not much good at scaring anyone.

a648e849fc88b03402c3dd521857182299a7dd70.en: A free French conversation group at the Médiathèque Saint-Exupéry on Friday 30 October, 2 to 3.15pm, led by librarians. It is open to all levels and nationalities, with talk about books, films and culture.

a1be8f0ca1cce90b48cf8c219ed646c2ea62350e.en: A festive afternoon at the Médiathèque Salou Casaïs in Pinsaguel on Friday 30 October for the Martror. Makeup effects from 2pm, a storytelling show of rat tales at 4pm, then Occitan dancing with Les Pescofis from 5pm to 7pm.

78dfe9f8c1dda8309b19c5a58be2c9ebfd452f6b.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins with melodies chosen to match the works. Three routes cover the painting and sculpture salons, the women depicted in the collections, and the medieval rooms and cloister.

0471317ed33271cafc7a31673d218f1125977f87.en: A workshop at the Musée des Arts Précieux Paul-Dupuy using posters from the exhibition to learn cyanotype, an early photographic process that prints images in blue tones using sunlight.

a6af2f57a951a33a2b78ccbf2bff93a11440ad2b.en: A screening of the animated film Azur & Asmar at the José Cabanis media library on Friday 30 October at 3pm, part of the animation cinema festival. Two boys raised on the same legends are separated as they grow up.

3b75763a7754e040bf970c87c5827ba27165b506.en: A public performance at the Auditorium Saint-Pierre-des-Cuisines, where students of the Conservatoire dance department show the work made in a week with choreographer Dylan Crossman. Tickets are online from 16 October; a few places may free up before the show.

f1b545accfcb500365a0b27a6b968a38a7ad4355.en: A calm, sensory evening visit for families at the Musée des Arts Précieux Paul-Dupuy, lasting 45 minutes. It is for children aged 3 to 5, and one adult must come with each child.

95efe4a90658d4bf5d39d3d0fbd12bbd138456df.en: A free installation at the Quai des Savoirs where visitors make a portrait with natural pigments from fermentation, which keeps changing like the micro-organisms around us. Led by artist-researcher Diane Trouillet, open 30 October to 1 November.

95263ec141ccf0a8112eea0218b97043e564cff3.en: A weekly stand-up night in central Toulouse, where several comedians share the bill, mixing local talent with new and established names from across France. This session is on Friday 30 October at 7pm.

a8afb6c70b3de99357149ce8bdf061b242d9bfd8.en: A free evening of live music, art and food at the Quai des Savoirs on Friday 30 October, 7pm to 11pm, organised by the Toulouse culture magazine Clutch to mark 10 years of the Lumières sur le Quai festival.

1343ee12fa709520806c91fd7d23cab9262b57cf.en: An electronica concert at Le Rex in Toulouse by the duo Two Lanes, the German brothers Leo and Rafa. They mix acoustic recordings, analogue synths and electronic rhythms, and have over 300 million streams.

e4360f48a44435379e4d2c82438c86637735d00e.en: A concert by French rapper Ajna at La Cabane in Les Halles de la Cartoucherie on Friday 30 October, doors at 7.30pm. He presents Antidote, a long-awaited project that follows his sold-out tour.

e8d7389103f1f86fe56ec3b1dda2e17fc2fd7e53.en: A queer Halloween party at the Delirium Café in Toulouse on Friday 30 October, 7.30pm to 11.30pm, with a pop DJ set, themed decor and cocktails. It is billed as safe and inclusive, with no dress code.

1d8a2b9e9439225c02f74510a1a2c9b6d045ca78.en: A soul and funk concert at La Cave d'Occitanie in Pechbonnieu on Friday 30 October, 8pm to 10pm, closing the season. The newly formed band shares songs about love, peace and sharing from over 20 years of experience.

0e1b119a4220d52d149ccd8a29acc15140deca31.en: A Day of the Dead party at La Voile Blanche in Toulouse on Friday 30 October, 8pm to 4am. Expect reggaeton, flowers and candles, and Día de los Muertos make-up is encouraged.

e5e8841c28dca2318b43db2369062c237dc0200c.en: The closing night of the Occitania festival at Cabaret Le 9 in Toulouse on Friday 30 October at 8pm, a balèti fandango for the Martror and the Day of the Dead. Masca Son plays energetic techno-punk-trad, and La Tarasca blends son jarocho with Occitan song.

79229180c9546488c57ad140c60eca356b7bdb07.en: A screening at the ABC cinema in the presence of director Khalil Cherti and actress Nina Meurice. The listing gives no further details.

8423699e5fc8a2a98c0c4a0867c587b8e4ce9ba4.en: A Stranger Things-themed evening at the Tournefeuille media library on Friday 30 October from 6.30pm, with an escape game and a quiz. It ends with a screening of Gremlins at Utopia Tournefeuille at 9pm.

2eee968b489dd69ec01dc1c2c3a948c4ee9df8c1.en: A rock concert at Les Marins d'Eau Douce in Ramonville on Friday 30 October at 9pm, by a band whose members come from different parts of the world. Tickets are 5 euros, sold by the artists.

a26ae0e745a0960a288d7c81bd2e33be453d8479.en: A free electronic music night at Le Comptoir bar in Toulouse from 9pm to 1.30am, organised by Kosmopolit Events. Psytech, psytrance and bounce sets make up the line-up.

3fbf734c2787c8fb9f48420c1426a6ac16341bda.en: A night with Max TenRoM, a Toulouse producer who mixes melodic techno and live percussion, trained in jazz. He founded the CULTE collective in Toulouse and has played venues such as Buddha Bar and Sol Selectas.

e2522a270621ad17cfd086702773d5fc0b6c4fe7.en: A tribe, techno and drum and bass night at The Petit London on Friday 30 October, 10pm to 2am, with Antiform's return and the first night of a new venture with NET. Entry is free.

faa51f1632162da8fad2f5e7a2751af825997023.en: A Halloween party at Urban Lab in Toulouse for women and people who identify with the female spectrum. It has an all-female DJ set, Halloween shows, stalls and a prize for the best costume. Its code is sisterhood and respect.

e6a5a8577ed95f5cd286b6081eca2f41dea256ab.en: An all-night deep, raw, techno and tech house set by DRIZER AC on board the barge Le Cri de la Mouette, on Friday 30 October from midnight to 6am. The night builds from hypnotic pads to punchy kicks.

cb2021ddeac9530eaa81392343151ac82e911c19.en: A queer Halloween party at Le Rex in Toulouse on Friday 30 October, 11.55pm to 5.30am. Techno and hard trance sets are joined by drag and creature performances; come in your best costume.

227fd3122e93976f068c4abf319b16db4d158994.en: A pop, rock and new wave night at Le Bikini, with hits by Simple Minds, a-ha, The Cure, Depeche Mode, Étienne Daho and many more 1980s acts.

3688d6ed94ff09e9c4cb1ad084f15585d5bf523e.en: A Halloween night of hard music at Interference in Toulouse on Friday 30 October, 11.59pm to 6am. Hardstyle, rawstyle and hardcore acts including Cantal Goyave and Hackash open the first chapter of the series. Under-18s are not admitted.

9dfb1a4e1f3d2fea887d8c9c361ca7728a9d3c2f.en: An ARCHICITY workshop at the Mairie de Goyrans: a playful collective activity in which participants use brain, motor and manual skills to build and grow an imaginary city together.

214f14a645ddd7001347b9270e6017c6cae1d780.en: An exhibition-workshop at the Pôle civique where visitors see an imaginary paper city built collectively and shown at different stages. Participants make miniature architecture that is added to the work as it grows.

3fea1e39b48643400ce48bd62a3b607517d62bbd.en: A two-part creative workshop on the Giscard manufacture. On 31 October at the Archives, participants make lino-printed stamps for a collective catalogue; on 7 November, they model a clay motif at the Manufacture Giscard and take it home.

839d3f7767016a7b2d10a9a17514212b9f051522.en: Story sessions for children aged 0 to 3 at the Médiathèque des Izards every Saturday from 10 to 10.30am, including 31 October. Booking is by phone.

1bd8495d6bad48dea8696ce908032e178d929a2b.en: A free drop-in day at the Quai des Savoirs on 31 October and 1 November, 10am to 6pm, showing the maker space Plateau créatif with 3D pens, electronics and programming. Designed for ages 7 to 15, though adults can join too.

aa7309f1b9ae6e703b962b9f4a3b1c5c88b8ff11.en: A programme of short animated films by final-year students of ESMA Toulouse, shown at the Quai des Savoirs at 10.30am on 31 October and 1 November. The 51-minute selection is for ages 3 and up, free with on-site booking.

ee1a1419a73597752d9e37da8ddd44df37c69d6f.en: A 45-minute storytelling show for families from age 5 at the Frouzins municipal library. The storyteller retells tales found in a handkerchief, including Little Pio, who is always hungry, and Hansel and Gretel lost in the forest.

bd39fdf415aa7768a513eef9266a669451a8ca96.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins on monsters, gargoyles and legends. It looks at human and animal monstrosity and the distorted bodies that provoke fear, curiosity and fascination.

9f45277f739a6909fe81bd79bc7900caca5acb01.en: A 45-minute visit of the Bibliothèque d'Étude et du Patrimoine, a 1930s Art Deco landmark, covering its history and distinctive features. Booking is by email.

7334aa2878745f7aa63537669794784740752839.en: A Saturday talk at the Quai des Savoirs by Thierry Brassac of the University of Montpellier, on the science of soft toys. Children from age 6 are invited to share ideas for the research on why cuddly toys matter. Free on the day, 45 minutes.

323910e43656de3975c3f7a220950ce79df6e091.en: A free cloud-watching session on Saturday 31 October, 11am to noon, led by writer Mathieu Simonet. Participants lie on the grass, write what they see, and add to a poetic petition on cloud rights. Suitable from age 7.

565a5708b66347d6667f25c334f77808a38570c3.en: The closing celebration of the Fiesta de Muertos at Le Kiwi, with a make-up workshop, a family film at Cinéma L'Autan, a costumed parade around Ramonville with giant puppets, and a concert by the duo Framboyán.

2911297a579c6dab8d4a83706a989676349946d8.en: An interactive exhibition-workshop at the Pôle civique where visitors imagine and build miniature architecture to make a city. The collective artwork grows with each contribution and is shown at different stages. Everyone can take part.

5c2b6c671c31732d96f04f21d42bd823b03df9df.en: A participatory science session for children from 8 at the Quai des Savoirs on 31 October and 1 November. Visitors register their favourite soft toy, answer a questionnaire, have a photo taken and a radio interview. One adult per child; 1.5 hours.

72501a90ee999e306ea3093fd6d143bf365f1ab9.en: A manga reading club at the Médiathèque des Izards for ages 14 and up, on Saturday 31 October from 2 to 4pm and on 12 December. Members share what they have been reading.

37c1852c8d445f9e70ad85f6f3faad368908b3b5.en: Free live painting by the artist Reso at the Quai des Savoirs on 31 October, 2 to 7pm, and on 1 November in the morning and afternoon. He paints a large circle for science, with a child for future generations.

7f85fd2f4a21200597fe4819abd91869022ed0b6.en: A games festival at the Salle du Lac in Castanet-Tolosan on 31 October, 2pm to midnight, run by La Voie du Thalos. It offers board games, miniature games, escape games and role-playing, plus a raffle around 10pm. Some sessions need booking.

3061c24e31f8dc0dae5ff1a5a8bf432e0b714846.en: A participatory theatre piece by Compagnie LUIT at the Quai des Savoirs. Visitors enter a time accelerator and live decades into a future where states have faded, then help write an adaptation manual for their community.

aa15097a500ab9ff72f0c1cae14c309b8cb15c2f.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins on Gothic art, across three spaces: the sacristy, the Rieux chapel and the chapter house. It covers knights' sarcophagi, bishops' tombs and painted keystones from the 13th to the early 16th century.

89c3bce7bb9120174fd46c1ac73cb671eef46b47.en: A walk along the Port Saint-Sauveur and the canal in Toulouse, with a university geologist, a guide and a professional singer. It recalls when barges carrying goods shaped everyday life in the city.

51b1ac0f85a8b56fdf8ed5396c162cd9792d37d4.en: A screening of Shaun the Sheep's Halloween special at the ABC cinema, followed by a gross-out snack. Guests are invited to come in costume.

009ebb6905b185fb0ea5f4d557a6524fca20df20.en: An outdoor walkabout show by Le Clair Obscur at the Quai des Savoirs, in which volunteers become astronauts and follow scientific protocols to search for life. Suitable from age 7 when accompanied; about 1 hour 10.

355e3d33502aac831381dc4e763191287bce05bd.en: A talk at the Quai des Savoirs on Saturday 31 October, 3 to 4.15pm, on why science fiction so often turns to dystopia. Speakers from Métal Hurlant and comics creators discuss how to imagine positive futures. Free entry.

f58a4283424f6d4b3105dcbb4ac7335dd11c3e3b.en: A monthly film club at the José Cabanis media library, where film fans share favourites and gripes in a relaxed setting. The session lasts 1.5 hours in the small auditorium on the third floor.

771e64241dec565bb508617c45006f8da829b2c5.en: A 30-minute visit of treasures from the reserves of the Bibliothèque d'Étude et du Patrimoine on Saturday 31 October. It looks at variations on Little Red Riding Hood, from Gustave Doré's illustrations to an abstract accordion book by Warja Lavater.

2240d41f1d37eb2e029c6b0adae0085ef5d16fc1.en: A two-hour hands-on session at the José Cabanis media library on Saturday 31 October, 3 to 6pm, with a digital embroidery machine run by Combustible Numérique. Visitors take home their own creation.

4fce7e7cb004d45a8129656549bc488fe9c80014.en: A celebration of 30 years of the Canal du Midi as living heritage, held at Port Saint-Sauveur in Toulouse with the tourist office. The title refers to the gabare, the traditional barge.

c3b7c607939366aa08b8d4a2873bdc7e28da4f41.en: A film for children from 6 at Cinéma L'Autan. Johan and his father live alone at sea until a radio message sends the boy off to chase the Feathered King, a story that touches gently on loss.

b50bb101a7841eb11dc184bbd8a74a3ee048b5ae.en: A funny and spooky visit of the Musée des Augustins for all ages, run with the Millimétrée company. It is a playful ghost hunt through the collections.

558e1d0eb0157c0eb9d2ef30b5149e287db75d69.en: A Halloween-themed visit at the Musée des Arts Précieux Paul-Dupuy, exploring the ghosts and creatures in the collections before trick-or-treating. Scary costumes are welcome; one adult per child or sibling group.

bf7452a27265d72be5be7b12653540e8fe0414e8.en: A family reading session of monster and ghost stories at the José Cabanis media library on Saturday 31 October at 4.30pm, for ages 4 and up. It lasts 30 to 40 minutes, with no booking and limited places.

0148845d8641ab9cb7bf7958401bddd2436ec0f9.en: An opening evening at Le Grand Bazar on Saturday 31 October, 6pm to 10pm, for an exhibition on black humour and still life. It includes a food event by Spicchizzi and a talk.

e80a5bd6bfc3b92908a6b3f1f365ce646a0b73f1.en: A community evening at Le Grenier in Castanet-Tolosan to celebrate loved ones who have died, famous or personal. Visitors can leave a photo or object, share a meal and talk about death and grief. Free entry; bring your own food.

91c8c279b93a055d3e1025d7850f7b02a259c5e7.en: A late-night Halloween show at the MEETT exhibition centre in Toulouse on 31 October, with Holy Priest and guests including Aisha, Kole and Vortek's. Adults only, and ID is checked at the entrance.

345771db496afae74331d78b3548a6eddd33b721.en: A talk at the Quai des Savoirs on Saturday 31 October, 6.30 to 8pm, by environmental scientist Romain Teisserenc on the state of the planet, using stories and data from Arctic rivers. A debate on our relationship with nature follows. Free.

8e8050ba936002b077aa3dd358763833aed9afb6.en: A Mexican Halloween evening at the Bar du bout de la colline: a spooky walk through the P.-P. Riquet district from 6pm, then a Day of the Dead party from 8pm with a food truck, an ancestors' altar and a DJ. Bring photos of loved ones.

7fe30ceb6b8b975aa79293bb576ca8338f46661d.en: A weekly stand-up night in central Toulouse, where several comedians share the bill, mixing local talent with new and established names from across France. This session is on Saturday 31 October at 7pm.

a39caae79661145ce4e4b1720f2abc46916fc6b0.en: A one-hour evening tour of the Musée des Augustins with zombies wandering among the artworks. Costumes are strongly recommended; booking is required, with a departure every 15 minutes, in partnership with Millimétrée.

6d2d176f04b2456168dcb551ed4cb80af28cb44a.en: A Halloween cabaret night at Cabaret Le 9 in Toulouse on Saturday 31 October, doors at 7.30pm and show at 9pm. It has exhibitions, an open stage, guest performers, a look contest and a DJ set. Some events are interpreted in French Sign Language.

e1b5c612f0e9de4a3cd057ecbb25ec5a8cf98e37.en: Kery James, a major figure of French hip-hop known for humanist, socially committed rap, performs his album R.A.P – Résistance Amour Poésie at Interference with four musicians. He has sold over 700,000 albums.

083f282d653b6649e2fea3615bb6134f3097eff2.en: An instrumental Halloween night at La Cabane in Les Halles de la Cartoucherie on Saturday 31 October, doors at 8.30pm. Hilight Tribe's ethno trance shares the bill with I Roots (dub), Scientyfreaks (trance) and Spoink (electro improvisation).

6f9d5a79541f59f11b1115d6c281bb38940b83f2.en: A weekly stand-up night in central Toulouse, where several comedians share the bill, mixing local talent with new and established names from across France. This session is on Saturday 31 October at 8.30pm.

bac1cbcbe31510fd30d9aa465607264e3c8aafb5.en: A Halloween warehouse party at Le Sing Sing in Toulouse, billed as Nightmare Park. Eight hours of tech-house, techno and groove from six DJs, with live performers and sets built into the stage. Costumes are strongly recommended.

1050ff77f5cb7577ea4da5437d1c71f543ef20cd.en: A set by Hellisha Sauvage at The Petit London, a Toulouse DJ who mixes dark disco, downtempo, oriental techno and psytech. Her sets move freely between styles, from late-night bangers to soft morning melodies.

0f940409f6a97651edb33cfb41d0791bcf87b657.en: An eight-hour Halloween rave at the Esmeralda Club in Sesquières on 31 October, with two stages, 16 artists and hard techno, industrial and bouncy sounds. Free shuttle buses run from central Toulouse, and tickets start at 10 euros.

2361711638ce404eb89d6b9ba035e16a545e8729.en: A Halloween night at O Club by Charleston in Toulouse on Saturday 31 October, 11pm to 6am, themed around demons and temptation. VIP tables are booked by phone, and tickets are sold via Shotgun.

898b8d3a29f0c9b06248882958728c3bfe6ee767.en: The first Bears Tolosa night in Toulouse, with Bears Paname's Halloween party at Le Cube on Saturday 31 October, 11.59pm to 6am. DJ Vibration plays for the bear community.

5811c7d970421e1389db6ac8c7c81a71932188f5.en: A Halloween night of techno, hard techno and trance at Le Rex in Toulouse on Saturday 31 October, 11.55pm to 5.30am. Plein Phare presents Bermude and Juria, with an immersive set-up and costumes recommended.

03565786b6b9be1af76c5cadcf1fb5c515087395.en: A Halloween night at Interference on 31 October, hosted by the JetLag Gang editorial team. Reggaeton, cumbia RKT and dembow sets run through the night, with a Spanish-language theme of a journey into hell.

cf1b2da6960f4822fb0797cf70bdb167528f50b0.en: A hard techno Halloween night at Le Bikini on Saturday 31 October, 11.55pm to 5.30am, with Carla Schmitt, Vizionn, Karløta, Ilusion and Lullaby. Tickets cost 18 to 27 euros, depending on when you buy.

8de00e6ba70597ae0c7d67fe55f3e0f475c7ef42.en: The return of the Tou Fckn Louz crew to the barge Le Cri de la Mouette for a techno-only Halloween night on 31 October, doors at midnight. The whole crew plays, with a raw, dark sound. Costumes are recommended.
