445871f1c1592e344eb2b32fb88db5f50e441968.en: A free Sunday at the Musée des Augustins: an open art workshop from 11am to 5pm, a family visit on gargoyles and legends at 11am (booking required), and a guided tour on the afterlife at 2.30pm.

3ecd3609c450464591d22bde1f6addef54a5ec6d.en: A screening of Le Mystère Lucy Lost at Utopia Tournefeuille on Sunday 1 November at 11am, introduced by pianist Myriam Becquart, who plays the lobby piano first. Tickets cost 6 euros.

1f6073fc96535400d4a3afdd835449ba9d113f50.en: A voguing ball at Le Bikini on Halloween, the first Halloween Party Ball in Toulouse, presented by The Legendary Vinii Revlon of House of Revlon. Dancers compete across categories on the runway in costume.

b0d83b653f3f17039e3b938f30d44590211ceab6.en: An instrumental night at La Cabane on Sunday 1 November, doors at 7.30pm, with Hilight Tribe alongside Roots Zombie (electro dub), Luneris (techno trad) and Bandi (electro dub). Tickets are 29 euros.

ec034615084c466d08267625e89e4b710dcd528b.en: An open day at Actual Talent in Balma on Thursday 19 November 2026 for industry professionals, with permanent jobs and temporary missions in drafting, maintenance, automation and engineering. Booking an appointment by phone is recommended.

8c45c4dff0e9cee86e7f62a8385677db73783156.en: An immersion workshop on careers in industry, run by France Travail with Unither and Camas Formation at the Colomiers agency. A France Travail adviser presents the sector and its training, and employers explain the skills they look for.

c0eaa7a63dd83978729d00344bbdc86fe25a9931.en: A careers event at the France Travail Toulouse Cartoucherie agency where visitors meet food-industry professionals and attend short company talks. Training with IFRIA and AREA is also presented, and questions are welcome.

66a606d9b96577408d01da2e2a3b05d4c1979b32.en: A film at Cinéma L'Autan about General de Gaulle's flight to London in June 1940, when he refused to accept the armistice. It follows the resistance that grows around him in England, France and Africa.

04cdb6a79bfc1acff4b46c48a7f4dea9bafb7fa2.en: A 30-minute visit at the Musée des Arts Précieux Paul-Dupuy with a museum guide, looking at one precious artwork, a clock, which reflects the eclectic collections or a new acquisition.

e7bef5124831c46d1f910531a290e5a5da95af10.en: A screening of Mahdi Fleifel's film Vers un pays inconnu (1h46) at Le Cratère, followed by a meeting with the Ciné-Palestine team on Monday 2 November at 8pm. Two Palestinian cousins, refugees in Athens, try to raise money for false passports.

ebc4982014edfe3d81f5bb3635b4f1b6a39fd52f.en: A meeting linked to the film Vers un pays inconnu at Le Cratère in Toulouse, about two Palestinian cousins who live as refugees in Athens and try to raise money for false passports to reach Germany.

6b59efadb0b89def0ac26f3a00b98b8e6cf44370.en: The fourth Forum des futurs désirables at the Quai des Savoirs on 3 November 2026, a day of round tables and participatory workshops on sharing knowledge across the arts and sciences. The theme is futures literacy and citizen participation.

e46a5f5e06e545472538355dbf3265d2e4db1043.en: Computer workshops for job seekers run by the association Trajectoire vers l'emploi at the José Cabanis media library every Tuesday from 10am to 1pm, outside school holidays. They cover Word and Excel refreshers and job-search skills.

cc49bf9ea68c5abd6753135c09e2405f7e8c55ef.en: A month of documentary film in Toulouse under the theme Contre-courant, looking at people who choose or are forced to take divergent paths. Screenings and talks explore resistance, ecological choices and alternative ways of living.

220bff9eefd2134683e7cf958c86221291240b24.en: An exhibition at the Bibliothèque Ancely from 3 to 7 November by Planète Sciences, answering questions about green hydrogen: where it comes from, how it is stored, where it is used in the region and what jobs it creates. For ages 10 and up.

3f10d3d9aa3727dade7c9d6aab0f46cced0bf048.en: An overview of family history research for children, run by the association EGMT at the Roseraie library from 3 to 18 November. It shows how to motivate young people to explore the history of their families.

3d524bdf570df68444c8fd35a4e1051fcf4a197f.en: An exhibition on Toulouse between the two world wars, lent by the Toulouse municipal archives and shown at the Médiathèque Danièle Damin from 3 to 26 November.

308f28a67b54cca0158de717f4b7494b357954ec.en: Computer troubleshooting sessions at the Médiathèque Empalot, 2.30 to 5pm on set Tuesdays and Thursdays from October to December. Participants can bring their own machine and learn to fix common problems and their causes. Booking is required.

6ef0ac3eb01fc027e4772e0b20af5fe78fd3152a.en: A one-hour flamenco session for seniors at the Médiathèque Empalot on Tuesday 3 November at 3pm, led by Soledad Cuesta as part of the Inclusion Flamenca programme. Booking is by phone.

5819da21bc9bc8501dc8ea2318f4ad5352fe7d43.en: A visit of the IVRESSE exhibition at the Musée des Arts Précieux Paul-Dupuy, drawing on its graphic art collection of drawings, prints and advertising posters to show how intoxication appears in art.

d670fce59cb63c0483abef76e0858e60b3153b61.en: A knitting and book-talk workshop at the Médiathèque Côte Pavée on Tuesday 3 November from 3.30 to 5.30pm, for sharing skills and talking about books. Booking is by phone.

94873cf4580700c1fe478d8b3eee0ed353193e46.en: A 1.5-hour talk at the Médiathèque Saint-Cyprien on Tuesday 3 November at 6pm by music teacher Thomas Boissier, on how the blues became rock. Suitable from age 12.

67a264d5224a88be7a931f81e5b2b950d7a2a596.en: A free online training course for associations on mobilising, running and keeping volunteers, the middle of three linked workshops run by the Maison des associations. It is limited to eight associations with two representatives each.

40175f6995514ca3ac507894775df79c6c4d6bc9.en: A talk at the José Cabanis media library on Tuesday 3 November at 6pm by JeuneMac, a 22-year-old Toulouse graphic designer who shares positive messages through a character called MAC. His work is on show in the Arts area through November.

1de6a381a932760c90779fb80cf379dc3c333f76.en: A warm-up show for the Setlmana Santa dark wave festival at Le Metronum, with Lol Tolhurst, founding drummer of The Cure, performing with his son Gray and guests. The festival runs from 1 to 6 December 2026.

1cc863b64e70b8e751dc5a315ac0e09c3725ca45.en: A screening at Utopia Tournefeuille on Tuesday 3 November at 8pm, followed by an exchange with director Nicolas Réglat. The documentary was chosen as a Coup de cœur Occitanie 2026 by the local media libraries. Tickets cost 5 euros.

306070780f539e4b0fd017c8fe5f2cc5fdb4b8a2.en: A screening at Utopia Tournefeuille on Tuesday 3 November at 9pm, preceded at 8.15pm in the lobby by a 30-minute concert from the Volubilis vocal ensemble of Pibrac, with British works by Tallis, Dowland, Elgar and others. The concert needs no booking.

36a8e3b81fd76b571282e5f0cd905f4c3f3ca906.en: An exhibition at the Maison des associations from 3 to 27 November on the largely overlooked role of women in the 1936 Spanish social revolution, both in combat and in education, health and community support. Free entry.

b44d442e265e6a7329cb9d5415eebfbd350ce2c7.en: A three-month training course by Dalkia for energy and climate technicians, from 7 December 2026 to 26 February 2027 at Afpa in Toulouse and Montauban, with two weeks of placement. It covers electricity and heating, ventilation and air conditioning.

4cf807425029741f4b17e1b4ac5fa87518832cf2.en: A 30-minute session of stories, dance and wonder for children aged 0 to 3 at the Médiathèque Saint-Exupéry, on several dates including 4 November and 14 November at 10am. Booking is by phone or email.

32b7ab434921dec51be32ff858dd22678a9f5729.en: A 30-minute story session on a story mat for children aged 0 to 6 at the Médiathèque Empalot, on Wednesday 4 November and Wednesday 2 December at 10.15am. Booking is by phone.

ea0feee1d19e8545ac2fc8436de99e5a269ac2a8.en: A weekly 30-minute reading session for children aged 0 to 3 at the Médiathèque des Minimes, every Wednesday at 10.15am outside school holidays.

d4bbb1bd1e3439dd5ea76842ab2e07679641de25.en: A reading session for babies at the Médiathèque Grand M on Wednesdays at 10.30am, including 4 and 18 November. It is a moment of books for curious little listeners. Booking is by phone.

4f5642a8e3d066fa6641bd7213c8a1e285f4da52.en: A 30-minute session of reading and cuddles for children aged 0 to 3 at the Bibliothèque Duranti at 10.30am, on 4 November, 25 November and 16 December, among others.

a63508bd32ce535205e9fbb752dbcf0e243e0fba.en: A 30-minute reading session for children aged 0 to 3 at the Médiathèque Danièle Damin from 10.30am to 11am. Sessions are weekly or monthly, with themes linked to the season or current events.

4eeeab3f296defa38744680aad92c18c1389481e.en: A weekly reading session for children aged 0 to 3 at the Médiathèque Côte Pavée, every Wednesday at 10.30am outside school holidays.

388bbb8c2f079551b42cb9614d2a909674d5699c.en: Hands-on science activities from the Quai des Petits at the Pôle éducation in Fonbeauzard on 4, 6 and 7 November. A magnetic maze, gears, magic mirrors and scent boxes introduce magnetism and balance to young children. Free entry.

94f489879a3d3dfde3ee1865f906a1c2f379b7d1.en: A master class by percussionist Stéphane Perruchet at the CRR Salle Dupin, a versatile player known for batá drums and Afro-Cuban polyrhythms. He teaches at Music'halle and has worked with Mario Lucio and Tcheka.

0f99ee55ec1a669b1678365b1847ff12464a5750.en: Video-game afternoons every Wednesday from 2 to 5pm at the Médiathèque Grand M, outside school holidays, with discovery games, cooperative play and competitions. Entry is free with a library card; sessions last one hour each.

0fae4df8560d4f1aeba6e20ceef94e7574c4211c.en: A family visit of the photography exhibition at the Château d'Eau, followed by a four-hands pop-up workshop on the history of photography. An adult must come along. The exhibition runs until 21 February 2027.

8dfd21a8e78fa0fa9d932d19cb51bbd39fa631f0.en: An autumn gardening session on Wednesday 4 November at 2.30pm at the Médiathèque Grand M, with the Natural History Museum and Toulouse composting masters. Participants sow seeds saved from summer, look at garden creatures and learn recycling. Two hours.

74d50f7212d2a65398c38657b92ab1bb17b1b476.en: A cooperative history game at the Castelet in which children, guided by a mediator, help a resistance member escape before the guard finds her. It combines puzzles, observation and a board game, and introduces the site's history.

433d0316d674d298973e653bc839c7e4f48843cc.en: A November programme of talks, tours and workshops at the Musée de la Résistance et de la Déportation, including talks on foreigners in the Resistance and the first act of resistance in Toulouse in 1940. Some sessions need online booking.

e8008718a53793f683e500b9dd67af190fc06458.en: A presentation on Wednesday 4 November at 3pm of the 2026–2027 National Resistance and Deportation Competition theme, Foreigners in the Resistance (1940–1945). It covers the main lines of the theme, local resources and feedback from past participants.

78b515507f25ca34da7c2835fd42ed7452dcd5f0.en: A reading club for children aged 8 to 12 at the Médiathèque Pradettes, held on 7 October, 4 November and 2 December at 3pm.

3d97b33b1caa805505b4a90e53c56b0bb2e2545f.en: A weekly digital help session every Wednesday and Thursday from 3 to 5pm at the José Cabanis media library, outside school holidays. Bring your equipment and prepared questions; a digital mediator helps with computer problems. Lasts one hour.

7c4620e969069f0ff096d8d82d33f9d533297679.en: A two-hour Nintendo Switch session on the Bibliobus at Place Job for children from 7, on Wednesday 4 November, 3.30 to 5.30pm. Booking is by phone or email.

9ca4cd3cb90e3461f0741252ca7e9b03e1a5ee85.en: A monthly beginners workshop at the José Cabanis media library on the first Wednesday of each month, 4 to 6pm. Two participants at a time learn Ableton Live with a mediator and leave with their own piece. Suitable from age 13; same-day sign-up.

d2bf389e173202ee6f813ff24cc1a66077d5a5a9.en: The launch of the 2027 manga prize at the José Cabanis media library on Wednesday 4 November, 4 to 6pm. The programme includes a manga quiz, a badge workshop, a paper toy and a presentation of the shortlisted books.

4c65a81bd1f8b17c30f952ecddd6cd315b4611bf.en: A talk at the José Cabanis media library on Wednesday 4 November at 5pm by Dominique Missika, author of a biography of Irène Nemirovsky. The Russian-born writer's last manuscript, Suite française, was published by her daughter. Organised by Hébraïca.

b65cfd4bcdc0a5d211b4281faf53b48c4287fb0d.en: A reading of texts on parenthood at the Médiathèque Simone-de-Beauvoir in Ramonville, drawn from writing workshops run by the association Regards and led by Valérie Anna Reich. The texts are sincere, poetic and lively.

1f098809ac0723a613e1788bd5d9715dd56d13ce.en: A reading of texts on parenthood by the association Regards at the Médiathèque Simone de Beauvoir in Ramonville. The texts come from writing workshops about the ups and downs of being a parent.

b7c0dcf412dafb667ddaf0dfbc3c0572ff638552.en: A rap concert by Spider Zed at Le Rex de Toulouse on Wednesday 4 November, doors at 7.30pm. Tickets cost 26 euros in advance and 28 euros on the door.

f71b746adec3c1289f201801f82a59b2e27090e1.en: A screening of the film Moulin at Utopia Tournefeuille on Wednesday 4 November at 8pm. The Haute-Garonne Resistance and Deportation Museum introduces the film and its programme. No booking is needed.

c2a276122ed3b21e67d3bc984b82ee10546b4fe6.en: A self-guided detective trail for children at the Chapelle de La Grave, following the young orphan Étienne, who has lost a gift for a friend. Children use a kit with a pencil, binoculars, magnifying glass and booklet to find details and solve puzzles.

1bcd1f0e0d800efe3411b5c8e3ee9415ff6917a9.en: A percussion master class at the CRR Salle Offenbach by Émilien Prodhomme, principal timpanist of the Orchestre National du Capitole de Toulouse. He also teaches at ISDAT and at the Percu'Sud academy in Limoux.

37ea4052baa2b33a759c72217a04a1822c97c85c.en: A series of creative workshops for seniors at the Salle de l'Oustal in Escalquens, mixing creativity, movement and memories to train the memory in a friendly setting. For people aged 60 and over; booking is required.

457d8f4329c93f11e4ef09e44eace65d0512a0e0.en: A free training course for associations on governance: the roles of the general meeting, the board and the office, and the duties of volunteer leaders. It also covers tools for transparent, democratic management. Run by Profession Sport Animation 31.

7d8fb65273d91ff0d28f5da8bff73f9a92272c1f.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins on contemporary art, where architects, designers and artists have brought a bold entrance, a new logo, light, colour, sound and temporary installations into the museum's collections.

091c2d6bdd476c6d356d4bdcea51a56b1b6cc3b1.en: A session at the Roseraie library on Thursday 5 November at 2.30pm for people who run genealogy workshops for children and teenagers. It explores what activities might work for young people. Booking is by phone.

74b1772f1bc55d244c8f98051b573285a5c601f7.en: Workshops at the Auzeville-Tolosane municipal media library on being an eco-responsible digital citizen. They cover greener digital habits, the environmental impact of the internet, reusing copyrighted works, and free software alternatives.

4ff64ba347eb7cdb95b7c3110ff2300c70d08817.en: A screening of the 65-minute documentary La lutte armée n'est pas un jeu d'enfant by Nicolas Réglat at the José Cabanis media library on Thursday 5 November at 3pm. It follows a man raised to take up armed struggle, now looking at the planet with his daughter.

e157808129a5121b84dd698038fb72e7556fe9aa.en: A free adult readers' club at the Médiathèque des Pradettes, meeting on Thursdays from 3 to 5pm, including 5 November and 3 December. It is open to all, with no requirements, to share favourite books, films and stories.

4d3e0f8589f3856929e98112ce92d7b27d74162f.en: Shared reading sessions for children from age 3 at the library of the Toulouse Natural History Museum, on Wednesday 4 November at 4.30pm. Entry to the library is free; places are limited.

7b34b9a74813a52e82a284744719ae4a043a8eb7.en: A chance to meet the author Philippe Jaenada at the bookshop-café Le Chameau sauvage in Toulouse on Thursday 5 November, 4.30 to 6.30pm. He will chat, sign books and talk over coffee. His novel L'inconnue du quai de Javel is on the Goncourt shortlist.

65a3754fe92bdb489a72061041f4e6dee13d7551.en: Free wellbeing workshops and peer meetings for carers of people with disabilities, run by the inclusive venue Café&Co in Toulouse. Stress management, cosmetic treatments and theatre-forum sessions run through the autumn, alongside meetings with peer carers.

5fd00b006a841673e233f54e0f693c5b555cec40.en: A documentary screening at the José Cabanis media library on Thursday 5 November at 6pm, by Perin K. Caspar, about a large and chaotic family. The film looks at his brother and sister and the worries they carry. The director will attend.

52385bd7f0e7bde575ccfa9fce908e1fdd39ad95.en: A talk at the Musée de la Résistance et de la Déportation on Thursday 5 November at 6.30pm with Mercedes de Orriols and documentary-maker Alfredo Botto. They discuss the family exile after the Spanish Civil War, through the work of the poet Alvaro de Orriols.

54cf9071d833de20138ddd6d0c70040a3283391c.en: A concert in the collections of the Musée des Augustins at 6.30pm, with flute and piano works by Johann Sebastian and Carl Philipp Emanuel Bach. The flute student Amélie Mallinger plays with young flautists.

49902ab4299c7fbe91c3820220d38bc6037950c4.en: A two-hour detective workshop at the Médiathèque Grand M on Thursday 5 November at 6.30pm, for ages 16 and up. Participants read Benjamin Stevenson's novel Tout le monde dans ce train est suspect, then solve the case with bookseller Renaud Layet.

ea6acad609c97b6db6ff910883ca1e8b9bf543a2.en: A jam night at Le Grenier in Castanet-Tolosan on the first and third Thursdays of each month. The bar opens at 6pm and musicians of all kinds play French song, variety and jazz, with food on site. Musicians can join in.

8320f6c5d31cffd58a3a2f48fcfa1f607a07b191.en: A weekly stand-up night in central Toulouse, where several comedians share the bill, mixing local talent with new and established names from across France. This session is on Thursday 5 November at 7pm.

d4f03df8e781b9d529e14d57b5faeacae774b292.en: A family theatre piece at Le Kiwi in which a tribe gathers for the last flight of its father, who refuses to leave. Acrobatics, dance and a brass-band funeral make a playful, absurd goodbye.

28f4112884a0c0ce78fe33e3bb9fabbf81b4cde2.en: A concert at Interference by Renan Luce, marking 20 years since his first album Repenti, with its thirteen songs played in album order. The opening act is Suzanne Belaubre, whose intimate songs have jazz touches.

be14282dd887aeda92320f13492f46fcdd421e02.en: A screening of Breaking Away at Utopia Tournefeuille on Thursday 5 November at 8pm, organised by RAYON, the municipal venue for soft mobility. A debate follows on how cycling can change more than the way we travel.

a7f97beea04cc7fa8a7fe43076ea126fee00f10f.en: A screening of the documentary Le Blob, un génie sans cerveau by Jacques Mitsch at La Bastide in Quint-Fonsegrives on Thursday 5 November, 8.30 to 10pm. The director takes questions afterwards. Free for all ages.

1ec2433a307deeab37577a4784e57a470a91cab2.en: An exhibition of art prints at the municipal library, made by the Toulouse studio Les Multiples. The limited-edition giclée prints, by illustrators, comic artists and contemporary artists, use pigment inks on archival paper.

6ae9eee707c4b9f2c563a04c0470f9411f67fdf5.en: A cybersecurity awareness workshop at the Cité Marianne in Lille on Friday 6 November, 9.30 to 11.30am, for associations and social economy organisations. It covers digital risks and first protective steps, and is limited to 15 people.

808b4a18ef8d200dc92cf5ff07289adde0f0a7a9.en: A dance piece by Caty Olive and Christian Rizzo in which a costume and light keep moving even without a dancer on stage. The work has no fixed start or end, and questions the link between the performance and the audience. Shown at the Chapelle des Carmélites.

ec7aa9e824291a87d005dfe91389e324a7879cc4.en: A free French conversation group at the Médiathèque des Pradettes on the first Friday of each month, 10am to noon. Librarians guide relaxed talk about books, films and culture, open to all levels and nationalities.

7a20a89badc504ea8721d2036cf9f16c1f54fc3a.en: A science talk by Julien Capin of the Centre de Biologie Structurale in Montpellier on a cell-free platform for detecting protein interactions. He covers AI-guided affinity maturation and work on a bacterial toxin linked to ulcerative colitis.

10eff2506bc8d699ed463aef5ca7de562ea6653d.en: A screening of the documentary Freedom Fields at the Médiathèque Grand M on Friday 6 November at 2.30pm. It follows three women footballers and their team in post-revolution Libya, with a discussion afterwards.

a9ddd1f94220da286cd2d2299e186c4cc3740145.en: A one-hour guided tour of the Musée des Augustins on still lifes and genre scenes. It looks at the textures of glass, terracotta and porcelain, and the everyday domestic world they show.

e4351f46c1de372f8a0cbd81e914466c64cdea35.en: A 30-minute story session for children from age 4 at the Bibliothèque Duranti every Friday from 4.30pm, outside school holidays. It is a short reading after school and a snack.

eb56a4bf3edf12619ba772d25fdfd4c7e70c48c5.en: A 1.5-hour creative writing session for children aged 8 to 12 at the José Cabanis media library on Friday 6 November at 5pm. Children invent stories and play with words. Booking is by phone.

8830ddb3633e58880434c7e01a3d36d5a714c829.en: An audio-described one-hour visit at the Musée des Augustins for visually impaired visitors and their companions. It explores the black legend of Cleopatra and the storytelling power of two paintings.

260427e9e9cd253759d6c71ab60b66c5b02a0633.en: An open evening of traditional Occitan songs at the COMDT, where people sing together over a drink. Entry is free.

9fc1f20656540d13773a2a900c6ac8fc975c07da.en: A weekly stand-up night in central Toulouse, where several comedians share the bill, mixing local talent with new and established names from across France. This session is on Friday 6 November at 7pm.

fead3fd45f7036d3a9c1eeecceae2500a3cb643d.en: A screening of the film Balade dans les ateliers by Gilles Thomat at the galerie 3.1 on Friday 6 November, in two free sessions at 7pm and 7.45pm for 20 people each. Booking is by email. The gallery's exhibition Qui est là? runs until 9 January 2027.

2b886602df920ca75757f3abe8eb36934c80def7.en: A concert by rapper NeS at La Cabane in Les Halles de la Cartoucherie, Toulouse. The Val-de-Marne artist, known for a freestyle-honed technique and introspective songs, has released several albums and singles.

e2da8196d4b11d54d8d992f2f12086b13f1dc54e.en: A concert by piano accompanists of the Toulouse Conservatoire at the Auditorium Saint-Pierre-des-Cuisines, revisiting classical works in dialogue with film under the title La musique classique au cinéma. A few seats may free up before the show.

d36d597e4713b87209621c98aab449c271f03ae0.en: An evening of opera favourites by the Musicâme France chamber collective at the Chapelle Sainte-Anne in Toulouse. The programme includes Rossini, Puccini, Verdi, Bizet and Mozart, with a new fantasy on The Magic Flute.

5e7c3255802e7feed4c828e23a94f36eaed9ca8e.en: A concert at Interference by Pony Pony Run Run, back after ten years away with new songs, their hit Hey You and a new show. The tour this autumn is aimed at getting crowds dancing.

fb65b78e1879785f1846b4efadc5e2b1b432f46c.en: A screening of Malraux's film Espoir, Sierra de Teruel (1940, 68 min) at Cinéma L'Autan on Friday 6 November at 8.30pm, introduced by Nicolas Potin. A talk on the Spanish Civil War and cinema follows, with film clips and posters.

054ace6e024e0bcdbea760c57a1891f2900aaf87.en: A screening of the film Iranien at Utopia Tournefeuille on Friday 6 November at 8pm, followed by an exchange with director Mehran Tamadon, moderated by Maïa Ricaud of Cie Les Chiennes Nationales.

126dfe90c4640f40cf3aec1ffb30c742eb9cb4fc.en: The Eclusiales XIV, an amateur theatre competition at the Espace Jacques Brel in Castanet-Tolosan from 6 to 8 November. Comedies and an improv show run through the weekend, and awards close the festival on Sunday.

9f5137646157945891d55207b192791ff5cabfa6.en: A weekly stand-up night in central Toulouse, where several comedians share the bill, mixing local talent with new and established names from across France. This session is on Friday 6 November at 8.30pm.

94cea0c7317fbef9db0bab2a86b0d7dc753752da.en: A rock, pop and reggae-tinged concert by the friends' band Feel Good Now at Les Marins d'Eau Douce in Ramonville on Friday 6 November at 9pm. Tickets are 10 euros with a drink; booking is recommended for tapas.

8443d6e27bbbe341f444d5907acfe55eb966d227.en: A B2B night of techno and its offshoots at Interference in Balma on Friday 6 November, midnight to 6am. Five DJ duos share a 360-degree stage in one continuous set.

a19e644410c149c11c2707148cf60159b4f15810.en: A ten-year anniversary night for the Madback label at Le Rex in Toulouse on 6 November, hosted by Karnage. The line-up of industrial and hardcore artists includes Matt Green, Tripped and Densha Crisis.

3d7cd719ed3158191a948e7f9cf0b438d9659491.en: A Halloween progressive and psytrance night at Le Bikini on Friday 6 November. Omiki presents his first album in France, alongside Henrique Camacho, the Brazilian FNX and Mr Frisson.

589547d627554e80c3be4f238a1442ce93998a42.en: A session of the Mort ou vif workshops at the Archives municipales, reconstructing a brawl after a Toulouse cabaret in 1776 that led to a death a month later. Participants follow the case to an online record for the Urban-Hist module Meurtres à la carte.

69682d623dff24d21d8377c56253a3c039071cbe.en: An open writing workshop at the Médiathèque Empalot on Saturday 7 November at 10am, on our relationship with living beings, human and non-human. Led by Lise Balas, it starts from texts by contemporary writers. Two and a half hours; booking by phone.

44a2a62f3f83d01a2d41d8fd772e0afba348073c.en: A guided walk around the modern and contemporary buildings of the Rangueil campus at Université Paul Sabatier, led by a guide and an architect. It explores the architectural trends that shape the city's identity.

d9c4193a47ad89e529e58265707dfd8fa01aadcd.en: A readers' club at the Médiathèque des Izards, 10am to noon, on 12 September, 11 October, 7 November and 5 December. Readers share favourite books in a relaxed group.

46f578a9981a76a2f4dbcd5517b3d5d3feac3720.en: A book fair at the Salle de l'Oustal in Escalquens, where visitors meet independent authors, illustrators and small publishers. They can leaf through carefully chosen books and find titles through conversation.

eaf2602b4aea52114bf6534b5b385a10f029014f.en: Story sessions for children aged 0 to 4 at the Médiathèque des Pradettes, weekly or monthly, with themes linked to the season or current events. Book at the desk or by phone.

7569f6f7e89d37378df20ee67904a9e18dcf95ec.en: A two-hour art workshop for children aged 6 to 12 at the Musée des Augustins, themed Forward, knights. The children explore the museum works and make a printed tote bag. No parent may stay with them.

83cebe6f221a997dd560bfecfa94e4dcfe88f960.en: A literary breakfast on 7 November at 10.30am at the Médiathèque Serveyrolles, sharing thoughts on epistolary novels over tea or coffee. Attend one or both sessions, 7 November and 5 December.

507b4c34eb743acfb6968bfb00d454024b3332b0.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins in French, adapted for people with intellectual disabilities. It covers the museum's paintings and sculptures with a guide.

6a818796e3e8e9bc53f72ba2b923efb09b89b4a5.en: A creative music session for children aged 2 to 6 at the Simone-de-Beauvoir media library in Ramonville, with singing, dance and sound objects on the theme of flies. Limited to 10 children, one parent each; booking is required.

b1301a2e6fdabd6e15ef0a7044fc162d02f1bac0.en: A relaxed one-hour café meeting at the Médiathèque Saint-Exupéry on Saturday 7 November at 11am, to share recent favourite novels, comics and albums over tea or coffee.

f7f84375336c47d4e78c3f743f9812757428bbd1.en: A lunch show for the 40th anniversary of the association La Joie de vivre, at the Salle de la Musardière. It features Délice d'Amour's show around the world in heels, with a Mediterranean caterer. Bookings closed on 20 October 2026.

b2c55ebed50c31c943e28c1c1a6b926104cd5544.en: A monthly video game tournament at the Médiathèque Grand M on Saturday 7 November from 2 to 5pm, with sports, fighting and strategy games. Players can try to win the tournament.

04028b65d52bd631dfb3d4af2dabb9204c922033.en: An afternoon at the José Cabanis media library on Saturday 7 November, 2 to 6pm, to discover Wikipedia and OpenStreetMap. Toulouse volunteers answer questions and can help with a first contribution. Suitable from age 12.

cd5659d91110d6dc4287232b12f1fe133ab53df9.en: The Articulinaire food day at the Tiers-lieu Le Moulin in Roques on 7 November, with family activities from 2 to 6pm: plant-based paints, a blind spice tasting, anti-waste cooking and butter-making. The project runs from 6 to 28 November across six communes.

7078ac7e73ec12a3a62a7173f23aa6e192288ee3.en: A reading of the album Le cerf-volant de Toshiro by Toulouse author Ghislaine Roman at the Médiathèque Fabre on Saturday 7 November at 2.30pm, followed by a poetry writing workshop. For ages 8 and up; booking is required.

de7ee018cdb48621892bd2c1a592f1a0d639d0c0.en: A free guided visit at 3pm of the permanent exhibition at the Musée de la Résistance et de la Déportation, showing the paths of foreign men and women who joined the French Resistance. Entry is subject to places.

cfd1d29344024c772937e24d42a90693d3be5ddb.en: A talk by historian André Arnal on 5 November 1940, the date of a first act of resistance in Toulouse, marked by a plaque on a building facing the Musée des Augustins. Part of the November programme at the Resistance museum.

23ab4f6a7784b82c25caed675ec53c7a1470632c.en: A meeting at Le Cratère about Ainara, 17, from a Catholic school, who tells her family she wants to spend time in a convent just before her baccalauréat.

f23923413f2feff60a37f1aaceb2f12b9f87ba4d.en: A talk with architect and ceramist Denise Bresciani at the Tiers-lieu Le Moulin, about her work with biological materials, some of them edible. Part of the Articulinaire food project running from 6 to 28 November.

e316311aaff1a1268216bd3b2a7925306932d308.en: A screening of the Spanish film Les Dimanches (1h58) at Le Cratère on Saturday 7 November at 5pm, followed by a meeting with the Instituto Cervantes. The film follows 17-year-old Ainara's surprising decision to join a convent.

808a871a7a7e8714a7f09a79ad680a14a38a56eb.en: A one-off screening of Yael Naim, une nouvelle âme at Utopia Borderouge, followed by an exchange with Yael Naim and director Jill Coulon. Organised with the Metronum and Les Femmes s'en Mêlent.

051518c00ccbd4c675a6fab580e480a31a10806b.en: A weekly stand-up night in central Toulouse, where several comedians share the bill, mixing local talent with new and established names from across France. This session is on Saturday 7 November at 7pm.

954c3a32e4d31fc971145c3a852080bbe44fb353.en: A concert by Ebony at La Cabane in Les Halles de la Cartoucherie. The Star Academy 2024 finalist, known for Unforgettable and Rage, presents songs from her first album on an intimate tour that leads to the Olympia on 1 November.

1c2cdcc78e00f6b2bb225be7627fba8587f3c494.en: A concert under the dome of the Chapelle de La Grave by the ensemble Antiphona, with music from the 12th century to Fauré, including Hildegard of Bingen, Palestrina and Monteverdi. The programme explores the chapel's acoustics.

828f86a480d2fafd61e492650180e96a035b5034.en: A meeting at Le Cratère about two broke fifty-somethings who are obsessed with having one last drink, and the shy architecture student they meet by chance.

fb7d4e20c6628e23fd1edae86710e38c3a9e62c4.en: A screening of the Italian film Le dernier pour la route (1h40) at Le Cratère on Saturday 7 November at 8pm, followed by a meeting with the Società Dante Alighieri. Two broke fifty-somethings take a shy architecture student under their wing.

0d38ae4ca516c1c09aa7b53f86fcc8a785ba7a35.en: A weekly stand-up night in central Toulouse, where several comedians share the bill, mixing local talent with new and established names from across France. This session is on Saturday 7 November at 8.30pm.

98a4c09df0f092dcdca6ab75623d7c228358f864.en: An 80s and 90s dance night at Le Sing Sing in Toulouse on Saturday 7 November, 9pm to 4am, with DJ Mango mixing hits from ABBA and Madonna to Daft Punk. Entry includes one drink.

f9b425022f406f3541138fb059709fdeb3ec6093.en: A techno night at Dagobar on 7 November by ElectroNyx, with varied sets across several facets of techno and an all-female line-up. It follows the success of the first night there.

618783ea3fb910c8a28ee9b7e018c491de074ed5.en: Four recent European films from Spain, Italy, Germany and France, screened in original version at Le Cratère on 7 and 8 November. Each screening is followed by a meeting with a partner cultural institute, as part of a European network programme.

11f0b330fd3d292917d17af69d424daf748d7d70.en: A detective-style talk at the José Cabanis media library on Sunday 8 November at 2.15pm with Renaud Layet of the Série B bookshop. It explores the history and codes of the mystery novel and asks which is the best of all time. Booking required.

0e4280c6a16701e2be84202c6e32d50d362c422a.en: A family visit of the Monument à la Gloire de la Résistance, focused on its architecture and the feelings it evokes. The guide warns that some references about the Second World War may be strong for younger children.

95dc54b48613c9474b66fdc09a0a09a7f65ecd99.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins on women, femininity and feminism in its paintings and sculptures. It explores how women moved from being models to becoming artists.

8ed82d4a5cd76d35e6e098a8415b669f7ef64db9.en: A one-hour escape game at the Bibliothèque d'Étude et du Patrimoine on Sunday 8 November at 2.30pm, for ages 12 and up. Players apply to an AI company and must prove they are fully human by solving puzzles. Booking is by email.

872e8b077c0112f09e485795b08cc95eee7a9ca4.en: A meeting at Le Cratère about Léa, 16, whose family runs a faded hotel in the forests of former East Germany, and who has a gift for singing.

f45d6389bac160b3e8959f0a03ace3abb3969925.en: A screening of the German film Home stories (1h56) at Le Cratère on Sunday 8 November at 5pm, followed by a meeting with the Goethe-Institut. Léa prepares for a reality TV show while her family's hotel faces bankruptcy.

4d811494157c825808e0fdd2364b78e43087616d.en: A set by Folamour at Interference, a French producer and DJ with over 10 years of career and a selection drawn from house, soul, funk, disco and afrobeat. The date moved to Sunday 8 November, 6pm to midnight; tickets remain valid.

abcf19ac452459a5941dd674cb95d004428e981e.en: A one-off screening of Yael Naim, une nouvelle âme at Utopia Tournefeuille on Sunday 8 November at 7pm, followed by a meeting with director Jill Coulon. Pre-sales at the desk and on Festik.

00b37bd508f2fe0966e4f918887ff58ada03d858.en: A screening of the French film Zion (1h39) at Le Cratère on Sunday 8 November at 8pm, followed by a meeting with the Alliance française. In Guadeloupe, a young dealer is left caring for a baby found at his door.

df6750a0e57bfb6c67eeb9e251c75f163624b6ab.en: A meeting at Le Cratère about Chris, a young Guadeloupean who is drawn into a risky delivery for a local boss.

3e98b5d0c27c96ef737d3dcd11897c6cf62b758e.en: A 30-minute visit at the Musée des Arts Précieux Paul-Dupuy with a museum mediator, looking at one precious artwork, Popy Moreni's violet dress. It reflects the eclectic collections or a recent acquisition.

bfc489eefde2006a6f06a5f4eda49d4a53784246.en: A talk at the Université Capitole on women in vallenato, the traditional music of Colombia's Caribbean coast. It covers the EVAFE women's festival and the emancipation of female musicians. Moderated by Katherine Salamanca.

1864d5672ffe1a6b09a623687effba2748636607.en: A meeting at Le Cratère, linked to the Africlap festival, about Mehdi, 11, in Algeria, whose only chance of survival is surgery abroad. His family's visa applications have been refused.

8feaa5e3bad6020bc542aa4d47d8bba3fa31a40d.en: A screening of Amor Hakkar's film Le premier rôle (1h26) at Le Cratère on Monday 9 November at 8.30pm, with the Africlap team. An 11-year-old in Algeria needs surgery abroad, but the family's visa requests are refused.

925261404eb760c924c6da43f7806bf76151d8a2.en: The Africlap festival of African cinema at Le Cratère from 9 to 13 November 2026, with three evenings of screenings and meetings: Le premier rôle, Repose en paix si tu peux and Songs for Madagascar.

d0df63851366b02d2baad5c49273fe44307991c2.en: An online webinar on pastoralism and forest fire prevention, presenting support schemes in Occitanie and Spain, the effects of CAP reforms and payments for environmental services. Speakers come from the Occitanie regional chamber of agriculture.

5cedce91f12ca75462c0aa3137853ef487c1999b.en: A guided visit of the Musée des Arts Précieux Paul-Dupuy showing drawings by Beaux-Arts students at the front in the First World War, and small wooden carvings made by soldiers, some in the trenches. A selection from storage is shown.

a3f736d18eb4f45856f43190b2d1572914b43f74.en: A 1.5-hour talk at the Bibliothèque d'Étude et du Patrimoine on Tuesday 10 November at 5.30pm, on how books were made in the Japanese Jesuit mission in the early 17th century. It uses a book printed in Nagasaki in 1605.

4b0774559be8e73e14891a0383dd35f5dc8d629d.en: The opening evening of the Locombia festival at La Brique Rouge in Empalot, with an exhibition on Colombian Caribbean picó culture, a Colombian buffet and an opening concert by women musicians from the EVAFE vallenato festival.

3ef4bdadc534e48072d40e541d062aff17b7d128.en: A Magic Boys show at Le Zapata in Toulouse on 10 November, the eve of a public holiday, with dance and choreographed striptease. Reserved for women until 11pm; entry with a glass of sparkling wine costs 12 euros.

274ef689e4c3f5d3b4956439c621b345ae477cd3.en: A meeting at Le Cratère about a film set on a remote New England island in the 1890s, following two lighthouse keepers in a hypnotic, hallucinatory story.

c2001118c95e066ad8a3caf6f6bfb8064f697c19.en: A screening of Robert Eggers's The Lighthouse (1h49) at Le Cratère on Tuesday 10 November at 8pm, followed by a meeting with students. Robert Pattinson and Willem Dafoe play two keepers on a New England island.

71f4a1df026594f7b8443659f5a0aeb809bf852b.en: A release party at L'engrenage in Balma on 10 November from 8pm, with four bands from post-visual kei to chaotic hardcore. Tickets are 5 euros in advance and 10 euros on the door, cash only.

77cc1d603d14d1e675cb01c8a0dee47881e34d83.en: A talk on how the Vichy regime banned Freemasonry from August 1940 and seized its archives and property in Toulouse, and how the reparations came long after the Liberation. Held with the Musée de la Mémoire in Portet-sur-Garonne.

0dd93acac79b26d7b8826ac094f5d40ce67407aa.en: A night of techno, hard bounce and rave at Le Rex in Toulouse on 10 November, the eve of a public holiday. Manil and Peaksou play a B2B set from start to finish.

8ee8537a330850cfed27c6ed2bdcdf4b1050b6e5.en: A wreath-laying ceremony for Armistice Day at the war memorial in Castanet-Tolosan at noon on 11 November, with the youth council and veterans' groups. It is followed by a reception at the Salle Ginette Forgues.

420f912fd869cb6b9c27e4e663eda907b3a6ce43.en: A free jam session of Colombian music at L'Astronef, open to all musicians and led by several artists from the Locombia festival. Bring your instruments; places are limited, so arrive early.

429e3f169b0975b4676cf2457ffd4851c38c9cc3.en: A viola master class at the CRR Salle Stravinski by Michel Michalakakos, a former member of the National Orchestra of France and the Paris String Trio. He teaches at the Paris conservatoire and is president of the Association des Amis de l'Alto.

b63e8c4d7ab9fed94b08ed7450c71c071e897f9a.en: A horn master class at the CRR Espace Varèse by Stefan Dohr, solo horn of the Berlin Philharmonic. It is part of the conservatoire's master classes, in partnership with the Orchestre national du Capitole de Toulouse.

ed223a7cdca10bff0986dd8f4538a8b3e2e41add.en: A talk at Université Jean-Jaurès on how traditional music such as vallenato passes on heritage and mixes with modern sounds. It also looks at gender in artistic practice and the role of music in identity.

49efa68e8df10f6fa516d30ab67020247ddea4ee.en: A screening of Johan Grimonprez's 150-minute film at Médiathèque Grand M on Thursday 12 November at 2.30pm. It links Congo's independence, the African independence wave, the US civil rights movement and the Cold War through jazz. A discussion follows.

0006fe495c365d3a78cee627848fc59061375b8e.en: A hands-on workshop at the Médiathèque Empalot to get to know an Android phone and set it up for your needs. Booking is at the desk or by phone.

b39cb86be981a60f4e4b071e93bb7050e9af27a1.en: A reading club at the Bibliothèque Ancely on Thursday 12 November at 5pm. Booking is by phone or email.

bda9c62ef5b4388980c442bbd96c2a574fb38fa1.en: A screening of Sense and Sensibility (Raison et sentiments) at Cinéma L'Autan, in original and dubbed versions. After her husband's death, Mrs Dashwood and her daughters must leave their estate for a modest cottage, and Elinor falls for Edward.

1338bf89ec3baaa9d35819cd9edadb0f2c00487b.en: A night-time treasure hunt at the Chapelle de La Grave, when the chapel is closed to the public. Teams follow clues tied to the building's history and its artworks to find the treasure of Sister Héloïse, with torches.

2f43094847fd0faac57833dd2f3baa1d6ffa0d5a.en: A concert at Interference by the Belgian kraut-trance noise duo La Jungle, now a trio, playing their seventh album An Order of Things. Doors open at 7.30pm.

bab1f0477e00b605ae5b8322a784ab32ca18b165.en: A philosophy café at Le Kiwi led by philosopher Michel Sparagano, asking whether artificial intelligence is progress or a threat. The talk covers technology in daily life, its effect on collective choices and the ethical questions it raises.

38947edfaca2b122a520738a3da40056472788df.en: A screening of the French film Repose en paix, si tu peux (1h23) at Le Cratère on Thursday 12 November at 8.30pm, with the film team. Franck has been dead for three weeks and his divorced parents cannot agree where he should be buried.

d07afeeae3a99fd7401e4faa27f8f313ad6953f2.en: A meeting at Le Cratère about Franck, who has been dead for three weeks, and his divorced parents, who cannot agree where he should be buried.

b053fefd412a3d4b6a51553919cb2b82121ef818.en: A psychedelic tropical noise concert by the Bogotá trio Los Pirañas at Le Taquin in Toulouse, part of the Locombia festival. Their experimental cumbia, psych rock and electronic touches are made to dance to. Tickets are 15 euros, or 12 concession.

c3012abffbf9e5bb1200db0f355824a086ac5b9b.en: A wordless duo show for schools by Cie Les Humanophones and Cie Sons de toile at the Théâtre Jules Julien on Friday 13 November at 10am and 2.30pm. A funny, physical tale about two characters distracted by their phones, for ages 5 and up, 40 minutes.

b27131d36c3e09197a8f0d55bc194c74d6d8ddc6.en: A talk at Université Jean-Jaurès, using the trio MAAAR to show how traditional music draws on migration and exchange. Their sounds mix influences from Brittany, Occitania, Galicia, Venezuela and Colombia.

408572728cc426f60beb62de5b8222a516b0d6e5.en: A two-voice visit of the photography exhibition at the Château d'Eau with two cultural mediators, from the Château d'Eau and the Musée des Arts Précieux Paul-Dupuy teams. The exhibition runs 16 October 2026 to 21 February 2027.

a0b34237cd4a980fb7870db1634b832f7ce165d0.en: A readers' meeting at the Médiathèque Saint-Cyprien on Thursday 12 November at 5.15pm, where people share their favourite books.

72a858b9cce0f6edc1e5e57ca3c9d509887c9abe.en: A one-hour reading recital at the Médiathèque Côte Pavée on Friday 13 November at 6pm by the reading company Le 22 de l'Av'nue. It mixes dialogues, poems and texts about humour.

0d533b2eee3fc0dbc77a176f56447fdf86ff2f34.en: A repair café in Castanet-Tolosan on Friday 13 November, 6 to 9pm, run by La Rafistolerie. Bring things to fix and tools to share basic DIY skills against waste, with a free-swap space and low-cost drinks.

d8560926940302b3c7aecb7c7b329c2c19957f11.en: A series of art-history lectures on photography by Morgane Reygnier at the Pavillon blanc Henri-Molina, held on Fridays from 13 November 2026 to 21 May 2027. Topics include the history of photography, comics, landscapes, portraits and video art.

1606a733e9490ac5841f987d7017bd009d100344.en: An evening at Cinéma L'Autan with two films about the Nobel-winning writer Annie Ernaux: Claire Simon's Écrire la vie, built on students' readings of her work, and Judith Godrèche's Mémoire de fille. A free drink is served between the screenings.

138972de260ebd88fea8eb27c1255a9786f85fad.en: An opening on Friday 13 November at 6.30pm at the Théâtre des Mazades for the Locombia festival's 10th year, with typography and prints by La Linterna, a Cali workshop founded in 1934. Free entry; the show runs until 15 December.

77cbd17875a1e8689112805d50e603e85a3cb07b.en: A torch-lit evening visit of the Basilique Notre-Dame la Daurade and the church of Saint-Nicolas in Toulouse, organised by the Noviciat with the tourist office. The buildings are shown at nightfall.

e93a99ec51df0d769f77041621eb8df82f6dd8c3.en: A seated, very limited live concert by Superpoze at the Église du Gesù, with light designed for the architecture and an immersive sound system. Doors at 6pm, live from 7pm for about 1.5 hours.

05af8dc71bfb4c04a236a14652f6f0d539bc0752.en: A contemplative electronic concert by Superpoze at the Église du Gesù, for a very limited seated audience. The melancholic electronic and instrumental music is meant to reveal the church's architecture and acoustics. Doors 6pm, music from 7pm.

b7f765b20b067c4140d567b3ad0d9e082733b316.en: A screening of César Paes's film Songs for Madagascar (1h28) at Le Cratère on Friday 13 November at 8.30pm, with the film team. Madagascar's leading musicians come together to create a shared sound and defend their island's natural resources.

15533543021e761f6e90d99daac96b5a5cfd502c.en: A meeting at Le Cratère about Madagascar All Stars, six leading Malagasy musicians who come together to create a shared sound for their island.

67baed3bc6cb2d90162e22b29f6997dfe9267310.en: A soul and funk concert by the seven-piece band Snappy Tones at Les Marins d'Eau Douce in Ramonville on Friday 13 November at 9pm. The set covers Motown classics and funk hits. Tickets are 10 euros with a drink.

9fce3ec2073fbaaff14fa016eaaa444392d3d143.en: A concert by the vocal trio MAAAR at the Théâtre des Mazades, part of the Locombia festival. The three women blend voices from Venezuela, Colombia, Andalusia, Brittany, Galicia and Occitania. Their first album launches in Toulouse. For ages 8 and up.

b7ad85d1d0befbb6c61605487e9077e2bed2f38c.en: The sixth Hit Me Baby night at Interference on 13 November, a 2000s and 2010s party with pop, R&B and hip-hop hits from Britney Spears to Lorie. The night adds a 360-degree set, new stands on the rooftop and a giant MSN chat screen.

7e84cb694590179917600fa9e9a7736ed24125f7.en: A Schranz night at Le Bikini on Friday 13 November, midnight to 5.30am, with Nikolina headlining and Esilise and Charlotte Newman on the bill. The club will get a custom stage design. Tickets are sold on Shotgun and at the Bikini.

5216394956b70038a7d07b25bc25375a352bb423.en: A sensory 45-minute visit of the Musée des Augustins for babies from 6 months to 2 years, with one free adult companion per child. Activities include listening to echoes, looking through a tube and singing, led by Stéphanie Combes.

04512faff4d7a18db3316aa166582812fddce500.en: A workshop at the Archives municipales for the bicentenary of photography. Participants investigate rare photographic archives to rediscover Toulouse through nearly 200 years of images.

4b7431b31536d8990d90bc1bdaf586b8eb09a45f.en: A two-hour visit of a Toulouse house built before 1948 and renovated to energy class A, with a heat pump and external wall insulation. The owner, builders and advisers comment on the works. The address is sent to registrants two days before.

506f2f8b8aeee4d44da4dcd4c4f416dbbb041dbc.en: A screening at the José Cabanis media library on Saturday 14 November at 10.15am of two short documentaries on migration, followed by a discussion with Nicolas Potin and the association SINGA.

465801b837f017d61c21bccbf2443e0fe59d86af.en: A 1.5-hour creative workshop for families at the Musée des Augustins, for children from age 3 with an adult, making a stencil landscape. Booking is required for at least one adult and one child.

49165a445bc79c7a8ff8d77f0c7a5780ec2346d6.en: Reading clubs for readers aged 9 to 13 at the Médiathèque des Izards, where members share favourite books and comics. Dates, booking and times are on the library site or from the librarians.

49384d858dee9212d77a32f86403ff455e1a70d4.en: Weekly or monthly story sessions for children aged 0 to 3 at the Bibliothèque Ancely, with themes tied to the season or current events. Information is available by phone.

bb3757748f5147d90b639181053400363c667452.en: A concert-visit at the Notre-Dame du Taur church, where organist Baptiste Genniaux introduces the organ in music and words, then leads a hands-on workshop with mini instruments. Organised by the Noviciat with Toulouse les Orgues.

18b4998f552c25c8a30f2ffe28982acc8fbdabf7.en: A family storytelling session at the Médiathèque Simone-de-Beauvoir in Ramonville, with albums read aloud and set to music by Anne Payan. A parent must attend, places are limited, and booking is at the desk or by phone.

6bc6c76c716502fdf70d8e9249da3c237d4bfb70.en: A free repair café in Blagnac, where people bring objects to mend, with tools and volunteer experts on hand from 2pm to 5.30pm. The next session on 14 November is at the salle des Caouecs.

41e2cd785979b82e09c9a1993d7487cc1e349915.en: A two-hour art workshop for children aged 6 to 12 at the Musée des Augustins, themed A perte de vue with a stencilled landscape. The children explore the museum's works and try drawing, painting and modelling. No parent may stay with them.

b2bc5b1e16eb7f58c7f77ae718323f0556e83fd0.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins on the materials of its works, such as marble, bronze and clay, which make up the very essence of each piece.

59699d6d84e88bbee75182f335195456e2788561.en: A screening of the short film Imaq, la brillante at the José Cabanis media library on Saturday 14 November at 2.30pm. A woman in Capbreton dreams of Greenland and writes to a woman in Ilulissat. A discussion with the director and Nicolas Potin follows.

6c75dc920384aaf00a186c3a360415f2ef6f0bf4.en: A Chagall-inspired art workshop for children at the Aussonne municipal library. They discover Chagall's world, play with colour combinations and make a stained-glass-style collage.

624cd418c6e83623901310e936f07a6ac5ba1b0c.en: A family gardening workshop on cuttings at the Médiathèque Rangueil on Saturday 14 November at 2.30pm and 3.30pm, part of the Parenting Month. The session lasts one hour; booking is by phone.

0dfcdd9245bf036a3717949fb57b32d2571f7715.en: A plant photography workshop at the Pavillon blanc Henri-Molina, covering focus, framing and light, as part of the FReDD environmental film festival.

c4a05a279c4cc1772987222118e6fc286e60a426.en: A Halloween film at Cinéma L'Autan for ages 6 and up. The farmer ruins the flock's beloved pumpkins, and Shaun turns into a mad scientist to fix it, with wild results.

ad528a87d1b7247249a3a82c500fc7b0c713ebeb.en: A one-hour session called Oxygène at the Médiathèque Côte Pavée on Saturday 14 November at 4pm. The listing gives no further detail; booking is by phone.

7e654cb870111a91fc46ca161c4fde2006ac9c3a.en: A screening of the documentary La Marseillaise des ivrognes (96 min) at the José Cabanis media library on Saturday 14 November at 4pm, with the Cinespana festival. It follows a 1961 team collecting resistance songs in northern Spain under Franco.

f9d72b35740d116a7e5375d267e0e1a16c62feb8.en: Colombia screenings at Utopia Borderouge as part of Locombia: a family programme of five Colombian short films from age 6 at 4pm, then a 1998 documentary on singer Totó La Momposina at 5.15pm.

b2311d8615dc4f77508f9a4943038ac3684ef968.en: A musical evening at the Salle des fêtes du Lac in Castanet-Tolosan. The Les Rollande theatre troupe presents songs and dances on women's everyday lives, then the Toulouse duo BarBar leads a traditional dance. Proceeds go to a bilingual Occitan school.

f57bde219deedc8bd600cd49ab2ba72173234454.en: A concert by Stanislas, a 21-year-old singer-songwriter from Colombes, at the Rex in Toulouse. He blends indie rap and alternative pop, has released the EP Topless, and is preparing a first tour.

efefce5bddc620b915298fbadd3a22b339ebe45b.en: An Italian programme called La Dolce Vita at the Auditorium Saint-Pierre-des-Cuisines, conducted by Julien Martineau with La Chambre Napolitaine and tenor François Pardailhé. Tickets are online from 4 November; a few seats may free up before the show.

e68f5802f877bcd183e26075dbd632d66c849705.en: The tenth Noche Loca night at Le Metronum, celebrating Colombian music on Saturday 14 November, 8pm to midnight. It features Totó La Momposina's family celebration, El Gran Piquete and a DJ set by Angela Blackburn. Tickets are 16 to 18 euros in advance.

b2dfe8d426576dd0429c7627f94fe1a24adc404d.en: A flamenco show at the Kiwi by Cie LS'Arte and Association Lunares, presented by the Ramonville-Zuera twinning committee. Two dancers, a guitarist and a singer perform soleares, siguiriyas and alegrías, in a deep and elegant tribute to the tradition.

4f9b2f89bdb2a64a9571869d3be176fac5ab2425.en: A night of uptempo, early hardcore, rawstyle and gabber at Le Bikini on Saturday 14 November, with Panic, Satirized, The Saints, 99PRBLMZ and Hackash, plus a laser show. Early tickets are in very limited quantity.

36f41685d074c66651331f8a7982a000b62f5c85.en: An Insane Tour night at Interference in Balma on Saturday 14 November, midnight to 6am, with Vieze Asbak and more. It previews the Insane Festival, held 6 to 8 May 2027. Under-18s are not admitted.

74ec271b89a66e7bf87251307c68940816adc9f4.en: A meeting at Le Cratère about Providence, a young Parisian who discovers she lives next door to the author of her favourite children's books.

1dd8bfaee351462d4387a80fd27cf38f28cf6a1f.en: A screening of Philippe Riche's film La Fille dans les nuages (1h28) at Le Cratère on Sunday 15 November at 10am, with Noma'Dock. An author gives Providence a magic pen that makes what is written come true.

08c72eddf71af0e58bca5dbed0c69067fb1e3b72.en: A one-hour mental walk through the Musée des Augustins led by designer Aurélie Fourment, a practitioner of neuro-cognitive approaches. Through the works, it explores the images we hold in our minds.

39493a3a5fafb6bae5761d381c834925e3ff84ac.en: A screening of Marie-Monique Robin's documentary at Le Cratère on Sunday 15 November at 2pm. It shows how the Alsatian town of Ungersheim reached energy and food self-sufficiency, and is followed by a meeting with Noma'Dock.

02107cb84e276b08ffba001e3a78874c7c2f242f.en: A screening of Thomas Lacoste's documentary Soulèvements (106 min) at Médiathèque Grand M on Sunday 15 November at 3pm. It portrays 16 people in the movement against land grabs and industrial damage, followed by a discussion with the FReDD festival.

d41d16fc718af94c321dc73862655b6712311f4e.en: A meeting at the José Cabanis media library on Sunday 15 November at 3pm with author Stéphanie Fontez and deaf actress Florence Houmad, about their book on learning sign language and deaf culture. A sign-language interpreter is present; 1h20.

aef4371cb7195b0b08b2483c153470ecf27cbff8.en: A screening of Roberto Della Torre's documentary Des ricochets en eau douce (56 min) at Le Cratère on Sunday 15 November at 3.30pm, with the director. It looks at industrial gravel extraction from the water table in the Ariège valley.

8899ea3c67ef75087cbcecb92b58b21fdec9fff0.en: A day of the FReDD environmental film festival at Le Cratère on Sunday 15 November, 10am to 5pm, with films, a shared lunch and a round table on Toulouse's transition. Three films cost 12 euros, and single tickets 4 euros.

6f9d41f89f32040e133d266143f26c5992e8b57d.en: A regional day at the Diagora centre in Labège on 16 November on innovation, research and climate change in Occitanie's farming. Organised by the regional chamber of agriculture for farm advisers, with a morning on climate and workshops by sector.

200b6dcb780db9c9f3d928b090d8ad4b00637984.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins through scents such as musk, cinnamon, jasmine and chocolate, which invite visitors to smell the paintings. Route 1 covers the painting and sculpture salons.

21b89b96a89fbcba583c956279665b731e6870ed.en: The second film in the Bataille de Gaulle series, J'écris ton nom, at Cinéma L'Autan. It follows the general from June 1940, as a resistance grows around him in England, France and Africa.

12dee5a922334598ef79611914d5518ba3c2e0e9.en: The Transfo Digitale Day at La Cité in Toulouse on Tuesday 17 November, a format where business leaders work together on their own digital challenges, with talks and specialists in digital transformation. Organised by AD'OCC.

7592e01f689a57753fba7cd42e04dea67f1f53d6.en: A careers session from Safran Spacecraft Propulsion during Industry Week 2026. The company builds plasma engines and propulsion systems for satellites; its Vernon site in Normandy is 45 minutes from Paris.

1531d8b0b1fd377ab5da571b30a5eace64d96562.en: An information session at the France Travail Blagnac agency with the HANVOL association, supporting people with disabilities who want to work in aeronautics. Open to holders of a CAP, BEP, baccalauréat, BTS or licence.

38085847c4087271f2a63dc6e980beca04b4413f.en: A café-debate at the Guilhermy bibliobus on Tuesday 17 November, 3.30 to 5.30pm, on the environmental impact of everyday digital habits, such as emails and streaming. For ages 13 and up; booking is by phone or email.

898bb4e85a627af3e312439c25643be247280713.en: Science and digital workshops run by CGI professionals in schools within about 100 km of Toulouse. Activities include music, programming robots, algorithms and AI, lasting 45 minutes to 1.5 hours; contact is by email or phone.

839cfbac14abe00f594f5ad7471381b006d99a82.en: A master class at the CRR Salle Stravinski by Xavier Miquel, an early-music specialist who plays with Les Passions and Le Concert Spirituel and teaches recorder at the Colomiers conservatoire.

c6ab34e9631337a3a9840e561d23d8b6b47343c9.en: A guided nature walk along the canal banks from the Saouzelong metro station, led by the Veracruz association. It explores plants, birds and insects, and continues to the rewilded nature trail of Ramonville.

99bbdadb8f2bfd6b56738ca307d053a51934069c.en: A gentle music listening session for babies aged 0 to 3 at the Bibliothèque Duranti on Wednesday 18 November at 10.30am. It lasts 30 minutes; booking is by phone.

4f84b0a1fd5335bcb09d9cbc852bd7821da30920.en: Weekly or monthly reading and story sessions for children aged 0 to 3 at the Médiathèque Saint-Cyprien on Wednesdays at 10.30am, including 18 November and 9 December.

80beaf3631dc3fdb34eaedb5da8eb5adef617d07.en: A 30-minute reading session for children in the story cabin of the Médiathèque Rangueil on Wednesdays at 10.30am, including 18 November and 9 December. Booking is by phone.

79051b56dcd53dfd45d9f078c359e27086aa7aa1.en: A weekly session for children aged 0 to 3 at the Médiathèque Simone de Beauvoir in Ramonville, run by the library team. It is free and needs booking; one accompanying adult per child is asked, and a parent must attend.

2238ccd238debf219966c0f320a635a66ad1c387.en: A working group for building professionals at the Maison de l'Energie on why costs differ between stages of a condominium energy renovation, from audit to quote. A questionnaire is provided in advance.

0fe74ccb9699e61ab5710cd749bb2c0fa6e2d906.en: A stop-motion workshop at the Médiathèque d'Aussonne, where participants write a script, take photos and edit a video on a tablet, giving everyday objects the illusion of movement.

5d8b3245d0addb006824b3c1f87159a76958be73.en: A documentary screening at the José Cabanis media library on Wednesday 18 November at 2.30pm: Arbres – un voyage immobile (47 min), about giant trees such as baobabs and sequoias. A discussion with Nicolas Potin follows.

8548cf0813608fbc76ee425c907b9e5ecce5e524.en: A craft afternoon at the Soupetard social centre on 14 October, 2.30 to 5pm, making cheerful signs for the lantern procession on 18 December. For ages 6 and up; no booking.

8d672d5d8c250f3ad3c84282ec4c1cf5ad0da3da.en: A workshop with author and illustrator Laurent Moreau at the Pradettes library on Wednesday 18 November at 2.30pm. Children discover his book Tu vois le jour and join a large colourful mural based on his drawing. From age 4; booking by phone.

9129f278dcf4cbe45bff22884c15b240e6874a97.en: A two-hour manga character workshop at the Duranti library on Wednesday 18 November at 3pm, led by the International School of Manga and Animation. Participants shape a character's silhouette, attitude and personality. For ages 10 and up.

6eac70672e6a161fbc995eaaf999da6135f272d9.en: A two-hour paper-folding workshop at the José Cabanis media library on Wednesday 18 November, 3 to 5pm, in the drawing studio on the arts floor. Suitable from age 12.

249482a151c6c689a2ef8b5ff18ea45a2f8d265e.en: A card-making workshop at the Danièle Damin library on Wednesday 18 November at 3pm with illustrator Fanny Pageaud. Participants make flap cards inspired by flamenco postcards, hiding a message or a creature under a petal. For ages 10 and up.

1e0517e12e72f396c9535d7e31156f3f670caa7e.en: A one-hour session on electrical waste and the Invisible Monster at the Médiathèque Côte Pavée on Wednesday 18 November at 4pm. Booking is by phone.

99722e02523a229cfec39b3f898bccc679bc482e.en: A creative gouache workshop at the Médiathèque de Pechabou for children aged 7 and up, where they learn to use gouache and complete a painting of their own.

f42dceb62735c5a7014585033c02c6440cd30062.en: A meeting with author-illustrator Laurent Moreau at the Médiathèque Grand M on Wednesday 18 November at 5pm. Visitors see him draw and talk with him, followed by a book signing with La Renaissance bookshop from 6pm.

5af52c71d5628eee12c69447e32ff1be29b72ec4.en: A master class by pianist Bertrand Chamayou at the CRR Espace Varèse, part of the conservatoire's master classes with the Orchestre national du Capitole de Toulouse. He is known for Ravel and Liszt and has won five Victoires de la musique classique.

d7edb335cd5e5c8f3020502f3873452140aaea73.en: A staged reading of 7 minutes by Stefano Massini at the Médiathèque Saint-Cyprien on Wednesday 18 November at 6pm, performed by two actresses ahead of the December show at the Théâtre de la Cité. A discussion follows.

84787562c56ada5d89e4683d94df3f075436a8ba.en: A listening session at the José Cabanis media library on Tuesday 17 November at 6pm of a 1993 radio documentary about a cleaner retiring from the INA sound library. It is followed by a discussion with Nicolas Potin.

a0af85326948ed9ff00931b748be7e17c698b9e1.en: An event on Thursday 19 November, 9am to 5.15pm, at the CESI campus in Labège, where schoolgirls discover engineering careers through talks, testimonies and immersive activities. Organised with Elles bougent.

acc63c41cdbaea355dd77bc872c1433e9b5ff231.en: A partners' day at Le Kiwi on parenting, with anthropologist Serge Escots in the morning and interactive workshops in the afternoon. It is organised with the Couleurs et Rencontres social centre in Ramonville.

e59827dfef39de349600711a4c4aaf0df1792c60.en: A free four-half-day course in Colomiers for carers of people with disabilities, run by Format Différence. It helps turn lived experience into a resource and move towards becoming a peer carer. Dates are 19 and 26 November.

eeaae36655b0388ed65768c62f161c7e634247f6.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins on painting as a way of thinking about the world. Before photography, painters alone created the images that helped people understand and learn about the world.

c9a2a81edc88ef2852c730a994b93b4db2607880.en: A workshop at the Médiathèque Empalot on securing an Android phone and setting the options that protect your private information. Booking is at the desk or by phone.

4d64a64121ac7635fb72ede88554842288010209.en: A screening at the José Cabanis media library on Thursday 19 November at 3pm of three short documentaries by young directors, made with the ENSAV and the Lycée des Arènes, plus a film about the library itself.

d6f1e7b191f22adc0d661170e3cee2b5acdfd0a1.en: A teen reading club at the Médiathèque Saint-Cyprien on Thursday 19 November at 5.30pm, where young readers share favourites among manga, music and novels. Other dates are 15 October and 17 December.

ac71bdf14d9843c8fa93d3678884c81927957327.en: An evening at the Musée des Augustins with the artist Nicolas Dhervillers: life drawing and sketching of statues from 6pm, and talks at 6.30pm and 7.30pm. Entry to the museum is paid; the activities are free.

7821724b7f2f79809c4de67e2e138b0e17d5cf4f.en: A screening at the José Cabanis media library on Thursday 19 November at 6pm of Fanny Molins's documentary Atlantic Bar (77 min), about a bar in Arles and its regulars facing the loss of their meeting place. A talk with Nicolas Potin follows.

e727bd9d2af9983651b14d5723882b373279b379.en: A staged reading of 7 minutes by Stefano Massini at the Médiathèque des Pradettes on Thursday 19 November at 6pm, performed by two actresses before the December show at the Théâtre de la Cité. A talk follows.

df1d44305d449cd1d2bed634b735e7ea8b95f59b.en: A free training course for associations introducing artificial intelligence: its main concepts, uses and how to choose suitable tools. No technical background is needed. Run by Profession Sport Animation 31 at the Maison des associations.

fe0d24f87dab8fdb4773a09b0535250db2735fb9.en: A gluten-free concert-meal by singer and cook Marlène Bouniort, mixing funky jazz, nursery rhymes, maloya and ragtime, with dishes chosen by the audience. Part of the Articulinaire project; light food is served from 6pm.

02fd4f26f8ed948cebe504b4d2b48f0192a26978.en: A concert at Le Rex in Toulouse by Roadrunners, the Le Havre rock group active from 1982 to 1996. They made six albums and played more than a thousand live shows, mixing Beatles-style melody with raw energy.

23b32a61b68961ed71befb526ad45f9da7592ae5.en: An improvised science talk at the Eurêkafé, where performers play assistant scientists with no preparation. They answer questions from the audience live on cutting-edge research and the lives of the scientists invited.

7a70febdaa59b171bae7f96ca4f51d7ff5171004.en: A concert at Le Bikini by rapper Jolagreen23 on the tour for the extended edition of his first album, 23 JOURS PLUS TARD, which has 23 tracks. He recently announced a Zénith date in Paris.

6968d7b66d0fa86b9fb5e87ff03f05994ae00f9a.en: A monthly girls' karaoke night at Zapata in Toulouse, on a Thursday from 8pm to midnight, with games, blind tests and a giant screen. It is relaxed and welcoming, and singing out of tune is fully accepted. This session is on 19 November.

0ab84ad33de6d9fa4633e3a86673807fa1174e1b.en: A talk at Le Kiwi on the history of women at the Olympic Games, covering bans, struggles, records and sex tests, with pioneers and activists. It suits sports fans as well as those new to the subject.

82ae894d369708db3d1451fee7b712d27c381562.en: A screening at Cinéma L'Autan of On n'est pas nos parents, about a 2023 strike at the Citroën plant in Aulnay-sous-Bois. A new generation of workers takes up the struggle first fought by immigrant workers in 1982.

2a6ca8c4bf3d896502ec24d1166f9ee60beed285.en: An exhibition at the Médiathèque Saint-Cyprien from 19 November to 25 February, echoing a project on the Białowieża forest. It shows botanical plates, artists' books and tree fruits from library and museum collections.

fd008207992c955b8a91207fc2118f7957a5b138.en: A dance-and-reading show at the Saint-Cyprien cultural centre for children aged 3 to 5, built from forest picture books by Caroline Dassieu and Angie Larqué. It echoes the Białowieża exhibition and is staged across several sites.

d7b082193a58e4144918b0430b84bb7880361be5.en: A job dating day in Toulouse with about thirty aerospace, space and defence companies from Occitanie, where candidates can apply on the spot. Company pitches are in the morning and talks in the afternoon; preparation is through France Travail.

bc31fcd0b14aaf46ec7cbad5613c4b55b2aac4f0.en: A 30-minute reading session for babies at the Médiathèque Serveyrolles on 7 October, 20 November and 16 December at 10.30am. Booking is by phone.

800f29451de3c5d69af59c968663841d51caa357.en: A guided visit of the exhibition La Part des anges at the Musée des Augustins, led by two voices, one of them the artist Nicolas Dhervillers.

a5a3fbad7b681d8255da385085d2cf9977c2a6bf.en: A creative workshop at the Pavillon blanc Henri-Molina in which participants make an image half photographed portrait and half drawing, changing the face graphically. Part of the BD Colomiers festival.

70739104f2a346dc08a11e9d0ea98c66085e114c.en: A porcelain-painting workshop at the Musée des Arts Précieux Paul-Dupuy, inspired by works in the exhibition. Creations are collected later, once they have been fired.

a37f9238588e53036a5d451047057ee6de91f342.en: An adult erotic expo at the Sing Sing in Toulouse on 20 and 21 November, with more than 30 exhibitors, shows, a DJ, a BDSM area and a tombola. Strictly for over-18s.

7b7d7b9578da36befeb889e7f1267d234309cc5a.en: A staged reading of Stefano Massini's 7 minutes at the Médiathèque Côte Pavée on Friday 20 November at 6pm, by two actresses from the Théâtre de la Cité ahead of the December production. It lasts one hour.

ea54f0c31de33b9fbdf7318799574fbfde5b7e94.en: A solo show by Silencio Compagnie at the Théâtre Jules Julien on 20 and 21 November at 7pm, for ages 12 and up. When the children of a small French town vanish, Jasper, the one who remains, tells a sharp, fantastical detective tale. One hour.

fe1674de0d9bd67e218f64bf58955c10c6211fca.en: A concert at the Villeneuve-Tolosane municipal media library by women singers and musicians who draw on Celtic traditions. Their original songs and traditional airs use harp, guitar, whistles and bodhrán.

f0c88480442c841fbad00fbdb8a5a1a1c5c5a26b.en: A concert at Interference on the Be Not Afraid world tour, with Polyphia, Perturbator and RJ Pasin. Polyphia blend instrumental rock with trap and electronic music, Perturbator is a French synthwave artist, and RJ Pasin mixes metalcore and hyperpop.

d1d79b05ef0a01ece79a10431c6a0c392edc9d9f.en: A concert by Lisa Pariente at Le Rex in Toulouse. The Parisian singer, known since 2019 for French versions of international hits, makes catchy, bright pop songs about love and her generation, produced by Moon Boy.

9d9984027b10224b97e3b06f48cc403e52100bce.en: A concert in Toulouse by Zélie, who sings and dances her force and sensitivity over energetic, raw songs with electronic sounds. Her show mixes contemporary dance, hip-hop and acidic pop, after a sold-out Cigale date.

e2e76dadd5d15f8618697c20a0a5591c75f375f5.en: A funk and soul concert at Les Marins d'Eau Douce in Ramonville on Friday 20 November at 9pm by the Toulouse band FUNK.IT, reworking funk classics from Stevie Wonder onwards with new grooves and brass. Booking is recommended for food.

a08aeeaa6c5bc77dd76d7cdaf4c7d60cde2ec160.en: A 10th-anniversary night for the Moontrip collective at Interference on Friday 20 November, midnight to 6am, with ten local artists in five B2B sets. Tickets are 10 euros, with a raffle of DJ kit and festival passes.

27c3d4ba5d9f167ed07d4044eecdce2be36c7d79.en: A Hot Meal Records night at Le Bikini with Janis Zielinski, Bad Boombox, Mija and Mischluft. The listing gives no further details.

2b561068d42aad9ef2091274b2b394dd1505a134.en: A goose-fat and craft market at the village centre of Pechabou on Saturday 21 November, 8am to 3pm. About forty stallholders sell duck, cheese, wine and crafts, with a children's farm and an animal-sound contest.

75504d8b38d7681c411a34fc711139386f372348.en: A master class at the CRR Salle Stravinski by guitarist Jérémy Peret, a versatile player born in Aveyron who plays both classical and electric guitar and has won international prizes.

858b9bb7607e274b6c2c6c24d2db1717b14d50b4.en: A two-hour clay workshop at the Resistance museum with sculptor Claire Michel. Participants create their own image of freedom, inspired by the museum's Marianne noire, as part of the 25th anniversary of the Taubira law. For all ages.

5e168fd000048994ba9bbbc7c0a34282fa6e019d.en: A children's show at the Cornebarrieu media library in which Rita moves house and finds her new room empty. With little more than imagination, she plays, invents and surprises herself, through movement, stories and sound.

ccd6d208816cc3e006aeaf5023cff7bb1593197e.en: An interactive miniature theatre, Déplacer les montagnes, at the Kiwi. Visitors step into a miniature landscape with a large wooden-block building game and embroidered books, and shape their own story.

80efce19e8fba7a2fa36cd4842d9578675aa1608.en: An exhibition of pastel works by a collective of artists from Auzeville at the Pechabou library, with a meeting on Saturday 21 November at 10.30am.

0a1a0c3ff8c945acc8d80668e0a380b493950860.en: A photography workshop run with the association Declic at the Pavillon blanc Henri-Molina. The listing gives no further details.

ed46893f959c6220bf4b6fbb30fda288533a893a.en: A writing workshop at the Médiathèque Grand M on Saturday 21 November at 10.30am, led by Cie DSH. It links to the show Vas-y frappe-moi si tu peux about violence and resilience. For ages 15 and up; booking by phone.

ad0eaa31d25583a56e8bd6f0656389037e3773de.en: A relaxed coffee meeting at the Médiathèque Fabre to share recent favourite novels, comics or films, on 26 September, 21 November and 19 December at 10.30am. For ages 16 and up; booking is by phone or email.

02e79d48eb94f257081a279d5cc369241e488179.en: A workshop with author-illustrator Laurent Moreau at the Izards library on Saturday 21 November at 10.30am, based on his book Le goût de la pluie. Children tear, collage and draw a large illustration. From age 5; booking by phone.

935a87a4b23d837f5d7f1e1a79f03f583a79ae56.en: A two-hour cyanotype workshop at the Musée des Augustins for children aged 6 to 12. They explore the museum and make blue-toned prints. No parent may stay with the child.

cdd517501fcca9d9a16c934b4597f020d2404be1.en: A 30-minute storytelling show at the Médiathèque Empalot on Saturday 21 November at 11am and 3pm, adapted from the story of Finn and the place where the sea meets the sky. From age 3; booking by phone.

f323d14c146e7a202e754b17c1f58f952e235e3a.en: The 10th Dictée du Lauragais, a public spelling test for all ages at the Salle du Lac in Castanet-Tolosan, with four levels. It raises awareness of illiteracy, and blind and partially sighted people take part too, using the same text in Braille.

c4658d968820bd95aeec71bcd6c8999fe598efe6.en: A plant swap at the salle de VIC in Castanet-Tolosan, where people bring perennials, shrubs, bulbs and houseplants to exchange.

1bfeb358b30dce74724f0961edb554c7a9731854.en: A writing workshop led by Lise Balas at the Médiathèque Danièle Damin on Saturday 21 November at 2pm, on our relationship with living beings. It uses texts by Mélanie Leblanc and Marielle Macé. For adults; 2.5 hours.

fe1987a9f347cfa8eeef40836ee6b3fc14fa45e2.en: An interactive show at the Médiathèque Grand M on Saturday 21 November at 2.30pm. Violette asks what it means to be a girl or a boy, and the audience joins her to rewrite the story. From age 5, about an hour.

81f21d086a508965a9567ba035abbbe1c837d033.en: A shared reading club at the Médiathèque des Pradettes on Saturday 21 November, 2.30 to 4.30pm, where people bring a favourite text or discover new ones.

ffda24bfad3fa2e1e057672ecb8c3d85096b15f0.en: A guided tour of the photography exhibition at the Château d'Eau, interpreted in French Sign Language. The exhibition runs 16 October 2026 to 21 February 2027.

5fd869e3e22732a16df78fb9e6d7517a06b4850f.en: A hands-on taster of virtual and augmented reality at the José Cabanis media library on Saturday 21 November and 19 December, 3 to 5pm. People try a headset with immersive places and games. For ages 13 and up.

9ccd73df9aaff0203db5f50a368d5e3aecb6a9aa.en: A photo and drawing workshop for very young children at the Pavillon blanc Henri-Molina, led by Anne Letuffe.

5e5abdecdb6607997cb10462c31a1a255c26c8d1.en: A screening of Le mystère Lucy Lost at Cinéma L'Autan, for ages 6 and up. Lucy has extraordinary gifts that make the villagers shun her on a remote island, until she meets Milly, a girl only Lucy can see.

faa33a47560704dc0315876d2563e4bce905621d.en: A conversation about the exhibition La Part des anges at the Musée des Augustins between museum director Laure Dalon and artist Nicolas Dhervillers, on artist residencies and the carte blanche.

2bf347745c15717b72961eb02ff21fdda213f9f0.en: A 1.5-hour workshop at the Médiathèque Grand M on Saturday 21 November at 5pm, for adults who look after children, on supporting children who do not fit gender stereotypes. Run by Cie Folies passagères after the show Et si on rejouait l'histoire.

b89a7e1b6ef06a10fdf94d691d83d94dcab53c40.en: A concert by Dr. Peacock at the Arena Electronic Club in Toulouse, his only French date. The 90-minute concert show is followed by an exclusive DJ set. Doors open at 8pm; under-18s are not admitted.

7c7752ac6c6dde2d9842183f82ac472a236d9e1a.en: A concert by 63OG at Le Rex in Toulouse. The Cameroon-born rapper, known for DMV flow in French and English, sold out the Cigale in 2025 and plays his first Olympia on 26 October 2026.

a301ef44107f614e4a8f86a6371b947272736dae.en: A concert by 47Ter at Le Bikini in Toulouse. The three pop-rap artists from Yvelines, known for the platinum hit Côte Ouest, return with a new album on adulthood, nostalgia and disillusion.

c742b20fcceccad792450ef32ddcf12e88370790.en: A concert at Interference with Sheldon and Peet. Sheldon, a founding member of the 75e Session collective, blends jazz, reggae and rock into his rap. Peet, a Belgian artist from the group Le 77, writes poetic, personal songs.
