d2eace691a907d580dcf2dbcb9b0cc74a49cffea.en: A concert at the Zénith Toulouse Métropole with Dub Inc and Danakil. Dub Inc are among France's best-known reggae bands, mixing melody and sincere lyrics in French, English and Kabyle.

fc67d2f5a3015ad879eb8fa2f09969680b6f5666.en: The Hard Arena XXL night at the Arena Electronic Club in Toulouse on Saturday 21 November, 11pm to 5.30am. After Dr. Peacock's concert, two stages host a DJ set and other hard-music acts. Under-18s are not admitted, even with a ticket.

eb3cf39c5350cf121584dcbe96940c7c086de497.en: A 90s party at Le Bikini with pop, rock and electro hits, from Nirvana and the Spice Girls to Daft Punk and IAM.

87473efc221ef8c154792906d8d3084f383038ec.en: A family lotto at the Ramonville fire station on Sunday 22 November at 2.30pm, with prizes including holidays, appliances, headphones and a television. Cards cost 4 euros for one, 10 for three or 18 for six, and there is a refreshments stand.

004da8139a5c17ccd3096ab66244d344e298c963.en: A walk along the Canal du Midi in Toulouse from the Passerelle des Soupirs by the harbour esplanade, on one of two routes that show the city's architecture and gardens from the waterside. Run by Parcours d'architecture.

dc0437d7ffbb1abee54700e14dca31129a9fb141.en: A screening of Olivier Azam and Daniel Mermet's documentary on Howard Zinn's A People's History of the United States (106 min) at the José Cabanis media library on Sunday 22 November at 3pm, followed by a talk with Nicolas Potin.

95a70d994cf2377d0225de3dc5c4c0bbfba568a9.en: A guided walk from the Mirail Université metro station through Le Mirail, presented as an eco-neighbourhood before its time. Part of a series of district visits in Toulouse, run by the Noviciat with the tourist office.

48641a52abbcb5a767d40f3268b39e5067e6bb67.en: A Sunday meeting on the Profondeur de champ landscape exhibition at the Pavillon blanc Henri-Molina, with artists Juliette Mancini, Margaux Meissonnier and Clément Vuillier talking about their work and books. Part of the BD Colomiers festival.

84288ad8024d65a3bbce9614389e2eaafc131f5a.en: A 1.5-hour workshop at the Médiathèque Grand M on Sunday 22 November at 4pm on how online men's-rights content has grown into dozens of accounts and channels, often run as a business, and why platforms promote it.

b8aa8defdb1156f650b453e0871b5bb3dcd30b5c.en: A Sunday night at La Cabane in Les Halles de la Cartoucherie on 22 November, 6pm to midnight, with Chloé b2b Ivan Smagghe, Madgee and Leiris. Adults only, with ID checked at the door. Hotel partner gives 10% off with a ticket.

57b4bd726de0d8f2f215f47d460286f6c66defb8.en: An advance screening at Cinéma L'Autan of the Romanian film Journal d'une femme de chambre, part of the European Art and Essay cinema day. A Romanian maid in Bordeaux rehearses a play about a maid while her own daughter grows up far away in Romania.

f27a1d802de81cfd5f9b804d4fcc86916ec03197.en: A rock tribute to the band Téléphone at Interference by Minitel, led by guitarist Christophe Dubois. The concert revisits the group's biggest songs, from Argent trop cher to Cendrillon.

20cbfde4e80beeb220511011284152d7b3924c5d.en: A punk concert at Le Rex by Spike and the Gimme Gimmes, a supergroup led by Spike Slawson that reworks pop, rock and R&B classics with punk energy. Doors at 7.30pm; tickets are 28 euros in advance.

0a636c9feda83abc49fc932016b0d9b90cd77dee.en: A screening of Natalia Koryncka-Gruz's documentary Simona (2022) at the Saint-Cyprien cultural centre. Ida, great-niece of the Białowieża forest protector Simona Kossak, traces her family story through old photos.

796ca12f38ab23643ead469b70493659f5ea37df.en: A free training course for association leaders on putting a value on volunteer work in the accounts, and on the Passeport Bénévole, a tool for recording volunteer skills. Run by the Centre Toulousain du Bénévolat at the Maison des associations.

4d91adfd2230039a428eef5836c6ea21e3b26027.en: The 42nd autumn salon of the Artistes Ramonvillois at the Kiwi, a fortnight of paintings, sculpture, drawings and photos on the theme of ups and downs. The opening is on Monday 23 November at 6.30pm.

c2417cc33720912fc90b38f7c021d646c96a7bfc.en: A master class at the CRR Espace Varèse by pianist and improviser Jean-François Zygel, who teaches improvisation at the Paris conservatoire. He performs with the Orchestre national du Capitole in Toulouse on 26 November 2026.

475e7b20bcf29df826e3375c8045f7e4a4595154.en: A talk at the Médiathèque Saint-Cyprien on Tuesday 24 November at 6pm by Thomas Boissier, on progressive rock from 1968 to today, from concept albums to long sonic explorations. For ages 12 and up; 1.5 hours.

761b7b32f4812f3c745a92b079c3f7d3152b19a0.en: A talk at the José Cabanis media library on Tuesday 24 November at 6pm by historian Jean-Marc Olivier on the rebirth of French military aviation from 1945 to 1960, from the Mystère IV to the Mirage IV. Held with L'Envol des Pionniers.

98de136e5a52146ecf32b207e96b15d29027426f.en: A talk at the Résistance museum by Florence Delzons on who sought refuge in Aveyron before and during the Second World War, and how local people responded, from hospitality to xenophobia and indifference.

e59358a8295836d4bc2a97bda19c03a6bcd3db44.en: A debate at the Médiathèque Grand M on Tuesday 24 November at 6.30pm on the rise of online masculinism, with feminist writer Stéphanie Lamy, sociologist Tristan Renard, researcher Céline Mimault and playwright Orvoën Bret. A book signing follows.

e6da3ba4ebb8dfe13ece0fe2e3c20aa9afa397b5.en: A stand-up show by comedian Thomas GT at the Flashback Café in Toulouse, held in partnership with the Fondation des Femmes de Toulouse. The comedy is personal, funny and sensitive.

84390e49b686ad16d25d8c4ff9ddcf90d49bd015.en: An exhibition in November at the Évasion bar by Toulouse artist Evartiiste, with textured works inspired by fauvism and Dada.

b27c030d6c09a138500b8e8d1afeff0a51aff887.en: A 24 Hours of Braille session at the José Cabanis media library on Wednesday 25 November, 2 to 5pm, with the CTEB braille centre. Participants learn to write their name in braille and explore the alphabet. Open to all, especially children.

42df2d11fcd34576cc7aec0dc44bd140bb663dae.en: A virtual-reality games afternoon at the Médiathèque Grand M on Wednesday 25 November, 2 to 5pm. Two 1.5-hour sessions for ages 12 and up; booking by phone.

ac641fc2abd9051736faf6fd984e1e1f6a947b1a.en: A workshop at the Ancely library on Wednesday 25 November at 2.30pm, where children make a leporello of lemons full of alliteration, inspired by Françoise de Guibert's books. For ages 7 and up; booking required.

5d0c501e17537484c322b65e8bb4d771df531909.en: A story session at the Duranti library on Wednesday 25 November at 3.30pm, in which librarians and Professor Chourave take children to the Hogwarts greenhouses to repot mandrakes. For ages 8 and up; one hour.

41fa8d05b2a7cbd090ea167021d0dafba4e5e660.en: A monthly music blind test on the music floor of the José Cabanis media library, held on one Wednesday a month for one hour. It is a fun, friendly quiz.

dc312c88026c1c7a44b4e09c68b1ee938c4bdefe.en: A short showcase concert at the Toulouse Conservatoire's Salle Stravinski, where students from different classes perform together to show the range of instruments. Younger pupils can discover instruments they do not yet know.

47ed0f5fe08b8a69cf19bd3e4160314526628066.en: A comics-sharing evening at the Médiathèque Côte Pavée on Wednesday 25 November at 6.30pm, held with the Pont des Demoiselles library. Participants share the comics they have discovered. 1.5 hours; booking by phone.

bab19cf9f71f3da3866e59443324899bdb266911.en: A release party at Le Rex for the EP I Will Remember You in Death by the cello-based trio Kartage, with Cold Blossom and Underground Therapy. The EP comes out on 25 November 2026.

78523c544101dd693f4aeef78742d774404b66bc.en: The grand final of the Étoile Rose talent contest at the Flashback Café on Wednesday 25 November. Singing, dance, performance and humour are judged by a panel of professionals, with the audience also taking part.

a6c6738c1c21ef7c2cb137c5c17003f77171a855.en: An open-mic slam night at Refuge by the Roof, hosted by the Toulouse association Le Slamant Rose. Bring a text to perform or come to listen; sign-up on site from 7pm.

de1829becd5b303f28e1a410cb9dcce3caada196.en: A karaoke night at Le Bijou with a live pianist, Lucas, who adapts to each singer's range. Singers sign up on a list, wait their turn and sing along to lyrics shown on a projector.

6239e8acb3282759794d70c863f9557fa92def15.en: A jazz concert at the Taquin in Toulouse by pianist Simon Chivallon, who moves easily from Monk and the Beatles to Fauré and Brassens. Inspired by Brad Mehldau, his trio plays with fresh lyricism.

643c56db2affd7740cc5477a3e8375fce4bec51a.en: A concert at Bear's House Toulouse by the local artist Osir, who mixes electro-acoustic sounds with improvised singing and guitar. The set is hopeful and energetic.

6770fc47ffd99f0fd71a596df77dd3df15b3ad40.en: A day of urban-planning talks at the Centre de congrès Pierre Baudis in Toulouse on Thursday 26 November, organised by the APUMP Occitanie association. Forty projects are presented in 40 minutes each by designer and client pairs; about 500 people attend.

4e53e71239d0fcaf3c99c5065c5bbc5cc39134f8.en: A master class at the CRR Espace Varèse by Brazilian composer Aurélio Edler-Copes, who electrifies acoustic instruments and merges them with real-time electronics.

d7e16b84c1aa66660e59622322c943bbd382f4d2.en: A talk with Charlotte Riou, curator at the Musée des Augustins, on the museum's gothic collections, described as an exceptional ensemble.

39b488bcb15834a0e8304e4196425f90c758c725.en: A doctoral thesis defence in the Salle Ruffié on how circulating immune cells affect the barrier function of the intestinal lining and help spread inflammatory damage.

7c768833aac3894cf3d22f312a3ab2daee57ecb7.en: A two-hour origami workshop at the Roseraie library on Thursday 26 November at 2.15pm, making a star crown for the festive season. Booking is by phone.

f3fca9461a4c3f4f6d1f3ae35dbf05f8b2e687ec.en: A hands-on session at the Médiathèque Empalot to install Linux on your own computer, to replace Windows or gain full freedom over your hardware. Bring your computer; 2.30 to 5pm, booking required.

d8b4d17fe178326cc051f9d136c68e6aa9e53344.en: A detective-style talk at the Danièle Damin library on Thursday 26 November at 4.30pm with Renaud Layet of the Série B bookshop. It explores the history of the mystery novel and asks which is the best of all time.

da145393db192bce7aec65a45eea3fd336048adb.en: An exhibition of the two winners of a young artists' competition at the Salle Dauriac in the Hôtel de Ville, from 26 November to 5 January. The artists meet visitors on 26 November at 6.30pm, followed by a free drink.

ef112fe0ded1ec58085cfd8d9b26023c99875f5f.en: A release party for Toulouse artist HYL at the Flashback Café, celebrating his third project. It is a sunny mix of pop, rap and colourful electro, with surprise guests.

44335578440aff81932f686357601963b4081458.en: A Magic Boys show at Le Zapata on 26 November, with dance and choreographed striptease, reserved for women until 11pm. Entry with a glass of sparkling wine costs 12 euros; the show runs 8pm to 4am.

4f5c93cf5f8365b108c538cb105fd08b72185052.en: An all-women early clubbing night on the barge Le Cri de la Mouette on Thursday 26 November, 8pm to midnight. The playlist runs from the 90s and 2000s to today's hits. Tickets are 10 euros, and 10% goes to a charity.

ce006580551c3c8c4337b1c3533e6038bc7a84ce.en: A meeting at the COMDT for musicians and dancers to play and dance together, introducing the Occitan traditional bal. The COMDT runs these gatherings from September onwards.

13eacdd072ab20fc5906258f84b01dd2bfb75fda.en: A concert at L'Astronef by Jazz Prank, a French math-rock duo of guitar and drums. Their music is built on repetition and rhythm, with guitar parts sequenced live on a looper.

7bd530afec519776fe0766da6f56591661248ffa.en: A double bill at the Bijou with Julia Pertuy, a singer-songwriter who blends organic acoustic sounds and electronic textures with cello and keyboards, and Jon Onj, a Paris and Marseille R&B and soul artist known for the album TEKIBAMA.

6d1ec5800420f082a9685c607283ed577c50f828.en: A live show at Bear's House by the Toulouse trio Ultragama, who turn the DJ set into live music with bass, drums and guitar. They play funk, house and disco in a one-hour set with no breaks.

f38b31a6316494c42c08b1e8a193f16de098944c.en: A jam night at the Betty Pop's bar, led by Tim & Co, with an open stage for musicians and listeners. The night is about groove, improvisation and live music.

07241d6b03c50ad304df1cdee46a9a2e3ce80154.en: A ska and rocksteady concert at Café Ginette by Space Fever, a four-piece band from south-west France. They play classics and original songs for the dancefloor.

333dea9399c6997955d1e1da1c33945d6a118721.en: The opening night of the third Toulouse Django Festival at the Taquin, with violinist RT Jouaville and guitarist Simba Baumgartner, great-grandson of Django Reinhardt, in a typical gypsy jazz quartet.

b4b7c84f6286d3ff1484bf51ffd8489365b082d3.en: A concert at Breughel l'Ancien by La Cerculeuse, a Toulouse rap collective of four artists and a DJ.

aadfad961450081d2d2c516abfe45613ab553710.en: A free four-half-day course in Toulouse for carers of people with disabilities, run by Format Différence. It helps turn lived experience into a resource and move towards becoming a peer carer. Dates are 20 and 27 November.

81df65c48d4f07dc6d27f5b136705e2cc93c0c0f.en: An exhibition of fresh mushrooms at the Salle Ginette Forgues in Castanet-Tolosan, with the Toulouse mycological association. Colour-coded containers show whether each mushroom is edible, toxic or deadly, and members answer questions.

329bd9d4658f42d9dd7bdf9fd0635669ed9e2912.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins on travel, landscape and geography. It moves through Europe, from Italy and Greece to Holland, Turkey, Switzerland and the Pyrenees, and its legends and places.

c5670f5944c31879a096267b578a1fb621d73246.en: A guided visit of the Chapelle des Carmélites, a little-known baroque chapel near the Capitole whose painted ceiling is often compared with the Sistine Chapel. Visitors learn about the convent's history and its nuns.

cf49a4bf91b9c310ddecee42fb8e6bc724701bcc.en: A screening of Mindaugas Survila's documentary Dans les bois (65 min) at the Médiathèque Saint-Cyprien on Friday 27 November at 6pm, showing wildlife in one of the last primeval forests of the Baltic. Followed by a talk with a naturalist photographer.

49142c284fff5ba2bf47ccdd7f6ae94ead5218df.en: Urban Sketchers workshops in Toulouse at the Écluse Saint-Pierre and the Parvis de Brienne, teaching people to draw the city directly from life. The workshops are open to all audiences.

6ec5c130788d6369c5c11538daa62af79da9ecee.en: A sophrology visit called Échos de ciels at the Musée des Augustins, held for the International Day against Violence against Women and led by sophrologist Carine and guide Sarah.

ad2bf57362bfb127414ee60b67b4bf8a9d6fc266.en: A sophro-visite at the Musée des Augustins, combining a cultural visit with Caycedian sophrology. It is run by the association La sophrologie curieuse on the day against violence against women.

1e861d8622db763c4fbd4afbebca724eee194c23.en: A torch-lit evening visit of the Église Saint-Nicolas in Toulouse, part of the Noviciat's night series with the tourist office. The church is shown in an atypical light.

a8e9947eea7c2442d6f60ca74c4c2725c6a14f0b.en: A live cine-concert, Comment domestiquer les humains ?, by Groupe Scalpel at the Théâtre Jules Julien on Friday 27 November at 7.30pm, for ages 15 and up. In 2033 revolutionaries face alien beings who turn humans into pets. 55 minutes with live music.

a6ff6a490a1de32b0f68b83ebb696bec4bbe5f3a.en: A ticket pack for the Sublime Tour at Interference, with live sets by rapper Luther and Rounhaa and a Sublime Club DJ set. Over-18s only.

e0e94ffdd0a2b91929ab4081b4df2bdab2d80d1f.en: A bingo show by Cie STRAP at the Refuge by the Roof, run by a couple who mix folk traditions with American-style shows. The game has many prizes to win.

183218ecf5c56eb675c9c5efc1aba2a83242b491.en: A concert by Emma, a pop singer who rose through Star Academy, at Le Metronum on Friday 27 November, doors 8pm. Her first solo tour this autumn follows her EP L'Amour reste. Tickets are 28 euros in advance.

f0f6b6c361dd07309aab69b9305d1c267ac1e473.en: A concert at Évasion by Dharuma, a band that mixes electronic and instrumental music, drawing on jazz, drum and bass, ambient and Asian culture inspired by shonen manga.

38e4299ac7c62fdfce1ff7d56e16d778856c2adc.en: A dance show at the Moulin tiers-lieu, A day in a life by Loan Le Dinh. It follows the everyday effort to keep a small space of innocence and childhood in a troubled world, playfully and with choreography, sound and light.

151679116aa6b52ba13306e1b59f66c122d8a8ab.en: A brass-band disco and funk night by Retro Fever at Le Taquin on 27 and 28 November, with hits by Kool & the Gang, Earth Wind & Fire, Jackson Five and Boney M. The arrangements are built for everyone to sing and dance.

a53f5451ae7102807ca4d6a850933d4894033d40.en: A concert at Les Marins d'Eau Douce in Ramonville on Friday 27 November at 9pm by Lost on Moon, who give pop and rock standards a blues and soul feel. Midnight Sun opens. Entry is free; booking is recommended for food.

de779b37169e387e0cd47f77a29d8b9512d7750c.en: A concert at Café Ginette by TAVÎ, who perform Kurdish songs, including songs banned in Kurdistan. The repertoire runs from Dengbêj chants to resistance anthems and love songs.

0c54dbb91297e688324e18a179f640b26939fde4.en: A pop-punk and grunge concert at Betty Pop's by Marty Went Back, a Toulouse trio formed in 2017 to find their friend Marty after a trip in a DeLorean.

9242b9dc566db75af0a5272ea9f0818367c85b40.en: A concert at Le Bijou by singer-songwriter Buridane, who presents the album Colette Fantôme, a dialogue with a ghost and a dream of emancipation. Her songs are described as ones that wash away and renew.

c8e54bfc9c82c3aaab10fc67bceb4aefed596f1b.en: A concert at Breughel l'Ancien by Anzul Project, which mixes North African-inspired covers and originals in Berber, Arabic and French over a dancing rock groove, followed by an oriental bass DJ set by DJ NoBreakfast.

880475faaac083e5b2c964480ff4ffcd184fb38e.en: A Sublime Club night at Interference on the Sublime Tour, with Luther, Rounhaa and the Sublime Club over two days in twelve cities. Pre-booking is on Shotgun. Sublime Club is for over-18s only.

5a85d130dd1c034e7d059b6987e307bffb40de64.en: A workshop at the Archives municipales on the annual chronicles of the Capitouls, Toulouse's city officers, written from 1295 to 1787. Each session explores daily life and the concerns of residents in those years.

81ec69bd529caeb6d83b17ac81b977240733926d.en: A weekend of beatmaking, live coding and music machines at the Bibliothèque d'Étude et du Patrimoine on 28 and 29 November, from 10am on Saturday and 2pm on Sunday. Workshops, concerts, an exhibition and a vinyl mix of regional music.

4c879694f696c1f10eac13caf52742b9da35f3ce.en: A book and CD jumble sale at the José Cabanis media library, with books, magazines, CDs and comics at very low prices. Proceeds go to a reading-project association; cards are not accepted.

717777ae77bf105b1defdb7c9eade1bb76bf9148.en: A family watercolour workshop at the Musée des Augustins for children from age 3, themed Prendre racine. Adults and children create together; 1.5 hours, with booking for at least one adult and one child.

83c034aa984aed7e95115d188957979a376d3d0e.en: A one-hour guided tour of the José Cabanis media library's spaces and behind-the-scenes areas, led by a librarian, on Saturday 28 November at 10.30am. Meet in the entrance hall.

915cf1ad38baa481566c23a33f1db08c128ab206.en: A readers' club at the Médiathèque Danièle Damin, with sessions on 5 September, 10 October and 28 November at 11am. People share their latest favourite reads; 1.5 hours.

308d7a9d8af790f4528586b35411f6d940ee6e32.en: A two-hour watercolour workshop at the Musée des Augustins for children aged 6 to 12, themed Prendre racine. Children explore the museum's works and try drawing, painting and modelling. No parent may stay with them.

00d036cf0baf2b9524f8eb19124ea947dfcbaee0.en: A manga reading club for children aged 8 to 13 at the Médiathèque des Izards on Saturday 28 November, 2 to 4pm, where members share what they have been reading.

e019e80f411c4a16b272646d46a6c67b1db48bcd.en: A market of local makers at the Bijou for an afternoon of discovery, where visitors meet original designers and artisans from the area.

8c605951004b036b9510c5f178e70840ecfb456f.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins on the International Day against Violence against Women, with melodies chosen to match the works. Route 2 gives a voice to the women depicted in the collections.

46cfbd403535479e0ef653c257fa9ba112379296.en: A screening of the documentary Station Lacaune, Enfance gelée (44 min) by Nathan Clavère at the Résistance museum.

a153741cd9f98c4593f36f1722c960bf9b1541a0.en: An illustrated exhibition at the Pont des Demoiselles library of three herbaria by Émilie Vast, showing the small flora of European woods, broadleaf trees and wild plants of towns.

978e4d29aa7541bdb2a4bb931913c93ca9a0e5d4.en: A 24-hour short-story writing marathon at the Simone-de-Beauvoir media library in Ramonville, run by the association De Fil(le) en Récit on 28 and 29 November. Writers get a surprise theme and must finish by 5pm on Sunday. Free, with registration.

68332baa28cbe7319238ae6c069be152d5e3f821.en: The ninth short-story writing marathon at the Simone-de-Beauvoir media library in Ramonville, on 28 and 29 November, with a surprise theme and a shared supper on Saturday. Free, for 20 places; registration is required.

51dde94c049b2db2171969d1e7de0a54dfedc473.en: A theatre evening at the Salle des glaces in Pechabou for the charity Enfants du Mékong, which sponsors children's schooling in Southeast Asia. All proceeds go to the charity.

124ab3ecd307acc4a6ff96f51d771d21c34c1cf6.en: A concert by DINAA at Le Rex in Toulouse, presented by Bleu Citron and Face B. The listing gives no further details.

c42d8e2f6bd4fa828103f4f9205cf84e23d7f7a8.en: A screening at Le Cratère of Marie Dumora's documentary La Ligne bleue (2h05). It follows the high Bruche valley in Alsace, where the Struthof camp was built, and the marks left on the people and the mountain.

ee2e31f188a06a7eca9c3471ca3c85c72fbd28b1.en: A Sublime Tour date at Interference with Luther, plus a live set by Rounhaa and a Sublime Club over two days. The Sublime Club is for over-18s only.

0fac7419176c1fc56441c25222d152da2cd981f9.en: An open-mic session at the Bijou, where musicians from Toulouse and beyond sign up on a list 30 minutes before the start and play one or two songs. A piano, guitar and cajon are provided.

264fdabdb3a412f8bd2831eeb63ad24612cd47cc.en: A live set by Kontroll Tek at the Local Mini Brasserie, a solo project mixing punk and rap with a drum machine, sampler and sharp voice. It is live analogue music, not a DJ set.

4b0c1200135e0fac0f03493551d4a18bef3453eb.en: A night at Évasion with DJ You You, mixing pop, rock, hip-hop, disco and funk. It is run as a chosen-mix event by the Devil Inside collective.

fb48fb309c9572616ed31438bd13fc2c2dd5811d.en: A concert at Betty Pop's by Nomad Frequencies, blending digital dub, heavy bass and folk-inspired sounds from the Balkans, Latin America and Asia.

ae0945877302e913592f3337f2b49e94f51a1a36.en: A concert at the Café de Toulouse by Petitcopek, a singer of modern fables from Sète. His album Côté Passager mixes bossa-nova rhythms with sincere love songs in a sunny, positive southern rap.

93e5594fe93f1ba1c6ec6871681c8a1baa120655.en: ElectroNyx's first 100% drum and bass night at Dagobar, with an all-female line-up, heavy basslines and intense sets.

1b807ae4abc0f99e0b23e0d0fe04df716aa59f6f.en: A concert by Big Ass Cat at Bear's House in Toulouse. The band plays alternative funk and garage energy with hard riffs, moving between abrasive and atmospheric passages. They are presenting the single Sir. Psychocat.

c25a097c68f5798bda90eef6268bd557db55ec27.en: A groove concert at Breughel l'Ancien by TBFC, a seven-piece collective that mixes funk, jazz and improvisation into danceable live music.

84ebfe7c575842e98f6a48ae8d316d2ba478ffdc.en: A concert at Café Ginette by Djégo, which mixes blues and machines: hypnotic electronica and psychedelic guitar, with reverb-soaked riffs and percussive rhythms.

d009e7d9f265bfdc7e65a257c852cfc209b04fce.en: A groovy party at the Flashback Café, held as part of the Culture Bar-Bars festival. The listing gives no further details.

c62304db175b42f55c50a45daad7a65ae8aaa229.en: A BooooM night at Astronef with DJs Naosa and Shahzen. Naosa makes hybrid bass music and queer underground sets; Shahzen digs into folk traditions across Occitania and North Africa.

1e727b1437c401384d203459438737ea7620e199.en: A rave night at Interference on Saturday 28 November, 11.59pm to 6am, with Thunder presenting KX CHR, NØNAME, Blurred Movement and Wanton. ID is required and under-18s are not admitted.

cd47b95f97bbb96c7f2a2a1371e94a58d29da401.en: A Latin afternoon and evening on the barge Le Fenix, 3pm to 9pm, with a concert at 6pm by Hanoï Veloz Trio: salsa, bachata, merengue and reggaeton, plus original songs and Cuban tres.

f7c4a1da5f6bd3f32031cd7e3f80f03496732d47.en: A concert at Le Bikini on the 50th Anniversary Tour of German heavy-metal band Accept, with Dynazty and Tailgunner. Accept play their 17th album, Humanoid, on one of only three French dates.

9e133776d274b1afa5dc52a06dddba9ed151256f.en: A concert at Interference by Eluveitie, the Swiss band that mixes modern metal with Celtic traditions, with Pain (industrial metal) and Wolfheart (melodic death metal).

45572c8a1261d8e4bef63345575407a741a95898.en: Sign-language workshops at the Kiwi on Tuesday evenings from February to May 2027, for beginners (18 to 19.30) and for people with basic skills (20 to 21). Ten sessions cost 60 euros for beginners and 50 for practice; register by 18 December 2026.

db564eb017d06462be1836865e13f32b437121de.en: A master class at the CRR Espace Varèse by pianist and composer Paul Lay, a member of Ping Machine who has won several international competitions. Part of the conservatoire's master classes with the Orchestre national du Capitole.

acbe92c133be152b07d536d90f882fba8277474a.en: Free talks at the inclusive venue Café&Co in Toulouse for carers of people with disabilities, with specialists on schooling, housing, emotional life and employment. Dates run from 26 September to 12 December.

5d2fb3122638a6b4af1e7f9a0f0c86a3dc7a8714.en: The last online session of a free three-part training for associations on engaging volunteers. It covers how to build the volunteer journey and the levers that keep people involved. Limited to eight associations.

9054d92b7ba563f7d3433a016bec0af5ae8f069d.en: A dancing reading for toddlers at the Ancely library on Wednesday 2 December at 10.30am by the company A'Corps Imparfaits. Through movement it explores separation, adventure and return. 20 minutes for ages 0 to 3; booking by phone.

be3f02f408987ead329e91cf792cada6e175457e.en: A read-aloud session at the Médiathèque Côte Pavée on Wednesday 2 December at 4pm, by the group Les mômes au fil des mots.

1a5209c09ac421384baa9f18f8d16532eff210d4.en: A 4-event pass for the Setmana Santa 2026 gothic and darkwave festival in Toulouse, with exhibitions, films, concerts and DJ sets at several city venues, including the Rex, the Metronum and the Chorus. Tickets are on Festik and Shotgun.

c373e3421297aa0e449ba157918bf4157570ec26.en: A warm-up show for the Setmana Santa festival at the Rex on 2 December, with Rosa Crux, a goth and deathrock project from Rouen with metal skeleton percussionists, plus Malefixio and Gaouta.

0bee7b89c0133d3556242ae236b6226913a1930f.en: A concert by disiz at the Zénith Toulouse Métropole with a six-piece band. The show mixes emotion, tension and explosive moments across an artist's varied repertoire.

4a9ac4c10a39cd047382bddca77ffb8ff1adb601.en: An exhibition of pop-up books by illustrator Philippe UG at the Serveyrolles media library, from 2 December to 27 February. Pages fold out into birds, mushrooms and clockwork robots.

d7d3e82ae349b9ef2b8c7f2af3d28a2c44cc37d0.en: An exhibition of works by local artists at the Roseraie library from 3 to 23 December, on the theme of celebrating Christmas.

98545254baed28582517533f69948b024c7e6828.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins on the history of the Augustinian order and its convent, founded on prayer, study and community life. The cloister, chapels and decoration show its place in Toulouse heritage.

0ae1c2e0f1156c1778358b58ee55f4089fa06bdf.en: A concert at Le Bikini by Sniper, the French rap group founded in 1997, now touring as a duo of Aketo and Tunisiano. They revive their classics, add new songs and speak in engaged rap.

2192846c19d32ade7dbefe7db06fb43c85a8661d.en: A metal concert at the Rex by Soen, the Swedish prog-metal band, with support from Tribulation, on a French tour for their seventh album Reliance.

7f1c5825ae7afb964ef590f34070e550062c14ad.en: A dark wave concert at DAda as part of the Setmana Santa festival, by Hinfort, a solo project from Cologne mixing post-punk and darkwave with cold basslines and melancholic vocals.

67834657630287e2ec21585927b88de83d75708e.en: Two silent-film screenings with live music by pupils of the CRI Axe Sud conservatoire at Le Moulin tiers-lieu, part of the Synchro festival of the Cinémathèque de Toulouse. Five short films, including Méliès's Voyage dans la lune, get new scores.

856cdf7447d9fc760aa9d658dbe448fc0934d1f9.en: A master class at the CRR Salle Stravinski by flautist Mathilde Calderini, solo flute of the Radio France Philharmonic since 2020, known for a velvety sound.

3b96bf235cb338b0e9861c4ef170961f7151e49a.en: An immersive night in the Carmelite chapel on 4 December, 6.30pm to midnight, with techno, performers, actors and themed animations. Food trucks and a make-up stand are on site, and dressing up is advised.

3b44586b9406cd2f43fa9a52d2eb4dba7a66ae62.en: A Messe Basse immersive event by Mind Family in the Carmelite chapel, mixing electronic music with performers and actors, so the audience lives the experience rather than just watching a concert.

121dedbbbafac5272e77272a2bf5a717f6bd46ed.en: A theatre and magic show for children aged 1 to 6 at the Pechabou library, about Lili, who sneaks into the living room on Christmas night to see her presents. 30 minutes.

36ad5ccc573cb4f9c453a7b63d25dd0779b02be9.en: A concert at Le Rex by Jwles, a rapper from Saint-Denis and co-founder of LTR Worldwide, whose multilingual flow mixes influences from New York and Grasse. Doors open at 7.30pm on Friday 4 December; 20 euros in advance.

ffa9ec8f186a3eb8bb0dcea0caba48d3fd397631.en: A dancefloor concert at Interference by Mentissa, the singer known for Et Bam, returning with the upbeat single Désolée, a pop track with a French-house bass.

2e2e981508eaf62e2859a6637b1c8a305d556abc.en: A convivial traditional session at the COMDT. Players bring any instrument, learn by ear and improvise on the Occitan repertoire.

ef13beadd32e1c7e577e59a9b2499ebf0bd6981f.en: An ElectroNyx hard techno night at Little O'Clock with an all-female line-up: Voluptia from 9pm, La Vachette from 10.30pm and Rorenu from midnight.

7b87f9bc1a8ba3649d54bbf6c726b88a2733e30c.en: A concert at Les Marins d'Eau Douce in Ramonville on Friday 4 December at 9pm by Résonance 432, a six-piece band reworking pop and rock hits from Eurythmics to Portishead. Tickets are 5 euros.

3ce20eca3904f304791c868f7a49c1ca261df9b0.en: A live techno concert at Interference by PACT, a new project of Joachim Pastor, Joris Delacroix and Teho. The audience becomes a fourth member, playing live with the sound through machines built for the show.

3f166d1ff5b233f874d25d8386e68d5792747128.en: A multi-site photo exhibition at the Saint-Cyprien cultural centre showing the work of Lech Wilczek and Simona Kossak, who lived for over 30 years in the Białowieża primeval forest. Opening on Friday 4 December at 6.30pm.

2d27f1bebe6ace408721b712e1526e479c432b56.en: A free beginner training for associations on making communication materials with Canva. It covers setting the goal of a support, choosing formats and learning the tool's essential features.

251195ee83ec4114312d85f7c24302ba7042c7ff.en: A cooperative, playful workshop, the Fresque des nouveaux récits, at the José Cabanis media library on Saturday 5 December at 10.15am. Participants imagine a desirable future for everyone. Three hours, for ages 15 and up; booking required.

a3262f3a1d9287de5e61d543bf3f97b8577faf23.en: A poetic show of music, theatre and objects about winter and snow at the Pradettes library on Saturday 5 December at 10.30am, for children from birth to age 4. 30 minutes; booking is needed.

ebfbe097e0f3fd572c57192076b4d0fa1e43f794.en: A running route called Archifooting through the Grand Parc Canal, retracing the history of Pierre-Paul Riquet, builder of the Canal du Midi. Run with the tourist office.

4233ce4eeb07b48f7e6084bd1b71fbc7ad0cc019.en: A first guided visit of the exhibition L'art malgré tout at the Resistance museum, presenting the work of photographer Léa Pignard and how it echoes the museum. An afternoon Polaroid workshop can follow.

099bc6476154ced42153c7484d4e881520e8fc99.en: A Saturday afternoon at the José Cabanis media library, 2 to 6pm, to discover Wikipedia and OpenStreetMap with Toulouse volunteers. Toulibre members also help with Linux and free software. From age 12.

9ae09dc70e33fab0e1fa26162e0090991ed4d9ac.en: A round-table launch of the book Białowieża, la forêt de Simona Kossak & Lech Wilczek at the Saint-Cyprien cultural centre, with Le Château d'Eau, as part of the Toulouse photo publishing fair.

82424de0f62aa5634f60354e72ac468530152806.en: A Polaroid workshop at the Resistance museum with photographer Léa Pignard, whose work on the Spanish Civil War is on show. Participants learn emulsion transfer, which moves, distorts and reinvents the image. From age 14; 3 hours.

d44b8883ac7bc5b0bbb45a82574ddcf5ae0f4eea.en: The Harpissima weekend for harpists at the Toulouse Conservatoire, 5 and 6 December, ending with a concert on Sunday 6 December at 5pm at the Auditorium Saint-Pierre-des-Cuisines. Recitals by Mélanie Laurent and Mathilde Calderini.

29cc45b671f85268b5a13ab655f55f58903848ba.en: A concert at Le Rex by Changeline, a self-taught artist who mixes intimate pop-rap storytelling with avant-garde electronic production. Saturday 5 December, doors 7.30pm; 20 euros in advance.

314966c448bc064906c91c8919d237791ac53a1e.en: A concert at Le Bikini by Ben PLG, with a support act, presented by Bleu Citron and Caramba Culture Live.

c256b5509043ffeafa4448762ec1127e347dd691.en: A synth-pop and cold-wave concert at Le Metronum with Martin Dupont, a Marseille group formed in 1982, and Estetica Noir from Italy, as part of the Setmana Santa warm-up.

3d8398f6cd7ebec6abb1da92502f7bb9a7c8a5b5.en: The Białowieża photo exhibition at the Jardin Royal in Toulouse, from 5 December 2026 to 27 February 2027. It shows the photographs of Lech Wilczek and Simona Kossak, many seen in France for the first time.

158610b78eb8e7841fc15fbcbe523ce4052a0f44.en: The Białowieża photo exhibition at the Cartailhac library of the Toulouse Natural History Museum, from 5 December 2026 to 27 February 2027. It shows the couple's photographs from 30 years in the primeval forest.

5e215e215a778f10ac5f3490a4983cfd64edc560.en: A night of dark disco, EBM and darkwave at Nova Club in Toulouse on 6 December, 12.30am to 5am, with Years of Denial, HIV+ and Dave Calm, part of the Setmana Santa festival.

d155d62fe3695ddd283be78b8b8ca14590d647dc.en: A one-hour family visit of the Musée des Augustins led by a museum guide on the first Sunday of each month, for young and old.

b84d629d44186315425291a78787ca7a5a787fb0.en: A Christmas lunch for people aged 70 and over, offered by the town hall on Saturday 5 December at noon at the Salle de la Musardière. A partner of any age is welcome.

74649fc277813855c9a93c64cd1abacb651c3beb.en: A master class at the CRR Salle Stravinski by violinist Carole Petitdemange, a former member of the Quatuor Ardeo who teaches in Madrid and has played with Renaud Capuçon and Bertrand Chamayou.

80db87db9146788d27b1b18462d0a72767c2b395.en: A talk and debate at the Salle de l'Oustal in Escalquens on how the ocean regulates the climate. CNRS research engineer Marc Souhaut draws on IPCC data on CO2 and marine chemistry.

d51bebe6c3492c18de286e02d97d5b5eb7c3320e.en: A master class at the CRR Espace Varèse by pianist Marie-Josèphe Jude, a winner of the Clara Haskil competition and a Victoire de la musique, in partnership with the ISDAT.

392e1dfe88770647c6d60b0f05ac164b77d96f05.en: The TERRO 2026 day at the Kiwi for organisations working on ecological and social transition in Occitania. It offers a round table, project presentations and collaborative workshops.

689ca1de365f9d7b1df73d5cb113566b340d7b15.en: The prize-giving of the Académie des Livres de Toulouse on Tuesday 8 December, 2 to 6pm, at the José Cabanis media library. Local authors are honoured in about ten categories, and the Plume d'Or goes to the best book.

b07e37ab47299b698529f1a6f63bd9df69a21c5c.en: A talk at the Bibliothèque d'Étude et du Patrimoine on Tuesday 8 December at 6pm about Gaston Roquemaurel, a little-known explorer from Toulouse, a naval officer and ethnologist who travelled from the Antarctic to the South China Sea.

bbd2d1f708a05690c20a0c4fc12c1e618c3afa5c.en: Story sessions for children aged 0 to 3 at the Izards library on Wednesday 9 December at 10.15am and 10.45am. Booking is by phone.

e48d214e45a853c6c0ea9ccf05e939e6acd7cf30.en: A parent-and-baby session on the five senses at the Duranti library on Wednesday 9 December at 10.30am, built around books. For ages 0 to 3; 30 minutes.

52359848b9aa70fe8bf0de63767243d0d2ca26f7.en: A two-hour workshop at the Pradettes library in which children invent short stories. Booking is at the desk or by phone.

6ae1d4911e866be6b6e67b29e12655dee95fd0cf.en: A writing workshop at the Duranti library on Wednesday 9 December at 3.30pm, led by Toulouse author Ghislaine Roman, on a funny idea: what if Father Christmas wanted to change jobs? For ages 8 and up; 2 hours.

e95598bd293299d24fcdfe4e62f025b2f5145485.en: A two-voice reading for children from age 3 at the Muséum de Toulouse's Pourquoi Pas? children's library on Wednesday 9 December at 4.30pm, with picture books about the forest and the animals that live in it.

9a6183ccd4345619a0f36b6d12a2310994964a89.en: Shared forest readings for children from age 3, linked to the Białowieża exhibition: at the Muséum's children's library on 9 December at 4.30pm, and at the Saint-Cyprien library on 16 December at 11am.

1f6fe4c9d96d80141072324d1fd8795c3c482847.en: A round table at the José Cabanis media library on Wednesday 9 December at 6pm on rising poverty in Toulouse, with the deputy mayor Maroua Bouzaida, the student food-aid association Linkee, Main Tendue 31 and the Restos du Cœur.

57c1937dc78d2f7f16b1c14bae77d92fda45357b.en: A master class at the Conservatoire by trombonist Michel Becquet, former principal trombone of the Orchestre de la Suisse Romande and professor at the Lyon conservatoire, who plays with the World Trombone Quartet.

a348aca54c74a85b888b9e27943b9d1a06a7dd6b.en: A singing session at the Bibliothèque d'Étude et du Patrimoine on Thursday 10 December at 1pm, where Pascal Caumont teaches two Christmas songs in Occitan from the library's old music collection. No experience needed; 1 hour.

0e3213a43fc0a0cc6fbf7529d326af9ec64fadd9.en: A free training course for associations on internal and external communication. It covers building a communication strategy, the channels available and practical tools to run it day to day. Run by Profession Sport Animation 31.

71adbf16fdedd647f3ea1f30501f7dbad2df9712.en: An association offering computer workshops for job seekers at the Izards library, covering Word, Excel and job-search topics. The workshops are open to everyone, not only members. Booking is by phone.

c1a55b25ce85c8d1cf3582ecf3d549e1db3d572c.en: A guided visit of the Białowieża exhibition for blind and partially sighted visitors, with a volunteer who describes what cannot be seen. The service is run by Souffleurs d'Images, part of Groupe SOS Solidarités.

25c6a07083e8479f35a4d2ce6c1617ce790df7f5.en: A screening of eleven first-film animated shorts at the José Cabanis media library on Thursday 10 December at 6.30pm, from colourful and funny to dark and political. A showcase of new talent in animation.

0c10e0555dfbdf042ae8ac9780aa9842854469a5.en: A concert at the Espace Varèse of works by students in instrumental and electroacoustic composition classes, led by Guy-Olivier Ferla and Guillaume Hermen.

9021e0da5c2a8f7229ebf02b99596f7ae2d3aae6.en: A concert by 55asky at Le Rex on Thursday 10 December 2026. The French artist mixes hyperpop, digicore, rap and alternative electronic music with a digitised voice, and presents his first album RÖSËLITÄ.

e70b86b1f5c96aa4ccb889a4ebe5da6c7357b7fe.en: A Magic Boys show at Le Zapata on 10 December, with dance and choreographed striptease, reserved for women until 11pm. Entry with a glass of sparkling wine costs 12 euros; the show runs 8pm to 4am.

4a8fe22e16b3cda562721ee4b5bb0131749b5111.en: A gala concert at the Auditorium Saint-Pierre-des-Cuisines for the Caisse des Écoles of Toulouse, with Haydn's Sinfonia concertante and Dvořák's Symphony No. 8, conducted by Christophe Millet. Reserved places are collected on the evening of the gala.

f56c8a8b863321207b894e68985a991a91a48ea2.en: A master class at the CRR Espace Varèse by cellist Éric-Maria Couturier, who teaches at the Paris and Lyon conservatoires and has played with the Ensemble intercontemporain.

bcb19224c81a845521e10d2a6628a05ecc812ed4.en: A school performance of Traversée by Rift Compagnie at the Théâtre Jules Julien on Friday 11 December at 10am and 2.30pm, for ages 6 and up. A grandmother helps her shy granddaughter overcome her fear of the outside world, with puppetry and music.

e5512f73b4b0c36373aeb12261ca5781967d8138.en: A master class by cellist Matthieu Lejeune, a soloist and chamber musician who teaches at the Lausanne HEMU and at the Saint-Maur-des-Fossés conservatoire.

fd894d52ed080920c45c52799977b6f26fb30b32.en: A show called Petite Source at the Bibliothèque Pinel on Friday 11 December at 5.30pm, for ages 2 and up. A young First Nations girl in the Australian bush follows her people's wisdom on a journey of theatre, objects and sound.

c28ee304b80873780e51e6b3cf603b205a1fa9fd.en: A musical talk at the Médiathèque Fabre on Friday 11 December at 6pm on the music of the early 20th-century American South, where immigrant traditions mixed with African American music and led towards rock 'n' roll.

44dca75c1ca691a7b7a1b9f096baf6d17a855a44.en: A Christmas storytelling evening at the Danièle Damin library on Friday 11 December at 6pm, with the librarians as Christmas elves. For ages 4 and up; 1 hour.

85e392d4e8211552c39338bfea66a9f0a1b264e2.en: A reading of Prokofiev's Peter and the Wolf with oboist Salomé Ansel at the Côte Pavée library on Friday 11 December at 6.30pm. Booking is by phone.

8c6fe0f14b7d35dea4c2f6c98643743fca58e720.en: A concert at Le Rex on 11 December by Esthesis, a Toulouse post-progressive band, presenting its third album OUT OF STEP. Solventis, a dark folk and electro duo from Toulouse, open the evening.

58d6a7071b3df4812c21c0ac896f74d62b75fdce.en: A solo classical-guitar concert at the Carmelite chapel by Irakli Khutsichvili, blending jazz, world music and classical music in an intimate, contemplative setting.

7351fb33a1f6c8e41c025e345f6d9aebf11a7892.en: A play at the Kiwi by La Féroce about two climbers above 3,000 metres, whose friendship is tested by the drop and the euphoria of the heights. A story of vertigo, laughter and solitude.

462776e2e8c597bfeb960a3c4de9fb46bea6371d.en: A club night at the Metronum with Applause Show, featuring the artists Artem, Mabradaa and Lorkestra, whose sets talk to one another, ending with a three-artist B2B on stage. It brings the Onda Mix energy of Rio Loco.

b34f5aab7c592c49f1c34ed2f113ba31a44696d0.en: A concert at Les Marins d'Eau Douce in Ramonville on Friday 11 December at 9pm by Elastic Band, a horn and rhythm band paying tribute to double bass players. Tickets are 10 euros with a drink.

c1b26a6f9112a5f030bd2c45d7c8cdfedd5f100a.en: A workshop at the Muséum de Toulouse in which participants use heritage archives to write a personal story, shaped as a small collective photographic object. 8 hours.

ae271415a7a6e1bd73e6d4578377f97234e7cc60.en: A master class at the CRR Salle Stravinski by guitarist Jérémy Peret, a versatile player who moves between classical, jazz and popular music and has won international prizes in Nagoya and Tokyo.

2979350ea5f3b76c7b373e4bdb4260201417a0a8.en: A family creative workshop at the Musée des Augustins for children from age 3 and an adult, making a winter-landscape collage, Brisez la glace Booking is needed for at least one adult and one child; 1.5 hours.

87ccb03dd8d6e03e57b26d5a21ee6bd573f89beb.en: A cine-dance session at the José Cabanis media library on Saturday 12 December at 10.30am. Short animated films are followed by an inclusive dance workshop for people with or without disabilities. From age 7; booking needed.

2e9866b324a0f202be626c570c5863ee2387bdbe.en: A botanical drawing workshop with author-illustrator Fanny Pageaud at the Saint-Cyprien library on Saturday 12 December at 10.30am, linked to the Białowieża exhibition. Participants can bring what they collected on walks.

76cbb95da68dad6344d425597bfbb558b3c279c8.en: A reading for children aged 0 to 3 at the Minimes library on Saturday 12 December at 11am, by Toulouse artists, as part of the year-end market with the Centre culturel des Minimes. 1 hour.

df0337fa241b63f55a80af43d134405d4e1977be.en: A children's art workshop at the Musée des Augustins for ages 6 to 12, themed Brisez la glace Children explore the works and try drawing, painting and modelling. No parent may stay with them.

f3dd6d9e55fb97c9fa042875e86538ee6bcc19a7.en: A card-making workshop with Fanny Pageaud at the José Cabanis media library on Saturday 12 December at 3pm, inspired by her book Voir et savoir. Participants make flap cards that hide a petal, a leaf or a secret message.

5c3dfc0ff80c29cc44a0ff1ac479e821b2a91f98.en: The show Fables by Cie Bajo El Mar at the Rangueil library on Saturday 12 December at 3.30pm. It rereads La Fontaine's fables through dance and rap. 45 minutes, from age 7; booking by phone.

7f0f71fc0f1a1f8024de67295c8ebb60a2ff9b1d.en: A reading for children aged 4 and up at the Minimes library on Saturday 12 December at 4pm, by Toulouse artists as part of the year-end market. 1 hour; booking by phone.

1cad061c4765689526260c3d71901b8576033aa5.en: The storytelling show Petite Source at the Danièle Damin library on Saturday 12 December at 4pm, about a young First Nations girl in the Australian bush. 30 minutes, for ages 2 and up.

830017cd24b88d33bf58949bce2fd368ffb1d036.en: A meeting with author-illustrator Fanny Pageaud at the José Cabanis media library on Saturday 12 December at 5pm, about her book Voir et savoir, which explains botany with flaps to lift. It won the Millepages youth prize; from age 8.

887dd18abf4cf25394d3f68f80d88d599807a169.en: A concert at Le Rex by Théo Juice, an independent French rapper and producer whose music he calls Sexy Music. Doors open at 7.30pm on Saturday 12 December; tickets are 25 euros in advance.

4f74578c92aa26828ce55638cf606d5acd2f1abb.en: A metal concert at the Metronum on Saturday 12 December by Psykup, a cult Toulouse alternative band marking 30 years, presenting their sixth album The Joke of Tomorrow. Manimal, from Toulouse, open the evening.

604b26396f601c14859f3de7ade311a797a1ccc9.en: A live set by Henrik Schwarz at La Cabane in Les Halles de la Cartoucherie, Toulouse, on Saturday 12 December, 9.30pm to 4am, with Leiris, Gasky and Giles & Diego. Known for live music blending house, techno and organic sounds. Adults only.

416700a97f111cae4c61e318274ea448dcd34690.en: A rave night at Interference on Saturday 12 December, 11.59pm to 6am, presented by Thunder with Onlynumbers, William Luck, Mosmoz, Daisy and Predacid, plus an audio-visual and laser show. Under-18s are not admitted; ID is required.

965029134f37881141c57eeb430802039baba51f.en: A guided visit of the Minimes district in Toulouse as part of a Sunday neighbourhood series run by the Noviciat with the tourist office and the association En Quête de Patrimoine.

918f128fc0b1d9457ddff07d27a92653545b637d.en: A drawn concert-story, Nuit Noire, on Sunday 13 December at 4pm at the José Cabanis media library. It is inspired by Bernard Moitessier's solo sailing voyage and an ecological text, with live drawing and music. 1h15; from age 11.

68d45a29da6738abed0bb0090ba2eb982efbbcb2.en: A Christmas choral concert at the Auditorium Saint-Pierre-des-Cuisines by the conservatoire's children's choirs, conducted by Delphine Armand, Frédéric Terrien and Mark Opstad. Reservations open 3 December at noon.

0d82371b45067d49faa19630951bf4c96a71f551.en: A Christmas concert at the Carmelite chapel by the children's choir La Lauzeta, with traditional and contemporary carols. The choristers stage and sing the pieces themselves.

2d37dd70ac5e0d0fd8732aaf8b26172e637f5a93.en: A concert at the Alban Minville cultural centre by pupils of the Play Music programme of the Toulouse conservatoire, which brings music education to schools and communities. Reservations open 4 December at noon.

0ffc84af327fb580e9237a9e04425d54b23333ce.en: A talk at the Espace Roguet by choreographer and author Laurence Pagès on dance for young people. It covers how to keep young people wanting to dance, how to address young audiences, and how to share dance history with teenagers.

5f2385ce95a5397fd104709108181a1d2690c0e2.en: An arts-education discovery route at the Saint-Cyprien cultural centre, linked to the Białowieża exhibition. It is followed by a lab session with analogue and digital photography techniques, tied to the themes of the images.

10b6b2d6eb25f4c103bf12cd4a2ff8dffae22c36.en: A talk at the José Cabanis media library on Tuesday 15 December at 6pm with Miadana Randriamorasata, a Toulouse mural painter who began with graffiti and urban culture and has made art her profession for 11 years.

7d85d0c98b20dd24e85a9038d5e28e2a833b8a43.en: A Play Music concert at the conservatoire's La Vache site by pupils of Variation #3, where volunteer pupils learn an orchestral instrument (winds, strings or percussion) through group training. Reservations open 4 December at noon.

426b23bdcac94f6c9d83c6246bc321429beb16ce.en: A master class at the CRR Espace Varèse by clarinettist Renaud Escriva, who performs classical and contemporary works and was trained in Toulouse, Saint-Germain-en-Laye, Bordeaux and Nice.

c796ba91ddcfd0a380115b9b2b1b50daab2e242e.en: A musical awakening session for children aged 0 to 5 at the Empalot library on Wednesday 16 December at 10.30am, with listening, rhythm and dance led by Soledad Cuesta. One hour; booking by phone.

c9793f65689b00943e936efb08a8184050c8a511.en: A 45-minute storytelling show for families from age 5 at the Maison Pour Tous. A storyteller finds tales in a handkerchief, including Little Pio, who is always hungry, and Hansel and Gretel lost in the forest. A storytelling circle follows.

1245d0bfa20941a260969a9d297d1d3f7db91b8a.en: A two-hour paper crown workshop at the José Cabanis media library on Wednesday 16 December, 3 to 5pm, in the drawing studio on the arts floor. From age 12.

5bdfcc354eb441977459ea952893b54ceb832935.en: A Christmas treasure hunt at the Duranti library on Wednesday 16 December at 3.30pm, with mischievous elves hidden among the books and clues tucked between them. For ages 6 and up; 2 hours, booking by phone.

92e7f9dde5de403af275f1f5267887884b7efeb7.en: Storytelling under the Christmas tree at the Fabre library on Wednesday 16 December at 4pm. A cosy hour of stories, then sweet treats. From age 5; booking by phone or email.

31915c6617f2e09be9583735c376acccea100bce.en: A pre-Christmas taste for children aged 4 to 10 at the Pradettes library on Wednesday 16 December at 5pm.

5f2749dc59b440b24e79be50679bcfa0315879aa.en: A workshop at the Empalot library on Thursday 17 December, 2.30 to 5pm, on how to choose a computer or tablet for your needs. It explains the basics of RAM and processors. Booking is at the desk or by phone.

acdb1e6a6be2f0e413a645b1f8d44afea56fc61c.en: A one-year anniversary evening at the Musée des Augustins to mark its reopening, with a music break, talks about works and a sketching session on statues from 6pm. Entry is paid; the activities are free.

540aea16f64f6f3dab44313e8138816478ee841d.en: The monthly girls' giant karaoke night at Zapata in Toulouse on Thursday 17 December, 8pm to midnight, with games, blind tests and an XXL screen. It is for women who want a relaxed evening, and singing out of tune is welcome.

062adce6565d7bd601a30bc039da88e99a673a1c.en: A string-quartet concert at the Bibliothèque d'Étude et du Patrimoine on Friday 18 December at 1pm. The quartet Les Impromptueuses reimagines pop hits, from a Beatles nod to Lady Gaga and Billie Eilish, for strings.

c4116719847943a56ed7e2ad15d20628b476c96b.en: The fifth Farandole des Lucioles at the Serveyrolles garden and library on Friday 18 December at 4.30pm, under a theme of love. It includes a walk with cheerful signs, a show, a choir and a party in the library. Free, with no booking.

b30747029b68d1301fdc34bdb48e725276c9df8b.en: A concert at Le Bikini by La Rvfleuze, a rapper from Paris's 19th arrondissement known for the Serrure freestyle series, whose tracks have been streamed by millions.

d8d1387612df0dc3d5b9d1a92a2911728b5f359a.en: The Christmas concert of the Toulouse Maîtrise at the Basilique Saint-Sernin, conducted by Mark Opstad. Reservations open 8 December at noon.

6f3bbb724253ee3d913b34cee6fdde813ddf01eb.en: An immersive concert at Le Kiwi by Turbo Niglo, a duo of guitarists who mix guitars, percussion and electronic machines with their own visuals and stage effects.

12efad540c9de09302009f7d5d672c84b101c5b1.en: A blues-rock concert at Les Marins d'Eau Douce in Ramonville on Friday 18 December at 8.30pm by the Toulouse band Rooster Kicks, formed in 2022 with influences from Red Hot Chili Peppers and Muse. Entry is free; booking is recommended for food.

9f494a74a46b80a611a8134d2a93e81387cb9cca.en: A reading exchange at the Médiathèque Grand M on Saturday 19 December at 10.30am, where readers share books and discoveries and leave with ideas for their next reads. Two hours, from age 16.

2a5414a8e98b732a9b0afa38e036e8846417dada.en: A leporello notebook workshop at the Rangueil library on Saturday 19 December at 10.30am, for ages 8 and up. 1.5 hours; booking by phone.

5f45d3c78cb36886f1d9197b161be57ef4d7fb44.en: A storytelling show by the Cie des épices at the Pavillon blanc Henri-Molina, linked to the photo exhibition. It takes the audience on an imaginary walk, from the wonders of the world to the search for colour. From age 5.

44f46d767775441d6c71df94fe357e058892feff.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins, route 3 of La visite parfumée, through the medieval rooms, the cloister galleries and the museum garden. Scents such as musk, cinnamon and chocolate accompany the works.

0664e437d8e5abe14536020ad360f6a713a0bcfc.en: A puppet show by Cie Les Voyageurs Immobiles at the Moulin tiers-lieu. A small chimera hatches in a world sewn from soft fabrics and learns to dance, fly and swim from playful animals. A syrup aperitif is offered.

8658572456e7b79fbf85b6b82987e1a4fa33e467.en: A concert at Le Rex by Seth Gueko, a French independent rapper known for his Barlou street persona, provocation and a mix of slang, verlan and pop-culture references. He has released more than 13 projects, including Michto and Bad Cowboy.

095847bbb913be9125947e28e7c886ad6285720c.en: A house night at La Cabane on Saturday 19 December, 9.30pm to 4am, with the German duo Andhim, known for their super-house sound, plus Giles & Diego and Gasky. Adults only, with ID checked at the door.

ad15b515b2d92a442170aa0a19a3967c1b343fa2.en: A magic and clown show for families at La Péniche Didascalie. Virginie pulls a suitcase full of tricks: light on her fingers, bubbles, giant cards and a little dog doing tricks. For ages 3 to 99; about 45 to 50 minutes.

ad058985ed76af51040b5a4539124a333c2f0163.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins, route 3 of La visite en musique, through the medieval rooms, the cloister galleries and the museum garden. Melodies are chosen to match the works.

3640c6a8911722ee46779ba6e88f5f2e1499eb7b.en: A storytelling session in French Sign Language at the Musée des Augustins. A deaf actor tells the story of Lili the gargoyle with a Kamishibaï, a Japanese paper theatre, as a way into the museum.

c3f8641c1671f7eef5b2a95096fe957029b86026.en: A children's art workshop at the Musée des Augustins for ages 6 to 12, themed winter landscape with stencils. Children explore works and try drawing, painting and modelling. No parent may stay with them.

57952df13a31853a0dd4d6455ac52047d776331d.en: A creative surprise Christmas workshop at the Danièle Damin library on Wednesday 23 December at 3pm, for ages 7 and up. One hour; booking by phone or email.

77f82603322f52d54e56a01b01b0e4d4264416b2.en: A Christmas decorations workshop at the Rangueil library on Wednesday 23 December at 3pm, for ages 5 and up. One hour; booking by phone.

8465778acdc05e35256fde4c003fe623eb5b0b91.en: A Christmas-special Magic Boys show at Le Zapata on 23 December, with dance and choreographed striptease, reserved for women until 11pm. Entry with a glass of sparkling wine costs 12 euros; 8pm to 4am.

1570af2e824f528434039069ed990a1d40a2f2c2.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins on the mother and child, a universal theme in art that moved from divine models to everyday scenes at the end of the 19th century. The museum closes at 4pm that day.

b413cf7784ae4c47971ed2baca2a9bebff9aea46.en: A screening of the animated film Persepolis (97 min) by Marjane Satrapi and Vincent Paronnaud at the Résistance museum. A young woman recalls the turbulent history of Iran through war, repression and dictatorship. For ages 11 and up.

4c74e10a75bd1b7a52992d88e98f0343ac469218.en: A master class at the CRR Espace Varèse by tuba player Guillaume Dionnet, solo tuba of the Orchestre National de Lyon and professor at the Lyon conservatoire, a leading figure of the tuba in France.

ae49c317e8af1311b886a625a1865a10f4f00c0a.en: A two-hour life-drawing workshop in the rooms of the Musée des Augustins, led by the atelier L'Imagerie, to sharpen the eye for form and body. Free for students.

1a3cc9b05cc98db57caf85caf42454cbb739ff08.en: A blues-rock and psychedelic concert at Les Marins d'Eau Douce in Ramonville on Friday 8 January 2027 at 9pm by the Toulouse trio Black Burst, with riffs moving from classic blues to modern stoner. Entry is 5 euros.

6b10f3466bfe20ab739587d00856facdfdf76304.en: A guided botanical walk from the Saint-Cyprien cultural centre to the Muséum de Toulouse, with museum botanist Boris Presseq on the trees of city streets, linked to the Białowieża exhibition. Bring a camera.

c8da60d60bf7d77eff81367ff64df87918483b30.en: A children's art workshop at the Musée des Augustins for ages 6 to 12, themed In bloom (engraving). Children explore works and try drawing, painting and modelling. No parent may stay with them.

069546c8fe7338bd4d432aa9125186d07d9f0cba.en: A book presentation of Camera Luminaria, the photo collection of the Château d'Eau, with texts by Nathalie Boulouch. Published for the bicentenary of photography.

029704fc67c64675b8482269628181828814af8d.en: An informal talk with Laure Dalon, director of the Musée des Augustins, about the life of the collections, including works, restoration and acquisitions. Sometimes with a guest; 1.5 hours.

b1ade1a3911337109a272759f84124ec1f2c9653.en: A storytelling visit for children aged 3 to 5 at the Musée des Augustins with Douyou Démone, who invents funny stories from artworks, on the theme A little case of water. An adult must come along; 45 minutes.

f1a7c1ccb2e8c40166d41ba8fbfdedf960ca49be.en: A master class at the CRR Salle Stravinski by Marie Hirigoyen Bidart, a specialist in Basque monodic singing who has done fieldwork since 1947 and teaches traditional music at the Maurice Ravel conservatoire in the Basque Country.

13beca80f3aad33f31a20fd5b670979cf5848a16.en: A free training course for associations on creating newsletters that people want to read. It covers choosing tools, improving open and click rates and making emails more relevant. Run by the City's associative life department.

631ef7a2266f80a0a70fb715d31f0acc12294c23.en: A talk on Thursday 28 January at Le Moulin tiers-lieu by Saïd Benjelloun, emeritus professor of Arabic literature, on fraternity in Arab-Muslim culture. It opens a cultural cycle on fraternity, sisterhood and adelphity.

bfadce89a5709b2d17f277d1f75f04f59b5e44ca.en: A master class at the CRR Espace Varèse by viola soloist Antoine Tamestit, covering viola repertoire from the Baroque to today, from Bach and Telemann to Berlioz and Bartók.

c4a42c96bb185da80b2d34b9e30608491ac7a661.en: A one-hour stand-up show by comedian Lalou at Interference, on tour in 2026 after sold-out dates in France, Switzerland and Belgium. Known from her candid online videos, she shares personal stories with sharp humour.

d07def4bc46f8c2ab6036c9a43e42477f9f8da84.en: A concert at Le Rex by independent rapper Juste Shani, whose music mixes strong messages with catchy tracks. She has played the Olympia as support to IAM and festivals such as Solidays and Lollapalooza.

40608fe700b431fffa2ab5be5fbb4c35ef90d783.en: A circus-theatre show by Cie A Chose est Fine at Le Moulin tiers-lieu. A juggling duo's everyday life is disrupted by vampires, a diva and a magician, with melancholy and sharp humour about circus hierarchy.

3a637d282b4237d154e794ec4219446d15e8c71a.en: A concert at Les Marins d'Eau Douce in Ramonville on Friday 15 January 2027 at 9pm by the trio Roxanne on the Moon, who sing Police and Sting songs for a 2.5-hour live set. Entry is 10 euros with a drink.

b66db64381bee201d170cb08f271327f0cf32757.en: An all-night party at Le Bikini with Dimension Bonus (formerly Salut c'est cool) and Roland Cristal, organised by Les Productions du Possible. The listing gives no further details.

d67b56d0dae525e4b45b352141ac4ea6bac55912.en: A family clay-modelling workshop at the Musée des Augustins for children from age 3 with an adult, themed Little tree. 1.5 hours; booking is required for at least one adult and one child.

2358b6693cef15b889995c17a24f3b901770dabb.en: A children's clay workshop at the Musée des Augustins for ages 6 to 12, themed Little tree. Children explore works and try drawing, painting and modelling. No parent may stay with them.

83d7271eeadbf316b0fb198306885bfc963fff84.en: Two dance performances at the Auditorium Saint-Pierre-des-Cuisines on Saturday 16 January 2027, at 3pm and 7pm. Reservations open 7 January at noon.

29e05c601b332ad48d897c071227f15238b31909.en: A concert at Le Bikini by Zaoui, the solo project of Raphaël Faget-Zaoui, formerly of Thérapie Taxi. His direct, playful pop draws on the album Pulsations and on singles such as Toxic et Chic and Xanax mon amour.

134f351f3b5ae4bb8037318d38b416c4326428d8.en: A musical play at the Salle Jacques Brel about how Germaine Tillion, an ethnologist and resistance member, used song and music-hall style to keep her dignity in the Ravensbrück camp in 1944. The women resist their conditions with joy.

f86fd11af44bbf1fc5f3a39f61b9da93278db91b.en: A bilingual French and Polish tour of the Białowieża exhibition at the Saint-Cyprien cultural centre, run by the association Apolina. It offers another way of looking at and discussing the images.

220cd9bced2d98ccb20833375488bc15f5d1c972.en: A free training course for associations on sponsorship and private funding, covering patronage and partnerships, their advantages and limits, and how to set them up within the law. Run by Profession Sport Animation 31.

2038f54ba017650db1ec511ce94f8bfa629deb0d.en: An afterwork evening at the Musée des Augustins for the Night of Reading, themed childhood, with visits, workshops, shows, concerts and readings, many of them free. Entry is paid; activities are free and free for students.

9e410c68421f96aa97f8bd38777897f05c3fa0de.en: An exhibition at the Salle Dauriac of photographer Isabelle Bousquet, whose series Ligne de vie captures fleeting moments. A meeting with the artist is on Thursday 21 January at 6.30pm.

9776085ce1ef79df7faced8d6f4086217196b00f.en: A dance performance by Marianne Masson at the Moulin tiers-lieu, improvised from music and themes suggested by the audience, with no fourth wall, performed among the spectators. Part of the Night of Reading; light food from 6pm.

2ce5d5b37d00e79117adac8ad1e38ee6b97efa02.en: A solo show at Le Kiwi by Chacha of the company Muerto Coco, who turns 40 and asks what being an adult means. She confronts her childhood memories of playing at being grown up with other people's views.

21ab09dbc28bf7fcd969c1931b157a5fad313357.en: A guided tour of the Musée des Augustins on how literature inspires art, from the Bible and Shakespeare to Flaubert and Musset. Readings light up the works along the way.

43a0f0ec5c4c8325c81c732f7ec99c8a6bfc4a2d.en: A seated yoga break at the Musée des Augustins for visitors with visual or motor disabilities, led by Géraldine Avisse. It lasts 1h15.

42478c0884cd25fa7c9679048a2ba9631fbb1c5d.en: A punk blues-rock concert at Les Marins d'Eau Douce in Ramonville by Ball'n Tittys, a garage band with a taste for offbeat covers and a Tarantino touch. Friday 22 January at 9pm; entry is free.

d0125771b1a91ddc3766daf54d0b379cadef11bd.en: A master class at the CRR Espace Varèse by the Duo Melis, the guitar duo of Susana Prieto and Alexis Muzurakis. Known internationally since 1999, they play baroque to contemporary repertoire.

4096366c1c7dd571a7f1de2265cfcf7b9769ad99.en: A children's paper-craft workshop at the Musée des Augustins for ages 6 to 12, making a landscape mini-book by cutting and assembling. Children explore works and try drawing and modelling. No parent may stay.

f47d21bcf641c40bb7e052b3aff96fa289cf0641.en: A karaoke night at Le Moulin tiers-lieu with live pianist Lucas Lemauff, who adapts to each singer's range. Singers sign up on a list and sing to lyrics on a projector, as part of the Nuits de la Lecture. Food is served from 6pm.

956fa1395d360f8b179e4e0fa91f5f7dc11b2611.en: A concert at Le Bikini by Marguerite, a singer revealed by Star Academy. Her platinum hit Les filles, les meufs and her new songs La boss and Crash Test lead to a new national tour.

c582cd75f957990cb5b2c1dab52e86420c67a8ce.en: A techno live show at Le Rex by marta, a duo formed in 2022 with violin, drums and club energy, known for the EP ROOM. It is their Toulouse date on a tour for 2026 and 2027.

79279cbbcc49a271749f35bb6bdb342a10a84421.en: A metal concert at Interference, presented with Garmonbozia, by the German band Orden Ogan with the Finnish band Ensiferum on the Tour of the Grave 2027. Both are known for epic metal and have fans across Europe.

c46a3228d257c79d6c69d0bba230fef89d6fdefd.en: A cultural-education route linked to the Białowieża exhibition, combining photography, archives and artistic practice across three Toulouse venues.

689b439dd721c6eb16b8fc1d6fc246626319c509.en: A metal concert at the Metronum on Tuesday 26 January 2027 by the Lyon band Resolve, touring their third album Spread My Ashes Into Space, with Silent Planet and Spleen. Tickets are 31 euros in advance.

20e1260d6b8451fe6fd99bb4ffad6e089f9a78f2.en: A free training course for associations on digital tools. It starts with a self-assessment of the association's digital strengths and weaknesses, then covers choosing the right tools and new ways of working. Run by Profession Sport Animation 31.

56d238c9818bf4a1c170f62c79096a388d23d4de.en: A cabaret preview at Le Kiwi of work by about ten international artists on a four-month project at the Ésacto'Lido circus school. The show mixes acrobatic poetry, absurd humour and dreamy, socially engaged themes.

8c600c5a0dd9fd198430c7d6ff380dec8bc778b9.en: Open days at MJM Graphic Design Toulouse on 29 and 30 January 2027, with student projects on display and an introduction to creative careers. Free entry.

a269c578ef2ea5907effa3991e1c59f4d7edc8e4.en: The 14th Night of Conservatoires at the Toulouse Conservatoire on Friday 29 January 2027, 6pm to 11pm, with pupil performances, dance processions, ensemble concerts and surprise guests.

564486f20f2420ad6b66ca3e47cc145f8ef95e0f.en: A concert at Le Rex by the duo Tonique & Man, presented by Cosmo Régarts. Their second album Where We're At is a warmer, more personal pop record, blending soft disco, modern pop and French elegance.

3b0b2a3a4b2a896f16ac5aa726bda9566f8ca24b.en: A concert at the Salle Jacques Brel by the Normandy folk band La Maison Tellier, presenting their eighth album Timidité des Arbres as part of a festival programme.

59098b7678cd8d4c98b34389596a386e26af3b4c.en: A rock concert at Les Marins d'Eau Douce in Ramonville on Friday 29 January 2027 at 9pm by six-piece band Insane Element, with modern riffs and melodies. The set runs 1.5 hours and mixes originals with covers. Free entry.

55aed485fba88a51f846feedeedbcd9523dcaefe.en: A family workshop at the Musée des Augustins for children from age 3 and an adult, making a printed tote bag, En avant chevaliers. 1.5 hours; booking is required for at least one adult and one child.

e7b2d25dd265ecb02be29cc9ba65e01750e8c458.en: The eighth Fête du Kiwi, with an 80s theme. The evening has a kitsch lotto at 5pm, disco and funk dance lessons, a shared meal with a food truck and a dance party from 9pm. Lotto cards cost 3 euros.

5d3b89c6889d08f9d65e314bd751bb774817aa52.en: A concert at Le Bikini by Adèle Castillon, presented by Bleu Citron with Agapè, with a support act.

1d79d16fd9c7b14b68f808789b5908b1bfd670c1.en: A master class at the CRR Espace Varèse by soprano Delphine Gillot, a Lausanne-born singer trained at the Guildhall in London and the Royal Academy's Opera Studio, who has sung at Glyndebourne and Monte-Carlo.

61591267ae4122aab14728bfa40e16bc3a26e083.en: A free training course for associations on writing an annual activity report: structuring it, choosing what to include and presenting results clearly to members, partners and funders. Run through the Maison des associations.

31754ab93ad29f8da89c75369f5e58d5e61aba19.en: A concert at Le Bikini by Pierre de Maere, a 24-year-old singer-songwriter whose album Regarde-moi went platinum. His romantic, ironic pop is on a tour across France, Belgium, Switzerland and Luxembourg in 2026–27.

50b308a68ada26692e8704b3ab8db3ff1ffe2928.en: A concert at Les Marins d'Eau Douce on Friday 5 February 2027 at 8pm by Peony Pox, a band formed in 2023 whose songs mix low-spirited ballads and angry riffs. Their EP Exhale came out in May 2026. Tickets are 10 euros; drinks are not included.

491b94780ecb8131613ff8e31862f884899159c0.en: A rock concert at Les Marins d'Eau Douce on Friday 5 February 2027 at 9pm by Adikt, an intense rock band formed in 2008 that mixes stoner, grunge and fusion. Peony Pox open the evening. Tickets are 10 euros.

58746f1b050a7f7d8301eb886697d2cd4f55fd67.en: A family-history creative day at Le Château d'Eau: a guided visit of the Białowieża exhibition, then a workshop writing a collective family story from personal archives, shaped into a small photographic object.

678e829290d7d0eb1677aca155c5fe4838903b49.en: A family musical show at the Salle Jacques Brel. Ego the whale and Yaya the panda, a climate activist, sail to New York for a summit on the planet, and face a wicked duck. Comedy with songs, part of the Detours de Chant festival.

d2cc57b240552b643b7a9524c700f98dc7941824.en: A photography course at the Saint-Cyprien cultural centre on modern and contemporary architecture, showing how the city looks through the lens. Participants present their images and build a collective exhibition at the end of the course.

67def9e0c95122ffd50b44fb32c7c92ac1a14631.en: A workshop at the Noviciat where participants look at Toulouse's monuments, choose a favourite and colour a mask of it, ready for a festive walk.

7ffae968e75810e9a5fe1d3093000e8985606d2b.en: A concert at Le Bikini by rapper Jazzy Bazz, from Paris's 19th arrondissement, known for La Cool Connexion and the L'Entourage collective. His album Nirvana reflects on time and inspiration and rejects mass production.

266afc80c3dd9afb894558a47c1b56e3ca7c75c0.en: A workshop at the Pavillon blanc Henri-Molina where objects are placed on light-sensitive paper to make images close to X-rays.

8666280cea3f94e87d961161e62c084535bc11c0.en: A tour date at Le Bikini for NTO, with a new live show and staging for the tour.

e7150818e4c6c9b148ca2a4ed62dfee249e0d674.en: A metalcore concert at Le Rex by Revnoir, a French band formed in 2023 that has already played the Rex, signed with Arising Empire and sold out La Maroquinerie in Paris. Tickets are 23 euros in advance.

662da66dfa60674a68c7a68af0f1c5218ddff928.en: A live date at Le Bikini on 13 February 2027 for Acid Arab, the Franco-Algerian collective blending electronic textures with oriental sounds. It previews a new chapter with the single Goulou Marhaba.

df661622c352e4961afd84350de3bb3a3f92cf56.en: A concert at Le Rex by Eloïz, a Lille singer-songwriter whose folk, pop and country songs celebrate freedom and the American West. Her album Les Grands Espaces came out in 2025.

3a9a52f54571b4a75dfcbf0f62f903c9bcacc130.en: A concert at Les Marins d'Eau Douce on Friday 19 February 2027 at 9pm by Le Cirque Penché, a Toulouse French-song band with accordion, bass, drums and guitar. Their poetic, socially aware songs are sung in an intimate set.

d0ee1505285bf9c5538e2f57e19f36af66e96969.en: A show at Le Bikini by Worakls, presenting a new stage called OVERTURE with Ekaterina Shelehova and Antonin Winter. The set blends classical sounds with technology in an innovative staging.

04bfb913e94b28b3d053e2a4885478bbbbcf13f6.en: A concert at Le Bikini by Aupinard, presenting his first album spleen. social club. The record mixes bossa nova, soul and electro, with Anaïs Cardot, Ino Casablanca and Sonny Rave.

9ec8a3850182d83a538158a27515be63164daa09.en: An exhibition at Le Kiwi of work by members of Au Pinceau Tordu, an art studio in Ramonville founded by painter Adeline Zaepffel. The studio teaches watercolour, acrylic, oil and drawing to all ages.

cf2e7519413dc0686ff4c1ab549945f50279b4a7.en: A free practical workshop for associations on building a forecast budget and a financial report. Participants can bring their own documents and, if they wish, their computer.

e1a12d90fb7d361060a337702acc71b43599d3d4.en: A talk at the Toulouse Natural History Museum's auditorium on the Białowieża forest, one of Europe's last primeval forests.

3963dc0b50f55aa9993ad8515910f3e4cd7392c0.en: A master class at the Conservatoire, in partnership with ISDAT, by violinist Marie Charvet, who works from baroque to contemporary music. She was solo violinist of Court-Circuit and teaches at the Lyon conservatoire.

1de76fbffe275194615946516ef5f32283058875.en: An immersive discovery route for young children at the Saint-Cyprien cultural centre, linked to the Białowieża exhibition. It mixes dance readings, photography, picture books and early dance, for preschool classes (MS and GS).

c2d2618561fae516977df79f1a1bc0f18b34216f.en: A performance by composer and multi-instrumentalist Joris Ragel at the closing evening of the Białowieża exhibition. It is a nature-inspired set built from reworked objects, music technology and acoustic guitar.

0f354bf24f699a09b8e86617e0f8bb585091c31b.en: A theatre piece at the Salle Jacques Brel about a true story of a Spanish family caught in civil war and Franco's dictatorship. Objects from a desk drawer rebuild the history, with humour, and ask how a society can repair itself.

ad05e34652552513e98d52bf9743fe0f46c2f69f.en: A creative show at the Auditorium Saint-Pierre-des-Cuisines that combines the Toulouse Maîtrise choir, second-cycle dance students and the traditional music department. Reservations open 17 February 2027 at noon.

4b8f786aa74905aef3c4ffd718b87e485a1cdd55.en: A master class at the CRR Salle Berlioz by Marc Danel, a founding member of the Quatuor Danel, who recorded Shostakovich's complete quartets and teaches at Manchester University and the Lyon conservatoire.

cab83bff2d6795be2fcd3bc446919efe5bd644ad.en: A reggae concert at Le Bikini by the Paris duo Jahneration, who sing in English mixed with Jamaican patois. They have played over 400 concerts and filled the Olympia in 2022. Presented by Bleu Citron and Ovastand, with a support act.

78317138f42f0017d97b684e2650c3d31d751435.en: A concert at La Cabane by JeanJass, a Belgian rapper and producer of Belgian and Moroccan heritage. His album Les Champs de Sacs Plastique mixes family memories and roots, including the song Le pays de mon père.

e7f3a6e77fa0f3faddcadbf5a6ad3d6731d7eb61.en: A blues concert at Les Marins d'Eau Douce in Ramonville on Friday 5 March 2027 at 8pm by the band Burnin' Blue, and its acoustic duo Random Currents. Repertoire covers blues, soul and rock standards. Tickets are 10 euros with a drink.

c2e601de0ec0f814e7f1a8091ebda95da77fcf3b.en: A concert at Interference by Les Wriggles, the comic French-song group marking 30 years, with songs about the absurd, joy and everyday life. Their audience has grown across generations.

31381c77b5450c22b25ed4024ffc6c8cce9245f4.en: A concert at Le Bikini by Billx, presenting his album 23H23, a journey from hardtek to a more modern hard psy sound, with a more melodic, mystical feel.

fdead88b815bafc928b49e0a601f83905c00afeb.en: A free training course for associations on the basics of association accounting: cash-based and commitment-based methods, and how to apply them whatever the size of the group. Run by Profession Sport Animation 31.

d39d93ea66595c03bd93f2d035dc803012a30a2c.en: A dance piece at Le Kiwi by Compagnie Appach. Two dancers build a tender, wild relationship in a shifting textile landscape, between childhood and adulthood, with a rock soundtrack.

340b910bf5bb162f379e73242630173ef88a8d97.en: A rock concert in Occitan at the Salle Jacques Brel by Christian Almerge from Carcassonne. He covers hits from the 1960s to the 1980s with humour and energy, for all generations.

b4028c0d036abbd9f3383d4290bb55b9e3f9ea21.en: A podcast-making workshop run by the Collectif ORAL in Frouzins, part of the Haute-Garonne council's Ateliers Inclusifs for young people aged 6 to 19. It gives access to arts and sports activities in regular venues.

33f6c64d7892c28d8abcec69750f9939fcb2f9cb.en: An exhibition at Le Kiwi of new season visuals made by residents with photographer David Perpère, artist Soia and the ARTO team. Local people photographed, drew, cut and glued to create the images, shown at the season launch.
