6a14dd70fcba55f790cc17db8eccb7b68a587a33.en: A concert at Le Rex by the duo Felhur x Andro, presented with the Junzi Arts partnership. Their soft, sharp rap blends poetry, rock and techno, and their EP Pousser sur des cendres includes the viral track Bébou.

755663d1562779dbf1e4d04b21bd5a79b20e4967.en: A concert at Le Bikini by TeddyBear, a 24-year-old singer from Mons, Belgium. His album Le plus beau blends chanson, pop and rap with strings, electronic textures and a first-person view of his era.

2ff53b8829ca8aa8cb7c3b7ac3edf79828c71782.en: A stage show at Interference by Médine, presenting his Enfants du destin series, stories of children caught in the upheavals of history, from colonisation to war and slavery. Acoustic and intimate, it runs 1.5 hours and mixes concert with theatre.

58a8b0107c8d08eb1a98d603e51d2a600d3d3d97.en: A free training course for associations on the GDPR and personal data: which obligations apply, how to spot sensitive data, secure practices and how to inform members and volunteers. Run by Profession Sport Animation 31.

8a9a8e015132228c9d76d6ff2e6c33b4267f0be2.en: A concert at Le Rex by K.Maro, a Lebanese-born Montreal artist who had an international hit with Femme Like U. He now also produces and collects art and presents a project that links music and visual arts.

9dbe21ca50c51a12ba50cec3795bf6d05f596ce4.en: A theatre piece at the Kiwi by Les Têtes de Mule. In 1950s Paris, a struggling novelist is cleared of murdering a financier, then becomes famous with her lawyer friend, until the truth comes out.

47c790028bc5706bbabdab746a079c649fd43d7c.en: A concert at Les Marins d'Eau Douce in Ramonville on Friday 12 March 2027 at 9pm by Basil, a six-piece indie rock band from Toulouse with a British singer, Lorna. Their first album comes out in 2026. Tickets are 10 euros with a drink.

f18c15f33d1edb5a695b4c96f288b84e86ccdaac.en: A concert by the Conservatoire's symphony orchestra and choirs, with soloists, conducted by Christophe Millet. The programme is Beethoven's Ninth Symphony, the first symphony to use voices and chorus, ending in the Ode to Joy. Reservations to come.

034c866ec201cd2086cec35d0a5d8eb24e342b99.en: A rock and grunge concert at La Cabane by Ayron Jones, a Seattle guitarist and singer whose raw voice and fierce guitars recall Prince and Lenny Kravitz. His songs turn a hard childhood into raw optimism. With three musicians.

f6e117e0aeb79ec7e7b70940fd336f5bdbd7df27.en: A concert at Interference by Danyl, a self-taught Franco-Algerian artist and beatmaker who makes raï-influenced music and was among the first to produce tracks live on Twitch. His first album is ZMIG.

631c4cb0aa921f6119581c46c74dd01cd27a9e48.en: A concert at Le Bikini by Makala, who since his album YAMOTO takes the stage with a strong, precise live presence. The listing is short and the show is described as a moment.

09867997414ef5e98615c08ef9c4738f6dd3a8fb.en: A jazz concert at Halle aux Grains on Saturday 27 March 2027 by daoud, a provocative, free-spirited jazz artist. His album ok is due on ACT, and his group has played Ronnie Scott's and the Montreux Jazz Festival.

c8be3719c1ac5bd79b032b8c1c83b96b0bf8a3cc.en: A training course at Le Kiwi by Le cercle des éléphants on rethinking education and cultural practice with children. It mixes theory, practice analysis and participatory tools to build cooperative relationships.

6407043f8e24df4adfd3747b170a5f2f4477a86e.en: A free training course for associations on crowdfunding and calls for projects: diversifying funding sources, identifying suitable opportunities and preparing strong applications. Run by Profession Sport Animation 31.

cd9fbad6f9a7474ec12933e2bfe92fabecff725c.en: A rock concert at the Rex in Toulouse by the Irish duo Dea Matrona, who sing in Irish and English. Their DIY career includes BBC Radio 1 airplay, Glastonbury and a support slot with The Beaches.

a23d771c94a047a3cad4f6a4df763444837dfe84.en: A photo bingo game at the Pavillon blanc Henri-Molina, run with the association Colomiers Contraste.

1f21008b51e395eea80883c408767da8b615248a.en: A workshop at the Pavillon blanc Henri-Molina in which participants break up a black-and-white portrait photograph by cutting it, then frame it with colourful techniques.

a7291b5925769b2d1bf7e85372d28ca16b3a17bc.en: A concert at the Zénith Toulouse Métropole by French 79, the Marseille electronic producer praised by Jean-Michel Jarre, known for the albums Olympic, Joshua and TEENAGERS. His last tour played 106 dates in 23 countries.

c64d0bfeb53d41063af56cbe761c8f875e0e7c3e.en: A photo guessing game at the Pavillon blanc Henri-Molina: players guess or describe a photograph using different means. It lasts one to three hours and suits up to 36 players.

de18fd0a5563f082b532d32efaf03aab48e40dc5.en: A concert at Interference by Théa, a queer 23-year-old artist whose EP Comète mixes punk, rave and emo with pop hymns about rage, doubt and climate fears. Her Cigale show was already sold out.

3404ce5ceb55bb85c32f917ca06147f16af568d0.en: A concert with photo and video projections by the Toulouse duo Ayant at the Pavillon blanc Henri-Molina.

8f727a1b6ef108744b3bab5554082190138b500a.en: A concert at Le Rex by Lushe, a 21-year-old French-language rapper whose boom-bap style is built on careful, introspective lyrics. A first Maroquinerie date sold out within 24 hours.

1d9583fcc45cc2d06784003b9e7786e21465cf76.en: A concert at Interference by Snarky Puppy, the five-time Grammy-winning collective that blends funk, soul, gospel, fusion and jazz. Presented by Bleu Citron with Anteprima Productions.

b63b6aec5a034eed4fb4d10b1faeb49837cd5eb4.en: A tribute concert, Me Gustas Tú, at Interference, playing the songs of Manu Chao, Mano Negra and Radio Bemba. It is a sing-along, dance-along night of rock, reggae, rumba and punk, touring France and Spain in April 2027.

f7714ec31fe3343ae31c0f6064a21b569859c0c9.en: A heavy metal concert at the Zénith Toulouse Métropole by Sabaton, the Swedish band known for anthems about history, on The Legendary Tour 2027. They are joined by The Legendary Orchestra and guest soloists.

ebb5f9e4eade8a140cfe729f37c036a9a251406a.en: A concert at La Cabane by Antes & Madzes, a duo from Rodez whose frank, self-mocking songs are rooted in Aveyron. They have sold out the Rex and the Metronum in Toulouse.

a1d0a015f44be741b2f05b190a51f3ee518be986.en: A concert at Le Bikini by Assassin, a Paris hip-hop group founded in the mid-1980s and led by Rockin' Squat. They were the first French rap group to earn a gold record fully independently, and they return in 2026 with a new album and tour.

00954d6f2c8254a32d4e334e7d2b771493d2dcc5.en: A concert at La Cabane by Warhaus, the solo project of Maarten Devoldere. On The Donkey he moves towards instinctive, tribal rhythms and hypnotic voices, and the show mixes elegant pop with club energy.

a6d67953180027ab95e8411136325431b570120b.en: A master class at the CRR Espace Varèse by guitarist Thibaut Garcia, a leading young figure of contemporary classical guitar and a winner of several international competitions.

dd3053894a2f42acecdc0553d20a968584bdf369.en: A book presentation of El libro de la vida by Virgilio Martínez Jareño at the Hegoalde civic centre library. The family trilogy follows a grandfather, his son and his granddaughter on a journey around the world, with two iguanas and an old compass.

a303b25676c01595fd97099ef43d0c8c9a2c567b.en: A talk called Introducción a la IA: bases para entender at the Iparralde library, from 19:00 to 20:30, for adults aged 14 and over, in Spanish. It explains what AI is, its effects on jobs and privacy, and citizens' rights, and entry is free.

d4745e0bfe0f121ef963a781db54cfaae31b7f56.en: Versos de intramuros is a poetry recital by Santiago Cobos, with the actor-reader La Pulga bringing the texts of his book Pájaros Azules to life. Tickets cost 1 euro and go on sale from 8 October.

27381372b29110f0ec91a4a7186b8d552d889e83.en: The romance reading club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, led by Marta Lobo, runs sessions at 19:00 in Spanish. The first book is Paula Gallego's Todas las criaturas oscuras, about a shapeshifting assassin sent to impersonate a princess.

4c579cffad1bfd3e3841a6346526dcaaa2691254.en: A presentation of the book Auzolanaren lurretan: EHZ 30 urtez zuzenean at the Eva Forest Liburutopia on Thursday 22 October. It traces 30 years of the Basque collective's history, in Basque.

e69d29a62851286fa5b2a071738169b252af98f8.en: Teatro da mangiare? at the Teatro Jesús Ibáñez de Matauco is a show where actor-farmers cook and eat on stage. It tells their life on the land, and the audience shares the meal, with a warning about gluten in the pasta.

9ff5d65ee7b666dfd1e98d37d660e2d1bd1222fc.en: A bertso session at the Gasteiz Antzokia, with six bertsolariak, including Manex Agirre, Maialen Lujanbio and Eli Zaldua. The Arabako Bertsozale Elkartea organises the evening.

23890fbe19d47c046549c6c362fc2b084b09a5c6.en: The 11th Dazz Jazz festival runs from 21 to 25 October at Arkabia, with five concerts at 20:00. The line-up includes DJ Toner Q4rtet with Erik Truffaz, Niño Josele, Caramelo de Cuba and the Paloma Cosano Big Band.

014541d5b1f9857773546206b5d702efdff1eb71.en: Alana Sinkëy, a singer and songwriter whose voice blends her African roots with jazz and soul, performs at Arkabia on 22 October as part of Dazz Jazz 2026.

6657942189105b226274fa12b94ea0355ff4428d.en: The Gazte Hitzak 2026 exhibition travels through the civic centres. It shows the winning texts of the Gazte Arte literary contest, with illustrations by students of ID Arte, and is at Iparralde from 9 to 22 October.

ac2f71223fac86abd3f0690ac447cb1f1fa615a4.en: Inurri Itsuak, a film by Igor Legarreta, is screened at the Cines Florida. A storm runs an English ship full of coal aground in Bizkaia, and a family risks everything to keep the coal.

085909a6d8d90aaaff831145400cd21143ffea19.en: The 23rd short story contest of the Asociación Afroamericana, under the theme Referentes / Erreferenteak, invites writers to give voice to their role models.

56add76ff6b2c80f235fe855894d676475c0d922.en: Hybrid Innovation Week at Hibridalab in Álava runs from 19 to 23 October. It is the first edition of an open-innovation week that joins art, technology, education and business, and it opens with the Álava Deputy General.

ff91a2a6fa03e4bcf05279b30ae8301dfb68060e.en: ArabaClick 2026 hosts Foronda, 16, a photo exhibition by Unai San Policarpo. Its pictures document his village of Foronda and the house where his grandparents last lived.

6ae6ff9d819ccdb45b1505b647b91ad92bcaf504.en: Trashumantes 2026 is a travelling exhibition of local artists, presented at the Zas Kultur Espazioa on 24 September. Its works fit in a suitcase and can be shown in any space, from a room to an open case.

5f08677f33dca98484d95291971f5020eea2ac2f.en: Irudika 2026, the professional illustration meeting of the Basque Country, celebrates its tenth anniversary at the Artium museum from 22 to 24 October. About 39 professionals and publishers from many countries take part.

e155c5d7a2c8ef1516f993dfa480c7a744c3fdf8.en: FusionArte 2026 at the Auditorio Txema Blasco in Alegría-Dulantzi runs from 4 to 25 October with three shows: Impureza, Loratzen and Harribitxi.

cda7feae971aad6df21db6b2a424b9f62ab85c57.en: The Basque Climate and Energy Week, Asteklima 2026, runs from 16 to 25 October across the territory. The programme mixes outreach, awareness activities and practical experiences, organised by the Basque government.

5b9a5a2e16fc7133c2185296473afcf97e0de68e.en: Cabezas de piedra – arte románico is a photo exhibition by Pepe Elejalde. It places images of stone heads from Romanesque Álava over photographs that complement them.

5d14979f8720f56df421b0ec80eafe0e4670f520.en: Hojas de agua, an exhibition of watercolour and acrylic paintings by self-taught artist Iñaki Núñez Ruilope, is shown at the Lakua civic centre. The works use pigment and transparency to reflect a conceptual idea.

7a916c5988a24f691c618839551d91cfd5691d8d.en: Sueños dibujados by Nathaly Arciniega is an exhibition of 14 works at the El Pilar civic centre. The artist, who has cerebral palsy, paints dreams and a longing for freedom, and entry is free.

5338a93ce7d0744495782b9b694a3863ff3f9749.en: The Dulantzi Musika Fest 2026 programme features local groups, shared as an image. No further details are given in the listing.

9222761e403f5d4025b664c77637f6a9baa332ff.en: CalleClic 2026 is a street photography contest organised by the RdeR photography group in Vitoria-Gasteiz. Entries go to the group by email.

6c538d2e71b0759119eb41928528ab44327eabc9.en: The European Heritage Days in Álava run through October under the motto Gure eskuetan. Álava joins Gipuzkoa and Bizkaia in the Council of Europe initiative, in collaboration with the Basque government.

e370fb3a4be9f98fd0a7022363239c7e8852b83f.en: The European Heritage Days 2026 in the Basque Country focus on architectural heritage, from farmhouses to industrial buildings. Bizkaia offers more than 270 free proposals in 77 towns, and Gipuzkoa has more than 98 activities.

d11fe2e4a9cacebd024d3f374af257b592e58f06.en: Entre gestos y miradas by Marimar Pérez is a portrait exhibition. It opens at the Ibaiondo civic centre on 1 October with the artist present, then tours five civic centres until 15 December.

b0695cda3df933a9454617eaee6b8faf57b07592.en: Camino al trabajo by Maite Santiago is a photo series made in 2026. It follows her daily commute by tram and on foot, watching the people around her and the reflections and advertising of the streets.

5896b5bd4f092fafe4c99e0c0e8163cb73858f55.en: ARABA ZABALDUA is a collective photo exhibition by the Colectivo Revelare at the Izaskun Arrue Kulturgunea from 1 to 31 October. The theme is Álava abierta, and it forms part of the ArabaClick festival.

a95f9c1057e3c5d422de0f46efa9764cc8af057a.en: Get Me A Stone by Rosalind Nashashibi at the Artium museum shows paintings linked to Palestine made from 2021 to 2026, and the film Occupation of the Inner Life. Stones in the works stand for resistance.

36c63642505be5bf70f7bf1f2001eeeef2b8b932.en: The 50th anniversary of the Plaza de los Fueros exhibition at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa looks at the square designed by Eduardo Chillida and architect Luis Peña Ganchegui in 1976. Pieces from its creation are shown together for the first time.

967b67bc2333f79febd77fc0bc0810e14bdd4819.en: Sinbiotika by ceramicist Txaro Marañon, at the Centro Cultural Montehermoso, brings clay into contact with plastic fragments collected from beaches. The works address ocean pollution and microplastics in the food chain.

a0b9aa75517c79636c1b8884fe8913662cc6bd3d.en: The second Concurso de Videoclips IAK 2026 rewards music videos in Basque. Entries must be published online, and the deadline is 8 November 2026, with prizes of 1,000 and 500 euros. The selected works are screened on 19 December.

31ab580f0077ce5ee71ece79c704ca2f40a51597.en: Paisaje de tres palos by Silvia Martín, part of ArabaClick 2026, is shown at the Archivo de Álava. It photographs football goalposts that remain in the villages of Álava.

8b51c094f9837c604a00b8ffa2c5cd7e5d75e3f5.en: Foragers, a 2022 film by Palestinian artist Jumana Manna, is screened in the Sala Z at Artium. It follows foraging for wild plants in Palestine and Israel, and the laws that have led to fines for picking them.

7cca5cd470378b0846f38e76d0692176e78e435d.en: World Press Photo 2026 is shown at the Depósito de Aguas in Vitoria-Gasteiz from 15 October to 15 November. The show has 42 stories by photographers, including the year's winning photograph of two women holding a relative arrested by ICE in New York.

ee28da2626864b386435ce20035db8e8e434485b.en: Guided visits to the World Press Photo 2026 exhibition at the Centro Cultural Montehermoso start on 19 October. School groups book in advance, while the public visits take place at set times on Thursdays to Sundays.

29772f899b43f8737308a75ea4f345d01c235815.en: Gazte Talent 2026, the twelfth edition, is open to groups and solo artists aged 14 to 35 in Álava and Treviño. It offers an artistic residency at IAK and prizes of 1,000 euros.

49d98374d1f336bf4cd02cb3e380d36f3aa318f2.en: A course on knowledge production in contemporary art at the Artium museum runs from 6 October to 17 November, in six sessions of two and a half hours. It is run by UNED with Artium, free in person and online for 40 euros.

5c5645f589a0638852447694e81edff0f98ee12b.en: Miradas jóvenes, a collective exhibition at the I·D Arte design school as part of ArabaClick, shows photo series by six young photographers.

ef4690c5cc207c7a1f6541828fe485e13066fc92.en: Fronteras at the Félix Petite theatre, part of the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026, satirises celebrity culture and Western indifference to crises. Two characters tell of a Western news photographer and a Syrian teenage graffiti artist.

ab6920a87290e5f8d91ec8c755f10f4a303f0d9f.en: A course for professional or training actors on the bufón, a grotesque comic character. Students build a personal character with agile, conscious play, using comedy from a sharp angle. It needs energy, concentration and some acting basics.

755a323ce5ec4379e09a34aa6f4cd62e29ac4122.en: The tenth edition of the Danzálava international dance and movement festival, based mainly at the Artium museum, features experimental work. The 2026 programme opens in March with Guillermo Weickert and includes Ana Vallés in May.

78dbfae23f9f7f310f1cdeb07d481c6ec6dceff7.en: The 14th Aitzina Folk solidarity festival, which supports research into ataxia telangiectasia, presents its programme in Vitoria-Gasteiz. Acts include Dervish, Maruja Limón and Luar Na Lubre, and Natxo de Felipe plays on 8 November at the Palacio Europa.

3e711290b37c1395ccab2a12e23d29e435ef6474.en: Jokoaren irudiak literaturan / Imágenes del juego en la literatura runs from 22 October to 29 November at the Palacio de Bendaña. It shows 25 original prints by 20 students of the Escuela de Artes y Oficios, inspired by literary texts about play.

2c7b5142e181e259a3c3d3851c318bd61f7ec001.en: Ana Sampedro's photo exhibition Intervalos, part of ArabaClick 2026, is at the EHU Araba campus. Her series returns again and again to the trees of her city, watching how light and the seasons change them.

caa2d8c780a7d84fdffaef946541805c4eb8deaf.en: Mauricio Catón's ArabaClick 2026 series follows a walk through Vitoria during one of the last snowfalls, moving from the outskirts into the city centre. The photographs show different urban spaces where the snow falls like a storm.

56bd93547c0d2f8ca343df44866acf45f1bfba35.en: Josetxu Silgo's ArabaClick 2026 exhibition Barro looks at the Zadorra reservoirs, the largest man-made infrastructure in the Basque Country. Their flooding created unexpected new landscapes, which the photographs present as a place where chance meets water.

d07f782aefca17814f0daf914a63c7037aa56eef.en: The VIII ArabaClick photography festival brings 64 artists to seventeen exhibition spaces in October and November. For the first time it extends beyond Vitoria-Gasteiz, with shows in Laguardia, Alegría-Dulantzi, the Gorbeia and Valderejo natural parks.

e21df9a856f32d7023964adafde3e142f2ea192e.en: Castillos is an ArabaClick 2026 photo series by the Colectivo Revelare, with seven photographers. It shows straw bales left in the fields after the harvest, and the work and seasons behind them.

cb3e6ad6bd97b5d54940e97e497258bfbda199ef.en: A collective exhibition curated by Gustavo Bravo at the Sala Amárica, part of ArabaClick 2026, brings together works by 19 artists. The show is organised around the landscapes and people of Álava.

96288a828d297a901c24931ca57942e9b3d131ad.en: Saroi, an ArabaClick 2026 exhibition by Oihana Garitano, is shown at the Sala Amárica. The listing gives no further details.

eb40a8a0d595388ad308f8fcaeb7fef5400f70ca.en: The Sábados Musicales cycle returns in Álava with 10 small-format concerts, mostly at the Museo de Bellas Artes, covering early, classical, contemporary and world music. The 2026 season opens in January with a children's show, Salvemos los cuentos.

9d4fed73e358fe06ca00ee24c2a5341f687ec354.en: The 51st Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival runs from 25 September to 13 December, with 34 shows in 47 sessions and eight outreach activities. It includes seven international proposals, six world premieres and seven shows in Basque.

91b5424d55c65035e0cac05d57a6ee4d17c3f7af.en: Estructuras para el fracaso, a solo exhibition by painter Marcos Ramos, opens at Zas Kultur on 15 October and runs for two months. The paintings start from ruined rural houses and address memory and the gap between promises of progress and reality.

cf0c7ce39aa20e36e75e4c838d01fb03b91c1714.en: The Filmoteca Vasca's Klasikoak 2026 cycle runs from October to December with eleven films in Vitoria, Bilbao, San Sebastián, Pamplona and San Juan de Luz. It opens on 7 October at Artium with Casablanca, a film the Filmoteca shows for the first time.

98669be838c862fd5d6740d925e6b5c4da03fdda.en: The second season of the 16th Auzo Eszena runs from October to December with eight non-professional shows in civic centre halls. Shows start at 19:00 and tickets cost 5 or 7 euros, and the first show, Muchas magias por venir, is on 18 October at Aldabe.

719cd728d9008424c060046aca09342f4afeab0e.en: The Recorriendo Álava choral cycle, organised by the Federación Alavesa de Coros and the Álava Foral Council, runs from 3 October to 20 December with 24 choirs. The first concert, on 3 October at 19:00, takes place at the church of San Esteban in Mendoza.

310a7aec6e8169fa4ec4dc716cafdeb9facfe5ff.en: A family activity at Ataria on Thursdays from 19:00 to 19:45, led by the Asociación Ixileku Elkartea. It is for all ages, with children under 16 accompanied by an adult, and entry is free until capacity is reached.

25a7719a2ebc740bf505927332eb8837cd6183df.en: Free guided tours of the Artium museum run on Sundays at 12:30 from October to December 2026, each lasting about an hour. Access is free with the museum entry ticket, and bookings are made on 945209020 or at the museum.

8cde9e32551d8047d78db5bf00d3fb149a4094a2.en: A bilingual nature walk at the Los Fresnos observatory in Salburua, from 09:30 to 11:30. An educator helps visitors find and identify the water birds that live on the lakes, and entry is free until capacity is reached.

9003e7e873fc8c33dd961f04a2456d378f371c46.en: A photo exhibition for the 20th anniversary of the San Andrés sports centre, with pictures from five clubs that train there, including gymnastics, badminton, table tennis, underwater hockey and synchronised swimming.

def2785853f31290a2488e6f07fa1d9ee88402d7.en: Bor-Bor open weekend workshops for young children and their families run on Sunday mornings at Artium in October, November and December 2026. Activities use materials such as cellophane, frottage and watercolour to introduce contemporary art.

9237cd998379fbd92a6e1aeb5315eee053bd7122.en: Juan Sagastizabal's exhibition Elegía Entomológica is at Zuloa Irudia in Gasteiz from 18 September to 9 January.

d93acc87a5a3fbc76d2c7eb48eb7160c7b5dc017.en: Fantasía y razón at the Museo de Bellas Artes de Álava brings together for the first time in Álava the four major print series by Francisco de Goya: Caprichos, Desastres de la guerra, Tauromaquia and Disparates. The show runs until February 2027.

7a7209ae68425db8631714b6c2ca79615d29220c.en: Siete árboles clave, at the Museo de Ciencias Naturales de Álava until 28 February, presents seven tree species that shape Basque landscapes, including the beech, the holm oak and the Scots pine. Each one suits particular soils, humidity and relief.

9c5c05db12550f8972288ac95ccfb2d2db4e3965.en: Irene Kopelman's solo exhibition Silueta y otras historias at Artium combines earlier works with a new project on the rock formations of Peñas Carrias, on the border between Álava and Burgos. It also draws on her editorial work since 2003.

2f74d62ef949d6b46b2d8f92c455f391967d3c81.en: The Arabari buruz lecture cycle at the Fundación Sancho el Sabio Vital in Betoño returns monthly on Thursdays at 18:30, with eight talks from 8 October to May. The first talk, by Santiago de Pablo, covers the history of Deportivo Alavés.

ef78e800eec688499fd713c57d36ffc2d65ad765.en: The Vitoria-Gasteiz Municipal Band's 2026-2027 subscription season, El sonido de la existencia, has 10 concerts from 23 September to 26 May. The composer in residence is Bert Appertmont, and subscriptions went on sale on 22 July.

486b9b8048032327099651c6a865a7adac16a7a9.en: Gozatu Sarean Euskaraz is a Basque Government digital portal that gathers almost 100 Basque-language online resources, such as web series, apps, websites and children's games. All the products received Government funding.

9b898db0cd7599ac93379fcc33bfd98da30b9f48.en: The Museo de Armería de Álava shows the history and evolution of weapons from the origins of humanity to the early 20th century. Guided visits and bookings are available on 945 181925.

333ab08825ea104f6d26fd6108ebd3c5960df88a.en: The Museo Fournier de Naipes de Álava holds more than 24,000 items from five continents. The palace displays a selection in cases, including illustrated cards on art and history from the 15th century to today. Guided visits: 945 203 707.

09f0154ceef2f4e8daa100d2df07a0f0c3dd95e3.en: The Museo de Bellas Artes de Álava specialises in Basque art from 1850 to 1950. Its collection includes Ignacio Zuloaga, Darío de Regoyos and Ignacio Díaz Olano, and rooms devoted to Fernando de Amárica with works from his foundation.

b08015dba433fe962dba4a50767280385f23a883.en: The permanent exhibition at the Museo de Arqueología de Álava, at BIBAT, covers the archaeological heritage of Álava from prehistory to the present day.

7c004e1daf13e3543b112e6a210fc225fd1ebe77.en: The first floor of the Museo de Alfarería Vasca shows 380 pieces of old Basque ceramics owned by the Basque Government, used in the Basque Country from the 16th century onward. The collection reflects everyday life in a very different period.

f7a6192acd3bb63e9eb70e46933e5c4530de8314.en: The Hau Colección exhibition at Artium, Movimientos elementales (1950-2000), reorganises the museum's collection through more than a hundred artworks, documents and archive materials. Hau is a Basque word meaning this, and the show starts in the 1950s.

79ecc204e0f5f8082b14ceeddb4350e39e39d06c.en: A case study at Artium on Elena Asins, Jorge Oteiza and Pablo Palazuelo, three pioneers of geometric abstraction. It explores structure, geometry, space and transcendence, and is part of the Bilduma Hau Colección show curated by Fernando Golvano.

6d332356893067a0fd3d06ae5fc89fc06921f9ca.en: Cajita de música is a short family dance show by Ana Capilla, lasting 25 minutes. A dancer living in a music box tries to find where music truly comes from, moving from classical music to rock and roll. It is performed at the Zigoitia cultural centre.

5fed439df1ec0ebd8b5ea0c70b299242134cabfe.en: The Klaustro Sounds 2026 festival runs from 18 January to 13 December at the Montehermoso Cultural Centre cloister. Sunday performances include Joseba Irazoki on 18 January, Raúl Lomas with Periko Ráez on 4 October and Garazi Navas on 13 December.

1c40056f5210f90b792ba3e97acdf4c7e52d9524.en: Gorrión is a mural by illustrator Itzala at LABE Gazte Laborategia. It shows a young blonde girl and a sparrow flying around her in an S-shaped path. Itzala works in illustration, comics and portraiture and recently finished her first graphic novel, Udara.

b33fd38de47746fc99c8fbcd06549a7dff0bc12d.en: Dirdir is a film and live music festival at Arkabia, where musicians play soundtracks live to films. Zabala, Christina Rosenvinge, Lorena Álvarez with Víctor Herrero, Amorante and Fantasma Sur take part. Sessions cost 10 euros, and a full pass costs 40.

7c21b64b05be2905bf795b602e848c464ada1da3.en: Members of the Genera group present their book Cuidar el vínculo, enfrentar el daño at the Eva Forest Liburutopia on Friday, 23 October. The talk is in Basque.

034c36dfcd6972c13b1aecdf4d04d9d451f6412f.en: Gigante, by Mark Rosenblatt and part of the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026, is staged at the Félix Petite. José María Pou plays Roald Dahl, who must decide whether to apologise for an antisemitic article or stand firm.

28d9880bf1372ecc04c56fad4b877e6d1d8512ec.en: Ankhara, Ekyrian and Delenda Est play the Urban Rock Concept room in Gasteiz on 16 October.

77dcd6dc32c0357c44e40a8250ea457992644086.en: The Vitoria-Gasteiz Municipal Txistulari Band plays a concert for dancing at the Izaskun Arrue cultural centre at 20:00. It is for all audiences, and entry is free until capacity is reached.

1212e43258fb4d8fa63d3869bc9c16b41c60b5a1.en: Tzan Tzan Fest 2026 opens on Friday 23 October at 20:00 at the Barrundia sports centre with three pieces: Trembling Frequencies by Helena Wilhelmsson, Pack-Back by Marilisa Gallichio and Alessia Sinato, and Velaquich Amorch by Colectivo D'elas.

ebeae9a913e13e5ec3582463a0a0ebc34b86f77e.en: Royal Cloud, an urban dance collective from Vitoria-Gasteiz with nine dancers, performs outside the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa as a warm-up for Afrikaldia. The group mixes hip hop, choreography and freestyle.

853b5e0e21c91d41973ac2674873c9c10e1287c8.en: Paula Mattheus, a singer-songwriter who writes all her own songs, plays the Jimmy Jazz room in Vitoria-Gasteiz on 23 October. Her voice is described as broken and sweet at once, and her pop songs draw on her own experiences.

0add366ae3c09ac504b50c38514c7cfcfce2a622.en: Niño Josele, one of the guitarists and composers who has best explored the dialogue between flamenco and jazz, plays Arkabia as part of Dazz Jazz 2026. His music mixes flamenco roots with jazz improvisation and harmony.

fc67f776af9540b5a60986e380e37360727e6fd6.en: Superthings: Filma follows three sixth-grade friends, Mía, Kai and Finn, who find a fragment of Kazoom that merges their grey town with Kaboom City. Turned into the Kazoom Kids, they must stop the villain Mr. King. Shown at Cines Gorbeia.

d79fdba9439a2863aaaaca25352e6078cbbc9ccb.en: Superthings: Filma follows three sixth-grade friends, Mía, Kai and Finn, who find a fragment of Kazoom that merges their grey town with Kaboom City. Turned into the Kazoom Kids, they must stop the villain Mr. King. Shown at Cines Florida.

2a4d9749f81ad1db3e7227cc9bd6a3c0503e2aa7.en: The 11th edition of the TZAN TZAN contemporary dance festival runs from 17 to 25 October in Barrundia and at Sala Baratza. The programme includes performances, an intensive dance workshop, a public talk and wine tastings linked to the pieces.

c002544704a14d1a613190e895b03067aefe2335.en: Robotekin, the Basque Association of Robotics and Automation, organises a 48-hour LeRobot hackathon for 50 young people aged 18 to 35 at the Robotory in Vitoria-Gasteiz, from 23 to 25 October. Entry is free until places are filled.

59fa01b55f9d02bb6776cd4e11b1839b36775ea0.en: The ArabaClick 2026 exhibition at Ataria, the Salburua wetlands interpretation centre, is part of the eighth edition of the Álava photography meeting. It brings together emerging and established photographers, and entry is free until capacity is reached.

ed651c31da8e4cd60e670658787e9f4f4890c92b.en: Álava imaginaria, an ArabaClick 2026 exhibition at Ataria, brings together photo series by five visual creators. They capture Álava's landscapes and biodiversity at dawn and dusk, from mountain mist and horses to the storks of Salburua.

c279dbf70113a0dd5ae3b25e73befa44a13f651e.en: Bihotza is a documentary produced by Fundación Vital and Kutxabank, filmed across Álava over three years. In 15 short episodes totalling 45 minutes, it shows the region's rich environment and its high biodiversity.

0eae63cf6cb5ca5a653149dc1122af7ea8857b19.en: Regresion, Coins for Charon and Warg play the Urban Rock Concept room in Gasteiz on 24 October.

1457ad31add307696d4b9f1a5459e85a962976cf.en: NUKORE, Bourbon Kings and Tudetuz play Sala Kubik on 24 October.

f143c6fa3b7adfa664440b5c3d9eb2f6f3ac2e55.en: La Mala Pékora and The Sakamantekas play the Sala Jimmy Jazz in Vitoria-Gasteiz on 24 October.

977fc7c2c56cf2c1d9e54f6779a1b70f9858c195.en: Komodor, a rock quintet from Douarnenez in Brittany, plays with the band Rápida at Helldorado. Komodor's retro-leaning sound draws on MC5 and T. Rex, and its second album, Time & Space, came out in 2026.

4883e63aaa844d458eadc569213fdf1387d79d02.en: The Led Leppelin tribute Zed Leppelin Dyslexic Tribute plays Sala Le Coup in Vitoria-Gasteiz on Saturday 24 October. It is the first of two consecutive Basque dates, and it aims for the energy of 1970s hard rock.

8d22e912d2540e3c873ef1a6d03d591142ae014c.en: Caramelo de Cuba, a leading figure of Cuban jazz and Afro-Cuban music, plays Arkabia as part of Dazz Jazz 2026. His music combines son, rumba and other Cuban rhythms with jazz improvisation and harmony.

8d9e4f518f926557922335f8874ba5d713be8b55.en: The municipal libraries' book swap market for Library Day runs on 24 and 25 October at the Iradier Arena. Each person may swap up to five books published after 2000, with live music by Caoba and children's workshops both days.

9b3eec4bff04d11ea8960a12d86733f191c8d4ce.en: Iruña de Oca holds its Halloween 2026 programme from 24 October to 1 November. The listing only provides the programme.

c178c50874de1cae45a9df9740767317f47f5892.en: A workshop introducing Seitai culture, which is over a century old, and its practices Katsugen Undo, yuki and the Osei Scheme. It is led by Joseba Sierra, a member of the Seitai Barcelona Foundation, through his Bilboseitai project.

bba93c0482e0d2407e597c96e7d0ca861df9c640.en: A short manga drawing workshop in Basque for ages 9 to 14 at the Salburua civic centre library, from 11:00 to 13:00. It covers the basics of manga drawing, and costs 2 euros for members and 3.40 euros for non-members. Registration closes 25 October.

0b6ef6acd2e6690f1e2cf33272e0eb0991b1c4be.en: Soprano Alicia Amo and violinist Andoni Mercero present a homage to G. Kurtag for the centenary of his birth, at the Jesús Guridi Conservatory. Their pairing of voice and violin is unusual, and the programme is a surprising one.

e88996811cfa6cdf260c7ec5915ab75a32790b44.en: A screening of the film Mary Anning eta dinosauroen hondartza, in Basque, on Sunday 25 October at the Izaskun Arrue cultural centre. It runs 72 minutes and is for ages 7 and over. It follows 12-year-old Mary Anning hunting fossils in 1811.

910c95b5092c6595fa2b7c772f8a713d4c5fd17d.en: Tres manzanas podridas by Tercera fila, part of the Auzo Eszena 2026 autumn season at the Arriaga civic centre. Three neighbours from the Kalisi residences meet at dawn after one of them screams, and then the other two join her fight.

f5e849fc6d7f43e0792bd942f7b2f1ecbd2590d1.en: Tzan Tzan Fest closes on Sunday 25 October at 19:00 at Sala Baratza with Olatz de Andrés's Cuerpos que se entregan a aquello que va a desaparecer, a 25-minute piece on cyclical repetition, and Alba de Miguel's Grietas. A video-dance piece ends the programme.

fc9c51f5d6b3ae926f6ddd50fb2f51dc297f1a80.en: Sustrai by the San Sebastián company ZirKuSS is avant-garde circus for all audiences at the Félix Petite. It fuses high-level acrobatics with dance and a strong dramaturgy, exploring entropy and the degradation of matter.

3bbd58128cafe29fce7db8345a4d5deccb26ee77.en: Riot in the Attic plays live at the Urban Rock Concept room in Vitoria-Gasteiz on 25 October.

e03e03386f24a4911beed2574bc58b6e63cc3423.en: The Paloma Cosano Big Band combines the jazz tradition with a contemporary outlook, with a powerful sound and careful arrangements. It plays Arkabia as part of Dazz Jazz 2026 in Vitoria-Gasteiz.

44fef23521f722752389c4aa5c5671ba84d6fe8a.en: The 23rd Bernaola Zikloa contemporary music cycle has 16 concerts from 25 October to 28 February, in seven venues across the city and Álava. Entry is free, but concerts at Montehermoso require an invitation. It opens with The Half Moon on 25 October at 12:00.

942c2ed930295cba1b87339a46722023598640be.en: The documentary Sustraiak is screened as part of Neguko Ataria 2026 at the EHU Faculty of Letters. It is followed by a discussion with its protagonists and the director, Óliver del Nozal.

0eb7925fe70d42f845363dd2254880d12289c995.en: The Lyceum Club and the 27 writers book club, led by Natalia Vara, meets on the second Monday of each month at 19:00 in the Orisol room, in Spanish. The first book is Luisa Carnés's Tea rooms, about women workers in a 1930s Madrid tea room.

bddac0978bdc60e39bb8a9a7eea6c7d8354446f4.en: The GABIA 2026 theatre cycle looks at the processes behind staging. Margarita Molotov by Pez Limbo is set in a ruined restaurant where the audience becomes customers, and Harrapakalan by Ane Arrugaeta is about someone stuck between play and pause.

2389c55f06a3ca8032ecc72d2436308da4d98d7c.en: Harribitxi, by Iker Álvarez González and Aitor Urquiza, centres on the txistu and mixes new compositions with traditional repertoire, with drums and psaltery. At the Auditorio Txema Blasco in Alegría-Dulantzi, local dance, theatre and choir groups join them.

d38587397df287757459dc1869cf8f80b5ad35ef.en: Trío Magadis, three harpists formed in 2023, performs new works by Zuriñe Gerenabarrena, Nuria Giménez-Compas, Gabriel Erkoreka and Braís Novoa Loira at the Jesús Guridi Conservatory on 31 October at 19:30. The concert explores one, two and three harps.

748088c6e4abed4c9eb39778774c36eafdc47e15.en: The English book club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, led by John Costello, meets monthly at 19:00 in the Orisol room for intermediate and advanced readers. The first book is Samantha Harvey's Orbital, about six astronauts in space.

1a7d8cb4734dc2c7753df84dcc35eca7cfe05c35.en: Geure(R)a, part of Arabako Plazetan 2026, combines nature, poetry, dance and video mapping. Three dancers perform a suspended choreography with music by Juantxo Zeberio and verses by Toti Martínez de Lezea. It aims to revive stories of Basque witches.

9b50a4103e4895995a2b3ab2e079ba72254e1ae9.en: An exhibition of watercolours by Julien Ramina on the panels of the EHU Faculty of Letters, part of Neguko Ataria 2026. The programme covers winter rites, masquerades and traditional carnivals.

33c0be2a64a88db5019808ec302d005dd06c1c8a.en: A talk for adults in Spanish at the Ariznabarra civic centre library from 18:00 to 19:30, marking the national ADHD day. It introduces ADHD, dyslexia and dysgraphia as forms of neurodivergence and suggests ways to support them. Entry is free.

67e9fd073291cdedccfa7a046f82ad853ae2e7c5.en: Julene Gatzagaetxebarria presents Etengabeko (ber)eraikuntzan, a collection of 53 poems and illustrations, at the El Pilar library. The poems invite readers to reflect on everyday situations and behaviours. Entry is free until capacity is reached.

1ee46604ce187caf0215b7596962a98878253b60.en: The fourth Martes de Patrimonio lecture series opens on 27 October at 19:00 at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. Ane Albisu Iriarte discusses traditional dress in the Basque Country and Álava from the 19th to the 21st century. Entry is free.

5f5a4f4dc5653d3b765f3aeea22eac25ef463b60.en: The band Goodbye Keppler plays Parral Taberna on 27 November.

5454eece5d6d20e5aa35cf1ebd01d4e49db2cab9.en: A practical workshop in Castilian for children aged 8 to 11 at the Lakua civic centre library, from 18:00 to 19:30, where they learn what librarians do. It is free but needs prior registration, open from 14 to 28 October.

3ca959a360314f5b347bf7618683e9f49f7f1298.en: A talk and live performance on the handpan, given with Mercury Handpans at the Arriaga civic centre from 19:00 to 20:00. It covers the instrument's history, evolution and how it is made. Entry is free until capacity is reached.

d0004b7ef2c62d5992b1b01290058db884cf8281.en: A storytelling session at the Zabalgana library about Patxi Putxi, who knows domestic animals well and tells what happened with them. Tickets cost 1 euro and go on sale from 15 October.

1bf16fee34a1d65fcfd148f0e8645181aa0b0322.en: A talk by Isabel Mellén at 19:00 in Castilian at the Aldabe civic centre library. It asks what place women held in medieval Vitoria's trades and guilds. Entry is free until capacity is reached.

ec0ac4a08ce804091f962a9a8281caa4b2456db2.en: Storytelling sessions for ages 6 to 9 and 10 to 12 at the Arana civic centre library, about the night of souls, or gau beltza, with old traditions and tales of nature. Tickets cost 1 euro and go on sale from 15 October.

ece2ae7a72916e007d426dd0ba0fe551661bf667.en: Mayalde, a Salamanca folk group with nearly four decades on stage, plays the Teatro Jesús Ibáñez de Matauco as part of Aitzina Folk 2026. Its music draws on oral tradition and rural sounds, made with spoons, mortars, pots and bagpipes. It is a family project.

699c142879bbb8aa256e3d59a42923d18e72b94b.en: Ordubete is a Basque-language stand-up comedy monologue by Beñat Iturbe. The listing gives no further details.

df811d9fe53c53b739ddc1f44b07e459e7ccf7af.en: Aitona Zittalak is a Basque folk-rock band from Abetxuko in Vitoria-Gasteiz, formed in 2019. At the Izaskun Arrue cultural centre it presents its second album, Ez dugu erremediorik, with veteran musicians.

41a57d965f496c1a3b3d4f737aabdbafa955138e.en: El Altar del Holocausto, an instrumental rock band with more than a decade of history, plays Sala Kubik. Its sound moves between post-rock and ambient music, and its intense live show has made it a cult band.

b6c78744557dad6c1056924a281f742f4b172ac3.en: Tickets for Despistaos at Sala Kubik in Vitoria-Gasteiz on 7 November. The Spanish rock and pop-rock band was founded in 2002 in Guadalajara by singer and songwriter Dani Marco, and is known for Física o Química.

036065f25d3cfbdf3af41c7209037f2d4bdbde8a.en: Maria Arnal presents her new show AMA at Sala Jimmy Jazz. It is the first chapter of a new repertoire that mixes voice, dance and artificial intelligence, with a feminist and critical outlook. It marks her return to the stage.

f956e1e4764331ea192a33e7f6ab5aadd0e450ed.en: Indianápolis, a five-piece band from Madrid, plays indie anthems by Spanish bands such as Vetusta Morla, Izal and Love of Lesbian. The two-hour show is designed as a big indie party at the Urban Rock Concept room.

1c6a01456affe485d8208ff2add0f2854c494c81.en: Kinki Boys, a Bilbao trio formed in 2018, plays a Vermut Sessions show at Helldorado. They mix raw rock and roll, punk and dark post-punk, and their latest EP, Jugando Sucio, includes Amalur, their first song in Basque.

a535d3cf454fb37c861e37e7ac7cd763e6f7dee3.en: Mandrágora Negra presents its fifth studio album, Guerrero inmortal, at Urban Rock Concept, with guests BudaSam. The band has more than a hundred concerts behind it and several records.

43e3987b2e2231affdc1348c33f0a3cb51b1bcba.en: Rebrote, a band known for its energy and strong live shows, plays Sala Jimmy Jazz. Its music mixes rhythm, attitude and good atmosphere.

ddaff6dfacdb967c9020b0ec2afe0e9520bd364f.en: Baby Folk by Xaramela is a children's concert for babies and their families, as part of Aitzina Folk 2026. It lasts about 45 minutes at the Teatro Jesús Ibáñez de Matauco, with sessions at 12:00, 17:00 and 18:30.

3c426c8da6cb5520e24fbc1262e3b8844c9fba62.en: Cinema Stereo is an indie rock band with enveloping melodies, atmospheric guitars and intense rhythms. It plays Urban Rock Concept.

941b6e874477e03c021f5b921d9fd5a63f850d08.en: A free guided visit to the Félix Petite theatre, including its dressing rooms and storage, and how the theatre and its programme are run. Registration at civic centres runs from 13 October to 2 November.

870312817ca63c101ef9a8d02f4fb3259627c035.en: Cinémartium at Artium, with the Institut Français de Bilbao, screens Comme un fils by Nicolas Boukhrief (2023) on 27 October at 18:30. A teacher helps a 14-year-old boy who steals to survive. It has French subtitles and free entry.

62951c7e75f2a8fb6006f23f575a340c170604af.en: A World Press Photo roundtable at the Montehermoso Cultural Centre, EnfocAH: La guerra contra las personas. Photojournalists Bernat Armangué and Santi Palacios, journalist Patricia R. Blanco and Kate Burton of Médicos Sin Fronteras discuss how wars are shown.

1851e58b3fc7d60d23c78fb105bee778840cda52.en: Karmele, Asier Altuna's film based on Kirmen Uribe's novel, is screened in Basque at the Izaskun Arrue cultural centre. After the 1937 war, Karmele's family is exiled in France, where she falls in love with a trumpeter. Sessions at 10:15 and 17:45.

fb86b08e9ebdba2567fefe85ca323c74297a4e06.en: The fourth Martes de Patrimonio series, run by the Álava Foral Council's restoration service, has six talks at 19:00 at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. Its theme is the study and conservation of Álava's heritage, from 27 October.

102a01fa0613c5ea1b7add2f2ae1254874c738a6.en: For Library Day, El Pilar and Bizan offer a guided visit on 28 October at 18:00 to see the new mural. On 29 October at 18:00, two storytelling sessions run at once, for adults and children, and children must register.

3872bcb62bd57c752a623f6bd76205efbe6d8f9e.en: The Neguko Ataria 2026 programme, a talks cycle on winter rites, masquerades and traditional carnivals, runs from 26 October to 6 November at the EHU Faculty of Letters. It includes the Sustraiak screening on 29 October.

99103b75962ab05d75a0f0eca53bce133f24fe3a.en: For Library Day, El Pilar and Bizan hold two storytelling sessions on 29 October at 18:00, one for adults and one for children. Mitxel Elortza presents his book Ospa, egurgile for children, with keyboard and music.

413feca02151471c1dcd1f95653fee9aa7664d3d.en: Soprano Estíbaliz Martyn and pianist Sergio Kuhlmann perform Donde nace la voz on 29 October at 18:00 at the Jesús Guridi Conservatory. The programme mixes opera arias, zarzuela, musical theatre and film scores.

22f86020a213afe1ac531a79f51ef06200a4f076.en: Eneko Bidegain presents his novel Hegal egiten at the Izaskun Arrue cultural centre, in conversation with Karmele Jaio. It recalls the 1986 escape of two Iparretarrak prisoners from Pau prison, following Maddi Hegi.

8e365a13051ba086f0496e5fda53dd71c67f2f7a.en: Taiat Dansa's Las hijas de Bernarda at the Félix Petite, part of the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026, hides the mother and watches her five daughters. It fuses dance, live music, theatre and film, with fragments of Lorca.

3cf4e2b38662e17c7e86ec0e8b1c0ac8f7030384.en: The Gasteizko Irakurle Kluba 2026-2027 reading club, coordinated by Iban Zalduak, meets monthly at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa to read and discuss books in Basque. The club marks its 25th year.

c50c34874ded911894b48bee3b9ad8434176575e.en: Eugene O'Neill's Long Day's Journey into Night, at the Félix Petite in the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026, follows the Tyrone family over one summer day. Carlos Hipólito plays James Tyrone, directed by Ernesto Caballero.

0768a99a1d3e0d29eebe12bec4bdad1609f56560.en: Babel by R.F. Kuang, the first book of the 2026-2027 Narrativas de lo fantástico club, is set in 1828 at Oxford's translation institute. Robin, a Cantonese orphan, must decide whether violence is the only path to change.

750a078d527c75c10f2d5fbbbc5eecedd8026718.en: The Goya talk at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, part of Martes de Patrimonio, is given by Lauren Aliende Hoya and Rebeca Fernández García on 3 November at 19:00. It explains how copper became an experimental canvas and describes the restoration work.

608297c9fce8d14457e37c5cd175e9121413cf34.en: A theatre, storytelling and music piece based on Ana María Matute's book Los niños tontos, marking the centenary of her birth. Carles García Domingo, Esther Sanz Pastor and Raúl Jiménez del Río perform it at the Lakua civic centre library.

260e4b1785d80dbd6d45af49158bc109d3c0c625.en: Un poeta, a 2025 Colombian dark comedy by Simón Mesa Soto, follows an ageing poet who tries to help a teenager named Yurlady develop her talent. It won the Jury Prize at Cannes and the Horizonte Award at the San Sebastián festival.

2c7dfdf4fc166fe6fc63ccc3f05da3a5de1dacc9.en: A monthly Irish folk session in Vitoria-Gasteiz pubs, where musicians play traditional Celtic tunes on whistles, fiddles, bodhráns, guitars and uilleann pipes. It is part of Aitzina Folk 2026.

43aca98307e38e19c2710fae7fa11714c1f4053d.en: The fifth Afrikaldia Basque African Film Festival takes place in Vitoria-Gasteiz from 3 to 9 November. More information will follow.

2aa65566ffcf3df7aec2a5dc65efbb43132486c1.en: Zinema Gaur returns to Montehermoso with four films in original version with Spanish subtitles, curated by Garbiñe Ortega: Un poeta, Aro Berria, Qué te dice esa naturaleza and Las Corrientes. Elena Duque leads an animation workshop on 7 November.

9ffa0d27430cba47c05f999f0946b05fcb6fa994.en: A storytelling session at the Ariznabarra civic centre library, with Aitor Vinagret telling tales from the point of view of a sheep. Tickets cost 1 euro and go on sale from 21 October.

a9244eae03fc050eb1dc0ee43187a542c0f47f72.en: A talk at the Ibaiondo civic centre at 19:00 in Castilian, with Edurne Baz, on how fashion has reflected social change and identity throughout history. Entry is free until capacity is reached.

934588a8080decba7bad1a29a0ff80031d15715a.en: Idazteaz beste is an interview cycle on Basque literature by Mikel Ayerbe. This session discusses the memory of conflict, drawing on journalist Gorka Bereziartua's first novel, Garondoan (2026), and the work of Iban Zaldua. Entry is free.

58cb9b70d25b28b9744533130bb309c9debe41ed.en: A photobook tasting club at the Salcedo room of the Montehermoso Cultural Centre, on the first Wednesday of each month from 19:00 to 21:00, led by Sara Berasaluce and Yone Estívariz. Twelve people take part per session, and no prior knowledge is needed.

8df02dc5a964e7f9d2be7b5a460e46b0651a274e.en: The Municipal Band's concert El tiempo de los mitos, conducted by Luis Orduña with saxophonist Vincent David, is held at the Palacio de Congresos Europa. Its programme of myth-inspired works includes Ragnarök, Gurifesta and Vesuvius, and a world premiere.

23373758ccaf84293aaa49c19483e79e12bdda69.en: The Browning, Within Destruction and Abbie Falls play Sala Jimmy Jazz in Vitoria-Gasteiz on 4 November, as part of Route Resurrection 2026.

425b9cf2b995fe282b5f242da9fb342830cd3734.en: Óscar J. González gives a talk on the research and documentation of traditional masquerades, based on his book Mascaradas de la península Ibérica. It is part of Neguko Ataria 2026 at the EHU Faculty of Letters.

1cabc9981f9a1d7021fa995e071ff98d6b814f56.en: The documentary Las Norbet Guan. Cochamo style follows two women who reach a remote valley in Chile, facing fear of the hard rock, endless rain and bodily pain. Screened with Spanish subtitles at the Hegoalde civic centre library, with free entry.

7cf0b6a385734c75fcf6dee1f7b40ea6a41387b2.en: A round table at the EHU Faculty of Letters, part of Neguko Ataria 2026, on women's participation in traditional masquerades. Speakers Lurdes Lekuona and Cristina García are moderated by Maider Maraña of Fundación Baketik.

f445072388893ebcfcb5f48e091aa2b69ca9a002.en: The contemporary reading club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, led by Leire Ibáñez de Gauna, meets on Saturdays at 11:00 in the Cervera room, in Spanish. The next book is Selva Almada's Una casa sola, on 5 November.

68431bd1b4a014830593274eee9465532103e4f5.en: Izaki Gardenak end their comeback with five farewell concerts: Bilbao on 5 November, Villava on 13 November, San Sebastián on 14 November, Berriz on 21 November and Vitoria-Gasteiz's Jimmy Jazz on 27 November.

0804c151bb320d7ee0d5d30e802e878fee187597.en: A magic workshop in Basque for ages 7 to 12 at the Iparralde civic centre library, from 18:00 to 19:30, led by magician Andoni. Participants learn to amaze others with everyday objects. It costs 1.50 euros for members and 2.50 euros for non-members.

21e529cc73e33c1d1d25609782b0df2114a26d1c.en: XAK, the new project of musician Paxkal Irigoyen from Garazi, plays the Izaskun Arrue cultural centre on 6 November as a quintet. Its folk and pop sound follows the first album, XAK – Mukuru 023, released last year.

52d718395c0bb306356143785212d7430fc2cd46.en: A night of music at Le Coup with Kensho, María Martín, Negarb, Lede DJ and more. The listing gives no further details.

f2f9e849803d53f3c18f7d697d32f0c8c751cd51.en: Robin Torres brings the tribute show Hija de la Luna – El mejor homenaje a Mecano del mundo to the Buesa Arena. It is based on Mecano's Descanso dominical tour and returns after nine years of touring, with more than 300 concerts across Spain and Latin America.

9574776f848e298dccbffc094d7f12f17bd62a1f.en: Gansos Rosas, a Guns N' Roses tribute band, plays Helldorado. Steven Adler, the original drummer of the American band, praised them. Their set includes Sweet Child O' Mine, November Rain and Welcome to the Jungle.

a7ed6d3faa46e2b5f1ab0626e5606ce6d248a992.en: Maldita Nerea's seventh studio album, Manual para seres maravillosos, is the basis of its 6 November concert at Sala Jimmy Jazz in Vitoria-Gasteiz. The album marks a turning point in the band's sound.

d882150b7a8848cb4553c1ef62c152ed7757248f.en: A stop-motion workshop led by filmmaker Elena Duque at Montehermoso, part of Zinema Gaur 2026. Participants study experimental animation techniques, inspired by the 1968 Paris cinétracts, and make short political films from recycled materials.

a8891a897e5dee0c3f6aad2f9ba2cf786136d0a0.en: A storytelling session in Basque by Ane Gebara at the El Pilar library, set in the jungle, with lions and animal adventures. Tickets cost 1 euro and go on sale from 31 October. Adult company is optional from age 5.

fd77db4aed82b2b58ec2e050332042c284cb5aef.en: El amor es un pájaro rebelde, a voice and piano concert by Noelia Ibáñez and Amaia Zipitria, is part of Sábados Musicales 2026 at the Museo de Bellas Artes. Entry is free with an invitation, and one invitation covers a child and an adult.

5fd3f3a4a548662a57c885b5e35ebdc6412be509.en: Sonic Beat Explosion, a German garage rock band formed in Altenburg in 2006, plays Helldorado in a Vermut Sessions show. Their sound draws on Detroit bands such as MC5 and The Stooges, and they return to Spain after eleven years.

d76632284e580bbfe8116567c85ed010aa795dd9.en: A new festival, PPR — PUNK PA' RATO 2026, takes place at Le Coup on 7 November.

98b133bfa6e22e1260970e008c2bf87dc9ffc496.en: Constelaciones, a contemporary play at the Félix Petite as part of the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026, is about a quantum physicist and a beekeeper. Parallel universes show many versions of their relationship, with no single ending.

a3c95714c5273fd225bf9527adaa5de7baf4cad9.en: Ensemble Kuraia from Bilbao, founded in 1997 by María Eugenia Luc, gives the final concert of the composition course led by Elena Mendoza, as part of the Bernaola cycle at the Jesús Guridi Conservatory. The group promotes music by composers of our time.

4810d957c8b0c1429a518f5b1b24652cf6b4858b.en: The Vintage Caravan, a hard rock trio from Iceland formed in 2006, and Psycho Rebel Front, a psychedelic and stoner band from Logroño, play Helldorado. The Vintage Caravan's latest album, Portals, came out in 2025.

a37c6b2384425e54783b8ad578c6a82c4879c672.en: Depedro, the project of Jairo Zavala, plays Sala Jimmy Jazz on 7 November. Since 2008 it has blended influences from Latin America, Africa, the Mediterranean and the United States across eight albums.

9a28c1c005febb8e721641bbfc739401c937e534.en: Raphael brings his show Raphaelísimo to the Buesa Arena on 7 November. It features his greatest hits, such as Yo soy aquel and Mi gran noche, plus songs from his album Ayer… aún, a tribute to French chanson.

8544c5c4fcd433f7f398dd36cd1927d88c376dee.en: An exhibition by the artist Gorka Hierro at the El Pilar civic centre presents his work and his project for a new art gallery opening next year. His wood-based pieces grow from childhood memories of his carpenter father.

ab75a7d1677b4cc744d0718657960872d0a0a840.en: The Recorriendo Álava choral cycle features Coro Ametsak Abesbatza and Coro Maiora Canemus on 8 November at 12:30 at the church of San Vicente de Arriaga in Vitoria-Gasteiz. The cycle is organised by the Federación Alavesa de Coros and the Álava Foral Council.

c1edf1b75aa3367fe77d86816821bcfa6031c96a.en: Deserto, part of the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026, stages Roberto Bolaño's work through fragments of his books, interviews and memoirs, with Livera as the writer. It warns of strobe lights, loud sound, smoking and violence against women.

14a5d24a087456d457d178dca9a8c7b61faae80a.en: The XIII Encuentros de Documentación at Artium, for contemporary art documentation centres, explore how archives and libraries activate documentary heritage amid digitisation and artificial intelligence, including access and ethics.

19296494d74dd3a5ee051739148a9c5f72cc422f.en: Los Hermanos Cubero, a duo of brothers from Guadalajara, mix Castilian roots music with bluegrass at the Teatro Jesús Ibáñez de Matauco, as part of Aitzina Folk 2026. Their album Cubero bueno, Cubero malo uses just guitar and mandolin.

846ba0da2a11d1230b610706a1617cbd7bd88bed.en: Clara de Frutos talks with Antonio Altarriba about her comic Vanguardia es una mujer, which honours the women of the Generation of '27, including Concha Méndez. The talk is part of the Lyceum Club centenary programme.

09ed3df64800005eb6a6bc6f79db601f5327250c.en: The Common Ground, a dance sextet by Poliana Lima at the Teatro Jesús Ibáñez de Matauco, part of the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026. Four of its six performers are migrants in Spain. It explores diversity and community.

f31227d310ef3bb824a71ac25b5b2eea363f2228.en: Tretatxu, a puppet show by Compañía Anita Maravillas at the Félix Petite, part of the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026. A mischievous boy grows into the most admired bandit of his land, but he forgets his own people.

01fb239c8a4c37d4b938e4f48aa13016e3cd0ac0.en: Todo mal by Miernes Addams, part of Auzo Eszena 2026 at the Salburua civic centre, is a comic monologue about a centuries-old character who finds university, dating apps and flatmates exhausting. Tickets are sold at civic centres and online.

ec6bf1011e324ea47170fd088a4af1bceaa2af14.en: A comic piece with philosophical touches by Txubio Fernández de Jauregui and Esperanza López. The two performers think aloud about asking forgiveness, the passing of time and the future of humanity.

2248bc44cd2f11dae5cd0002cb62e0a3c2fed6f1.en: Natxo de Felipe returns to the stage with Abandonatuak, eleven years after Oskorri's farewell, with unreleased songs. Joined by the Kuarteto Philiperena, he revives fifteen recovered songs in new string quartet arrangements, as part of Aitzina Folk 2026.

9b5eec99cb78f7a1eda18f2b7b699a9e076f3928.en: A special Zinema Gaur session programmed by Elena Duque, with short films made from 2019 to 2025 in 16mm, Super 8 and stop motion. Titles include Portales, Valdediós and Ojitos mentirosos, and a short course in fast painting.

1ae91eba44201128d20628f4a98e78af5902b8c9.en: Begira, a storytelling session at the Lakua civic centre library, about snow, a strange creature and fruit songs. Tickets cost 1 euro. A second session is at 18:15.

733bc5b8e30c7a72fd41181c8c93afe356629015.en: A second storytelling session called Begira at the Lakua library, with the same snowy stories and fruit songs. Tickets cost 1 euro. The first session is at 17:00.

92293c1ee7541693edb1594ffbaf096b676d1e93.en: Adarretatik zintzilik dauden istorioak, a Basque storytelling session for ages 4 and up at the Zabalgana civic centre library, where stories drift on the air like falling leaves. Tickets cost 1 euro and go on sale from 27 October.

dcfcb9e4b10f0a47f539b19e4982f3351e83e699.en: The Martes de Patrimonio talk Anatomía de un rescate, about the Renaissance tabernacle of Moscador, is given at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. The series, run by the Álava Foral Council's restoration service, has six free talks at 19:00.

98d93ee7970777683a3589dde543f8bc7cacdb0e.en: Aro Berria, a 2025 Basque film by Irati Gorostidi, is screened at Montehermoso as part of Zinema Gaur 2026, with the director and the actress Marina Suárez present. In 1978 factory workers abandon a strike, and some seek social change in a mountain community.

6ae2f10e710e41227e02b9e15370c525d3f3738a.en: Pianist Antonio Oyarzabal, based in London, joins the Cuarteto Bretón at Arkabia for piano quintets by Dvorak and Amy Beach, as part of the Fundación Vital Martes Musicales 2026-2027 series.

1e0e1ecc1271ff821b719c9cc5fa71513ad095b8.en: The 37th Martes Musicales series of Fundación Vital runs at Arkabia from 10 November to 23 March, with fifteen chamber concerts at 19:30. The opening concert on 10 November features Antonio Oyarzabal and the Cuarteto Bretón.

d339c1a9e7444c6eda65e7a721171f1c987654ad.en: A family workshop in Basque at the Hegoalde civic centre library for ages 3 and up, from 18:00 to 19:00. Children explore the situation of the polar bear through play with unstructured materials. It costs 1 euro for members and 1.70 euros for non-members.

c4f60be756b00c3c753068bc6947ac894075a9fb.en: A children's workshop in Basque at the Aldabe civic centre library at 18:00, led by Irantxu Lekue. Children choose literary or illustrated works to create a personal piece for a shared art installation. Costs 1 euro for members and 1.70 euros for non-members.

d9e1e05a0ed28691eb1e8402f6cb193f6a03ed15.en: FIAR, the second edition of the Álava Travelling Relational Art Festival, aims to transform relations between artists, citizens and the territory. The listing gives no further details.

3d09b85ec472c8bb35c3b9345a170aa8f7316250.en: Munduari bira (ia) 80 trukotan, a children's storytelling show at the Arana civic centre library, in which a magician returns home from a trip around the world to find his key stolen. Tickets cost 1 euro and go on sale from 29 October.

463e8c9eac61e106526e79ed360257e865b720a6.en: Xiberoots, a Basque reggae band formed in 2014 that mixes ragga, hip-hop and rock, and Chala Rasta, a reggae band from the south of Buenos Aires province, play Sala Jimmy Jazz. Their songs cover identity, social struggle and resistance.

29df6855841b6a6c466b0f54188d782667d04532.en: A children's reading club in Basque at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, led by Odei Arregi, for children born in 2015 or 2016. Six sessions unlock a mystery, one key at a time, through books from 16 October to May. Sessions run from 18:00 to 19:30.

a0022ec1004e0fda686a80b837b7f3ab5a92e0a6.en: La niña 104, staged by Yarleku Teatro at the Zigoitia cultural centre as part of Camino Escena Norte 2026, follows girls in an orphanage who sew while waiting to be adopted. A new girl arrives who does not share their hope. Recommended for ages 5 and up.

c3d946cc2149da47d21be2024d7ff1c876ae2316.en: A night of tribute bands at Urban Rock Concept as part of Partiendo La Pana: Repartiendo Estopa, a tribute to Estopa, and Hablando en Plata, a tribute to Melendi.

2e6d10fefe8ee19a0c549de16047e85032185dd9.en: Etxekalte and Makriba play Sala Kubik in Vitoria-Gasteiz on 13 November.

929762ea7654e53f6d67f63be64ceb0fa5721050.en: Otxo Bikotea, the duo of Maider and Lolita formed in 2019, mixes Basque and Occitan music with influences from Quebec, Galicia and Brazil. It plays the Gasteiz Antzokia as part of Aitzina Folk 2026. Its first album, Kokinak, came out in 2024.

99c72a0a29a78f81c2362fd8fe4084c0255040d2.en: Spike and the Gimme Gimmes, a punk rock band known for reinterpreting classics from every genre at speed, play Sala Jimmy Jazz. The listing describes their live shows as high-energy celebrations of sing-along punk.

22b1f9d0ea4f0af111c116a21d787f30a7b1915f.en: The classic reading club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, led by Leire Ibáñez de Gauna, meets on Saturdays at 11:00 in the Cervera room, in Spanish. On 14 November it reads the Cantar de los Nibelungos, the German epic, in a prose version.

2ead88a1dcb61d2116741844306b7557607b7e3a.en: A one-hour conversation with filmmaker Isaki Lacuesta at Arkabia, as part of the Dirdir festival. It covers cinema, art and music, including his films Segundo premio, about Los Planetas, and Flores para Antonio.

386613a03ee1ea2372f3291d2e262a814893305a.en: Familiak elkARTzen is a free contemporary art workshop for children aged 3 to 6 with an adult, at Montehermoso on Saturdays from October to December. The 14 November session, Mapas del cuerpo, invites children to draw their bodies. Places are limited.

fd046de2b53078d33d6e1e8e5d540ccc9a5ff47a.en: El gran inmolador by Escena 5, part of Auzo Eszena 2026 at the Zabalgana civic centre, is a musical theatre piece. A reality show set in the 2000s makes five women compete for popularity without knowing it, a contest that could cost them their lives.

b0193d21bc7a29e99afbd3a96ce70f01b7f68348.en: Fantasma Sur, a project of Alondra Bentley and Ylia with films by Isaki Lacuesta and Albert Coma, plays Arkabia as part of Dirdir 2026. The film Un año, una noche follows a couple caught in the 2015 Bataclan attack in Paris.

a1c5f700c792403a5c51e4f887d3f576929101f4.en: Maika Makovski and Geminis La Banda play Helldorado in Vitoria-Gasteiz on 14 November.

08c8579ba900a54ac8211283c62df0286509a0ad.en: A four-session course at the Zabalgana civic centre, from 18:00 to 20:00, on structural racism, feminism and anti-racism, and Islamophobia. The speaker is Marra Ngom. The course is free, with registration until 9 November.

0988f87e03176f0576d9bde74fe47ca43d5a6f7b.en: The second AntiRumores session, on identity, migration and uprooting, at the Zabalgana civic centre from 18:00 to 20:00. The speaker is Anita Hichaicoto Topapori, a social communicator and African feminist activist. Free, with registration until 10 November.

378156320e3f9ff329f080bcd4b1a525a488df8b.en: Aita Donostia's Illustrations musicales for La vie profonde de Saint François d'Assise, first performed in Paris in 1926, is revived by the Euskadiko Orkestra, conducted by Ernest Martínez Izquierdo, with tenor Luken Munguira and the Easo choirs.

4e5238565f5c7e3b12ac8d136c3d1a805fc8a356.en: A talk by Isabel González de Urbina at the Arriaga civic centre, 19:00 to 20:30, on how vulnerability can open new forms of encounter in a world that rewards perfection. Entry is free.

396b59260da308b780f74ee22404a940d6dc2ee4.en: Jardín Remoto Experience, a photography symposium at the Nanclares de la Oca convent in Álava, runs from 13 to 15 November 2026 for its fourth edition. It includes lectures, portfolio reviews and prizes worth 14,000 euros, with accommodation included.

5877f59e90ea7ca0b87b04bb6991013f3a9541f8.en: A bookbinding workshop in Basque for adults aged 14 and over at the Iparralde civic centre library, from 11:00 to 13:00. Participants make a travel notebook, a Midori, led by Ana Hernando. Costs 2 euros for members and 3.40 for non-members.

58632c82e0db75ccab12b3d53e3f6ee2835439fc.en: Old Time Spooks, a Vitoria-Gasteiz band formed in 2022, mix punk energy with folk and sing about horror stories in Spanish. They share the Sala Jimmy Jazz bill with Fillas de Cassandra, a Galician duo, as part of Aitzina Folk 2026.

e3adb02730a99c39f4b7145b46294f80e4a8d7aa.en: Teoría King Kong, Virginie Despentes's feminist essay on rape, prostitution and pornography, is adapted for the stage at the Teatro Jesús Ibáñez de Matauco, part of the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026. A talk with the team follows.

6a7180ac8cb3f3d8bdea1d7ab03c247754dc6718.en: La vida extraordinaria by Mariano Tenconi Blanco, at the Félix Petite in the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026, follows two lifelong poets and friends, Aurora and Blanca, whose ordinary lives are changed by friendship and literature.

29998f3f16423a3744a2688bf8090bfb7dde422c.en: Lur eta Amets, an 87-minute family film in Basque by Imanol Zinkunegi and Joseba Ponce, is shown at the Izaskun Arrue cultural centre. Twins travel through history with their grandmother Andere and her cat Baltaxar, pursued by two villains.

f6a250de7a7a96db86301eb9a68374248af06e36.en: Piratas de Secano by Xip Xap, part of Aitzina Folk 2026, is a 60-minute participatory family show. Five pirates turn the street into a ship, with original songs, group games and a band of drums, bass, guitar and violin. It is directed by Jordi Granell.

5a042676208312e7cc3f1e374e0bedfc5eaff1fc.en: Farra, by the Lucas Escobedo company, is a baroque cabaret of scenes set in Golden Age Madrid, mixing music, magic, acrobatics and humour. It won the 2025 Max Award for Best Musical Show and is part of the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026.

d0d4fcf8e4e6bbd6a4e211622ee63b568d213565.en: Galbahe sets the poems of the book Galbahea to music. Its only album, Ez gara dena ahazteko nahikoa biziko, was recorded in 2025. The project ends in late 2026, so this IAK concert is one of its last chances to see it live.

6e1ed8627f47e236bfc9bc1cc5814aeb1641a68b.en: Ignatius Farray, a Tenerife comedian who started stand-up 20 years ago, brings El show de Ignatius to Sala Jimmy Jazz. He hosted the radio programme La vida moderna and starred in the series El fin de la comedia, which was nominated for an Emmy.

618fa6877af5757d81d99b863058579961677285.en: Entre gestos y miradas, a portrait exhibition by Marimar Pérez, tours five civic centres. It is at Ibaiondo from 1 to 16 October, Iparralde from 17 to 31 October, Salburua in November, Hegoalde in late November and El Pilar in December.

ddcfe45002d8ee565c82448f2c83867045be195e.en: A Martes de Patrimonio talk at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa on the mural painting of Ribera de Valderejo, combining nature, art and restoration. It is part of the restoration service's six-talk cycle at 19:00, with free entry.

a37f7482bf2bb04218f46bcc52da2ac492347eb0.en: Hong Sangsoo's Qué te dice esa naturaleza, screened in Zinema Gaur at Montehermoso, follows Donghwa, a young poet from Seoul, who visits his girlfriend's parents on a hill. Over a day and night, family and personal troubles surface over wine and dinner.

b4a3a0f9544eed0a886b11d015d2b4f2687097f4.en: The Antaeus Quintet, formed by former students of the Reina Sofía school, plays Mozart's Clarinet Quintet K. 581 and Brahms's Clarinet Quintet Op. 115 at Arkabia. It is part of the 2026-2027 Martes Musicales series.

809f394b807ca5bb2f8061db6b597fbaba23d609.en: Diario del enemigo, an ironic thriller about censorship, has sessions at the Abetxuko library. A censor's body is found in a fridge, and every suspect is an artist. Tickets cost 1 euro, and the actors Begoña Martín and Raúl Camino talk after each session.

e3410f38f9542d9faeee76d7df22a60c039430a4.en: A graffiti lettering workshop with Saioa García, La Omega, for ages 12 to 16 at the El Pilar family library, from 18:00 to 19:30. Participants learn letter styles to decorate their work. It costs 1.50 euros for members and 2.50 euros for non-members.

81042b4f81e8cd7d059efe8634e89ebed67ae04b.en: The second session of Diario del enemigo, a thriller about censorship staged at the Abetxuko library, with a talk with the actors Begoña Martín and Raúl Camino afterwards. Tickets cost 1 euro and go on sale from 4 November.

cc86f36f153eae54fe8e232f28f1520c218260a8.en: A science fiction reading club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, led by Joseba Gómez, in Spanish at 19:00 in the Amaritu room. The first book is Carl Sagan's Contacto on 21 October, followed by Hiromi Kawakami's Bajo el ojo del gran pájaro.

853c45c0dce37e8119d2310ac21bdd2c4d72bbc9.en: Cenizas y luz, a Municipal Band concert with guest conductor Bert Appermont at the Palacio de Congresos Europa, explores friendship, loss, suffering and hope. The programme includes Appermont's First Symphony, Gilgamesh, and Saga Maligna.

8f95991a299ff96b809880919c4cb250b5fc6b8b.en: The third session of Diario del enemigo, a thriller about censorship staged at the Abetxuko library, with a talk with the actors Begoña Martín and Raúl Camino afterwards. Tickets cost 1 euro and go on sale until 18 November.

e995a1c9c4255d3d3fe835c5b0ebdc46cb6c75ea.en: A monthly folk session at Hala Bedi Taberna, part of Aitzina Folk 2026, where musicians play traditional Basque tunes and songs from many cultures. Everyone who wants to play is welcome.

3aa7e3f148478a0a049ee8f13b30cecc83f73d9a.en: A talk at the Aldabe civic centre library at 19:00 in Castilian with artist and writer Dorleta Ortiz de Elguea, on her creative life, painting, literature and the process of making art. Entry is free until capacity is reached.

c0c4a8f4c47eaeff9c1bcba644649e1d0721551c.en: A storytelling session at the Arriaga civic centre library with Josune García de Bikuña, drawing on grandmothers' words and childhood imagination. Stories of bold, mischievous girls mix humour, tenderness and magic. Tickets cost 1 euro.

e8ade1ae9d4a269281a6c5d7d63501215b354990.en: A castanet workshop for adults aged 14 and over at the Ariznabarra civic centre library, from 18:30 to 20:00, taught by Alba Martín. Castanets are lent, or participants can bring their own. It costs 1.50 euros for members and 2.50 euros for non-members.

b318d59d1e79ffc201dbcd2f3806ee60f6021df2.en: Rigor Mortis, a comedy of secrets at the Teatro Jesús Ibáñez de Matauco, part of the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026. When grandfather Rufino dies with his mouth open, his wife, daughter and granddaughter try to keep it hidden.

aa23f811ec1344122bfadf42cd5415911e92046e.en: A children's workshop in Basque at the Aldabe civic centre library for ages 3 to 6, led by Itziar Nanclares de Gamboa. Children explore fear through a story and artistic creation. It costs 1.50 euros for members and 2.50 euros for non-members.

524b3033d09fe9770f57c7ae6169fb909321d92b.en: Verborrea, a tragicomedy at the Félix Petite as part of the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026, follows outcasts who were once in a punk band. They live in a crumbling house in the Sierra Norte of Madrid, in a limbo between life and death.

11e845098aab4c7e1bc3121b3e7274fb3d2890d5.en: Dervish, a band from County Sligo, plays Arkabia as part of Aitzina Folk 2026. It released The Boys of Sligo in 1989 and The Great Irish Songbook in 2019, with guests including Steve Earle and Brendan Gleeson.

2dadbf65c941f76cebbb9d1c9aca1d2d80d3c23a.en: Raimundo el Canastero, a flamenco singer known for a deep, emotional voice, plays Sala Jimmy Jazz with the Broken Brothers Brass Band.

2934c8a6b7e0a085eb8bf5d2259f02e1db2ae3dd.en: Antonio Orozco plays the Buesa Arena on 20 November with La gira de mi vida, a tour celebrating his 26 years in music.

76cdd3f0836fd799d8430726e5e490d66b39209e.en: Jochen Lempert: Local Ecology at Artium is his first exhibition in the Basque Country. It shows photographs of the nature around Vitoria-Gasteiz. Lempert, who trained in biology, uses photography to question how images represent the world.

b0b76c5defc5e187d76d8e3126ad57c8deae315e.en: A storytelling session at the Arana civic centre library about Lucinda's journey through friendship, courage and inner light, showing that one can shine again after hard times. Tickets cost 1 euro and go on sale from 7 November.

685a652d96a0c7977e99a320ccd87771796c6abe.en: De la siesta a la fiesta, a 90-minute collective sensory experience at Artium on 21 November at 17:00, by POMPA with Mara Sannia and Irene Aguilera. Using sound, voice and slow movement, it invites the audience to listen and rest without relying on sight.

f618366f9da10070fe943c0f925460b9953354a7.en: GBH, Larsen, Deaf Devils and The Capaces play Sala Jimmy Jazz on 21 November.

d1ca0ff13019f9834d1b528ba26612244dd9eb46.en: La M.O.D.A. from Burgos and Siloé from Valladolid, led by Fito Robles, play the Buesa Arena on 21 November, with guest Nacho Pistacho. Doors open at 18:30, and the concerts run from 19:30 to 00:30.

a1eb62ffdb9a6d795d05b94115a2e233598b29d8.en: Akusma, a multichannel acousmatic concert of electroacoustic works at Montehermoso as part of the Bernaola cycle. Sound and light surround the audience in three dimensions, and listeners hear sounds without seeing their sources.

e5cdf36eb8add47436a36d345b49384da185f6f8.en: Saltaire, an Irish trio of Kaitlin Cullen-Verhauz, Ian Kinsella and Conor Lyons, plays Arkabia as part of Aitzina Folk 2026. It released its debut EP, Only Moonlight, in 2026, blending Irish and American folk.

43cb1803782e1fa11305ad8166959e50c3f4b5f9.en: Barrence Whitfield, a shouter with more than 40 years of music, plays with MFC Chicken at Helldorado, revisiting the early repertoire of The Savages. Henri Herbert & The Fury, who lived in Austin, Texas, also play.

509ee61facfaa922b4d958f27dbc2affd6e51170.en: Gure Zirkua, the first travelling circus in Basque, founded in 2017 by actor and humourist Iker Galartza, returns to Vitoria-Gasteiz. Its tent at the Paseo de la Música hosts shows for all audiences from 21 November. Tickets go on sale on 21 October.

ecc3308663a4c01f9149cde64ef572fe1c1c1e9e.en: Mini Break by Brodas Bros, a children's show at the Félix Petite as part of the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026, introduces hip hop through beatbox, DJing, scratch and graffiti. Two characters, Hip and Hop, join the Beat and the Break.

48f4eae56364c4558252f5990d56bd0311cf0a9c.en: An AntiRumores session in Basque at the Zabalgana civic centre, from 18:00 to 20:00, on coexistence in times of Islamophobia, with social worker Hajar Samadi of the Bidaya association. It is free, with simultaneous Spanish translation.

b76840d5f57166503dd56714bab5e1f96c8de66b.en: An information exhibition by Fashion Revolution at the Ataria wetlands centre on the environmental and social impact of textiles, from fibre to end of life. It also shows sustainable alternatives such as upcycling. Free entry.

dc6b3f9dd6311c32ff510e44a7b137637370e408.en: TIME (Tick Interventions of Mnemic Entropy) by Oriol Pares and Jaime De Los Ríos, part of Klaustro Sounds 2026 at the Montehermoso cloister, is a living process inspired by chaos theory, where humans and machines collaborate.

3f9f64d36232d107d4015f4f1750438ac238c4ed.en: 136 escalones by Ipazapi, part of Auzo Eszena 2026, is a theatre piece. At a residents' meeting in a friendly building, a new tenant brings out everyone's prejudices. Tickets are sold at civic centres and online until 22 November.

0ac3ee41bc35e77382b53d59337303524347e711.en: Nomaziak Abesbatza, a choir singing in Basque, performs at the Izaskun Arrue cultural centre on 22 November as part of the IAKantuan cycle. The cycle, built around voice and singing, also includes the Kantalab course, whose students enter free.

7d6363c488fcc76f58c6727665c308ce06626d1c.en: Flotsam and Jetsam, a thrash metal band from Phoenix, Arizona, plays Urban Rock Concept on 22 November. Their 16th album, Rats in the Temple, came out on 28 August 2026 on Napalm Records.

f5ec4ddb5004b3d97b11a91a1121801bae313fcc.en: A talk in Basque by Rosa Ramos of Uharri Soziolinguistika Aplikatua at the Izaskun Arrue cultural centre. It asks whether language competence is the key to speaking Basque in Vitoria-Gasteiz, and what the Basque movement can do about it.

c25649bfff57ef8ed98e05f4f9a3fa57ec2b67f4.en: Amarilla by R.F. Kuang, the first book of the 2026-2027 American literature reading club, is read on 14 November at 19:00 in the Amaritu room. A thief steals the unpublished manuscript of a dead writer and will do anything to keep her new life.
