ac74062f42f28d0635fc2b13cf97347282afe48a.en: A Martes de Patrimonio talk at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa at 19:00, on communities as active guardians of intangible cultural heritage. It is part of the restoration service's six-talk series, with free entry.

9df41500cb0443708d7db824fdd10347eb2009f2.en: Barremagia, a magic show by Andoni at the Hegoalde civic centre library, promises to surprise and make people laugh. Tickets cost 1 euro and go on sale from 12 November.

2be2405571ed4e5dff84726db38d0a7925c5d72f.en: Nunca olvides que te quiero, by Nicholas Sparks, is the romance book for the reading club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, led by Marta Lobo, in the Cervera room at 19:00. It is a romantic thriller about life, death and human connection.

71a87b4a5d9240cf4d0d46469bc5809283e5f8a6.en: Celia en la revolución, a novel by Elena Fortún written in 1943, follows a teenage Celia in besieged Madrid, between survival and revolution. It is an autobiographical chronicle, and the Lyceum Club session is on 16 November.

21dfd626b8431227ec938f1499b65b0e21ecc46d.en: A session of the Gasteizko Irakurle Kluba 2026-2027 reading club on Kantu leuna by Leila Sulmani, at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. The club meets monthly to read and discuss books in Basque, and this year it marks its 25th anniversary.

9f862a32bb16fa4af4d40f97789152c8c13840c9.en: Kokitoren Amona, a children's show at the Zabalgana library, follows a grandmother and grandson on a magical journey to say goodbye to each other. It gently addresses grief and the death of loved ones. Tickets cost 1 euro and go on sale from 13 November.

5d4bccf447fb5f043f9a6e821c16c0350e1af663.en: Los Fulanos, the Latin soul band returning with Paquito Sex Machine on vocals, play Helldorado on 27 November as part of the Midnight Boogie Weekend. The Valencia-based The Lazy Tones, inspired by Chess Records blues, also play.

2bf602a344b74671eeb80aaccb95336ea9cb45ec.en: Izaki Gardenak, a Basque indie-rock and pop band formed in 2012, plays Jimmy Jazz Gasteiz on 27 November with Sara Zozaya. The band has just released its album Orube and has toured since early 2025.

d3550a689fd4e2821b3af5386e2e68ceb9a9b546.en: Eman mama goxoa, a show by Pantzart at the Salburua civic centre library, is built on the fantasy of a snack, with dolls and songs. It encourages babies to take part in a shared play atmosphere. Tickets cost 1 euro and go on sale from 14 November.

457df27ba4ff3a36030cc45bcbc94c6692321ea2.en: Split Dogs, a punk and heavy rock 'n' roll band formed in Brighton in 2022, plays Helldorado with Exuvia, a stoner, punk and rock band formed in Pamplona in 2023. It is a Vermut Sessions show.

526cfd32499005580c7ebc9110c03628c19ffbc2.en: Lo mejor de Hans Zimmer is a 60-minute Candlelight concert in Vitoria-Gasteiz, played by a string quartet. It includes suites from Dunkirk, Gladiator, Interstellar and Dune. It is for ages 8 and over, and under-16s must be accompanied by an adult.

ed88601ef3baf6a35189db4f402d56e69c8d7eff.en: A meeting with the dancers Juan Loriente and Nekane Santamaría at Artium, part of the danZálava 2026 festival. Entry is free until capacity is reached.

68c81247ee7047fe8f77c92004b3ecf57b2c9f62.en: Luar Na Lubre, the Galician folk group founded in A Coruña in 1986, celebrates its 40th anniversary at the Jesús Guridi Conservatory as part of Aitzina Folk 2026. It has released 21 albums and given more than 2,500 concerts in over 60 countries.

96865cf5bc1b1c66d633a41d21b2fd65eb7aaca4.en: Bengo and Tatta play Sala Jimmy Jazz on 28 November. Bengo, from Oiartzun, mixes urban pop with breakdance influences, and Tatta, from Arrasate, is one of the voices of the Basque urban scene. Both give Basque a central role.

5a549f0e51328871d8eb7c61d529d36d2650aa61.en: Brit Festival by Neon Collective is a show of more than two hours in two sets. The first pays tribute to British bands such as Blur, Arctic Monkeys, Radiohead and Coldplay, and the second to Oasis. A DJ opens the night at Sala Kubik.

9b1ff73d93162578bf32691bd72ec527b2b4fdb1.en: Dulce Castigo, a tribute band to Los Suaves, plays Urban Rock Concept on 28 November.

177f6e29931554dd2a00f2ffb1eb90ca62c85b1c.en: Nine Below Zero, a British R&B band formed in London in 1977 and a cult name across Europe, plays Helldorado with Haylen as part of the Midnight Boogie Weekend. Their latest album is 13 Shades of Blue.

89c5ddab01134cc709f54373f357c1c19cb8a1e2.en: Queen vs. ABBA is a 60-minute candlelit string quartet concert in Vitoria-Gasteiz, featuring Dancing Queen, Bohemian Rhapsody, Waterloo and We Are the Champions. It is for ages 8 and over, and under-16s must come with an adult.

e327962dd822c19a5dfaf447f1c7917634ee2944.en: A decoupage workshop for children at the Ibaiondo civic centre, from 16:30 to 18:00, led by Jaio Deco. Children decorate a recycled tin with comic strips. It costs 1.50 euros for members and 2.50 euros for non-members.

f336921e0b086284260e9e492b30628e3abba5d1.en: Xocolat, at the Teatro Federico Garcia Lorca as part of the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026, follows a chocolate master and a creative apprentice in a factory. Their encounter turns routine chocolate-making into a shared game of dreams.

1360c330bae883319570e34112a0db4aeac0a958.en: A children's workshop for ages 6 to 9 at the Ibaiondo civic centre, from 18:30 to 20:00, led by Jaio Deco. Children decorate a recycled tin with paint, fabric and stencils. It costs 1.50 euros for members and 2.50 euros for non-members.

e7b08c6f00daeaefcc93b364767140db7d17511d.en: Corrents, by Maitane and Laura, is a dance piece in Auzo Eszena 2026 at the Salburua civic centre. Two bodies fight to stay afloat or sink under pressure, loneliness and crisis. It speaks for all the times that could not be spoken.

e633785b7da6c68f80f83794b898d7f95db925ba.en: Hamnet by Maggie O'Farrell is the book for the English club's session on 23 November at 19:00 in the Orisol room. Agnes, a young healer, marries a Latin tutor, and her marriage is tested by her family's opposition and a tragedy.

fdc5d993d8e19d2d6e9aac12d46288c917d66d46.en: The Euskadiko Orkestra, conducted by Lucas Macías, plays Falla's El sombrero de tres picos, Debussy's La mer and Stravinsky's The Firebird suite at the Jesús Guridi Conservatory. The programme looks at early 20th-century modernism, centred on Paris.

8be28c86b484341c6ff5debe38dab176444284f0.en: Las corrientes, by Milagros Mumenthaler, is screened in Zinema Gaur at Montehermoso. Lina, a 34-year-old fashion professional, gives in to a sudden impulse at a prize ceremony in Switzerland, and an old past surfaces on her return to Buenos Aires.

e9da7b64f4a595f5c993f7fa579aa4252b01ae95.en: Cello Duello, the German cellists Wolfgang Emanuel Schmidt and Jens-Peter Maintz, plays Arkabia with works by Haydn, Offenbach, Servais and Paganini, as part of Martes Musicales 2026-2027. The duo was formed in 1992.

40d027d96c4a7936b52b2c967bd3b2233ba990a4.en: I Baschi alla Biennale 1976/2026 at Artium marks fifty years since Basque artists, filmmakers, musicians and poets presented work at the 1976 Venice Biennale. On 26 November the museum presents an expanded case study with films from 1976.

879c0c43724baf80dc3f47c8bd4d7924c7ef4f54.en: Topafolk, a meeting of traditional and folk music schools, gathers young students from Vitoria-Gasteiz and Álava at the Jesús Guridi Conservatory, as part of Aitzina Folk 2026. Each school plays several pieces, and families learn about the festival.

07bad8fafd688a79b2343a003a2c78ef65e196dc.en: Perforaciones, a family art workshop at Montehermoso on 28 November at 12:00 and 17:30, for children aged 3 to 6 with an adult. Children work with clay and wire to build sculptures. It is free, with limited places.

bf5e62402a1a8590ad622452a746fd8622544c7b.en: A children's workshop in Basque at the Aldabe civic centre library, for ages 7 to 12, led by Alba Tojo. Children make their own artist's book from favourite stories, using printing, drawing and collage. Costs 2 euros for members and 3.40 for non-members.

6b0d89f9612451174edeeb2bda4eeb6bdcdddfeb.en: A danZálava workshop, Cuña dos: Seguir volando en este instante, by Juan Loriente and Nekane Santamaría at Artium, ends with an open showing on Saturday 28 November at 20:00. The festival is run by Zuriñe Benavente and Ignacio Monterrubio.

091bd12163dee246ffad26c0eceb2e8ddbd4b9c9.en: A handmade candle workshop for adults at the Salburua civic centre library, from 11:00 to 13:00, in Castilian, led by Manarte. Participants make a scented decorative candle from wax, fragrance and colour. Costs 2 euros for members and 3.40 for non-members.

26b99ba0a37a383b3b2d2181545271478ed69aec.en: A creative packaging workshop at the Lakua civic centre library, from 10:30 to 13:00, for ages 14 and over. Participants make sustainable wraps, boxes and cards, led by Ainhoa of Idea Papel Tijera. Costs 2.50 euros for members and 4.25 for non-members.

ff3e60837a8ffe13e12df9a8450bc966e8542bd6.en: A Macbeth Song, a show-concert by The Tiger Lillies and La Perla 29 at the Félix Petite, part of the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026. It retells Macbeth as a story of power, guilt and ambition, through live songs and accordions.

75d169e39045a526c1ed75ce30fed30b3b8d7f39.en: Alos Quartet, led by Xabier Zeberio, presents AHOPEKA, an acoustic show of its repertoire with pieces adapted for intimate spaces, as part of Aitzina Folk 2026. The quartet aims to bring the audience close to the music.

fec37b929226f4d19f9a3fcebb530e68a4e861e4.en: Eman mama goxoa, a show by Pantzart at the Iparralde civic centre library, is built on the fantasy of a snack, with dolls and songs. It encourages babies to take part in a shared play atmosphere. Tickets cost 1 euro and go on sale from 23 November.

5da730264d14d536a62a09b4dff9bfb85f618fea.en: Fragile, a post-hardcore band from Angers, France, formed by members of Wild Fox, LANE, Scuffles and Dogs For Friends, plays Sala Jimmy Jazz with Ateri. Its melodic hardcore draws on Drug Church, Turnstile and Touché Amoré.

dce03aa7e16ec8ba8680a1fe933e22b72d1d416a.en: Kokito eta India, a children's show at the Lakua civic centre library, follows Kokito, who has lost something important, with help from India. Aurora Briz and Aitor Vinagret visit during the show. Tickets cost 1 euro and go on sale from 17 November.

b0e15623e021b252bdf7b074ca20d76b23d2a61a.en: Avant que les flammes ne s'éteignent, a 2023 French film by Mehdi Fikri with French subtitles, is screened at Artium on 1 December at 18:30 in the Cinémartium series. After her younger brother dies in a police raid, Malika fights to bring the case to trial.

201fd3df8963c990a33fe00973f8ce0b884d2d82.en: The Martes de Patrimonio talk Un pedazo de cielo cristalizado is given at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa at 19:00, with free entry. It is part of the restoration service's six-talk series.

da137c0a97b808ca118cd3a723be4748fa2b2e22.en: Ukrainian-Austrian pianist Dmytro Choni, born in Kyiv in 1993, plays Arkabia as part of the Martes Musicales 2026-2027 series. He won the Van Cliburn (2022) and Leeds (2021) piano competitions and returns after playing the series in 2019.

59701db3c700d112052ef9d8b75432482b595b09.en: A Bernaola cycle concert in the Aula Magna of the Jesús Guridi Conservatory, showing contemporary music by young composers and performers from the school. The Bernaola Zikloa aims to bring current music to the city in high-quality performances.

34b2210cccea74170d13a74037717917502a26b5.en: A guided visit to the Círculo Vitoriano, Álava's oldest recreational cultural society, founded in 1864. The tour shows rooms that are usually reserved for members, including the library and reading room. It is part of HEI Escuela Abierta de la Ciudadanía.

4ec96b621ce17fb27118becb083b4769d1c694f0.en: A musical storytelling session at the Abetxuko library about a journey through ten magical worlds of the Paradise Machine. It is tender, participatory and funny, with a visit by Perli eta Koxkolo. Tickets cost 1 euro.

46d12db3626b22bc6a341bbbf368466edc2b24e4.en: A family handpan workshop for children aged 8 to 12 with an adult, at the Arriaga civic centre from 18:00 to 19:00, in Castilian, led by Mercury Handpans. Children learn how the instrument is played. It costs 1 euro for members and 1.70 euros for non-members.

fa788efc3e014053b01b5c14beca08065344ebf2.en: Calabobos by Luis Mario, the December book of the contemporary reading club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, meets on Saturday at 11:00 in the Cervera room. A man searches for his sister in a rainy Cantabrian village before the high tide.

dc1e235dae934b685fdce44a3572200302cc3342.en: Rojo Nieve by Musaloka Kolektiboa, at the Teatro Jesús Ibáñez de Matauco as part of the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026, tells a massacre through the eyes of two clown bakers who play with dough. It mixes tenderness, darkness and absurdity.

09acb157817b108df001efa1ccd4f9d067a1ec59.en: Olaia Inziarte plays an intimate acoustic concert at the IAK Izaskun Arrue cultural centre, in a small format that adapts to different spaces. Her songs centre on everyday Basque and seek strength in vulnerability.

6eb4c2914d19624fccd7168b24097b45958bdba3.en: Kinky Bwoy, a reggae and dancehall artist from Spain, plays Sala Jimmy Jazz with fresh, urban and danceable songs.

6da98e683cbc69bf73875f3809b1dac50b4231ae.en: Cosmic Sessions Vol. VII takes place at Sala Jimmy Jazz on 5 December, with Akauzazte, Frente Abierto and Ustel.

dc93b72c2c72ddbb7ca38a22d4c0987d8cd9633f.en: Saurom, a rock band with folk, Celtic, traditional music and metal influences, plays Sala Jimmy Jazz on Sunday 6 December. Its lyrics draw on legends, poems and traditional tales.

26607b2d25ccf127616e21fa5da8b84fe88f1252.en: Atlas, a journey with singer-songwriter Aurora Briz through the sounds of an open diary, her beach, motherhood and history, accompanied by her guitar India. It is held at the Zabalgana library. Tickets cost 1 euro.

9964e6cefed1839e6fa173852479cd786957cc6b.en: Atlas de anatomía, a solo dance piece with a live choir at the Félix Petite, part of the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026. It reflects on the lineages the body holds, mixing bastard flamenco with Latin and Afro-Latin dance.

8cff9cefa4b53ec6b46c4fa1dbd80eb6f0cdd8cd.en: Katakunba, a new quarterly comedy show by IAK, features monologues in Basque by Leo Bueriberi, Lander Varona and Eñaut Zuazo, with two special guests. It is staged at the Izaskun Arrue cultural centre.

446dacd293c55068e44cd769640a6bb083a31715.en: Armenian, a System of a Down tribute band from Zaragoza that has played since 2006, marks the 20th anniversary of Mezmerize and Hypnotize at Urban Rock Concept with hits such as Chop Suey and Toxicity.

eb09bafc594dce6ea0b9694d68ec027fbdf0fa48.en: Sho-Hai, a rapper and songwriter from Zaragoza, is one of Spain's leading hip-hop figures, known for direct, witty lyrics that mix reflection, social critique and humour. He plays Sala Jimmy Jazz, and tickets are on sale.

66ea83695ebd0b6c9b8171fdb3630ae17a15f2f0.en: Utopía by Thomas More, in the classic reading club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, criticises early modern European society through an alternative political structure. It is discussed on 12 December at 11:00 in the Cervera room.

94a49b04903c1cc4c3cef8d1a85a9f81e81a772b.en: Elkaar Ensemble performs Herri ahotsak at the Museo de Bellas Artes de Álava as part of Sábados Musicales 2026. Entry is free with an invitation, and one invitation covers a child and an adult.

e1b26665d35dbd4dc90453982aeba268937117dc.en: Metalaskala Fest 2026 takes place at Sala Jimmy Jazz on 12 December with Any Given Day from Germany, Promkinks from Madrid and Name Off from Vitoria-Gasteiz. Any Given Day presents its latest album, Limitless.

af545edc8dd02be8f9cef79358f680f550f1d70e.en: Amorante, the project of ethnomusicologist Iban Urizar, plays live over Hitchcock's The Birds at Arkabia as part of Dirdir 2026. The film keeps Bernard Herrmann's score, made with a trautonium, which Amorante reinterprets.

3802097306afbd30f2923846fea45f435aac2c8f.en: A Metal Gaua Festibala 2026 takes place at Urban Rock Concept on 12 December with Retador, The Kraven and Wojtyla.

3bd27e81f3503e9a4e5b8dbf7d4ab578ffd76f32.en: Migrazioa, bidaia ahatezina, a family film in Basque at the Izaskun Arrue cultural centre, follows the Mallard family of ducks. Pam persuades her husband Mack to travel south to Jamaica, via New York, after meeting migrating ducks.

e916081d1c21efb79cad1331d3d893198677c63b.en: Stone, a multidisciplinary meeting at Sala Jimmy Jazz, closes the tenth-anniversary programme of the danZálava dance festival with Bernaola Zikloa. It celebrates a decade of research into the body and movement, built on improvisation.

0997c30ace21a2a7f0a617ae476ea6d040fcbbe3.en: Ilargiaren alaba by Toti Martínez de Lezea is the 1 December book of the Narrativas de lo fantástico club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. Madalen learns that some women have been arrested for witchcraft in her village.

66cbfb4651780affc622e6e0dfbd5d871f49da98.en: Gordas, lisiadas y mamarrachas, a comedy show with Coria Castillo and Anna Marchessi, at the Zabalgana civic centre at 19:00 in Castilian. It asks why some people are treated differently. Free, with registration until 17 November.

82a0940462fd70df20a9c749bc434a7fda10dc4e.en: La vuelta a casa, performed by Irtaxe Gallardo at the Ariznabarra civic centre library, tells of Berta, who returns to her village after an urgent message from her sister. She confronts what she fled. Tickets cost 1 euro.

66ce127d78e0adaa75f5e4647dac80115bab1bb6.en: The Euskadiko Orkestra plays Guridi's Diez melodías vascas, Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 22 with Elisabeth Leonskaja, and Elgar's Enigma Variations under Marzena Diakun at the Jesús Guridi Conservatory, marking 90 years of the first Basque government.

0b51f9a060a99d06e19e30a544b28f9fb35b4a0b.en: A charisma workshop at the El Pilar library from 18:00 to 19:30, led by Cris Etxepare, based on her book Carisma. It offers simple tools for communication and confidence. Costs 1.50 euros for members and 2.50 for non-members.

d3dbcec9cc6ee64279fc55588715c9efbc1b33b4.en: A family workshop for children aged 4 to 8 with an adult, at the Salburua civic centre library from 17:30 to 19:00, led by Manarte. Participants shape polymer clay into keyrings, magnets and bookmarks. Costs 1.50 euros for members and 2.50 for non-members.

fb1fac25b8de0c7b0a2c3df12a3659021ce2b2a6.en: A workshop for adults at the Arriaga civic centre from 11:00 to 13:00, in Castilian, led by Jaio Deco. Participants decorate reused wood with five techniques and two protective finishes. Costs 2 euros for members and 3.40 for non-members.

eba180ba32bc6b8c267ca1b4e08409df85b06932.en: A free guided walk at the Museo de Bellas Artes on Vitoria-Gasteiz's colonial and slavery heritage, including the monument to explorer Manuel Iradier. Guides are activists from Contrapunto Decolonial. Registration is open until 12 December.

fe6743043ad7e78e2d2f0bc1673c785bdd6dbdae.en: Leonora, a poetic approach to the surrealist painter Leonora Carrington, at the Félix Petite in the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026. It focuses on her youth and her time in Spain after the Civil War, with an accessible performance.

0efc776bfa81918b6ecaffef98dff67614357e16.en: Lurdes Iriondo, ez gera alferrik pasako, a 72-minute documentary by Inge Mendioroz, is screened at the Izaskun Arrue cultural centre as a Kulturklik special. It shows singer Lurdes Iriondo's work for the Basque language and culture, especially for children.

4ed9f5ac0d1b4fe65d59058205d5b23a614eaf06.en: Peiremans+, the pop project of Gorka Urbizu (Berri Txarrak), Imanol Ubeda, Marino Goñi and Txiki, plays Sala Jimmy Jazz on 16 and 17 December. The band, whose last studio EP came out ten years ago, then announces another long break.

1d11768a7ea989b3031a7519ebf8a9e94f2f9d84.en: Cumbres Borrascosas by Emily Brontë is the 17 December romance book at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, led by Marta Lobo, in the Cervera room at 19:00. The story of revenge and passion follows Heathcliff across the Yorkshire moors.

2f4b591ceaf882492a6851b07f99a28a32bd576e.en: La ley innata, a Candlelight concert in Vitoria-Gasteiz played by a string quartet, includes Dulce introducción al caos, Si te vas and a flamenco coda. It lasts 60 minutes and is for ages 8 and over, with under-16s accompanied by an adult.

4e1d0c4f7a7cb0f6daed73cbda48bed9087d149b.en: A Candlelight concert of Coldplay and Imagine Dragons hits, played by a string quartet in Vitoria-Gasteiz. The programme includes Clocks, Viva la Vida, Radioactive and Believer. It lasts 60 minutes and is for ages 8 and over.

1972582792d5060740a9ffd203655b6acc947242.en: HOFE presents Bihotzak badaki (El corazón lo sabe) at Sala Jimmy Jazz on 18 December, with Labar. The album mixes very different songs, with singles such as R.A., Tan petit and Esto no es amor with Natalia Lacunza.

beb37652705c204de9dec91d90edcf1eb71b557a.en: Iber Rock Tributos, a party of more than three hours at Sala Kubik, features two tribute bands: Amor Castúo to Extremoduro and Perros Verdes to Marea. Perros Verdes' singer Álvaro has one of the closest voices to Marea's leader, Kutxi Romero.

43acccbba9e236458ddfa9de181f8f1dd9ab848c.en: Anestesia celebrates the 30th anniversary of their album Erantzun with a special tour, and one of its concerts is at Sala Jimmy Jazz on 19 December.

77f6bbd677ea5839c69c0d7339aa7c9b2f6c3952.en: Cat o' nine tales by Jeffrey Archer is the 21 December book of the English club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, at 19:00 in the Orisol room. Its 12 tales, many written in prison, mix crime and emotion with surprise endings.

93d2145141578a427bec151e67642fd2e44d83c6.en: Segis, also known as Segismundo Toxicómano, is a punk-rock band from Vitoria-Gasteiz playing Sala Jimmy Jazz on 25 and 26 December. Its powerful, direct sound comes with protest lyrics.

500c19dbbf3224964bc2fd2480372819bcc6795e.en: Clásicos Navideños, a Candlelight concert in Vitoria-Gasteiz played by a string quartet, features Christmas classics such as Corelli's Christmas Concerto, Adam's O Holy Night and Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker suite. It lasts 60 minutes and is for ages 8 and over.

ed9ecefb6b0b1d4cdbfab2e9583556f60d9900c1.en: Txopet from Bilbao and Mirotz from Vitoria-Gasteiz play the IAK room on 26 December. Txopet has played festivals such as Bilbao BBK Live and Azkena Rock Festival. Mirotz, a three-piece, presents its first release with melodic bass and drums.

48637186b1ae793bdc88d1e6d161098149717fc1.en: A Candlelight concert of Christmas film soundtracks, played by a string quartet in Vitoria-Gasteiz. It includes White Christmas, Jingle Bell Rock, Carol of the Bells and All I Want for Christmas Is You. It lasts 60 minutes and is for ages 8 and over.

b50a8316c34e871c92128bf716b3ddd511e1e167.en: La Txama, a Pamplona band mixing cumbia, punk rock and Basque music, and Sedientos de Cumbia, a Pamplona cumbia band formed in 2024, play Sala Jimmy Jazz on 2 January. Sedientos de Cumbia released its first album, BIENDESED, in 2026.

b4d455a77710a97691a1fb41202090f9802b1391.en: KOP, Rat-Zinger and Against You play Sala Jimmy Jazz in Vitoria-Gasteiz on 8 January.

28d8914db7dec6998b0759f1901bba23f4ecadcb.en: La Frontera, the Spanish rock band that started in 1985 with the song Duelo al Sol, plays Helldorado with Los Misterios. Its tenth album, Tu Revolución, produced by Carlos Narea, came after three years away.

7e21fc0d52094c0464ba90249ddc3ca315c23472.en: EZEZEZ and Sal del Coche play Sala Jimmy Jazz in Vitoria-Gasteiz on 9 January.

7e77121474ec3bd29b45283fff718b11c5439f69.en: Los chicos del cementerio by Aiden Thomson is the 12 January book of the Narrativas de lo fantástico club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. Yadriel, a young nahualo, summons a spirit that turns out to be Julián Díaz, the school's bad boy.

f4164200a84c33efcabbe22ca89db0684784eef6.en: Paul Goodwin conducts the Euskadiko Orkestra in Bach Inspirazio at the Jesús Guridi Conservatory, reinventing Bach through works by Elgar, Webern, Vaughan Williams, Holst and Villa-Lobos. The programme ends with Bachianas Brasileiras No. 2.

76bb75512ce8f52d94391c4cc39a4739c9067b3b.en: The Trío Salduie, formed in 2000 in Zaragoza, plays a programme of Spanish music by Basque composers and others linked to the Basque Country at Arkabia, as part of Martes Musicales 2026-2027. The trio has recorded five albums.

803275b2e4c1f1f5c5681eb6adc058198f196af9.en: Únicos, a contemporary dance show in the Vitoria-Gasteiz International Theatre Festival 2026, follows two children who recognise themselves as unique. It asks how identity is shaped, and it won the FETEN 2026 award for best dance show.

558d169fd3c35dbea0973c176fb2abe071edd35a.en: Garazi Navas and Tunipanea play at Montehermoso as part of Klaustro Sounds 2026. Tunipanea builds experimental instruments and automatons, Navas plays the accordion, and their duo creates complex, shifting textures.

500209be97ded7328265a94a34dd1691850973b5.en: Clownsulta-3 by Auskalhop, part of Auzo Eszena 2026 at the Zabalgana civic centre, has short scenes set in a health centre, with a magician nurse, a singer and Death playing hide-and-seek. Tickets are sold until 13 December.

df1807aaebce016e76beefc94d3743398c8f92e6.en: The Jury Experience: Muerte por IA, at the Teatro Jesús Ibáñez de Matauco, asks the audience to act as jurors in a trial over a self-driving car that caused a death. Viewers weigh the evidence and vote on who is guilty.

9fb95c8536340a71faba52b9a4038175997d3a58.en: Memorias habladas, memorias armadas, the memoirs of Concha Méndez collected by her granddaughter Paloma, is the 14 December session of the Lyceum Club book club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. The poet freed herself from her time's taboos.

c571de93bfea1e54031bdb0fa659ae0c97da73e5.en: La voie royale by Frédéric Mermoud, a 2023 French film with French subtitles, is screened at Artium on 15 December at 18:30. Sophie leaves her family farm for a science prep class, aiming for the Polytechnique in a fierce competition.

8a48292e83cecfd7f9bf3ebdb6d3c55e0a204185.en: The Bizan Gala, a collaboration between the Municipal Band and the Bizan senior centres, features the Goizargi Gospel Choir led by Ramon Escalé. The programme includes works by Donald Lawrence, Kirk Franklin and Fred Hammond at the Palacio de Congresos Europa.

ae48c83fefb688ae351f620a607b131298c64c8f.en: Tenor Marcelo Solís and pianist José Luis Onieva perform Italian opera arias from Handel to Puccini at Arkabia, as part of the Martes Musicales 2026-2027 series. The route runs from London to Rome, with Mozart, Verdi and others.

c6732a3a316bf544b66b61c0354946924cbe20cf.en: A book presentation of Arabako euskara. Gasteizko aldaera at the Izaskun Arrue cultural centre. The book, by Aitor Arana Luzuriaga, offers a dictionary and short grammar of the Basque spoken in Vitoria-Gasteiz.

7b7e7c00cdfc4f8ab49419a4fcc309510230e635.en: Proyecto Hail Mary by Andy Weir is the 16 December session of the science fiction club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, in Spanish at 19:00. Ryland Grace wakes from a coma far from Earth, and must save humanity.

bef044e8c2fd63dff06108b9d5e31e428c836faf.en: The Municipal Band's concert El alma y la trascendencia, conducted by Luis Orduña with the Goizargi Gospel Choir and Ramón Escalé on Hammond organ, is held at the Palacio de Congresos Europa. It includes Healed and Wade in the Water.

fa9bbf14e50206f1cc60ee6b978a61f89087879b.en: Patrizioak eta plebeioak by Kepa Altonaga is discussed in the Gasteizko Irakurle Kluba reading club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. The club meets monthly to read and discuss books in Basque, and turns 25 this year.

bca1f17e81ca6e119182386eb04f1b39458b5e31.en: La voz de los objetos rechazados, Tunipanea's concert-exhibition at Artium on 19 December at 17:00, uses experimental instruments made from furniture legs and tins. It is for children aged 6 and over with an adult, and entry is free.

e977d4bf9b074034f41beb8c2ca0b4f996375b65.en: El milagro de Helen Keller, by Towanda, is staged at the Zabalgana civic centre as part of Auzo Eszena 2026. Anne Sullivan, a governess marked by her own past, arrives at the life of Helen Keller, a girl trapped in silence and darkness.

db90481b408665bb8a8cf1b6ece8a20a60e5628d.en: Punto de araña by Nerea Pallarés is the January book of the contemporary reading club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, meeting on Saturdays at 11:00. Ari arrives in Camariñas to run its lace museum, unaware of what the women have decided.

5fc4c997631f5b0f3e39a8c4ec4be653152ff720.en: Dzast Ahotsak, a choir of about 30 singers directed by Jabolo Sagastume, performs at the water-tank hall of the Montehermoso Cultural Centre as part of Bernaola. Its programme of works by Arvo Pärt and Veljo Tormis suits a very reverberant space.

9c78fa79fe60fe90af9b37583b4f93ee1e86e08d.en: Doña Jimena Díaz de Vivar by María Teresa León is the 11 January book of the Lyceum Club reading group at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. The biography follows Rodrigo and Jimena Díaz de Vivar through love, battles and exile.

d5c7d4e0bfadc523396e898c13cdc98fcbab9b48.en: The Flying Rebollos, a rock and roll band formed in Portugalete in 1990, reunited in 2025 and play Helldorado on 26 December with EH, Mertxe. A new album is planned for spring 2027.

58a021ed6ff83bb95124f570c50f1ceb2e15bab8.en: Kokonutt by Miren Amuriza is the 15 January session of the children's reading club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, in Basque, for children born in 2015 or 2016. Each session unlocks one of six keys to a mysterious box.

6227b80e74b045cf68548de52c7398d649aa8d41.en: The band Mescalina, formed in 2024 by musicians with long touring experience, pays tribute on 15 January at Urban Rock Concept to Maná, Jarabe de Palo and Los Rodríguez.

5a1d198d7030caed0d4a7a59e2b3b1ba27669c72.en: Band Jovi, a Bon Jovi tribute band, plays Sala Jimmy Jazz on 15 January.

599e8e186f9941183b7ebe55abbc3755b814d1c0.en: La religiosa by Denis Diderot is the 16 January book of the classic reading club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. The novel satirises convent life through a girl forced to become a nun. Sessions are on Saturdays at 11:00 in the Cervera room.

54fa97c444fcdd5eb875f24c7baf2ecc1b1cb1d3.en: Josetxu Piperrak, leader of the punk group Piperrak, plays Sala Jimmy Jazz with Manifa, a punk rock band from Bizkaia formed in 2003, and Shöck, formed in Bilbao in 2015.

21298f8516c8708f1f92836e22d6dddb084a0b01.en: Zetak, the Navarrese band led by Pello Reparaz, presents its new show Km0 at the Buesa Arena on 16, 22 and 23 January 2027. Tickets for 22 and 23 January have sold out, and those for 16 January go on sale on the group's website.

61395cb8add2b0970ac65f40344c7766a19af23a.en: Sonografia irudipenak, a Bernaola cycle piece at the Izaskun Arrue cultural centre by Manu Gaigne and Garazi Navas, uses old audio and video recordings from across the Basque Country alongside new field recordings.

fdf44f9abe48d612afd1c4897d1c8ddc6bdbc1be.en: Violinist Tianwa Yang and pianist Nicholas Rimmer pay tribute to Pablo de Sarasate at Arkabia, as part of Martes Musicales 2026-2027. Yang has recorded Sarasate's complete works for violin, and the programme includes works by Dvorak, Popper and Saint-Saëns.

9075bdc86e5b6c8c102bbf6a016dca748ee52556.en: Saltonautas by Jingfang Hao is the 20 January book of the science fiction club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. Three young scientists from a divided Earth race to make first contact with an alien species heading for the solar system.

f5b10e0f440ba135c369a43be1e7d1d4e12d7b1d.en: Christina Rosenvinge's film concert at Arkabia, part of Dirdir 2026, looks back at her work composing film soundtracks and her acting career. She is joined by Amaia Miranda, León Sierra, Charly Bautista and Xerach Peñate.

9c1647c3938c2cf298c81884825a61103230cc93.en: Esto No Es Rock Radical Vasco at Sala Kubik on 23 January features tribute acts to La Polla, Eskorbuto and Kortatu: Hasta la Polla, Los Demenciales Chicos Acelerados and Aizu.

16aca2dac87bd86dc6d288ac67b67a8f884f3962.en: Restos from Austin, Texas, and The Pink Stones from Athens, Georgia, tour Spain together in January 2027, with a stop at Helldorado. Restos blend folk-rock and psychedelia, while The Pink Stones mix cosmic country, folk, soul and psychedelic rock.

134a675eaa171577d00dfc4a711824c0443ba79d.en: Eñaut Elorrieta presents his fifth album, Festina Lente, recorded with musicians from The National, at Sala Jimmy Jazz. The tour also celebrates 30 years since his first song with Ken Zazpi, and he will play some of his best-known songs.

d73fbc3475c46ab546832e5d247afe68f96ef6a0.en: Punchclock, a trio close to punk rock with clarinettist and singer Isabelle Duthoit, percussionist Steve Heather and guitarist Andy Moor, plays Sala Jimmy Jazz as part of Bernaola. Raw guitars and tribal drums build into a storm and then a silence.

8f5b070e27252159888bfccdbc9385586f8efc86.en: Salbaiak, a work for string orchestra by Trigger String Orchestra, describes eight landscapes of the Basque Country, from east to west, using only acoustic instruments. It is part of Klaustro Sounds 2027 at the Montehermoso cloister.

930a53bebe7f0d70879c5ffae1f7fe89f81bf222.en: Perfume by Patrick Suskind is the 25 January book of the English club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. Jean-Baptiste Grenouille, born without scent but with an extraordinary sense of smell, commits terrible crimes to capture the essence of his victims.

0953309bc04ad7a2686b3a04897afe24547ddf58.en: Gerezi denbora by Montserrat Roig is the book for a Gasteizko Irakurle Kluba 2026-2027 session at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. The club, coordinated by Iban Zalduak, meets monthly to read and discuss books in Basque, and turns 25 this year.

49230392669484c95381e996c4e001322214afd7.en: Flawless by Elsie Silver is the 28 January book of the romance club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. Set in Chestnut Springs, a small town of grumpy cowboys, it tells of a romance that begins with a shared bed.

ea8d3d566e9ea4acead6966e87e322adbdeffb03.en: A free walking tour of Zabalgana, Barrios con Historia, from 10:00 to 13:00, led by historian Kristina Pozo Sevilla. It looks at how migration shaped the neighbourhood's streets and cultures. Registration runs until 30 January 2027.

5a9e31554fd98249b7d026cbda25b0fdb79e2b04.en: David Guapo's family comedy show, #Quenonosfrunjanlafiesta, at Sala Kubik mixes music, acting and improvisation. He talks about family life, couples and technology, and invites audience interaction.

97dabd1ab0db500ea2376aea146f51d486eec586.en: The trio MUJERES and the band Fastasmage play Sala Jimmy Jazz in Vitoria-Gasteiz on 30 January.

7bc3a106c5fe0fcc252a8b61209eb673f73f427b.en: The Only Good Indians by Stephen Graham Jones is the 2 February book of the Narrativas de lo fantástico club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. Men who once broke a tribal taboo by hunting on the elders' land are pursued one by one.

3cb9ade1ed866ee66d84db0665976492da053458.en: The Euskadiko Orkestra, under Philipp von Steinaecker with violinist Akiko Suwanai, plays Schumann's Genoveva Overture and Fourth Symphony and Prokofiev's First Violin Concerto at the Jesús Guridi Conservatory.

988cf2c540dc75c7a31144dcfa00264fb2646140.en: Pianist and composer Michael Andreas Häringer, born in Barcelona to German parents, plays Beethoven's Appassionata Sonata, Schubert's Impromptu and works by Chopin, Liszt and Debussy at Arkabia, as part of Martes Musicales 2026-2027.

d3fbbbdf8deac2816418413a5732bb7d2521333e.en: 500 Noches presents Sabina en las Venas at Sala Jimmy Jazz, a tribute to Joaquín Sabina led by singer Darío Luís.

9931a96a8192b14728b14e1dc0b027bba6713896.en: Tanxugueiras, a Galician trio mixing traditional music with contemporary sounds, plays Sala Jimmy Jazz in Vitoria-Gasteiz on 6 February 2027.

b46e5be6105f9993372326e456d6b9472479c335.en: Rosalía de Castro: Raíz apasionada de Galicia by Luisa Carnés is the 8 February book of the Lyceum Club reading group at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. The biography follows the Galician poet from her childhood in Padrón to the death of her mother.

2b176036d2ee12ad88b00539bc68fbfaa8ff7787.en: Indiana by George Sand is the 13 February book of the classic reading club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, led by Leire Ibáñez de Gauna. A young woman in a loveless marriage falls for a charming aristocrat, and the novel questions unfair marriage laws.

b8497394b1487402ab7b3f3d5a0f09b0d1a89aba.en: Metamorfosis, a percussion concert by Carlota Cáceres at the Jesús Guridi Conservatory as part of the Bernaola cycle, explores change through multi-percussion, from the body to the landscape and from acoustic to electronic sound.

ac071ef9aa391aa2ff1fa2d80bf950df8b9b5b82.en: Toundra, the instrumental rock band formed in Madrid in 2007, plays Sala Jimmy Jazz with Medalla and Caballo Muerte. Its new album, Siete, explores freer sounds with analogue electronics.

f7e876a7e50d3e34240ed86220e0542897c05cf8.en: A percussion concert by Carlota Cáceres at the Jesús Guridi Conservatory, organised with the Bernaola cycle as part of the Musikagileak 2026-2027 circuit. The programme includes works by Kaija Saariaho, Lei Liang and Aurelio Edler-Copes.

7d4ca2bf17ac6244cf7bdb570db0a4ee73d09a9c.en: Koldo Uriarte's film music concert, Filmetarako musika, at Montehermoso as part of Klaustro Sounds 2027, features a quartet with projections by Xavi Vitoria. Uriarte composed the music for Juanma Bajo Ulloa's film Baby.

a5d91d1678e1114bb71c5d1eaf486ef15acc0d39.en: A Martes Musicales concert at Arkabia by students of Musikene, the higher music school of the Basque Country, as part of Martes Musicales 2026-2027. Artists and works will be announced later.

2672e3d74eb06aa8f1726699247ada4112155932.en: Hyperion by Dan Simmons is the 17 February book of the science fiction club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. Seven pilgrims travel to the world of Hyperion before Armageddon, carrying hopes and secrets.

8f2c776ae688ba17e71685e5df2b9fcace72804a.en: James by Percival Everett is the 26 January book of the American literature club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, at 19:00 in the Amaritu room. James, an enslaved man who can read, escapes after being sold and travels with Huck.

f12c42447a0688aaac2cd0af104d0653faa61a06.en: A social theatre project, Un barrio para todas, at Ariznabarra, with 12 sessions in early 2027, led by PorPol Teatro. Residents use documentary theatre to examine barriers to living together and accessibility. It is free, with registration until 31 March.

350425f8e24d1582415b868738d1c5fe788a6507.en: Catálogo de aves muertas by Ernesto Carrión is the 4 February book of the contemporary club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. After biologist Elisa dies in a crash, her husband and son camp at the lakes of Ozogoche to seek answers.

4c3ab3ee91d4483e368746cb5fec54f99318a4d0.en: El universo interior, a Municipal Band concert at the Palacio de Congresos Europa with guest conductor Renata Oliveira and violinist David Martínez, explores memory, change and hope. It includes A Brussels Requiem by Bert Appermont.

c36c685a28d401440e9c2533e02db60616ed32b1.en: The Gasteizko Irakurle Kluba 2026-2027 reading club session on Kontra by Ane Zubeldia, at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. The club, coordinated by Iban Zalduak, meets monthly to read and discuss books in Basque and turns 25 this year.

168713220ea40c2054277f67ae041c7ee4756648.en: Korri, Kuru, Korri by Patxi Zubizarreta is the 19 February session of the children's reading club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, in Basque, for children born in 2015 or 2016. Six sessions unlock a mystery, one key at a time.

b702639ed3f94d6a12b23459b51311e94d7c0e14.en: Clearwater Creedence Revival, a Creedence Clearwater Revival tribute led by vocalist Peter Barton, plays Helldorado. Its veteran British rock musicians recreate the swamp rock sound with hits such as Proud Mary and Fortunate Son.

a3af17e99bf9d92bf28a8f29abd74c01e045fed8.en: Gasteiz in Metal 2026 takes place at Urban Rock Concept on 20 February with the bands Delion, WildHärd and Aeroscreamer.

2d428eada9180d93266642adce551f618fc724d6.en: KOMA, a metal band formed in Pamplona in 1995 with a groove and heavy metal sound, plays Sala Jimmy Jazz with its show Enemigos del silencio. The band has released several albums.

790087e876326c58eaa0a4c4b62c910fae5bb7b8.en: Our Souls at Night by Kent Haruf is the 22 February book of the English club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. Two widowed neighbours in Holt, Colorado, start spending their nights together against loneliness and find a second chance at love.

1a034973165a38b23a023f3c66eb055e00197fb1.en: Mezzo-soprano Mireia Pintó and pianist Vladislav Bronevetzky present Cabaret songs at Arkabia, with French and American cabaret pieces by Poulenc, Satie, Weill, Britten and Bolcom, as part of Martes Musicales 2026-2027.

61e2dd68894572d40946e6ad79d3bb51fee156d7.en: La casa en el mar más azul by TJ Klune is the 25 February book of the romance club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. Linus Baker, a civil servant of the Department of Magical Youth, is sent to supervise an orphanage with few records.

34ee46839df16adea3b2d1455c89b464eee8ca3e.en: Silueta by Harkaitz Cano is the book for a Gasteizko Irakurle Kluba 2026-2027 session at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. The club meets monthly to read and discuss books in Basque, and this year it marks its 25th anniversary.

f1a933177cea459ab9155ce985d3607f97d49204.en: A 60-minute Candlelight concert in Vitoria-Gasteiz with a string quartet, featuring Coldplay and Ed Sheeran songs such as Clocks, Bad Habits, Shivers and Viva la Vida. It is for ages 8 and over, and under-16s must be accompanied.

716e9688b1dca506abc95b77b794832c0c4cbe08.en: Numen presents its album Erre, a traditional and melodic black metal work, at Sala Kubik with Nashgul, a grindcore and death metal band formed in A Coruña in 2001. Nashgul released Santa Cruz Sessions for its 25th anniversary.

184818b864be10e8a238a1ac3bab799fa575177b.en: Ara Malikian plays the Buesa Arena on 27 February. His violin moves from classical music to rock, flamenco and Middle Eastern melodies, in a show that mixes humour and emotion.

a9d75766dfacbd44086fc8d38346bfce5816c787.en: Trío Zukan, a trio of txistu, accordion and percussion, plays the Izaskun Arrue cultural centre as part of Bernaola. Since its birth in 2014, composers such as María Eugenia Luc and Zuriñe F. Gerenabarrena have written works for the group.

6b688d1c3f70d2b2c2cadd419eda90c6e293405f.en: An AntiRumores lab at the Zabalgana civic centre on 2, 9 and 16 March 2027, from 18:30 to 20:00, led by Leticia Urretabizkaia. It is for people who want to reflect on privilege, power and anti-racism, and to design a community action together. Free.

74f9737f09a6fd65d0ae330a86f4a8c542cd3766.en: El núcleo del sol by Johanna Sinisalo is the 12 March book of the Narrativas de lo fantástico club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. In a totalitarian Finland, the state breeds a submissive human subspecies, and the most independent women are sterilised.

b021d3b0f28d38c586a5313da69e31dda561d429.en: A Martes Musicales concert at Arkabia by students of the Jesús Guridi Conservatory, as part of Martes Musicales 2026-2027. Artists and works will be announced later.

c84e708e268a793c6ddec0a06fba5a90480b22f1.en: El monte de las furias by Fernanda Trías is the 4 March book of the contemporary club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. A woman who guards the edge of a mountain finds a body in her garden, and she and the warden decide to bury it.

785cd645ef391e1b26eb84d1a0e6fd8471b73299.en: El Rollo de Siempre, a tribute festival, comes to Sala Kubik for the first time with two shows: a tribute to Extremoduro and a tribute to Platero y Tú and Fito & Fitipaldis. The night is dedicated to Spanish rock classics.

a6f0c11c8eb1620c48a4f2753335b20b520b339d.en: The Mandelring Quartett plays América at Arkabia, as part of Martes Musicales 2026-2027. The programme pairs Dvorak's American Quartet and a selection of his Humoresques with arrangements of jazz classics.

6ca72dbc4e245b43c1bacecd8d52043bc9f8eb1c.en: Benetako zirkua by Karmele Mitxelena is the 12 March session of the children's reading club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, in Basque, for children born in 2015 or 2016. Six sessions unlock a mystery, one key at a time.

85cee95e9a7fcb0b652a11863722da2c6a3fe60c.en: Levitants, an alternative rock band from Valladolid that combines post-punk with synthesiser atmospheres, plays a Vermut Sessions show at Helldorado.

4d43fcc5c3b66f1c82b4eb46abf516b551048d9e.en: ETS will play ETXEAN at the Buesa Arena on 13 March 2027, a 360-degree show with the stage at the centre. Its 30,000 presale tickets sold out in under 24 hours, and it is presented as the largest Basque-language gathering in Álava.

cd86fe2c36c26ca43f2e5269190ca50b2a8b057a.en: Mursego, the solo project of cellist Maite Arroitajauregi, presents LAU at Montehermoso as part of Klaustro Sounds 2027. The show questions the boundaries between concert and performance, music and visuals.

9fc23b5150162f7b53144aafd404fc2e94f675e8.en: Cántico inútil by Ernestina de Champourcin, published in 1936, is the 15 March book of the Lyceum Club reading group at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. The collection is seen as the peak of a period of great creation.

3f375ca1d9cb2255b9e57be83846219acc73d2f8.en: Amerika, a Euskadiko Orkestra concert at the Jesús Guridi Conservatory with Venezuelan trumpeter Pacho Flores under Manuel Hernández-Silva. It moves through tangos, milongas and Latin American works, including Gershwin's An American in Paris.

efb4609a94f950b5ec80aeb2d7d4ebae7a1d2293.en: Camerata Nordica, Sweden's main chamber orchestra, founded in 1974, plays Mozart's Sextet K. 364 and Tchaikovsky's Souvenir de Florence at Arkabia, as part of Martes Musicales 2026-2027.

87fbe5dfd0d1135a409cea379ddf646255d25abc.en: La glándula de Ícaro by Anna Starobinets is the 17 March book of the science fiction club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. Its stories portray a wavering humanity, with science, religion and passion turned into a dystopia close to reality.

2161427d99b172123976e5cbec850a7a11f0bdad.en: Un cuento perfecto by Elísabet Benavent is the 18 March book of the romance club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, led by Marta Lobo. A woman who has everything and a young man with nothing share a love story between success and doubt.

6edb17b5c72be84c94c045cd7316ea0cd8cfb525.en: Auzozine, a film forum at the Arriaga civic centre at 18:00, uses cinema to discuss human rights and citizen participation from a feminist perspective linking the Global North and South. It is led by Helena González of Zinhezba, with free entry.

f433dced3bcdf4e10d75ef9ba7f32f5b0add29e2.en: Linkoln Park, a Linkin Park tribute at Sala Jimmy Jazz, covers the band's discography and pays special tribute to Minutes to Midnight, whose 20th anniversary falls in May.

45259e4938e3f6818d605a8786ac41a69e54da40.en: Las medias rojas y otros cuentos feministas by Emilia Pardo Bazán is the 20 March book of the classic reading club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. The stories criticise the situation of women in 19th-century Spain.

30e0d509e2ec8227f2d346a69a9ede4b14afbe0e.en: Ceremonia by Leslie Marmon is the 23 March book of the American literature club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. Tayo, a war veteran of mixed Laguna Pueblo ancestry, makes a healing journey to overcome his trauma and find his identity.

33faa1171fecc5be081f68e84e7af101ff6edbda.en: The Osimun Quartet, a saxophone quartet, plays Let the music speak at Arkabia in two parts, with works by Bach, Beethoven, Seara, Ligeti and Conneson. It is part of Martes Musicales 2026-2027.

9eeb63a3b9ab46616363f8dc1cb59befc6fa37dd.en: Belako, a Biscayan indie rock and post-punk band, plays Sala Jimmy Jazz with Aiko el Grupo. Their sound mixes powerful guitars, electronic beats and high energy on stage.

51b022a5f87dcf14c071c3c126b3f2469c95c9db.en: Raíces, a Municipal Band concert at the Palacio de Congresos Europa, includes Pompeii by José Alberto Pina, Trencadís by Bert Appermont and Khachaturian's Viuda Valenciana. It also features Volver a la montaña by Shelley Hanson.

f4208deb97af12ca5890624f5d2f387b0778323d.en: A reading club for racialised people and those with migration experience, led by Victoria Rodríguez at the Amaritu room on 15 March and 19 April 2027. The books include Papusza by Bronisława Wajs and Reni Eddo-Lodge's essay on racism.

e57c9f506b061e1d8bc0b15b4ff5924b7732a978.en: The Awakening by Kate Chopin is the 22 March book of the English club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, at 19:00 in the Orisol room. It follows a woman whose unconventional views on motherhood clash with the norms of the 19th-century American South.

a28f6795d2798edf4503685f5217e054e5cb824e.en: Sueños y emociones, a Municipal Band concert at the Palacio de Congresos Europa directed by Luis Orduña, with Musikene collaborating. It includes Bert Appermont's The Cross & The Crown and a premiere by Guillermo Lauzurika.

e32c6fe37720d04b35516eccb9beafc47f7967ed.en: Bisita by Mikel Pagadi is the 6 April book of the Narrativas de lo fantástico club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. Aliens land in a field between two farmhouses in Anoeta, in the Basque Country, and the locals must decide what to do.

a9904cb70c3298622dc5c8ae77ca6a12b1c0de77.en: Animales luminosos by Jeremías Gamboa is the 1 April book of the contemporary club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. A student reaches a Colorado university and finds the contradictions of campus life.

d85474064b7ef1ecb213dc4254dc0b55bf6ece0b.en: El fantasma y la señora Muir by R.A. Dick is the 10 April book of the classic reading club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. A young widow moves to a seaside cottage said to be haunted, and a tender, unlikely love grows with its ghost.

2f8f9525435462b4d1ded79ebac56b8633fbffc1.en: Memoria de la Melancolía by María Teresa León is the 12 April book of the Lyceum Club reading group at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa. Its quasi-poetic autobiography recalls the Second Republic and the modernisation of Spain.

ff7b1211bed37d0cb1a687181eddcca64ed446bb.en: Christian Zacharias conducts and plays piano in Schumann's Introduction and Allegro appassionato and Brahms's Third Symphony, with Brahms's Nänie and Schicksalslied sung by the Bilboko Koral Elkartea, at the Jesús Guridi Conservatory.

a17b12340f069ab6f7ab532065344b62f903a5f7.en: Maia: Ganbara misteriotsua by Haizea López is the 16 April session of the children's reading club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, in Basque, for children born in 2015 or 2016. Six sessions unlock a mystery, one key at a time.

740013256448e47bf3b261da5861c9f04d7041e2.en: Balkan Paradise Orchestra brings its new show to Sala Kubik, with energetic songs from its latest album and EP. The show fuses Balkan brass with pop and electronica, with choreography, and its Game Sessions Vol. II remixes feature guests such as Tanxugueiras.

4c269ab1835fba789698a178c327ab13f3a4d0d3.en: Paddy Clarke Ha Ha Ha by Roddy Doyle is the 19 April book of the English club at the Casa de Cultura Ignacio Aldecoa, at 19:00 in the Orisol room. Nine-year-old Paddy narrates his life with humour and innocence while trying to understand adults.

fbb5c93275ef15f7e13c82a608dc5ec6ffb1017e.en: A 150-hour employment course at the Centro Río Gállego in Montañana on propagating ornamental nursery plants. It covers identifying species, propagation methods and growing techniques. In person, 8am to 1pm.

eaef2a51e96570969d650d0e59cc75da1d27bade.en: A joint exhibition at Espacio Joven Ibercaja, Craft and Cuerpos etéreos, by Alicia Blasco and Estela Ferrer Peraire. Blasco combines digital illustration with textile techniques; Ferrer Peraire makes abstract, organic sculptures.

08809f92a840938f43f10ab982d111eb2b53a7a1.en: A photography exhibition of 30 images by FONAMAD, the Madrid nature photographers, celebrating Spain's biodiversity and the legacy of naturalist Félix Rodríguez de la Fuente. At the Salvador Allende civic centre in Las Fuentes.

c7b66600a92621c4c09aa4eb0c231eba9673393d.en: An October exhibition of oil and acrylic paintings by Delfín Campos, showing everyday scenes and landscapes. Free entry at the Tío Jorge civic centre.

32fd216a2b2116dba99524916de8046495445380.en: An October exhibition of acrylic paintings by Esperanza Galve, titled Trazos de vida, at the Distrito 14 civic centre in La Jota. Free entry.

f71522d7a3fb082bcd6ae3ac5a9ad60a7ba500df.en: A 22-hour forklift course covering workplace safety, load rules, vehicle checks and practical manoeuvres with and without a load. Location to be confirmed.

3e21c2890834bc90397011b2e5fefd5d1501f6a7.en: A book display of works by contemporary Spanish women writers at the Cubit youth library, marking Día de las Escritoras on 19 October. Free entry while space lasts.

d4eba66f481d3a89fc1b1395922224b2bc434244.en: An exhibition at the Zaragoza Chamber of Commerce recalling its traditional Feria de Muestras, held to mark the Chamber's 140th anniversary.

e7beea1c619de7e0508831bbeff929a226827e25.en: An art project turning discarded books into miniature literary scenes, plus an 8 October workshop at 6pm where participants make a frame-object from books and their own photos. Booking by email.

4dd98626788e0da3f539eeb95be0fae7e52ad4de.en: An exhibition at the Delicias civic centre telling Zaragoza's history through the ordinary people who lived in its streets. It reconstructs their families, trades and daily lives from genealogical research.

43037f9d0859725cbff63f423ef936c167a92910.en: An exhibition of posters from every edition of the Zaragoza Comic Fair, marking its 25th anniversary, at the Estación del Norte civic centre.

1fb93042c53b92d04d239f754cd781883a97807c.en: A six-panel exhibition at the Water and Environment Documentation Centre on the Ebro river, from the SEDEXCHARE research project. It explains flood risk and river resilience, and the last panel invites shared ideas and debate.

d82b24f0716096064d178a336ca0729bac67eed7.en: An exhibition of papier-mâché Catrinas made in a Day of the Dead workshop, shown at the José Martí civic centre as part of MexicActur, a Mexican culture festival in Actur from 18 October to 2 November 2026.

bdfd55b64d64e995139801c5c038f584ea0b7a2a.en: A painting exhibition by Silvia Gallardo titled Felinas, featuring animals, the sea and women. It is dedicated to women who keep pursuing their dreams despite fear. At the Valdefierro civic centre.

630178a6fe5d632a68c382d7cd4797e2abd51cb5.en: A 60-hour course towards the official Spanish Sign Language certificate, level A1. It covers basic communication with deaf people, the sign alphabet, time, numbers and simple conversation. 18 places.

f132efbb2525becff5a0fd2b23bdb34f79aba24c.en: A yoga and Pilates class that combines Pilates exercises with the breathing and relaxation of Hatha yoga. It suits active people who want to strengthen the body or calm the mind. No experience needed.

dd8404269624a61fbc4bd1965a6551163b85d91d.en: A back-health yoga and Pilates class combining Pilates exercises with the breathing and relaxation of Hatha yoga, to keep the spine in good tone. No experience needed.

983c7cb1a62aa50022ad2468cccb666bdde879b6.en: An exhibition of joint work between Escuela Superior de Diseño de Aragón students and seniors from the Luis Buñuel centre, on peaceful coexistence between generations, at the Juslibol civic centre.

eb5f4ab35f57cc72d73c3aecc317cf48167c8267.en: A 30-hour course on order preparation and picking. It covers product coding and barcodes, picking methods and equipment, packaging and quality control. At the Portazgo industrial estate.

6800b058c504dca3869ddcc4fd32a17152910ac5.en: A 30-hour basic electricity course at the Portazgo industrial estate. It covers automation basics, motors, contactors and timers, with practical motor-control circuits. 15 places.

97594dad1fce350ac2828cf167ba59146d2d009e.en: An exhibition by Carla Nicolás and Natalia Escudero, Criar-crear, born from their letters and exchanges during motherhood. It combines photography, installation, video and objects on care, creativity and time.

3f86979fece79bc4f956a3e5ea09fe9b075615cb.en: An exhibition of key works from the Museo Goya collection at the Ibercaja Patio de la Infanta, while the museum is being transformed. It runs until October 2026.

800e3372e69143148576404f894dd28f9f1c85cd.en: CEGADOS, an exhibition by painter Xavier Colomer at the Palacio de Montemuzo from 4 September to 2 November 2026, with free entry. Large distorted portraits are designed to unsettle the viewer rather than please.

d6d7d1b93992d1614f417b7752913791e067818d.en: Equivalencias, the first show in the Observatorio series of rapid-response exhibitions at the IAACC Pablo Serrano. Its 16 works by Alegría and Piñero, June Crespo, Glenda León and Javier Peñafiel explore analogy with reality.

82f25b3d2700470d732ab029f0539ef30f63b8d7.en: A 12-hour practical course at Etopia on using the Claude AI assistant, from basics to advanced use, over three four-hour sessions. It covers prompting, documents, Projects and work workflows.

56841fa72d53e9a35a684236582e7dc01920a8e4.en: Duales 2026, an exhibition of contemporary ceramics from Aragon by 24 artists at the Fortea hall, exploring duality. It is linked to a Catalan show at the Centro de Artesanía of Aragon until 8 November.

112183d77ff818f2fb7bce652034166498add0a8.en: A show around the Circa XX collection at the IAACC Pablo Serrano, one of Spain's major private contemporary art collections, with 1,241 works. Its artworks are marked in the galleries and linked to an itinerary.

1529565a1237b243c8e0aca5d27fa8947e87a40b.en: Vuestra obra, an interactive display at the IAACC Pablo Serrano where four works from the Circa XX collection were proposed and visitors voted on social media for their favourite.

562acea4ebd0109aaebd0156564933f135888534.en: A display of documentary holdings at the IAACC Pablo Serrano, including international publications and posters donated by the family of designer López Velilla, marking International Design Day.

64e1baf72e79d7acc0c257018fc3366de93b2e20.en: Goya. Del museo al Palacio, 62 artworks in the Aljafería palace, including prints, drawings and paintings by Goya and works by his teachers and the Bayeu family. They are presented chronologically in historic rooms.

2166718f329385bf4bfe8dfc8ba403f831e3172b.en: An exhibition at the Fire Museum marking the 1973 fire at Tapicerías Bonafonte in Zaragoza, one of the most serious in Spain in recent decades. Photographs and panels honour the victims, survivors and families.

1e48c629ebb6dc538f766ae160d09f2ad8a53eef.en: La edad de piedra, an exhibition of 125 mostly original works at the Centro de Historias on the early years of comic artist Paco Roca, from age nine to his first professional work. It runs from 2 October 2026 to 10 January 2027.

d596de2f10f766d35e5a8d89d48f0c585b077de1.en: Juegos palabares, an exhibition of artworks made from objects and words at the Centro de Historias. It invites visitors to play with language and find poetry in everyday things.

ec70162b7a31d38de74426494fb387a280b7a804.en: Archivo Portera, showing the film work of neurologist Alberto Portera, who shot super-8 films of artists in their studios between the 1960s and 1980s. Among them are Pablo Serrano, Antonio Saura and Manolo Millares.

d68479f3939b2a3dbefa33ba102d64818d695b2f.en: A Mercedes-Benz motorsport exhibition at Mobility City, showing racing cars from the 1930s to today, including Fangio's world championship car. Some pieces from the Mercedes-Benz Museum are shown in Spain for the first time.

30645ac25f8b3c7bb4a28f06952dfbd0c2cfe2dc.en: Naufragios, an exhibition at CaixaForum Zaragoza on underwater archaeology. Shipwrecks and recovered objects show how navigation shaped human history.

b03e6fed6207f03ce4d053a848050fd96138e3a6.en: La ciencia de Pixar, an interactive exhibition at CaixaForum Zaragoza on the science and technology behind Pixar films, and how characters such as Buzz Lightyear and Sully were created.

b853248265464189f8c26b5262587e699d035632.en: Adult drawing and painting classes at Academia Barbasán in central Zaragoza, for beginners or to advance. Two-hour in-person sessions cover drawing, watercolour, oil, acrylic and mixed media, in morning and afternoon groups.

b1e5e14659a09c9b50aa8068a03613b879794972.en: Aragón y las Artes: 1976–1995, the third show in a project on Aragonese art after Franco. It covers painting, architecture, photography, film and ceramics, including the Grupo Pórtico and El Paso.

78fd18875dc5f3a9ff8d2a7fd6a898cbc040b033.en: STEAM education activities at Etopia, the base of the STEAMbrace project, a European initiative led by Edelvives. It offers workshops for students, teachers and families, plus conferences and contests.

55d1ec2cdb61c06a876761b594809cd33b64cd30.en: A 90-minute adult paper-folding workshop at the Benjamín Jarnés library in Actur, led by José María Escudero. Participants build modular origami structures without scissors or glue, and the group meets on Thursdays. Limited places; booking required.

d178d7b17bb72bc11f37bbeeab64e11d33730170.en: An eight-session workshop at Harinera ZGZ on co-creating art with mycelium, the root network of fungi that can form light, biodegradable materials. Thursdays from 15 October to 3 December, 11am to 1pm, for ages 16 and up.

1b4fa917c027218cb26a3993d5f34f2cb2dd4857.en: A talk at the University of Zaragoza's Paraninfo by the director Paula Ortiz on the genesis, development and results of some of her most important works.

99662d954a384889eb1269ee3db90032f966841a.en: A 40-hour course on traffic, transport and warehouse management. It covers route and load planning, transport documents such as the CMR consignment note, coordination with the warehouse, and handling incidents. 15 places; venue to be confirmed.

a19caa990fdf3b6be73e69f50d25278ce565ec2c.en: A low-impact class that combines Pilates with barre, a discipline drawing on ballet, Pilates and yoga. It aims to tone deep muscles, improve posture and strengthen the core. No experience needed.

a1ee0814d408c6ffdc3d25a407d6efbf89454c39.en: A 25-hour introductory course at SYSTEM Formación in Delicias on computing basics, Word, internet browsing and email, including attachments and contacts. 16 places.

b13e5873e120265ec2c7b86bb3b92e65ab5a5724.en: Zona Art Lab, a creative space at the Montañana youth zone for people aged 12 to 30. Members can work on painting, music, digital design, photography, clothing customisation, theatre or podcasts, with the tools and support provided.

6de07850871c1c79764f07a03962af60f55e9e2e.en: A free screening of La bola negra at Cines Aragonia, a film nominated for an Oscar. Open to those over 14; places are limited.

9ba41fa217de90ddb927e039d563b7cd7c71e9e8.en: A 20-hour creative welding course on making a metal sculpture. It covers MIG-MAG, stick and TIG welding, safe use of tools, jigs and templates, tubular-wire welding and finishing. 15 places.

424e0d0f91a693cfc2785a75d6be694bcc56d40b.en: A course at the Casa de las Culturas y la Solidaridad on intercultural mediation: tools to prevent and resolve conflicts where cultural difference is an obstacle.

b3a5208418579947440ce7067db4e0ebf2ae70b9.en: An open meeting point at the Garrapinillos youth zone, where young people can use its resources freely, with or without supervision by the animation team.

812101541190b72019219d32daba59342ef0e85c.en: A nine-hour course at the Joaquín Roncal centre on job searching with AI: prompting, tailoring CVs and cover letters to job adverts, interview practice and a personal job-search plan. 15 places.

9daebbd7b10785658ed8a6bf01e534fc8f6d6727.en: A family storytelling show, Cuentos de sustos, risas y tembleques, by Pilita Toy at the Garrapinillos library. Haunted mansions, vampires, witches and skeletons. Limited places; booking required.

6b980b40579e12b25b64405343e7a6019cc91e2d.en: A ten-session videomapping workshop at El Túnel for ages 16 to 25, run by the artist Yaguar Visual. It covers projection, visual composition and sound sync with MadMapper, Resolume and Tagtool, ending in a group piece. 12 places.

f4ebc62383e4887dc19385979e3a4316ed5f115a.en: The Biodetectives project at La Azucarera, in which teenagers solve a laboratory mystery as forensic scientists. Sessions run from 24 September to 19 November, with a demo day on 27 November. One registration covers the whole project.

d54d17ce5d84acc6943922253f0f80983b113fee.en: Five afternoon workshops at La Azucarera on teamwork, creativity and public speaking, for ages 14 to 18 and 19 to 30. Topics include lateral thinking, speaking under pressure and presenting a project with impact. Registration per session.

88fd80800e2723d4b52696e882f951f525b4baa9.en: Glow Up, a wellbeing programme at La Azucarera for two age groups, 14 to 17 and 18 to 30. Sessions cover emotions and thoughts, emotional theatre and acting-based expression, aimed at building a supportive group of peers.

30b9bca3a92fb45903346e35ef174b4a597d2bb9.en: An exhibition of paintings by Manuel Álvarez at the Teatro de las Esquinas. The works express emotion through colour, lines, light and shadow, and each visitor completes them through their own response.

dd203e9f363b04c059160e9f749da168877eaa4b.en: The launch of the book Absurdas teorías sobre la felicidad by Pilar Aguarón Ezpeleta at the Oliver civic centre. Its thirteen stories follow ordinary characters, especially women, through love, loss, memory and freedom. Free entry while space lasts.

fa5ad5d486dcc1938a3742e4098d9fd4514eb8a9.en: A talk and hands-on session by AVA, an Aragonese cooperative, on how fungi live, communicate and benefit medicine and food, plus how to grow mushrooms at home. Pre-registration required; limited places.

ea504296a0fcf12faf66bc44f1f23dafb47eebd9.en: A puppet and music comedy, Los guardianes de los cuentos, at the Casetas library. Perrault and Grimm must open chests of stories with the audience's help. Based on books by Roberto Malo and Daniel Tejero. For ages 3 and up.

2e445bda4908aa5e65d4254ff4d2643d6146179d.en: An Oktoberfest at the Valdespartera fairground from 9 to 19 October 2026, daily from 6pm. An orchestra plays from 8pm, then DJ Lagarto. Some days are ticketed in advance or at the box office; others are free entry.

47be04ce19b49e9e01268050f1e6e7f7d7e1184c.en: Craft workshops every Thursday at the Garrapinillos youth zone, open to young people who want to make things by hand.

5de6d129bb12f8ad7202bc5b17d8b2bf8cc98302.en: A classical yoga class at the A.G.U.A. women's association, using simple body movements, breathing and relaxation techniques. Suitable for all, especially for people dealing with anxiety, stress or muscle pain.

5dd2b5bb4fcc4636c8902bb558a468df444dc5f6.en: A social running group at La Azucarera every Thursday through to December, with no timing or competition, meant for making friends. The last Thursday of each month adds a short talk and a healthy snack. Registration is per session.

d997d4ed60676fb105fe11b759f277c3e1ae5338.en: A guitar course for the 2026–27 season at the Universidad youth zone, open to all levels. It teaches through a wide repertoire of songs and technical exercises on scales and chords. Limited places; booking required.

1451bbfacfe57e94c4002c0e1ace661a794b2966.en: Ludosport at the Universidad youth zone for 2026–27, a sport inspired by lightsaber combat. It is a sport with its own rules and techniques, not a cosplay activity.

769c43fce03a375be21834a43789d6d7d359a625.en: A talk at the Distrito Sur civic centre on breastfeeding, with midwives from Viamed and the head of the Aragon Milk Bank. It covers getting support, answering questions without judgement, and milk donation for premature babies.

09546ac0c2fb6511d3f0fb606813576750aba026.en: An adult storytelling show, Maletas de cuentos, by the Zaragoza narrator Mariano Lasheras at the Ricardo Magdalena library. He shares short tales of rogues and clever tricksters from around the world, with a trip through folk stories.

d4f44b2249be5bab4df3fe76feed03ac7e43082e.en: A free screening of short dance-film works at El Túnel on 22 October at 7pm, with the finalist works from the Fiver festival. About 60 minutes; introduced by festival director Samuel Retortillo.

22491411b2bad95f6f9a052e38ca9185dd951633.en: Move and Reset, a weekly space at the Universidad youth zone for movement, dance and body exploration. Participants pause to ask what their body needs today and then dance, play or rest.

242dcb6ed1ac6afcd30a5a49ca06df67eacf8059.en: The first session of the Tardes Confabuladas storytelling series at the Las Armas socio-educational centre, with Laura Jaen of Binomio Teatro. Her show Quizás explores the open endings of love stories through narration and theatre.

edeaf5f3283a3acb3f03452b99dea0f20a918bb4.en: A musical comedy, El Imitador, at the Teatro de las Esquinas. It follows actor-singer Julián Fontalvo from his childhood in South America to New York and Europe, through songs by Sting, Bob Marley, Piaf and Amy Winehouse.

e7e7575c0ab336403fa2c560d384583b959fd390.en: A combined Pilates and yoga class at the A.G.U.A. women's association. It joins Pilates exercises with the breathing and relaxation of Hatha yoga, to calm the mind and strengthen the body. No experience needed.

b005945b2e99aee35ac1f89a13f3ad224f522972.en: An artist's café talk at the Casa de la Mujer on the Criar-crear exhibition, with artists Carla Nicolás and Natalia Escudero and guests from art and science. They discuss care, parenting and creative work. Moderated by Esto no es un museo.

c028c6242d21fa7bab3d26a8a4ac6ef0b37da540.en: The Casa de Kavita at the Casa de las Culturas y la Solidaridad, a theatrical and sensory tour of an Indian home with rituals, music, dance and aromas. Guided visits on 28 September, 13 October and 22 October need registration.

cf4480468484d48ebf235c55a0dfd98db48ad7eb.en: The 29th International Film Festival by Women, from 19 to 25 October, with thirteen sessions at the Zaragoza Film Library and the Casa de la Mujer. It includes fiction, documentary and short films, and a session on films by Aragonese women.

e2cb2abc7b9f63e0ead1071a14f09724bbc6c05c.en: A creative workshop at the San Juan de Mozarrifar youth zone in which teams write, act and edit a horror trailer on their phones. Everyone then watches the films and votes for the most unsettling.

3d5a228031ac233830604d49eabbb4ffcf68e622.en: A 10-hour introduction to video games at the Las Fuentes youth zone, covering game types and the competitive e-sports world, for beginners. Costs 10 euros; 7 places. May lead to a place in the AUGUA esports academy.

06ce331cc84738e2fec08ffc53d7a932b6d26148.en: An exhibition at the Avempace youth zone, Menudas artistas, a walk through art history that celebrates six remarkable women artists.

1ecebd981d6eaa067e73da6b04adbbc9b9eb4fb3.en: A beginner's strength-training workshop at Zona Joven San Juan de Mozarrifar. Basic exercises and simple routines teach safe technique and build confidence.

229b55c288cefed2ba3995d115840c5fbdfcda69.en: A Halloween programme at Zona Joven San Gregorio: pumpkin carving, a decorate-your-space day on 17 October, craft and cooking workshops from 13 to 28 October, and a horror film marathon on 25 October. Booking is required; details by phone or WhatsApp on 671 46 77 51.

d8b165dbd54ab5c0220b70c646d530a05b13aa1d.en: A Halloween mask-making workshop at Zona Joven Torrero. No experience is needed.

58965d8bfce0c8d5d2c03b907c62fce503a01a71.en: An exhibition of the comic Más capaces que nunca, made with Amanixer and the illustrator Sara Jotabé. Through comics and humour it shows the lives of women and girls with disabilities and the barriers they face.

890fc93d0499b5f8edccfdbeb1ce4c2fa8ee0e59.en: A dessert-making session at Zona Joven Movera. Participants learn step by step how to make and decorate sweet treats.

ec6d93aed23fe5fd1053d27f7bbe7fe5023c98d0.en: A Playus tournament at Zona Joven Peñaflor. Sign up at the youth zone.

38e2c8bfd6140d096b5bb3e36bf83e5cebb4104e.en: Madola, Instante fosilizado: an exhibition at the Centro Joaquín Roncal CAI from 17 September to 31 October, organised by Fundación CAI and CERCO. Free entry.

7d77f0586d3d4145314576c7a375181081d2f88b.en: A Halloween night at Zona Joven Monzalbarba, part of its traditional Truco o Trato. Bring a costume and join in the fun.

8a065918e34affd029fda2230a1eee2ea32336aa.en: A cooking course at Zona Joven Torrero during October: four afternoons of learning recipes, cooking tips and group cooking.

401dfc09ca20b777821716cbdb0fc18f7abfe434.en: Túnel, dance cycle 2 at El Túnel in the second half of October 2026: three workshops for young people and five free public performances, including films and dance pieces on 21, 22, 24, 25 and 31 October.

7b7f8f1d949f39dfe5d405cff518d98f308e410f.en: ZABARET, an irreverent cabaret at the Recinto Ferial in Valdespartera, hosted by the actor and comedian Canco Rodríguez. It mixes contemporary circus, acrobatics, music, dance and improvised comedy.

5963f8b11111080815fbce7433b6c6d73ad1e78f.en: A drama group for people aged 12 to 18 at IES La Azucarera on Tuesdays. Theatre games, improvisation and character work build creativity and teamwork. No experience is needed.

e4f72d0db9c834310736ffff432cee4c534aa892.en: A workshop at Centro Cívico Esquinas del Psiquiátrico on optimism and positive thinking. It offers practical ideas and exercises for handling negative thoughts and facing the future more positively.

2bcecb8ed86001c973991190eb5a426380045ce0.en: A group exhibition of painting and photography by six artists at Centro Cívico Esquinas del Psiquiátrico.

def975557bc6d26a53557e51588bff9a7d47bb48.en: ¿Una vuelta?, an immersive exhibition by the Madrid artist Rocío Guerrero at Casa de los Morlanes. Paintings of fairground scenes, neon and nostalgia turn childhood memories into a contemporary story.

680926bf83da5413089744644ba105f882970653.en: Urban garnacha wine tastings at Zaragoza hotels in 2026, organised by Grandes Vinos and the hotel association. Each session at 20:00 tastes six wines for 10 euros, with proceeds going to Fundación Down Zaragoza. Dates include 22 October at Ibis Styles Zaragoza Centro.

66705ba08df88ba423a923f6a542b80909f1a179.en: The Autumn 2026 programme in Distrito Sur: nine free environmental activities from 3 October to 21 November, including botanical walks, a bike tour, a sustainable cleaning workshop and a nature walk. Times and venues vary by date.

f48126c73185eb3df8c2349d44c2b4b3664d106a.en: Math Joven, five independent workshops at La Azucarera on game theory and strategic thinking, from the Prisoner's Dilemma to Nim. Sessions run on 27 October, 10 November and 24 November, and you can book one or more.

e79abe677393823e32f323e522ca7c02574a4268.en: Urban Joven, five independent workshops at La Azucarera on architecture, space and the people who use it. Sessions run on 28 October, 11 November and 25 November, and you can book one or more.

f7cccd1a8d83eb34c4553ba6d853f4030c70cc26.en: Science Joven, five independent workshops at La Azucarera on anatomy dissection and chemistry experiments. Sessions run on 29 October, 12 November and 26 November, and you can book one or more.

147393476539b2a2a3ad7fa3fcc485ff837ba9b7.en: Thursday meet-up at Zona Joven Movera, with games, challenges, music and conversation in a relaxed setting. Come alone or with friends; each week brings new activities.

2bcf5397d81bf672867a0a0003e2e716ef7fc835.en: Volunteer work at the Galacho de Juslibol nature area for people aged 18 and over. It involves nine work sessions across the year. Sign-up closes on 31 January.

c7c8ca134013f50293cc2661767d6abf74943a82.en: Autumn board games at Zona Joven Actur, with co-operative and competitive games.

e4594dab9044b2bd8fa97837ce554518867bf25a.en: A 30-hour analogue photography course at the Centro de la Imagen on Calle Miguel Servet. Students develop their own black-and-white film and print in the darkroom.

cbbef06fea127bcbc603c09beb9f6d125728aaa3.en: An online course of 125 hours on soil fertility and cover crops, run by Zaragoza Dinámica. It covers soil physics, chemistry and biology, and techniques such as reduced tillage and organic fertilisers.

94e841c9451a6c75a273dca0f1e463f8d0955b36.en: A drone course at Zona Joven Peñaflor. Sign up at the youth zone.

70366c8f69be2037e554258dbcf9f37a0338a4a1.en: A football league at Zona Joven Peñaflor. Sign up at the youth zone.

851ff64ab4acc8a3463ae3b744ba53ddf8a64602.en: Tuesday games at Zona Joven Movera: board games, challenges and strategy games, from quick matches to team competitions.

e2c8dbe39a2568cd61c53853d976e1b7ff23fa2f.en: Wednesday sports at Zona Joven Movera: basketball, football, calisthenics and fronton, with a mix of practice and friendly competition.

c243427c5c1ed5a350dbc186b386299a1ff7fef4.en: An introduction to theatre at Zona Joven Miguel de Molinos. Theatre games, improvisation and expression techniques help people build confidence. No experience is needed.

41f3dcb3754ba8a18f030b68f265f6eab3fc18e7.en: A short-film workshop at Zona Joven Juslibol. Participants make an audiovisual piece from writing the script to editing the final film.

827860ba88e4350257a6c742602965032d1e6ca7.en: Prueba y Juega at Arcosur Golf: on the last Saturday of each month at 12:30, a free 50-minute taster session. Participants learn the basic swing and practise on the range. All equipment is provided.

4d9f209746c6ede4a84753e904c7448685d4560f.en: A weekly creative workshop at Zona Joven Monzalbarba, with new techniques and room for members' own projects.

8c0f70eb45111267de59325ceae6ab08ac85f27c.en: Sunday reading at Zona Joven Monzalbarba. Members share short readings, whether or not they already enjoy reading.

b0d96fa61d73036fbbd6ae0866b939ca63fe5e1a.en: An audiovisual space at Zona Joven Monzalbarba for film, podcasts, photography and video. Members choose the format and the team provides the tools.

facc3c188c712d77c3b6298f560c2c1bea5d373f.en: Survival cooking at Zona Joven Monzalbarba: simple recipes with easy-to-find ingredients, for people who are cooking for themselves for the first time or want to replace shop-bought snacks.

60cee92cd988758e33aeb9eebae350adf776229d.en: A weekly board-game competition at Zona Joven Garrapinillos, where players challenge the current champion for first place.

7945b21ab553bfd21fcc7f3bcf3de59524606534.en: Free play at Zona Joven Garrapinillos, with foosball, table tennis, darts and more.

fadaf432855c45d1788128bcda6cd602b24d04a6.en: Technology activities at Zona Joven Garrapinillos.

3743e90f8bd0c1ec68f0d4f31dcc484c4b27ff14.en: A relaxation session at Zona Joven Peñaflor for switching off from the day.

89dd9cf69844f907920e8e623df9ff0c585f8e2b.en: A games afternoon at Zona Joven Monzalbarba: Wii or PlayStation, Kahoot quizzes and Among Us, with games for every taste.

0c01e266e66861b7cdec2934d9fa01ebe0e59e9e.en: An active afternoon at Zona Joven Monzalbarba with foosball, darts, table tennis and mini tournaments.

2978d4b2705e45d4254db8b7aeb4052b89d5e121.en: A quiet Tuesday at Zona Joven Monzalbarba with no screens and no loud games. Members can join talks, finish workshops or propose their own activity.
