e784e5d73b9529f878ce44862e95a559d065a05e.en: An information and guidance service for young people aged 12 to 30 on education, work and personal matters.

a6f4a506aa4b2995b206b6a5128dc7f96cf52ee9.en: An open afternoon at Zona Joven Monzalbarba to meet new people, play games, take part in workshops, courses or sport.

a5f95846477bcb53843bf70974db4cd87d0038cb.en: Board-game afternoons at Zona Joven Monzalbarba, from Mortal and Bang to Monopoly, Catan, 7 Wonders and zombie-fighting games.

57ccdc01e571ede588ab5490731c24e7e4a8dddf.en: Advisory support for associations at the Casa de las Culturas y la Solidaridad, aimed at building a welcoming, intercultural and co-operative Zaragoza through local groups.

24989a4a99aa9ca23675d0fcbe96454d86d3324f.en: Sign-up for Scout Group Virgen del Carmen 410, an educational group for children and young people based at the Parroquia del Carmen in central Zaragoza. It focuses on teamwork, respect for nature and community service.

31d009f8dcf15740d1f21803cc55523ab921d377.en: The Centro Cívico Garrapinillos celebrates its 20th anniversary, thanking the people who have used it over the years.

3a200f36626bfb2e8753e05faede1ce3402e1e93.en: Local food markets across Zaragoza, including agroecological and agri-food markets, where producers sell fruit, vegetables, oils and preserves directly to buyers.

6ce51ff95eb067e94af58d83becfa7687a9d30ca.en: Me quiero, me cuido 2.0 at Zona Joven San Juan de Mozarrifar: a weekly space for self-care and simple creative projects such as natural cosmetics, relaxation tools and organisation ideas. No experience is needed.

7d8315000d7fb4ea9e44f6cef8299a3641f8b099.en: Friday cooking at Zona Joven San Juan de Mozarrifar, with easy recipes from healthy dishes to world cuisine, and tips for using leftovers. Cook solo or in a team.

be34552c746fb33430d1c4bb525acf83f6841ce6.en: A laughter-therapy session at the Centro Cívico Universidad to release stress and reconnect with yourself and others.

906e34a4e705e79ea8f0167a5abe117c75adc1b1.en: A points-based board-game league at Zona Joven San Juan de Mozarrifar over one term. Players take part in different games, complete challenges and climb the ranking.

0c513bd503df2c548bf15c3a0bfad7e1d09350c8.en: An autumn ping-pong league at Zona Joven San Juan de Mozarrifar. Players compete weekly, earn points and climb the rankings, with special challenges and themed days.

d731d2765e2da1c13b0b11560af882ae62459f8b.en: A B2 English course that trains students to use the language fluently across everyday and specialised situations, covering reading, writing, speaking and listening on general topics.

cd5c3b39a3af0d9c750ed91b46260186e2e6588e.en: A monthly experimental percussion cycle focused on active listening and collective improvisation. Each session explores sound objects and instruments, and builds soundscapes with guest musicians.

4c58091dfe574dd8141fcc8ac0de0ab5bb08d9ab.en: A wastewater treatment course run by Zaragoza Dinámica, online and 150 hours long. It prepares students for public bodies and private companies that run wastewater treatment plants.

c431a0d90c13386531c8e0c8b01659bc1e2398f0.en: A digital photography course at the Centro de la Imagen in three levels, from beginner to advanced, with a lighting workshop for portraits. 60 hours in total, mornings and afternoons.

dae9a36f1f43bf51382a8e2f7dc15f8910d82a3c.en: Kairós Impulsa, a job-placement programme run by Kairós with INAEM and EU funds. It serves unemployed people aged 16 to 29 and offers a personal employment plan, job-search coaching and gamified learning.

3c148fd2359468c038e876476f8d1402eda0f236.en: Acoustic guitar lessons at Zona Joven Pilar Lorengar, covering chords and rhythm for beginners.

a642f4727daf53448233faa1a216ece4cba619ca.en: Individual 30-minute drum lessons at Zona Joven Pilar Lorengar for beginners.

062a87d13571ca243108e5399b807166497739d6.en: Junior volleyball training on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 16:00 to 17:00 at the Terrazas de CDM sports facility. Open to young people who want to learn volleyball and play in a team.

128cf55d7c676792d7cbafa3c0ddefb89d260895.en: A chess league for young people at Zona Joven San Pablo, running from October to May. Matches take place on one or two Fridays a month, from 18:00 to 20:00.

c324070e32ba1c8aea482d88365e58f75e7b590d.en: Cooking sessions for young people aged 12 to 30 at the CSL Federico Ozanam kitchen. Participants cook, taste and learn about traditional dishes from different countries to build intercultural understanding.

daa8092515240dc790db4183e92cb086e66c5251.en: Drum lessons at Zona Joven Andalán, with the chance to play with other instruments and form a band.

cb1485006bb561f44b4d850601f349a9cf271946.en: A football team for children and adolescents that will play in the Liga Joven during the 2026/2027 season. The project aims to build healthy habits, social skills and teamwork.

195b0709a9423882397205b2c738019fff25a2fe.en: Drone piloting lessons at Zona Joven Andalán, with small groups and a look at professional uses for drones.

45fa0d530d5052c81c4a0dfb530ede83ede92c39.en: Guitar and bass lessons at Zona Joven Grande Covián for beginners and more advanced players. Places are limited.

f85d201c002a578a1e1b0cbb6cb4b146bcb195b1.en: A varied sports programme at IES Francisco Grande Covián, including martial arts, boxing, calisthenics, dodgeball, ultimate frisbee and hockey.

f0cad352d04d7048165664c3a747bb36bc23c973.en: Spanish, electric or acoustic guitar lessons at Zona Joven Andalán, at your own pace with experienced teachers.

0e5186d0c7eea832c6965a97d4cc81c14a8a9099.en: Piano lessons at Zona Joven Andalán at your own pace with experienced teachers.

a6277ab91583debeccd85b4188fc6eeafd583fa9.en: A piano course at the Zona Joven Luis Buñuel for complete beginners. It covers playing, reading music, playing by ear and songs from classical to pop.

624255a383a37415f5aa198d5da8a01b7ef94f16.en: A singing course at Zona Joven Pilar Lorengar that helps students use their voice well.

8b67d15020f48e2ed292e8da2746d47d62656b78.en: Mozart's Last Journey to Paris, performed at Essaion de Paris, follows the composer's 1778 visit to Paris, a trip he hoped would make him known.

0e6250d75e542df3ed5ba8a487997c4c3baded5e.en: Sophie et Alex at Théâtre Bo Saint-Martin is a comedy about life's stages, written and performed by two comedians.

d644e5b172b66cd72e8dda9c25e88888f5b97594.en: J'aurai 14 ans toute ma vie at Théâtre des Mathurins features an actress who played Pénélope in the film La Boum, looking back on her career and her wish to make films.

ab203c4bf439164fad1082dc45472a3ab352cc34.en: L'Heure H at Le Contrescarpe is a play by Jean-Louis Lahaye, a RTBF presenter for 25 years, asking what people would sacrifice for power or for their country.

24fe72215e6261455443c2cb8579be970f02e953.en: Ailleurs at Studio des Champs-Élysées is a play written and directed by Audrey Schebat. Its first performance is on 8 October 2026 at 7 pm.

dd4f197a3e2cfaf4656409dce6945b0e5070e3e4.en: La fin de la civilisation at Le Funambule Montmartre follows four strangers locked in a laboratory by an AI meant to protect them, who must prove they do not carry a virus.

597c162fd86ddfa06ed40b9fe9baaa3f5524397d.en: Circo Infinito at Bobino is a family circus show, mixing acrobatics, poetry and humour in a setting above the ground.

f1391d03fc79f741e5f92170e5175905e88aea3f.en: Sören Prévost at Le Montorgueil is a stand-up show based on a conspiracy book, with the comedian presenting a story about a theory.

c6c0a978813c392e7d5094d460a8c719e472d7e1.en: École des femmes at Artistic Athévains is a version of Molière's School for Wives, following Arnolphe and the young woman he has kept locked up.

6b296054d9603646cb57b729cb6822e4739902a0.en: Le Schpountz, adapted from Marcel Pagnol, is staged at Théâtre Rouge du Lucernaire. Irénée, a shop assistant from near Marseille, dreams of becoming a film star.

0c915922353044850c431c034d35ac6280b905be.en: La Cantatrice chauve and La Leçon, two plays by Eugène Ionesco, are staged at Théâtre de la Huchette. Both satirise everyday speech and conversations.

3fb3c4a6305e7e6817ba80791938f39fef2a23f6.en: Guillaume Guisset performs a stand-up show at La Scala Paris. He grew up in a large family in Neuilly.

4aaea7a503deef1d7ac4eb481977b5629ef4f3a0.en: Camille Tissot performs a stand-up show at Théâtre de Dix Heures, talking about her worries, motherhood and fear of death.

476e33b41777aca5b60fdd04a20a3b3f29787c57.en: La Belle Hélène et les garçons at La Scène Parisienne is a Théâtre du Petit Monde adaptation of Offenbach's operetta.

b70479cd453afa463024c820f40b856fd7c7f79d.en: L'Histoire de Manon at the Palais Garnier presents the Paris Opera's staging of Kenneth MacMillan's ballet about a young woman who seeks pleasure.

76c268157ab20af85aa112ba808cd485bdf1fd51.en: The Strokes play Accor Arena. Tickets are limited to four per buyer, and there is ID checking to limit resale.

1e9aaeb1d86eca0d391bf082dcca2903b81c5fc2.en: Sacrée soirée at La Grande Comédie is a comedy by Alil about a single man who does not believe in love.

4c7c57d6149b7fdb43a09ed6a854f5f2c42e04c4.en: Les femmes ont toujours raison, les hommes n'ont jamais tort is a comedy at Le Passage vers les Étoiles, which has drawn more than 150,000 spectators.

aef8d5a3a80b9921c0118d7b71d769314cfbc156.en: Il ne pleut plus en Bretagne at Théâtre Auguste is a song show by Sylvain Gary, with piano by composer François Marie.

f4d2868103bcaed7af438608145fb8e5fd32e8c8.en: Un ouvrage de dames at La Divine Comédie is a comedy in which Sophie makes a serious mistake and seeks advice from the Widow, who always has a solution.

fbad78a3eb4c7558d6c7b0ea24f45599e3fb68ce.en: AZ at L'Européen is a stand-up show about a common lack of enthusiasm, poking fun at the pressure to be passionate and fully invested.

76f09439d612bd9c7edf8cd158200eeb21f81cb6.en: Frédérick Sigrist's show 39-45, the Age of Deconstruction, at L'Européen is about the years of his life that shaped him most.

63143ba9a8cd0f7a6bb975d900d0f3fde249f41b.en: Cédric Salaün, at Théâtre du Marais, is a stand-up show on how fast life passes and how people should make the most of it.

3bf1139232b2921297159716cfe3b3d0f2fea2f7.en: Destiny at La Divine Comédie is an improvised show in which the audience chooses the location, character archetypes and danger, and four actors improvise a new story.

6f7d971754de1a56cf80fac1a3c635b2ba800685.en: Les Aventures merveilleuses de l'inexistante Ayse at Comédie Saint-Michel is a feminist fairy tale about a woman who is written out of her own story.

a5599106da734ca3519876209a921514ba96d138.en: L'Âge bête at Les Folies Bergère stars Michèle Laroque and Kad Merad as a couple who have just met and want to live their story without limits.

58ce10fce0c0c298ac45cf4ebae4df823bef8a1d.en: Mercury Rev play a 25th anniversary concert of their album All Is Dream at Le Trianon on 22 October 2026, with Mick Harvey and Amanda Acevedo supporting.

c434191412dcdd560bf2ddd246dd85f62d52a12e.en: Totally Crazy. at Crazy Horse Paris is a revue and champagne show from the venue's creative house.

7260d3cf1589962ac658eca9c6681d1220548f84.en: Oh les beaux jours at Théâtre des Bouffes Parisiens is Samuel Beckett's play, directed by Marc Paquien, with Catherine Frot and Pierre Banderet.

b13e64252380cc2db40bdb2bea7c625312f13a82.en: Singin' in the Rain at Théâtre du Lido brings the 1952 film to the stage from September 2026.

cd328fedf46a702967b863a2e4c66554d0fea058.en: Nawell Madani at Casino de Paris returns with a new show about mental load, fame and the temptation of cosmetic treatments.

2a79fddb17e6fbf660ec7ca869059a5aa07b2381.en: Le Rôti at Comédie Saint-Martin is a new comedy by Amanda Sthers, following her earlier plays.

fe2867d40c112536ddff37448775a0f6b9077ec1.en: Deep Purple play Adidas Arena. Tickets are limited to eight per order, and the show is produced by Gérard Drouot Productions.

9785a73258c4f1890b2381e13b4311e422fe3070.en: La Leçon at Théâtre de la Huchette is Eugène Ionesco's play directed by Marcel Cuvelier. A shy teacher and an insolent pupil see the roles swap.

0f892f91a16a1bbd010a885b7438ec5616230868.en: Chante et tais-toi at Comédie des Champs-Élysées follows Pablo Diaz, a popular singer whose agent wants his private life to stay private.

0b4c75d568a1e9578d4277edf874607a84d7a569.en: Le procès d'une vie at Splendid Saint-Martin is a play by Barbara Lamballais and Karina Testa, about Marie-Claire, who falls pregnant at 16 in 1971, when abortion was a crime.

7d680faba274aa8f61724056411f484dc0612ba2.en: Le cercle des poètes disparus at Le Théâtre Libre is a stage version of Dead Poets Society, which has drawn nearly 500,000 spectators.

ff83bb8c6236e313546ced74e7f629edacc03474.en: Le livre de l'intranquillité at Studio Raspail is a stage adaptation of Fernando Pessoa's book, mixing daily life with philosophy.

67010aba20ee652fb880077a7bfcea9626f28e72.en: Du couscous à l'Élysée at Théâtre Edgar is a modern comedy about Sam, a telesales worker whose life changes when Célia enters it.

4467422d109c472d219f20cbf6a4d502283b4685.en: Dhyepha in Borderline at Comédie des 3 Bornes is a one-person comedy about being diagnosed with borderline personality disorder.

3ecbff9edd63b41a2821cfe13b8a21b691a669d0.en: Les Aventuriers de minuit at Théâtre Marigny - Studio Marigny is a mystery play by the Renard Argenté company, which has staged earlier crime plays.

de8e3c5345ccd5bf13a9cd956454928df878cda3.en: Le roi borgne at La Nouvelle Seine is a play about money and questions, in which humans arrive on Earth with the power of questions.

c59eab7167fe5963110a3f2e8d13b4d64eaf149f.en: La femme qui n'aimait pas Rabbi Jacob at Théâtre du Petit Montparnasse is directed by Jean-Philippe Daguerre, with Bernard Malaka and Charlotte Matzneff.

9bd4305adfe33433762ace78c71f46c10088a4b8.en: Tristan Pierre at Théâtre de Dix Heures presents Mélanjolie, a show in which he walks through the streets of his childhood.

ad85db21b991592cc4ebec9e97bd20605db2e9ca.en: Ilyes Djadel's Déjà at Palais des Glaces is his second show, exclusive to the venue from 24 September 2026.

92da66a83a71d993a621b6670d34043948ef8e9d.en: Patrick Piard: Gênant at Théâtre Le Métropole mixes stand-up and sketches, with toxic characters such as the annoying ex.

0e0bf61d72a09969022e3551323620bf62421c0b.en: Meurtre sous hypnose at La Grande Comédie - Petite Salle is a play whose actors are audience members under hypnosis.

613fb24207a41f306af604fe870419212e538a6e.en: Les Doublages Improvisés is an improvised dubbing show by the Geneva company Alliance Créative, staged at the Splendid Saint-Martin theatre.

aea3bad401cdebffa3bdafeeffc50f87bd93b15b.en: Future Palace returns to Paris on 9 November 2026 at Le Backstage by The Mill. The Berlin post-hardcore trio presents its new single Deep Blue.

4ecbd308c908f134e0ab466c9a93cf14e1d8c63d.en: Pour un oui pour un non, a play by Nathalie Sarraute directed by Michel Favart, follows two long-time friends whose friendship is tested. It runs one hour at Essaion de Paris.

0189205c64c9776fb393b559fc432a2aaff71d23.en: Daphné Huynh brings her show on the bimbo and femininity from Belgium to the Comédie de Paris, mixing cabaret, stand-up and personal stories.

112fd7a824b4b06f6ad03ad7e06ff8eb0c2b921c.en: Nathalie Boileau's comedy show at La Divine Comédie, Salle 2, uses caricatured characters to satirise relationships between men and women in the 21st century.

0a11bb76acc627c1d8f14d3c2d808153003d39a4.en: Hayrettin presents the stand-up show Kaos Show at the Casino de Paris, mixing absurd humour, guest appearances and audience games.

0103961a9b19ca6823ef1f3432c7cb6cfc4ef462.en: Ibeyi performs at the Cirque d'Hiver Bouglione, presenting their new album Offering, which is based on Yoruba religious influences and includes the single Aset.

bcb4c65dfd8051d4530e64cec25045bc173d2eef.en: Les Folies d'Offenbach, staged at La Scène Parisienne, presents well-known excerpts from Offenbach operettas such as La Vie Parisienne, La Périchole and La Belle Hélène.

2047899cb2b27776931466be79134d0ef9a73bb6.en: Master Boot Record and Fulci Arottenbit play La Machine du Moulin Rouge. Master Boot Record is a project founded in 2016 that mixes heavy metal and synthesised electronic music.

6fdd1db83acd4690df20d51bf72d9edf7dbe3cc1.en: Jérémy Charbonnel presents Seul Tout, a stand-up show about his life as a single father, staged at the Théâtre des Mathurins.

360f9d2c70767ff92167e50574bae1a2e949701c.en: Place à l'audace is a solo show by Stéphanie Paviet at the Apollo Théâtre. A young woman from Savoie moves to Paris to become an actress, directed by Papy.

1c22dc3d05ca9e52fc10d543810b5ed27813e45f.en: Allt, a progressive metalcore band from Karlskoga, Sweden, plays La Maroquinerie. The band released its first album, From The New World, in 2024.

ac445c1d2fb88c973131c3535b9d320b5cda2fb7.en: Sofy performs at La Boule Noire on 10 November 2026. The artist mixes trip-hop, Britpop and garage rock. Ticket sales open on Friday 15 May.

c06fc212b5080c5b17c039d1aef500afae504259.en: Doc Gynéco performs at Adidas Arena. The French rapper released Première Consultation in 1996, and the show revisits songs such as Viens voir le docteur.

caf7433510c5c18a13ec7b93db0bd01fa23d51a5.en: Fink plays Élysée Montmartre on 10 November, presenting his ninth studio album, The City Is Coming to Erase It All. A second French date is at Transbo in Lyon on 31 October.

38981f6ad4b0a1c1dcc8feb3ed1e8fa23cb5a7be.en: Adrien Soleiman presents the second volume of his BelleJazzClub project at Le Trabendo on 10 November. The project mixes jazz with pop.

830bf5909384922396e177bd8aca4731b20acb61.en: Jessie Ware plays the Casino de Paris on 10 November 2026 as part of the Superbloom Tour, presenting her 2026 album Superbloom.

9bd913886ba2e6da828ea9ec45cc8e28cfd540e5.en: Tove Lo plays L'Olympia on 10 November 2026 to present her new album ESTRUS. She is best known for Habits (Stay High) and Talking Body.

103a2a6aa606e591a09d36aeb8522c20d769b820.en: Luna, le secret de Jean is a play set in Germany in 1943, in which two French prisoners are forced to sing Édith Piaf songs for a Nazi colonel's wife. It is staged at La Scène Libre.

ae95b2303a9defeb398ddca2838966764856e49a.en: Swae Lee performs at Le Bataclan. The singer was part of the duo Rae Sremmurd and is known for Unforgettable, Sunflower and Sicko Mode.

776e2e2b126a8a228e493e2414f07f202b3f167b.en: Amistat, a twin-brother duo with one voice, plays Alhambra with Orange Oak as support. The tour presents new songs from their 2026 album.

e10fdf631d5dc41bbb96f100e9abd95041996a9b.en: Absolutely Hilarious, a comedy night with guest LA BAJON, opens its ninth season at the Théâtre de la Gaîté Rive Gauche on 6 October.

d8f75ec321e4e91d2bdc65f9576f03b951935f86.en: Samara Joy plays the Auditorium Patrick Devedjian at La Seine Musicale. The jazz singer is known for her acclaimed albums.

c6857ca410a4e786f635c1359dbf1cc5c95a5232.en: Sofia Titrit performs her stand-up show Trop de là-bas pour ici at La Divine Comédie, Salle 2. The show covers identity, ambition and love.

bd1118e851a35fc8fb08319dd0a00a5cbc75e5b6.en: Catch Impro is an improv show at La Scène Montparnasse, with Arnaud Tsamere and others. Two teams of improvising wrestlers fight in a theatrical match.

81f36c5d8690517aa1e2d993b6491a6856b33389.en: Bruxelles 1900 is an exhibition at the Petit Palais in Paris from 10 November 2026 to 25 April 2027. The museum recommends booking a free timed slot in advance.

174ae2b84c3c0b0389a90b92e0ff8848b4346355.en: Au pays du Père Noël, written and directed by Olivier Solivérès, has 22 performances at the Théâtre Marigny. A guided tour of the North Pole leads to Santa's secrets.

cf6ded5f9cde8cd787a1a8f50ff5e532da78fd1d.en: Andy Warhol: La ligne et l'image is an exhibition at the Musée du Luxembourg, from 16 September 2026 to 10 January 2027, that focuses on his drawings. A children's studio visit is also offered.

bc99fab1fa7d342884f3ea3b43f28bceb3696de8.en: Le Père Noël est enrhumé is a Christmas musical for families at the Comédie Saint-Michel. Father Christmas catches a cold and Mrs Christmas and the elf Gus look for a cure.

cbbb4e1f5dcdda9a9d8835fa9f3339d9d785ac17.en: Liszt, Satie and Beethoven is a piano recital by Pascal Mantin at Église Saint-Ephrem, with works including Für Elise and Clair de lune.

32fcedb8b071e430330b93de624082bc2a6435f6.en: Spike and the Gimme Gimmes, formerly Me First and the Gimme Gimmes, play La Machine du Moulin Rouge on 11 November 2026, performing punk versions of pop, rock and R&B hits.

38392be695d613737c0d7153881c036987ec6ffe.en: Levara is a trio based in Los Angeles, formed by singer Jules Galli, guitarist Trev Lukather and drummer Josh Devine. The band plays Nouveau Casino.

f316b3c93beee596d45e1f2d36905609de3aa4f5.en: Bi-2 presents its world tour supporting the album Voyage autour du Soleil, with a symphony orchestra and hits from across its career, at the Casino de Paris on 11 November. Recommended from age 8.

5a6d896fac1a542cf8ebc92eacaa378c61621ddf.en: Sur un fil is a theatre, dance and shadow show by two artists about the weight of past events. A man on a bench remembers his relationship with Claire at La Scala Paris.

02a65a2cfa9818a0b2c6484997676d15a6808ad0.en: Jack & Jack, a duo that rose from the Vine app, plays La Bellevilloise. Their song No One Compares To You has more than 255 million Spotify streams.

2378e3691799314407d682f4bb09e14d27ba6899.en: Artemas, a darkwave artist known for the viral single i like the way you kiss me, plays Élysée Montmartre on 11 November. The show is part of his largest world tour to date.

96cf4f6fc3c7cdf9c1b6f3441d3eaed6ad5e5e41.en: Tristan Lucas presents a new stand-up show at Le Point Virgule, revisiting life stages from childhood to old age. His previous show Français Content was performed in more than 15 countries.

e2c302b3b715ff221ee106071f913d111f5d7d7f.en: Paris Basketball hosts Fenerbahçe Istanbul at Accor Arena. Reduced-price tickets are available from 22 euros for licence holders, minors and job seekers.

e66d7d54f13e75a1cbf3aa75d8cef958aa581ffc.en: Le Premier Homme, Albert Camus' last text, is performed by David Seigneur at Essaion de Paris. Adapted and directed by Patrick Roldez, the show lasts 70 minutes.

941f32c21eddd3ec1b3d4ed1c63edaff040ff17b.en: Audrey Perrin presents a comedy show about menopause and identity for a woman aged 50. It is performed at Théâtre du Marais and lasts 70 minutes.

edd078a0374549a08ea8444b964f4f9e56ab252a.en: Une Mouette adapts Chekhov's The Seagull with two actors at the Théâtre Paradis du Lucernaire. The production follows an author and an actress who rehearse the play.

215ae28744fe5374cd43c9d46d396269293a9887.en: Anneke van Giersbergen & Band plays La Machine du Moulin Rouge. The Dutch singer, formerly frontwoman of The Gathering, has released more than 25 albums.

b1e4769cd4fd0fecbbde260b9d9408a2200aea42.en: Daniel Morin presents Certifié Morin, his first one-man show at Théâtre de la Gaîté Rive Gauche, marking 20 years on France Inter. The show lasts 1 hour 20 minutes.

1b4c2c187dc0eae810642ec8740080e5b9c3cf17.en: Simon Collot presents a stand-up show at Le Point Virgule about preparing his wedding, with digressions about his childhood, doubts and family relationship.

0b33c1d9db14ec4d462378368384e4e8ab203a2d.en: Eddie Cudi presents a stand-up show at La Divine Comédie, Salle 1, about identity, origins and cultural contrasts, using cartoon-style characters.

034e00f068d598003dea2aed641a1ad1feb462fc.en: JeanJass, a Belgian rapper known from the duo Caballero, performs at L'Olympia. He is also a producer.

449b927835cdf62af6eb662007cca443354876f8.en: Schumann and Mendelssohn is a concert at Seine Musicale with Schumann's Cello Concerto and works by Mendelssohn, a composition written by the 15-year-old composer.

45edfebc1e0644466c8bff65d6b189e99cf5b692.en: Radio Free Alice plays Point Éphémère. The band's debut album What's In Between is due on 30 October.

5789c31bbffe43ee55b3af7b92cc34e29987ef2f.en: Lily et Lily is a play at Théâtre de Paris with Michèle Bernier and Francis Perrin, directed by Marie-Pascale Osterrieth. It is set in Hollywood in 1935 and runs from 12 November.

71a123c32e8f6d1334e41620ef2f8f00834dd1b4.en: Sofiane (Fianso) gives a final concert at Accor Arena on 12 November 2026. He is a figure of French rap who also works in cinema and theatre.

efcac462789d52cea062555764ca85537aa257f5.en: Haute & Freddy, a duo formed by Michelle Buzz and Lance Shipp, plays Alhambra on 12 November. Their album is Big Disgrace.

6b2370b41bd3e31ff8b062cedf37f69ab1b096b5.en: Je n'aime pas le classique, staged at the Casino de Paris, is hosted by Belgian humorist Alex Vizorek and based on the classical compilation of the same name.

7b1e9358356804c09d8b79e0f8bc74f24580f2b6.en: Haute & Freddy's concert on 12 November moved from La Bellevilloise to Alhambra because of strong demand. Existing tickets remain valid.

22832fc12db40ab498b7d717fd075ea28869d0c9.en: Rim Murr performs Paris-Beyrouth en chanson at the Théâtre de la Tour Eiffel. She reworks French songs by Bécaud and Dalida and Arabic songs by Fairuz.

69bc8fa2e16e785a2982044cc79b5dc51213b68c.en: Charlie Winston performs Clash Pop, a set of his classic songs with a six-piece ensemble, at Salle Gaveau.

a51c1a6f268e5c87760ce365e6df2906c20a8c68.en: Gospel Dream, a choir founded in 1989, performs Afro-American church gospel songs at Église de la Madeleine.

94bf147c39151ca2d957221e5b798b3d229ddc5f.en: The Amazing Keystone Big Band, with singer Neima Naouri, performs 12 Judy Garland songs at Espace Carpeaux, including Somewhere Over The Rainbow.

dfa885894b2c1d9290b6bab942b2397383808160.en: Caravan is a musical at Le Funambule Montmartre inspired by the film Whiplash. A young jazz drummer leaves his family for the city.

c68dd0e308accb6d0e9b3c51e0852d582c067999.en: Tiquetonne is a play by Marguerite Kloeckner and Alexis Chevalier, directed by Chevalier. A woman meets Gershwin and tries to win back her lost kingdom. It runs 70 minutes.

c376eb90258d3aa9dee332b946719caa35b612a1.en: Comme s'il en pleuvait is a comedy-drama by Sébastien Thiéry at Théâtre des Mathurins. A couple finds money appearing in their living room. The show lasts 1 hour 15 minutes and is for ages 12 and up.

90a1c4aeb6bcd344e022c77f329af725c6dc1b5f.en: Dance or Die, a piano show by David Greilsammer at La Scala Paris, was inspired by a ceremony in the Amazon. It explores a more physical approach to the piano.

8723787fc4191c60e45b302eb7ee561b6b574a34.en: Tchaikovsky, Mozart and Chopin is a candlelit concert at Église Saint-Ephrem, a Baroque church built in 1733 in the Latin Quarter, with pianists who won national awards.

331d07d3eb11f3fc7e5cbca45ede564a42327cc0.en: The Monteverdi Choir, with the English Baroque Soloists under Christophe Rousset, performs Handel's oratorio Theodora at Salle Gaveau on 13 November 2026 at 19:30.

da47ce09c99365c4ad499505b7f90226ecca6ce0.en: The Witcher III: Wild Hunt concert, celebrating the game's 10th anniversary, is at Le Grand Rex on 13 November 2026. The show then goes to Radiant-Bellevue in Lyon on 18 November.

64d5838b446f605a62ca14a207b9bdb3121e375d.en: Così fan tutte, the Mozart opera with libretto by Da Ponte directed by Jean-Yves Ruf, is at Athénée Théâtre Louis-Jouvet. It is performed by the Concert de la Loge under Julien Chauvin.

647c77411011cd78b57aed1e97271fb045643d00.en: Fontaines D.C. plays Accor Arena on the autumn tour of about twenty arena concerts across Europe and the UK. The seating numbering in the hall is reversed.

d3c60878254970cf70045168287cb9478e0fbf13.en: Eric Dupond-Moretti presents J'ai dit oui., a show about his 36 years as a lawyer and his time as Minister of Justice, at Théâtre Marigny. The performance on 13 November will be filmed.

67cbb6aa0ca47c240a9a7fa1415d89a59a2f4c4c.en: Nosaj Thing and Daito Manabe present LXR, their first joint music project, which combines sound, visuals and generative systems. It is at La Gaîté Lyrique.

9268597d93f2b7b0e1f0f47c242a818a2e0a73dc.en: Omah Lay performs at Zénith Paris – La Villette on 13 November 2026 on the Clarity of Mind Tour. The Nigerian afrobeat artist has been active since 2020.

bcbe72ba8689dbdf9beb71b5bd1d41ee3d55cfc5.en: Noonzy, a Belgian indie-pop artist with four years of career, performs at Popup. on 13 November.

ffa87718a45d0010eca7506465c476f8ccb160b2.en: Thomas Barbazan, known as DJ Chelou, presents a show of songs, stand-up and impressions at Apollo Théâtre. He has worked in radio for more than 20 years.

278beae7e18fd00cdc370996eeec040abec0e606.en: Flash Cocotte is a club night at La Machine du Moulin Rouge on Friday 13 November, across the Central and Chaufferie spaces, with one ticket for both.

bc715c07fe044a2d48d3254f2800ac97624498b5.en: Andy Warhol: La ligne et l'image, an exhibition of Warhol's drawings at the Musée du Luxembourg from 16 September 2026 to 10 January 2027. This guided tour is given in English.

569d86e2801ac67c19c3aad94efc80244532f79f.en: Le Cid by Pierre Corneille, directed by Jean-Philippe Daguerre, tells the story of Chimène and Rodrigue, whose love is opposed by their families in Castile. It is staged at Théâtre Le Ranelagh.

5a8f23665e47ceb37c0afd7336b137a6af46690f.en: Lilly, le musical is an original family musical by Oscar Sisto and Lou Deleuze, who won Eurovision Junior 2025. It is staged at Théâtre de la Tour Eiffel.

655849c5977f357373230c1ae22472470c30c180.en: La Course des marmottes de Noël is a family musical at Mélo d'Amélie. A young marmot named Lily wants to meet Father Christmas before her six-month hibernation.

e60e864f86f111fcf9f564d66d8adf0362ff1e69.en: Belmondo – Le Magnifique is an exhibition about Jean-Paul Belmondo at the Cinémathèque Française from 14 October to 15 November 2026. Suitable from age 6; closed on Tuesdays.

7e39dfaf658e735573d4894f34a3f542c2364886.en: Christelle Chollet presents Culottée, her new stand-up show marking 20 years of her career, performed with live musicians at L'Européen.

39c965fa0d6c4bcf10f12c2e8f26de00696ab5e6.en: L'Odyssée lumineuse, a light show at the Parc Floral de Paris, runs from 14 November 2026 to 24 January 2027. Some dates are excluded, and the park closes at 22:00.

76e1222c31f15cd428a6549ae4730168cc14eed5.en: Le Clan des Poétesses is a show by three young poets who combine poetry with dance, music and humour. It is staged in Salle 2 of La Scène Parisienne.

dcd5fe78cfccb74b0c775dc62697a307adde3971.en: Walls of Jericho, the Detroit metalcore band fronted by Candace Kucsulain, plays Alhambra on 14 November 2026. Support acts are to be announced.

a5ecd15a31196a91badee4c8c16f1805bc3178d7.en: PRESIDENT, a British collective that mixes metal and electronic music, plays Élysée Montmartre. Ticket purchases are limited to eight per order.

a7f9a64dec4d6219216c810443d75b4e74d5df40.en: Jason Brokerss performs the last dates of his show in Paris at Théâtre de la Madeleine, after two sold-out seasons. The show is recommended from age 16.

1b89eaae3d7b6d3d2b6d5d569bd4c12541d58350.en: Apollo Comedy Club is an open stage night at Apollo Théâtre in Paris, featuring emerging comedians.

4d1111f4138d855846c0681ed5e236af54dba277.en: The Jeff Panacloc Company is an immersive comedy show at Dôme de Paris, set in the secret office of Jeff Panacloc.

84ac052f30015b96a70327e1aec8ff382ead3f59.en: JB Mpiana, known as Papa Chéri and leader of Wenge Musica, performs Congolese rumba at Accor Arena. He has been active for more than 40 years.

be4d42aece526eda2494faa6c5407bd11ef4a69a.en: Rosa Bursztein presents Dédoublée at the Casino de Paris, a show about her search for love and her contradictions. It covers family history and motherhood.

cf5ac8a49b714cb280f0c6eac553d680865fa2df.en: Ensemble..., a concert at La Cigale with Mike and Riké of Sinsemilia, Guizmo and Manu of Tryo, and HK and Vanupié, sharing songs from their repertoires.

2283f02227515542bd725e91610fb2696606f296.en: Marlon Magnée, co-founder of La Femme, performs as a solo artist at Le Trianon with his first solo album. Ticket purchases are limited to eight per order.

d8e5a4facbc01e8e7dc01065ab6e04e761ae8bff.en: Yannick Noah presents an acoustic tour with guitarist Nicolas Paillet at L'Embarcadère, revisiting his biggest hits with stories from his career.

c54e6d52473cc672b3ac70abbbb0cc88a735f02e.en: The Vintage Caravan, an Icelandic rock band, plays Glazart as part of Garmonbozia's presentation. The band has toured Europe, the UK and South America.

8da91e302e97d09a9f937ab370729870f21ca767.en: Deelee S, a French hip-hop artist from the south of France, performs at La Maroquinerie. He writes with a West Coast and French rap influence.

5c8ec5a4ffeb6ace94ff88c1e59d86cfb1c59204.en: Richard Bona performs at Salle Gaveau with his trio of piano, drums and bass. The concert opens the Jazz à Gaveau season.

b3255a3aca6ec7935ed1bc3c1bf1cbea78ccf8d5.en: Calogero performs a selection of songs from his career in more intimate venues at Théâtre Jacques Prévert, Salle Molière, with reworked versions.

d2cf1c0039751ae3322a7dcdd24af10cc8e79de0.en: Willy Rovelli presents a stand-up show at Théâtre de la Clarté about finding happiness despite climate change, conflicts and inflation.

83a4337ac1c6c54e9be0e8bfa55590a01b53604d.en: Le Jour où j'ai osé is a magic show by Alexandra Duvivier at Le Double Fond. It tells the story of her shyness and the path to becoming a magician.

8b765adfbe7ef3c54921e293e5df2ff6266c6f2f.en: Une année de réchauffement is a comedy by Frédéric, a man who struggles with climate anxiety and becomes a national activist. It is staged at Le Funambule Montmartre.

ec7725f3f14f4292585cbae4c8b9f6f5db2f1e7e.en: L'Odyssée lumineuse, Open ticket version, runs at the Parc Floral de Paris from 14 November 2026 to 24 January 2027 with the same schedule.

1db89637a551d42736bca09f8ccb6fbbc1ee11d2.en: Bébé Concert presents Johann Sebastian Bach at Salle Gaveau, a 40-minute morning concert for children and adults.

69780a2632ad59be3304257789b36f4c063753cb.en: Le Grrôle de Noël is a Christmas comedy by the SAFA brothers at Gaîté Rive Gauche. The Grinch-like character Le Grrôle plans to steal all the presents, but a girl named Anna gets in his way.

e6b5df7a4ab0402af1807ebd81cd44cd8f0aa39e.en: Le Cas Pucine presents Anima, a new show by Eliott and Capucine after their work on the television talent show La France a un incroyable talent. It is at La Cigale.

60b0bdb3c00ffff70f0fd3e81c173e82bf8268e6.en: Beethoven's Pastoral Symphony is performed by the Orchestre Colonne under Félix Benatti at Seine Musicale on 15 November at 16:00. The programme includes a new work by Manoukian and a mystery piece.

64b33cc466398fc801a0e0edc5af7773abe62ff1.en: Faites nous confiance is an improvised theatre show by two actors who build a fiction from a story told by a spectator. It is staged at Théâtre Bo Saint-Martin.

29aca35a7712d0189292a8bb11e7f8bfb910cec2.en: Mozart's Requiem, Gjeilo's Sunrise Mass and Handel's Hallelujah are performed at Église Saint-Louis-en-l'Île by the Chambre Musicale orchestra and Chœur Tempestuoso.

628129b796bf1a5086b63a8b4541237394dfa8bb.en: Le Chanteur, a musical tribute to Daniel Balavoine at Espace des Arts, traces his career. Balavoine died aged 33 in a helicopter accident during the Paris-Dakar rally in 1986.

330f5711f743f0df60d885d14f69ed387e177c03.en: Mendelssohn, Schubert and Beethoven is a chamber concert at Église Saint-Ephrem with cellist Maya Devane and pianist Darreng Sheng. The works include Beethoven's Sonata Op. 69.

85fd012e904d6f6214e713c16ffee0becdf8a343.en: Coco Makmak presents Big Time, a 1h15 one-woman stand-up show about cultural contradictions, family taboos and mixed marriages, at La Scène Parisienne, Salle 1.

4ffaf7f59a32c6a7a725b277bc4253cf9ebb8bbd.en: Hélène presents a concert at Salle Pleyel on 15 November as the final date of a tour through China that runs from Shanghai to Beijing. It includes her hits and Chinese songs.

a22937b2d1c204452605c812dcfc2243959eac43.en: Clayton Stephenson, the first Black finalist of the Van Cliburn competition, makes his Paris debut at Salle Gaveau with works by Bach-Busoni, Albéniz and Prokofiev.

74ae8904c9f7190c06f5b9873cdb54e02e6f9a1a.en: Yannick Noah presents Un p'tit tour à deux, an acoustic concert at Le Grand Rex on 15 November 2026 at 18:00, with guitarist Nicolas Paillet.

2fc9ea7a339242dde74a3df0626901174900d704.en: Boy Harsher, a duo formed in 2014, performs at Le Bataclan. Their song Pain comes from the EP Lesser Man.

a8eff21a288053f97d966d4d103e5bef0ec671b8.en: Westlife performs at Zénith Paris – La Villette on the British and European leg of their 25th anniversary tour. Ticket purchases are limited to eight per order.

21b03c94623cd4528ef02a0d30dce6fe366da340.en: Kery James presents an explosive hip-hop concert at Accor Arena on 15 November 2026, performing tracks from his album R.A.P. with a DJ, drummer and guest artists.

f11482565966ced8f7d2d6316e2496d9beaf4eec.en: Soprano Lise Davidsen gives a Lieder recital of Franz Schubert songs, including Erlkönig and Ganymed, accompanied by pianist James Baillieu at Palais Garnier. Orders are final.

e10a03b756e0baaf2c167af7471372d743832cd4.en: LP performs at L'Olympia, presenting her soul-influenced pop. Ticket purchases are limited to eight per order.

4b652d6837dbca68be8b0ae9f7953a997e6b3826.en: Chinchilla, an independent pop-rock artist known for Little Girl Gone, plays La Maroquinerie with Jolina Louise as support.

e177b2ac145fcbfad036a85950639e49d30b947f.en: Montell Fish presents his new project Nest at the Casino de Paris on 15 November. The alternative artist has more than 4.2 billion streams.

21fb37c941bd8a951afe45599a34b146a1999294.en: Au plus près de Lanvin & Marchal at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, an evening of almost two hours with Gérard Lanvin and Olivier Marchal, who talk as friends.

d2d4083f743bd20d8553efb0606add3d679dede3.en: Girls in Hawaii at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, presenting the album Eldorado, out 25 September 2026, with a European tour in the autumn.

7a864b87c5e8e7965b328bf424bb5100f7fdefa3.en: Marine Leonardi's show at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Les Derniers Couches. Cynical and dark humour about everyday annoyances, from couples to motherhood.

ffce696ffda56bb1d3d6f774999e846b61b20c7d.en: Tristan Lucas at La Baie des Singes in Clermont-Ferrand. In 60 minutes, Tristan revisits life decade by decade with absurd and sharp questions.

9d60c9890f445fa6da867765467542a39d4cebfd.en: The Locos (ex-Ska-P) at La Puce à l'Oreille in Clermont-Ferrand. The band was formed in 2005 by Pipi, a former singer of Ska-P, and marked 20 years in 2025.

ed7c3f9e7b8f584f62364e3632e9520188ed214b.en: Secrets de Beatmaker, a children's concert from age 6 at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, lasting 50 minutes.

fe7ba7fe8780423eae13ec4b6508519a9349a0ab.en: Bal Barre at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand. The SuperTronica project mixes traditional music from Auvergne and Lithuania with electronic music.

1d55a4c9652153c595d21bbbb0f3547a43196fcf.en: The Nutcracker ballet at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, Tchaikovsky's music with Marius Petipa's choreography, following a girl's Christmas Eve.

093994fbb1bc629af77293dfa490b42e9a8833cd.en: Frankie and the Witch Fingers at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand.

2b7e3d1afc6dc273efc3a15708567a6401d5584c.en: La Team Goldman at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Les Derniers Couches, a show of Jean-Jacques Goldman's songs. Its first Zénith date in December 2024 drew more than 4,500 people.

22dc929d09d8a23b4209329e6cf55afa247ed2d9.en: Camille's The Sound of Milk at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand. Nine years after Ouï, the album comes in three parts: Naissance, Enfance and more.

4f60bae64b26166ed143412fd408be619a150540.en: Cascadeur at La Puce à l'Oreille in Clermont-Ferrand. After more than 15 years, a Victoire de la Musique and four albums, the band plays an anniversary tour.

2cb6e04dec39782319ac25ed0b6e9be617490ab5.en: Le grand Noël au Zénith at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand on 5 and 6 December 2026, a Christmas show after a 2025 edition.

34f9f7b1ae04e1e460c9e7b49146cccb182b44c9.en: Raeverie invites Dawn to Dusk at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Kulture2.

9af94564ff3547cd27da5b075887bab57b033e9b.en: Yanns at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Les Derniers Couches. At 26, Yanns has sold over 100,000 albums and 150,000 concert tickets.

adca65c122a2cbbdc5371d92df56a3bef8d3b800.en: Piche at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand. At 29, the singer describes a hybrid identity that defies labels, blending drag and music.

f81d3a2d27ba4f85f00204286af7637e38656633.en: Christophe Maé at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Décibels Productions and Martiprod. He returns to the biggest stages in France, Switzerland and Belgium in 2026 after a triumphant tour.

bee055c1cf56f46ce6e0491d5e3321548e33c50b.en: Gaëtan Roussel at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Les Derniers Couches, on the solo tour for his sixth studio album, Marjolaine.

f1f66814769244264d503734ede1ee2dba90b4d5.en: The Amy Winehouse Band at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand.

c8174de70fa277657784e9216d1d9204a0883efe.en: With U2 Day at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, a tribute concert to U2 by four performers. It is not U2, and none of its members appear.

0d11959242a523b623de34d85e46c53c7e56151b.en: Zaoui at La Puce à l'Oreille in Clermont-Ferrand. Raphaël Faget-Zaoui, after the success of Thérapie Taxi, launches a solo project under the name Zaoui with insolent, intimate pop.

67eb52476d25639fd2805401d6dab39a4f81b53f.en: Yan Wagner's Il est vilaine at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, a set drawing on albums such as Forty Eight Hours, This Never Happened and Couleur Chaos.

681698d1e81c4436746eb8e4b99fb81ea43fa361.en: Anthony Kavanagh's Happy show, in preview, at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Les Derniers Couches. The Quebec comedian's show shares his contagious energy and humour.

a30ecb9497df3c55d2870ee10dfbaf3da1d4330f.en: Casse-Noisette, a two-act ballet by Imperial Heritage Ballet at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, a sumptuous production in which toys come to life.

da21bc9b070f30d248092df28b30075b9db5b61e.en: Le Paname Comedy Club on tour at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Les Derniers Couches. An hour of stand-up from the club's comedians across France.

de4e4082083c8779c545a878926b91631ca03a6f.en: Gospel pour 100 voix at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Les Derniers Couches, a 100-voice gospel show nominated for a Reality TV Award in London.

d82c5a4af9c046bfe9c00a47f31c5da1a26961d5.en: Morgane Berling at Maison de la Culture's Salle Boris Vian in Clermont-Ferrand. At 24, Morgane wonders how to become an adult, balancing Saturday nights and the Sunday market.

08ee910ae6d9e64c5ab403849fdf104cf2fc5edd.en: Morgane Berling at the Salle Boris Vian of Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, a comedy about becoming an adult, split between Saturday nights and Sunday markets, with cheeky humour.

e88209a67624d30e273ed0da30d63b05e1a6eab2.en: Gus the illusionist at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Les Derniers Couches. A new show with bigger illusions that take the audience up into the mountains, with the poetic and interactive style of his earlier work.

0be62bcff41d70916a572d79695c69a3f937305a.en: Romuald Maufras at La Baie des Singes in Clermont-Ferrand, a new show on government, ecology, education and consumption, with sensitive subjects and stand-up in the style of his online videos.

9d41445de2cfa7d874799530d38bba6edd0436df.en: Les Quatre Saisons, a family ballet to Vivaldi's The Four Seasons at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Capitale Production.

ba00304d08e4455ce33282a15c04b629e0ace5bd.en: Thomas Marty at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Les Derniers Couches, returning after the success of his first show to tell new adventures.

f08cfd4f0495dd0c7ce73d9c2a3fb260420e8147.en: Foxhole and Not Scientists at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand. The punk-rock and post-punk band plays nervous guitars, tense basslines and raw emotion, influenced by The Cure, The Clash, Joy Division and the Ramones.

7931d6838d36f931b8ca46bd4ece42b4df546875.en: Michèle Laroque and Kad Merad in L'Âge bête at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Fimalac Entertainment. A play by Olivier Baroux about a new couple who want to live their story without limits.

9e6745c1fcc4f4540988b0fd31cae132cd473b74.en: Tagada Jones at L'Arlequin in Clermont-Ferrand. The French alternative rock band, which blends metal, punk and hardcore, has played nearly 2,000 concerts in 43 countries.

e43b67321ed3af1703a64a4d5ae92785800f2987.en: Dub Coast 9 at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, a winter sound system night with Dawa Hifi Sound System, Bass Troopers and Zites Vibration.

31d23b00df19527cfa678ca42d2020ebf2094bfd.en: Zamdane at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, touring The Spectacle Rahma after two sold-out Olympia dates and a sold-out Zénith in Paris. The show follows the album SOLSAD.

a4f16cac4ae0aac3f96ea57a23b98ed1dd807007.en: Nawell Madani's new show at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Les Derniers Couches. It covers mental load, fame and botox in a frank and mature tone.

dc51c9b6fcefa402be986d62c0568a8361a89bcf.en: Clément Viktorovitch's L'art de ne pas dire at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by TAL Ticket. He is a political science doctor known for explaining public debate in the media, online and in books.

7e80b9ec0586de3b7336c213347427a21a254dee.en: Kid Francescoli at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, the project of Marseille producer Mathieu Hocine. Its sound is elegant, sensual and cinematic.

1f5d8465e63d761c48a205d85bc80dc76c60049f.en: The Hillbilly Moon Explosion at La Puce à l'Oreille in Clermont-Ferrand, a Swiss modern rockabilly band with the voice of Emanuela Hutter and double bass by Oliver Baroni.

7b9bfe01ca77994192aa3b43b24e9589cd3ed198.en: Les hommes viennent de Mars et les femmes de Vénus at the Polydome amphitheatre in Clermont-Ferrand, a stage show presented by RPO, based on the popular book on relationships.

e75cf0f835019ce4a0327a3baa9569bed43df732.en: Les Étoiles du Cirque de Pékin's Odyssée at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, a flamboyant acrobatic show that reinvents China's ancient acrobatic arts.

b56f8875bec5b5c57f76bd440792e3ae27cce82c.en: Forever, the tribute show to Michael Jackson at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, marking his death on 25 June 2009.

52223492b73344ad427e58df86200d5e0ef771c4.en: Bigflo & Oli's Karma Tour at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, promoting Karma, their fifth album, a return to rap roots after more than 10 years of work.

beab537e53fc253fda5c81244c9094c7a8369582.en: Après la nuit at La Puce à l'Oreille in Clermont-Ferrand, an immersive show where couples, childhood friends, brothers and near strangers wake up together in one bed.

a4e5ad492d60d88c456587e98042779901033b10.en: Les Chevaliers du Fiel's Fansvacances à Dubaï at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, a comedy about Dubai as the trendy destination, with Christian Lambert, a star character from their hit plays.

058f3b4d8940d773b0d0e5c85292727f39a089d8.en: La P'tite Fumée at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, returning with an explosive tour and a reinvented live show for their instrumental electro.

0864b952f4060e8726ca7c6ae0404cc1e8c990b1.en: Les Louanges at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand. The project of Vincent Roberge, a singer-songwriter and producer, draws on D'Angelo, Gorillaz and Leonard Cohen.

528c8607df03785388763301d15ff2fbcc6d3c20.en: A single-person ticket for L'Aventure Michelin in Clermont-Ferrand, valid until 31 December 2027 according to the opening calendar. The museum covers more than 130 years of the Michelin group's history.

ea70247f277b8da684ed19d9ee46bad1f57bfb48.en: Gauvain Sers at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, returning with a fourth album after four years, between Paris and the Creuse, intimate and political.

5cf49306d6d2984fba7f027da8f6e853ae6d1156.en: Les Bodin's Grandeur Nature at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, returning in 2027 as an extension of the 30th anniversary tour.

fdc01be7759ea643d4802b5486b91b668c300f5e.en: The Last Internationale at La Puce à l'Oreille in Clermont-Ferrand, a New York rock band formed by singer Delila Paz and guitarist Edgey Pires, known for its political lyrics.

c6777990903cba14254e73630242ad3e83702836.en: Zed Yun Pavarotti's Unmiracle Tour at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, with 11 new dates in 2027, including one at the Olympia on 17 February, and songs from his third album.

c7487939094308f255138fd32d8904c344f4e5c5.en: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, A Painted Symphony, at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand. The soundtrack of the video game goes on an international tour in 2027. Purchases are limited to four tickets per order.

36fe1b9e480b63529927baf721ad25445fabff3d.en: Linh's first national tour at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Les Derniers Couches, after the single Je pense à vous, which has 50 million streams.

e0c62a4fc28e4dbef5bd089bfdb3e6d6977db8ba.en: Lisa Perrio's one-person show at the Salle Boris Vian of Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, co-written with Florian Nardone, with a gallery of characters met during the day.

31b732fb992ab717006a5d56c41078c5d077249b.en: Enslaved, Sólstafir and Gaahls Wyrd at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand. The co-headline tour runs in February 2027 across Europe and the UK, and Enslaved's new album Mið is out on 30 October 2026.

9274f63e146c6486630e5edbb7caa63d17ee9d1d.en: Ugly Kid Joe at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, presented with AEG. The satirical hard rock band from Isla Vista, California, is known for the album America's Least Wanted (1992).

886b211890643ce88e00997568b74f1abcfbf10b.en: L'Arnaqueuse at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Cœur de Scène Productions.

1b4b29200d664605607fb19f14f6562aad64a169.en: And Also the Trees at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, after 45 years and 14 studio albums, with independent records that move beyond coldwave and gothic rock.

d4583654b8d49341f2df15e8e145e7b2f441fb74.en: The Magical Music of Harry Potter at Salle Jean Cocteau in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by France Billet and Star Entertainment. Oscar-nominated film music, with The Magical Film Orchestra and Choir and illusions.

7e9469624d74d74dbd1814d94e6a91af73a88987.en: The Music of Hans Zimmer & Others at Salle Jean Cocteau in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by France Billet, with film scores from Dune, James Bond, Pirates of the Caribbean, The Lion King, Gladiator and more.

a2c5b045455d2831c45a278e6e964f02044365c3.en: JeanJass at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, a rapper and producer shaped by Belgium and Morocco, presenting Les Champs de Sacs Plastiques.

452539f05f8270fe98b5deaf6e4a910620890b62.en: Keen'V's 20th anniversary show at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, reflecting on the Équilibre Tour and starting a new page.

cbe972b0369abaca7ed2a10796f6403d7827e3c2.en: Sidilarsen and Parallyx at La Puce à l'Oreille in Clermont-Ferrand. Sidilarsen presents Que la lumière soit, its eighth album, which follows the hit On va tous crever.

143b34d3a152f605dd9823d337d93a2a95fdf49d.en: Anne Roumanoff's L'âge libre at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Les Derniers Couches. Humour and bite about the contemporary world and its contradictions, with characters such as an exalted conspiracy theorist.

ed1e2e3b602090fde31b7856a51931251e1f5de4.en: Chest and Deefait at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand. The band mixes hard music with pure joy, blending the influences of its members into a personal sound.

e171ef51fc768eb736f24b7ab3be2501d674b5fc.en: Le Lac des Cygnes, a ballet with orchestra, at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Capitale Production, on a 2027 tour across France and Europe.

a7a0d827617516721504364dd0bab967516e9da9.en: Pomme at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, presenting her fifth album at 30. It is the first album she has directed alone, after earlier albums with Waxx, Albin de la Simone and Flavien Berger.

ec04f22107d8c32f49a32bce51d2240f2690dc5b.en: La légende d'Auria, Les traqueuses d'ombre, at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, a musical adventure in which three young artists, Auria, Lumea and Stellia, protect the light from Noxar.

a05ce3e8aa52fe1c36e94be4de935aa3d5550efe.en: Aldebert's anniversary show at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, built around a selection of songs and a childlike spirit that refuses to grow up.

55340e08ec7f24a3033965bf401fd5f5650b84a2.en: Sellig's Épisode 7 at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, a comedy about everyday moments that spiral out of control, from hotel receptions to gift boxes with a shamanism workshop.

de5cd3913be0bf63ff1044b7d07da5b4583ddf81.en: Arnaud Tsamère at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Les Derniers Couches, after his show 2 mariages et 1 enterrement, which is also available on Canal.

dc163385e104e53c546db8467243e72e1f96fc71.en: Sarah Schwab's Elles & moi at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, a new show with an orchestra, after her tour and her run at the Folies Bergère.

2f80be1d3b31586f57a75e647a52b420962963bf.en: Thylacine at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, a concert about finding balance with oneself and the world, as the artist continues a creative quest.

80fb3d7a63c1fdbb19d7ff91b611de9f43e41051.en: Charlie Haid's final run of his humour and mentalism show at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Les Derniers Couches, after a successful tour across the French-speaking world.

7298ad057c2d5cda25da7b01a43992a3122e6d71.en: Celtic Legends' 25th anniversary tour at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand. The band plays Salle Pleyel in Paris from 26 to 28 February 2027, then tours France. It has shared its music with more than 3 million spectators.

fb59ce11ea44994d43561a1d4a84f1eed8de651c.en: K-Pop Sensations, a new 2027 K-pop tribute show at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, with singers, dancers, LED screens and light effects.

58739f9edbb1a555685e79f19d33b8e76fe23c86.en: Dominique A at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, presenting the album Spirales, which grew out of a walk in his town in June 2024.

35cca818daf492dd25451e1e5d230c4c8c7fef3e.en: MPL at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand. The uplifting group has a sound with no fixed family and is free to mix styles.

0f276e55b4572525f6fa52e3e2cf61d377173e1f.en: Le Gang des Chieuses at Théâtre du Casino de Royat, presented by Cœur de Scène Productions.

01c5af90dda6eb3d2094590f2a9bbe4058cf475d.en: Ninho at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, on a large 2027 tour. The rapper has more than 430 certified singles and several multi-certified albums.

4cb4c145d750c0d8ff2912e407976ba6ee19763b.en: Greg Duth's Coquille at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Contremarque. A stand-up show with jokes about the show itself.

d2d6d838127e91667ec9cf49380115188f198789.en: Raul Midón at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, a Grammy-nominated singer and guitarist who blends soul, jazz, Latin rhythms and acoustic folk.

50044eeee3c8f5153951b0e6e4a175ad06985b93.en: Bernard Lavilliers at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, on a 2027 tour of 30 dates, including songs from the album Rite cruel.

79aa0db532a53b05de8a228f32977d656b77f779.en: Jain at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, presenting Soul System, her fourth album. It blends electro, rock, funk and clubbing and comes after more than 12 years of work.

22a208ae1d82c4efd8fcb1e98b1d5dab029f7e61.en: Edgar-Yves Jr. at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by RPO, back on the road after two years of touring Solide and online videos.

7fd864c24dbb33b2646641ad27ba208386f5c069.en: 500 voix pour Johnny at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Voices Harmony. Ten years after his death, 15,000 choristers will sing in a tribute to Johnny Hallyday in 2027.

5a6491c82dc24eb2d96ced80439fb6848c0b0117.en: La Rue Kétanou at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, a band with more than 20 years of free and friendly songs and loyal fans.

97d6f9e3a83826e21d01e2dca1b65bfd91e51d9f.en: Messmer's 13Hz at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand in 2027, the hypnotist's final performances to close the 13Hz tour.

3141520027016cb0e0fdbba3480a4298e086d879.en: Chantal Goya's 50 Ans d'Amour at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, celebrating 50 years on stage from 1975 to 2025 with a show built around the world of Marie-Rose.

562f91e2e4f5e32a9c32c12d633a6f5432bb7a3b.en: La Lettre at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, a comedy about four childhood friends who reunite after the death of Samy and find a letter that holds all their secrets.

66708fe41e5c5673061234c5d5165c7652dff1bd.en: Julien Santini at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, an unclassifiable stand-up show that mixes offbeat humour, poetry and daring.

704d6ad5dc51943551ec1abd9de064b7510894ea.en: Loïc Nottet at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, returning with new music and a new chapter that is freer and more intimate, on a tour of France and Belgium.

8388d22231862480bf550e851e722a1b797752c5.en: Médine's Enfants du destin at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, presented by Furax and Mind. The rapper tells stories of children caught in the turmoil of history.

f7973cd8b741bb50d29c04303761f97b015c07a3.en: Danyl at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand. The self-taught producer, songwriter and beatmaker was one of the first to make tracks live on Twitch, and draws on raï sounds.

d1c735793b3af98c0331c3be51bd5195bd6bba1d.en: Arnaud Demanche's Beaux tout nus at La Baie des Singes in Clermont-Ferrand, a corrosive show about the obsession with appearance, based on an anecdote from a first date 25 years earlier.

9cf79c44ad0908ea5ec52903466343c5994c130a.en: Isaac Delusion at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, a pop artist since 2012 whose delicate and timeless sound draws on Anglo-Saxon influences.

6f2e293caa51f72451125da0bf2759b3f71466dc.en: Olivier de Benoist's show at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, the story of an incurable optimist who loses his way and finds a family.

88d31931b5e747efe7ff610fb53173bc0796c42b.en: Patrick Fiori at Zénith d'Auvergne in Clermont-Ferrand, returning after a successful tour to reinvent the meeting with the audience in a warm and generous evening.

23e67cd3869035cd79e8ce014adffa3f6caf0c15.en: Fabrice Éboué's Solitude at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, staged by Thomas Gaudin and following the Adieu Hier tour. Not recommended under 15.

0e9af2cae1cb26b91bef4566e57917947eb0cb0b.en: Zélie at La Coopérative de Mai in Clermont-Ferrand, singing and dancing about strength and sensitivity over energetic songs with electronic sounds.

b03f977239f6471917cbfc3d08aa4dccf14be411.en: Il Cello at Maison de la Culture in Clermont-Ferrand, a trio of three singers, Salvatore, Sébastien and Levon, discovered on The Voice France and trained by Florent Pagny.

df523ede5e7112cf73c6a8334949759505e172db.en: Le Mariage de Figaro at the Théâtre de la Porte Saint-Martin in Paris, directed by Alain Françon, with Vincent Dedienne as Figaro, Micha Lescot and Alix Poisson as the Almavivas, and Noémie Lvovsky as Marcelline.

3bfd12101de50c40b9f8b44640d86ac05ba9429e.en: Día de Muertos, an exhibition by Marta Nascimento at the Éphémère Galerie of Comptoir des Voyages and along rue Saint-Victor in Paris. The artist from Rio de Janeiro studied journalism before working in the Amazon.

2cf836ccf2ed25373a0628b4415d085263c59224.en: An exhibition and games at the Maison de l'animal en ville in Paris about misunderstood animals such as crows, rats, foxes, cockroaches, mosquitoes and bats.

7c75379d688476dbe6a5cc23e025b9d30a701e84.en: Ciné-club Intérieur/Nuit #23 in Paris, a screening of En Liberté. (2018) by Pierre Salvadori, with Adèle Haenel and Pio Marmaï. The script was co-written by Benoît Graffin, Benjamin Charbit and Pierre Salvadori.

167c0bc98608466caea482fae6b60ab8c0d35390.en: Ces femmes qui construisent at the ENSA Paris-La Villette, a documentation project since 2024 of the work, tools and innovations of women builders. More than 350 women have contributed.

76b0b4919acde353b5a42e4d471616d12a8f1952.en: Les vents français à la conquête du monde at the Conservatoire Frédéric Chopin in Paris, a wind concert featuring Roussel's Divertissement Op. 6, with rare works by Hindemith, Zemlinsky and Janáček.

204683042bec8f852011ca462b1b36f02b8e3d01.en: A meeting with the Danish poet Pia Tafdrup at the Bibliothèque Sainte-Geneviève in Paris. Tafdrup's work explores the body, nature and love, rooted in attention to sensation and language.

4fc93cd7d8a5ed75c822f88649ae9726fc8f7ff3.en: A board game evening at the Bibliothèque Amélie in Paris, for casual players and fans, with classic games and new releases.

01235d65a9cbc683f02b89db2eaef89a4705efbf.en: La Ronde des histoires at the Bibliothèque Jacqueline Dreyfus-Weill in Paris, a storytime with stories and nursery rhymes for children aged 6 months to 3 years. Registration is required.

e3ba43d2856f1b56da0a7165d607ae1637ff57c8.en: Stories for young and old at the Maison de l'animal en ville in Paris, with tales, picture books and kamishibai, on the theme of misunderstood animals.

eed21ed254b260837aa222bcb6e1742c58166abb.en: Les Variations Goldberg de Bach at the Église Saint-Ephrem in Paris, performed by pianist Remi Masunaga, with Bach's Goldberg Variations alongside Schubert's Impromptus and Liszt's Hungarian Rhapsody.

7c7a3af58255226c1ff056d34ef698fb28bcde4a.en: Jimmy Carr's Laughs Funny. at the Salle Pleyel in Paris, presented by Gérard Drouot Production. Fast jokes, sharp humour and direct interaction with the audience.

9d3e499f7f580e642b2e5c836853f40b63b92e55.en: Misandrag, an open-stage drag show hosted by Morphine Blaze at bonjour madame in Paris. Newcomers to drag perform in a friendly atmosphere. Free entry, with a donation on the night.

bbfe152b500a1c535a19499a0d473e2e34235000.en: A special screening of La Petite Dernière by Hafsia Herzi at UGC Ciné Cité Bercy in Paris. Fatima, 17, the youngest in a family from the suburbs, starts studying philosophy in Paris and begins to break from family traditions.

22bbcf67c2b891d2e2461847cc9006d0974260c3.en: The City of Paris at Paris Photo 2026 at the Grand Palais, marking 200 years of photography with the theme of alterations and the fragility and longevity of the medium.

8ebf4b0e2244309a72e1bed464a4d2cae67dccba.en: Le Concert pulvérisé by Léonie Pernet at the Carreau du Temple in Paris, a fragmented concert in which poems and audio archives run through the music, around the album Poèmes Pulvérisés.

7ca77f30978d50f5cbab68da1e69cfeae9418f4b.en: Redoubt, a Nordic film club screening at the Swedish Institute in Paris. During the Cold War, a farm labourer fortifies a house with scrap metal to protect himself and his neighbours, drawing their puzzlement.

9cb109f011323dc5d825059e8cb25c6b08248c61.en: A literary bistro with Jonathan Zaccaï and Sammy Lussan at the Centre Wallonie-Bruxelles in Paris, around Surexposé. A seaside holiday in Cape Verde turns sour when a compromising photo circulates.

7708bf3cad2c96b2637852e660f930c573ade3c1.en: À l'œuvre: Mariam The Believer at the Swedish Institute in Paris, contemporary chamber music in the Soleil et Lune exhibition, linking materials, colour, sound and voice.

66c792de7a7c63a311f7680ebd9435b451573cf8.en: Luther's Sublime Tour at the 360 venue in Rennes, presented by Cartel Concerts.

7155eaca403cc6ec346f02040b2c46e475c47b51.en: Merci au suivant at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a comedy by Robert Punzano, author of Ce soir ou jamais. Elsa, a single woman pressured by her mother and friends, looks for love.

edf2361caf4b56ad4aef727b94c221d2d534f60e.en: Hélène Vézier's Testostérone at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a show about women who have what it takes, covering guilt, expectations and social institutions.

75932d320b61aacb4189afbcb8d14842b1ec3f93.en: Forever, the tribute show to Michael Jackson by Richard Walter Productions at Zénith de Rouen, marking the 2009 death of the King of Pop.

f9dd23f58e09e8fc875451f01ab2783813a49968.en: Nadège's Puzzle at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a personal show about being a woman, the daughter of immigrants and a global citizen, covering motherhood and burnout.

23c175075064eb616e65d7948f4eab57947d87ae.en: Philippe Audrey Larrue-St-Jacques' Enfant du siècle at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a show that uses intelligence and culture for humour. It has won over Canadian audiences.

5b2754e409a58813fc89c94cdcf65edd040e1ec1.en: Thomas Marty at Zénith de Rouen, returning after the success of his first show to tell new adventures.

aec2e02997013a13cc9bf92cd1fceefea74d6c8c.en: With U2 Day at Zénith de Rouen, a tribute concert to U2 by four performers who play the band's biggest hits. It is not U2, and none of its members appear.

f92c3538ee100afd1e3b79a5ca0aeadcfdee49eb.en: Celtic Legends' 25th anniversary tour at Zénith de Rouen. The band plays Salle Pleyel in Paris from 26 to 28 February 2027, followed by a national tour.

9c7d0bde96ab07501225578c1f66dfcf5bfbf9d4.en: Nina Azoulai's Bonne copine at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a sarcastic show about trying to tick the boxes of success, from career to marriage and children.

d7a089a95b491e5071944daf8a1a4f5ec37acc2c.en: Cécile Marx's Iconique at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a stand-up and music show about embarrassing moments becoming great stories, from toxic friendships to a chaotic path.

1d571c32350c8bfc879b546928e1a152c5309d6f.en: Julien Schmidt at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a one-man show featuring characters from his TV and Instagram work, from a punk dog to a ski resort director.

6ad431a4527f3ac6b3358a87b0ca2d60998978fe.en: Cirque Arlette Gruss' Essentiel at the Chapiteau Arlette Gruss in Rouen, a circus show about what makes life worth an epic.

207627f0920e7a8351557718f94b29f1daa7edab.en: Nawell Madani's new show at Zénith de Rouen, speaking frankly about mental load, fame and the daily challenges of life.

a030a494e97c18b360c09042280f2d9afd5b9e7b.en: François Guédon's Aux urnes et caetera at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a comedy about politics ahead of 2027, including the question of a licence to be French.

e6e2b165750cc53f38fdbbc7962c3d3d2e7019ed.en: Chicandier et Mathou Cann at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, back after two years away, playing their own roles and characters to depict the times with no holds barred.

bd4bba03878dd173f66d93419c6a4f7de7b49045.en: Guillaume Sentou's Mec cool at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a show that asks what makes a cool guy, with wordplay and humour.

50688631d6ddfcbae9ef43c6b1cce52897a85a6e.en: Bernard Lavilliers at Zénith de Rouen, on tour with 30 dates in 2027, presented by Gilbert Coullier Productions and Gentilshommes de Fortune.

633adf57f2edb3c7c6c05f9c3f9ea5136e8331ab.en: François Mallet at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a stand-up show about mental health, falls and cracks, told with humour and sincerity.

cdc8f818da0c4f363763925825199a680f7ad891.en: Luc Langevin's L'illusionniste at Zénith de Rouen, a large-scale illusion show created with his long-time collaborator, the magician Stéphane Bourgoin.

e7136d541b8c595cf2f66d99ebe51fdb1120f625.en: Frédérick Sigrist's 39 – 45 at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a new show about the age range that marked his life, by a humorist with radio and TV work on France Inter.

b7e28549086f8f0dd81ce4a268243d497b1ddcae.en: Réveil de dingue at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, new comedy adventures from the makers of Couple en délire, featuring the hyperactive character Jean-Phi.

863e1aaeb6c71b00e81a4fb091ccda1f9f915ae8.en: Jarry at Zénith de Rouen, a show of love and humour that is rhythmic, shared with the audience and meant to restore faith in people.

52b7ba39e8d8904ab6e576fbb7bdebf86c50a641.en: Shen Yun at Zénith de Rouen, a show of ancient China with dance and images, presented as a calm and beautiful journey.

fe1e5906e05f281b97f0cc205e5ea9de4a8891e0.en: L'évasion de la Tour Fatale Enflammée at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen. A job interview in a TV tower turns into a nightmare when robbers break in looking for a hidden safe, trapping Tom, a cleaner, and Benjamin.

187ec1b9cd266b921b0a6be4eaf948d5e302edd6.en: Very Bad Spy - Sir John at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a spoof of action films with a secret agent somewhere between James Bond and Tex Avery, full of gadgets.

6ebafbeae2e7e7ee36d4fff3062c9be4cc9b00f8.en: Les adoleschiants at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen. Léa, 14 and a half, meets her grandfather Michel, a grumpy retired farmer she has never known.

7c456ecf6bca6ff657cd7db323bcdda352c4f5d9.en: International Festival Ballet's Swan Lake at Zénith de Rouen, a classical ballet to Tchaikovsky's music, with choreography by Ivanov and Petipa.

f33e2f491340c9d37152f56455d96d8779b84e58.en: Aldebert's birthday show at Zénith de Rouen, with songs from his career, celebrating a childlike spirit.

a6ae9910b34ef35a21f08288fc532696de6532d6.en: Tété's Vertige du Seum at Trianon Transatlantique in Rouen, his first new single in seven years, telling a story of personal transformation.

5218979e123617c3c72772a8d4dc74b38a977d1e.en: Topick's L'excellence ordinaire at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a comedy of gags and frank talk about being without money, culture or looks.

6968a3c49585631b2c2bd47137d45f33a1031973.en: Kosh's HPS at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a theatre and sound show in which a performer experiences the world through hearing, with laughter.

1c77db62f62e61055a611c37d6a75b7b72087601.en: ABBA Gold, the concert show returning in 2026 and 2027 under the title #emotion, focusing on the emotional power of ABBA's music, at Zénith de Rouen.

6f7d3541389968c2c0f0ea1c13d85014d27af4d9.en: Bénédicte Bousquet's Hors classe at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a sequel to D'école et moi about the daily life of a teacher and mother.

325ccd75a650830217b0ef311affbe640a75d323.en: Rémi Marceau's Certifié conforme at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, an impersonation show updated with current events, combining vocal and physical performance with audience interaction.

b1899c785f70ea59c4678c43fb5972922a86c42c.en: Le grand soir at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a comedy about four unemployed friends who plan a male strip show.

483e201c9e7c17e025f706601b26aead7f100c10.en: Laissez-moi tranquille at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a boulevard comedy that turns into a quartet when a wife wants to leave her husband. Written by Catherine Praud and Rémi Viallet.

3785aad8fd5e2ac5d0e686af173e9b1896bf61b5.en: Tristan Lucas at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a show that revisits life's stages from childhood to old age through absurd and sharp questions.

e5294a951f3ab41a591b9cf2990b012e9d1d539f.en: Le Roi Soleil at Zénith de Rouen, a show marking 20 years, produced by Dove Attia and directed by Kamel Ouali, with new 2027 dates. More than 350,000 tickets were sold before the premiere.

2efae21da9e8e8a7505bed3eed6f75825af55e79.en: Lucas & Veufla's duo show En carence de fer at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen.

c64885642e5059e33eb7d044b9c3e62a466a8ec6.en: Mickael est Denise's new show at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, with the comic character Denise, who promises surprises.

b8e1a86d190da794c721a556ba0a42c993d9f0ea.en: Enzo Tarantini at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a nostalgic retrospective of the 1990s generation, known from the Daron character online.

86e931f4ff9373d9001e25d3f2093e3e79ab8760.en: The World of Queen's L'Éternelle Légende at Zénith de Rouen, after three years of sold-out tours and more than 1.3 million spectators.

71bdc940d5787a5ebc3e3ebb1ea9ddb32eba4ab7.en: Nadim's Fraîcheur de vivre at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a spontaneous show full of laughter and energy about life.

7fdd36650eb7835d4eec13fcd2feb6651ac4c935.en: Jonathan O'Donnell's Sympa l'ambiance at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a show built on energy and exchange with the audience.

3ad322d8f906d2d795fe2e48e7f98b83e6f5cbfa.en: Thomas Piet's Koala at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a one-man show about the pressure to be a real man, from birth to adulthood, with humour and intimacy.

bf2ea2047edc68ce288b81e123cc61ff361cdc1c.en: Una Roberta at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, an intercultural journey between France and Italy, two close countries that know each other poorly.

8887791b04665da5279e2319c9509562ef37ee33.en: Le Lac des cygnes at Zénith de Rouen, presented by Capitale Production with the Paris Ballet Theater, on a 2027 tour across France and Europe.

8818919c07ff53cd00eeb3e18329935e7032f049.en: Kino's Panic Attack at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a show about a first panic attack and a diagnosis of generalised anxiety with agoraphobia.

c38fb3a9e784623cf7198710dd1d1e59bee9cf29.en: Pierre Aucaigne's Cessez at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a family-friendly show with unpredictable comedy and juggling.

5ed3ad363009f5b57aaf9a20d3c2b53bd954d87c.en: Cédric Salaün's Déjà dix-sept heures at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a stand-up about how quickly life passes.

d58e51b6242ef09114369f97d9fe75b34113bd83.en: Hubert-Félix Thiéfaine at Zénith de Rouen, presented by Lorelei and Arachnée Productions. An unclassifiable artist since the 1970s, he fills the largest halls.

9af9688995013437015d1e89e9505db59b656163.en: Fabienne Alabret's Épanouies at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, portraits of women told with humour and tenderness, a favourite of the 2024 Festival Off d'Avignon.

fc520a940b0b2e10cd6b6dc92709f24d8d31bed1.en: Keen'V's 20-year celebration at Zénith de Rouen, looking back on the Équilibre Tour and starting a new chapter.

70b1cb70ef7d6b928d8efd3f03ee04105a03d3bc.en: Eliott Doyle's C'est quoi la suite at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, a stand-up show that starts with spelling out his name.

2cdf144e41e11ffeb66c76e464bdf295a66f2dc0.en: Marie-Claire Neveu's Hepatik Girl at Théâtre à l'Ouest in Rouen, about buying a flat while living with three autoimmune and inflammatory conditions.

a1ef953f234d886879cffc79e50c1eb17fed0eea.en: Deluxe's tour at Zénith de Rouen, from an all-female band that is playing music with its best friends 4,897 days after its first record.

0be62dd9abde0ac4d1561a27d685cb07c3f84705.en: Iturritik 2026, the fifth edition of the dance festival in Donostia from 23 to 25 October, with five indoor shows, two street shows and several workshops.

04c33f2b3cf5373f6a459a852cc701170f1d44cf.en: John Dealer and The Coconuts with Stupid Fuckin People live at Le Bukowski in Donostia on 24 October.

5c2be2247cdefbfa21202c7a04433798d8bc893f.en: Argazki bat behelainoan with Andon Ollokiegi, a Basque post-hardcore and post-punk band that released its first full album in 2023 and singles in 2025.

1b4ad1126c2ba66db4c1f58801e05c7b02eab11a.en: Samba Badago at Marruma Kulturala in Donostia on Sunday 25 October at 18:00, in an acoustic format.

f095ea79810ffa39c7ddaeb4ea69e29640294266.en: Astelehen bat, liburu bat, a Basque-language literary discussion of Erbeste by Juan Garzia Garmendia at the Centro Cultural Lugaritz in Donostia, guided by Aritz Gorrotxategi.

db90ada0c2a5a0f17ab95de33063955ceeb04fc6.en: La gran noche del pop, a film screening at Sala Imanol Larzabal in Donostia about the 1985 recording of We Are the World, followed by a discussion.

457d581b064c6b11fccba90e8777f1698f5d6111.en: Libres de acoso, a screening of Félix Zurita's documentary at the Centro Cultural Intxaurrondo in Donostia, followed by a discussion led by Nerea Redondo.

58c38eeaeec914d19668c6aa16edc09d71f018a9.en: An open rehearsal of iZULOA at the Centro Cultural Intxaurrondo in Donostia, the new stage creation by Garazi Egiguren and Inés Osinaga, with a cast of eight. Visitors see the creative process.

cb3d257ffeae8fac5bbbe4b05354d892e90cee38.en: A photo exhibition at the Italian Cultural Institute in Stockholm, by Lorenzo Castore, shot in the apartment of the poet Patrizia Cavalli shortly after her death.

7c83f1915f6f5efe47238a563da403b8de8498b0.en: A Nationalmuseum exhibition, open 23 April 2026 to 28 February 2027, on the ceramic work of Wilhelm Kåge and Shōji Hamada, who shared an interest in form, clay and glaze.

3f9a272436072f4619af6fc3ead0af0a0e5c6c94.en: A weekly Thursday English stand-up night in Södermalm, run by ComedyNation at Pitchers Mariatorget Casino, with local and English-speaking comedians across two hours.

36813d367c7241346998e9999e584cd18be25c0c.en: An opera at Folkoperan in which a teenager named Aisha discovers a powerful voice and is drawn into her own heritage, confronting her father and mother.

67b73102c2ab5c469a92a6120dbaec81e7c6267a.en: Photography and digital art exhibition at Fotografiska, including a photographer who fooled the world with fabricated images and an AI agent trained on the life of an artist.

2e5f856d07ea32ae7befba1930ba4873a5fc0388.en: A design exhibition at Artipelag, created by Lidewij Edelkoort and Philip Fimmano, exploring the inner child as a source of creativity.

3faedbc047772e3b34869e77bc8562ba445606cb.en: Jag är Ulla Winblad, an opera at Folkoperan about the woman behind Bellman's songs, set in 18th-century Stockholm, with music by Andrea Tarrodi and a libretto by Klas Östergren.

751f9bbd2efce7b98c7e4698825c5c8df0693327.en: A guided sea kayak tour near Vaxholm in the Stockholm archipelago, with a traditional Swedish fika served by the water.

e8e2ad267305fece6844f6a3334e8288f0776f7d.en: BCUC, a band from Soweto that blends funk, hip-hop and punk, performing at Debaser Strand in Stockholm.

ef71655ba8fabf7f8b2cb81d489f79e5888d2107.en: An exhibition at the Spirit Museum in Stockholm on the Absolut Vodka brand, told through advertisements, bottles, art and cocktails, with a cocktail machine.

946245c5f8d79c9004a32701cde4ca76c53fd342.en: Lotta Antonsson's I Am Everything exhibition at Fotografiska, exploring gender, identity and objectification in photography.

79f9db528a1108211a4397ffd9a8b9c087001e25.en: A guided tour at the Swedish Spy Museum about female spies and the hidden networks of Stockholm during the Second World War.

de439d7bf77acb8beb89ef573f97e84ec4992697.en: Oss Swingers Emellan, a farce with mistaken identities at Intiman Theatre in Stockholm, starring Thomas Petersson, Måns Nathanaelson and Clara Hry.

13572ac5fe06efd7db616144726467c27a6a371a.en: Free admission to Moderna Museet every Friday from 18:00 to 20:00 during the spring and autumn seasons. From 28 November to 5 April a ticket is required.

81b9a6943bc81944cb055f0fdb4c4e325076de3f.en: Svartklubben, a dinner-and-music experience in the dark, where guests eat and enjoy performances without sight.

87465ce2286f8fb3e73a90c1d36da3461e76852c.en: ccap's GAME ON, a new contemporary dance work by Cristina Capriolis for Stora Scen in Stockholm.

3223a351a0549f8f3a4f4299a77f6cb6dbf0df93.en: Torka aldrig tårar utan handskar, a newly written musical at Göta Lejon based on Jonas Gardell's novel and TV series.

43071f47b6bb183d002c0f3f9e19dd67891e26b4.en: A ghost-themed walking theatre tour through the alleys and squares of Stockholm's Old Town, with stories of the city's darker past.

fb16a0a99097e158fbefefb0e9dbac8ee0890a0e.en: The Sewing & Craft Festival 2026 at Stockholm Convention Center, for experienced crafters and beginners alike, with materials and inspiration.
